`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("capacity hint: edit-log entries kept for EditsSince; an older consumer sees EditLogCovers() == false and invalidates everything")
        constexpr std::size_t kEditLogKeep = 4096;

        std::uint32_t CountNewlines(std::string_view s) noexcept
        {
            return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::count(s.begin(), s.end(), '\n'));
        }

        // In range, sorted, disjoint, strictly increasing begins (spec s3.3).
        bool OpsAreValid(std::span<const EditOp> ops, ByteOffset size) noexcept
        {
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < ops.size(); ++i)
            {
                const ByteRange r = ops[i].range;
                if (r.begin > r.end || r.end > size) return false;
                if (i > 0 && (r.begin < ops[i - 1].range.end || r.begin <= ops[i - 1].range.begin)) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    TextBuffer::TextBuffer() = default;

    TextBuffer::TextBuffer(Rope text, EolMap eols) : m_rope(std::move(text)), m_eols(std::move(eols)) {}

    const Rope& TextBuffer::Text() const { return m_rope; }
    RopeSnapshot TextBuffer::Snapshot() const { return { m_rope, m_version }; }
    std::uint64_t TextBuffer::Version() const { return m_version; }
    std::uint64_t TextBuffer::ChangeId() const { return m_changeId; }
    bool TextBuffer::Dirty() const { return m_changeId != m_savedChangeId; }

    void TextBuffer::MarkSaved()
    {
        m_savedChangeId = m_changeId;
        BreakUndoGroup();   // a save is a grouping boundary (spec s3.3)
    }

    void TextBuffer::BeginTransaction(const SelectionSet& before) { BeginTransaction(before, TransactionKind::Other); }

    void TextBuffer::BeginTransaction(const SelectionSet& before, TransactionKind kind)
    {
        if (m_depth++ > 0) return;
        m_open.emplace();
        m_open->before = before;
        m_open->kind = kind;
        m_open->idBefore = m_changeId;
    }

    void TextBuffer::EndTransaction(const SelectionSet& after)
    {
        assert(m_depth > 0 && "EndTransaction without BeginTransaction");
        if (m_depth == 0 || --m_depth > 0) return;
        UndoEntry entry = std::move(*m_open);
        m_open.reset();
        if (entry.batches.empty() && !entry.eolAfter) return;   // empty transactions are dropped
        entry.after = after;
        Commit(std::move(entry));
    }

    void TextBuffer::Edit(std::span<const EditOp> ops)
    {
        assert(m_depth > 0 && "TextBuffer::Edit outside a transaction");
        if (m_depth == 0) return;
        EditBatch batch = ApplyOps(ops);
        if (batch.records.empty()) return;
        m_open->batches.push_back(std::move(batch));
    }

    TextBuffer::EditBatch TextBuffer::ApplyOps(std::span<const EditOp> ops)
    {
        EditBatch batch;
        const Rope before = m_rope;
        if (!OpsAreValid(ops, before.Size()))
        {
            assert(false && "EditOp ranges must be in range, sorted, disjoint, with strictly increasing begins");
            return batch;
        }
        std::vector<EditShift> shifts;
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> firstRows;
        std::int64_t delta = 0;
        std::int32_t rowDelta = 0;
        std::uint32_t lastRowBefore = 0;
        for (const EditOp& op : ops)
        {
            if (op.range.Empty() && op.text.empty()) continue;   // a no-op records nothing
            EditRecord r;
            r.range = op.range;
            before.CopyTo(op.range, r.oldText);
            r.newText = op.text;
            r.newBegin = static_cast<ByteOffset>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(op.range.begin) + delta);
            delta += static_cast<std::int64_t>(r.newText.size()) - static_cast<std::int64_t>(op.range.Size());
            shifts.push_back({ op.range.begin, op.range.end, r.newText.size() });
            firstRows.push_back(before.OffsetToPoint(op.range.begin).row);
            lastRowBefore = before.OffsetToPoint(op.range.end).row;
            rowDelta += static_cast<std::int32_t>(CountNewlines(r.newText)) - static_cast<std::int32_t>(CountNewlines(r.oldText));
            batch.records.push_back(std::move(r));
        }
        if (batch.records.empty()) return batch;

        // Back to front: an op never moves the offsets or rows of the ops before it.
        for (std::size_t i = batch.records.size(); i-- > 0;)
        {
            const EditRecord& r = batch.records[i];
            m_rope = m_rope.Replace(r.range, r.newText);
            const std::vector<EolException> gone = m_eols.ApplyEdit(firstRows[i], CountNewlines(r.oldText), CountNewlines(r.newText));
            batch.eolRemoved.insert(batch.eolRemoved.end(), gone.begin(), gone.end());
        }

        ++m_version;
        m_log.push_back({ m_version, firstRows.front(), lastRowBefore, rowDelta });
        if (m_log.size() > 2 * kEditLogKeep)
            m_log.erase(m_log.begin(), m_log.end() - static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(kEditLogKeep));
        for (AnchorSet* set : m_anchorSets) set->Shift(shifts);
        for (EditObserver* o : m_observers) o->OnBufferEdited(shifts, m_version);
        return batch;
    }

    void TextBuffer::ApplyInverse(const EditBatch& batch)
    {
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        ops.reserve(batch.records.size());
        for (const EditRecord& r : batch.records)
        {
            const ByteRange range{ r.newBegin, r.newBegin + r.newText.size() };
            if (!ops.empty() && ops.back().range.end == range.begin)
            {
                // Touching records (two adjacent deletions) invert to one op:
                // nothing lies between them after the batch.
                ops.back().range.end = range.end;
                ops.back().text += r.oldText;
                continue;
            }
            ops.push_back({ range, r.oldText });
        }
        ApplyOps(ops);
        m_eols.Restore(batch.eolRemoved);   // back in pre-batch rows now
    }

    void TextBuffer::ApplyForward(const EditBatch& batch)
    {
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        ops.reserve(batch.records.size());
        for (const EditRecord& r : batch.records) ops.push_back({ r.range, r.newText });
        ApplyOps(ops);
    }

    void TextBuffer::Commit(UndoEntry&& entry)
    {
        m_redo.clear();
        entry.idAfter = ++m_lastIssuedId;
        m_changeId = entry.idAfter;
        m_undo.push_back(std::move(entry));
    }

    bool TextBuffer::Undo(SelectionSet& sels)
    {
        if (m_depth > 0 || m_undo.empty()) return false;
        UndoEntry entry = std::move(m_undo.back());
        m_undo.pop_back();
        for (auto it = entry.batches.rbegin(); it != entry.batches.rend(); ++it) ApplyInverse(*it);
        if (entry.eolBefore) m_eols = *entry.eolBefore;
        m_changeId = entry.idBefore;
        sels = entry.before;
        entry.sealed = true;
        m_redo.push_back(std::move(entry));
        return true;
    }

    bool TextBuffer::Redo(SelectionSet& sels)
    {
        if (m_depth > 0 || m_redo.empty()) return false;
        UndoEntry entry = std::move(m_redo.back());
        m_redo.pop_back();
        for (const EditBatch& b : entry.batches) ApplyForward(b);
        if (entry.eolAfter) m_eols = *entry.eolAfter;
        m_changeId = entry.idAfter;
        sels = entry.after;
        m_undo.push_back(std::move(entry));
        return true;
    }

    void TextBuffer::BreakUndoGroup()
    {
        if (!m_undo.empty()) m_undo.back().sealed = true;
    }

    std::span<const EditLogEntry> TextBuffer::EditsSince(std::uint64_t version) const
    {
        const auto it = std::upper_bound(m_log.begin(), m_log.end(), version,
                                         [](std::uint64_t v, const EditLogEntry& e) { return v < e.version; });
        return { it, m_log.end() };
    }

    bool TextBuffer::EditLogCovers(std::uint64_t version) const noexcept
    {
        if (version >= m_version) return true;
        return !m_log.empty() && m_log.front().version <= version + 1;
    }

    void TextBuffer::RegisterAnchors(AnchorSet& set)
    {
        if (std::find(m_anchorSets.begin(), m_anchorSets.end(), &set) == m_anchorSets.end()) m_anchorSets.push_back(&set);
    }

    void TextBuffer::UnregisterAnchors(AnchorSet& set) noexcept
    {
        std::erase(m_anchorSets, &set);
    }

    void TextBuffer::AddObserver(EditObserver& observer)
    {
        if (std::find(m_observers.begin(), m_observers.end(), &observer) == m_observers.end()) m_observers.push_back(&observer);
    }

    void TextBuffer::RemoveObserver(EditObserver& observer) noexcept
    {
        std::erase(m_observers, &observer);
    }
}
```

### Task TE1-9: Undo grouping, the undo memory cap, and the `TextSettings` block (spec s3.3, s8)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp` (`UndoPolicy`, clock, byte accounting)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.cpp` (`Edit`, `Commit`, `Undo`, `Redo`, new `CanMerge` / `EnforceMemoryCap` / `Weigh`)
- Modify: `premake5.lua:1275` (ArcaneTests: source-compile `TextSettings.cpp`, after `EditorViewportSettings.cpp`)
- Modify: `docs/superpowers/audits/2026-10-03-settings-inventory.md:1606` (a new `### Text editor` section just before `### Existing cvars (e)`), and the "Post-freeze amendments" table (lines 185-204)
- Modify: `scripts/settings-frozen-names.txt` (regenerated by the lint, never by hand)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextBufferUndoPolicyTest.cpp`, `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextSettingsTest.cpp`

**Where `TextSettings` lives, and why:** `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.{hpp,cpp}`, on the EXE side and outside `ArcaneText` (the skeleton's file map already puts it there). A static lib CAN reach the reflection headers: `ArcaneAssetPipeline` is a StaticLib with the reflected `TextureMetaSettings`, through `IncludeDir.ArcaneCore` + `Astra` + `Mosaic`. It still does not belong in the lib, for three reasons:
1. `ARC_SETTINGS` registers from a namespace-scope static initializer. MSVC links an object file out of a `.lib` only when something references a symbol in it, and nothing references a settings-only TU. So a `TextSettings.obj` inside `ArcaneText.lib` would silently never register in `ArcaneEditor.exe`. AssetPipeline escapes this only because its TU also defines functions the cook calls.
2. Editor-audience settings are declared in ArcaneEditor (settings spec s3.2; `EditorSnapshotSettings.hpp`'s header comment). A shipped game holds no Editor settings.
3. The core stays registry-free and testable with plain option structs (`UndoPolicy` here; `DecodeOptions`, `EditContext` later). `TextSettings.hpp` maps the published block onto them (`ToUndoPolicy`, ...). A sweep case proves each mapping once, and a default-equality case pins the core's fallback defaults to the settings defaults.

ArcaneTests source-compiles `TextSettings.cpp` (the existing per-file pattern, `premake5.lua:1258-1275`). ArcaneEditor already compiles it through `src/**`, because `removefiles` only drops Core/Syntax/Vim.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `TextBuffer` (TE1-8).
- Produces:
  - `struct UndoPolicy { std::uint32_t groupMs = 300; std::uint64_t memoryBytes = 64 MiB; }`.
  - On `TextBuffer`: `using Clock = std::function<std::uint64_t()>`, `SetUndoPolicy(const UndoPolicy&)`, `GetUndoPolicy()`, `SetClock(Clock)`, `UndoBytes()`, `DroppedUndoEntries()`.
  - Grouping: an entry of kind `Typing` or `Deleting` merges into the previous entry when all of these hold: same kind; the previous entry is not sealed (no save, explicit break, undo/redo or reload since); this transaction's first edit came within `groupMs` of the previous entry's last edit; and the previous entry's `after` selections equal this one's `before` (the cursor did not move). `groupMs == 0` disables merging. `Other` never merges.
  - Undo and Redo are grouping boundaries for the entry left on top: after either, the next typing step never merges into it (`BreakUndoGroup()` at the end of both).
  - The memory cap drops the oldest undo entries while undo + redo bytes exceed `memoryBytes`. This includes the new entry itself when it alone is too big. When the undo stack is empty and redo alone is still over (a cap lowered through `SetUndoPolicy` after undoing), it drops redo entries from the FAR end of the chain, so the remaining redos stay reachable in order. Both count in `DroppedUndoEntries()`.
  - `Arcane::Editor::TextSettings { std::uint32_t undoGroupMs = 300; std::uint32_t undoMemoryMB = 64; }`, registered as `editor.text.*` (Editor, PreferencesMachine, Live, page "Text Editor"; `undoMemoryMB` is Dev); `Text::UndoPolicy ToUndoPolicy(const TextSettings&)`.

```cpp
// Undo grouping and the memory cap (text-editor spec s3.3), driven by an
// injected clock so the 300 ms window is deterministic.

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"

#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    struct Typist
    {
        TextBuffer buf{ Rope::FromUtf8(""), EolMap{} };
        SelectionSet sels = SelectionSet::Cursor(0);
        std::uint64_t now = 1000;

        Typist() { buf.SetClock([this] { return now; }); }

        void Type(std::string_view t, TransactionKind kind)
        {
            const ByteOffset at = sels.Primary().head;
            const SelectionSet after = SelectionSet::Cursor(at + t.size());
            buf.BeginTransaction(sels, kind);
            buf.Edit(std::vector<EditOp>{ { { at, at }, std::string(t) } });
            buf.EndTransaction(after);
            sels = after;
        }
    };
}

TEST_CASE("Undo grouping: typing within the window is one step; any boundary starts a new one", "[text-buffer]")
{
    Typist t;
    t.Type("a", TransactionKind::Typing);
    t.now += 100;
    t.Type("b", TransactionKind::Typing);
    t.now += 100;
    t.Type("c", TransactionKind::Typing);
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 1u);
    t.now += 301;
    t.Type("d", TransactionKind::Typing);   // the window passed
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 2u);
    t.now += 10;
    t.Type("e", TransactionKind::Other);    // Other never merges
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 3u);
    t.now += 10;
    t.Type("f", TransactionKind::Typing);   // nor does anything merge into an Other entry
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 4u);
    t.now += 10;
    t.buf.BreakUndoGroup();
    t.Type("g", TransactionKind::Typing);
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 5u);
    t.now += 10;
    t.Type("h", TransactionKind::Deleting); // a different kind
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 6u);
    t.now += 10;
    t.sels = SelectionSet::Cursor(0);       // the cursor moved between keystrokes
    t.Type("i", TransactionKind::Deleting);
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 7u);
    CHECK(t.buf.Text().ToString() == "iabcdefgh");
    SelectionSet s = t.sels;
    for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k) t.buf.Undo(s);
    CHECK(t.buf.Text().ToString() == "abc");
    t.buf.Undo(s);
    CHECK(t.buf.Text().ToString().empty());   // "abc" was one step
}

TEST_CASE("Undo grouping: a save seals the group, and groupMs 0 disables merging", "[text-buffer]")
{
    Typist t;
    t.Type("a", TransactionKind::Typing);
    t.buf.MarkSaved();
    t.now += 10;
    t.Type("b", TransactionKind::Typing);
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 2u);
    SelectionSet s = t.sels;
    t.buf.Undo(s);
    CHECK_FALSE(t.buf.Dirty());

    Typist u;
    u.buf.SetUndoPolicy({ 0, std::uint64_t(1) << 26 });
    u.Type("a", TransactionKind::Typing);
    u.now += 1;
    u.Type("b", TransactionKind::Typing);
    CHECK(u.buf.UndoDepth() == 2u);
}

TEST_CASE("Undo memory cap: the oldest entries drop first, and a step bigger than the cap leaves no history", "[text-buffer]")
{
    Typist t;
    t.buf.SetUndoPolicy({ 300, 4096 });
    std::vector<std::string> states{ "" };
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i)
    {
        t.now += 1000;
        t.Type(std::string(1000, static_cast<char>('a' + i)), TransactionKind::Other);
        states.push_back(t.buf.Text().ToString());
    }
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoBytes() <= 4096u);
    CHECK(t.buf.DroppedUndoEntries() > 0u);
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() + t.buf.DroppedUndoEntries() == 10u);
    SelectionSet s = t.sels;
    while (t.buf.Undo(s)) {}
    CHECK(t.buf.Text().ToString() == states[t.buf.DroppedUndoEntries()]);

    Typist big;
    big.buf.SetUndoPolicy({ 300, 100 });
    big.Type(std::string(1000, 'z'), TransactionKind::Other);
    CHECK(big.buf.UndoDepth() == 0u);
    CHECK(big.buf.DroppedUndoEntries() == 1u);
    CHECK(big.buf.Text().Size() == 1000u);
    CHECK(big.buf.Dirty());
}

TEST_CASE("Undo grouping: undo and redo seal the entry they leave on top", "[text-buffer]")
{
    Typist t;
    t.Type("a", TransactionKind::Typing);
    t.now += 10;
    {
        // Backspace: a Deleting step removing the "a".
        const SelectionSet after = SelectionSet::Cursor(0);
        t.buf.BeginTransaction(t.sels, TransactionKind::Deleting);
        t.buf.Edit(std::vector<EditOp>{ { { 0, 1 }, "" } });
        t.buf.EndTransaction(after);
        t.sels = after;
    }
    REQUIRE(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 2u);
    t.now += 10;
    SelectionSet s = t.sels;
    REQUIRE(t.buf.Undo(s));                   // "a" is back, the cursor after it
    t.sels = s;
    REQUIRE(t.buf.Text().ToString() == "a");
    t.now += 10;
    t.Type("b", TransactionKind::Typing);     // inside the window, the cursor did not move
    CHECK(t.buf.Text().ToString() == "ab");
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoDepth() == 2u);           // "a" and "b" are separate steps
    s = t.sels;
    REQUIRE(t.buf.Undo(s));
    CHECK(t.buf.Text().ToString() == "a");    // only "b" is undone

    Typist r;
    r.Type("x", TransactionKind::Typing);
    SelectionSet rs = r.sels;
    REQUIRE(r.buf.Undo(rs));
    REQUIRE(r.buf.Redo(rs));
    r.sels = rs;
    r.now += 10;
    r.Type("y", TransactionKind::Typing);
    CHECK(r.buf.UndoDepth() == 2u);           // a redo is a boundary as well
}

TEST_CASE("Undo memory cap: a lowered cap trims a redo-heavy history from the far end", "[text-buffer]")
{
    Typist t;
    std::vector<std::string> states{ "" };
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i)
    {
        t.now += 1000;
        t.Type(std::string(1000, static_cast<char>('a' + i)), TransactionKind::Other);
        states.push_back(t.buf.Text().ToString());
    }
    SelectionSet s = t.sels;
    while (t.buf.Undo(s)) {}                  // all six steps are on the redo stack
    REQUIRE(t.buf.RedoDepth() == 6u);
    REQUIRE(t.buf.Text().ToString().empty());
    t.buf.SetUndoPolicy({ 300, 4096 });       // about three 1000-byte steps fit
    CHECK(t.buf.UndoBytes() <= 4096u);
    CHECK(t.buf.RedoDepth() < 6u);
    CHECK(t.buf.RedoDepth() > 0u);
    CHECK(t.buf.DroppedUndoEntries() == 6u - t.buf.RedoDepth());
    const std::size_t kept = t.buf.RedoDepth();
    while (t.buf.Redo(s)) {}                  // the NEAR redos survive, in order
    CHECK(t.buf.Text().ToString() == states[kept]);
}
```

```cpp
    std::uint64_t TextBuffer::SteadyNowMs()
    {
        return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(
            std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count());
    }

    void TextBuffer::SetUndoPolicy(const UndoPolicy& policy)
    {
        m_policy = policy;
        EnforceMemoryCap();
    }

    void TextBuffer::SetClock(Clock clock) { m_clock = clock ? std::move(clock) : Clock(&TextBuffer::SteadyNowMs); }

    void TextBuffer::Edit(std::span<const EditOp> ops)
    {
        assert(m_depth > 0 && "TextBuffer::Edit outside a transaction");
        if (m_depth == 0) return;
        EditBatch batch = ApplyOps(ops);
        if (batch.records.empty()) return;
        const std::uint64_t now = m_clock();
        if (m_open->batches.empty()) m_open->firstEditMs = now;
        m_open->lastEditMs = now;
        m_open->batches.push_back(std::move(batch));
    }

    std::uint64_t TextBuffer::Weigh(const UndoEntry& entry)
    {
        std::uint64_t bytes = sizeof(UndoEntry) + (entry.before.Size() + entry.after.Size()) * sizeof(Selection);
        for (const EditBatch& b : entry.batches)
        {
            bytes += sizeof(EditBatch) + b.eolRemoved.size() * sizeof(EolException);
            for (const EditRecord& r : b.records) bytes += sizeof(EditRecord) + r.oldText.size() + r.newText.size();
        }
        if (entry.eolBefore) bytes += entry.eolBefore->MemoryBytes();
        if (entry.eolAfter) bytes += entry.eolAfter->MemoryBytes();
        return bytes;
    }

    bool TextBuffer::CanMerge(const UndoEntry& entry) const
    {
        if (entry.kind == TransactionKind::Other || m_policy.groupMs == 0 || m_undo.empty()) return false;
        const UndoEntry& top = m_undo.back();
        if (top.sealed || top.kind != entry.kind || top.eolAfter || entry.eolAfter) return false;
        if (entry.firstEditMs < top.lastEditMs || entry.firstEditMs - top.lastEditMs > m_policy.groupMs) return false;
        return top.after == entry.before;   // the cursor did not move between them
    }

    void TextBuffer::Commit(UndoEntry&& entry)
    {
        m_redo.clear();
        m_redoBytes = 0;
        entry.idAfter = ++m_lastIssuedId;
        m_changeId = entry.idAfter;
        const std::uint64_t bytes = Weigh(entry);
        entry.bytes = bytes;
        if (CanMerge(entry))
        {
            UndoEntry& top = m_undo.back();
            for (EditBatch& b : entry.batches) top.batches.push_back(std::move(b));
            top.after = std::move(entry.after);
            top.idAfter = entry.idAfter;
            top.lastEditMs = entry.lastEditMs;
            top.bytes += bytes;
        }
        else
        {
            m_undo.push_back(std::move(entry));
        }
        m_undoBytes += bytes;
        EnforceMemoryCap();
    }

    void TextBuffer::EnforceMemoryCap()
    {
        // The oldest undo entries go first: the far past is worth least.
        while (m_undoBytes + m_redoBytes > m_policy.memoryBytes && !m_undo.empty())
        {
            m_undoBytes -= m_undo.front().bytes;
            m_undo.pop_front();
            ++m_dropped;
        }
        // Redo can still be over the cap when the cap was LOWERED (SetUndoPolicy)
        // while undo had moved history onto the redo stack. Then the FAR end of
        // the redo chain goes: m_redo.back() is the next redo and m_redo.front()
        // the furthest, so dropping from the front keeps every remaining redo
        // reachable, in order.
        while (m_undoBytes + m_redoBytes > m_policy.memoryBytes && !m_redo.empty())
        {
            m_redoBytes -= m_redo.front().bytes;
            m_redo.erase(m_redo.begin());
            ++m_dropped;
        }
    }

    bool TextBuffer::Undo(SelectionSet& sels)
    {
        if (m_depth > 0 || m_undo.empty()) return false;
        UndoEntry entry = std::move(m_undo.back());
        m_undo.pop_back();
        m_undoBytes -= entry.bytes;
        for (auto it = entry.batches.rbegin(); it != entry.batches.rend(); ++it) ApplyInverse(*it);
        if (entry.eolBefore) m_eols = *entry.eolBefore;
        m_changeId = entry.idBefore;
        sels = entry.before;
        entry.sealed = true;
        m_redoBytes += entry.bytes;
        m_redo.push_back(std::move(entry));
        // An undo is a grouping boundary (spec s3.3) for the entry it UNCOVERS
        // too: type "a", Backspace, Ctrl+Z, then "b" within the window must not
        // merge "b" into the "a" step (the cursor is back where "a" left it).
        BreakUndoGroup();
        return true;
    }

    bool TextBuffer::Redo(SelectionSet& sels)
    {
        if (m_depth > 0 || m_redo.empty()) return false;
        UndoEntry entry = std::move(m_redo.back());
        m_redo.pop_back();
        m_redoBytes -= entry.bytes;
        for (const EditBatch& b : entry.batches) ApplyForward(b);
        if (entry.eolAfter) m_eols = *entry.eolAfter;
        m_changeId = entry.idAfter;
        sels = entry.after;
        m_undoBytes += entry.bytes;
        m_undo.push_back(std::move(entry));
        BreakUndoGroup();   // the redone entry is the top again; typing after a redo starts a new step
        return true;
    }
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// editor.text.* -- the text editor's reflected settings (text-editor spec s8;
// settings rule 2026-10-07). A plain struct: the reflection and ARC_SETTINGS
// live in TextSettings.cpp. The ArcaneText core never reads the registry; the
// mappers below turn the published block into the plain option structs the
// core takes, so Core tests build options directly and TextSettingsTest proves
// each mapping once.
//
// Why here (exe side) and not in the ArcaneText lib:
//   - ARC_SETTINGS registers from a static initializer, and an object file in
//     a .lib that nothing references is never linked -- a settings-only TU
//     inside ArcaneText.lib would silently not register in ArcaneEditor.exe;
//   - Editor-audience settings are declared in ArcaneEditor (settings spec s3.2);
//   - the core stays registry-free.

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"

#include <cstdint>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct TextSettings
    {
        std::uint32_t undoGroupMs = 300;   // typing within this window joins the previous undo step
        std::uint32_t undoMemoryMB = 64;   // undo history kept per document; oldest steps drop first
    };

    [[nodiscard]] inline Text::UndoPolicy ToUndoPolicy(const TextSettings& s) noexcept
    {
        Text::UndoPolicy p;
        p.groupMs = s.undoGroupMs;
        p.memoryBytes = std::uint64_t(s.undoMemoryMB) * 1024u * 1024u;
        return p;
    }
}
```

### Task TE1-10: External append, reload as one undo step, and line-ending conversion (spec s3.5, s5.3)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp` (public: `AppendExternal` x2, `ReloadExternal` x2, `LastReloadClearedHistory`, `ConvertLineEndings`, `ClearHistory`; `UndoEntry` fields `breaksBefore` / `breaksAfter`; private `RestoreWholeMap`; member `m_lastReloadClearedHistory`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.cpp` (the new functions; in `Undo` and `Redo`, the two whole-map lines become `RestoreWholeMap` calls)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextBufferExternalTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE1-8/TE1-9 `TextBuffer`; `EolMap::AppendRows` (TE1-6); `SelectionSet::ApplyEdits`, `ClampTo` (TE1-7).
- Produces (the binding two plus overloads):
  - `void AppendExternal(std::string_view tail)`: every new break takes the dominant style.
  - `void AppendExternal(std::string_view tail, const EolMap& tailEols)`: the decoded tail's own styles. Row `i` of `tailEols` is the tail's i-th break.
  - `void ReloadExternal(std::string newText, const SelectionSet& before)`: the binding form. It keeps the dominant style and no exceptions.
  - `void ReloadExternal(std::string newText, EolMap newEols, const SelectionSet& before)`.
  - `bool LastReloadClearedHistory() const`.
  - `bool ConvertLineEndings(Eol style, const SelectionSet& sels)`: false when the map is already uniform `style`.
  - `void ClearHistory()` (CANON A2, NEW): drops every undo and redo entry and seals the group, leaving `changeId`, `savedChangeId` and `version` untouched. TE2-15's Reopen with Encoding is the only caller (`ReloadExternal(text, eols, sels); ClearHistory(); MarkSaved();`), because the old text was decoded under another encoding and undoing into it would put mis-decoded bytes back under the new label (spec s3.5 as amended by CANON D5).

Rules (spec s3.5, s5.3):
- **Append** happens outside a transaction. It is NOT an undo entry, `changeId` and `savedChangeId` are left alone (a clean document stays clean), and `version` bumps with one edit-log entry whose `firstRow` is the old last row. Registered anchors and observers see an insertion at the old end, so a Right anchor at the end follows the tail. Whether to append at all (clean or read-only only, the 4 KB window hash, the `\r`-at-old-end case) is TextDocument's decision in TE2/TE6. The buffer only executes it.
- **Reload** is one undoable `Other` transaction. It is sealed on both sides and trimmed to the changed middle (common prefix and suffix), so a one-byte external change costs bytes, not megabytes. The trim snaps both ends to code-point starts (a common prefix ending inside a shared lead byte, e.g. `é` C3 A9 -> `ê` C3 AA, is shortened by its continuation bytes), so the recorded edit, the edit shifts and the mapped selections never land mid-character. Its entry also records the whole `EolMap` before and after, and the break counts before and after. If the reload's whole undo entry (`Weigh`: the old and new middle plus both whole `EolMap`s, the same weight `Commit` charges against the cap) exceeds the undo cap, the history (undo and redo) is cleared instead, and `LastReloadClearedHistory()` reports it so TE2 can show the s5.4 note. Never the old text alone: a 40 MB rewrite of 30 MB under a 64 MB cap would otherwise be recorded, then evicted by `Commit` with no note, and Ctrl+Z would silently do nothing.
- **Whole-map restore keeps appended rows.** `AppendExternal` adds rows OUTSIDE history, so a reload or convert entry's recorded `EolMap` knows nothing of the rows appended after it. Undo and Redo therefore restore the recorded map only for the breaks that existed when the entry was recorded (`breaksBefore` / `breaksAfter`), and every break past that count keeps the style it has now (`RestoreWholeMap`). Reload, Follow-append, Ctrl+Z then saves the appended rows byte-identically.
- **ConvertLineEndings** changes only the `EolMap`, never the rope, so `version` does not bump. It is one sealed undo step with a new `changeId`, so the document becomes dirty.
- **ClearHistory** touches only the history: the rope, the `EolMap`, `version`, `changeId` and `savedChangeId` stay as they are, so a dirty document stays dirty and a clean one stays clean. Afterwards `CanUndo()` and `CanRedo()` are false, `UndoBytes()` is 0, and the next typing step cannot merge into anything (the history is empty). It is refused inside a transaction.

```cpp
TEST_CASE("AppendExternal: no undo entry, the document stays clean, version and log advance", "[text-buffer]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("line1\n"), EolMap{});
    SelectionSet s = SelectionSet::Cursor(0);
    Commit(buf, s, { { { 0, 0 }, ">" } });
    buf.MarkSaved();
    const auto version = buf.Version();
    const auto changeId = buf.ChangeId();
    AnchorSet ends;
    const AnchorSet::Id tailAnchor = ends.Add({ buf.Text().Size(), Bias::Right });
    buf.RegisterAnchors(ends);
    buf.AppendExternal("line2\nline3\n");
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == ">line1\nline2\nline3\n");
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.Dirty());
    CHECK(buf.ChangeId() == changeId);
    CHECK(buf.Version() == version + 1);
    CHECK(buf.UndoDepth() == 1u);
    CHECK(ends.Get(tailAnchor).offset == buf.Text().Size());   // Follow: a Right anchor at the end stays at the end
    const auto log = buf.EditsSince(version);
    REQUIRE(log.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(log[0].firstRow == 1u);
    CHECK(log[0].rowDelta == 2);
    buf.UnregisterAnchors(ends);
    SelectionSet u = s;
    REQUIRE(buf.Undo(u));   // the history behind the append is still valid
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "line1\nline2\nline3\n");
    CHECK(buf.Dirty());
}

TEST_CASE("ReloadExternal: an entry over the cap clears the history even when the old text alone fits", "[text-buffer]")
{

    REQUIRE(buf.UndoDepth() == 1u);
    buf.ReloadExternal(std::string(800, 'c'), s);   // old middle 400 B fits; old + new 1200 B does not
    CHECK(buf.LastReloadClearedHistory());          // the note shows: the history was cleared on purpose
    CHECK(buf.UndoDepth() == 0u);
    CHECK(buf.DroppedUndoEntries() == 0u);          // nothing was silently evicted by the cap
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.CanRedo());

TEST_CASE("ReloadExternal: the trimmed middle never splits a code point", "[text-buffer]")
{
    // old "x" "é" "a" "y" = 78 C3 A9 61 79; new "x" "ê" "b" "y" = 78 C3 AA 62 79.
    // The byte-wise common prefix is 78 C3; it snaps back to 1 so the changed
    // middle begins on a code point, and the suffix "y" is already a start.
    struct Spy : EditObserver
    {
        std::vector<EditShift> seen;
        void OnBufferEdited(std::span<const EditShift> e, std::uint64_t) override { seen.assign(e.begin(), e.end()); }
    } spy;
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("x\xC3\xA9" "ay"), EolMap{});
    buf.AddObserver(spy);
    const SelectionSet s = SelectionSet::Cursor(3);   // between "é" and "a": inside the changed middle
    buf.ReloadExternal("x\xC3\xAA" "by", s);
    REQUIRE(spy.seen.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(spy.seen[0].begin == 1u);
    CHECK(spy.seen[0].end == 4u);
    CHECK(spy.seen[0].newLength == 3u);
    SelectionSet u = s;
    REQUIRE(buf.Undo(u));
    REQUIRE(buf.Redo(u));                              // u = the reload's mapped selections
    const ByteOffset head = u.Primary().head;
    CHECK((head == 1u || head == 4u));                 // a code-point start of "x" "ê" "b" "y", never 2
    buf.RemoveObserver(spy);

    // The suffix side: "é" C3 A9 -> "ĩ" C4 A9 share only the trail byte A9.
    TextBuffer tail(Rope::FromUtf8("q\xC3\xA9"), EolMap{});
    tail.AddObserver(spy);
    tail.ReloadExternal("q\xC4\xA9", SelectionSet::Cursor(3));
    REQUIRE(spy.seen.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(spy.seen[0].begin == 1u);
    CHECK(spy.seen[0].end == 3u);                      // not 2: the shared A9 is not a code point
    tail.RemoveObserver(spy);
}

TEST_CASE("Whole-map undo and redo keep the line endings of rows appended after the entry", "[text-buffer]")
{
    // A reload that adds a row, then a Follow append whose last break is LF in
    // a CRLF file. Undo and redo of the reload must not reset that LF.
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb\n"), EolMap(Eol::CRLF));
    SelectionSet s;
    buf.ReloadExternal("a\nx\ny\n", EolMap(Eol::CRLF), s);   // breaks: 2 -> 3
    buf.MarkSaved();
    EolMap tail(Eol::CRLF);
    tail.SetStyle(1, Eol::LF);                                 // the file now ends "c\r\nd\n"
    buf.AppendExternal("c\nd\n", tail);
    REQUIRE(buf.Eols().StyleOf(3) == Eol::CRLF);
    REQUIRE(buf.Eols().StyleOf(4) == Eol::LF);

    REQUIRE(buf.Undo(s));
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "a\nb\nc\nd\n");
    CHECK(buf.Eols().StyleOf(0) == Eol::CRLF);
    CHECK(buf.Eols().StyleOf(1) == Eol::CRLF);
    CHECK(buf.Eols().StyleOf(2) == Eol::CRLF);                 // "c"
    CHECK(buf.Eols().StyleOf(3) == Eol::LF);                   // "d": the appended LF, shifted up one row
    REQUIRE(buf.Redo(s));
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "a\nx\ny\nc\nd\n");
    CHECK(buf.Eols().StyleOf(3) == Eol::CRLF);
    CHECK(buf.Eols().StyleOf(4) == Eol::LF);

    // Convert, append, undo: the appended row keeps the ending it had in the file.
    TextBuffer conv(Rope::FromUtf8("a\n"), EolMap(Eol::LF));
    SelectionSet c;
    REQUIRE(conv.ConvertLineEndings(Eol::CRLF, c));
    conv.AppendExternal("b\n", EolMap(Eol::LF));               // the writer still writes LF
    REQUIRE(conv.Eols().StyleOf(1) == Eol::LF);
    REQUIRE(conv.Undo(c));
    CHECK(conv.Eols().StyleOf(0) == Eol::LF);
    CHECK(conv.Eols().StyleOf(1) == Eol::LF);
    REQUIRE(conv.Redo(c));
    CHECK(conv.Eols().StyleOf(0) == Eol::CRLF);
    CHECK(conv.Eols().StyleOf(1) == Eol::LF);
}

TEST_CASE("ConvertLineEndings: one undo step, dirty, no text change", "[text-buffer]")
{
    EolMap mixed(Eol::LF);
    mixed.SetStyle(1, Eol::CRLF);
    mixed.SetStyle(2, Eol::CR);
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb\nc\nd"), mixed);
    SelectionSet s;
    const auto version = buf.Version();
    REQUIRE(buf.ConvertLineEndings(Eol::CRLF, s));
    CHECK(buf.Eols() == EolMap(Eol::CRLF));
    CHECK(buf.Dirty());
    CHECK(buf.Version() == version);
    CHECK(buf.UndoDepth() == 1u);
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.ConvertLineEndings(Eol::CRLF, s));   // already uniform
    REQUIRE(buf.Undo(s));
    CHECK(buf.Eols() == mixed);
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.Dirty());
    REQUIRE(buf.Redo(s));
    CHECK(buf.Eols() == EolMap(Eol::CRLF));
}

TEST_CASE("ClearHistory: drops undo and redo, keeps the text, ids and version", "[text-buffer]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("abc"));
    SelectionSet s;
    Commit(buf, s, { { { 0, 0 }, "1" } });
    buf.MarkSaved();
    Commit(buf, s, { { { 0, 0 }, "2" } });
    Commit(buf, s, { { { 0, 0 }, "3" } });
    REQUIRE(buf.Undo(s));                    // one entry on each side
    REQUIRE(buf.CanUndo());
    REQUIRE(buf.CanRedo());
    const std::string text = buf.Text().ToString();
    const auto version = buf.Version();
    const auto changeId = buf.ChangeId();
    const bool dirty = buf.Dirty();
    REQUIRE(dirty);

    buf.ClearHistory();
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.CanUndo());
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.CanRedo());
    CHECK(buf.UndoDepth() == 0u);
    CHECK(buf.RedoDepth() == 0u);
    CHECK(buf.UndoBytes() == 0u);
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == text);
    CHECK(buf.Version() == version);
    CHECK(buf.ChangeId() == changeId);
    CHECK(buf.Dirty() == dirty);              // savedChangeId untouched: still dirty
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.Undo(s));

    buf.MarkSaved();                          // the Reopen with Encoding sequence ends here
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.Dirty());
    Commit(buf, s, { { { 0, 0 }, "4" } });    // a new history starts from the cleared state
    CHECK(buf.UndoDepth() == 1u);
    REQUIRE(buf.Undo(s));
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == text);
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.Dirty());
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.CanUndo());
}
```

`if (entry.eolAfter) m_eols = *entry.eolAfter;` with

```cpp
    void TextBuffer::RestoreWholeMap(const EolMap& recorded, std::uint32_t recordedBreaks)
    {
        // `recorded` is authoritative for the breaks that existed when the entry
        // was recorded. Every later break came from AppendExternal (outside
        // history; appends only add at the end), and keeps the style m_eols holds
        // for it now -- set explicitly, because the recorded dominant may differ.
        EolMap restored = recorded;
        const std::uint32_t breaks = m_rope.LineCount() - 1;
        for (std::uint32_t row = recordedBreaks; row < breaks; ++row) restored.SetStyle(row, m_eols.StyleOf(row));
        m_eols = std::move(restored);
    }

    void TextBuffer::AppendExternal(std::string_view tail) { AppendExternal(tail, EolMap(m_eols.Dominant())); }

    void TextBuffer::AppendExternal(std::string_view tail, const EolMap& tailEols)
    {
        assert(m_depth == 0 && "AppendExternal inside a transaction");
        if (tail.empty() || m_depth > 0) return;
        const ByteOffset size = m_rope.Size();
        const std::uint32_t lastRow = m_rope.LineCount() - 1;
        const std::uint32_t breaks = CountNewlines(tail);
        m_rope = m_rope.Append(tail);
        m_eols.AppendRows(lastRow, tailEols, breaks);   // the tail's first break ends the old last row
        const EditShift shift{ size, size, tail.size() };
        ++m_version;
        m_log.push_back({ m_version, lastRow, lastRow, static_cast<std::int32_t>(breaks) });
        if (m_log.size() > 2 * kEditLogKeep)
            m_log.erase(m_log.begin(), m_log.end() - static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(kEditLogKeep));
        for (AnchorSet* set : m_anchorSets) set->Shift(std::span(&shift, 1));
        for (EditObserver* o : m_observers) o->OnBufferEdited(std::span(&shift, 1), m_version);
    }

    void TextBuffer::ReloadExternal(std::string newText, const SelectionSet& before)
    {
        ReloadExternal(std::move(newText), EolMap(m_eols.Dominant()), before);
    }

    void TextBuffer::ReloadExternal(std::string newText, EolMap newEols, const SelectionSet& before)
    {
        assert(m_depth == 0 && "ReloadExternal inside a transaction");
        if (m_depth > 0) return;
        m_lastReloadClearedHistory = false;

        // Trim to the changed middle: the common prefix and suffix stay put.
        const std::string old = m_rope.ToString();
        const std::size_t common = std::min(old.size(), newText.size());
        std::size_t prefix = 0;
        while (prefix < common && old[prefix] == newText[prefix]) ++prefix;
        // Snap the prefix back to a code-point start in BOTH texts: a shared lead
        // byte (C3 A9 -> C3 AA) would otherwise leave the edit, its shifts and
        // the mapped selections inside a character. At most 3 continuation bytes.
        const auto continuesAt = [](const std::string& s, std::size_t i) {
            return i < s.size() && Utf8::IsContinuation(static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]));
        };
        for (int k = 0; k < 3 && prefix > 0 && (continuesAt(old, prefix) || continuesAt(newText, prefix)); ++k) --prefix;
        std::size_t suffix = 0;
        while (suffix < common - prefix && old[old.size() - 1 - suffix] == newText[newText.size() - 1 - suffix]) ++suffix;
        // The suffix's first byte is the same in both texts: when it continues a
        // code point, give it back to the middle (C3 A9 -> C4 A9 shares only A9).
        for (int k = 0; k < 3 && suffix > 0 && continuesAt(old, old.size() - suffix); ++k) --suffix;
        const ByteRange changed{ prefix, old.size() - suffix };
        std::string middle = newText.substr(prefix, newText.size() - suffix - prefix);
        const bool textChanges = !(changed.Empty() && middle.empty());
        if (!textChanges && newEols == m_eols) return;

        BreakUndoGroup();
        UndoEntry entry;
        entry.before = before;
        entry.kind = TransactionKind::Other;
        entry.idBefore = m_changeId;
        entry.eolBefore = m_eols;
        entry.breaksBefore = m_rope.LineCount() - 1;
        entry.firstEditMs = entry.lastEditMs = m_clock();
        SelectionSet after = before;
        if (textChanges)
        {
            const EditShift shift{ changed.begin, changed.end, middle.size() };
            const EditOp op{ changed, std::move(middle) };
            entry.batches.push_back(ApplyOps(std::span(&op, 1)));
            after.ApplyEdits(std::span(&shift, 1));
            after.ClampTo(m_rope.Size());
        }
        m_eols = std::move(newEols);
        entry.eolAfter = m_eols;
        entry.breaksAfter = m_rope.LineCount() - 1;
        entry.after = std::move(after);
        entry.sealed = true;

        if (Weigh(entry) > m_policy.memoryBytes)
        {
            // spec s5.3: the reload's undo entry does not fit the history -- clear
            // it instead of recording. The weight is the WHOLE entry (old and new
            // middle, both maps), the same one Commit charges: checking the old
            // text alone let Commit evict the entry silently, with no note.
            m_undo.clear();
            m_redo.clear();
            m_undoBytes = m_redoBytes = 0;
            m_changeId = ++m_lastIssuedId;
            m_lastReloadClearedHistory = true;
            return;
        }
        Commit(std::move(entry));
    }

    bool TextBuffer::ConvertLineEndings(Eol style, const SelectionSet& sels)
    {
        assert(m_depth == 0 && "ConvertLineEndings inside a transaction");
        if (m_depth > 0) return false;
        EolMap uniform(style);
        if (m_eols == uniform) return false;
        BreakUndoGroup();
        UndoEntry entry;
        entry.before = sels;
        entry.after = sels;
        entry.idBefore = m_changeId;
        entry.eolBefore = m_eols;
        entry.eolAfter = uniform;
        entry.breaksBefore = entry.breaksAfter = m_rope.LineCount() - 1;
        entry.sealed = true;
        m_eols = std::move(uniform);
        Commit(std::move(entry));
        return true;
    }

    void TextBuffer::ClearHistory()
    {
        assert(m_depth == 0 && "ClearHistory inside a transaction");
        if (m_depth > 0) return;
        // Nothing is left to merge into, so the group is sealed by construction:
        // CanMerge() refuses an empty undo stack.
        m_undo.clear();
        m_redo.clear();
        m_undoBytes = m_redoBytes = 0;
        // m_changeId, m_savedChangeId, m_lastIssuedId and m_version stay: ids are
        // never reissued, and Dirty() keeps its meaning across the clear.
    }
```
(`Commit` never merges these: they are kind `Other` and carry `eolAfter`.)

### Task TE1-11: `FileCodec`, file bytes to buffer text and back, byte-identical (spec s3.5, s11.1)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.cpp` (new field `defaultLineEnding`)
- Modify: `docs/superpowers/audits/2026-10-03-settings-inventory.md` (one row in `### Text editor`, one amendment row), `scripts/settings-frozen-names.txt` (regenerated)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/FileCodecTest.cpp`, `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextSettingsTest.cpp` (one new case)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Utf8::*` (TE1-1), `Rope` (TE1-2), `EolMap` (TE1-6), `TextBuffer` (TE1-8, in the one-edit property).
- Produces:
  - `enum class TextEncoding { Utf8, Utf8Bom, Utf16LE, Utf16BE, Windows1252 }` (UTF-16 always carries its BOM).
  - `enum class ReadOnlyReason { None, InvalidUtf8, InvalidUtf16, Binary }`.
  - `struct DecodeOptions { std::optional<TextEncoding> forced; Eol defaultEol = Eol::LF; }`. `forced` is `Utf8` or `Windows1252`, which is what Reopen with Encoding offers (spec s3.5). Any other value (`Utf8Bom`, `Utf16LE`, `Utf16BE`) is ignored: `DecodeFile` treats it exactly like no `forced` value, and BOM detection runs.
  - `struct DecodedText { std::string text; EolMap eols; TextEncoding encoding; ReadOnlyReason readOnly; std::size_t heldBytes = 0; }`. `heldBytes` (NEW, finding 1.8) counts the trailing input bytes that were NOT decoded: 1 for a UTF-16 file whose body has an odd length (a writer mid-unit), else 0. The text equals the decoding of `bytes[0, size - heldBytes)`. A caller that tracks the file (TE2-15 open, TE2-17 reload) syncs to `size - heldBytes`, so the next poll's append completes the unit.
  - `struct EncodeError { std::uint32_t row; std::uint32_t byteCol; std::uint32_t value; std::string message; }`.
  - `bool LooksBinary(std::string_view)` (NUL in the first 8 KB), `DecodedText DecodeFile(std::string_view bytes, const DecodeOptions& = {})`, `std::expected<std::string, EncodeError> EncodeFile(const Rope&, const EolMap&, TextEncoding)`, `std::pair<std::string, EolMap> SplitLineEndings(std::string_view, Eol defaultEol)`.
  - `DecodedText DecodeFragment(std::string_view bytes, TextEncoding encoding, Eol defaultEol)` (CANON A4, NEW): decodes BOM-less bytes in a KNOWN encoding -- UTF-8 rules for `Utf8`/`Utf8Bom` (raw bytes kept; `InvalidUtf8`, else `Binary` on a NUL; a leading `EF BB BF` is text, not a BOM), BOM-less UTF-16 LE/BE with the lone-surrogate rule (`InvalidUtf16`), Windows-1252 byte for byte. CR/CRLF/LF fold exactly as in `DecodeFile`; a fragment with no break takes `defaultEol` as its dominant style. `encoding` is echoed into the result. The caller passes complete units only (TE2-4 `CompleteTailLength`); this is TE2-17's appended-tail decoder (CANON B2).
  - `constexpr bool EncodingHasBom(TextEncoding)` (CANON A4, NEW): true for `Utf8Bom`, `Utf16LE`, `Utf16BE`.
  - `std::string_view EncodingId(TextEncoding)` (CANON A4, NEW): the stable identity string, exactly `"utf-8"`, `"utf-8-bom"`, `"utf-16le"`, `"utf-16be"`, `"windows-1252"` (recovery markers, view state and the automation report store it). `std::optional<TextEncoding> EncodingFromId(std::string_view)` is the inverse, ASCII case-insensitive; an unknown id gives `std::nullopt`. The UI label is TE2-15's `Editor::EncodingLabel`; the file-local message helper in `FileCodec.cpp` is `EncodingDisplayName` (CANON B12).
  - `Editor::TextLineEnding { LF, CRLF }`, `TextSettings::defaultLineEnding` (`editor.text.defaultLineEnding`, PreferencesProject: a project may set its line-ending default, spec s8), `Text::Eol Editor::ToEol(TextLineEnding)`, `Text::DecodeOptions Editor::ToDecodeOptions(const TextSettings&)`.

Rules (spec s3.5):
- BOM detection order: `EF BB BF` gives Utf8Bom (the BOM is stripped, then written back), `FF FE` gives Utf16LE, `FE FF` gives Utf16BE, and anything else is UTF-8.
- Invalid UTF-8 keeps its **raw bytes** in the text. It is read-only (`InvalidUtf8`), and `EncodeFile(Utf8)` writes the same bytes back. NUL in the first 8 KB of a UTF-8 file means `Binary`, also raw and read-only. TE2 decides whether to refuse a binary file outright.
- A UTF-16 lone surrogate becomes its 3-byte WTF-8 form (an invalid sequence the view draws as hex boxes). The file is read-only (`InvalidUtf16`), and encoding back writes the same unit. A UTF-16 BOM with an odd body length keeps its encoding: the complete units are decoded, and the stray last byte is HELD (`heldBytes = 1`), not decoded. That is the shape of a UTF-16 log caught mid-write, and the next append completes the held byte (TE2-17). Falling back to raw UTF-8 would make every later Follow tail UTF-8 with NULs (finding 1.8). A held byte is not part of the text, so a save of an edited document does not write it (it is half a code unit and holds no character).
- Windows-1252 is decoded only when forced. The five undefined bytes (81 8D 8F 90 9D) map to the C1 control of the same value, as `MultiByteToWideChar` does, so every byte round-trips. Forcing 1252 clears the read-only reason (Reopen with Encoding makes a legacy file editable).
- Line endings: CRLF, lone CR and LF all become `'\n'`. The dominant style is the most frequent; ties go LF over CRLF over CR. A file with no break takes `defaultEol`. The rest are exceptions.
- A lone-CR break followed directly by an LF break (the row between them is empty) cannot be written as `\r` + `\n`: that reads back as ONE CRLF break, and a line is lost. Edits produce this state (Enter at the start of the row after a CR row in an LF file); the decoder never does. `EncodeFile` writes that LF break as CRLF instead (`\r` + `\r\n`), so the CR row keeps its byte and the line count survives a reload. The reload then reports that row as a CRLF exception (finding 1.9).
- Encoding refuses what the target cannot hold: invalid UTF-8 for UTF-16 or 1252, and code points 1252 lacks. It reports the row, byte column and value, so TE2's save banner can name the place.
- A fragment (an appended tail) carries no BOM, so it is never detected: `DecodeFragment` is told the encoding the document already has. Decoding a UTF-16 tail through `DecodeFile` would read it as UTF-8 with NULs and call it binary (Review Focus F2).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

`ArcaneTests/src/Text/FileCodecTest.cpp`:
```cpp
// FileCodec (text-editor spec s3.5, s11.1): every encoding, BOM and line-ending
// style -- mixed files and lone CR included -- loads and saves byte-identical;
// invalid and binary content stays raw and read-only; a one-character edit to a
// mixed file changes exactly that line's bytes.

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include <rapidcheck.h>
#include <rapidcheck/catch.h>

#include "TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp"

#include <initializer_list>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    std::string S(std::initializer_list<char32_t> cps)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (const char32_t cp : cps) Utf8::Append(out, cp);
        return out;
    }

    std::string Utf16Bytes(const std::u16string& s, bool le)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (const char16_t u : s)
        {
            const char lo = static_cast<char>(u & 0xFF), hi = static_cast<char>(u >> 8);
            out.push_back(le ? lo : hi);
            out.push_back(le ? hi : lo);
        }
        return out;
    }

    struct Piece { std::string utf8; std::u16string utf16; std::string cp1252; bool in1252; };

    const std::vector<Piece>& Pieces()
    {
        static const std::vector<Piece> p = {
            { "a", u"a", "a", true },
            { " ", u" ", " ", true },
            { "\t", u"\t", "\t", true },
            { S({ 0xE9 }), u"é", std::string(1, static_cast<char>(0xE9)), true },
            { S({ 0x20AC }), u"€", std::string(1, static_cast<char>(0x80)), true },
            { S({ 0x65E5 }), u"日", "", false },
            { S({ 0x1F600 }), u"\U0001F600", "", false },
            { "\n", u"\n", "\n", true },
            { "\r\n", u"\r\n", "\r\n", true },
            { "\r", u"\r", "\r", true },
        };
        return p;
    }

    std::string Normalized(std::string s)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (s[i] == '\r')
            {
                out.push_back('\n');
                if (i + 1 < s.size() && s[i + 1] == '\n') ++i;
            }
            else out.push_back(s[i]);
        }
        return out;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: mixed line endings and a lone CR round-trip byte-identical", "[text-codec]")
{
    const std::string file = "one\r\ntwo\nthree\rfour\r\n";
    const DecodedText d = DecodeFile(file);
    CHECK(d.text == "one\ntwo\nthree\nfour\n");
    CHECK(d.encoding == TextEncoding::Utf8);
    CHECK(d.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::None);
    CHECK(d.eols.Dominant() == Eol::CRLF);   // 2 CRLF, 1 LF, 1 CR
    CHECK(d.eols.StyleOf(1) == Eol::LF);
    CHECK(d.eols.StyleOf(2) == Eol::CR);
    CHECK(d.eols.IsMixed());
    const auto out = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8(d.text, 8), d.eols, d.encoding);
    REQUIRE(out.has_value());
    CHECK(*out == file);
    CHECK(DecodeFile("a\r").eols.StyleOf(0) == Eol::CR);
    CHECK(DecodeFile("a\nb\r\n").eols.Dominant() == Eol::LF);   // tie: LF wins
    CHECK(DecodeFile("abc", { std::nullopt, Eol::CRLF }).eols.Dominant() == Eol::CRLF);   // no break: the default
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: every encoding round-trips byte-identical", "[text-codec]")
{
    rc::prop("decode -> encode == the file", [] {
        const auto enc = static_cast<TextEncoding>(*rc::gen::inRange(0, 5));
        std::string utf8, cp1252;
        std::u16string utf16;
        const auto n = *rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, 40);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        {
            const Piece& p = Pieces()[*rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, Pieces().size())];
            if (enc == TextEncoding::Windows1252 && !p.in1252) continue;
            utf8 += p.utf8;
            utf16 += p.utf16;
            cp1252 += p.cp1252;
        }
        std::string file;
        switch (enc)
        {
        case TextEncoding::Utf8: file = utf8; break;
        case TextEncoding::Utf8Bom: file = "\xEF\xBB\xBF" + utf8; break;
        case TextEncoding::Utf16LE: file = "\xFF\xFE" + Utf16Bytes(utf16, true); break;
        case TextEncoding::Utf16BE: file = "\xFE\xFF" + Utf16Bytes(utf16, false); break;
        case TextEncoding::Windows1252: file = cp1252; break;
        }
        DecodeOptions o;
        if (enc == TextEncoding::Windows1252) o.forced = TextEncoding::Windows1252;
        const DecodedText d = DecodeFile(file, o);
        RC_ASSERT(d.encoding == enc);
        RC_ASSERT(d.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::None);
        RC_ASSERT(d.text == Normalized(utf8));
        const auto out = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8(d.text, 8), d.eols, d.encoding);
        RC_ASSERT(out.has_value());
        RC_ASSERT(*out == file);
    });
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: invalid UTF-8 and binary files stay raw, read-only and byte-identical", "[text-codec]")
{
    rc::prop("raw bytes survive", [](const std::vector<unsigned char>& raw) {
        const std::string file(raw.begin(), raw.end());
        if (file.starts_with("\xEF\xBB\xBF") || file.starts_with("\xFF\xFE") || file.starts_with("\xFE\xFF")) return;
        const DecodedText d = DecodeFile(file);
        RC_ASSERT(d.encoding == TextEncoding::Utf8);
        const bool expectReadOnly = !Utf8::IsValid(file) || file.substr(0, 8192).find('\0') != std::string::npos;
        RC_ASSERT((d.readOnly != ReadOnlyReason::None) == expectReadOnly);
        const auto out = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8(d.text, 8), d.eols, d.encoding);
        RC_ASSERT(out.has_value());
        RC_ASSERT(*out == file);
    });
    CHECK(DecodeFile(std::string("ab\0cd", 5)).readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::Binary);
    CHECK(DecodeFile(std::string(9000, 'a') + std::string(1, '\0')).readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::None);   // NUL past 8 KB
    CHECK(DecodeFile(std::string("caf\xE9", 4)).readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8);
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: UTF-16 lone surrogates are kept read-only; an odd length holds its stray byte", "[text-codec]")
{
    const std::string file = std::string("\xFF\xFE", 2) + Utf16Bytes(u"a", true) + std::string("\x00\xD8", 2) + Utf16Bytes(u"b", true);
    const DecodedText d = DecodeFile(file);
    CHECK(d.encoding == TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    CHECK(d.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16);
    CHECK(d.text == "a" + S({ 0xD800 }) + "b");
    const auto out = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8(d.text, 8), d.eols, d.encoding);
    REQUIRE(out.has_value());
    CHECK(*out == file);
    CHECK(d.heldBytes == 0u);

    // FF FE 61 00 0A 00 62: "a\n" plus the first byte of the next unit (a writer
    // mid-write). It stays UTF-16LE and editable; the stray byte is held, so a
    // tail decoded later continues in UTF-16, never as UTF-8 with NULs (F2).
    const std::string odd("\xFF\xFE\x61\x00\x0A\x00\x62", 7);
    const DecodedText o = DecodeFile(odd);
    CHECK(o.encoding == TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    CHECK(o.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::None);
    CHECK(o.text == "a\n");
    CHECK(o.heldBytes == 1u);
    const auto oOut = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8(o.text), o.eols, o.encoding);
    REQUIRE(oOut.has_value());
    CHECK(*oOut == odd.substr(0, odd.size() - o.heldBytes));   // the decoded prefix round-trips
    // The completing byte arrives as a BOM-less fragment that starts at the held byte.
    const DecodedText rest = DecodeFragment(std::string("\x62\x00", 2), TextEncoding::Utf16LE, Eol::LF);
    CHECK(rest.text == "b");
    const DecodedText be = DecodeFile(std::string("\xFE\xFF\x00\x61\x00", 5));
    CHECK(be.encoding == TextEncoding::Utf16BE);
    CHECK(be.text == "a");
    CHECK(be.heldBytes == 1u);
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: a forced encoding other than UTF-8 or Windows-1252 is ignored and detection runs", "[text-codec]")
{
    const std::string wide = std::string("\xFF\xFE", 2) + Utf16Bytes(u"hi\n", true);
    const DecodedText w = DecodeFile(wide, { TextEncoding::Utf16BE, Eol::LF });
    CHECK(w.encoding == TextEncoding::Utf16LE);   // the BOM decides, not the ignored value
    CHECK(w.text == "hi\n");
    const std::string bom = std::string("\xEF\xBB\xBF", 3) + "x";
    CHECK(DecodeFile(bom, { TextEncoding::Utf16LE, Eol::LF }).encoding == TextEncoding::Utf8Bom);
    CHECK(DecodeFile(bom, { TextEncoding::Utf16LE, Eol::LF }).text == "x");
    CHECK(DecodeFile(bom, { TextEncoding::Utf8Bom, Eol::LF }).encoding == TextEncoding::Utf8Bom);
    CHECK(DecodeFile(wide, { TextEncoding::Utf8Bom, Eol::LF }).encoding == TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    // The two real choices still apply: UTF-8 keeps its own BOM detection and reads
    // a UTF-16 BOM file as raw bytes; Windows-1252 decodes every byte.
    CHECK(DecodeFile(bom, { TextEncoding::Utf8, Eol::LF }).encoding == TextEncoding::Utf8Bom);
    CHECK(DecodeFile(wide, { TextEncoding::Utf8, Eol::LF }).encoding == TextEncoding::Utf8);
    CHECK(DecodeFile(wide, { TextEncoding::Windows1252, Eol::LF }).encoding == TextEncoding::Windows1252);
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: a lone CR row followed by an empty LF row keeps both lines", "[text-codec]")
{
    EolMap eols(Eol::LF);
    eols.SetStyle(0, Eol::CR);   // "a" ends in CR, the empty row in LF, then "b"
    const auto out = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8("a\n\nb"), eols, TextEncoding::Utf8);
    REQUIRE(out.has_value());
    CHECK(*out == "a\r\r\nb");   // not "a\r\nb", which reads back as ONE CRLF break
    CHECK(DecodeFile(*out).text == "a\n\nb");
    const auto wide = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8("a\n\nb"), eols, TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    REQUIRE(wide.has_value());
    CHECK(DecodeFile(*wide).text == "a\n\nb");
    // A CR row followed by a NON-empty LF row is written as it is.
    CHECK(*EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nc\nb"), eols, TextEncoding::Utf8) == "a\rc\nb");

    // The edit that produces it: Enter at the start of the row after a CR row in an LF file.
    const DecodedText d = DecodeFile("x\na\rb\n");
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8(d.text), d.eols);
    SelectionSet s;
    buf.BeginTransaction(s);
    buf.Edit(std::vector<EditOp>{ { { 4, 4 }, "\n" } });   // before "b"
    buf.EndTransaction(s);
    const auto saved = EncodeFile(buf.Text(), buf.Eols(), d.encoding);
    REQUIRE(saved.has_value());
    CHECK(*saved == "x\na\r\r\nb\n");
    CHECK(DecodeFile(*saved).text == buf.Text().ToString());   // four lines, none lost

    rc::prop("encode -> decode keeps every line, whatever the styles", [] {
        static const Eol styles[] = { Eol::LF, Eol::CRLF, Eol::CR };
        const Eol dominant = styles[*rc::gen::inRange(0, 3)];
        EolMap map(dominant);
        std::string text;
        const auto rows = *rc::gen::inRange(1, 12);
        for (int r = 0; r < rows; ++r)
        {
            text.append(*rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, 3), 'a');   // empty rows are common
            if (r + 1 < rows)
            {
                text.push_back('\n');
                map.SetStyle(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(r), styles[*rc::gen::inRange(0, 3)]);
            }
        }
        const auto out = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8(text), map, TextEncoding::Utf8);
        RC_ASSERT(out.has_value());
        RC_ASSERT(DecodeFile(*out).text == text);
    });
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: Windows-1252 maps every byte, undefined ones to C1, and unlocks binary-looking files", "[text-codec]")
{
    const std::string undefinedBytes = std::string("\x81\x8D\x8F\x90\x9D", 5);
    const DecodedText d = DecodeFile(undefinedBytes, { TextEncoding::Windows1252, Eol::LF });
    CHECK(d.text == S({ 0x81, 0x8D, 0x8F, 0x90, 0x9D }));
    CHECK(*EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8(d.text), d.eols, TextEncoding::Windows1252) == undefinedBytes);
    const DecodedText nul = DecodeFile(std::string("a\0b", 3), { TextEncoding::Windows1252, Eol::LF });
    CHECK(nul.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::None);
    CHECK(nul.encoding == TextEncoding::Windows1252);
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: encoding refuses what the target cannot hold, naming the place", "[text-codec]")
{
    const auto out = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8("ok\n" + S({ 0x65E5 })), EolMap{}, TextEncoding::Windows1252);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(out.has_value());
    CHECK(out.error().row == 1u);
    CHECK(out.error().byteCol == 0u);
    CHECK(out.error().value == 0x65E5u);
    CHECK_FALSE(out.error().message.empty());
    const auto bad = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8(std::string("a\xFF", 2)), EolMap{}, TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(bad.has_value());
    CHECK(bad.error().value == 0xFFu);
    CHECK(bad.error().byteCol == 1u);
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: a one-character edit to a mixed file changes exactly that line's bytes", "[text-codec]")
{
    rc::prop("replace one byte / insert one break -> the file differs only there", [] {
        static const char* const styles[] = { "\n", "\r\n", "\r" };
        std::string file;
        std::vector<std::size_t> rowStart;   // file offset of each row
        std::vector<std::size_t> rowLength;
        const auto rows = *rc::gen::inRange(1, 20);
        bool prevCr = false;
        for (int r = 0; r < rows; ++r)
        {
            rowStart.push_back(file.size());
            const auto len = *rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, 6);
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) file.push_back(static_cast<char>('a' + *rc::gen::inRange(0, 3)));
            rowLength.push_back(len);
            if (r + 1 < rows || *rc::gen::inRange(0, 2) == 0)
            {
                int style = *rc::gen::inRange(0, 3);
                if (style == 0 && len == 0 && prevCr) style = 1;   // a CR then an LF would read back as one CRLF break
                file += styles[style];
                prevCr = style == 2;
            }
        }
        std::vector<int> candidates;
        for (int r = 0; r < rows; ++r) if (rowLength[r] > 0) candidates.push_back(r);
        if (candidates.empty()) return;
        const int row = candidates[*rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, candidates.size())];
        const auto col = *rc::gen::inRange<std::size_t>(0, rowLength[row]);

        const DecodedText d = DecodeFile(file);
        TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8(d.text, 8), d.eols);
        const ByteOffset at = buf.Text().LineStart(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(row)) + col;
        SelectionSet s;
        buf.BeginTransaction(s);
        buf.Edit(std::vector<EditOp>{ { { at, at + 1 }, "Z" } });
        buf.EndTransaction(s);
        std::string expected = file;
        expected[rowStart[row] + col] = 'Z';
        const auto out = EncodeFile(buf.Text(), buf.Eols(), d.encoding);
        RC_ASSERT(out.has_value());
        RC_ASSERT(*out == expected);

        TextBuffer buf2(Rope::FromUtf8(d.text, 8), d.eols);
        buf2.BeginTransaction(s);
        buf2.Edit(std::vector<EditOp>{ { { at, at }, "\n" } });
        buf2.EndTransaction(s);
        std::string expected2 = file;
        expected2.insert(rowStart[row] + col, EolMap::Bytes(d.eols.Dominant()));
        const auto out2 = EncodeFile(buf2.Text(), buf2.Eols(), d.encoding);
        RC_ASSERT(out2.has_value());
        RC_ASSERT(*out2 == expected2);
    });
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: encoding ids are stable, round-trip, and parse case-insensitively", "[text-codec]")
{
    static_assert(!EncodingHasBom(TextEncoding::Utf8));
    static_assert(EncodingHasBom(TextEncoding::Utf8Bom));
    static_assert(EncodingHasBom(TextEncoding::Utf16LE));
    static_assert(EncodingHasBom(TextEncoding::Utf16BE));
    static_assert(!EncodingHasBom(TextEncoding::Windows1252));

    struct Row { TextEncoding encoding; std::string_view id; };
    const Row rows[] = {
        { TextEncoding::Utf8, "utf-8" },
        { TextEncoding::Utf8Bom, "utf-8-bom" },
        { TextEncoding::Utf16LE, "utf-16le" },
        { TextEncoding::Utf16BE, "utf-16be" },
        { TextEncoding::Windows1252, "windows-1252" },
    };
    for (const Row& r : rows)
    {
        INFO("id " << std::string(r.id));
        CHECK(EncodingId(r.encoding) == r.id);
        const std::optional<TextEncoding> back = EncodingFromId(EncodingId(r.encoding));
        REQUIRE(back.has_value());
        CHECK(*back == r.encoding);
    }
    CHECK(EncodingFromId("UTF-8") == TextEncoding::Utf8);
    CHECK(EncodingFromId("Windows-1252") == TextEncoding::Windows1252);
    CHECK(EncodingFromId("UTF-16LE") == TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    CHECK_FALSE(EncodingFromId("latin-1").has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(EncodingFromId("utf8").has_value());   // ids are exact apart from case
    CHECK_FALSE(EncodingFromId("").has_value());
}

TEST_CASE("FileCodec: DecodeFragment decodes BOM-less bytes in a known encoding", "[text-codec]")
{
    // A BOM-less UTF-16LE tail with CRLF breaks: '\n' text, CRLF dominant, the LF row an exception.
    const DecodedText le = DecodeFragment(Utf16Bytes(u"a\r\nb\r\nc\n", true), TextEncoding::Utf16LE, Eol::LF);
    CHECK(le.text == "a\nb\nc\n");
    CHECK(le.encoding == TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    CHECK(le.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::None);
    CHECK(le.eols.Dominant() == Eol::CRLF);
    CHECK(le.eols.StyleOf(2) == Eol::LF);
    const DecodedText be = DecodeFragment(Utf16Bytes(u"x\r\n", false), TextEncoding::Utf16BE, Eol::LF);
    CHECK(be.text == "x\n");
    CHECK(be.eols.Dominant() == Eol::CRLF);
    // A fragment is never sniffed for a BOM: FF FE here is the character U+FEFF, not a marker.
    const DecodedText zw = DecodeFragment(Utf16Bytes(u"﻿z", true), TextEncoding::Utf16LE, Eol::LF);
    CHECK(zw.text == S({ 0xFEFF }) + "z");

    // A lone surrogate becomes WTF-8 and makes the content read-only.
    const std::string lone = Utf16Bytes(u"a", true) + std::string("\x00\xD8", 2) + Utf16Bytes(u"b", true);
    const DecodedText ls = DecodeFragment(lone, TextEncoding::Utf16LE, Eol::LF);
    CHECK(ls.text == "a" + S({ 0xD800 }) + "b");
    CHECK(ls.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16);

    // Windows-1252 maps every one of the 256 bytes, and the result encodes back byte-identical.
    std::string all;
    for (int b = 0; b < 256; ++b) all.push_back(static_cast<char>(b));
    const DecodedText w = DecodeFragment(all, TextEncoding::Windows1252, Eol::LF);
    CHECK(w.encoding == TextEncoding::Windows1252);
    CHECK(w.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::None);   // the NUL byte is a character in 1252
    CHECK(w.text.find(S({ 0x20AC })) != std::string::npos);   // 0x80
    CHECK(w.text.find(S({ 0x0081 })) != std::string::npos);   // undefined -> C1
    CHECK(w.text.find(S({ 0x00E9 })) != std::string::npos);   // 0xE9
    const auto wOut = EncodeFile(Rope::FromUtf8(w.text), w.eols, TextEncoding::Windows1252);
    REQUIRE(wOut.has_value());
    CHECK(*wOut == all);

    // UTF-8 keeps an invalid byte raw and reports it; a leading EF BB BF is text, not a BOM.
    const std::string bad = std::string("ok", 2) + std::string(1, static_cast<char>(0xFF)) + "\n";
    const DecodedText u = DecodeFragment(bad, TextEncoding::Utf8, Eol::LF);
    CHECK(u.text == bad);
    CHECK(u.encoding == TextEncoding::Utf8);
    CHECK(u.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8);
    const std::string bomLike = std::string("\xEF\xBB\xBF", 3) + "x";
    const DecodedText kept = DecodeFragment(bomLike, TextEncoding::Utf8Bom, Eol::LF);
    CHECK(kept.text == bomLike);
    CHECK(kept.encoding == TextEncoding::Utf8Bom);
    CHECK(kept.readOnly == ReadOnlyReason::None);

    // No break: the caller's default style (TE2-17 passes the buffer's dominant style).
    CHECK(DecodeFragment("abc", TextEncoding::Utf8, Eol::CRLF).eols.Dominant() == Eol::CRLF);
    // Same folding as DecodeFile, lone CR included.
    const DecodedText mixed = DecodeFragment("p\rq\r\nr\n", TextEncoding::Utf8, Eol::LF);
    CHECK(mixed.text == DecodeFile("p\rq\r\nr\n").text);
    CHECK(mixed.eols == DecodeFile("p\rq\r\nr\n").eols);
}
```
