```cpp
        // target(const Selection&) -> std::pair<ByteOffset, std::optional<std::uint32_t>> (new head, goal).
        template <class F>
        void Move(bool extend, F&& target)
        {
            m_buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
            if (extend)
            {
                m_sels.MoveWith([&](Selection& s) {
                    auto [head, goal] = target(s);
                    s.head = head;
                    s.goalColumn = goal;
                });
                return;
            }
            m_sels.MoveWith([&](Selection& s) {
                auto [head, goal] = target(s);
                s.anchor = s.head = head;
                s.goalColumn = goal;
            });
        }
```

```cpp
        bool InRanges(std::span<const CodePointRange> table, char32_t cp) noexcept
        {
            const auto it = std::upper_bound(table.begin(), table.end(), cp,
                                             [](char32_t v, const CodePointRange& r) { return v < r.lo; });
            return it != table.begin() && cp <= std::prev(it)->hi;
        }

        Utf8::Unit UnitAt(const Rope& t, ByteOffset at)
        {
            std::string buf;
            t.CopyTo({ at, std::min(t.Size(), at + 4) }, buf);
            return Utf8::DecodeAt(buf, 0);
        }

        // The unit that ends at `at` (> 0) and where it starts.
        std::pair<Utf8::Unit, ByteOffset> UnitBefore(const Rope& t, ByteOffset at)
        {
            const ByteOffset from = at >= 4 ? at - 4 : 0;
            std::string buf;
            t.CopyTo({ from, at }, buf);
            const std::size_t start = Utf8::PrevUnitStart(buf, buf.size());
            return { Utf8::DecodeAt(buf, start), from + start };
        }

        std::uint32_t LeadingColumns(std::string_view prefix, std::uint32_t tab, std::size_t& graphemeEnd, std::uint32_t stopAt)
        {
            // Walks graphemes of prefix; stops before the first one whose end column would pass stopAt.
            std::uint32_t col = 0;
            std::size_t i = 0;
            while (i < prefix.size())
            {
                const std::uint32_t next = prefix[i] == '\t' ? (col / tab + 1) * tab : col + 1;
                if (next > stopAt) break;
                col = next;
                i = NextGraphemeBoundary(prefix, i);
            }
            graphemeEnd = i;
            return col;
        }
```
(`CodePointRange` comes from `Graphemes.hpp`, already included.) Then the definitions:
```cpp
    std::uint32_t GraphemeColumnModel::ColumnOf(const Rope& text, ByteOffset offset) const
    {
        const Point p = text.OffsetToPoint(offset);
        return ColumnInLine(text.Substr({ offset - p.col, offset }), m_tab);
    }

    ByteOffset GraphemeColumnModel::OffsetAtColumn(const Rope& text, std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t column) const
    {
        const ByteOffset start = text.LineStart(row);
        const std::string line = text.Substr({ start, text.LineEnd(row) });
        std::size_t end = 0;
        LeadingColumns(line, m_tab, end, column);
        return start + end;
    }

    WordChars::WordChars() : WordChars(FromSpec("A-Za-z0-9_")) {}

    WordChars WordChars::FromSpec(std::string_view spec)
    {
        WordChars w{ std::bitset<128>{} };
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < spec.size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto a = static_cast<unsigned char>(spec[i]);
            if (i + 2 < spec.size() && spec[i + 1] == '-')
            {
                const auto b = static_cast<unsigned char>(spec[i + 2]);
                for (unsigned c = a; c <= b && c < 128; ++c) w.ascii.set(c);
                i += 2;
            }
            else if (a < 128)
            {
                w.ascii.set(a);
            }
        }
        return w;
    }

    bool WordChars::IsWord(char32_t cp) const noexcept
    {
        if (cp < 128) return ascii.test(static_cast<std::size_t>(cp));
        return !InRanges(kNonWord, cp) && !InRanges(kUnicodeSpace, cp);
    }

    CharClass ClassifyChar(char32_t cp, bool valid, const WordChars& words) noexcept
    {
        if (!valid) return CharClass::Punctuation;
        if (cp == U'\n') return CharClass::Newline;
        if (cp == U' ' || cp == U'\t' || cp == U'\r' || cp == 0x0B || cp == 0x0C || InRanges(kUnicodeSpace, cp))
            return CharClass::Whitespace;
        return words.IsWord(cp) ? CharClass::Word : CharClass::Punctuation;
    }
```
(`WordChars w{ std::bitset<128>{} }` calls the private constructor declared in the header; `FromSpec` is a member, so it can.)

Motion definitions:
```cpp
    ByteOffset TextCommands::WordRightFrom(ByteOffset p) const
    {
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        const ByteOffset size = t.Size();
        const auto classAt = [&](ByteOffset at) {
            const Utf8::Unit u = UnitAt(t, at);
            return std::pair{ ClassifyChar(u.cp, u.valid, m_ctx.wordChars), at + u.length };
        };
        if (p >= size) return size;
        if (const auto [c, next] = classAt(p); c == CharClass::Newline) return next;   // cross one line break
        ByteOffset q = p;
        while (q < size)
        {
            const auto [c, next] = classAt(q);
            if (c != CharClass::Whitespace) break;
            q = next;
        }
        if (q >= size) return size;
        const CharClass run = classAt(q).first;
        if (run == CharClass::Newline) return q;   // stop before the line break
        while (q < size)
        {
            const auto [c, next] = classAt(q);
            if (c != run) break;
            q = next;
        }
        return q;
    }

    ByteOffset TextCommands::WordLeftFrom(ByteOffset p) const
    {
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        const auto classBefore = [&](ByteOffset at) {
            const auto [u, start] = UnitBefore(t, at);
            return std::pair{ ClassifyChar(u.cp, u.valid, m_ctx.wordChars), start };
        };
        if (p == 0) return 0;
        if (const auto [c, start] = classBefore(p); c == CharClass::Newline) return start;
        ByteOffset q = p;
        while (q > 0)
        {
            const auto [c, start] = classBefore(q);
            if (c != CharClass::Whitespace) break;
            q = start;
        }
        if (q == 0) return 0;
        const CharClass run = classBefore(q).first;
        if (run == CharClass::Newline) return q;
        while (q > 0)
        {
            const auto [c, start] = classBefore(q);
            if (c != run) break;
            q = start;
        }
        return q;
    }

    std::pair<ByteOffset, std::uint32_t> TextCommands::VerticalTarget(ByteOffset head, std::int64_t rows,
                                                                      std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal, bool clampToRows) const
    {
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        const ColumnModel& cm = Columns();
        const std::uint32_t col = goal ? *goal : cm.ColumnOf(t, head);
        const std::uint32_t row = t.OffsetToPoint(head).row;
        const DisplayMap* dm = m_ctx.display;
        const std::int64_t last = static_cast<std::int64_t>(dm ? dm->DisplayRowCount() : t.LineCount()) - 1;
        const std::int64_t from = dm ? dm->BufferRowToDisplay(row) : row;
        std::int64_t to = from + rows;
        if (to < 0)
        {
            if (!clampToRows) return { 0, col };
            to = 0;
        }
        if (to > last)
        {
            if (!clampToRows) return { t.Size(), col };
            to = last;
        }
        const auto target = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(dm ? dm->DisplayRowToBuffer(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(to)) : to);
        return { cm.OffsetAtColumn(t, target, col), col };
    }

    void TextCommands::MoveLeft(bool extend)
    {
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        Move(extend, [&](const Selection& s) {
            const ByteOffset to = (!extend && !s.Empty()) ? s.Start() : PrevGraphemeBoundary(t, s.head);
            return std::pair{ to, std::optional<std::uint32_t>{} };
        });
    }

    void TextCommands::MoveRight(bool extend)
    {
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        Move(extend, [&](const Selection& s) {
            const ByteOffset to = (!extend && !s.Empty()) ? s.End() : NextGraphemeBoundary(t, s.head);
            return std::pair{ to, std::optional<std::uint32_t>{} };
        });
    }

    void TextCommands::MoveWordLeft(bool extend)
    {
        Move(extend, [&](const Selection& s) { return std::pair{ WordLeftFrom(s.head), std::optional<std::uint32_t>{} }; });
    }

    void TextCommands::MoveWordRight(bool extend)
    {
        Move(extend, [&](const Selection& s) { return std::pair{ WordRightFrom(s.head), std::optional<std::uint32_t>{} }; });
    }

    void TextCommands::MoveUp(bool extend)
    {
        Move(extend, [&](const Selection& s) {
            const auto [to, col] = VerticalTarget(s.head, -1, s.goalColumn, false);
            return std::pair{ to, std::optional<std::uint32_t>(col) };
        });
    }

    void TextCommands::MoveDown(bool extend)
    {
        Move(extend, [&](const Selection& s) {
            const auto [to, col] = VerticalTarget(s.head, 1, s.goalColumn, false);
            return std::pair{ to, std::optional<std::uint32_t>(col) };
        });
    }

    void TextCommands::MovePageUp(std::uint32_t rows, bool extend)
    {
        Move(extend, [&](const Selection& s) {
            const auto [to, col] = VerticalTarget(s.head, -static_cast<std::int64_t>(rows), s.goalColumn, true);
            return std::pair{ to, std::optional<std::uint32_t>(col) };
        });
    }

    void TextCommands::MovePageDown(std::uint32_t rows, bool extend)
    {
        Move(extend, [&](const Selection& s) {
            const auto [to, col] = VerticalTarget(s.head, static_cast<std::int64_t>(rows), s.goalColumn, true);
            return std::pair{ to, std::optional<std::uint32_t>(col) };
        });
    }

    void TextCommands::MoveLineStart(bool extend)
    {
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        Move(extend, [&](const Selection& s) {
            const std::uint32_t row = t.OffsetToPoint(s.head).row;
            const ByteOffset start = t.LineStart(row);
            const ByteOffset firstNonBlank = start + LeadingWhitespace(LineText(t, row));
            return std::pair{ s.head == firstNonBlank ? start : firstNonBlank, std::optional<std::uint32_t>{} };
        });
    }

    void TextCommands::MoveLineEnd(bool extend)
    {
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        Move(extend, [&](const Selection& s) {
            return std::pair{ t.LineEnd(t.OffsetToPoint(s.head).row), std::optional<std::uint32_t>{} };
        });
    }

    void TextCommands::MoveDocumentStart(bool extend)
    {
        Move(extend, [](const Selection&) { return std::pair{ ByteOffset(0), std::optional<std::uint32_t>{} }; });
    }

    void TextCommands::MoveDocumentEnd(bool extend)
    {
        const ByteOffset end = m_buffer.Text().Size();
        Move(extend, [end](const Selection&) { return std::pair{ end, std::optional<std::uint32_t>{} }; });
    }

    void TextCommands::SelectAll()
    {
        m_buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
        m_sels.SetSingle(0, m_buffer.Text().Size());
    }

    void TextCommands::DeleteWordBack()
    {
        EditEach(TransactionKind::Deleting, [&](const Selection& s) -> std::optional<SelectionEdit> {
            if (!s.Empty()) return SelectionEdit{ { s.Range(), {} }, 0, 0 };
            const ByteOffset from = WordLeftFrom(s.head);
            if (from == s.head) return std::nullopt;
            return SelectionEdit{ { { from, s.head }, {} }, 0, 0 };
        });
    }

    void TextCommands::DeleteWordForward()
    {
        EditEach(TransactionKind::Deleting, [&](const Selection& s) -> std::optional<SelectionEdit> {
            if (!s.Empty()) return SelectionEdit{ { s.Range(), {} }, 0, 0 };
            const ByteOffset to = WordRightFrom(s.head);
            if (to == s.head) return std::nullopt;
            return SelectionEdit{ { { s.head, to }, {} }, 0, 0 };
        });
    }
```
(`PrevGraphemeBoundary(t, 0)` returns 0 and `NextGraphemeBoundary(t, size)` returns `size`, so the edges need no special case.)

```cpp
    bool TextCommands::ConfirmCursorCount(std::size_t requested) const
    {
        if (requested <= m_ctx.maxCursors) return true;
        return m_ctx.confirmCursors ? m_ctx.confirmCursors(requested) : false;
    }

    std::optional<ByteOffset> TextCommands::FindForward(const Rope& text, std::string_view needle, ByteOffset from)
    {
        if (needle.empty() || from >= text.Size()) return std::nullopt;
        std::string window;   // the searched tail plus the next chunk, so a match can straddle chunks
        ByteOffset windowStart = from;
        std::optional<ByteOffset> found;
        text.ForEachChunkWhile({ from, text.Size() }, [&](std::string_view chunk) {
            window.append(chunk);
            const std::size_t at = window.find(needle);
            if (at != std::string::npos)
            {
                found = windowStart + at;
                return false;
            }
            const std::size_t keepFrom = window.size() + 1 >= needle.size() ? window.size() + 1 - needle.size() : 0;
            window.erase(0, keepFrom);
            windowStart += keepFrom;
            return true;
        });
        return found;
    }

    std::vector<ByteOffset> TextCommands::FindAll(const Rope& text, std::string_view needle)
    {
        std::vector<ByteOffset> hits;
        if (needle.empty()) return hits;
        std::string window;
        ByteOffset windowStart = 0;
        std::size_t searchFrom = 0;   // matches never overlap
        text.ForEachChunk({ 0, text.Size() }, [&](std::string_view chunk) {
            window.append(chunk);
            for (std::size_t at; (at = window.find(needle, searchFrom)) != std::string::npos;)
            {
                hits.push_back(windowStart + at);
                searchFrom = at + needle.size();
            }
            // Positions before max(searchFrom, the last needle-1 bytes) can never start a match now.
            const std::size_t tailStart = window.size() + 1 >= needle.size() ? window.size() + 1 - needle.size() : 0;
            const std::size_t cut = std::max(searchFrom, tailStart);
            window.erase(0, cut);
            windowStart += cut;
            searchFrom = 0;
        });
        return hits;
    }

    std::optional<ByteRange> TextCommands::WordRangeAt(ByteOffset offset) const
    {
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        const auto wordAt = [&](ByteOffset at) {
            const Utf8::Unit u = UnitAt(t, at);
            return std::pair{ ClassifyChar(u.cp, u.valid, m_ctx.wordChars) == CharClass::Word, at + u.length };
        };
        const auto wordBefore = [&](ByteOffset at) {
            const auto [u, start] = UnitBefore(t, at);
            return std::pair{ ClassifyChar(u.cp, u.valid, m_ctx.wordChars) == CharClass::Word, start };
        };
        const bool here = offset < t.Size() && wordAt(offset).first;
        const bool before = offset > 0 && wordBefore(offset).first;
        if (!here && !before) return std::nullopt;
        ByteOffset begin = offset, end = offset;
        while (begin > 0)
        {
            const auto [w, start] = wordBefore(begin);
            if (!w) break;
            begin = start;
        }
        while (end < t.Size())
        {
            const auto [w, next] = wordAt(end);
            if (!w) break;
            end = next;
        }
        return ByteRange{ begin, end };
    }

    bool TextCommands::AddNextMatch()
    {
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        m_buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
        const Selection primary = m_sels.Primary();
        if (primary.Empty())
        {
            bool any = false;   // first press: every cursor selects its word (Sublime)
            m_sels.MoveWith([&](Selection& s) {
                if (!s.Empty()) return;
                if (const std::optional<ByteRange> w = WordRangeAt(s.head))
                {
                    s.anchor = w->begin;
                    s.head = w->end;
                    s.goalColumn.reset();
                    any = true;
                }
            });
            return any;
        }
        const std::string needle = t.Substr(primary.Range());
        const auto overlapsSelection = [&](ByteRange r) {
            const auto all = m_sels.All();
            return std::any_of(all.begin(), all.end(), [&](const Selection& s) { return s.Start() < r.end && r.begin < s.End(); });
        };
        const auto tryFrom = [&](ByteOffset from, ByteOffset limit) -> std::optional<ByteRange> {
            for (std::optional<ByteOffset> hit = FindForward(t, needle, from); hit && *hit < limit; hit = FindForward(t, needle, *hit + 1))
            {
                const ByteRange r{ *hit, *hit + needle.size() };
                if (!overlapsSelection(r)) return r;
            }
            return std::nullopt;
        };
        std::optional<ByteRange> next = tryFrom(primary.End(), t.Size() + 1);
        if (!next) next = tryFrom(0, primary.Start());   // wrap
        if (!next || !ConfirmCursorCount(m_sels.Size() + 1)) return false;
        m_sels.Add(next->begin, next->end);
        return true;
    }

    bool TextCommands::SelectAllMatches()
    {
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        const Selection primary = m_sels.Primary();
        ByteRange range = primary.Range();
        if (primary.Empty())
        {
            const std::optional<ByteRange> w = WordRangeAt(primary.head);
            if (!w) return false;
            range = *w;
        }
        const std::string needle = t.Substr(range);
        const std::vector<ByteOffset> hits = FindAll(t, needle);
        if (hits.empty() || !ConfirmCursorCount(hits.size())) return false;
        m_buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
        std::vector<Selection> sels;
        sels.reserve(hits.size());
        for (const ByteOffset h : hits) sels.push_back({ m_sels.AllocateId(), h, h + needle.size(), std::nullopt });
        for (Selection& s : sels)
            if (s.Start() == range.begin) s.id = m_sels.AllocateId();   // the old primary's match stays primary
        m_sels.Replace(std::move(sels));
        return true;
    }

    bool TextCommands::SplitSelectionIntoLines()
    {
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> out;
        bool split = false;
        for (const Selection& s : m_sels.All())
        {
            const Point a = t.OffsetToPoint(s.Start());
            const Point b = t.OffsetToPoint(s.End());
            if (s.Empty() || a.row == b.row)
            {
                out.push_back(s);
                continue;
            }
            split = true;
            for (std::uint32_t row = a.row; row <= b.row; ++row)
            {
                const ByteOffset begin = row == a.row ? s.Start() : t.LineStart(row);
                const ByteOffset end = row == b.row ? s.End() : t.LineEnd(row);
                if (row == b.row && b.col == 0) break;   // a selection ending at a row start does not take that row
                out.push_back({ m_sels.AllocateId(), begin, end, std::nullopt });
            }
        }
        if (!split || !ConfirmCursorCount(out.size())) return false;
        m_buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
        m_sels.Replace(std::move(out));
        return true;
    }

    bool TextCommands::AddCursorAbove() { return AddCursorVertical(-1); }
    bool TextCommands::AddCursorBelow() { return AddCursorVertical(1); }

    bool TextCommands::AddCursorVertical(int direction)
    {
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        const auto all = m_sels.All();
        const Selection edge = direction > 0 ? all.back() : all.front();
        const std::uint32_t headRow = t.OffsetToPoint(edge.head).row;
        const std::uint32_t anchorRow = t.OffsetToPoint(edge.anchor).row;
        const std::uint32_t edgeRow = direction > 0 ? std::max(headRow, anchorRow) : std::min(headRow, anchorRow);
        const DisplayMap* dm = m_ctx.display;
        const std::int64_t from = dm ? dm->BufferRowToDisplay(edgeRow) : edgeRow;
        const std::int64_t last = static_cast<std::int64_t>(dm ? dm->DisplayRowCount() : t.LineCount()) - 1;
        const std::int64_t to = from + direction;
        if (to < 0 || to > last) return false;
        if (!ConfirmCursorCount(m_sels.Size() + 1)) return false;
        const auto row = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(dm ? dm->DisplayRowToBuffer(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(to)) : to);
        const ColumnModel& cm = Columns();
        const std::uint32_t headCol = edge.goalColumn.value_or(cm.ColumnOf(t, edge.head));
        const ByteOffset head = cm.OffsetAtColumn(t, row, headCol);
        const ByteOffset anchor = edge.Empty() ? head : cm.OffsetAtColumn(t, row, cm.ColumnOf(t, edge.anchor));
        m_buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
        m_sels.Add(anchor, head, headCol);
        return true;
    }

    void TextCommands::SingleSelection()
    {
        m_buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
        const Selection primary = m_sels.Primary();
        m_sels.Replace({ primary });
    }
```

```cpp
    void TextCommands::SelectLine()
    {
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        const auto endOf = [&](std::uint32_t row) { return row + 1 < t.LineCount() ? t.LineStart(row + 1) : t.Size(); };
        m_buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
        m_sels.MoveWith([&](Selection& s) {
            const RowSpan r = RowsOf(t, s);
            const ByteOffset begin = t.LineStart(r.first);
            ByteOffset end = endOf(r.last);
            if (!s.Empty() && s.Start() == begin && s.End() == end) end = endOf(r.last + 1);   // already whole rows: one more
            s.anchor = begin;
            s.head = end;
            s.goalColumn.reset();
        });
    }

    void TextCommands::DuplicateLines()
    {
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        // Two kinds of insertion: a cursor row's copy goes at the row START (above
        // the original row), a selection's copy right after the selection END. In
        // selection order they can come out of offset order (a selection, then a
        // cursor on the same row: "^ab|c|") and can meet at one offset (a selection
        // ending where a cursor's row starts). So sort them, and merge equal
        // offsets into one op: the selection copy first (it belongs right after
        // the selection), then the row copy (right before its row). No insertion
        // is ever dropped.
        struct Insert
        {
            ByteOffset at;
            bool rowCopy;
            std::string text;
        };
        std::vector<Insert> inserts;
        std::optional<std::uint32_t> lastRow;   // cursor rows never decrease in selection order
        for (const Selection& s : m_sels.All())
        {
            if (s.Empty())
            {
                const std::uint32_t row = t.OffsetToPoint(s.head).row;
                if (lastRow == row) continue;   // one copy per row
                lastRow = row;
                inserts.push_back({ t.LineStart(row), true, LineText(t, row) + "\n" });
            }
            else
            {
                inserts.push_back({ s.End(), false, t.Substr(s.Range()) });
            }
        }
        std::stable_sort(inserts.begin(), inserts.end(), [](const Insert& a, const Insert& b) {
            return a.at != b.at ? a.at < b.at : (!a.rowCopy && b.rowCopy);
        });
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (Insert& in : inserts)
        {
            if (!ops.empty() && ops.back().range.begin == in.at)
            {
                ops.back().text += in.text;
                continue;
            }
            ops.push_back({ { in.at, in.at }, std::move(in.text) });
        }
        // Cursors ride the original (now lower) row: Right. A selection stays on its
        // original text: its start moves past any copy inserted AT it (a row copy of
        // its own row, or the copy of a selection ending there): Right; its end stays
        // before its own copy: Left.
        EditAndMap(TransactionKind::Other, std::move(ops), Bias::Right, Bias::Right, Bias::Left);
    }

    void TextCommands::DeleteLines()
    {
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        const std::uint32_t lastRow = t.LineCount() - 1;
        const auto all = m_sels.All();
        const std::vector<RowSpan> blocks = MergedRows(t, all, true);
        const ColumnModel& cm = Columns();
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> columns;
        std::size_t si = 0;
        for (const RowSpan& b : blocks)
        {
            while (si + 1 < all.size() && RowsOf(t, all[si]).first < b.first) ++si;
            columns.push_back(cm.ColumnOf(t, all[si].head));
            if (b.last < lastRow) ops.push_back({ { t.LineStart(b.first), t.LineStart(b.last + 1) }, {} });
            else if (b.first > 0) ops.push_back({ { t.LineEnd(b.first - 1), t.Size() }, {} });   // the last rows take the break before them
            else ops.push_back({ { 0, t.Size() }, {} });
        }
        m_buffer.BeginTransaction(m_sels, TransactionKind::Other);
        m_buffer.Edit(ops);
        const Rope& after = m_buffer.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> out;
        std::uint32_t removed = 0;
        for (std::size_t k = 0; k < blocks.size(); ++k)
        {
            const RowSpan& b = blocks[k];
            const bool tail = b.last >= lastRow;
            const std::uint32_t row = (tail && b.first > 0 ? b.first - 1 : b.first) - removed;
            removed += b.last - b.first + 1;
            const ByteOffset at = cm.OffsetAtColumn(after, std::min(row, after.LineCount() - 1), columns[k]);
            out.push_back({ m_sels.AllocateId(), at, at, std::nullopt });
        }
        m_sels.Replace(std::move(out));
        m_buffer.EndTransaction(m_sels);
    }

    bool TextCommands::MoveLinesUp() { return MoveLines(-1); }
    bool TextCommands::MoveLinesDown() { return MoveLines(1); }

    bool TextCommands::MoveLines(int direction)
    {
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        const std::uint32_t lastRow = t.LineCount() - 1;
        const auto all = m_sels.All();
        const std::vector<RowSpan> blocks = MergedRows(t, all, true);
        if (direction < 0 ? blocks.front().first == 0 : blocks.back().last == lastRow) return false;   // Sublime: nothing moves
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::vector<std::int64_t> deltas;   // each op keeps its length, so only its own selections move
        for (const RowSpan& b : blocks)
        {
            const std::string block = t.Substr({ t.LineStart(b.first), t.LineEnd(b.last) });
            if (direction < 0)
            {
                const std::string prev = LineText(t, b.first - 1);
                ops.push_back({ { t.LineStart(b.first - 1), t.LineEnd(b.last) }, block + "\n" + prev });
                deltas.push_back(-static_cast<std::int64_t>(prev.size() + 1));
            }
            else
            {
                const std::string next = LineText(t, b.last + 1);
                ops.push_back({ { t.LineStart(b.first), t.LineEnd(b.last + 1) }, next + "\n" + block });
                deltas.push_back(static_cast<std::int64_t>(next.size() + 1));
            }
        }
        const ByteOffset size = t.Size();
        std::vector<Selection> out;
        std::size_t k = 0;
        for (Selection s : all)
        {
            while (k + 1 < blocks.size() && RowsOf(t, s).first > blocks[k].last) ++k;
            const auto shift = [&](ByteOffset o) {
                return std::min<ByteOffset>(static_cast<ByteOffset>(std::max<std::int64_t>(0, static_cast<std::int64_t>(o) + deltas[k])), size);
            };
            s.anchor = shift(s.anchor);
            s.head = shift(s.head);
            out.push_back(s);
        }
        m_buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
        m_buffer.BeginTransaction(m_sels, TransactionKind::Other);
        m_buffer.Edit(ops);
        m_sels.Replace(std::move(out));
        m_buffer.EndTransaction(m_sels);
        return true;
    }

    void TextCommands::JoinLines()
    {
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        const std::uint32_t lastRow = t.LineCount() - 1;
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (RowSpan b : MergedRows(t, m_sels.All(), false))
        {
            if (b.first == b.last) b.last = std::min(b.first + 1, lastRow);   // a single row joins the next
            for (std::uint32_t r = b.first; r < b.last; ++r)
            {
                const std::string next = LineText(t, r + 1);
                const std::size_t indent = LeadingWhitespace(next);
                const ByteOffset begin = t.LineEnd(r);
                if (!ops.empty() && begin <= ops.back().range.begin) continue;
                ops.push_back({ { begin, t.LineStart(r + 1) + indent }, indent == next.size() ? std::string() : std::string(" ") });
            }
        }
        // A cursor at the join stays before the space; a selection grows over the joined rows.
        EditAndMap(TransactionKind::Other, std::move(ops), Bias::Left, Bias::Left, Bias::Right);
    }
```

### Task TE1-19: Toggle line and block comments, with the tokens as parameters (spec s7, s6.3)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp` (`CommentTokens`; `EditContext::comment`; the two commands)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.cpp`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextCommandsCommentTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE1-14..18 `TextCommands`.
- Produces:
  - `struct CommentTokens { std::string line; std::string blockBegin; std::string blockEnd; }` and `EditContext::comment`. TE3 fills it from the grammar's `comment` (`{"line": "//", "block": ["/*", "*/"]}`). There is no setting: the tokens are grammar data.
  - `bool ToggleLineComment()` (Ctrl+/). The rows covered by every selection decide together. If every non-blank row starts with the token after its indentation, the token and one following space are removed. Otherwise `token + " "` is inserted at the smallest indentation (in bytes) of the non-blank rows (Neovim `gc` padding, spec s6.3). Blank rows are untouched. Without a line token it falls back to block comments.
  - `bool ToggleBlockComment()` (Ctrl+Shift+/). Per selection: an empty selection inserts `begin + end` with the cursor between them. A selection whose trimmed text is already wrapped is unwrapped, together with one space just inside each token. Anything else is wrapped as `begin + text + end`, and the selection grows over the tokens. Without block tokens it falls back to line comments. Both return false when nothing applied.

```cpp
    // A grammar's comment tokens (.arcsyntax "comment", TE3). Empty = the language has none.
    struct CommentTokens
    {
        std::string line;         // "//", "#", "--"
        std::string blockBegin;   // "/*"
        std::string blockEnd;     // "*/"
    };
```

`TextCommands.cpp`:
```cpp
    bool TextCommands::ToggleLineComment()
    {
        const std::string& token = m_ctx.comment.line;
        if (token.empty())
            return !m_ctx.comment.blockBegin.empty() && !m_ctx.comment.blockEnd.empty() && ToggleBlockComment();
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> rows;
        for (const RowSpan& b : MergedRows(t, m_sels.All(), false))
            for (std::uint32_t r = b.first; r <= b.last; ++r) rows.push_back(r);

        std::size_t minIndent = std::string::npos;
        bool allCommented = true;
        bool any = false;
        for (const std::uint32_t r : rows)
        {
            const std::string line = LineText(t, r);
            const std::size_t ws = LeadingWhitespace(line);
            if (ws == line.size()) continue;   // blank rows neither decide nor change
            any = true;
            minIndent = std::min(minIndent, ws);
            if (line.compare(ws, token.size(), token) != 0) allCommented = false;
        }
        if (!any) return false;

        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const std::uint32_t r : rows)
        {
            const std::string line = LineText(t, r);
            const std::size_t ws = LeadingWhitespace(line);
            if (ws == line.size()) continue;
            const ByteOffset start = t.LineStart(r);
            if (allCommented)
            {
                std::size_t end = ws + token.size();
                if (end < line.size() && line[end] == ' ') ++end;
                ops.push_back({ { start + ws, start + end }, {} });
            }
            else
            {
                ops.push_back({ { start + minIndent, start + minIndent }, token + " " });
            }
        }
        EditAndMap(TransactionKind::Other, std::move(ops), Bias::Right, Bias::Left, Bias::Right);
        return true;
    }

    bool TextCommands::ToggleBlockComment()
    {
        const std::string& open = m_ctx.comment.blockBegin;
        const std::string& close = m_ctx.comment.blockEnd;
        if (open.empty() || close.empty()) return !m_ctx.comment.line.empty() && ToggleLineComment();
        const Rope& t = m_buffer.Text();
        EditEach(TransactionKind::Other, [&](const Selection& s) -> std::optional<SelectionEdit> {
            if (s.Empty())
            {
                return SelectionEdit{ { s.Range(), open + close }, open.size(), open.size() };
            }
            const std::string inner = t.Substr(s.Range());
            const std::size_t lead = inner.find_first_not_of(" \t\n");
            const std::size_t trail = inner.find_last_not_of(" \t\n");
            std::string text;
            if (lead != std::string::npos && trail + 1 >= lead + open.size() + close.size()
                && inner.compare(lead, open.size(), open) == 0 && inner.compare(trail + 1 - close.size(), close.size(), close) == 0)
            {
                std::size_t b = lead + open.size();
                if (b < inner.size() && inner[b] == ' ') ++b;
                std::size_t e = trail + 1 - close.size();
                if (e > b && inner[e - 1] == ' ') --e;
                text = inner.substr(0, lead) + inner.substr(b, e - b) + inner.substr(trail + 1);
            }
            else
            {
                text = open + inner + close;
            }
            const ByteOffset n = text.size();
            return SelectionEdit{ { s.Range(), text }, s.Reversed() ? n : 0, s.Reversed() ? 0 : n };
        });
        return true;
    }
```
(The two fallbacks cannot recurse forever. Each one calls the other only when the other's tokens are non-empty, and that call never falls back again.)

**Spec requirements this chunk does NOT place, and why**
- s3.5 size thresholds (`openMaxMB`, `syntaxMaxMB`, `longLineMaxBytes`, `multilineSearchMaxMB`): enforced where files open (TE2) and in the tokenizer and search (TE3/TE4). The core has no thresholds of its own.
- s3.5 append detection (size grew + 4 KB window hash, the Follow toggle, "clean or read-only only"): TE2-4 (classifier) and TE2-17 (poll, append, reload), per CANON B1; TE6-3 adds only the Follow cadence. The buffer only executes `AppendExternal`, and the tail is decoded by TE1-11's `DecodeFragment` (CANON B2). One note for that task: if the old file ended in a lone `\r` and the tail starts with `\n`, the pair is one CRLF on disk, so it must be treated as a full reload, not an append.
- s8 `detectIndentation`, `ensureFinalNewline`, `trimTrailingWhitespace`, `autoClosePairs`, and the view/syntax budgets: introduced by the tasks that use them (open/save in TE2, typing pairs with grammar `autoClose` in TE2/TE3, budgets in TE3).
- s4.6 bracket matching and `foldMarkers`; s7 expand selection to brackets, go to matching bracket, column select by keyboard, Alt+Enter: these need grammar brackets or scopes (TE3) or `TextSearch` (TE4). `FoldSource::Marker` and `ConfirmCursorCount` are the hooks they plug into.
- Grammar-driven indentation (`indent.increase/decrease`) in `Newline`: TE3 extends `EditContext`. TE1 copies the indentation only.
- UAX #29 Hangul jamo sequences (GB6-8), Prepend (GB9b) and Indic conjunct breaks (GB9c): outside the spec's stated subset. The `Graphemes.hpp` header says so.

**Spec gaps and conflicts found (and how this chunk resolved them)**
1. `TextSummary` cannot combine `longestLineBytes` across a join without the first row's length. Added `firstLineBytes` as a fifth member, at the end (a member addition, not a re-sign). CANON A1 adopts this as an amendment to the skeleton's binding `TextSummary`, and spec s3.1 is amended to match (CANON D2).
2. The binding `ReloadExternal(std::string, const SelectionSet&)` has no way to pass the reloaded file's line endings, and `AppendExternal(std::string_view)` has no way to pass the tail's. Added overloads taking an `EolMap`. The binding forms keep the dominant style.
3. Spec s8 says a project may override "line-ending defaults", but s8's list has no such name. Introduced `editor.text.defaultLineEnding` (LF/CRLF, PreferencesProject) for files with no break.
4. The spec names `ThirdParty/NOTICES`; the repo's file is `NOTICE.md` (the skeleton agrees). The sum_tree attribution goes in its "Reimplemented (not vendored)" list.
5. The settings inventory is marked FROZEN (S5-2). Every `editor.text.*` name here is recorded as a post-freeze addition: a `### Text editor` section in Part 3 plus rows in the "Post-freeze amendments" table, with `settings-frozen-names.txt` regenerated by the lint. The controller confirmed this route as binding for the whole plan (new rows into Part 3 plus the "Post-freeze amendments" table; frozen names regenerated by the lint, never by hand).
6. Spec s3.2 says anchors live in "sorted vectors". `AnchorSet` keeps stable ids (vim marks and bookmarks need them) in an unsorted slot vector, and shifts in O(anchors x log edits) through `EditShiftMap`. The cost is the same for single edits.
7. Spec s3.3 says ops are "sorted, non-overlapping". The buffer also requires strictly increasing begins, since two insertions at one offset have no defined order. In Release an invalid batch is refused, not applied.
8. Spec s4.4 does not bound the edit log. It keeps the newest 4096 batches (a marked capacity hint), and `EditLogCovers(v)` tells a consumer, i.e. TE3's highlight cache, when it must invalidate everything.
9. Undo grouping merges same-kind steps only: Typing with Typing, Deleting with Deleting. Spec s3.3 speaks of "consecutive typing transactions" (amended by CANON D4). Callers that compute their own selections, vim included, go through `TextCommands::ApplyEdits`, which groups by the same rule; no caller outside `TextCommands` opens raw transactions (s2.1).
10. Two further additions: `ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16` (a lone surrogate kept as WTF-8), and the binary sniff (NUL in the first 8 KB) applies only to UTF-8 decoding, since UTF-16 legitimately contains NULs and forced 1252 unlocks such files (spec s3.5).
11. The skeleton's binding `TextBuffer(Rope, EolMap)` gains a default argument: `explicit TextBuffer(Rope text, EolMap eols = {})` (CANON A2). The default `EolMap` is LF-dominant with no exceptions, so `TextBuffer(Rope::FromUtf8(s))` is the short form every later chunk uses. This is an additive change to the skeleton signature; nothing else in it is re-signed.
12. `Utf8::Append(std::string&, char32_t)` (TE1-1) is the single UTF-8 encoder for the whole plan (CANON B13): TE2-10's and TE5a-1's `AppendUtf8` are deleted in their chunks, and this chunk's codec, harness and tests already use `Utf8::Append`.
13. Reopen with Encoding clears undo history (CANON D5, controller ruling): the old text was decoded under another encoding, and undoing into it would put mis-decoded bytes back under the new label (Review Focus F3). `TextBuffer::ClearHistory()` exists for that one caller (TE2-15).
14. An appended tail has no BOM, so `DecodeFile` would mis-detect a UTF-16 tail as binary UTF-8 (Review Focus F2). `DecodeFragment` decodes in the document's known encoding; the encoding's identity string (`EncodingId`/`EncodingFromId`) and `EncodingHasBom` live beside it so no later chunk keeps a second name table (CANON B12).
15. Spec s5.3 says the history is cleared when "the reload's old text exceeds `undoMemoryMB`". The check uses the reload's WHOLE undo entry (`Weigh`: old and new middle plus both `EolMap`s), because that is what `Commit` charges against the cap. Checking the old text alone let `Commit` evict an over-cap entry silently, with no note and a Ctrl+Z that does nothing (review finding 1.6). Every case the spec's wording clears is still cleared.
16. A UTF-16 file whose body has an odd length keeps its encoding and HOLDS the stray byte (`DecodedText::heldBytes`). Before, it fell back to raw UTF-8, and every Follow tail after it decoded as UTF-8 with NULs (finding 1.8). TE2-15/TE2-17 sync to `size - heldBytes`.
17. A lone-CR row followed by an empty LF row cannot be written as `\r\n` without losing a line. `EncodeFile` writes that LF as CRLF (finding 1.9). This is the one place an encoded break differs from its `EolMap` style, and it happens only for a state that edits create and a file cannot express.

### Task TE2-1: The `.arctmp~` transient-file rule in every project scan (spec s5.3)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Project/TransientFiles.hpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Project/AssetRegistry.cpp:1-17` (include), `:323-331` (`AddFile` head), `:500-505` (`PeekId` head)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/Project/ContentDiscovery.cpp:1-10` (include), `:56-68` (`EnumerateContentSourceFiles` loop)
- Modify: `ArcaneAssetPipeline/src/Arcane/AssetPipeline/CookSession.cpp:1-20` (include), `:92-98` (`EnumerateSources` loop)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TransientFileRuleTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Arcane::AssetRegistry::{ScanContent, AddFile, PeekId}` (AssetRegistry.hpp:84-112), `Arcane::Editor::EnumerateContentSourceFiles`, `kDiscoveryExtensions` (ContentDiscovery.hpp:64-95).
- Produces: `inline constexpr std::string_view Arcane::kTransientSaveMarker = ".arctmp~";` and `[[nodiscard]] inline bool Arcane::IsTransientSaveFile(const std::filesystem::path& p);` -- TE2-3 (temp names), TE6 (crash-recovery snapshots, if they write beside files) rely on them.

The rule today is only *accidentally* true: `x.json.arctmp~12-1` has the extension `.arctmp~12-1`, which no kind table routes. A name like `x.arctmp~12-1.json` (or a future scan that keys on more than the extension) would be registered and get an id minted and written back into the temp file. One shared predicate closes that, and every scan of project files calls it.

```cpp
// Text editor TE2-1 (spec s5.3): a save's `.arctmp~` temp and backup never reach
// the asset registry, mid-session discovery or the cook -- one shared predicate.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Project/ContentDiscovery.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Project/AssetRegistry.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Project/TransientFiles.hpp>

#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace
{
    struct ScratchDir
    {
        std::filesystem::path dir;
        explicit ScratchDir(const char* name) : dir(std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / name)
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
            std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
        }
        ~ScratchDir()
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
        }
    };

    void WriteAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view bytes)
    {
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary).write(bytes.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    }

    std::string ReadAll(const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        std::ifstream in(p, std::ios::binary);
        return std::string(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    }
}

    CHECK(Arcane::IsTransientSaveFile(std::filesystem::path(L"\u00e9t\u00e9.txt.arctmp~9-9")));
    CHECK(Arcane::IsTransientSaveFile("x.arctmp~7-1.json"));
    CHECK_FALSE(Arcane::IsTransientSaveFile("a.json"));
    CHECK_FALSE(Arcane::IsTransientSaveFile("a.arctmp"));                              // no tilde: not the marker
    CHECK_FALSE(Arcane::IsTransientSaveFile("C:/odd.arctmp~/a.json"));                 // a folder name does not count
    CHECK(Arcane::kTransientSaveMarker == ".arctmp~");
}
```

`ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Project/TransientFiles.hpp`:
```cpp
#pragma once

// The `.arctmp~` rule (text editor spec s5.3). A text save writes
// `<name>.arctmp~<pid>-<n>` beside its target -- and, while ReplaceFileW runs,
// a `<name>.arctmp~<pid>-<n>.bak` backup -- then replaces the target. Every
// scan of project files asks THIS predicate, so a save never shows up as a
// created, deleted or imported file: the asset registry (ScanContent /
// AddContent / AddFile / PeekId), mid-session content discovery
// (ContentDiscovery.cpp) and the cook's source enumeration (CookSession.cpp).
// Header-only: ArcaneCore, ArcaneEditor and ArcaneAssetPipeline all include it.

#include <filesystem>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane
{
    // What every transient save file's NAME contains (never a folder's).
    inline constexpr std::string_view kTransientSaveMarker = ".arctmp~";

    [[nodiscard]] inline bool IsTransientSaveFile(const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        const std::u8string name = p.filename().u8string();
        const std::u8string_view marker(reinterpret_cast<const char8_t*>(kTransientSaveMarker.data()),
                                        kTransientSaveMarker.size());
        return name.find(marker) != std::u8string::npos;
    }
}
```

`ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Project/AssetRegistry.cpp` -- add after `#include <Arcane/Base/Log.hpp>` (line 5):
```cpp
#include <Arcane/Project/TransientFiles.hpp>   // the `.arctmp~` rule (text editor spec s5.3)
```
and make the head of `AddFile` (lines 323-331) read:
```cpp
    std::optional<Guid> AssetRegistry::AddFile(const std::filesystem::path& file,
                                               const std::filesystem::path& contentDir,
                                               std::string_view scheme)
    {
        // A text save's temp or backup (`.arctmp~`) is never an asset: not read,
        // not minted, not written to -- whatever extension the name ends with.
        if (IsTransientSaveFile(file))
            return std::nullopt;

        const std::string ext = LowerExt(file);

        // A .meta is a sidecar carrying another file's identity, not an asset itself.
        if (ext == ".meta")
            return std::nullopt;
```
and the head of `PeekId` (lines 500-505):
```cpp
    std::optional<Guid> AssetRegistry::PeekId(const std::filesystem::path& file)
    {
        if (IsTransientSaveFile(file))
            return std::nullopt;   // the `.arctmp~` rule: a save's temp never carries an identity
        std::error_code ec;
        if (!std::filesystem::is_regular_file(file, ec))
            return std::nullopt;   // the scan only ever sees files that exist
```

```cpp
// Text editor TE2-3 (spec s5.3): the save's pure decisions -- which step a save
// takes, how a ReplaceFileW failure classifies, the temp/backup names, and the
// self-save fingerprint's hash.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSavePlan.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Project/TransientFiles.hpp>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;

TEST_CASE("save plan: the step a save takes", "[text-io]")
{
    SaveFacts f;
    f.targetExists = false;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::CreateNew);                        // a new file: temp + MoveFileExW

    f.targetExists = true;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::ReplaceAtomic);                    // the ordinary save

    f.readOnlyAttribute = true;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::RefuseReadOnly);                   // D14: refused with the banner
    f.mode = SaveMode::OverwriteInPlace;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::RefuseReadOnly);                   // no mode writes through the attribute...
    f.mode = SaveMode::RemoveReadOnlyThenAtomic;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::ClearReadOnlyThenReplace);         // ...except the confirmed removal
    f.readOnlyAttribute = false;
    f.mode = SaveMode::Atomic;

    f.holders.push_back({ 4242, "game.exe", false });
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::AskAboutHolders);                  // a writer would be orphaned
    f.mode = SaveMode::AtomicSkipHolderCheck;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::ReplaceAtomic);                    // "Save anyway"
    f.mode = SaveMode::OverwriteInPlace;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::OverwriteInPlace);                 // "Overwrite in place"
    f.mode = SaveMode::Atomic;
    f.holders.clear();

    f.underFollow = true;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::AskAboutHolders);                  // always for a followed file
    f.underFollow = false;
    f.recentExternalWrite = true;
    CHECK(PlanSave(f) == SaveStep::AskAboutHolders);                  // ...and one written in the last recentWriteSeconds
}

TEST_CASE("save plan: the holder check runs only for an atomic replace of a writable existing file", "[text-io]")
{
    CHECK(NeedsHolderCheck(true, false, SaveMode::Atomic));
    CHECK_FALSE(NeedsHolderCheck(false, false, SaveMode::Atomic));
    CHECK_FALSE(NeedsHolderCheck(true, true, SaveMode::Atomic));
    CHECK_FALSE(NeedsHolderCheck(true, false, SaveMode::AtomicSkipHolderCheck));
    CHECK_FALSE(NeedsHolderCheck(true, false, SaveMode::OverwriteInPlace));
    CHECK_FALSE(NeedsHolderCheck(true, false, SaveMode::RemoveReadOnlyThenAtomic));
}

TEST_CASE("save plan: ReplaceFileW failures classify into the recovery the save runs", "[text-io]")
{
    CHECK(ClassifyReplaceFailure(Win32Error::kInvalidFunction) == ReplaceFailure::Unsupported);
    CHECK(ClassifyReplaceFailure(Win32Error::kNotSupported) == ReplaceFailure::Unsupported);
    CHECK(ClassifyReplaceFailure(Win32Error::kUnableToMoveReplacement) == ReplaceFailure::OriginalIntact);
    CHECK(ClassifyReplaceFailure(Win32Error::kUnableToRemoveReplaced) == ReplaceFailure::OriginalIntact);
    CHECK(ClassifyReplaceFailure(Win32Error::kUnableToMoveReplacement2) == ReplaceFailure::OriginalUnderBackup);
    CHECK(ClassifyReplaceFailure(Win32Error::kSharingViolation) == ReplaceFailure::SharingViolation);

    CHECK(Win32Error::kUnableToMoveReplacement == 1176u);
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextSavePlan.hpp`:
```cpp
#pragma once

// The text save's PURE half (text editor spec s5.3): which step a save takes,
// how a ReplaceFileW failure classifies, the `.arctmp~` temp/backup names and
// the self-save fingerprint. No <windows.h>: the Win32 error codes the save
// classifies are spelled here, and TextFileIO.cpp does the I/O.

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace Win32Error
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("Win32 vocabulary: winerror.h codes the text save path classifies")
        inline constexpr std::uint32_t kSuccess = 0, kInvalidFunction = 1, kFileNotFound = 2, kPathNotFound = 3,
                                       kAccessDenied = 5, kSharingViolation = 32, kLockViolation = 33,
                                       kNotSupported = 50, kDiskFull = 112, kUnableToRemoveReplaced = 1175,
                                       kUnableToMoveReplacement = 1176, kUnableToMoveReplacement2 = 1177;
    }

    // One stat of a file. mtime is the raw FILETIME (100 ns ticks) as an integer.
    struct FileStamp
    {
        bool          exists = false;
        std::uint64_t size = 0;
        std::int64_t  mtime = 0;
        std::uint32_t attributes = 0;
    };
    [[nodiscard]] bool SameStamp(const FileStamp& a, const FileStamp& b);

    // A process the Restart Manager says holds the file open.
    struct FileHolder
    {
        std::uint32_t pid = 0;
        std::string   appName;            // UTF-8, as the Restart Manager names it
        bool          thisProcess = false;
    };

    enum class SaveMode : std::uint8_t
    {
        Atomic,                    // the ordinary save: holders checked first
        AtomicSkipHolderCheck,     // "Save anyway": replace, detaching any writer
        OverwriteInPlace,          // truncate + rewrite through a write-shared handle (not atomic)
        RemoveReadOnlyThenAtomic,  // the confirmed "Remove read-only and save"
    };

    struct SaveFacts
    {
        bool targetExists = false;
        bool readOnlyAttribute = false;
        bool underFollow = false;            // the document follows the file (TE6 sets it)
        bool recentExternalWrite = false;    // written by someone else within editor.text.recentWriteSeconds
        std::vector<FileHolder> holders;     // the Restart Manager's answer (empty when not asked)
        SaveMode mode = SaveMode::Atomic;
    };

    enum class SaveStep : std::uint8_t
    {
        CreateNew,                 // temp + MoveFileExW(MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH)
        ReplaceAtomic,             // temp + ReplaceFileW (MoveFileExW fallback where unsupported)
        OverwriteInPlace,
        ClearReadOnlyThenReplace,
        RefuseReadOnly,            // banner: Save As..., Remove read-only and save (confirmed)
        AskAboutHolders,           // banner: Overwrite in place / Save anyway / Cancel
    };
    [[nodiscard]] SaveStep PlanSave(const SaveFacts& facts);
    // The Restart Manager is asked only when its answer can change the step.
    [[nodiscard]] bool NeedsHolderCheck(bool targetExists, bool readOnlyAttribute, SaveMode mode);

    enum class ReplaceFailure : std::uint8_t
    {
        Unsupported,          // ERROR_INVALID_FUNCTION / ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED: fall back to MoveFileExW
        OriginalIntact,       // _REPLACEMENT (1176) / REMOVE_REPLACED (1175, backup named): delete the temp
        OriginalUnderBackup,  // _REPLACEMENT_2 (1177): move the backup back first
        SharingViolation,
        AccessDenied,
        Other,
    };
    [[nodiscard]] ReplaceFailure ClassifyReplaceFailure(std::uint32_t win32Error);

    // `<target>.arctmp~<pid>-<serial>`, beside the target (same volume, so
    // ReplaceFileW and MoveFileExW never copy across volumes).
    [[nodiscard]] std::filesystem::path TransientSavePath(const std::filesystem::path& target,
                                                          std::uint32_t pid, std::uint32_t serial);
    [[nodiscard]] std::filesystem::path TransientBackupPath(const std::filesystem::path& temp);   // temp + ".bak"
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t NextTransientSerial();   // process-wide, thread-safe, starts at 1

    // What a save wrote (spec s5.3 self-save suppression).
    struct FileFingerprint
    {
        std::uint64_t size = 0;
        std::int64_t  mtime = 0;
        std::uint64_t hash = 0;
        bool          valid = false;
    };
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t HashBytes(std::string_view bytes);   // FNV-1a 64
    [[nodiscard]] FileFingerprint FingerprintOf(std::string_view bytes, std::int64_t mtime);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextSavePlan.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSavePlan.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Project/TransientFiles.hpp>

#include <atomic>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    bool SameStamp(const FileStamp& a, const FileStamp& b)
    {
        if (a.exists != b.exists) return false;
        if (!a.exists) return true;
        return a.size == b.size && a.mtime == b.mtime;
    }

    SaveStep PlanSave(const SaveFacts& f)
    {
        if (!f.targetExists)
            return SaveStep::CreateNew;
        if (f.readOnlyAttribute)
            return f.mode == SaveMode::RemoveReadOnlyThenAtomic ? SaveStep::ClearReadOnlyThenReplace
                                                                : SaveStep::RefuseReadOnly;
        if (f.mode == SaveMode::OverwriteInPlace)
            return SaveStep::OverwriteInPlace;
        if (f.mode == SaveMode::Atomic && (!f.holders.empty() || f.underFollow || f.recentExternalWrite))
            return SaveStep::AskAboutHolders;
        return SaveStep::ReplaceAtomic;
    }

    bool NeedsHolderCheck(bool targetExists, bool readOnlyAttribute, SaveMode mode)
    {
        return targetExists && !readOnlyAttribute && mode == SaveMode::Atomic;
    }

    ReplaceFailure ClassifyReplaceFailure(std::uint32_t e)
    {
        using namespace Win32Error;
        if (e == kInvalidFunction || e == kNotSupported)               return ReplaceFailure::Unsupported;
        if (e == kUnableToMoveReplacement || e == kUnableToRemoveReplaced) return ReplaceFailure::OriginalIntact;
        if (e == kUnableToMoveReplacement2)                            return ReplaceFailure::OriginalUnderBackup;
        if (e == kSharingViolation || e == kLockViolation)            return ReplaceFailure::SharingViolation;
        if (e == kAccessDenied)                                        return ReplaceFailure::AccessDenied;
        return ReplaceFailure::Other;
    }

    std::filesystem::path TransientSavePath(const std::filesystem::path& target, std::uint32_t pid, std::uint32_t serial)
    {
        std::filesystem::path p = target;
        p += std::string(Arcane::kTransientSaveMarker) + std::to_string(pid) + "-" + std::to_string(serial);
        return p;
    }

    std::filesystem::path TransientBackupPath(const std::filesystem::path& temp)
    {
        std::filesystem::path p = temp;
        p += ".bak";
        return p;
    }

    std::uint32_t NextTransientSerial()
    {
        static std::atomic<std::uint32_t> serial{ 0 };
        return serial.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed) + 1;
    }

    std::uint64_t HashBytes(std::string_view bytes)
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("algorithm: FNV-1a 64-bit offset basis and prime")
        constexpr std::uint64_t kBasis = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull, kPrime = 0x100000001b3ull;
        std::uint64_t h = kBasis;
        for (const char c : bytes)
        {
            h ^= static_cast<std::uint8_t>(c);
            h *= kPrime;
        }
        return h;
    }

    FileFingerprint FingerprintOf(std::string_view bytes, std::int64_t mtime)
    {
        return FileFingerprint{ bytes.size(), mtime, HashBytes(bytes), true };
    }
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// External-change classification (text editor spec s3.5, s5.3): what a fresh
// stat of an open text file means against what the document last synced, and
// what the document does about it. Pure; TextDocument::PollDisk feeds it.

#include "TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSavePlan.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    ARC_CONSTANT("spec s3.5: append detection hashes the 4 KB window just before the old end of the file")
    inline constexpr std::uint64_t kAppendWindowBytes = 4096;

    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t AppendWindowStart(std::uint64_t oldSize);

    // What the document knows about the bytes it holds.
    struct SyncedFileState
    {
        FileStamp       stamp;              // the stat the buffer equals
        std::uint64_t   windowHash = 0;     // HashBytes of [AppendWindowStart(size), size)
        std::uint16_t   lastUnit = 0;       // the file's last code unit (byte, or UTF-16 unit); 0 = empty
        FileFingerprint selfSave;           // what our last save wrote (spec s5.3 self-save suppression)
    };

    enum class DiskChange : std::uint8_t { None, SelfSave, Appended, Truncated, Rewritten, Deleted, Recreated };

    // `windowHashNow`: HashBytes of the file's bytes at [AppendWindowStart(synced
    // size), synced size) read NOW -- only meaningful when the file grew; nullopt
    // when it was not (or could not be) read, which classifies as Rewritten.
    [[nodiscard]] DiskChange ClassifyDiskChange(const SyncedFileState& synced, const FileStamp& now,
                                                std::optional<std::uint64_t> windowHashNow);

    enum class DiskAction : std::uint8_t { Ignore, AcceptSelfSave, AppendTail, SilentReload, DirtyBanner, DeletedBanner };
    // Append only when the document is clean or read-only (spec s3.5); a tail
    // that would turn the last lone CR into CRLF reloads instead.
    [[nodiscard]] DiskAction DecideDiskAction(DiskChange change, bool dirty, bool readOnly, bool tailSplitsCrLf);

    // The longest prefix of an appended tail that holds only whole characters.
    // Utf8Bom behaves as Utf8 in all three (the BOM sits at offset 0, never in a tail).
    [[nodiscard]] std::size_t CompleteTailLength(std::string_view tail, Text::TextEncoding encoding);
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint16_t LastUnitOf(std::string_view bytes, Text::TextEncoding encoding);
    [[nodiscard]] bool TailSplitsCrLf(std::uint16_t lastUnit, std::string_view tail, Text::TextEncoding encoding);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextChangeClassifier.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextChangeClassifier.hpp"

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        bool IsUtf16(Text::TextEncoding e) { return e == Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE || e == Text::TextEncoding::Utf16BE; }

        std::uint16_t Unit16(std::string_view bytes, std::size_t at, Text::TextEncoding e)
        {
            const auto b0 = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(bytes[at]);
            const auto b1 = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(bytes[at + 1]);
            return e == Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE ? static_cast<std::uint16_t>(b0 | (b1 << 8))
                                                : static_cast<std::uint16_t>((b0 << 8) | b1);
        }

        // Expected length of a UTF-8 sequence from its lead byte; 0 = not a lead.
        std::size_t Utf8SequenceLength(std::uint8_t lead)
        {
            if (lead < 0x80) return 1;
            if ((lead & 0xE0) == 0xC0) return 2;
            if ((lead & 0xF0) == 0xE0) return 3;
            if ((lead & 0xF8) == 0xF0) return 4;
            return 0;
        }
    }

    std::uint64_t AppendWindowStart(std::uint64_t oldSize)
    {
        return oldSize > kAppendWindowBytes ? oldSize - kAppendWindowBytes : 0;
    }

    DiskChange ClassifyDiskChange(const SyncedFileState& synced, const FileStamp& now,
                                  std::optional<std::uint64_t> windowHashNow)
    {
        if (!now.exists)
            return synced.stamp.exists ? DiskChange::Deleted : DiskChange::None;
        if (!synced.stamp.exists)
            return DiskChange::Recreated;
        if (now.size == synced.stamp.size && now.mtime == synced.stamp.mtime)
            return DiskChange::None;
        if (synced.selfSave.valid && now.size == synced.selfSave.size && now.mtime == synced.selfSave.mtime)
            return DiskChange::SelfSave;
        if (now.size < synced.stamp.size)
            return DiskChange::Truncated;
        if (now.size > synced.stamp.size && windowHashNow && *windowHashNow == synced.windowHash)
            return DiskChange::Appended;
        return DiskChange::Rewritten;
    }

    DiskAction DecideDiskAction(DiskChange change, bool dirty, bool readOnly, bool tailSplitsCrLf)
    {
        const bool mayReplaceText = !dirty || readOnly;
        switch (change)
        {
        case DiskChange::None:      return DiskAction::Ignore;
        case DiskChange::SelfSave:  return DiskAction::AcceptSelfSave;
        case DiskChange::Deleted:   return DiskAction::DeletedBanner;
        case DiskChange::Appended:
            if (!mayReplaceText) return DiskAction::DirtyBanner;
            return tailSplitsCrLf ? DiskAction::SilentReload : DiskAction::AppendTail;
        case DiskChange::Truncated:
        case DiskChange::Rewritten:
        case DiskChange::Recreated:
            return mayReplaceText ? DiskAction::SilentReload : DiskAction::DirtyBanner;
        }
        return DiskAction::Ignore;
    }

    std::size_t CompleteTailLength(std::string_view tail, Text::TextEncoding encoding)
    {
        if (encoding == Text::TextEncoding::Windows1252)
            return tail.size();
        if (IsUtf16(encoding))
        {
            std::size_t n = tail.size() & ~std::size_t{ 1 };
            if (n >= 2)
            {
                const std::uint16_t last = Unit16(tail, n - 2, encoding);
                if (last >= 0xD800 && last <= 0xDBFF)
                    n -= 2;   // a high surrogate waits for its low half
            }
            return n;
        }
        // UTF-8: find the last lead byte within 3 bytes of the end; if its
        // sequence runs past the end, the tail stops before it.
        const std::size_t size = tail.size();
        for (std::size_t back = 1; back <= 4 && back <= size; ++back)
        {
            const auto b = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(tail[size - back]);
            if ((b & 0xC0) == 0x80)
                continue;   // a continuation byte: keep looking for its lead
            const std::size_t len = Utf8SequenceLength(b);
            if (len == 0 || len <= back)
                return size;          // ASCII, an invalid lead, or a complete sequence
            return size - back;       // the sequence is cut: hold it back
        }
        return size;                  // only continuation bytes: invalid bytes, each its own cluster
    }

    std::uint16_t LastUnitOf(std::string_view bytes, Text::TextEncoding encoding)
    {
        if (IsUtf16(encoding))
            return bytes.size() >= 2 ? Unit16(bytes, (bytes.size() & ~std::size_t{ 1 }) - 2, encoding) : 0;
        return bytes.empty() ? 0 : static_cast<std::uint8_t>(bytes.back());
    }

    bool TailSplitsCrLf(std::uint16_t lastUnit, std::string_view tail, Text::TextEncoding encoding)
    {
        if (lastUnit != u'\r')
            return false;
        if (IsUtf16(encoding))
            return tail.size() >= 2 && Unit16(tail, 0, encoding) == u'\n';
        return !tail.empty() && tail.front() == '\n';
    }
}
```

```cpp
// Text editor TE2-5 (spec s5.3): reads share READ|WRITE|DELETE so a running
// writer keeps writing; the canonical path collapses case, 8.3 names and
// junctions into one document key.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp"

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cwctype>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;

namespace
{
    struct ScratchDir
    {
        std::filesystem::path dir;
        explicit ScratchDir(const char* name) : dir(std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / name)
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
            std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
        }
        ~ScratchDir()
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
        }
    };

    void WriteAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view bytes)
    {
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary).write(bytes.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    }
}

TEST_CASE("text file io: a file another handle holds open for writing still reads", "[text-io]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-read-shared");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "game.log";
    WriteAll(p, "line 1\nline 2\n");
    HANDLE writer = ::CreateFileW(p.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE, nullptr,
                                  OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
    REQUIRE(writer != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE);

    // A reader that does not share WRITE is refused while the writer holds the file...
    HANDLE plain = ::CreateFileW(p.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
    const DWORD plainError = ::GetLastError();
    CHECK(plain == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE);
    CHECK(plainError == ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION);
    if (plain != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) ::CloseHandle(plain);

    // ...the text editor's read shares READ|WRITE|DELETE and gets the bytes.
    const ReadOutcome r = ReadFileShared(p, 1024);
    CHECK(r.ok);
    CHECK(r.bytes == "line 1\nline 2\n");
    CHECK(r.stamp.exists);
    CHECK(r.stamp.size == 14u);

    // The writer keeps writing; a range read sees the new tail.
    DWORD wrote = 0;
    ::SetFilePointer(writer, 0, nullptr, FILE_END);
    REQUIRE(::WriteFile(writer, "line 3\n", 7, &wrote, nullptr));
    const auto tail = ReadRangeShared(p, 14, 7);
    REQUIRE(tail.has_value());
    CHECK(*tail == "line 3\n");
    CHECK(StatFile(p).size == 21u);
    ::CloseHandle(writer);
}

TEST_CASE("text file io: the size limit, a missing file and the stat", "[text-io]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-read-limits");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "notes.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "0123456789");
    const ReadOutcome big = ReadFileShared(p, 4);
    CHECK_FALSE(big.ok);
    CHECK(big.tooLarge);
    CHECK(big.bytes.empty());
    CHECK(big.stamp.size == 10u);                      // the stat is still reported

    const ReadOutcome missing = ReadFileShared(s.dir / "gone.txt", 1024);
    CHECK_FALSE(missing.ok);
    CHECK(missing.win32Error == ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND);
    CHECK_FALSE(StatFile(s.dir / "gone.txt").exists);

    REQUIRE(::SetFileAttributesW(p.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY));
    const FileStamp st = StatFile(p);
    CHECK(st.exists);
    CHECK(st.size == 10u);
    CHECK((st.attributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) != 0);
    CHECK(st.mtime != 0);
    REQUIRE(::SetFileAttributesW(p.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL));
    CHECK(FileIndexOf(p) != 0u);
}

{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-canonical");

    std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);

    WriteAll(p, "x");

    const auto canon = CanonicalFilePath(p);
    REQUIRE(canon.has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(canon->wstring().starts_with(L"\\\\?\\"));   // the \\?\ prefix is stripped

    std::wstring upper = p.wstring();
    std::transform(upper.begin(), upper.end(), upper.begin(), [](wchar_t c) { return static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towupper(c)); });
    CHECK(CanonicalFilePath(upper) == canon);                 // case

    std::wstring shortName(32768, L'\0');
    const DWORD n = ::GetShortPathNameW(p.c_str(), shortName.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(shortName.size()));
    shortName.resize(n);
    if (n == 0 || std::filesystem::path(shortName) == p)
        WARN("8.3 names are disabled on this volume -- the short-name leg did not run");
    else
        CHECK(CanonicalFilePath(shortName) == canon);         // 8.3

    const std::filesystem::path link = s.dir / "jn";
    const std::wstring cmd = L"cmd /c mklink /J \"" + link.wstring() + L"\" \"" + dir.wstring() + L"\" >nul 2>&1";
    if (_wsystem(cmd.c_str()) == 0)
    {
        CHECK(CanonicalFilePath(link / "ReadMe.Notes.md") == canon);   // junction
        ::RemoveDirectoryW(link.c_str());                             // the junction only, never its target
    }
    else
        WARN("mklink /J failed -- the junction leg did not run");

    CHECK_FALSE(CanonicalFilePath(dir / "missing.md").has_value());
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// TextFileIO (text editor spec s5.3): the Windows file layer under
// TextDocument. Reads open with FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE |
// FILE_SHARE_DELETE, so a running game (or the editor's own logger) keeps
// writing, rotating or deleting the file being viewed. Identity is the
// canonical path from GetFinalPathNameByHandleW (case, 8.3 names, junctions
// and symlinks resolved). Saves (TE2-6) and holder checks (TE2-7) live here too.

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSavePlan.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <optional>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct ReadOutcome
    {
        bool          ok = false;
        bool          tooLarge = false;   // above maxBytes: nothing read (the stamp is still filled)
        std::uint32_t win32Error = 0;
        std::string   bytes;
        FileStamp     stamp;              // on success stamp.size == bytes.size()
    };

    [[nodiscard]] ReadOutcome ReadFileShared(const std::filesystem::path& path, std::uint64_t maxBytes);
    // [offset, offset + length), shorter when the file is shorter; nullopt when it cannot be opened.
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::string> ReadRangeShared(const std::filesystem::path& path,
                                                             std::uint64_t offset, std::uint64_t length);
    [[nodiscard]] FileStamp StatFile(const std::filesystem::path& path);
    // GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(FILE_NAME_NORMALIZED | VOLUME_NAME_DOS) with the
    // \\?\ (and \\?\UNC\) prefix stripped; nullopt when the file cannot be opened.
    // Known limit (spec s5.3): two hard links to one file stay two keys.
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::filesystem::path> CanonicalFilePath(const std::filesystem::path& path);
    // nFileIndexHigh:Low, 0 when unreadable (ReplaceFileW changes it; overwrite in place does not).
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t FileIndexOf(const std::filesystem::path& path);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp"

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        // Every text-editor open shares all three ways (spec s5.3).
        constexpr DWORD kShareAll = FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE;

        struct Handle
        {
            HANDLE h = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
            explicit Handle(HANDLE v) : h(v) {}
            ~Handle() { if (h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) ::CloseHandle(h); }
            Handle(const Handle&) = delete;
            Handle& operator=(const Handle&) = delete;
            [[nodiscard]] bool Valid() const { return h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE; }
        };

        std::int64_t ToInt64(const FILETIME& ft)
        {
            return static_cast<std::int64_t>((static_cast<std::uint64_t>(ft.dwHighDateTime) << 32) | ft.dwLowDateTime);
        }

        std::uint64_t ToUInt64(DWORD high, DWORD low)
        {
            return (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(high) << 32) | low;
        }

        // Reads up to `length` bytes from the handle's position; a file that
        // shrank mid-read returns what was there.
        bool ReadUpTo(HANDLE h, std::uint64_t length, std::string& out)
        {
            out.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(length));
            std::uint64_t done = 0;
            while (done < length)
            {
                const DWORD chunk = static_cast<DWORD>(std::min<std::uint64_t>(length - done, std::uint64_t{ 1 } << 30));
                DWORD got = 0;
                if (!::ReadFile(h, out.data() + done, chunk, &got, nullptr))
                    return false;
                if (got == 0)
                    break;
                done += got;
            }
            out.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(done));
            return true;
        }
    }

    ReadOutcome ReadFileShared(const std::filesystem::path& path, std::uint64_t maxBytes)
    {
        ReadOutcome r;
        const Handle h(::CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, kShareAll, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
                                     FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL | FILE_FLAG_SEQUENTIAL_SCAN, nullptr));
        if (!h.Valid())
        {
            r.win32Error = ::GetLastError();
            return r;
        }
        BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION info{};
        if (!::GetFileInformationByHandle(h.h, &info))
        {
            r.win32Error = ::GetLastError();
            return r;
        }
        const std::uint64_t size = ToUInt64(info.nFileSizeHigh, info.nFileSizeLow);
        r.stamp = FileStamp{ true, size, ToInt64(info.ftLastWriteTime), info.dwFileAttributes };
        if (size > maxBytes)
        {
            r.tooLarge = true;
            return r;
        }
        if (!ReadUpTo(h.h, size, r.bytes))
        {
            r.win32Error = ::GetLastError();
            r.bytes.clear();
            return r;
        }
        r.stamp.size = r.bytes.size();
        r.ok = true;
        return r;
    }

    std::optional<std::string> ReadRangeShared(const std::filesystem::path& path, std::uint64_t offset, std::uint64_t length)
    {
        const Handle h(::CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, kShareAll, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr));
        if (!h.Valid())
            return std::nullopt;
        LARGE_INTEGER at{};
        at.QuadPart = static_cast<LONGLONG>(offset);
        if (!::SetFilePointerEx(h.h, at, nullptr, FILE_BEGIN))
            return std::nullopt;
        std::string out;
        if (!ReadUpTo(h.h, length, out))
            return std::nullopt;
        return out;
    }

    FileStamp StatFile(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA data{};
        if (!::GetFileAttributesExW(path.c_str(), GetFileExInfoStandard, &data))
            return FileStamp{};
        return FileStamp{ true, ToUInt64(data.nFileSizeHigh, data.nFileSizeLow), ToInt64(data.ftLastWriteTime),
                          data.dwFileAttributes };
    }

    std::optional<std::filesystem::path> CanonicalFilePath(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        const Handle h(::CreateFileW(path.c_str(), FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, kShareAll, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
                                     FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS, nullptr));
        if (!h.Valid())
            return std::nullopt;
        std::wstring buf(MAX_PATH, L'\0');
        DWORD n = ::GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(h.h, buf.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(buf.size()),
                                              FILE_NAME_NORMALIZED | VOLUME_NAME_DOS);
        if (n == 0)
            return std::nullopt;
        if (n >= buf.size())   // too small: n is the size needed, terminator included
        {
            buf.assign(n, L'\0');
            n = ::GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(h.h, buf.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(buf.size()),
                                            FILE_NAME_NORMALIZED | VOLUME_NAME_DOS);
            if (n == 0 || n >= buf.size())
                return std::nullopt;
        }
        buf.resize(n);
        constexpr std::wstring_view kUncPrefix = L"\\\\?\\UNC\\";
        constexpr std::wstring_view kLocalPrefix = L"\\\\?\\";
        if (std::wstring_view(buf).starts_with(kUncPrefix))
            return std::filesystem::path(L"\\\\" + buf.substr(kUncPrefix.size()));
        if (std::wstring_view(buf).starts_with(kLocalPrefix))
            return std::filesystem::path(buf.substr(kLocalPrefix.size()));
        return std::filesystem::path(buf);
    }

    std::uint64_t FileIndexOf(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        const Handle h(::CreateFileW(path.c_str(), FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, kShareAll, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
                                     FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS, nullptr));
        BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION info{};
        if (!h.Valid() || !::GetFileInformationByHandle(h.h, &info))
            return 0;
        return ToUInt64(info.nFileIndexHigh, info.nFileIndexLow);
    }
}
```
