### Task TE2-6: TextFileIO saves -- `.arctmp~` temp, `ReplaceFileW`, create path, fallback, partial-failure recovery, read-only, overwrite in place (spec s5.3)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp` (append the save API), `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.cpp` (append the implementation)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextFileSaveTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `PlanSave`, `NeedsHolderCheck`, `ClassifyReplaceFailure`, `TransientSavePath`, `TransientBackupPath`, `NextTransientSerial`, `FingerprintOf`, `Win32Error` (TE2-3); `StatFile`, `FileIndexOf` (TE2-5).
- Produces: `struct SaveFileOps { std::uint32_t (*replaceFile)(const wchar_t*, const wchar_t*, const wchar_t*); std::uint32_t (*moveFile)(const wchar_t*, const wchar_t*, std::uint32_t); std::vector<FileHolder> (*listHolders)(const std::filesystem::path&); }`; `const SaveFileOps& RealSaveFileOps()`; `namespace MoveFlags { kReplaceExisting, kWriteThrough }`; `enum class SaveStatus : std::uint8_t { Saved, SavedWithoutAclPreservation, ReadOnlyAttribute, AccessDenied, SharingViolation, HoldersPresent, RecoveredOriginalIntact, RecoveredFromBackup, RecoveryFailed, WriteFailed }`; `constexpr bool SavedOk(SaveStatus)`; `struct SaveRequest { std::filesystem::path target; std::string_view bytes; SaveMode mode; bool underFollow; bool recentExternalWrite; std::uint32_t pid; }`; `struct SaveOutcome { SaveStatus status; std::uint32_t win32Error; std::vector<FileHolder> holders; bool overwriteInPlaceAvailable; std::filesystem::path tempPath, backupPath; FileFingerprint written; }`; `SaveOutcome SaveFileBytes(const SaveRequest&, const SaveFileOps& = RealSaveFileOps())`; `bool ProbeWriteShared(const std::filesystem::path&)`.

`ReplaceFileW` gets an explicit backup name (`<temp>.bak`) so `ERROR_UNABLE_TO_MOVE_REPLACEMENT_2` leaves the original at a known name the save moves back. `ReplaceFileW` may report a target held without delete sharing as `ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION`, `ERROR_UNABLE_TO_REMOVE_REPLACED` or `ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED`; on the last two the save probes the target with a `DELETE` open and reports a sharing violation when that open fails with one, so the in-use banner appears whichever code the volume returns (TE2-7 records the code a real holder produces).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

`ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextFileSaveTest.cpp`:
```cpp
// Text editor TE2-6 (spec s5.3): the save writes `.arctmp~` beside the target and
// replaces through ReplaceFileW; creates through MoveFileExW; falls back where
// ReplaceFileW is unsupported; recovers _REPLACEMENT / _2; refuses a read-only
// file; overwrites in place keeping the file index. Partial failures are
// injected through SaveFileOps.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Project/TransientFiles.hpp>

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#include <aclapi.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "advapi32.lib")   // GetNamedSecurityInfoW / SetEntriesInAclW / SetNamedSecurityInfoW

#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;

namespace
{
    struct ScratchDir
    {
        std::filesystem::path dir;
        explicit ScratchDir(const char* name) : dir(std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / name)
        {
            Clear();
            std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
        }
        ~ScratchDir() { Clear(); }
        void Clear()
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            if (std::filesystem::exists(dir, ec))
                for (const auto& e : std::filesystem::recursive_directory_iterator(dir, ec))
                    ::SetFileAttributesW(e.path().c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL);
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
        }
    };

    void WriteAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view bytes)
    {
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary).write(bytes.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    }

    std::string ReadAll(const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        std::ifstream in(p, std::ios::binary);
        return std::string(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    }

    int TransientFilesIn(const std::filesystem::path& dir)
    {
        int n = 0;
        for (const auto& e : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(dir))
            if (Arcane::IsTransientSaveFile(e.path())) ++n;
        return n;
    }

    bool OnNtfs(const std::filesystem::path& dir)
    {
        wchar_t root[MAX_PATH] = {};
        wchar_t fs[MAX_PATH] = {};
        return ::GetVolumePathNameW(dir.c_str(), root, MAX_PATH)
            && ::GetVolumeInformationW(root, nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, fs, MAX_PATH)
            && std::wstring_view(fs) == L"NTFS";
    }

    // ---- DACL helpers (finding 6.16, s11.4: ReplaceFileW keeps the ACLs) ----
    // BUILTIN\Guests: a trustee a temp file never carries an EXPLICIT entry for, so
    // an explicit allow entry for it can only be the one this test added.
    std::vector<BYTE> GuestsSid()
    {
        DWORD size = SECURITY_MAX_SID_SIZE;
        std::vector<BYTE> sid(size, 0);
        if (!::CreateWellKnownSid(WinBuiltinGuestsSid, nullptr, sid.data(), &size))
            sid.clear();
        return sid;
    }

    // Adds an explicit (non-inherited) allow entry to the file's DACL.
    DWORD AddExplicitAllow(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::vector<BYTE>& sid, DWORD mask)
    {
        PACL oldDacl = nullptr;
        PSECURITY_DESCRIPTOR sd = nullptr;
        DWORD rc = ::GetNamedSecurityInfoW(p.c_str(), SE_FILE_OBJECT, DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION,
                                           nullptr, nullptr, &oldDacl, nullptr, &sd);
        if (rc != ERROR_SUCCESS)
            return rc;
        EXPLICIT_ACCESSW ea{};
        ea.grfAccessPermissions = mask;
        ea.grfAccessMode = GRANT_ACCESS;
        ea.grfInheritance = NO_INHERITANCE;
        ea.Trustee.TrusteeForm = TRUSTEE_IS_SID;
        ea.Trustee.TrusteeType = TRUSTEE_IS_WELL_KNOWN_GROUP;
        ea.Trustee.ptstrName = reinterpret_cast<LPWSTR>(sid.data());
        PACL newDacl = nullptr;
        rc = ::SetEntriesInAclW(1, &ea, oldDacl, &newDacl);
        if (rc == ERROR_SUCCESS)
            rc = ::SetNamedSecurityInfoW(const_cast<wchar_t*>(p.c_str()), SE_FILE_OBJECT, DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION,
                                         nullptr, nullptr, newDacl, nullptr);
        ::LocalFree(newDacl);
        ::LocalFree(sd);
        return rc;
    }

    // True when the file's DACL holds an EXPLICIT allow entry for `sid` granting `mask`.
    bool HasExplicitAllow(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::vector<BYTE>& sid, DWORD mask)
    {
        PACL dacl = nullptr;
        PSECURITY_DESCRIPTOR sd = nullptr;
        if (::GetNamedSecurityInfoW(p.c_str(), SE_FILE_OBJECT, DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION,
                                    nullptr, nullptr, &dacl, nullptr, &sd) != ERROR_SUCCESS)
            return false;
        bool found = false;
        ACL_SIZE_INFORMATION info{};
        if (dacl && ::GetAclInformation(dacl, &info, sizeof(info), AclSizeInformation))
            for (DWORD i = 0; i < info.AceCount && !found; ++i)
            {
                void* raw = nullptr;
                if (!::GetAce(dacl, i, &raw))
                    continue;
                const auto* header = static_cast<const ACE_HEADER*>(raw);
                if (header->AceType != ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE_TYPE || (header->AceFlags & INHERITED_ACE) != 0)
                    continue;
                auto* ace = static_cast<ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE*>(raw);
                found = (ace->Mask & mask) == mask && ::EqualSid(reinterpret_cast<PSID>(&ace->SidStart), sid.data());
            }
        ::LocalFree(sd);
        return found;
    }

    // ---- injected partial failures ---------------------------------------
    std::uint32_t g_replaceError = 0;
    bool g_renameToBackup = false;      // simulate _2: the original now sits under the backup name
    bool g_failBackupRestore = false;   // the move back fails too

    std::uint32_t FakeReplace(const wchar_t* replaced, const wchar_t* /*replacement*/, const wchar_t* backup)
    {
        if (g_renameToBackup)
            ::MoveFileExW(replaced, backup, 0);
        return g_replaceError;
    }

    std::uint32_t FakeMove(const wchar_t* from, const wchar_t* to, std::uint32_t flags)
    {
        if (g_failBackupRestore && std::wstring_view(from).ends_with(L".bak"))
            return ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED;
        return ::MoveFileExW(from, to, flags) ? 0u : ::GetLastError();
    }

    SaveFileOps FakeOps(std::uint32_t replaceError, bool renameToBackup = false, bool failBackupRestore = false)
    {
        g_replaceError = replaceError;
        g_renameToBackup = renameToBackup;
        g_failBackupRestore = failBackupRestore;
        SaveFileOps o;
        o.replaceFile = &FakeReplace;
        o.moveFile = &FakeMove;
        return o;
    }

    // ---- injected Restart Manager answers (finding 2.7) ----------------------
    std::vector<FileHolder> OnlyThisProcess(const std::filesystem::path&)
    {
        return { FileHolder{ static_cast<std::uint32_t>(::GetCurrentProcessId()), "ArcaneEditor.exe", true } };
    }

    std::vector<FileHolder> AGameAndThisProcess(const std::filesystem::path&)
    {
        return { FileHolder{ 4242u, "Game.exe", false },
                 FileHolder{ static_cast<std::uint32_t>(::GetCurrentProcessId()), "ArcaneEditor.exe", true } };
    }
}

TEST_CASE("text save: a new file is created through the temp; an existing one is replaced", "[text-io]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-save-basic");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "notes.md";

    const SaveOutcome created = SaveFileBytes({ p, "first\n" });
    CHECK(created.status == SaveStatus::Saved);
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == "first\n");
    CHECK(TransientFilesIn(s.dir) == 0);
    CHECK(created.written.valid);
    CHECK(created.written.size == 6u);
    CHECK(created.written.hash == HashBytes("first\n"));
    CHECK(created.written.mtime == StatFile(p).mtime);

    const std::uint64_t indexBefore = FileIndexOf(p);
    const SaveOutcome replaced = SaveFileBytes({ p, "second\n" });
    CHECK(replaced.status == SaveStatus::Saved);
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == "second\n");
    CHECK(TransientFilesIn(s.dir) == 0);                  // temp moved in, backup deleted
    CHECK(FileIndexOf(p) != indexBefore);                 // ReplaceFileW: a new file object (spec s5.3)
}

TEST_CASE("text save: ReplaceFileW keeps the original's creation time, named streams, DACL entries and attributes", "[text-io]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-save-preserve");
    if (!OnNtfs(s.dir))
    {
        WARN("the temp volume is not NTFS -- named streams and ACLs cannot be checked");
        return;
    }
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "config.ini";
    WriteAll(p, "a=1\n");
    WriteAll(p.wstring() + L":arcane.note", "kept");
    FILETIME created{};
    created.dwHighDateTime = 0x01D00000;                   // a fixed past creation time
    {
        HANDLE h = ::CreateFileW(p.c_str(), FILE_WRITE_ATTRIBUTES, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
        REQUIRE(h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE);
        REQUIRE(::SetFileTime(h, &created, nullptr, nullptr));
        ::CloseHandle(h);
    }
    // Finding 6.16 (s11.4): an explicit DACL entry and the hidden + archive bits the
    // `.arctmp~` temp does not have -- the saved file must still carry them.
    std::vector<BYTE> guests = GuestsSid();
    REQUIRE_FALSE(guests.empty());
    REQUIRE(AddExplicitAllow(p, guests, FILE_GENERIC_READ) == ERROR_SUCCESS);
    REQUIRE(HasExplicitAllow(p, guests, FILE_GENERIC_READ));
    REQUIRE(::SetFileAttributesW(p.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN | FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE));

    REQUIRE(SaveFileBytes({ p, "a=2\n" }).status == SaveStatus::Saved);
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == "a=2\n");
    CHECK(ReadAll(p.wstring() + L":arcane.note") == "kept");
    WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA data{};
    REQUIRE(::GetFileAttributesExW(p.c_str(), GetFileExInfoStandard, &data));
    CHECK(data.ftCreationTime.dwHighDateTime == created.dwHighDateTime);
    CHECK(data.ftCreationTime.dwLowDateTime == created.dwLowDateTime);
    CHECK(HasExplicitAllow(p, guests, FILE_GENERIC_READ));                  // the DACL entry survived ReplaceFileW
    CHECK((data.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN) != 0);           // and the attributes did
    CHECK((data.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE) != 0);
    CHECK(TransientFilesIn(s.dir) == 0);
}

TEST_CASE("text save: a read-only file is refused; the confirmed removal saves", "[text-io]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-save-readonly");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "locked.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "checked in\n");
    REQUIRE(::SetFileAttributesW(p.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY));

    const SaveOutcome refused = SaveFileBytes({ p, "mine\n" });
    CHECK(refused.status == SaveStatus::ReadOnlyAttribute);
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == "checked in\n");
    CHECK(TransientFilesIn(s.dir) == 0);
    CHECK(SaveFileBytes({ p, "mine\n", SaveMode::OverwriteInPlace }).status == SaveStatus::ReadOnlyAttribute);

    const SaveOutcome removed = SaveFileBytes({ p, "mine\n", SaveMode::RemoveReadOnlyThenAtomic });
    CHECK(removed.status == SaveStatus::Saved);
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == "mine\n");
    CHECK((StatFile(p).attributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) == 0);
}

// Finding 2.5: the user confirmed removing the flag in order to SAVE. A save that
// then fails must leave the file's read-only (VCS lock) state as it found it.
TEST_CASE("text save: a confirmed read-only removal whose replace fails puts the read-only flag back", "[text-io]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-save-readonly-restore");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "locked.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "checked in\n");
    REQUIRE(::SetFileAttributesW(p.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY));
    const SaveRequest req{ p, "mine\n", SaveMode::RemoveReadOnlyThenAtomic };

    const SaveOutcome intact = SaveFileBytes(req, FakeOps(ERROR_UNABLE_TO_MOVE_REPLACEMENT));
    CHECK(intact.status == SaveStatus::RecoveredOriginalIntact);
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == "checked in\n");
    CHECK((StatFile(p).attributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) != 0);

    const SaveOutcome restored = SaveFileBytes(req, FakeOps(ERROR_UNABLE_TO_MOVE_REPLACEMENT_2, true));
    CHECK(restored.status == SaveStatus::RecoveredFromBackup);
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == "checked in\n");
    CHECK((StatFile(p).attributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) != 0);    // moved back from the backup, read-only again

    const SaveOutcome stranded = SaveFileBytes(req, FakeOps(ERROR_UNABLE_TO_MOVE_REPLACEMENT_2, true, true));
    CHECK(stranded.status == SaveStatus::RecoveryFailed);
    REQUIRE(std::filesystem::exists(stranded.backupPath));
    CHECK((StatFile(stranded.backupPath).attributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) != 0);   // the original, under the backup name
}
```

Append to `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.cpp` -- first add to the anonymous namespace (after `ReadUpTo`):
```cpp
        // Writes everything; does not flush (callers flush once at the end).
        bool WriteAllHandle(HANDLE h, std::string_view bytes, DWORD& error)
        {
            std::size_t done = 0;
            while (done < bytes.size())
            {
                const DWORD chunk = static_cast<DWORD>(std::min<std::size_t>(bytes.size() - done, std::size_t{ 1 } << 30));
                DWORD wrote = 0;
                if (!::WriteFile(h, bytes.data() + done, chunk, &wrote, nullptr))
                {
                    error = ::GetLastError();
                    return false;
                }
                done += wrote;
            }
            return true;
        }

        // The temp beside the target. CREATE_NEW: a stale temp is never reused.
        std::uint32_t WriteTemp(const std::filesystem::path& temp, std::string_view bytes)
        {
            DWORD error = 0;
            bool ok = false;
            {
                const Handle h(::CreateFileW(temp.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, CREATE_NEW, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr));
                if (!h.Valid())
                    return ::GetLastError();
                ok = WriteAllHandle(h.h, bytes, error) && ::FlushFileBuffers(h.h);
                if (!ok && error == 0)
                    error = ::GetLastError();
            }
            if (!ok)
            {
                ::DeleteFileW(temp.c_str());
                return error != 0 ? error : Win32Error::kDiskFull;
            }
            return Win32Error::kSuccess;
        }

        SaveStatus StatusForError(std::uint32_t e)
        {
            if (e == Win32Error::kSharingViolation || e == Win32Error::kLockViolation) return SaveStatus::SharingViolation;
            if (e == Win32Error::kAccessDenied) return SaveStatus::AccessDenied;
            return SaveStatus::WriteFailed;
        }

        // A DELETE open that fails with a sharing violation: someone holds the
        // target without FILE_SHARE_DELETE, whatever code ReplaceFileW reported.
        bool HeldWithoutDeleteShare(const std::filesystem::path& target)
        {
            HANDLE h = ::CreateFileW(target.c_str(), DELETE, kShareAll, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
            if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
                return ::GetLastError() == ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION;
            ::CloseHandle(h);
            return false;
        }

        std::uint32_t RealReplace(const wchar_t* replaced, const wchar_t* replacement, const wchar_t* backup)
        {
            return ::ReplaceFileW(replaced, replacement, backup, 0, nullptr, nullptr) ? 0u : ::GetLastError();
        }

        std::uint32_t RealMove(const wchar_t* from, const wchar_t* to, std::uint32_t flags)
        {
            return ::MoveFileExW(from, to, flags) ? 0u : ::GetLastError();
        }

        // Finding 2.5: a confirmed "Remove read-only and save" that did not save puts
        // the flag back on whichever name holds the original now -- the target, or,
        // after a _2 failure whose move back failed too, the backup.
        void RestoreAttributes(const std::filesystem::path& target, const std::filesystem::path& backup, DWORD attributes)
        {
            if (::GetFileAttributesW(target.c_str()) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES)
                ::SetFileAttributesW(target.c_str(), attributes);
            else if (!backup.empty() && ::GetFileAttributesW(backup.c_str()) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES)
                ::SetFileAttributesW(backup.c_str(), attributes);
        }

        SaveOutcome WriteInPlace(const std::filesystem::path& target, std::string_view bytes)
        {
            SaveOutcome out;
            const Handle h(::CreateFileW(target.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, kShareAll, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr));
            if (!h.Valid())
            {
                out.win32Error = ::GetLastError();
                out.status = StatusForError(out.win32Error);
                return out;
            }
            LARGE_INTEGER zero{};
            DWORD error = 0;
            if (!::SetFilePointerEx(h.h, zero, nullptr, FILE_BEGIN) || !WriteAllHandle(h.h, bytes, error)
                || !::SetEndOfFile(h.h) || !::FlushFileBuffers(h.h))
            {
                out.win32Error = error != 0 ? error : ::GetLastError();
                out.status = SaveStatus::WriteFailed;
                return out;
            }
            out.status = SaveStatus::Saved;
            return out;
        }
```

```cpp
    const SaveFileOps& RealSaveFileOps()
    {
        static const SaveFileOps ops{ &RealReplace, &RealMove, nullptr };
        return ops;
    }

    bool ProbeWriteShared(const std::filesystem::path& file)
    {
        const Handle h(::CreateFileW(file.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, kShareAll, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr));
        return h.Valid();

    SaveOutcome SaveFileBytes(const SaveRequest& req, const SaveFileOps& ops)
    {
        SaveOutcome out;
        const FileStamp before = StatFile(req.target);
        bool clearedReadOnly = false;   // ClearReadOnlyThenReplace took the flag off
        const auto finish = [&](SaveStatus status) -> SaveOutcome
        {
            out.status = status;
            if (SavedOk(status))
                out.written = FingerprintOf(req.bytes, StatFile(req.target).mtime);
            else if (clearedReadOnly)
                RestoreAttributes(req.target, out.backupPath, before.attributes);   // finding 2.5: every non-success outcome
            return out;
        };

        SaveFacts facts;
        facts.targetExists = before.exists;
        facts.readOnlyAttribute = before.exists && (before.attributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) != 0;
        facts.underFollow = req.underFollow;
        facts.recentExternalWrite = req.recentExternalWrite;
        facts.mode = req.mode;
        if (ops.listHolders && NeedsHolderCheck(facts.targetExists, facts.readOnlyAttribute, req.mode))
        {
            facts.holders = ops.listHolders(req.target);
            // Finding 2.7: this editor's own handles are never a writer the replace would
            // orphan. A followed or recently written file still asks (PlanSave's other two
            // reasons) -- which covers the editor opening its own log.
            std::erase_if(facts.holders, [](const FileHolder& h) { return h.thisProcess; });
        }

        switch (PlanSave(facts))
        {
        case SaveStep::RefuseReadOnly:
            return finish(SaveStatus::ReadOnlyAttribute);
        case SaveStep::AskAboutHolders:
            out.holders = std::move(facts.holders);
            out.overwriteInPlaceAvailable = ProbeWriteShared(req.target);
            return finish(SaveStatus::HoldersPresent);
        case SaveStep::OverwriteInPlace:
        {
            const SaveOutcome inPlace = WriteInPlace(req.target, req.bytes);
            out.win32Error = inPlace.win32Error;
            return finish(inPlace.status);
        }
        case SaveStep::ClearReadOnlyThenReplace:
            if (!::SetFileAttributesW(req.target.c_str(), before.attributes & ~static_cast<DWORD>(FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY)))
            {
                out.win32Error = ::GetLastError();
                return finish(SaveStatus::AccessDenied);
            }
            clearedReadOnly = true;   // from here, a failure restores it (finish)
            break;   // then the atomic replace below
        case SaveStep::CreateNew:
        case SaveStep::ReplaceAtomic:
            break;
        }

        const std::uint32_t pid = req.pid != 0 ? req.pid : static_cast<std::uint32_t>(::GetCurrentProcessId());
        out.tempPath = TransientSavePath(req.target, pid, NextTransientSerial());
        if (const std::uint32_t e = WriteTemp(out.tempPath, req.bytes); e != Win32Error::kSuccess)
        {
            out.win32Error = e;
            return finish(e == Win32Error::kAccessDenied ? SaveStatus::AccessDenied : SaveStatus::WriteFailed);
        }

        if (!facts.targetExists)
        {
            if (const std::uint32_t e = ops.moveFile(out.tempPath.c_str(), req.target.c_str(), MoveFlags::kWriteThrough); e != 0)
            {
                ::DeleteFileW(out.tempPath.c_str());
                out.win32Error = e;
                return finish(e == Win32Error::kAccessDenied ? SaveStatus::AccessDenied : SaveStatus::WriteFailed);
            }
            return finish(SaveStatus::Saved);
        }

        out.backupPath = TransientBackupPath(out.tempPath);
        const std::uint32_t e = ops.replaceFile(req.target.c_str(), out.tempPath.c_str(), out.backupPath.c_str());
        if (e == Win32Error::kSuccess)
        {
            ::DeleteFileW(out.backupPath.c_str());   // a failed delete leaves an ignored .arctmp~ file
            return finish(SaveStatus::Saved);
        }
        out.win32Error = e;
        switch (ClassifyReplaceFailure(e))
        {
        case ReplaceFailure::Unsupported:
            if (const std::uint32_t m = ops.moveFile(out.tempPath.c_str(), req.target.c_str(),
                                                     MoveFlags::kReplaceExisting | MoveFlags::kWriteThrough); m == 0)
                return finish(SaveStatus::SavedWithoutAclPreservation);
            else
            {
                ::DeleteFileW(out.tempPath.c_str());
                out.win32Error = m;
                return finish(SaveStatus::WriteFailed);
            }
        case ReplaceFailure::OriginalUnderBackup:
            if (ops.moveFile(out.backupPath.c_str(), req.target.c_str(), MoveFlags::kWriteThrough) == 0)
            {
                ::DeleteFileW(out.tempPath.c_str());
                return finish(SaveStatus::RecoveredFromBackup);
            }
            return finish(SaveStatus::RecoveryFailed);
        case ReplaceFailure::SharingViolation:
            ::DeleteFileW(out.tempPath.c_str());
            out.overwriteInPlaceAvailable = ProbeWriteShared(req.target);
            return finish(SaveStatus::SharingViolation);
        case ReplaceFailure::OriginalIntact:
        case ReplaceFailure::AccessDenied:
            ::DeleteFileW(out.tempPath.c_str());
            if (HeldWithoutDeleteShare(req.target))
            {
                out.overwriteInPlaceAvailable = ProbeWriteShared(req.target);
                return finish(SaveStatus::SharingViolation);
            }
            return finish(ClassifyReplaceFailure(e) == ReplaceFailure::AccessDenied ? SaveStatus::AccessDenied
                                                                                   : SaveStatus::RecoveredOriginalIntact);
        case ReplaceFailure::Other:
            ::DeleteFileW(out.tempPath.c_str());
            return finish(SaveStatus::WriteFailed);
        }
        ::DeleteFileW(out.tempPath.c_str());
        return finish(SaveStatus::WriteFailed);
    }
```

```cpp
// text-file-holder-fixture: holds ONE file open with a chosen access and share
// mode until its stdin reaches EOF, so ArcaneTests can prove the text save's
// sharing-violation, overwrite-in-place and Restart Manager paths against a
// REAL second process (TextFileHoldersTest.cpp). Its own premake project (a
// second wmain cannot live in ArcaneTests); plain Win32, no engine code.
//
//   text-file-holder-fixture <path> <access: r|w|rw> <share: none|r|rw|rwd>
//
// Prints "HELD <pid>\n" once the handle is open (or "ERROR <code>\n" and exits
// 1), then blocks until stdin closes, closes the handle and exits 0.

#include <cstdio>
#include <string_view>

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>

int wmain(int argc, wchar_t** argv)
{
    if (argc != 4)
    {
        std::fputs("usage: text-file-holder-fixture <path> <r|w|rw> <none|r|rw|rwd>\n", stderr);
        return 2;
    }
    const std::wstring_view access(argv[2]);
    const std::wstring_view share(argv[3]);
    DWORD a = 0;
    if (access.find(L'r') != std::wstring_view::npos) a |= GENERIC_READ;
    if (access.find(L'w') != std::wstring_view::npos) a |= GENERIC_WRITE;
    DWORD s = 0;
    if (share != L"none")
    {
        if (share.find(L'r') != std::wstring_view::npos) s |= FILE_SHARE_READ;
        if (share.find(L'w') != std::wstring_view::npos) s |= FILE_SHARE_WRITE;
        if (share.find(L'd') != std::wstring_view::npos) s |= FILE_SHARE_DELETE;
    }
    HANDLE h = ::CreateFileW(argv[1], a, s, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
    {
        std::printf("ERROR %lu\n", ::GetLastError());
        std::fflush(stdout);
        return 1;
    }
    std::printf("HELD %lu\n", ::GetCurrentProcessId());
    std::fflush(stdout);
    HANDLE in = ::GetStdHandle(STD_INPUT_HANDLE);
    char buf[64];
    DWORD got = 0;
    while (::ReadFile(in, buf, sizeof(buf), &got, nullptr) && got > 0) {}
    ::CloseHandle(h);
    return 0;
}
```

```cpp
// Text editor TE2-7 (spec s5.3): a second process holds the file with a chosen
// sharing mode; the save reports holders (Restart Manager), a sharing
// violation, whether overwrite in place is possible, and succeeds by the right
// route once the user picks one.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Project/TransientFiles.hpp>

#include <filesystem>

#include <string>
#include <string_view>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;

namespace

    struct ScratchDir
    {
        std::filesystem::path dir;
        explicit ScratchDir(const char* name) : dir(std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / name)
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
            std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
        }
        ~ScratchDir()
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
        }
    };

    void WriteAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view bytes)
    {
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary).write(bytes.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    }

    std::string Read(const std::filesystem::path& p) { return ReadFileShared(p, 1u << 20).bytes; }

    int TransientFilesIn(const std::filesystem::path& dir)
    {
        int n = 0;
        for (const auto& e : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(dir))
            if (Arcane::IsTransientSaveFile(e.path())) ++n;
        return n;
    }

    std::filesystem::path FixtureExe()
    {
        wchar_t buf[MAX_PATH] = {};
        ::GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, buf, MAX_PATH);
        return (std::filesystem::path(buf).parent_path() / ".." / "text-file-holder-fixture" /
                "text-file-holder-fixture.exe").lexically_normal();
    }

    // A real second process holding `file` until Release() / destruction.
    class HeldFile
    {
    public:
        HeldFile(const std::filesystem::path& file, const wchar_t* access, const wchar_t* share)
        {
            REQUIRE(std::filesystem::exists(FixtureExe()));
            SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES sa{ sizeof(sa), nullptr, TRUE };
            HANDLE outRead = nullptr, outWrite = nullptr, inRead = nullptr;
            REQUIRE(::CreatePipe(&outRead, &outWrite, &sa, 0));
            REQUIRE(::CreatePipe(&inRead, &m_stdinWrite, &sa, 0));
            ::SetHandleInformation(outRead, HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, 0);
            ::SetHandleInformation(m_stdinWrite, HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, 0);
            STARTUPINFOW si{};
            si.cb = sizeof(si);
            si.dwFlags = STARTF_USESTDHANDLES;
            si.hStdInput = inRead;
            si.hStdOutput = outWrite;
            si.hStdError = outWrite;
            std::wstring cmd = L"\"" + FixtureExe().wstring() + L"\" \"" + file.wstring() + L"\" " + access + L" " + share;
            PROCESS_INFORMATION pi{};
            const BOOL ok = ::CreateProcessW(nullptr, cmd.data(), nullptr, nullptr, TRUE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, nullptr, nullptr, &si, &pi);
            ::CloseHandle(inRead);
            ::CloseHandle(outWrite);
            REQUIRE(ok);
            m_process = pi.hProcess;
            ::CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
            std::string line;
            char c = 0;
            DWORD got = 0;
            while (::ReadFile(outRead, &c, 1, &got, nullptr) && got == 1 && c != '\n')
                line.push_back(c);
            ::CloseHandle(outRead);
            INFO("fixture said: " << line);
            REQUIRE(line.starts_with("HELD "));
            m_pid = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::stoul(line.substr(5)));
        }
        ~HeldFile() { Release(); }
        HeldFile(const HeldFile&) = delete;
        HeldFile& operator=(const HeldFile&) = delete;
        void Release()
        {
            if (m_stdinWrite) { ::CloseHandle(m_stdinWrite); m_stdinWrite = nullptr; }
            if (m_process) { ::WaitForSingleObject(m_process, 10000); ::CloseHandle(m_process); m_process = nullptr; }
        }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t Pid() const { return m_pid; }

    private:
        HANDLE m_stdinWrite = nullptr;
        HANDLE m_process = nullptr;
        std::uint32_t m_pid = 0;
    };

    bool Names(const std::vector<FileHolder>& holders, std::uint32_t pid)
    {
        return std::any_of(holders.begin(), holders.end(), [&](const FileHolder& h) { return h.pid == pid; });
    }
}

TEST_CASE("text holders: a writer without delete sharing -> holders, then in use, then overwrite in place", "[text-io]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-holders-writer");

    CHECK(c.status == SaveStatus::Saved);
    CHECK(Read(p) == "new\n");
```

```cpp
    std::vector<FileHolder> ListFileHolders(const std::filesystem::path& file)
    {
        std::vector<FileHolder> out;
        DWORD session = 0;
        WCHAR key[CCH_RM_SESSION_KEY + 1] = {};
        if (::RmStartSession(&session, 0, key) != ERROR_SUCCESS)
            return out;
        const std::wstring path = file.wstring();
        LPCWSTR files[] = { path.c_str() };
        if (::RmRegisterResources(session, 1, files, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr) == ERROR_SUCCESS)
        {
            UINT needed = 0;
            UINT count = 0;
            DWORD reasons = 0;
            std::vector<RM_PROCESS_INFO> infos;
            DWORD rc = ::RmGetList(session, &needed, &count, nullptr, &reasons);
            while (rc == ERROR_MORE_DATA)   // the list can grow between calls: ask again with the new size
            {
                infos.resize(needed);
                count = needed;
                rc = ::RmGetList(session, &needed, &count, infos.data(), &reasons);
            }
            if (rc == ERROR_SUCCESS)
                for (UINT i = 0; i < count; ++i)
                {
                    const DWORD pid = infos[i].Process.dwProcessId;
                    out.push_back(FileHolder{ static_cast<std::uint32_t>(pid), WideToUtf8(infos[i].strAppName),
                                              pid == ::GetCurrentProcessId() });
                }
        }
        ::RmEndSession(session);
        return out;
    }
```

### Task TE2-8: Chain SDL's single Windows message hook (spec s5.5)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneClient/src/Arcane/Platform/WindowsMessageHooks.hpp`, `ArcaneClient/src/Arcane/Platform/WindowsMessageHooks.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneClient/src/Arcane/Platform/Window.cpp:1-4` (include), `:65-73` (`SessionEndHook` runs the chain)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/WindowsMessageHookTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the existing process-wide `SDL_SetWindowsMessageHook(&SessionEndHook, nullptr)` registration (Window.cpp:113-119).
- Produces (ARC_API, `namespace Arcane`): `using WindowsMessageHook = bool (*)(void* user, void* msg);` `void AddWindowsMessageHook(WindowsMessageHook, void* user)`, `void RemoveWindowsMessageHook(WindowsMessageHook, void* user)`, `bool RunWindowsMessageHooks(void* msg)`. TE2-10's `TextInputHook` registers through it.

SDL3 has one hook slot per process (last writer wins); `Window.cpp` already owns it for the session-end route. Chaining keeps that route and gives every later consumer the same pre-`TranslateMessage` view without replacing it.

```cpp
// Text editor TE2-8 (spec s5.5): SDL's single Windows message hook is chained,
// not replaced -- every registered hook sees each message; any false swallows it.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include <Arcane/Platform/WindowsMessageHooks.hpp>

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>

namespace
{
    struct Counter
    {
        int  seen = 0;
        bool keep = true;
    };

    bool CountingHook(void* user, void* msg)
    {
        auto* c = static_cast<Counter*>(user);
        ++c->seen;
        CHECK(static_cast<const MSG*>(msg)->message == WM_NULL);
        return c->keep;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("windows message hooks: every hook sees each message, a false swallows it, removal stops it", "[text-input]")
{
    Counter a, b;
    Arcane::AddWindowsMessageHook(&CountingHook, &a);
    Arcane::AddWindowsMessageHook(&CountingHook, &b);
    Arcane::AddWindowsMessageHook(&CountingHook, &a);    // the same (hook, user) twice: registered once

    MSG m{};
    m.message = WM_NULL;
    CHECK(Arcane::RunWindowsMessageHooks(&m));
    CHECK(a.seen == 1);
    CHECK(b.seen == 1);

    b.keep = false;
    CHECK_FALSE(Arcane::RunWindowsMessageHooks(&m));   // swallowed...
    CHECK(a.seen == 2);                                 // ...after every hook saw it
    CHECK(b.seen == 2);

    Arcane::RemoveWindowsMessageHook(&CountingHook, &b);
    CHECK(Arcane::RunWindowsMessageHooks(&m));
    CHECK(a.seen == 3);
    CHECK(b.seen == 2);

    Arcane::RemoveWindowsMessageHook(&CountingHook, &a);
    CHECK(Arcane::RunWindowsMessageHooks(&m));
    CHECK(a.seen == 3);
    Arcane::AddWindowsMessageHook(nullptr, &a);         // a null hook is ignored
    CHECK(Arcane::RunWindowsMessageHooks(&m));
}

// Finding 2.6: a hook may re-enter the chain (ImmAssociateContextEx SENDS
// messages, a nested pump runs the chain again) and may add or remove hooks;
// the chain never calls a hook while holding its lock, and never calls a hook
// that was removed meanwhile.
namespace
{
    struct Reentrant
    {
        int  seen = 0;
        int  nested = 0;
        bool removeOther = false;
        void* other = nullptr;
    };

    bool OtherHook(void* user, void*)
    {
        ++static_cast<Reentrant*>(user)->seen;
        return true;
    }

    bool NestingHook(void* user, void* msg)
    {
        auto* r = static_cast<Reentrant*>(user);
        ++r->seen;
        if (static_cast<const MSG*>(msg)->message != WM_NULL)
            return true;
        MSG inner{};
        inner.message = WM_USER;
        CHECK(Arcane::RunWindowsMessageHooks(&inner));       // re-entered from inside a hook: no deadlock
        ++r->nested;
        if (r->removeOther)
            Arcane::RemoveWindowsMessageHook(&OtherHook, r->other);   // removed while the outer run is in flight
        return true;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("windows message hooks: a hook re-enters the chain and removes another hook without deadlock", "[text-input]")
{
    Reentrant outer, other;
    outer.removeOther = true;
    outer.other = &other;
    Arcane::AddWindowsMessageHook(&NestingHook, &outer);
    Arcane::AddWindowsMessageHook(&OtherHook, &other);
    MSG m{};
    m.message = WM_NULL;
    CHECK(Arcane::RunWindowsMessageHooks(&m));
    CHECK(outer.nested == 1);
    CHECK(outer.seen == 2);                                   // the outer message and the nested one
    CHECK(other.seen == 1);                                   // the nested run only: removed before the outer run reached it
    Arcane::RemoveWindowsMessageHook(&NestingHook, &outer);
    CHECK(Arcane::RunWindowsMessageHooks(&m));
    CHECK(other.seen == 1);
}
```

`ArcaneClient/src/Arcane/Platform/WindowsMessageHooks.hpp`:
```cpp
#pragma once

// The chain behind SDL's ONE Windows message hook (text editor spec s5.5).
// SDL_SetWindowsMessageHook has a single process-wide slot (last writer wins);
// Window.cpp owns it for the session-end route and runs this chain from it, so
// every other consumer (the text editor's dead-key and layout hook) sees each
// message before TranslateMessage without replacing anyone.
//
// `msg` is a MSG* on Windows (opaque here so <windows.h> stays out of public
// headers). Return false to swallow the message. Hooks run on the thread that
// pumps SDL events, in registration order, and every hook sees every message
// (one swallowing does not hide it from the others). The chain calls hooks
// OUTSIDE its lock (finding 2.6): a hook may re-enter it (ImmAssociateContextEx
// sends messages; a nested pump runs the chain again) and may add or remove
// hooks -- a hook removed while a run is in flight is not called again by it.

#include <Arcane/Base/Api.hpp>

namespace Arcane
{
    using WindowsMessageHook = bool (*)(void* user, void* msg);

    ARC_API void AddWindowsMessageHook(WindowsMessageHook hook, void* user);      // a duplicate (hook, user) is ignored
    ARC_API void RemoveWindowsMessageHook(WindowsMessageHook hook, void* user);
    // Runs the chain; false when any hook swallowed. Window.cpp's SDL hook calls it.
    ARC_API bool RunWindowsMessageHooks(void* msg);
}
```

`ArcaneClient/src/Arcane/Platform/WindowsMessageHooks.cpp`:
```cpp
#include <Arcane/Platform/WindowsMessageHooks.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <mutex>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane
{
    namespace
    {
        struct Entry
        {
            WindowsMessageHook hook;
            void*              user;
        };

        std::mutex& HooksMutex()
        {
            static std::mutex m;
            return m;
        }

        std::vector<Entry>& Hooks()
        {
            static std::vector<Entry> v;
            return v;
        }
    }

    void AddWindowsMessageHook(WindowsMessageHook hook, void* user)
    {
        if (!hook)
            return;
        const std::lock_guard lock(HooksMutex());
        std::vector<Entry>& v = Hooks();
        if (std::none_of(v.begin(), v.end(), [&](const Entry& e) { return e.hook == hook && e.user == user; }))
            v.push_back(Entry{ hook, user });
    }

    void RemoveWindowsMessageHook(WindowsMessageHook hook, void* user)
    {
        const std::lock_guard lock(HooksMutex());
        std::erase_if(Hooks(), [&](const Entry& e) { return e.hook == hook && e.user == user; });
    }

    bool RunWindowsMessageHooks(void* msg)
    {
        // Snapshot under the lock, call outside it (finding 2.6): a hook that
        // re-enters the chain or edits it can never deadlock on this mutex.
        std::vector<Entry> snapshot;
        {
            const std::lock_guard lock(HooksMutex());
            snapshot = Hooks();
        }
        bool keep = true;
        for (const Entry& e : snapshot)
        {
            bool registered = false;
            {
                const std::lock_guard lock(HooksMutex());   // removed meanwhile? then not called
                const std::vector<Entry>& v = Hooks();
                registered = std::any_of(v.begin(), v.end(), [&](const Entry& x) { return x.hook == e.hook && x.user == e.user; });
            }
            if (registered)
                keep = e.hook(e.user, msg) && keep;   // every hook sees every message
        }
        return keep;
    }
}
```

### Task TE2-9: Keyboard layout facts -- AltGr, Latin letters, dead keys, asked of the layout (spec s5.5)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextKeyboardLayout.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextKeyboardLayout.cpp`
- Modify: `premake5.lua` (TE2 block: add `TextKeyboardLayout.cpp`)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextKeyboardLayoutTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Arcane::Editor::EditorActions` (`Register`, `BeginFrame`, `Pressed`, `PressedInWindow`, `SetActiveKeyLayout`), `Arcane::KeyLayout`, `Arcane::Keys` (EditorActions.hpp:27-138, KeyLayout.hpp:18-56).
- Produces: `struct KeyboardLayoutFacts { std::uintptr_t layout; bool hasAltGr; bool lettersLatin; }`; `std::uintptr_t ActiveKeyboardLayout()`; `KeyboardLayoutFacts QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts(std::uintptr_t layout)`; `char LatinLetterForScancode(std::uint32_t pcScancode, std::uintptr_t layout)`; `std::uint32_t ScancodeForVirtualKey(std::uint32_t vk, std::uintptr_t layout)`; `bool IsDeadKey(std::uint32_t vk, std::uintptr_t layout)`; `struct KeyForChar { std::uint32_t vk; bool shift, ctrl, alt; }`; `std::optional<KeyForChar> KeyForCharacter(char16_t, std::uintptr_t layout)`. TE5 reads `lettersLatin` for `vim.latinLettersInNormal` (auto) and `LatinLetterForScancode` for Normal-mode letters.

**The Labelled-letter verification (spec s5.5 "The plan verifies Arcane's KeyLayout honours this").** Read from the settings tree: the ImGui route matches a Labelled letter through `ImGui::IsKeyChordPressed(ImGuiKey_<letter>)` (EditorActions.cpp:376-389), and `imgui_impl_sdl3` maps the SDL *key event's* keycode to that `ImGuiKey` (`ImGui_ImplSDL3_KeyEventToImGuiKey`, imgui_impl_sdl3.cpp:237-313). SDL3's default `SDL_HINT_KEYCODE_OPTIONS` (`french_numbers,latin_letters`; Arcane never overrides it -- the only `SDL_SetHint` call is Window.cpp:221's activation hint) gives a non-Latin layout's letter keys their US-position Latin keycode in key events, so `Ctrl+V` arrives as `ImGuiKey_V`. The SDL-snapshot route (Global/Viewport actions) uses `SystemKeyLayout::KeycodeFor` -> `SDL_GetKeyFromScancode(sc, NONE, key_event=false)`, which does *not* apply `latin_letters`; EditorActions covers that with `FallbackApplies` (EditorActions.cpp:322-332), which matches the letter's QWERTY scancode position when the layout's key produces no Latin letter. The test below proves (a) on Russian and Greek the Windows VK of every letter sits at exactly its US scancode position -- so "QWERTY position" *is* "the VK letter" there -- and (b) both routes fire `Ctrl+V` on a non-Latin layout.

```cpp
// Text editor TE2-9 (spec s5.5): AltGr, Latin-letter and dead-key facts come
// from the layout itself (ToUnicodeEx / VkKeyScanExW / MapVirtualKeyExW), and a
// Labelled letter chord means the key's Latin VK letter on every layout.
// Layouts are loaded with KLF_NOTELLSHELL and unloaded only if this test loaded them.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/View/TextKeyboardLayout.hpp"
#include "Input/EditorActions.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/CVarRegistry.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Input/InputSnapshot.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Input/KeyLayout.hpp>

#include <imgui.h>

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;

namespace
{
    class ScopedLayout
    {
    public:
        ScopedLayout(const wchar_t* klid, WORD expectedLanguage)
        {
            const int count = ::GetKeyboardLayoutList(0, nullptr);
            std::vector<HKL> before(static_cast<std::size_t>(count));
            ::GetKeyboardLayoutList(count, before.data());
            m_hkl = ::LoadKeyboardLayoutW(klid, KLF_NOTELLSHELL);
            m_loadedHere = m_hkl && std::find(before.begin(), before.end(), m_hkl) == before.end();
            // LoadKeyboardLayoutW answers with the system default when it cannot load the request.
            m_ok = m_hkl && LOWORD(reinterpret_cast<UINT_PTR>(m_hkl)) == expectedLanguage;
        }
        ~ScopedLayout()
        {
            if (m_loadedHere)
                ::UnloadKeyboardLayout(m_hkl);
        }
        ScopedLayout(const ScopedLayout&) = delete;
        ScopedLayout& operator=(const ScopedLayout&) = delete;
        [[nodiscard]] bool Ok() const { return m_ok; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uintptr_t Id() const { return reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(m_hkl); }

    private:
        HKL  m_hkl = nullptr;
        bool m_loadedHere = false;
        bool m_ok = false;
    };
}

TEST_CASE("keyboard layout: US has no AltGr, Latin letters, '{' is Shift+[, no dead quote", "[text-input]")
{
    const ScopedLayout us(L"00000409", 0x0409);
    if (!us.Ok()) SKIP("the US layout could not be loaded");
    const KeyboardLayoutFacts f = QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts(us.Id());
    CHECK(f.layout == us.Id());
    CHECK_FALSE(f.hasAltGr);
    CHECK(f.lettersLatin);
    const auto k = KeyForCharacter(u'{', us.Id());
    REQUIRE(k.has_value());
    CHECK(k->vk == VK_OEM_4);
    CHECK(k->shift);
    CHECK_FALSE(k->ctrl);
    CHECK_FALSE(IsDeadKey(VK_OEM_7, us.Id()));
    CHECK(LatinLetterForScancode(ScancodeForVirtualKey('V', us.Id()), us.Id()) == 'v');
}

TEST_CASE("keyboard layout: German has AltGr ('{' = AltGr+7) and QWERTZ letters", "[text-input]")
{
    const ScopedLayout de(L"00000407", 0x0407);
    if (!de.Ok()) SKIP("the German layout could not be loaded");
    const KeyboardLayoutFacts f = QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts(de.Id());
    CHECK(f.hasAltGr);
    CHECK(f.lettersLatin);
    const auto k = KeyForCharacter(u'{', de.Id());
    REQUIRE(k.has_value());
    CHECK(k->vk == '7');
    CHECK(k->ctrl);
    CHECK(k->alt);
    CHECK(LatinLetterForScancode(0x2C, de.Id()) == 'y');   // the key in US-Z's place is labelled Y on QWERTZ
    CHECK(LatinLetterForScancode(0x15, de.Id()) == 'z');   // and US-Y's place is Z
}

TEST_CASE("keyboard layout: Polish (programmers) types letters with AltGr", "[text-input]")
{
    const ScopedLayout pl(L"00000415", 0x0415);
    if (!pl.Ok()) SKIP("the Polish layout could not be loaded");
    CHECK(QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts(pl.Id()).hasAltGr);
    const auto k = KeyForCharacter(u'\u0105', pl.Id());   // a-ogonek
    REQUIRE(k.has_value());
    CHECK(k->vk == 'A');
    CHECK(k->ctrl);
    CHECK(k->alt);
}

TEST_CASE("keyboard layout: US-International has AltGr and dead quote and grave keys", "[text-input]")
{
    const ScopedLayout intl(L"00020409", 0x0409);
    if (!intl.Ok()) SKIP("the US-International layout could not be loaded");
    CHECK(QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts(intl.Id()).hasAltGr);
    CHECK(IsDeadKey(VK_OEM_7, intl.Id()));   // ' and "
    CHECK(IsDeadKey(VK_OEM_3, intl.Id()));   // ` and ~
    CHECK_FALSE(IsDeadKey('A', intl.Id()));
}

TEST_CASE("keyboard layout: Russian and Greek letters are non-Latin and every letter VK sits at its US position", "[text-input]")
{
    const ScopedLayout us(L"00000409", 0x0409);
    if (!us.Ok()) SKIP("the US layout could not be loaded");
    const ScopedLayout ru(L"00000419", 0x0419);
    const ScopedLayout el(L"00000408", 0x0408);
    for (const ScopedLayout* l : { &ru, &el })
    {
        if (!l->Ok()) { WARN("a non-Latin layout could not be loaded"); continue; }
        CHECK_FALSE(QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts(l->Id()).lettersLatin);
        for (std::uint32_t vk = 'A'; vk <= 'Z'; ++vk)
        {
            INFO("VK " << static_cast<char>(vk));
            const std::uint32_t scan = ScancodeForVirtualKey(vk, l->Id());
            CHECK(scan == ScancodeForVirtualKey(vk, us.Id()));                       // the VK letter == the QWERTY position...
            CHECK(LatinLetterForScancode(scan, l->Id()) == static_cast<char>('a' + (vk - 'A')));   // ...and reads back as that letter
        }
    }
}

TEST_CASE("keyboard layout: on a non-Latin layout Ctrl+V reaches a Labelled chord on both routes", "[text-input]")
{
    struct Cyrillic final : Arcane::KeyLayout   // the letter scancodes produce U+0430.. (no Latin letter anywhere)
    {
        std::int32_t KeycodeFor(std::uint32_t sc) const override
        { return (sc >= 4 && sc <= 29) ? 0x430 + static_cast<std::int32_t>(sc - 4) : Arcane::QwertyKeyLayout().KeycodeFor(sc); }
        std::uint32_t ScancodeFor(std::int32_t kc) const override
        { for (std::uint32_t sc = 1; sc < 512; ++sc) if (KeycodeFor(sc) == kc) return sc; return 0; }
        std::string KeyName(std::int32_t kc) const override { return Arcane::QwertyKeyLayout().KeyName(kc); }
    } cyrillic;

    Arcane::CVarRegistry reg;
    EditorActions actions(reg);
    actions.Register({ "t.paste", "Paste", ActionContext::Global, "Ctrl+V" });
    SetActiveKeyLayout(&cyrillic);

    // The SDL-snapshot route: the V key's scancode, a Cyrillic keycode -> FallbackApplies.
    Arcane::InputSnapshot snap;
    snap.SetScancode(Arcane::Keys::kScanLCtrl);
    snap.SetScancode(Arcane::Keys::ScanLetter('V'));
    snap.AddKeycode(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(cyrillic.KeycodeFor(Arcane::Keys::ScanLetter('V'))));
    Arcane::InputSnapshot none;
    ActionFrameInput in;
    in.snap = &none;
    in.dt = 1.0 / 60.0;
    actions.BeginFrame(in);
    in.snap = &snap;
    actions.BeginFrame(in);
    CHECK(actions.Pressed("t.paste"));

    // The ImGui route: SDL3's latin_letters keycode option makes the key EVENT carry SDLK_V,
    // which imgui_impl_sdl3 maps to ImGuiKey_V -- simulated here as that key event.
    ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
    ImGuiContext* ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(800, 600);
    io.IniFilename = nullptr;
    unsigned char* px = nullptr;
    int w = 0, h = 0;
    io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
    bool fired = false;
    const auto frame = [&] { io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f; ImGui::NewFrame(); fired = actions.PressedInWindow("t.paste"); ImGui::Render(); };
    frame();
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Ctrl, true);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_V, true);
    frame();
    frame();   // the trickled queue may need a second frame for the second event
    CHECK(fired);
    ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);
    SetActiveKeyLayout(nullptr);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextKeyboardLayout.hpp`:
```cpp
#pragma once

// The keyboard layout's own answers (text editor spec s5.5): whether it HAS
// AltGr, whether its letter keys are Latin, which keys are dead -- asked of
// the layout with ToUnicodeEx / VkKeyScanExW / MapVirtualKeyExW, never inferred
// from event timing. Layouts are HKLs passed as integers so no <windows.h>
// leaks out. ToUnicodeEx is always called with flag 0x4 (keyboard state
// unchanged, Windows 10 1607+), so asking never disturbs a pending dead key.

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct KeyboardLayoutFacts
    {
        std::uintptr_t layout = 0;    // the HKL these describe
        bool hasAltGr = false;        // a key's Ctrl+Alt (AltGr) layer produces a character or a dead key
        bool lettersLatin = true;     // VK 'A'..'Z' all produce Latin letters unshifted
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::uintptr_t ActiveKeyboardLayout();                        // GetKeyboardLayout(0)
    [[nodiscard]] KeyboardLayoutFacts QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts(std::uintptr_t layout);
    // 'a'..'z' when the key at PC scancode `pcScancode` has a letter VK on `layout`
    // (the Windows convention for Ctrl+letter chords), else 0.
    [[nodiscard]] char LatinLetterForScancode(std::uint32_t pcScancode, std::uintptr_t layout);
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t ScancodeForVirtualKey(std::uint32_t vk, std::uintptr_t layout);
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsDeadKey(std::uint32_t vk, std::uintptr_t layout);

    struct KeyForChar
    {
        std::uint32_t vk = 0;
        bool shift = false, ctrl = false, alt = false;
    };
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<KeyForChar> KeyForCharacter(char16_t ch, std::uintptr_t layout);   // VkKeyScanExW
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextKeyboardLayout.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/TextKeyboardLayout.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "user32.lib")   // ToUnicodeEx / VkKeyScanExW / MapVirtualKeyExW / GetKeyboardLayout

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("Win32 vocabulary: ToUnicodeEx flag bit 2 -- do not change the keyboard state (Windows 10 1607+)")
        constexpr UINT kToUnicodeKeepState = 0x4;
        ARC_CONSTANT("Win32 vocabulary: the 'down' bit of a GetKeyboardState byte")
        constexpr BYTE kKeyDown = 0x80;

        HKL AsHkl(std::uintptr_t v) { return reinterpret_cast<HKL>(v); }

        // Keys whose AltGr layer can carry characters: digits, letters, the OEM
        // punctuation keys and the ISO 102nd key.
        bool CandidateKey(UINT vk)
        {
            return (vk >= '0' && vk <= '9') || (vk >= 'A' && vk <= 'Z') || (vk >= VK_OEM_1 && vk <= VK_OEM_3)
                || (vk >= VK_OEM_4 && vk <= VK_OEM_8) || vk == VK_OEM_102;
        }

        int Translate(UINT vk, const BYTE* state, HKL hkl, wchar_t* buf, int cap)
        {
            const UINT scan = ::MapVirtualKeyExW(vk, MAPVK_VK_TO_VSC, hkl);
            return ::ToUnicodeEx(vk, scan, state, buf, cap, kToUnicodeKeepState, hkl);
        }
    }

    std::uintptr_t ActiveKeyboardLayout()
    {
        return reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(::GetKeyboardLayout(0));
    }

    KeyboardLayoutFacts QueryKeyboardLayoutFacts(std::uintptr_t layout)
    {
        KeyboardLayoutFacts f;
        f.layout = layout;
        const HKL hkl = AsHkl(layout);
        BYTE altGr[256] = {};
        altGr[VK_CONTROL] = altGr[VK_LCONTROL] = altGr[VK_MENU] = altGr[VK_RMENU] = kKeyDown;
        const BYTE none[256] = {};
        wchar_t buf[8] = {};
        for (UINT vk = 0; vk < 256 && !f.hasAltGr; ++vk)
        {
            if (!CandidateKey(vk))
                continue;
            const int n = Translate(vk, altGr, hkl, buf, 8);
            if (n < 0 || (n > 0 && buf[0] >= 0x20))   // a dead key or a printable character on the AltGr layer
                f.hasAltGr = true;
        }
        int latin = 0;
        for (UINT vk = 'A'; vk <= 'Z'; ++vk)
        {
            const int n = Translate(vk, none, hkl, buf, 8);
            if (n == 1 && ((buf[0] >= L'a' && buf[0] <= L'z') || (buf[0] >= L'A' && buf[0] <= L'Z')))
                ++latin;
        }
        f.lettersLatin = latin == 26;
        return f;
    }

    char LatinLetterForScancode(std::uint32_t pcScancode, std::uintptr_t layout)
    {
        const UINT vk = ::MapVirtualKeyExW(pcScancode, MAPVK_VSC_TO_VK_EX, AsHkl(layout));
        return (vk >= 'A' && vk <= 'Z') ? static_cast<char>('a' + (vk - 'A')) : '\0';
    }

    std::uint32_t ScancodeForVirtualKey(std::uint32_t vk, std::uintptr_t layout)
    {
        return ::MapVirtualKeyExW(vk, MAPVK_VK_TO_VSC, AsHkl(layout));
    }

    bool IsDeadKey(std::uint32_t vk, std::uintptr_t layout)
    {
        const BYTE none[256] = {};
        wchar_t buf[8] = {};
        return Translate(vk, none, AsHkl(layout), buf, 8) < 0;
    }

    std::optional<KeyForChar> KeyForCharacter(char16_t ch, std::uintptr_t layout)
    {
        const SHORT r = ::VkKeyScanExW(static_cast<WCHAR>(ch), AsHkl(layout));
        if (r == -1)
            return std::nullopt;
        const BYTE mods = HIBYTE(r);
        KeyForChar k;
        k.vk = LOBYTE(r);
        k.shift = (mods & 1) != 0;
        k.ctrl = (mods & 2) != 0;
        k.alt = (mods & 4) != 0;
        return k;
    }
}
```
