```cpp
#include <string_view>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;
using Arcane::Text::TextEncoding;

namespace
{
    struct ScratchDir
    {
        std::filesystem::path dir;
        explicit ScratchDir(const char* name) : dir(std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / name)
        {
            Clear();
            std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
        }
        ~ScratchDir() { Clear(); }
        void Clear()
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            if (std::filesystem::exists(dir, ec))
                for (const auto& e : std::filesystem::recursive_directory_iterator(dir, ec))
                    ::SetFileAttributesW(e.path().c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL);
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
        }
    };

    void WriteAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view bytes)
    {
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary).write(bytes.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    }

    std::string ReadAll(const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        std::ifstream in(p, std::ios::binary);
        return std::string(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    }

    std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> OpenOrFail(const std::filesystem::path& p, TextDocumentServices s = {})
    {
        std::string error;
        std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> doc = TextDocument::Open(p, std::move(s), error);
        INFO(error);
        REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
        return doc;
    }

    // Types `text` at `at` through TE1's command class, as the view would.
    void Type(TextDocument& doc, Arcane::Text::ByteOffset at, std::string_view text)
    {
        TextModel& model = doc.Model();
        Arcane::Text::TextCommands cmds(model.buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model));
        cmds.SetSelections({ Arcane::Text::Selection{ 0, at, at, std::nullopt } });
        cmds.InsertText(text);
    }
}

TEST_CASE("text sniff: NULs in the first 8 KB are binary unless a UTF-16 BOM says otherwise; the path rules", "[text-doc]")
{
    CHECK(kSniffBytes == 8192u);
    CHECK(SniffText("plain text\n") == TextSniffResult::Text);
    CHECK(SniffText(std::string("a\0b", 3)) == TextSniffResult::Binary);
    CHECK(SniffText(std::string("\xFF\xFEh\0", 4)) == TextSniffResult::Text);
    CHECK(SniffText(std::string("\xFE\xFF\0h", 4)) == TextSniffResult::Text);
    CHECK(SniffText(std::string(9000, 'a') + std::string(1, '\0')) == TextSniffResult::Text);   // past the window
    for (const char* cpp : { "a.cpp", "a.CXX", "a.cc", "a.c", "a.hpp", "a.hxx", "a.hh", "a.h", "a.inl" })
        CHECK(IsCppSourcePath(cpp));
    CHECK_FALSE(IsCppSourcePath("a.hlsl"));
    CHECK(IsKnownBinaryExtension("hero.PNG"));
    CHECK(IsKnownBinaryExtension("x.dll"));
    CHECK_FALSE(IsKnownBinaryExtension("scene.gltf"));            // glTF is JSON text
    const auto text = ExplicitTextExtensions();
    CHECK(std::find(text.begin(), text.end(), ".md") != text.end());
    CHECK(std::find(text.begin(), text.end(), ".log") != text.end());
    CHECK(std::find(text.begin(), text.end(), ".cpp") == text.end());
}

TEST_CASE("text sniff: SniffsAsText reads the head of a real file; NULs, a binary extension or no file is not text", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-doc-sniff");
    const std::filesystem::path text = s.dir / "notes.txt";
    WriteAll(text, "plain text\n");
    CHECK(SniffsAsText(text));
    const std::filesystem::path nul = s.dir / "dump.dat";
    WriteAll(nul, std::string("ab\0cd", 5));
    CHECK_FALSE(SniffsAsText(nul));
    CHECK_FALSE(SniffsAsText(s.dir / "missing.txt"));               // unreadable: false, never a throw
    const std::filesystem::path png = s.dir / "fake.png";
    WriteAll(png, "not really a png\n");
    CHECK_FALSE(SniffsAsText(png));                                  // a known binary extension wins
}

TEST_CASE("text document: a UTF-8 file opens editable under its canonical path; any spelling finds the same key", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-doc-open");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "Notes.md";
    WriteAll(p, "# Title\nbody\n");
    TextDocumentServices services;
    const Arcane::Guid id = Arcane::Guid::Generate();
    services.peekGuid = [&](const std::filesystem::path&) { return id; };
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p, services);
    CHECK(doc->Title() == "Notes.md");
    CHECK(doc->CanonicalPath() == *CanonicalFilePath(p));
    CHECK(doc->AssetGuid() == id);
    CHECK(doc->Encoding() == TextEncoding::Utf8);
    CHECK_FALSE(Arcane::Text::EncodingHasBom(doc->Encoding()));
    CHECK(std::string(EncodingLabel(doc->Encoding())) == "UTF-8");
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->ReadOnly());
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "# Title\nbody\n");
    CHECK(&doc->Buffer() == &doc->Model().buffer);                // Buffer() is the primary model's buffer
    CHECK(doc->WindowLabel().starts_with("Notes.md###textdoc_"));
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::None);
    doc->ShowNote("hello");
    CHECK(doc->Note() == "hello");
    doc->ShowNote("");
    CHECK(doc->Note().empty());

    std::wstring upper = p.wstring();
    std::transform(upper.begin(), upper.end(), upper.begin(), [](wchar_t c) { return static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towupper(c)); });
    CHECK(OpenOrFail(upper)->CanonicalPath() == doc->CanonicalPath());

    Type(*doc, 0, "X");
    CHECK(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Save());
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == "X# Title\nbody\n");
    CHECK(doc->Synced().stamp.size == 14u);
}

TEST_CASE("text document: UTF-16 with a BOM round-trips byte-identical", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-doc-utf16");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "wide.txt";
    const std::string bytes("\xFF\xFEh\0i\0\r\0\n\0", 10);
    WriteAll(p, bytes);
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    CHECK(doc->Encoding() == TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    CHECK(Arcane::Text::EncodingHasBom(doc->Encoding()));
    CHECK(std::string(EncodingLabel(doc->Encoding())) == "UTF-16 LE");
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "hi\n");
    CHECK(doc->Save());
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == bytes);
}

TEST_CASE("text document: invalid UTF-8 opens read-only with its bytes; Reopen as Windows-1252 edits and saves 1252", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-doc-1252");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "legacy.bat";
    const std::string original = "echo caf\xE9\r\n";
    WriteAll(p, original);
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    CHECK(doc->ReadOnly());
    CHECK(doc->ReadOnlyReason() == TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8);
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "echo caf\xE9\n");                // raw bytes, never lossy-decoded
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::ReadOnlyContent);
    CHECK(BannerActions(doc->Banner()) == std::vector<TextBannerAction>{ TextBannerAction::ReopenAs1252 });
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Save());                                                   // read-only content never saves
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == original);

    const TextModel* modelBefore = &doc->Model();
    const Arcane::Text::TextBuffer* bufferBefore = &doc->Buffer();
    doc->ApplyBannerAction(TextBannerAction::ReopenAs1252);
    CHECK(&doc->Model() == modelBefore);                                        // decoded into the SAME model and buffer
    CHECK(&doc->Buffer() == bufferBefore);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->ReadOnly());
    CHECK(doc->Encoding() == TextEncoding::Windows1252);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::None);
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "echo caf\xC3\xA9\n");
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());

    // Review Focus F3: the reopen is not undoable. Undo would put the raw
    // invalid-UTF-8 bytes back under the Windows-1252 label.
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().CanUndo());
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().CanRedo());
    CHECK(doc->Note().find("Undo history was cleared") != std::string::npos);
    {
        TextModel& model = doc->Model();
        Arcane::Text::TextCommands cmds(model.buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model));
        CHECK_FALSE(cmds.Undo());                                               // Ctrl+Z is a no-op
    }
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "echo caf\xC3\xA9\n");
    CHECK(doc->Encoding() == TextEncoding::Windows1252);
    CHECK(doc->Save());
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == original);                                              // unedited: byte-identical

    Type(*doc, 10, "!");                                                        // after the UTF-8 e-acute (bytes 8..9)
    CHECK(doc->Save());
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == "echo caf\xE9!\r\n");
}

// Rev-2 T1 (TE1-11 heldBytes): the stray last byte of an odd UTF-16 body is held,
// not decoded -- the synced state ends before it, so a later append completes it.
TEST_CASE("text document: a UTF-16 file with an odd byte count opens editable; the synced size stops before the held byte", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-doc-utf16odd");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "odd.log";
    WriteAll(p, std::string("\xFF\xFE" "a\0\n\0b", 7));       // BOM, "a\n", and the first byte of 'b'
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    CHECK(doc->Encoding() == TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->ReadOnly());
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "a\n");
    CHECK(doc->Synced().stamp.size == 6u);                         // 7 bytes - 1 held
    REQUIRE(doc->ReopenWithEncoding(TextEncoding::Utf16LE));
    CHECK(doc->Synced().stamp.size == 6u);                         // the reopen holds it the same way
}

// Rev-2 A10: the outside-change hook is empty-safe and runs before Reopen with
// Encoding changes the buffer -- never on a reopen refused while dirty.
TEST_CASE("text document: NotifyOutsideChange runs the installed hook before Reopen with Encoding changes the buffer", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-doc-outside");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "legacy.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "caf\xE9\n");
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    doc->NotifyOutsideChange();                                    // nothing installed: a no-op
    int calls = 0;
    std::string seen;
    doc->SetOutsideChangeHook([&] { ++calls; seen = doc->Buffer().Text().ToString(); });
    REQUIRE(doc->ReopenWithEncoding(TextEncoding::Windows1252));
    CHECK(calls == 1);
    CHECK(seen == "caf\xE9\n");                                    // the hook saw the text BEFORE the reload
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "caf\xC3\xA9\n");
    Type(*doc, 0, "x");
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->ReopenWithEncoding(TextEncoding::Utf8));      // refused while dirty: nothing changes...
    CHECK(calls == 1);                                             // ...so nothing is notified
}

TEST_CASE("text document: NUL bytes open read-only (binary); the read-only lock layers on top", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-doc-binary");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "dump.log";
    WriteAll(p, std::string("ok\0\0bad", 7));
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    CHECK(doc->ReadOnlyReason() == TextReadOnlyReason::Binary);
    doc->SetReadOnlyLock(true);
    CHECK(doc->ReadOnlyReason() == TextReadOnlyReason::Locked);
    doc->SetReadOnlyLock(false);
    CHECK(doc->ReadOnlyReason() == TextReadOnlyReason::Binary);

    const std::filesystem::path plain = s.dir / "plain.txt";
    WriteAll(plain, "text");
    auto locked = OpenOrFail(plain);
    locked->SetReadOnlyLock(true);
    CHECK(locked->ReadOnly());
    CHECK_FALSE(locked->Save());
}

TEST_CASE("text document: above editor.text.openMaxMB the file is not opened; a missing file names itself", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-doc-limits");
    const std::filesystem::path big = s.dir / "huge.log";
    WriteAll(big, std::string(2u * 1024u * 1024u, 'x'));
    const Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeRung limit("editor.text.openMaxMB", Arcane::CVarValue::UInt32(1u));
    std::string error;
    CHECK(TextDocument::Open(big, {}, error) == nullptr);
    CHECK(error.find("openMaxMB") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(error.find("open it externally") != std::string::npos);
    error.clear();
    CHECK(TextDocument::Open(s.dir / "gone.txt", {}, error) == nullptr);
    CHECK(error.find("gone.txt") != std::string::npos);
}

// D-R2: buffer-bound members are built in InitAfterLoad, which Open runs once with
// the model and the view in place (building them in the constructor dereferenced null).
TEST_CASE("text document: Open runs InitAfterLoad once, with the model and the view in place", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-doc-initafterload");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "a.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "a\n");
    struct ProbeReset
    {
        ~ProbeReset() { TextDocument::InitAfterLoadProbeForTest() = nullptr; }
    } reset;
    int calls = 0;
    bool modelAndView = false;
    TextDocument::InitAfterLoadProbeForTest() = [&](TextModel* model, TextEditorView* view)
    {
        ++calls;
        modelAndView = model != nullptr && view != nullptr && &view->Model() == model;
    };
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    CHECK(calls == 1);
    CHECK(modelAndView);
    CHECK(&doc->View().Model() == &doc->Model());
    REQUIRE(doc->ReopenWithEncoding(TextEncoding::Windows1252));   // the SAME model and view: nothing to rebuild
    CHECK(calls == 1);
}

TEST_CASE("text document: the open applies editor.text.undoGroupMs / undoMemoryMB to the buffer", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-doc-undo");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "notes.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "a\n");
    const Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeRung group("editor.text.undoGroupMs", Arcane::CVarValue::UInt32(50u));
    const Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeRung memory("editor.text.undoMemoryMB", Arcane::CVarValue::UInt32(2u));
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().GetUndoPolicy().groupMs == 50u);                                   // at open, before any reload
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().GetUndoPolicy().memoryBytes == std::uint64_t(2) * 1024u * 1024u);
}

TEST_CASE("text document: a move retitles but keeps the window id; the window draws headless", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-doc-move");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "a.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "one\ntwo\n");
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    const std::string id = doc->WindowLabel().substr(doc->WindowLabel().find("###"));
    const std::filesystem::path moved = s.dir / "b.txt";
    std::filesystem::rename(p, moved);
    doc->NoteMoved(moved);
    CHECK(doc->Title() == "b.txt");
    CHECK(doc->CanonicalPath() == *CanonicalFilePath(moved));
    CHECK(doc->WindowLabel() == "b.txt" + id);

    ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
    ImGuiContext* ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(1024, 768);
    io.IniFilename = nullptr;
    unsigned char* px = nullptr;
    int w = 0, h = 0;
    io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
    bool close = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
    {
        io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        close = true;
        doc->Draw(close);
        ImGui::Render();
    }
    CHECK_FALSE(close);
    ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The path and content rules every text route shares (text editor spec s1,
// s3.5, s5.3): C++ never opens in the text editor (it stays in the IDE), a
// known binary format is refused, a file with NUL bytes in its first 8 KB
// sniffs as binary (a UTF-16 BOM excepted), and the explicit text extensions
// register the text document directly.

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <span>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    ARC_CONSTANT("spec s3.5: binary detection looks for NUL bytes in the first 8 KB")
    inline constexpr std::size_t kSniffBytes = 8192;

    enum class TextSniffResult : std::uint8_t { Text, Binary };
    [[nodiscard]] TextSniffResult SniffText(std::string_view head);

    [[nodiscard]] bool IsCppSourcePath(const std::filesystem::path& p);         // .cpp .cxx .cc .c .hpp .hxx .hh .h .inl
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsKnownBinaryExtension(const std::filesystem::path& p);
    [[nodiscard]] std::span<const std::string_view> ExplicitTextExtensions();   // lowercase, with the dot

    // A real file's verdict: not a known binary extension AND its first
    // kSniffBytes sniff as text. False when the file cannot be read (TE7-9's
    // opener asks this before routing an unknown extension to the text editor).
    [[nodiscard]] bool SniffsAsText(const std::filesystem::path& p);
}
```

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSniff.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <optional>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        std::string LowerExt(const std::filesystem::path& p)
        {
            const std::u8string u = p.extension().u8string();
            std::string ext(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(u.data()), u.size());
            std::transform(ext.begin(), ext.end(), ext.begin(),
                           [](unsigned char c) { return static_cast<char>(c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' ? c + ('a' - 'A') : c); });
            return ext;
        }

        bool In(std::span<const std::string_view> set, std::string_view ext)
        {
            return std::find(set.begin(), set.end(), ext) != set.end();
        }

        constexpr std::string_view kCpp[] = { ".cpp", ".cxx", ".cc", ".c", ".hpp", ".hxx", ".hh", ".h", ".inl" };
        constexpr std::string_view kBinary[] = {
            ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".tga", ".bmp", ".hdr", ".dds", ".ktx", ".ktx2", ".psd", ".exr",
            ".wav", ".ogg", ".mp3", ".flac", ".ttf", ".otf", ".glb", ".fbx",
            ".exe", ".dll", ".pdb", ".lib", ".obj", ".exp", ".ilk", ".dmp", ".bin",
            ".zip", ".7z", ".rar", ".gz", ".pak", ".arcart",
        };
        constexpr std::string_view kText[] = {
            ".md", ".markdown", ".txt", ".log", ".ini", ".cfg", ".conf", ".toml", ".yaml", ".yml", ".xml",
            ".json", ".jsonc", ".csv", ".tsv", ".hlsl", ".hlsli", ".fx", ".lua", ".bat", ".cmd", ".ps1", ".psm1",
            ".sh", ".bash", ".gitignore", ".gitattributes", ".editorconfig",
            ".arcsyntax", ".arctheme", ".arcproj", ".meta",
        };
    }

    TextSniffResult SniffText(std::string_view head)
    {
        if (head.starts_with("\xFF\xFE") || head.starts_with("\xFE\xFF"))
            return TextSniffResult::Text;   // UTF-16 with a BOM: NULs are expected
        const std::string_view window = head.substr(0, std::min(head.size(), kSniffBytes));
        return window.find('\0') == std::string_view::npos ? TextSniffResult::Text : TextSniffResult::Binary;
    }

    bool IsCppSourcePath(const std::filesystem::path& p) { return In(kCpp, LowerExt(p)); }
    bool IsKnownBinaryExtension(const std::filesystem::path& p) { return In(kBinary, LowerExt(p)); }
    std::span<const std::string_view> ExplicitTextExtensions() { return kText; }

    bool SniffsAsText(const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        if (IsKnownBinaryExtension(p))
            return false;
        const std::optional<std::string> head = ReadRangeShared(p, 0, kSniffBytes);   // shorter when the file is
        return head && SniffText(*head) == TextSniffResult::Text;
    }
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// TextDocument (text editor spec s5.3): the EditorDocument for every text file
// without a dedicated Arcane editor. Identity is the CANONICAL PATH
// (GetFinalPathNameByHandleW): an asset's Guid is only a lookup into it. Bytes
// decode through Text::DecodeFile -- UTF-8 (+/- BOM), UTF-16 LE/BE with a BOM,
// and Windows-1252 on request (Reopen with Encoding). Invalid UTF-8, invalid
// UTF-16 or binary content opens READ-ONLY with its raw bytes, so saving can
// never corrupt it. The document draws a banner strip over one TextEditorView.
//
// Model() / View() are the canonical accessors of the PRIMARY model and view
// (TE4-17's split adds a secondary view); Buffer() is the primary model's
// buffer. ShowNote() is the document's one note channel.

#include "Documents/EditorDocument.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextChangeClassifier.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Guid.hpp>

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class TextDocument;

    enum class TextReadOnlyReason : std::uint8_t { None, InvalidUtf8, InvalidUtf16, Binary, Locked };

    enum class TextBannerKind : std::uint8_t
    {
        None,
        ReadOnlyContent,   // invalid UTF-8 / invalid UTF-16 / binary
        SaveFailed,
    };

    enum class TextBannerAction : std::uint8_t { ReopenAs1252, Retry, Dismiss };

    struct TextBanner
    {
        TextBannerKind kind = TextBannerKind::None;
        std::string    message;
    };
    // The buttons a banner offers, in order. Pure.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<TextBannerAction> BannerActions(const TextBanner& banner);
    [[nodiscard]] const char* BannerActionLabel(TextBannerAction action);
    // The UI label of an encoding ("UTF-8", "UTF-8 with BOM", "UTF-16 LE",
    // "UTF-16 BE", "Windows-1252"). The stable id is Text::EncodingId.
    [[nodiscard]] const char* EncodingLabel(Text::TextEncoding encoding);

    struct TextDocumentServices
    {
        std::function<Arcane::Guid(const std::filesystem::path&)> peekGuid;   // the asset id when the file is one
    };

    class TextDocument final : public EditorDocument
    {
    public:
        // Null with `error` set: missing or unreadable, or above editor.text.openMaxMB.
        static std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> Open(const std::filesystem::path& path, TextDocumentServices services,
                                                  std::string& error);

        const std::string& Title() const override { return m_title; }
        Arcane::Guid AssetGuid() const override { return m_guid; }
        bool Dirty() const override;
        bool Save() override;
        bool WindowFocused() const override { return m_windowFocused; }
        void Draw(bool& requestClose) override;
        void NoteMoved(const std::filesystem::path& newPath) override;
        void NoteReopened() override;

        [[nodiscard]] std::filesystem::path CanonicalPath() const { return m_canonical; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::filesystem::path& Path() const noexcept { return m_path; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::string& WindowLabel() const noexcept { return m_windowLabel; }
        // The PRIMARY model and view (canonical accessors).
        [[nodiscard]] TextModel& Model() noexcept { return *m_model; }
        [[nodiscard]] const TextModel& Model() const noexcept { return *m_model; }
        [[nodiscard]] TextEditorView& View() noexcept { return *m_view; }
        // The primary model's buffer.
        [[nodiscard]] Text::TextBuffer& Buffer() noexcept { return m_model->buffer; }
        [[nodiscard]] const Text::TextBuffer& Buffer() const noexcept { return m_model->buffer; }
        [[nodiscard]] Text::TextEncoding Encoding() const noexcept { return m_encoding; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool ReadOnly() const noexcept { return m_readOnlyReason != TextReadOnlyReason::None; }
        [[nodiscard]] TextReadOnlyReason ReadOnlyReason() const noexcept { return m_readOnlyReason; }
        [[nodiscard]] const TextBanner& Banner() const noexcept { return m_banner; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::string& Note() const noexcept { return m_note; }
        // The one note channel: a quiet line over the view with a Dismiss button. "" clears.
        void ShowNote(std::string note) { m_note = std::move(note); }
        [[nodiscard]] const SyncedFileState& Synced() const noexcept { return m_synced; }

        // Re-decode the file as `encoding` (spec s3.5) into the SAME buffer;
        // refused while dirty. Undo history is cleared (and a note says so): the
        // old text was decoded under another encoding. The choice is kept for
        // reloads (and TE6 remembers it per file).
        bool ReopenWithEncoding(Text::TextEncoding encoding);
        void ApplyBannerAction(TextBannerAction action);
        // TE6 (spec s5.4): Open as Text on an asset with a dedicated editor opens locked.
        void SetReadOnlyLock(bool locked);

        // Rev-2 A10: called before the first buffer change of every path that changes the
        // buffer from outside a view's input step (Reopen with Encoding, the save
        // transforms, a reload, a Follow append, convert line endings). Runs the one
        // installed hook; empty-safe. TE5a-22 subscribes the vim adapter (an open Insert
        // transaction ends first, finding 5a.7); nothing in TE2-TE4 subscribes.
        void NotifyOutsideChange() { if (m_outsideChange) m_outsideChange(); }
        void SetOutsideChangeHook(std::function<void()> hook) { m_outsideChange = std::move(hook); }

        // Tests only: called first thing in InitAfterLoad with the model and view it sees.
        static std::function<void(TextModel*, TextEditorView*)>& InitAfterLoadProbeForTest();

    private:
        TextDocument(std::filesystem::path path, std::filesystem::path canonical, TextDocumentServices services);
        // D-R2: THE place every member or overlay that needs Buffer(), View() or the
        // model is built -- never the constructor or a member initialiser (m_model and
        // m_view do not exist until Open creates them). Open calls it once, after both
        // exist and AdoptDecoded ran; a later path that rebuilds the model or the view
        // calls it again. TE3-30, TE4-11/14/15/17/18/22 and TE6 append to its body.
        void InitAfterLoad();
        // Encoding, content read-only state, the banner and the synced fingerprint
        // from one decode of `read` (the text itself is already in the buffer). The
        // synced state stops `heldBytes` short of the file's end (rev-2 T1: TE1-11's
        // held odd UTF-16 byte is read back by the next poll as an appended tail).
        void AdoptDecoded(const ReadOutcome& read, Text::TextEncoding encoding, Text::ReadOnlyReason readOnly,
                          std::size_t heldBytes);
        // editor.text.defaultLineEnding (ToDecodeOptions) + the Reopen with Encoding choice.
        [[nodiscard]] Text::DecodeOptions CurrentDecodeOptions() const;
        void SyncFrom(std::string_view bytes, const FileStamp& stamp);
        void Retitle();
        void RecomputeReadOnly();
        void DrawBanner();
        [[nodiscard]] std::string Name() const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t MaxOpenBytes() const;

        std::filesystem::path             m_path;
        std::filesystem::path             m_canonical;
        TextDocumentServices              m_services;
        Arcane::Guid                      m_guid;
        std::string                       m_title;
        std::string                       m_windowLabel;
        std::string                       m_labelId;          // "###textdoc_<hash of the opening canonical path>": the dock slot holds across moves
        std::string                       m_canonicalUtf8;
        std::unique_ptr<TextModel>        m_model;            // created once by Open; never replaced
        std::unique_ptr<TextEditorView>   m_view;
        Text::TextEncoding                m_encoding = Text::TextEncoding::Utf8;
        std::optional<Text::TextEncoding> m_forcedEncoding;   // the Reopen with Encoding choice
        TextReadOnlyReason                m_contentReadOnly = TextReadOnlyReason::None;
        TextReadOnlyReason                m_readOnlyReason = TextReadOnlyReason::None;
        bool                              m_locked = false;
        SyncedFileState                   m_synced;
        TextBanner                        m_banner;
        std::string                       m_note;
        bool                              m_windowFocused = false;
        std::function<void()>             m_outsideChange;    // rev-2 A10: empty until TE5a-22 subscribes
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"

#include "Input/EditorActions.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <imgui.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <expected>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("units: bytes per MiB (editor.text.*MB settings)")
        constexpr std::uint64_t kBytesPerMiB = 1024ull * 1024ull;

        std::string Utf8(const std::filesystem::path& p)
        {
            const std::u8string u = p.u8string();
            return std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(u.data()), u.size());
        }

        // The codec's content verdict -> the document's read-only reason.
        TextReadOnlyReason FromContentReason(Text::ReadOnlyReason reason)
        {
            switch (reason)
            {
            case Text::ReadOnlyReason::None:         return TextReadOnlyReason::None;
            case Text::ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8:  return TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8;
            case Text::ReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16: return TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16;
            case Text::ReadOnlyReason::Binary:       return TextReadOnlyReason::Binary;
            }
            return TextReadOnlyReason::Binary;   // unknown: the safe side
        }
    }

    std::vector<TextBannerAction> BannerActions(const TextBanner& b)
    {
        switch (b.kind)
        {
        case TextBannerKind::None:            return {};
        case TextBannerKind::ReadOnlyContent: return { TextBannerAction::ReopenAs1252 };
        case TextBannerKind::SaveFailed:      return { TextBannerAction::Retry, TextBannerAction::Dismiss };
        }
        return {};
    }

    const char* BannerActionLabel(TextBannerAction a)
    {
        switch (a)
        {
        case TextBannerAction::ReopenAs1252: return "Reopen as Windows-1252";
        case TextBannerAction::Retry:        return "Retry";
        case TextBannerAction::Dismiss:      return "Dismiss";
        }
        return "?";
    }

    const char* EncodingLabel(Text::TextEncoding e)
    {
        switch (e)
        {
        case Text::TextEncoding::Utf8:        return "UTF-8";
        case Text::TextEncoding::Utf8Bom:     return "UTF-8 with BOM";
        case Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE:     return "UTF-16 LE";
        case Text::TextEncoding::Utf16BE:     return "UTF-16 BE";
        case Text::TextEncoding::Windows1252: return "Windows-1252";
        }
        return "?";
    }

    TextDocument::TextDocument(std::filesystem::path path, std::filesystem::path canonical, TextDocumentServices services)
        : m_path(std::move(path)), m_canonical(std::move(canonical)), m_services(std::move(services))
    {
        m_guid = m_services.peekGuid ? m_services.peekGuid(m_canonical) : Arcane::Guid::Nil();
        char id[24] = {};
        std::snprintf(id, sizeof(id), "%016llx", static_cast<unsigned long long>(HashBytes(Utf8(m_canonical))));
        m_labelId = std::string("###textdoc_") + id;
        Retitle();
    }

    std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> TextDocument::Open(const std::filesystem::path& path, TextDocumentServices services,
                                                     std::string& error)
    {
        const std::optional<std::filesystem::path> canonical = CanonicalFilePath(path);
        if (!canonical)
        {
            error = "'" + Utf8(path) + "' could not be opened: it is missing or not accessible";
            return nullptr;
        }
        std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> doc(new TextDocument(path, *canonical, std::move(services)));
        const ReadOutcome r = ReadFileShared(*canonical, doc->MaxOpenBytes());
        if (r.tooLarge)
        {
            error = "'" + doc->Name() + "' is " + std::to_string(r.stamp.size / kBytesPerMiB) + " MB, above editor.text.openMaxMB ("
                  + std::to_string(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().openMaxMB) + " MB) -- open it externally";
            return nullptr;
        }
        if (!r.ok)
        {
            error = "'" + doc->Name() + "' could not be read (Windows error " + std::to_string(r.win32Error) + ")";
            return nullptr;
        }
        const Text::DecodedText decoded = Text::DecodeFile(r.bytes, doc->CurrentDecodeOptions());
        doc->m_model = std::make_unique<TextModel>(Text::Rope::FromUtf8(decoded.text), decoded.eols);
        doc->m_model->buffer.MarkSaved();   // a freshly read document equals its file
        // editor.text.undoGroupMs / undoMemoryMB from the first keystroke (TE2-17 re-applies the
        // live values before every reload).
        doc->m_model->buffer.SetUndoPolicy(ToUndoPolicy(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>()));
        doc->m_view = std::make_unique<TextEditorView>(*doc->m_model);
        doc->AdoptDecoded(r, decoded.encoding, decoded.readOnly, decoded.heldBytes);
        // The model, buffer and view above are created HERE only. AdoptDecoded is metadata
        // (encoding, read-only reason, synced stamp, banner): ReopenWithEncoding and TE2-17's
        // reload re-run it over the SAME buffer. Everything bound to the buffer or the view
        // (TE3-30's InitHighlight(), TE4's overlays and members) is built in InitAfterLoad,
        // once per document (D-R2).
        doc->InitAfterLoad();
        return doc;
    }

    std::function<void(TextModel*, TextEditorView*)>& TextDocument::InitAfterLoadProbeForTest()
    {
        static std::function<void(TextModel*, TextEditorView*)> probe;
        return probe;
    }

    void TextDocument::InitAfterLoad()
    {
        if (const auto& probe = InitAfterLoadProbeForTest())
            probe(m_model.get(), m_view.get());
        // D-R2: later tasks append the buffer- and view-bound construction here
        // (TE3-30 InitHighlight, TE4-11/14/15/17/18/22, TE6), in task order.
    }

    Text::DecodeOptions TextDocument::CurrentDecodeOptions() const
    {
        Text::DecodeOptions options = ToDecodeOptions(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>());
        options.forced = m_forcedEncoding;
        return options;
    }

    std::uint64_t TextDocument::MaxOpenBytes() const
    {
        return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::max<std::uint32_t>(1u, Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().openMaxMB)) * kBytesPerMiB;
    }

    std::string TextDocument::Name() const { return Utf8(m_path.filename()); }

    void TextDocument::Retitle()
    {
        m_title = Name();
        m_windowLabel = m_title + m_labelId;
        m_canonicalUtf8 = Utf8(m_canonical);
    }

    void TextDocument::RecomputeReadOnly()
    {
        m_readOnlyReason = m_locked ? TextReadOnlyReason::Locked : m_contentReadOnly;
    }

    void TextDocument::SetReadOnlyLock(bool locked)
    {
        m_locked = locked;
        RecomputeReadOnly();
    }

    void TextDocument::SyncFrom(std::string_view bytes, const FileStamp& stamp)
    {
        m_synced.stamp = stamp;
        m_synced.windowHash = HashBytes(bytes.substr(static_cast<std::size_t>(AppendWindowStart(bytes.size()))));
        m_synced.lastUnit = LastUnitOf(bytes, m_encoding);
    }

    void TextDocument::AdoptDecoded(const ReadOutcome& read, Text::TextEncoding encoding, Text::ReadOnlyReason readOnly,
                                    std::size_t heldBytes)
    {
        m_encoding = encoding;
        m_contentReadOnly = FromContentReason(readOnly);
        RecomputeReadOnly();
        // Rev-2 T1: a UTF-16 file with an odd byte count decodes up to its stray last
        // byte, which TE1-11 HOLDS (not in the text). The synced size and window end
        // before it, so the next poll reads it as the start of an appended tail and
        // CompleteTailLength completes the unit once its other half is written.
        const std::size_t held = std::min<std::size_t>(heldBytes, read.bytes.size());
        FileStamp stamp = read.stamp;
        stamp.size -= held;
        SyncFrom(std::string_view(read.bytes).substr(0, read.bytes.size() - held), stamp);
        const char* what = nullptr;
        switch (m_contentReadOnly)
        {
        case TextReadOnlyReason::Binary:       what = "contains NUL bytes"; break;
        case TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8:  what = "is not valid UTF-8"; break;
        case TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16: what = "is not valid UTF-16"; break;
        case TextReadOnlyReason::None:
        case TextReadOnlyReason::Locked:       break;
        }
        if (what == nullptr)
            m_banner = {};
        else
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::ReadOnlyContent,
                "'" + Name() + "' " + what + ", so it opened read-only and keeps its bytes exactly. "
                "If it is a legacy text file, reopen it as Windows-1252." };
    }

    bool TextDocument::Dirty() const { return m_model->buffer.Dirty(); }

    bool TextDocument::ReopenWithEncoding(Text::TextEncoding encoding)
    {
        if (Dirty())
            return false;
        const ReadOutcome r = ReadFileShared(m_canonical, MaxOpenBytes());
        if (!r.ok)
        {
            ShowNote("Could not reread '" + Name() + "' (Windows error " + std::to_string(r.win32Error) + ")");
            return false;
        }
        m_forcedEncoding = encoding;
        Text::DecodedText decoded = Text::DecodeFile(r.bytes, CurrentDecodeOptions());
        const Text::TextEncoding decodedAs = decoded.encoding;
        const Text::ReadOnlyReason contentReadOnly = decoded.readOnly;
        const std::size_t heldBytes = decoded.heldBytes;

        NotifyOutsideChange();   // rev-2 A10: before the buffer changes (vim ends an open Insert transaction)
        // The SAME buffer (the view, a split view and every observer stay bound):
        // no new model, no Rebind.
        Text::TextBuffer& buffer = m_model->buffer;
        buffer.ReloadExternal(std::move(decoded.text), std::move(decoded.eols), m_model->selections);
        buffer.ClearHistory();   // spec s3.5 / CANON D5: undo must not reach text decoded under the old encoding
        buffer.MarkSaved();      // the buffer equals the file again
        m_model->selections.ClampTo(buffer.Text().Size());

        AdoptDecoded(r, decodedAs, contentReadOnly, heldBytes);
        ShowNote(std::string("Reopened '") + Name() + "' as " + EncodingLabel(m_encoding)
                 + ". Undo history was cleared: the earlier text was decoded as a different encoding.");
        return true;
    }

    bool TextDocument::Save()
    {
        if (ReadOnly())
            return false;
        Text::TextBuffer& buffer = m_model->buffer;
        const std::expected<std::string, Text::EncodeError> encoded = Text::EncodeFile(buffer.Text(), buffer.Eols(), m_encoding);
        if (!encoded)
        {
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveFailed, "Could not save '" + Name() + "': " + encoded.error().message
                                   + ". Your changes are still here." };
            return false;
        }
        const std::string& bytes = *encoded;
        SaveRequest req;
        req.target = m_canonical;
        req.bytes = bytes;
        const SaveOutcome out = SaveFileBytes(req);
        if (!SavedOk(out.status))
        {
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveFailed, "Could not save '" + Name() + "' (Windows error "
                                   + std::to_string(out.win32Error) + "). Your changes are still here." };
            return false;
        }
        buffer.MarkSaved();
        m_synced.selfSave = out.written;
        // Finding 2.15: the synced stamp is what WE wrote (our size, the save's own
        // mtime), never a fresh stat -- an append landing between the replace and a
        // stat would otherwise be absorbed into the stamp and never shown.
        SyncFrom(bytes, FileStamp{ true, out.written.size, out.written.mtime, 0 });
        m_banner = {};
        return true;
    }

    void TextDocument::ApplyBannerAction(TextBannerAction a)
    {
        switch (a)
        {
        case TextBannerAction::ReopenAs1252: (void)ReopenWithEncoding(Text::TextEncoding::Windows1252); break;
        case TextBannerAction::Retry:        (void)Save(); break;
        case TextBannerAction::Dismiss:      m_banner = {}; break;
        }
    }

    void TextDocument::NoteMoved(const std::filesystem::path& newPath)
    {
        m_path = newPath;
        m_canonical = CanonicalFilePath(newPath).value_or(newPath);
        Retitle();
    }

    void TextDocument::NoteReopened()
    {
        m_view->Focus();
    }

    void TextDocument::DrawBanner()
    {
        if (m_banner.kind != TextBannerKind::None)
        {
            ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(0.0f);
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(m_banner.message.c_str());
            ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
            std::optional<TextBannerAction> clicked;
            for (const TextBannerAction a : BannerActions(m_banner))
            {
                ImGui::PushID(static_cast<int>(a));
                if (ImGui::SmallButton(BannerActionLabel(a)))
                    clicked = a;
                ImGui::PopID();
                ImGui::SameLine();
            }
            ImGui::NewLine();
            ImGui::Separator();
            if (clicked)
                ApplyBannerAction(*clicked);
        }
        if (!m_note.empty())
        {
            ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", m_note.c_str());
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::SmallButton("Dismiss##textnote"))
                ShowNote("");
        }
    }

    void TextDocument::Draw(bool& requestClose)
    {
        bool open = true;
        const bool visible = ImGui::Begin(m_windowLabel.c_str(), &open, Dirty() ? ImGuiWindowFlags_UnsavedDocument : 0);
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s", m_canonicalUtf8.c_str());   // the tab (or title bar) is LastItemData after Begin
        if (!visible)
        {
            m_windowFocused = false;
            ImGui::End();
            requestClose = !open;
            return;
        }
        m_windowFocused = ImGui::IsWindowFocused(ImGuiFocusedFlags_RootAndChildWindows);
        EditorActions& keys = EditorActions::Get();
        if (m_windowFocused)
        {
            keys.MarkContextActive(ActionContext::Document);
            if (keys.Pressed("document.save"))
                (void)RequestSave();
        }
        DrawBanner();
        m_view->Draw("##text", ImVec2(0.0f, 0.0f), ReadOnly());
        ImGui::End();
        requestClose = !open;
    }
}
```

```cpp
{

    REQUIRE(::SetFileAttributesW(p.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY));
    TextDocumentServices services;
    services.readOnlyReason = [](const std::filesystem::path&) { return std::string("locked by Git LFS -- run `git lfs lock`"); };
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p, services);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->ReadOnly());                          // the attribute refuses the SAVE, not the edit
    Type(*doc, 0, "x");

    CHECK(doc->RequestSave() == SaveGestureResult::Refused);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::SaveReadOnly);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().message.find("locked by Git LFS") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(BannerActions(doc->Banner()) == std::vector<A>{ A::SaveAs, A::RemoveReadOnlyAndSave, A::Cancel });
    CHECK(doc->Dirty());

    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::RemoveReadOnlyAndSave);      // asks first, repeating the warning
    CHECK(doc->Banner().confirmingRemoveReadOnly);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().message.find("locked by Git LFS") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(BannerActions(doc->Banner()) == std::vector<A>{ A::ConfirmRemoveReadOnly, A::Cancel });
    CHECK(Read(p) == "checked in\n");

    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::ConfirmRemoveReadOnly);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::None);
    CHECK(Read(p) == "xchecked in\n");
    CHECK((StatFile(p).attributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) == 0);

    Type(*other, 0, "b");
    CHECK_FALSE(other->Save());
    CHECK(other->Banner().message.find("may be under version control") != std::string::npos);   // no probe: the default wording
}

TEST_CASE("text save flow: trim and final newline are one undo step each; the fingerprint is recorded", "[text-doc]")
{

    const Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeLayer layer;
    const Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeRung trim("editor.text.trimTrailingWhitespace", Arcane::CVarValue::Bool(true));
    const Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeRung eol("editor.text.ensureFinalNewline", Arcane::CVarValue::Bool(true));
    CHECK(doc->Save());
    CHECK(Read(p) == "a\nb\n");
    CHECK(doc->Synced().selfSave.valid);
    CHECK(doc->Synced().selfSave.size == 4u);
    CHECK(doc->Synced().selfSave.mtime == StatFile(p).mtime);
    CHECK(doc->Synced().selfSave.hash == HashBytes("a\nb\n"));
    auto& sels = doc->Model().selections;
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Undo(sels));
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "a\nb");
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Undo(sels));
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "a  \nb\t");

    // Nothing to change: no transaction, so no empty undo step.
    TextModel& model = doc->Model();
    Arcane::Text::TextCommands cmds(model.buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model));
    CHECK(cmds.TrimTrailingWhitespace());
    CHECK(cmds.EnsureFinalNewline());
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "a\nb\n");
    CHECK_FALSE(cmds.TrimTrailingWhitespace());
    CHECK_FALSE(cmds.EnsureFinalNewline());
    CHECK(cmds.Undo());
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Text().ToString() == "a\nb");                 // the last step was EnsureFinalNewline's
}

// Rev-2 A10: Save and Save As notify before the save transforms edit the buffer
// (TE5a-22's vim adapter ends an open Insert transaction there); a refused save does not.
TEST_CASE("text save flow: the outside-change hook runs before the save transforms, never on a refused save", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-flow-outside");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "t.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "a  \n");
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    const Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeLayer layer;
    const Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeRung trim("editor.text.trimTrailingWhitespace", Arcane::CVarValue::Bool(true));
    int calls = 0;
    std::string seen;
    doc->SetOutsideChangeHook([&] { ++calls; seen = doc->Buffer().Text().ToString(); });
    CHECK(doc->Save());
    CHECK(calls == 1);
    CHECK(seen == "a  \n");                                  // before the trim edited the buffer
    CHECK(Read(p) == "a\n");
    CHECK(doc->SaveAs(s.dir / "u.txt"));
    CHECK(calls == 2);

    const std::filesystem::path bad = s.dir / "bad.txt";
    WriteAll(bad, "caf\xE9\n");                             // invalid UTF-8: read-only content
    auto ro = OpenOrFail(bad);
    int roCalls = 0;
    ro->SetOutsideChangeHook([&] { ++roCalls; });
    CHECK_FALSE(ro->Save());
    CHECK_FALSE(ro->SaveAs(s.dir / "v.txt"));
    CHECK(roCalls == 0);                                     // a refused save changes nothing
}

    WriteAll(p, "x\n");
    double clock = 100.0;
    TextDocumentServices services;
    services.now = [&] { return clock; };
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p, services);
    Type(*doc, 0, "y");
    doc->NoteExternalWrite();
    CHECK(doc->RequestSave() == SaveGestureResult::Deferred);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().message.find("written by another program") != std::string::npos);
    clock += 11.0;                                           // past editor.text.recentWriteSeconds (10)
    CHECK(doc->RequestSave() == SaveGestureResult::Saved);
}

TEST_CASE("text save flow: a character the encoding cannot hold refuses the save and names where it is", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-flow-encode");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "legacy.txt";
    const std::string original = "caf\xE9\r\n";              // a euro-free Windows-1252 file
    WriteAll(p, original);
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::ReopenAs1252);
    REQUIRE(doc->Encoding() == Arcane::Text::TextEncoding::Windows1252);
    Type(*doc, 0, "\xE4\xB8\xAD");                            // U+4E2D: no Windows-1252 byte holds it

    CHECK(doc->RequestSave() == SaveGestureResult::Refused);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::SaveEncodeError);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().message.find("Cannot save as Windows-1252") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().message.find("line 1, byte 1") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().message.find("U+4E2D") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(BannerActions(doc->Banner()) == std::vector<A>{ A::SaveAsUtf8, A::SaveAs, A::Dismiss });
    CHECK(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(Read(p) == original);                              // nothing was written
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Save());
    CHECK(Read(p) == original);

    // Finding 2.12: a plain Save As keeps Windows-1252 and fails the same way...
    const std::filesystem::path copy = s.dir / "copy.txt";
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->SaveAs(copy));
    CHECK_FALSE(std::filesystem::exists(copy));
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::SaveEncodeError);
    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::Dismiss);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::None);
    CHECK(doc->Dirty());

    // ...so the banner offers Save as UTF-8: the same file, in an encoding that holds every character.
    CHECK(doc->RequestSave() == SaveGestureResult::Refused);
    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::SaveAsUtf8);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::None);
    CHECK(doc->Encoding() == Arcane::Text::TextEncoding::Utf8);
    CHECK(Read(p) == "\xE4\xB8\xAD" "caf\xC3\xA9\r\n");      // the line ending is kept
    CHECK(doc->Note().find("UTF-8") != std::string::npos);

    // SaveAs with an explicit encoding writes in it and makes it the document's.
    CHECK(doc->SaveAs(copy, Arcane::Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE));
    CHECK(Read(copy) == std::string("\xFF\xFE\x2D\x4E" "c\0a\0f\0\xE9\0\r\0\n\0", 16));
    CHECK(doc->Encoding() == Arcane::Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
}

TEST_CASE("text save flow: Save As onto a file another tab holds is refused before anything is written", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-flow-saveas-open");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "a.txt";
    const std::filesystem::path q = s.dir / "b.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "a\n");
    WriteAll(q, "b\n");
    std::filesystem::path asked;
    TextDocumentServices services;
    services.saveAsTargetOpenElsewhere = [&](TextDocument&, const std::filesystem::path& target)
    {
        asked = target;
        return target == *CanonicalFilePath(q);              // the other tab holds b.txt
    };
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p, services);
    Type(*doc, 0, "x");
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->SaveAs(q));
    CHECK(asked == *CanonicalFilePath(q));                   // asked with the canonical key
    CHECK(Read(q) == "b\n");                                 // the other tab's file is untouched
    CHECK(doc->CanonicalPath() == *CanonicalFilePath(p));    // and this document's identity too
    CHECK(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Note().find("already open") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(doc->SaveAs(s.dir / "c.txt"));                     // any other target still saves
    CHECK(Read(s.dir / "c.txt") == "xa\n");
}

TEST_CASE("text save flow: afterSave runs after every successful Save and Save As, never after a refused one", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-flow-aftersave");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "a.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "one\n");
    int calls = 0;
    std::filesystem::path seen;
    TextDocumentServices services;
    services.afterSave = [&](TextDocument& d) { ++calls; seen = d.CanonicalPath(); };
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p, services);
    Type(*doc, 0, "x");
    CHECK(doc->Save());
    CHECK(calls == 1);
    CHECK(seen == *CanonicalFilePath(p));

    REQUIRE(::SetFileAttributesW(p.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY));
    Type(*doc, 0, "y");
    CHECK(doc->RequestSave() == SaveGestureResult::Refused);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::SaveReadOnly);
    CHECK(calls == 1);                                       // a refused save is not a save

    const std::filesystem::path target = s.dir / "b.txt";
    CHECK(doc->SaveAs(target));
    CHECK(calls == 2);
    CHECK(seen == *CanonicalFilePath(target));              // called with the new identity in place
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.cpp` -- add after `TextCommands::Redo` (inside `namespace Arcane::Text`):
```cpp
    bool TextCommands::TrimTrailingWhitespace()
    {
        const Rope& text = m_buffer.Text();
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::string line;
        for (std::uint32_t row = 0; row < text.LineCount(); ++row)
        {
            const ByteOffset b = text.LineStart(row);
            const ByteOffset e = text.LineEnd(row);
            text.CopyTo(ByteRange{ b, e }, line);
            std::size_t keep = line.size();
            while (keep > 0 && (line[keep - 1] == ' ' || line[keep - 1] == '\t'))
                --keep;
            if (keep < line.size())
                ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ b + keep, e }, std::string{} });
        }
        if (ops.empty())
            return false;
        EditAndMap(TransactionKind::Other, std::move(ops), Bias::Left, Bias::Left, Bias::Right);
        return true;
    }

    bool TextCommands::EnsureFinalNewline()
    {
        const Rope& text = m_buffer.Text();
        const ByteOffset size = text.Size();
        if (size == 0)
            return false;
        std::string last;
        text.CopyTo(ByteRange{ size - 1, size }, last);
        if (last == "\n")
            return false;
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ size, size }, "\n" });   // the new break takes the file's dominant ending (EolMap)
        EditAndMap(TransactionKind::Other, std::move(ops), Bias::Left, Bias::Left, Bias::Right);
        return true;
    }
```

```cpp
    std::vector<TextBannerAction> BannerActions(const TextBanner& b)
    {
        using A = TextBannerAction;
        switch (b.kind)
        {
        case TextBannerKind::None:             return {};
        case TextBannerKind::ReadOnlyContent:  return { A::ReopenAs1252 };
        case TextBannerKind::SaveFailed:       return { A::Retry, A::SaveAs, A::Dismiss };
        case TextBannerKind::SaveReadOnly:
            return b.confirmingRemoveReadOnly ? std::vector<A>{ A::ConfirmRemoveReadOnly, A::Cancel }
                                              : std::vector<A>{ A::SaveAs, A::RemoveReadOnlyAndSave, A::Cancel };
        case TextBannerKind::SaveAccessDenied: return { A::SaveAs, A::Cancel };
        case TextBannerKind::SaveInUse:
            return b.overwriteInPlaceAvailable ? std::vector<A>{ A::Retry, A::SaveAs, A::OverwriteInPlace, A::Cancel }
                                               : std::vector<A>{ A::Retry, A::SaveAs, A::Cancel };
        case TextBannerKind::SaveHolders:
            return b.overwriteInPlaceAvailable ? std::vector<A>{ A::OverwriteInPlace, A::SaveAnyway, A::Cancel }
                                               : std::vector<A>{ A::SaveAnyway, A::Cancel };
        case TextBannerKind::SaveRecovery:     return { A::Retry, A::SaveAs, A::Dismiss };
        case TextBannerKind::SaveEncodeError:  return { A::SaveAsUtf8, A::SaveAs, A::Dismiss };
        }
        return {};
    }

    const char* BannerActionLabel(TextBannerAction a)
    {
        switch (a)
        {
        case TextBannerAction::ReopenAs1252:          return "Reopen as Windows-1252";
        case TextBannerAction::Retry:                 return "Retry";
        case TextBannerAction::Dismiss:               return "Dismiss";
        case TextBannerAction::SaveAs:                return "Save As...";
        case TextBannerAction::RemoveReadOnlyAndSave: return "Remove read-only and save";
        case TextBannerAction::ConfirmRemoveReadOnly: return "Yes, remove read-only and save";
        case TextBannerAction::OverwriteInPlace:      return "Overwrite in place (not atomic)";
        case TextBannerAction::SaveAnyway:            return "Save anyway";
        case TextBannerAction::Cancel:                return "Cancel";
        case TextBannerAction::SaveAsUtf8:            return "Save as UTF-8";
        }
        return "?";
    }

    double TextDocument::Now() const
    {
        if (m_services.now)
            return m_services.now();
        return std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
    }

    void TextDocument::NoteExternalWrite() { m_lastExternalWrite = Now(); }

    bool TextDocument::RecentExternalWrite() const
    {
        return m_lastExternalWrite
            && Now() - *m_lastExternalWrite < static_cast<double>(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().recentWriteSeconds);
    }

    std::string TextDocument::ReadOnlyReasonText() const
    {
        return m_services.readOnlyReason ? m_services.readOnlyReason(m_canonical) : std::string("it may be under version control");
    }

    std::string TextDocument::HoldersMessage(const std::string& name, const std::vector<FileHolder>& holders) const
    {
        if (!holders.empty())
        {
            std::string who;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < holders.size(); ++i)
            {
                if (i > 0) who += i + 1 == holders.size() ? " and " : ", ";
                who += (holders[i].thisProcess ? std::string("this editor") : holders[i].appName)
                     + " (pid " + std::to_string(holders[i].pid) + ")";
            }
            return "'" + name + "' is open in " + who + ". Replacing it would detach a program that is still writing it.";
        }
        if (m_follow)
            return "'" + name + "' is being followed. Replacing it would detach the program writing it.";
        return "'" + name + "' was written by another program in the last "
             + std::to_string(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().recentWriteSeconds)
             + " seconds. Replacing it could detach a program that is still writing it.";
    }

    std::expected<std::string, Text::EncodeError> TextDocument::EncodeForSave(Text::TextEncoding encoding)
    {
        const TextSettings& s = Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>();
        Text::TextCommands cmds(m_model->buffer, m_model->selections, DefaultEditContext(*m_model));
        if (s.trimTrailingWhitespace)
            (void)cmds.TrimTrailingWhitespace();
        if (s.ensureFinalNewline)
            (void)cmds.EnsureFinalNewline();
        return Text::EncodeFile(m_model->buffer.Text(), m_model->buffer.Eols(), encoding);
    }

    std::string TextDocument::EncodeErrorMessage(const Text::EncodeError& e, Text::TextEncoding encoding) const
    {
        char codePoint[16] = {};
        std::snprintf(codePoint, sizeof(codePoint), "U+%04X", static_cast<unsigned>(e.value));
        return std::string("Cannot save as ") + EncodingLabel(encoding) + ": line " + std::to_string(e.row + 1u)
             + ", byte " + std::to_string(e.byteCol + 1u) + " holds " + codePoint
             + " it cannot represent. Nothing was written; Save as UTF-8 keeps every character.";
    }

    void TextDocument::AdoptSavedEncoding(Text::TextEncoding encoding, const std::filesystem::path& target)
    {
        if (encoding == m_encoding)
            return;
        const char* was = EncodingLabel(m_encoding);
        m_encoding = encoding;
        m_forcedEncoding.reset();   // the file is no longer what Reopen with Encoding chose: let a reload detect it
        ShowNote(std::string("Saved '") + Utf8(target.filename()) + "' as " + EncodingLabel(encoding) + " (it was " + was + ").");
    }

    bool TextDocument::Save() { return SaveWith(SaveMode::Atomic); }

    SaveGestureResult TextDocument::RequestSave()
    {
        if (SaveWith(SaveMode::Atomic))
            return SaveGestureResult::Saved;
        return m_banner.kind == TextBannerKind::SaveHolders ? SaveGestureResult::Deferred : SaveGestureResult::Refused;
    }

    bool TextDocument::SaveWith(SaveMode mode, std::optional<Text::TextEncoding> as)
    {
        if (ReadOnly())
            return false;   // read-only content never saves (spec s3.5)
        NotifyOutsideChange();   // rev-2 A10: the trim / final-newline transforms may edit the buffer
        const Text::TextEncoding encoding = as.value_or(m_encoding);
        const std::expected<std::string, Text::EncodeError> encoded = EncodeForSave(encoding);
        if (!encoded)
        {
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveEncodeError, EncodeErrorMessage(encoded.error(), encoding) };
            return false;   // nothing written; the buffer stays dirty
        }
        const std::string& bytes = *encoded;
        SaveRequest req;
        req.target = m_canonical;
        req.bytes = bytes;
        req.mode = mode;
        req.underFollow = m_follow;
        req.recentExternalWrite = RecentExternalWrite();
        const SaveOutcome out = SaveFileBytes(req, m_services.saveOps ? *m_services.saveOps : RealSaveFileOps());
        const bool ok = HandleSaveOutcome(out, bytes, m_canonical);
        if (ok)
            AdoptSavedEncoding(encoding, m_canonical);
        if (ok && m_services.afterSave)
            m_services.afterSave(*this);
        return ok;
    }

    bool TextDocument::SaveAs(const std::filesystem::path& target, std::optional<Text::TextEncoding> as)
    {
        if (ReadOnly())
            return false;
        // Finding 2.16: one tab per file (spec s5.3) -- a Save As onto a file another
        // document holds would give two live documents for it. Refused before writing.
        const std::filesystem::path targetKey = CanonicalFilePath(target).value_or(target);
        if (targetKey != m_canonical && m_services.saveAsTargetOpenElsewhere
            && m_services.saveAsTargetOpenElsewhere(*this, targetKey))
        {
            ShowNote("'" + Utf8(target.filename()) + "' is already open in another tab -- save or close it there first. "
                     "Nothing was written.");
            return false;
        }
        NotifyOutsideChange();   // rev-2 A10: the trim / final-newline transforms may edit the buffer
        const Text::TextEncoding encoding = as.value_or(m_encoding);
        const std::expected<std::string, Text::EncodeError> encoded = EncodeForSave(encoding);
        if (!encoded)
        {
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveEncodeError, EncodeErrorMessage(encoded.error(), encoding) };
            return false;
        }
        const std::string& bytes = *encoded;
        SaveRequest req;
        req.target = target;
        req.bytes = bytes;
        const SaveOutcome out = SaveFileBytes(req, m_services.saveOps ? *m_services.saveOps : RealSaveFileOps());
        if (!SavedOk(out.status))
            return HandleSaveOutcome(out, bytes, target);
        m_path = target;
        m_canonical = CanonicalFilePath(target).value_or(target);
        m_guid = m_services.peekGuid ? m_services.peekGuid(m_canonical) : Arcane::Guid::Nil();
        Retitle();
        const bool ok = HandleSaveOutcome(out, bytes, target);
        if (ok)
            AdoptSavedEncoding(encoding, target);
        if (m_services.identityChanged)
            m_services.identityChanged(*this);
        if (ok && m_services.afterSave)
            m_services.afterSave(*this);   // after the re-key: it sees the new identity
        return ok;
    }

    bool TextDocument::HandleSaveOutcome(const SaveOutcome& out, const std::string& bytes, const std::filesystem::path& target)
    {
        const std::string name = Utf8(target.filename());
        const std::string err = std::to_string(out.win32Error);
        switch (out.status)
        {
        case SaveStatus::Saved:
        case SaveStatus::SavedWithoutAclPreservation:
            m_model->buffer.MarkSaved();
            m_model->buffer.BreakUndoGroup();   // a save ends the typing group (spec s3.3)
            m_synced.selfSave = out.written;
            // Finding 2.15: the stamp is what WE wrote (our size, the save's own mtime);
            // a fresh stat here would absorb an append that landed after the replace.
            SyncFrom(bytes, FileStamp{ true, out.written.size, out.written.mtime, 0 });
            m_banner = {};
            if (out.status == SaveStatus::SavedWithoutAclPreservation && !m_aclNoteShown)
            {
                ShowNote("Saved '" + name + "' without keeping its permissions: this volume does not support ReplaceFileW.");
                m_aclNoteShown = true;
            }
            return true;
        case SaveStatus::ReadOnlyAttribute:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveReadOnly, "'" + name + "' is read-only -- " + ReadOnlyReasonText()
                + ". Removing the flag behind a version control system's back is how work gets lost; Save As keeps your changes elsewhere." };
            break;
        case SaveStatus::AccessDenied:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveAccessDenied, "Windows denied writing '" + name + "' -- "
                + ReadOnlyReasonText() + ". Save As keeps your changes elsewhere." };
            break;
        case SaveStatus::SharingViolation:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveInUse, "'" + name + "' is in use by another program. Nothing was written.",
                                   out.overwriteInPlaceAvailable };
            break;
        case SaveStatus::HoldersPresent:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveHolders, HoldersMessage(name, out.holders), out.overwriteInPlaceAvailable };
            break;
        case SaveStatus::RecoveredOriginalIntact:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveRecovery, "Saving '" + name + "' failed (Windows error " + err
                + "); the file on disk is unchanged. Your changes are still here." };
            break;
        case SaveStatus::RecoveredFromBackup:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveRecovery, "Saving '" + name + "' failed part-way (Windows error " + err
                + "); the original was put back. Your changes are still here." };
            break;
        case SaveStatus::RecoveryFailed:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveRecovery, "Saving '" + name + "' failed part-way and the original could not "
                "be put back. Nothing is lost: the original is '" + Utf8(out.backupPath) + "' and your version is '"
                + Utf8(out.tempPath) + "'." };
            break;
        case SaveStatus::WriteFailed:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::SaveFailed, "Could not save '" + name + "' (Windows error " + err
                + "). Your changes are still here." };
            break;
        }
        return false;
    }

    void TextDocument::ApplyBannerAction(TextBannerAction a)
    {
        switch (a)
        {
        case TextBannerAction::ReopenAs1252:
            (void)ReopenWithEncoding(Text::TextEncoding::Windows1252);
            break;
        case TextBannerAction::Retry:
            (void)SaveWith(SaveMode::Atomic);
            break;
        case TextBannerAction::SaveAs:
            if (m_services.requestSaveAsPath)
                m_services.requestSaveAsPath(*this);
            break;
        case TextBannerAction::RemoveReadOnlyAndSave:
            // The confirmation repeats the readOnlyReason phrase verbatim (TE6-22's tests rely on it).
            m_banner.confirmingRemoveReadOnly = true;
            m_banner.message = "Remove the read-only flag from '" + Name() + "' and save? " + ReadOnlyReasonText()
                             + " -- if a version control system locked it, your change may be lost or conflict.";
            break;
        case TextBannerAction::ConfirmRemoveReadOnly:
            (void)SaveWith(SaveMode::RemoveReadOnlyThenAtomic);
            break;
        case TextBannerAction::OverwriteInPlace:
            (void)SaveWith(SaveMode::OverwriteInPlace);
            break;
        case TextBannerAction::SaveAnyway:
            (void)SaveWith(SaveMode::AtomicSkipHolderCheck);
            break;
        case TextBannerAction::SaveAsUtf8:
            if (m_banner.kind == TextBannerKind::SaveEncodeError)
                (void)SaveWith(SaveMode::Atomic, Text::TextEncoding::Utf8);   // finding 2.12
            break;
        case TextBannerAction::Cancel:
        case TextBannerAction::Dismiss:
            m_banner = {};
            break;
        }
    }
```

### Task TE2-17: External changes -- appends on the poll that sees them, replacements once settled (D-R10), clean reload as one undoable transaction, dirty banner, clean-only append, truncation, rotation, deletion (spec s3.5, s5.3)

**Files:**

- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.cpp` (the one-field block `TextFollowSettings`: `editor.text.follow.maxDebounceMs`, D-R10)
- Modify: `docs/superpowers/audits/2026-10-03-settings-inventory.md` (one row in Part 3's `### Text editor` table, one "Post-freeze amendments" row), `scripts/settings-frozen-names.txt` (regenerated by the lint, never by hand -- D-R8)
- Create: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextFollowMeasureTest.cpp` (hidden tag `[.text-measure]`: the measurement behind the setting's default; never runs in the suite)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextDocumentExternalTest.cpp`, `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextFollowSettingsSweepTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `ClassifyDiskChange`, `DecideDiskAction`, `CompleteTailLength`, `TailSplitsCrLf`, `LastUnitOf`, `AppendWindowStart`, `kAppendWindowBytes` (TE2-4, all over `Text::TextEncoding`); `StatFile`, `ReadRangeShared`, `ReadFileShared`, `SameStamp`, `HashBytes` (TE2-3/5); TE1 `TextBuffer::{AppendExternal(tail, tailEols), ReloadExternal(text, eols, before), LastReloadClearedHistory(), SetUndoPolicy, MarkSaved, Eols}`, `Text::DecodeFile(bytes, const DecodeOptions&) -> DecodedText` (incl. `DecodedText::heldBytes`, TE1-11, rev-2 T1), `Text::DecodeFragment(bytes, TextEncoding, Eol defaultEol) -> DecodedText` (CANON B2: the appended tail carries no BOM), `Text::TextCommands::SetSelections(next, primaryIndex)`; `Editor::ToDecodeOptions`, `Editor::ToUndoPolicy`, `DefaultEditContext` (TE2-11); TE2-15's `Buffer()`, `Model()`, `Encoding()`, `ShowNote`, `AdoptDecoded(read, encoding, readOnly, heldBytes)` (finding 2.14; rev-2 T1), `NotifyOutsideChange()` (rev-2 A10); TE2-16's `Now()`, `SaveWith`, `HandleSaveOutcome`; TE1-10's `TextBuffer::ClearHistory()` (finding 2.13); `TextSettings::{watchPollSeconds, undoMemoryMB}`.
- Produces: `TextBannerKind` += `ChangedOnDisk, DeletedOnDisk`; `TextBannerAction` += `Reload, KeepMine`; `TextDocument::{Tick(double) override, PollDisk(), ReloadFromDisk(), KeepMine()}` (`ReloadFromDisk` stays a NON-virtual `void`: TE6-7's `EditorDocument` virtual is named `ReloadFromExternalChange()`, so nothing is hidden); `std::uint64_t TextDocument::AppendCount() const` (appends taken from disk since open; CANON A11); `struct TextFollowSettings { std::uint32_t maxDebounceMs; }` (category `editor.text.follow`, categoryPath `"Text Editor"`, PreferencesMachine, Live, Editor; the cvar `editor.text.follow.maxDebounceMs`, Dev, measured default -- D-R10); private `m_pendingStamp`, `m_pendingWindowHash`, `m_pendingSince`, `m_bannerAck`, `ReplacementSettled`, `WindowHashBefore`, `ClearDiskBanner`, `PartialTailOnly` (rev-2 T1: growth that is only a partial character so far -- a held odd UTF-16 byte, a writer mid-unit -- is no change yet: no banner, no recent-write mark, no reload before a save). `ReloadFromDisk` and `AppendTail` call `NotifyOutsideChange()` before their buffer change (rev-2 A10). An appended tail that `DecodeFragment` reports as not valid text in the document's encoding (`readOnly` = `InvalidUtf8`, `InvalidUtf16`, or `Binary` for a NUL in UTF-8) is appended byte-faithfully but turns the document read-only with that reason and the `ReadOnlyContent` banner, never editable text. **TE6-3**'s Follow (cadence and per-poll chunk cap inside `PollDisk`) and the log witnesses drive `PollDisk` through `Tick` and read `AppendCount`.

The poll (CANON B1, C TE2 #12) classifies every stamp change at once. Growth whose bytes before the old end are unchanged (`DiskChange::Appended`) is acted on by the poll that sees it: a clean or read-only document appends the tail's complete characters immediately (`CompleteTailLength`; an incomplete trailing unit stays on disk for the next poll, and the synced stamp and size advance only by the bytes consumed), so a log that is written continuously -- its stamp different at every poll -- shows each poll's lines at once (Review Focus F1). Only a replacement -- `Truncated`, `Rewritten` (rotation included), `Deleted`, `Recreated` -- waits until it has SETTLED (D-R10), so a program mid-way through replacing a file is never read half-way (the "debounced" of spec s5.3 applies to these alone, at `editor.text.watchPollSeconds`). It settles when two consecutive polls see the same stamp; or when the next poll finds that the file only GREW past the end the earlier sighting saw, the 4 KB before that end unchanged (a game truncates its log at start, then writes every 100 ms: its stamp never repeats, Review Focus F1); or, at worst, once `editor.text.follow.maxDebounceMs` has passed since the first sighting (a file rewritten in place without pause). `m_synced` describes the bytes the buffer's clean state equals and advances only when the buffer takes those bytes in -- an append, a reload, a save (built from what the save wrote, finding 2.15). The dirty and deleted banners remember the disk state they showed in a separate `m_bannerAck` (finding 2.9): growth under the dirty banner still classifies as `Appended` against `m_synced`, an Undo back to clean takes it in at the next poll, and a save of a CLEAN buffer first takes in any change it has not seen, so Ctrl+S never writes old text over a writer's lines. `KeepMine` keeps `m_bannerAck`: the next save overwrites that disk state on purpose. The appended tail is decoded with `Text::DecodeFragment` in the document's encoding, never `DecodeFile`: a UTF-16 tail has no BOM and would read as UTF-8 with NULs (Review Focus F2). When the fragment's `readOnly` is not `None` (an invalid UTF-8 byte, a lone UTF-16 surrogate, a NUL in UTF-8 -> `Binary`, TE1-11), the tail is still appended exactly (the buffer must equal the file), but an editable document turns read-only with that reason and the `ReadOnlyContent` banner, exactly as if it had been opened with that content; a document that is already content-read-only keeps its first reason. A reload keeps cursors by line/column, is one undoable transaction, and marks the document clean (the buffer equals the file); when TE1's reload finds the reload's undo step (old and new text) larger than the live `editor.text.undoMemoryMB`, it clears the history itself and `LastReloadClearedHistory()` makes the document say so through `ShowNote` (spec s5.4). A reload whose old or new content is read-only content, or whose encoding differs from the document's, clears the undo history and says so (finding 2.13, F3 on the reload path: Ctrl+Z must never bring raw invalid bytes back as editable text, nor text decoded under another encoding). A reload takes its encoding, read-only reason, synced fingerprint and banner from `AdoptDecoded` -- the code `Open` and Reopen with Encoding run -- so a read-only banner never goes stale (finding 2.14). The self-save fingerprint makes the document's own save invisible to the poll.

```cpp
    void WriteAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view bytes)
    {

    }

    void AppendAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view bytes)
    {
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary | std::ios::app).write(bytes.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    }

    {

    }

    // Finding 2.15: a writer appends right after our replace, before the save's own stat.
    std::uint32_t ReplaceThenWriterAppends(const wchar_t* replaced, const wchar_t* replacement, const wchar_t* backup)
    {
        if (!::ReplaceFileW(replaced, replacement, backup, 0, nullptr, nullptr))
            return ::GetLastError();
        AppendAll(std::filesystem::path(replaced), "writer line\n");
        return 0;
    }
    std::uint32_t RealMove(const wchar_t* from, const wchar_t* to, std::uint32_t flags)
    {
        return ::MoveFileExW(from, to, flags) ? 0u : ::GetLastError();
    }
    const SaveFileOps kWriterRaceOps{ &ReplaceThenWriterAppends, &RealMove, nullptr };

    std::string TextOf(TextDocument& d) { return d.Buffer().Text().ToString(); }

    void Type(TextDocument& doc, Arcane::Text::ByteOffset at, std::string_view text)
    {
        TextModel& model = doc.Model();
        Arcane::Text::TextCommands cmds(model.buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model));
        cmds.SetSelections({ Arcane::Text::Selection{ 0, at, at, std::nullopt } });
        cmds.InsertText(text);
    }

    void Settle(TextDocument& d) { d.PollDisk(); d.PollDisk(); }   // a replacement acts on the second of two equal polls (D-R10's first rule)
}

TEST_CASE("external change: a rewrite waits one poll; a clean document reloads silently as one undoable step", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-ext-clean");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "a.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "one\ntwo\n");
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    Type(*doc, 4, "X");
    REQUIRE(doc->Save());
    WriteAll(p, "one\nTWO\nthree\n");                      // grew, but the bytes before the old end changed: a rewrite
    doc->PollDisk();
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "one\nXtwo\n");                  // a writer may be mid-way through replacing it: wait for a second equal poll
    doc->PollDisk();
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "one\nTWO\nthree\n");
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::None);
    CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 0u);
    auto& sels = doc->Model().selections;
    REQUIRE(doc->Buffer().Undo(sels));                     // Ctrl+Z after a reload restores the previous version...
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "one\nXtwo\n");
    CHECK(doc->Dirty());                                   // ...which no longer equals the file on disk
    REQUIRE(doc->Buffer().Undo(sels));                     // and the history behind it stays valid
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "one\ntwo\n");
}

{

    Settle(*doc);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::ChangedOnDisk);
    CHECK(BannerActions(doc->Banner()) == std::vector<A>{ A::Reload, A::KeepMine });
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "mine base\n");
    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::Reload);
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "theirs\n");

    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "mine base\n");                  // a mistaken Reload is one Ctrl+Z away
    CHECK(doc->Dirty());

    WriteAll(p, "theirs again\n");
    Settle(*doc);

    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::KeepMine);
```
