```cpp
}

TEST_CASE("external change: growth appends to a clean document on the poll that sees it -- no undo entry, still clean, history intact", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-ext-append");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "game.log";
    WriteAll(p, "line 1\n");
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    Type(*doc, 0, "> ");
    REQUIRE(doc->Save());
    const std::uint64_t changeId = doc->Buffer().ChangeId();
    AppendAll(p, "line 2\nline 3\n");
    doc->PollDisk();                                       // ONE poll: appends are never debounced
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "> line 1\nline 2\nline 3\n");
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().ChangeId() == changeId);
    CHECK(doc->Synced().stamp.size == Read(p).size());
    CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 1u);

    AppendAll(p, "line 4\n");                              // a second append lands on the first (the window hash moved on)
    doc->PollDisk();
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "> line 1\nline 2\nline 3\nline 4\n");
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 2u);
    doc->PollDisk();                                       // nothing new: no further append
    CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 2u);

    REQUIRE(doc->Buffer().Undo(doc->Model().selections));  // the old edit undoes; the appended tail stays
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "line 1\nline 2\nline 3\nline 4\n");
}

TEST_CASE("external change: a file that grows between every poll shows each poll's lines at once (Review Focus F1)", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-ext-steady");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "game.log";
    WriteAll(p, "start\n");
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    Type(*doc, 0, "# ");
    REQUIRE(doc->Save());
    const bool couldUndo = doc->Buffer().CanUndo();
    REQUIRE(couldUndo);
    std::string expected = "# start\n";
    for (int i = 1; i <= 10; ++i)
    {
        const std::string line = "tick " + std::to_string(i) + "\n";
        AppendAll(p, line);                                // the writer never pauses: the stamp differs at every poll
        expected += line;
        doc->PollDisk();
        INFO("poll " << i);
        CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == expected);                   // this poll's complete lines are already in the buffer
        CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
        CHECK(doc->Buffer().CanUndo() == couldUndo);       // an append is no undo entry
        CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == static_cast<std::uint64_t>(i));
    }
    REQUIRE(doc->Buffer().Undo(doc->Model().selections));  // the pre-growth edit is still the top of the history
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == expected.substr(2));
}

TEST_CASE("external change: a UTF-16LE file growing by odd byte counts appends exactly its complete lines (Review Focus F2)", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-ext-utf16");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "wide.log";
    WriteAll(p, std::string("\xFF\xFE" "a\0\n\0", 6));       // BOM + "a\n"
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    REQUIRE(doc->Encoding() == Arcane::Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(doc->ReadOnly());

    AppendAll(p, std::string("b\0\n\0c", 5));              // 5 bytes: "b\n" and the first half of 'c'
    doc->PollDisk();
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "a\nb\n");                       // decoded as BOM-less UTF-16LE, no NULs; the half unit waits
    CHECK(doc->Synced().stamp.size == 10u);                // the synced size advanced by the 4 consumed bytes only
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->ReadOnly());
    CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 1u);

    AppendAll(p, std::string("\0\n\0", 3));                // 3 more bytes complete 'c' and its break
    doc->PollDisk();
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "a\nb\nc\n");
    CHECK(doc->Synced().stamp.size == 14u);
    CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 2u);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Encoding() == Arcane::Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
}

// Rev-2 T1 (TE1-11 heldBytes): the stray byte of an odd UTF-16 body waits outside the
// synced state; the append that completes its unit brings it in -- and until then a
// poll sees nothing (no banner for a dirty document either).
TEST_CASE("external change: a held odd UTF-16 byte is completed by the next append (Review Focus F2)", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-ext-utf16held");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "odd.log";
    WriteAll(p, std::string("\xFF\xFE" "a\0\n\0b", 7));     // FF FE 61 00 0A 00 62
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    REQUIRE(TextOf(*doc) == "a\n");
    REQUIRE(doc->Synced().stamp.size == 6u);
    doc->PollDisk();                                       // only the held byte lies past the synced end
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "a\n");
    CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 0u);
    AppendAll(p, std::string(1, '\0'));                    // the other half of 'b'
    doc->PollDisk();
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "a\nb");
    CHECK(doc->Encoding() == Arcane::Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->ReadOnly());
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Synced().stamp.size == 8u);
    CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 1u);

    WriteAll(p, std::string("\xFF\xFE" "a\0\n\0b", 7));
    auto dirty = OpenOrFail(p);
    Type(*dirty, 0, "x");
    dirty->PollDisk();
    CHECK(dirty->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::None);   // a partial character is not a change on disk
}

// Rev-2 A10: an append and a reload notify before they change the buffer; a poll
// that finds nothing does not.
TEST_CASE("external change: the outside-change hook runs before an append and a reload, never on a quiet poll", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-ext-outside");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "a.log";
    WriteAll(p, "one\n");
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    int calls = 0;
    std::string seen;
    doc->SetOutsideChangeHook([&] { ++calls; seen = TextOf(*doc); });
    doc->PollDisk();
    CHECK(calls == 0);                                     // nothing changed: no notification
    AppendAll(p, "two\n");
    doc->PollDisk();
    CHECK(calls == 1);
    CHECK(seen == "one\n");                                // before AppendExternal
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "one\ntwo\n");
    WriteAll(p, "new\n");
    Settle(*doc);
    CHECK(calls == 2);
    CHECK(seen == "one\ntwo\n");                           // before ReloadExternal
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "new\n");
}

    CHECK(ro->AppendCount() == 1u);
}

TEST_CASE("external change: a tail that is not valid text in the document's encoding turns it read-only instead of appending editable text", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-ext-badtail");

    const std::filesystem::path u8 = s.dir / "game.log";
    WriteAll(u8, "line 1\n");
    auto a = OpenOrFail(u8);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(a->ReadOnly());
    AppendAll(u8, "bad \xFF\n");                         // an invalid UTF-8 byte in the tail
    a->PollDisk();
    CHECK(TextOf(*a) == "line 1\nbad \xFF\n");             // kept exactly: the buffer equals the file...
    CHECK(a->ReadOnly());                                   // ...but it is not editable text
    CHECK(a->ReadOnlyReason() == TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8);
    CHECK(a->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::ReadOnlyContent);
    CHECK_FALSE(a->Dirty());
    CHECK(a->AppendCount() == 1u);
    AppendAll(u8, "line 3\n");                             // later valid growth still appends; the reason stays
    a->PollDisk();
    CHECK(a->AppendCount() == 2u);
    CHECK(a->ReadOnlyReason() == TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8);

    const std::filesystem::path nul = s.dir / "dump.txt";
    WriteAll(nul, "ok\n");
    auto b = OpenOrFail(nul);
    AppendAll(nul, std::string("x\0y\n", 4));            // a NUL in a UTF-8 tail: Binary (TE1-11)
    b->PollDisk();
    CHECK(TextOf(*b) == std::string("ok\nx\0y\n", 7));
    CHECK(b->ReadOnlyReason() == TextReadOnlyReason::Binary);

    const std::filesystem::path wide = s.dir / "wide.log";
    WriteAll(wide, std::string("\xFF\xFE" "a\0\n\0", 6));     // BOM + "a\n"
    auto c = OpenOrFail(wide);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(c->ReadOnly());
    AppendAll(wide, std::string("\x00\xDC" "b\0\n\0", 6));  // a lone LOW surrogate, then "b\n"
    c->PollDisk();
    CHECK(c->ReadOnly());
    CHECK(c->ReadOnlyReason() == TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf16);
    CHECK(c->Encoding() == Arcane::Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    CHECK(c->AppendCount() == 1u);
    CHECK_FALSE(c->Dirty());
}

TEST_CASE("external change: Tick polls on editor.text.watchPollSeconds", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-ext-tick");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "a.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "1\n");
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    WriteAll(p, "22\n");                                   // a new SIZE: the stamp sees it even within one mtime tick (finding 2.11)
    doc->Tick(0.5);
    doc->Tick(0.4);                                        // 0.9 s: not yet a poll
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "1\n");
    doc->Tick(0.2);                                        // poll 1: a rewrite, seen once
    doc->Tick(1.0);                                        // poll 2: the same stamp -- settled
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "22\n");
}

// Review Focus F1 (b), D-R10: a game truncates its log at start, then writes before
// every poll. No two consecutive polls ever see the same stamp, so the old
// "two equal stamps" rule never fired; growth past the truncated end settles it.
TEST_CASE("external change: a log truncated and then written before every poll reloads on the next poll and keeps appending", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-ext-truncgrow");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "game.log";
    std::string old;
    for (int i = 0; i < 200; ++i)
        old += "previous session line " + std::to_string(i) + "\n";
    WriteAll(p, old);
    double clock = 0.0;
    TextDocumentServices services;
    services.now = [&] { return clock; };
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p, services);

    WriteAll(p, "session start\n");                       // truncated...
    FileStamp prev = StatFile(p);
    doc->PollDisk();                                       // a replacement, seen once
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == old);
    std::string expected = "session start\n";
    for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i)
    {
        const std::string line = "frame " + std::to_string(i) + "\n";
        AppendAll(p, line);                                // ...then written before every poll
        expected += line;
        const FileStamp now = StatFile(p);
        CHECK_FALSE(SameStamp(prev, now));                 // the stamp never repeats
        prev = now;
        clock += 0.25;
        doc->PollDisk();
        INFO("poll " << i);
        CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == expected);                   // poll 1 reloads (growth only past the pending end); later polls append
        CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    }
    CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 5u);
}

// D-R10's cap: a file rewritten in place at every poll (not growth) loads as it is
// once editor.text.follow.maxDebounceMs has passed since the first sighting.
TEST_CASE("external change: a file that never stops being rewritten loads after editor.text.follow.maxDebounceMs", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-ext-cap");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "status.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "original\n");
    double clock = 0.0;
    TextDocumentServices services;
    services.now = [&] { return clock; };
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p, services);
    const Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeRung cap("editor.text.follow.maxDebounceMs", Arcane::CVarValue::UInt32(1000u));
    const char* const versions[] = { "AAAA\n", "BBBBBB\n", "CCCC\n", "DDDDDD\n", "EEEE\n" };
    for (const char* v : versions)                         // a different size each poll, the bytes before the end changed
    {
        WriteAll(p, v);
        doc->PollDisk();
        INFO("poll at " << clock << " s");
        if (clock < 1.0)
            CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "original\n");           // still settling
        else
            CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == v);                      // the cap passed: loaded as it is now
        clock += 0.25;
    }
}

// Review Focus F1 (c), findings 2.8/2.9: under the dirty banner the synced state
// stays what the clean buffer equals, so growth is still an append; Undo back to
// clean takes it in, and Ctrl+S never writes the old text over the writer's lines.
TEST_CASE("external change: growth under the dirty banner stays an append; back to clean, a save keeps the writer's lines", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-ext-dirtyundo");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "game.log";
    WriteAll(p, "line 1\n");
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    Type(*doc, 0, "mine ");
    AppendAll(p, "line 2\n");
    doc->PollDisk();
    REQUIRE(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::ChangedOnDisk);
    CHECK(doc->Synced().stamp.size == 7u);                 // m_synced still describes "line 1\n"
    AppendAll(p, "line 3\n");
    doc->PollDisk();                                       // more growth: still the banner, never a silent drop
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::ChangedOnDisk);
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "mine line 1\n");

    REQUIRE(doc->Buffer().Undo(doc->Model().selections));  // back to clean, before any further poll
    REQUIRE_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->RequestSave() == SaveGestureResult::Deferred);   // the writer is active, so the save asks first...
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "line 1\nline 2\nline 3\n");    // ...and the clean buffer took the writer's lines in, as an append
    CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 1u);
    CHECK(Read(p) == "line 1\nline 2\nline 3\n");
    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::SaveAnyway);
    CHECK(Read(p) == "line 1\nline 2\nline 3\n");          // nothing the writer wrote was lost
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
}

// Finding 2.13 (F3 on the reload path) and 2.14 (the reload goes through AdoptDecoded).
TEST_CASE("external change: a reload that ends read-only content or changes the encoding clears undo; the read-only banner goes with it", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-ext-reloadro");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "legacy.txt";
    WriteAll(p, "caf\xE9\n");                              // invalid UTF-8: read-only, raw bytes
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    REQUIRE(doc->ReadOnly());
    REQUIRE(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::ReadOnlyContent);
    WriteAll(p, "cafe!\n");                                // a writer fixes it on disk
    Settle(*doc);
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "cafe!\n");
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->ReadOnly());
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::None);     // AdoptDecoded: no stale read-only banner
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().CanUndo());                  // Ctrl+Z can never bring the invalid bytes back as editable text
    CHECK(doc->Note().find("Undo history was cleared") != std::string::npos);

    const std::filesystem::path q = s.dir / "wide.txt";
    WriteAll(q, "a\n");
    auto other = OpenOrFail(q);
    Type(*other, 0, "x");
    REQUIRE(other->Save());                                // an undoable edit in its history
    WriteAll(q, std::string("\xFF\xFE" "b\0\n\0", 6));     // the file comes back as UTF-16LE
    Settle(*other);
    CHECK(other->Encoding() == Arcane::Text::TextEncoding::Utf16LE);
    CHECK(TextOf(*other) == "b\n");
    CHECK_FALSE(other->Buffer().CanUndo());                // undo would put UTF-8-decoded text under the UTF-16 label
}

// Finding 2.15: the synced stamp is what the save WROTE, so an append that lands
// between the replace and any later stat is shown, never absorbed.
TEST_CASE("external change: an append right after our own save is shown on the next poll", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-ext-saverace");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "game.log";
    WriteAll(p, "x\n");
    TextDocumentServices services;
    services.saveOps = &kWriterRaceOps;
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p, services);
    Type(*doc, 0, "y");
    REQUIRE(doc->Save());
    CHECK(Read(p) == "yx\nwriter line\n");
    CHECK(doc->Synced().stamp.size == 3u);                 // "yx\n": what we wrote, not the file's 15 bytes
    CHECK(doc->Synced().stamp.size == doc->Synced().selfSave.size);
    doc->PollDisk();                                       // growth past our end: an append, at once
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "yx\nwriter line\n");
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->AppendCount() == 1u);
}

TEST_CASE("external change: reloading more than editor.text.undoMemoryMB clears the history and says so", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-ext-bigreload");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "big.log";
    WriteAll(p, std::string(2u * 1024u * 1024u, 'a'));
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p);
    const Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeRung limit("editor.text.undoMemoryMB", Arcane::CVarValue::UInt32(1u));
    WriteAll(p, "small\n");
    Settle(*doc);
    CHECK(TextOf(*doc) == "small\n");
    CHECK(doc->Note().find("History cleared") != std::string::npos);   // from LastReloadClearedHistory(), through ShowNote
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().CanUndo());
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().Undo(doc->Model().selections));
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());
}
```

(removing the four separate cases TE2-16 had for them), and add:
```cpp
    void TextDocument::Tick(double dt)
    {
        m_pollElapsed += dt;
        if (m_pollElapsed < Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().watchPollSeconds)
            return;
        m_pollElapsed = 0.0;
        PollDisk();
    }

    void TextDocument::PollDisk()
    {
        const FileStamp now = StatFile(m_canonical);
        if (SameStamp(now, m_synced.stamp))
        {
            m_pendingStamp.reset();
            return;
        }
        // D-R10: the dirty (or deleted) banner already covers exactly this disk state.
        // A buffer that became clean again does take the change in (below).
        if (m_bannerAck && SameStamp(*m_bannerAck, now) && (Dirty() || !now.exists))
            return;
        const DiskObservation seen = ObserveDisk(now);
        if (PartialTailOnly(seen))
            return;   // rev-2 T1: only a partial character past the synced end -- no change yet
        // Appended (and the document's own save) act on the poll that sees them, so a
        // log written without pause still shows each poll's lines (CANON C TE2 #12).
        // A replacement acts once it has SETTLED (D-R10).
        const bool replacement = seen.change == DiskChange::Truncated || seen.change == DiskChange::Rewritten
                              || seen.change == DiskChange::Deleted   || seen.change == DiskChange::Recreated;
        if (replacement && !ReplacementSettled(now))
            return;
        m_pendingStamp.reset();
        ActOnDisk(seen, now);
    }

    std::optional<std::uint64_t> TextDocument::WindowHashBefore(const FileStamp& stamp) const
    {
        if (!stamp.exists)
            return std::nullopt;
        const std::uint64_t start = AppendWindowStart(stamp.size);
        if (std::optional<std::string> w = ReadRangeShared(m_canonical, start, stamp.size - start))
            return HashBytes(*w);
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    bool TextDocument::ReplacementSettled(const FileStamp& now)
    {
        const double t = Now();
        if (!m_pendingStamp)
        {
            m_pendingStamp = now;                          // seen once
            m_pendingWindowHash = WindowHashBefore(now);
            m_pendingSince = t;
            return false;
        }
        if (SameStamp(*m_pendingStamp, now))
            return true;                                   // two consecutive polls agree
        if (now.exists && m_pendingStamp->exists && now.size > m_pendingStamp->size && m_pendingWindowHash
            && WindowHashBefore(*m_pendingStamp) == m_pendingWindowHash)
            return true;                                   // it only GREW past the pending end: the replacement is done, a writer appends
        const double capSeconds = static_cast<double>(Arcane::Settings<TextFollowSettings>().maxDebounceMs) / 1000.0;
        if (t - m_pendingSince >= capSeconds)
            return true;                                   // still changing at the cap: load it as it is now
        m_pendingStamp = now;                              // changed again: wait on the new state; the cap keeps counting from the first sighting
        m_pendingWindowHash = WindowHashBefore(now);
        return false;
    }

    bool TextDocument::PartialTailOnly(const DiskObservation& seen) const
    {
        return seen.change == DiskChange::Appended && CompleteTailLength(seen.tail, Encoding()) == 0;
    }

    void TextDocument::ClearDiskBanner()
    {
        if (m_banner.kind == TextBannerKind::ChangedOnDisk || m_banner.kind == TextBannerKind::DeletedOnDisk)
            m_banner = {};
        m_bannerAck.reset();
    }

    TextDocument::DiskObservation TextDocument::ObserveDisk(const FileStamp& now) const
    {
        DiskObservation seen;
        const std::uint64_t oldSize = m_synced.stamp.size;
        std::optional<std::uint64_t> windowHash;
        if (now.exists && m_synced.stamp.exists && now.size > oldSize)
            if (std::optional<std::string> w = ReadRangeShared(m_canonical, AppendWindowStart(oldSize), oldSize - AppendWindowStart(oldSize)))
            {
                seen.window = std::move(*w);
                windowHash = HashBytes(seen.window);
            }
        seen.change = ClassifyDiskChange(m_synced, now, windowHash);
        if (seen.change == DiskChange::Appended)
        {
            if (std::optional<std::string> t = ReadRangeShared(m_canonical, oldSize, now.size - oldSize))
            {
                seen.tail = std::move(*t);
                const std::string_view tail = seen.tail;
                seen.splitsCrLf = TailSplitsCrLf(m_synced.lastUnit, tail.substr(0, CompleteTailLength(tail, Encoding())), Encoding());
            }
            else
                seen.change = DiskChange::Rewritten;   // the tail could not be read: treat it as a replacement
        }
        return seen;
    }

    void TextDocument::ActOnDisk(const DiskObservation& seen, const FileStamp& now)
    {
        if (seen.change != DiskChange::None && seen.change != DiskChange::SelfSave)
            NoteExternalWrite();
        switch (DecideDiskAction(seen.change, Dirty(), ReadOnly(), seen.splitsCrLf))
        {
        case DiskAction::Ignore:
            break;
        case DiskAction::AcceptSelfSave:
            m_synced.stamp = now;
            break;
        case DiskAction::AppendTail:
            AppendTail(seen.window, seen.tail, now);
            ClearDiskBanner();   // a buffer that became clean again took the change in
            break;
        case DiskAction::SilentReload:
            ReloadFromDisk();    // clears the disk banners and m_bannerAck itself
            break;
        case DiskAction::DirtyBanner:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::ChangedOnDisk, "'" + Name() + "' changed on disk. Reload it (your version "
                "stays one Ctrl+Z away) or keep yours (Save then overwrites the disk)." };
            // D-R10 (finding 2.9): the banner remembers what it showed; m_synced stays the
            // bytes the buffer's clean state equals, so later growth is still Appended.
            m_bannerAck = now;
            break;
        case DiskAction::DeletedBanner:
            m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::DeletedOnDisk, "'" + Name() + "' was deleted on disk. Save recreates it." };
            m_bannerAck = now;
            break;
        }
    }

    void TextDocument::AppendTail(std::string_view window, std::string_view tail, const FileStamp& now)
    {
        // Complete characters only (a UTF-16 unit, a surrogate pair, a UTF-8 sequence);
        // the rest stays on disk and the next poll rereads it from the synced end.
        const std::string_view consumed = tail.substr(0, CompleteTailLength(tail, Encoding()));
        if (consumed.empty())
            return;   // only a partial character so far: the synced stamp stays put
        NotifyOutsideChange();   // rev-2 A10: before AppendExternal (vim ends an open Insert transaction)
        // The tail has no BOM: decode it in the document's known encoding (CANON B2), its
        // breaks folded as DecodeFile folds them, a break-less tail taking the dominant style.
        const Text::DecodedText d = Text::DecodeFragment(tail.substr(0, CompleteTailLength(tail, Encoding())), Encoding(), Buffer().Eols().Dominant());
        Buffer().AppendExternal(d.text, d.eols);   // no undo entry, ids unchanged (spec s3.5)
        ++m_appendCount;
        // A tail that is not valid text in this encoding (invalid UTF-8, a lone UTF-16
        // surrogate, a NUL in UTF-8 -> Binary; TE1-11) is kept byte-faithfully above, but the
        // document no longer edits: the same read-only state an open of that content gives.
        if (d.readOnly != Text::ReadOnlyReason::None && m_contentReadOnly == TextReadOnlyReason::None)
        {
            m_contentReadOnly = FromContentReason(d.readOnly);
            RecomputeReadOnly();
            const char* what = m_contentReadOnly == TextReadOnlyReason::Binary      ? "gained NUL bytes"
                             : m_contentReadOnly == TextReadOnlyReason::InvalidUtf8 ? "gained bytes that are not valid UTF-8"
                                                                                     : "gained bytes that are not valid UTF-16";
            if (m_banner.kind == TextBannerKind::None)
                m_banner = TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::ReadOnlyContent,
                    "'" + Name() + "' " + what + " on disk, so it is read-only now and keeps its bytes exactly. "
                    "If it is a legacy text file, reopen it as Windows-1252." };
        }
        // The synced state advances by the CONSUMED bytes only, so a held-back partial
        // character keeps the synced size behind the file and is read whole next time.
        const std::uint64_t newSize = m_synced.stamp.size + consumed.size();
        std::string joined(window);
        joined.append(consumed);
        const std::size_t keep = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min<std::uint64_t>(joined.size(), kAppendWindowBytes));
        m_synced.stamp = FileStamp{ true, newSize, now.mtime, now.attributes };
        m_synced.windowHash = HashBytes(std::string_view(joined).substr(joined.size() - keep));
        m_synced.lastUnit = LastUnitOf(consumed, Encoding());
    }

    void TextDocument::ReloadFromDisk()
    {
        const ReadOutcome r = ReadFileShared(m_canonical, MaxOpenBytes());
        if (!r.ok)
        {
            ShowNote(r.tooLarge ? "'" + Name() + "' grew past editor.text.openMaxMB; it was not reloaded."
                                : "Could not reload '" + Name() + "' (Windows error " + std::to_string(r.win32Error) + ").");
            return;
        }
        NotifyOutsideChange();   // rev-2 A10: before ReloadExternal (vim ends an open Insert transaction)
        Text::DecodeOptions options = ToDecodeOptions(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>());
        options.forced = m_forcedEncoding;   // a Reopen with Encoding choice survives reloads
        Text::DecodedText d = Text::DecodeFile(r.bytes, options);
        const Text::TextEncoding decodedAs = d.encoding;
        const Text::ReadOnlyReason contentReadOnly = d.readOnly;
        const std::size_t heldBytes = d.heldBytes;   // rev-2 T1: an odd UTF-16 body's stray byte
        // Finding 2.13 (F3 on the reload path): undo must never put read-only content's raw
        // bytes back as editable text, nor text decoded under another encoding under this one.
        const bool clearHistory = m_contentReadOnly != TextReadOnlyReason::None
                               || contentReadOnly != Text::ReadOnlyReason::None || decodedAs != m_encoding;
        TextModel& model = Model();
        Text::TextBuffer& buffer = Buffer();
        // Cursors are kept by line/column (spec s5.3); the primary stays primary.
        const std::size_t primaryIndex = model.selections.PrimaryIndex();
        std::vector<std::pair<Text::Point, Text::Point>> points;
        {
            const Text::Rope& before = buffer.Text();
            for (const Text::Selection& sel : model.selections.All())
                points.emplace_back(before.OffsetToPoint(sel.anchor), before.OffsetToPoint(sel.head));
        }
        buffer.SetUndoPolicy(ToUndoPolicy(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>()));   // the live editor.text.undoMemoryMB cap
        // One undoable Other transaction (TE1-10). If the reload's undo step (old and new
        // text) exceeds the cap, TE1 clears the history instead and reports it; the document never clears it itself.
        buffer.ReloadExternal(std::move(d.text), std::move(d.eols), model.selections);
        if (clearHistory)
            buffer.ClearHistory();
        buffer.MarkSaved();   // the buffer equals the file again; undo returns to the previous text
        if (clearHistory)
            ShowNote("Reloaded '" + Name() + "' from disk as " + EncodingLabel(decodedAs) + ". Undo history was cleared: the "
                     "earlier text was read-only content or decoded as a different encoding.");
        else if (buffer.LastReloadClearedHistory())   // the s5.4 note, through the one note channel
            ShowNote("History cleared: '" + Name() + "' was reloaded from disk and the reload's undo step (old and new text) is larger than editor.text.undoMemoryMB.");
        const Text::Rope& after = buffer.Text();
        const auto clampPoint = [&](const Text::Point& pt)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = std::min(pt.row, after.LineCount() - 1);
            const Text::ByteOffset start = after.LineStart(row);
            return std::min<Text::ByteOffset>(start + pt.col, after.LineEnd(row));
        };
        std::vector<Text::Selection> mapped;
        for (const auto& [a, h] : points)
            mapped.push_back(Text::Selection{ 0, clampPoint(a), clampPoint(h), std::nullopt });
        Text::TextCommands(buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model)).SetSelections(std::move(mapped), primaryIndex);
        // Finding 2.14: the encoding, the content read-only reason, the synced fingerprint and
        // the banner (ReadOnlyContent, or none) come from the code Open and Reopen run.
        AdoptDecoded(r, decodedAs, contentReadOnly, heldBytes);
        m_pendingStamp.reset();
        m_bannerAck.reset();   // the buffer equals the file again
    }

    void TextDocument::KeepMine()
    {
        // m_bannerAck keeps the disk state the user chose to overwrite: the poll does not
        // raise the banner again for it, and the next Save overwrites it on purpose.
        m_banner = {};
    }
```

`ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextFollowMeasureTest.cpp`:
```cpp
// Text editor TE2-17 (D-R10): measures the default of editor.text.follow.maxDebounceMs
// and prints it (hidden tag: run by hand from the exe dir; it writes 64 MiB to TEMP).
//
// M = the median wall time over 5 runs of rewriting a 64 MiB file IN PLACE (same
// size, 64 KiB writes, then FlushFileBuffers): the slowest one-shot non-growth
// replacement a real tool performs on a large text file -- the only case the cap
// decides (growth after a truncation settles by D-R10's growth rule first).
// Rule: clamp(roundUp100(2 x M), 2000, 10000) ms. The floor is two polls at
// editor.text.watchPollSeconds' default (1 s): a replacement that ends within two
// polls settles by D-R10's two-agreeing-polls rule anyway.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

TEST_CASE("text measure: editor.text.follow.maxDebounceMs", "[.text-measure]")
{
    const std::filesystem::path p = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "arcane-te2-measure-rewrite.log";
    const std::size_t size = std::size_t{ 64 } << 20;
    const std::size_t chunkSize = std::size_t{ 64 } << 10;
    std::string chunk(chunkSize, 'a');
    {
        const HANDLE h = ::CreateFileW(p.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
        REQUIRE(h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE);
        for (std::size_t done = 0; done < size; done += chunkSize)
        {
            DWORD wrote = 0;
            REQUIRE(::WriteFile(h, chunk.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(chunkSize), &wrote, nullptr));
        }
        REQUIRE(::FlushFileBuffers(h));
        ::CloseHandle(h);
    }
    std::vector<double> runs;
    for (int run = 0; run < 5; ++run)
    {
        chunk.assign(chunkSize, static_cast<char>('b' + run));
        const HANDLE h = ::CreateFileW(p.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE,
                                       nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
        REQUIRE(h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE);
        const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        for (std::size_t done = 0; done < size; done += chunkSize)
        {
            DWORD wrote = 0;
            REQUIRE(::WriteFile(h, chunk.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(chunkSize), &wrote, nullptr));
        }
        REQUIRE(::FlushFileBuffers(h));
        const auto t1 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        ::CloseHandle(h);
        runs.push_back(std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(t1 - t0).count());
    }
    std::vector<double> sorted = runs;
    std::sort(sorted.begin(), sorted.end());
    const double m = sorted[2];
    const auto value = std::clamp<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::ceil(2.0 * m / 100.0) * 100.0), 2000u, 10000u);
    std::printf("maxDebounceMs: runs %.1f %.1f %.1f %.1f %.1f ms, M = %.1f ms -> default %u ms\n",
                runs[0], runs[1], runs[2], runs[3], runs[4], m, value);
    std::filesystem::remove(p);
    SUCCEED();
}
```

```cpp
    struct ImGuiScope

        ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();

        ImGuiScope()
        {
            ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
            ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
            io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(800, 600);
            io.IniFilename = nullptr;
            unsigned char* px = nullptr;
            int w = 0, h = 0;

        ~ImGuiScope()
        {

    TextSharedVerbs PressAndRead(EditorActions& actions, ImGuiKeyChord mods, ImGuiKey key)
    {
        ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
        TextSharedVerbs got;
        const auto frame = [&] { io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f; ImGui::NewFrame(); const TextSharedVerbs v = ReadTextSharedVerbs(actions);
                                 got.undo |= v.undo; got.redo |= v.redo; got.cut |= v.cut; got.copy |= v.copy; got.paste |= v.paste; got.close |= v.close;
                                 ImGui::Render(); };
        frame();
        if (mods & ImGuiMod_Ctrl) io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Ctrl, true);
        if (mods & ImGuiMod_Shift) io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Shift, true);
        io.AddKeyEvent(key, true);
        frame();
        frame();
        io.AddKeyEvent(key, false);
        if (mods & ImGuiMod_Ctrl) io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Ctrl, false);
        if (mods & ImGuiMod_Shift) io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Shift, false);
        frame();
        return got;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("text clipboard: line endings normalise; one entry per cursor distributes on an equal count", "[text-actions]")
{
    CHECK(NormalizeClipboardText("a\r\nb\rc\n") == "a\nb\nc\n");
    std::string os;
    const TextClipboard fake{ [&](const std::string& s) { os = s; }, [&] { return os; } };
    CopyToClipboard(fake, { "alpha", "beta" });
    CHECK(os == "alpha\nbeta");
    CHECK(PasteForCursors(os, 2) == std::vector<std::string>{ "alpha", "beta" });     // remembered parts
    CHECK(PasteForCursors(os, 3) == std::vector<std::string>(3, "alpha\nbeta"));      // a different count: the whole text each
    CHECK(PasteForCursors("x\ny\nz\n", 3) == std::vector<std::string>{ "x", "y", "z" }); // copied elsewhere: one line per cursor
    CHECK(PasteForCursors("solo", 1) == std::vector<std::string>{ "solo" });
}

TEST_CASE("text verbs: per-document history, multi-cursor cut/copy/paste, read-only, close", "[text-actions]")
{
    const std::filesystem::path p = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "arcane-te2-verbs.txt";
    std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary) << "aa bb\n";
    std::string os;
    TextDocumentServices services;
    services.clipboard = TextClipboard{ [&](const std::string& s) { os = s; }, [&] { return os; } };
    std::string error;
    auto doc = TextDocument::Open(p, services, error);
    REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
    TextModel& model = doc->Model();
    const auto selectTwo = [&]
    {
        Arcane::Text::TextCommands(model.buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model))
            .SetSelections({ Selection{ 0, 0, 2, std::nullopt }, Selection{ 0, 3, 5, std::nullopt } });
    };
    selectTwo();
    bool close = false;

    doc->ApplySharedVerbs(TextSharedVerbs{ .copy = true }, close);
    CHECK(os == "aa\nbb");
    doc->ApplySharedVerbs(TextSharedVerbs{ .cut = true }, close);
    CHECK(doc->Model().buffer.Text().ToString() == " \n");
    CHECK(doc->Model().selections.Size() == 2u);
    doc->ApplySharedVerbs(TextSharedVerbs{ .paste = true }, close);       // two cursors, two parts: each gets its own
    CHECK(doc->Model().buffer.Text().ToString() == "aa bb\n");
    doc->ApplySharedVerbs(TextSharedVerbs{ .undo = true }, close);
    CHECK(doc->Model().buffer.Text().ToString() == " \n");
    doc->ApplySharedVerbs(TextSharedVerbs{ .redo = true }, close);
    CHECK(doc->Model().buffer.Text().ToString() == "aa bb\n");
    CHECK_FALSE(close);

    selectTwo();
    doc->SetReadOnlyLock(true);
    os = "zz";
    doc->ApplySharedVerbs(TextSharedVerbs{ .cut = true, .paste = true }, close);
    CHECK(doc->Model().buffer.Text().ToString() == "aa bb\n");          // read-only: nothing changes...
    CHECK(os == "aa\nbb");                                               // ...but copying (cut's copy half) still works
    doc->ApplySharedVerbs(TextSharedVerbs{ .close = true }, close);
    CHECK(close);
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->OwnsSharedVerbs());                                 // its view is not drawn, so it owns no keys
    std::filesystem::remove(p);
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The text editor's clipboard (spec s5.1, s7). A copy with several selections
// stores ONE ENTRY PER CURSOR: the OS clipboard gets them joined by LF, and the
// parts are remembered process-wide, so a paste into any text document with
// the same cursor count distributes them (Sublime). A clipboard copied
// elsewhere with exactly one line per cursor distributes too.

#include <cstddef>
#include <functional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct TextClipboard
    {
        std::function<void(const std::string&)> set;
        std::function<std::string()>            get;
    };
    [[nodiscard]] TextClipboard ImGuiTextClipboard();   // ImGui::SetClipboardText / GetClipboardText

    [[nodiscard]] std::string NormalizeClipboardText(std::string text);   // CRLF and lone CR -> LF (the rope stores LF)
    void CopyToClipboard(const TextClipboard& clipboard, const std::vector<std::string>& parts);
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::string> PasteForCursors(const std::string& normalizedClip, std::size_t cursorCount);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextClipboard.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/TextClipboard.hpp"

#include <imgui.h>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        struct Remembered
        {
            std::string              joined;
            std::vector<std::string> parts;
        };
        Remembered& Memory()
        {
            static Remembered m;
            return m;
        }
    }

    TextClipboard ImGuiTextClipboard()
    {
        return TextClipboard{
            [](const std::string& s) { ImGui::SetClipboardText(s.c_str()); },
            [] { const char* t = ImGui::GetClipboardText(); return std::string(t ? t : ""); },
        };
    }

    std::string NormalizeClipboardText(std::string text)
    {
        std::string out;
        out.reserve(text.size());
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < text.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (text[i] == '\r')
            {
                out.push_back('\n');
                if (i + 1 < text.size() && text[i + 1] == '\n')
                    ++i;
            }
            else
                out.push_back(text[i]);
        }
        return out;
    }

    void CopyToClipboard(const TextClipboard& clipboard, const std::vector<std::string>& parts)
    {
        std::string joined;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < parts.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (i > 0)
                joined.push_back('\n');
            joined += parts[i];
        }
        Memory() = Remembered{ joined, parts };
        if (clipboard.set)
            clipboard.set(joined);
    }

    std::vector<std::string> PasteForCursors(const std::string& clip, std::size_t cursorCount)
    {
        if (cursorCount <= 1)
            return { clip };
        const Remembered& m = Memory();
        if (m.parts.size() == cursorCount && m.joined == clip)
            return m.parts;
        std::vector<std::string> lines;
        std::size_t start = 0;
        for (;;)
        {
            const std::size_t nl = clip.find('\n', start);
            if (nl == std::string::npos)
            {
                lines.push_back(clip.substr(start));
                break;
            }
            lines.push_back(clip.substr(start, nl - start));
            start = nl + 1;
        }
        if (!lines.empty() && lines.back().empty())
            lines.pop_back();
        if (lines.size() == cursorCount)
            return lines;
        return std::vector<std::string>(cursorCount, clip);
    }
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The text document's keyboard verbs (text editor spec s7). The SHARED verbs
// reuse the editor's existing action ids -- edit.undo, edit.redo,
// edit.redoAlt, edit.cut, edit.copy, edit.paste, document.close and the new
// Global document.closeAlt (Ctrl+F4) -- answered by the focused text document
// through PressedInWindow (the Settings window's local-undo precedent), so
// rebinding Undo rebinds it everywhere. document.save stays the Document
// context's (Pressed, like every other document). TE4 adds the text.* rows
// (ActionContext::TextDocument) here.

#include "Input/EditorActions.hpp"

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct TextSharedVerbs
    {
        bool undo = false, redo = false, cut = false, copy = false, paste = false, close = false;
    };
    [[nodiscard]] TextSharedVerbs ReadTextSharedVerbs(const EditorActions& actions);
}
```

```cpp
    void TextDocument::ApplySharedVerbs(const TextSharedVerbs& v, bool& requestClose)
    {
        TextModel& model = Model();
        Text::TextCommands cmds(Buffer(), model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model));
        bool moved = false;
        if (v.undo && !ReadOnly())
            moved |= cmds.Undo();
        if (v.redo && !ReadOnly())
            moved |= cmds.Redo();
        if (v.copy || v.cut)
        {
            const std::vector<std::string> parts = cmds.CopySelections();
            if (std::any_of(parts.begin(), parts.end(), [](const std::string& s) { return !s.empty(); }))
            {
                CopyToClipboard(m_services.clipboard, parts);
                if (v.cut && !ReadOnly())
                {
                    cmds.DeleteSelections();
                    moved = true;
                }
            }
        }
        if (v.paste && !ReadOnly() && m_services.clipboard.get)
        {
            const std::string clip = NormalizeClipboardText(m_services.clipboard.get());
            if (!clip.empty())
            {
                // One part per cursor (equal counts distribute, else the whole text at each); one undo step.
                const std::vector<std::string> perCursor = PasteForCursors(clip, model.selections.Size());
                cmds.InsertPerSelection(perCursor);
                moved = true;
            }
        }
        if (moved)
            View().RevealOffset(model.selections.Primary().head, false);
        if (v.close)
            requestClose = true;
    }
```

### Task TE2-19: `DocumentHost` -- canonical-path index, fallback factory, `OpenAt`, re-keying; `TextDocument::GoTo` (spec s5.3, s9)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/EditorDocument.hpp` (`CanonicalPath`, `RevealPoint`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/DocumentHost.hpp:23-148`, `ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/DocumentHost.cpp:30-189` (also `RegisterTextFactory`, `HasDedicatedFactory` and the private `Route::text` flag)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp`, `.cpp` (`CanonicalPath` becomes an override; `GoTo`; `RevealPoint` forwards to `GoTo`)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextDocumentHostTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE1 `Text::Point`, `Rope::{LineCount, LineStart, LineEnd}`; `Text::TextCommands::SetSelections(std::vector<Selection>)` (TE1-14: no text change, the last element becomes primary, id-0 selections get fresh ids); `DefaultEditContext(TextModel&)` (TE2-11); `TextDocument::{Open, Model, View}` (TE2-15); `TextEditorView::{RevealOffset, Focus}` (TE2-13).
- Produces: `virtual std::filesystem::path EditorDocument::CanonicalPath() const` (default empty), `virtual void EditorDocument::RevealPoint(std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t col)` (default nothing); `void TextDocument::GoTo(Text::Point at)` (CANON B8: THE "go to a point" in an open text document -- row clamped to the last row, column clamped to that row's byte length, one cursor there, centred in the primary view; the `RevealPoint` override forwards to it; **TE4-13** extends its body to unfold a fold hiding the target; **TE7-9**'s FileOpener calls it); `DocumentHost::{SetPathCanonicalizer(PathCanonicalizer), SetFallbackFactory(OpenFactory, std::function<bool(const std::filesystem::path&)> claims), SetGuidResolver(GuidResolver), OpenAt(const std::filesystem::path&, const Arcane::Text::Point&), OpenAt(const Arcane::Guid&, const Arcane::Text::Point&), FindByCanonicalPath(const std::filesystem::path&), RefreshCanonicalKey(EditorDocument&)}`; `void DocumentHost::RegisterTextFactory(std::string extension, OpenFactory factory)` (registers the extension factory exactly like `RegisterFactory` and marks it a TEXT route: it counts for `HasFactory`, never for `HasDedicatedFactory`; **TE2-20**'s explicit-extension loop registers through it) and `[[nodiscard]] bool DocumentHost::HasDedicatedFactory(const std::filesystem::path& path) const` (true only when an extension factory registered through `RegisterFactory` takes `path` -- never a text route, never the fallback; the extension match is case-insensitive like `HasFactory`'s). After TE2-20, `HasFactory` is true for every text file, so the "has a dedicated editor" facts read `HasDedicatedFactory`: **TE6-12**'s Open as Text lock and **TE7-9**'s FileOpener `hasDedicatedEditor` (and the tab menu / asset panels / Open With page) consume it. Also `using PathCanonicalizer = std::function<std::filesystem::path(const std::filesystem::path&)>; using GuidResolver = std::function<std::optional<std::filesystem::path>(const Arcane::Guid&)>;`. `DocumentHost` has NO C++ route (CANON B5): a C/C++ source is simply not claimed by TE2-20's fallback predicate until **TE7-9** removes that exclusion and its FileOpener owns C++ opens. Callers outside TE2 (**Spec 2**'s Goto Anything / Find in Files, **TE5**'s global marks) reach `OpenAt` through TE7's FileOpener (CANON A10); **TE6**'s Open as Text uses the canonical index to focus an already-open text tab.

Identity rules (spec s5.3): a document that reports a canonical path is keyed by it; `OpenPath` resolves any spelling (case, 8.3, junction) to that key *before* constructing anything, so the Asset Browser, a Problems `file:line` row and `--open-path` all focus one tab. A Guid-keyed document (the existing asset editors) is untouched: it reports no canonical path. An asset move re-keys (`NoteAssetMoved` -> `NoteMoved` -> `RefreshCanonicalKey`).

```cpp
// Text editor TE2-19 (spec s5.3, s9): DocumentHost's canonical-path index, the
// fallback factory and OpenAt -- with fake documents -- and TextDocument::GoTo
// (CANON B8) on a real document.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Documents/DocumentHost.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;

namespace
{
    // The fake canonicalizer: lowercase, forward slashes.
    std::filesystem::path Lower(const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        std::string s = p.generic_string();
        std::transform(s.begin(), s.end(), s.begin(), [](unsigned char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c)); });
        return s;
    }

    struct FakeTextDoc final : EditorDocument
    {
        std::string title;
        std::filesystem::path canonical;
        Arcane::Guid guid;
        int reopened = 0;
        std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t>> revealed;
        FakeTextDoc(const std::filesystem::path& p, Arcane::Guid g = Arcane::Guid::Nil())
            : title(p.filename().string()), canonical(Lower(p)), guid(g) {}
        const std::string& Title() const override { return title; }
        Arcane::Guid AssetGuid() const override { return guid; }
        bool Dirty() const override { return false; }
        bool Save() override { return true; }
        void Draw(bool&) override {}
        void NoteReopened() override { ++reopened; }
        void NoteMoved(const std::filesystem::path& p) override { title = p.filename().string(); canonical = Lower(p); }
        std::filesystem::path CanonicalPath() const override { return canonical; }
        void RevealPoint(std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t col) override { revealed.emplace_back(row, col); }
    };

    struct Rig
    {
        DocumentHost host;
        int fallbackBuilds = 0;
        Rig()
        {
            host.SetPathCanonicalizer(&Lower);
            host.RegisterFactory(".arcmat", [](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return std::make_unique<FakeTextDoc>(p); });
            host.SetFallbackFactory(
                [this](const std::filesystem::path& p) -> std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument>
                {
                    ++fallbackBuilds;
                    return std::make_unique<FakeTextDoc>(p);
                },
                // The fake claims predicate: everything but a PNG and a C++ source
                // (the real one, TE2-20, refuses C/C++ until TE7-9 -- D15).
                [](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return p.extension() != ".png" && p.extension() != ".cpp"; });
        }
    };
}

}

TEST_CASE("document host: OpenAt opens or focuses and moves the cursor; OpenAt(guid) resolves first", "[text-doc][editor]")
{

    CHECK(again == d);

TEST_CASE("document host: a move or a Save As re-keys; closing drops the key", "[text-doc][editor]")
{
    Rig r;
    const Arcane::Guid id = Arcane::Guid::Generate();
    auto* doc = static_cast<FakeTextDoc*>(r.host.Add(std::make_unique<FakeTextDoc>("C:/p/old.json", id)));
    CHECK(r.host.FindByCanonicalPath(Lower("C:/p/old.json")) == doc);
    r.host.NoteAssetMoved(id, "C:/p/sub/new.json");
    CHECK(r.host.FindByCanonicalPath(Lower("C:/p/old.json")) == nullptr);
    CHECK(r.host.FindByCanonicalPath(Lower("C:/p/sub/new.json")) == doc);

    doc->canonical = Lower("C:/p/saved-as.json");           // the document changed its own identity (Save As)
    r.host.RefreshCanonicalKey(*doc);
    CHECK(r.host.FindByCanonicalPath(Lower("C:/p/sub/new.json")) == nullptr);
    CHECK(r.host.OpenPath("C:/P/SAVED-AS.json") == doc);

    r.host.RequestClose(doc);
    CHECK(r.host.Count() == 0u);
    CHECK(r.host.FindByCanonicalPath(Lower("C:/p/saved-as.json")) == nullptr);
}

// After TE2-20 HasFactory is true for every text file; HasDedicatedFactory is the
// "a dedicated editor takes it" fact (TE6-12's Open as Text lock, TE7-9's FileOpener).
TEST_CASE("document host: dedicated factories are told apart from text routes and the fallback", "[text-doc][editor]")
{
    DocumentHost host;
    const auto none = [](const std::filesystem::path&) -> std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument> { return nullptr; };
    host.RegisterFactory(".arcsprite", none);
    host.RegisterTextFactory(".md", none);
    host.SetFallbackFactory(none, [](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return p.extension() == ".cfgx"; });
    CHECK(host.HasDedicatedFactory("C:/p/s.ARCSPRITE"));                // case-insensitive, like HasFactory
    CHECK(host.HasFactory("C:/p/notes.md"));
    CHECK_FALSE(host.HasDedicatedFactory("C:/p/notes.md"));             // a text route is not a dedicated editor
    CHECK_FALSE(host.HasDedicatedFactory("C:/p/NOTES.MD"));
    CHECK(host.HasFactory("C:/p/a.cfgx"));
    CHECK_FALSE(host.HasDedicatedFactory("C:/p/a.cfgx"));               // nor is the fallback
    CHECK_FALSE(host.HasDedicatedFactory("C:/p/a.png"));                // nor nothing

    // A text route opens like any extension route.
    int textBuilds = 0;
    host.RegisterTextFactory(".TXT", [&](const std::filesystem::path& p) -> std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument>
    { ++textBuilds; return std::make_unique<FakeTextDoc>(p); });
    CHECK(host.OpenPath("C:/p/readme.txt") != nullptr);               // the registered spelling is lowered
    CHECK(textBuilds == 1);
    CHECK_FALSE(host.HasDedicatedFactory("C:/p/readme.txt"));
}

// CANON B8: GoTo is the one go-to-point; RevealPoint (DocumentHost::OpenAt's hook) forwards to it.
TEST_CASE("text document: GoTo clamps to the buffer and leaves one cursor there; RevealPoint forwards to it", "[text-doc][editor]")
{
    const std::filesystem::path p = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "arcane-te2-goto.txt";
    std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary) << "alpha\nbe\ngamma\n";   // rows start at 0, 6, 9, 15 (the empty last row)
    {
        std::string error;
        std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> doc = TextDocument::Open(p, {}, error);
        INFO(error);
        REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
        TextModel& model = doc->Model();

        // Two cursors first: GoTo collapses them into one.
        Arcane::Text::TextCommands(model.buffer, model.selections, DefaultEditContext(model))
            .SetSelections({ Arcane::Text::Selection{ 0, 1, 1, std::nullopt }, Arcane::Text::Selection{ 0, 7, 7, std::nullopt } });
        REQUIRE(model.selections.Size() == 2u);

        doc->GoTo(Arcane::Text::Point{ 1, 1 });
        CHECK(model.selections.Size() == 1u);
        CHECK(model.selections.Primary().anchor == 7u);
        CHECK(model.selections.Primary().head == 7u);

        doc->GoTo(Arcane::Text::Point{ 1, 40 });               // the column clamps to the row's byte length ("be")
        CHECK(model.selections.Primary().head == 8u);

        doc->GoTo(Arcane::Text::Point{ 99, 3 });               // the row clamps to the last row (empty: column 0)
        CHECK(model.selections.Size() == 1u);
        CHECK(model.selections.Primary().head == 15u);
        CHECK(model.selections.Primary().anchor == 15u);

        doc->RevealPoint(2, 2);                                // the EditorDocument hook lands where GoTo does
        CHECK(model.selections.Primary().head == 11u);
        CHECK_FALSE(doc->Dirty());                             // moving the cursor is not an edit
    }
    std::filesystem::remove(p);
}
```

```cpp
    std::filesystem::path DocumentHost::Canonical(const std::filesystem::path& p) const
    {
        if (m_canonicalizer)
            return m_canonicalizer(p);
        std::error_code ec;
        const std::filesystem::path abs = std::filesystem::absolute(p, ec);
        return (ec ? p : abs).lexically_normal();
    }

    void DocumentHost::IndexCanonical(EditorDocument* doc)
    {
        const std::filesystem::path c = doc->CanonicalPath();
        if (!c.empty())
            m_byCanonical[c.native()] = doc;
    }

    void DocumentHost::UnindexCanonical(const EditorDocument* doc)
    {
        std::erase_if(m_byCanonical, [doc](const auto& kv) { return kv.second == doc; });
    }

    EditorDocument* DocumentHost::FindByCanonicalPath(const std::filesystem::path& canonical)
    {
        const auto it = m_byCanonical.find(canonical.native());
        return it == m_byCanonical.end() ? nullptr : it->second;
    }

    void DocumentHost::RefreshCanonicalKey(EditorDocument& doc)
    {
        UnindexCanonical(&doc);
        IndexCanonical(&doc);
    }

    EditorDocument* DocumentHost::OpenPath(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        // Identity first (spec s5.3): any spelling of an open file focuses its
        // one tab, before anything is constructed.
        if (!m_byCanonical.empty())
            if (EditorDocument* open = FindByCanonicalPath(Canonical(path)))
            {
                open->NoteReopened();
                return m_focusRequest = open;
            }
        const std::string ext = LowerExt(path);
        for (const Route& route : m_factories)
        {
            if (route.ext != ext)
                continue;
            // Focus-not-reopen, cheap form first (review m4): resolve the asset
            // identity WITHOUT constructing a document -- a discarded construct
            // is not free (compile submits on the live doc's coalesce keys).
            if (route.peek)
                if (const Arcane::Guid peeked = route.peek(path); peeked.IsValid())
                    if (EditorDocument* open = FindByGuid(peeked))
                    {
                        open->NoteReopened();   // re-select its page like a fresh open (final fix R)
                        return m_focusRequest = open;
                    }
            std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument> doc = route.factory(path);
            if (!doc)
                return nullptr;   // factory already logged the cause
            if (doc->AssetGuid().IsValid())
                if (EditorDocument* open = FindByGuid(doc->AssetGuid()))
                {
                    open->NoteReopened();
                    return m_focusRequest = open;
                }
            return m_focusRequest = Add(std::move(doc));
        }
        // The fallback (spec s5.3): any text file no extension factory claims.
        if (m_fallback && m_fallbackClaims && m_fallbackClaims(path))
        {
            std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument> doc = m_fallback(path);
            if (!doc)
                return nullptr;   // the fallback logged why (binary, unreadable, above openMaxMB)
            if (doc->AssetGuid().IsValid())
                if (EditorDocument* open = FindByGuid(doc->AssetGuid()))
                {
                    open->NoteReopened();
                    return m_focusRequest = open;
                }
            return m_focusRequest = Add(std::move(doc));
        }
        ARC_WARN("DocumentHost: no editor registered for '{}'", ext);
        return nullptr;
    }

    EditorDocument* DocumentHost::OpenAt(const std::filesystem::path& path, const Arcane::Text::Point& at)
    {
        EditorDocument* doc = OpenPath(path);
        if (doc)
            doc->RevealPoint(at.row, at.col);
        return doc;
    }

    EditorDocument* DocumentHost::OpenAt(const Arcane::Guid& guid, const Arcane::Text::Point& at)
    {
        if (!m_guidResolver)
            return nullptr;
        const std::optional<std::filesystem::path> path = m_guidResolver(guid);
        return path ? OpenAt(*path, at) : nullptr;
    }

    bool DocumentHost::HasFactory(const std::filesystem::path& path) const
    {
        const std::string ext = LowerExt(path);
        if (std::any_of(m_factories.begin(), m_factories.end(), [&](const Route& r) { return r.ext == ext; }))
            return true;
        return m_fallback && m_fallbackClaims && m_fallbackClaims(path);
    }

    void DocumentHost::RegisterTextFactory(std::string extension, OpenFactory factory)
    {
        // Lowered like LowerExt's side of the match, so ".TXT" and ".txt" are one route.
        std::transform(extension.begin(), extension.end(), extension.begin(),
                       [](unsigned char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c)); });
        m_factories.push_back(Route{ std::move(extension), std::move(factory), nullptr, /*text*/ true });
    }

    bool DocumentHost::HasDedicatedFactory(const std::filesystem::path& path) const
    {
        const std::string ext = LowerExt(path);
        return std::any_of(m_factories.begin(), m_factories.end(),
                           [&](const Route& r) { return !r.text && r.ext == ext; });
    }

    EditorDocument* DocumentHost::Add(std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument> doc)
    {
        m_docs.push_back(std::move(doc));
        IndexCanonical(m_docs.back().get());
        if (m_observer.opened) m_observer.opened(*m_docs.back());
        return m_docs.back().get();
    }

    void DocumentHost::NoteAssetMoved(const Arcane::Guid& g, const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        if (EditorDocument* d = FindByGuid(g))
        {
            d->NoteMoved(p);
            RefreshCanonicalKey(*d);   // a text document's identity follows the file (spec s5.3)
        }
    }

    void DocumentHost::CloseAll()
    {
        m_pendingClose = nullptr;
        m_lastActive = nullptr;
        if (m_observer.closing) for (const auto& d : m_docs) m_observer.closing(*d);
        m_docs.clear();
        m_dockPlaced.clear();
        m_byCanonical.clear();
    }

    void DocumentHost::Close(EditorDocument* doc)
    {
        if (m_lastActive == doc) m_lastActive = nullptr;
        m_dockPlaced.erase(doc);   // a reopen docks fresh again
        UnindexCanonical(doc);
        if (m_observer.closing) m_observer.closing(*doc);
        m_docs.erase(std::remove_if(m_docs.begin(), m_docs.end(),
                                    [doc](const auto& d) { return d.get() == doc; }),
                     m_docs.end());
    }
```

```cpp
        // Go to `at` (0-based row, BYTE column) -- spec s9; CANON B8: the one
        // go-to-point of an open text document (TE7-9's FileOpener calls it).
        // The row clamps to the last row and the column to that row's byte
        // length; every cursor collapses into one there (no text change, no
        // undo entry), centred in the primary view. TE4-13 extends the body to
```

`TextDocument.cpp` (add `#include <algorithm>` beside its standard includes):
```cpp
    void TextDocument::GoTo(Text::Point at)
    {
        const Text::Rope& text = Model().buffer.Text();
        const std::uint32_t row = std::min(at.row, text.LineCount() - 1);
        const Text::ByteOffset o = std::min<Text::ByteOffset>(text.LineStart(row) + at.col, text.LineEnd(row));
        Text::TextCommands(Model().buffer, Model().selections, DefaultEditContext(Model()))
            .SetSelections({ Text::Selection{ 0, o, o, std::nullopt } });
        View().RevealOffset(o, true);   // centred (spec s9)
    }

    void TextDocument::RevealPoint(std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t col)
    {
        GoTo(Text::Point{ row, col });
        View().Focus();
    }
```

```cpp
            std::error_code ec;
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
            std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
        }
        ~ScratchDir()
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
        }
    };

    void WriteAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view bytes)
    {
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary).write(bytes.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    }
}

TEST_CASE("text routes: path[:line[:col]] parses, a drive letter is never a line", "[text-doc]")
{
    const PathAndPoint a = SplitPathAndPoint("C:/proj/notes.md:12:3");
    CHECK(a.path == std::filesystem::path("C:/proj/notes.md"));
    CHECK(a.point.row == 11u);
    CHECK(a.point.col == 2u);
    const PathAndPoint b = SplitPathAndPoint("Config/app.ini:7");
    CHECK(b.path == std::filesystem::path("Config/app.ini"));
    CHECK(b.point.row == 6u);
    CHECK(b.point.col == 0u);
    const PathAndPoint c = SplitPathAndPoint("C:/proj/notes.md");
    CHECK(c.path == std::filesystem::path("C:/proj/notes.md"));
    CHECK(c.point.row == 0u);
    CHECK(SplitPathAndPoint("C:").path == std::filesystem::path("C:"));
    CHECK(SplitPathAndPoint("a.md:0").point.row == 0u);       // line 0 clamps to the first row
    CHECK(SplitPathAndPoint("a.md:x").path == std::filesystem::path("a.md:x"));
}

TEST_CASE("text routes: a file:line:col column counts characters and is converted to bytes on the target row", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-routes-col");
    const std::string_view bytes = "x\ncaf\xC3\xA9 = 1\n";          // row 1: "caf\u00e9 = 1", the e-acute is two bytes
    WriteAll(s.dir / "menu.txt", bytes);
    const std::u8string u = (s.dir / "menu.txt").generic_u8string();
    const std::string spelled = std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(u.data()), u.size()) + ":2:6";
    const PathAndPoint at = SplitPathAndPoint(spelled);
    CHECK(at.point.row == 1u);
    CHECK(at.point.col == 5u);                                         // 0-based CHARACTER column: the '='

    const Arcane::Text::Rope rope = Arcane::Text::Rope::FromUtf8(bytes);
    CHECK(CharColumnToByteColumn(rope, at.point).col == 6u);           // five characters are six bytes
    CHECK(CharColumnToByteColumn(rope, Arcane::Text::Point{ 1, 99 }).col == 9u);   // past the row: its byte length
    CHECK(CharColumnToByteColumn(rope, Arcane::Text::Point{ 9, 0 }).row == 2u);    // past the last row: the last row
    CHECK(CharColumnToByteColumn(rope, Arcane::Text::Point{ 0, 1 }).col == 1u);    // ASCII: characters == bytes

    DocumentHost host;
    RegisterTextDocumentRoutes(host, TextRouteServices{});
    auto* doc = dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(OpenAtPathAndPoint(host, at));
    REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
    CHECK(doc->Model().selections.Primary().head == 8u);              // row start 2 + 6 bytes: on the '=', not inside the e-acute
    CHECK(OpenAtPathAndPoint(host, PathAndPoint{ s.dir / "missing.txt", {} }) == nullptr);
}

TEST_CASE("text routes: text files open, binary is refused, C/C++ is not claimed, one tab per file", "[text-doc]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te2-routes");
    WriteAll(s.dir / "README.md", "# hi\n");
    WriteAll(s.dir / "LICENSE", "plain text, no extension\n");
    WriteAll(s.dir / "blob.dat", std::string("\0\1\2", 3));
    WriteAll(s.dir / "crash.log", std::string("ok\0bad\n", 7));
    WriteAll(s.dir / "hero.png", "\x89PNG");
    WriteAll(s.dir / "Game.cpp", "int main() {}\n");

    DocumentHost host;
    RegisterTextDocumentRoutes(host, TextRouteServices{});

    auto* md = dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(host.OpenPath(s.dir / "README.md"));
    REQUIRE(md != nullptr);
    CHECK(host.HasFactory(s.dir / "README.md"));
    CHECK_FALSE(host.HasDedicatedFactory(s.dir / "README.md"));         // registered through RegisterTextFactory (TE2-19)

    std::wstring upper = (s.dir / "README.md").wstring();
    std::transform(upper.begin(), upper.end(), upper.begin(), [](wchar_t c) { return static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towupper(c)); });
    CHECK(host.OpenPath(upper) == md);                                  // canonical identity: one tab
    CHECK(host.Count() == 1u);

    CHECK(dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(host.OpenPath(s.dir / "LICENSE")) != nullptr);   // the fallback sniffs text
    CHECK(host.OpenPath(s.dir / "blob.dat") == nullptr);                 // the fallback sniffs binary: refused
    auto* log = dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(host.OpenPath(s.dir / "crash.log"));      // .log is explicit: opens read-only
    REQUIRE(log != nullptr);
    CHECK(log->ReadOnlyReason() == TextReadOnlyReason::Binary);
    CHECK(host.OpenPath(s.dir / "hero.png") == nullptr);                 // a known binary format
    CHECK_FALSE(host.HasFactory(s.dir / "hero.png"));

    // The fallback refuses a C/C++ source until TE7-9 (D15) -- TE7-9 inverts these three checks.
    CHECK_FALSE(host.HasFactory(s.dir / "Game.cpp"));                    // so Problems keeps routing a C++ row to OpenAsText -> OpenSourceAtLine
    CHECK(host.OpenPath(s.dir / "Game.cpp") == nullptr);
    CHECK(host.OpenAt(s.dir / "Game.cpp", Arcane::Text::Point{ 9, 0 }) == nullptr);

    auto* atLine = dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(host.OpenAt(s.dir / "README.md", Arcane::Text::Point{ 0, 2 }));
    REQUIRE(atLine == md);
    CHECK(md->Model().selections.Primary().head == 2u);
    CHECK(host.Count() == 3u);

    // The app's order: a dedicated editor first, then the text routes -- only the
    // dedicated one is a dedicated factory (TE6-12's lock, TE7-9's FileOpener).
    DocumentHost withEditor;
    withEditor.RegisterFactory(".arcmat", [](const std::filesystem::path&) -> std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument> { return nullptr; });
    RegisterTextDocumentRoutes(withEditor, TextRouteServices{});
    CHECK(withEditor.HasDedicatedFactory(s.dir / "Brick.arcmat"));
    CHECK(withEditor.HasFactory(s.dir / "notes.md"));
    CHECK_FALSE(withEditor.HasDedicatedFactory(s.dir / "notes.md"));
    CHECK_FALSE(withEditor.HasDedicatedFactory(s.dir / "LICENSE"));     // the fallback is not one either
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// How text files reach the text editor (spec s5.3): the explicit text
// extensions register TextDocument directly; any other path no extension
// factory claims falls back to it when it sniffs as text (a known binary
// format, or NUL bytes in the first 8 KB, is refused with a message);
// documents are keyed by their canonical path. A C/C++ source is not claimed
// (an interim rule: TE7-9's FileOpener owns C++ opens and removes it, D15).

#include "Documents/DocumentHost.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Guid.hpp>

#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct TextRouteServices
    {
        // Passed to every TextDocument::Open. `document.afterSave` is assigned only
        // by TE6-12's ComposeTextAfterSave (D-R7), never here.
        TextDocumentServices document;
        std::function<std::optional<std::filesystem::path>(const Arcane::Guid&)> resolveGuid;     // OpenAt(guid)
    };
    // Call AFTER the dedicated editors' RegisterFactory calls: an extension
    // that already has a factory keeps it.
    void RegisterTextDocumentRoutes(DocumentHost& host, TextRouteServices services);

    // "path[:line[:col]]" with 1-based line/col (the Console / --open-path /
    // compiler spelling) -> the path and a 0-based point. A drive letter's
    // colon never starts a line number. `:col` is a 1-based CHARACTER column
    // and `point.col` keeps it as a 0-based CHARACTER column (not a byte
    // column): apply it with OpenAtPathAndPoint, which converts it on the
    // target row. TE7-11 re-routes these callers through FileOpener with
    // `Openers::PositionFrom(point.row + 1, point.col + 1)` (a character-column
    // FilePosition).
    struct PathAndPoint
    {
        std::filesystem::path path;
        Arcane::Text::Point   point;   // row and CHARACTER column, both 0-based
    };
    [[nodiscard]] PathAndPoint SplitPathAndPoint(std::string_view text);
    // (row, CHARACTER column) -> (row, BYTE column) on `text`: the row clamps to
    // the last row, the column walks that row's UTF-8 (Text::Utf8::DecodeAt) and
    // clamps to its byte length -- never inside a multi-byte character.
    [[nodiscard]] Arcane::Text::Point CharColumnToByteColumn(const Arcane::Text::Rope& text, Arcane::Text::Point at);
    // Open (or focus) `at.path` and go to `at.point`: a TextDocument converts the
    // character column on its buffer (CharColumnToByteColumn) and RevealPoints the
    // byte point; any other document gets the point as parsed. Null when nothing opens it.
    EditorDocument* OpenAtPathAndPoint(DocumentHost& host, const PathAndPoint& at);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocumentRoutes.cpp`:
```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocumentRoutes.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSniff.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Base/Log.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        std::string Utf8Name(const std::filesystem::path& p)
        {
            const std::u8string u = p.filename().u8string();
            return std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(u.data()), u.size());
        }
    }

    void RegisterTextDocumentRoutes(DocumentHost& host, TextRouteServices services)
    {
        host.SetPathCanonicalizer([](const std::filesystem::path& p)
        {
            if (std::optional<std::filesystem::path> c = CanonicalFilePath(p))
                return *c;
            std::error_code ec;
            const std::filesystem::path abs = std::filesystem::absolute(p, ec);
            return (ec ? p : abs).lexically_normal();
        });

        const TextDocumentServices docServices = services.document;
        const auto open = [docServices](const std::filesystem::path& p) -> std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument>
        {
            std::string error;
            std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> doc = TextDocument::Open(p, docServices, error);
            if (!doc)
                ARC_WARN("Text editor: {}", error);
            return doc;
        };

        for (const std::string_view ext : ExplicitTextExtensions())
            if (!host.HasFactory(std::filesystem::path("x" + std::string(ext))))
                host.RegisterTextFactory(std::string(ext), open);   // a text route, not a dedicated editor (HasDedicatedFactory, TE2-19)

        host.SetFallbackFactory(
            [open](const std::filesystem::path& p) -> std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument>
            {
                if (IsKnownBinaryExtension(p))
                {
                    ARC_WARN("Text editor: '{}' is a binary format with no editor in Arcane", Utf8Name(p));
                    return nullptr;
                }
                const std::optional<std::string> head = ReadRangeShared(p, 0, kSniffBytes);
                if (!head)
                {
                    ARC_WARN("Text editor: '{}' could not be read", Utf8Name(p));
                    return nullptr;
                }
                if (SniffText(*head) == TextSniffResult::Binary)
                {
                    ARC_WARN("Text editor: '{}' looks binary (NUL bytes in its first 8 KB); Arcane has no editor for it",
                             Utf8Name(p));
                    return nullptr;
                }
                return open(p);
            },
            // C/C++ exclusion removed by TE7-9 (D15). Until then a C/C++ source is
            // not claimed: OpenPath / OpenAt return null for it, and the Problems
            // panel keeps sending a C++ row to EditorApp::OpenSourceAtLine.
            [](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return !IsCppSourcePath(p) && !IsKnownBinaryExtension(p); });

        if (services.resolveGuid)
            host.SetGuidResolver(services.resolveGuid);
    }

    PathAndPoint SplitPathAndPoint(std::string_view text)
    {
        std::string s(text);
        const auto takeNumber = [&](std::uint32_t& out) -> bool
        {
            const std::size_t colon = s.rfind(':');
            if (colon == std::string::npos || colon <= 1 || colon + 1 >= s.size())
                return false;   // none, or a drive letter's colon
            const std::string_view digits(s.data() + colon + 1, s.size() - colon - 1);
            if (!std::all_of(digits.begin(), digits.end(), [](unsigned char c) { return std::isdigit(c) != 0; }))
                return false;
            out = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::stoul(std::string(digits)));
            s.resize(colon);
            return true;
        };
        PathAndPoint r;
        std::uint32_t last = 0, previous = 0;
        if (takeNumber(last))
        {
            if (takeNumber(previous))
            {
                r.point.row = previous > 0 ? previous - 1 : 0;
                r.point.col = last > 0 ? last - 1 : 0;
            }
            else
                r.point.row = last > 0 ? last - 1 : 0;
        }
        r.path = std::filesystem::path(std::u8string(reinterpret_cast<const char8_t*>(s.data()), s.size()));
        return r;
    }

    Arcane::Text::Point CharColumnToByteColumn(const Arcane::Text::Rope& text, Arcane::Text::Point at)
    {
        const std::uint32_t row = std::min(at.row, text.LineCount() - 1);
        const std::string line = text.Substr(Arcane::Text::ByteRange{ text.LineStart(row), text.LineEnd(row) });
        std::size_t byte = 0;
        for (std::uint32_t c = 0; c < at.col && byte < line.size(); ++c)
            byte += std::max<std::size_t>(1, Arcane::Text::Utf8::DecodeAt(line, byte).length);   // an invalid byte counts as one
        return Arcane::Text::Point{ row, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::min(byte, line.size())) };
    }

    EditorDocument* OpenAtPathAndPoint(DocumentHost& host, const PathAndPoint& at)
    {
        EditorDocument* doc = host.OpenPath(at.path);   // arms the tab focus, like OpenAt
        if (!doc)
            return nullptr;
        if (auto* text = dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(doc))
        {
            const Arcane::Text::Point bytes = CharColumnToByteColumn(text->Buffer().Text(), at.point);
            text->RevealPoint(bytes.row, bytes.col);   // GoTo + focus (TE2-19)
        }
        else
            doc->RevealPoint(at.point.row, at.point.col);
        return doc;
    }
}
```

```cpp
    void EditorApp::BeginTextSaveAs(Arcane::Editor::TextDocument& doc)
    {
        if (!m_gpu)
            return;
        {
            const std::lock_guard lock(m_textSaveAs.mutex);
            if (m_textSaveAs.waiting)
                return;   // one dialog at a time
            m_textSaveAs.waiting = true;
            m_textSaveAs.document = doc.CanonicalPath();
            m_textSaveAs.picked.reset();
        }
        const std::u8string start = doc.CanonicalPath().u8string();
        const std::string startUtf8(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(start.data()), start.size());
        m_gpu->Win().ShowSaveFileDialog(&EditorApp::OnTextSaveAsPicked, this, nullptr, nullptr, startUtf8.c_str());
    }

    void EditorApp::OnTextSaveAsPicked(const char* path, void* user)   // the SDL dialog thread
    {
        auto* self = static_cast<EditorApp*>(user);
        const std::lock_guard lock(self->m_textSaveAs.mutex);
        self->m_textSaveAs.waiting = false;
        if (path)
            self->m_textSaveAs.picked = std::filesystem::path(std::u8string(reinterpret_cast<const char8_t*>(path)));
    }

    void EditorApp::PumpTextSaveAs()
    {
        std::optional<std::filesystem::path> picked;
        std::filesystem::path key;
        {
            const std::lock_guard lock(m_textSaveAs.mutex);
            if (!m_textSaveAs.picked)
                return;
            picked = std::exchange(m_textSaveAs.picked, std::nullopt);
            key = m_textSaveAs.document;
        }
        if (auto* doc = dynamic_cast<Arcane::Editor::TextDocument*>(m_documents.FindByCanonicalPath(key)))
            if (!doc->SaveAs(*picked))
                ARC_WARN("Text editor: Save As '{}' did not complete (see the document's banner)", picked->generic_string());
    }
```
