```cpp
// Text editor TE2-21: what the verify report says about an open text document.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocumentRoutes.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;

TEST_CASE("text report facts: EOL ids, encoding ids, lines, caret, flags", "[text-doc]")
{
    CHECK(std::string(TextEolId(Arcane::Text::Eol::LF)) == "lf");
    CHECK(std::string(TextEolId(Arcane::Text::Eol::CRLF)) == "crlf");
    CHECK(std::string(TextEolId(Arcane::Text::Eol::CR)) == "cr");

    const std::filesystem::path p = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "arcane-te2-facts.md";
    std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary) << "a\r\nbb\r\nccc\r\n";
    {
        std::string error;
        auto doc = TextDocument::Open(p, {}, error);
        INFO(error);
        REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
        doc->GoTo(Arcane::Text::Point{ 1, 1 });
        const Arcane::VerifyReport::TextDocumentFacts f = TextReportFacts(*doc);
        CHECK(f.name == "arcane-te2-facts.md");
        CHECK(f.path.ends_with("arcane-te2-facts.md"));
        CHECK(f.path.find('\\') == std::string::npos);    // generic separators
        CHECK(f.lines == 4u);
        CHECK(f.encoding == "utf-8");                     // Text::EncodingId(TextEncoding::Utf8)
        CHECK(f.eol == "crlf");
        CHECK(f.caretRow == 1u);
        CHECK(f.caretCol == 1u);
        CHECK_FALSE(f.dirty);
        CHECK_FALSE(f.readOnly);
    }

    // A UTF-8 BOM is part of the encoding itself (TextEncoding::Utf8Bom): there is no separate bom flag.
    const std::filesystem::path bomPath = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "arcane-te2-facts-bom.txt";
    std::ofstream(bomPath, std::ios::binary) << "\xEF\xBB\xBFhi\n";
    {
        std::string error;
        auto doc = TextDocument::Open(bomPath, {}, error);
        INFO(error);
        REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
        CHECK(doc->Encoding() == Arcane::Text::TextEncoding::Utf8Bom);
        const Arcane::VerifyReport::TextDocumentFacts f = TextReportFacts(*doc);
        CHECK(f.encoding == "utf-8-bom");
        CHECK(f.eol == "lf");
        CHECK(f.lines == 2u);
    }
    std::filesystem::remove(p);
    std::filesystem::remove(bomPath);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocumentRoutes.hpp` -- add `#include <Arcane/Host/VerifyReport.hpp>` and:
```cpp
    // The report's line-ending id: "lf" | "crlf" | "cr". (The encoding id is
    // TE1-11's Text::EncodingId -- one list, no second spelling here.)
    [[nodiscard]] const char* TextEolId(Text::Eol eol);
    // What the verify report says about one open text document (its textDocuments entry, TE2-21).
    [[nodiscard]] Arcane::VerifyReport::TextDocumentFacts TextReportFacts(TextDocument& doc);
```
`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocumentRoutes.cpp` (add `#include "TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp"` for `Text::EncodingId`):
```cpp
    const char* TextEolId(Text::Eol eol)
    {
        switch (eol)
        {
        case Text::Eol::LF:   return "lf";
        case Text::Eol::CRLF: return "crlf";
        case Text::Eol::CR:   return "cr";
        }
        return "?";
    }

    Arcane::VerifyReport::TextDocumentFacts TextReportFacts(TextDocument& doc)
    {
        Arcane::VerifyReport::TextDocumentFacts f;
        const std::u8string generic = doc.CanonicalPath().generic_u8string();
        f.path.assign(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(generic.data()), generic.size());
        f.name = doc.Title();
        const Text::Rope& text = doc.Buffer().Text();
        f.lines = text.LineCount();
        f.encoding = std::string(Text::EncodingId(doc.Encoding()));   // "utf-8" | "utf-8-bom" | "utf-16le" | "utf-16be" | "windows-1252"
        f.eol = TextEolId(doc.Buffer().Eols().Dominant());
        f.dirty = doc.Dirty();
        f.readOnly = doc.ReadOnly();
        const Text::Point caret = text.OffsetToPoint(doc.Model().selections.Primary().head);
        f.caretRow = caret.row;
        f.caretCol = caret.col;
        f.firstVisibleRow = doc.View().Facts().firstVisibleRow;
        return f;
    }
```

**Spec requirements this chunk could not place, and why**

1. **Inline IME composition drawing (s5.1 "the composition string is drawn inline (underlined) until committed").** Arcane's SDL3 + imgui_impl_sdl3 path never delivers the composition string: the backend ignores `SDL_EVENT_TEXT_EDITING`, and getting it requires `SDL_HINT_IME_IMPLEMENTED_UI` -- a process-wide hint that would also remove the OS composition window from every other ImGui text field (InputText draws no composition). TE2 positions the OS composition window at the primary caret (`ImGuiPlatformImeData`), which is what every other field gets. Needs a ruling: either accept the OS window, or a later task routes `SDL_EVENT_TEXT_EDITING` through a second native-event tap and draws the composition in both the text view and InputText.
2. **IME *disable* in vim Normal/Visual/operator-pending (s5.1, s5.5) -- now placed (CANON B24, Review Focus F5, D-R1).** `WantVisible` alone only hides the candidate window (SDL keeps the IME associated while text input is active, and vim Normal mode still needs text input for its character keys), so TE2-10's `SetImeAllowed(false)` disassociates the focused window's input context with `ImmAssociateContextEx(hwnd, nullptr, 0)` at once, and `PollFrame` takes it away again every frame (SDL3's `SDL_StartTextInput`, called from `Platform_SetImeDataFn` in ImGui's `EndFrame`, re-associates it); `true` restores `IACE_DEFAULT`. `WM_SETFOCUS` / `WM_INPUTLANGCHANGE` are SENT messages the chain never sees, so nothing relies on them. Tested key-level through the real message queue (PostMessage, the SDL-shaped pump, TranslateMessage); TE5a-22 only calls it.
3. **Typed characters outside the BMP (emoji via Win+.)** are replaced by U+FFFD inside ImGui itself (`ImWchar` is 16-bit: no `IMGUI_USE_WCHAR32`; imgui.cpp:1792-1793). TE2 drops them with a one-time warning rather than inserting U+FFFD; drawing such characters already falls under the s1.2 font limits. Fixing typing needs `IMGUI_USE_WCHAR32` across the workspace (ArcaneClient exports ImGui), an ABI-wide change outside this chunk. Controller ruling: `IMGUI_USE_WCHAR32` is NOT in this plan (an owed follow-up after GATE-1); the drop-with-one-time-warning behaviour stays (spec amendment CANON D16).
4. **Witness scenarios of s11.4 that need a scripted save or a second process in the host** (in-use banner then Retry, Overwrite in place, read-only refusal, `_REPLACEMENT`/`_2`, one file through Browser + Console + 8.3 path focusing one tab, dirty-growth banner) are covered by the headless [text-io]/[text-doc] suites against the real file system and a real second process (TE2-6, TE2-7, TE2-15..20); their host-level witness forms need scripted input in the editor and belong to TE6's witness task (spec s12.1 step 6). The s11.4 Windows-1252 reopen scenario is TE2-15's in-process `[text-doc]` case, which GATE-1 cites (CANON B4: TE6-25 is dropped). TE2-21 delivers the host witness that opens a text file.
5. **Very tall files:** the view's scroll extent is `rows * lineHeight` in ImGui float space; past roughly 10^6 rows float precision makes scrolling coarse. TE6's `[perf]` budget for the 100 MB log should measure it; a row-anchored scroll (display row + pixel offset) is the fix if it fails.

**Overlaps with other chunks:** resolved by CANON B1 (TE2-4 + TE2-17 own external-change detection, append, truncation and rotation; TE6-1/TE6-2 are dropped and TE6-3's Follow rides TE2-17's poll), B3 (TE2-16 owns the D14 read-only banner mechanics; TE6-22 supplies only the `VcsReadOnlyReason` wording through `services.readOnlyReason`), B4 (TE2-15's `[text-doc]` 1252 case is the s11.4 witness; TE6-25 is dropped) and B5 (no C++ route in TE2: FileOpener, TE7, decides where C/C++ opens; TE2's fallback claims predicate keeps `!IsCppSourcePath` until TE7-9 removes it). TE1 names are TE1's own spellings (header table); there are no reconcile items left.

**Open points found while reconciling (not CANON items; for the controller):**
1. An appended tail whose `DecodeFragment` result has `readOnly != None` (an invalid UTF-8 byte or a lone UTF-16 surrogate in the tail) is appended without making the document read-only (TE2-17). The raw bytes are kept, so a save is still byte-faithful for UTF-8, but a UTF-16 lone surrogate would be re-encoded; a follow-up should mark the document read-only in that case. **Resolved (cross-fix X9):** TE2-17 now marks the document read-only with the fragment's reason and the `ReadOnlyContent` banner.
2. TE2-17 applies `ToUndoPolicy(Settings<TextSettings>())` to the buffer before a reload; TE2-15's open does not yet, so `undoGroupMs`/`undoMemoryMB` reach the buffer only from the first reload. TE2-15 should set it at open as well. **Resolved (cross-fix X8):** TE2-15's `Open` applies it.
3. TE2-21's golden gate still says "sixteen" combinations/lanes; like the report schema number, that count should be derived at execution (TE6-23 already derives its own from `$combos`). **Resolved (cross-fix X10):** TE2-21 counts the `$combos` rows first and writes `N + 2`.
4. Until TE7-11, `SplitPathAndPoint`'s 1-based character column is stored unconverted as a byte column, so a Problems `file:line:col` row on a non-ASCII line can land mid-character (`GoTo` clamps to the row, not to a character boundary). **Resolved (cross-fix X11):** `point.col` is now a character column, converted on the target row by `CharColumnToByteColumn` / `OpenAtPathAndPoint` (TE2-20), which `--open-path` uses.

## Chunk TE3: Syntax

Delivers spec s12.1 step 3: PCRE2 10.49 vendored with JIT and bounded, per-thread match state (s4.2); the `.arcsyntax` grammar engine -- parse, validate, compile, link into refcounted, versioned grammar snapshots (s4.1); a TextMate earliest-match tokenizer with interned states, the long-line cap and root resync, line-local force-close and a per-line time budget (s4.3, s3.5); a versioned highlight cache whose worker results are mapped forward through the edit log, with convergence stops and bounded UI catch-up (s4.4); scope interning and the `.arctheme` `syntax` block (s4.5); grammar brackets and fold markers (s4.6); the thirteen v1 grammars with scope-test samples (s4.7, s11.2); and the measured defaults for the six syntax budgets and limits (s8, s11.5).
Depends on TE1 (Rope, RopeSnapshot, TextBuffer edit log + `EditLogCovers`, FoldModel, TextSettings, the `ArcaneText` premake project) and TE2 (TextDocument + `TextDocumentServices`, `TextEditorView::SetRowColorRuns`). Names follow CANON.md (binding). No TE3 task is dropped. TE4 gets `CompiledGrammar` metadata (comment tokens, brackets, autoClose, indent rules, word class, symbols), `FindMatchingBracket` / `FindEnclosingBrackets`, marker folds in `FoldModel`, `HighlightCache::Peek`, the `Regex`/`MatchScratch` engine for `TextSearch`, and `GrammarRegistry::Names()`/`Detect()` for the language picker; TE5 gets the grammar `comment` tokens and `WordClass()` for `iskeyword`.

Every grammar file and scope-test sample in this chunk was run through a Python model of the TE3-9..TE3-11 tokenizer and the TE3-20 runner before it was written here (1,672 assertions, 0 failures; the model uses Python's `re`, whose syntax and semantics agree with PCRE2's for every construct these grammars use -- fixed-width lookbehind, no `\G`, no possessive quantifiers), as were the expected runs of TE3-10/TE3-11's tokenizer tests (the regex-limit case, which Python cannot model, was derived by hand), and the PCRE2 build recipe of TE3-1 was trial-built with the VS 2026 toolchain (JIT on; one C4267 warning in `pcre2_dfa_match.c`, disabled below by number).

| TE1 edit-log contract | (a) every `Edit`, `AppendExternal` and `ReloadExternal` call bumps `Version()` by exactly 1 and logs one entry stamped with the new version; (b) entries are in application order, each in the row coordinates left by the entry before it; (c) an entry means rows `[firstRow, lastRowBefore]` (pre-edit coordinates) were replaced by rows `[firstRow, lastRowBefore + rowDelta]`; (d) `EditsSince(v)` returns every retained entry with `version > v`, oldest first; (e) the log keeps the newest 4096 batches and `EditLogCovers(v)` says whether `EditsSince(v)` is complete. - [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test** -- append to `ArcaneTests/src/VendorSmokeTest.cpp`:

```cpp
// PCRE2 10.49 (text editor spec s4.2): the 8-bit library is built with
// Unicode and JIT; the editor compiles every pattern with PCRE2_UTF |
// PCRE2_MATCH_INVALID_UTF, so a subject holding a raw invalid byte matches
// instead of failing.
#define PCRE2_STATIC
#define PCRE2_CODE_UNIT_WIDTH 8
#include <pcre2.h>

TEST_CASE("PCRE2: the 8-bit library JIT-compiles and matches, invalid UTF tolerated", "[vendor][pcre2]")
{
    std::uint32_t jit = 0;
    REQUIRE(pcre2_config(PCRE2_CONFIG_JIT, &jit) >= 0);
    CHECK(jit == 1u);

    int errorCode = 0;
    PCRE2_SIZE errorOffset = 0;
    pcre2_code* code = pcre2_compile(reinterpret_cast<PCRE2_SPTR>("(\\d+)-(\\w+)"), PCRE2_ZERO_TERMINATED,
                                     PCRE2_UTF | PCRE2_MATCH_INVALID_UTF | PCRE2_UCP, &errorCode, &errorOffset, nullptr);
    REQUIRE(code != nullptr);
    REQUIRE(pcre2_jit_compile(code, PCRE2_JIT_COMPLETE) == 0);
    std::size_t jitSize = 0;
    REQUIRE(pcre2_pattern_info(code, PCRE2_INFO_JITSIZE, &jitSize) == 0);
    CHECK(jitSize > 0u);

    pcre2_match_data* md = pcre2_match_data_create(8, nullptr);
    REQUIRE(md != nullptr);
    const std::string subject = "id 42-abc";
    REQUIRE(pcre2_match(code, reinterpret_cast<PCRE2_SPTR>(subject.data()), subject.size(), 0, 0, md, nullptr) == 3);
    const PCRE2_SIZE* ov = pcre2_get_ovector_pointer(md);
    CHECK(ov[0] == 3u); CHECK(ov[1] == 9u);   // "42-abc"
    CHECK(ov[2] == 3u); CHECK(ov[3] == 5u);   // "42"
    CHECK(ov[4] == 6u); CHECK(ov[5] == 9u);   // "abc"

    const std::string invalid = std::string("x") + '\xE9' + "y 7-q";   // a lone Latin-1 byte
    REQUIRE(pcre2_match(code, reinterpret_cast<PCRE2_SPTR>(invalid.data()), invalid.size(), 0, 0, md, nullptr) == 3);
    CHECK(pcre2_get_ovector_pointer(md)[0] == 4u);

    pcre2_match_data_free(md);
    pcre2_code_free(code);
}
```

3b. Create `ThirdParty/pcre2/premake5.lua` (the enkiTS pattern with the `THIRDPARTY_*` parameters):

```lua
-- PCRE2 premake5 build script (Arcane text editor, spec 2026-10-07 s4.2)
-- PCRE2 10.49: BSD-3-Clause WITH PCRE2-exception (LICENCE.md); the JIT
-- compiler (deps/sljit) is BSD-2-Clause (deps/sljit/LICENSE).
-- One library: 8-bit code units, Unicode, JIT. src/config.h, include/pcre2.h
-- and src/pcre2_chartables.c are the distributed .generic/.dist templates,
-- copied unmodified; config.h.generic leaves every SUPPORT_* macro
-- undefined, so the defines below ARE the configuration (NON-AUTOTOOLS-BUILD
-- step 1). pcre2_jit_compile.c #includes the sljit sources itself
-- ("../deps/sljit/sljit_src/sljitLir.c"); they are never compiled on their own.

project "pcre2"
    kind "StaticLib"
    language "C"
    location(THIRDPARTY_PROJECT_LOCATION or ".")
    staticruntime(THIRDPARTY_STATICRUNTIME or "on")

    targetdir ("bin/" .. outputdir .. "/%{prj.name}")
    objdir    ("bin-int/" .. outputdir .. "/%{prj.name}")

    files {
        "src/pcre2_auto_possess.c",
        "src/pcre2_chartables.c",
        "src/pcre2_chkdint.c",
        "src/pcre2_compile.c",
        "src/pcre2_compile_cgroup.c",
        "src/pcre2_compile_class.c",
        "src/pcre2_config.c",
        "src/pcre2_context.c",
        "src/pcre2_convert.c",
        "src/pcre2_dfa_match.c",
        "src/pcre2_error.c",
        "src/pcre2_extuni.c",
        "src/pcre2_find_bracket.c",
        "src/pcre2_jit_compile.c",
        "src/pcre2_maketables.c",
        "src/pcre2_match.c",
        "src/pcre2_match_data.c",
        "src/pcre2_match_next.c",
        "src/pcre2_newline.c",
        "src/pcre2_ord2utf.c",
        "src/pcre2_pattern_info.c",
        "src/pcre2_script_run.c",
        "src/pcre2_serialize.c",
        "src/pcre2_string_utils.c",
        "src/pcre2_study.c",
        "src/pcre2_substitute.c",
        "src/pcre2_substring.c",
        "src/pcre2_tables.c",
        "src/pcre2_ucd.c",
        "src/pcre2_valid_utf.c",
        "src/pcre2_xclass.c",
        "src/*.h",
        "include/pcre2.h",
    }

    includedirs { "src", "include" }

    defines {
        "HAVE_CONFIG_H",
        "PCRE2_CODE_UNIT_WIDTH=8",
        "PCRE2_STATIC",
        "SUPPORT_PCRE2_8",
        "SUPPORT_UNICODE",
        "SUPPORT_JIT",
        "_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS",
    }

    filter "system:windows"
        systemversion "latest"
        -- C4267 (size_t -> uint32_t) fires once, in pcre2_dfa_match.c's
        -- frame bookkeeping (trial build 2026-10-07); upstream code, benign.
        disablewarnings { "4267" }

    filter "configurations:Debug"
        runtime "Debug"
        symbols "on"

    filter "configurations:Release"
        runtime "Release"
        optimize "on"
        defines { "NDEBUG" }

    filter "configurations:Dist"
        runtime "Release"
        optimize "on"
        defines { "NDEBUG" }
```

```cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Regex.hpp"

#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    std::shared_ptr<const Regex> MustCompile(std::string_view pattern, RegexOptions options = RegexOptions::None)
    {
        auto re = Regex::Compile(pattern, options);
        INFO(std::string(pattern) << ": " << (re ? std::string() : re.error().message));
        REQUIRE(re.has_value());
        return *re;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("Regex: compiles with JIT, reports captures, min length and \\G use", "[text-regex]")
{
    const auto re = MustCompile("(\\d+)-(\\w+)");
    CHECK(re->Jitted());
    CHECK(re->CaptureCount() == 2u);
    CHECK(re->MinLength() == 3u);
    CHECK_FALSE(re->UsesStartAnchor());
    CHECK(MustCompile("\\Gabc")->UsesStartAnchor());
    CHECK_FALSE(MustCompile("abc", RegexOptions::NoJit)->Jitted());
}

TEST_CASE("Regex: a bad pattern is an error with the PCRE2 message and offset", "[text-regex]")
{
    const auto re = Regex::Compile("(abc");
    REQUIRE_FALSE(re.has_value());
    CHECK(re.error().message.find("missing closing parenthesis") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(re.error().offset == 4u);
}

TEST_CASE("MatchScratch: match from an offset, groups, unset groups, no match", "[text-regex]")
{
    MatchScratch scratch(RegexLimits{});
    const auto re = MustCompile("(a)|(b)");
    REQUIRE(scratch.Match(*re, "xxb", 0) == MatchStatus::Match);
    std::size_t b = 0, e = 0;
    REQUIRE(scratch.Group(0, b, e)); CHECK(b == 2u); CHECK(e == 3u);
    CHECK_FALSE(scratch.Group(1, b, e));            // (a) did not participate
    REQUIRE(scratch.Group(2, b, e)); CHECK(b == 2u);
    CHECK_FALSE(scratch.Group(3, b, e));            // out of range
    CHECK(scratch.Match(*re, "xxb", 3) == MatchStatus::NoMatch);
    CHECK(scratch.Match(*re, "xxb", 9) == MatchStatus::NoMatch);   // past the end is a miss, never BADOFFSET
}

TEST_CASE("MatchScratch: lookbehind sees bytes before the start offset", "[text-regex]")
{
    MatchScratch scratch(RegexLimits{});
    const auto re = MustCompile("(?<=<)[a-z]+");
    REQUIRE(scratch.Match(*re, "<tag>", 1) == MatchStatus::Match);
    std::size_t b = 0, e = 0;
    REQUIRE(scratch.Group(0, b, e));
    CHECK(b == 1u); CHECK(e == 4u);
}

TEST_CASE("MatchScratch: NotEmpty refuses empty matches, NotEmptyAtStart only at the offset", "[text-regex]")
{
    MatchScratch scratch(RegexLimits{});
    const auto re = MustCompile("a*");
    std::size_t b = 0, e = 0;
    REQUIRE(scratch.Match(*re, "bba", 0, MatchFlags::NotEmptyAtStart) == MatchStatus::Match);
    REQUIRE(scratch.Group(0, b, e)); CHECK(b == 1u); CHECK(e == 1u);   // empty, but not at the start offset
    REQUIRE(scratch.Match(*re, "bba", 0, MatchFlags::NotEmpty) == MatchStatus::Match);
    REQUIRE(scratch.Group(0, b, e)); CHECK(b == 2u); CHECK(e == 3u);
}

TEST_CASE("MatchScratch: invalid UTF-8 never errors; an invalid byte never matches '.'", "[text-regex]")
{
    MatchScratch scratch(RegexLimits{});
    const auto re = MustCompile("y.", RegexOptions::Ucp);
    const std::string subject = std::string("y") + '\xE9' + " yz";
    REQUIRE(scratch.Match(*re, subject, 0) == MatchStatus::Match);
    std::size_t b = 0, e = 0;
    REQUIRE(scratch.Group(0, b, e));
    CHECK(b == 3u);
    // A start offset inside a multi-byte character is accepted under PCRE2_MATCH_INVALID_UTF.
    const auto letters = MustCompile("[a-z]+", RegexOptions::Ucp);
    REQUIRE(scratch.Match(*letters, "\xC3\xA9tab", 1) == MatchStatus::Match);
    REQUIRE(scratch.Group(0, b, e)); CHECK(b == 2u);
}

TEST_CASE("MatchScratch: UCP makes \\b Unicode-aware", "[text-regex]")
{
    MatchScratch scratch(RegexLimits{});
    CHECK(scratch.Match(*MustCompile("\\btrue\\b", RegexOptions::Ucp), "\xC3\xA9true", 0) == MatchStatus::NoMatch);
    CHECK(scratch.Match(*MustCompile("\\btrue\\b", RegexOptions::Ucp), "(true)", 0) == MatchStatus::Match);
}

TEST_CASE("MatchScratch: a catastrophic pattern hits the match limit instead of hanging", "[text-regex]")
{
    MatchScratch scratch(RegexLimits{ 10000, 0 });
    const auto jit = MustCompile("^(a+)+$");
    const auto interp = MustCompile("^(a+)+$", RegexOptions::NoJit);
    const std::string subject = std::string(40, 'a') + 'b';
    CHECK(scratch.Match(*jit, subject, 0) == MatchStatus::LimitHit);
    CHECK(scratch.Match(*interp, subject, 0) == MatchStatus::LimitHit);
    CHECK(scratch.LimitHits() == 2u);
    CHECK(scratch.LastErrorMessage().find("limit") != std::string::npos);
    scratch.SetLimits(RegexLimits{ 0, 0 });   // back to PCRE2's defaults
    CHECK(scratch.Limits().matchLimit == 0u);
}

TEST_CASE("MatchScratch: groups beyond the initial ovector grow it", "[text-regex]")
{
    MatchScratch scratch(RegexLimits{});
    std::string pattern;
    for (int i = 0; i < 40; ++i) pattern += "(x)";
    const auto re = MustCompile(pattern);
    REQUIRE(scratch.Match(*re, std::string(40, 'x'), 0) == MatchStatus::Match);
    std::size_t b = 0, e = 0;
    REQUIRE(scratch.Group(40, b, e));
    CHECK(b == 39u); CHECK(e == 40u);
}

TEST_CASE("Regex: one compiled pattern is shared read-only by two threads, each with its own scratch", "[text-regex]")
{
    const auto re = MustCompile("[0-9]+");
    std::vector<int> found(2, 0);
    auto work = [&](int slot) {
        MatchScratch scratch(RegexLimits{});
        const std::string subject = "a1b22c333d4444";
        for (int round = 0; round < 2000; ++round)
        {
            std::size_t pos = 0, b = 0, e = 0;
            int n = 0;
            while (scratch.Match(*re, subject, pos) == MatchStatus::Match && scratch.Group(0, b, e)) { ++n; pos = e; }
            found[static_cast<std::size_t>(slot)] += n;
        }
    };
    std::thread t0(work, 0), t1(work, 1);
    t0.join(); t1.join();
    CHECK(found[0] == 8000);
    CHECK(found[1] == 8000);
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The one regex engine of the text editor (spec s4.2): PCRE2 10.49, 8-bit,
// JIT. A Regex is compiled once and shared READ-ONLY across threads (grammar
// snapshots, compiled find queries). Everything PCRE2 mutates while matching
// -- match data, the match context with its limits, the JIT stack -- lives in
// a MatchScratch, and each thread owns its own (the UI thread one, the
// highlight worker one). Every pattern is compiled with PCRE2_UTF |
// PCRE2_MATCH_INVALID_UTF, so raw invalid bytes (spec s3.5) never make a
// match fail; they simply never match '.' or a class.

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <expected>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <thread>

struct pcre2_real_code_8;
struct pcre2_real_match_data_8;
struct pcre2_real_match_context_8;
struct pcre2_real_jit_stack_8;

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    // editor.text.regexMatchLimit / regexDepthLimit (TE3-3). 0 = PCRE2's
    // built-in default. PCRE2 ignores the depth limit for JIT-compiled
    // patterns; JIT recursion is bounded by the scratch's JIT stack instead.
    struct RegexLimits
    {
        std::uint32_t matchLimit = 0;
        std::uint32_t depthLimit = 0;
    };

    enum class RegexOptions : std::uint32_t
    {
        None      = 0,
        Caseless  = 1u << 0,
        Multiline = 1u << 1,   // ^ and $ at internal newlines (the multi-line search path, s4.2)
        DotAll    = 1u << 2,
        Ucp       = 1u << 3,   // Unicode \w \d \s \b (grammars always; find/vim decide per query)
        NoJit     = 1u << 4,   // interpreter only (tests and the depth-limit measurement)
    };
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr RegexOptions operator|(RegexOptions a, RegexOptions b) noexcept
    {
        return static_cast<RegexOptions>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(a) | static_cast<std::uint32_t>(b));
    }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool HasOption(RegexOptions set, RegexOptions bit) noexcept
    {
        return (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(set) & static_cast<std::uint32_t>(bit)) != 0;
    }

    struct RegexError
    {
        std::string message;
        std::size_t offset = 0;   // byte offset into the pattern
    };

    class Regex
    {
    public:
        ~Regex();
        Regex(const Regex&)            = delete;
        Regex& operator=(const Regex&) = delete;

        [[nodiscard]] static std::expected<std::shared_ptr<const Regex>, RegexError>
        Compile(std::string_view pattern, RegexOptions options = RegexOptions::None);

        [[nodiscard]] const std::string& Pattern() const noexcept { return m_pattern; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t CaptureCount() const noexcept { return m_captureCount; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t MinLength() const noexcept { return m_minLength; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool Jitted() const noexcept { return m_jitted; }
        // The pattern text contains \G, so its result depends on the start
        // offset: the tokenizer never reuses a cached match for it (TE3-9).
        [[nodiscard]] bool UsesStartAnchor() const noexcept { return m_usesStartAnchor; }
        [[nodiscard]] pcre2_real_code_8* Code() const noexcept { return m_code; }

    private:
        Regex() = default;

        pcre2_real_code_8* m_code = nullptr;
        std::string        m_pattern;
        std::uint32_t      m_captureCount = 0;
        std::uint32_t      m_minLength = 0;
        bool               m_jitted = false;
        bool               m_usesStartAnchor = false;
    };

    enum class MatchStatus : std::uint8_t { Match, NoMatch, LimitHit, Error };

    enum class MatchFlags : std::uint32_t
    {
        None            = 0,
        NotEmpty        = 1u << 0,   // PCRE2_NOTEMPTY: an empty match never counts
        NotEmptyAtStart = 1u << 1,   // PCRE2_NOTEMPTY_ATSTART: no empty match AT the start offset
    };
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr MatchFlags operator|(MatchFlags a, MatchFlags b) noexcept
    {
        return static_cast<MatchFlags>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(a) | static_cast<std::uint32_t>(b));
    }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool HasFlag(MatchFlags set, MatchFlags bit) noexcept
    {
        return (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(set) & static_cast<std::uint32_t>(bit)) != 0;
    }

    class MatchScratch
    {
    public:
        explicit MatchScratch(RegexLimits limits);
        ~MatchScratch();
        MatchScratch(const MatchScratch&)            = delete;
        MatchScratch& operator=(const MatchScratch&) = delete;

        void SetLimits(RegexLimits limits);
        [[nodiscard]] RegexLimits Limits() const noexcept { return m_limits; }

        // Searches `subject` from byte `start` (lookbehind may look before
        // it). A start past the end is a NoMatch. LimitHit = match limit,
        // depth limit, heap limit or JIT stack exhausted.
        MatchStatus Match(const Regex& re, std::string_view subject, std::size_t start, MatchFlags flags = MatchFlags::None);

        // Group i of the last Match; false when it did not participate or i
        // is out of range. Group 0 is the whole match.
        [[nodiscard]] bool Group(std::uint32_t i, std::size_t& begin, std::size_t& end) const noexcept;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t GroupSlots() const noexcept { return m_lastSlots; }

        [[nodiscard]] int LastErrorCode() const noexcept { return m_lastError; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::string LastErrorMessage() const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t LimitHits() const noexcept { return m_limitHits; }

    private:
        void EnsureOvector(std::uint32_t pairs);
        void ApplyLimits();
        void CheckThread();

        pcre2_real_match_data_8*    m_matchData = nullptr;
        pcre2_real_match_context_8* m_context = nullptr;
        pcre2_real_jit_stack_8*     m_jitStack = nullptr;
        std::uint32_t               m_ovecPairs = 0;
        std::uint32_t               m_lastSlots = 0;
        RegexLimits                 m_limits;
        int                         m_lastError = 0;
        std::uint64_t               m_limitHits = 0;
        std::thread::id             m_owner;   // the first thread that matched; asserted after (s4.2: one scratch per thread)
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/Regex.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Regex.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#define PCRE2_STATIC
#define PCRE2_CODE_UNIT_WIDTH 8
#include <pcre2.h>

#include <cassert>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("capacity hint: the JIT stack a MatchScratch starts with; PCRE2 grows it on demand up to kJitStackMaxBytes")
        constexpr std::size_t kJitStackStartBytes = 32 * 1024;
        ARC_CONSTANT("memory cap: the most JIT stack one thread's matches may use; exhausting it is a LimitHit, the JIT's analogue of the depth limit PCRE2 ignores under JIT")
        constexpr std::size_t kJitStackMaxBytes = 1024 * 1024;
        ARC_CONSTANT("capacity hint: ovector pairs a fresh MatchScratch allocates; EnsureOvector grows it for patterns with more groups")
        constexpr std::uint32_t kInitialOvectorPairs = 16;

        std::string ErrorText(int code)
        {
            PCRE2_UCHAR buffer[256];
            const int n = pcre2_get_error_message(code, buffer, sizeof buffer);
            if (n < 0) return "PCRE2 error " + std::to_string(code);
            return std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(buffer), static_cast<std::size_t>(n));
        }

        bool IsLimitError(int rc) noexcept
        {
            return rc == PCRE2_ERROR_MATCHLIMIT || rc == PCRE2_ERROR_DEPTHLIMIT || rc == PCRE2_ERROR_HEAPLIMIT
                || rc == PCRE2_ERROR_JIT_STACKLIMIT;
        }

        std::uint32_t BuiltInLimit(std::uint32_t what) noexcept
        {
            std::uint32_t value = 0;
            pcre2_config(what, &value);
            return value;
        }
    }

    Regex::~Regex()
    {
        if (m_code) pcre2_code_free(m_code);
    }

    std::expected<std::shared_ptr<const Regex>, RegexError> Regex::Compile(std::string_view pattern, RegexOptions options)
    {
        std::uint32_t flags = PCRE2_UTF | PCRE2_MATCH_INVALID_UTF;
        if (HasOption(options, RegexOptions::Caseless))  flags |= PCRE2_CASELESS;
        if (HasOption(options, RegexOptions::Multiline)) flags |= PCRE2_MULTILINE;
        if (HasOption(options, RegexOptions::DotAll))    flags |= PCRE2_DOTALL;
        if (HasOption(options, RegexOptions::Ucp))       flags |= PCRE2_UCP;

        int errorCode = 0;
        PCRE2_SIZE errorOffset = 0;
        pcre2_code* code = pcre2_compile(reinterpret_cast<PCRE2_SPTR>(pattern.data()), pattern.size(), flags,
                                         &errorCode, &errorOffset, nullptr);
        if (!code) return std::unexpected(RegexError{ ErrorText(errorCode), static_cast<std::size_t>(errorOffset) });

        std::shared_ptr<Regex> re(new Regex());
        re->m_code = code;
        re->m_pattern = std::string(pattern);
        pcre2_pattern_info(code, PCRE2_INFO_CAPTURECOUNT, &re->m_captureCount);
        pcre2_pattern_info(code, PCRE2_INFO_MINLENGTH, &re->m_minLength);
        re->m_usesStartAnchor = pattern.find("\\G") != std::string_view::npos;
        if (!HasOption(options, RegexOptions::NoJit))
            re->m_jitted = pcre2_jit_compile(code, PCRE2_JIT_COMPLETE) == 0;   // a JIT failure falls back to the interpreter
        return std::shared_ptr<const Regex>(std::move(re));
    }

    MatchScratch::MatchScratch(RegexLimits limits)
        : m_limits(limits)
    {
        m_matchData = pcre2_match_data_create(kInitialOvectorPairs, nullptr);
        m_ovecPairs = kInitialOvectorPairs;
        m_context = pcre2_match_context_create(nullptr);
        m_jitStack = pcre2_jit_stack_create(kJitStackStartBytes, kJitStackMaxBytes, nullptr);
        pcre2_jit_stack_assign(m_context, nullptr, m_jitStack);
        ApplyLimits();
    }

    MatchScratch::~MatchScratch()
    {
        pcre2_match_data_free(m_matchData);
        pcre2_match_context_free(m_context);
        pcre2_jit_stack_free(m_jitStack);
    }

    void MatchScratch::SetLimits(RegexLimits limits)
    {
        m_limits = limits;
        ApplyLimits();
    }

    void MatchScratch::ApplyLimits()
    {
        pcre2_set_match_limit(m_context, m_limits.matchLimit ? m_limits.matchLimit : BuiltInLimit(PCRE2_CONFIG_MATCHLIMIT));
        pcre2_set_depth_limit(m_context, m_limits.depthLimit ? m_limits.depthLimit : BuiltInLimit(PCRE2_CONFIG_DEPTHLIMIT));
    }

    void MatchScratch::EnsureOvector(std::uint32_t pairs)
    {
        if (pairs <= m_ovecPairs) return;
        pcre2_match_data_free(m_matchData);
        m_matchData = pcre2_match_data_create(pairs, nullptr);
        m_ovecPairs = pairs;
    }

    void MatchScratch::CheckThread()
    {
        if (m_owner == std::thread::id{}) m_owner = std::this_thread::get_id();
        assert(m_owner == std::this_thread::get_id() && "a MatchScratch belongs to one thread (spec s4.2)");
    }

    MatchStatus MatchScratch::Match(const Regex& re, std::string_view subject, std::size_t start, MatchFlags flags)
    {
        CheckThread();
        m_lastSlots = 0;
        if (start > subject.size())
        {
            m_lastError = PCRE2_ERROR_NOMATCH;
            return MatchStatus::NoMatch;
        }
        EnsureOvector(re.CaptureCount() + 1);
        std::uint32_t options = 0;
        if (HasFlag(flags, MatchFlags::NotEmpty))        options |= PCRE2_NOTEMPTY;
        if (HasFlag(flags, MatchFlags::NotEmptyAtStart)) options |= PCRE2_NOTEMPTY_ATSTART;
        const int rc = pcre2_match(re.Code(), reinterpret_cast<PCRE2_SPTR>(subject.data()), subject.size(), start,
                                   options, m_matchData, m_context);
        if (rc > 0)
        {
            m_lastError = 0;
            m_lastSlots = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(rc);   // highest group that matched, + 1
            return MatchStatus::Match;
        }
        m_lastError = rc;
        if (rc == PCRE2_ERROR_NOMATCH) return MatchStatus::NoMatch;
        if (IsLimitError(rc))
        {
            ++m_limitHits;
            return MatchStatus::LimitHit;
        }
        return MatchStatus::Error;   // rc == 0 cannot happen: EnsureOvector sized the vector for every group
    }

    bool MatchScratch::Group(std::uint32_t i, std::size_t& begin, std::size_t& end) const noexcept
    {
        if (i >= m_lastSlots) return false;
        const PCRE2_SIZE* ov = pcre2_get_ovector_pointer(m_matchData);
        if (ov[2 * i] == PCRE2_UNSET) return false;
        begin = static_cast<std::size_t>(ov[2 * i]);
        end   = static_cast<std::size_t>(ov[2 * i + 1]);
        return true;
    }

    std::string MatchScratch::LastErrorMessage() const
    {
        return m_lastError == 0 ? std::string() : ErrorText(m_lastError);
    }
}
```

```cpp
TEST_CASE("sweep: editor.text syntax defaults are the declared values", "[sweep][text]")
{

    CHECK(s.syntaxMaxMB == 32u);
    CHECK(s.longLineMaxBytes == 65536u);
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The syntax engine's tunables, as plain numbers. The ArcaneText library
// never reads a cvar (the CommandStack precedent, App/UndoSettings.hpp): the
// editor maps editor.text.* into this with Editor::ToSyntaxLimits and pushes
// it into each HighlightCache. A zero means "no bound" for every field EXCEPT
// syncCatchUpLines, where 0 means "the UI thread never tokenizes" (the
// setting's own meaning). Tests use the zeros; the settings' ranges keep
// production values non-zero.

#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Regex.hpp"

#include <cstdint>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct SyntaxLimits
    {
        std::uint64_t syntaxMaxBytes = 0;          // editor.text.syntaxMaxMB, in bytes (s3.5); 0 = no size gate
        std::uint32_t longLineMaxBytes = 0;        // editor.text.longLineMaxBytes (s3.5); 0 = no cap
        std::uint32_t tokenizeLineBudgetUs = 0;    // editor.text.tokenizeLineBudgetUs (s4.3); 0 = no per-line budget
        std::uint32_t highlightFrameBudgetUs = 0;  // editor.text.highlightFrameBudgetMs, in us (s4.4); 0 = a job runs to its end row
        std::uint32_t syncCatchUpLines = 0;        // editor.text.syncCatchUpLines (s4.4); 0 = no UI catch-up at all
        std::uint32_t syncCatchUpBudgetUs = 0;     // editor.text.syncCatchUpBudgetUs (s4.4); 0 = lines bound only
        std::uint32_t bracketScanMaxLines = 0;     // editor.text.bracketScanMaxLines (s4.6); 0 = unbounded
        RegexLimits   regex;                       // editor.text.regexMatchLimit / regexDepthLimit (s4.2); 0 = PCRE2 default
    };
}
```

```cpp
// remembered per extension, as ".ext=Grammar Name;..." (one string cvar; the

{

    {

        std::string grammar;     // "INI"
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatLanguageOverrides(std::span<const LanguageOverride> overrides);
    // Returns `text` with `extension` mapped to `grammar` (replacing an
    // existing entry in place, else appended); an empty grammar removes it.
    [[nodiscard]] std::string SetLanguageOverride(std::string_view text, std::string_view extension, std::string_view grammar);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string NormaliseExtension(std::string_view extension);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/LanguageOverrides.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/LanguageOverrides.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        std::string_view Trim(std::string_view s)
        {
            while (!s.empty() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s.front()))) s.remove_prefix(1);
            while (!s.empty() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s.back()))) s.remove_suffix(1);
            return s;
        }
    }

    std::string NormaliseExtension(std::string_view extension)
    {
        std::string out(Trim(extension));
        std::transform(out.begin(), out.end(), out.begin(), [](unsigned char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c)); });
        if (!out.empty() && out.front() != '.') out.insert(out.begin(), '.');
        return out;
    }

    std::vector<LanguageOverride> ParseLanguageOverrides(std::string_view text)
    {
        std::vector<LanguageOverride> out;
        while (!text.empty())
        {
            const std::size_t semi = text.find(';');
            const std::string_view entry = text.substr(0, semi);
            text = semi == std::string_view::npos ? std::string_view() : text.substr(semi + 1);
            const std::size_t eq = entry.find('=');
            if (eq == std::string_view::npos) continue;
            const std::string ext = NormaliseExtension(entry.substr(0, eq));
            const std::string_view grammar = Trim(entry.substr(eq + 1));
            if (ext.size() < 2 || grammar.empty()) continue;
            out.push_back({ ext, std::string(grammar) });
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::string FormatLanguageOverrides(std::span<const LanguageOverride> overrides)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (const LanguageOverride& o : overrides)
        {
            if (!out.empty()) out += ';';
            out += o.extension;
            out += '=';
            out += o.grammar;
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::string SetLanguageOverride(std::string_view text, std::string_view extension, std::string_view grammar)
    {
        std::vector<LanguageOverride> v = ParseLanguageOverrides(text);
        const std::string ext = NormaliseExtension(extension);
        const auto it = std::find_if(v.begin(), v.end(), [&](const LanguageOverride& o) { return o.extension == ext; });
        const std::string name(Trim(grammar));
        if (name.empty())
        {
            if (it != v.end()) v.erase(it);
        }
        else if (it != v.end())
            it->grammar = name;
        else
            v.push_back({ ext, name });
        return FormatLanguageOverrides(v);
    }
}
```

```cpp
        l.regex.depthLimit       = s.regexDepthLimit;
```

```cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Scope.hpp"

#include <thread>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

TEST_CASE("ScopeTable: interning is idempotent; id 0 is the empty scope", "[text-scope]")
{
    ScopeTable t;
    CHECK(t.Size() == 1u);
    CHECK(t.Name(0).empty());
    const ScopeId a = t.Intern("string.quoted.double.json");
    const ScopeId b = t.Intern("comment.line.json");
    CHECK(a != 0u);
    CHECK(a != b);
    CHECK(t.Intern("string.quoted.double.json") == a);
    CHECK(t.Name(a) == "string.quoted.double.json");
    CHECK(t.Find("comment.line.json") == b);
    CHECK_FALSE(t.Find("keyword").has_value());
    CHECK(t.Intern("") == 0u);
}

TEST_CASE("ScopeTable: run flags mark string.* and comment.* by their first segment, and keys as strings", "[text-scope]")
{
    CHECK(RunFlagsForScopeName("string") == kRunString);
    CHECK(RunFlagsForScopeName("string.quoted.double.json") == kRunString);
    CHECK(RunFlagsForScopeName("comment.block.hlsl") == kRunComment);
    CHECK(RunFlagsForScopeName("stringy.thing") == kRunNone);
    CHECK(RunFlagsForScopeName("markup.raw.inline.markdown") == kRunNone);
    // A key's text is literal, never code: JSON's {"a}":1} must not close the object at the key's '}' (finding 3.11).
    CHECK(RunFlagsForScopeName("entity.name.key") == kRunString);
    CHECK(RunFlagsForScopeName("entity.name.key.json") == kRunString);
    CHECK(RunFlagsForScopeName("entity.name.keyword.x") == kRunNone);   // dotted prefix, not a text prefix
    CHECK(RunFlagsForScopeName("entity.name.function.lua") == kRunNone);
    ScopeTable t;
    CHECK(t.Flags(t.Intern("comment.line.ini")) == kRunComment);
    CHECK(t.Flags(0) == kRunNone);
}

TEST_CASE("ScopeTable: concurrent interning agrees on ids", "[text-scope]")
{
    ScopeTable t;
    std::vector<ScopeId> a(200), b(200);
    auto work = [&t](std::vector<ScopeId>& out) {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < out.size(); ++i) out[i] = t.Intern("scope.n" + std::to_string(i % 50));
    };
    std::thread t0(work, std::ref(a)), t1(work, std::ref(b));
    t0.join(); t1.join();
    CHECK(a == b);
    CHECK(t.Size() == 51u);
}

TEST_CASE("ScopeMap: longest dotted prefix wins; no partial-segment matches", "[text-scope]")
{
    ScopeTable t;
    const ScopeId dq = t.Intern("string.quoted.double.json");
    const ScopeId sq = t.Intern("string.unquoted.yaml");
    const ScopeId stringy = t.Intern("stringy.value");
    const ScopeId cmt = t.Intern("comment.block.json");
    const ScopeStyle red   { PackRgba(255, 0, 0, 255), true, false, false };
    const ScopeStyle green { PackRgba(0, 255, 0, 255), true, false, true };
    const ScopeStyle grey  { PackRgba(128, 128, 128, 255), true, true, false };
    ScopeMap map(t, { { "string", red }, { "string.quoted", green }, { "comment", grey } });
    CHECK(map.RuleCount() == 3u);
    CHECK(map.Style(dq) == green);
    CHECK(map.Style(sq) == red);
    CHECK_FALSE(map.Style(stringy).hasColor);   // "stringy" is not under "string"
    CHECK(map.Style(cmt) == grey);
    CHECK_FALSE(map.Style(0).hasColor);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/SyntaxTypes.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// The syntax layer's shared vocabulary. The names are the plan skeleton's
// binding cross-chunk interfaces; TE3 adds members (never renames): run flags
// for bracket matching (s4.6), the partial-line resume point and resume
// state (s4.3), the long-line cap marker (s3.5) and the line's fold marker (s4.6).

#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    using ScopeId = std::uint32_t;   // ScopeTable id; 0 = no scope (draws in the default text colour)
    using StateId = std::uint32_t;   // StateTable id; 0 = the grammar's root state

    enum RunFlags : std::uint8_t
    {
        kRunNone    = 0,
        kRunString  = 1u << 0,   // inside (or is) a string.* scope, or an entity.name.key.* key (literal text)
        kRunComment = 1u << 1,   // inside (or is) a comment.* scope
    };

    struct TokenRun
    {
        std::uint32_t byteStart;
        ScopeId scope;
        std::uint8_t flags = kRunNone;
    };

    enum class FoldMarker : std::uint8_t { None, Begin, End };

    class CompiledGrammar;
    using GrammarSnapshot = std::shared_ptr<const CompiledGrammar>;

    // One tokenizer candidate the regex limit disabled for the rest of a line
    // (spec s4.2): the grammar that owns the rule, the rule index, and which of
    // its patterns (the tokenizer's candidate kind: rule, end, boundary end or
    // escape). The pointer is valid while the line's grammar snapshot lives --
    // a cache drops every row when its grammar changes.
    struct DisabledRuleRef
    {
        const CompiledGrammar* grammar = nullptr;
        std::uint32_t rule = 0;
        std::uint8_t kind = 0;
    };

    // What a partial line carries besides its region stack (endState), so a
    // resumed line is identical to an unbudgeted one (spec s4.3, plan rev 2
    // D-R3): the limit-disabled candidates and the zero-width step counter.
    // Empty (no allocation) on every complete line.
    struct LineResumeState
    {
        std::vector<DisabledRuleRef> disabled;
        std::uint32_t noProgress = 0;
    };

    struct LineTokens
    {
        std::vector<TokenRun> runs;     // run-length: each run lasts until the next one's byteStart
        StateId endState = 0;
        bool partial = false;           // the per-line budget ran out (s4.3)
        std::uint32_t resumeAt = 0;     // partial: runs cover [0, resumeAt); endState is the state AT resumeAt
        LineResumeState resume;         // partial: the rest of the tokenizer state at resumeAt; cleared when the line completes
        bool capped = false;            // longer than longLineMaxBytes: the last run (scope 0) starts at the cap (s3.5)
        FoldMarker foldMarker = FoldMarker::None;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/Scope.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// Scopes (spec s4.3, s4.5): dotted TextMate-style names, interned once to a
// ScopeId so a token run carries 4 bytes, not a string. ScopeMap turns a
// theme's prefix rules into a flat ScopeId -> style table, resolved by the
// longest dotted prefix ("string.quoted.double.json" -> "string.quoted" ->
// "string").

#include "TextEditor/Syntax/SyntaxTypes.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <shared_mutex>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct TransparentStringHash
    {
        using is_transparent = void;
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t operator()(std::string_view s) const noexcept { return std::hash<std::string_view>{}(s); }
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::uint8_t RunFlagsForScopeName(std::string_view name) noexcept;

    // Thread-safe: grammars intern while compiling (UI thread); the worker
    // only reads ids. Ids are never reused or removed.
    class ScopeTable
    {
    public:
        ScopeTable();
        [[nodiscard]] ScopeId Intern(std::string_view name);
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<ScopeId> Find(std::string_view name) const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::string Name(ScopeId id) const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint8_t Flags(ScopeId id) const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t Size() const;

    private:
        mutable std::shared_mutex m_mutex;
        std::vector<std::string> m_names;
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> m_flags;
        std::unordered_map<std::string, ScopeId, TransparentStringHash, std::equal_to<>> m_ids;
    };

    // Colour packed exactly like ImGui's IM_COL32 (R in bits 0-7, A in
    // 24-31), so the view hands it to ImDrawList unchanged; the library stays
    // ImGui-free.
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t PackRgba(std::uint8_t r, std::uint8_t g, std::uint8_t b, std::uint8_t a) noexcept
    {
        return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(r) | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(g) << 8) | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(b) << 16)
             | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(a) << 24);
    }

    struct ScopeStyle
    {
        std::uint32_t color = 0;
        bool hasColor = false;   // false: the default text colour
        bool italic = false;
        bool bold = false;
        bool operator==(const ScopeStyle&) const = default;
    };

    struct ScopeStyleRule
    {
        std::string prefix;      // "string.quoted"
        ScopeStyle style;
    };

    // UI-thread object. Built once per theme over every scope interned so far;
    // a scope interned later (a grammar loaded after the theme) resolves on
    // its first Style() call.
    class ScopeMap
    {
    public:
        ScopeMap() = default;
        ScopeMap(const ScopeTable& scopes, std::vector<ScopeStyleRule> rules);

        [[nodiscard]] const ScopeStyle& Style(ScopeId id);
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t RuleCount() const noexcept { return m_rules.size(); }

    private:
        [[nodiscard]] ScopeStyle Resolve(ScopeId id) const;

        const ScopeTable* m_scopes = nullptr;
        std::unordered_map<std::string, ScopeStyle, TransparentStringHash, std::equal_to<>> m_rules;
        std::vector<ScopeStyle> m_lut;
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> m_resolved;
        ScopeStyle m_default;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/Scope.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Scope.hpp"

#include <mutex>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    std::uint8_t RunFlagsForScopeName(std::string_view name) noexcept
    {
        const std::string_view first = name.substr(0, name.find('.'));
        if (first == "string") return kRunString;
        if (first == "comment") return kRunComment;
        // An object key (JSON, YAML, TOML, INI: entity.name.key.*) is literal text, so bracket matching
        // (s4.6) skips the brackets inside it exactly as inside a string -- {"a}":1} (finding 3.11).
        // Dotted-prefix match, like ScopeMap's: "entity.name.keyword" is not under it.
        constexpr std::string_view key = "entity.name.key";
        if (name.starts_with(key) && (name.size() == key.size() || name[key.size()] == '.')) return kRunString;
        return kRunNone;
    }

    ScopeTable::ScopeTable()
    {
        m_names.emplace_back();
        m_flags.push_back(kRunNone);
        m_ids.emplace(std::string(), 0u);
    }

    ScopeId ScopeTable::Intern(std::string_view name)
    {
        {
            std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
            if (const auto it = m_ids.find(name); it != m_ids.end()) return it->second;
        }
        std::unique_lock lock(m_mutex);
        if (const auto it = m_ids.find(name); it != m_ids.end()) return it->second;   // raced
        const ScopeId id = static_cast<ScopeId>(m_names.size());
        m_names.emplace_back(name);
        m_flags.push_back(RunFlagsForScopeName(name));
        m_ids.emplace(std::string(name), id);
        return id;
    }

    std::optional<ScopeId> ScopeTable::Find(std::string_view name) const
    {
        std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
        if (const auto it = m_ids.find(name); it != m_ids.end()) return it->second;
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    std::string ScopeTable::Name(ScopeId id) const
    {
        std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
        return id < m_names.size() ? m_names[id] : std::string();
    }

    std::uint8_t ScopeTable::Flags(ScopeId id) const
    {
        std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
        return id < m_flags.size() ? m_flags[id] : static_cast<std::uint8_t>(kRunNone);
    }

    std::size_t ScopeTable::Size() const
    {
        std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
        return m_names.size();
    }

    ScopeMap::ScopeMap(const ScopeTable& scopes, std::vector<ScopeStyleRule> rules)
        : m_scopes(&scopes)
    {
        for (ScopeStyleRule& r : rules) m_rules.insert_or_assign(std::move(r.prefix), r.style);   // a repeated prefix: the last wins
        const std::size_t n = scopes.Size();
        m_lut.resize(n);
        m_resolved.assign(n, 1);
        for (std::size_t id = 0; id < n; ++id) m_lut[id] = Resolve(static_cast<ScopeId>(id));
    }

    const ScopeStyle& ScopeMap::Style(ScopeId id)
    {
        if (!m_scopes) return m_default;
        if (id >= m_lut.size())
        {
            m_lut.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(id) + 1);
            m_resolved.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(id) + 1, 0);
        }
        if (!m_resolved[id])
        {
            m_lut[id] = Resolve(id);
            m_resolved[id] = 1;
        }
        return m_lut[id];
    }

    ScopeStyle ScopeMap::Resolve(ScopeId id) const
    {
        if (id == 0) return m_default;
        std::string name = m_scopes->Name(id);
        for (;;)
        {
            if (const auto it = m_rules.find(name); it != m_rules.end()) return it->second;
            const std::size_t dot = name.rfind('.');
            if (dot == std::string::npos) return m_default;
            name.resize(dot);
        }
    }
}
```

### Task TE3-5: The `.arctheme` `syntax` block and `editor.theme.syntax.rules` (spec s4.5)

The theme loader is `ArcaneEditor/src/Settings/ThemePresets.cpp` (`ReadThemeFile`, `WriteThemeJson`, `ApplyThemeToRegistry`), driven by `ThemePage.cpp:22-41` (`ApplyFile`) and `:144-155` (`ExportThemeTo`). `ArcaneEditor/src/Settings/SyntaxThemeSettings.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// The `.arctheme` `syntax` block (text editor spec s4.5): scope prefix ->
// colour (a "#rrggbb[aa]" literal or a palette token "editor.theme.<field>")
// and style. Applying a theme stores its block, as canonical JSON, in
// editor.theme.syntax.rules (Hidden; machine-wide like the palette); "" means
// the built-in syntax colours (TE3-6), which use palette tokens only.

#include <imgui.h>

#include <expected>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct EditorSyntaxThemeSettings
    {
        std::string rules;   // canonical JSON of the active theme's `syntax` object; "" = built-in
    };

    struct SyntaxThemeEntry
    {
        std::string prefix;      // "string.quoted"
        std::string token;       // "editor.theme.textDim" when the colour is a palette token; "" for a literal
        ImVec4 color{};          // the literal (display sRGB) when token is empty
        bool italic = false;
        bool bold = false;
    };

    // `json` is a `syntax` object's text; "" parses to an empty list. Errors
    // name the offending key.
    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<std::vector<SyntaxThemeEntry>, std::string> ParseSyntaxThemeJson(std::string_view json);
    // Canonical compact JSON, entry order kept, colours as "#rrggbbaa",
    // false styles omitted.
    [[nodiscard]] std::string SyntaxThemeJson(std::span<const SyntaxThemeEntry> entries);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Settings/SyntaxThemeSettings.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Settings/SyntaxThemeSettings.hpp"

#include "Settings/EditorThemeSettings.hpp"
#include "Settings/ThemePresets.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Reflection.hpp>

#include <Json.hpp>

#include <cctype>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    ARC_REFLECT_TYPE(EditorSyntaxThemeSettings)
        ARC_REFLECT_TYPE_ATTR(Settings, "editor.theme.syntax", SettingScope::PreferencesMachine, ApplyMode::Live, Audience::Editor)
        ARC_REFLECT_FIELD(EditorSyntaxThemeSettings, rules)
            ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(DisplayName, "Syntax colours") ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(Flags, CVarFlags::Hidden)
            ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(Keywords, "highlight theme scope colour arctheme text editor")
            ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(Tooltip, "The applied theme's syntax block (scope prefix to colour and style), written when "
                                      "a theme is applied or imported. Empty uses the built-in syntax colours.")
    ARC_END_REFLECT_TYPE()

    ARC_SETTINGS(EditorSyntaxThemeSettings);

    namespace
    {
        bool ValidPrefix(std::string_view s)
        {
            if (s.empty() || s.front() == '.' || s.back() == '.') return false;
            char prev = '\0';
            for (const char c : s)
            {
                const bool word = std::isalnum(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)) || c == '_' || c == '-' || c == '+';
                if (!word && c != '.') return false;
                if (c == '.' && prev == '.') return false;
                prev = c;
            }
            return true;
        }

        bool KnownToken(std::string_view token)
        {
            constexpr std::string_view kPrefix = "editor.theme.";
            if (!token.starts_with(kPrefix)) return false;
            const std::string_view field = token.substr(kPrefix.size());
            for (const ThemeToken& t : kThemeTokens)
                if (t.field == field) return true;
            return false;
        }
    }

    std::expected<std::vector<SyntaxThemeEntry>, std::string> ParseSyntaxThemeJson(std::string_view json)
    {
        std::vector<SyntaxThemeEntry> out;
        if (json.empty()) return out;
        const nlohmann::ordered_json doc = nlohmann::ordered_json::parse(json, nullptr, /*allow_exceptions*/ false);
        if (doc.is_discarded() || !doc.is_object()) return std::unexpected(std::string("\"syntax\" must be a JSON object"));
        for (auto it = doc.begin(); it != doc.end(); ++it)
        {
            const std::string& key = it.key();
            if (!ValidPrefix(key)) return std::unexpected("\"" + key + "\" is not a scope prefix (dotted words)");
            if (!it->is_object()) return std::unexpected("\"" + key + "\" must be an object");
            SyntaxThemeEntry e;
            e.prefix = key;
            bool haveColor = false;
            for (auto f = it->begin(); f != it->end(); ++f)
            {
                if (f.key() == "color")
                {
                    if (!f->is_string()) return std::unexpected("\"" + key + "\".color must be a string");
                    const std::string c = f->get<std::string>();
                    if (c.starts_with('#'))
                    {
                        const std::optional<ImVec4> v = ParseHexColor(c);
                        if (!v) return std::unexpected("\"" + key + "\".color: expected \"#rrggbb\" or \"#rrggbbaa\"");
                        e.color = *v;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (!KnownToken(c)) return std::unexpected("\"" + key + "\".color: \"" + c + "\" is not a theme token");
                        e.token = c;
                    }
                    haveColor = true;
                }
                else if (f.key() == "italic" || f.key() == "bold")
                {
                    if (!f->is_boolean()) return std::unexpected("\"" + key + "\"." + f.key() + " must be true or false");
                    (f.key() == "italic" ? e.italic : e.bold) = f->get<bool>();
                }
                else
                    return std::unexpected("\"" + key + "\": unknown key \"" + f.key() + "\"");
            }
            if (!haveColor) return std::unexpected("\"" + key + "\" has no \"color\"");
            out.push_back(std::move(e));
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::string SyntaxThemeJson(std::span<const SyntaxThemeEntry> entries)
    {
        nlohmann::ordered_json doc = nlohmann::ordered_json::object();
        for (const SyntaxThemeEntry& e : entries)
        {
            nlohmann::ordered_json v = nlohmann::ordered_json::object();
            v["color"] = e.token.empty() ? FormatHexColor(e.color) : e.token;
            if (e.italic) v["italic"] = true;
            if (e.bold) v["bold"] = true;
            doc[e.prefix] = std::move(v);
        }
        return doc.dump();
    }
}
```

`SyntaxThemeSettings.cpp` -- add:

```cpp
    namespace
    {
        SyntaxThemeEntry Tok(std::string_view prefix, std::string_view field, bool italic = false, bool bold = false)
        {
            SyntaxThemeEntry e;
            e.prefix = std::string(prefix);
            e.token = "editor.theme." + std::string(field);
            e.italic = italic;
            e.bold = bold;
            return e;
        }

        const std::vector<SyntaxThemeEntry>& BuiltIn()
        {
            static const std::vector<SyntaxThemeEntry> entries = {
                Tok("comment", "textDim", true),
                Tok("string", "amberLight"),
                Tok("constant", "amber"),
                Tok("constant.language", "accentHovered"),
                Tok("keyword", "accentHovered"),
                Tok("storage", "accentHovered"),
                Tok("entity.name", "accentHovered"),
                Tok("entity.name.function", "text", false, true),
                Tok("entity.name.section", "accent", false, true),
                Tok("entity.other.attribute-name", "amber"),
                Tok("meta.preprocessor", "accent"),
                Tok("meta.attribute", "accent"),
                Tok("markup.heading", "accent", false, true),
                Tok("markup.bold", "text", false, true),
                Tok("markup.italic", "text", true),
                Tok("markup.raw", "amberLight"),
                Tok("markup.fenced_code", "amberLight"),
                Tok("markup.quote", "textDim"),
                Tok("markup.list", "textDim"),
                Tok("markup.underline.link", "accentHovered"),
                Tok("markup.log.level.trace", "textDim"),
                Tok("markup.log.level.debug", "textDim"),
                Tok("markup.log.level.info", "text"),
                Tok("markup.log.level.warning", "warning"),
                Tok("markup.log.level.error", "error"),
                Tok("markup.log.level.critical", "error", false, true),
                Tok("markup.log.message.warning", "warning"),
                Tok("markup.log.message.error", "error"),
                Tok("markup.log.message.critical", "error"),
                Tok("constant.other.timestamp.log", "textDim"),
                Tok("entity.name.logger.log", "textDim"),
                Tok("entity.name.tag.log", "accentHovered"),
                Tok("invalid", "error"),
            };
            return entries;
        }

        ImVec4 TokenColor(std::string_view token, const Theme::Palette& palette)
        {
            constexpr std::string_view kPrefix = "editor.theme.";
            const std::string_view field = token.substr(kPrefix.size());
            for (const ThemeToken& t : kThemeTokens)
                if (t.field == field) return palette.*(t.palette);
            return palette.text;   // unreachable for a parsed entry (ParseSyntaxThemeJson checks the token)
        }
    }

    std::span<const SyntaxThemeEntry> BuiltInSyntaxTheme() { return BuiltIn(); }

    std::vector<Arcane::Text::ScopeStyleRule> ResolveSyntaxTheme(std::span<const SyntaxThemeEntry> entries,
                                                                const Theme::Palette& palette)
    {
        std::vector<Arcane::Text::ScopeStyleRule> rules;
        rules.reserve(entries.size());
        for (const SyntaxThemeEntry& e : entries)
        {
            Arcane::Text::ScopeStyle s;
            s.color = ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(e.token.empty() ? e.color : TokenColor(e.token, palette));
            s.hasColor = true;
            s.italic = e.italic;
            s.bold = e.bold;
            rules.push_back({ e.prefix, s });
        }
        return rules;
    }

    std::vector<Arcane::Text::ScopeStyleRule> ActiveSyntaxRules(std::string_view rulesJson, const Theme::Palette& palette)
    {
        if (!rulesJson.empty())
            if (const auto entries = ParseSyntaxThemeJson(rulesJson)) return ResolveSyntaxTheme(*entries, palette);
        return ResolveSyntaxTheme(BuiltIn(), palette);
    }
```

(`ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32` is a pure conversion -- the existing `ThemePresetsTest.cpp:18` uses it without a context.) Note: italic/bold are carried through to `ScopeStyle`; the editor ships JetBrains Mono Regular only, so TE3-30's renderer draws them in the regular face (reported as a gap).

  - `std::expected<GrammarDesc, GrammarError> ParseGrammar(std::string_view jsonText)`

The format is the spec's s4.1 schema, validated strictly so a typo is a Problems row rather than a silently ignored key. Additions, each needed by a v1 grammar and reported in the chunk self-review: an optional top-level `"notice"` string (the MIT attribution of ported content, s4.7 -- JSON has no comments); `brackets` entries are single ASCII characters (every v1 language's pairs are; the matcher in TE3-18 relies on it). `files` entries are matched case-insensitively against the extension (`".json"`) or the whole file name (`".bashrc"`, `"cmakelists.txt"`).
