- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/Grammar.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// .arcsyntax grammars (spec s4.1). ParseGrammar turns the JSON into a
// GrammarDesc and validates its shape strictly (unknown keys are errors, so a
// typo becomes a Problems row naming the rule instead of a silently dead
// rule). Regexes are compiled later, by CompileGrammarRules (TE3-8).

#include "TextEditor/Syntax/SyntaxTypes.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <cstdint>
#include <expected>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    ARC_CONSTANT("file format: the .arcsyntax version this editor reads (spec s4.1)")
    inline constexpr int kArcSyntaxVersion = 1;

    struct RuleDesc
    {
        enum class Kind : std::uint8_t { Match, Region };
        Kind kind = Kind::Match;
        std::string path;           // "patterns[3].patterns[0]": names the rule in Problems rows
        std::string match;          // Match
        std::string begin;          // Region
        std::string end;            // Region (required)
        std::string escape;         // Region (optional)
        std::string scope;          // both (optional)
        std::string contentScope;   // Region (optional)
        std::string embed;          // Region: another grammar's name for the content (exclusive with patterns)
        std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::string>> captures;            // Match: group -> scope, ascending
        std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::vector<std::string>>> keywords; // Match: scope -> words
        std::vector<RuleDesc> patterns;                                         // Region: nested rules
    };

    struct SymbolDesc
    {
        std::string match;
        std::uint32_t nameGroup = 0;
        std::string kind;
    };

    struct GrammarDesc
    {
        std::string name;
        std::string scope;
        std::string notice;                      // attribution of ported content; not used by the engine
        std::vector<std::string> files;          // lowercase: an extension ".json" or a whole file name ".bashrc"
        std::string firstLine;
        std::string lineComment;
        std::string blockCommentBegin;
        std::string blockCommentEnd;
        std::vector<std::pair<char, char>> brackets;
        std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> autoClose;
        std::string indentIncrease;
        std::string indentDecrease;
        std::string wordChars = "A-Za-z0-9_";    // a regex character-class body (vim's iskeyword, s6.5)
        std::vector<SymbolDesc> symbols;
        std::string foldBegin;
        std::string foldEnd;
        bool lineLocal = false;
        std::vector<RuleDesc> patterns;
    };

    struct GrammarError
    {
        std::string rulePath;   // "" = the file's top level
        std::string message;
        [[nodiscard]] std::string Text() const { return rulePath.empty() ? message : rulePath + ": " + message; }
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<GrammarDesc, GrammarError> ParseGrammar(std::string_view jsonText);
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsValidScopeName(std::string_view scope) noexcept;
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/Grammar.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Grammar.hpp"

#include <Json.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <initializer_list>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        using Json = nlohmann::json;

        ARC_CONSTANT("sanity bound, not a tunable: region nesting deeper than this in a grammar file is a mistake, refused before it can recurse the parser")
        constexpr int kMaxRuleDepth = 32;

        std::unexpected<GrammarError> Fail(std::string path, std::string message)
        {
            return std::unexpected(GrammarError{ std::move(path), std::move(message) });
        }

        std::string Join(const std::string& path, std::string_view key)
        {
            return path.empty() ? std::string(key) : path + "." + std::string(key);
        }

        std::expected<void, GrammarError> OnlyKeys(const Json& obj, const std::string& path, std::initializer_list<std::string_view> allowed)
        {
            for (auto it = obj.begin(); it != obj.end(); ++it)
                if (std::find(allowed.begin(), allowed.end(), std::string_view(it.key())) == allowed.end())
                    return Fail(path, "unknown key \"" + it.key() + "\"");
            return {};
        }

        // Messages carry the path too, so GrammarError::message alone still
        // names where the problem is ("foldMarkers: missing \"end\"").
        std::expected<std::string, GrammarError> String(const Json& obj, std::string_view key, const std::string& path, bool required)
        {
            const std::string where = path.empty() ? std::string() : path + ": ";
            const auto it = obj.find(std::string(key));
            if (it == obj.end())
            {
                if (required) return Fail(path, where + "missing \"" + std::string(key) + "\"");
                return std::string();
            }
            if (!it->is_string() || it->get<std::string>().empty())
                return Fail(path, where + "\"" + std::string(key) + "\" must be a non-empty string");
            return it->get<std::string>();
        }

        std::expected<std::string, GrammarError> Scope(const Json& obj, std::string_view key, const std::string& path)
        {
            auto s = String(obj, key, path, false);
            if (!s) return s;
            if (!s->empty() && !IsValidScopeName(*s)) return Fail(path, "\"" + std::string(key) + "\" \"" + *s + "\" is not a scope name");
            return s;
        }

        std::expected<std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>>, GrammarError>
        Pairs(const Json& obj, std::string_view key, bool singleChars)
        {
            std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> out;
            const auto it = obj.find(std::string(key));
            if (it == obj.end()) return out;
            const std::string what = "\"" + std::string(key) + "\" must be an array of [open, close] " +
                                     (singleChars ? "single ASCII characters" : "non-empty strings");
            if (!it->is_array()) return Fail("", what);
            for (const Json& p : *it)
            {
                if (!p.is_array() || p.size() != 2 || !p[0].is_string() || !p[1].is_string()) return Fail("", what);
                std::string a = p[0].get<std::string>(), b = p[1].get<std::string>();
                const auto ok = [singleChars](const std::string& s) {
                    return singleChars ? (s.size() == 1 && static_cast<unsigned char>(s[0]) > 0x20 && static_cast<unsigned char>(s[0]) < 0x7f)
                                       : !s.empty();
                };
                if (!ok(a) || !ok(b)) return Fail("", what);
                out.emplace_back(std::move(a), std::move(b));
            }
            return out;
        }

        std::expected<RuleDesc, GrammarError> ParseRule(const Json& j, const std::string& path, int depth)
        {
            if (depth > kMaxRuleDepth) return Fail(path, "rules nested deeper than " + std::to_string(kMaxRuleDepth) + " levels");
            if (!j.is_object()) return Fail(path, "a rule must be an object");
            const bool hasMatch = j.contains("match"), hasBegin = j.contains("begin");
            if (hasMatch == hasBegin) return Fail(path, hasMatch ? "has both \"match\" and \"begin\"" : "needs \"match\" or \"begin\"");
            RuleDesc r;
            r.path = path;
            if (hasMatch)
            {
                r.kind = RuleDesc::Kind::Match;
                if (auto k = OnlyKeys(j, path, { "match", "scope", "captures", "keywords" }); !k) return std::unexpected(k.error());
                auto m = String(j, "match", path, true);  if (!m) return std::unexpected(m.error());
                auto s = Scope(j, "scope", path);         if (!s) return std::unexpected(s.error());
                r.match = std::move(*m);
                r.scope = std::move(*s);
                if (const auto c = j.find("captures"); c != j.end())
                {
                    const std::string cp = Join(path, "captures");
                    if (!c->is_object()) return Fail(cp, "must be an object of \"group\": scope");
                    for (auto it = c->begin(); it != c->end(); ++it)
                    {
                        const std::string& g = it.key();
                        if (g.empty() || g.size() > 3 || !std::all_of(g.begin(), g.end(), [](char ch) { return ch >= '0' && ch <= '9'; }))
                            return Fail(cp, "\"" + g + "\" is not a group number");
                        if (!it->is_string() || !IsValidScopeName(it->get<std::string>()))
                            return Fail(cp, "\"" + g + "\" must map to a scope name");
                        r.captures.emplace_back(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::stoul(g)), it->get<std::string>());
                    }
                    std::sort(r.captures.begin(), r.captures.end());
                }
                if (const auto k = j.find("keywords"); k != j.end())
                {
                    const std::string kp = Join(path, "keywords");
                    if (!k->is_object()) return Fail(kp, "must be an object of scope: [words]");
                    for (auto it = k->begin(); it != k->end(); ++it)
                    {
                        if (!IsValidScopeName(it.key())) return Fail(kp, "\"" + it.key() + "\" is not a scope name");
                        if (!it->is_array()) return Fail(kp, "\"" + it.key() + "\" must be an array of words");
                        std::vector<std::string> words;
                        for (const Json& w : *it)
                        {
                            if (!w.is_string() || w.get<std::string>().empty()) return Fail(kp, "\"" + it.key() + "\" holds an empty or non-string word");
                            words.push_back(w.get<std::string>());
                        }
                        r.keywords.emplace_back(it.key(), std::move(words));
                    }
                }
                return r;
            }
            r.kind = RuleDesc::Kind::Region;
            if (auto k = OnlyKeys(j, path, { "begin", "end", "escape", "scope", "contentScope", "patterns", "embed" }); !k)
                return std::unexpected(k.error());
            auto b = String(j, "begin", path, true);         if (!b) return std::unexpected(b.error());
            auto e = String(j, "end", path, true);           if (!e) return std::unexpected(e.error());
            auto x = String(j, "escape", path, false);       if (!x) return std::unexpected(x.error());
            auto s = Scope(j, "scope", path);                if (!s) return std::unexpected(s.error());
            auto c = Scope(j, "contentScope", path);         if (!c) return std::unexpected(c.error());
            auto em = String(j, "embed", path, false);       if (!em) return std::unexpected(em.error());
            r.begin = std::move(*b);
            r.end = std::move(*e);
            r.escape = std::move(*x);
            r.scope = std::move(*s);
            r.contentScope = std::move(*c);
            r.embed = std::move(*em);
            if (const auto p = j.find("patterns"); p != j.end())
            {
                if (!r.embed.empty()) return Fail(path, "\"embed\" and \"patterns\" cannot be combined (the embedded grammar supplies the rules)");
                if (!p->is_array()) return Fail(path, "\"patterns\" must be an array");
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < p->size(); ++i)
                {
                    auto child = ParseRule((*p)[i], path + ".patterns[" + std::to_string(i) + "]", depth + 1);
                    if (!child) return std::unexpected(child.error());
                    r.patterns.push_back(std::move(*child));
                }
            }
            return r;
        }
    }

    bool IsValidScopeName(std::string_view scope) noexcept
    {
        if (scope.empty() || scope.front() == '.' || scope.back() == '.') return false;
        char prev = '\0';
        for (const char c : scope)
        {
            const bool word = std::isalnum(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)) || c == '_' || c == '-' || c == '+';
            if (!word && c != '.') return false;
            if (c == '.' && prev == '.') return false;
            prev = c;
        }
        return true;
    }

    std::expected<GrammarDesc, GrammarError> ParseGrammar(std::string_view jsonText)
    {
        Json doc;
        try
        {
            doc = Json::parse(jsonText.begin(), jsonText.end());
        }
        catch (const Json::parse_error& e)
        {
            return Fail("", std::string("not valid JSON: ") + e.what());
        }
        if (!doc.is_object()) return Fail("", "the file must hold a JSON object");
        if (auto k = OnlyKeys(doc, "", { "format", "version", "name", "scope", "notice", "files", "firstLine", "comment", "brackets",
                                         "autoClose", "indent", "wordChars", "symbols", "foldMarkers", "lineLocal", "patterns" }); !k)
            return std::unexpected(k.error());
        if (const auto f = doc.find("format"); f == doc.end() || !f->is_string() || f->get<std::string>() != "arcsyntax")
            return Fail("", "\"format\" must be \"arcsyntax\"");
        if (const auto v = doc.find("version"); v == doc.end() || !v->is_number_integer() || v->get<int>() != kArcSyntaxVersion)
            return Fail("", "unsupported \"version\" (this editor reads " + std::to_string(kArcSyntaxVersion) + ")");

        GrammarDesc g;
        auto name = String(doc, "name", "", true);           if (!name) return std::unexpected(name.error());
        auto scope = String(doc, "scope", "", true);         if (!scope) return std::unexpected(scope.error());
        if (!IsValidScopeName(*scope)) return Fail("", "\"scope\" \"" + *scope + "\" is not a scope name");
        auto notice = String(doc, "notice", "", false);      if (!notice) return std::unexpected(notice.error());
        auto firstLine = String(doc, "firstLine", "", false); if (!firstLine) return std::unexpected(firstLine.error());
        g.name = std::move(*name);
        g.scope = std::move(*scope);
        g.notice = std::move(*notice);
        g.firstLine = std::move(*firstLine);

        if (const auto f = doc.find("files"); f != doc.end())
        {
            if (!f->is_array()) return Fail("", "\"files\" must be an array of strings");
            for (const Json& e : *f)
            {
                if (!e.is_string() || e.get<std::string>().empty()) return Fail("", "\"files\" must be an array of non-empty strings");
                std::string s = e.get<std::string>();
                std::transform(s.begin(), s.end(), s.begin(), [](unsigned char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c)); });
                g.files.push_back(std::move(s));
            }
        }
        if (const auto c = doc.find("comment"); c != doc.end())
        {
            if (!c->is_object()) return Fail("", "\"comment\" must be an object");
            if (auto k = OnlyKeys(*c, "comment", { "line", "block" }); !k) return std::unexpected(k.error());
            auto line = String(*c, "line", "comment", false); if (!line) return std::unexpected(line.error());
            g.lineComment = std::move(*line);
            if (const auto b = c->find("block"); b != c->end())
            {
                if (!b->is_array() || b->size() != 2 || !(*b)[0].is_string() || !(*b)[1].is_string() ||
                    (*b)[0].get<std::string>().empty() || (*b)[1].get<std::string>().empty())
                    return Fail("comment", "\"block\" must be [open, close]");
                g.blockCommentBegin = (*b)[0].get<std::string>();
                g.blockCommentEnd = (*b)[1].get<std::string>();
            }
        }
        auto brackets = Pairs(doc, "brackets", true);   if (!brackets) return std::unexpected(brackets.error());
        for (const auto& [o, c] : *brackets) g.brackets.emplace_back(o[0], c[0]);
        auto autoClose = Pairs(doc, "autoClose", false); if (!autoClose) return std::unexpected(autoClose.error());
        g.autoClose = std::move(*autoClose);
        if (const auto in = doc.find("indent"); in != doc.end())
        {
            if (!in->is_object()) return Fail("", "\"indent\" must be an object");
            if (auto k = OnlyKeys(*in, "indent", { "increase", "decrease" }); !k) return std::unexpected(k.error());
            auto inc = String(*in, "increase", "indent", false); if (!inc) return std::unexpected(inc.error());
            auto dec = String(*in, "decrease", "indent", false); if (!dec) return std::unexpected(dec.error());
            g.indentIncrease = std::move(*inc);
            g.indentDecrease = std::move(*dec);
        }
        if (doc.contains("wordChars"))
        {
            auto w = String(doc, "wordChars", "", true); if (!w) return std::unexpected(w.error());
            g.wordChars = std::move(*w);
        }
        if (const auto s = doc.find("symbols"); s != doc.end())
        {
            if (!s->is_array()) return Fail("symbols", "\"symbols\" must be an array");
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s->size(); ++i)
            {
                const Json& e = (*s)[i];
                const std::string sp = "symbols[" + std::to_string(i) + "]";
                if (!e.is_object()) return Fail(sp, "a symbols entry must be an object");
                if (auto k = OnlyKeys(e, sp, { "match", "name", "kind" }); !k) return std::unexpected(k.error());
                auto m = String(e, "match", sp, true); if (!m) return std::unexpected(m.error());
                auto kind = String(e, "kind", sp, true); if (!kind) return std::unexpected(kind.error());
                const auto n = e.find("name");
                if (n == e.end() || !n->is_number_integer() || n->get<long long>() < 0)
                    return Fail(sp, "symbols \"name\" must be a capture group number >= 0");
                g.symbols.push_back({ std::move(*m), static_cast<std::uint32_t>(n->get<long long>()), std::move(*kind) });
            }
        }
        if (const auto fm = doc.find("foldMarkers"); fm != doc.end())
        {
            if (!fm->is_object()) return Fail("foldMarkers", "\"foldMarkers\" must be an object");
            if (auto k = OnlyKeys(*fm, "foldMarkers", { "begin", "end" }); !k) return std::unexpected(k.error());
            auto b = String(*fm, "begin", "foldMarkers", true); if (!b) return std::unexpected(b.error());
            auto e = String(*fm, "end", "foldMarkers", true);   if (!e) return std::unexpected(e.error());
            g.foldBegin = std::move(*b);
            g.foldEnd = std::move(*e);
        }
        if (const auto ll = doc.find("lineLocal"); ll != doc.end())
        {
            if (!ll->is_boolean()) return Fail("", "\"lineLocal\" must be true or false");
            g.lineLocal = ll->get<bool>();
        }
        const auto p = doc.find("patterns");
        if (p == doc.end() || !p->is_array()) return Fail("", "missing \"patterns\" array");
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < p->size(); ++i)
        {
            auto rule = ParseRule((*p)[i], "patterns[" + std::to_string(i) + "]", 1);
            if (!rule) return std::unexpected(rule.error());
            g.patterns.push_back(std::move(*rule));
        }
        return g;
    }
}
```

(The `brackets` and `symbols` failures name their key in the message; every rule-level failure carries the rule path in `rulePath`.)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/Grammar.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/Grammar.cpp` (compile/link types and functions appended)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/GrammarCompileTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Regex::Compile`, `RegexOptions::Ucp` (TE3-2); `ScopeTable`, `RunFlagsForScopeName` (TE3-4); `GrammarDesc`, `ParseGrammar` (TE3-7)
- Produces (namespace `Arcane::Text`):
  - `struct ScopeRef { ScopeId id; std::uint8_t flags; }`
  - `struct CompiledRule { RuleDesc::Kind kind; std::string path; std::shared_ptr<const Regex> match, end, escape; ScopeRef scope, contentScope; std::uint8_t contentFlags; std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t, ScopeRef>> captures; std::unordered_map<std::string, ScopeRef, TransparentStringHash, std::equal_to<>> keywords; std::vector<std::uint32_t> children; std::int32_t embed; }`
  - `struct CompiledSymbol { std::shared_ptr<const Regex> regex; std::uint32_t nameGroup; std::string kind; }`
  - `class GrammarRules` (immutable compile result): `Name()`, `Desc()`, `RootScope()`, `LineLocal()`, `RootRules()`, `Rule(i)`, `RuleCount()`, `EmbedNames()`, `FirstLine()`, `FoldBegin()`, `FoldEnd()`, `IndentIncrease()`, `IndentDecrease()`, `WordClass()`, `Symbols()`, `Brackets()`
  - `class CompiledGrammar` (binding name): `grammarVersion()`, `Rules()`, `RulesPtr()`, `Embed(std::int32_t)`, `Embeds()`, `Name()`, `LineLocal()`
  - `std::expected<std::shared_ptr<const GrammarRules>, GrammarError> CompileGrammarRules(GrammarDesc desc, ScopeTable& scopes)`
  - `GrammarSnapshot LinkGrammar(std::shared_ptr<const GrammarRules> rules, std::vector<GrammarSnapshot> embeds, std::uint64_t version)`
  - `GrammarSnapshot MakePlainTextGrammar(ScopeTable& scopes, std::uint64_t version)`

`grammarVersion()` keeps the skeleton's spelling ("`GrammarSnapshot` ... carries `grammarVersion()`"). Compiled grammars are split in two so a reload is cheap and safe: `GrammarRules` holds every compiled `Regex` and never changes; a `CompiledGrammar` is one linking of those rules to the current snapshots of the grammars it embeds, stamped with a version. Relinking (an embedded grammar changed) creates a new `CompiledGrammar` sharing the old `GrammarRules`.

```cpp
          {"begin":"/\\*","end":"\\*/","scope":"comment.block.t"}]})"), scopes);

    ScopeTable scopes;
    const auto inner = CompileGrammarRules(Desc(R"({"format":"arcsyntax","version":1,"name":"Inner","scope":"source.inner","patterns":[]})"), scopes);
    const auto outer = CompileGrammarRules(Desc(R"({"format":"arcsyntax","version":1,"name":"Outer","scope":"text.outer",
        "patterns":[{"begin":"<<","end":">>","embed":"Inner"},{"begin":"\\[","end":"\\]","embed":"Inner"},{"begin":"\\{","end":"\\}","embed":"Missing"}]})"), scopes);
    REQUIRE(inner.has_value());
    REQUIRE(outer.has_value());
    CHECK((*outer)->EmbedNames() == std::vector<std::string>{ "Inner", "Missing" });
    CHECK((*outer)->Rule((*outer)->RootRules()[1]).embed == 0);
    const GrammarSnapshot innerSnap = LinkGrammar(*inner, {}, 7);
    const GrammarSnapshot outerSnap = LinkGrammar(*outer, { innerSnap, nullptr }, 8);
    CHECK(innerSnap->grammarVersion() == 7u);
    CHECK(outerSnap->grammarVersion() == 8u);
    CHECK(outerSnap->Embed(0) == innerSnap);
    CHECK(outerSnap->Embed(1) == nullptr);
    const GrammarSnapshot relinked = LinkGrammar(outerSnap->RulesPtr(), { innerSnap, nullptr }, 9);
    CHECK(relinked->RulesPtr() == outerSnap->RulesPtr());   // regexes are compiled once
    CHECK(relinked->grammarVersion() == 9u);
}
```

`Grammar.hpp` -- add includes `"TextEditor/Syntax/Regex.hpp"`, `"TextEditor/Syntax/Scope.hpp"`, `<memory>`, `<unordered_map>`, and append inside the namespace:

```cpp
    struct ScopeRef
    {
        ScopeId id = 0;
        std::uint8_t flags = kRunNone;   // RunFlagsForScopeName of the scope's name
    };

    struct CompiledRule
    {
        RuleDesc::Kind kind = RuleDesc::Kind::Match;
        std::string path;
        std::shared_ptr<const Regex> match;     // Match: the token; Region: begin
        std::shared_ptr<const Regex> end;       // Region
        std::shared_ptr<const Regex> escape;    // Region, optional
        ScopeRef scope;                         // Match token / Region delimiters (id 0 = none: the surrounding content scope)
        ScopeRef contentScope;                  // Region content (id 0 = use `scope`)
        std::uint8_t contentFlags = kRunNone;   // flags of the region's content: contentScope's, else scope's
        std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t, ScopeRef>> captures;
        std::unordered_map<std::string, ScopeRef, TransparentStringHash, std::equal_to<>> keywords;
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> children;    // Region: nested rule indices
        std::int32_t embed = -1;                // Region: index into EmbedNames() / CompiledGrammar::Embed()
    };

    struct CompiledSymbol
    {
        std::shared_ptr<const Regex> regex;
        std::uint32_t nameGroup = 0;
        std::string kind;
    };

    // What CompileGrammarRules builds; frozen into a GrammarRules.
    struct GrammarRulesData
    {
        GrammarDesc desc;
        ScopeId rootScope = 0;
        std::vector<CompiledRule> rules;
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> root;
        std::vector<std::string> embedNames;
        std::shared_ptr<const Regex> firstLine, foldBegin, foldEnd, indentIncrease, indentDecrease, wordClass;
        std::vector<CompiledSymbol> symbols;
    };

    // Immutable after CompileGrammarRules; shared read-only by every thread and
    // every relink.
    class GrammarRules
    {
    public:
        explicit GrammarRules(GrammarRulesData data) : m(std::move(data)) {}

        [[nodiscard]] const std::string& Name() const noexcept { return m.desc.name; }
        [[nodiscard]] const GrammarDesc& Desc() const noexcept { return m.desc; }
        [[nodiscard]] ScopeId RootScope() const noexcept { return m.rootScope; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool LineLocal() const noexcept { return m.desc.lineLocal; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::vector<std::uint32_t>& RootRules() const noexcept { return m.root; }
        [[nodiscard]] const CompiledRule& Rule(std::uint32_t index) const { return m.rules[index]; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t RuleCount() const noexcept { return m.rules.size(); }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::vector<std::string>& EmbedNames() const noexcept { return m.embedNames; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::shared_ptr<const Regex>& FirstLine() const noexcept { return m.firstLine; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::shared_ptr<const Regex>& FoldBegin() const noexcept { return m.foldBegin; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::shared_ptr<const Regex>& FoldEnd() const noexcept { return m.foldEnd; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::shared_ptr<const Regex>& IndentIncrease() const noexcept { return m.indentIncrease; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::shared_ptr<const Regex>& IndentDecrease() const noexcept { return m.indentDecrease; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::shared_ptr<const Regex>& WordClass() const noexcept { return m.wordClass; }   // "[" + wordChars + "]"
        [[nodiscard]] const std::vector<CompiledSymbol>& Symbols() const noexcept { return m.symbols; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::vector<std::pair<char, char>>& Brackets() const noexcept { return m.desc.brackets; }

    private:
        GrammarRulesData m;
    };

    // One linking of a GrammarRules to the snapshots of the grammars it embeds
    // (spec s4.1): immutable, refcounted, versioned. Holding a snapshot keeps
    // its rules, its regexes and its embedded grammars alive -- a reload never
    // pulls compiled patterns out from under the highlight worker.
    class CompiledGrammar
    {
    public:
        CompiledGrammar(std::shared_ptr<const GrammarRules> rules, std::vector<GrammarSnapshot> embeds, std::uint64_t version)
            : m_rules(std::move(rules)), m_embeds(std::move(embeds)), m_version(version) {}

        [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t grammarVersion() const noexcept { return m_version; }   // skeleton spelling
        [[nodiscard]] const GrammarRules& Rules() const noexcept { return *m_rules; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::shared_ptr<const GrammarRules>& RulesPtr() const noexcept { return m_rules; }
        [[nodiscard]] const GrammarSnapshot& Embed(std::int32_t index) const { return m_embeds[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)]; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::vector<GrammarSnapshot>& Embeds() const noexcept { return m_embeds; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::string& Name() const noexcept { return m_rules->Name(); }
        [[nodiscard]] bool LineLocal() const noexcept { return m_rules->LineLocal(); }

    private:
        std::shared_ptr<const GrammarRules> m_rules;
        std::vector<GrammarSnapshot> m_embeds;   // parallel to Rules().EmbedNames(); nullptr = unresolved (content draws in contentScope)
        std::uint64_t m_version = 0;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<std::shared_ptr<const GrammarRules>, GrammarError> CompileGrammarRules(GrammarDesc desc, ScopeTable& scopes);
    // `embeds` must be parallel to rules->EmbedNames().
    [[nodiscard]] GrammarSnapshot LinkGrammar(std::shared_ptr<const GrammarRules> rules, std::vector<GrammarSnapshot> embeds,
                                              std::uint64_t version);
    // The built-in fallback (spec s4.1): "Plain Text", text.plain, line-local, no rules.
    [[nodiscard]] GrammarSnapshot MakePlainTextGrammar(ScopeTable& scopes, std::uint64_t version);
```

`Grammar.cpp` -- append inside the namespace:

```cpp
    namespace
    {
        struct Compiler
        {
            ScopeTable& scopes;
            GrammarRulesData& out;

            std::expected<std::shared_ptr<const Regex>, GrammarError> Re(const std::string& pattern, const std::string& path)
            {
                auto re = Regex::Compile(pattern, RegexOptions::Ucp);
                if (!re) return Fail(path, re.error().message + " (at offset " + std::to_string(re.error().offset) + ")");
                return *re;
            }

            ScopeRef Ref(const std::string& name)
            {
                if (name.empty()) return {};
                return ScopeRef{ scopes.Intern(name), RunFlagsForScopeName(name) };
            }

            std::int32_t EmbedIndex(const std::string& name)
            {
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < out.embedNames.size(); ++i)
                    if (out.embedNames[i] == name) return static_cast<std::int32_t>(i);
                out.embedNames.push_back(name);
                return static_cast<std::int32_t>(out.embedNames.size() - 1);
            }

            // Returns the new rule's index. Children are compiled after the
            // parent slot exists, so indices stay stable (`rules` may grow).
            std::expected<std::uint32_t, GrammarError> Rule(const RuleDesc& d)
            {
                const std::uint32_t index = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(out.rules.size());
                out.rules.emplace_back();
                CompiledRule r;
                r.kind = d.kind;
                r.path = d.path;
                r.scope = Ref(d.scope);
                if (d.kind == RuleDesc::Kind::Match)
                {
                    auto m = Re(d.match, d.path + ".match"); if (!m) return std::unexpected(m.error());
                    r.match = *m;
                    for (const auto& [group, scope] : d.captures)
                    {
                        if (group > r.match->CaptureCount())
                            return Fail(d.path + ".captures", "group " + std::to_string(group) + " but the pattern has " +
                                                              std::to_string(r.match->CaptureCount()) + " groups");
                        r.captures.emplace_back(group, Ref(scope));
                    }
                    for (const auto& [scope, words] : d.keywords)
                        for (const std::string& w : words) r.keywords.insert_or_assign(w, Ref(scope));
                }
                else
                {
                    auto b = Re(d.begin, d.path + ".begin"); if (!b) return std::unexpected(b.error());
                    auto e = Re(d.end, d.path + ".end");     if (!e) return std::unexpected(e.error());
                    r.match = *b;
                    r.end = *e;
                    if (!d.escape.empty())
                    {
                        auto x = Re(d.escape, d.path + ".escape"); if (!x) return std::unexpected(x.error());
                        r.escape = *x;
                    }
                    r.contentScope = Ref(d.contentScope);
                    r.contentFlags = r.contentScope.id ? r.contentScope.flags : r.scope.flags;
                    if (!d.embed.empty()) r.embed = EmbedIndex(d.embed);
                    for (const RuleDesc& c : d.patterns)
                    {
                        auto child = Rule(c); if (!child) return std::unexpected(child.error());
                        r.children.push_back(*child);
                    }
                }
                out.rules[index] = std::move(r);
                return index;
            }

            std::expected<std::shared_ptr<const Regex>, GrammarError> Optional(const std::string& pattern, const std::string& path)
            {
                if (pattern.empty()) return std::shared_ptr<const Regex>();
                return Re(pattern, path);
            }
        };
    }

    std::expected<std::shared_ptr<const GrammarRules>, GrammarError> CompileGrammarRules(GrammarDesc desc, ScopeTable& scopes)
    {
        GrammarRulesData data;
        Compiler c{ scopes, data };
        data.rootScope = scopes.Intern(desc.scope);
        for (const RuleDesc& d : desc.patterns)
        {
            auto index = c.Rule(d); if (!index) return std::unexpected(index.error());
            data.root.push_back(*index);
        }
        auto first = c.Optional(desc.firstLine, "firstLine");        if (!first) return std::unexpected(first.error());
        auto fb = c.Optional(desc.foldBegin, "foldMarkers.begin");   if (!fb) return std::unexpected(fb.error());
        auto fe = c.Optional(desc.foldEnd, "foldMarkers.end");       if (!fe) return std::unexpected(fe.error());
        auto ii = c.Optional(desc.indentIncrease, "indent.increase"); if (!ii) return std::unexpected(ii.error());
        auto id = c.Optional(desc.indentDecrease, "indent.decrease"); if (!id) return std::unexpected(id.error());
        auto wc = c.Re("[" + desc.wordChars + "]", "wordChars");     if (!wc) return std::unexpected(wc.error());
        data.firstLine = *first;
        data.foldBegin = *fb;
        data.foldEnd = *fe;
        data.indentIncrease = *ii;
        data.indentDecrease = *id;
        data.wordClass = *wc;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < desc.symbols.size(); ++i)
        {
            const SymbolDesc& s = desc.symbols[i];
            const std::string path = "symbols[" + std::to_string(i) + "]";
            auto re = c.Re(s.match, path + ".match"); if (!re) return std::unexpected(re.error());
            if (s.nameGroup > (*re)->CaptureCount())
                return Fail(path, "\"name\" is group " + std::to_string(s.nameGroup) + " but the pattern has " +
                                  std::to_string((*re)->CaptureCount()) + " groups");
            data.symbols.push_back({ *re, s.nameGroup, s.kind });
        }
        data.desc = std::move(desc);
        return std::make_shared<const GrammarRules>(std::move(data));
    }

    GrammarSnapshot LinkGrammar(std::shared_ptr<const GrammarRules> rules, std::vector<GrammarSnapshot> embeds, std::uint64_t version)
    {
        embeds.resize(rules->EmbedNames().size());
        return std::make_shared<const CompiledGrammar>(std::move(rules), std::move(embeds), version);
    }

    GrammarSnapshot MakePlainTextGrammar(ScopeTable& scopes, std::uint64_t version)
    {
        GrammarDesc d;
        d.name = "Plain Text";
        d.scope = "text.plain";
        d.lineLocal = true;
        auto rules = CompileGrammarRules(std::move(d), scopes);
        return LinkGrammar(std::move(*rules), {}, version);   // a rule-less desc always compiles
    }
```

(`Fail` is TE3-7's helper; this anonymous-namespace block is appended after TE3-7's, so it sees it.)

```cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Syntax/StateTable.hpp"

#include <thread>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

TEST_CASE("StateTable: equal stacks share an id; the empty stack is kRoot", "[text-tokenizer]")
{
    StateTable t;
    const auto* g = reinterpret_cast<const CompiledGrammar*>(0x1000);   // identity only; never dereferenced
    const auto* h = reinterpret_cast<const CompiledGrammar*>(0x2000);
    CHECK(t.Intern({}) == StateTable::kRoot);
    const std::vector<StateFrame> a{ { g, 3 } }, b{ { g, 3 }, { h, 1 } }, c{ { h, 3 } };
    const StateId ia = t.Intern(a), ib = t.Intern(b), ic = t.Intern(c);
    CHECK(ia != StateTable::kRoot);
    CHECK(ia != ib);
    CHECK(ia != ic);   // same rule index, different grammar
    CHECK(t.Intern(std::vector<StateFrame>{ { g, 3 } }) == ia);
    CHECK(t.Frames(ib) == b);
    CHECK(t.Frames(StateTable::kRoot).empty());
    CHECK(t.Size() == 4u);
    CHECK(kNoState != StateTable::kRoot);
}

TEST_CASE("StateTable: two threads interning the same stacks agree", "[text-tokenizer]")
{
    StateTable t;
    const auto* g = reinterpret_cast<const CompiledGrammar*>(0x1000);
    std::vector<StateId> x(300), y(300);
    auto work = [&](std::vector<StateId>& out) {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < out.size(); ++i)
        {
            std::vector<StateFrame> s(1 + i % 5, StateFrame{ g, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i % 7) });
            out[i] = t.Intern(s);
        }
    };
    std::thread a(work, std::ref(x)), b(work, std::ref(y));
    a.join(); b.join();
    CHECK(x == y);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/StateTable.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// The tokenizer's state at a line boundary is the stack of open regions
// (spec s4.3). Stacks are interned to small StateIds so a cache entry stores
// 4 bytes and "converged?" is an integer compare. One table per highlight
// session (HighlightCache), shared with that session's worker jobs, so it is
// thread-safe; ids are never reused.

#include "TextEditor/Syntax/SyntaxTypes.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <cstdint>
#include <shared_mutex>
#include <span>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct StateFrame
    {
        const CompiledGrammar* grammar = nullptr;   // the grammar owning `rule` (the root or an embedded one)
        std::uint32_t rule = 0;                     // an open Region rule of that grammar
        bool operator==(const StateFrame&) const = default;
    };

    ARC_CONSTANT("sentinel, not a tunable: a StateId no StateTable ever issues (worker 'no cached start' marker)")
    inline constexpr StateId kNoState = ~StateId{ 0 };

    class StateTable
    {
    public:
        ARC_CONSTANT("table contract: the empty stack, the grammar's root state, is always id 0")
        static constexpr StateId kRoot = 0;

        StateTable();
        [[nodiscard]] StateId Intern(std::span<const StateFrame> frames);
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<StateFrame> Frames(StateId id) const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t Size() const;

    private:
        struct Hash
        {
            std::size_t operator()(const std::vector<StateFrame>& s) const noexcept;
        };

        mutable std::shared_mutex m_mutex;
        std::vector<std::vector<StateFrame>> m_stacks;
        std::unordered_map<std::vector<StateFrame>, StateId, Hash> m_ids;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/StateTable.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/StateTable.hpp"

#include <functional>
#include <mutex>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    std::size_t StateTable::Hash::operator()(const std::vector<StateFrame>& s) const noexcept
    {
        std::size_t h = s.size();
        for (const StateFrame& f : s)
        {
            h ^= std::hash<const void*>{}(f.grammar) + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull + (h << 6) + (h >> 2);
            h ^= std::hash<std::uint32_t>{}(f.rule) + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull + (h << 6) + (h >> 2);
        }
        return h;
    }

    StateTable::StateTable()
    {
        m_stacks.emplace_back();
        m_ids.emplace(std::vector<StateFrame>{}, kRoot);
    }

    StateId StateTable::Intern(std::span<const StateFrame> frames)
    {
        if (frames.empty()) return kRoot;
        std::vector<StateFrame> key(frames.begin(), frames.end());
        {
            std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
            if (const auto it = m_ids.find(key); it != m_ids.end()) return it->second;
        }
        std::unique_lock lock(m_mutex);
        if (const auto it = m_ids.find(key); it != m_ids.end()) return it->second;
        const StateId id = static_cast<StateId>(m_stacks.size());
        m_stacks.push_back(key);
        m_ids.emplace(std::move(key), id);
        return id;
    }

    std::vector<StateFrame> StateTable::Frames(StateId id) const
    {
        std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
        return id < m_stacks.size() ? m_stacks[id] : std::vector<StateFrame>{};
    }

    std::size_t StateTable::Size() const
    {
        std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
        return m_stacks.size();
    }
}
```

(The two `0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull` literals are inside a function body, not a `constexpr`/`static const` declaration, so the constant scanner does not see them; they are the golden-ratio hash mixer.)

### Task TE3-10: Tokenizer -- TextMate earliest match, regions, captures, keywords, embed (spec s4.1, s4.3)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/Tokenizer.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/Tokenizer.cpp`
- Create: `ArcaneTests/src/Helpers/TextGrammarFixtures.hpp` (inline test grammars + run printer, reused by later syntax tests)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TokenizerTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `MatchScratch`, `MatchStatus`, `MatchFlags` (TE3-2); `ScopeTable` (TE3-4); `CompiledGrammar`, `CompiledRule`, `ScopeRef` (TE3-8); `StateTable`, `StateFrame` (TE3-9)
- Produces:
  - `class ISyntaxProblemSink { virtual void RegexLimitHit(const CompiledGrammar&, std::uint32_t ruleIndex, std::string_view which) = 0; }` (implementations are thread-safe)
  - `struct TokenizeOptions { std::uint32_t longLineMaxBytes; std::uint32_t lineBudgetUs; const std::function<std::uint64_t()>* clock; ISyntaxProblemSink* problems; }`
  - `std::uint64_t SteadyNowUs() noexcept`
  - `class Tokenizer { Tokenizer(const CompiledGrammar& root, StateTable&, MatchScratch&); LineTokens TokenizeLine(std::string_view line, StateId start, const TokenizeOptions& = {}); }`
  - test helpers `Arcane::Test::CompileTestGrammar(std::string_view json, ScopeTable&, std::uint64_t version = 1, std::vector<GrammarSnapshot> embeds = {})`, `Arcane::Test::DescribeRuns(const LineTokens&, const ScopeTable&)`

The matching rule (spec s4.3): at the current position, among the active candidates the **earliest** match wins, and a tie goes to the candidate listed first. The candidate order is fixed: the `end` of every enclosing **embed** region (outermost first -- an embedded language can never swallow the fence that closes it), then the top region's `end` (TextMate's "end wins ties over nested patterns"), then the nested patterns (or the embedded grammar's root rules) in file order, then the region's `escape` (so a nested pattern that colours an escape beats the plain escape at the same position). Each candidate's next match on the line is cached and reused while it lies at or after the current position; a pattern containing `\G` is always re-searched. `match` rules and `escape` never match empty (`PCRE2_NOTEMPTY`); `begin`/`end` may (lookahead delimiters), and a no-progress guard force-advances one code point after 16 consecutive empty steps.

Run scopes: plain text gets the top region's `contentScope` (else its `scope`; 0 at the root); a `match` token gets its `scope` (else the content scope), then each capture group paints its span, or a `keywords` hit replaces the whole token's scope; `begin`/`end` tokens get the region's `scope` (else the surrounding content scope). Each run's flags are the OR of every open region's content flags and the token's own scope flags. Adjacent runs with equal scope and flags merge.

```cpp
// Inline grammars for the syntax-engine tests, and a compact run printer:

    inline Arcane::Text::GrammarSnapshot CompileTestGrammar(std::string_view json, Arcane::Text::ScopeTable& scopes,
                                                            std::uint64_t version = 1,
                                                            std::vector<Arcane::Text::GrammarSnapshot> embeds = {})
    {
        auto desc = Arcane::Text::ParseGrammar(json);
        INFO((desc ? std::string() : desc.error().Text()));
        REQUIRE(desc.has_value());
        auto rules = Arcane::Text::CompileGrammarRules(std::move(*desc), scopes);
        INFO((rules ? std::string() : rules.error().Text()));
        REQUIRE(rules.has_value());
        return Arcane::Text::LinkGrammar(std::move(*rules), std::move(embeds), version);
    }

    inline std::string DescribeRuns(const Arcane::Text::LineTokens& t, const Arcane::Text::ScopeTable& scopes)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (const Arcane::Text::TokenRun& r : t.runs)
        {
            if (!out.empty()) out += ' ';
            out += std::to_string(r.byteStart) + ':' + scopes.Name(r.scope);

    }
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/Tokenizer.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// The TextMate-style tokenizer (spec s4.3). One instance per thread per
// highlight session: it owns reusable scratch vectors and borrows that
// thread's MatchScratch; the grammar and the StateTable are shared.

#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Grammar.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Regex.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/StateTable.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/SyntaxTypes.hpp"

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <span>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    // Regex limit reports (spec s4.2). Called from the UI thread and the
    // worker, so implementations must be thread-safe.
    class ISyntaxProblemSink
    {
    public:
        virtual ~ISyntaxProblemSink() = default;
        // `which` is "match", "begin", "end" or "escape".
        virtual void RegexLimitHit(const CompiledGrammar& grammar, std::uint32_t ruleIndex, std::string_view which) = 0;
    };

    struct TokenizeOptions
    {
        std::uint32_t longLineMaxBytes = 0;                       // 0 = no cap (s3.5)
        std::uint32_t lineBudgetUs = 0;                           // 0 = no budget (s4.3)
        const std::function<std::uint64_t()>* clock = nullptr;    // microseconds; nullptr = SteadyNowUs
        ISyntaxProblemSink* problems = nullptr;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t SteadyNowUs() noexcept;

    class Tokenizer
    {
    public:
        Tokenizer(const CompiledGrammar& root, StateTable& states, MatchScratch& scratch);

        // Tokenizes one line (no '\n') starting in `start`.
        [[nodiscard]] LineTokens TokenizeLine(std::string_view line, StateId start, const TokenizeOptions& options = {});

    private:
        struct Candidate
        {
            enum class Kind : std::uint8_t { Rule, End, BoundaryEnd, Escape };
            Kind kind = Kind::Rule;
            const CompiledGrammar* grammar = nullptr;
            std::uint32_t rule = 0;
            std::uint32_t frame = 0;   // End / BoundaryEnd / Escape: the stack index of the region
        };

        struct Slot
        {
            bool known = false;
            bool none = false;
            std::size_t start = 0;
            std::size_t end = 0;
            std::vector<std::size_t> groups;   // 2 per group slot; kUnsetGroup when a group did not participate
        };

        struct Segment
        {
            std::size_t begin = 0;
            std::size_t end = 0;
            ScopeRef scope;
        };

        // Tokenizes `subject` from `pos` in `stack`; returns where it stopped
        // (subject.size() when it reached the end).
        std::size_t Run(std::string_view subject, std::size_t pos, std::vector<StateFrame>& stack, LineTokens& out,
                        const TokenizeOptions& options);
        void BuildCandidates(const std::vector<StateFrame>& stack);
        [[nodiscard]] const CompiledRule& RuleOf(const StateFrame& f) const;
        [[nodiscard]] const CompiledRule& RuleOf(const Candidate& c) const;
        [[nodiscard]] const Regex& RegexOf(const Candidate& c) const;
        [[nodiscard]] static MatchFlags FlagsOf(const Candidate& c, const CompiledRule& r) noexcept;
        [[nodiscard]] ScopeRef ContentScope(std::span<const StateFrame> stack) const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint8_t StackFlags(std::span<const StateFrame> stack) const;
        void EmitMatch(LineTokens& out, std::string_view subject, const Slot& s, const CompiledRule& r, std::span<const StateFrame> stack);
        static void Emit(LineTokens& out, std::size_t begin, std::size_t end, ScopeId scope, std::uint8_t flags);
        [[nodiscard]] static std::size_t Utf8Step(std::string_view s, std::size_t pos) noexcept;

        const CompiledGrammar& m_root;
        StateTable& m_states;
        MatchScratch& m_scratch;
        std::vector<Candidate> m_candidates;
        std::vector<Slot> m_slots;
        Slot m_winner;
        std::vector<Segment> m_segments;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/Tokenizer.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Tokenizer.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <limits>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("loop guard, not a tunable: consecutive zero-width steps (empty begin/end delimiters) after which the tokenizer force-advances one code point")
        constexpr std::uint32_t kNoProgressLimit = 16;

        constexpr std::size_t kUnsetGroup = std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max();
    }

    std::uint64_t SteadyNowUs() noexcept
    {
        return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(
            std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count());
    }

    Tokenizer::Tokenizer(const CompiledGrammar& root, StateTable& states, MatchScratch& scratch)
        : m_root(root), m_states(states), m_scratch(scratch)
    {
    }

    LineTokens Tokenizer::TokenizeLine(std::string_view line, StateId start, const TokenizeOptions& options)
    {
        LineTokens out;
        std::vector<StateFrame> stack = m_states.Frames(start);
        Run(line, 0, stack, out, options);
        out.endState = m_states.Intern(stack);
        return out;
    }

    const CompiledRule& Tokenizer::RuleOf(const StateFrame& f) const { return f.grammar->Rules().Rule(f.rule); }
    const CompiledRule& Tokenizer::RuleOf(const Candidate& c) const { return c.grammar->Rules().Rule(c.rule); }

    const Regex& Tokenizer::RegexOf(const Candidate& c) const
    {
        const CompiledRule& r = RuleOf(c);
        switch (c.kind)
        {
            case Candidate::Kind::End:
            case Candidate::Kind::BoundaryEnd: return *r.end;
            case Candidate::Kind::Escape:      return *r.escape;
            case Candidate::Kind::Rule:        break;
        }
        return *r.match;   // a Match rule's token or a Region's begin
    }

    MatchFlags Tokenizer::FlagsOf(const Candidate& c, const CompiledRule& r) noexcept
    {
        if (c.kind == Candidate::Kind::Escape) return MatchFlags::NotEmpty;
        if (c.kind == Candidate::Kind::Rule && r.kind == RuleDesc::Kind::Match) return MatchFlags::NotEmpty;
        return MatchFlags::None;
    }

    ScopeRef Tokenizer::ContentScope(std::span<const StateFrame> stack) const
    {
        if (stack.empty()) return {};
        const CompiledRule& r = RuleOf(stack.back());
        return r.contentScope.id ? r.contentScope : r.scope;
    }

    std::uint8_t Tokenizer::StackFlags(std::span<const StateFrame> stack) const
    {
        std::uint8_t f = kRunNone;
        for (const StateFrame& s : stack) f |= RuleOf(s).contentFlags;
        return f;
    }

    void Tokenizer::BuildCandidates(const std::vector<StateFrame>& stack)
    {
        m_candidates.clear();
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 1 < stack.size(); ++i)
            if (RuleOf(stack[i]).embed >= 0)
                m_candidates.push_back({ Candidate::Kind::BoundaryEnd, stack[i].grammar, stack[i].rule, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i) });
        if (stack.empty())
        {
            for (const std::uint32_t r : m_root.Rules().RootRules()) m_candidates.push_back({ Candidate::Kind::Rule, &m_root, r, 0 });
        }
        else
        {
            const StateFrame top = stack.back();
            const std::uint32_t topIndex = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(stack.size() - 1);
            const CompiledRule& r = RuleOf(top);
            m_candidates.push_back({ Candidate::Kind::End, top.grammar, top.rule, topIndex });
            if (r.embed >= 0)
            {
                if (const GrammarSnapshot& target = top.grammar->Embed(r.embed))
                    for (const std::uint32_t x : target->Rules().RootRules())
                        m_candidates.push_back({ Candidate::Kind::Rule, target.get(), x, 0 });
            }
            else
            {
                for (const std::uint32_t x : r.children) m_candidates.push_back({ Candidate::Kind::Rule, top.grammar, x, 0 });
            }
            if (r.escape) m_candidates.push_back({ Candidate::Kind::Escape, top.grammar, top.rule, topIndex });
        }
        m_slots.assign(m_candidates.size(), Slot{});
    }

    void Tokenizer::Emit(LineTokens& out, std::size_t begin, std::size_t end, ScopeId scope, std::uint8_t flags)
    {
        if (begin >= end) return;
        if (!out.runs.empty() && out.runs.back().scope == scope && out.runs.back().flags == flags) return;
        out.runs.push_back({ static_cast<std::uint32_t>(begin), scope, flags });
    }

    void Tokenizer::EmitMatch(LineTokens& out, std::string_view subject, const Slot& s, const CompiledRule& r,
                              std::span<const StateFrame> stack)
    {
        const std::uint8_t base = StackFlags(stack);
        if (!r.keywords.empty())
            if (const auto it = r.keywords.find(subject.substr(s.start, s.end - s.start)); it != r.keywords.end())
            {
                Emit(out, s.start, s.end, it->second.id, base | it->second.flags);
                return;
            }
        const ScopeRef whole = r.scope.id ? r.scope : ContentScope(stack);
        if (r.captures.empty())
        {
            Emit(out, s.start, s.end, whole.id, base | whole.flags);
            return;
        }
        m_segments.assign(1, Segment{ s.start, s.end, whole });
        for (const auto& [group, ref] : r.captures)
        {
            if (2 * group + 1 >= s.groups.size()) continue;
            std::size_t gb = s.groups[2 * group], ge = s.groups[2 * group + 1];
            if (gb == kUnsetGroup) continue;
            gb = std::clamp(gb, s.start, s.end);
            ge = std::clamp(ge, s.start, s.end);
            if (gb >= ge) continue;
            std::vector<Segment> next;
            next.reserve(m_segments.size() + 2);
            for (const Segment& seg : m_segments)
            {
                if (seg.end <= gb || seg.begin >= ge) { next.push_back(seg); continue; }
                if (seg.begin < gb) next.push_back({ seg.begin, gb, seg.scope });
                if (seg.end > ge) next.push_back({ ge, seg.end, seg.scope });
            }
            next.push_back({ gb, ge, ref });
            std::sort(next.begin(), next.end(), [](const Segment& a, const Segment& b) { return a.begin < b.begin; });
            m_segments = std::move(next);
        }
        for (const Segment& seg : m_segments) Emit(out, seg.begin, seg.end, seg.scope.id, base | seg.scope.flags);
    }

    std::size_t Tokenizer::Utf8Step(std::string_view s, std::size_t pos) noexcept
    {
        const auto byte = [&](std::size_t i) { return static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]); };
        const unsigned char lead = byte(pos);
        std::size_t n = 1;
        if ((lead & 0xE0u) == 0xC0u) n = 2;
        else if ((lead & 0xF0u) == 0xE0u) n = 3;
        else if ((lead & 0xF8u) == 0xF0u) n = 4;
        if (pos + n > s.size()) return 1;
        for (std::size_t i = 1; i < n; ++i)
            if ((byte(pos + i) & 0xC0u) != 0x80u) return 1;   // an invalid byte is its own step (spec s3.5)
        return n;
    }

    std::size_t Tokenizer::Run(std::string_view subject, std::size_t pos, std::vector<StateFrame>& stack, LineTokens& out,
                               const TokenizeOptions& options)
    {
        (void)options;   // TE3-11: budget, limit reports
        BuildCandidates(stack);
        std::uint32_t noProgress = 0;
        for (;;)
        {
            std::size_t best = m_candidates.size();
            std::size_t bestStart = std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max();
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_candidates.size(); ++i)
            {
                Slot& s = m_slots[i];
                const Regex& re = RegexOf(m_candidates[i]);
                if (!s.known || re.UsesStartAnchor() || (!s.none && s.start < pos))
                {
                    s.known = true;
                    const MatchStatus status = m_scratch.Match(re, subject, pos, FlagsOf(m_candidates[i], RuleOf(m_candidates[i])));
                    if (status == MatchStatus::Match)
                    {
                        s.none = false;
                        m_scratch.Group(0, s.start, s.end);
                        const std::uint32_t slots = m_scratch.GroupSlots();
                        s.groups.assign(2 * static_cast<std::size_t>(slots), kUnsetGroup);
                        for (std::uint32_t g = 0; g < slots; ++g) m_scratch.Group(g, s.groups[2 * g], s.groups[2 * g + 1]);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        s.none = true;   // NoMatch, LimitHit (skipped for the rest of the line) or Error
                    }
                }
                if (!s.none && s.start < bestStart)
                {
                    best = i;
                    bestStart = s.start;
                }
            }

            if (best == m_candidates.size())
            {
                const ScopeRef c = ContentScope(stack);
                Emit(out, pos, subject.size(), c.id, StackFlags(stack));
                return subject.size();
            }

            const Candidate c = m_candidates[best];
            m_winner = m_slots[best];
            const ScopeRef content = ContentScope(stack);
            Emit(out, pos, m_winner.start, content.id, StackFlags(stack));
            const std::size_t before = pos;
            const CompiledRule& r = RuleOf(c);
            switch (c.kind)
            {
                case Candidate::Kind::Rule:
                    if (r.kind == RuleDesc::Kind::Match)
                    {
                        EmitMatch(out, subject, m_winner, r, stack);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        const ScopeRef delim = r.scope.id ? r.scope : content;
                        Emit(out, m_winner.start, m_winner.end, delim.id, StackFlags(stack) | delim.flags);
                        stack.push_back({ c.grammar, c.rule });
                        BuildCandidates(stack);
                    }
                    break;
                case Candidate::Kind::Escape:
                    Emit(out, m_winner.start, m_winner.end, content.id, StackFlags(stack));
                    break;
                case Candidate::Kind::End:
                case Candidate::Kind::BoundaryEnd:
                {
                    const std::size_t keep = c.kind == Candidate::Kind::End ? stack.size() - 1 : c.frame;
                    const std::span<const StateFrame> parent(stack.data(), keep);
                    const ScopeRef delim = r.scope.id ? r.scope : ContentScope(parent);
                    Emit(out, m_winner.start, m_winner.end, delim.id, StackFlags(parent) | delim.flags);
                    stack.resize(keep);
                    BuildCandidates(stack);
                    break;
                }
            }
            pos = m_winner.end;

            if (pos == before)
            {
                if (++noProgress > kNoProgressLimit)
                {
                    if (pos >= subject.size()) return subject.size();
                    const std::size_t step = Utf8Step(subject, pos);
                    const ScopeRef here = ContentScope(stack);
                    Emit(out, pos, pos + step, here.id, StackFlags(stack));
                    pos += step;
                    noProgress = 0;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                noProgress = 0;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

The `0xE0u`-style masks are expressions in a function body, not declarations, so the constant scanner does not flag them.

### Task TE3-11: Tokenizer modes -- long-line cap and root resync, line-local force-close, per-line budget, limit reports, fold markers (spec s3.5, s4.1, s4.2, s4.3, s4.6)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/Tokenizer.hpp` (`ResumeLine`, `Finish`, `FoldMarkerOf`, `OnLimitHit`, the disabled-candidate list and the zero-width counter as members that a partial line saves into `LineTokens::resume`; the free `CopyRowForTokenize`), `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/Tokenizer.cpp` (`TokenizeLine` and `Run` replaced; new functions)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TokenizerModesTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE3-10's `Tokenizer`; `Rope::LineStart`, `Rope::LineEnd`, `Rope::CopyTo` (skeleton)
- Produces: `void Tokenizer::ResumeLine(std::string_view line, LineTokens& tokens, const TokenizeOptions& = {})`; `void CopyRowForTokenize(const Rope& rope, std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t longLineMaxBytes, std::string& out)`; a partial line's `LineTokens::resume` (TE3-4's `LineResumeState`) is filled here and read back by `ResumeLine`

These are the four behaviours every mode (UI catch-up, worker, full re-tokenize, line-local) must share, so they live in the tokenizer itself and "incremental == full" holds by construction (spec s3.5, s11.2):
- **Long-line cap (s3.5):** a line longer than `longLineMaxBytes` is tokenized only up to the cap; one plain run (scope 0) starts at the cap; `capped` is set; the end state is the **root**, whatever was open -- the named exception to "no heuristic resync". `CopyRowForTokenize` copies at most `cap + 1` bytes of a row, so a 40 MB line costs a 64 KB copy and the result is identical (runs carry starts only).
- **Line-local (s4.1):** lines start at the root and any region still open at the end of the line is force-closed there (end state = root).
- **Per-line budget (s4.3):** after `lineBudgetUs` (checked every 16 steps, after at least one step) the line stops `partial` with `resumeAt`, `endState` = the region stack there, and `resume` = the rest of the tokenizer state there: the limit-disabled candidates and the zero-width step counter (plan rev 2 D-R3, finding 3.2). `ResumeLine` restores all three and continues, so the finished line is identical to an unbudgeted one. A rule the limit disabled stays disabled after a resume: a re-search from a later position could match where the unbudgeted line never looked, and would report the hit again. A run of empty steps cut by the budget still force-advances at the 17th step: resetting the counter would let a 16-step budget slice stop at the same position forever.
- **Regex limits (s4.2):** a candidate whose search hits the limit is skipped for the rest of that line (across region pushes/pops) and reported to `options.problems` with `"match"`/`"begin"`/`"end"`/`"escape"`; the line still completes.
- **Fold markers (s4.6):** `foldMarker` is `Begin` when the grammar's `foldMarkers.begin` matches the line, else `End` when `.end` does.

```cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Helpers/TextGrammarFixtures.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/StateTable.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Tokenizer.hpp"

#include <mutex>
#include <set>

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using Arcane::Test::CompileTestGrammar;
using Arcane::Test::DescribeRuns;
using Arcane::Test::kBlockyGrammar;

namespace
{
    struct RecordingSink final : ISyntaxProblemSink
    {
        std::mutex m;
        std::vector<std::string> hits;
        void RegexLimitHit(const CompiledGrammar& g, std::uint32_t rule, std::string_view which) override
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(m);
            hits.push_back(g.Name() + "#" + std::to_string(rule) + ":" + std::string(which));
        }
    };
}

TEST_CASE("Tokenizer modes: a line over the cap is cut there, drawn plain after it, and resyncs to the root", "[text-tokenizer]")
{
    ScopeTable scopes; StateTable states; MatchScratch scratch{ RegexLimits{} };
    const GrammarSnapshot g = CompileTestGrammar(kBlockyGrammar, scopes);
    Tokenizer t(*g, states, scratch);
    TokenizeOptions opt;
    opt.longLineMaxBytes = 8;
    // "/* open " fills the cap with an open comment; the next line must still start at the root.
    const LineTokens l = t.TokenizeLine("/* open comment that runs on", StateTable::kRoot, opt);
    CHECK(l.capped);
    CHECK(DescribeRuns(l, scopes) == "0:comment.block.blocky 8:");
    CHECK(l.endState == StateTable::kRoot);
    const LineTokens next = t.TokenizeLine("12", l.endState, opt);
    CHECK(DescribeRuns(next, scopes) == "0:constant.numeric.blocky");
    // At exactly the cap nothing is cut.
    const LineTokens exact = t.TokenizeLine("12345678", StateTable::kRoot, opt);
    CHECK_FALSE(exact.capped);
}

TEST_CASE("Tokenizer modes: CopyRowForTokenize copies cap+1 bytes; results match the full line", "[text-tokenizer]")
{
    ScopeTable scopes; StateTable states; MatchScratch scratch{ RegexLimits{} };
    const GrammarSnapshot g = CompileTestGrammar(kBlockyGrammar, scopes);
    Tokenizer t(*g, states, scratch);
    const std::string longLine = "if " + std::string(1000, 'x') + " 12";
    const Rope rope = Rope::FromUtf8("a\n" + longLine + "\nb");
    std::string copy;
    CopyRowForTokenize(rope, 1, 16, copy);
    CHECK(copy.size() == 17u);
    TokenizeOptions opt;
    opt.longLineMaxBytes = 16;
    CHECK(DescribeRuns(t.TokenizeLine(copy, StateTable::kRoot, opt), scopes) ==
          DescribeRuns(t.TokenizeLine(longLine, StateTable::kRoot, opt), scopes));
    CopyRowForTokenize(rope, 2, 16, copy);
    CHECK(copy == "b");
    CopyRowForTokenize(rope, 1, 0, copy);
    CHECK(copy == longLine);
}

TEST_CASE("Tokenizer modes: line-local grammars start at the root and force-close open regions", "[text-tokenizer]")
{
    ScopeTable scopes; StateTable states; MatchScratch scratch{ RegexLimits{} };
    const GrammarSnapshot g = CompileTestGrammar(R"({"format":"arcsyntax","version":1,"name":"Kv","scope":"source.kv","lineLocal":true,
        "patterns":[{"begin":"\"","end":"\"","scope":"string.quoted.kv"},{"match":"^[a-z]+(?==)","scope":"entity.name.key.kv"}]})", scopes);
    Tokenizer t(*g, states, scratch);
    const LineTokens a = t.TokenizeLine("title=\"unterminated", StateTable::kRoot);
    CHECK(DescribeRuns(a, scopes) == "0:entity.name.key.kv 5: 6:string.quoted.kv");
    CHECK(a.endState == StateTable::kRoot);
    // Even when handed a non-root start, a line-local line starts at the root.
    const LineTokens b = t.TokenizeLine("next=1", 12345);
    CHECK(DescribeRuns(b, scopes) == "0:entity.name.key.kv 4:");
}

TEST_CASE("Tokenizer modes: the per-line budget yields a partial line that resumes to the identical result", "[text-tokenizer]")
{
    ScopeTable scopes; StateTable states; MatchScratch scratch{ RegexLimits{} };
    const GrammarSnapshot g = CompileTestGrammar(kBlockyGrammar, scopes);
    Tokenizer t(*g, states, scratch);
    std::string line;
    for (int i = 0; i < 200; ++i) line += "if 12 \"s\" ";
    const LineTokens full = t.TokenizeLine(line, StateTable::kRoot);

    std::uint64_t now = 0;
    const std::function<std::uint64_t()> clock = [&now] { return now += 10; };   // every read advances 10 us
    TokenizeOptions opt;
    opt.lineBudgetUs = 200;
    opt.clock = &clock;
    LineTokens part = t.TokenizeLine(line, StateTable::kRoot, opt);
    REQUIRE(part.partial);
    CHECK(part.resumeAt > 0u);
    CHECK(part.resumeAt < line.size());
    int resumes = 0;
    while (part.partial && resumes < 1000)
    {
        t.ResumeLine(line, part, opt);
        ++resumes;
    }
    CHECK(resumes > 1);
    CHECK_FALSE(part.partial);
    CHECK(DescribeRuns(part, scopes) == DescribeRuns(full, scopes));
    CHECK(part.endState == full.endState);
}

TEST_CASE("Tokenizer modes: a catastrophic rule hits the match limit, is reported, skipped for the line, and the line completes", "[text-tokenizer]")
{
    ScopeTable scopes; StateTable states; MatchScratch scratch{ RegexLimits{ 5000, 0 } };
    const GrammarSnapshot g = CompileTestGrammar(R"({"format":"arcsyntax","version":1,"name":"Bad","scope":"source.bad",
        "patterns":[{"match":"(a+)+$","scope":"invalid.bad"},{"begin":"\"","end":"\"","scope":"string.quoted.bad"},
                    {"match":"[0-9]+","scope":"constant.numeric.bad"}]})", scopes);
    Tokenizer t(*g, states, scratch);
    RecordingSink sink;
    TokenizeOptions opt;
    opt.problems = &sink;
    // Two string regions open and close after the hit, so the root candidates are rebuilt twice: a disabled
    // rule must stay disabled across those rebuilds.
    const LineTokens l = t.TokenizeLine("12 \"x\" " + std::string(40, 'a') + "b \"y\" 34", StateTable::kRoot, opt);
    CHECK(DescribeRuns(l, scopes) == "0:constant.numeric.bad 2: 3:string.quoted.bad 6: 49:string.quoted.bad 52: 53:constant.numeric.bad");
    REQUIRE(sink.hits.size() == 1u);   // reported once for the line, not once per position or per rebuild
    CHECK(sink.hits[0] == "Bad#0:match");
}

TEST_CASE("Tokenizer modes: a limit-disabled rule stays disabled across a budget resume and is reported once", "[text-tokenizer]")
{
    ScopeTable scopes; StateTable states; MatchScratch scratch{ RegexLimits{ 5000, 0 } };
    const GrammarSnapshot g = CompileTestGrammar(R"({"format":"arcsyntax","version":1,"name":"Bad","scope":"source.bad",
        "patterns":[{"match":"(a+)+$","scope":"invalid.bad"},{"match":"[0-9]+","scope":"constant.numeric.bad"}]})", scopes);
    Tokenizer t(*g, states, scratch);
    // From byte 0 the catastrophic rule hits the limit on the 40 a's + 'b'. From any position past that block a
    // re-search MATCHES the trailing "aaa" -- so a resume that forgot the disabled rule would colour it.
    std::string line = std::string(40, 'a') + "b";
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; ++i) line += " 1";
    line += " aaa";

    RecordingSink fullSink;
    TokenizeOptions fullOpt;
    fullOpt.problems = &fullSink;
    const LineTokens full = t.TokenizeLine(line, StateTable::kRoot, fullOpt);
    CHECK(DescribeRuns(full, scopes).find("invalid.bad") == std::string::npos);
    CHECK(fullSink.hits.size() == 1u);

    std::uint64_t now = 0;
    const std::function<std::uint64_t()> clock = [&now] { return now += 10; };
    RecordingSink partSink;
    TokenizeOptions opt;
    opt.lineBudgetUs = 1;   // every 16th step stops the line
    opt.clock = &clock;
    opt.problems = &partSink;
    LineTokens part = t.TokenizeLine(line, StateTable::kRoot, opt);
    REQUIRE(part.partial);
    CHECK(part.resume.disabled.size() == 1u);
    int resumes = 0;
    while (part.partial && resumes < 1000)
    {
        t.ResumeLine(line, part, opt);
        ++resumes;
    }
    CHECK(resumes >= 1);
    CHECK_FALSE(part.partial);
    CHECK(DescribeRuns(part, scopes) == DescribeRuns(full, scopes));
    CHECK(part.endState == full.endState);
    CHECK(partSink.hits.size() == 1u);       // not re-reported on resume
    CHECK(part.resume.disabled.empty());     // a complete line carries no resume state
}

TEST_CASE("Tokenizer modes: a budget stop inside a run of empty steps resumes with the zero-width counter", "[text-tokenizer]")
{
    ScopeTable scopes; StateTable states; MatchScratch scratch{ RegexLimits{} };
    // At every 'x' the empty region opens and closes: 17 empty steps, then a force-advance of one code point.
    const GrammarSnapshot g = CompileTestGrammar(R"({"format":"arcsyntax","version":1,"name":"Loop","scope":"s.loop",
        "patterns":[{"begin":"(?=x)","end":"(?=x)","scope":"meta.loop"}]})", scopes);
    Tokenizer t(*g, states, scratch);
    const std::string line(64, 'x');
    const LineTokens full = t.TokenizeLine(line, StateTable::kRoot);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(full.partial);

    std::uint64_t now = 0;
    const std::function<std::uint64_t()> clock = [&now] { return now += 10; };
    TokenizeOptions opt;
    opt.lineBudgetUs = 1;   // stops after 16 steps -- one short of the force-advance
    opt.clock = &clock;
    LineTokens part = t.TokenizeLine(line, StateTable::kRoot, opt);
    REQUIRE(part.partial);
    CHECK(part.resumeAt == 0u);
    CHECK(part.resume.noProgress == 16u);
    int resumes = 0;
    while (part.partial && resumes < 10000)
    {
        t.ResumeLine(line, part, opt);
        ++resumes;
    }
    CHECK_FALSE(part.partial);   // with the counter reset on resume, the line would stop at byte 0 forever
    CHECK(DescribeRuns(part, scopes) == DescribeRuns(full, scopes));
    CHECK(part.endState == full.endState);
}

TEST_CASE("Tokenizer modes: fold markers are detected per line", "[text-tokenizer]")
{
    ScopeTable scopes; StateTable states; MatchScratch scratch{ RegexLimits{} };
    const GrammarSnapshot g = CompileTestGrammar(kBlockyGrammar, scopes);
    Tokenizer t(*g, states, scratch);
    CHECK(t.TokenizeLine("  // region Lighting", StateTable::kRoot).foldMarker == FoldMarker::Begin);
    CHECK(t.TokenizeLine("// endregion", StateTable::kRoot).foldMarker == FoldMarker::End);
    CHECK(t.TokenizeLine("x // region", StateTable::kRoot).foldMarker == FoldMarker::None);
}
```

```cpp
        constexpr std::uint32_t kBudgetCheckStride = 16;
```
