There is one command layer: TE1's `class Text::TextCommands` (never a namespace, never a `TextCommandContext`), constructed per command over a model's buffer and selections with an `EditContext`.

```cpp
namespace Arcane::Text {                                         // TE1 (Core)
// Rope: FromUtf8, Size, LineCount, LineStart, LineEnd, OffsetToPoint, PointToOffset, CopyTo (replaces out),
//       Substr, ByteAt, ForEachChunk, ToString;  struct RopeSnapshot { Rope rope; std::uint64_t version; };
enum class Bias : std::uint8_t { Left, Right };   struct Anchor { ByteOffset offset; Bias bias; };
class AnchorSet { using Id = std::uint32_t; Id Add(Anchor); void Remove(Id); bool Contains(Id) const; Anchor Get(Id) const;
                  void Set(Id, Anchor); std::size_t Size() const; void Clear(); template<class F> void ForEach(F&&) const; /* f(Id, Anchor) */ };
struct EditShift { ByteOffset begin, end, newLength; };           // pre-edit coordinates
struct EditOp { ByteRange range; std::string text; };            // a batch: sorted, disjoint, strictly increasing begins
enum class TransactionKind { Other, Typing, Deleting };
class EditObserver { virtual void OnBufferEdited(std::span<const EditShift>, std::uint64_t version) = 0; };
enum class Eol { LF, CRLF, CR };   // EolMap: EolMap(); explicit EolMap(Eol); Dominant(), StyleOf(row), IsMixed(); static Bytes(Eol)
class TextBuffer { TextBuffer(); explicit TextBuffer(Rope text, EolMap eols = {});   // TE1-8 (default argument: CANON A2)
                   Text(); Snapshot(); Eols(); Version(); Dirty(); MarkSaved(); BeginTransaction(const SelectionSet&, TransactionKind);
                   Edit(std::span<const EditOp>); EndTransaction(const SelectionSet&); bool Undo(SelectionSet&); bool Redo(SelectionSet&);
                   CanUndo(); CanRedo(); BreakUndoGroup(); EditsSince(version); EditLogCovers(version);
                   RegisterAnchors(AnchorSet&); UnregisterAnchors(AnchorSet&); AddObserver(EditObserver&); RemoveObserver(EditObserver&);
                   bool ConvertLineEndings(Eol, const SelectionSet&); void ReloadExternal(std::string, EolMap, const SelectionSet&);
                   bool LastReloadClearedHistory() const; void ClearHistory() /* TE1-10; TE2-15's reopen is its only caller */; };
struct Selection { std::uint32_t id; ByteOffset anchor, head; std::optional<std::uint32_t> goalColumn; bool Empty() const; };
class SelectionSet { All(); Size(); Primary() /* newest id */; PrimaryIndex(); AllocateId(); Add(anchor, head, goal) -> id;
                     SetSingle(ByteOffset anchor, ByteOffset head); Replace(std::vector<Selection>); ApplyEdits(std::span<const EditShift>); operator==; };
struct FoldRange { std::uint32_t headerRow, lastRow; };   enum class FoldSource { Indent, Marker, Manual };
class FoldModel { FoldModel(); static IndentColumns; static IsBlank; static IndentRegionAt(const Rope&, row, tabSize) -> std::optional<FoldRange>;
                  static IndentRegions(const Rope&, tabSize); bool Fold(const Rope&, FoldRange, FoldSource); bool Unfold(const Rope&, row);
                  bool UnfoldInnermost(const Rope&, row); void UnfoldAll(); bool IsFoldedAt(const Rope&, header) const;
                  std::vector<FoldRange> Folded(const Rope&) const; void OnEdits(std::span<const EditShift>); void Prune(const Rope&); Count(); };
class DisplayMap { DisplayMap(); SetFolds(std::span<const FoldRange>, std::uint32_t bufferRowCount); BufferRowCount; DisplayRowCount;
                   IsHidden; BufferRowToDisplay; DisplayRowToBuffer; VisibleAtOrBefore; FoldAt; HiddenRuns; };
class ColumnModel { ColumnOf(const Rope&, ByteOffset); OffsetAtColumn(const Rope&, row, column); };   class GraphemeColumnModel(tabSize);
struct WordChars { static WordChars FromSpec(std::string_view); };   struct CommentTokens { std::string line, blockBegin, blockEnd; };
struct EditContext { std::uint32_t tabSize = 4; bool insertSpaces = true; bool autoIndent = true; WordChars wordChars;
                     const DisplayMap* display = nullptr; const ColumnModel* columns = nullptr; std::uint32_t maxCursors;
                     std::function<bool(std::size_t)> confirmCursors; CommentTokens comment; };
class TextCommands {   // a CLASS (CANON A3); every TE4 command runs through one of these
```

Resolved by CANON (no open reconciliation notes remain for this chunk):
- **One command layer.** TE2's view runs every command through `Text::TextCommands(m_model->buffer, m_model->selections, MakeContext())`, where `MakeContext()` calls the provider installed with `SetEditContextProvider` (default `DefaultEditContext`, TE2-13). TE4-18 adds the model's indentation to `DefaultEditContext`; TE4-24 installs `TextDocument::MakeEditContext` as every view's provider; TE4-22 puts a filter before the view's `InsertText` / `Backspace` calls.
- **`TextModel` over a shared buffer** is TE2-11's shape and `ReopenWithEncoding` into the same buffer is TE2-15's (CANON B7); TE4-17 only adds the split.
- **The syntax service** reaches the document as `TextDocumentServices::syntax` (a pointer, null = no highlighting); TE4 code reads `m_services.syntax` and null-checks it.
- **The display map** is TE1's (default constructor + `SetFolds`); `TextModel::SyncDisplay()` keeps it current (TE2-11 body; TE4-12 replaces the body with `Text::SyncDisplay(folds, display, buffer.Text())`).

```cpp
TEST_CASE("TextDocument context: name, specificity, overlap", "[text-actions]")
{
    CHECK(std::string_view(ActionContextName(ActionContext::TextDocument)) == "Text document");
    CHECK(ContextSpecificity(ActionContext::TextDocument) == 2);
    CHECK(ContextSpecificity(ActionContext::TextDocument) > ContextSpecificity(ActionContext::Document));
    CHECK(ContextSpecificity(ActionContext::TextDocument) < ContextSpecificity(ActionContext::Text));
    CHECK(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::TextDocument, ActionContext::Global));
    CHECK(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::Global, ActionContext::TextDocument));
    CHECK(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::TextDocument, ActionContext::Document));
    CHECK(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::Document, ActionContext::TextDocument));
    CHECK(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::TextDocument, ActionContext::TextDocument));
    CHECK_FALSE(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::TextDocument, ActionContext::Text));       // a field's Enter/Escape never meets a text row
    CHECK_FALSE(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::TextDocument, ActionContext::Outliner));   // F2 rename vs F2 next bookmark
    CHECK_FALSE(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::TextDocument, ActionContext::Graph));
    CHECK_FALSE(ContextsOverlap(ActionContext::TextDocument, ActionContext::AssetBrowser));
    CHECK(UsesImGuiRoute(ActionContext::TextDocument));
}

TEST_CASE("Key chords: a bare [ is a labelled key; Ctrl+[ and Ctrl+Shift+[ parse and round-trip", "[text-actions]")
{
    const auto outdent = ParseKeyChord("Ctrl+[");
    REQUIRE(outdent.has_value());
    CHECK(outdent->ctrl);
    CHECK(outdent->type == KeyType::Labelled);
    CHECK(outdent->key == '[');
    CHECK(FormatKeyChord(*outdent) == "Ctrl+[");
    const auto fold = ParseKeyChord("Ctrl+Shift+[");
    REQUIRE(fold.has_value());
    CHECK(fold->shift);
    CHECK(fold->key == '[');
    CHECK(FormatKeyChord(*fold) == "Ctrl+Shift+[");
    REQUIRE(ParseKeyChord("[").has_value());
    CHECK(ParseKeyChord("[")->key == '[');
    CHECK(ParseKeyChord("[KeyW]")->type == KeyType::Physical);   // a physical name is still one
    CHECK_FALSE(ParseKeyChord("[KeyQQ]").has_value());
    CHECK(FormatKeyChord(*ParseKeyChord("Ctrl+]")) == "Ctrl+]");
    // The Shortcuts page's capture of Ctrl + the BracketLeft scancode (47) formats to text that parses back.
    const KeyChord physical{ true, false, false, false, KeyType::Physical, 47 };
    const KeyChord labelled = ToKeyType(physical, KeyType::Labelled);
    const auto reparsed = ParseKeyChord(FormatKeyChord(labelled));
    REQUIRE(reparsed.has_value());
    CHECK(*reparsed == labelled);
}

TEST_CASE("TextDocument rows fire while the text view takes text input; a panel row does not", "[text-actions]")
{
    Arcane::CVarRegistry reg;
    EditorActions actions(reg);
    actions.Register({ "t.lineStart", "Line Start", ActionContext::TextDocument, "Home" });
    actions.Register({ "t.next", "Next Asset", ActionContext::AssetBrowser, "Down" });
    ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
    ImGuiContext* ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(800, 600);
    io.IniFilename = nullptr;
    unsigned char* px = nullptr; int w = 0, h = 0;
    io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
    bool home = false, down = false;
    const auto frame = [&](bool typing, bool capture)
    {
        Arcane::InputSnapshot s;
        ActionFrameInput in; in.snap = &s; in.captureLive = capture; in.dt = 1.0 / 60.0;
        actions.BeginFrame(in);
        io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        io.WantTextInput = typing;   // what the text view's PlatformImeData.WantTextInput makes it
        home = actions.Pressed("t.lineStart");
        down = actions.Pressed("t.next");
        ImGui::Render();
    };
    frame(true, false);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_Home, true);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_DownArrow, true);
    frame(true, false);
    CHECK(home);          // the text document is the typist: Home is navigation, never text
    CHECK_FALSE(down);    // an Asset Browser row keeps the typing gate
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_Home, false);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_DownArrow, false);
    frame(false, false);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_DownArrow, true);
    frame(false, false);
    CHECK(down);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_DownArrow, false);
    frame(false, true);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_Home, true);
    frame(true, true);
    CHECK_FALSE(home);    // an Input Actions rebind capture owns the keyboard
    ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);
}
```

```cpp
    const char* ActionContextName(ActionContext c) noexcept
    {
        switch (c)
        {
        case ActionContext::Global:        return "Global";
        case ActionContext::Viewport:      return "Viewport";
        case ActionContext::Graph:         return "Graph";
        case ActionContext::AssetBrowser:  return "Asset Browser";
        case ActionContext::Outliner:      return "Outliner";
        case ActionContext::Inspector:     return "Inspector";
        case ActionContext::Text:          return "Text field";
        case ActionContext::Console:       return "Console";
        case ActionContext::InputDocument: return "Input Actions";
        case ActionContext::Document:      return "Document";
        case ActionContext::TextDocument:  return "Text document";
        }
        return "?";
    }

    int ContextSpecificity(ActionContext c) noexcept
    {
        switch (c)
        {
        case ActionContext::Global:       return 0;
        case ActionContext::Document:     return 1;
        case ActionContext::TextDocument: return 2;   // alongside the panels (text editor spec s7.2)
        case ActionContext::Text:         return 3;
        default:                          return 2;
        }
    }

    bool ContextsOverlap(ActionContext a, ActionContext b) noexcept
    {
        if (a == ActionContext::Text || b == ActionContext::Text) return a == b;   // fires only while typing; Global never does
        if (a == b || a == ActionContext::Global || b == ActionContext::Global) return true;
        const auto docHosted = [](ActionContext c)
        {
            return c == ActionContext::Graph || c == ActionContext::Inspector || c == ActionContext::InputDocument
                || c == ActionContext::TextDocument;
        };
        return (a == ActionContext::Document && docHosted(b)) || (b == ActionContext::Document && docHosted(a));
    }
```

`EditorActions.cpp:532-543` -- `Live` exempts TextDocument rows from the typing gate:

```cpp
    bool EditorActions::Live(const State& s, bool imguiRoute) const
    {
        if (m_listening) return false;
        const ActionContext c = s.desc.context;
        if (c == ActionContext::Text) return true;
        if (c == ActionContext::Global || c == ActionContext::Viewport)
            return EditorShortcutsLive(m_frame.playMode, m_frame.wantCaptureKeyboard, m_frame.captureLive,
                                       c == ActionContext::Viewport, m_frame.viewportActive);
        if (m_frame.captureLive) return false;
        // The text document IS the typist (TE4-1, text editor spec s7.2): its
        // view sets WantTextInput to receive characters, and its rows are
        // navigation/editing chords; the unmodified ones use non-printing keys
        // only (Home, Tab, F3), so they never steal a typed character. The
        // caller (DispatchTextActions) runs them only while the view has focus.
        if (c == ActionContext::TextDocument) return true;
        const bool typing = imguiRoute && ImGui::GetCurrentContext() ? ImGui::GetIO().WantTextInput : m_frame.wantTextInput;
        return s.chord.ctrl || s.chord.alt || s.chord.super || !typing;
    }
```

```cpp
    const std::map<std::string_view, std::string_view> spec = {
        { "text.wordLeft", "Ctrl+Left" }, { "text.wordRight", "Ctrl+Right" },
        { "text.selectWordLeft", "Ctrl+Shift+Left" }, { "text.selectWordRight", "Ctrl+Shift+Right" },
        { "text.lineStart", "Home" }, { "text.lineEnd", "End" },
        { "text.documentStart", "Ctrl+Home" }, { "text.documentEnd", "Ctrl+End" },
        { "text.pageUp", "PageUp" }, { "text.pageDown", "PageDown" },
        { "text.addNextMatch", "Ctrl+D" }, { "text.selectAllMatches", "Alt+F3" },
        { "text.splitSelectionIntoLines", "Ctrl+Shift+L" },
        { "text.addCursorAbove", "Ctrl+Alt+Up" }, { "text.addCursorBelow", "Ctrl+Alt+Down" },
        { "text.selectLine", "Ctrl+L" }, { "text.duplicateLine", "Ctrl+Shift+D" }, { "text.deleteLine", "Ctrl+Shift+K" },
        { "text.moveLineUp", "Alt+Up" }, { "text.moveLineDown", "Alt+Down" },
        { "text.indent", "Tab" }, { "text.outdent", "Shift+Tab" }, { "text.indentAlt", "Ctrl+]" }, { "text.outdentAlt", "Ctrl+[" },
        { "text.toggleLineComment", "Ctrl+/" }, { "text.toggleBlockComment", "Ctrl+Shift+/" }, { "text.joinLines", "Ctrl+J" },
        { "text.find", "Ctrl+F" }, { "text.replace", "Ctrl+H" }, { "text.findNext", "F3" }, { "text.findPrevious", "Shift+F3" },
        { "text.goToLine", "Ctrl+G" }, { "text.fold", "Ctrl+Shift+[" }, { "text.unfold", "Ctrl+Shift+]" },
        { "text.goToMatchingBracket", "Ctrl+M" },
        { "text.toggleBookmark", "Ctrl+F2" }, { "text.nextBookmark", "F2" }, { "text.previousBookmark", "Shift+F2" },
    };
    std::set<std::string_view> ids;
    std::size_t index = 0;
    for (const TextActionRow& row : kTextActionTable)
    {
        INFO(row.desc.id);
        CHECK(row.desc.id.starts_with("text."));
        CHECK(row.desc.context == ActionContext::TextDocument);
        CHECK_FALSE(row.desc.displayName.empty());
        CHECK(ids.insert(row.desc.id).second);
        CHECK(static_cast<std::size_t>(row.action) == index);            // the enum IS the table order
        CHECK(FindTextAction(row.action) == &row);
        const auto chord = ParseKeyChord(row.desc.defaultChord);
        REQUIRE(chord.has_value());
        CHECK_FALSE(ReservedChordReason(*chord).has_value());
        const bool unboundByDesign = row.desc.id == "text.convertLineEndings";
        CHECK(chord->Bound() == !unboundByDesign);
        if (const auto it = spec.find(row.desc.id); it != spec.end())
            CHECK(FormatKeyChord(*chord) == FormatKeyChord(*ParseKeyChord(it->second)));
        ++index;
    }
    CHECK(kTextActionTable.size() == static_cast<std::size_t>(TextAction::Count));
    for (const auto& [id, chord] : spec) { INFO(id); CHECK(ids.contains(id)); }
    for (const EditorActionDesc& d : kEditorActionTable) { INFO(d.id); CHECK_FALSE(ids.contains(d.id)); }
}

TEST_CASE("Text action table: registered with the editor's table, nothing in conflict, no undesigned same-context overlap", "[text-actions]")
{
    Arcane::CVarRegistry reg;
    EditorActions actions(reg);
    RegisterEditorActions(actions);
    for (const TextActionRow& row : kTextActionTable)
    {
        INFO(row.desc.id);
        CHECK_FALSE(reg.Find("editor.keys." + std::string(row.desc.id)).IsStale());
        CHECK(actions.ConflictsOf(row.desc.id).empty());
    }
    for (const TextActionRow& a : kTextActionTable)
        for (const TextActionRow& b : kTextActionTable)
        {
            if (a.desc.id >= b.desc.id) continue;
            const auto ca = ParseKeyChord(a.desc.defaultChord), cb = ParseKeyChord(b.desc.defaultChord);
            INFO(a.desc.id << " vs " << b.desc.id);
            CHECK_FALSE(SameKey(*ca, *cb));
        }
}

TEST_CASE("Text action table: Ctrl+D is Add Next Match in a focused text document and edit.duplicate elsewhere (spec s7 item 3)", "[text-actions]")
{
    Arcane::CVarRegistry reg;
    EditorActions actions(reg);
    RegisterEditorActions(actions);
    GuiRig gui;
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    bool addNext = false, duplicate = false, lineStart = false, frameAll = false;
    const auto frame = [&](std::initializer_list<std::uint32_t> sc, bool textFocused)
    {
        const Arcane::InputSnapshot s = Snap(sc);
        ActionFrameInput in; in.snap = &s; in.dt = 1.0 / 60.0;
        actions.BeginFrame(in);
        io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        if (textFocused) actions.MarkContextActive(ActionContext::TextDocument);   // what DispatchTextActions does (TE4-24)
        addNext = actions.Pressed("text.addNextMatch");
        duplicate = actions.Pressed("edit.duplicate");
        lineStart = actions.Pressed("text.lineStart");
        frameAll = actions.Pressed("editor.view.frameAll");
        ImGui::Render();
    };
    const auto ctrlD = [&](bool down)
    {
        io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiMod_Ctrl, down);
        io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_LeftCtrl, down);
        io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_D, down);
    };
    frame({}, true);
    ctrlD(true);
    frame({ Keys::kScanLCtrl, Keys::ScanLetter('D') }, true);
    CHECK(addNext);
    CHECK_FALSE(duplicate);        // shadowed by specificity, as graph.duplicate shadows it in the graph
    ctrlD(false);
    frame({}, false);
    frame({}, false);              // two frames: the context bit ages out (now | prev)
    ctrlD(true);
    frame({ Keys::kScanLCtrl, Keys::ScanLetter('D') }, false);
    CHECK(duplicate);              // no text document focused: Duplicate fires
    ctrlD(false);
    frame({}, true);
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_Home, true);
    frame({ Keys::kScanHome }, true);
    CHECK(lineStart);
    CHECK_FALSE(frameAll);         // Home in a text document never frames the scene
    io.AddKeyEvent(ImGuiKey_Home, false);
    CHECK(actions.ConflictsOf("text.addNextMatch").empty());   // both default: a designed shadow, not a conflict
    CHECK(actions.ConflictsOf("text.lineStart").empty());
}
```

```cpp
// TE4-3 (spec s8): the s8 list is the contract -- every editor.text.* name it
// lists is a registered Editor preference; the budgets and limits are Dev rows;
// the spec-fixed defaults hold; TE4's own six rows have their defaults.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include "Helpers/SettingsSweep.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"
#include <Arcane/Config/CVarRegistry.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>
#include <cstdint>

#include <string_view>
#include <type_traits>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane;

namespace
{
    std::int64_t AsInteger(const CVarValue& v)
    {
        switch (v.type)
        {
        case CVarType::Int32:  return v.AsInt32();
        case CVarType::UInt32: return static_cast<std::int64_t>(v.AsUInt32());
        case CVarType::Int64:  return v.AsInt64();
        case CVarType::UInt64: return static_cast<std::int64_t>(v.AsUInt64());
        default: FAIL("not an integer cvar"); return 0;
        }
    }

    std::string MissingOf(std::span<const std::string_view> fields, std::string_view prefix)
    {
        std::string missing;
        for (std::string_view field : fields)
        {
            const std::string name = std::string(prefix) + std::string(field);
            if (!CVarRegistry::Get().Describe(name)) missing += "  " + name + "\n";
        }
        return missing;
    }
}
```

```cpp
// TE4-4 (spec s4.2, s5.2): find queries compile once on the PCRE2 wrapper --
// plain text is escaped, case and whole word are flags, a pattern that can
// match a line break is routed to the multi-line path.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.hpp"
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    RegexLimits Limits() { RegexLimits l; l.matchLimit = 1000000; l.depthLimit = 100000; return l; }
    SearchQuery Q(std::string text, bool regex = false, bool caseSensitive = false, bool wholeWord = false)
    {
        SearchQuery q; q.text = std::move(text); q.regex = regex; q.caseSensitive = caseSensitive; q.wholeWord = wholeWord;
        return q;
    }
    bool Matches(const CompiledQuery& q, std::string_view subject, std::size_t* at = nullptr)
    {
        MatchScratch m(Limits());
        if (m.Match(*q.regex, subject, 0) != MatchStatus::Match) return false;
        std::size_t b = 0, e = 0;
        if (at && m.Group(0, b, e)) *at = b;
        return true;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch: a plain query is escaped, so metacharacters match themselves", "[text-search]")
{
    CHECK(TextSearch::EscapeLiteral("a.b*c(d)[e]{f}|g?h+i^j$k\\l") == "a\\.b\\*c\\(d\\)\\[e\\]\\{f\\}\\|g\\?h\\+i\\^j\\$k\\\\l");
    const CompiledQuery q = TextSearch::Compile(Q("a.b"), "");
    REQUIRE(q.Valid());
    CHECK(q.error.empty());
    CHECK(Matches(q, "xa.b"));
    CHECK_FALSE(Matches(q, "axb"));
    CHECK_FALSE(q.multiline);
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch: case sensitivity is a compile flag for plain and regex queries", "[text-search]")
{
    CHECK(Matches(TextSearch::Compile(Q("Foo"), ""), "foo"));
    const CompiledQuery cs = TextSearch::Compile(Q("Foo", false, true), "");
    CHECK_FALSE(Matches(cs, "foo"));
    CHECK(Matches(cs, "Foo"));
    CHECK(Matches(TextSearch::Compile(Q("F.O", true), ""), "fxo"));
    CHECK_FALSE(Matches(TextSearch::Compile(Q("F.O", true, true), ""), "fxo"));
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch: whole word uses the grammar's word class plus non-ASCII letters and digits", "[text-search]")
{
    const CompiledQuery q = TextSearch::Compile(Q("foo", false, true, true), "A-Za-z0-9_");
    REQUIRE(q.Valid());
    std::size_t at = 0;
    CHECK_FALSE(Matches(q, "foobar"));
    CHECK_FALSE(Matches(q, "_foo"));
    CHECK(Matches(q, "(foo)", &at));
    CHECK(at == 1);
    CHECK_FALSE(Matches(q, "\xC3\xA9" "foo"));                  // an e-acute before it is a word character
    CHECK(Matches(q, "foo-bar"));                                // '-' is not a word character here...
    const CompiledQuery dash = TextSearch::Compile(Q("foo", false, true, true), "A-Za-z0-9_\\-");
    CHECK_FALSE(Matches(dash, "foo-bar"));                       // ...but is in a grammar that says so
    const CompiledQuery alt = TextSearch::Compile(Q("a|b", true, true, true), "");
    CHECK_FALSE(Matches(alt, "ab"));                             // the boundary wraps the whole alternation
    CHECK(Matches(alt, "a b"));
    CHECK(TextSearch::WordClass("") == "(?:[A-Za-z0-9_]|[\\p{L}\\p{N}])");
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch: whole word compiles for every shipped wordChars shape, a '-' first or last included", "[text-search]")
{
    // rev-2 4.2: "[" + chars + "\p{L}\p{N}]" was an invalid range ("_-\p{L}") for the
    // INI / TOML / YAML / XML / shell grammars, whose wordChars end in '-'.
    for (std::string_view chars : { "A-Za-z0-9_-", "A-Za-z0-9_.-", "A-Za-z0-9_:.-", "-A-Za-z0-9_", "A-Za-z0-9_\\-" })
    {
        INFO(chars);
        const CompiledQuery q = TextSearch::Compile(Q("foo", false, true, true), chars);
        REQUIRE(q.Valid());
        CHECK(q.error.empty());
        CHECK_FALSE(Matches(q, "foo-bar"));                      // '-' is a word character in all of them
        CHECK_FALSE(Matches(q, "\xC3\xA9" "foo"));               // non-ASCII letters still are
        CHECK(Matches(q, "(foo)"));
    }
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch: a pattern that can match a line break takes the multi-line path", "[text-search]")
{
    for (std::string_view p : { "a\\nb", "\\r", "\\R", "x\\x0Ay", "\\x{a}", "\\x{000D}", "\\cJ", "\\012", "(?s)a.b", "(?is:a.b)", "a\nb" })
    {
        INFO(p);
        CHECK(TextSearch::PatternNeedsMultiline(p));
    }
    for (std::string_view p : { "a\\\\nb", "\\s+", "[^a]+", "(?i)a.b", "(?-s)a.b", "\\x41", "\\N", "abc" })
    {
        INFO(p);
        CHECK_FALSE(TextSearch::PatternNeedsMultiline(p));
    }
    CHECK(TextSearch::Compile(Q("a\\nb", true), "").multiline);
    CHECK_FALSE(TextSearch::Compile(Q("a\\nb"), "").multiline);   // plain text: a backslash and an n
    CHECK(TextSearch::Compile(Q("a\nb"), "").multiline);          // plain text with a real line break (a pasted selection)
    SearchQuery forced = Q("abc");
    forced.forceMultiline = true;                                 // vim \_s / \%^ (TE5c)
    CHECK(TextSearch::Compile(forced, "").multiline);
}

    q.scope = { { 10, 20 }, { 0, 5 }, { 4, 8 }, { 30, 30 }, { 20, 22 } };
    const CompiledQuery c = TextSearch::Compile(q, "");

}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// TextSearch (text editor spec s4.2, s3.2, s9; TE4-4..6): find queries
// compiled once on TE3's PCRE2 wrapper, run against an immutable RopeSnapshot.
// Two paths (spec s4.2 "Contiguous input"):
//  - line by line, for every pattern that cannot match a line break: each line
//    is copied into a reused scratch string; a line longer than the window is
//    matched in overlapping windows with lookbehind context;
//  - multi-line, when the pattern can match a line break (or vim forced it): a
//    materialized copy of the snapshot, refused above multilineMaxBytes.
// Matches are byte ranges of ONE snapshot and are never anchors (spec s3.2):
// callers recompute them for the next version.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Regex.hpp"

#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct SearchQuery
    {
        std::string text;
        bool regex = false;
        bool caseSensitive = false;
        bool wholeWord = false;
        bool forceMultiline = false;      // vim's \_x, \%^, \%$ (TE5c): always the multi-line path
        std::vector<ByteRange> scope;     // in-selection: a match must lie inside one range; empty = whole document
    };

    struct CompiledQuery
    {
        std::shared_ptr<const Regex> regex;   // null = an empty or an invalid query
        bool multiline = false;
        std::vector<ByteRange> scope;         // sorted, disjoint, non-empty
        std::string pattern;                  // the PCRE2 source that was compiled
        std::string error;                    // the compile error; "" for a valid or an empty query
        [[nodiscard]] bool Valid() const noexcept { return regex != nullptr; }
    };

    namespace TextSearch
    {
        // Every PCRE2 metacharacter backslash-escaped: plain text matches itself.
        [[nodiscard]] std::string EscapeLiteral(std::string_view text);
        // True when the pattern names a line break (\n \r \R \v, \x0a / \x{d}, \cJ, \012, a literal LF/CR)
        // or turns on dot-all ((?s)). \s and negated classes do NOT count: on the line path they simply
        // never see a line break, which is what a find-bar user expects.
        [[nodiscard]] bool PatternNeedsMultiline(std::string_view pcrePattern);
        // "(?:[<wordChars>]|[\p{L}\p{N}])": the grammar's word characters (vim's iskeyword, spec
        // s6.5/s11.3) plus every non-ASCII letter and digit. Two classes, not one: wordChars is a
        // class BODY that may begin or end with '-' (INI "A-Za-z0-9_-"), and a '-' next to \p{..}
        // inside one class is an invalid range. "[<wordChars>]" alone is valid whenever the grammar
        // compiled (TE3-8 compiles exactly that). Empty wordChars = "A-Za-z0-9_".
        [[nodiscard]] std::string WordClass(std::string_view wordChars);
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<ByteRange> NormalizeScope(std::vector<ByteRange> scope);
        [[nodiscard]] CompiledQuery Compile(const SearchQuery& query, std::string_view wordChars);
    }
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>

namespace Arcane::Text::TextSearch
{
    namespace
    {
        bool HexIsLineBreak(std::string_view digits)
        {
            if (digits.empty()) return false;
            unsigned value = 0;
            for (const char c : digits)
            {
                const int d = (c >= '0' && c <= '9') ? c - '0'
                            : (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') ? c - 'a' + 10
                            : (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') ? c - 'A' + 10 : -1;
                if (d < 0) return false;
                value = value * 16 + static_cast<unsigned>(d);
                if (value > 0x10FFFF) return false;
            }
            return value == 0x0A || value == 0x0D;
        }
    }

    std::string EscapeLiteral(std::string_view text)
    {
        std::string out;
        out.reserve(text.size() * 2);
        for (const char c : text)
        {
            switch (c)
            {
            case '\\': case '^': case '$': case '.': case '|': case '?': case '*': case '+':
            case '(': case ')': case '[': case ']': case '{': case '}':
                out.push_back('\\');
                break;
            default:
                break;
            }
            out.push_back(c);
        }
        return out;
    }

    bool PatternNeedsMultiline(std::string_view p)
    {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < p.size(); ++i)
        {
            const char c = p[i];
            if (c == '\n' || c == '\r') return true;                 // a literal line break in the pattern
            if (c == '\\' && i + 1 < p.size())
            {
                const char e = p[i + 1];
                if (e == 'n' || e == 'r' || e == 'R' || e == 'v') return true;   // \v: PCRE2 vertical space includes LF
                if (e == 'x')
                {
                    if (i + 2 < p.size() && p[i + 2] == '{')
                    {
                        const std::size_t close = p.find('}', i + 3);
                        if (close != std::string_view::npos && HexIsLineBreak(p.substr(i + 3, close - (i + 3)))) return true;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        std::size_t n = 0;
                        while (n < 2 && i + 2 + n < p.size() && std::isxdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(p[i + 2 + n]))) ++n;
                        if (HexIsLineBreak(p.substr(i + 2, n))) return true;
                    }
                }
                if (e == 'c' && i + 2 < p.size())
                {
                    const char k = p[i + 2];
                    if (k == 'J' || k == 'j' || k == 'M' || k == 'm') return true;
                }
                if (e == '0' && (p.substr(i + 1, 3) == "012" || p.substr(i + 1, 3) == "015")) return true;
                ++i;   // the escaped character is consumed
                continue;
            }
            if (c == '(' && i + 1 < p.size() && p[i + 1] == '?')
            {
                for (std::size_t j = i + 2; j < p.size(); ++j)
                {
                    const char f = p[j];
                    if (f == 's') return true;                       // (?s) / (?is: -- dot matches a line break
                    if (f == '-' || f == ')' || f == ':') break;     // (?-s) turns it off; the flag list ended
                    if (!std::isalpha(static_cast<unsigned char>(f)) && f != '^') break;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    std::string WordClass(std::string_view wordChars)
    {
        const std::string_view chars = wordChars.empty() ? std::string_view("A-Za-z0-9_") : wordChars;
        return "(?:[" + std::string(chars) + "]|[\\p{L}\\p{N}])";   // each branch one character: a valid lookbehind
    }

    std::vector<ByteRange> NormalizeScope(std::vector<ByteRange> scope)
    {
        std::erase_if(scope, [](const ByteRange& r) { return r.end <= r.begin; });
        std::sort(scope.begin(), scope.end(), [](const ByteRange& a, const ByteRange& b) { return a.begin < b.begin; });
        std::vector<ByteRange> out;
        for (const ByteRange& r : scope)
        {
            if (!out.empty() && r.begin <= out.back().end) out.back().end = std::max(out.back().end, r.end);
            else out.push_back(r);
        }
        return out;
    }

    CompiledQuery Compile(const SearchQuery& q, std::string_view wordChars)
    {
        CompiledQuery out;
        out.scope = NormalizeScope(q.scope);
        if (q.text.empty()) return out;                              // empty: invalid, no error to show
        std::string body = q.regex ? q.text : EscapeLiteral(q.text);
        out.multiline = q.forceMultiline || PatternNeedsMultiline(body);
        if (q.wholeWord)
        {
            const std::string k = WordClass(wordChars);
            body = "(?<!" + k + ")(?:" + body + ")(?!" + k + ")";
        }
        RegexOptions options = RegexOptions::None;
        if (!q.caseSensitive) options = options | RegexOptions::Caseless;
        if (out.multiline) options = options | RegexOptions::Multiline;   // PCRE2_MULTILINE on the materialized copy
        auto compiled = Regex::Compile(body, options);
        out.pattern = std::move(body);
        if (compiled) out.regex = std::move(*compiled);
        else out.error = compiled.error().message.empty() ? std::string("invalid pattern") : compiled.error().message;
        return out;
    }
}
```

### Task TE4-5: `TextSearch` line-by-line path and the pure `Search` API (spec s4.2, s3.2, s9)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.hpp` (append the search types and functions below inside `namespace Arcane::Text`; add `<atomic>`, `<cstdint>`, `<functional>`, `<optional>` to its includes)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.cpp` (append the implementation; add `<format>`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/Regex.hpp` / `.cpp` (TE3-2: three `MatchFlags` values, `MatchStatus::Partial` and `Regex::MaxLookbehind`)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextSearchLineTest.cpp`

**Lane (rev-2 X7):** this task runs in lane L4 and edits the shared `Regex.hpp` / `Regex.cpp` (L2 creates them, L3 consumes them). Rebase the L4 branch onto the current `feat/text-editor` immediately before this task, and do not edit those two files while another lane has an unmerged edit to them (the header's rebase-before-edit rule).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE4-4 `CompiledQuery`, `TextSearch::Compile`; TE1 `Rope::{LineStart, LineEnd, LineCount, OffsetToPoint, CopyTo, Size}`, `RopeSnapshot{rope, version}`; TE3-2 `MatchScratch` (`Match`, `Group`), `MatchStatus`, `MatchFlags` (incl. `NotEmptyAtStart`), `RegexLimits`, `Regex::CaptureCount()`; and the additions this task makes to TE3-2's wrapper: `MatchFlags::NotBol` / `MatchFlags::NotEol` (PCRE2_NOTBOL / PCRE2_NOTEOL, for windows that start or end mid-line), `MatchFlags::PartialHard` (PCRE2_PARTIAL_HARD, for every window but a line's last) with `MatchStatus::Partial` (returned only when `PartialHard` was passed; `Group(0, b, e)` is then the partial match's start and the subject's end), and `std::uint32_t Regex::MaxLookbehind() const` (`PCRE2_INFO_MAXLOOKBEHIND`: characters, not bytes).
- Produces: `enum class SearchStatus { Complete, EmptyQuery, InvalidPattern, MatchLimitHit, MaxMatchesHit, TooLargeForMultiline, Deferred, Cancelled }`; `struct SearchLimits { RegexLimits regex; std::uint64_t lineWindowBytes, multilineMaxBytes, maxMatches; }`; `struct SearchHit { ByteRange range; std::uint32_t row; std::string_view subject; ByteOffset subjectBase; const MatchScratch* match; std::uint32_t captureCount; }` (`captureCount` = the pattern's `Regex::CaptureCount()`, rev-2 4.5); `struct SearchResult { std::vector<ByteRange> matches; SearchStatus status; std::string message; std::uint64_t version; }`; `using SearchHitFn = std::function<bool(const SearchHit&)>`; `TextSearch::ForEachMatch(snapshot, query, window, limits, cancel, onHit, message) -> SearchStatus`; **`TextSearch::Search(const RopeSnapshot&, const CompiledQuery&, const SearchLimits&, const std::atomic<bool>* cancel = nullptr) -> SearchResult`** (spec s9, for spec 2's Find in Files); `TextSearch::SearchRows(snapshot, query, firstRow, lastRow, limits) -> SearchResult`; `TextSearch::FindNext(snapshot, query, from, forward, wrap, limits, SearchStatus*, cancel = nullptr, std::string* message = nullptr, bool notEmptyAtFrom = false) -> std::optional<ByteRange>` (`notEmptyAtFrom`: forward only, an empty match exactly at `from` is skipped -- the find bar's Next after an empty match and its Replace of an empty match, rev-2 4.6).

**Matching loop (rev-2 4.1, 4.6).** Every path uses pcre2demo's loop: after a match `[b, e)` the next search starts at `e`; when the match was empty it starts at `e` with `MatchFlags::NotEmptyAtStart`, so the same empty match never repeats but a longer match at the same offset still counts (`x*|a` on `"a"` is `""`, `"a"`, `""`, as in Perl and PCRE2's own demo). PCRE2 then either finds a non-empty match at `e` or moves on by itself, so there is no manual code-point step. A line longer than `lineWindowBytes` is matched in windows that each START where the search stands (the last match's end, or a partial match's start), preceded by `4 x MaxLookbehind()` bytes of read-only context; every window but the line's last runs with `PartialHard`, so a match that would run past the window's end comes back `Partial` and the next window starts AT it instead of losing or cutting it. Only a match longer than a whole window (its partial start is the window's own start) is re-run without `PartialHard` and reported cut at the window's end -- spec s5.2's documented known limit. So windowed == unwindowed for every match no longer than the window, which the property checks.

```cpp
// TE4-5 (spec s4.2, s9): the line-by-line path -- each line is the subject
// (^ $ exact), long lines in overlapping windows that report exactly what an
// unwindowed scan does, invalid UTF-8 searchable, limits reported not hung.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include <rapidcheck.h>
#include <rapidcheck/catch.h>
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.hpp"
#include <atomic>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using Pairs = std::vector<std::pair<ByteOffset, ByteOffset>>;

namespace
{
    SearchLimits Lim(std::uint64_t window = 0)
    {
        SearchLimits l;
        l.regex.matchLimit = 10000000;
        l.regex.depthLimit = 100000;
        l.lineWindowBytes = window;
        l.multilineMaxBytes = 1u << 20;
        return l;
    }
    RopeSnapshot Snap(std::string_view text, std::uint64_t version = 1) { return RopeSnapshot{ Rope::FromUtf8(text), version }; }
    CompiledQuery Q(std::string text, bool regex = false)
    {
        SearchQuery q; q.text = std::move(text); q.regex = regex; q.caseSensitive = true;
        return TextSearch::Compile(q, "");
    }
    Pairs Ranges(const SearchResult& r)
    {
        Pairs out;
        for (const ByteRange& m : r.matches) out.emplace_back(m.begin, m.end);
        return out;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch line path: plain matches across lines, in order, tagged with the snapshot's version", "[text-search]")
{
    const SearchResult r = TextSearch::Search(Snap("ab ab\nxab\n\nab", 7), Q("ab"), Lim());
    CHECK(r.status == SearchStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(r.version == 7);
    CHECK(Ranges(r) == Pairs{ { 0, 2 }, { 3, 5 }, { 7, 9 }, { 11, 13 } });
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch line path: ^ and $ are the line's own start and end", "[text-search]")
{
    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(Snap("ab\ncab\nab"), Q("^ab", true), Lim())) == Pairs{ { 0, 2 }, { 7, 9 } });
    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(Snap("ab\ncab\nab"), Q("ab$", true), Lim())) == Pairs{ { 0, 2 }, { 4, 6 }, { 7, 9 } });
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch line path: empty matches advance one code point; invalid bytes are searchable and never match '.'", "[text-search]")
{
    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(Snap("a\xC3\xA9"), Q("x*", true), Lim())) == Pairs{ { 0, 0 }, { 1, 1 }, { 3, 3 } });
    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(Snap("caf\xE9 caf"), Q("caf"), Lim())) == Pairs{ { 0, 3 }, { 5, 8 } });
    CHECK(TextSearch::Search(Snap("\xE9"), Q(".", true), Lim()).matches.empty());
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch line path: after an empty match a longer match at the same offset still counts (pcre2demo's loop)", "[text-search]")
{
    // rev-2 4.6: stepping one code point past an empty match lost the "a" (Perl: "", "a", "").
    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(Snap("a"), Q("x*|a", true), Lim())) == Pairs{ { 0, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 1, 1 } });
    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(Snap("ba\nb"), Q("x*|a", true), Lim()))
          == Pairs{ { 0, 0 }, { 1, 1 }, { 1, 2 }, { 2, 2 }, { 3, 3 }, { 4, 4 } });
    SearchStatus st{};
    const auto next = TextSearch::FindNext(Snap("ab"), Q("x*", true), 1, true, false, Lim(), &st, nullptr, nullptr, true);
    REQUIRE(next.has_value());
    CHECK((next->begin == 2 && next->end == 2));                 // the empty match AT `from` is skipped
    const auto same = TextSearch::FindNext(Snap("ab"), Q("x*", true), 1, true, false, Lim(), &st);
    REQUIRE(same.has_value());
    CHECK((same->begin == 1 && same->end == 1));                 // without the flag it is the first hit
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch line path: a match that crosses a window's end is carried into the next window, not lost", "[text-search]")
{
    // rev-2 4.1: with fixed overlapping windows this lost the match (it begins in window 1's report
    // range but runs past window 1's end, and window 2 starts after its begin).
    const RopeSnapshot s = Snap("bbbbbaaaab");
    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(s, Q("aaaa"), Lim(8))) == Pairs{ { 5, 9 } });
    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(s, Q("aaaa"), Lim(8))) == Ranges(TextSearch::Search(s, Q("aaaa"), Lim())));
    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(s, Q("a+b", true), Lim(8))) == Pairs{ { 5, 10 } });   // greedy: never cut short
    // Empty matches across windows: the same set as one subject, nothing reported twice.
    const RopeSnapshot letters = Snap("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy");
    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(letters, Q("x*|e", true), Lim(8))) == Ranges(TextSearch::Search(letters, Q("x*|e", true), Lim())));
    // Whole word needs the character after the window: "foo" at a window's end followed by "bar" is not a word.
    SearchQuery w; w.text = "foo"; w.caseSensitive = true; w.wholeWord = true;
    const CompiledQuery word = TextSearch::Compile(w, "");
    const RopeSnapshot fb = Snap("xxxxx foobar foo");
    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(fb, word, Lim(9))) == Pairs{ { 13, 16 } });
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch line path: a single match longer than the window is cut at the window's end (spec s5.2 known limit)", "[text-search]")
{
    const RopeSnapshot s = Snap(std::string(20, 'a'));
    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(s, Q("a+", true), Lim())) == Pairs{ { 0, 20 } });
    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(s, Q("a+", true), Lim(8))) == Pairs{ { 0, 8 }, { 8, 16 }, { 16, 20 } });
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch line path: in-selection keeps only matches inside a scope range", "[text-search]")
{
    SearchQuery q; q.text = "ab"; q.caseSensitive = true; q.scope = { { 3, 9 } };
    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(Snap("ab ab\nxab\n\nab"), TextSearch::Compile(q, ""), Lim())) == Pairs{ { 3, 5 }, { 7, 9 } });
    q.scope = { { 3, 8 } };                                     // 7..9 straddles the scope's end
    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(Snap("ab ab\nxab\n\nab"), TextSearch::Compile(q, ""), Lim())) == Pairs{ { 3, 5 } });
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch: SearchRows covers only the visible rows; FindNext wraps both ways", "[text-search]")
{
    const RopeSnapshot s = Snap("ab ab\nxab\n\nab");
    CHECK(Ranges(TextSearch::SearchRows(s, Q("ab"), 1, 2, Lim())) == Pairs{ { 7, 9 } });
    SearchStatus st{};
    auto f = TextSearch::FindNext(s, Q("ab"), 4, true, true, Lim(), &st);
    REQUIRE(f.has_value());
    CHECK((f->begin == 7 && f->end == 9));
    f = TextSearch::FindNext(s, Q("ab"), 12, true, true, Lim(), &st);
    REQUIRE(f.has_value());
    CHECK(f->begin == 0);                                        // wrapped to the top
    CHECK_FALSE(TextSearch::FindNext(s, Q("ab"), 12, true, false, Lim(), &st).has_value());
    f = TextSearch::FindNext(s, Q("ab"), 7, false, true, Lim(), &st);
    REQUIRE(f.has_value());
    CHECK(f->begin == 3);                                        // the last match beginning before 7
    f = TextSearch::FindNext(s, Q("ab"), 0, false, true, Lim(), &st);
    REQUIRE(f.has_value());
    CHECK(f->begin == 11);                                       // wrapped to the bottom
    CHECK(st == SearchStatus::Complete);
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch line path: a catastrophic pattern hits the match limit and says where; caps and cancel are reported", "[text-search]")
{
    SearchLimits tight = Lim();
    tight.regex.matchLimit = 1000;
    const SearchResult r = TextSearch::Search(Snap("ok\naaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaab"), Q("(a+)+$", true), tight);
    CHECK(r.status == SearchStatus::MatchLimitHit);
    CHECK(r.message.find("editor.text.regexMatchLimit") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(r.message.find("line 2") != std::string::npos);
    SearchLimits capped = Lim();
    capped.maxMatches = 2;
    const SearchResult c = TextSearch::Search(Snap("a a a a"), Q("a"), capped);
    CHECK(c.status == SearchStatus::MaxMatchesHit);
    CHECK(c.matches.size() == 2);
    const std::atomic<bool> cancel{ true };
    CHECK(TextSearch::Search(Snap("a\na"), Q("a"), Lim(), &cancel).status == SearchStatus::Cancelled);
    CHECK(TextSearch::Search(Snap("a"), Q(""), Lim()).status == SearchStatus::EmptyQuery);
    CHECK(TextSearch::Search(Snap("a"), Q("(", true), Lim()).status == SearchStatus::InvalidPattern);
}

TEST_CASE("TextSearch line path: windowed long lines report exactly the unwindowed matches (property)", "[text-search]")
{
    rc::prop("windows of 8..32 bytes == one subject per line", [] {
        const std::string text = *rc::gen::container<std::string>(rc::gen::element('a', 'b', 'a', 'b', '\n'));
        const int patternLength = *rc::gen::inRange(1, 4);
        const std::string pattern = *rc::gen::container<std::string>(static_cast<std::size_t>(patternLength), rc::gen::element('a', 'b'));
        const std::uint64_t window = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(*rc::gen::inRange(8, 33));
        // The model: leftmost non-overlapping occurrences, per line.
        Pairs model;
        std::size_t lineStart = 0;
        for (;;)
        {
            const std::size_t nl = text.find('\n', lineStart);
            const std::size_t lineEnd = nl == std::string::npos ? text.size() : nl;
            const std::string_view line(text.data() + lineStart, lineEnd - lineStart);
            for (std::size_t p = line.find(pattern); p != std::string_view::npos; p = line.find(pattern, p + pattern.size()))
                model.emplace_back(lineStart + p, lineStart + p + pattern.size());
            if (nl == std::string::npos) break;
            lineStart = nl + 1;
        }
        const RopeSnapshot s = Snap(text);
        RC_ASSERT(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(s, Q(pattern), Lim())) == model);
        RC_ASSERT(Ranges(TextSearch::Search(s, Q(pattern), Lim(window))) == model);
    });
}
```

The wrapper additions (TE3-2's `Regex.hpp` / `Regex.cpp`; the names of TE3's members are the ones that file uses for the compiled code and the PCRE2 option word):

```cpp
    // Regex.hpp -- enum class MatchStatus gains a LAST value (existing callers never see it: it is
    // returned only when MatchFlags::PartialHard was passed):
    enum class MatchStatus : std::uint8_t { Match, NoMatch, LimitHit, Error, Partial };
    // enum class MatchFlags gains, on the next three free bits:
        NotBol      = 1u << 2,   // PCRE2_NOTBOL: the subject's start is not a line start (a long line's later window)
        NotEol      = 1u << 3,   // PCRE2_NOTEOL: the subject's end is not a line end (a long line's earlier window)
        PartialHard = 1u << 4,   // PCRE2_PARTIAL_HARD: a match that runs into the subject's end is Partial, never cut
    // class Regex gains:
        // The longest lookbehind in CHARACTERS (PCRE2_INFO_MAXLOOKBEHIND); a UTF-8 window needs 4x that in bytes.
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t MaxLookbehind() const noexcept;

    // Regex.cpp -- in MatchScratch::Match, where the MatchFlags become PCRE2 options:
        if (HasFlag(flags, MatchFlags::NotBol))      options |= PCRE2_NOTBOL;
        if (HasFlag(flags, MatchFlags::NotEol))      options |= PCRE2_NOTEOL;
        // TE3-2 JIT-compiles PCRE2_JIT_COMPLETE only, so a PARTIAL_HARD call gets PCRE2_ERROR_JIT_BADOPTION from
        // the JIT inside pcre2_match, which then runs the interpreter (same match/depth limits). Only a long
        // line's non-final windows pass it.
        if (HasFlag(flags, MatchFlags::PartialHard)) options |= PCRE2_PARTIAL_HARD;
    // after the `if (rc > 0) { ... }` block, before `m_lastError = rc;`:
        if (rc == PCRE2_ERROR_PARTIAL)
        {
            m_lastError = rc;
            m_lastSlots = 1;   // ovector[0] = the partial match's start, ovector[1] = the subject's end (pcre2partial)
            return MatchStatus::Partial;
        }
    // and:
    std::uint32_t Regex::MaxLookbehind() const noexcept
    {
        std::uint32_t n = 0;
        pcre2_pattern_info(m_code, PCRE2_INFO_MAXLOOKBEHIND, &n);
        return n;
    }
```

```cpp
    enum class SearchStatus : std::uint8_t
    {
        Complete,               // every match in the window was reported (or the callback stopped early)
        EmptyQuery,
        InvalidPattern,
        MatchLimitHit,          // a regex limit stopped the scan (spec s4.2): reported, never a hang
        MaxMatchesHit,          // the caller's cap (SearchLimits::maxMatches)
        TooLargeForMultiline,   // the multi-line path refused the file (editor.text.multilineSearchMaxMB)
        Deferred,               // a per-frame row query met a multi-line pattern: the worker owns it
        Cancelled,
    };

    struct SearchLimits
    {
        RegexLimits   regex{};                // editor.text.regexMatchLimit / regexDepthLimit
        std::uint64_t lineWindowBytes = 0;    // editor.text.longLineMaxBytes; 0 = never window
        std::uint64_t multilineMaxBytes = 0;  // editor.text.multilineSearchMaxMB, in bytes
        std::uint64_t maxMatches = 0;         // a caller's cap for Search(); 0 = none
    };

    struct SearchHit
    {
        ByteRange          range;             // absolute, in the snapshot
        std::uint32_t      row = 0;           // the row the match begins on
        std::string_view   subject;           // the scratch the regex ran on; valid during the callback only
        ByteOffset         subjectBase = 0;   // absolute offset of subject[0]
        const MatchScratch* match = nullptr;  // capture groups (Group(i, b, e)), subject-relative
        std::uint32_t      captureCount = 0;  // the pattern's capture groups (Regex::CaptureCount): "$10" names group 10 iff >= 10
    };

    struct SearchResult
    {
        std::vector<ByteRange> matches;
        SearchStatus status = SearchStatus::Complete;
        std::string message;                  // for the find bar / vim message line when not Complete
        std::uint64_t version = 0;            // the snapshot's buffer version
    };

    using SearchHitFn = std::function<bool(const SearchHit&)>;   // return false to stop

    namespace TextSearch
    {
        // Every match whose begin lies in [window.begin, window.end), in document order.
        SearchStatus ForEachMatch(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, ByteRange window,
                                  const SearchLimits& limits, const std::atomic<bool>* cancel, const SearchHitFn& onHit,
                                  std::string* message);
        // Spec s9: the pure whole-document search (the find bar's worker; spec 2's Find in Files).
        [[nodiscard]] SearchResult Search(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, const SearchLimits& limits,
                                          const std::atomic<bool>* cancel = nullptr);
        // The matches beginning on rows [firstRow, lastRow] (the visible range). Line path only:
        // a multi-line query returns Deferred.
        [[nodiscard]] SearchResult SearchRows(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query,
                                              std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow, const SearchLimits& limits);
        // Forward: the first match beginning at or after `from`; backward: the last one beginning
        // before `from`; `wrap` continues from the other end. `notEmptyAtFrom` (forward only) skips
        // an empty match exactly at `from` -- the next match after an empty one (rev-2 4.6).
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<ByteRange> FindNext(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, ByteOffset from,
                                                        bool forward, bool wrap, const SearchLimits& limits, SearchStatus* status,
                                                        const std::atomic<bool>* cancel = nullptr, std::string* message = nullptr,
                                                        bool notEmptyAtFrom = false);
    }
```

```cpp
namespace Arcane::Text::TextSearch
{
    namespace
    {
        bool IsCancelled(const std::atomic<bool>* cancel) { return cancel && cancel->load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }

        std::string LimitMessage(std::uint32_t row)
        {
            return std::format("Search stopped: the pattern hit editor.text.regexMatchLimit / regexDepthLimit on line {}.", row + 1);
        }

        // A LimitHit or an Error from MatchScratch::Match, as the search status and its message.
        SearchStatus Stopped(MatchStatus r, std::uint32_t row, std::string* message)
        {
            if (r == MatchStatus::LimitHit)
            {
                if (message) *message = LimitMessage(row);
                return SearchStatus::MatchLimitHit;
            }
            if (message) *message = "Search stopped: the regex engine reported an error.";
            return SearchStatus::InvalidPattern;
        }

        enum class Flow : std::uint8_t { Continue, PastEnd, Stopped };
        using FlowFn = std::function<Flow(const SearchHit&)>;

        struct LineScanner
        {
            LineScanner(const Rope& r, const CompiledQuery& q, const SearchLimits& l) : rope(r), query(q), limits(l), m(l.regex) {}
            const Rope& rope;
            const CompiledQuery& query;
            const SearchLimits& limits;
            std::string scratch;
            MatchScratch m;                                  // this thread's match data, context and JIT stack

            // Every match beginning on `row` (spec s4.2: the line is the subject; a line longer than
            // lineWindowBytes in windows). pcre2demo's loop throughout (rev-2 4.6): after an empty
            // match the next attempt at the same offset is NotEmptyAtStart, so nothing repeats and a
            // longer match there still counts. A window starts where the search stands, with
            // 4 x MaxLookbehind() bytes of context before it (whole word's lookbehind sees the real
            // neighbour); every window but the line's last is PartialHard, so a match that would run
            // past its end comes back Partial and the NEXT window starts at it (rev-2 4.1). Only a
            // match longer than a whole window is re-run without PartialHard and cut at the window's
            // end (spec s5.2's known limit).
            SearchStatus ScanRow(std::uint32_t row, const FlowFn& fn, Flow& flow, std::string* message)
            {
                const ByteOffset ls = rope.LineStart(row), le = rope.LineEnd(row);
                const std::uint64_t len = le - ls;
                const std::uint64_t window = limits.lineWindowBytes;
                const std::uint64_t lookbehind = std::uint64_t{ query.regex->MaxLookbehind() } * 4;   // characters -> UTF-8 bytes
                std::uint64_t pos = 0;           // line-relative: where the search stands
                bool afterEmpty = false;         // the last reported match was empty and ended at `pos`
                for (;;)
                {
                    const std::uint64_t ws = pos;
                    const bool last = window == 0 || len - ws <= window;           // the line's last (or only) window
                    const std::uint64_t we = last ? len : ws + window;
                    const std::uint64_t subjectStart = ws - std::min(ws, lookbehind);
                    scratch.clear();
                    rope.CopyTo({ ls + subjectStart, ls + we }, scratch);
                    std::size_t at = static_cast<std::size_t>(ws - subjectStart);
                    bool cut = false;                        // a match longer than this window: take it cut at `we`
                    std::optional<std::uint64_t> resume;     // a Partial: the next window starts at its begin
                    for (;;)
                    {
                        MatchFlags flags = MatchFlags::None;
                        if (subjectStart > 0) flags = flags | MatchFlags::NotBol;  // the subject does not start the line
                        if (!last) flags = flags | MatchFlags::NotEol;
                        if (!last && !cut) flags = flags | MatchFlags::PartialHard;
                        if (afterEmpty) flags = flags | MatchFlags::NotEmptyAtStart;
                        const MatchStatus r = m.Match(*query.regex, scratch, at, flags);
                        if (r == MatchStatus::NoMatch) break;
                        if (r == MatchStatus::LimitHit || r == MatchStatus::Error) return Stopped(r, row, message);
                        std::size_t mb = 0, me = 0;
                        m.Group(0, mb, me);
                        if (r == MatchStatus::Partial)
                        {
                            if (subjectStart + mb > ws)
                            {
                                resume = subjectStart + mb;
                                afterEmpty = afterEmpty && mb == at;    // still the offset an empty match ended at
                                break;
                            }
                            cut = true;                                // starts at the window's start: no window holds it
                            continue;                                  // the same offset again, without PartialHard
                        }
                        SearchHit hit;
                        hit.range = { ls + subjectStart + mb, ls + subjectStart + me };
                        hit.row = row;
                        hit.subject = scratch;
                        hit.subjectBase = ls + subjectStart;
                        hit.match = &m;
                        hit.captureCount = query.regex->CaptureCount();
                        flow = fn(hit);
                        if (flow != Flow::Continue) return SearchStatus::Complete;
                        afterEmpty = me == mb;
                        at = me;
                    }
                    if (resume)
                    {
                        pos = *resume;
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (last) return SearchStatus::Complete;
                    afterEmpty = afterEmpty && subjectStart + at == we;    // an empty match right at the window's end
                    pos = we;
                }
            }
        };

        SearchStatus ForEachLine(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& q, ByteRange window, const SearchLimits& limits,
                                 const std::atomic<bool>* cancel, const SearchHitFn& onHit, std::string* message)
        {
            const Rope& rope = snapshot.rope;
            const ByteOffset size = rope.Size();
            LineScanner scanner(rope, q, limits);
            bool stopped = false;
            const auto scanArea = [&](ByteRange area, const ByteRange* scope) -> SearchStatus
            {
                const std::uint32_t first = rope.OffsetToPoint(std::min<ByteOffset>(area.begin, size)).row;
                const std::uint32_t last = rope.OffsetToPoint(std::min<ByteOffset>(area.end, size)).row;
                for (std::uint32_t row = first;; ++row)
                {
                    if (IsCancelled(cancel)) return SearchStatus::Cancelled;
                    Flow flow = Flow::Continue;
                    const SearchStatus s = scanner.ScanRow(row, [&](const SearchHit& h) -> Flow
                    {
                        if (h.range.begin < area.begin) return Flow::Continue;
                        if (h.range.begin >= area.end) return Flow::PastEnd;
                        if (scope && (h.range.begin < scope->begin || h.range.end > scope->end)) return Flow::Continue;
                        return onHit(h) ? Flow::Continue : Flow::Stopped;
                    }, flow, message);
                    if (s != SearchStatus::Complete) return s;
                    if (flow == Flow::Stopped) { stopped = true; return SearchStatus::Complete; }
                    if (flow == Flow::PastEnd || row == last) break;
                }
                return SearchStatus::Complete;
            };
            if (q.scope.empty()) return scanArea(window, nullptr);
            for (const ByteRange& s : q.scope)
            {
                const ByteRange area{ std::max(window.begin, s.begin), std::min(window.end, s.end + 1) };
                if (area.begin >= area.end) continue;
                const SearchStatus status = scanArea(area, &s);
                if (status != SearchStatus::Complete || stopped) return status;
            }
            return SearchStatus::Complete;
        }
    }

    SearchStatus ForEachMatch(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, ByteRange window,
                              const SearchLimits& limits, const std::atomic<bool>* cancel, const SearchHitFn& onHit, std::string* message)
    {
        if (!query.Valid())
        {
            if (message) *message = query.error;
            return query.error.empty() ? SearchStatus::EmptyQuery : SearchStatus::InvalidPattern;
        }
        if (window.begin >= window.end || window.begin > snapshot.rope.Size()) return SearchStatus::Complete;
        if (query.multiline)
        {
            if (message) *message = "Multi-line search runs on the worker.";
            return SearchStatus::Deferred;                       // TE4-6 replaces this branch with the materialized path
        }
        return ForEachLine(snapshot, query, window, limits, cancel, onHit, message);
    }

    SearchResult Search(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, const SearchLimits& limits, const std::atomic<bool>* cancel)
    {
        SearchResult out;
        out.version = snapshot.version;
        bool capped = false;
        out.status = ForEachMatch(snapshot, query, { 0, snapshot.rope.Size() + 1 }, limits, cancel, [&](const SearchHit& h)
        {
            out.matches.push_back(h.range);
            if (limits.maxMatches != 0 && out.matches.size() >= limits.maxMatches) { capped = true; return false; }
            return true;
        }, &out.message);
        if (capped && out.status == SearchStatus::Complete)
        {
            out.status = SearchStatus::MaxMatchesHit;
            out.message = std::format("Stopped after {} matches.", limits.maxMatches);
        }
        return out;
    }

    SearchResult SearchRows(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow,
                            const SearchLimits& limits)
    {
        SearchResult out;
        out.version = snapshot.version;
        if (query.Valid() && query.multiline) { out.status = SearchStatus::Deferred; return out; }
        const Rope& rope = snapshot.rope;
        const std::uint32_t last = std::min(lastRow, rope.LineCount() - 1);
        if (firstRow > last) return out;
        const ByteRange window{ rope.LineStart(firstRow), rope.LineEnd(last) + 1 };
        out.status = ForEachMatch(snapshot, query, window, limits, nullptr, [&](const SearchHit& h)
        {
            out.matches.push_back(h.range);
            return true;
        }, &out.message);
        return out;
    }

    std::optional<ByteRange> FindNext(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, ByteOffset from, bool forward, bool wrap,
                                      const SearchLimits& limits, SearchStatus* status, const std::atomic<bool>* cancel, std::string* message,
                                      bool notEmptyAtFrom)
    {
        SearchStatus local = SearchStatus::Complete;
        SearchStatus& st = status ? *status : local;
        const ByteOffset end = snapshot.rope.Size() + 1;
        from = std::min<ByteOffset>(from, end - 1);
        std::optional<ByteRange> found;
        const auto first = [&](ByteRange window)
        {
            st = ForEachMatch(snapshot, query, window, limits, cancel, [&](const SearchHit& h)
            {
                if (notEmptyAtFrom && h.range.begin == from && h.range.end == from) return true;   // the empty match we stand on
                found = h.range;
                return false;
            }, message);
        };
        const auto last = [&](ByteRange window)
        {
            st = ForEachMatch(snapshot, query, window, limits, cancel, [&](const SearchHit& h) { found = h.range; return true; }, message);
        };
        if (forward)
        {
            first({ from, end });
            if (!found && wrap && st == SearchStatus::Complete && from > 0) first({ 0, from });
        }
        else
        {
            last({ 0, from });
            if (!found && wrap && st == SearchStatus::Complete) last({ from, end });
        }
        return found;
    }
}
```

```cpp
        // Spec s4.2: a pattern that can span lines gets the whole snapshot as one
        // contiguous subject. It runs on the worker (the find bar never calls it per
        // frame) and is refused above multilineMaxBytes, so a 400 MB log never
        // doubles its memory for a regex.
        SearchStatus ForEachMaterialized(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& q, ByteRange window,
                                         const SearchLimits& limits, const std::atomic<bool>* cancel, const SearchHitFn& onHit,
                                         std::string* message)
        {
            const Rope& rope = snapshot.rope;
            const std::uint64_t size = rope.Size();
            if (size > limits.multilineMaxBytes)
            {
                if (message)
                    *message = std::format("Multi-line search is limited to {} MB (editor.text.multilineSearchMaxMB); this file is {} MB.",
                                           limits.multilineMaxBytes >> 20, (size + (std::uint64_t{ 1 } << 20) - 1) >> 20);
                return SearchStatus::TooLargeForMultiline;
            }
            const std::string text = rope.ToString();
            MatchScratch m(limits.regex);
            std::size_t pos = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min<ByteOffset>(window.begin, size));
            std::uint32_t row = rope.OffsetToPoint(pos).row;
            std::size_t counted = pos;                               // newlines counted up to here
            const auto rowAt = [&](std::size_t offset)
            {
                if (offset > counted)
                {
                    row += static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::count(text.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(counted),
                                                                 text.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(offset), '\n'));
                    counted = offset;
                }
                return row;
            };
            bool afterEmpty = false;                                 // pcre2demo's loop (rev-2 4.6), as TE4-5's line path
            while (pos <= text.size())
            {
                if (IsCancelled(cancel)) return SearchStatus::Cancelled;
                const MatchStatus r = m.Match(*q.regex, text, pos, afterEmpty ? MatchFlags::NotEmptyAtStart : MatchFlags::None);
                if (r == MatchStatus::NoMatch) break;
                if (r == MatchStatus::LimitHit || r == MatchStatus::Error) return Stopped(r, rowAt(pos), message);
                std::size_t mb = 0, me = 0;
                m.Group(0, mb, me);
                if (mb >= window.end) break;
                const ByteRange range{ mb, me };
                bool inScope = q.scope.empty();
                for (const ByteRange& s : q.scope)
                    if (range.begin >= s.begin && range.end <= s.end) { inScope = true; break; }
                if (inScope)
                {
                    SearchHit hit;
                    hit.range = range;
                    hit.row = rowAt(mb);
                    hit.subject = text;
                    hit.subjectBase = 0;
                    hit.match = &m;
                    hit.captureCount = q.regex->CaptureCount();
                    if (!onHit(hit)) return SearchStatus::Complete;
                }
                afterEmpty = me == mb;
                pos = me;
            }
            return SearchStatus::Complete;
        }
```

### Task TE4-7: Search edits -- replacement expansion, Replace / Replace All as one undo step, matches -> selections, the cursor gate (spec s2.1, s3.2, s5.2)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/SearchCommands.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/SearchCommands.cpp`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/SearchCommandsTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE4-4/5 `SearchQuery`, `CompiledQuery`, `SearchHit` (incl. `captureCount`), `SearchLimits`, `TextSearch::{Compile, ForEachMatch}`; TE3-2 `MatchScratch::Group`; TE1 `TextBuffer(Rope, EolMap)`, `TextBuffer::{Text, Snapshot, BreakUndoGroup, Undo, Redo}`, `class TextCommands` (`TextCommands(TextBuffer&, SelectionSet&, EditContext = {})`, `Buffer()`, `EditAndMap(TransactionKind, std::vector<EditOp>, Bias cursorBias, Bias startBias, Bias endBias)`, `SetSelections(std::vector<Selection>, std::size_t primaryIndex)` -- id 0 = a fresh id, the primary index gets the newest, overlaps merge, clamped; TE1-14), `TransactionKind::Other`, `SelectionSet::{SetSingle, All, Primary, Size}`, `Selection{id, anchor, head, goalColumn}`, `EditOp`, `Bias`.
- Produces (namespace `Arcane::Text`): `std::string ExpandReplacement(std::string_view, const SearchHit&, bool regex)` (`$n` / `${n}` resolve against `SearchHit::captureCount + 1` slots, so `$10` is group 10 whenever the pattern has ten groups, set or not -- rev-2 4.5); `void AssignSelections(TextCommands&, std::span<const ByteRange> ranges, std::size_t primary)` (range.begin = anchor, range.end = head; ranges[primary] is primary; an undo-group boundary, then `TextCommands::SetSelections` -- rev-2 4.11); `enum class CursorGate { Empty, Proceed, NeedsConfirmation }`; `CursorGate CheckCursorCount(std::uint64_t count, std::uint32_t maxCursors)`; `SearchCommands::ReplaceAll(TextBuffer&, SelectionSet&, std::vector<EditOp>)` (an empty op followed by an op at the same begin -- pcre2demo's `""` then `"a"` -- merge into one op, so the batch stays valid); `SearchCommands::ReplaceOne(TextBuffer&, SelectionSet&, ByteRange, std::string_view) -> bool`; `SearchCommands::SelectRanges(TextCommands&, std::span<const ByteRange>, ByteOffset focus)`. TE5c's `:s` does NOT reuse them: vim's replacement syntax differs, so TE5c-8 has its own `Text::VimExpandReplacement` (CANON A6, B16).

Add Next Match (Ctrl+D) and Select All Matches (Alt+F3) are TE1-17's plain-text commands with TE1's `ConfirmCursorCount`; TE4 does not duplicate them. `CheckCursorCount` is the same rule as a pure function, for the find bar, whose matches arrive asynchronously from its worker (TE4-10) and cannot block inside a command. The functions here live in namespace `SearchCommands`, not `TextCommands` (TE1's `TextCommands` is a class). Every edit goes through `TextCommands::EditAndMap` and every selection change through `TextCommands::SetSelections` after a `BreakUndoGroup()` (TE1's motions break the group the same way), so the s2.1 single mutation path holds and typing on either side of a jump is two undo steps. `AssignSelections` is the one TE4 helper the other selection-moving commands (TE4-12 folds, TE4-14 brackets, TE4-23 column select, TE4-10 the find bar) call.

```cpp
TEST_CASE("Search edits: $10 is group 10 whenever the pattern has ten groups, set or not", "[text-search]")
{
    // rev-2 4.5: the matched-slot count (10 here: group 10 did not take part) made $10 read "$1" + "0".
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("abcdefghi"), EolMap());
    const auto ten = ReplaceOps(buf, "(a)(b)(c)(d)(e)(f)(g)(h)(i)(x)?", "[$10|$1]", true);
    REQUIRE(ten.size() == 1);
    CHECK(ten[0].text == "[|a]");
    const auto nine = ReplaceOps(buf, "(a)(b)(c)(d)(e)(f)(g)(h)(i)", "[$10]", true);
    REQUIRE(nine.size() == 1);
    CHECK(nine[0].text == "[a0]");                               // nine groups: $1, then a literal 0
}

TEST_CASE("Search edits: Replace All of an empty match and a longer one at the same offset is one valid batch", "[text-search]")
{
    // rev-2 4.6: pcre2demo's loop reports "" and "a" both at offset 0; the batch merges them.
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("a"), EolMap());
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(0, 0);
    auto ops = ReplaceOps(buf, "x*|a", "<$0>", true);
    REQUIRE(ops.size() == 3);
    SearchCommands::ReplaceAll(buf, sels, std::move(ops));
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "<><a><>");                   // Perl's s/x*|a/<$&>/g
    CHECK(buf.Undo(sels));
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "a");
}

TEST_CASE("Search edits: Replace All is one undo step and one redo step", "[text-search]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("a1 b2 a3\na4"), EolMap());
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(9, 9);
    auto ops = ReplaceOps(buf, "a(\\d)", "x$1", true);
    REQUIRE(ops.size() == 3);
    SearchCommands::ReplaceAll(buf, sels, std::move(ops));
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "x1 b2 x3\nx4");
    CHECK(sels.Size() == 1);
    CHECK(sels.Primary().head == 9);                             // a caret at a match's start stays at its start
    CHECK(buf.Undo(sels));
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "a1 b2 a3\na4");
    CHECK(buf.Redo(sels));
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "x1 b2 x3\nx4");
    CHECK(buf.Undo(sels));
    CHECK_FALSE(buf.Undo(sels));                                 // nothing else was recorded
}

TEST_CASE("Search edits: Replace One replaces the range and keeps the replacement selected", "[text-search]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("foo bar foo"), EolMap());
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(8, 11);
    CHECK(SearchCommands::ReplaceOne(buf, sels, { 8, 11 }, "baz!"));
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "foo bar baz!");
    CHECK(Sel(sels) == Sels{ { 8, 12 } });
    CHECK_FALSE(SearchCommands::ReplaceOne(buf, sels, { 40, 41 }, "x"));
}

TEST_CASE("Search edits: matches become selections; the one at or after the focus is primary", "[text-search]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("0123456789ab"), EolMap());
    SelectionSet sels;
    TextCommands cmd(buf, sels);                                 // selections change through TextCommands only (spec s2.1)
    const std::vector<ByteRange> ranges = { { 0, 2 }, { 5, 7 }, { 10, 12 } };
    SearchCommands::SelectRanges(cmd, ranges, 4);
    CHECK(Sel(sels) == Sels{ { 0, 2 }, { 5, 7 }, { 10, 12 } });
    CHECK(sels.Primary().anchor == 5);
    SearchCommands::SelectRanges(cmd, ranges, 99);
    CHECK(sels.Primary().anchor == 10);                          // nothing after the focus: the last one
}

TEST_CASE("Search edits: placing selections is an undo-group boundary", "[text-search]")
{
    // rev-2 4.11: without the break, typing, a jump that lands where the caret was, and typing
    // again merged into one undo step.
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("ab"), EolMap());
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(0, 0);
    TextCommands cmd(buf, sels);
    cmd.InsertText("x");                                         // "xab", caret 1
    const std::vector<ByteRange> here = { { 1, 1 } };
    SearchCommands::SelectRanges(cmd, here, 0);                  // the caret where it already is
    cmd.InsertText("y");                                         // "xyab"
    CHECK(buf.Undo(sels));
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "xab");                       // "y" alone
}

    CHECK(CheckCursorCount(0, 10) == CursorGate::Empty);
    CHECK(CheckCursorCount(10, 10) == CursorGate::Proceed);
    CHECK(CheckCursorCount(11, 10) == CursorGate::NeedsConfirmation);
}
```
