```cpp
#pragma once

// Search edits (text editor spec s2.1, s3.2, s5.2; TE4-7): replacement
// expansion, Replace / Replace All as ONE undo step, matches -> selections and
// the cursor gate. Every edit runs through TextCommands::EditAndMap (the single
// mutation layer); TE1-17 owns Ctrl+D / Alt+F3.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    // One match's replacement. Plain mode: the text as typed. Regex mode: $0-$99 and ${n}
    // are capture groups ($$ is '$'); \n \t \\ are a line break, a tab, a backslash. An
    // unset or missing group expands to "". "$10" is group 10 when the pattern HAS ten
    // groups (hit.captureCount), else group 1 followed by '0'.
    [[nodiscard]] std::string ExpandReplacement(std::string_view replacement, const SearchHit& hit, bool regex);

    // Replace cmd's selections with ranges (begin = anchor, end = head); ranges[primary] is the
    // primary (spec s3.4). An undo-group boundary first, as TE1's motions, then
    // TextCommands::SetSelections -- the one way TE4 moves selections (spec s2.1).
    void AssignSelections(TextCommands& cmd, std::span<const ByteRange> ranges, std::size_t primary);

    enum class CursorGate : std::uint8_t { Empty, Proceed, NeedsConfirmation };
    // Spec s3.2: making cursors from matches asks first above editor.text.maxCursors.
    [[nodiscard]] CursorGate CheckCursorCount(std::uint64_t count, std::uint32_t maxCursors) noexcept;

    namespace SearchCommands
    {
        // Spec s5.2: every op in ONE transaction (TransactionKind::Other), so one Ctrl+Z. `ops` are in
        // match order; an empty op followed by one at the same begin (pcre2demo's "" then "a") merge.
        void ReplaceAll(TextBuffer& buffer, SelectionSet& sels, std::vector<EditOp> ops);
        // One match replaced as its own undo step; a selection equal to it now covers the replacement.
        bool ReplaceOne(TextBuffer& buffer, SelectionSet& sels, ByteRange match, std::string_view text);
        // Matches -> selections; the first range at or after `focus` (else the last) is primary.
        void SelectRanges(TextCommands& cmd, std::span<const ByteRange> ranges, ByteOffset focus);
    }
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/SearchCommands.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/SearchCommands.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <optional>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    std::string ExpandReplacement(std::string_view rep, const SearchHit& hit, bool regex)
    {
        if (!regex) return std::string(rep);
        std::string out;
        // The pattern's group slots (rev-2 4.5), not GroupSlots() -- that is the highest group that
        // took part, + 1, so an unset group 10 would make "$10" read as "$1" + "0".
        const std::size_t groupCount = hit.match ? std::size_t{ hit.captureCount } + 1 : 0;
        const auto group = [&](std::size_t n)
        {
            std::size_t b = 0, e = 0;
            if (!hit.match || n >= groupCount || !hit.match->Group(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(n), b, e)) return;
            if (e < b || e > hit.subject.size()) return;
            out.append(hit.subject.substr(b, e - b));
        };
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < rep.size(); ++i)
        {
            const char c = rep[i];
            if (c == '$' && i + 1 < rep.size())
            {
                const char d = rep[i + 1];
                if (d == '$') { out.push_back('$'); ++i; continue; }
                if (d == '{')
                {
                    const std::size_t close = rep.find('}', i + 2);
                    const std::string_view digits = close == std::string_view::npos ? std::string_view{} : rep.substr(i + 2, close - (i + 2));
                    if (!digits.empty() && std::all_of(digits.begin(), digits.end(), [](char x) { return std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(x)) != 0; }))
                    {
                        std::size_t n = 0;
                        for (const char x : digits) n = n * 10 + static_cast<std::size_t>(x - '0');
                        group(n);
                        i = close;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                if (std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(d)))
                {
                    std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(d - '0');
                    std::size_t used = 1;
                    if (i + 2 < rep.size() && std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(rep[i + 2])))
                    {
                        const std::size_t two = n * 10 + static_cast<std::size_t>(rep[i + 2] - '0');
                        if (two < groupCount) { n = two; used = 2; }
                    }
                    group(n);
                    i += used;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            if (c == '\\' && i + 1 < rep.size())
            {
                const char d = rep[i + 1];
                if (d == 'n') { out.push_back('\n'); ++i; continue; }
                if (d == 't') { out.push_back('\t'); ++i; continue; }
                if (d == '\\') { out.push_back('\\'); ++i; continue; }
            }
            out.push_back(c);
        }
        return out;
    }

    void AssignSelections(TextCommands& cmd, std::span<const ByteRange> ranges, std::size_t primary)
    {
        if (ranges.empty()) return;
        std::vector<Selection> out;
        out.reserve(ranges.size());
        for (const ByteRange& r : ranges) out.push_back(Selection{ 0, r.begin, r.end, std::nullopt });   // id 0: SetSelections allocates
        cmd.Buffer().BreakUndoGroup();                       // a selection change ends the typing group (TE1's motions do the same)
        cmd.SetSelections(std::move(out), primary);          // the primary gets the newest id; overlaps merge; clamped (TE1-14)
    }

    CursorGate CheckCursorCount(std::uint64_t count, std::uint32_t maxCursors) noexcept
    {
        if (count == 0) return CursorGate::Empty;
        return count > maxCursors ? CursorGate::NeedsConfirmation : CursorGate::Proceed;
    }

    namespace SearchCommands
    {
        void ReplaceAll(TextBuffer& buffer, SelectionSet& sels, std::vector<EditOp> ops)
        {
            if (ops.empty()) return;
            // pcre2demo's loop can report an empty match and then a longer one at the SAME offset
            // (x*|a on "a"); TE1's batch needs strictly increasing begins, so the two become one op.
            std::vector<EditOp> batch;
            batch.reserve(ops.size());
            for (EditOp& op : ops)
            {
                if (!batch.empty() && batch.back().range.begin == op.range.begin && batch.back().range.end == batch.back().range.begin)
                {
                    batch.back().range.end = op.range.end;
                    batch.back().text += op.text;
                    continue;
                }
                batch.push_back(std::move(op));
            }
            buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
            TextCommands(buffer, sels).EditAndMap(TransactionKind::Other, std::move(batch), Bias::Left, Bias::Left, Bias::Right);
            buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
        }

        bool ReplaceOne(TextBuffer& buffer, SelectionSet& sels, ByteRange match, std::string_view text)
        {
            if (match.begin > match.end || match.end > buffer.Text().Size()) return false;
            std::vector<EditOp> ops;
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ match, std::string(text) });
            buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
            TextCommands(buffer, sels).EditAndMap(TransactionKind::Other, std::move(ops), Bias::Right, Bias::Left, Bias::Right);
            buffer.BreakUndoGroup();
            return true;
        }

        void SelectRanges(TextCommands& cmd, std::span<const ByteRange> ranges, ByteOffset focus)
        {
            if (ranges.empty()) return;
            std::size_t primary = ranges.size() - 1;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < ranges.size(); ++i)
                if (ranges[i].begin >= focus) { primary = i; break; }
            AssignSelections(cmd, ranges, primary);
        }
    }
}

---

### Task TE4-8: `SearchWorker` (background count, find, collect) and `VisibleMatchCache` (spec s3.2, s5.2)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/SearchWorker.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/SearchWorker.cpp`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/SearchWorkerTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE4-5/6 `TextSearch::{ForEachMatch, FindNext (incl. notEmptyAtFrom), SearchRows}`, `SearchLimits`, `SearchStatus`, `SearchHit`; TE4-7 `ExpandReplacement`; TE1 `RopeSnapshot`, `EditOp` (`TextBuffer.hpp`), `TextBuffer::{Snapshot, AppendExternal, Version}` (test).
- Produces: `enum class SearchJobKind { Find, ReplaceAll, Cursors, Count }` (also the priority order); `struct SearchJob { kind; RopeSnapshot snapshot; CompiledQuery query; SearchLimits limits; ByteOffset current; bool hasCurrent; std::uint32_t buckets; std::uint32_t visibleFirstRow, visibleLastRow; bool wantVisible; bool topUp; RopeSnapshot base; std::uint32_t baseFirstRow, baseLastRow, firstRow, lastRow; std::uint64_t baseTotal, baseCurrentIndex; std::vector<std::uint32_t> baseBuckets; ByteOffset from; bool forward, wrap, notEmptyAtFrom; std::string replacement; bool regexReplacement; }`; `struct SearchJobResult { kind; ticket; version; RopeSnapshot snapshot; status; message; total; currentIndex; bucketCounts; visible; found; edits; }` (`snapshot` = the snapshot the job ran on, so TE4-10 can map its ranges forward, D-R4); `class SearchWorker { std::uint64_t Submit(SearchJob); std::optional<SearchJobResult> Poll(); void Cancel(SearchJobKind); void CancelAll(); bool WaitIdle(std::chrono::milliseconds); }`; `class VisibleMatchCache { std::span<const ByteRange> Get(snapshot, query, generation, firstRow, lastRow, limits); SearchStatus Status(); const std::string& Message(); std::uint64_t Recomputes(); void Invalidate(); }`. TE5's `hlsearch` and incremental search reuse `VisibleMatchCache` (unchanged by rev 2).

**The Count top-up (D-R4; TE4-10 decides when to send one).** A full count of a 400 MB log takes longer than Follow's poll, so its result always arrives for an older version. A top-up turns such a result into an exact count for the current version without a full rescan: TE4-10 passes the old result's snapshot as `base`, its total, histogram and active index, and the rows the edit log says were touched -- `[baseFirstRow, baseLastRow]` in the old version and `[firstRow, lastRow]` now (TE4-10's `EditedRowSpan`, built on TE1's log and TE3-16's `MapRowForward`); every other row is unchanged and keeps its matches. The worker counts the matches BEGINNING on those rows in both snapshots and reports `baseTotal - old + new`. On a Follow append the touched rows are the old last row and the appended tail, so the top-up scans only the tail. Line-path queries only (a single-line match lies on one row); TE4-10 never sends one for a multi-line query. Count keeps no per-match list (TE4-16: one histogram bucket per track pixel), which is why the dropped matches are recounted on the base snapshot instead of being looked up.

// TE4-8 (spec s3.2, s5.2): the find bar's worker counts, finds and collects
// against snapshots; a newer job of a kind supersedes the older one; results
// carry their version. The visible matches are recomputed per snapshot,
// never shifted (search matches are not anchors).
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include "TextEditor/Core/SearchWorker.hpp"
#include <chrono>
#include <numeric>
#include <string>

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using namespace std::chrono_literals;

namespace
{
    SearchLimits Lim()
    {
        SearchLimits l;
        l.regex.matchLimit = 10000000;
        l.regex.depthLimit = 100000;
        l.multilineMaxBytes = 1u << 20;
        return l;
    }
    std::string Needles(int n)
    {
        std::string s;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) s += "line " + std::to_string(i) + " needle\n";
        return s;
    }
    CompiledQuery Q(std::string text, bool regex = false)
    {
        SearchQuery q; q.text = std::move(text); q.regex = regex; q.caseSensitive = true;
        return TextSearch::Compile(q, "");
    }
    SearchJob Job(SearchJobKind kind, const RopeSnapshot& s, CompiledQuery q)
    {
        SearchJob j;
        j.kind = kind; j.snapshot = s; j.query = std::move(q); j.limits = Lim();
        return j;
    }
    std::optional<SearchJobResult> Settle(SearchWorker& w)
    {
        REQUIRE(w.WaitIdle(5000ms));
        return w.Poll();
    }
}

TEST_CASE("SearchWorker: Count reports the total, the active match's 1-based index and a row histogram", "[text-search]")
{
    SearchWorker worker;
    const RopeSnapshot s{ Rope::FromUtf8(Needles(17)), 42 };
    SearchJob j = Job(SearchJobKind::Count, s, Q("needle"));
    const std::uint64_t third = s.rope.LineStart(2) + 7;         // "line 2 " is 7 bytes
    j.hasCurrent = true;
    j.current = third;
    j.buckets = 4;
    const std::uint64_t ticket = worker.Submit(j);
    const auto r = Settle(worker);
    REQUIRE(r.has_value());
    CHECK(r->ticket == ticket);
    CHECK(r->version == 42);
    CHECK(r->status == SearchStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(r->total == 17);
    CHECK(r->currentIndex == 3);
    REQUIRE(r->bucketCounts.size() == 4);
    CHECK(std::accumulate(r->bucketCounts.begin(), r->bucketCounts.end(), std::uint64_t{ 0 }) == 17);
    CHECK_FALSE(worker.Poll().has_value());
}

TEST_CASE("SearchWorker: a newer job of the same kind supersedes the older one", "[text-search]")
{
    SearchWorker worker;
    const RopeSnapshot s{ Rope::FromUtf8(Needles(2000)), 1 };
    worker.Submit(Job(SearchJobKind::Count, s, Q("needle")));
    const std::uint64_t second = worker.Submit(Job(SearchJobKind::Count, s, Q("line")));
    const auto r = Settle(worker);
    REQUIRE(r.has_value());
    CHECK(r->ticket == second);
    CHECK(r->total == 2000);
    CHECK_FALSE(worker.Poll().has_value());                      // the superseded result never surfaces
}

TEST_CASE("SearchWorker: Find wraps; ReplaceAll collects expanded edits; Cursors collects ranges", "[text-search]")
{
    SearchWorker worker;
    const RopeSnapshot s{ Rope::FromUtf8("k1=v1\nk2=v2"), 9 };
    SearchJob find = Job(SearchJobKind::Find, s, Q("k\\d", true));
    find.from = 7; find.forward = true; find.wrap = true;
    worker.Submit(find);
    auto r = Settle(worker);
    REQUIRE(r.has_value());
    REQUIRE(r->found.has_value());
    CHECK(r->found->begin == 0);                                 // after offset 7 nothing: wrapped to the top
    SearchJob all = Job(SearchJobKind::ReplaceAll, s, Q("(k\\d)=(v\\d)", true));
    all.replacement = "$2=$1";
    all.regexReplacement = true;
    worker.Submit(all);
    r = Settle(worker);
    REQUIRE(r.has_value());
    REQUIRE(r->edits.size() == 2);
    CHECK(r->edits[0].text == "v1=k1");
    CHECK((r->edits[1].range.begin == 6 && r->edits[1].range.end == 11));
    worker.Submit(Job(SearchJobKind::Cursors, s, Q("=")));
    r = Settle(worker);
    REQUIRE(r.has_value());
    CHECK(r->edits.size() == 2);
    CHECK(r->edits[1].text.empty());
}

{
    SearchWorker worker;

    SearchJob j = Job(SearchJobKind::Count, s, Q("a\\nb", true));
    j.wantVisible = true;
    j.visibleFirstRow = 2;
    j.visibleLastRow = 3;
    worker.Submit(j);
    const auto r = Settle(worker);

    REQUIRE(r->visible.size() == 1);

TEST_CASE("SearchWorker: a Count top-up recounts only the touched rows and adds them to the old total (D-R4)", "[text-search]")
{
    SearchWorker worker;
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8(Needles(5)), EolMap());        // rows 0..4 "line i needle", row 5 empty
    const RopeSnapshot before = buf.Snapshot();
    SearchJob full = Job(SearchJobKind::Count, before, Q("needle"));
    full.buckets = 2;
    worker.Submit(full);
    const auto base = Settle(worker);
    REQUIRE(base.has_value());
    REQUIRE(base->total == 5);
    CHECK(base->snapshot.version == before.version);              // a result carries the snapshot it ran on

    buf.AppendExternal("line 5 needle\nline 6 needle needle\n");   // TE1's Follow append: old row 5 + new rows 6, 7
    const RopeSnapshot appended = buf.Snapshot();
    SearchJob top = Job(SearchJobKind::Count, appended, Q("needle"));
    top.topUp = true;
    top.base = before;
    top.baseFirstRow = 5; top.baseLastRow = 5;                    // the old last row: the tail joined it
    top.firstRow = 5; top.lastRow = 7;                            // the old last row and the tail, now
    top.baseTotal = base->total;
    top.baseBuckets = base->bucketCounts;
    top.buckets = 2;
    worker.Submit(top);
    auto r = Settle(worker);
    REQUIRE(r.has_value());
    CHECK(r->status == SearchStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(r->total == 8);
    CHECK(r->version == appended.version);
    CHECK(std::accumulate(r->bucketCounts.begin(), r->bucketCounts.end(), std::uint64_t{ 0 }) == 8);

    // An edit that removed matches: the old row's matches are subtracted, the new row's added.
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(0, 0);
    const Rope& rope = buf.Text();
    const EditOp op{ { rope.LineStart(6), rope.LineEnd(6) }, "gone" };
    buf.BeginTransaction(sels);
    buf.Edit(std::span<const EditOp>(&op, 1));
    buf.EndTransaction(sels);
    SearchJob edited = Job(SearchJobKind::Count, buf.Snapshot(), Q("needle"));
    edited.topUp = true;
    edited.base = appended;
    edited.baseFirstRow = 6; edited.baseLastRow = 6;
    edited.firstRow = 6; edited.lastRow = 6;
    edited.baseTotal = r->total;
    edited.hasCurrent = true;
    edited.current = buf.Text().LineStart(1) + 7;                 // the active match on row 1, above the edit
    edited.baseCurrentIndex = 2;
    worker.Submit(edited);
    r = Settle(worker);
    REQUIRE(r.has_value());
    CHECK(r->total == 6);
    CHECK(r->currentIndex == 2);                                  // above the touched rows: its index stands
}

{
    const RopeSnapshot s{ Rope::FromUtf8(Needles(200000)), 1 };
    {
        SearchWorker worker;
        worker.Submit(Job(SearchJobKind::Count, s, Q("needle")));
    }   // must not hang
    SUCCEED();
}

TEST_CASE("VisibleMatchCache: recomputed per snapshot version, query generation and row window; never shifted", "[text-search]")
{
    VisibleMatchCache cache;
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("ab ab\nab"), EolMap());
    const CompiledQuery q = Q("ab");
    auto m = cache.Get(buf.Snapshot(), q, 1, 0, 1, Lim());
    CHECK(m.size() == 3);
    CHECK(cache.Recomputes() == 1);
    m = cache.Get(buf.Snapshot(), q, 1, 0, 1, Lim());
    CHECK(cache.Recomputes() == 1);                              // same version, generation, rows: reused
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(0, 0);
    buf.BeginTransaction(sels);
    const EditOp op{ { 0, 0 }, "x" };
    buf.Edit(std::span<const EditOp>(&op, 1));
    buf.EndTransaction(sels);
    m = cache.Get(buf.Snapshot(), q, 1, 0, 1, Lim());
    CHECK(cache.Recomputes() == 2);                              // a new version: recomputed from the text
    REQUIRE(m.size() == 3);
    CHECK(m[0].begin == 1);
    cache.Get(buf.Snapshot(), q, 2, 0, 1, Lim());
    CHECK(cache.Recomputes() == 3);                              // a new query generation
    cache.Get(buf.Snapshot(), q, 2, 1, 1, Lim());
    CHECK(cache.Recomputes() == 4);                              // scrolled
    cache.Get(buf.Snapshot(), Q("a\\nb", true), 3, 0, 1, Lim());
    CHECK(cache.Status() == SearchStatus::Deferred);             // multi-line: the worker's job
}

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/SearchWorker.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// The find bar's background half (text editor spec s5.2, s3.2; TE4-8): one
// thread per owner that counts matches (the "3 of 17" total and the scrollbar
// histogram), finds the next match, and collects every match for Replace All
// or matches -> cursors -- always on a RopeSnapshot, never the live buffer, so
// a 400 MB log is searched while the user types. A newer job of a kind cancels
// the older one. Every result carries the snapshot it ran on: the UI maps its
// ranges forward through the edit log to the current version (D-R4, TE4-10;
// spec s3.2: matches are never anchors). VisibleMatchCache is the per-frame
// half: the visible rows' matches, recomputed for every new snapshot.

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"   // EditOp
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.hpp"

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class SearchJobKind : std::uint8_t { Find = 0, ReplaceAll = 1, Cursors = 2, Count = 3 };   // also the run priority

    struct SearchJob
    {
        SearchJobKind kind = SearchJobKind::Count;
        RopeSnapshot snapshot;
        CompiledQuery query;
        SearchLimits limits;
        // Count
        ByteOffset current = 0;            // the active match's begin; its 1-based index is reported
        bool hasCurrent = false;
        std::uint32_t buckets = 0;         // scrollbar histogram buckets over buffer rows; 0 = none
        std::uint32_t visibleFirstRow = 0, visibleLastRow = 0;
        bool wantVisible = false;          // multi-line queries: the matches touching those rows
        // Count top-up (D-R4): count only the touched rows -- [baseFirstRow, baseLastRow] of `base`
        // and [firstRow, lastRow] of `snapshot` -- and report baseTotal - old + new. Line path only.
        bool topUp = false;
        RopeSnapshot base;                 // the snapshot the earlier (complete) count ran on
        std::uint32_t baseFirstRow = 0, baseLastRow = 0;
        std::uint32_t firstRow = 0, lastRow = 0;
        std::uint64_t baseTotal = 0;
        std::uint64_t baseCurrentIndex = 0;          // the active match's index in that count; 0 = unknown
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> baseBuckets;      // its histogram; the top-up adjusts it
        // Find
        ByteOffset from = 0;
        bool forward = true;
        bool wrap = true;
        bool notEmptyAtFrom = false;       // skip an empty match exactly at `from` (rev-2 4.6)
        // ReplaceAll
        std::string replacement;
        bool regexReplacement = false;
    };

    struct SearchJobResult
    {
        SearchJobKind kind = SearchJobKind::Count;
        std::uint64_t ticket = 0;
        std::uint64_t version = 0;                 // the snapshot's buffer version
        RopeSnapshot snapshot;                     // the snapshot the job ran on (TE4-10 maps ranges forward from it)
        SearchStatus status = SearchStatus::Complete;
        std::string message;
        std::uint64_t total = 0;                   // Count
        std::uint64_t currentIndex = 0;            // Count: 1-based; 0 = the current offset is not a match
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> bucketCounts;   // Count
        std::vector<ByteRange> visible;            // Count with wantVisible
        std::optional<ByteRange> found;            // Find
        std::vector<EditOp> edits;                 // ReplaceAll (expanded text) / Cursors (empty text)
    };

    class SearchWorker
    {
    public:
        SearchWorker();
        ~SearchWorker();
        SearchWorker(const SearchWorker&) = delete;
        SearchWorker& operator=(const SearchWorker&) = delete;

        std::uint64_t Submit(SearchJob job);            // supersedes a pending or running job of the same kind
        std::optional<SearchJobResult> Poll();          // UI thread; only the latest ticket of a kind surfaces
        void Cancel(SearchJobKind kind);
        void CancelAll();
        bool WaitIdle(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout);   // tests and shutdown paths

    private:
        struct Impl;
        std::unique_ptr<Impl> m_impl;
    };

    class VisibleMatchCache
    {
    public:
        std::span<const ByteRange> Get(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, std::uint64_t queryGeneration,
                                       std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow, const SearchLimits& limits);
        [[nodiscard]] SearchStatus Status() const noexcept { return m_status; }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::string& Message() const noexcept { return m_message; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t Recomputes() const noexcept { return m_recomputes; }
        void Invalidate() noexcept { m_valid = false; }

    private:
        std::vector<ByteRange> m_matches;
        SearchStatus m_status = SearchStatus::Complete;
        std::string m_message;
        std::uint64_t m_version = 0, m_generation = 0, m_recomputes = 0;
        std::uint32_t m_firstRow = 0, m_lastRow = 0;
        bool m_valid = false;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/SearchWorker.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/SearchWorker.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/SearchCommands.hpp"   // ExpandReplacement

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <deque>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        // The bytes of rows [first, last] (clamped) as a ForEachMatch window: every match BEGINNING on them.
        ByteRange RowsWindow(const Rope& rope, std::uint32_t first, std::uint32_t last)
        {
            const std::uint32_t lastRow = std::min(last, rope.LineCount() - 1);
            if (first > lastRow) return { 0, 0 };
            return { rope.LineStart(first), rope.LineEnd(lastRow) + 1 };
        }

        // D-R4's top-up: the base total, minus the base's matches on the touched base rows, plus the
        // matches on the touched rows now; the histogram and the active index adjusted the same way.
        void RunTopUp(const SearchJob& job, const std::atomic<bool>& cancel, SearchJobResult& out)
        {
            out.bucketCounts = job.baseBuckets;
            const auto buckets = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(out.bucketCounts.size());
            const std::uint64_t baseLines = job.base.rope.LineCount(), lines = job.snapshot.rope.LineCount();
            std::uint64_t dropped = 0, added = 0;
            out.status = TextSearch::ForEachMatch(job.base, job.query, RowsWindow(job.base.rope, job.baseFirstRow, job.baseLastRow),
                                                  job.limits, &cancel, [&](const SearchHit& h)
            {
                ++dropped;
                if (buckets > 0)
                    if (std::uint32_t& b = out.bucketCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(std::uint64_t{ h.row } * buckets / baseLines)]; b > 0) --b;
                return true;
            }, &out.message);
            if (out.status != SearchStatus::Complete) return;
            const ByteRange now = RowsWindow(job.snapshot.rope, job.firstRow, job.lastRow);
            out.status = TextSearch::ForEachMatch(job.snapshot, job.query, now, job.limits, &cancel, [&](const SearchHit& h)
            {
                ++added;
                if (buckets > 0) ++out.bucketCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(std::uint64_t{ h.row } * buckets / lines)];
                return true;
            }, &out.message);
            if (out.status != SearchStatus::Complete) return;
            out.total = job.baseTotal - std::min(job.baseTotal, dropped) + added;
            if (job.hasCurrent && job.baseCurrentIndex > 0)
            {
                if (now.end <= now.begin || job.current < now.begin)
                    out.currentIndex = job.baseCurrentIndex;                                  // above the edit: same matches before it
                else if (job.current >= now.end && job.baseCurrentIndex > dropped)
                    out.currentIndex = job.baseCurrentIndex - dropped + added;                // below it: shifted by the change
            }                                                                                 // inside it: unknown (0)
        }

        SearchJobResult RunSearchJob(const SearchJob& job, std::uint64_t ticket, const std::atomic<bool>& cancel)
        {
            SearchJobResult out;
            out.kind = job.kind;
            out.ticket = ticket;
            out.version = job.snapshot.version;
            out.snapshot = job.snapshot;
            if (!job.query.Valid())
            {
                out.status = job.query.error.empty() ? SearchStatus::EmptyQuery : SearchStatus::InvalidPattern;
                out.message = job.query.error;
                return out;
            }
            const Rope& rope = job.snapshot.rope;
            const ByteRange all{ 0, rope.Size() + 1 };
            switch (job.kind)
            {
            case SearchJobKind::Count:
            {
                if (job.topUp)
                {
                    RunTopUp(job, cancel, out);
                    break;
                }
                const std::uint32_t lines = rope.LineCount();
                if (job.buckets > 0) out.bucketCounts.assign(job.buckets, 0);
                ByteRange visible{};
                if (job.wantVisible)
                {
                    const std::uint32_t last = std::min(job.visibleLastRow, lines - 1);
                    visible = { rope.LineStart(std::min(job.visibleFirstRow, last)), rope.LineEnd(last) + 1 };
                }
                out.status = TextSearch::ForEachMatch(job.snapshot, job.query, all, job.limits, &cancel, [&](const SearchHit& h)
                {
                    ++out.total;
                    if (job.hasCurrent && h.range.begin == job.current) out.currentIndex = out.total;
                    if (job.buckets > 0)
                        ++out.bucketCounts[static_cast<std::size_t>(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(h.row) * job.buckets / lines)];
                    if (job.wantVisible && h.range.end >= visible.begin && h.range.begin < visible.end) out.visible.push_back(h.range);
                    return true;
                }, &out.message);
                break;
            }
            case SearchJobKind::Find:
                out.found = TextSearch::FindNext(job.snapshot, job.query, job.from, job.forward, job.wrap, job.limits, &out.status,
                                                 &cancel, &out.message, job.notEmptyAtFrom);
                break;
            case SearchJobKind::ReplaceAll:
            case SearchJobKind::Cursors:
                out.status = TextSearch::ForEachMatch(job.snapshot, job.query, all, job.limits, &cancel, [&](const SearchHit& h)
                {
                    out.edits.push_back(EditOp{ h.range, job.kind == SearchJobKind::ReplaceAll
                                                         ? ExpandReplacement(job.replacement, h, job.regexReplacement)
                                                         : std::string{} });
                    return true;
                }, &out.message);
                break;
            }
            return out;
        }
    }

    struct SearchWorker::Impl
    {
        struct Pending { std::uint64_t ticket = 0; SearchJob job; };
        std::mutex mutex;
        std::condition_variable wake, idle;
        std::array<std::optional<Pending>, 4> pending;
        std::array<std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>>, 4> running;
        std::array<std::uint64_t, 4> latest{};
        std::deque<SearchJobResult> results;
        std::uint64_t nextTicket = 1;
        bool busy = false;
        bool stop = false;
        std::thread thread;

        bool AnyPending() const { return std::any_of(pending.begin(), pending.end(), [](const auto& p) { return p.has_value(); }); }

        void Run()
        {
            std::unique_lock lock(mutex);
            for (;;)
            {
                wake.wait(lock, [&] { return stop || AnyPending(); });
                if (stop) return;
                std::size_t kind = 0;
                while (!pending[kind]) ++kind;                       // Find, ReplaceAll, Cursors, Count
                Pending job = std::move(*pending[kind]);
                pending[kind].reset();
                auto cancel = std::make_shared<std::atomic<bool>>(false);
                running[kind] = cancel;
                busy = true;
                lock.unlock();
                SearchJobResult result = RunSearchJob(job.job, job.ticket, *cancel);
                lock.lock();
                running[kind].reset();
                busy = false;
                if (!cancel->load() && job.ticket == latest[kind]) results.push_back(std::move(result));
                idle.notify_all();
            }
        }
    };

    SearchWorker::SearchWorker() : m_impl(std::make_unique<Impl>())
    {
        m_impl->thread = std::thread([impl = m_impl.get()] { impl->Run(); });
    }

    SearchWorker::~SearchWorker()
    {
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(m_impl->mutex);
            m_impl->stop = true;
            for (auto& r : m_impl->running)
                if (r) r->store(true);
        }
        m_impl->wake.notify_all();
        m_impl->thread.join();
    }

    std::uint64_t SearchWorker::Submit(SearchJob job)
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_impl->mutex);
        const auto k = static_cast<std::size_t>(job.kind);
        const std::uint64_t ticket = m_impl->nextTicket++;
        m_impl->latest[k] = ticket;
        m_impl->pending[k] = Impl::Pending{ ticket, std::move(job) };
        if (m_impl->running[k]) m_impl->running[k]->store(true);
        m_impl->wake.notify_one();
        return ticket;
    }

    std::optional<SearchJobResult> SearchWorker::Poll()
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_impl->mutex);
        while (!m_impl->results.empty())
        {
            SearchJobResult r = std::move(m_impl->results.front());
            m_impl->results.pop_front();
            if (r.ticket == m_impl->latest[static_cast<std::size_t>(r.kind)]) return r;
        }
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    void SearchWorker::Cancel(SearchJobKind kind)
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_impl->mutex);
        const auto k = static_cast<std::size_t>(kind);
        m_impl->latest[k] = m_impl->nextTicket++;                    // anything in flight is now stale
        m_impl->pending[k].reset();
        if (m_impl->running[k]) m_impl->running[k]->store(true);
    }

    void SearchWorker::CancelAll()
    {
        for (const SearchJobKind k : { SearchJobKind::Find, SearchJobKind::ReplaceAll, SearchJobKind::Cursors, SearchJobKind::Count })
            Cancel(k);
    }

    bool SearchWorker::WaitIdle(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout)
    {
        std::unique_lock lock(m_impl->mutex);
        return m_impl->idle.wait_for(lock, timeout, [&] { return !m_impl->busy && !m_impl->AnyPending(); });
    }

    std::span<const ByteRange> VisibleMatchCache::Get(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, const CompiledQuery& query, std::uint64_t generation,
                                                      std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow, const SearchLimits& limits)
    {
        if (m_valid && m_version == snapshot.version && m_generation == generation && m_firstRow == firstRow && m_lastRow == lastRow)
            return m_matches;
        SearchResult r = TextSearch::SearchRows(snapshot, query, firstRow, lastRow, limits);
        m_matches = std::move(r.matches);
        m_status = r.status;
        m_message = std::move(r.message);
        m_version = snapshot.version;
        m_generation = generation;
        m_firstRow = firstRow;
        m_lastRow = lastRow;
        m_valid = true;
        ++m_recomputes;
        return m_matches;
    }
}

    CHECK(Marks("  x", WhitespaceMode::Boundary) == Marked{ { 0, S }, { 1, S } });

    std::string error;
    auto doc = Editor::TextDocument::Open(path, Editor::TextDocumentServices{}, error);
    REQUIRE(doc);
    ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
    ImGuiContext* ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(1280, 800);
    io.IniFilename = nullptr;
    unsigned char* px = nullptr; int w = 0, h = 0;
    io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
    Recorder rec;
    doc->View().AddOverlay(&rec);
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
    {
        io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(900, 600), ImGuiCond_Always);
        bool close = false;
        doc->Draw(close);
        ImGui::Render();
    }
    CHECK(rec.frames == 2);
    CHECK(rec.background == std::vector<std::uint32_t>{ 0, 1, 2, 3 });
    CHECK(rec.foreground == rec.background);
    CHECK(rec.gutter == rec.background);
    CHECK(rec.texts == std::vector<std::string>{ "alpha", "beta", "gamma", "" });
    CHECK(rec.rowsAgree);
    doc->View().RemoveOverlay(&rec);
    doc.reset();
    ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);
    std::filesystem::remove(path);
}

TEST_CASE("Text view: SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow reads back while pending, applies at the next Draw, clamps to the last display row", "[text-view]")
{
    const std::filesystem::path path = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "te4-top-row.txt";
    {
        std::ofstream out(path, std::ios::binary);
        for (int i = 0; i < 200; ++i) out << "line " << i << "\n";   // 201 display rows (the empty last one)
    }
    std::string error;
    auto doc = Editor::TextDocument::Open(path, Editor::TextDocumentServices{}, error);
    REQUIRE(doc);
    ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
    ImGuiContext* ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(1280, 800);
    io.IniFilename = nullptr;
    unsigned char* px = nullptr; int w = 0, h = 0;
    io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
    const auto frame = [&] {
        io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(900, 600), ImGuiCond_Always);
        bool close = false;
        doc->Draw(close);
        ImGui::Render();
    };
    Editor::TextEditorView& view = doc->View();
    frame();
    CHECK(view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow() == 0u);
    CHECK(view.VisibleRowCount() == view.Facts().visibleRows);
    CHECK(view.VisibleRowCount() > 0u);

    view.SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow(40);
    CHECK(view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow() == 40u);                      // pending: read back before any Draw
    frame();
    CHECK(view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow() == 40u);                      // applied in that frame's geometry
    CHECK(view.Facts().firstVisibleRow == 40u);                       // no folds: buffer row == display row
    CHECK(view.LastVisibleDisplayRow() == 40u + view.VisibleRowCount() - 1u);

    view.SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow(100000);
    CHECK(view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow() == 100000u);                  // pending values are not clamped
    frame();
    CHECK(view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow() == view.Display().DisplayRowCount() - 1u);   // clamped at Draw: 200

    doc.reset();
    ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);
    std::filesystem::remove(path);
}
// The folded-file clamp (a request past the end lands on DisplayRowCount() - 1
// of the FOLDED map) is in TE4-12's tests: folds on the model arrive there.

```cpp
#pragma once

// Pure layout for the text area's extras (text editor spec s5.1; TE4-9, TE4-16):
// whitespace marks, indent guides, rulers, the gutter's columns, scrollbar
// ticks. No ImGui: the overlays (View/TextAreaOverlays, GutterOverlays,
// ScrollbarOverlay) turn these into draw calls.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    // = Editor::RenderWhitespace by ordinal (editor.text.renderWhitespace).
    enum class WhitespaceMode : std::uint8_t { None = 0, Boundary = 1, Selection = 2, All = 3 };
    enum class WhitespaceKind : std::uint8_t { Space, Tab };
    struct WhitespaceMark { std::uint32_t byteCol = 0; WhitespaceKind kind = WhitespaceKind::Space; };

    // Boundary: every tab, and every space except a single one between two non-whitespace
    // characters. Selection: whitespace inside `selectedCols` (line-relative byte ranges).
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<WhitespaceMark> WhitespaceMarks(std::string_view line, WhitespaceMode mode,
                                                              std::span<const ByteRange> selectedCols);

    // The leading whitespace's width in columns (tabs to the next stop); nullopt = a blank line.
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::uint32_t> MeasureIndent(std::string_view line, std::uint32_t tabSize);

    // Guide columns per row of a visible block: one at every multiple of indentSize below the
    // row's indent. A blank row takes min(previous non-blank, next non-blank); `above`/`below`
    // are the nearest non-blank rows outside the block (nullopt = none, counts as 0).
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::vector<std::uint32_t>> IndentGuideColumns(std::span<const std::optional<std::uint32_t>> indents,
                                                                             std::optional<std::uint32_t> above,
                                                                             std::optional<std::uint32_t> below,
                                                                             std::uint32_t indentSize);

    // editor.text.rulers: "80, 120" -> {80, 120}; junk, zero and duplicates are dropped; sorted.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::uint32_t> ParseRulers(std::string_view text);

    // The gutter, left to right: bookmark/Problems markers, line numbers, fold arrows.
    struct GutterColumns
    {
        float markerX = 0.0f, markerW = 0.0f;
        float numbersX = 0.0f, numbersW = 0.0f;
        float foldX = 0.0f, foldW = 0.0f;
        float total = 0.0f;
    };
    // Markers and folds are one line-height square each, around the numbers column TE2 sizes
    // (GutterWidth: 0 when line numbers are off).
    [[nodiscard]] GutterColumns ComputeGutterColumns(float numbersWidth, float lineHeight);
}

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/TextLayoutExtras.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextLayoutExtras.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <charconv>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    std::vector<WhitespaceMark> WhitespaceMarks(std::string_view line, WhitespaceMode mode, std::span<const ByteRange> selected)
    {
        std::vector<WhitespaceMark> out;
        if (mode == WhitespaceMode::None) return out;
        const auto isWs = [&](std::size_t i) { return i < line.size() && (line[i] == ' ' || line[i] == '\t'); };
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < line.size(); ++i)
        {
            const char c = line[i];
            if (c != ' ' && c != '\t') continue;
            if (mode == WhitespaceMode::Boundary && c == ' ' && i > 0 && !isWs(i - 1) && i + 1 < line.size() && !isWs(i + 1)) continue;
            if (mode == WhitespaceMode::Selection
                && std::none_of(selected.begin(), selected.end(), [&](const ByteRange& r) { return i >= r.begin && i < r.end; }))
                continue;
            out.push_back({ static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i), c == '\t' ? WhitespaceKind::Tab : WhitespaceKind::Space });
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::optional<std::uint32_t> MeasureIndent(std::string_view line, std::uint32_t tabSize)
    {
        tabSize = std::max<std::uint32_t>(1, tabSize);
        std::uint32_t col = 0;
        for (const char c : line)
        {
            if (c == ' ') ++col;
            else if (c == '\t') col += tabSize - col % tabSize;
            else return col;
        }
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    std::vector<std::vector<std::uint32_t>> IndentGuideColumns(std::span<const std::optional<std::uint32_t>> indents,
                                                               std::optional<std::uint32_t> above, std::optional<std::uint32_t> below,
                                                               std::uint32_t indentSize)
    {
        indentSize = std::max<std::uint32_t>(1, indentSize);
        const std::size_t n = indents.size();
        std::vector<std::optional<std::uint32_t>> prev(n), next(n);
        std::optional<std::uint32_t> run = above;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) { if (indents[i]) run = indents[i]; prev[i] = run; }
        run = below;
        for (std::size_t i = n; i-- > 0;) { if (indents[i]) run = indents[i]; next[i] = run; }
        std::vector<std::vector<std::uint32_t>> out(n);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        {
            const std::uint32_t width = indents[i] ? *indents[i] : std::min(prev[i].value_or(0), next[i].value_or(0));
            for (std::uint32_t c = 0; c < width; c += indentSize) out[i].push_back(c);
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::vector<std::uint32_t> ParseRulers(std::string_view text)
    {
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> out;
        std::size_t i = 0;
        while (i < text.size())
        {
            const std::size_t comma = std::min(text.find(',', i), text.size());
            std::string_view tok = text.substr(i, comma - i);
            while (!tok.empty() && (tok.front() == ' ' || tok.front() == '\t')) tok.remove_prefix(1);
            while (!tok.empty() && (tok.back() == ' ' || tok.back() == '\t')) tok.remove_suffix(1);
            std::uint32_t v = 0;
            const auto [p, ec] = std::from_chars(tok.data(), tok.data() + tok.size(), v);
            if (!tok.empty() && ec == std::errc{} && p == tok.data() + tok.size() && v > 0) out.push_back(v);
            i = comma + 1;
        }
        std::sort(out.begin(), out.end());
        out.erase(std::unique(out.begin(), out.end()), out.end());
        return out;
    }

    GutterColumns ComputeGutterColumns(float numbersWidth, float lineHeight)
    {
        GutterColumns g;
        g.markerX = 0.0f;
        g.markerW = lineHeight;
        g.numbersX = g.markerW;
        g.numbersW = std::max(0.0f, numbersWidth);
        g.foldX = g.numbersX + g.numbersW;
        g.foldW = lineHeight;
        g.total = g.foldX + g.foldW;
        return g;
    }
}

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextViewOverlay.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// The text view's paint/click seam (text editor spec s5.1; TE4-9). Row
// decorations -- current line, rulers, indent guides, whitespace, search
// matches, bracket boxes, fold arrows, bookmark and Problems markers,
// scrollbar annotations -- are overlays the view calls at fixed points of its
// Draw, in registration order, so TextEditorView stays the one place that lays
// rows out and every decoration is drawn from the same row geometry.

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextLayoutExtras.hpp"

#include <imgui.h>
#include <imgui_internal.h>   // ImRect

#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class TextEditorView;

    struct TextRowPaint
    {
        ImDrawList* drawList = nullptr;
        const TextEditorView* view = nullptr;
        std::uint32_t bufferRow = 0, displayRow = 0;
        ImVec2 rowMin{}, rowMax{};      // the row's band across the text area, screen space
        float textX = 0.0f;             // screen x of byte column 0 (after horizontal scroll)
        std::string_view text;          // the row's bytes, no line break; valid during the call
        float spaceWidth = 0.0f;        // the advance of ' ' in the text font (rulers, guides)
        std::function<float(std::uint32_t byteCol)> xAt;   // screen x of a byte column on this row (the row's LineCursor)
    };

    struct TextGutterPaint
    {
        ImDrawList* drawList = nullptr;
        const TextEditorView* view = nullptr;
        std::uint32_t bufferRow = 0, displayRow = 0;
        ImVec2 rowMin{}, rowMax{};      // the row's band across the gutter
        Text::GutterColumns columns{};
        bool gutterHovered = false;     // the mouse is anywhere over the gutter this frame
    };

    struct TextGutterClick
    {
        std::uint32_t bufferRow = 0;
        float xInGutter = 0.0f;
        ImGuiMouseButton button = ImGuiMouseButton_Left;
        Text::GutterColumns columns{};
    };

    struct TextScrollbarPaint
    {
        ImDrawList* drawList = nullptr;
        const TextEditorView* view = nullptr;
        ImRect track{};
        std::uint32_t displayRowCount = 0;
    };

    class ITextViewOverlay
    {
    public:
        virtual ~ITextViewOverlay() = default;
        virtual void BeginFrame(const TextEditorView&) {}
        virtual void RowBackground(const TextRowPaint&) {}       // under selections and text
        virtual void RowForeground(const TextRowPaint&) {}       // over text and carets
        virtual void Gutter(const TextGutterPaint&) {}
        virtual bool GutterClicked(const TextGutterClick&) { return false; }   // true = consumed (the view does nothing else)
        virtual void Scrollbar(const TextScrollbarPaint&) {}
    };
}
```

        void RemoveOverlay(ITextViewOverlay* overlay);

        // TE4 forwarding accessors (TE2's TextModel and TextViewFacts underneath).

        [[nodiscard]] Text::DisplayMap& Display() noexcept { return Model().display; }

In `Draw`, after TE2 computes `displayRows` and `g.lineH` and before `g.rows = VisibleDisplayRows(ImGui::GetScrollY(), ...)`, apply a pending top row to THIS frame's scroll (ImGui's `SetScrollY` would only land next frame), and record the display row the frame actually starts at right after `g.rows` is computed:

```cpp
#pragma once

// Text-area overlays (text editor spec s5.1; TE4-9): the current-line band,
// column rulers, indent guides and whitespace marks (TextAreaOverlay), and
// search-match backgrounds with a distinct active match (SearchHighlightOverlay,
// fed by the find bar and, in TE5, by vim's hlsearch).

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextLayoutExtras.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextViewOverlay.hpp"

#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class TextAreaOverlay final : public ITextViewOverlay
    {
    public:
        // The document's indent width (TE4-18: detected or set), the guides' step.
        explicit TextAreaOverlay(std::function<std::uint32_t()> indentWidth);
        void BeginFrame(const TextEditorView& view) override;
        void RowBackground(const TextRowPaint& p) override;
        void RowForeground(const TextRowPaint& p) override;

    private:
        std::function<std::uint32_t()> m_indentWidth;
        bool m_currentLine = true;
        bool m_guides = true;
        Text::WhitespaceMode m_whitespace = Text::WhitespaceMode::Selection;
        std::uint32_t m_tabSize = 4;
        std::string m_rulerText;
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> m_rulers;
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> m_caretRows;                 // sorted
        std::vector<Text::ByteRange> m_selected;                // non-empty selections
        std::unordered_map<std::uint32_t, std::vector<std::uint32_t>> m_guideColumns;   // this frame's visible rows
    };

    struct MatchHighlights
    {
        std::span<const Text::ByteRange> matches;   // sorted, disjoint; valid for this frame
        std::optional<Text::ByteRange> active;
    };

    class SearchHighlightOverlay final : public ITextViewOverlay
    {
    public:
        explicit SearchHighlightOverlay(std::function<MatchHighlights()> source) : m_source(std::move(source)) {}
        void BeginFrame(const TextEditorView&) override { m_now = m_source ? m_source() : MatchHighlights{}; }
        void RowBackground(const TextRowPaint& p) override;

    private:
        std::function<MatchHighlights()> m_source;
        MatchHighlights m_now;
    };
}

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextAreaOverlays.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/TextAreaOverlays.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp"
#include "Widgets/EditorTheme.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    TextAreaOverlay::TextAreaOverlay(std::function<std::uint32_t()> indentWidth) : m_indentWidth(std::move(indentWidth)) {}

    void TextAreaOverlay::BeginFrame(const TextEditorView& view)
    {
        const TextSettings& s = Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>();
        m_currentLine = s.highlightCurrentLine;
        m_guides = s.indentGuides;
        m_whitespace = static_cast<Text::WhitespaceMode>(s.renderWhitespace);
        m_tabSize = std::max<std::uint32_t>(1, m_indentWidth ? m_indentWidth() : static_cast<std::uint32_t>(s.tabSize));
        if (s.rulers != m_rulerText) { m_rulerText = s.rulers; m_rulers = Text::ParseRulers(m_rulerText); }

        const Text::Rope& rope = view.Buffer().Text();
        m_caretRows.clear();
        m_selected.clear();
        for (const Text::Selection& sel : view.Selections().All())
        {
            m_caretRows.push_back(rope.OffsetToPoint(sel.head).row);
            if (sel.anchor != sel.head) m_selected.push_back({ std::min(sel.anchor, sel.head), std::max(sel.anchor, sel.head) });
        }
        std::sort(m_caretRows.begin(), m_caretRows.end());

        m_guideColumns.clear();
        if (!m_guides) return;
        const std::uint32_t firstD = view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow(), lastD = view.LastVisibleDisplayRow();
        if (lastD < firstD) return;
        std::string line;
        const auto indentOf = [&](std::uint32_t row)
        {
            line.clear();
            rope.CopyTo({ rope.LineStart(row), rope.LineEnd(row) }, line);
            return Text::MeasureIndent(line, m_tabSize);
        };
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> rows;
        std::vector<std::optional<std::uint32_t>> indents;
        for (std::uint32_t d = firstD; d <= lastD; ++d)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = view.Display().DisplayRowToBuffer(d);
            rows.push_back(row);
            indents.push_back(indentOf(row));
        }
        // The nearest non-blank rows outside the view, looked for at most one view-height away.
        const std::uint32_t span = lastD - firstD + 1;
        std::optional<std::uint32_t> above, below;
        for (std::uint32_t k = 1; k <= span && rows.front() >= k && !above; ++k) above = indentOf(rows.front() - k);
        for (std::uint32_t k = 1; k <= span && rows.back() + k < rope.LineCount() && !below; ++k) below = indentOf(rows.back() + k);
        const auto columns = Text::IndentGuideColumns(indents, above, below, m_tabSize);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < rows.size(); ++i) m_guideColumns[rows[i]] = columns[i];
    }

    void TextAreaOverlay::RowBackground(const TextRowPaint& p)
    {
        if (m_currentLine && std::binary_search(m_caretRows.begin(), m_caretRows.end(), p.bufferRow))
            p.drawList->AddRectFilled(p.rowMin, p.rowMax, ImGui::GetColorU32(Theme::kPanelRaised));
        const float space = p.spaceWidth;
        for (const std::uint32_t col : m_rulers)
        {
            const float x = std::floor(p.textX + static_cast<float>(col) * space) + 0.5f;
            p.drawList->AddLine(ImVec2(x, p.rowMin.y), ImVec2(x, p.rowMax.y), ImGui::GetColorU32(Theme::kBorder));
        }
    }

    void TextAreaOverlay::RowForeground(const TextRowPaint& p)
    {
        const float space = p.spaceWidth;
        if (const auto it = m_guideColumns.find(p.bufferRow); it != m_guideColumns.end())
        {
            const ImU32 guide = ImGui::GetColorU32(Theme::WithAlpha(Theme::kTextDim, 0.25f));
            for (const std::uint32_t col : it->second)
            {
                const float x = std::floor(p.textX + static_cast<float>(col) * space) + 0.5f;
                p.drawList->AddLine(ImVec2(x, p.rowMin.y), ImVec2(x, p.rowMax.y), guide);
            }
        }
        if (m_whitespace == Text::WhitespaceMode::None) return;
        std::vector<Text::ByteRange> selectedCols;
        if (m_whitespace == Text::WhitespaceMode::Selection)
        {
            const Text::ByteOffset ls = p.view->Buffer().Text().LineStart(p.bufferRow);
            const Text::ByteOffset le = ls + p.text.size();
            for (const Text::ByteRange& s : m_selected)
                if (s.end > ls && s.begin <= le) selectedCols.push_back({ std::max(s.begin, ls) - ls, std::min(s.end, le) - ls });
            if (selectedCols.empty()) return;
        }
        const ImU32 dim = ImGui::GetColorU32(Theme::WithAlpha(Theme::kTextDim, 0.6f));
        const float cy = (p.rowMin.y + p.rowMax.y) * 0.5f;
        const float dot = std::max(1.0f, (p.rowMax.y - p.rowMin.y) * 0.06f);
        for (const Text::WhitespaceMark& m : Text::WhitespaceMarks(p.text, m_whitespace, selectedCols))
        {
            const float x0 = p.xAt(m.byteCol);
            const float x1 = p.xAt(m.byteCol + 1);
            if (m.kind == Text::WhitespaceKind::Space)
            {
                p.drawList->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2((x0 + x1) * 0.5f, cy), dot, dim);
                continue;
            }
            const float pad = dot * 2.0f;                               // a tab: a line with an arrow head
            p.drawList->AddLine(ImVec2(x0 + pad, cy), ImVec2(x1 - pad, cy), dim);
            p.drawList->AddLine(ImVec2(x1 - pad - pad, cy - pad), ImVec2(x1 - pad, cy), dim);
            p.drawList->AddLine(ImVec2(x1 - pad - pad, cy + pad), ImVec2(x1 - pad, cy), dim);
        }
    }

    void SearchHighlightOverlay::RowBackground(const TextRowPaint& p)
    {
        if (m_now.matches.empty() && !m_now.active) return;
        const Text::ByteOffset ls = p.view->Buffer().Text().LineStart(p.bufferRow);
        const Text::ByteOffset le = ls + p.text.size();
        const float thin = std::max(1.0f, ImGui::GetFontSize() * 0.12f);
        const auto paint = [&](Text::ByteRange r, ImU32 color)
        {
            if (r.end < ls || r.begin > le) return;
            const auto c0 = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::max(r.begin, ls) - ls);
            const auto c1 = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::min(r.end, le) - ls);
            const float x0 = p.xAt(c0);
            float x1 = p.xAt(c1);
            if (r.end > le) x1 += p.spaceWidth;                           // the match continues past the line break
            if (x1 - x0 < thin) x1 = x0 + thin;                           // an empty match is a thin bar
            p.drawList->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(x0, p.rowMin.y), ImVec2(x1, p.rowMax.y), color);
        };
        const ImU32 other = ImGui::GetColorU32(Theme::WithAlpha(Theme::kAmber, 0.30f));
        const auto first = std::lower_bound(m_now.matches.begin(), m_now.matches.end(), ls,
                                            [](const Text::ByteRange& m, Text::ByteOffset v) { return m.end < v; });
        for (auto it = first; it != m_now.matches.end() && it->begin <= le; ++it) paint(*it, other);
        if (m_now.active) paint(*m_now.active, ImGui::GetColorU32(Theme::WithAlpha(Theme::kAccent, 0.55f)));
    }
}
```

### Task TE4-10: `FindBarModel` -- the find bar's state machine (spec s5.2, s3.2)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/SearchForward.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/SearchForward.cpp` (D-R4: worker results carried to the current version through the edit log)
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/FindBarModel.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/FindBarModel.cpp`
- Modify: `premake5.lua` ArcaneTests `files` (append `FindBarModel.cpp`; `SearchForward.cpp` is in `TextEditor/Core/`, which TE1's `ArcaneText` globs)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/SearchForwardTest.cpp`, `ArcaneTests/src/Text/FindBarModelTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE4-4..8 (`SearchQuery`, `CompiledQuery`, `TextSearch::{Compile, ForEachMatch, NormalizeScope}`, `SearchLimits`, `SearchStatus`, `SearchWorker`, `SearchJob` (incl. the Count top-up fields and `notEmptyAtFrom`), `SearchJobResult` (incl. `snapshot`), `VisibleMatchCache`, `ExpandReplacement`, `CheckCursorCount`, `SearchCommands::{ReplaceAll, ReplaceOne, SelectRanges(TextCommands&, ...)}`); TE1 `AnchorSet` (`Add -> Id`, `Get`, `Clear`), `Anchor`, `TextBuffer::{RegisterAnchors(AnchorSet&), UnregisterAnchors, Snapshot, Version, Text, EditsSince, EditLogCovers, AppendExternal (test)}`, `EditLogEntry{version, firstRow, lastRowBefore, rowDelta}`, `RopeSnapshot`, `Rope::{OffsetToPoint, LineStart, LineCount, Substr}`, `class TextCommands` (`SetSelections` through TE4-7's `SearchCommands::SelectRanges`; `InsertText` in tests), `SelectionSet::{Primary, All, Size, SetSingle}`; **TE3-14/16 `std::optional<std::uint32_t> MapRowForward(std::uint32_t row, std::span<const EditLogEntry> edits) noexcept`** (`TextEditor/Syntax/HighlightCache.hpp`) and TE1's gap rule as TE3-14's `Sync` applies it (`!EditLogCovers(v) || edits.empty() || edits.front().version != v + 1` = a gap).
- Produces:
  - (namespace `Arcane::Text`, `Core/SearchForward.hpp`) `std::optional<std::span<const EditLogEntry>> EditsSinceCovered(const TextBuffer&, std::uint64_t fromVersion)`; `std::optional<ByteRange> MapRangeForward(ByteRange, const Rope& from, std::span<const EditLogEntry>, const Rope& to)`; `struct EditedRows { std::uint32_t first, lastBefore, lastAfter; }`; `std::optional<EditedRows> EditedRowSpan(std::span<const EditLogEntry>, std::uint32_t rowsBefore)`.
  - `struct FindBarFrame { Text::SelectionSet* selections; std::string_view wordChars; Text::SearchLimits limits; std::uint32_t firstVisibleRow, lastVisibleRow, scrollbarBuckets, maxCursors; }`; `class FindBarModel` -- `Open(bool replace, const SelectionSet&)`, `Open(std::string query, bool replace)` (TE6's call), `Close()`, `IsOpen()`, `ReplaceMode()/SetReplaceMode`, `QueryText()/SetQueryText`, `ReplaceText()/SetReplaceText`, `Regex()/SetRegex`, `CaseSensitive()/SetCaseSensitive`, `WholeWord()/SetWholeWord`, `InSelection()/SetInSelection(bool, const SelectionSet&)`, `Update(const FindBarFrame&)`, `Next()`, `Previous()`, `Replace()`, `ReplaceAll()`, `SelectAllAsCursors()`, `PendingCursorConfirmation()`, `PendingCursorCount()`, `ConfirmCursors(bool)`, `VisibleMatches()`, `ActiveMatch()`, `CountText()` (`"3 of 17"`, `"17 results"`, `"No results"`, `"..."` only before any count applied for the current query; a `~` before the total when it is approximate), `ErrorText()`, `Buckets()`, `Generation()`, `SetRevealHandler(std::function<void(Text::ByteRange)>)`, `Worker()`.

**Results across versions (D-R4, rev-2 4.3).** A worker result is computed on a snapshot at version V and read at version W. Before rev 2 the bar applied it only when V == W and otherwise asked again, so on a log under Follow (a new version every poll) the count stayed `...` and Find / Replace All / Alt+Enter re-scanned forever. Now every result is CARRIED to W through TE1's edit log with the highlight cache's own mapping -- `MapRowForward` (TE3-16) over `EditsSince(V)` under TE1's gap rule (`EditsSinceCovered`); no second mechanism:
- a match range maps when every row it spans survives (`MapRangeForward`); a row an edit touched drops the match (only a log gap -- over 4096 batches -- makes the bar ask again);
- Find's match, the active match, Replace All's edits, Alt+Enter's ranges and a multi-line count's visible matches are carried this way; Replace All reports how many matches it skipped because their lines changed while it ran;
- the count is KEPT (`"17 results"` from the last count, never `...` again for the same query) and brought up to date by TE4-8's top-up: `EditedRowSpan` names the rows the log touched in V and in W (every row above and below them maps one to one -- `MapRowForward` agrees, a property test checks it), and the worker recounts only those rows. On a Follow append those rows are the old last row and the appended tail, so the top-up scans only the tail. A count in flight is never superseded just because the version moved (that was the starvation); only a new question -- query, active match, histogram height -- replaces it;
- a multi-line query has no top-up (a match may span an untouched and a touched row), so its kept count is marked approximate (`~17 results`) until a full count lands; a line-path count is exact for its version and needs no mark.

Also here: a query change cancels the Find, Replace All and Alt+Enter requests still in flight for the old query (rev-2 4.4); Next after an empty match and Replace of an empty match continue PAST it (`notEmptyAtFrom`, rev-2 4.6), so `x*` -> `-` steps `"ab"` to `"-a-b-"` instead of inserting at one place forever; every selection change goes through `TextCommands` (`SelectRanges`, rev-2 4.11).

`ArcaneTests/src/Text/SearchForwardTest.cpp`:

```cpp
// TE4-10 (D-R4, spec s3.2): search results carried to a newer version through TE1's edit
// log with TE3-16's MapRowForward -- a range moves with edits elsewhere and is dropped when
// an edit touched its row; EditedRowSpan agrees with MapRowForward.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include <rapidcheck.h>
#include <rapidcheck/catch.h>
#include "TextEditor/Core/SearchForward.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/HighlightCache.hpp"   // MapRowForward
#include <algorithm>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

TEST_CASE("Search forward: a range moves with an edit elsewhere and is dropped by an edit on its row", "[text-search]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("aa\nbb needle\ncc\n"), EolMap());
    const RopeSnapshot before = buf.Snapshot();
    const ByteRange needle{ 6, 12 };                             // row 1
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(0, 0);
    TextCommands(buf, sels).InsertText("top\n");                 // a row inserted above it
    std::optional<std::span<const EditLogEntry>> edits = EditsSinceCovered(buf, before.version);
    REQUIRE(edits.has_value());
    const std::optional<ByteRange> moved = MapRangeForward(needle, before.rope, *edits, buf.Text());
    REQUIRE(moved.has_value());
    CHECK(buf.Text().Substr(*moved) == "needle");
    const RopeSnapshot mid = buf.Snapshot();
    sels.SetSingle(buf.Text().LineStart(2), buf.Text().LineStart(2));
    TextCommands(buf, sels).InsertText("x");                     // typed on the needle's row
    edits = EditsSinceCovered(buf, mid.version);
    REQUIRE(edits.has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(MapRangeForward(*moved, mid.rope, *edits, buf.Text()).has_value());
    REQUIRE(EditsSinceCovered(buf, buf.Version()).has_value());
    CHECK(EditsSinceCovered(buf, buf.Version())->empty());       // nothing since now: nothing to map
}

TEST_CASE("Search forward: a multi-line range survives only when every row it spans does", "[text-search]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb\nc\nd\n"), EolMap());
    const RopeSnapshot before = buf.Snapshot();
    const ByteRange span{ 2, 6 };                                // "b\nc\n": rows 1..3 (it ends at row 3's start)
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(4, 4);
    TextCommands(buf, sels).InsertText("C");                     // row 2, inside the span
    const auto edits = EditsSinceCovered(buf, before.version);
    REQUIRE(edits.has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(MapRangeForward(span, before.rope, *edits, buf.Text()).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE("Search forward: a log that no longer reaches back is a gap", "[text-search]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("x"), EolMap());
    const std::uint64_t old = buf.Version();
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4100; ++i)                               // TE1 keeps the newest 4096 batches
    {
        const EditOp op{ { 0, 0 }, "y" };
        buf.BeginTransaction(sels);
        buf.Edit(std::span<const EditOp>(&op, 1));
        buf.EndTransaction(sels);
    }
    CHECK_FALSE(EditsSinceCovered(buf, old).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE("Search forward: EditedRowSpan agrees with MapRowForward -- rows outside it are untouched and map one to one (property)", "[text-search]")
{
    rc::prop("random edit batches", [] {
        const int initialRows = *rc::gen::inRange(1, 30);
        std::string text;
        for (int i = 0; i < initialRows; ++i) text += "r" + std::to_string(i) + "\n";
        TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8(text), EolMap());
        const RopeSnapshot before = buf.Snapshot();
        SelectionSet sels;
        sels.SetSingle(0, 0);
        const int batches = *rc::gen::inRange(1, 6);
        for (int k = 0; k < batches; ++k)
        {
            const ByteOffset size = buf.Text().Size();
            const ByteOffset at = *rc::gen::inRange<ByteOffset>(0, size + 1);
            const ByteOffset len = *rc::gen::inRange<ByteOffset>(0, std::min<ByteOffset>(size - at, 8) + 1);
            const std::string insert = *rc::gen::element<std::string>("", "x", "\n", "y\nz\n");
            if (len == 0 && insert.empty()) continue;
            const EditOp op{ { at, at + len }, insert };
            buf.BeginTransaction(sels);
            buf.Edit(std::span<const EditOp>(&op, 1));
            buf.EndTransaction(sels);
        }
        const auto log = EditsSinceCovered(buf, before.version);
        RC_ASSERT(log.has_value());
        if (log->empty()) return;
        const std::uint32_t rowsBefore = before.rope.LineCount(), rowsAfter = buf.Text().LineCount();
        const std::optional<EditedRows> span = EditedRowSpan(*log, rowsBefore);
        RC_ASSERT(span.has_value());
        RC_ASSERT(span->first <= span->lastBefore);
        RC_ASSERT(span->first <= span->lastAfter);
        RC_ASSERT(rowsBefore - 1 - span->lastBefore == rowsAfter - 1 - span->lastAfter);
        const auto line = [](const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row) { return r.Substr({ r.LineStart(row), r.LineEnd(row) }); };
        for (std::uint32_t row = 0; row < rowsBefore; ++row)
        {
            if (row >= span->first && row <= span->lastBefore) continue;
            const std::uint32_t now = row < span->first ? row : row - span->lastBefore + span->lastAfter;
            RC_ASSERT(MapRowForward(row, *log) == std::optional<std::uint32_t>(now));   // TE3-16's mapping agrees
            RC_ASSERT(line(before.rope, row) == line(buf.Text(), now));              // and the row is untouched
        }
    });
}

`ArcaneTests/src/Text/FindBarModelTest.cpp`:

```cpp
// TE4-10 (spec s5.2, s3.2): the find bar's model -- type-to-search from where
// the bar opened, "3 of 17", next/previous, Replace / Replace All (one undo),
// Alt+Enter behind maxCursors, in-selection, errors; results computed on an
// older version are carried forward through the edit log (D-R4).
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/FindBarModel.hpp"
#include <chrono>
#include <string>

using namespace Arcane;
using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    SearchLimits Lim()
    {
        SearchLimits l;
        l.regex.matchLimit = 10000000;
        l.regex.depthLimit = 100000;
        l.multilineMaxBytes = 1u << 20;
        return l;
    }
    std::string Needles(int n)
    {
        std::string s;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) s += "line " + std::to_string(i) + " needle\n";
        return s;
    }
    Editor::FindBarFrame Frame(SelectionSet& sels, std::uint32_t maxCursors = 10000)
    {
        Editor::FindBarFrame f;
        f.selections = &sels;
        f.wordChars = "A-Za-z0-9_";
        f.limits = Lim();
        f.firstVisibleRow = 0;
        f.lastVisibleRow = 1000;
        f.scrollbarBuckets = 10;
        f.maxCursors = maxCursors;
        return f;
    }
    void Settle(Editor::FindBarModel& m, const Editor::FindBarFrame& f)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i)
        {
            m.Update(f);
            REQUIRE(m.Worker().WaitIdle(std::chrono::seconds(5)));
        }
        m.Update(f);
    }
    bool Selected(const SelectionSet& s, ByteRange r)
    {
        const Selection& p = s.Primary();
        return std::min(p.anchor, p.head) == r.begin && std::max(p.anchor, p.head) == r.end;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("Find bar model: typing searches from where the bar opened; '3 of 17'; next and previous", "[text-findbar]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8(Needles(17)), EolMap());
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(buf.Text().LineStart(2), buf.Text().LineStart(2));
    Editor::FindBarModel m(buf);
    m.Open(false, sels);
    m.SetQueryText("needle");
    const auto f = Frame(sels);
    Settle(m, f);
    REQUIRE(m.ActiveMatch().has_value());
    CHECK(m.ActiveMatch()->begin == buf.Text().LineStart(2) + 7);
    CHECK(Selected(sels, *m.ActiveMatch()));
    CHECK(m.CountText() == "3 of 17");
    CHECK(m.VisibleMatches().size() == 17);
    CHECK(m.Buckets().size() == 10);
    m.Next();
    Settle(m, f);
    CHECK(m.CountText() == "4 of 17");
    m.Previous();
    Settle(m, f);
    CHECK(m.CountText() == "3 of 17");
}

TEST_CASE("Find bar model: an edit drops the active match on its row; the count is kept, then brought up to date", "[text-findbar]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8(Needles(17)), EolMap());
    SelectionSet sels;
    Editor::FindBarModel m(buf);
    m.Open(false, sels);
    m.SetQueryText("needle");
    const auto f = Frame(sels);
    Settle(m, f);
    REQUIRE(m.ActiveMatch().has_value());
    sels.SetSingle(0, 0);
    TextCommands(buf, sels).InsertText("needle ");
    CHECK_FALSE(m.ActiveMatch().has_value());                    // its row was edited: matches are never anchors (spec s3.2)
    m.Update(f);
    CHECK_FALSE(m.ActiveMatch().has_value());                    // carried forward: dropped, not moved onto other text
    CHECK(m.CountText() == "17 results");                        // D-R4: the last count is kept, never "..." again
    Settle(m, f);
    CHECK(m.CountText() == "18 results");
    REQUIRE(m.VisibleMatches().size() == 18);
    CHECK(m.VisibleMatches()[0].begin == 0);
}

TEST_CASE("Find bar model: a log that grows every poll keeps a count that updates and settles, never '...' (D-R4)", "[text-findbar]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8(Needles(2000)), EolMap());
    SelectionSet sels;
    Editor::FindBarModel m(buf);
    m.Open(false, sels);
    m.SetQueryText("needle");
    const auto f = Frame(sels);
    Settle(m, f);
    REQUIRE(m.CountText() == "1 of 2000");
    for (int i = 0; i < 40; ++i)
    {
        buf.AppendExternal("line " + std::to_string(2000 + i) + " needle\n");   // Follow (TE1): one batch, no undo entry
        m.Update(f);                                             // the result in hand is one append behind
        const std::string text = m.CountText();
        INFO(text);
        REQUIRE(text.rfind("1 of ", 0) == 0);                    // never "...", the active match kept its index
        CHECK(std::stoull(text.substr(5)) == static_cast<unsigned long long>(2000 + i));   // and the total moves on
        REQUIRE(m.Worker().WaitIdle(std::chrono::seconds(5)));   // the top-up (only the tail) finishes
    }
    Settle(m, f);
    CHECK(m.CountText() == "1 of 2040");                         // the log stopped: the count settles, exact

    m.Next();
    m.Update(f);                                                 // the Find is submitted ...
    REQUIRE(m.Worker().WaitIdle(std::chrono::seconds(5)));
    buf.AppendExternal("line 9999 needle\n");                    // ... and the log grows before it is read
    m.Update(f);                                                 // carried forward and applied, not asked again
    REQUIRE(m.ActiveMatch().has_value());
    CHECK(m.ActiveMatch()->begin == buf.Text().LineStart(1) + 7);
    CHECK(Selected(sels, *m.ActiveMatch()));
}

TEST_CASE("Find bar model: Replace All is one undo step; Replace uses capture groups on the active match only", "[text-findbar]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8(Needles(17)), EolMap());
    SelectionSet sels;
    Editor::FindBarModel m(buf);
    m.Open(true, sels);
    m.SetQueryText("needle");
    m.SetReplaceText("pin");
    const auto f = Frame(sels);
    Settle(m, f);
    m.ReplaceAll();
    Settle(m, f);
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString().find("needle") == std::string::npos);
    CHECK(buf.Undo(sels));
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == Needles(17));

    TextBuffer kv(Rope::FromUtf8("k1=v1\nk2=v2"), EolMap());
    SelectionSet kvSels;
    Editor::FindBarModel r(kv);
    r.Open(true, kvSels);
    r.SetRegex(true);
    r.SetQueryText("(k\\d)=(v\\d)");
    r.SetReplaceText("$2=$1");
    const auto kf = Frame(kvSels);
    Settle(r, kf);
    REQUIRE(r.ActiveMatch().has_value());
    CHECK(r.ActiveMatch()->begin == 0);
    r.Replace();
    Settle(r, kf);
    CHECK(kv.Text().ToString() == "v1=k1\nk2=v2");
    REQUIRE(r.ActiveMatch().has_value());
    CHECK(r.ActiveMatch()->begin == 6);                          // Replace moved on to the next match
}

{

    const auto f = Frame(sels);

    CHECK(m.ActiveMatch()->begin == 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
    {
        m.Replace();
        Settle(m, f);
    }
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "-a-b-");                     // Perl's s/x*/-/g, one press per match
}

TEST_CASE("Find bar model: changing the query drops a find still in flight for the old one", "[text-findbar]")
{
    // rev-2 4.4: Recompile did not cancel it, so a stale result moved the selection while the error showed.
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8(Needles(17)), EolMap());
    SelectionSet sels;
    Editor::FindBarModel m(buf);
    m.Open(false, sels);
    m.SetQueryText("needle");
    const auto f = Frame(sels);
    Settle(m, f);
    REQUIRE(m.ActiveMatch().has_value());
    const Selection before = sels.Primary();
    m.Next();
    m.Update(f);                                                 // the Find for "needle" is submitted ...
    REQUIRE(m.Worker().WaitIdle(std::chrono::seconds(5)));       // ... and done, its result queued
    m.SetRegex(true);
    m.SetQueryText("(");                                         // ... when the query turns invalid
    m.Update(f);
    CHECK_FALSE(m.ErrorText().empty());
    CHECK(sels.Primary().anchor == before.anchor);               // the old query's result never landed
    CHECK(sels.Primary().head == before.head);
}

    const auto f = Frame(sels);
    Settle(m, f);
    CHECK(m.CountText().find("4") != std::string::npos);        // rows 0..3 continue onto a "line ..." row
    buf.AppendExternal("line 5 needle\n");
    m.Update(f);
    CHECK(m.CountText().find("~4") != std::string::npos);        // kept, but a spanning match may have changed
    Settle(m, f);
    CHECK(m.CountText().find("~") == std::string::npos);
    CHECK(m.CountText().find("5") != std::string::npos);
}
