```cpp
#pragma once

// Search results across versions (text editor spec s3.2, D-R4; TE4-10). Matches are
// never anchors: a worker result computed at version V is carried to the current
// version through TE1's edit log with TE3-16's MapRowForward under TE1's gap rule --
// the highlight cache's mechanism, not a second one. A range whose rows an edit
// touched is dropped; every other row's bytes are unchanged, so its columns hold.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <span>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    // EditsSince(from) when the log reaches back to `from` (TE1's gap rule, as TE3-14's Sync
    // applies it); nullopt = a gap, nothing can be carried. Empty = the buffer is still at `from`.
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::span<const EditLogEntry>> EditsSinceCovered(const TextBuffer& buffer, std::uint64_t from);

    // `range` of `from` in `to`'s coordinates, `edits` taking `from` to `to`; nullopt when an edit
    // touched any row the range spans (a range ending at a row's start spans that row too).
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<ByteRange> MapRangeForward(ByteRange range, const Rope& from, std::span<const EditLogEntry> edits,
                                                           const Rope& to);

    // The rows `edits` touched: [first, lastBefore] before them, [first, lastAfter] after. Every row
    // above `first` keeps its number and every row below the span keeps its distance from the end;
    // both are untouched (MapRowForward maps them the same way). nullopt = no edits.
    struct EditedRows
    {
        std::uint32_t first = 0;
        std::uint32_t lastBefore = 0;
        std::uint32_t lastAfter = 0;
    };
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<EditedRows> EditedRowSpan(std::span<const EditLogEntry> edits, std::uint32_t rowsBefore);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/SearchForward.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/SearchForward.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Syntax/HighlightCache.hpp"   // MapRowForward (TE3-14/16)

#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    std::optional<std::span<const EditLogEntry>> EditsSinceCovered(const TextBuffer& buffer, std::uint64_t from)
    {
        if (from == buffer.Version()) return std::span<const EditLogEntry>{};
        if (from > buffer.Version() || !buffer.EditLogCovers(from)) return std::nullopt;
        const std::span<const EditLogEntry> edits = buffer.EditsSince(from);
        if (edits.empty() || edits.front().version != from + 1) return std::nullopt;   // TE1's gap rule
        return edits;
    }

    std::optional<ByteRange> MapRangeForward(ByteRange range, const Rope& from, std::span<const EditLogEntry> edits, const Rope& to)
    {
        const std::uint32_t first = from.OffsetToPoint(range.begin).row;
        const std::uint32_t last = from.OffsetToPoint(range.end).row;
        std::optional<std::uint32_t> mappedFirst;
        for (std::uint32_t row = first; row <= last; ++row)   // a multi-line match: every row it spans survives, in step
        {
            const std::optional<std::uint32_t> mapped = MapRowForward(row, edits);
            if (!mapped) return std::nullopt;
            if (!mappedFirst) mappedFirst = *mapped;
            else if (*mapped != *mappedFirst + (row - first)) return std::nullopt;
        }
        const std::uint32_t mappedLast = *mappedFirst + (last - first);
        return ByteRange{ to.LineStart(*mappedFirst) + (range.begin - from.LineStart(first)),
                          to.LineStart(mappedLast) + (range.end - from.LineStart(last)) };
    }

    std::optional<EditedRows> EditedRowSpan(std::span<const EditLogEntry> edits, std::uint32_t rowsBefore)
    {
        if (edits.empty() || rowsBefore == 0) return std::nullopt;
        std::uint32_t first = std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max();
        std::int64_t rows = rowsBefore;                       // the row count before each entry
        std::int64_t tail = rowsBefore;                       // trailing rows no entry so far has touched
        for (const EditLogEntry& e : edits)
        {
            // Each entry is in the coordinates the one before it left (TE1's contract): rows above
            // its firstRow are not moved, rows after its lastRowBefore move by rowDelta untouched.
            first = std::min(first, e.firstRow);
            tail = std::min<std::int64_t>(tail, std::max<std::int64_t>(0, rows - 1 - static_cast<std::int64_t>(e.lastRowBefore)));
            rows += e.rowDelta;
        }
        EditedRows out;
        out.first = first;
        out.lastBefore = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(rowsBefore) - 1 - tail);
        out.lastAfter = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(rows - 1 - tail);
        return out;
    }
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/FindBarModel.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// The find bar's state machine (text editor spec s5.2; TE4-10). No ImGui
// (FindBar.cpp draws it). Counting, finding and collecting run on its own
// SearchWorker against snapshots; the visible rows' matches come from a
// VisibleMatchCache recomputed per snapshot. A worker result computed on an older
// version is carried to the current one through the edit log (D-R4,
// SearchForward.hpp); the count is kept and topped up over the rows the log
// touched. Commands are REQUESTS the next Update() runs, so every selection change
// happens inside Update with that frame's view, through TextCommands (spec s2.1).

#include "TextEditor/Core/Anchor.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/SearchCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/SearchWorker.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct FindBarFrame
    {
        Text::SelectionSet* selections = nullptr;   // the focused view's (TE4-17)
        std::string_view wordChars;                 // the grammar's (whole word)
        Text::SearchLimits limits;                  // SearchLimitsFromSettings (TE4-11)
        std::uint32_t firstVisibleRow = 0, lastVisibleRow = 0;   // buffer rows
        std::uint32_t scrollbarBuckets = 0;         // the scrollbar track's height in pixels (TE4-16)
        std::uint32_t maxCursors = 0;               // editor.text.maxCursors
    };

    class FindBarModel
    {
    public:
        explicit FindBarModel(Text::TextBuffer& buffer);
        ~FindBarModel();
        FindBarModel(const FindBarModel&) = delete;
        FindBarModel& operator=(const FindBarModel&) = delete;

        // Seeds the query from a single-line primary selection; a multi-line one turns on
        // in-selection instead. Type-to-search starts from the selection's start.
        void Open(bool replace, const Text::SelectionSet& sels);
        void Open(std::string query, bool replace);   // TE6 (and spec 2) open the bar on a given query
        void Close();
        [[nodiscard]] bool IsOpen() const noexcept { return m_open; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool ReplaceMode() const noexcept { return m_replaceMode; }
        void SetReplaceMode(bool on) noexcept { m_replaceMode = on; }

        [[nodiscard]] const std::string& QueryText() const noexcept { return m_query.text; }
        void SetQueryText(std::string text);
        [[nodiscard]] const std::string& ReplaceText() const noexcept { return m_replacement; }
        void SetReplaceText(std::string text) { m_replacement = std::move(text); }
        [[nodiscard]] bool Regex() const noexcept { return m_query.regex; }
        void SetRegex(bool on);
        [[nodiscard]] bool CaseSensitive() const noexcept { return m_query.caseSensitive; }
        void SetCaseSensitive(bool on);
        [[nodiscard]] bool WholeWord() const noexcept { return m_query.wholeWord; }
        void SetWholeWord(bool on);
        [[nodiscard]] bool InSelection() const noexcept { return m_inSelection; }
        void SetInSelection(bool on, const Text::SelectionSet& sels);

        void Update(const FindBarFrame& frame);   // once per frame while open (UI thread)

        void Next()               { m_request = Request::Next; }
        void Previous()           { m_request = Request::Previous; }
        void Replace()            { m_request = Request::Replace; }
        void ReplaceAll()         { m_request = Request::ReplaceAll; }
        void SelectAllAsCursors() { m_request = Request::Cursors; }   // spec s5.2: Alt+Enter
        [[nodiscard]] bool PendingCursorConfirmation() const noexcept { return !m_pendingCursors.empty(); }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t PendingCursorCount() const noexcept { return m_pendingCursors.size(); }
        void ConfirmCursors(bool create) { m_confirm = create ? Confirm::Yes : Confirm::No; }

        [[nodiscard]] std::span<const Text::ByteRange> VisibleMatches() const noexcept { return m_visible; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<Text::ByteRange> ActiveMatch() const noexcept;
        [[nodiscard]] std::string CountText() const;                      // "3 of 17", "17 results", "No results", "...", "~17 results"
        [[nodiscard]] const std::string& ErrorText() const noexcept { return m_error; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::span<const std::uint32_t> Buckets() const noexcept;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t Generation() const noexcept { return m_generation; }
        void SetRevealHandler(std::function<void(Text::ByteRange)> fn) { m_reveal = std::move(fn); }   // unfold + scroll (TE4-24)
        [[nodiscard]] Text::SearchWorker& Worker() noexcept { return m_worker; }

    private:
        enum class Request : std::uint8_t { None, Incremental, Next, Previous, Replace, ReplaceAll, Cursors };
        enum class Confirm : std::uint8_t { None, Yes, No };
        // The question a count answers. A new VERSION is not a new question: the last count is
        // carried and topped up (D-R4); only these replace a count in flight.
        struct CountKey
        {
            std::uint64_t generation = 0;
            std::optional<Text::ByteOffset> active;
            std::uint32_t buckets = 0, firstRow = 0, lastRow = 0;
            bool operator==(const CountKey&) const = default;
        };
        // The count shown: the last result that applied, for the version it was computed at.
        struct AppliedCount
        {
            Text::RopeSnapshot snapshot;
            std::uint64_t total = 0;
            std::uint64_t currentIndex = 0;                 // 1-based index of `current` (0 = none)
            std::optional<Text::ByteOffset> current;        // the active match it indexed, in snapshot's coordinates
            Text::SearchStatus status = Text::SearchStatus::Complete;
            std::vector<std::uint32_t> buckets;
            bool approximate = false;                       // a multi-line count carried across edits
        };

        Text::SearchJob Job(Text::SearchJobKind kind, const Text::RopeSnapshot& snap, const FindBarFrame& f) const;
        void Recompile(const FindBarFrame& f, const Text::RopeSnapshot& snap);
        // `range` of `from` in the buffer's current coordinates (D-R4); nullopt = dropped or a log gap.
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<Text::ByteRange> ToNow(Text::ByteRange range, const Text::RopeSnapshot& from) const;
        void CarryForward(const Text::RopeSnapshot& now);
        void Apply(Text::SearchJobResult& r, const FindBarFrame& f);
        void ProcessConfirmation(const FindBarFrame& f);
        void ProcessRequest(const FindBarFrame& f);
        void SubmitFind(Request origin, const Text::RopeSnapshot& snap, const FindBarFrame& f, Text::ByteOffset from, bool forward,
                        bool notEmptyAtFrom = false);
        void SubmitCountIfStale(const FindBarFrame& f, const Text::RopeSnapshot& snap);
        void SetActive(Text::ByteRange r, const Text::RopeSnapshot& now);

        Text::TextBuffer& m_buffer;
        Text::SearchWorker m_worker;
        Text::VisibleMatchCache m_cache;
        Text::AnchorSet m_scope;                       // in-selection ranges, as anchors
        std::vector<std::pair<Text::AnchorSet::Id, Text::AnchorSet::Id>> m_scopeIds;   // (begin, end) per range
        Text::SearchQuery m_query;
        std::string m_replacement;
        Text::CompiledQuery m_compiled;
        std::string m_error;
        bool m_open = false, m_replaceMode = false, m_inSelection = false, m_dirty = false, m_autoConfirm = false;
        std::uint64_t m_generation = 0, m_scopeVersion = 0;
        Text::ByteOffset m_searchStart = 0;
        std::vector<Text::ByteRange> m_visible;
        Text::RopeSnapshot m_visibleSnap;              // multi-line: the version m_visible is in
        std::optional<Text::ByteRange> m_active;
        Text::RopeSnapshot m_activeSnap;               // the version m_active is in
        std::optional<AppliedCount> m_count;
        std::uint64_t m_activeIndex = 0;               // m_count's index of the CURRENT active match (0 = unknown)
        CountKey m_countKey;
        std::uint64_t m_countTicket = 0, m_findTicket = 0, m_replaceAllTicket = 0, m_cursorsTicket = 0;
        Request m_findOrigin = Request::None;
        Request m_request = Request::None;
        Confirm m_confirm = Confirm::None;
        std::vector<Text::ByteRange> m_pendingCursors;
        Text::RopeSnapshot m_pendingSnap;              // the version m_pendingCursors are in
        std::function<void(Text::ByteRange)> m_reveal;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/FindBarModel.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/FindBarModel.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/SearchForward.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <format>
#include <utility>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        Text::ByteRange Ordered(const Text::Selection& s) { return { std::min(s.anchor, s.head), std::max(s.anchor, s.head) }; }
    }

    FindBarModel::FindBarModel(Text::TextBuffer& buffer) : m_buffer(buffer) { m_buffer.RegisterAnchors(m_scope); }

    FindBarModel::~FindBarModel()
    {
        m_worker.CancelAll();
        m_buffer.UnregisterAnchors(m_scope);
    }

    void FindBarModel::Open(bool replace, const Text::SelectionSet& sels)
    {
        m_open = true;
        m_replaceMode = replace;
        const Text::ByteRange r = Ordered(sels.Primary());
        m_searchStart = r.begin;
        if (r.end > r.begin)
        {
            const Text::Rope& rope = m_buffer.Text();
            if (rope.OffsetToPoint(r.begin).row == rope.OffsetToPoint(r.end).row)
            {
                std::string text;
                rope.CopyTo(r, text);
                SetQueryText(std::move(text));
            }
            else
            {
                SetInSelection(true, sels);
            }
        }
        m_dirty = true;
    }

    void FindBarModel::Open(std::string query, bool replace)
    {
        m_open = true;
        m_replaceMode = replace;
        SetQueryText(std::move(query));
        m_dirty = true;
    }

    void FindBarModel::Close()
    {
        m_open = false;
        m_worker.CancelAll();
        m_findTicket = m_replaceAllTicket = m_cursorsTicket = m_countTicket = 0;
        m_visible.clear();
        m_active.reset();
        m_pendingCursors.clear();
        m_request = Request::None;
        m_countKey = CountKey{};
    }

    void FindBarModel::SetQueryText(std::string text)
    {
        if (text == m_query.text) return;
        m_query.text = std::move(text);
        m_dirty = true;
    }
    void FindBarModel::SetRegex(bool on)         { if (on != m_query.regex)         { m_query.regex = on;         m_dirty = true; } }
    void FindBarModel::SetCaseSensitive(bool on) { if (on != m_query.caseSensitive) { m_query.caseSensitive = on; m_dirty = true; } }
    void FindBarModel::SetWholeWord(bool on)     { if (on != m_query.wholeWord)     { m_query.wholeWord = on;     m_dirty = true; } }

    void FindBarModel::SetInSelection(bool on, const Text::SelectionSet& sels)
    {
        m_scope.Clear();
        m_scopeIds.clear();
        if (on)
            for (const Text::Selection& s : sels.All())
                if (s.anchor != s.head)
                {
                    const Text::ByteRange r = Ordered(s);
                    m_scopeIds.emplace_back(m_scope.Add(Text::Anchor{ r.begin, Text::Bias::Right }),   // insertions at the edges stay outside
                                            m_scope.Add(Text::Anchor{ r.end, Text::Bias::Left }));
                }
        m_inSelection = !m_scopeIds.empty();
        m_dirty = true;
    }

    std::optional<Text::ByteRange> FindBarModel::ActiveMatch() const noexcept
    {
        if (m_active && m_activeSnap.version == m_buffer.Version()) return m_active;
        return std::nullopt;   // Update() carries it to a new version (or drops it) before anything reads it
    }

    std::span<const std::uint32_t> FindBarModel::Buckets() const noexcept
    {
        return m_count ? std::span<const std::uint32_t>(m_count->buckets) : std::span<const std::uint32_t>{};
    }

    std::string FindBarModel::CountText() const
    {
        if (m_query.text.empty() || !m_compiled.Valid()) return {};
        const std::optional<Text::ByteRange> active = ActiveMatch();
        if (!m_count) return active ? "? of ..." : "...";             // D-R4: only before any count applied for this query
        const std::string approx = m_count->approximate ? "~" : "";
        const std::string plus = m_count->status == Text::SearchStatus::Complete ? "" : "+";
        if (m_count->total == 0 && !m_count->approximate) return "No results";
        if (active && m_activeIndex > 0) return std::format("{} of {}{}{}", m_activeIndex, approx, m_count->total, plus);
        return std::format("{}{}{} {}", approx, m_count->total, plus, m_count->total == 1 ? "result" : "results");
    }

    Text::SearchJob FindBarModel::Job(Text::SearchJobKind kind, const Text::RopeSnapshot& snap, const FindBarFrame& f) const
    {
        Text::SearchJob j;
        j.kind = kind;
        j.snapshot = snap;
        j.query = m_compiled;
        j.limits = f.limits;
        return j;
    }

    void FindBarModel::Recompile(const FindBarFrame& f, const Text::RopeSnapshot& snap)
    {
        Text::SearchQuery q = m_query;
        q.scope.clear();
        if (m_inSelection)
            for (const auto& [begin, end] : m_scopeIds) q.scope.push_back({ m_scope.Get(begin).offset, m_scope.Get(end).offset });
        m_scopeVersion = snap.version;
        // Only the in-selection anchors moved (an edit, not the user): when the ranges came out the
        // same -- a Follow append past them -- the query, its count and its results all still stand.
        if (!m_dirty && Text::TextSearch::NormalizeScope(q.scope) == m_compiled.scope) return;
        m_compiled = Text::TextSearch::Compile(q, f.wordChars);
        m_error = m_compiled.error;
        ++m_generation;
        m_cache.Invalidate();
        m_worker.Cancel(Text::SearchJobKind::Count);                 // a count of the old query must not land as this one's
        m_countTicket = 0;
        m_count.reset();                                             // a new question: "..." until its first count
        m_activeIndex = 0;
        m_visible.clear();
        if (m_dirty)
        {
            // rev-2 4.4: anything still in flight answers the OLD query -- it must never land.
            m_worker.Cancel(Text::SearchJobKind::Find);
            m_worker.Cancel(Text::SearchJobKind::ReplaceAll);
            m_worker.Cancel(Text::SearchJobKind::Cursors);
            m_findTicket = m_replaceAllTicket = m_cursorsTicket = 0;
            m_pendingCursors.clear();
            m_active.reset();
            if (m_compiled.Valid()) m_request = Request::Incremental;   // type-to-search: from where the bar opened
        }
        m_dirty = false;
    }

    std::optional<Text::ByteRange> FindBarModel::ToNow(Text::ByteRange range, const Text::RopeSnapshot& from) const
    {
        if (from.version == m_buffer.Version()) return range;
        const std::optional<std::span<const Text::EditLogEntry>> edits = Text::EditsSinceCovered(m_buffer, from.version);
        if (!edits) return std::nullopt;                             // a log gap: nothing can be carried
        return Text::MapRangeForward(range, from.rope, *edits, m_buffer.Text());
    }

    void FindBarModel::SetActive(Text::ByteRange r, const Text::RopeSnapshot& now)
    {
        m_active = r;
        m_activeSnap = now;
    }

    // D-R4: the active match and a multi-line query's visible matches follow the text to `now`;
    // a match whose row an edit touched is dropped. Then the count's index is re-checked.
    void FindBarModel::CarryForward(const Text::RopeSnapshot& now)
    {
        if (m_active && m_activeSnap.version != now.version)
        {
            const std::optional<Text::ByteRange> moved = ToNow(*m_active, m_activeSnap);
            if (moved) SetActive(*moved, now);
            else m_active.reset();
        }
        if (m_compiled.multiline && !m_visible.empty() && m_visibleSnap.version != now.version)
        {
            std::vector<Text::ByteRange> kept;
            for (const Text::ByteRange& v : m_visible)
                if (const std::optional<Text::ByteRange> moved = ToNow(v, m_visibleSnap)) kept.push_back(*moved);
            m_visible = std::move(kept);
            m_visibleSnap = now;
        }
        // The count indexes the active match when it was computed for it and nothing above it changed.
        m_activeIndex = 0;
        const std::optional<Text::ByteRange> active = ActiveMatch();
        if (!active || !m_count || !m_count->current || m_count->currentIndex == 0) return;
        if (m_count->snapshot.version == now.version)
        {
            if (*m_count->current == active->begin) m_activeIndex = m_count->currentIndex;
            return;
        }
        const std::optional<std::span<const Text::EditLogEntry>> edits = Text::EditsSinceCovered(m_buffer, m_count->snapshot.version);
        if (!edits) return;
        const std::optional<Text::EditedRows> span = Text::EditedRowSpan(*edits, m_count->snapshot.rope.LineCount());
        if (span && m_count->snapshot.rope.OffsetToPoint(*m_count->current).row < span->first && *m_count->current == active->begin)
            m_activeIndex = m_count->currentIndex;                   // above every edit: the matches before it are the same
    }

    void FindBarModel::Update(const FindBarFrame& f)
    {
        if (!m_open || !f.selections) return;
        Text::RopeSnapshot snap = m_buffer.Snapshot();
        if (m_dirty || (m_inSelection && snap.version != m_scopeVersion)) Recompile(f, snap);
        CarryForward(snap);
        while (std::optional<Text::SearchJobResult> r = m_worker.Poll()) Apply(*r, f);
        ProcessConfirmation(f);
        ProcessRequest(f);
        snap = m_buffer.Snapshot();                                  // a replace may have edited
        CarryForward(snap);
        if (m_compiled.Valid() && !m_compiled.multiline)
        {
            const std::span<const Text::ByteRange> v = m_cache.Get(snap, m_compiled, m_generation, f.firstVisibleRow, f.lastVisibleRow, f.limits);
            m_visible.assign(v.begin(), v.end());
            if (m_cache.Status() == Text::SearchStatus::MatchLimitHit) m_error = m_cache.Message();
        }
        else if (!m_compiled.Valid())
        {
            m_visible.clear();
        }
        SubmitCountIfStale(f, snap);
    }

    void FindBarModel::Apply(Text::SearchJobResult& r, const FindBarFrame& f)
    {
        const Text::RopeSnapshot now = m_buffer.Snapshot();
        switch (r.kind)
        {
        case Text::SearchJobKind::Find:
        {
            if (r.ticket != m_findTicket) return;
            m_findTicket = 0;
            if (r.status != Text::SearchStatus::Complete && !r.message.empty()) m_error = r.message;
            if (!r.found) return;                                    // no match then: not re-asked (D-R4)
            const std::optional<Text::ByteRange> found = ToNow(*r.found, r.snapshot);
            if (!found) { m_request = m_findOrigin; return; }        // its row changed meanwhile (or a log gap): ask again
            SetActive(*found, now);
            Text::TextCommands cmd(m_buffer, *f.selections);
            Text::SearchCommands::SelectRanges(cmd, std::span<const Text::ByteRange>(&*found, 1), found->begin);
            if (m_reveal) m_reveal(*found);
            return;
        }
        case Text::SearchJobKind::Count:
        {
            if (r.ticket != m_countTicket) return;
            m_countTicket = 0;
            AppliedCount c;
            c.snapshot = r.snapshot;
            c.total = r.total;
            c.currentIndex = r.currentIndex;
            c.current = m_countKey.active ? std::optional<Text::ByteOffset>(*m_countKey.active) : std::nullopt;
            c.status = r.status;
            c.buckets = std::move(r.bucketCounts);
            c.approximate = m_compiled.multiline && r.version != now.version;   // a spanning match may have changed (no top-up)
            m_count = std::move(c);
            if (m_compiled.multiline)
            {
                m_visible = std::move(r.visible);
                m_visibleSnap = r.snapshot;
            }
            if (r.status == Text::SearchStatus::TooLargeForMultiline || r.status == Text::SearchStatus::MatchLimitHit) m_error = r.message;
            CarryForward(now);
            return;
        }
        case Text::SearchJobKind::ReplaceAll:
        {
            if (r.ticket != m_replaceAllTicket) return;
            m_replaceAllTicket = 0;
            if (r.status != Text::SearchStatus::Complete)
            {
                m_error = r.message.empty() ? std::string("Replace All stopped: the search did not complete.") : r.message;
                return;
            }
            const std::optional<std::span<const Text::EditLogEntry>> edits = Text::EditsSinceCovered(m_buffer, r.version);
            if (!edits) { m_request = Request::ReplaceAll; return; }   // a log gap: collect again
            std::vector<Text::EditOp> ops;
            ops.reserve(r.edits.size());
            std::size_t skipped = 0;
            for (Text::EditOp& e : r.edits)
            {
                const std::optional<Text::ByteRange> moved = edits->empty() ? std::optional<Text::ByteRange>(e.range)
                                                                            : Text::MapRangeForward(e.range, r.snapshot.rope, *edits, m_buffer.Text());
                if (moved) ops.push_back(Text::EditOp{ *moved, std::move(e.text) });
                else ++skipped;
            }
            Text::SearchCommands::ReplaceAll(m_buffer, *f.selections, std::move(ops));   // spec s5.2: one undo step
            m_active.reset();
            if (skipped > 0)
                m_error = std::format("Replace All left {} match{} on lines that changed while it ran.", skipped, skipped == 1 ? "" : "es");
            return;
        }
        case Text::SearchJobKind::Cursors:
        {
            if (r.ticket != m_cursorsTicket) return;
            m_cursorsTicket = 0;
            const std::optional<std::span<const Text::EditLogEntry>> edits = Text::EditsSinceCovered(m_buffer, r.version);
            if (!edits) { m_request = Request::Cursors; return; }      // a log gap: collect again
            std::vector<Text::ByteRange> ranges;
            ranges.reserve(r.edits.size());
            for (const Text::EditOp& e : r.edits)
                if (const std::optional<Text::ByteRange> moved = edits->empty() ? std::optional<Text::ByteRange>(e.range)
                                                                                : Text::MapRangeForward(e.range, r.snapshot.rope, *edits, m_buffer.Text()))
                    ranges.push_back(*moved);
            const bool alreadyConfirmed = std::exchange(m_autoConfirm, false);
            const Text::CursorGate gate = Text::CheckCursorCount(ranges.size(), f.maxCursors);
            if (gate == Text::CursorGate::NeedsConfirmation && !alreadyConfirmed)
            {
                m_pendingCursors = std::move(ranges);
                m_pendingSnap = now;
            }
            else if (gate != Text::CursorGate::Empty)
            {
                Text::TextCommands cmd(m_buffer, *f.selections);
                Text::SearchCommands::SelectRanges(cmd, ranges, f.selections->Primary().head);
            }
            return;
        }
        }
    }

    void FindBarModel::ProcessConfirmation(const FindBarFrame& f)
    {
        const Confirm c = std::exchange(m_confirm, Confirm::None);
        if (c == Confirm::None || m_pendingCursors.empty()) return;
        if (c == Confirm::Yes)
        {
            const std::optional<std::span<const Text::EditLogEntry>> edits = Text::EditsSinceCovered(m_buffer, m_pendingSnap.version);
            if (edits)
            {
                std::vector<Text::ByteRange> ranges;                 // carried to now (D-R4); a touched row drops its cursor
                for (const Text::ByteRange& p : m_pendingCursors)
                    if (const std::optional<Text::ByteRange> moved = edits->empty() ? std::optional<Text::ByteRange>(p)
                                                                                    : Text::MapRangeForward(p, m_pendingSnap.rope, *edits, m_buffer.Text()))
                        ranges.push_back(*moved);
                Text::TextCommands cmd(m_buffer, *f.selections);
                Text::SearchCommands::SelectRanges(cmd, ranges, f.selections->Primary().head);
            }
            else
            {
                m_autoConfirm = true;                                // a log gap: collect again, already confirmed
                m_request = Request::Cursors;
            }
        }
        m_pendingCursors.clear();
    }

    void FindBarModel::SubmitFind(Request origin, const Text::RopeSnapshot& snap, const FindBarFrame& f, Text::ByteOffset from, bool forward,
                                  bool notEmptyAtFrom)
    {
        Text::SearchJob j = Job(Text::SearchJobKind::Find, snap, f);
        j.from = from;
        j.forward = forward;
        j.wrap = true;
        j.notEmptyAtFrom = notEmptyAtFrom;
        m_findOrigin = origin;
        m_findTicket = m_worker.Submit(std::move(j));
    }

    void FindBarModel::ProcessRequest(const FindBarFrame& f)
    {
        const Request req = std::exchange(m_request, Request::None);
        if (req == Request::None || !m_compiled.Valid()) return;
        const Text::RopeSnapshot snap = m_buffer.Snapshot();
        const Text::ByteRange sel = Ordered(f.selections->Primary());
        const std::optional<Text::ByteRange> active = ActiveMatch();
        switch (req)
        {
        case Request::Incremental:
            SubmitFind(req, snap, f, m_searchStart, true);
            break;
        case Request::Next:
            // After an empty match the next one starts AT its end but may not be that empty match again (rev-2 4.6).
            if (active) SubmitFind(req, snap, f, active->end, true, active->begin == active->end);
            else SubmitFind(req, snap, f, sel.end, true);
            break;
        case Request::Previous:
            SubmitFind(req, snap, f, active ? active->begin : sel.begin, false);
            break;
        case Request::Replace:
            if (active && sel.begin == active->begin && sel.end == active->end)
            {
                std::string text = m_replacement;
                if (m_query.regex)
                    Text::TextSearch::ForEachMatch(snap, m_compiled, { active->begin, active->begin + 1 }, f.limits, nullptr,
                                                   [&](const Text::SearchHit& h)
                    {
                        if (h.range.begin == active->begin && h.range.end == active->end)
                        {
                            text = Text::ExpandReplacement(m_replacement, h, true);
                            return false;
                        }
                        return true;
                    }, nullptr);
                Text::SearchCommands::ReplaceOne(m_buffer, *f.selections, *active, text);
                m_active.reset();
                // Continue after the replacement; an empty match replaced is not found again where it was (rev-2 4.6).
                SubmitFind(Request::Next, m_buffer.Snapshot(), f, active->begin + text.size(), true, active->begin == active->end);
            }
            else
            {
                SubmitFind(Request::Next, snap, f, sel.begin, true);   // select the next match first; the next Replace replaces it
            }
            break;
        case Request::ReplaceAll:
        {
            Text::SearchJob j = Job(Text::SearchJobKind::ReplaceAll, snap, f);
            j.replacement = m_replacement;
            j.regexReplacement = m_query.regex;
            m_replaceAllTicket = m_worker.Submit(std::move(j));
            break;
        }
        case Request::Cursors:
            m_cursorsTicket = m_worker.Submit(Job(Text::SearchJobKind::Cursors, snap, f));
            break;
        case Request::None:
            break;
        }
    }

    void FindBarModel::SubmitCountIfStale(const FindBarFrame& f, const Text::RopeSnapshot& snap)
    {
        if (!m_compiled.Valid()) return;
        CountKey key;
        key.generation = m_generation;
        if (const std::optional<Text::ByteRange> a = ActiveMatch()) key.active = a->begin;
        key.buckets = f.scrollbarBuckets;
        if (m_compiled.multiline) { key.firstRow = f.firstVisibleRow; key.lastRow = f.lastVisibleRow; }
        // The question: the query, the active match, the histogram height. A new version or a scroll
        // is not a new question.
        const bool sameQuestion = key.generation == m_countKey.generation && key.active == m_countKey.active
                               && key.buckets == m_countKey.buckets;
        // D-R4: a count in flight is never replaced because the version moved (or a Follow view
        // scrolled) -- that starved the count on a log under Follow. It is carried forward when it lands.
        if (m_countTicket != 0 && sameQuestion) return;
        if (m_countTicket == 0 && key == m_countKey && m_count && m_count->snapshot.version == snap.version) return;   // answered
        m_countKey = key;
        Text::SearchJob j = Job(Text::SearchJobKind::Count, snap, f);
        j.hasCurrent = key.active.has_value();
        j.current = key.active.value_or(0);
        j.buckets = f.scrollbarBuckets;
        j.wantVisible = m_compiled.multiline;
        j.visibleFirstRow = f.firstVisibleRow;
        j.visibleLastRow = f.lastVisibleRow;
        // The same question for a newer version: count only the rows the log touched (TE4-8's top-up),
        // when the last count was complete, the query is single-line and the log reaches back.
        if (m_countTicket == 0 && sameQuestion && m_count && !m_compiled.multiline && m_count->status == Text::SearchStatus::Complete
            && m_count->buckets.size() == f.scrollbarBuckets)
        {
            const std::optional<std::span<const Text::EditLogEntry>> edits = Text::EditsSinceCovered(m_buffer, m_count->snapshot.version);
            const std::optional<Text::EditedRows> span = edits ? Text::EditedRowSpan(*edits, m_count->snapshot.rope.LineCount())
                                                               : std::nullopt;
            if (span)
            {
                j.topUp = true;
                j.base = m_count->snapshot;
                j.baseFirstRow = span->first;
                j.baseLastRow = span->lastBefore;
                j.firstRow = span->first;
                j.lastRow = span->lastAfter;
                j.baseTotal = m_count->total;
                j.baseBuckets = m_count->buckets;
                j.baseCurrentIndex = m_activeIndex;                  // CarryForward checked it indexes this active match
            }
        }
        if (!j.topUp && m_count && m_compiled.multiline && m_count->snapshot.version != snap.version) m_count->approximate = true;
        m_countTicket = m_worker.Submit(std::move(j));
    }
}
```

```cpp
// keys: typing searches, Enter / Shift+Enter move, Alt+Enter makes cursors,
// Escape closes.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include "TextEditor/View/FindBar.hpp"
#include <imgui.h>
#include <chrono>
#include <string>

using namespace Arcane;
using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    std::string Needles(int n)
    {
        std::string s;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) s += "line " + std::to_string(i) + " needle\n";
        return s;
    }
    struct Rig
    {
        ImGuiContext* prev = nullptr;
        ImGuiContext* ctx = nullptr;
        TextBuffer buf{ Rope::FromUtf8(Needles(17)), EolMap() };
        SelectionSet sels;
        Editor::FindBarModel model{ buf };
        Editor::FindBarUiState ui;
        Editor::FindBarFrame frame;
        Editor::FindBarDrawResult last;
        bool closed = false;                                     // any frame asked to close
        Rig()
        {
            prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
            ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
            ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
            ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
            io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(1280, 800);
            io.IniFilename = nullptr;
            unsigned char* px = nullptr; int w = 0, h = 0;
            io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
            frame.selections = &sels;
            frame.wordChars = "A-Za-z0-9_";
            frame.limits.regex.matchLimit = 10000000;
            frame.limits.regex.depthLimit = 100000;
            frame.limits.multilineMaxBytes = 1u << 20;
            frame.lastVisibleRow = 1000;
            frame.maxCursors = 10000;
        }
        ~Rig() { ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx); ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev); }
        void Frame()
        {
            ImGui::GetIO().DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
            ImGui::NewFrame();
            ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(0, 0));
            ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(1000, 200));
            ImGui::Begin("Doc");
            model.Update(frame);
            last = Editor::DrawFindBar(model, frame, ui);
            closed = closed || last.closeRequested;
            ImGui::End();
            ImGui::Render();
        }
        void Settle()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) { REQUIRE(model.Worker().WaitIdle(std::chrono::seconds(5))); Frame(); }
        }
        void Key(ImGuiKey key, ImGuiKey mod = ImGuiKey_None)
        {
            ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
            if (mod != ImGuiKey_None) io.AddKeyEvent(mod, true);
            io.AddKeyEvent(key, true);
            Frame();
            io.AddKeyEvent(key, false);
            if (mod != ImGuiKey_None) io.AddKeyEvent(mod, false);
            Frame();
        }
    };
}

TEST_CASE("Find bar: type, Enter, Shift+Enter, Alt+Enter, Escape", "[text-findbar]")
{
    Rig r;
    r.model.Open(false, r.sels);
    r.ui.focusQuery = true;
    r.Frame();
    r.Frame();
    ImGui::GetIO().AddInputCharactersUTF8("needle");
    r.Frame();
    CHECK(r.model.QueryText() == "needle");
    r.Settle();
    REQUIRE(r.model.ActiveMatch().has_value());
    CHECK(r.model.ActiveMatch()->begin == 7);                    // "line 0 needle"
    r.Key(ImGuiKey_Enter);
    r.Settle();
    CHECK(r.model.ActiveMatch()->begin == r.buf.Text().LineStart(1) + 7);
    r.Key(ImGuiKey_Enter, ImGuiMod_Shift);
    r.Settle();
    CHECK(r.model.ActiveMatch()->begin == 7);
    r.Key(ImGuiKey_Enter, ImGuiMod_Alt);
    r.Settle();
    CHECK(r.sels.Size() == 17);                                 // every match is a cursor
    r.ui.focusQuery = true;
    r.Frame();
    r.Key(ImGuiKey_Escape);
    CHECK(r.closed);
}

TEST_CASE("Find bar: above maxCursors, Alt+Enter opens the confirmation and Create cursors applies it", "[text-findbar]")
{
    Rig r;
    r.frame.maxCursors = 3;
    r.model.Open(false, r.sels);
    r.model.SetQueryText("needle");
    r.Settle();
    r.model.SelectAllAsCursors();
    r.Settle();
    REQUIRE(r.model.PendingCursorConfirmation());
    r.model.ConfirmCursors(true);                                // what the modal's button does
    r.Frame();
    CHECK(r.sels.Size() == 17);
    CHECK_FALSE(r.model.PendingCursorConfirmation());
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The search limits every text-editor search runs under, from the published
// editor.text.* settings (spec s4.2: bounded everywhere).

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    [[nodiscard]] inline Text::SearchLimits SearchLimitsFromSettings(const TextSettings& s)
    {
        Text::SearchLimits l;
        l.regex.matchLimit = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(s.regexMatchLimit);
        l.regex.depthLimit = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(s.regexDepthLimit);
        l.lineWindowBytes = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(s.longLineMaxBytes);
        l.multilineMaxBytes = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(s.multilineSearchMaxMB) << 20;
        return l;
    }
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The find bar (text editor spec s5.2; TE4-11): docked at the top of the text
// document. Regex / case / whole word / in-selection toggles, "3 of 17",
// Enter / Shift+Enter next / previous, Alt+Enter every match -> a cursor
// (behind the maxCursors question), Replace / Replace All in replace mode.

#include "TextEditor/View/FindBarModel.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct FindBarUiState
    {
        bool focusQuery = false;     // focus the query field on the next draw (Ctrl+F, after Enter)
        bool focusReplace = false;
        bool queryWasActive = false;     // last frame: Escape closes the bar from a field that is typing
        bool replaceWasActive = false;
    };

    struct FindBarDrawResult
    {
        bool closeRequested = false;
    };

    FindBarDrawResult DrawFindBar(FindBarModel& model, const FindBarFrame& frame, FindBarUiState& ui);

    // The "Create cursors?" modal (spec s3.2). nullopt while unanswered; true / false once answered.
    std::optional<bool> DrawCursorConfirmModal(bool pending, std::uint64_t count, std::uint32_t maxCursors);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/FindBar.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/FindBar.hpp"

#include "Input/EditorActions.hpp"
#include "Widgets/EditorTheme.hpp"
#include "Widgets/EditorWidgets.hpp"
#include "Widgets/IconsLucide.h"

#include <imgui.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        void Tooltip(const char* text)
        {
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_ForTooltip)) ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", text);
        }
    }

    std::optional<bool> DrawCursorConfirmModal(bool pending, std::uint64_t count, std::uint32_t maxCursors)
    {
        const char* id = "Create cursors?";
        if (pending && !ImGui::IsPopupOpen(id)) ImGui::OpenPopup(id);
        std::optional<bool> answer;
        if (ImGui::BeginPopupModal(id, nullptr, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize))
        {
            if (!pending)
            {
                ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
            }
            else
            {
                ImGui::Text("Turn %llu matches into cursors?", static_cast<unsigned long long>(count));
                ImGui::TextDisabled("That is more than editor.text.maxCursors (%u).", maxCursors);
                if (ImGui::Button("Create cursors")) { answer = true; ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup(); }
                ImGui::SameLine();
                if (ImGui::Button("Cancel") || EditorActions::Get().Pressed("ui.cancel")) { answer = false; ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup(); }
            }
            ImGui::EndPopup();
        }
        return answer;
    }

    FindBarDrawResult DrawFindBar(FindBarModel& model, const FindBarFrame& frame, FindBarUiState& ui)
    {
        FindBarDrawResult out;
        if (!model.IsOpen()) return out;
        // Escape closes the bar while one of its fields is being typed in. Read before the fields:
        // a field cancels itself on Escape, so it is no longer active once drawn.
        const bool cancel = (ui.queryWasActive || ui.replaceWasActive) && EditorActions::Get().Pressed("ui.cancel");
        ImGui::PushID("findbar");
        const float side = ImGui::GetFrameHeight();
        if (ImGui::Button(model.ReplaceMode() ? ICON_LC_CHEVRON_DOWN "##mode" : ICON_LC_CHEVRON_RIGHT "##mode", ImVec2(side, side)))
            model.SetReplaceMode(!model.ReplaceMode());
        Tooltip("Toggle replace");
        ImGui::SameLine();
        const float fieldWidth = std::max(side * 8.0f, ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x * 0.4f);

        if (ui.focusQuery) { ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere(); ui.focusQuery = false; }
        std::string query = model.QueryText();
        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(fieldWidth);
        const bool enter = InputTextString("##query", &query, ImGuiInputTextFlags_EnterReturnsTrue);
        const bool queryActive = ImGui::IsItemActive();
        if (query != model.QueryText()) model.SetQueryText(std::move(query));
        if (enter)
        {
            if (ImGui::GetIO().KeyShift) model.Previous();
            else model.Next();
            ui.focusQuery = true;                                    // keep typing in the field
        }
        // Alt+Enter: the single-line field does not validate on it (imgui_widgets.cpp:5151-5153), so it is read here.
        if (queryActive && ImGui::IsKeyChordPressed(ImGuiMod_Alt | ImGuiKey_Enter)) model.SelectAllAsCursors();

        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (IconToggle(ICON_LC_CASE_SENSITIVE "##case", model.CaseSensitive())) model.SetCaseSensitive(!model.CaseSensitive());
        Tooltip("Match case");
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (IconToggle(ICON_LC_WHOLE_WORD "##word", model.WholeWord())) model.SetWholeWord(!model.WholeWord());
        Tooltip("Match whole word");
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (IconToggle(ICON_LC_REGEX "##regex", model.Regex())) model.SetRegex(!model.Regex());
        Tooltip("Use regular expression");
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (IconToggle(ICON_LC_TEXT_SELECT "##insel", model.InSelection()) && frame.selections)
            model.SetInSelection(!model.InSelection(), *frame.selections);
        Tooltip("Find in selection");
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (!model.ErrorText().empty())
        {
            ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, Theme::kError);
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(model.ErrorText().c_str());
            ImGui::PopStyleColor();
        }
        else
        {
            const std::string count = model.CountText();
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(count.c_str());
        }
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (ImGui::Button(ICON_LC_ARROW_UP "##prev")) model.Previous();
        Tooltip("Previous match (Shift+Enter)");
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (ImGui::Button(ICON_LC_ARROW_DOWN "##next")) model.Next();
        Tooltip("Next match (Enter)");
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (ImGui::Button(ICON_LC_X "##close")) out.closeRequested = true;
        Tooltip("Close (Escape)");

        bool replaceActive = false;
        if (model.ReplaceMode())
        {
            ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(side, side));
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ui.focusReplace) { ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere(); ui.focusReplace = false; }
            std::string replacement = model.ReplaceText();
            ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(fieldWidth);
            const bool replaceEnter = InputTextString("##replace", &replacement, ImGuiInputTextFlags_EnterReturnsTrue);
            replaceActive = ImGui::IsItemActive();
            if (replacement != model.ReplaceText()) model.SetReplaceText(std::move(replacement));
            if (replaceEnter) { model.Replace(); ui.focusReplace = true; }
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::Button(ICON_LC_REPLACE " Replace")) model.Replace();
            Tooltip("Replace this match and find the next");
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::Button(ICON_LC_REPLACE_ALL " Replace All")) model.ReplaceAll();
            Tooltip("Replace every match (one undo step)");
        }

        ui.queryWasActive = queryActive;
        ui.replaceWasActive = replaceActive;
        if (cancel) out.closeRequested = true;
        if (const std::optional<bool> yes = DrawCursorConfirmModal(model.PendingCursorConfirmation(), model.PendingCursorCount(), frame.maxCursors))
            model.ConfirmCursors(*yes);
        ImGui::PopID();
        return out;
    }
}
```

  ```cpp
    FindBarFrame TextDocument::MakeFindFrame()
    {
        const TextSettings& s = Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>();
        TextEditorView& view = View();
        FindBarFrame f;
        f.selections = &view.Selections();
        const Text::GrammarSnapshot grammar = Grammar();
        f.wordChars = grammar ? std::string_view(grammar->Rules().Desc().wordChars) : std::string_view{};
        f.limits = SearchLimitsFromSettings(s);
        f.firstVisibleRow = view.Display().DisplayRowToBuffer(view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow());
        f.lastVisibleRow = view.Display().DisplayRowToBuffer(view.LastVisibleDisplayRow());
        f.scrollbarBuckets = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::max(1.0f, view.LineHeight() * static_cast<float>(
                                 view.LastVisibleDisplayRow() - view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow() + 1)));
        f.maxCursors = s.maxCursors;
        return f;
    }
  ```

### Task TE4-12: Folding UI -- folds on the view's model, gutter arrows, fold / unfold at the cursors, reveal (spec s3.6, s4.6, s5.1)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/FoldActions.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/FoldActions.cpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/GutterOverlays.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/GutterOverlays.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp` / `.cpp` (TE2-11: the model gains its `FoldModel`, the marker-fold generation and an edit observer that shifts the folds; `SyncDisplay()`'s body becomes `Text::SyncDisplay(folds, display, buffer.Text())`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp` (TE2-13: a `Folds()` accessor)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp` / `.cpp` (TE2-15: own and attach a `FoldGutterOverlay`; refresh the model's marker folds once per frame)
- Modify: `premake5.lua` ArcaneTests `files` (append `GutterOverlays.cpp`)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/FoldUiTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE1-12 `FoldModel` (`static IndentColumns`, `static IsBlank`, `static IndentRegionAt(const Rope&, row, tabSize)`, `static IndentRegions(const Rope&, tabSize)`, `Fold(const Rope&, FoldRange, FoldSource)`, `Unfold(const Rope&, row)` -- unfolds every fold headed at or hiding `row`, `UnfoldAll()`, `IsFoldedAt(const Rope&, header)`, `Folded(const Rope&)`, `OnEdits(std::span<const EditShift>)`), `FoldRange{headerRow, lastRow}` (`==` defaulted), `FoldSource::{Indent, Marker}`; TE3-19 `FoldModel::FoldableAt(const Rope&, std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t tabSize) const` (marker region first, else `IndentRegionAt`; CANON B20), `FoldModel::{MarkerFolds, MarkerFoldEnd}`, `MarkerFold{beginRow, endRow}`, `Text::RefreshMarkerFolds(FoldModel&, const HighlightCache&, std::uint64_t& seenGeneration)` (`Syntax/FoldMarkers.hpp`); TE1-13 `DisplayMap::{SetFolds(std::span<const FoldRange>, std::uint32_t rowCount), IsHidden, DisplayRowCount}`; TE1-8 `EditObserver::OnBufferEdited(std::span<const EditShift>, std::uint64_t)`, `TextBuffer::{AddObserver, RemoveObserver}`; TE1-14 `class TextCommands` (`Buffer()`, `Selections()`); TE2-11 `TextModel` (+ `SyncDisplay()` and its `displaySyncedVersion` / `displaySynced` bookkeeping), TE2-13 `TextEditorView::Draw` (calls `m_model->SyncDisplay()` first); TE2-15 `TextDocument::InitAfterLoad()` (D-R2); TE3-30 `TextDocument::Highlight() -> Text::HighlightCache*`; TE4-7 `AssignSelections(TextCommands&, std::span<const ByteRange>, std::size_t)`; TE4-9 overlay seam and `TextEditorView` accessors (`SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow` for the folded clamp case); TE1-15 `TextSettings::tabSize`.
- Produces: `Text::InnermostFoldHeader(const FoldModel&, const Rope&, std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t tabSize) -> std::optional<std::uint32_t>`; `Text::SyncDisplay(const FoldModel&, DisplayMap&, const Rope&)`; `Text::FoldCommands::{FoldAtCursors(FoldModel&, DisplayMap&, TextCommands&, std::uint32_t tabSize), UnfoldAtCursors(FoldModel&, DisplayMap&, const SelectionSet&, const Rope&), ToggleFoldAt(FoldModel&, DisplayMap&, const Rope&, std::uint32_t header, std::uint32_t tabSize), RevealSelections(FoldModel&, DisplayMap&, const SelectionSet&, const Rope&), FoldAll(FoldModel&, DisplayMap&, TextCommands&, std::uint32_t tabSize), UnfoldAll(FoldModel&, DisplayMap&, const Rope&)} -> bool` (CANON A5; `FoldAll` / `UnfoldAll` are vim's `zM` / `zR`; rev-2 4.11: the two that move carets out of new folds take the `TextCommands` they move them through -- its buffer's text is the rope -- instead of a bare `SelectionSet&` + `const Rope&`); `TextModel::folds`, `TextModel::editing`, `TextModel::followForeignEdits` (TE4-17), `TextModel::markerGeneration`, `TextModel::displaySyncedFolds`; `TextModel::SyncDisplay()` now also rebuilds when the folded set changed; `TextEditorView::Folds()`; `class Editor::FoldGutterOverlay`. There is no free `Text::FoldableAt`: every "is this row foldable" query is TE3-19's member. TE5a's `zc zo za zR zM zj zk` call these commands and the TE1/TE3 `FoldModel` members.

Folds are per view (spec s5.1), so they live on the view's `TextModel` next to its `DisplayMap`. TE1's `FoldModel` keeps folds as anchors and needs `OnEdits` on every edit, so the model registers an `EditObserver` on its buffer; TE4-17 extends the same observer to shift a split view's selections. `TextModel::SyncDisplay()` (TE2-11) is the one place the display map is rebuilt outside the fold commands: TE2-13's `Draw` and `DefaultEditContext` call it, and from this task it rebuilds when the buffer version OR the folded set changed (so a caller that folds through `FoldModel` directly -- TE5's vim, TE6-17's restore -- only has to call `model.SyncDisplay()`). Marker folds (TE3-19) come from the highlight cache: the document calls `Text::RefreshMarkerFolds` for each view's model once per frame.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

```cpp
// TE4-12 (spec s3.6, s4.6): folding from the keyboard and the gutter, through
// the view's DisplayMap; a caret never sits in hidden rows; folds follow edits.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include "TextEditor/Core/FoldActions.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/GutterOverlays.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp"
#include <imgui.h>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>

using namespace Arcane;
using namespace Arcane::Text;

TEST_CASE("Folding: the innermost foldable region around a row; fold / unfold at the cursors", "[text-fold]")
{
    Editor::TextModel m(Rope::FromUtf8("a\n  b\n  c\nd\n  e\n"));
    const Rope& rope = m.buffer.Text();
    SyncDisplay(m.folds, m.display, rope);
    CHECK(m.folds.FoldableAt(rope, 0, 4) == FoldRange{ 0, 2 });   // TE3-19's member is the one foldable query
    CHECK_FALSE(m.folds.FoldableAt(rope, 1, 4).has_value());
    CHECK(InnermostFoldHeader(m.folds, rope, 0, 4) == 0u);       // a header is inside its own region
    CHECK(InnermostFoldHeader(m.folds, rope, 1, 4) == 0u);
    CHECK(InnermostFoldHeader(m.folds, rope, 2, 4) == 0u);
    CHECK(InnermostFoldHeader(m.folds, rope, 3, 4) == 3u);
    CHECK(InnermostFoldHeader(m.folds, rope, 4, 4) == 3u);
    CHECK_FALSE(InnermostFoldHeader(m.folds, rope, 5, 4).has_value());

    m.selections.SetSingle(rope.LineStart(2) + 1, rope.LineStart(2) + 1);
    TextCommands cmd(m.buffer, m.selections);                     // carets leave a new fold through TextCommands (spec s2.1)
    CHECK(FoldCommands::FoldAtCursors(m.folds, m.display, cmd, 4));
    CHECK(m.folds.IsFoldedAt(rope, 0));
    CHECK(m.display.DisplayRowCount() == 4);
    CHECK(m.selections.Primary().head == rope.LineEnd(0));     // the caret left the hidden rows
    CHECK(FoldCommands::UnfoldAtCursors(m.folds, m.display, m.selections, rope));
    CHECK_FALSE(m.folds.IsFoldedAt(rope, 0));
    CHECK(m.display.DisplayRowCount() == 6);
}

TEST_CASE("Folding: toggling a header, revealing a caret that lands in a fold, folds follow an edit above", "[text-fold]")
{
    Editor::TextModel m(Rope::FromUtf8("a\n  b\n  c\nd\n  e\n"));
    SyncDisplay(m.folds, m.display, m.buffer.Text());
    CHECK(FoldCommands::ToggleFoldAt(m.folds, m.display, m.buffer.Text(), 3, 4));
    CHECK(m.folds.IsFoldedAt(m.buffer.Text(), 3));
    CHECK_FALSE(FoldCommands::ToggleFoldAt(m.folds, m.display, m.buffer.Text(), 1, 4));   // not a header
    m.selections.SetSingle(0, 0);
    TextCommands(m.buffer, m.selections).InsertText("top\n");    // a row inserted above: the fold moves down with its text
    CHECK(m.folds.IsFoldedAt(m.buffer.Text(), 4));
    const Rope& rope = m.buffer.Text();
    m.selections.SetSingle(rope.LineStart(5), rope.LineStart(5));   // a goto / a find landed inside the fold
    CHECK(FoldCommands::RevealSelections(m.folds, m.display, m.selections, rope));
    CHECK_FALSE(m.folds.IsFoldedAt(rope, 4));
    CHECK_FALSE(FoldCommands::RevealSelections(m.folds, m.display, m.selections, rope));   // nothing left to reveal
}

TEST_CASE("Folding: a click on the fold column toggles; the marker column and non-headers are not consumed", "[text-fold]")
{
    Editor::TextModel m(Rope::FromUtf8("a\n  b\n  c\nd\n  e\n"));
    SyncDisplay(m.folds, m.display, m.buffer.Text());
    Editor::FoldGutterOverlay overlay(m, [] { return 4u; });
    const GutterColumns cols = ComputeGutterColumns(32.0f, 16.0f);
    CHECK(overlay.GutterClicked({ 0, cols.foldX + 1.0f, ImGuiMouseButton_Left, cols }));
    CHECK(m.folds.IsFoldedAt(m.buffer.Text(), 0));
    CHECK(overlay.GutterClicked({ 0, cols.foldX + 1.0f, ImGuiMouseButton_Left, cols }));
    CHECK_FALSE(m.folds.IsFoldedAt(m.buffer.Text(), 0));
    CHECK_FALSE(overlay.GutterClicked({ 0, cols.markerX + 1.0f, ImGuiMouseButton_Left, cols }));
    CHECK_FALSE(overlay.GutterClicked({ 1, cols.foldX + 1.0f, ImGuiMouseButton_Left, cols }));
    CHECK_FALSE(overlay.GutterClicked({ 0, cols.foldX + 1.0f, ImGuiMouseButton_Right, cols }));
}

TEST_CASE("Folding: FoldAll folds every region (nested too) and moves carets out; UnfoldAll opens them all", "[text-fold]")
{
    // rows: 0 "a", 1 "  b", 2 "    c", 3 "  d", 4 "e", 5 "  f", 6 "" -- regions {0,3}, {1,2}, {4,5}
    Editor::TextModel m(Rope::FromUtf8("a\n  b\n    c\n  d\ne\n  f\n"));
    m.SyncDisplay();
    const Rope& rope = m.buffer.Text();
    m.selections.SetSingle(rope.LineStart(2) + 4, rope.LineStart(2) + 4);
    TextCommands cmd(m.buffer, m.selections);
    CHECK(FoldCommands::FoldAll(m.folds, m.display, cmd, 4));
    CHECK(m.folds.IsFoldedAt(rope, 0));
    CHECK(m.folds.IsFoldedAt(rope, 1));                            // the inner region is folded too (vim zM)
    CHECK(m.folds.IsFoldedAt(rope, 4));
    CHECK(m.display.DisplayRowCount() == 3u);                      // rows 0, 4, 6 stay visible
    CHECK(m.selections.Primary().head == rope.LineEnd(0));        // the caret left the hidden rows
    CHECK_FALSE(FoldCommands::FoldAll(m.folds, m.display, cmd, 4));   // nothing new to fold

    CHECK(FoldCommands::UnfoldAll(m.folds, m.display, rope));
    CHECK(m.folds.Folded(rope).empty());
    CHECK(m.display.DisplayRowCount() == 7u);
    CHECK_FALSE(FoldCommands::UnfoldAll(m.folds, m.display, rope));  // nothing folded
}

TEST_CASE("Folding: TextModel::SyncDisplay follows a fold made directly on the FoldModel (no version change)", "[text-fold]")
{
    Editor::TextModel m(Rope::FromUtf8("a\n  b\n  c\nd\n"));
    m.SyncDisplay();
    const std::uint64_t version = m.buffer.Version();
    CHECK(m.display.DisplayRowCount() == 5u);
    REQUIRE(m.folds.Fold(m.buffer.Text(), FoldRange{ 0, 2 }, FoldSource::Manual));   // vim zf / TE6-17's restore path
    m.SyncDisplay();
    CHECK(m.buffer.Version() == version);
    CHECK(m.display.DisplayRowCount() == 3u);
    m.folds.UnfoldAll();
    m.SyncDisplay();
    CHECK(m.display.DisplayRowCount() == 5u);
}

TEST_CASE("Folding: a top-row request past the end clamps to the FOLDED map's last display row (TE4-9's SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow)", "[text-fold][text-view]")
{
    const std::filesystem::path path = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "te4-fold-top-row.txt";
    {
        std::ofstream out(path, std::ios::binary);
        out << "root\n";
        for (int i = 0; i < 150; ++i) out << "    child " << i << "\n";   // rows 1..150 fold under row 0
        for (int i = 0; i < 49; ++i) out << "tail " << i << "\n";        // rows 151..199, then the empty row 200
    }
    std::string error;
    auto doc = Editor::TextDocument::Open(path, Editor::TextDocumentServices{}, error);
    REQUIRE(doc);
    ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
    ImGuiContext* ctx = ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(ctx);
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(1280, 800);
    io.IniFilename = nullptr;
    unsigned char* px = nullptr; int w = 0, h = 0;
```

```cpp
// Fold commands (text editor spec s3.6, s4.6; TE4-12): the keyboard and the
// gutter fold through the view's FoldModel + DisplayMap (folds are per view,
// spec s5.1). A caret never stays in hidden rows: folding moves it to the

#include "TextEditor/Core/FoldModel.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"

{

    // The header of the innermost foldable region containing `row` (a header row is in its own region).
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::uint32_t> InnermostFoldHeader(const FoldModel& folds, const Rope& rope, std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t tabSize);
```

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/FoldActions.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/SearchCommands.hpp"   // AssignSelections

#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        // The source a region folded from FoldModel::FoldableAt carries.
        FoldSource SourceAt(const FoldModel& folds, std::uint32_t header)
        {
            return folds.MarkerFoldEnd(header) ? FoldSource::Marker : FoldSource::Indent;
        }

        // A caret inside a fold moves to the end of the outermost folded header that hides it -- through
        // TextCommands: an undo-group boundary, then SetSelections (rev-2 4.11).
        void MoveCaretsOutOfFolds(const FoldModel& folds, const DisplayMap& display, TextCommands& cmd)
        {
            const Rope& rope = cmd.Buffer().Text();
            const SelectionSet& sels = cmd.Selections();
            const std::vector<FoldRange> folded = folds.Folded(rope);
            std::vector<ByteRange> ranges;
            std::size_t primary = 0;
            bool moved = false;
            const std::uint32_t primaryId = sels.Primary().id;
            for (const Selection& s : sels.All())
            {
                ByteOffset anchor = s.anchor, head = s.head;
                const std::uint32_t row = rope.OffsetToPoint(head).row;
                if (display.IsHidden(row))
                {
                    std::uint32_t header = row;
                    for (const FoldRange& r : folded)
                        if (row > r.headerRow && row <= r.lastRow) header = std::min(header, r.headerRow);
                    anchor = head = rope.LineEnd(header);
                    moved = true;
                }
                if (s.id == primaryId) primary = ranges.size();
                ranges.push_back({ anchor, head });
            }
            if (moved) AssignSelections(cmd, ranges, primary);
        }
    }

    std::optional<std::uint32_t> InnermostFoldHeader(const FoldModel& folds, const Rope& rope, std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t tabSize)
    {
        if (folds.IsFoldedAt(rope, row) || folds.FoldableAt(rope, row, tabSize)) return row;
        std::optional<std::uint32_t> best;
        for (const FoldRange& f : folds.Folded(rope))                         // manual / marker folds around the row
            if (row > f.headerRow && row <= f.lastRow && (!best || f.headerRow > *best)) best = f.headerRow;
        // Indentation: the nearest less-indented non-blank row above whose region reaches the row.
        std::string line;
        const auto indentOf = [&](std::uint32_t r) -> std::optional<std::uint32_t>
        {
            line.clear();
            rope.CopyTo({ rope.LineStart(r), rope.LineEnd(r) }, line);
            if (FoldModel::IsBlank(line)) return std::nullopt;
            return FoldModel::IndentColumns(line, tabSize);
        };
        std::optional<std::uint32_t> need = indentOf(row);
        for (std::uint32_t h = row; h-- > 0;)
        {
            const std::optional<std::uint32_t> indent = indentOf(h);
            if (!indent || (need && *indent >= *need)) continue;
            if (const std::optional<FoldRange> r = FoldModel::IndentRegionAt(rope, h, tabSize); r && row <= r->lastRow)
            {
                if (!best || h > *best) best = h;
                break;
            }
            need = indent;
            if (*indent == 0) break;
        }
        return best;
    }

    void SyncDisplay(const FoldModel& folds, DisplayMap& display, const Rope& rope)
    {
        const std::vector<FoldRange> folded = folds.Folded(rope);
        display.SetFolds(folded, rope.LineCount());
    }

    namespace FoldCommands
    {
        bool FoldAtCursors(FoldModel& folds, DisplayMap& display, TextCommands& cmd, std::uint32_t tabSize)
        {
            const Rope& rope = cmd.Buffer().Text();
            const SelectionSet& sels = cmd.Selections();
            std::vector<std::uint32_t> headers;
            for (const Selection& s : sels.All())
                if (const std::optional<std::uint32_t> h = InnermostFoldHeader(folds, rope, rope.OffsetToPoint(s.head).row, tabSize))
                    headers.push_back(*h);
            std::sort(headers.begin(), headers.end());
            headers.erase(std::unique(headers.begin(), headers.end()), headers.end());
            bool changed = false;
            for (const std::uint32_t h : headers)
                if (!folds.IsFoldedAt(rope, h))
                    if (const std::optional<FoldRange> r = folds.FoldableAt(rope, h, tabSize); r && folds.Fold(rope, *r, SourceAt(folds, h)))
                        changed = true;
            if (!changed) return false;
            SyncDisplay(folds, display, rope);
            MoveCaretsOutOfFolds(folds, display, cmd);
            return true;
        }

        bool FoldAll(FoldModel& folds, DisplayMap& display, TextCommands& cmd, std::uint32_t tabSize)
        {
            const Rope& rope = cmd.Buffer().Text();
            // Every header: indentation regions plus marker regions (FoldableAt prefers the marker on a shared row).
            std::vector<std::uint32_t> headers;
            for (const FoldRange& r : FoldModel::IndentRegions(rope, tabSize)) headers.push_back(r.headerRow);
            for (const MarkerFold& m : folds.MarkerFolds()) headers.push_back(m.beginRow);
            std::sort(headers.begin(), headers.end());
            headers.erase(std::unique(headers.begin(), headers.end()), headers.end());
            bool changed = false;
            for (const std::uint32_t h : headers)
                if (!folds.IsFoldedAt(rope, h))
                    if (const std::optional<FoldRange> r = folds.FoldableAt(rope, h, tabSize); r && folds.Fold(rope, *r, SourceAt(folds, h)))
                        changed = true;
            if (!changed) return false;
            SyncDisplay(folds, display, rope);
            MoveCaretsOutOfFolds(folds, display, cmd);
            return true;
        }

        bool UnfoldAll(FoldModel& folds, DisplayMap& display, const Rope& rope)
        {
            if (folds.Folded(rope).empty()) return false;
            folds.UnfoldAll();
            SyncDisplay(folds, display, rope);
            return true;
        }

        bool UnfoldAtCursors(FoldModel& folds, DisplayMap& display, const SelectionSet& sels, const Rope& rope)
        {
            const std::vector<FoldRange> folded = folds.Folded(rope);
            bool changed = false;
            for (const Selection& s : sels.All())
            {
                const std::uint32_t a = rope.OffsetToPoint(std::min(s.anchor, s.head)).row;
                const std::uint32_t b = rope.OffsetToPoint(std::max(s.anchor, s.head)).row;
                for (const FoldRange& r : folded)
                    if (r.headerRow >= a && r.headerRow <= b && folds.Unfold(rope, r.headerRow)) changed = true;
            }
            if (changed) SyncDisplay(folds, display, rope);
            return changed;
        }

        bool ToggleFoldAt(FoldModel& folds, DisplayMap& display, const Rope& rope, std::uint32_t header, std::uint32_t tabSize)
        {
            bool changed = false;
            if (folds.IsFoldedAt(rope, header)) changed = folds.Unfold(rope, header);
            else if (const std::optional<FoldRange> r = folds.FoldableAt(rope, header, tabSize)) changed = folds.Fold(rope, *r, SourceAt(folds, header));
            if (changed) SyncDisplay(folds, display, rope);
            return changed;
        }

        bool RevealSelections(FoldModel& folds, DisplayMap& display, const SelectionSet& sels, const Rope& rope)
        {
            bool changed = false;
            for (const Selection& s : sels.All())
            {
                const std::uint32_t row = rope.OffsetToPoint(s.head).row;
                const std::vector<FoldRange> folded = folds.Folded(rope);   // the folds' current rows (the display may lag an edit)
                const bool hidden = std::any_of(folded.begin(), folded.end(),
                                                [&](const FoldRange& r) { return row > r.headerRow && row <= r.lastRow; });
                if (hidden && folds.Unfold(rope, row)) changed = true;      // Unfold(row): every fold hiding it
            }
            if (changed) SyncDisplay(folds, display, rope);
            return changed;
        }
    }
}
```

and both constructors end with `editSync.model = this; buffer.AddObserver(editSync);`. `TextModel.cpp`:

```cpp
    void TextModel::EditSync::OnBufferEdited(std::span<const Text::EditShift> edits, std::uint64_t)
    {
        model->folds.OnEdits(edits);
        if (model->followForeignEdits && !model->editing) model->selections.ApplyEdits(edits);
    }

    TextModel::~TextModel() { buffer.RemoveObserver(editSync); }

    // Replaces TE2-11's body (CANON A5/A7): rebuild when the buffer version OR the
    // folded set changed since the last call, so folding through FoldModel
    // directly (vim, view-state restore) needs only model.SyncDisplay().
    void TextModel::SyncDisplay()
    {
        const Text::Rope& rope = buffer.Text();
        std::vector<Text::FoldRange> folded = folds.Folded(rope);
        if (displaySynced && displaySyncedVersion == buffer.Version() && folded == displaySyncedFolds)
            return;
        Text::SyncDisplay(folds, display, rope);
        displaySyncedVersion = buffer.Version();
        displaySyncedFolds = std::move(folded);
        displaySynced = true;
    }
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// Gutter overlays (text editor spec s5.1): fold arrows (TE4-12) and, from
```

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/GutterOverlays.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/FoldActions.hpp"
#include "Widgets/EditorTheme.hpp"
#include "Widgets/IconsLucide.h"

#include <imgui.h>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    void FoldGutterOverlay::Gutter(const TextGutterPaint& p)
    {
        const Text::Rope& rope = m_model.buffer.Text();
        const bool folded = m_model.folds.IsFoldedAt(rope, p.bufferRow);
        if (!folded && (!p.gutterHovered || !m_model.folds.FoldableAt(rope, p.bufferRow, TabSize()))) return;   // open arrows: on hover
        const char* icon = folded ? ICON_LC_CHEVRON_RIGHT : ICON_LC_CHEVRON_DOWN;
        const ImVec2 size = ImGui::CalcTextSize(icon);
        const ImVec2 at(p.rowMin.x + p.columns.foldX + (p.columns.foldW - size.x) * 0.5f,
                        p.rowMin.y + ((p.rowMax.y - p.rowMin.y) - size.y) * 0.5f);
        p.drawList->AddText(at, ImGui::GetColorU32(folded ? Theme::kText : Theme::kTextDim), icon);
    }

    bool FoldGutterOverlay::GutterClicked(const TextGutterClick& c)
    {
        if (c.button != ImGuiMouseButton_Left) return false;
        if (c.xInGutter < c.columns.foldX || c.xInGutter >= c.columns.foldX + c.columns.foldW) return false;
        return Text::FoldCommands::ToggleFoldAt(m_model.folds, m_model.display, m_model.buffer.Text(), c.bufferRow, TabSize());
    }

    void FoldGutterOverlay::RowForeground(const TextRowPaint& p)
    {
        if (!m_model.folds.IsFoldedAt(m_model.buffer.Text(), p.bufferRow)) return;
        const float x0 = p.xAt(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p.text.size())) + p.spaceWidth;
        const ImVec2 size = ImGui::CalcTextSize("...");
        const float padX = p.spaceWidth * 0.5f;
        const ImVec2 a(x0, p.rowMin.y + 1.0f), b(x0 + size.x + padX * 2.0f, p.rowMax.y - 1.0f);
        p.drawList->AddRectFilled(a, b, ImGui::GetColorU32(Theme::kPanelRaised), (b.y - a.y) * 0.3f);
        p.drawList->AddText(ImVec2(x0 + padX, p.rowMin.y + ((p.rowMax.y - p.rowMin.y) - size.y) * 0.5f),
                            ImGui::GetColorU32(Theme::kTextDim), "...");
    }
}
```

```cpp
TEST_CASE("Go to line: parsing 'line' and 'line:col'", "[text-goto]")
{
    const auto a = ParseGotoTarget("12");
    REQUIRE(a.has_value());
    CHECK(a->line == 12);
    CHECK_FALSE(a->column.has_value());
    const auto b = ParseGotoTarget(" 12 : 5 ");
    REQUIRE(b.has_value());
    CHECK(b->line == 12);
    CHECK(b->column == 5u);
    for (const char* bad : { "", "0", "abc", "12:", ":5", "12:0", "-3", "1:2:3" })
    {

TEST_CASE("Go to line: resolving clamps rows and counts columns in characters", "[text-goto]")
{
    const Rope r = Rope::FromUtf8("ab\n\tcd\xC3\xA9" "f\nx");
    CHECK(ResolveGotoTarget(r, { 2, 4u }).row == 1);
    CHECK(ResolveGotoTarget(r, { 2, 4u }).col == 3);              // tab, c, d -> the e-acute starts at byte 3
    CHECK(ResolveGotoTarget(r, { 2, 5u }).col == 5);              // after the 2-byte e-acute
    CHECK(ResolveGotoTarget(r, { 2, 99u }).col == 6);             // clamped to the line's end
    CHECK(ResolveGotoTarget(r, { 99, std::nullopt }).row == 2);   // clamped to the last line
    CHECK(ResolveGotoTarget(r, { 1, std::nullopt }).col == 0);
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("ab\ncd"), EolMap());
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(0, 2);
    GotoCommands::GoToPoint(buf, sels, { 1, 1 });
    CHECK(sels.Size() == 1);
    CHECK(sels.Primary().anchor == 4);
    CHECK(sels.Primary().head == 4);
}

TEST_CASE("Go to line: a jump is an undo-group boundary, even one that lands where the caret was", "[text-goto]")
{
    // rev-2 4.11: typing, a jump back to the same place, typing again was one undo step.
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("ab\ncd"), EolMap());
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(0, 0);
    TextCommands(buf, sels).InsertText("x");                     // "xab\ncd", caret 1
    GotoCommands::GoToPoint(buf, sels, { 0, 1 });                // the caret where it already is
    TextCommands(buf, sels).InsertText("y");
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "xyab\ncd");
    CHECK(buf.Undo(sels));
```

```cpp
// Go to line (text editor spec s5.2; TE4-13): "line" or "line:col", both 1-based
// as typed. A column counts characters (code points; a tab is one). Spec 2's
// Goto Anything ':' supersedes the popup and reuses these.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"

#include <optional>
#include <string_view>

{

    {
        std::uint32_t line = 1;
        std::optional<std::uint32_t> column;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<GotoTarget> ParseGotoTarget(std::string_view text);
    // Clamps the line to the document and the column to the line's end.
    [[nodiscard]] Point ResolveGotoTarget(const Rope& rope, const GotoTarget& target);

        void GoToPoint(TextBuffer& buffer, SelectionSet& sels, Point point);   // one caret, through TextCommands; an undo-group boundary
    }
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/GotoTarget.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/GotoTarget.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <charconv>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        std::string_view Trim(std::string_view s)
        {
            while (!s.empty() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s.front()))) s.remove_prefix(1);
            while (!s.empty() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s.back()))) s.remove_suffix(1);
            return s;
        }

        std::optional<std::uint32_t> Positive(std::string_view s)
        {
            s = Trim(s);
            std::uint32_t v = 0;
            const auto [p, ec] = std::from_chars(s.data(), s.data() + s.size(), v);
            if (s.empty() || ec != std::errc{} || p != s.data() + s.size() || v == 0) return std::nullopt;
            return v;
        }

        std::size_t NextCodePoint(std::string_view s, std::size_t i)
        {
            if (i >= s.size()) return i + 1;
            const auto b = static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]);
            const std::size_t len = b < 0x80 ? 1 : (b >> 5) == 0x6 ? 2 : (b >> 4) == 0xE ? 3 : (b >> 3) == 0x1E ? 4 : 1;
            if (i + len > s.size()) return i + 1;
            for (std::size_t k = 1; k < len; ++k)
                if ((static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i + k]) & 0xC0) != 0x80) return i + 1;
            return i + len;
        }
    }

    std::optional<GotoTarget> ParseGotoTarget(std::string_view text)
    {
        text = Trim(text);
        if (text.empty()) return std::nullopt;
        const std::size_t colon = text.find(':');
        GotoTarget t;
        const std::optional<std::uint32_t> line = Positive(text.substr(0, colon));
        if (!line) return std::nullopt;
        t.line = *line;
        if (colon != std::string_view::npos)
        {
            const std::optional<std::uint32_t> col = Positive(text.substr(colon + 1));
            if (!col) return std::nullopt;
            t.column = *col;
        }
        return t;
    }

    Point ResolveGotoTarget(const Rope& rope, const GotoTarget& t)
    {
        const std::uint32_t row = std::min(std::max<std::uint32_t>(t.line, 1), rope.LineCount()) - 1;
        if (!t.column || *t.column <= 1) return { row, 0 };
        std::string line;
        rope.CopyTo({ rope.LineStart(row), rope.LineEnd(row) }, line);
        std::size_t byte = 0;
        for (std::uint32_t c = 1; c < *t.column && byte < line.size(); ++c) byte = NextCodePoint(line, byte);
        return { row, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::min(byte, line.size())) };
    }

    namespace GotoCommands
    {
        void GoToPoint(TextBuffer& buffer, SelectionSet& sels, Point point)
        {
            const ByteOffset offset = buffer.Text().PointToOffset(point);
            buffer.BreakUndoGroup();                                         // a jump ends the typing group (rev-2 4.11)
            TextCommands(buffer, sels).SetSelections({ Selection{ 0, offset, offset, std::nullopt } });   // spec s2.1: through TextCommands
        }
    }
}
```
