`TextDocument` (TE2-15) changes: include `TextEditor/View/TextStatusStrip.hpp`; public `TextStatusStrip& StatusStrip() noexcept { return m_status; }`; private `TextStatusStrip m_status; std::uint64_t m_selCharsVersion = ~std::uint64_t{ 0 }; Text::ByteRange m_selCharsRange{}; std::uint64_t m_selChars = 0; std::uint64_t SelectedChars();`:

```cpp
    // Characters in the single selection; recounted only when the text or the selection changed
    // (a Ctrl+A over a large log counts once, not every frame).
    std::uint64_t TextDocument::SelectedChars()
    {
        const Text::Selection& p = FocusedView().Selections().Primary();
        const Text::ByteRange r{ std::min(p.anchor, p.head), std::max(p.anchor, p.head) };
        if (r.begin == r.end) return 0;
        if (m_selCharsVersion == Buffer().Version() && m_selCharsRange.begin == r.begin && m_selCharsRange.end == r.end) return m_selChars;
        std::uint64_t n = 0;
        Buffer().Text().ForEachChunk(r, [&](std::string_view chunk)
        {
            for (const char c : chunk) n += (static_cast<unsigned char>(c) & 0xC0) != 0x80 ? 1u : 0u;
        });
        m_selCharsVersion = Buffer().Version();
        m_selCharsRange = r;
        m_selChars = n;
        return n;
    }
```

In `Draw`: the views get the height left after the footer -- `const float footer = ImGui::GetFrameHeightWithSpacing() + ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.y;` and `DrawViews(ImVec2(avail.x, avail.y - footer))` (TE4-17's call) -- then after the views:

```cpp
        TextEditorView& focused = FocusedView();
        const Text::Rope& rope = Buffer().Text();
        TextStatusStripState state;
        state.primary = rope.OffsetToPoint(focused.Selections().Primary().head);
        std::string line;
        rope.CopyTo({ rope.LineStart(state.primary.row), rope.LineEnd(state.primary.row) }, line);
        state.primaryLineText = line;
        state.indent = Indentation();
        state.tabSize = state.indent.width;
        state.selectionCount = focused.Selections().Size();
        state.selectedChars = state.selectionCount == 1 ? SelectedChars() : 0;
        state.encodingLabel = EncodingLabel(Encoding());
        state.note = Note();                                                   // TE2-15: the one note channel
        state.eol = Buffer().Eols().Dominant();
        state.mixedEol = Buffer().Eols().IsMixed();
        const Text::GrammarSnapshot grammar = Grammar();
        state.language = grammar ? std::string_view(grammar->Name()) : std::string_view{};
        state.languages = [this]                                               // TE3-30's service; none = Plain Text only
        {
            return m_services.syntax ? m_services.syntax->Registry().Names() : std::vector<std::string>{ "Plain Text" };
        };
        if (ReadOnly()) state.readOnlyReason = ReadOnlyBadgeText(ReadOnlyReason());
        state.split = SplitOpen();
        TextStatusStripActions actions;
        m_status.Draw(state, actions);
        if (actions.reopenWith) ReopenWithEncoding(*actions.reopenWith);
        if (actions.convertEol) (void)ConvertLineEndings(*actions.convertEol);   // spec s3.5: one undo step (rev-2 A10: the one path)
        if (actions.setIndentation) SetIndentation(*actions.setIndentation);
        if (actions.setLanguage) PickLanguage(*actions.setLanguage);
        if (actions.toggleSplit) { if (SplitOpen()) CloseSplit(); else OpenSplit(true); }
```

The strip holds no note of its own: `state.note` is read from TE2-15's `Note()` every frame, so a note set by TE2 (save, reload) or TE6 (recovery) through `ShowNote` shows until `ShowNote("")` clears it.

```cpp
    void TextDocument::PickLanguage(std::string_view name)
    {
        if (!m_services.syntax) return;                                 // no syntax service: Plain Text is all there is
        SetLanguage(name);                                              // TE3-30
        const std::string ext = CanonicalPath().extension().string();   // spec s4.1: remembered per extension
        CVarRegistry& reg = CVarRegistry::Get();
        const CVarHandle h = reg.Find("editor.text.languageByExtension");
        if (h.IsStale()) return;
        const std::string next = Text::SetLanguageOverride(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().languageByExtension, ext, name);
        reg.Set(h, CVarValue::String(next), SetBy::EditorUser, "editor", CVarContext::Editor);
        reg.Publish();
        NoteSettingEdited(SetBy::EditorUser, "editor.text.languageByExtension");   // the debounced archive write keeps it
    }
```

```cpp
    bool TextDocument::ConvertLineEndings(Text::Eol eol)
    {
        // The ONE convert-line-endings path (spec s3.5): the strip, TE4-20's Inspector page and
        // TE4-24's text.convertLineEndings row call it. Read-only content is never converted.
        if (ReadOnly())
            return false;
        NotifyOutsideChange();   // rev-2 A10 (TE2-15): before the buffer changes -- vim ends an open Insert transaction
        return Buffer().ConvertLineEndings(eol, FocusedView().Selections());
    }
```

(`PickLanguage` and `ConvertLineEndings` are declared public in `TextDocument.hpp`; `m_services.syntax` is the `TextSyntaxService*` TE3-30 adds to `TextDocumentServices` (null-checked); `Find` / `Set` / `Publish` / `NoteSettingEdited` is the EditorUser write `Settings/FontsPage.cpp:14-22` and `Settings/ThemePage.cpp:30-37` use; `TextDocument.cpp` includes `Settings/SettingsHost.hpp`.)

```cpp
#pragma once

// The text document's Inspector page (text editor spec s5.3; TE4-20): path,
// size, encoding, language, line endings, indentation and the read-only
// reason; editable where meaningful (Reopen with Encoding, language, line
// endings = convert every line, indentation). Arcane's one Inspector model:
// the document draws no properties block of its own. Edits are queued while
// the rows draw and run after the last one (a reopen replaces the text the
// rows read).

#include "Panels/InspectorSource.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/EolMap.hpp"          // Eol
#include "TextEditor/Core/IndentDetect.hpp"    // IndentStyle
#include "TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp"       // Text::TextEncoding

#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class TextDocumentInspectorPage final : public InspectorPage
    {
    public:
        struct Model
        {
            std::function<std::string()> name, path;
            std::function<std::uintmax_t()> size;
            std::function<std::string()> encodingLabel;              // TE2-15's EncodingLabel(TextEncoding)
            std::function<void(Text::TextEncoding)> reopenWithEncoding;
            std::function<std::string()> language;
            std::function<std::vector<std::string>()> languages;
            std::function<void(std::string_view)> setLanguage;
            std::function<Text::Eol()> eol;
            std::function<bool()> mixedEol;
            std::function<void(Text::Eol)> convertEol;
            std::function<Text::IndentStyle()> indentation;
            std::function<void(const Text::IndentStyle&)> setIndentation;
            std::function<std::optional<std::string>()> readOnlyReason;
        };

        explicit TextDocumentInspectorPage(Model model) : m_model(std::move(model)) {}
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<InspectorCrumb> Breadcrumb() const override;
        void Draw(PropertyGrid& grid) override;

    private:
        Model m_model;
        std::vector<std::function<void()>> m_deferred;
    };

    // "999 bytes", "12.1 KB (12,345 bytes)".
    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatFileSize(std::uintmax_t bytes);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocumentInspectorPage.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocumentInspectorPage.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/View/TextStatusStrip.hpp"   // EolLabel
#include "Widgets/PropertyGrid.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <format>
#include <iterator>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    std::string FormatFileSize(std::uintmax_t bytes)
    {
        std::string digits = std::to_string(bytes);
        for (int i = static_cast<int>(digits.size()) - 3; i > 0; i -= 3) digits.insert(static_cast<std::size_t>(i), ",");
        const std::string exact = digits + (bytes == 1 ? " byte" : " bytes");
        if (bytes < 1024) return exact;
        const char* units[] = { "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB" };
        double value = static_cast<double>(bytes) / 1024.0;
        std::size_t unit = 0;
        while (value >= 1024.0 && unit + 1 < std::size(units)) { value /= 1024.0; ++unit; }
        return std::format("{:.1f} {} ({})", value, units[unit], exact);
    }

    std::vector<InspectorCrumb> TextDocumentInspectorPage::Breadcrumb() const
    {
        return { InspectorCrumb{ m_model.name ? m_model.name() : std::string("Text"), {}, std::optional<std::string>{ std::string("text") } } };
    }

    void TextDocumentInspectorPage::Draw(PropertyGrid& grid)
    {
        const auto defer = [this](std::function<void()> fn) { m_deferred.push_back(std::move(fn)); };
        if (grid.Section("File"))
        {
            PropertyGrid::Rows rows(grid, "##textfile");
            if (rows)
            {
                grid.ReadOnlyRow("Path", m_model.path ? m_model.path() : std::string{});
                grid.ReadOnlyRow("Size", FormatFileSize(m_model.size ? m_model.size() : 0));
                const std::optional<std::string> reason = m_model.readOnlyReason ? m_model.readOnlyReason() : std::nullopt;
                grid.ReadOnlyRow("Read-only", reason ? *reason : std::string("No"));
            }
        }
        if (grid.Section("Text"))
        {
            PropertyGrid::Rows rows(grid, "##texttext");
            if (rows)
            {
                grid.ReadOnlyRow("Encoding", m_model.encodingLabel ? m_model.encodingLabel() : std::string{});
                // Spec s3.5: a file that is not UTF-8 is reopened as Windows-1252 (or back as UTF-8);
                // TE2 refuses the reopen while the document is dirty.
                const std::array<Text::TextEncoding, 2> reopen{ Text::TextEncoding::Utf8, Text::TextEncoding::Windows1252 };
                const char* reopenItems[] = { "UTF-8", "Windows 1252" };
                if (const int picked = grid.ComboRow("Reopen with encoding", reopenItems, 2, -1); picked >= 0 && m_model.reopenWithEncoding)
                    defer([this, e = reopen[static_cast<std::size_t>(picked)]] { m_model.reopenWithEncoding(e); });

                const std::vector<std::string> names = m_model.languages ? m_model.languages() : std::vector<std::string>{};
                const std::string language = m_model.language ? m_model.language() : std::string{};
                std::vector<const char*> languageItems;
                int currentLanguage = -1;
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < names.size(); ++i)
                {
                    languageItems.push_back(names[i].c_str());
                    if (names[i] == language) currentLanguage = static_cast<int>(i);
                }
                if (const int picked = grid.ComboRow("Language", languageItems.data(), static_cast<int>(languageItems.size()), currentLanguage);
                    picked >= 0 && m_model.setLanguage)
                    defer([this, name = names[static_cast<std::size_t>(picked)]] { m_model.setLanguage(name); });

                const std::array<Text::Eol, 3> eols{ Text::Eol::LF, Text::Eol::CRLF, Text::Eol::CR };
                const char* eolItems[] = { "LF", "CRLF", "CR" };
                const bool mixed = m_model.mixedEol && m_model.mixedEol();
                const Text::Eol eol = m_model.eol ? m_model.eol() : Text::Eol::LF;
                int currentEol = -1;
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < eols.size(); ++i)
                    if (!mixed && eols[i] == eol) currentEol = static_cast<int>(i);
                if (const int picked = grid.ComboRow("Line endings", eolItems, 3, currentEol); picked >= 0 && m_model.convertEol)
                    defer([this, e = eols[static_cast<std::size_t>(picked)]] { m_model.convertEol(e); });
                if (mixed)
                    grid.ReadOnlyRow("Mixed endings", std::format("Yes: each line keeps its own; new lines use {}. Pick one above to convert every line.",
                                                                  EolLabel(eol)));

                const Text::IndentStyle indent = m_model.indentation ? m_model.indentation() : Text::IndentStyle{};
                bool spaces = indent.spaces;
                if (grid.CheckboxRow("Indent with spaces", spaces) && m_model.setIndentation)
                    defer([this, indent, spaces] { Text::IndentStyle o = indent; o.spaces = spaces; m_model.setIndentation(o); });
                int width = static_cast<int>(indent.width);
                if (grid.IntRow("Indent size", width) && m_model.setIndentation)
                    defer([this, indent, width] { Text::IndentStyle o = indent; o.width = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::clamp(width, 1, 16)); m_model.setIndentation(o); });
            }
        }
        std::vector<std::function<void()>> run;
        run.swap(m_deferred);
        for (const std::function<void()>& fn : run) fn();
    }
}
```

```cpp
    TextDocumentInspectorPage::Model TextDocument::MakeInspectorModel()
    {
        TextDocumentInspectorPage::Model m;
        m.name = [this] { return CanonicalPath().filename().string(); };
        m.path = [this] { return CanonicalPath().string(); };
        m.size = [this] { return static_cast<std::uintmax_t>(Synced().stamp.size); };
        m.encodingLabel = [this] { return std::string(EncodingLabel(Encoding())); };
        m.reopenWithEncoding = [this](Text::TextEncoding e) { (void)ReopenWithEncoding(e); };   // false: refused (dirty); TE2-15 says why
        m.language = [this] { const Text::GrammarSnapshot g = Grammar(); return g ? std::string(g->Name()) : std::string("Plain Text"); };
        m.languages = [this] { return m_services.syntax ? m_services.syntax->Registry().Names() : std::vector<std::string>{ "Plain Text" }; };
        m.setLanguage = [this](std::string_view name) { PickLanguage(name); };
        m.eol = [this] { return Buffer().Eols().Dominant(); };
        m.mixedEol = [this] { return Buffer().Eols().IsMixed(); };
        m.convertEol = [this](Text::Eol e) { (void)ConvertLineEndings(e); };   // TE4-19's one path (notifies first, rev-2 A10)
        m.indentation = [this] { return Indentation(); };
        m.setIndentation = [this](const Text::IndentStyle& o) { SetIndentation(o); };
        m.readOnlyReason = [this] { return ReadOnly() ? std::optional<std::string>(ReadOnlyBadgeText(ReadOnlyReason())) : std::nullopt; };
        return m;
    }
```

```cpp
    CompiledSymbol Rule(const char* pattern, std::uint32_t group, const char* kind)
    {
        auto compiled = Regex::Compile(pattern, RegexOptions::None);
        REQUIRE(compiled.has_value());
        return CompiledSymbol{ *compiled, group, kind };

TEST_CASE("Symbols: grammar rules name their symbols by capture group, in document order", "[text-symbols]")
{
    const std::vector<CompiledSymbol> rules = {
        Rule("^#{1,6}\\s+(.+)$", 1, "heading"),
        Rule("\"([^\"]+)\"\\s*:", 1, "key"),
    };
    const RopeSnapshot s{ Rope::FromUtf8("# Title\n\n## Sub\n{\"a\": 1, \"b\": {\"c\": 2}}"), 1 };
    const std::vector<TextSymbol> syms = ExtractSymbols(s, rules, Lim());
    REQUIRE(syms.size() == 5);
    CHECK(syms[0].name == "Title");
    CHECK(syms[0].kind == "heading");
    CHECK((syms[0].range.begin == 2 && syms[0].range.end == 7));
    CHECK(syms[1].name == "Sub");
    CHECK(syms[1].start.row == 2);
    CHECK(syms[2].name == "a");
    CHECK(syms[2].kind == "key");
    CHECK(syms[2].start.row == 3);
    CHECK(syms[2].start.col == 2);
    CHECK(syms[3].name == "b");
    CHECK(syms[4].name == "c");
    const std::vector<CompiledSymbol> whole = { Rule("fn \\w+", 7, "function") };   // no group 7: the whole match names it
    const auto w = ExtractSymbols(RopeSnapshot{ Rope::FromUtf8("fn main"), 1 }, whole, Lim());
    REQUIRE(w.size() == 1);
    CHECK(w[0].name == "fn main");
}

TEST_CASE("Symbols: a text document is a symbol provider", "[text-symbols]")
{
    // rev-2 4.10: with TextDocumentServices{} there is no syntax service, so SetLanguage was a no-op, the
    // grammar stayed null and the case always SKIPPED. A real TextSyntaxService over a test grammar
    // directory makes it run every time; nothing depends on data/Syntaxes being staged.
    Test::TempDir dir("te4_symbols");
    std::filesystem::create_directories(dir.path / "engine");
    {
        std::ofstream(dir.path / "engine" / "Keys.arcsyntax", std::ios::binary)
            << R"({"format":"arcsyntax","version":1,"name":"Keys","scope":"source.keys","files":[".keys"],)"
               R"("symbols":[{"match":"\"([^\"]+)\"\\s*:","name":1,"kind":"key"}],)"
               R"("patterns":[{"match":"\"[^\"]*\"","scope":"string.quoted.keys"}]})";
    }
    Editor::TextSyntaxService svc(std::make_unique<Text::ManualHighlightExecutor>(), dir.path / "engine");
    svc.Tick(0.0);
    Editor::TextDocumentServices services;
    services.syntax = &svc;
    const std::filesystem::path path = dir.path / "a.keys";
    { std::ofstream(path, std::ios::binary) << "{\"alpha\": 1, \"beta\": {\"gamma\": 2}}\n"; }
    std::string error;
    auto doc = Editor::TextDocument::Open(path, services, error);
    REQUIRE(doc);
    Editor::ISymbolProvider* provider = Editor::SymbolProviderOf(doc.get());
    REQUIRE(provider != nullptr);
    REQUIRE(doc->Grammar() != nullptr);
    REQUIRE(doc->Grammar()->Name() == "Keys");                  // detected from ".keys"
    const std::vector<Editor::DocumentSymbol> syms = provider->Symbols();
    std::vector<std::string> names;
    for (const Editor::DocumentSymbol& s : syms) names.push_back(s.name);
    CHECK(names == std::vector<std::string>{ "alpha", "beta", "gamma" });
    REQUIRE(syms.size() == 3u);
    CHECK(syms[0].kind == "key");
    CHECK(syms[2].start.row == 0u);
    CHECK(provider->Symbols().size() == syms.size());           // cached for the version: same answer
    TextCommands(doc->Buffer(), doc->View().Selections()).InsertText("\"delta\": 0,\n");   // a new version
    CHECK(provider->Symbols().size() == 4u);                    // re-extracted for it
    doc->SetLanguage("Plain Text");
    REQUIRE(doc->Grammar() != nullptr);
    CHECK(doc->Grammar()->Name() == "Plain Text");
    CHECK(provider->Symbols().empty());                         // Plain Text declares no symbols
    doc.reset();
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// Documents that can list their symbols (text editor spec s9): spec 2's
// Goto Anything '@' queries the active document through this. TextDocument
// implements it from its grammar's `symbols` rules (TE4-21); the shader graph
// and input-actions documents may implement it later.

#include "Documents/EditorDocument.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"   // ByteRange, Point

#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct DocumentSymbol
    {
        std::string name;
        std::string kind;          // the grammar's word: "heading", "key", "function"
        Text::ByteRange range;     // the name's bytes
        Text::Point start;         // range.begin as row / byte column
    };

    class ISymbolProvider
    {
    public:
        virtual ~ISymbolProvider() = default;
        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::vector<DocumentSymbol> Symbols() = 0;   // document order
    };

    [[nodiscard]] inline ISymbolProvider* SymbolProviderOf(EditorDocument* doc) noexcept { return dynamic_cast<ISymbolProvider*>(doc); }
}
```

```cpp
// rule is a single-line pattern; `nameGroup` names the symbol (the whole match
// when the group is absent). Line by line on a snapshot, under the search limits.

#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Grammar.hpp"   // CompiledSymbol (TE3-8)

#include <string>
#include <vector>

{

    {
        std::string name;
        std::string kind;
        ByteRange range;
        Point start;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<TextSymbol> ExtractSymbols(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, std::span<const CompiledSymbol> rules,
                                                         const SearchLimits& limits);
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Syntax/SymbolExtractor.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/SymbolExtractor.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    std::vector<TextSymbol> ExtractSymbols(const RopeSnapshot& snapshot, std::span<const CompiledSymbol> rules, const SearchLimits& limits)
    {
        std::vector<TextSymbol> out;
        for (const CompiledSymbol& rule : rules)
        {
            if (!rule.regex) continue;
            CompiledQuery q;
            q.regex = rule.regex;
            q.multiline = false;
            TextSearch::ForEachMatch(snapshot, q, { 0, snapshot.rope.Size() + 1 }, limits, nullptr, [&](const SearchHit& h)
            {
                // The name group when it took part in the match, else the whole match (group 0).
                std::pair<std::size_t, std::size_t> g{ static_cast<std::size_t>(h.range.begin - h.subjectBase),
                                                       static_cast<std::size_t>(h.range.end - h.subjectBase) };
                std::size_t b = 0, e = 0;
                if (h.match && h.match->Group(rule.nameGroup, b, e) && e >= b) g = { b, e };
                if (g.second <= g.first || g.second > h.subject.size()) return true;
                TextSymbol s;
                s.name = std::string(h.subject.substr(g.first, g.second - g.first));
                s.kind = rule.kind;
                s.range = { h.subjectBase + g.first, h.subjectBase + g.second };
                s.start = snapshot.rope.OffsetToPoint(s.range.begin);
                out.push_back(std::move(s));
                return true;
            }, nullptr);
        }
        std::stable_sort(out.begin(), out.end(), [](const TextSymbol& a, const TextSymbol& b) { return a.range.begin < b.range.begin; });
        out.erase(std::unique(out.begin(), out.end(), [](const TextSymbol& a, const TextSymbol& b)
        {
            return a.range.begin == b.range.begin && a.range.end == b.range.end && a.kind == b.kind;
        }), out.end());
        return out;
    }
}
```

```cpp
    std::vector<DocumentSymbol> TextDocument::Symbols()
    {
        const TextSettings& s = Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>();
        const Text::GrammarSnapshot grammar = Grammar();
        if (!grammar || grammar->Rules().Symbols().empty()) return {};
        // Above syntaxMaxMB the stateful highlighter stops too (spec s3.5): no whole-file symbol scan.
        if (Buffer().Text().Size() > (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(s.syntaxMaxMB) << 20)) return {};
        const std::uint64_t version = Buffer().Version();
        const std::uint64_t grammarVersion = grammar->grammarVersion();
        if (version != m_symbolsVersion || grammarVersion != m_symbolsGrammar)
        {
            m_symbols.clear();
            for (Text::TextSymbol& t : Text::ExtractSymbols(Buffer().Snapshot(), grammar->Rules().Symbols(), SearchLimitsFromSettings(s)))
                m_symbols.push_back(DocumentSymbol{ std::move(t.name), std::move(t.kind), t.range, t.start });
            m_symbolsVersion = version;
            m_symbolsGrammar = grammarVersion;
        }
        return m_symbols;
    }
```

(`SymbolExtractor.cpp` is in `TextEditor/Syntax/`, which the `ArcaneText` library globs: a premake regenerate picks it up.)

### Task TE4-22: Auto-close pairs -- close, wrap, type over, delete the pair (spec s8 `autoClosePairs`, s4.1 `autoClose`)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/AutoClose.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/AutoClose.cpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextTypingFilter.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/AutoCloseFilter.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/AutoCloseFilter.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp` / `.cpp` (TE2-13: a typing filter sees each typed code point and plain Backspace first)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp` / `.cpp` (TE2-15: own the filter, attach it to every view)
- Modify: `premake5.lua` ArcaneTests `files` (append `AutoCloseFilter.cpp`)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/AutoCloseTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE2-15 `TextDocument::InitAfterLoad()` (D-R2); TE1 `TextBuffer::{Text, Undo(SelectionSet&), RegisterAnchors(AnchorSet&), UnregisterAnchors}`, TE1-14 `TextCommands::Context()` (the view's `cmds`), `TextCommands::ApplyEdits(TransactionKind, std::vector<EditOp> ops, std::vector<Selection> after, std::size_t primaryIndex)` (CANON A3: one transaction -- the edit plus the post-edit selections -- and with empty `ops` only the selections, no undo entry; product code never calls `BeginTransaction` / `Edit` / `EndTransaction` itself, spec s2.1), `TransactionKind::{Typing, Deleting}`, `EditOp{range, text}` (sorted, disjoint, strictly increasing begins), `AnchorSet::{Add, Remove, ForEach, Size}`, `Anchor{offset, bias}`, `Bias::Right`, `SelectionSet::{All, PrimaryIndex}`, `Selection::Empty`, `Rope::{ByteAt, Substr, OffsetToPoint, Size}`; TE3-8 `GrammarDesc::autoClose` (`std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>>`, read through `CompiledGrammar::Rules().Desc()`); TE4-3 `TextSettings::autoClosePairs`; TE2-11 `TextModel::{buffer, selections}` (TE2-11's shape, CANON A7); TE2-13 `TextEditorView::{ApplyBaselineKey(Text::TextCommands&, ...), InsertTyped(Text::TextCommands&, std::string_view, bool)}` (its `cmds`; `InsertTyped` is the ONE typed-text insertion point HandleKeyboard calls for each run of the D-R1 stream -- rev-2 E3); TE4-11 `TextDocument::Grammar()`; TE4-17 `TextDocument::AttachOverlays`; `Test::ScopedCodeRung`.
- Produces: `class Text::AutoCloser(TextBuffer&) { SetPairs(span<const pair<string,string>>), Type(SelectionSet&, std::string_view, const EditContext& = {}) -> bool, Backspace(SelectionSet&, const EditContext& = {}) -> bool, TrackedClosers() }` (each tracked closer belongs to the `SelectionSet` that typed it: one closer serves both views of a split, and a view's keystroke prunes and types over only its OWN closers -- rev-2 4.12); `class Editor::ITextTypingFilter { Typed(TextModel&, std::string_view codePoint, const Text::EditContext&) -> bool; Backspace(TextModel&, const Text::EditContext&) -> bool }` (the view passes the context its own `TextCommands` run with -- TE4-24's `MakeEditContext` once installed -- never a default `EditContext{}`); `TextEditorView::SetTypingFilter(ITextTypingFilter*)` (TE5's Insert mode keeps it: auto-close is an Insert-mode behaviour); `class Editor::AutoCloseFilter(TextBuffer&, PairsSource)`.

The rules are VS Code's defaults (`autoClosingBrackets: languageDefined`, `autoClosingOvertype: auto`, `autoClosingDelete: auto`, `autoSurround: languageDefined`): typing an opener with an empty selection inserts the pair when the next character is whitespace, the end of the line, or a closing bracket, and a quote does not close after a word character (`don't`); with a selection it wraps the selection and keeps it selected; typing a closer that this feature inserted moves over it; Backspace between an opener and the closer this feature inserted deletes both. Only closers it inserted are typed over or deleted with their opener (an anchor tracks each one, and anchors on rows without a caret are dropped). Each keystroke is one transaction (`Typing` / `Deleting`), so typing coalesces into the usual undo group.

```cpp
// TE4-22 (spec s8 autoClosePairs): the grammar's autoClose pairs close, wrap,
// are typed over and are deleted together -- only the closers this inserted.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include "Helpers/SettingsSweep.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/AutoClose.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/AutoCloseFilter.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp"
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane;
using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    const std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> kPairs = { { "(", ")" }, { "[", "]" }, { "\"", "\"" }, { "'", "'" } };

    struct Rig
    {
        TextBuffer buf;
        SelectionSet sels;
        AutoCloser closer{ buf };
        explicit Rig(std::string_view text) : buf(Rope::FromUtf8(text), EolMap()) { closer.SetPairs(kPairs); }
        std::string Text() const { return buf.Text().ToString(); }
    };
}

TEST_CASE("Auto-close: an opener closes before whitespace or a closer; the closer it inserted is typed over", "[text-autoclose]")
{
    Rig r("");
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, "("));
    CHECK(r.Text() == "()");
    CHECK(r.sels.Primary().head == 1);
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, "["));                         // before ")": a closer, so it closes
    CHECK(r.Text() == "([])");
    CHECK(r.closer.TrackedClosers() == 2);
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, "]"));                         // typed over, nothing inserted
    CHECK(r.Text() == "([])");
    CHECK(r.sels.Primary().head == 3);
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, ")"));
    CHECK(r.Text() == "([])");
    CHECK(r.sels.Primary().head == 4);
    CHECK(r.closer.TrackedClosers() == 0);
    CHECK_FALSE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, ")"));                     // nothing tracked: the caller inserts it

    Rig word("abc");
    word.sels.SetSingle(0, 0);
    CHECK_FALSE(word.closer.Type(word.sels, "("));               // before a word character: plain typing
    Rig quote("don");
    quote.sels.SetSingle(3, 3);
    CHECK_FALSE(quote.closer.Type(quote.sels, "'"));             // after a word character
    Rig assign("x = ");
    assign.sels.SetSingle(4, 4);
    REQUIRE(assign.closer.Type(assign.sels, "\""));
    CHECK(assign.Text() == "x = \"\"");
    CHECK(assign.sels.Primary().head == 5);
    CHECK_FALSE(assign.closer.Type(assign.sels, "a"));           // not a pair character
}

TEST_CASE("Auto-close: an opener wraps a selection and keeps it selected, per selection, as one undo step", "[text-autoclose]")
{
    Rig r("abc def");
    r.sels.SetSingle(0, 3);
    r.sels.Add(7, 4, std::nullopt);                              // a backward selection of "def"
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, "("));
    CHECK(r.Text() == "(abc) (def)");
    REQUIRE(r.sels.Size() == 2);
    CHECK(r.sels.All()[0].anchor == 1);
    CHECK(r.sels.All()[0].head == 4);
    CHECK(r.sels.All()[1].anchor == 10);                         // the direction survives
    CHECK(r.sels.All()[1].head == 7);
    r.buf.Undo(r.sels);
    CHECK(r.Text() == "abc def");
}

TEST_CASE("Auto-close: several carets close and type over together", "[text-autoclose]")
{
    Rig r("a\nb\n");
    r.sels.SetSingle(1, 1);
    r.sels.Add(3, 3, std::nullopt);
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, "["));
    CHECK(r.Text() == "a[]\nb[]\n");
    CHECK(r.sels.All()[0].head == 2);
    CHECK(r.sels.All()[1].head == 6);
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, "]"));
    CHECK(r.sels.All()[0].head == 3);
    CHECK(r.sels.All()[1].head == 7);
    r.buf.Undo(r.sels);
    CHECK(r.Text() == "a\nb\n");
}

TEST_CASE("Auto-close: Backspace deletes an inserted pair; never a pair the user typed; leaving the row forgets", "[text-autoclose]")
{
    Rig r("\n");
    r.sels.SetSingle(0, 0);
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Type(r.sels, "("));
    REQUIRE(r.closer.Backspace(r.sels));
    CHECK(r.Text() == "\n");
    CHECK(r.sels.Primary().head == 0);

    Rig typed("()");
    typed.sels.SetSingle(1, 1);
    CHECK_FALSE(typed.closer.Backspace(typed.sels));             // not inserted by auto-close

    Rig away("\n");
    away.sels.SetSingle(0, 0);
    REQUIRE(away.closer.Type(away.sels, "("));
    away.sels.SetSingle(3, 3);                                   // the caret leaves the row
    CHECK_FALSE(away.closer.Backspace(away.sels));
    CHECK(away.closer.TrackedClosers() == 0);
}

TEST_CASE("Auto-close: in a split, typing in one view never forgets the other view's closers", "[text-autoclose]")
{
    // rev-2 4.12: Prune kept only the closers on the TYPING view's caret rows, so the other view of a
    // split (same buffer, same filter) lost its own closer on every keystroke elsewhere.
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("\n\n"), EolMap());
    SelectionSet a, b;                                           // two views' selections over one buffer
    AutoCloser closer(buf);
    closer.SetPairs(kPairs);
    a.SetSingle(0, 0);                                           // view A on row 0
    REQUIRE(closer.Type(a, "("));                                // "()\n\n"
    b.SetSingle(3, 3);                                           // view B on row 1
    REQUIRE(closer.Type(b, "["));                                // "()\n[]\n"
    CHECK(closer.TrackedClosers() == 2);                         // A's ")" survived B's keystroke
    REQUIRE(closer.Type(a, ")"));                                // A types over its own closer
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "()\n[]\n");
    CHECK(a.Primary().head == 2);
    CHECK_FALSE(closer.Type(a, "]"));                            // B's closer is B's: A types a plain "]"
}

TEST_CASE("Auto-close: the filter follows editor.text.autoClosePairs", "[text-autoclose]")
{
    Editor::TextModel model(Rope::FromUtf8(""));
    Editor::AutoCloseFilter filter(model.buffer, [] { return std::span<const std::pair<std::string, std::string>>(kPairs); });
    const EditContext context = Editor::DefaultEditContext(model);   // the view passes its own context
    {
        const Test::ScopedCodeRung off("editor.text.autoClosePairs", CVarValue::Bool(false));
        CHECK_FALSE(filter.Typed(model, "(", context));
    }
    REQUIRE(filter.Typed(model, "(", context));
    CHECK(model.buffer.Text().ToString() == "()");
    CHECK(filter.Backspace(model, context));
    CHECK(model.buffer.Text().ToString().empty());
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/AutoClose.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// Auto-close pairs (text editor spec s8 autoClosePairs; TE4-22). The pairs
// are the grammar's `autoClose` (s4.1). An anchor tracks every closer this
// inserted: only those are typed over or deleted with their opener.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Anchor.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"     // EditContext

#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    class AutoCloser
    {
    public:
        explicit AutoCloser(TextBuffer& buffer);
        ~AutoCloser();
        AutoCloser(const AutoCloser&) = delete;
        AutoCloser& operator=(const AutoCloser&) = delete;

        void SetPairs(std::span<const std::pair<std::string, std::string>> pairs);
        // One typed code point. true = handled here (closed, wrapped or typed over, as one
        // Typing transaction through TextCommands with `context` -- the view's own); false =
        // the caller inserts it as plain typing. `sels` also names whose closers are whose:
        // in a split each view types over, deletes and forgets only its own (rev-2 4.12).
        [[nodiscard]] bool Type(SelectionSet& sels, std::string_view typed, const EditContext& context = {});
        // Plain Backspace. true = every caret sat between an opener and the closer `sels`'s
        // view inserted, and both went (one Deleting transaction).
        [[nodiscard]] bool Backspace(SelectionSet& sels, const EditContext& context = {});
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t TrackedClosers() const noexcept { return m_closers.Size(); }

    private:
        struct Pair { std::string open, close; };
        void Prune(const SelectionSet& sels);
        void Forget(AnchorSet::Id id);
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<AnchorSet::Id> TrackedAt(ByteOffset at, const SelectionSet& owner) const;
        [[nodiscard]] bool StartsWith(ByteOffset at, std::string_view text) const;
        [[nodiscard]] bool CanClose(ByteOffset at, const Pair& pair) const;

        TextBuffer& m_buffer;
        AnchorSet m_closers;
        std::vector<std::pair<AnchorSet::Id, const SelectionSet*>> m_owners;   // which view's selections typed each closer
        std::vector<Pair> m_pairs;
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/AutoClose.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/AutoClose.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"     // TextCommands::ApplyEdits (CANON A3)

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <optional>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        // Append an op; one that begins where the last empty op begins merges into it, so the
        // batch keeps strictly increasing begins (two adjacent selections share an offset).
        void Put(std::vector<EditOp>& ops, ByteRange range, std::string text)
        {
            if (!ops.empty() && ops.back().range.begin == range.begin && ops.back().range.end == ops.back().range.begin)
            {
                ops.back().range.end = range.end;
                ops.back().text += text;
                return;
            }
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ range, std::move(text) });
        }

        bool IsWordByte(char c) noexcept
        {
            const auto u = static_cast<unsigned char>(c);
            return std::isalnum(u) || u == '_' || u >= 0x80;
        }

        // Post-edit ranges (begin = anchor, end = head, so a direction survives) as
        // TextCommands::ApplyEdits' `after`; id 0 = ApplyEdits allocates one.
        std::vector<Selection> ToSelections(const std::vector<ByteRange>& ranges)
        {
            std::vector<Selection> out;
            out.reserve(ranges.size());
            for (const ByteRange& r : ranges) out.push_back(Selection{ 0, r.begin, r.end, std::nullopt });
            return out;
        }
    }

    AutoCloser::AutoCloser(TextBuffer& buffer) : m_buffer(buffer) { m_buffer.RegisterAnchors(m_closers); }
    AutoCloser::~AutoCloser() { m_buffer.UnregisterAnchors(m_closers); }

    void AutoCloser::SetPairs(std::span<const std::pair<std::string, std::string>> pairs)
    {
        m_pairs.clear();
        for (const auto& [open, close] : pairs)
            if (!open.empty() && !close.empty()) m_pairs.push_back(Pair{ open, close });
    }

    bool AutoCloser::StartsWith(ByteOffset at, std::string_view text) const
    {
        const Rope& rope = m_buffer.Text();
        if (at + text.size() > rope.Size()) return false;
        return rope.Substr({ at, at + text.size() }) == text;
    }

    std::optional<AnchorSet::Id> AutoCloser::TrackedAt(ByteOffset at, const SelectionSet& owner) const
    {
        for (const auto& [id, who] : m_owners)
            if (who == &owner && m_closers.Contains(id) && m_closers.Get(id).offset == at) return id;
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    void AutoCloser::Forget(AnchorSet::Id id)
    {
        m_closers.Remove(id);
        std::erase_if(m_owners, [id](const auto& o) { return o.first == id; });
    }

    // VS Code's languageDefined + beforeWhitespace rule.
    bool AutoCloser::CanClose(ByteOffset at, const Pair& pair) const
    {
        const Rope& rope = m_buffer.Text();
        const char next = at < rope.Size() ? rope.ByteAt(at) : '\n';
        bool nextOk = next == ' ' || next == '\t' || next == '\n' || next == '\r';
        for (const Pair& p : m_pairs)
            if (p.open != p.close && p.close[0] == next) nextOk = true;      // before a closing bracket
        if (!nextOk) return false;
        if (pair.open == pair.close && at > 0 && IsWordByte(rope.ByteAt(at - 1))) return false;   // don't
        return true;
    }

    // Forgets THIS view's closers on rows none of its carets is on; another view's closers are its own
    // business (a split shares one AutoCloser; rev-2 4.12).
    void AutoCloser::Prune(const SelectionSet& sels)
    {
        const Rope& rope = m_buffer.Text();
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> rows;
        for (const Selection& s : sels.All()) rows.push_back(rope.OffsetToPoint(s.head).row);
        std::vector<AnchorSet::Id> drop;
        for (const auto& [id, who] : m_owners)
        {
            if (who != &sels || !m_closers.Contains(id)) continue;
            const std::uint32_t row = rope.OffsetToPoint(std::min<ByteOffset>(m_closers.Get(id).offset, rope.Size())).row;
            if (std::find(rows.begin(), rows.end(), row) == rows.end()) drop.push_back(id);
        }
        for (const AnchorSet::Id id : drop) Forget(id);
    }

    bool AutoCloser::Type(SelectionSet& sels, std::string_view typed, const EditContext& context)
    {
        if (typed.empty() || m_pairs.empty()) return false;
        const Pair* opener = nullptr;
        bool closer = false;
        for (const Pair& p : m_pairs)
        {
            if (!opener && p.open == typed) opener = &p;
            if (p.close == typed) closer = true;
        }
        if (!opener && !closer) return false;
        Prune(sels);

        enum class Act : std::uint8_t { Plain, Wrap, Close, Over };
        std::vector<Act> acts;
        bool any = false;
        for (const Selection& s : sels.All())
        {
            Act act = Act::Plain;
            if (!s.Empty()) { if (opener) act = Act::Wrap; }
            else if (closer && TrackedAt(s.head, sels) && StartsWith(s.head, typed)) act = Act::Over;
            else if (opener && CanClose(s.head, *opener)) act = Act::Close;
            any = any || act != Act::Plain;
            acts.push_back(act);
        }
        if (!any) return false;

        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::vector<ByteRange> after;        // {anchor, head} in post-edit coordinates
        std::vector<ByteOffset> newClosers;  // post-edit offsets of the closers inserted now
        std::vector<AnchorSet::Id> consumed;
        std::int64_t shift = 0;
        const auto at = [&](ByteOffset pre, std::size_t extra) { return static_cast<ByteOffset>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(pre) + shift) + extra; };
        const std::span<const Selection> all = sels.All();
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < all.size(); ++i)
        {
            const Selection& s = all[i];
            const ByteOffset b = std::min(s.anchor, s.head), e = std::max(s.anchor, s.head);
            switch (acts[i])
            {
            case Act::Plain:
                Put(ops, { b, e }, std::string(typed));
                after.push_back({ at(b, typed.size()), at(b, typed.size()) });
                shift += static_cast<std::int64_t>(typed.size()) - static_cast<std::int64_t>(e - b);
                break;
            case Act::Wrap:
            {
                Put(ops, { b, b }, opener->open);
                Put(ops, { e, e }, opener->close);
                const ByteOffset nb = at(b, opener->open.size()), ne = at(e, opener->open.size());
                after.push_back(s.anchor <= s.head ? ByteRange{ nb, ne } : ByteRange{ ne, nb });
                shift += static_cast<std::int64_t>(opener->open.size() + opener->close.size());
                break;
            }
            case Act::Close:
                Put(ops, { b, b }, opener->open + opener->close);
                after.push_back({ at(b, opener->open.size()), at(b, opener->open.size()) });
                newClosers.push_back(at(b, opener->open.size()));
                shift += static_cast<std::int64_t>(opener->open.size() + opener->close.size());
                break;
            case Act::Over:
                consumed.push_back(*TrackedAt(b, sels));
                after.push_back({ at(b, typed.size()), at(b, typed.size()) });
                break;
            }
        }
        for (const AnchorSet::Id id : consumed) Forget(id);
        // One Typing transaction through TE1's command layer with the VIEW'S context (spec s2.1;
        // rev-2 4.12: never a default EditContext{}); only typed over (no ops) just moves the carets,
        // with no undo entry.
        TextCommands(m_buffer, sels, context).ApplyEdits(TransactionKind::Typing, std::move(ops), ToSelections(after), sels.PrimaryIndex());
        for (const ByteOffset c : newClosers)
            m_owners.emplace_back(m_closers.Add(Anchor{ c, Bias::Right }), &sels);   // typing at the caret pushes it right
        return true;
    }

    bool AutoCloser::Backspace(SelectionSet& sels, const EditContext& context)
    {
        if (m_closers.Size() == 0) return false;
        Prune(sels);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::vector<ByteRange> after;
        std::vector<AnchorSet::Id> used;
        ByteOffset removed = 0;
        for (const Selection& s : sels.All())
        {
            if (!s.Empty()) return false;
            const std::optional<AnchorSet::Id> id = TrackedAt(s.head, sels);
            if (!id) return false;
            const Pair* pair = nullptr;
            for (const Pair& p : m_pairs)
                if (s.head >= p.open.size() && StartsWith(s.head, p.close) && StartsWith(s.head - p.open.size(), p.open)) { pair = &p; break; }
            if (!pair) return false;
            const ByteRange range{ s.head - pair->open.size(), s.head + pair->close.size() };
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ range, {} });
            after.push_back({ range.begin - removed, range.begin - removed });
            removed += range.end - range.begin;
            used.push_back(*id);
        }
        if (ops.empty()) return false;
        for (const AnchorSet::Id id : used) Forget(id);
        TextCommands(m_buffer, sels, context).ApplyEdits(TransactionKind::Deleting, std::move(ops), ToSelections(after), sels.PrimaryIndex());
        return true;
    }
}
```

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/AutoCloseFilter.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    bool AutoCloseFilter::Refresh()
    {
        if (!Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().autoClosePairs) return false;
        const std::span<const std::pair<std::string, std::string>> pairs = m_pairs ? m_pairs() : std::span<const std::pair<std::string, std::string>>{};
        if (pairs.data() != m_pairsData || pairs.size() != m_pairsSize)   // the grammar changed
        {
            m_closer.SetPairs(pairs);
            m_pairsData = pairs.data();
            m_pairsSize = pairs.size();
        }
        return !pairs.empty();
    }

    bool AutoCloseFilter::Typed(TextModel& model, std::string_view codePoint, const Text::EditContext& context)
    {
        return Refresh() && m_closer.Type(model.selections, codePoint, context);   // model.selections: this view's closers
    }

    bool AutoCloseFilter::Backspace(TextModel& model, const Text::EditContext& context)
    {
        return Refresh() && m_closer.Backspace(model.selections, context);
    }
}
```

```cpp
    void TextEditorView::InsertTyped(Text::TextCommands& cmds, std::string_view text, bool readOnly)
    {
        if (readOnly || text.empty())
            return;
        if (!m_typing)
        {
            cmds.InsertText(text);
            return;
        }
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < text.size();)   // TE4-22: each code point is offered to the filter first
        {
            const auto lead = static_cast<unsigned char>(text[i]);
            const std::size_t len = std::min<std::size_t>(text.size() - i, lead < 0x80 ? 1 : (lead >> 5) == 0x6 ? 2 : (lead >> 4) == 0xE ? 3 : 4);
```

### Task TE4-23: Keyboard column selection (spec s3.2, s7 `text.columnSelect*`)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/ColumnSelect.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/ColumnSelect.cpp`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/ColumnSelectTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE1 `ColumnModel::{ColumnOf(const Rope&, ByteOffset), OffsetAtColumn(const Rope&, row, column)}` (display columns; `OffsetAtColumn` clamps to the line), `GraphemeColumnModel(tabSize)`, `class TextCommands` (`Buffer()`, `Selections()`, `Columns()` -- the context's `columns`, else `GraphemeColumnModel(tabSize)`; `ConfirmCursorCount(std::size_t)` -- true up to `EditContext::maxCursors`, above it the `confirmCursors` hook decides, a null hook refuses; TE1-17), `EditContext::{maxCursors, confirmCursors, columns}`, `TextBuffer::{Text, Undo}`, `SelectionSet::{All, Primary, operator==}`, `Rope::{OffsetToPoint, LineStart, LineEnd, LineCount}`; TE4-7 `AssignSelections(TextCommands&, std::span<const ByteRange>, std::size_t)`.
- Produces: `enum class Text::ColumnStep { Up, Down, Left, Right }`; `struct Text::ColumnBox { anchorRow, anchorCol, headRow, headCol }`; `class Text::ColumnSelector { bool Step(TextCommands&, ColumnStep); const std::optional<ColumnBox>& Box() const; }` (the step reads the box's columns, `maxCursors` and the cursor question from the `TextCommands`' context and moves the selections through it -- rev-2 4.11, 4.14). TE4-24 binds `text.columnSelectUp/Down/Left/Right` (Ctrl+Shift+Alt+arrows) to it; TE5's Visual-block mode may reuse `ColumnBox` for its rectangle.

TE1-17 left the keyboard half of s3.2's column selection to this chunk (Alt+drag is TE2's mouse path). The rectangle is kept in display columns, not bytes, so a step over a short line or a tab does not lose the column the box started in: the box is the state, and the selections are rebuilt from it after every step. Rows inside the box that are shorter than its left edge get no selection (Sublime and VS Code both skip them), except the anchor and head rows, which keep a clamped caret so the box never loses its ends. A selection set this selector did not produce (a click, an edit that moved the carets) starts a new box at the primary selection. A box taller than `editor.text.maxCursors` goes through TE1's `ConfirmCursorCount`, exactly as Ctrl+D, Alt+F3 and Ctrl+Alt+Up do: the document's hook (TE4-24) turns it into the "Create cursors?" question and re-runs the step on Yes (rev-2 4.14: it was refused silently). Every step is an undo-group boundary followed by `TextCommands::SetSelections`, through TE4-7's `AssignSelections` (rev-2 4.11).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

```cpp
// TE4-23 (spec s3.2): Ctrl+Shift+Alt+arrows grow a rectangle in display
// columns; short rows inside it are skipped; a foreign selection restarts it;
// above maxCursors it asks like every other cursor command.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include "TextEditor/Core/ColumnSelect.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"   // GraphemeColumnModel
#include <functional>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using Sels = std::vector<std::pair<ByteOffset, ByteOffset>>;

namespace
{
    Sels Of(const SelectionSet& s)
    {
        Sels out;
        for (const Selection& x : s.All()) out.emplace_back(x.anchor, x.head);
        return out;
    }
    // The context a view's commands carry: the display columns, the cursor limit and its question.
    EditContext Ctx(const ColumnModel& columns, std::uint32_t maxCursors, std::function<bool(std::size_t)> confirm = {})
    {
        EditContext c;
        c.columns = &columns;
        c.maxCursors = maxCursors;
        c.confirmCursors = std::move(confirm);
        return c;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("Column select: down and right grow the box; up shrinks it back", "[text-column]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("abcdef\nab\nabcdef\n"), EolMap());   // rows start at 0, 7, 10
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(2, 2);
    const GraphemeColumnModel cols(4);
    TextCommands cmd(buf, sels, Ctx(cols, 100));
    ColumnSelector box;
    REQUIRE(box.Step(cmd, ColumnStep::Down));
    CHECK(Of(sels) == Sels{ { 2, 2 }, { 9, 9 } });
    REQUIRE(box.Step(cmd, ColumnStep::Right));
    CHECK(Of(sels) == Sels{ { 2, 3 }, { 9, 9 } });                     // row 1 is two columns wide: a clamped caret
    REQUIRE(box.Step(cmd, ColumnStep::Down));
    REQUIRE(box.Step(cmd, ColumnStep::Right));
    CHECK(Of(sels) == Sels{ { 2, 4 }, { 9, 9 }, { 12, 14 } });
    CHECK(sels.Primary().head == 14);                                   // the head row is primary
    REQUIRE(box.Box().has_value());
    CHECK(box.Box()->headRow == 2);
    CHECK(box.Box()->headCol == 4);
    REQUIRE(box.Step(cmd, ColumnStep::Up));
    REQUIRE(box.Step(cmd, ColumnStep::Up));
    CHECK(Of(sels) == Sels{ { 2, 4 } });
    CHECK_FALSE(box.Step(cmd, ColumnStep::Up));                         // row 0 is the top
}

TEST_CASE("Column select: rows shorter than the box's left edge are skipped; tabs count as display columns", "[text-column]")
{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("abcdef\n\nabcdef"), EolMap());     // rows start at 0, 7, 8
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(4, 4);
    const GraphemeColumnModel cols(4);
    TextCommands cmd(buf, sels, Ctx(cols, 100));
    ColumnSelector box;
    REQUIRE(box.Step(cmd, ColumnStep::Down));
    CHECK(Of(sels) == Sels{ { 4, 4 }, { 7, 7 } });                     // the head row keeps a clamped caret
    REQUIRE(box.Step(cmd, ColumnStep::Down));
    CHECK(Of(sels) == Sels{ { 4, 4 }, { 12, 12 } });                   // the empty middle row is skipped

    TextBuffer tabs(Rope::FromUtf8("\tab\nabcdef"), EolMap());        // rows start at 0, 4
    SelectionSet t;
    t.SetSingle(8, 8);                                                  // row 1, column 4
    TextCommands tcmd(tabs, t, Ctx(cols, 100));
    ColumnSelector tbox;
    REQUIRE(tbox.Step(tcmd, ColumnStep::Up));
    CHECK(Of(t) == Sels{ { 1, 1 }, { 8, 8 } });                        // column 4 of "\tab" is after the tab
}

{
    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("abcdef\nabcdef\nabcdef\n"), EolMap());   // rows start at 0, 7, 14
    SelectionSet sels;

    ColumnSelector small;
    REQUIRE(small.Step(refuse, ColumnStep::Down));

{

    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("abcdef\nabcdef\nabcdef\n"), EolMap());
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(1, 1);
    const GraphemeColumnModel cols(4);
    std::vector<std::size_t> asked;
    bool answer = false;
    TextCommands cmd(buf, sels, Ctx(cols, 2, [&](std::size_t n) { asked.push_back(n); return answer; }));
    ColumnSelector box;
    REQUIRE(box.Step(cmd, ColumnStep::Down));                           // two cursors: within the limit, no question
    CHECK(asked.empty());
    CHECK_FALSE(box.Step(cmd, ColumnStep::Down));                       // three: asked, and refused
    CHECK(asked == std::vector<std::size_t>{ 3 });
    CHECK(sels.Size() == 2);                                            // nothing changed
    answer = true;
    REQUIRE(box.Step(cmd, ColumnStep::Down));                           // asked again, and granted
    CHECK(asked == std::vector<std::size_t>{ 3, 3 });
    CHECK(sels.Size() == 3);
}

    TextBuffer buf(Rope::FromUtf8("ab\nab\n"), EolMap());
    SelectionSet sels;
    sels.SetSingle(0, 0);
    const GraphemeColumnModel cols(4);

    cmd.InsertText("x");                                                // "xab\nab\n", caret 1
    ColumnSelector box;
    REQUIRE(box.Step(cmd, ColumnStep::Down));
    REQUIRE(box.Step(cmd, ColumnStep::Up));                             // back to the one caret at 1
    CHECK(Of(sels) == Sels{ { 1, 1 } });
    cmd.InsertText("y");
    CHECK(buf.Undo(sels));
    CHECK(buf.Text().ToString() == "xab\nab\n");                        // "y" alone
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/ColumnSelect.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// Keyboard column selection (text editor spec s3.2; TE4-23): a rectangle in
// display columns, grown one row or column per step; the selections are
// rebuilt from it every step, through TextCommands.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"   // ColumnModel, TextCommands

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class ColumnStep : std::uint8_t { Up, Down, Left, Right };

    struct ColumnBox
    {
        std::uint32_t anchorRow = 0, anchorCol = 0;
        std::uint32_t headRow = 0, headCol = 0;
    };

    class ColumnSelector
    {
    public:
        // One step over cmd's buffer and selections, in cmd.Columns()' display columns. false = the box
        // did not change: an edge, or more cursors than cmd's context allows and its question said no.
        bool Step(TextCommands& cmd, ColumnStep step);
        [[nodiscard]] const std::optional<ColumnBox>& Box() const noexcept { return m_box; }

    private:
        std::optional<ColumnBox> m_box;
        std::optional<SelectionSet> m_produced;   // what the last step left; anything else restarts the box
    };
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Core/ColumnSelect.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Core/ColumnSelect.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/SearchCommands.hpp"   // AssignSelections

#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    bool ColumnSelector::Step(TextCommands& cmd, ColumnStep step)
    {
        const Rope& rope = cmd.Buffer().Text();
        const SelectionSet& sels = cmd.Selections();
        const ColumnModel& columns = cmd.Columns();
        if (!m_box || !m_produced || !(*m_produced == sels))
        {
            const Selection& p = sels.Primary();
            const Point a = rope.OffsetToPoint(p.anchor);
            const Point h = rope.OffsetToPoint(p.head);
            m_box = ColumnBox{ a.row, columns.ColumnOf(rope, p.anchor), h.row, columns.ColumnOf(rope, p.head) };
        }
        ColumnBox next = *m_box;
        const std::uint32_t lastRow = rope.LineCount() == 0 ? 0 : rope.LineCount() - 1;
        switch (step)
        {
        case ColumnStep::Up:    if (next.headRow == 0) return false; --next.headRow; break;
        case ColumnStep::Down:  if (next.headRow >= lastRow) return false; ++next.headRow; break;
        case ColumnStep::Left:  if (next.headCol == 0) return false; --next.headCol; break;
        case ColumnStep::Right:
        {
            std::uint32_t widest = 0;   // the box never grows past the longest row it spans
            for (std::uint32_t r = std::min(next.anchorRow, next.headRow); r <= std::max(next.anchorRow, next.headRow); ++r)
                widest = std::max(widest, columns.ColumnOf(rope, rope.LineEnd(r)));
            if (next.headCol >= widest) return false;
            ++next.headCol;
            break;
        }
        }

        const std::uint32_t top = std::min(next.anchorRow, next.headRow), bottom = std::max(next.anchorRow, next.headRow);
        const std::uint32_t left = std::min(next.anchorCol, next.headCol);
        std::vector<ByteRange> ranges;
        std::size_t primary = 0;
        for (std::uint32_t r = top; r <= bottom; ++r)
        {
            const bool end = r == next.anchorRow || r == next.headRow;
            if (!end && columns.ColumnOf(rope, rope.LineEnd(r)) < left) continue;   // too short to reach the box
            if (r == next.headRow) primary = ranges.size();
            ranges.push_back({ columns.OffsetAtColumn(rope, r, next.anchorCol), columns.OffsetAtColumn(rope, r, next.headCol) });
        }
        // rev-2 4.14: above maxCursors, TE1's rule -- the context's hook asks (TE4-24: the "Create cursors?"
        // question, the step re-run on Yes); no hook, or a No, leaves everything as it was.
        if (!cmd.ConfirmCursorCount(ranges.size())) return false;
        AssignSelections(cmd, ranges, primary);   // an undo-group boundary, then TextCommands::SetSelections (rev-2 4.11)
        m_box = next;
        m_produced = cmd.Selections();
        return true;
    }
}
```

(`ColumnSelect.cpp` is in `TextEditor/Core/`, which `ArcaneText` globs: a premake regenerate picks it up.)

```cpp
    CVarRegistry reg;

    ImGuiContext* prev = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();

    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.DisplaySize = ImVec2(800, 600);
    io.IniFilename = nullptr;
    unsigned char* px = nullptr; int w = 0, h = 0;
    io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
    Recorder rec;
    const auto frame = [&](bool dispatch)
    {
        InputSnapshot s;
        Editor::ActionFrameInput in; in.snap = &s; in.dt = 1.0 / 60.0;
        actions.BeginFrame(in);
        io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        if (dispatch) Editor::DispatchTextActions(actions, rec);
        ImGui::Render();
    };
    const auto press = [&](std::initializer_list<ImGuiKey> mods, ImGuiKey key)
    {
        rec.ran.clear();
        for (const ImGuiKey m : mods) io.AddKeyEvent(m, true);
        io.AddKeyEvent(key, true);
        frame(true);
        io.AddKeyEvent(key, false);
        for (const ImGuiKey m : mods) io.AddKeyEvent(m, false);
        frame(false);
        return rec.ran;
    };
    frame(false);
    CHECK(press({ ImGuiMod_Ctrl }, ImGuiKey_D) == std::vector<TextAction>{ TextAction::AddNextMatch });

    CHECK(press({ ImGuiMod_Ctrl }, ImGuiKey_LeftBracket) == std::vector<TextAction>{ TextAction::OutdentAlt });
    CHECK(press({ ImGuiMod_Ctrl, ImGuiMod_Alt }, ImGuiKey_UpArrow) == std::vector<TextAction>{ TextAction::AddCursorAbove });
    CHECK(press({ ImGuiMod_Ctrl, ImGuiMod_Shift, ImGuiMod_Alt }, ImGuiKey_DownArrow) == std::vector<TextAction>{ TextAction::ColumnSelectDown });
    CHECK(press({ ImGuiMod_Ctrl }, ImGuiKey_Slash) == std::vector<TextAction>{ TextAction::ToggleLineComment });
    CHECK(press({ ImGuiMod_Alt }, ImGuiKey_F3) == std::vector<TextAction>{ TextAction::SelectAllMatches });
    CHECK(press({}, ImGuiKey_A).empty());                        // a typed letter is text, not an action
    CHECK(press({}, ImGuiKey_LeftArrow).empty());                // plain arrows stay the view's
    ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx);
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev);
}

    for (const Editor::TextActionRow& row : Editor::kTextActionTable)   // every row runs on a small document

TEST_CASE("Text actions: the views' context (no rerun) carries the document's indentation and reports a refused cursor count as a note", "[text-actions]")
{
    const Test::ScopedCodeRung limit("editor.text.maxCursors", CVarValue::UInt32(2));
    const std::filesystem::path path = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "te4-actions-context.txt";
    auto doc = OpenText(path, "x\n\tone\n\ttwo\n\tthree\n");       // detected: tabs (TE4-18)
    REQUIRE_FALSE(doc->Indentation().spaces);
    Text::EditContext ec = doc->MakeEditContext(doc->Model());    // what SetEditContextProvider hands the views
    CHECK_FALSE(ec.insertSpaces);                                  // the document's indentation, not the settings'
    CHECK(ec.display == &doc->Model().display);
    REQUIRE(ec.confirmCursors);
    CHECK_FALSE(ec.confirmCursors(5));                             // refused ...
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->PendingCursorQuestion().has_value());         // ... without a question (nothing to re-run)
    CHECK(doc->Note().find("editor.text.maxCursors") != std::string::npos);   // ... and said why
    doc->OpenSplit(false);                                         // the second view gets the same provider (AttachOverlays)
    Text::EditContext ec1 = doc->MakeEditContext(doc->ModelOf(*doc->SecondaryView()));
    CHECK(ec1.display == &doc->ModelOf(*doc->SecondaryView()).display);
    CHECK_FALSE(ec1.insertSpaces);
    // The VIEWS carry the provider (AttachOverlays installs it on both), and it is the document's
    // context: the document's indentation, the view's own display map, and the refusing hook.
    for (Editor::TextEditorView* v : { &doc->View(), doc->SecondaryView() })
    {
        const std::function<Text::EditContext(Editor::TextModel&)>& provider = v->EditContextProvider();
        REQUIRE(provider);                                         // empty = DefaultEditContext: no grammar, no hook
        Text::EditContext viaView = provider(doc->ModelOf(*v));
        CHECK(viaView.display == &doc->ModelOf(*v).display);
        CHECK_FALSE(viaView.insertSpaces);                         // tabs, detected for this document (TE4-18)
        REQUIRE(viaView.confirmCursors);
        doc->ShowNote("");
        CHECK_FALSE(viaView.confirmCursors(5));                    // refuses without asking ...
        CHECK_FALSE(doc->PendingCursorQuestion().has_value());
        CHECK(doc->Note().find("editor.text.maxCursors") != std::string::npos);   // ... and says why
    }
    doc.reset();
    std::filesystem::remove(path);
}
```

```cpp
    int DispatchTextActions(EditorActions& actions, TextActionTarget& target)
    {
        actions.MarkContextActive(ActionContext::TextDocument);
        int ran = 0;
        for (const TextActionRow& row : kTextActionTable)
        {
            const bool fired = row.repeats ? actions.PressedRepeat(row.desc.id) : actions.Pressed(row.desc.id);
            if (!fired) continue;
            target.RunTextAction(row.action);
            ++ran;
        }
        return ran;
    }
```

```cpp
    Text::EditContext TextDocument::MakeEditContext(TextModel& model, std::optional<TextAction> rerun)
    {
        // TE2-11 (+TE4-18): SyncDisplay, the editor.text.* editing settings, the display map and
        // the document's own indentation (model.indent).
        Text::EditContext ec = DefaultEditContext(model);
        if (const Text::GrammarSnapshot g = Grammar())
        {
            const Text::GrammarDesc& d = g->Rules().Desc();
            ec.wordChars = Text::WordChars::FromSpec(d.wordChars);
            ec.comment = Text::CommentTokens{ d.lineComment, d.blockCommentBegin, d.blockCommentEnd };
        }
        ec.confirmCursors = [this, rerun](std::size_t requested)
        {
            if (m_cursorsGranted) return true;
            if (rerun)
                m_cursorQuestion = CursorQuestion{ *rerun, requested };   // asked by Draw's modal; a yes re-runs the action
            else                                                          // typing / vim: nothing to re-run, say why
                ShowNote(std::format("Not added: {} cursors is more than editor.text.maxCursors ({}).",
                                     requested, Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>().maxCursors));
            return false;
        };
        return ec;
    }

    void TextDocument::AnswerCursorQuestion(bool yes)
    {
        const std::optional<CursorQuestion> q = std::exchange(m_cursorQuestion, std::nullopt);
        if (!q || !yes) return;
        m_cursorsGranted = true;
        RunTextAction(q->action);
        m_cursorsGranted = false;
    }

    void TextDocument::RunTextAction(TextAction action)
    {
        TextEditorView& view = FocusedView();
        TextModel& model = ModelOf(view);
        ViewEditScope edit(model);                     // this view places its own selections (TE4-17)
        Text::TextBuffer& buf = Buffer();
        Text::SelectionSet& sels = model.selections;
        Text::TextCommands cmd(buf, sels, MakeEditContext(model, action));   // a refused cursor count re-runs `action` on Yes
        const Text::Rope& rope = buf.Text();
        const auto page = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::max(1, view.PageRows()));
        const std::uint32_t caretRow = rope.OffsetToPoint(sels.Primary().head).row;
        switch (action)
        {
        case TextAction::WordLeft:                  cmd.MoveWordLeft(false); break;
        case TextAction::WordRight:                 cmd.MoveWordRight(false); break;
        case TextAction::SelectWordLeft:            cmd.MoveWordLeft(true); break;
        case TextAction::SelectWordRight:           cmd.MoveWordRight(true); break;
        case TextAction::LineStart:                 cmd.MoveLineStart(false); break;
        case TextAction::LineEnd:                   cmd.MoveLineEnd(false); break;
        case TextAction::SelectLineStart:           cmd.MoveLineStart(true); break;
        case TextAction::SelectLineEnd:             cmd.MoveLineEnd(true); break;
        case TextAction::DocumentStart:             cmd.MoveDocumentStart(false); break;
        case TextAction::DocumentEnd:               cmd.MoveDocumentEnd(false); break;
        case TextAction::SelectDocumentStart:       cmd.MoveDocumentStart(true); break;
        case TextAction::SelectDocumentEnd:         cmd.MoveDocumentEnd(true); break;
        case TextAction::PageUp:                    cmd.MovePageUp(page, false); break;
        case TextAction::PageDown:                  cmd.MovePageDown(page, false); break;
        case TextAction::SelectPageUp:              cmd.MovePageUp(page, true); break;
        case TextAction::SelectPageDown:            cmd.MovePageDown(page, true); break;
        case TextAction::AddNextMatch:              cmd.AddNextMatch(); break;
        case TextAction::SelectAllMatches:          cmd.SelectAllMatches(); break;
        case TextAction::SplitSelectionIntoLines:   cmd.SplitSelectionIntoLines(); break;
        case TextAction::AddCursorAbove:            cmd.AddCursorAbove(); break;
        case TextAction::AddCursorBelow:            cmd.AddCursorBelow(); break;
        // The column step asks past maxCursors through cmd's confirmCursors hook, so a Yes re-runs this action (rev-2 4.14).
        case TextAction::ColumnSelectUp:            m_columnSelect.Step(cmd, Text::ColumnStep::Up); break;
        case TextAction::ColumnSelectDown:          m_columnSelect.Step(cmd, Text::ColumnStep::Down); break;
        case TextAction::ColumnSelectLeft:          m_columnSelect.Step(cmd, Text::ColumnStep::Left); break;
        case TextAction::ColumnSelectRight:         m_columnSelect.Step(cmd, Text::ColumnStep::Right); break;
        case TextAction::SelectLine:                cmd.SelectLine(); break;
        case TextAction::ExpandSelectionToBrackets:
            if (const std::optional<Text::BracketContext> c = BracketContextNow()) Text::BracketCommands::ExpandSelectionToBrackets(cmd, *c);
            break;
        case TextAction::DuplicateLine:             if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.DuplicateLines(); break;
        case TextAction::DeleteLine:                if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.DeleteLines(); break;
        case TextAction::MoveLineUp:                if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.MoveLinesUp(); break;
        case TextAction::MoveLineDown:              if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.MoveLinesDown(); break;
        case TextAction::Indent:                    if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.Tab(); break;       // rows indent; else to the next tab stop
        case TextAction::IndentAlt:                 if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.Indent(); break;
        case TextAction::Outdent:
        case TextAction::OutdentAlt:                if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.Outdent(); break;
        case TextAction::ToggleLineComment:         if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.ToggleLineComment(); break;
        case TextAction::ToggleBlockComment:        if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.ToggleBlockComment(); break;
        case TextAction::JoinLines:                 if (!ReadOnly()) cmd.JoinLines(); break;
        case TextAction::Find:                      m_find->Open(false, sels); m_findUi.focusQuery = true; break;
        case TextAction::Replace:                   m_find->Open(!ReadOnly(), sels); m_findUi.focusQuery = true; break;
        case TextAction::FindNext:
            if (!m_find->IsOpen()) m_find->Open(false, sels);
            m_find->Next();
            break;
        case TextAction::FindPrevious:
            if (!m_find->IsOpen()) m_find->Open(false, sels);
            m_find->Previous();
            break;
        case TextAction::GoToLine:                  GotoLine().openRequested = true; break;
        case TextAction::Fold:                      Text::FoldCommands::FoldAtCursors(model.folds, model.display, cmd, model.indent.width); break;
        case TextAction::Unfold:                    Text::FoldCommands::UnfoldAtCursors(model.folds, model.display, sels, rope); break;
        case TextAction::GoToMatchingBracket:
            if (const std::optional<Text::BracketContext> c = BracketContextNow()) Text::BracketCommands::GoToMatchingBracket(cmd, *c);
            break;
        case TextAction::ToggleBookmark:            Bookmarks().Toggle(caretRow); break;
        case TextAction::NextBookmark:
            if (const std::optional<std::uint32_t> row = Bookmarks().Next(caretRow)) GoTo(Text::Point{ *row, 0 });
            break;
        case TextAction::PreviousBookmark:
            if (const std::optional<std::uint32_t> row = Bookmarks().Previous(caretRow)) GoTo(Text::Point{ *row, 0 });
            break;
        case TextAction::ZoomIn:                    view.ZoomBy(1); break;
        case TextAction::ZoomOut:                   view.ZoomBy(-1); break;
        case TextAction::ZoomReset:                 view.ResetZoom(); break;
        case TextAction::ConvertLineEndings:        // spec s3.5: explicit, one undo step, to the dominant style
            (void)ConvertLineEndings(buf.Eols().Dominant());   // TE4-19's one path: read-only refused, NotifyOutsideChange first (rev-2 A10)
            break;
        case TextAction::Count:                     break;
        }
        // A caret never stays inside a fold, and the primary stays on screen.
        Text::FoldCommands::RevealSelections(model.folds, model.display, sels, buf.Text());
        view.EnsureCursorVisible();
    }
```

**Spec gaps, conflicts and decisions the controller should see** (notes 1-3 and 6-8 of the first draft -- the TE1/TE2 command layer, `TextModel` over a shared buffer, the syntax-service constructor, the encoding enums, TE6's view APIs, `SetVim` -- are resolved by CANON and removed; the remaining numbers are kept):
4. **TE3 Regex additions.** The windowed line path needs `PCRE2_NOTBOL` / `PCRE2_NOTEOL`, `PCRE2_PARTIAL_HARD` and `PCRE2_INFO_MAXLOOKBEHIND`; TE4-5 adds `MatchFlags::{NotBol, NotEol, PartialHard}`, `MatchStatus::Partial` (returned only to a `PartialHard` caller) and `Regex::MaxLookbehind()` to TE3's wrapper (and git-adds TE3's `Regex.hpp` / `.cpp`; lane L4 rebases first, X7). A `PartialHard` call runs interpreted (TE3-2 JIT-compiles `PCRE2_JIT_COMPLETE` only); only an over-long line's non-final windows use it.
5. **Brackets are TE3's.** TE3-18 owns `FindMatchingBracket` / `FindEnclosingBrackets` (string and comment runs skipped, `bracketScanMaxLines` measured by TE3-32); TE4-14 is only the UI and commands over them. TE3's `brackets` are single ASCII characters; `autoClose` pairs (TE4-22) are strings.
9. **Chords the spec does not give.** Column select (Ctrl+Shift+Alt+arrows), expand selection to brackets (Ctrl+Shift+M), zoom (Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0) use VS Code / Sublime chords; `text.convertLineEndings` ships unbound (the status strip and the Inspector are its primary controls) and normalizes to the dominant style. `text.toggleFollow` is TE6-4's row (a `TextActionRow` with `TextAction::ToggleFollow`, unbound; CANON A8), not TE4's.
10. **Split view has no s7 row.** The s7 list names none; TE4 adds a status-strip toggle and the `OpenSplit` / `CloseSplit` API for vim's `:sp` / `:vs` / `Ctrl+W` (TE5c). A `text.splitView` row would be a one-line addition if wanted.
11. **Real defect in the settings tree:** `ParseKeyChord("Ctrl+[")` returned nullopt (a bare `[` started a physical key name), so the spec's Ctrl+[ outdent could not be a default and a captured Ctrl+[ on the Shortcuts page did not round-trip. TE4-1 fixes it.
12. **Typing gate.** `EditorActions::Live` silences unmodified panel chords while `WantTextInput` is set, which a text view sets to receive characters; TE4-1 exempts `ActionContext::TextDocument` (its unmodified rows use non-printing keys only: Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Tab, F2, F3). A design decision in shared input code.
13. **ImGui nav tabbing** would take Tab from `text.indent`; TE4-9 sets `ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavInputs` on the text-area child.
14. **New settings beyond the s8 list:** `editor.text.detectIndentationRows` (TE4-18; the detection bound) and TE3's `bracketScanMaxLines`. Both follow the every-tunable-is-a-setting rule; CANON D29 amends s8 with them, and TE4-3's s8-amendment contract case checks them.
15. **Auto-close rules** follow VS Code's defaults (`languageDefined`, close only before whitespace / end of line / a closer, no quote after a word character, type over and Backspace-delete only closers it inserted). The spec names the setting, not the rules.
16a. **Known limit (lossy split close, TE4-17):** `CloseView` on the primary while split rebuilds the primary's folds from the second view as `FoldSource::Marker` / `FoldSource::Indent`, so a vim Manual (`zf`) fold comes back as an Indent fold over the same rows (still folded; a later `zE` / edit treats it as Indent). Carrying the source needs a `FoldModel` accessor TE1-12 does not have; deferred.
16. **Documented limits, not bugs:** on an over-long line a single match longer than a whole window (`longLineMaxBytes`) is cut at the window's end (a shorter match that crosses a window's end moves to the next window, rev-2 4.1); a multi-line find's count carried across an edit is marked approximate (`~`) until its full recount lands (D-R4: no top-up for a pattern that can span rows); backward Find scans from the document start (on the worker); Find Next lands one frame later (it runs on the worker); symbols are not extracted above `syntaxMaxMB`; Problems markers show only `File` locators; keyboard column select skips rows shorter than the box's left edge (Sublime, VS Code); auto-close forgets a tracked closer once no caret is on its row.
17. **TE2 integration edits are described by insertion point**, not line numbers: the overlay call sites in `TextEditorView::Draw` (TE4-9), the find bar / go-to / status strip / modal positions in `TextDocument::Draw`, the second model and view (TE4-17), the indentation in `DefaultEditContext` (TE4-18), the typing filter (TE4-22), the removal of `ApplyBaselineKey`'s Home / End / PageUp / PageDown / Tab cases (TE4-24), and the `SetProblemsSource` call in TE2's text factory in `EditorApp.cpp` (TE4-15).
