### Findings that shaped this chunk (read before executing)

Each finding was verified against the settings tree `D:\dev\starworks\Arcane-settings` at `19716cf2`, and `main` at `e1db2d9e`.

1. **There is no autosave or recovery path to join.** Crash-window plan 3, "Autosave and recovery" (`docs/specs/2026-09-22-crash-window-design.md` s8), was never built: no `SaveTo` seam, no `RestoreData.json`, no restore prompt, no settings.
   - `EditorApp.hpp:143` and `EditorAppFrame.cpp:524` say "plan 3's job".
   - What *does* exist:
     - plan 1's clean-exit hook: `Diagnostics::SetCleanExitHook` / `RequestCleanExit` (`ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Base/Diagnostics.hpp:418-438`), and `EditorApp::InstallCleanExitHook` / `CleanExitRequested` (`EditorApp.hpp:144,148`);
     - `EditorLock` (`ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Project/Project.hpp:167-208`), whose stale lock nothing reads.
   - So TE6-13..TE6-15 build the text slice of s8 **in s8's own shapes**:
     - the s8.5 marker schema;
     - files under `<project>/Saved/Autosaves/`;
     - the s8.6 offer: per-entry checkbox, Restore Selected / Skip (plan revision 2, D-R9: Restore Selected / Discard Selected / Not now, session-scoped);
     - the s8.5 "never under a debugger or `--headless`" rule.
   - They write their own marker, `Saved/Autosaves/Text/RestoreData.json`, so plan 3 can later own `Saved/Autosaves/RestoreData.json` and fold the text entries into its one prompt without a migration (CANON D20).
2. **The CommandStack has no prune API, and commands are not keyed by asset.** `ArcaneClient/src/Arcane/Edit/CommandStack.hpp:53-191`.
   - Document steps hold a `std::weak_ptr<Doc*>` "anchor", e.g. `ShaderEditorDocument.cpp:216-223`.
   - A step expires when its anchor dies, and expired steps are discarded lazily, top-down, on Undo/Redo (`CommandStack.cpp:245-297`).
   - "Prune-on-invalidate" is the **Inspector history** rule (`InspectorHost::InvalidateSource` / `PruneStale`, `ArcaneEditor/src/Panels/InspectorHost.hpp:96,166`), not an undo-stack one.
   - So TE6-6 adds `CommandStack::PruneExpired()`. A clean reload then:
     - re-mints the document's anchor, which expires every pre-reload step;
     - prunes them eagerly;
     - calls `InspectorHost::InvalidateSource` for the document.
   - Together these are the "global CommandStack entries for that asset pruned" of s5.4 (CANON D22).
3. **"Open as text" already exists, but it opens the file in the OS default editor.**
   - The entry points are:
     - the Asset Browser row menu: `AssetPanelCommon.cpp:390-391`;
     - the Assets menu: `EditorPanels.cpp:400-401`;
     - the Inspector asset page: `AssetInspectorSource.cpp:393`;
     - the Problems locator route: `EditorAppProject.cpp:260-261`.
   - All of them end in `OsShell::OpenAsText`: `EditorAppFrame.cpp:190-200`, through `AssetPathAction`.
   - TE6-12 builds the in-editor backend (`EditorApp::OpenAsText`, `OpenAsTextFlow`); **TE7-11** re-points the four sites straight to `Files().OpenWith(path, OpenerId::ArcaneText())` (CANON B6). No new menu rows are needed.
4. **The editor has no OS file watcher.**
   - `EditorApp::PollAssetWatch` (`EditorAppProject.cpp:432-746`) is a ~1 Hz mtime poll with hard-coded per-kind branches.
   - Only materials reload an open document, and that reload never touches undo history.
   - Sprite, Mesh and InputActions documents ignore external changes. TE6-7..TE6-11 is the s5.4 audit plus its fixes.
5. **No timing baseline mechanism exists.** `scripts/automation-baselines.json` holds suite-wide assertion and case counts only, and `check-baselines.ps1` compares those two metrics.
   - TE6-18 adds a `perf[]` table (ceilings per configuration), a test helper that reads it, and a `-PerfReportPath` mode for the checker (CANON D32).
   - The precedent for an inline ceiling with headroom was the removed `PhysicsPerfTripwireTest` (`a0d5f03d6`).

### Task TE6-6: `CommandStack::PruneExpired` -- eager removal of a reloaded document's steps (spec s5.4)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneClient/src/Arcane/Edit/CommandStack.hpp`. Declare the method after `Clear` (`:147`).
- Modify: `ArcaneClient/src/Arcane/Edit/CommandStack.cpp`. Add the method after `DiscardExpired` (`:251-255`).
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/CommandStackTest.cpp`. Append cases that reuse the file's `DocStep` / `CountingCommand` fakes (`:310-343`).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `CommandStack::Expired` (private, `:219`).
- Produces: `std::size_t Arcane::CommandStack::PruneExpired()`. It removes every expired, non-scene transaction from both the undo and redo deques, wherever it sits, and keeps the order of everything else.

  Why non-scene only: `SceneStateId()` (`CommandStack.cpp:299-307`) is the scene's dirty clock. Pruning only `!affectsScene` steps leaves it unchanged by construction. Every document step returns `AffectsScene() == false` (`ShaderEditorDocument.cpp:219`).

  ABI: this is an added non-virtual member of an `ARC_API` class. It changes no layout and needs no `kGamePluginABIVersion` bump (GATE-1 Step 1 checks this).

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

In `CommandStack.hpp`, after `void Clear(std::string reason);`:

```cpp
        // Removes every EXPIRED, NON-SCENE transaction from both stacks,
        // wherever it sits (Undo/Redo only discard expired entries from the
        // top). Text editor spec s5.4: a dedicated editor that reloads its
        // asset under a clean working copy re-mints its anchor and prunes
        // here, so no pre-reload step survives anywhere in the history.
        // Scene steps are never touched, so SceneStateId() is unchanged.
        // Returns the number removed.
        std::size_t PruneExpired();
```

In `CommandStack.cpp`:

```cpp
    std::size_t CommandStack::PruneExpired()
    {
        const auto prunable = [](const Transaction& t) { return !t.affectsScene && Expired(t); };
        const std::size_t removed = std::erase_if(m_undo, prunable) + std::erase_if(m_redo, prunable);
        return removed;
    }
```

`std::erase_if` on `std::deque` is C++20 and is in `<deque>`, which the header already includes.

  `ApplyExternalAssetChange` acts on every open document whose `AssetGuid()` matches, except `origin` and except `TextDocument`s (TE2 reloads those itself). The result is:
  - `!DiskDiffersFromSaved()` -> `Unchanged`, clean or dirty: the file still holds what the document last saved (its own save's echo, or a touch). No reload, no banner, no history change (finding 6.2: save, edit, then the 1 Hz poll sees the save's mtime -- that is not a conflict, and its Reload would discard the post-save edits);
  - clean -> `ReloadAndClearHistory`;
  - dirty -> `NoteConflict`, whose Reload button calls `ReloadAndClearHistory`.

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/ExternalAssetReloadTest.cpp
// s5.4: a reload under a CLEAN dedicated editor clears that document's undo
// history (anchor re-minted + pruned) and shows the toolbar note; under a
// DIRTY one it raises the conflict banner and loses neither side.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Documents/DocumentHost.hpp"
#include "Documents/ExternalAssetReload.hpp"
#include "Documents/ExternalChangeStrip.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Edit/Command.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Edit/CommandStack.hpp>
#include <Astra/Registry/Registry.hpp>

using namespace Arcane;
using namespace Arcane::Editor;

namespace
{
    struct Step final : ICommand
    {
        std::weak_ptr<int> anchor;
        explicit Step(std::weak_ptr<int> a) : anchor(std::move(a)) {}
        void Undo() override {}
        void Redo() override {}
        const char* Label() const override { return "doc step"; }
        bool AffectsScene() const override { return false; }
        bool IsExpired() const override { return anchor.expired(); }
    };

    // A dedicated-editor stand-in: "disk" is a string the test changes.
    struct FakeDoc final : EditorDocument
    {
        Guid guid = Guid::Generate();
        std::string title = "fake";
        std::string memory = "v1", saved = "v1", disk = "v1";
        std::shared_ptr<int> anchor = std::make_shared<int>(0);
        int reloads = 0;

        const std::string& Title() const override { return title; }
        Guid AssetGuid() const override { return guid; }
        bool Dirty() const override { return memory != saved; }
        bool Save() override { saved = disk = memory; return true; }
        void Draw(bool&) override {}
        void NoteMoved(const std::filesystem::path&) override {}
        ExternalReloadResult ReloadFromExternalChange() override
        {
            if (disk == saved && memory == saved) return ExternalReloadResult::Unchanged;   // our own save's echo
            memory = saved = disk;
            ++reloads;
            return ExternalReloadResult::Reloaded;
        }
        void ExpireHistory() override { anchor = std::make_shared<int>(0); }
        bool DiskDiffersFromSaved() const override { return disk != saved; }
    };

    std::unique_ptr<Astra::Registry> Reg()
    {
        return std::make_unique<Astra::Registry>(std::make_shared<Astra::ComponentRegistry>());
    }
}

TEST_CASE("external asset reload: clean -> reloaded, history pruned, inspector invalidated, note shown", "[text-astext]")
{
    auto reg = Reg();
    CommandStack stack([&reg]() -> Astra::Registry& { return *reg; });
    DocumentHost host;
    auto* doc = static_cast<FakeDoc*>(host.Add(std::make_unique<FakeDoc>()));
    stack.Push(std::make_unique<Step>(doc->anchor));
    doc->memory = "v2"; doc->Save();                         // an edit, saved: clean with one step
    REQUIRE(stack.CanUndo());

    int invalidated = 0;
    const ExternalReloadContext ctx{ &stack, [&](EditorDocument&) { ++invalidated; } };
    doc->disk = "v3";                                        // Open as Text saved new bytes
    CHECK(ApplyExternalAssetChange(host, doc->guid, ctx) == ExternalChangeOutcome::Reloaded);
    CHECK(doc->memory == "v3");
    CHECK_FALSE(stack.CanUndo());                            // the pre-reload step is gone
    CHECK(invalidated == 1);
    CHECK(doc->ExternalStrip().HistoryNoteShown());
    CHECK(ExternalChangeStrip::kHistoryClearedText == "History cleared: the file was changed outside this editor");
}
```

```cpp
TEST_CASE("disk snapshot: a capture matches its own bytes; any byte change, a missing file or no capture differs", "[text-astext]")
{
    const auto dir = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "arcane-disk-snapshot";
    std::filesystem::remove_all(dir);
    std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
    const auto p = dir / "a.arcsprite";
    { std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary) << "{ \"ppu\": 16 }\n"; }

    DiskSnapshot s;
    CHECK_FALSE(s.Valid());
    CHECK(s.FileDiffers(p));                                 // never captured: cannot tell -> differs
    s.Capture(p);
    REQUIRE(s.Valid());
    CHECK_FALSE(s.FileDiffers(p));
    { std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc) << "{ \"ppu\": 16 }\n"; }   // rewritten, same bytes (a touch)
    CHECK_FALSE(s.FileDiffers(p));
    { std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc) << "{ \"ppu\": 32 }\n"; }   // same size, other bytes
    CHECK(s.FileDiffers(p));
    std::filesystem::remove(p);
    CHECK(s.FileDiffers(p));                                 // unreadable: differs
    s.Capture(p);
    CHECK_FALSE(s.Valid());                                  // capturing a missing file leaves it invalid
}
```

Never put the `private:` block mid-class: every member another task later adds "after X" must stay public, so later public members always go above this block (finding 6.6):

```cpp
    // Text editor spec s5.4: what a document did with "your file changed on disk".
    enum class ExternalReloadResult : std::uint8_t
    {
        Unchanged,     // the file holds what this document last loaded/saved (our own save's echo)
        Reloaded,      // the working copy was replaced from disk
        Failed,        // the file did not load; the in-memory copy is kept
        Unsupported,   // this document type does not reload (the default)
    };

        // ---- external change (text editor spec s5.4) ------------------------
        // Replace the working copy from disk, DISCARDING it -- callers gate on
        // Dirty() (ApplyExternalAssetChange never reloads a dirty document
        // without the user's Reload). Unchanged when the file equals what the
        // document holds. Not "ReloadFromDisk": TextDocument has a non-virtual
        // void ReloadFromDisk() (TE2-17) that would hide this virtual; text
        // documents reload through their own poll and never override this.
        virtual ExternalReloadResult ReloadFromExternalChange() { return ExternalReloadResult::Unsupported; }
        // Make every undo step this document pushed so far inert: re-mint the
        // anchor its commands hold weakly. The caller prunes the stack after.
        virtual void ExpireHistory() {}
        // True when the file no longer holds the bytes this document last
        // loaded or saved -- asked BEFORE Dirty(), so a save's own echo is
        // never a conflict even after more edits (finding 6.2). Default: cannot
        // tell, treat as changed.
        [[nodiscard]] virtual bool DiskDiffersFromSaved() const { return true; }
        // The toolbar note / conflict banner (each document draws it under its toolbar).
        ExternalChangeStrip& ExternalStrip() noexcept { return m_externalStrip; }
        const ExternalChangeStrip& ExternalStrip() const noexcept { return m_externalStrip; }
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/DiskSnapshot.hpp
#pragma once
// Text editor spec s5.4 echo test (finding 6.2): the size and FNV-1a hash of
// the bytes a document last loaded or saved. An mtime event from the 1 Hz
// asset poll is then told from a real change whether or not the document was
// edited since its save.
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class DiskSnapshot
    {
    public:
        // Record the file's current bytes. An unreadable file leaves the snapshot invalid.
        void Capture(const std::filesystem::path& file);
        // True when the file's bytes differ from the capture, the file cannot be
        // read, or nothing was captured (cannot tell -> treat as changed).
        [[nodiscard]] bool FileDiffers(const std::filesystem::path& file) const;
        [[nodiscard]] bool Valid() const noexcept { return m_valid; }

    private:
        std::uint64_t m_size = 0;
        std::uint64_t m_hash = 0;
        bool          m_valid = false;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/DiskSnapshot.cpp
#include "Documents/DiskSnapshot.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSavePlan.hpp"   // HashBytes (TE2-3, FNV-1a 64)

#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <optional>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        std::optional<std::string> ReadAll(const std::filesystem::path& file)
        {
            std::ifstream in(file, std::ios::binary);
            if (!in)
                return std::nullopt;
            std::string bytes((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
            if (in.bad())
                return std::nullopt;
            return bytes;
        }
    }

    void DiskSnapshot::Capture(const std::filesystem::path& file)
    {
        const std::optional<std::string> bytes = ReadAll(file);
        m_valid = bytes.has_value();
        m_size = bytes ? bytes->size() : 0u;
        m_hash = bytes ? HashBytes(*bytes) : 0u;
    }

    bool DiskSnapshot::FileDiffers(const std::filesystem::path& file) const
    {
        if (!m_valid)
            return true;
        const std::optional<std::string> bytes = ReadAll(file);
        return !bytes || bytes->size() != m_size || HashBytes(*bytes) != m_hash;
    }
}
```

Asset files are small (tens of KB); one read per poll event, and only for an asset whose mtime changed, never per frame.

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/ExternalChangeStrip.hpp
#pragma once
// The one-line strip a dedicated editor draws under its toolbar for an
// external change (text editor spec s5.4): the "History cleared" note after a
// clean reload, or the conflict banner (Reload / Keep mine) when the document
// had unsaved changes. Model + one Draw; the model is what the tests drive.
#include <functional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class ExternalChangeStrip
    {
    public:
        static constexpr std::string_view kHistoryClearedText =
            "History cleared: the file was changed outside this editor";

        void NoteHistoryCleared() { m_conflict = false; m_reload = {}; m_history = true; }
        void NoteConflict(std::string fileName, std::function<void()> reloadDiscardingMine)
        {
            m_conflict = true;
            m_file = std::move(fileName);
            m_reload = std::move(reloadDiscardingMine);
        }
        void Dismiss() { m_history = false; m_conflict = false; m_reload = {}; }
        // The banner's buttons (Draw calls them; tests call them directly).
        void ChooseReload() { auto run = std::move(m_reload); m_conflict = false; m_reload = {}; if (run) run(); }
        void ChooseKeepMine() { m_conflict = false; m_reload = {}; }

        [[nodiscard]] bool HistoryNoteShown() const noexcept { return m_history; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool ConflictShown() const noexcept { return m_conflict; }
        // Draws the strip inside the caller's window; false (nothing drawn) when empty.
        bool Draw();

    private:
        bool m_history = false;
        bool m_conflict = false;
        std::string m_file;
        std::function<void()> m_reload;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/ExternalChangeStrip.cpp
#include "Documents/ExternalChangeStrip.hpp"

#include <imgui.h>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    bool ExternalChangeStrip::Draw()
    {
        if (!m_conflict && !m_history)
            return false;
        ImGui::PushID("##external_change_strip");
        if (m_conflict)
        {
            ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
            ImGui::TextUnformatted((m_file + " changed on disk, and you have unsaved changes here.").c_str());
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::SmallButton("Reload (discard mine)"))
                ChooseReload();
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::SmallButton("Keep mine"))
                ChooseKeepMine();
        }
        else
        {
            ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
            ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", std::string(kHistoryClearedText).c_str());
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::SmallButton("Dismiss"))
                Dismiss();
        }
        ImGui::PopID();
        ImGui::Separator();
        return true;
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/ExternalAssetReload.hpp
#pragma once
// Text editor spec s5.4: "the same rule applies to any external change that
// reloads an asset under a clean dedicated editor". ONE function every
// trigger calls -- PollAssetWatch's mtime sweep and Open as Text's save.
#include "Documents/EditorDocument.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Guid.hpp>

#include <functional>

namespace Arcane { class CommandStack; }

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class DocumentHost;

    struct ExternalReloadContext
    {
        Arcane::CommandStack* undo = nullptr;                      // the ONE editor history (EditorApp::m_undo); null = no history to prune
        std::function<void(EditorDocument&)> invalidateInspector;  // InspectorHost::InvalidateSource (prune-on-invalidate)
    };

    enum class ExternalChangeOutcome : std::uint8_t { NoDocument, Unchanged, Reloaded, Conflict, Failed, Unsupported };

    // Reload `doc` from disk discarding its working copy, then clear its
    // history: re-mint its anchor, prune the stack, invalidate its Inspector
    // history, show the toolbar note. Unchanged/Failed/Unsupported clear nothing.
    ExternalReloadResult ReloadAndClearHistory(EditorDocument& doc, const ExternalReloadContext& ctx);

    // Every open document for `guid` (except `origin` and text documents,
    // which TE2's own watcher handles): the file still its last save ->
    // Unchanged (dirty or clean, finding 6.2); clean -> ReloadAndClearHistory;
    // dirty -> the conflict banner. Returns the strongest outcome seen.
    ExternalChangeOutcome ApplyExternalAssetChange(DocumentHost& docs, const Arcane::Guid& guid,
                                                   const ExternalReloadContext& ctx,
                                                   const EditorDocument* origin = nullptr);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/ExternalAssetReload.cpp
#include "Documents/ExternalAssetReload.hpp"

#include "Documents/DocumentHost.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Edit/CommandStack.hpp>

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    ExternalReloadResult ReloadAndClearHistory(EditorDocument& doc, const ExternalReloadContext& ctx)
    {
        const ExternalReloadResult r = doc.ReloadFromExternalChange();
        if (r != ExternalReloadResult::Reloaded)
            return r;
        doc.ExpireHistory();                       // every pre-reload step now holds a dead anchor
        if (ctx.undo)
            (void)ctx.undo->PruneExpired();        // ...and is removed, not merely skipped
        if (ctx.invalidateInspector)
            ctx.invalidateInspector(doc);          // its Inspector history keys named the old objects
        doc.ExternalStrip().NoteHistoryCleared();
        return r;
    }

    ExternalChangeOutcome ApplyExternalAssetChange(DocumentHost& docs, const Arcane::Guid& guid,
                                                   const ExternalReloadContext& ctx, const EditorDocument* origin)
    {
        ExternalChangeOutcome best = ExternalChangeOutcome::NoDocument;
        const auto rank = [](ExternalChangeOutcome o) { return static_cast<int>(o); };
        docs.ForEach([&](EditorDocument& d)
        {
            if (&d == origin || d.AssetGuid() != guid || dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(&d))
                return;
            ExternalChangeOutcome o = ExternalChangeOutcome::Unsupported;
            if (!d.DiskDiffersFromSaved())
            {
                // The file still holds this document's last load/save: our own
                // save's echo (or a touch). Dirty or not, nothing to reload and
                // nothing to ask -- edits made after that save are kept (6.2).
                o = ExternalChangeOutcome::Unchanged;
            }
            else if (d.Dirty())
            {
                // s5.4: "has unsaved changes -> shows its own conflict banner
                // instead of silently losing either side".
                EditorDocument* target = &d;
                d.ExternalStrip().NoteConflict(d.Title(), [target, ctx] { (void)ReloadAndClearHistory(*target, ctx); });
                o = ExternalChangeOutcome::Conflict;
            }
            else
            {
                switch (ReloadAndClearHistory(d, ctx))
                {
                    case ExternalReloadResult::Unchanged:   o = ExternalChangeOutcome::Unchanged; break;
                    case ExternalReloadResult::Reloaded:    o = ExternalChangeOutcome::Reloaded; break;
                    case ExternalReloadResult::Failed:      o = ExternalChangeOutcome::Failed; break;
                    case ExternalReloadResult::Unsupported: o = ExternalChangeOutcome::Unsupported; break;
                }
            }
            if (best == ExternalChangeOutcome::NoDocument || rank(o) > rank(best))
                best = o;
        });
        return best;
    }
}
```

The conflict closure captures `target` as a raw pointer. That is sound: the strip is a member of the document, so the closure dies with the document. `ctx` is captured by value, so the stack pointer and callback stay valid for the app's lifetime.

```cpp
    {

        std::filesystem::remove_all(d);
        std::filesystem::create_directories(d);

TEST_CASE("material document: clean reload drops every pre-reload step; own save echoes Unchanged", "[text-astext][material]")
{
    auto reg = std::make_unique<Astra::Registry>(std::make_shared<Astra::ComponentRegistry>());
    CommandStack stack([&reg]() -> Astra::Registry& { return *reg; });
    const auto dir = Dir("mat");
    MaterialAssetData data;
    data.id = Guid::Generate();
    data.name = "probe";
    data.kind = "Sprite";
    const auto path = dir / "probe.arcmat";
    REQUIRE(SaveMaterialAsset(path, data));

    ShaderEditorDocument::DocServices services;
    services.undo = [&stack] { return &stack; };
    auto doc = std::make_unique<ShaderEditorDocument>(services, path, data);
    // One document step holding the document's real anchor, exactly as the
    // document's own ParamEditCommand/GraphEditCommand hold it (:216-234).
    struct AnchoredStep final : ICommand
    {
        std::weak_ptr<ShaderEditorDocument*> anchor;
        explicit AnchoredStep(std::weak_ptr<ShaderEditorDocument*> a) : anchor(std::move(a)) {}
        void Undo() override {}
        void Redo() override {}
        const char* Label() const override { return "param"; }
        bool AffectsScene() const override { return false; }
        bool IsExpired() const override { const auto d = anchor.lock(); return !d || !*d; }
    };
    stack.Push(std::make_unique<AnchoredStep>(doc->AnchorForTest()));
    REQUIRE(doc->Save());
    REQUIRE(stack.CanUndo());
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->DiskDiffersFromSaved());                                   // finding 6.2: the file is our last save
    CHECK(doc->ReloadFromExternalChange() == ExternalReloadResult::Unchanged);   // the file IS what we saved

    MaterialAssetData external = *LoadMaterialAsset(path);
    external.name = "edited outside";
    REQUIRE(SaveMaterialAsset(path, external));
    CHECK(doc->DiskDiffersFromSaved());
    const ExternalReloadContext ctx{ &stack, {} };
    CHECK(ReloadAndClearHistory(*doc, ctx) == ExternalReloadResult::Reloaded);
    CHECK(doc->Title() == "edited outside");
    CHECK_FALSE(stack.CanUndo());
    CHECK(doc->ExternalStrip().HistoryNoteShown());
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->DiskDiffersFromSaved());                                   // the reload re-captured the file
}
```

```cpp
    ExternalReloadResult ShaderEditorDocument::ReloadFromExternalChange()
    {
        // Capture BEFORE the load: a write racing the load can only make the
        // next poll see a difference, never hide one behind newer bytes (6.2).
        DiskSnapshot fresh;
        fresh.Capture(m_path);
        auto data = Arcane::LoadMaterialAsset(m_path);
        if (!data)
        {
            ARC_WARN("'{}': reload from disk failed -- keeping the in-memory copy", m_title);
            return ExternalReloadResult::Failed;
        }
        if (!Dirty() && !m_disk.FileDiffers(m_path))
            return ExternalReloadResult::Unchanged;   // our own save's echo (or a touch): nothing to reload
        if (Arcane::CommandStack* s = UndoStack())
            EditGesture::ClosePending(*s, m_gesture); // never strand a parked gesture across the swap
        m_disk = fresh;                               // the bytes this reload holds
        m_data = std::move(*data);
        // ... the existing body from `m_snippet = m_data.snippet;` through
        //     RegenerateFromGraph() stays exactly as it is ...
        return ExternalReloadResult::Reloaded;
    }

    void ShaderEditorDocument::ExpireHistory()
    {
        // The anchor every ParamEdit/Graph/PassList/MeshMaterialMetadata step
        // holds weakly (:216-223). A fresh control block orphans the old one:
        // every pre-reload step reports IsExpired() from here on.
        m_anchor = std::make_shared<ShaderEditorDocument*>(this);
    }

    bool ShaderEditorDocument::DiskDiffersFromSaved() const
    {
        return m_disk.FileDiffers(m_path);           // the bytes of the last load / save / reload (finding 6.2)
    }
```

The Unchanged test compares BYTES (the `DiskSnapshot` of the last load, save or reload), so no canonical serializer of `MaterialAssetData` is needed: `MaterialAsset.hpp` has only `SaveMaterialAsset(path, data)` (`:113`) and no `operator==`. A rewrite with identical bytes is Unchanged; a reformatting tool that rewrites the same data with other bytes reloads it (harmless: the data is the same, the history clears).

The three captures, as one line each:
- the last statement of the constructor (`:184`'s definition): `m_disk.Capture(m_path);`
- in `Save()`, directly after the successful `SaveMaterialAsset(m_path, m_data)` (before `m_services.onAssetSaved(m_data.id)`, `:1933`): `m_disk.Capture(m_path);`
- in `ReloadFromExternalChange`, as shown above.

Header, private members (beside `m_anchor`): `DiskSnapshot m_disk;   // TE6-8 (finding 6.2): the bytes this document last loaded or saved`. Public, after `ExpireHistory`: `[[nodiscard]] bool DiskDiffersFromSaved() const override;`.

`m_gesture` and `UndoStack()` are the document's existing gesture state and resolver (the same pair the destructor uses at `:1000-1021`).

In `Draw`, right after the toolbar row, add:

```cpp
        ExternalStrip().Draw();
```

```cpp

                            (void)doc->ReloadFromExternalChange();
```

`ShaderEditorDocumentTest.cpp:869` (the file was changed on disk just above, so the reload happens):


`ShaderEditorDocumentTest.cpp:1753` reloads an UNCHANGED file to force a Rebuild. The new echo rule returns `Unchanged` there without rebuilding, so the case first writes a real external change (the name only; the coalesce keys follow the guid, so the "same coalesce keys" claim of the case still holds):

```cpp
        DiskSnapshot bytes;
        bytes.Capture(path_);                    // before the read (TE6-8's order)
```

```cpp
            if (e.kind == Arcane::Editor::AssetKind::Sprite || e.kind == Arcane::Editor::AssetKind::InputActions)
            {
                const auto path = project->ResolveAsset(Arcane::AssetId::FromGuid(e.guid));

                continue;
```

Self-save echoes: the sprite, mesh and input documents have no `onAssetSaved` re-baseline, so their own save's mtime bounces back here on the next 1 Hz sweep. That is safe whether or not the user kept editing after the save (finding 6.2): `ApplyExternalAssetChange` asks `DiskDiffersFromSaved()` FIRST, which compares the file's bytes with the bytes the document last loaded or saved (`DiskSnapshot`, TE6-7). A save's echo answers false, so it neither reloads nor raises the conflict banner, and the post-save edits stay. Only a real change of the bytes reaches the clean-reload or dirty-banner branch. TE6-8..TE6-11's tests assert `DiskDiffersFromSaved()` after each type's own save, and TE6-9's second case drives the save-then-edit sequence through `ApplyExternalAssetChange` on a real `SpriteDocument`.

**The rule.** A file whose extension has a **dedicated** editor factory (`docs.HasDedicatedFactory(path)`, TE2-19) opens **locked**:
- read-only, with `TextReadOnlyReason::Locked`;
- the banner `'<name>' has its own editor. This view is read-only.`;
- one button, **Enable editing**.

Every other file opens editable, exactly as TE2's routes open it. `HasFactory` is the wrong test for this. After TE2-20 it answers true for `.md`, `.arcsyntax` and every file the fallback claims, so every file would open locked.

**The save.** The app's text `afterSave` is ONE lambda, and ONE function assigns it: `ComposeTextAfterSave` (D-R7, CANON B21). It runs, in order, TE3-30's grammar reload (`NotifySaved`) and `OpenAsTextFlow::AfterSave`. No other task assigns `afterSave`: TE2-20's route block leaves it unset (an empty `std::function`; `Save` checks it), TE3-30 contributes its step to this composition, and the F4 test below calls `ComposeTextAfterSave` itself, so a plain `afterSave = ...` added anywhere in `EditorApp.cpp` fails Step 4's grep and cannot pass the test by building its own chain (finding 6.1). `AfterSave` looks up the saved document's asset guid: `AssetGuid()`, falling back to `AssetRegistry::PeekId(CanonicalPath())`.
- For an asset, it runs `ApplyExternalAssetChange(docs, guid, reload, &saved)`:
  - a clean dedicated editor reloads, its history is cleared and the note is shown;
  - a dirty one shows its conflict banner.

  It then calls `afterAssetSave(path)`. In the app, that callback (`EditorApp::OnTextAssetSaved`) invalidates the asset's caches by kind, which is "the registry's reload of that asset" (s5.4), and re-baselines `m_materialMtimes`.
- A non-asset save does nothing more.

Every text save runs this, not only the ones from Open as Text. A `.arcmat` opened from anywhere and saved as text reloads its material editor.

```cpp
    std::filesystem::path FreshDir(const char* name)
    {
        const auto dir = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "arcane-open-as-text" / name;
        std::filesystem::remove_all(dir);
        std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
        return dir;
    }

    void WriteFile(const std::filesystem::path& p, std::string_view text)
    {
        std::filesystem::create_directories(p.parent_path());
        std::ofstream out(p, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        out << text;
    }

    // Replace the whole text in ONE transaction, through TE1's command class
    // (product code never calls TextBuffer::BeginTransaction/Edit/EndTransaction).
    void ReplaceAll(TextDocument& t, std::string text)
    {
        const Text::ByteOffset size = t.Buffer().Text().Size();
        Text::TextCommands(t.Buffer(), t.Model().selections, DefaultEditContext(t.Model()))
            .EditAndMap(Text::TransactionKind::Other, { Text::EditOp{ Text::ByteRange{ 0, size }, std::move(text) } },
                        Text::Bias::Left, Text::Bias::Left, Text::Bias::Right);
    }

        CommandStack stack{ [this]() -> Astra::Registry& { return *reg; } };
        DocumentHost host;
        std::filesystem::path path;
        SpriteDocument* sprite = nullptr;
        TextDocumentServices services;
        int assetSaves = 0;   // the app's afterAssetSave (cache invalidation) stand-in

        explicit Fixture(const char* name)
        {
            path = FreshDir(name) / "s.arcsprite";
            SpriteAssetData data = SpriteDocument::NewSpriteData(Guid::Generate(), "s");
            REQUIRE(SaveSpriteAsset(path, data));
            host.RegisterFactory(".arcsprite", [this](const std::filesystem::path& p) -> std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument> {
                SpriteDocument::Services sv; sv.undo = [this] { return &stack; };
                return std::make_unique<SpriteDocument>(sv, p, *LoadSpriteAsset(p)); });
            sprite = static_cast<SpriteDocument*>(host.OpenPath(path));
            REQUIRE(sprite);
            // The app's services (TE2-20 wiring): the asset id from the file,
            // and afterSave from THE composition (D-R7) -- no syntax service here.
            services.peekGuid = [](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return AssetRegistry::PeekId(p).value_or(Guid::Nil()); };
            Compose(nullptr);
        }

        // Exactly what EditorApp does in TE2-20's route block, with the
        // fixture's history and cache-invalidation stand-in.
        void Compose(TextSyntaxService* syntax)
        {
            ComposeTextAfterSave(TextAfterSaveLinks{ syntax,

                                                     [this](const std::filesystem::path&) { ++assetSaves; } },

TEST_CASE("open as text: an asset with a dedicated editor opens locked; Enable editing unlocks", "[text-astext][witness][text]")
{
    Fixture f("locked");
    OpenAsTextFlow flow = f.Flow();
    TextDocument* t = flow.Open(f.path);
    REQUIRE(t);
    CHECK(flow.lastError.empty());
    CHECK(t->LockedByDedicatedEditor());
    CHECK(t->ReadOnly());
    CHECK(t->ReadOnlyReason() == TextReadOnlyReason::Locked);
    CHECK(t->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::Locked);
    CHECK(t->Banner().message == "'s.arcsprite' has its own editor. This view is read-only.");
    CHECK(BannerActions(t->Banner()) == std::vector<TextBannerAction>{ TextBannerAction::EnableEditing });
    CHECK(std::string_view(BannerActionLabel(TextBannerAction::EnableEditing)) == "Enable editing");
    CHECK_FALSE(t->Save());                                      // locked: nothing is written

    CHECK(t->EnableEditing());
    CHECK_FALSE(t->LockedByDedicatedEditor());
    CHECK_FALSE(t->ReadOnly());
    CHECK(t->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::None);
    CHECK(f.Flow().Open(f.path) == t);                           // one tab per canonical path
    CHECK(f.host.Count() == 2u);                                 // the sprite editor + one text tab

    OpenAsTextFlow missing = f.Flow();
    CHECK(missing.Open(f.path.parent_path() / "missing.txt") == nullptr);
    CHECK_FALSE(missing.lastError.empty());                      // TE2-15's error text, for the caller to show
}

TEST_CASE("open as text: another spelling of an open file finds its one tab (canonical lookup first)", "[text-astext][witness][text]")
{
    // Spec s5.3: any spelling of an open file is its one tab. Open canonicalises
    // the RAW path (TE2-5's CanonicalFilePath) BEFORE FindByCanonicalPath, so a
    // differently-cased or `..`-containing spelling must not open a second tab.
    Fixture f("spelling");
    TextDocument* t = f.Flow().Open(f.path);
    REQUIRE(t);
    REQUIRE(f.host.Count() == 2u);                               // the sprite editor + one text tab

    const std::filesystem::path dir = f.path.parent_path();
    const std::filesystem::path dotted = dir / ".." / dir.filename() / "s.arcsprite";
    const std::filesystem::path upper = dir / "S.ARCSPRITE";     // NTFS is case-insensitive
    REQUIRE(dotted != f.path);
    REQUIRE(upper != f.path);

    OpenAsTextFlow viaDots = f.Flow();
    CHECK(viaDots.Open(dotted) == t);
    CHECK(viaDots.lastError.empty());
    OpenAsTextFlow viaCase = f.Flow();
    CHECK(viaCase.Open(upper) == t);
    CHECK(viaCase.lastError.empty());
    CHECK(f.host.Count() == 2u);                                 // still one text tab
    CHECK(t->LockedByDedicatedEditor());                         // the reopen left the lock alone

    // s11.4 "a different-case / 8.3 path focuses a single tab" (finding 6.16):
    // the real file's short name, end to end through the flow and the host.
    std::wstring shortName(MAX_PATH, L'\0');
    const DWORD n = ::GetShortPathNameW(f.path.c_str(), shortName.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(shortName.size()));
    shortName.resize(n);
    if (n == 0 || std::filesystem::path(shortName) == f.path)
    {
        WARN("8.3 names are disabled on this volume -- the short-name leg did not run (TE2-5's [text-io] case records the same)");
        return;
    }
    OpenAsTextFlow viaShort = f.Flow();
    CHECK(viaShort.Open(std::filesystem::path(shortName)) == t);
    CHECK(viaShort.lastError.empty());
    CHECK(f.host.Count() == 2u);
}

TEST_CASE("open as text: save under a CLEAN dedicated editor reloads it, clears its history, shows the note", "[text-astext][witness][text]")
{
    Fixture f("clean");
    f.EditSprite();
    REQUIRE(f.sprite->Save());                                   // clean, one undo step
    REQUIRE(f.stack.CanUndo());

    TextDocument* t = f.Flow().Open(f.path);
    REQUIRE(t);
    REQUIRE(t->EnableEditing());
    std::string text = t->Buffer().Text().ToString();
    const auto at = text.find("33");
    REQUIRE(at != std::string::npos);
    text.replace(at, 2, "77");
    ReplaceAll(*t, text);
    REQUIRE(t->Save());

    CHECK(f.sprite->Data().pixelsPerUnit == 77.0f);
    CHECK_FALSE(f.stack.CanUndo());
    CHECK(f.sprite->ExternalStrip().HistoryNoteShown());
    CHECK(f.assetSaves == 1);                                    // the app's cache invalidation ran once
}

TEST_CASE("open as text: save under a DIRTY dedicated editor raises its conflict banner, losing nothing", "[text-astext][witness][text]")
{
    Fixture f("dirty");
    f.EditSprite();                                              // unsaved: ppu 33 in memory only
    TextDocument* t = f.Flow().Open(f.path);
    REQUIRE(t);
    REQUIRE(t->EnableEditing());
    std::string text = t->Buffer().Text().ToString();
    text += "\n";                                                // any byte change
    ReplaceAll(*t, text);
    REQUIRE(t->Save());

    CHECK(f.sprite->Data().pixelsPerUnit == 33.0f);              // the editor's unsaved value survives
    CHECK(f.sprite->ExternalStrip().ConflictShown());
    CHECK(f.stack.CanUndo());
}

TEST_CASE("open as text: a grammar saved as text reloads the grammar AND runs the asset path (F4)", "[text-astext][witness][text]")
{
    Fixture f("grammar");
    // The grammar lives in the service's engine search dir. Both sides use the
    // CANONICAL spelling: TEMP can be an 8.3 path, and NotifySaved matches the
    // saved document's canonical path against the search dirs.
    const auto written = f.path.parent_path() / "engine" / "Test.arcsyntax";
    WriteFile(written, kGrammar);
    const std::filesystem::path grammar = CanonicalFilePath(written).value_or(written);
    TextSyntaxService svc(std::make_unique<Text::ManualHighlightExecutor>(), grammar.parent_path());
    const std::uint64_t gen = svc.Registry().Generation();

    // .arcsyntax is a TEXT route in the app (TE2-15's ExplicitTextExtensions),
    // so HasFactory is true; it has no dedicated editor, so it opens unlocked.
    f.host.RegisterTextFactory(".arcsyntax", [](const std::filesystem::path&) -> std::unique_ptr<EditorDocument> { return nullptr; });
    REQUIRE(f.host.HasFactory(grammar));
    REQUIRE_FALSE(f.host.HasDedicatedFactory(grammar));

    // The app's composition (D-R7): the SAME function EditorApp calls, now
    // with a syntax service -- TE3-30's NotifySaved link, then TE6-12's
    // AfterSave. Nothing here assigns afterSave by hand.
    const Guid assetId = Guid::Generate();
    f.services.peekGuid = [assetId](const std::filesystem::path&) { return assetId; };   // the asset path runs
    f.Compose(&svc);

    TextDocument* t = f.Flow().Open(grammar);
    REQUIRE(t);
    CHECK_FALSE(t->LockedByDedicatedEditor());
    CHECK_FALSE(t->ReadOnly());
    CHECK(t->AssetGuid() == assetId);
    std::string text = t->Buffer().Text().ToString();
    const auto at = text.find("comment.line.t");
    REQUIRE(at != std::string::npos);
    text.replace(at, std::string_view("comment.line.t").size(), "comment.block.t");
    ReplaceAll(*t, text);
    REQUIRE(t->Save());

    CHECK(svc.Registry().Generation() > gen);                    // the grammar reloaded live (TE3-30)
    CHECK(f.assetSaves == 1);                                    // AND the asset path ran (TE6-12)
}
```

```cpp
    TextBanner TextDocument::LockBanner() const
    {
        return TextBanner{ TextBannerKind::Locked, "'" + Name() + "' has its own editor. This view is read-only." };
    }

    void TextDocument::SetReadOnlyLock(bool locked)
    {
        m_locked = locked;
        RecomputeReadOnly();
        if (locked)
        {
            // A save, disk or content banner already up keeps the strip: it
            // needs its own answer first. ApplyBannerAction hands the strip
            // back to the lock once that banner is gone.
            if (m_banner.kind == TextBannerKind::None)
                m_banner = LockBanner();
        }
        else if (m_banner.kind == TextBannerKind::Locked)
        {
            m_banner = {};
        }
    }

    bool TextDocument::EnableEditing()
    {
        ApplyBannerAction(TextBannerAction::EnableEditing);
        return !LockedByDedicatedEditor();
    }
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/OpenAsText.hpp
#pragma once
// Text editor spec s5.4 (D10): Open as Text, the app-free half of
// EditorApp::OpenAsText. FileOpener's Arcane backend (TE7-9) reaches it
// through EditorApp::OpenAsText; the [text-astext] witness drives it
// directly. A file whose extension has a DEDICATED editor opens locked.
#include "Documents/ExternalAssetReload.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class DocumentHost;

    struct OpenAsTextFlow
    {
        DocumentHost&         docs;
        ExternalReloadContext reload;
        // App extras after an ASSET was saved as text (cache invalidation by
        // kind, the asset-watch re-baseline); may be empty.
        std::function<void(const std::filesystem::path&)> afterAssetSave;
        // The services every text document the app opens carries (syntax,
        // clipboard, the composed afterSave). Additive to CANON A10.
        TextDocumentServices  services;
        // Why the last Open returned null (TE2-15's error text); empty after a success.
        std::string           lastError;

        // Focus the existing text tab for `path` (TE2's canonical identity), or open one.
        TextDocument* Open(const std::filesystem::path& path);
        // The afterSave link (CANON B21): for an asset, every other open
        // editor of it reloads (clean) or shows its conflict banner (dirty),
        // then afterAssetSave runs. A non-asset save does nothing here.
        void AfterSave(const TextDocument& saved) const;
    };

    // What the after-save steps need from their owner (the app, or a test).
    struct TextAfterSaveLinks
    {
        TextSyntaxService* syntax = nullptr;                                 // TE3-30's step; null = no grammar reload
        std::function<ExternalReloadContext()> reloadContext;                // asked per save (the app's history is null in Play)
        std::function<void(const std::filesystem::path&)> afterAssetSave;    // the app's cache invalidation + mtime re-baseline
    };

    // D-R7: THE one assignment of TextDocumentServices::afterSave for text
    // documents. Every successful Save / Save As then runs, in order:
    //   1. TE3-30: a saved grammar reloads live (syntax->NotifySaved);
    //   2. TE6-12: a saved asset reloads its clean dedicated editor, or raises
    //      its conflict banner, then afterAssetSave (OpenAsTextFlow::AfterSave).
    // EditorApp calls it in TE2-20's route block; the F4 test calls it on a
    // test DocumentHost. No other code assigns afterSave.
    void ComposeTextAfterSave(TextAfterSaveLinks links, DocumentHost& docs, TextDocumentServices& services);
}
```

**`OpenAsText.cpp`:**

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/OpenAsText.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/OpenAsText.hpp"

#include "Documents/DocumentHost.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Project/AssetRegistry.hpp>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    TextDocument* OpenAsTextFlow::Open(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        lastError.clear();
        // Spec s5.3: any spelling of an open file is its one tab. The host
        // keys text documents by CanonicalFilePath (TE2-5), so the RAW path is
        // canonicalised FIRST and the lookup asks with that spelling (a
        // differently-cased or `..` path finds the existing tab).
        const std::filesystem::path canonical = CanonicalFilePath(path).value_or(path);
        if (EditorDocument* existing = docs.FindByCanonicalPath(canonical))
            if (auto* text = dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(existing))
            {
                text->NoteReopened();   // as DocumentHost::OpenPath does for an open document
                return text;
            }

        std::string error;
        std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> doc = TextDocument::Open(path, services, error);
        if (!doc)
        {
            lastError = std::move(error);
            return nullptr;
        }
        // TE2-19's HasDedicatedFactory, never HasFactory: after TE2-20 HasFactory
        // is true for every text route and the fallback, so every file would lock.
        if (docs.HasDedicatedFactory(canonical))
            doc->SetReadOnlyLock(true);   // spec s5.4: read-only until Enable editing
        return static_cast<TextDocument*>(docs.Add(std::move(doc)));
    }

    void OpenAsTextFlow::AfterSave(const TextDocument& saved) const
    {
        const std::filesystem::path file = saved.CanonicalPath();
        Arcane::Guid guid = saved.AssetGuid();
        if (!guid.IsValid())
            guid = Arcane::AssetRegistry::PeekId(file).value_or(Arcane::Guid::Nil());
        if (!guid.IsValid())
            return;   // not an asset: TE2's save is the whole story
        // The saved text document is the origin; ApplyExternalAssetChange
        // skips text documents anyway (TE2-17 polls its own file).
        (void)ApplyExternalAssetChange(docs, guid, reload, &saved);
        if (afterAssetSave)
            afterAssetSave(file);
    }

    void ComposeTextAfterSave(TextAfterSaveLinks links, DocumentHost& docs, TextDocumentServices& services)
    {
        services.afterSave = [&docs, links = std::move(links)](TextDocument& saved)
        {
            // 1. TE3-30 (spec s4.1): a saved grammar reloads live.
            if (links.syntax)
                links.syntax->NotifySaved(saved.CanonicalPath());
            // 2. TE6-12 (spec s5.4): the asset path. The history pointer is read
            //    per save, not captured once at startup.
            const OpenAsTextFlow flow{ docs,
                                       links.reloadContext ? links.reloadContext() : ExternalReloadContext{},
                                       links.afterAssetSave, TextDocumentServices{} };
            flow.AfterSave(saved);
        };
    }
}
```

```cpp
    void EditorApp::OnTextAssetSaved(const std::filesystem::path& saved)
    {
        const std::optional<Arcane::Guid> g = Arcane::AssetRegistry::PeekId(saved);
        if (!g)
            return;
        if (const auto* e = m_assetModel.Find(*g))
            InvalidateAssetCaches(*g, e->kind);   // the registry-side reload of that asset (s5.4)
        // Our own write must not bounce back from PollAssetWatch as an
        // external edit: re-baseline under the key the watch uses
        // (the project's resolved path, not the canonical spelling).
        const Arcane::Project* project = m_runtime ? m_runtime->CurrentProject() : nullptr;
        const std::optional<std::filesystem::path> resolved =
            project ? project->ResolveAsset(Arcane::AssetId::FromGuid(*g)) : std::nullopt;
        std::error_code ec;
        const auto mtime = std::filesystem::last_write_time(resolved.value_or(saved), ec);
        if (!ec)
            m_materialMtimes[resolved.value_or(saved).generic_string()] = mtime;
    }

    Arcane::Editor::OpenAsTextFlow EditorApp::MakeOpenAsTextFlow()
    {
        return Arcane::Editor::OpenAsTextFlow{ m_documents, ExternalReloadCtx(),
                                               [this](const std::filesystem::path& p) { OnTextAssetSaved(p); },
                                               m_textDocumentServices };
    }

    Arcane::Editor::EditorDocument* EditorApp::OpenAsText(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        Arcane::Editor::OpenAsTextFlow flow = MakeOpenAsTextFlow();
        Arcane::Editor::TextDocument* doc = flow.Open(path);
        if (!doc)
            ARC_WARN("Open as text: {}", flow.lastError);
        return doc;
    }
```

`ExternalReloadCtx()` is TE6-11's. `m_materialMtimes` is keyed by the resolved asset path, as in TE6-11's Sprite/InputActions branches.

**Interfaces:**

Both `.cpp` files are already in the ArcaneTests `files` list (TE2/TE3 blocks), so this task needs TE2-15 and TE3-3 landed.

  - `std::vector<std::string_view> PresetIds()` (the six detected-preset ids, in TE7-7's order: `vscode sublime notepadpp rider clion nvim-wt`) and `bool IsPresetId(std::string_view)` -- the one list; TE7-3's Project-rung refusal names a preset by it (D-R6) and TE7-7's detector is pinned to it
  - `kGroupSource` / `kGroupText` / `kGroupAsset` (`"source"`, `"text"`, `"asset"`), `kDefaultOpenWith` = `"source=visualStudio;text=arcaneText;asset=dedicated"`
  - `bool IsSourceExtension(std::string_view)` (= `IsCppSourcePath(std::filesystem::path("x") += Text::NormaliseExtension(ext))`), `std::string NormaliseKey(std::string_view)`, `std::string ExtensionOf(const std::filesystem::path&)` (UTF-8, never throws). No `Openers::NormaliseExtension`: callers use `Text::NormaliseExtension`.
  - `struct OpenWithEntry { std::string key; OpenerId opener; }`, `ParseOpenWith`, `FormatOpenWith`, `SetOpenWith(text, key, std::optional<OpenerId>)`, `ValidateOpenWith`
  - `enum class FileGroup { Source, Text, Asset, Binary }`, `struct FileFacts { bool openInTextDocument, hasDedicatedEditor, isText; }` (`hasDedicatedEditor` = a dedicated Arcane editor's factory takes the file -- never the text routes; TE7-9 answers it with TE2-19's `DocumentHost::HasDedicatedFactory`), `FileGroup GroupOf(path, facts)`
  - `enum class ResolveReason { AlreadyOpen, Explicit, Extension, Group, BuiltInDefault }`, `struct Resolution { OpenerId opener; ResolveReason reason; std::string matchedKey; std::vector<std::string> skipped; }`
  - `Resolution ResolveOpener(path, facts, std::span<const OpenWithEntry>, std::span<const std::string> customIds, const std::optional<OpenerId>& explicitOpener = std::nullopt)`
  - `std::string_view OpenerDisplayName(OpenerKind)`

The resolution order this task pins (spec s5.6 "Rules", "Choosing"):
1. **Explicit** (Open With, Open as Text): the user's one-off choice for this open.
2. **Already open**: a file shown by an Arcane `TextDocument` is focused there, whatever the settings say ("no second copy in another tool behind the user's back").
3. The file's **extension** entry (`.lua=custom:vscode`).
4. Its **group** key: `asset` when an Arcane editor opens it, `source` for the nine C/C++ extensions, `text` for any other text file. A binary file has no group key.
5. The **built-in default** for the group: source -> `visualStudio`, asset -> `dedicated`, text -> `arcaneText`, binary -> `systemDefault`.

An entry that cannot apply is skipped and named in `Resolution::skipped`: `dedicated` for a file with no Arcane editor, or `custom:<id>` naming no entry in `editor.files.customEditors`. FileOpener (TE7-8) publishes these as Problems rows.

`dedicated` is overridable per extension or through the `asset` key ("not overridable to nothing": there is no "nothing" opener, and Open as Text stays available).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test** -- `ArcaneTests/src/Text/OpenerIdTest.cpp`:

```cpp
// TE7-1: opener ids, the editor.files.openWith map and ResolveOpener (text
// editor spec s5.6). Pure.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include <rapidcheck.h>
#include <rapidcheck/catch.h>

#include "Project/Openers/OpenerId.hpp"

#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers;

TEST_CASE("OpenerId: format and parse round-trip; malformed ids are refused", "[text-openers]")
{
    for (const OpenerId& id : { OpenerId::ArcaneText(), OpenerId::VisualStudio(), OpenerId::SystemDefault(),
                                OpenerId::Dedicated(), OpenerId::Custom("vscode"), OpenerId::Custom("nvim-wt") })
    {
        const std::optional<OpenerId> back = ParseOpenerId(FormatOpenerId(id));
        REQUIRE(back.has_value());
        CHECK(*back == id);
    }
    CHECK(FormatOpenerId(OpenerId::Custom("vscode")) == "custom:vscode");
    CHECK(ParseOpenerId("  visualStudio ") == OpenerId::VisualStudio());
    CHECK_FALSE(ParseOpenerId("notepad").has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(ParseOpenerId("custom:").has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(ParseOpenerId("custom:Bad Id").has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(ParseOpenerId("custom:a;b").has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(ParseOpenerId("custom:-lead").has_value());
    CHECK(IsValidCustomId("nvim-wt"));
    CHECK(IsValidCustomId("ed_2"));
    CHECK_FALSE(IsValidCustomId("Ed"));
}

TEST_CASE("PresetIds: the six detected presets, each a valid custom id", "[text-openers]")
{
    const std::vector<std::string_view> ids = PresetIds();
    CHECK(ids == std::vector<std::string_view>{ "vscode", "sublime", "notepadpp", "rider", "clion", "nvim-wt" });
    for (const std::string_view id : ids)
    {
        INFO(id);
        CHECK(IsValidCustomId(id));
        CHECK(IsPresetId(id));
    }
    CHECK_FALSE(IsPresetId("mine"));
    CHECK_FALSE(IsPresetId("VSCode"));   // ids are exact (lowercase by IsValidCustomId)
}

TEST_CASE("IsSourceExtension and NormaliseKey use the editor's one C/C++ list and one normaliser", "[text-openers]")
{
    for (const char* e : { ".c", ".cc", ".cpp", ".cxx", ".h", ".hh", ".hpp", ".hxx", ".inl", "CPP", " .Hpp " })
    {
        INFO(e);
        CHECK(IsSourceExtension(e));
    }
    CHECK_FALSE(IsSourceExtension(".hlsl"));
    CHECK_FALSE(IsSourceExtension(".c++"));   // TE2-15's IsCppSourcePath list is the nine; the C++ grammar claims more
    CHECK_FALSE(IsSourceExtension(""));
    CHECK(NormaliseKey(" .CPP ") == ".cpp");
    CHECK(NormaliseKey("Lua") == ".lua");
    CHECK(NormaliseKey(" Source ") == "source");
    CHECK(ExtensionOf("D:/p/Caf\xC3\xA9.MD") == ".md");
}

TEST_CASE("OpenWith map: parse normalises keys, folds repeats, reports bad entries", "[text-openers]")
{
    const std::vector<OpenWithEntry> v =
        ParseOpenWith(" .CPP = arcaneText ; LUA=custom:vscode;;Text=systemDefault;.x=nope;=arcaneText;.cpp=visualStudio");
    REQUIRE(v.size() == 3);
    CHECK(v[0].key == ".cpp");
    CHECK(v[0].opener == OpenerId::VisualStudio());   // a repeated key keeps its first position and its last value
    CHECK(v[1].key == ".lua");
    CHECK(v[1].opener == OpenerId::Custom("vscode"));
    CHECK(v[2].key == "text");
    CHECK(v[2].opener == OpenerId::SystemDefault());

    const std::vector<std::string> problems = ValidateOpenWith(".cpp=arcaneText;.x=nope;=arcaneText;nothing");
    REQUIRE(problems.size() == 3);
    CHECK(problems[0] == "'.x=nope': 'nope' is not an opener (arcaneText, visualStudio, systemDefault, dedicated, custom:<id>)");
    CHECK(problems[1] == "'=arcaneText' names no extension");
    CHECK(problems[2] == "'nothing' has no '='");
}

TEST_CASE("OpenWith map: Set replaces in place, appends, removes", "[text-openers]")
{
    const std::string base(kDefaultOpenWith);
    CHECK(SetOpenWith(base, "CPP", OpenerId::ArcaneText()) == base + ";.cpp=arcaneText");
    CHECK(SetOpenWith(base, "source", OpenerId::ArcaneText()) == "source=arcaneText;text=arcaneText;asset=dedicated");
    CHECK(SetOpenWith(base, "text", std::nullopt) == "source=visualStudio;asset=dedicated");
    CHECK(SetOpenWith("", ".md", OpenerId::Custom("vscode")) == ".md=custom:vscode");
}

TEST_CASE("OpenWith map: Format(Parse(x)) is a fixed point and keys stay unique", "[text-openers]")
{
    rc::prop("round trip", [] {
        const auto keys = *rc::gen::container<std::vector<std::string>>(
            rc::gen::element<std::string>(".c", ".lua", ".MD", "log", "text", "source", "asset", ".hpp"));
        std::string text;
        for (const std::string& k : keys)
        {
            const int pick = *rc::gen::inRange(0, 6);
            const std::optional<OpenerId> id =
                pick == 0 ? std::optional<OpenerId>(OpenerId::ArcaneText())
              : pick == 1 ? std::optional<OpenerId>(OpenerId::VisualStudio())
              : pick == 2 ? std::optional<OpenerId>(OpenerId::SystemDefault())
              : pick == 3 ? std::optional<OpenerId>(OpenerId::Dedicated())
              : pick == 4 ? std::optional<OpenerId>(OpenerId::Custom("ed-" + std::to_string(*rc::gen::inRange(0, 9))))
              : std::nullopt;
            text = SetOpenWith(text, k, id);
        }
        const std::vector<OpenWithEntry> entries = ParseOpenWith(text);
        RC_ASSERT(FormatOpenWith(entries) == text);
        RC_ASSERT(ValidateOpenWith(text).empty());
        std::set<std::string> seen;
        for (const OpenWithEntry& e : entries)
            RC_ASSERT(seen.insert(e.key).second);
    });
}

TEST_CASE("ResolveOpener: built-in defaults per group (spec s5.6)", "[text-openers]")
{
    const FileFacts text{ false, false, true };
    const FileFacts asset{ false, true, true };
    const FileFacts binary{ false, false, false };
    for (const char* f : { "a.c", "a.cc", "a.cpp", "a.cxx", "a.h", "a.hh", "a.hpp", "a.hxx", "a.inl", "A.CPP" })
    {
        INFO(f);
        const Resolution r = ResolveOpener(f, text, {}, {});
        CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::VisualStudio());
        CHECK(r.reason == ResolveReason::BuiltInDefault);
    }
    CHECK(ResolveOpener("notes.md", text, {}, {}).opener == OpenerId::ArcaneText());
    CHECK(ResolveOpener("Makefile", text, {}, {}).opener == OpenerId::ArcaneText());
    CHECK(ResolveOpener("brick.arcmat", asset, {}, {}).opener == OpenerId::Dedicated());
    CHECK(ResolveOpener("crash.dmp", binary, {}, {}).opener == OpenerId::SystemDefault());
    CHECK(GroupOf("x.hpp", asset) == FileGroup::Asset);   // an Arcane editor wins the group
}

TEST_CASE("ResolveOpener: the shipped default map answers by group key", "[text-openers]")
{
    const std::vector<OpenWithEntry> map = ParseOpenWith(kDefaultOpenWith);
    const Resolution cpp = ResolveOpener("D:/p/Game.cpp", FileFacts{ false, false, true }, map, {});
    CHECK(cpp.opener == OpenerId::VisualStudio());
    CHECK(cpp.reason == ResolveReason::Group);
    CHECK(cpp.matchedKey == "source");
    const Resolution md = ResolveOpener("D:/p/README.md", FileFacts{ false, false, true }, map, {});
    CHECK(md.opener == OpenerId::ArcaneText());
    CHECK(md.matchedKey == "text");
    const Resolution mat = ResolveOpener("D:/p/brick.arcmat", FileFacts{ false, true, true }, map, {});
    CHECK(mat.opener == OpenerId::Dedicated());
    CHECK(mat.matchedKey == "asset");
    const Resolution dmp = ResolveOpener("D:/p/crash.dmp", FileFacts{ false, false, false }, map, {});
    CHECK(dmp.opener == OpenerId::SystemDefault());
    CHECK(dmp.reason == ResolveReason::BuiltInDefault);
}

TEST_CASE("ResolveOpener: explicit, then already open, then extension, then group, then default", "[text-openers]")
{
    const std::vector<OpenWithEntry> map = ParseOpenWith("source=visualStudio;.cpp=custom:vscode;text=systemDefault");
    const std::vector<std::string> customs{ "vscode" };
    FileFacts f{ false, false, true };

    Resolution r = ResolveOpener("a.cpp", f, map, customs);
    CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::Custom("vscode"));
    CHECK(r.reason == ResolveReason::Extension);
    CHECK(r.matchedKey == ".cpp");

    r = ResolveOpener("a.hpp", f, map, customs);
    CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::VisualStudio());
    CHECK(r.reason == ResolveReason::Group);

    r = ResolveOpener("a.md", f, map, customs);
    CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::SystemDefault());

    f.openInTextDocument = true;
    r = ResolveOpener("a.cpp", f, map, customs);
    CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::ArcaneText());
    CHECK(r.reason == ResolveReason::AlreadyOpen);

    r = ResolveOpener("a.cpp", f, map, customs, OpenerId::SystemDefault());
    CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::SystemDefault());
    CHECK(r.reason == ResolveReason::Explicit);
}

TEST_CASE("ResolveOpener: entries that cannot apply are skipped and named", "[text-openers]")
{
    const std::vector<OpenWithEntry> map = ParseOpenWith(".lua=custom:gone;text=dedicated");
    const Resolution r = ResolveOpener("init.lua", FileFacts{ false, false, true }, map, {});
    CHECK(r.opener == OpenerId::ArcaneText());
    CHECK(r.reason == ResolveReason::BuiltInDefault);
    REQUIRE(r.skipped.size() == 2);
    CHECK(r.skipped[0] == ".lua=custom:gone: no such entry in editor.files.customEditors");
    CHECK(r.skipped[1] == "text=dedicated: no Arcane editor opens .lua files");

    const Resolution e = ResolveOpener("a.md", FileFacts{ false, false, true }, {}, {}, OpenerId::Dedicated());
    CHECK(e.opener == OpenerId::ArcaneText());
    REQUIRE(e.skipped.size() == 1);
    CHECK(e.skipped[0] == "Open With=dedicated: no Arcane editor opens .md files");
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/OpenerId.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// Who opens what (text editor spec s5.6, D15), the pure half: opener ids,
// the editor.files.openWith map ("key=opener;..."; the settings system has
// no map type, Arcane/Config/CVarTypes.hpp), file groups, and ResolveOpener
// -- the one decision every open route takes through FileOpener. No ImGui,
// no Win32; OpenerIdTest drives it directly.

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    enum class OpenerKind : std::uint8_t { ArcaneText, VisualStudio, SystemDefault, Custom, Dedicated };

    struct OpenerId
    {
        OpenerKind  kind = OpenerKind::ArcaneText;
        std::string custom;   // Custom only: the CustomEditor id

        static OpenerId ArcaneText()    { return { OpenerKind::ArcaneText, {} }; }
        static OpenerId VisualStudio()  { return { OpenerKind::VisualStudio, {} }; }
        static OpenerId SystemDefault() { return { OpenerKind::SystemDefault, {} }; }
        static OpenerId Dedicated()     { return { OpenerKind::Dedicated, {} }; }
        static OpenerId Custom(std::string id) { return { OpenerKind::Custom, std::move(id) }; }
        friend bool operator==(const OpenerId&, const OpenerId&) = default;
    };

    // "arcaneText" | "visualStudio" | "systemDefault" | "dedicated" | "custom:<id>".
    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatOpenerId(const OpenerId& id);
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<OpenerId> ParseOpenerId(std::string_view text);
    // [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]* -- never ';', '=' or ':', so it embeds in the map text.
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsValidCustomId(std::string_view id);
    // The detected presets' ids (TE7-7 offers them as custom programs with
    // these ids): vscode, sublime, notepadpp, rider, clion, nvim-wt. A
    // project's config may never name one (D-R6: a preset resolves to a
    // program); TE7-3 says so in its Problems row.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::string_view> PresetIds();
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsPresetId(std::string_view id);

    // The three group keys of editor.files.openWith (spec s5.6).
    inline constexpr std::string_view kGroupSource = "source";   // the nine C/C++ extensions
    inline constexpr std::string_view kGroupText   = "text";     // any other text file
    inline constexpr std::string_view kGroupAsset  = "asset";    // files an Arcane editor opens
    // editor.files.openWith's default: C/C++ -> Visual Studio, other text -> the
    // Arcane Text Editor, assets -> their Arcane editor (spec s5.6 "Defaults").
    inline constexpr std::string_view kDefaultOpenWith = "source=visualStudio;text=arcaneText;asset=dedicated";

    // .c .cc .cpp .cxx .h .hh .hpp .hxx .inl, any case, with or without the
    // dot -- TE2-15's IsCppSourcePath list, never a second copy (CANON B18).
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsSourceExtension(std::string_view extension);
    // A map key: the group keys pass through lowercased, anything else is an
    // extension normalised by Text::NormaliseExtension (TE3-3).
    [[nodiscard]] std::string NormaliseKey(std::string_view key);
    // `path`'s extension as UTF-8 (never throws on a non-ASCII path), lowercase with its dot.
    [[nodiscard]] std::string ExtensionOf(const std::filesystem::path& path);

    struct OpenWithEntry
    {
        std::string key;   // ".ext" or a group key
        OpenerId    opener;
    };

    // Parses "key=opener;key=opener". Malformed entries are skipped (ValidateOpenWith
    // names them); a repeated key keeps its first position and its last value.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<OpenWithEntry> ParseOpenWith(std::string_view text);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatOpenWith(std::span<const OpenWithEntry> entries);
    // `text` with `key` mapped to `opener` (replaced in place, else appended);
    // nullopt removes the key.
    [[nodiscard]] std::string SetOpenWith(std::string_view text, std::string_view key,
                                          const std::optional<OpenerId>& opener);
    // One message per entry ParseOpenWith skipped, in order.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::string> ValidateOpenWith(std::string_view text);

    enum class FileGroup : std::uint8_t { Source, Text, Asset, Binary };

    struct FileFacts
    {
        bool openInTextDocument = false;   // an Arcane TextDocument already shows this file
        bool hasDedicatedEditor = false;   // a DocumentHost extension factory takes it
        bool isText = false;               // the file sniffs as text
    };
    // hasDedicatedEditor: a DEDICATED Arcane editor's factory takes the file
    // (DocumentHost::HasDedicatedFactory, TE2-19) -- never the text routes, which
    // take every text file and would put all of them in the asset group.

    // Asset when an Arcane editor opens it, else Source for the nine C/C++
    // extensions, else Text or Binary by the sniff.
    [[nodiscard]] FileGroup GroupOf(const std::filesystem::path& path, const FileFacts& facts);

    enum class ResolveReason : std::uint8_t { AlreadyOpen, Explicit, Extension, Group, BuiltInDefault };

    struct Resolution
    {
        OpenerId                 opener;
        ResolveReason            reason = ResolveReason::BuiltInDefault;
        std::string              matchedKey;   // ".lua" / "text" (Extension / Group)
        std::vector<std::string> skipped;      // entries passed over, with why
    };

    // Explicit -> already open in a TextDocument -> the extension entry -> the
    // group key -> the group's built-in default (source: Visual Studio, asset:
    // dedicated, text: Arcane Text Editor, binary: system default). Dedicated
    // for a file with no Arcane editor, or a custom id not in `customIds`, is
    // skipped and named in `skipped`.
    [[nodiscard]] Resolution ResolveOpener(const std::filesystem::path& path, const FileFacts& facts,
                                           std::span<const OpenWithEntry> openWith,
                                           std::span<const std::string> customIds,
                                           const std::optional<OpenerId>& explicitOpener = std::nullopt);

    // "Arcane Text Editor", "Visual Studio", "System default", "Custom program", "Arcane editor".
    [[nodiscard]] std::string_view OpenerDisplayName(OpenerKind kind);
}
```
