`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/OpenerId.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Project/Openers/OpenerId.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSniff.hpp"        // IsCppSourcePath (TE2-15): the one C/C++ list
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/LanguageOverrides.hpp"  // Text::NormaliseExtension (TE3-3)

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    namespace
    {
        constexpr std::string_view kCustomPrefix = "custom:";

        std::string_view Trim(std::string_view s)
        {
            while (!s.empty() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s.front()))) s.remove_prefix(1);
            while (!s.empty() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s.back()))) s.remove_suffix(1);
            return s;
        }

        std::string Lower(std::string_view s)
        {
            std::string out(s);
            for (char& c : out) c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
            return out;
        }

        bool IsGroupKey(std::string_view key)
        {
            return key == kGroupSource || key == kGroupText || key == kGroupAsset;
        }

        struct ParsedEntry
        {
            std::optional<OpenWithEntry> entry;
            std::string problem;
        };

        std::vector<ParsedEntry> ParseAll(std::string_view text)
        {
            std::vector<ParsedEntry> out;
            while (!text.empty())
            {
                const std::size_t semi = text.find(';');
                const std::string_view raw = Trim(text.substr(0, semi));
                text = semi == std::string_view::npos ? std::string_view() : text.substr(semi + 1);
                if (raw.empty())
                    continue;
                const std::size_t eq = raw.find('=');
                if (eq == std::string_view::npos)
                {
                    out.push_back({ std::nullopt, "'" + std::string(raw) + "' has no '='" });
                    continue;
                }
                const std::string key = NormaliseKey(raw.substr(0, eq));
                if (key.size() < 2)
                {
                    out.push_back({ std::nullopt, "'" + std::string(raw) + "' names no extension" });
                    continue;
                }
                const std::string_view value = Trim(raw.substr(eq + 1));
                const std::optional<OpenerId> opener = ParseOpenerId(value);
                if (!opener)
                {
                    out.push_back({ std::nullopt, "'" + std::string(raw) + "': '" + std::string(value) +
                                                  "' is not an opener (arcaneText, visualStudio, systemDefault, dedicated, custom:<id>)" });
                    continue;
                }
                out.push_back({ OpenWithEntry{ key, *opener }, {} });
            }
            return out;
        }

        const OpenWithEntry* Find(std::span<const OpenWithEntry> entries, std::string_view key)
        {
            for (auto it = entries.rbegin(); it != entries.rend(); ++it)   // last wins, like a re-set key
                if (it->key == key)
                    return &*it;
            return nullptr;
        }
    }

    std::string FormatOpenerId(const OpenerId& id)
    {
        switch (id.kind)
        {
            case OpenerKind::ArcaneText:    return "arcaneText";
            case OpenerKind::VisualStudio:  return "visualStudio";
            case OpenerKind::SystemDefault: return "systemDefault";
            case OpenerKind::Dedicated:     return "dedicated";
            case OpenerKind::Custom:        return std::string(kCustomPrefix) + id.custom;
        }
        return "arcaneText";
    }

    bool IsValidCustomId(std::string_view id)
    {
        if (id.empty())
            return false;
        const auto alnum = [](char c) { return (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9'); };
        if (!alnum(id.front()))
            return false;
        return std::all_of(id.begin(), id.end(), [&](char c) { return alnum(c) || c == '-' || c == '_'; });
    }

    std::vector<std::string_view> PresetIds()
    {
        return { "vscode", "sublime", "notepadpp", "rider", "clion", "nvim-wt" };
    }

    bool IsPresetId(std::string_view id)
    {
        const std::vector<std::string_view> ids = PresetIds();
        return std::find(ids.begin(), ids.end(), id) != ids.end();
    }

    std::optional<OpenerId> ParseOpenerId(std::string_view text)
    {
        text = Trim(text);
        if (text == "arcaneText")    return OpenerId::ArcaneText();
        if (text == "visualStudio")  return OpenerId::VisualStudio();
        if (text == "systemDefault") return OpenerId::SystemDefault();
        if (text == "dedicated")     return OpenerId::Dedicated();
        if (text.starts_with(kCustomPrefix) && IsValidCustomId(text.substr(kCustomPrefix.size())))
            return OpenerId::Custom(std::string(text.substr(kCustomPrefix.size())));
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    bool IsSourceExtension(std::string_view extension)
    {
        const std::string ext = Arcane::Text::NormaliseExtension(extension);
        if (ext.size() < 2)
            return false;   // "" or "." -- no extension
        // CANON B18: TE2-15's list, asked through a stand-in file name.
        return IsCppSourcePath(std::filesystem::path("x") += ext);
    }

    std::string NormaliseKey(std::string_view key)
    {
        const std::string lower = Lower(Trim(key));
        return IsGroupKey(lower) ? lower : Arcane::Text::NormaliseExtension(lower);
    }

    std::string ExtensionOf(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        const std::u8string ext = path.extension().u8string();
        return Arcane::Text::NormaliseExtension(std::string(ext.begin(), ext.end()));
    }

    std::vector<OpenWithEntry> ParseOpenWith(std::string_view text)
    {
        std::vector<OpenWithEntry> out;
        for (ParsedEntry& p : ParseAll(text))
        {
            if (!p.entry)
                continue;
            const auto it = std::find_if(out.begin(), out.end(), [&](const OpenWithEntry& e) { return e.key == p.entry->key; });
            if (it != out.end())
                it->opener = p.entry->opener;
            else
                out.push_back(std::move(*p.entry));
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::string FormatOpenWith(std::span<const OpenWithEntry> entries)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (const OpenWithEntry& e : entries)
        {
            if (!out.empty())
                out += ';';
            out += e.key;
            out += '=';
            out += FormatOpenerId(e.opener);
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::string SetOpenWith(std::string_view text, std::string_view key, const std::optional<OpenerId>& opener)
    {
        std::vector<OpenWithEntry> v = ParseOpenWith(text);
        const std::string k = NormaliseKey(key);
        const auto it = std::find_if(v.begin(), v.end(), [&](const OpenWithEntry& e) { return e.key == k; });
        if (!opener)
        {
            if (it != v.end())
                v.erase(it);
        }
        else if (it != v.end())
            it->opener = *opener;
        else if (k.size() >= 2)
            v.push_back({ k, *opener });
        return FormatOpenWith(v);
    }

    std::vector<std::string> ValidateOpenWith(std::string_view text)
    {
        std::vector<std::string> out;
        for (const ParsedEntry& p : ParseAll(text))
            if (!p.entry)
                out.push_back(p.problem);
        return out;
    }

    FileGroup GroupOf(const std::filesystem::path& path, const FileFacts& facts)
    {
        if (facts.hasDedicatedEditor)
            return FileGroup::Asset;
        if (IsSourceExtension(ExtensionOf(path)))
            return FileGroup::Source;
        return facts.isText ? FileGroup::Text : FileGroup::Binary;
    }

    Resolution ResolveOpener(const std::filesystem::path& path, const FileFacts& facts,
                             std::span<const OpenWithEntry> openWith, std::span<const std::string> customIds,
                             const std::optional<OpenerId>& explicitOpener)
    {
        Resolution r;
        const std::string ext = ExtensionOf(path);
        const auto usable = [&](const OpenerId& id, std::string_view from) {
            if (id.kind == OpenerKind::Dedicated && !facts.hasDedicatedEditor)
            {
                r.skipped.push_back(std::string(from) + "=dedicated: no Arcane editor opens " +
                                    (ext.empty() ? std::string("this file") : ext + " files"));
                return false;
            }
            if (id.kind == OpenerKind::Custom &&
                std::find(customIds.begin(), customIds.end(), id.custom) == customIds.end())
            {
                r.skipped.push_back(std::string(from) + "=custom:" + id.custom +
                                    ": no such entry in editor.files.customEditors");
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        };

        if (explicitOpener && usable(*explicitOpener, "Open With"))
        {
            r.opener = *explicitOpener;
            r.reason = ResolveReason::Explicit;
            return r;
        }
        if (facts.openInTextDocument)
        {
            r.opener = OpenerId::ArcaneText();
            r.reason = ResolveReason::AlreadyOpen;
            return r;
        }
        if (!ext.empty())
            if (const OpenWithEntry* e = Find(openWith, ext); e && usable(e->opener, ext))
            {
                r.opener = e->opener;
                r.reason = ResolveReason::Extension;
                r.matchedKey = ext;
                return r;
            }

        const FileGroup group = GroupOf(path, facts);
        const std::string_view groupKey = group == FileGroup::Source ? kGroupSource
                                        : group == FileGroup::Text   ? kGroupText
                                        : group == FileGroup::Asset  ? kGroupAsset
                                                                     : std::string_view{};
        if (!groupKey.empty())
            if (const OpenWithEntry* e = Find(openWith, groupKey); e && usable(e->opener, groupKey))
            {
                r.opener = e->opener;
                r.reason = ResolveReason::Group;
                r.matchedKey = std::string(groupKey);
                return r;
            }

        r.reason = ResolveReason::BuiltInDefault;
        switch (group)
        {
            case FileGroup::Source: r.opener = OpenerId::VisualStudio();  break;
            case FileGroup::Asset:  r.opener = OpenerId::Dedicated();     break;
            case FileGroup::Text:   r.opener = OpenerId::ArcaneText();    break;
            case FileGroup::Binary: r.opener = OpenerId::SystemDefault(); break;
        }
        return r;
    }

    std::string_view OpenerDisplayName(OpenerKind kind)
    {
        switch (kind)
        {
            case OpenerKind::ArcaneText:    return "Arcane Text Editor";
            case OpenerKind::VisualStudio:  return "Visual Studio";
            case OpenerKind::SystemDefault: return "System default";
            case OpenerKind::Custom:        return "Custom program";
            case OpenerKind::Dedicated:     return "Arcane editor";
        }
        return "Arcane Text Editor";
    }
}
```

```cpp
// TE7-2: editor.files.customEditors (text editor spec s5.6). Pure.

TEST_CASE("CustomEditors: parse a valid list; format round-trips it", "[text-openers]")
{

        {"id":"vscode","name":"Visual Studio Code","exe":"C:\\VSC\\Code.exe","args":"-g \"{file}:{line}:{col}\""},
        {"id":"npp","exe":"notepad++.exe","args":"-n{line} \"{file}\""}

    REQUIRE(notArray.problems.size() == 1);
    CHECK(notArray.problems[0] == "editor.files.customEditors is not a JSON array");

    const CustomEditorList mixed = ParseCustomEditors(R"([
        {"id":"Bad Id","exe":"x.exe"},
        {"id":"ok","exe":"ok.exe"},
        {"id":"ok","exe":"twice.exe"},
        {"id":"noexe"},
        42
    ])");
    REQUIRE(mixed.editors.size() == 2);
    CHECK(mixed.editors[0].id == "ok");
    CHECK(mixed.editors[1].id == "noexe");   // kept (the page's half-filled entry), but reported
    REQUIRE(mixed.problems.size() == 4);
    CHECK(mixed.problems[0] == "editor.files.customEditors[0]: id 'Bad Id' must be lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_'");
    CHECK(mixed.problems[1] == "editor.files.customEditors[2]: id 'ok' is used twice");
    CHECK(mixed.problems[2] == "editor.files.customEditors[3] (noexe): exe is empty");
    CHECK(mixed.problems[3] == "editor.files.customEditors[4] is not an object");
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/CustomEditors.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// editor.files.customEditors (text editor spec s5.6): the user's own
// programs, a JSON array of {id, name, exe, args} held in one string setting
// (the settings system has no list type; editor.text.vim.remaps does the
// same). Pure; nlohmann/json.

#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    struct CustomEditor
    {
        std::string id;     // [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*: "custom:<id>" in editor.files.openWith
        std::string name;   // what the menus show
        std::string exe;    // an absolute path, or a bare program name looked up on PATH
        std::string args;   // the template: {file} {line} {col} {project} {solution}; empty = "{file}" quoted
        friend bool operator==(const CustomEditor&, const CustomEditor&) = default;
    };

    struct CustomEditorList
    {
        std::vector<CustomEditor> editors;   // the usable entries, in order (an entry with an empty exe is kept, and reported)
        std::vector<std::string>  problems;  // one line per rejected or incomplete entry (Problems rows, the Open With page)
    };

    [[nodiscard]] CustomEditorList ParseCustomEditors(std::string_view json);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatCustomEditors(std::span<const CustomEditor> editors);
    [[nodiscard]] const CustomEditor* FindCustomEditor(std::span<const CustomEditor> editors, std::string_view id);
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::string> CustomEditorIds(std::span<const CustomEditor> editors);
    // "Visual Studio Code" -> "visual-studio-code"; "-2", "-3"... when taken; "program" when nothing is left.
    [[nodiscard]] std::string MintCustomEditorId(std::string_view name, std::span<const CustomEditor> existing);
    // `editor.args`, or "\"{file}\"" when empty -- an entry always receives the file.
    [[nodiscard]] std::string EffectiveArgs(const CustomEditor& editor);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/CustomEditors.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Project/Openers/CustomEditors.hpp"

#include "Project/Openers/OpenerId.hpp"   // IsValidCustomId

#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    namespace
    {
        bool AllSpace(std::string_view s)
        {
            return std::all_of(s.begin(), s.end(), [](char c) { return std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)) != 0; });
        }
    }

    CustomEditorList ParseCustomEditors(std::string_view json)
    {
        CustomEditorList out;
        if (AllSpace(json))
            return out;
        const nlohmann::json doc = nlohmann::json::parse(json.begin(), json.end(), nullptr, false);
        if (doc.is_discarded() || !doc.is_array())
        {
            out.problems.push_back("editor.files.customEditors is not a JSON array");
            return out;
        }
        std::size_t index = 0;
        for (const nlohmann::json& item : doc)
        {
            const std::string where = "editor.files.customEditors[" + std::to_string(index++) + "]";
            if (!item.is_object())
            {
                out.problems.push_back(where + " is not an object");
                continue;
            }
            const auto str = [&](const char* key) -> std::string {
                const auto it = item.find(key);
                return it != item.end() && it->is_string() ? it->get<std::string>() : std::string();
            };
            CustomEditor e{ str("id"), str("name"), str("exe"), str("args") };
            if (!IsValidCustomId(e.id))
            {
                out.problems.push_back(where + ": id '" + e.id + "' must be lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_'");
                continue;
            }
            if (FindCustomEditor(out.editors, e.id))
            {
                out.problems.push_back(where + ": id '" + e.id + "' is used twice");
                continue;
            }
            if (AllSpace(e.exe))   // kept: a half-filled entry on the Open With page; launching it says "names no program"
                out.problems.push_back(where + " (" + e.id + "): exe is empty");
            if (e.name.empty())
                e.name = e.id;
            out.editors.push_back(std::move(e));
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::string FormatCustomEditors(std::span<const CustomEditor> editors)
    {
        nlohmann::json arr = nlohmann::json::array();
        for (const CustomEditor& e : editors)
            arr.push_back({ { "id", e.id }, { "name", e.name }, { "exe", e.exe }, { "args", e.args } });
        return arr.dump();
    }

    const CustomEditor* FindCustomEditor(std::span<const CustomEditor> editors, std::string_view id)
    {
        const auto it = std::find_if(editors.begin(), editors.end(), [&](const CustomEditor& e) { return e.id == id; });
        return it == editors.end() ? nullptr : &*it;
    }

    std::vector<std::string> CustomEditorIds(std::span<const CustomEditor> editors)
    {
        std::vector<std::string> out;
        out.reserve(editors.size());
        for (const CustomEditor& e : editors)
            out.push_back(e.id);
        return out;
    }

    std::string MintCustomEditorId(std::string_view name, std::span<const CustomEditor> existing)
    {
        std::string base;
        for (const char raw : name)
        {
            const char c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(raw)));
            const bool keep = (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9');
            if (keep)
                base.push_back(c);
            else if (!base.empty() && base.back() != '-')
                base.push_back('-');
        }
        while (!base.empty() && base.back() == '-')
            base.pop_back();
        if (base.empty())
            base = "program";
        if (!FindCustomEditor(existing, base))
            return base;
        for (int n = 2;; ++n)
        {
            const std::string candidate = base + "-" + std::to_string(n);
            if (!FindCustomEditor(existing, candidate))
                return candidate;
        }
    }

    std::string EffectiveArgs(const CustomEditor& editor)
    {
        return AllSpace(editor.args) ? std::string("\"{file}\"") : editor.args;
    }
}
```

### Task TE7-3: The `editor.files.*` settings (spec s5.6 "Choosing", s8; settings rule; plan rev 2 D-R6)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/Settings/FileOpenerSettings.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/Settings/FileOpenerSettings.cpp`
- Modify: `docs/superpowers/audits/2026-10-03-settings-inventory.md` (two rows at the end of TE1-9's `### Text editor` table, one "Post-freeze amendments" row -- D-R8), `scripts/settings-frozen-names.txt` (regenerated by the lint, never by hand -- D-R8), `premake5.lua` (append `FileOpenerSettings.cpp` to the TE7 block)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/SweepFilesTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE7-1 (`kDefaultOpenWith`, `ParseOpenWith`, `FormatOpenWith`, `SetOpenWith`, `FormatOpenerId`, `IsPresetId`), TE7-2 (`ParseCustomEditors`, `FormatCustomEditors`); the reflection macros as `Settings/EditorUiSettings.cpp:10-33` uses them (`ARC_REFLECT_TYPE_ATTR(Settings, <category>, <scope>, <apply>, <audience>, <categoryPath>)`); settings **S7-SEC** (on `main` once the settings arc merges -- the plan's base): `CVarFlags::LaunchesProgram` (`ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Config/CVarTypes.hpp:57`), `CVarRungRefusal` / `RungRefusal(CVarFlags, SettingScope, SetBy)` (`CVarTypes.hpp:146-157`), the registry backstop in `CVarRegistry::Set` (`CVarRegistry.cpp:844-852`: `SetResult::Denied`), `ApplyCVarDirectory` and `CVarApplyReport::refused` (`CVarConfig.hpp:22-33, 80-95`), as `BuildToolSettings.hpp:33-45` and `DiagnosticsSettings.hpp:58` flag their program paths; `Arcane::EditPreference`, `PreferenceRung`, `PreferenceTargetOf` (`ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Config/PreferenceScope.hpp`); `CVarRegistry::Explain` (its `history`: one record per (rung, source), weakest rung first, the back wins -- `CVarRegistry.hpp:53-73`, `CVarRegistry.cpp:860-877`), `CVarRegistry::Set` / `ClearRung` / `Publish`; `Arcane::Editor::NoteSettingEdited` (`Settings/SettingsHost.hpp:62`), `Arcane::Editor::RungSource` (`Settings/SettingsEdit.hpp:29`); `Arcane::Test::RequireDefault`, `Arcane::Test::ScopedCodeRung` (`ArcaneTests/src/Helpers/SettingsSweep.hpp`).
- Produces (namespace `Arcane::Editor`):
  - `struct FileOpenerSettings { std::string openWith; std::string customEditors; }` registered as `editor.files.openWith` (**PreferencesProject**, `Hidden`) / `editor.files.customEditors` (**PreferencesMachine**, `Hidden | LaunchesProgram` -- settings S7-SEC)
  - `kOpenWithPageCategory` = `"Editor/Files/Open With"`
  - `bool MayNamePrograms(Arcane::SetBy) noexcept`, `bool MayChooseCustomOpeners(Arcane::SetBy) noexcept`
  - `struct FilesSettingsSnapshot { std::string openWithText; Arcane::SetBy openWithRung; std::vector<Openers::OpenWithEntry> openWith; std::string customEditorsText; Arcane::SetBy customEditorsRung; std::vector<Openers::CustomEditor> customEditors; std::vector<std::string> customEditorsProblems; std::vector<std::string> refusals; }`
  - `FilesSettingsSnapshot ReadFilesSettings(const Arcane::CVarRegistry&)`, `FilesSettingsSnapshot ReadFilesSettings()`
  - `std::vector<Openers::OpenWithEntry> CurrentOpenWith()`, `std::vector<Openers::CustomEditor> CurrentCustomEditors()` (both read `ReadFilesSettings()`: the trusted values)
  - `bool WriteFilesSetting(std::string_view field, std::string value, std::string* note = nullptr)`, `bool SetOpenerFor(std::string_view key, const std::optional<Openers::OpenerId>&, std::string* note = nullptr)`, `bool SetCustomEditors(std::span<const Openers::CustomEditor>, std::string* note = nullptr)`

Decisions recorded here:
- **Representation.** There is no map or list cvar type: `CVarType` has thirteen value types (`ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Config/CVarTypes.hpp`). So `openWith` is the `key=opener;...` string of TE7-1, and `customEditors` is the JSON of TE7-2. TE3's `editor.text.languageByExtension` and TE5's `editor.text.vim.remaps` already do the same.
- **A project's settings can never name a program (plan rev 2 D-R6, finding 7.2).** A cloned repository must not be able to make a double-click run `cmd.exe /c ...`.
  - `editor.files.customEditors` (the programs) is registered **PreferencesMachine** with **`CVarFlags::LaunchesProgram`** (settings S7-SEC; rev-2 SCOPE-ENFORCEMENT). The REGISTRY refuses it, not a TE7 special case: `RungRefusal` denies a LaunchesProgram cvar on the EngineConfig, **Plugin** (`<plugin>/Config`), **Project** (`<project>/Config`) and **User** (`<project>/Saved/Config` in the editor, `Paths.cpp:111-114`) rungs, so `CVarRegistry::Set` returns `SetResult::Denied` and a config file's key is never applied -- `ApplyCVarDirectory` reports it in `CVarApplyReport::refused` and the settings arc's config diagnostics show it (and a config folder inside a project or plugin root refuses it whatever its rung). It is honoured only from the default, the machine-wide EditorUser rung, `--set`, code and an Editor-context console. **Defence in depth:** `ReadFilesSettings` still takes the list only from a rung that `MayNamePrograms`, and `MayNamePrograms` IS the registry's rule (`RungRefusal(CVarFlags::LaunchesProgram, SettingScope::PreferencesMachine, rung) == CVarRungRefusal::None`), so a record that ever reached another rung would be ignored with a refusal line. `SetCustomEditors` always writes the EditorUser rung (S7-SEC's `PreferenceTargetOf` also pins a LaunchesProgram row to All projects).
  - `editor.files.openWith` stays **PreferencesProject**. When its winning value comes from the Project or Plugin rung, only the built-in openers survive (`arcaneText`, `visualStudio`, `systemDefault`, `dedicated`); every `custom:<id>` entry is ignored with a refusal line, which says so separately when the id is a detected preset's (`IsPresetId`). The user's own Preferences (User and EditorUser rungs) may name any custom or preset id: the ids only resolve through the machine-wide program list above.
  - FileOpener (TE7-8) publishes the refusal lines as Problems rows. `SetOpenerFor` starts from the trusted entries, so a refused project entry is never copied into the user's value.
  - `[openers-guard]` (TE7-10/11) stays as a secondary check of the open paths; it is not what enforces this rule.
- **Writes.** `openWith` goes through `EditPreference`, so the row's All projects / This project switch is honoured (This project, the User rung, is a per-project row's home). `customEditors` always goes to EditorUser. A write that a stronger rung outranks (`SetResult::RefusedWeaker`: a `--set`, the console, a test's Code rung) is still **saved** -- the value is recorded on its rung and wins once the stronger one is cleared -- and the optional `note` says so (finding 7.3; TE5d's `WriteVimRemaps` treats it the same way). Only `Stale`, `TypeMismatch` and `Denied` return false.
- **Hidden rows.** Both rows carry `CVarFlags::Hidden`. The Open With page (TE7-15) is their editor, and Show advanced reveals the raw strings.
- **Where the page lives.** The Preferences tree has fixed roots (`kRootOrder` in `Settings/SettingsModel.cpp:17-18`: Project, Appearance, Keyboard, Layout, Editor, Engine, Game, Plugins). A path under none of them is filed under "Engine". The spec's "Preferences > Files > Open With" is therefore **Editor > Files > Open With**.

```cpp
// TE7-3: editor.files.* (text editor spec s5.6, D15; plan rev 2 D-R6).
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Helpers/SettingsSweep.hpp"
#include "Settings/FileOpenerSettings.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/CVarConfig.hpp>     // ApplyCVarDirectory, CVarApplyReport::refused (S7-SEC)
#include <Arcane/Config/CVarRegistry.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane;
namespace O = Arcane::Editor::Openers;

namespace
{
    // A value on any rung, cleared (and published) however the case exits --
    // ScopedCodeRung's shape for the rungs a project or the user's files fill.
    class ScopedRung
    {
    public:
        ScopedRung(std::string_view name, std::string value, SetBy rung, std::string_view source)
            : m_handle(CVarRegistry::Get().Find(name)), m_rung(rung)
        {
            INFO("cvar " << std::string(name));
            REQUIRE_FALSE(m_handle.IsStale());
            const SetResult r = CVarRegistry::Get().Set(m_handle, CVarValue::String(std::move(value)), rung, source,
                                                        CVarContext::Editor);
            REQUIRE((r == SetResult::Applied || r == SetResult::RefusedWeaker));
            CVarRegistry::Get().PublishImmediate();
        }
        ~ScopedRung()
        {
            CVarRegistry::Get().ClearRung(m_handle, m_rung);
            CVarRegistry::Get().PublishImmediate();
        }
        ScopedRung(const ScopedRung&) = delete;
        ScopedRung& operator=(const ScopedRung&) = delete;

    private:
        CVarHandle m_handle;
        SetBy m_rung;
    };

    bool HoldsRung(std::string_view name, SetBy rung)
    {
        const auto e = CVarRegistry::Get().Explain(name);
        return e && std::any_of(e->history.begin(), e->history.end(), [&](const CVarHistoryRecord& h) { return h.by == rung; });
    }

    const char* kTwoPrograms =
        R"([{"id":"mine","name":"Mine","exe":"C:/Tools/mine.exe","args":""},)"
        R"({"id":"vscode","name":"Visual Studio Code","exe":"C:/VSC/Code.exe","args":"-g \"{file}:{line}\""}])";
}

TEST_CASE("D-R6: custom programs come only from machine-wide Preferences -- the registry refuses every rung inside a project (S7-SEC)", "[sweep][files]")
{
    ScopedRung machine("editor.files.customEditors", R"([{"id":"mine","name":"Mine","exe":"C:/Tools/mine.exe","args":""}])",
                       SetBy::EditorUser, "editor-user");
    const std::string evil = R"([{"id":"mine","name":"Mine","exe":"C:/Windows/System32/cmd.exe","args":"/c calc"}])";
    CVarRegistry& reg = CVarRegistry::Get();
    const CVarHandle h = reg.Find("editor.files.customEditors");
    REQUIRE_FALSE(h.IsStale());
    // The registry itself (settings S7-SEC, CVarFlags::LaunchesProgram): a project's,
    // a plugin's, the engine's config and this project's Saved/Config are refused.
    for (const SetBy rung : { SetBy::Plugin, SetBy::Project, SetBy::User, SetBy::EngineConfig })
    {
        INFO("rung " << static_cast<int>(rung));
        CHECK(reg.Set(h, CVarValue::String(evil), rung, "project", CVarContext::Editor) == SetResult::Denied);
        CHECK_FALSE(HoldsRung("editor.files.customEditors", rung));
    }
    // A cloned project's committed config file: the key is reported, never applied.
    const std::filesystem::path dir = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "arcane-te7-files-projectcfg";
    std::filesystem::remove_all(dir);
    std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
    {
        std::ofstream cfg(dir / "editor.json", std::ios::binary);
        cfg << R"({ "files": { "customEditors": "[{\"id\":\"x\",\"name\":\"X\",\"exe\":\"C:/Windows/System32/cmd.exe\",\"args\":\"/c calc\"}]" } })";
    }
    const CVarApplyReport report = ApplyCVarDirectory(reg, dir, SetBy::Project, "project");
    REQUIRE(report.refused.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(report.refused[0].key == "editor.files.customEditors");
    CHECK(report.refused[0].why == CVarRungRefusal::LaunchesProgram);
    CHECK_FALSE(HoldsRung("editor.files.customEditors", SetBy::Project));
    std::filesystem::remove_all(dir);
    reg.PublishImmediate();

    const Editor::FilesSettingsSnapshot s = Editor::ReadFilesSettings();
    REQUIRE(s.customEditors.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(s.customEditors[0].exe == "C:/Tools/mine.exe");   // the machine-wide entry
    CHECK(s.customEditorsRung == SetBy::EditorUser);
    CHECK(s.refusals.empty());                               // nothing reached a rung the reader would have to ignore
    CHECK(Editor::CurrentCustomEditors() == s.customEditors);
    // Defence in depth: the reader's rule IS the registry's rule, rung for rung.
    for (const SetBy rung : { SetBy::Default, SetBy::EngineConfig, SetBy::Plugin, SetBy::Project, SetBy::EditorUser,
                              SetBy::User, SetBy::CommandLine, SetBy::Code, SetBy::Console })
    {
        INFO("rung " << static_cast<int>(rung));
        CHECK(Editor::MayNamePrograms(rung)
              == (RungRefusal(CVarFlags::LaunchesProgram, SettingScope::PreferencesMachine, rung) == CVarRungRefusal::None));
    }
    CHECK(Editor::MayNamePrograms(SetBy::EditorUser));
    CHECK(Editor::MayNamePrograms(SetBy::CommandLine));
    CHECK_FALSE(Editor::MayNamePrograms(SetBy::User));
    CHECK_FALSE(Editor::MayNamePrograms(SetBy::EngineConfig));
    CHECK(Editor::MayChooseCustomOpeners(SetBy::User));
    CHECK_FALSE(Editor::MayChooseCustomOpeners(SetBy::Project));
    CHECK_FALSE(Editor::MayChooseCustomOpeners(SetBy::Plugin));
}

    CHECK(Settings<Editor::FileOpenerSettings>().openWith == "source=visualStudio;text=arcaneText;asset=dedicated;.cpp=arcaneText");
    const std::vector<O::CustomEditor> list{ { "ed", "Ed", "C:/ed.exe", "" } };
    REQUIRE(Editor::SetCustomEditors(list));
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// editor.files.* (text editor spec s5.6, D15): who opens what. Two string
// settings, because the settings system has no map or list type
// (Arcane/Config/CVarTypes.hpp): openWith is "key=opener;..."
// (Openers::ParseOpenWith) and customEditors a JSON array
// (Openers::ParseCustomEditors). Both rows are Hidden -- Preferences >
// Editor > Files > Open With (OpenWithPage) is their editor; Show advanced
// reveals the raw text.
//
// A project's settings can never name a program (plan rev 2 D-R6):
// - customEditors is PreferencesMachine and CVarFlags::LaunchesProgram
//   (settings S7-SEC): the registry refuses it from the EngineConfig,
//   Plugin, Project and User rungs (Set -> Denied; a config file's key is
//   reported, never applied). ReadFilesSettings keeps the same rule as
//   defence in depth: it takes the list only from a rung that MayNamePrograms.
// - openWith is PreferencesProject. A winning value from the Project or a
//   Plugin rung keeps only the built-in openers; its custom:<id> entries (a
//   detected preset's id included) are ignored with a refusal.
// FileOpener publishes the refusals as Problems rows (TE7-8). Every reader
// of these settings goes through ReadFilesSettings / Current*, never the raw
// Settings<FileOpenerSettings>() strings.

#include "Project/Openers/CustomEditors.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/OpenerId.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/CVarRegistry.hpp>

#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    // The Preferences node the page and both rows share (under the Editor
    // root: SettingsModel's fixed roots would file a bare "Files" under Engine).
    inline constexpr std::string_view kOpenWithPageCategory = "Editor/Files/Open With";

    struct FileOpenerSettings
    {
        std::string openWith = std::string(Openers::kDefaultOpenWith);
        std::string customEditors = "[]";
    };

    // A value on `rung` may define programs (customEditors): exactly the
    // registry's S7-SEC rule for a LaunchesProgram, PreferencesMachine cvar --
    // Default, EditorUser, CommandLine, Code, Console. EngineConfig, Plugin,
    // Project and User are refused (the registry refuses them first).
    [[nodiscard]] bool MayNamePrograms(Arcane::SetBy rung) noexcept;
    // A value on `rung` may map files to custom:<id> openers (openWith):
    // every rung but Project and Plugin (a project's committed config).
    [[nodiscard]] bool MayChooseCustomOpeners(Arcane::SetBy rung) noexcept;

    struct FilesSettingsSnapshot
    {
        std::string openWithText;                          // the winning editor.files.openWith value (any rung)
        Arcane::SetBy openWithRung = Arcane::SetBy::Default;
        std::vector<Openers::OpenWithEntry> openWith;      // its entries; from Project/Plugin: built-in openers only
        std::string customEditorsText = "[]";              // the newest value on a rung that MayNamePrograms
        Arcane::SetBy customEditorsRung = Arcane::SetBy::Default;
        std::vector<Openers::CustomEditor> customEditors;  // ParseCustomEditors(customEditorsText).editors
        std::vector<std::string> customEditorsProblems;    // ... and its problems
        std::vector<std::string> refusals;                 // D-R6: one line per ignored entry or value
    };

    // The trusted view of editor.files.* (D-R6), read from the registry's
    // per-rung history (the pending store: a write is visible before Publish).
    [[nodiscard]] FilesSettingsSnapshot ReadFilesSettings(const Arcane::CVarRegistry& registry);
    [[nodiscard]] FilesSettingsSnapshot ReadFilesSettings();   // CVarRegistry::Get()

    // ReadFilesSettings().openWith / .customEditors.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Openers::OpenWithEntry> CurrentOpenWith();
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Openers::CustomEditor> CurrentCustomEditors();

    // editor.files.<field>: openWith on the rung a Preferences edit of it
    // belongs to (EditPreference: This project by default, All projects once
    // the row's switch says so), customEditors always on EditorUser (D-R6);
    // then NoteSettingEdited (the debounced archive) and Publish. A write a
    // stronger rung outranks (RefusedWeaker) is saved and returns true, with
    // `note` saying what still decides (finding 7.3); `note` is cleared
    // otherwise. False when the name is unknown or the registry refused it.
    bool WriteFilesSetting(std::string_view field, std::string value, std::string* note = nullptr);
    // "Always use this for .ext" / the Open With page: map one key (nullopt
    // removes it), starting from the TRUSTED entries -- a refused project
    // entry is never copied into the user's value.
    bool SetOpenerFor(std::string_view key, const std::optional<Openers::OpenerId>& opener, std::string* note = nullptr);
    bool SetCustomEditors(std::span<const Openers::CustomEditor> editors, std::string* note = nullptr);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Settings/FileOpenerSettings.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Settings/FileOpenerSettings.hpp"

#include "Settings/SettingsEdit.hpp"   // RungSource
#include "Settings/SettingsHost.hpp"   // NoteSettingEdited

#include <Arcane/Config/PreferenceScope.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Reflection.hpp>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    ARC_REFLECT_TYPE(FileOpenerSettings)
        ARC_REFLECT_TYPE_ATTR(Settings, "editor.files", SettingScope::PreferencesProject, ApplyMode::Live, Audience::Editor,
                              "Editor/Files/Open With")   // kOpenWithPageCategory
        ARC_REFLECT_FIELD(FileOpenerSettings, openWith)
            ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(DisplayName, "Open with (raw)") ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(Flags, CVarFlags::Hidden)
            ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(Keywords, "opener open file type association extension visual studio external editor vscode")
            ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(Tooltip, "Who opens each file type: .ext=opener;... plus the group keys source (C and C++), "
                                      "text and asset (files with an Arcane editor). Openers: arcaneText, visualStudio, "
                                      "systemDefault, dedicated, custom:<id>. A project's own config may use only the "
                                      "first four. Edit it on the Open With page.")
        ARC_REFLECT_FIELD(FileOpenerSettings, customEditors)
            ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(Scope, SettingScope::PreferencesMachine)   // D-R6: programs are machine-wide only
            ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(DisplayName, "Custom programs (raw)")
            ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(Flags, CVarFlags::Hidden | CVarFlags::LaunchesProgram)   // S7-SEC: no rung inside a project sets it
            ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(Keywords, "custom program external editor command line arguments vscode sublime notepad++ rider clion neovim")
            ARC_REFLECT_ATTR(Tooltip, "Your own programs as a JSON array of {id, name, exe, args}. args may use {file}, "
                                      "{line}, {col}, {project} and {solution}. Machine-wide only: a project's config "
                                      "cannot add programs. Edit them on the Open With page.")
    ARC_END_REFLECT_TYPE()

    ARC_SETTINGS(FileOpenerSettings);

    namespace
    {
        const std::string kOpenWithName = "editor.files.openWith";
        const std::string kCustomEditorsName = "editor.files.customEditors";

        std::string StringOf(const Arcane::CVarValue& v)
        {
            return v.type == Arcane::CVarType::String ? v.AsString() : std::string();
        }

        // Where a refused value or a winning rung came from, in the words of a Problems row or a note.
        std::string RungLabel(Arcane::SetBy rung, std::string_view module)
        {
            switch (rung)
            {
                case Arcane::SetBy::Default:      return "the default";
                case Arcane::SetBy::EngineConfig: return "the engine's config";
                case Arcane::SetBy::Plugin:       return "the plugin config of '" + std::string(module) + "'";
                case Arcane::SetBy::Project:      return "the project's config (Config/)";
                case Arcane::SetBy::EditorUser:   return "your All projects Preferences";
                case Arcane::SetBy::User:         return "this project's Saved/Config (This project)";
                case Arcane::SetBy::CommandLine:  return "the command line (--set)";
                case Arcane::SetBy::Code:         return "code";
                case Arcane::SetBy::Console:      return "the console";
            }
            return "an unknown rung";
        }
    }

    bool MayNamePrograms(Arcane::SetBy rung) noexcept
    {
        // The registry's own rule (settings S7-SEC), so the reader can never disagree with it.
        return Arcane::RungRefusal(Arcane::CVarFlags::LaunchesProgram, Arcane::SettingScope::PreferencesMachine, rung)
            == Arcane::CVarRungRefusal::None;
    }

    bool MayChooseCustomOpeners(Arcane::SetBy rung) noexcept
    {
        return rung != Arcane::SetBy::Project && rung != Arcane::SetBy::Plugin;
    }

    FilesSettingsSnapshot ReadFilesSettings(const Arcane::CVarRegistry& registry)
    {
        FilesSettingsSnapshot out;
        out.openWithText = std::string(Openers::kDefaultOpenWith);
        std::string openWithModule;
        if (const std::optional<Arcane::CVarExplain> e = registry.Explain(kOpenWithName); e && !e->history.empty())
        {
            const Arcane::CVarHistoryRecord& winner = e->history.back();   // weakest rung first: the back wins
            out.openWithText = StringOf(winner.value);
            out.openWithRung = winner.by;
            openWithModule = winner.module;
        }
        for (Openers::OpenWithEntry& entry : Openers::ParseOpenWith(out.openWithText))
        {
            if (entry.opener.kind == Openers::OpenerKind::Custom && !MayChooseCustomOpeners(out.openWithRung))
            {
                const std::string head = "editor.files.openWith: '" + entry.key + "=" + Openers::FormatOpenerId(entry.opener) +
                                         "' from " + RungLabel(out.openWithRung, openWithModule) + " is ignored: ";
                out.refusals.push_back(Openers::IsPresetId(entry.opener.custom)
                    ? head + "it names the detected program '" + entry.opener.custom +
                          "', and a project may choose only arcaneText, visualStudio, systemDefault or dedicated"
                    : head + "a project may choose only arcaneText, visualStudio, systemDefault or dedicated; "
                             "custom programs are assigned in your own Preferences");
                continue;
            }
            out.openWith.push_back(std::move(entry));
        }

        if (const std::optional<Arcane::CVarExplain> e = registry.Explain(kCustomEditorsName))
        {
            bool chosen = false;
            for (auto it = e->history.rbegin(); it != e->history.rend(); ++it)   // strongest first
            {
                if (!MayNamePrograms(it->by))
                {
                    out.refusals.push_back("editor.files.customEditors from " + RungLabel(it->by, it->module) +
                                           " is ignored: custom programs come only from your machine-wide Preferences (All projects)");
                    continue;
                }
                if (!chosen)
                {
                    out.customEditorsText = StringOf(it->value);
                    out.customEditorsRung = it->by;
                    chosen = true;
                }
            }
        }
        Openers::CustomEditorList list = Openers::ParseCustomEditors(out.customEditorsText);
        out.customEditors = std::move(list.editors);
        out.customEditorsProblems = std::move(list.problems);
        return out;
    }

    FilesSettingsSnapshot ReadFilesSettings()
    {
        return ReadFilesSettings(Arcane::CVarRegistry::Get());
    }

    std::vector<Openers::OpenWithEntry> CurrentOpenWith()
    {
        return ReadFilesSettings().openWith;
    }

    std::vector<Openers::CustomEditor> CurrentCustomEditors()
    {
        return ReadFilesSettings().customEditors;
    }

    bool WriteFilesSetting(std::string_view field, std::string value, std::string* note)
    {
        if (note)
            note->clear();
        Arcane::CVarRegistry& reg = Arcane::CVarRegistry::Get();
        const std::string name = "editor.files." + std::string(field);
        const Arcane::CVarHandle handle = reg.Find(name);
        if (handle.IsStale())
            return false;
        const bool machineOnly = name == kCustomEditorsName;   // D-R6: never This project
        const Arcane::SetBy rung = machineOnly
            ? Arcane::SetBy::EditorUser
            : Arcane::PreferenceRung(Arcane::SettingScope::PreferencesProject, Arcane::PreferenceTargetOf(reg, name));
        const Arcane::SetResult r = machineOnly
            ? reg.Set(handle, Arcane::CVarValue::String(value), Arcane::SetBy::EditorUser, RungSource(Arcane::SetBy::EditorUser),
                      Arcane::CVarContext::Editor)
            : Arcane::EditPreference(reg, name, Arcane::CVarValue::String(value));
        // RefusedWeaker is a save (finding 7.3): the value is recorded on its
        // rung and decides once the stronger rung is cleared.
        if (r != Arcane::SetResult::Applied && r != Arcane::SetResult::RefusedWeaker)
            return false;
        NoteSettingEdited(rung, name);
        reg.Publish();
        if (note)
        {
            const FilesSettingsSnapshot now = ReadFilesSettings(reg);
            const std::string& effective = machineOnly ? now.customEditorsText : now.openWithText;
            if (effective != value)
            {
                const Arcane::SetBy winner = machineOnly ? now.customEditorsRung : now.openWithRung;
                *note = "Saved; it takes effect once " + RungLabel(winner, {}) + "'s value for " + name +
                        " is cleared (Clear override on the row).";
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool SetOpenerFor(std::string_view key, const std::optional<Openers::OpenerId>& opener, std::string* note)
    {
        return WriteFilesSetting("openWith", Openers::SetOpenWith(Openers::FormatOpenWith(CurrentOpenWith()), key, opener), note);
    }

    bool SetCustomEditors(std::span<const Openers::CustomEditor> editors, std::string* note)
    {
        return WriteFilesSetting("customEditors", Openers::FormatCustomEditors(editors), note);
    }
}
```

### Task TE7-4: Argument templates -- `{file}` `{line}` `{col}` `{project}` `{solution}` with Windows quoting (spec s5.6 "Custom program")

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.cpp`
- Modify: `premake5.lua` (append to the TE7 block)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/CommandTemplateTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE7-2 `CustomEditor`, `EffectiveArgs`; `Arcane::Editor::RuntimeLaunch::QuoteArg(const std::wstring&)` (`Project/RuntimeLaunch.hpp:30`, the one Win32 argv escaper, already source-compiled into ArcaneTests at premake5.lua:1403).
- Produces (namespace `Arcane::Editor::Openers`):
  - `struct TemplateContext { std::filesystem::path file; std::uint32_t line = 1, column = 1; std::filesystem::path project, solution; }`
  - `struct ExpandedArgs { std::vector<std::wstring> argv; std::string error; bool Ok() const; }`
  - `std::vector<std::wstring> SplitCommandLine(std::wstring_view)`, `ExpandedArgs ExpandTemplate(std::string_view, const TemplateContext&)`
  - `std::wstring BuildCommandLine(const std::filesystem::path& program, std::span<const std::wstring> argv)`
  - `std::string PreviewCommandLine(const CustomEditor&, const TemplateContext&)`
  - `std::wstring Utf8ToWide(std::string_view)`, `std::string WideToUtf8(std::wstring_view)`, `std::string PathUtf8(const std::filesystem::path&)`

The approach, so quoting is right by construction:
1. The template is split into arguments by **CommandLineToArgvW's own rules**. Whatever the user quoted stays one argument: `-g "{file}:{line}:{col}"` is two arguments.
2. Placeholders expand **inside** each argument. A `{file}` holding spaces therefore never splits, quoted in the template or not.
3. Every argument is re-quoted with `RuntimeLaunch::QuoteArg`.

The tests prove the round trip against the real `CommandLineToArgvW`, including `{project}` ending in a backslash and values holding quotes. `{{` and `}}` are literal braces. An unknown placeholder, or `{project}` / `{solution}` when there is none, is an error the Preferences preview shows.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test** -- `ArcaneTests/src/Text/CommandTemplateTest.cpp`:

```cpp
// TE7-4: argument templates -> argv -> one Windows command line (text editor
// spec s5.6). SplitCommandLine and the round trip are checked against the
// real CommandLineToArgvW, the authority.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
#include <rapidcheck.h>
#include <rapidcheck/catch.h>

#include "Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp"

#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#ifdef _WIN32
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#include <shellapi.h>   // CommandLineToArgvW (shell32.lib: OsShell.cpp's #pragma links it)
#endif

using namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers;
using V = std::vector<std::wstring>;

TEST_CASE("SplitCommandLine: CommandLineToArgvW's rules for the arguments", "[text-openers]")
{
    CHECK(SplitCommandLine(L"") == V{});
    CHECK(SplitCommandLine(L"  a\tb  ") == V{ L"a", L"b" });
    CHECK(SplitCommandLine(LR"(-g "{file}:{line}:{col}")") == V{ L"-g", L"{file}:{line}:{col}" });
    CHECK(SplitCommandLine(LR"("" x)") == V{ L"", L"x" });
    CHECK(SplitCommandLine(LR"(a\\b c\"d)") == V{ LR"(a\\b)", LR"(c"d)" });
    CHECK(SplitCommandLine(LR"("a\\" b)") == V{ LR"(a\)", L"b" });
    CHECK(SplitCommandLine(LR"("a""b c")") == V{ LR"(a"b)", L"c" });   // "" inside quotes: a literal quote that ends the quoted run
    CHECK(SplitCommandLine(LR"(""")") == V{ LR"(")" });
}

TEST_CASE("ExpandTemplate: placeholders expand inside arguments; quoting is per argument", "[text-openers]")
{
    TemplateContext c;
    c.file = L"D:\\My Game\\Source\\Game Mode.cpp";
    c.line = 42;
    c.column = 7;
    c.project = L"D:\\My Game\\";
    c.solution = L"D:\\My Game\\MyGame.slnx";
    CHECK(ExpandTemplate(R"(-g "{file}:{line}:{col}")", c).argv == V{ L"-g", L"D:\\My Game\\Source\\Game Mode.cpp:42:7" });
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// A custom program's argument template (text editor spec s5.6) -> argv ->
// one Windows command line. The template is split by CommandLineToArgvW's
// own rules (what the user quoted stays one argument), placeholders expand
// INSIDE each argument (so a {file} with spaces never splits, quoted or not),
// and every argument is re-quoted with RuntimeLaunch::QuoteArg -- a
// {project} ending in a backslash or a value holding a quote reaches the
// program as exactly one argument. Placeholders: {file} {line} {col}
// {project} {solution}; {{ and }} are literal braces. Pure;
// CommandTemplateTest round-trips it through the real CommandLineToArgvW.

#include "Project/Openers/CustomEditors.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    struct TemplateContext
    {
        std::filesystem::path file;
        std::uint32_t line = 1;           // 1-based
        std::uint32_t column = 1;         // 1-based, in characters
        std::filesystem::path project;    // the project root; empty = no project open
        std::filesystem::path solution;   // the project's .slnx; empty = none generated yet
    };

    struct ExpandedArgs
    {
        std::vector<std::wstring> argv;   // the arguments, without the program
        std::string error;                // empty = expanded
        [[nodiscard]] bool Ok() const noexcept { return error.empty(); }
    };

    // CommandLineToArgvW's rules for the arguments after argv[0]: space and tab
    // separate outside quotes; 2n backslashes before a quote give n and the
    // quote toggles; 2n+1 give n and a literal quote; other backslashes are
    // literal; inside quotes, "" is a literal quote that ends the quoted run.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::wstring> SplitCommandLine(std::wstring_view args);
    [[nodiscard]] ExpandedArgs ExpandTemplate(std::string_view argsTemplate, const TemplateContext& context);
    // QuoteArg(program) + ' ' + QuoteArg(each argument).
    [[nodiscard]] std::wstring BuildCommandLine(const std::filesystem::path& program, std::span<const std::wstring> argv);
    // The command line `editor` would run for `context` (EffectiveArgs), as
    // UTF-8 -- the Open With page's live preview; "error: <why>" when it does not expand.
    [[nodiscard]] std::string PreviewCommandLine(const CustomEditor& editor, const TemplateContext& context);

    [[nodiscard]] std::wstring Utf8ToWide(std::string_view utf8);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string WideToUtf8(std::wstring_view wide);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string PathUtf8(const std::filesystem::path& path);   // never throws on a non-ASCII path
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp"

#include "Project/RuntimeLaunch.hpp"   // QuoteArg -- the one Win32 argv escaper

#ifdef _WIN32
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>   // MultiByteToWideChar / WideCharToMultiByte
#endif

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    namespace
    {
        std::wstring Native(const std::filesystem::path& p)
        {
            std::filesystem::path copy = p;
            copy.make_preferred();
            return copy.wstring();
        }
    }

    std::wstring Utf8ToWide(std::string_view utf8)
    {
#ifdef _WIN32
        if (utf8.empty())
            return {};
        const int n = ::MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, utf8.data(), static_cast<int>(utf8.size()), nullptr, 0);
        if (n <= 0)
            return {};
        std::wstring out(static_cast<std::size_t>(n), L'\0');
        ::MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, utf8.data(), static_cast<int>(utf8.size()), out.data(), n);
        return out;
#else
        return std::filesystem::path(std::u8string(utf8.begin(), utf8.end())).wstring();
#endif
    }

    std::string WideToUtf8(std::wstring_view wide)
    {
#ifdef _WIN32
        if (wide.empty())
            return {};
        const int n = ::WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, wide.data(), static_cast<int>(wide.size()), nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
        if (n <= 0)
            return {};
        std::string out(static_cast<std::size_t>(n), '\0');
        ::WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, wide.data(), static_cast<int>(wide.size()), out.data(), n, nullptr, nullptr);
        return out;
#else
        const std::u8string u8 = std::filesystem::path(std::wstring(wide)).u8string();
        return std::string(u8.begin(), u8.end());
#endif
    }

    std::string PathUtf8(const std::filesystem::path& path)
    {
        return WideToUtf8(path.wstring());
    }

    std::vector<std::wstring> SplitCommandLine(std::wstring_view s)
    {
        std::vector<std::wstring> out;
        std::wstring cur;
        bool inArg = false;      // a token has started (a bare "" is an empty argument)
        bool inQuotes = false;
        std::size_t i = 0;
        while (i < s.size())
        {
            const wchar_t c = s[i];
            if ((c == L' ' || c == L'\t') && !inQuotes)
            {
                if (inArg)
                {
                    out.push_back(std::move(cur));
                    cur.clear();
                    inArg = false;
                }
                ++i;
                continue;
            }
            inArg = true;
            if (c == L'\\')
            {
                std::size_t n = 0;
                while (i < s.size() && s[i] == L'\\')
                {
                    ++n;
                    ++i;
                }
                if (i < s.size() && s[i] == L'"')
                {
                    cur.append(n / 2, L'\\');
                    if (n % 2 == 1)
                    {
                        cur.push_back(L'"');   // an escaped quote; the next turn sees what follows it
                        ++i;
                    }
                    // even: the quote is a delimiter, handled by the next turn
                }
                else
                    cur.append(n, L'\\');
                continue;
            }
            if (c == L'"')
            {
                ++i;
                if (inQuotes && i < s.size() && s[i] == L'"')
                {
                    cur.push_back(L'"');   // "" inside quotes: a literal quote, and the quoted run ends
                    ++i;
                    inQuotes = false;
                    continue;
                }
                inQuotes = !inQuotes;
                continue;
            }
            cur.push_back(c);
            ++i;
        }
        if (inArg)
            out.push_back(std::move(cur));
        return out;
    }

    ExpandedArgs ExpandTemplate(std::string_view argsTemplate, const TemplateContext& c)
    {
        ExpandedArgs out;
        for (const std::wstring& token : SplitCommandLine(Utf8ToWide(argsTemplate)))
        {
            std::wstring arg;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < token.size(); ++i)
            {
                const wchar_t ch = token[i];
                const bool doubled = i + 1 < token.size() && token[i + 1] == ch;
                if ((ch == L'{' || ch == L'}') && doubled)
                {
                    arg.push_back(ch);
                    ++i;
                    continue;
                }
                if (ch == L'}')
                {
                    out.error = "unmatched '}' in the arguments (write }} for a literal brace)";
                    return out;
                }
                if (ch != L'{')
                {
                    arg.push_back(ch);
                    continue;
                }
                const std::size_t close = token.find(L'}', i + 1);
                if (close == std::wstring::npos)
                {
                    out.error = "unclosed '{' in the arguments (write {{ for a literal brace)";
                    return out;
                }
                const std::wstring name = token.substr(i + 1, close - i - 1);
                if (name == L"file")
                    arg += Native(c.file);
                else if (name == L"line")
                    arg += std::to_wstring(c.line);
                else if (name == L"col")
                    arg += std::to_wstring(c.column);
                else if (name == L"project")
                {
                    if (c.project.empty())
                    {
                        out.error = "{project} is used but no project is open";
                        return out;
                    }
                    arg += Native(c.project);
                }
                else if (name == L"solution")
                {
                    if (c.solution.empty())
                    {
                        out.error = "{solution} is used but the project has no solution (.slnx) yet";
                        return out;
                    }
                    arg += Native(c.solution);
                }
                else
                {
                    out.error = "unknown placeholder {" + WideToUtf8(name) +
                                "} (use {file}, {line}, {col}, {project} or {solution})";
                    return out;
                }
                i = close;
            }
            out.argv.push_back(std::move(arg));
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::wstring BuildCommandLine(const std::filesystem::path& program, std::span<const std::wstring> argv)
    {
        std::wstring cmd = RuntimeLaunch::QuoteArg(Native(program));
        for (const std::wstring& a : argv)
        {
            cmd.push_back(L' ');
            cmd += RuntimeLaunch::QuoteArg(a);
        }
        return cmd;
    }

    std::string PreviewCommandLine(const CustomEditor& editor, const TemplateContext& context)
    {
        const ExpandedArgs args = ExpandTemplate(EffectiveArgs(editor), context);
        if (!args.Ok())
            return "error: " + args.error;
        return WideToUtf8(BuildCommandLine(std::filesystem::path(Utf8ToWide(editor.exe)), args.argv));
    }
}
```

### Task TE7-5: Launching a custom program -- `CreateProcessW`, PATH, error mapping (spec s5.6 "Custom program", "Rules")

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/ProgramLaunch.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/ProgramLaunch.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/process-fixture/ProcessFixtureMain.cpp:113-163` (a `--record <path>` first argument), `premake5.lua` (append to the TE7 block)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/ProgramLaunchTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE7-4 (`ExpandTemplate`, `BuildCommandLine`, `Utf8ToWide`, `WideToUtf8`, `PathUtf8`, `TemplateContext`), TE7-2 (`CustomEditor`, `EffectiveArgs`); `Arcane::Test::TempDir` (`Helpers/TestEnvironment.hpp:33`); `Arcane::Editor::ModuleBuild::ExeDir()` (how `BuildDriverTest.cpp:100-104` finds `arcbuild-process-fixture.exe`). Not `Toolchain::FindOnPath`: its `IsRunnableCandidate` asks `std::filesystem::is_regular_file` (`Toolchain.cpp:88-104`), which is false for a Store app's execution alias (finding 7.1, below).
- Produces (namespace `Arcane::Editor::Openers`):
  - `enum class LaunchError : std::uint8_t { None, NoProgram, ProgramNotFound, BatchFileRefused, TemplateError, AccessDenied, NotAProgram, NeedsElevation, Failed, Unsupported };`
  - `struct LaunchResult { LaunchError error; std::string message; std::uint32_t processId; bool Ok() const; }`
  - `LaunchError ClassifyCreateProcessError(std::uint32_t)`, `std::string DescribeLaunchError(LaunchError)`
  - `bool ProgramFileExists(const std::filesystem::path&)` (a file, App Execution Alias reparse points included; never follows the reparse point)
  - `bool IsBatchFile(const std::filesystem::path&)` (`.bat` / `.cmd`, any case, after stripping trailing dots and spaces)
  - `std::uint32_t LaunchCreationFlags(bool breakaway) noexcept`, `bool RetryWithoutBreakaway(std::uint32_t win32Error) noexcept`
  - `std::filesystem::path ResolveProgram(std::string_view exe, std::string_view searchPath)`, `std::filesystem::path ResolveProgram(std::string_view exe)` (the process `PATH`), `std::string ProcessPathVariable()`
  - `LaunchResult LaunchCustomEditor(const CustomEditor&, const TemplateContext&)`
- The fixture gains `--record <path>` (argv[1] only): its `ARG:`/`CWD:` lines go to `<path>` instead of stdout, for a detached child whose stdout nobody reads.

Launch rules:
- **Detached, in its own console.** The launch is `CreateProcessW` with `CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE`. A console program such as `nvim.exe` or `wt.exe` must never share or hijack the editor's console. The flag has no effect on GUI programs.
- **Outlives the editor (finding 7.6).** The first attempt adds `CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB`, so a program launched from an editor that runs inside a kill-on-close job (a launcher's, a debugger's, a CI harness's) is not killed when the editor exits. Windows ignores the flag when the editor is in no job. When the editor's job forbids breakaway (no `JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_BREAKAWAY_OK`), `CreateProcessW` fails with `ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED` (5); the launch then retries once without the flag -- the program still opens, and lives as long as that job allows.
- **Working directory.** The project root when one is open, else the program's own folder.
- **Batch files are refused** (`.bat`/`.cmd`). Windows runs them through `cmd.exe`, which re-parses the arguments by different rules, so a `{file}` could no longer be quoted safely (the BatBadBut class of bugs). The message tells the user to point the entry at the program's `.exe`. Win32 path normalisation drops trailing dots and spaces, so `x.cmd.` and `x.cmd ` name `x.cmd`: `IsBatchFile` strips them before comparing (plan rev 2 D-R6). A path naming an alternate data stream (a `:` after the drive, `x.exe:stream`) is refused as not found.
- **Exe lookup.** A bare name is looked up on `PATH` with `.EXE` only, by this file's own walk. Existence is `ProgramFileExists`: `GetFileAttributesW`, which does not follow a reparse point (finding 7.1). A Store app's execution alias (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\WindowsApps\wt.exe`, an `IO_REPARSE_TAG_APPEXECLINK` reparse point) is a file there, while `std::filesystem::is_regular_file` -- which follows the reparse point and cannot open an AppExecLink -- answers false. `CreateProcessW` launches an alias directly. A path with a directory but not absolute is refused rather than resolved against an unknown current directory.

```cpp
// TE7-5: launching a custom program opener (text editor spec s5.6). The pure
// halves, plus one [witness] that really CreateProcessW's the
// arcbuild-process-fixture exe and reads back the argv it received.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Helpers/TestEnvironment.hpp"
#include "Project/ModuleBuild.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/ProgramLaunch.hpp"

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cwchar>
#include <cwctype>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#ifdef _WIN32
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>   // GetFileAttributesW: find a real execution alias for the 7.1 case

namespace fs = std::filesystem;
using namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers;

namespace
{
    fs::path FixtureExe()
    {
        return (Arcane::Editor::ModuleBuild::ExeDir() / ".." / "arcbuild-process-fixture" / "arcbuild-process-fixture.exe")
            .lexically_normal();
    }

    // The fixture writes its lines with an fflush each; CWD: is last.
    std::vector<std::string> WaitForRecord(const fs::path& record)
    {
        const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(10);
        while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline)
        {
            std::vector<std::string> lines;
            std::ifstream in(record, std::ios::binary);
            for (std::string line; std::getline(in, line);)
                lines.push_back(line);
            if (!lines.empty() && lines.back().starts_with("CWD:"))
                return lines;
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(20));
        }
        return {};
    }
}

TEST_CASE("ResolveProgram: absolute paths, bare names on the given PATH, nothing else", "[text-openers]")
{
    Arcane::Test::TempDir dir("openers_resolve");
    { std::ofstream(dir.path / "tool.exe") << "MZ"; }
    { std::ofstream(dir.path / "script.cmd") << "@echo off"; }
    const std::string search = PathUtf8(dir.path);
    const fs::path tool = dir.path / "tool.exe";
    // equivalent(), not ==: ResolveProgram appends the spelling ".EXE", and
    // NTFS names are case-insensitive while path::operator== is not.
    const fs::path bare = ResolveProgram("tool", search);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(bare.empty());
    CHECK(fs::equivalent(bare, tool));
    const fs::path named = ResolveProgram("tool.exe", search);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(named.empty());
    CHECK(fs::equivalent(named, tool));
    const fs::path absolute = ResolveProgram(PathUtf8(tool), "");
    REQUIRE_FALSE(absolute.empty());
    CHECK(fs::equivalent(absolute, tool));
    CHECK(ResolveProgram("missing", search).empty());
    CHECK(ResolveProgram("sub\\tool.exe", search).empty());   // relative with a folder: refused
    CHECK(ResolveProgram("", search).empty());
    CHECK(ResolveProgram(PathUtf8(tool) + ":stream", "").empty());   // an alternate data stream: refused
    CHECK(ProgramFileExists(tool));
    CHECK_FALSE(ProgramFileExists(dir.path));                        // a folder is not a program
    CHECK_FALSE(ProgramFileExists(dir.path / "missing.exe"));
}

#ifdef _WIN32
TEST_CASE("ProgramFileExists and ResolveProgram see a Store app's execution alias (7.1)", "[text-openers]")
{
    // A real alias on this machine: the first *.exe under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\WindowsApps
    // whose attributes carry FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT (wt.exe, winget.exe, python.exe, ...).
    const char* local = std::getenv("LOCALAPPDATA");
    if (!local || !*local)
        SKIP("LOCALAPPDATA is not set");
    const fs::path apps = fs::path(Utf8ToWide(local)) / L"Microsoft" / L"WindowsApps";
    fs::path alias;
    std::error_code ec;
    for (fs::directory_iterator it(apps, ec), end; !ec && it != end; it.increment(ec))
    {
        std::wstring ext = it->path().extension().wstring();
        for (wchar_t& c : ext)
            c = static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(static_cast<wint_t>(c)));
        const DWORD attrs = ::GetFileAttributesW(it->path().c_str());
        if (ext == L".exe" && attrs != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES && (attrs & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT) != 0)
        {
            alias = it->path();
            break;
        }
    }
    if (alias.empty())
        SKIP("no App Execution Alias under " << PathUtf8(apps) << " on this machine");
    INFO(PathUtf8(alias) << "  (std::filesystem::is_regular_file says " << fs::is_regular_file(alias, ec) << ")");
    CHECK(ProgramFileExists(alias));
    CHECK(ResolveProgram(PathUtf8(alias), "") == alias.lexically_normal());
    const fs::path bare = ResolveProgram(PathUtf8(alias.stem()), PathUtf8(apps));
    REQUIRE_FALSE(bare.empty());
    CHECK(_wcsicmp(bare.filename().c_str(), alias.filename().c_str()) == 0);
}
#endif

    LaunchResult r = LaunchCustomEditor(CustomEditor{ "b", "B", PathUtf8(dir.path / "x.cmd"), "" }, c);
    CHECK(r.error == LaunchError::BatchFileRefused);
    CHECK(r.message.find("cmd.exe") != std::string::npos);

    // D-R6: Win32 drops the trailing dot (and space), so these run x.cmd -- refused the same way.
    r = LaunchCustomEditor(CustomEditor{ "b2", "B2", PathUtf8(dir.path / "x.cmd") + ".", "" }, c);
    CHECK(r.error == LaunchError::BatchFileRefused);
    r = LaunchCustomEditor(CustomEditor{ "b3", "B3", PathUtf8(dir.path / "x.cmd") + ". .", "" }, c);
    CHECK(r.error == LaunchError::BatchFileRefused);

    r = LaunchCustomEditor(CustomEditor{ "m", "M", PathUtf8(dir.path / "missing.exe"), "" }, c);
    CHECK(r.error == LaunchError::ProgramNotFound);
    CHECK(r.message == "'" + PathUtf8(dir.path / "missing.exe") + "' was not found (not an existing file, and not on PATH)");

    r = LaunchCustomEditor(CustomEditor{ "t", "T", PathUtf8(FixtureExe()), "{nope}" }, c);
    CHECK(r.error == LaunchError::TemplateError);

    r = LaunchCustomEditor(CustomEditor{ "e", "E", "   ", "" }, c);
    CHECK(r.error == LaunchError::NoProgram);
}
```
