The five backends:

| Opener | Backend |
|---|---|
| Arcane Text Editor | `EditorApp::OpenAsText(path)` (TE6-12: focuses the canonical tab or opens one; a dedicated-editor asset opens locked), then `DocumentHost::Focus`, then `TextDocument::GoTo(ToBufferPoint(...))` when there is a position. It never goes through `DocumentHost::OpenPath`, whose extension factories would open a material's dedicated editor instead. |
| Dedicated | `DocumentHost::OpenPath(path)` |
| Visual Studio | `EditorApp::OpenInIde(path, line, column)`: solution discovery or generation, the Console line, then `IdeLaunch::OpenFileAt`. The backend first turns the character column into Visual Studio's UTF-16 column (`VisualStudioColumn`: the file's line from disk, UTF-8 with or without a BOM; a character outside the BMP counts two; a UTF-16 file or an unreadable one keeps the column as given) -- finding 7.5 |
| System default | `OsShell::ShellOpen(path)`. An extension with no association fails here with "No program is associated with this file type" and gets the Problems row; it does not fall back to the Open With picker, which `OsShell::OpenAsText` would. |
| Custom | `LaunchCustomEditor(editor, {file, line, col, project root, DiscoverSolution(root)})` |

**The crash viewer's `[file:line]` link** (`OpenSourceAtLine`) now asks `FileOpener` too: a `.cpp` reaches Visual Studio by the default opener. Its old silent `ShellOpen` fallback on NoDevenv/NoSolution/DetectionFailed is replaced by the spec's rule: the Problems row plus the offer.

**TE2's interim C++ exclusion is removed** (CANON B5, C TE7 #3). TE2 never built a C++ route; its fallback claims predicate kept `!IsCppSourcePath(p)` only until this task. The skeleton's "never opens .cpp" constraint is superseded by D15. A `.cpp` reaching the text routes, which only `FileOpener`'s Arcane backend or a FileOpener-resolved dedicated open can do, opens a `TextDocument`. TE2-20's `[text-doc]` case that pinned the refusal inverts; nothing else of TE2's is deleted.

**"Has a dedicated editor" is not `HasFactory`.** After TE2-20, `DocumentHost::HasFactory` is true for every text file: the explicit text extensions have the text factory, and the fallback claims everything else that is not a known binary format (and, once the exclusion goes, C/C++). Read as `FileFacts::hasDedicatedEditor`, it would put every text file in the `asset` group, so `source=visualStudio` and `text=...` would never apply and a `.cpp` would open as text by default. The wiring asks TE2-19's `HasDedicatedFactory` instead, and the test below pins it over the real routes.

```cpp
{
    Arcane::Test::TempDir dir("openers_wiring");
    const fs::path cpp = dir.path / "Game.cpp";
    { std::ofstream(cpp, std::ios::binary) << "int main()\n{\n    return 0;\n}\n"; }
    DocumentHost host;
    OpenerHost oh;
    oh.documents = &host;
    oh.openAsText = [&host](const fs::path& p) -> EditorDocument* {
        std::string error;
        std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> doc = TextDocument::Open(p, {}, error);
        INFO(error);
        return doc ? host.Add(std::move(doc)) : nullptr;
    };
    oh.openInIde = [](const fs::path&, int, int) { return IdeLaunch::Outcome::NoDevenv; };
    const FileOpenerBackends b = MakeFileOpenerBackends(std::move(oh));

    CHECK_FALSE(b.isOpenInTextDocument(cpp));
    CHECK_FALSE(b.hasDedicatedEditor(cpp));
    CHECK(b.isText(cpp));                                    // TE2's sniff: no NUL in the first 8 KB
    const OpenOutcome vs = b.openVisualStudio(cpp, FilePosition{ 3, 5 });
    CHECK_FALSE(vs.ok);
    const OpenOutcome text = b.openArcaneText(cpp, FilePosition{ 3, 5 });
    REQUIRE(text.ok);
    auto* doc = dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(text.document);
    REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
    CHECK(fs::equivalent(doc->CanonicalPath(), cpp));
    CHECK(b.isOpenInTextDocument(cpp));
    // Any spelling of the path finds the open tab (the host's key is CanonicalFilePath).
    std::wstring upper = cpp.wstring();
    for (wchar_t& c : upper)
        c = static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towupper(c));
    CHECK(b.isOpenInTextDocument(fs::path(upper)));
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// FileOpener's five backends over the editor's real machinery (text editor
// spec s5.6). The app fills an OpenerHost with its own entry points
// (EditorAppOpeners.cpp); tests fill it with a bare DocumentHost and fakes.
// With EditorAppOpeners.cpp, this is the only code that reaches
// DocumentHost::OpenPath, IdeLaunch file opens or OsShell::ShellOpen for an
// OPEN (OpenersGuardTest).

#include "Project/IdeLaunch.hpp"
#include "Project/OsShell.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/FileOpener.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/ProgramLaunch.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Editor { class DocumentHost; class EditorDocument; }

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    struct OpenerHost
    {
        DocumentHost* documents = nullptr;
        // Focus the file's text tab or open one (EditorApp::OpenAsText, TE6-12).
        std::function<EditorDocument*(const std::filesystem::path&)> openAsText;
        // EditorApp::OpenInIde(file, line, column): solution discovery + IdeLaunch::OpenFileAt.
        std::function<IdeLaunch::Outcome(const std::filesystem::path&, int, int)> openInIde;
        std::function<OsShell::ShellResult(const std::filesystem::path&)> shellOpen;            // default: OsShell::ShellOpen
        std::function<LaunchResult(const CustomEditor&, const TemplateContext&)> launch;        // default: LaunchCustomEditor
        std::function<std::filesystem::path()> projectRoot;                                    // {project}; empty = none
        std::function<std::filesystem::path()> solution;                                       // {solution}; empty = none
        std::function<bool(const std::filesystem::path&)> isText;                              // default: SniffsAsText
    };

    [[nodiscard]] FileOpenerBackends MakeFileOpenerBackends(OpenerHost host);

    [[nodiscard]] OpenOutcome OutcomeFromIde(IdeLaunch::Outcome outcome);       // Activated/OpenedInInstance/Launched = ok
    [[nodiscard]] OpenOutcome OutcomeFromShell(OsShell::ShellResult result);    // Ok = ok; else OsShell::Describe
    [[nodiscard]] OpenOutcome OutcomeFromLaunch(const LaunchResult& result);    // Ok = ok; else its message

    // 1-based line / character column -> 0-based row / byte column, clamped
    // to the buffer (row) and the line (column).
    [[nodiscard]] Arcane::Text::Point ToBufferPoint(const Arcane::Text::Rope& text, FilePosition at);

    // Visual Studio's TextSelection.MoveToLineAndOffset counts UTF-16 code
    // units (finding 7.5). A 1-based character column on `lineUtf8` -> the
    // 1-based UTF-16 column: a character outside the BMP counts two, an
    // invalid byte one (VS shows U+FFFD), columns past the end one each.
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t Utf16Column(std::string_view lineUtf8, std::uint32_t column);
    // The same on the file's line `at.line` as it is on disk (UTF-8, a BOM
    // skipped, CR stripped). A UTF-16 file (FF FE / FE FF) or an unreadable
    // one keeps `at.column`.
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t VisualStudioColumn(const std::filesystem::path& file, FilePosition at);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/FileOpenerWiring.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Project/Openers/FileOpenerWiring.hpp"

#include "Documents/DocumentHost.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp"                  // Utf8::DecodeAt (TE1-1)
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"      // TextDocument, GoTo (TE2-15/19)
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextFileIO.hpp"        // CanonicalFilePath (TE2-5): the host's key
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSniff.hpp"         // SniffsAsText (TE2-15)

#include <algorithm>
#include <fstream>
#include <memory>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    OpenOutcome OutcomeFromIde(IdeLaunch::Outcome outcome)
    {
        switch (outcome)
        {
            case IdeLaunch::Outcome::Activated:
            case IdeLaunch::Outcome::OpenedInInstance:
            case IdeLaunch::Outcome::Launched:
                return OpenOutcome{ true, {}, nullptr };
            default:
                return OpenOutcome{ false, IdeLaunch::Describe(outcome), nullptr };
        }
    }

    OpenOutcome OutcomeFromShell(OsShell::ShellResult result)
    {
        if (result == OsShell::ShellResult::Ok)
            return OpenOutcome{ true, {}, nullptr };
        return OpenOutcome{ false, std::string(OsShell::Describe(result)), nullptr };
    }

    OpenOutcome OutcomeFromLaunch(const LaunchResult& result)
    {
        if (result.Ok())
            return OpenOutcome{ true, {}, nullptr };
        return OpenOutcome{ false, result.message, nullptr };
    }

    Arcane::Text::Point ToBufferPoint(const Arcane::Text::Rope& text, FilePosition at)
    {
        const std::uint32_t rows = text.LineCount();
        const std::uint32_t wanted = at.line == 0 ? 0u : at.line - 1;
        const std::uint32_t row = std::min(wanted, rows == 0 ? 0u : rows - 1);
        std::string line;
        text.CopyTo(Arcane::Text::ByteRange{ text.LineStart(row), text.LineEnd(row) }, line);
        std::size_t byte = 0;
        for (std::uint32_t c = 1; c < at.column && byte < line.size(); ++c)
            byte += std::max<std::size_t>(1, Arcane::Text::Utf8::DecodeAt(line, byte).length);
        return Arcane::Text::Point{ row, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::min(byte, line.size())) };
    }

    std::uint32_t Utf16Column(std::string_view line, std::uint32_t column)
    {
        if (column <= 1)
            return 1;
        std::uint32_t units = 0;
        std::uint32_t c = 1;
        std::size_t byte = 0;
        for (; c < column && byte < line.size(); ++c)
        {
            const Arcane::Text::Utf8::Unit u = Arcane::Text::Utf8::DecodeAt(line, byte);
            units += (u.valid && u.cp >= 0x10000) ? 2u : 1u;   // a surrogate pair in VS's UTF-16 buffer
            byte += std::max<std::size_t>(1, u.length);
        }
        units += column - c;   // columns past the line's end
        return units + 1;
    }

    std::uint32_t VisualStudioColumn(const std::filesystem::path& file, FilePosition at)
    {
        std::ifstream in(file, std::ios::binary);
        if (!in)
            return at.column;
        std::string line;
        for (std::uint32_t row = 1; row <= at.line; ++row)
            if (!std::getline(in, line))
                return at.column;   // no such line: VS clamps it itself
        if (at.line == 1)
        {
            if (line.size() >= 2 && ((line[0] == '\xFF' && line[1] == '\xFE') || (line[0] == '\xFE' && line[1] == '\xFF')))
                return at.column;   // UTF-16: not decoded here
            if (line.starts_with("\xEF\xBB\xBF"))
                line.erase(0, 3);
        }
        if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r')
            line.pop_back();
        return Utf16Column(line, at.column);
    }

    FileOpenerBackends MakeFileOpenerBackends(OpenerHost host)
    {
        const auto h = std::make_shared<OpenerHost>(std::move(host));
        FileOpenerBackends b;
        b.isOpenInTextDocument = [h](const std::filesystem::path& p) {
            if (!h->documents)
                return false;
            // The host keys text documents by CanonicalFilePath (TE2-19/20), so
            // any spelling of an open file finds its tab.
            const std::optional<std::filesystem::path> key = CanonicalFilePath(p);
            return dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(h->documents->FindByCanonicalPath(key ? *key : p)) != nullptr;
        };
        // A DEDICATED editor only: HasFactory is also true for every text file
        // (the text routes), which would put them all in the asset group.
        b.hasDedicatedEditor = [h](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return h->documents && h->documents->HasDedicatedFactory(p); };
        b.isText = [h](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return h->isText ? h->isText(p) : SniffsAsText(p); };
        b.openArcaneText = [h](const std::filesystem::path& p, std::optional<FilePosition> at) -> OpenOutcome {
            EditorDocument* doc = h->openAsText ? h->openAsText(p) : nullptr;
            if (!doc)
                return OpenOutcome{ false, "the Arcane Text Editor could not open it (see the Console)", nullptr };
            if (h->documents)
                h->documents->Focus(doc);
            if (at)
                if (auto* t = dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(doc))
                    t->GoTo(ToBufferPoint(t->Buffer().Text(), *at));
            return OpenOutcome{ true, {}, doc };
        };
        b.openDedicated = [h](const std::filesystem::path& p) -> OpenOutcome {
            EditorDocument* doc = h->documents ? h->documents->OpenPath(p) : nullptr;
            if (!doc)
                return OpenOutcome{ false, "its Arcane editor could not open it (see the Console)", nullptr };
            return OpenOutcome{ true, {}, doc };
        };
        b.openVisualStudio = [h](const std::filesystem::path& p, std::optional<FilePosition> at) -> OpenOutcome {
            if (!h->openInIde)
                return OpenOutcome{ false, "this host has no Visual Studio opener", nullptr };
            // Visual Studio counts UTF-16 units; FilePosition counts characters (7.5).
            return OutcomeFromIde(h->openInIde(p, at ? static_cast<int>(at->line) : 0,
                                               at ? static_cast<int>(VisualStudioColumn(p, *at)) : 0));
        };
        b.openSystemDefault = [h](const std::filesystem::path& p) {
            return OutcomeFromShell(h->shellOpen ? h->shellOpen(p) : OsShell::ShellOpen(p));
        };
        b.openCustom = [h](const CustomEditor& e, const std::filesystem::path& p, std::optional<FilePosition> at) {
            TemplateContext c;
            c.file = p;
            c.line = at ? at->line : 1;
            c.column = at ? at->column : 1;
            c.project = h->projectRoot ? h->projectRoot() : std::filesystem::path{};
            c.solution = h->solution ? h->solution() : std::filesystem::path{};
            return OutcomeFromLaunch(h->launch ? h->launch(e, c) : LaunchCustomEditor(e, c));
        };
        return b;
    }
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// "Open in Arcane Text Editor instead" (text editor spec s5.6 "Rules"): a
// small non-modal popup raised once per offer FileOpener arms (an external
// opener failed on a text file). The Problems row stays either way; this is
// the one-click way out. Drawn by the app every frame, outside any window.

#include <cstdint>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    class FileOpener;

    inline constexpr const char* kOpenFailurePromptId = "Could not open file##files_open_failed";

    struct OpenFailurePromptState
    {
        std::uint64_t shownSerial = 0;   // the FileOpener::OfferSerial last raised
    };

    void DrawOpenFailurePrompt(FileOpener& files, OpenFailurePromptState& state);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/OpenFailurePrompt.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Project/Openers/OpenFailurePrompt.hpp"

#include "Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp"   // PathUtf8
#include "Project/Openers/FileOpener.hpp"

#include <imgui.h>

#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    void DrawOpenFailurePrompt(FileOpener& files, OpenFailurePromptState& state)
    {
        if (files.PendingOffer() && files.OfferSerial() != state.shownSerial)
        {
            state.shownSerial = files.OfferSerial();
            ImGui::OpenPopup(kOpenFailurePromptId);
        }
        if (!ImGui::BeginPopup(kOpenFailurePromptId))
            return;
        const std::optional<OpenFailure>& offer = files.PendingOffer();
        if (!offer)
        {
            ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
            ImGui::EndPopup();
            return;
        }
        const std::string headline = "Could not open " + PathUtf8(offer->path.filename()) + " with " + offer->openerName + ".";
        ImGui::TextUnformatted(headline.c_str());
        ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", offer->error.c_str());
        ImGui::Separator();
        if (ImGui::Button("Open in Arcane Text Editor instead"))
        {
            (void)files.AcceptOffer();
            ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
        }
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (ImGui::Button("Dismiss"))
        {
            files.DismissOffer();
            ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
        }
        ImGui::EndPopup();
    }
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/App/EditorAppOpeners.cpp` (new; `src/**.cpp` puts it in the ArcaneEditor project):

```cpp
// Who opens what (text editor spec s5.6, D15) -- EditorApp's half of
// FileOpener: the backends over live app state (InstallFileOpener), Visual
// Studio (OpenInIde, moved here from EditorAppProject.cpp) and the crash
// viewer's [file:line] link. With FileOpenerWiring.cpp this is the only file
// that reaches IdeLaunch / OsShell::ShellOpen / EditorApp::OpenAsText for an
// OPEN; OpenersGuardTest enforces it.

#include "App/EditorApp.hpp"

#include "Project/IdeLaunch.hpp"
#include "Project/OsShell.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/FileOpenerWiring.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/ProgramLaunch.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Base/Log.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Build/Toolchain.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Project/Project.hpp>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    void EditorApp::InstallFileOpener()
    {
        Openers::OpenerHost host;
        host.documents   = &m_documents;
        host.openAsText  = [this](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return OpenAsText(p); };   // TE6-12: the tab, or a new one (locked for dedicated-editor assets)
        host.openInIde   = [this](const std::filesystem::path& p, int line, int column) { return OpenInIde(p, line, column); };
        host.shellOpen   = [](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return OsShell::ShellOpen(p); };
        host.launch      = [](const Openers::CustomEditor& e, const Openers::TemplateContext& c) { return Openers::LaunchCustomEditor(e, c); };
        host.projectRoot = [this] {
            const Arcane::Project* p = m_runtime ? m_runtime->CurrentProject() : nullptr;
            return p ? p->Root() : std::filesystem::path{};
        };
        host.solution = [this] {
            const Arcane::Project* p = m_runtime ? m_runtime->CurrentProject() : nullptr;
            return p ? Arcane::Toolchain::DiscoverSolution(p->Root()) : std::filesystem::path{};
        };
        m_files = std::make_unique<Openers::FileOpener>(Openers::MakeFileOpenerBackends(std::move(host)));
    }

    Openers::FileOpener& EditorApp::Files()
    {
        return *m_files;
    }

    // ---- moved verbatim from EditorAppProject.cpp:2967-3013, plus the column ----
    IdeLaunch::Outcome EditorApp::OpenInIde(const std::filesystem::path& file, int line, int column)
    {
        const Arcane::Project* proj = m_runtime->CurrentProject();
        if (!proj)
        {
            ARC_ERROR("IDE: no open project -- nothing to open");
            return IdeLaunch::Outcome::NoSolution;
        }
        RefreshDevenv();

        // The solution to hand devenv, or to find in a running instance. A
        // project that has never been generated has none yet: run premake
        // alone (RegenerateSolution) and look again.
        std::filesystem::path solution = Arcane::Toolchain::DiscoverSolution(proj->Root());
        if (solution.empty())
        {
            ARC_INFO("IDE: no solution in {} yet -- generating (arcbuild generate)", proj->Root().generic_string());
            RegenerateSolution();
            solution = Arcane::Toolchain::DiscoverSolution(proj->Root());
        }

        const IdeLaunch::Outcome outcome = file.empty()
            ? IdeLaunch::OpenSolution(m_devenv.Path(), solution)
            : IdeLaunch::OpenFileAt(m_devenv.Path(), solution, file, line, column);

        // One Console line per click, its severity by whether the click did
        // what it asked: the three "it worked" outcomes are info, the
        // transient one (Blocked) a warning, everything else an error.
        const std::string what = file.empty()
            ? solution.filename().string()
            : file.filename().string() + (line > 0 ? ":" + std::to_string(line) : std::string())
                                       + (line > 0 && column > 0 ? ":" + std::to_string(column) : std::string());
        switch (outcome)
        {
            case IdeLaunch::Outcome::Activated:
            case IdeLaunch::Outcome::OpenedInInstance:
            case IdeLaunch::Outcome::Launched:
                ARC_INFO("IDE: {} -- {}", what, IdeLaunch::Describe(outcome));
                break;
            case IdeLaunch::Outcome::Blocked:
                ARC_WARN("IDE: {} -- {}", what, IdeLaunch::Describe(outcome));
                break;
            default:
                ARC_ERROR("IDE: {} -- {}", what, IdeLaunch::Describe(outcome));
                break;
        }
        return outcome;
    }

    void EditorApp::OpenSourceAtLine(const std::filesystem::path& file, int line)
    {
        // The crash viewer's [file:line] link (node-page phase s8.1): the
        // file's opener decides -- a .cpp reaches Visual Studio by default. A
        // failure is the files:open Problems row + the offer (spec s5.6),
        // never the old silent shell fallback.
        (void)m_files->Open(file, Openers::PositionFrom(line, 0));
    }
}
```

The guard scans `ArcaneEditor/src` (`.cpp`, `.hpp`, `.h`). It is widened per finding 7.8, and it is the **secondary** check: TE7-11 makes the bypass entry points private, so the compiler is the first one (D-R6).
- **Whole files, not lines.** Each file is reduced to code -- comments removed, the contents of string and character literals blanked (raw strings `R"d(...)d"` included), newlines kept -- and every rule runs over the whole reduced text. A call split over lines (`m_documents\n    .OpenPath(p)`, `OpenInIde(\n    file)`) matches, and a token inside a string or an `#include "..."` never does.
- **Tokens, not just calls.** Where the name is distinctive, the rule matches any mention, so an alias (`&EditorApp::OpenInIde`, `using IL = ...; IL::OpenFileAt`) and a wrapper (whose body must name the primitive) are caught: `OpenFile` / `OpenFileAt` / `OpenFileAtLine`, `OpenInIde`, `ShellOpen`, `ShellExecute*`, `OpenAsTextFlow`, the registry writes. `OpenAsText` matches as a call or an address (`RouteAction::OpenAsText` is an enumerator, not a bypass). The generic names keep a call form: `.OpenPath(` / `->OpenAt(` (any receiver), `TextDocument::Open`, and `docs.Add(` / `documents->Add(` / `m_documents.Add(` (DocumentHost's `Add`; `Add` itself is too common to match bare).
- **Budgets, not whole-file exemptions.** An allowed file carries the number of matches the opener's own implementation has there, derived from the code this plan writes; one more (a second `ShellOpen` slipped into `EditorAppOpeners.cpp`) fails with the hit marked "over its budget". `-1` means "the primitive's own declaration/definition file" (`OsShell.*`, `IdeLaunch.*`, `TextDocument.*`, `OpenAsText.*`, `DocumentHost.cpp`), where any number is the implementation itself.

| Rule (what it catches) | Allowed: file (budget) |
|---|---|
| `IdeLaunch file open`: `\bOpenFile(AtLine\|At)?\b` | `Project/IdeLaunch.hpp` (-1), `Project/IdeLaunch.cpp` (-1), `App/EditorAppOpeners.cpp` (1: `IdeLaunch::OpenFileAt`) |
| `OpenInIde with a file`: `\bOpenInIde\b` not followed by `({})` | `App/EditorApp.hpp` (1: the declaration), `App/EditorAppOpeners.cpp` (2: the definition and `InstallFileOpener`'s call) |
| `OS shell open`: `\bShellOpen\b` | `Project/OsShell.hpp` (-1), `Project/OsShell.cpp` (-1), `Project/Openers/FileOpenerWiring.cpp` (1), `App/EditorAppOpeners.cpp` (1) |
| `ShellExecute`: `\bShellExecute(Ex)?[AW]?\b` | `Project/OsShell.cpp` (-1) |

```cpp
    bool IdentChar(char c) { return std::isalnum(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)) != 0 || c == '_'; }

    // R"( -- or u8R" / uR" / UR" / LR" -- at `i` (the R), not the tail of an identifier.
    bool RawStringStart(const std::string& s, std::size_t i)
    {
        if (s[i] != 'R' || i + 1 >= s.size() || s[i + 1] != '"')
            return false;
        std::size_t p = i;
        if (p >= 2 && s[p - 2] == 'u' && s[p - 1] == '8')
            p -= 2;
        else if (p >= 1 && (s[p - 1] == 'u' || s[p - 1] == 'U' || s[p - 1] == 'L'))
            p -= 1;
        return p == 0 || !IdentChar(s[p - 1]);
    }

    // The file reduced to code: comments removed (a block comment leaves its
    // newlines), string / character literal contents blanked with their
    // quotes kept, raw strings collapsed to R"" plus their newlines, digit
    // separators (1'000) left alone. Line numbers survive.
    std::string CodeOnly(const std::string& s)
    {
        std::string out;
        out.reserve(s.size());
        const std::size_t n = s.size();
        std::size_t i = 0;
        while (i < n)
        {
            const char c = s[i];
            const char next = i + 1 < n ? s[i + 1] : '\0';
            if (c == '/' && next == '/')
            {
                while (i < n && s[i] != '\n')
                    ++i;
                continue;
            }
            if (c == '/' && next == '*')
            {
                out += ' ';
                for (i += 2; i < n && !(s[i] == '*' && i + 1 < n && s[i + 1] == '/'); ++i)
                    if (s[i] == '\n')
                        out += '\n';
                i = std::min(n, i + 2);
                continue;
            }
            if (RawStringStart(s, i))
            {
                const std::size_t open = s.find('(', i + 2);
                if (open != std::string::npos && open - (i + 2) <= 16)
                {
                    const std::string close = ")" + s.substr(i + 2, open - (i + 2)) + "\"";
                    const std::size_t end = s.find(close, open + 1);
                    const std::size_t stop = end == std::string::npos ? n : end + close.size();
                    out += "R\"\"";
                    for (std::size_t k = i; k < stop; ++k)
                        if (s[k] == '\n')
                            out += '\n';
                    i = stop;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            const bool digitSeparator = c == '\'' && i > 0 && std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i - 1])) &&
                                        std::isxdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(next));
            if (c == '"' || (c == '\'' && !digitSeparator))
            {
                out += c;
                for (++i; i < n && s[i] != c && s[i] != '\n'; ++i)
                    if (s[i] == '\\' && i + 1 < n)
                        ++i;
                if (i < n && s[i] == c)
                {
                    out += c;
                    ++i;
                }
                continue;
            }
            out += c;
            ++i;
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::size_t LineOf(const std::string& code, std::size_t pos)
    {
        return 1 + static_cast<std::size_t>(std::count(code.begin(), code.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(pos), '\n'));
    }

    std::string SourceLine(const std::string& src, std::size_t line)
    {
        std::istringstream in(src);
        std::string text;
        for (std::size_t k = 0; k < line && std::getline(in, text); ++k) {}
        return text;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("Openers guard: the scanner reduces C++ to code -- comments out, literals blank, lines kept", "[openers-guard]")
{
    const std::string src = "a.OpenPath(x); // b.OpenPath(y)\n"
                            "/* c.OpenPath(z)\n */ s = \"d.OpenPath(w)\";\n"
                            "q = R\"rx(e.OpenPath(v) \"quoted\")rx\"; r = '\"'; n = 1'000;\n"
                            "m_documents\n    .OpenPath(p);\n";
    const std::string code = CodeOnly(src);
    const std::regex call(R"rx((\.|->)\s*Open(Path|At)\s*\()rx");
    std::vector<std::size_t> lines;
    for (std::sregex_iterator it(code.begin(), code.end(), call), end; it != end; ++it)
        lines.push_back(LineOf(code, static_cast<std::size_t>(it->position())));
    CHECK(lines == std::vector<std::size_t>{ 1, 6 });   // the real call, and the one split over lines 5-6
    CHECK(std::count(code.begin(), code.end(), '\n') == std::count(src.begin(), src.end(), '\n'));
}

TEST_CASE("Openers guard: no editor code opens a file except through FileOpener", "[openers-guard]")
{
    const fs::path repo = Arcane::Test::FindReferenceProjectDir().parent_path();
    REQUIRE_FALSE(repo.empty());
    const fs::path root = repo / "ArcaneEditor" / "src";
    REQUIRE(fs::is_directory(root));
    std::vector<std::string> hits;
    std::size_t scanned = 0;
    for (const auto& entry : fs::recursive_directory_iterator(root))
    {
        if (!entry.is_regular_file())
            continue;
        const std::string ext = entry.path().extension().string();
        if (ext != ".cpp" && ext != ".hpp" && ext != ".h")
            continue;
        const std::string rel = fs::relative(entry.path(), repo).generic_string();
        if (std::find(kPendingTE7_11.begin(), kPendingTE7_11.end(), rel) != kPendingTE7_11.end())
            continue;
        ++scanned;
        std::ifstream in(entry.path(), std::ios::binary);
        const std::string src((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
        const std::string code = CodeOnly(src);
        for (const Rule& r : Rules())
        {
            std::vector<std::size_t> lines;
            for (std::sregex_iterator it(code.begin(), code.end(), r.pattern), end; it != end; ++it)
                lines.push_back(LineOf(code, static_cast<std::size_t>(it->position())));
            if (lines.empty())
                continue;
            const auto allow = std::find_if(r.allowed.begin(), r.allowed.end(), [&](const Allow& a) { return rel == a.file; });
            if (allow != r.allowed.end() && (allow->budget < 0 || static_cast<int>(lines.size()) <= allow->budget))
                continue;
            const std::string why = allow == r.allowed.end()
                ? std::string()
                : " -- " + std::to_string(lines.size()) + " here, over its budget of " + std::to_string(allow->budget);
            for (const std::size_t line : lines)
                hits.push_back(rel + ":" + std::to_string(line) + "  [" + r.what + why + "]  " + SourceLine(src, line));
        }
    }
    CHECK(scanned > 100);   // the walk really ran over the editor
    std::string report;
    for (const std::string& h : hits)
        report += "  " + h + "\n";
    INFO("open paths that bypass Openers::FileOpener (text editor spec s5.6):\n" << report);
    CHECK(hits.empty());
}
```

**The bypass entry points become private (plan rev 2 D-R6, finding 7.8).** A grep cannot see every alias or wrapper, so the primitives a bypass would need stop compiling outside the wiring:
- `DocumentHost::OpenPath` and both `OpenAt` overloads move to `private:`. `DocumentHost` befriends `Openers::HostOpenAccess`, a class of static forwarders. In `ArcaneEditor/src` only `FileOpenerWiring.cpp` (the dedicated backend) names it, and `[openers-guard]`'s `HostOpenAccess` rule holds it there; tests use it freely (the guard scans the editor, not the tests).
- `EditorApp::OpenAsText` moves to `private:`. `InstallFileOpener`, a member, hands it to the wiring.
- `TextDocument::Open`, `OpenAsTextFlow` and `DocumentHost::Add` stay public: TE2/TE3/TE4/TE6 tests construct documents through them by the hundred. `[openers-guard]` limits them in the editor (TE7-10's rules), as a secondary check.
- With the compiler holding `OpenPath` / `OpenAt`, the guard's DocumentHost rule narrows to DocumentHost receivers (`host`, `docs`, `documents`, `m_documents`). The generic `.OpenAt(` form would flag TE5's own `IVimHost::OpenAt` (`m_host.OpenAt(...)` in `VimState.cpp`, which opens through `FileOpener`), which lands after TE7.

Behaviour that changes on purpose (spec s5.6):
- A Problems `file:line` row opens with the file's opener **at its line and column**. A `.cpp` row goes to Visual Studio by default (as TE2-20's interim `OpenSourceAtLine` did, now through the user's choice). Text goes to the Arcane Text Editor at the line and column (TE2-20 dropped the column).
- "Open as text" on an asset (Asset Browser row menu, Assets menu, Inspector page) opens the Arcane Text Editor (TE6-12's locked tab for a dedicated-editor asset) instead of the OS editor; a Problems open-as-text row opens with the file's opener.
- `--open-path` opens with the file's opener (a `.md` in an Arcane tab; a `.cpp` in Visual Studio by default) at its line and column.
- A crash report's "Open .txt / .log / .symbolized.txt" opens in the Arcane Text Editor by default, and "Open .dmp" with the system default (binary).
- A Problems asset row, a created asset and a dedicated asset open honour the user's opener. A graph-node row asks for the dedicated editor explicitly: only it can show the node.
- The scripted focus re-request (`--open-asset` / `--open-path`, three frames) **focuses** the document the boot open produced, found by its asset id or canonical key; it never opens again (finding 7.12). An asset or file whose opener is an external program has no Arcane document, so nothing is re-requested and the program is launched once.

```cpp
    Arcane::Editor::EditorDocument* EditorApp::OpenAssetDocument(const Arcane::Guid& guid,
                                                                 std::optional<Arcane::Editor::Openers::OpenerId> opener)
    {
        if (!guid.IsValid())
            return nullptr;
        const Arcane::Project* project = m_runtime ? m_runtime->CurrentProject() : nullptr;
        if (!project)
            return nullptr;
        const auto path = project->ResolveAsset(Arcane::AssetId::FromGuid(guid));
        if (!path)
            return nullptr;
        const Arcane::Editor::Openers::OpenResult r = opener ? m_files->OpenWith(*path, *opener) : m_files->Open(*path);
        return r.document;
    }
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/HostOpenAccess.hpp` (new; header-only):

```cpp
#pragma once

// The one door to DocumentHost's private open primitives (text editor spec
// s5.6; plan rev 2 D-R6, finding 7.8). Every file open in the editor goes
// through Openers::FileOpener, so DocumentHost::OpenPath / OpenAt are private
// and this friend forwards to them. In ArcaneEditor/src only
// FileOpenerWiring.cpp (FileOpener's dedicated backend) may name it --
// [openers-guard] holds that; tests use it to drive a bare DocumentHost.

#include "Documents/DocumentHost.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Guid.hpp>

#include <filesystem>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    class HostOpenAccess
    {
    public:
        static EditorDocument* OpenPath(DocumentHost& host, const std::filesystem::path& path)
        {
            return host.OpenPath(path);
        }
        static EditorDocument* OpenAt(DocumentHost& host, const std::filesystem::path& path, const Arcane::Text::Point& at)
        {
            return host.OpenAt(path, at);
        }
        static EditorDocument* OpenAt(DocumentHost& host, const Arcane::Guid& guid, const Arcane::Text::Point& at)
        {
            return host.OpenAt(guid, at);
        }
    };
}
```

- before `namespace Arcane::Editor {` (the file's own), the forward declaration `namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers { class HostOpenAccess; }`;
- the declarations of `OpenPath` (with its comment) and of both `OpenAt` overloads (TE2-19's, with their comments) move from the public section to the top of the `private:` section, under

```cpp
        // Open primitives (text editor spec s5.6, plan rev 2 D-R6): private.
        // Every open goes through Openers::FileOpener; its wiring reaches these

```

From the worktree root:

```powershell
$rx = '\b((?:\w+\.)*host)\s*\.\s*Open(Path|At)\s*\('
Get-ChildItem ArcaneTests\src -Recurse -Include *.cpp,*.hpp |
    Where-Object { (Get-Content -Raw $_.FullName) -match $rx } |
    ForEach-Object {
        $t = Get-Content -Raw $_.FullName
        $t = [regex]::Replace($t, $rx, 'Arcane::Editor::Openers::HostOpenAccess::Open$2($1, ')
        if ($t -notmatch '#include "Documents/HostOpenAccess.hpp"') {
            $t = [regex]::Replace($t, '(#include "Documents/DocumentHost.hpp"\r?\n)', "`$1#include `"Documents/HostOpenAccess.hpp`"`n", 1)
        }
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($_.FullName, $t)
        Write-Output $_.FullName
    }
```

The menu lists, in order:
- **Arcane editor**, when the file has one;
- **Arcane Text Editor**, **Visual Studio**, **System default**;
- each custom program by name. The current default for the file is suffixed "(default)";
- **Choose...** -- an OS picker for a program, launched once;
- **Always use this for `.ext`** -- a checkbox that stays open when clicked and writes `editor.files.openWith` with the pick. With Choose... it also adds the program to `editor.files.customEditors`; an entry with the same exe is reused.

The menu only *reports* the pick. The app performs it (`ApplyOpenWithChoice`), the same "panel reports, app performs" split every panel action uses.

```cpp
        std::vector<std::string> out;
        for (const OpenWithItem& i : m.items)
            out.push_back(i.label + (i.isDefault ? " *" : ""));
        return out;
    }
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The Open With submenu body (text editor spec s5.6), shared by every file
// context menu: Asset Browser rows, the Inspector asset page, Problems rows
// and document tabs. BuildOpenWithMenu is pure (what the menu lists, which
// opener is the file's current default); DrawOpenWithItems draws it inside
// the caller's BeginMenu / BeginPopup and REPORTS the pick -- the app
// performs it (EditorApp::ApplyOpenWithChoice), like every panel action.

#include "Project/Openers/CustomEditors.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/OpenerId.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    struct OpenWithItem
    {
        OpenerId    opener;
        std::string label;
        bool        isDefault = false;   // what a plain open would use for this file
    };

    struct OpenWithMenuModel
    {
        std::string extension;             // ".cpp"; empty = no "Always use this" row
        std::vector<OpenWithItem> items;
    };

    struct OpenWithChoice
    {
        enum class Kind : std::uint8_t { None, Opener, Choose };
        Kind     kind = Kind::None;
        OpenerId opener;                   // Kind::Opener
        bool     always = false;           // "Always use this for .ext" was ticked
    };

    // `facts` are the file's real ones (FileOpener::FactsFor), so the item
    // marked "(default)" is exactly what a plain Open would pick (7.13);
    // "Arcane editor" is listed when facts.hasDedicatedEditor.
    [[nodiscard]] OpenWithMenuModel BuildOpenWithMenu(const std::filesystem::path& path, const FileFacts& facts,
                                                      std::span<const OpenWithEntry> openWith,
                                                      std::span<const CustomEditor> customs);
    // The live editor.files.* values, as FileOpener reads them (ReadFilesSettings: D-R6's trusted view).
    [[nodiscard]] OpenWithMenuModel BuildOpenWithMenu(const std::filesystem::path& path, const FileFacts& facts);

    // Inside the caller's open menu/popup. The "Always" tick lives in the
    // popup window's ImGui storage and resets after a pick.
    [[nodiscard]] OpenWithChoice DrawOpenWithItems(const OpenWithMenuModel& model);

    // Open With > Choose...: the picked program as a custom editor. An entry
    // with the same exe (any case) is reused; otherwise a new id is minted
    // from the exe's stem and the args are the quoted file.
    struct ChosenProgram
    {
        CustomEditor editor;
        bool isNew = false;
    };
    [[nodiscard]] ChosenProgram PlanChosenProgram(const std::filesystem::path& exe, std::span<const CustomEditor> existing);
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Project/Openers/OpenWithMenu.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Project/Openers/OpenWithMenu.hpp"

#include "Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp"   // PathUtf8, Utf8ToWide
#include "Settings/FileOpenerSettings.hpp"       // ReadFilesSettings

#include <imgui.h>

#include <cwctype>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    namespace
    {
        std::wstring LowerNormal(const std::filesystem::path& p)
        {
            std::wstring s = p.lexically_normal().wstring();
            for (wchar_t& c : s)
                c = static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(static_cast<wint_t>(c)));
            return s;
        }
    }

    OpenWithMenuModel BuildOpenWithMenu(const std::filesystem::path& path, const FileFacts& facts,
                                        std::span<const OpenWithEntry> openWith, std::span<const CustomEditor> customs)
    {
        OpenWithMenuModel m;
        m.extension = ExtensionOf(path);
        const std::vector<std::string> ids = CustomEditorIds(customs);
        const OpenerId current = ResolveOpener(path, facts, openWith, ids).opener;   // what Open would do (7.13)

        const auto add = [&](OpenerId id, std::string label) {
            const bool isDefault = id == current;
            m.items.push_back(OpenWithItem{ std::move(id), std::move(label), isDefault });
        };
        if (facts.hasDedicatedEditor)
            add(OpenerId::Dedicated(), std::string(OpenerDisplayName(OpenerKind::Dedicated)));
        add(OpenerId::ArcaneText(), std::string(OpenerDisplayName(OpenerKind::ArcaneText)));
        add(OpenerId::VisualStudio(), std::string(OpenerDisplayName(OpenerKind::VisualStudio)));
        add(OpenerId::SystemDefault(), std::string(OpenerDisplayName(OpenerKind::SystemDefault)));
        for (const CustomEditor& e : customs)
            add(OpenerId::Custom(e.id), e.name);
        return m;
    }

    OpenWithMenuModel BuildOpenWithMenu(const std::filesystem::path& path, const FileFacts& facts)
    {
        const FilesSettingsSnapshot s = ReadFilesSettings();   // never the raw strings (D-R6)
        return BuildOpenWithMenu(path, facts, s.openWith, s.customEditors);
    }

    OpenWithChoice DrawOpenWithItems(const OpenWithMenuModel& model)
    {
        OpenWithChoice choice;
        ImGuiStorage* storage = ImGui::GetStateStorage();
        const ImGuiID alwaysId = ImGui::GetID("##openwith_always");
        bool always = storage->GetBool(alwaysId, false);

        for (const OpenWithItem& item : model.items)
        {
            const std::string label = item.isDefault ? item.label + " (default)" : item.label;
            if (ImGui::MenuItem(label.c_str()))
            {
                choice.kind = OpenWithChoice::Kind::Opener;
                choice.opener = item.opener;
            }
        }
        ImGui::Separator();
        if (ImGui::MenuItem("Choose..."))
            choice.kind = OpenWithChoice::Kind::Choose;
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("Pick a program for this file. Tick \"Always use this\" first to keep it as a custom program.");
        if (!model.extension.empty())
        {
            ImGui::Separator();
            ImGui::PushItemFlag(ImGuiItemFlags_AutoClosePopups, false);   // ticking keeps the menu open
            const std::string alwaysLabel = "Always use this for " + model.extension;
            if (ImGui::MenuItem(alwaysLabel.c_str(), nullptr, always))
            {
                always = !always;
                storage->SetBool(alwaysId, always);
            }
            ImGui::PopItemFlag();
        }
        choice.always = always && !model.extension.empty();
        if (choice.kind != OpenWithChoice::Kind::None)
            storage->SetBool(alwaysId, false);   // the tick belongs to one pick
        return choice;
    }

    ChosenProgram PlanChosenProgram(const std::filesystem::path& exe, std::span<const CustomEditor> existing)
    {
        const std::wstring key = LowerNormal(exe);
        for (const CustomEditor& e : existing)
            if (LowerNormal(std::filesystem::path(Utf8ToWide(e.exe))) == key)
                return ChosenProgram{ e, false };
        const std::string stem = PathUtf8(exe.stem());
        CustomEditor editor{ MintCustomEditorId(stem, existing), stem, PathUtf8(exe), "\"{file}\"" };
        return ChosenProgram{ std::move(editor), true };
    }
}
```

```cpp
    void EditorApp::ApplyOpenWithChoice(const std::filesystem::path& path, std::optional<Openers::FilePosition> at,
                                        const Openers::OpenWithChoice& choice)
    {
        using Kind = Openers::OpenWithChoice::Kind;
        const std::string ext = Openers::ExtensionOf(path);
        if (choice.kind == Kind::Opener)
        {
            std::string note;
            if (choice.always && ext.size() > 1)
            {
                if (!SetOpenerFor(ext, choice.opener, &note))
                    ARC_WARN("Open With: could not save {} as the opener for {} files", Openers::FormatOpenerId(choice.opener), ext);
                else if (!note.empty())   // saved, but a stronger rung still decides (finding 7.3): say so, never look ignored
                    ARC_WARN("Open With: {} for {} files -- {}", Openers::FormatOpenerId(choice.opener), ext, note);
            }
            (void)m_files->OpenWith(path, choice.opener, at);
        }
        else if (choice.kind == Kind::Choose)
        {
            m_openWithChoose = PendingChoose{ path, at, choice.always };
            if (m_gpu)
                m_gpu->Win().ShowOpenFileDialog(&PathPickedThunk,
                    new PathDialogRequest{ &m_dialogs.openWithProgram, m_dialogs.openWithProgram.Arm() }, "Programs", "exe");
        }
    }

    void EditorApp::ConsumeOpenWithProgramPick()
    {
        const std::optional<std::string> exe = m_dialogs.openWithProgram.Take();
        if (!exe || !m_openWithChoose)
            return;
        const PendingChoose pending = *m_openWithChoose;
        m_openWithChoose.reset();
        const std::vector<Openers::CustomEditor> customs = CurrentCustomEditors();
        const Openers::ChosenProgram chosen =
            Openers::PlanChosenProgram(std::filesystem::path(Openers::Utf8ToWide(*exe)), customs);
        if (!pending.always)
        {
            (void)m_files->OpenWithProgram(chosen.editor, pending.path, pending.at);
            return;
        }
        std::vector<Openers::CustomEditor> next = customs;
        if (chosen.isNew)
            next.push_back(chosen.editor);
        const std::string ext = Openers::ExtensionOf(pending.path);
        std::string programsNote;
        std::string mapNote;
        if (!SetCustomEditors(next, &programsNote) ||
            (ext.size() > 1 && !SetOpenerFor(ext, Openers::OpenerId::Custom(chosen.editor.id), &mapNote)))
            ARC_WARN("Open With: could not save {} as the opener for {} files", chosen.editor.name, ext);
        for (const std::string* n : { &programsNote, &mapNote })
            if (!n->empty())   // finding 7.3: saved under a stronger rung -- tell the user why it does not show yet
                ARC_WARN("Open With: {} for {} files -- {}", chosen.editor.name, ext, *n);
        (void)m_files->OpenWith(pending.path, Openers::OpenerId::Custom(chosen.editor.id), pending.at);
    }
```

### Task TE7-13: Open With on every document tab (spec s5.6 "Open With ... document tab")

**Files:**
- Modify:
  - `ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/EditorDocument.hpp:34-36` (`WindowName`)
  - `ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/DocumentHost.hpp` (`SetTabMenu`, `PathOf`; the members)
  - `ArcaneEditor/src/Documents/DocumentHost.cpp`: `OpenPath` :30-61 records the path; `Add` forgets a recycled address's path; `NoteAssetMoved` :87 (TE2-19's `RefreshCanonicalKey` kept); `Close` :181-189 and `CloseAll` drop the path and the tab-menu target; `DrawAll` :203-237 gains the tab hook
  - the five documents' `WindowName` overrides: `CrashReportDocument.hpp:81`, `InputActionsDocument.hpp:32`, `MeshDocument.hpp:183`, `ShaderEditorDocument.hpp:189`, `SpriteDocument.hpp:99`
  - TE2's `TextDocument.hpp`
  - `ArcaneEditor/src/App/EditorAppOpeners.cpp` (`InstallFileOpener` installs the tab menu)
  - `ArcaneEditor/src/App/EditorApp.hpp` (`m_pendingOpenWith`)
  - `ArcaneEditor/src/App/EditorAppFrame.cpp:2617` (perform the pick after `DrawAll`)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/DocumentTabMenuTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `ImGui::FindWindowByName`, `ImGuiWindow::DockIsActive`, `DockTabIsVisible`, `DC.DockTabItemRect`, `TitleBarRect()` (`imgui_internal.h`, ImGui 1.92.9; `imgui.cpp:5182-5186` sets `DC.DockTabItemRect` for a docked window's tab); TE7-12 (`BuildOpenWithMenu`, `DrawOpenWithItems`, `ApplyOpenWithChoice`); TE7-8 `FileOpener::FactsFor`; TE7-11 `Openers::HostOpenAccess` (the tests' door to the now-private `OpenPath`); TE2 `TextDocument::CanonicalPath()`; TE2-19's `NoteAssetMoved` body (`d->NoteMoved(p); RefreshCanonicalKey(*d);`), `Add` (`IndexCanonical`) and `CloseAll` (clears `m_byCanonical`).
- Produces:
  - `virtual std::string EditorDocument::WindowName() const` (default `Title()`): the exact name passed to `ImGui::Begin`
  - `void DocumentHost::SetTabMenu(std::function<void(EditorDocument&, const std::filesystem::path&)>)`
  - `std::filesystem::path DocumentHost::PathOf(const EditorDocument&) const`: the file the document was opened from through `OpenPath`, kept across `NoteAssetMoved`; empty when unknown, e.g. a `TextDocument` added by `OpenAsTextFlow`, whose `CanonicalPath()` the app uses instead

The host keys its two new members by document address: `m_openedFrom` (the file each document was opened from) and `m_tabMenuDoc` (the document whose tab menu is up). Both are dropped wherever a document dies -- `Close` and `CloseAll` (the project switch, finding 7.10) -- and `Add` forgets any entry for the address it is handed, so a new document that reuses a freed address never inherits the old one's file (Open With would act on the wrong file).

Every document draws its own `ImGui::Begin`, so the host cannot put a context menu between Begin and the content. After each document's `Draw`, `DocumentHost::DrawAll` finds the document's window by `WindowName()` and checks for a right-click on its dock tab, or its title bar while floating. It then opens one host popup whose body is the app's tab menu, an "Open With" submenu. The pick is performed after `DrawAll` returns, because a mid-draw open could add a document to the list being drawn.

```cpp
{
    // Real files: TE2's OpenPath resolves canonical paths, which needs the file to exist.
    fs::path Touch(const fs::path& p)
    {
        fs::create_directories(p.parent_path());
        std::ofstream(p) << "{}";
        return p;
    }

    class FakeDoc final : public EditorDocument
    {
    public:
        FakeDoc(std::string title, Arcane::Guid guid)
            : m_title(std::move(title)), m_guid(guid), m_label(m_title + " (Fake)###fakedoc_" + guid.ToString()) {}
        const std::string& Title() const override { return m_title; }
        Arcane::Guid AssetGuid() const override { return m_guid; }

        bool Save() override { return true; }
        void Draw(bool&) override
        {

            ImGui::End();
        }

    private:
        std::string m_title;
        Arcane::Guid m_guid;
        std::string m_label;
    };

    // A document that always lives at the SAME address (one static slot), so a
    // case can prove that a new document at a freed address inherits nothing
    // from the old one (finding 7.10). One alive at a time.
    class SlotDoc final : public EditorDocument
    {
    public:
        explicit SlotDoc(std::string title) : m_title(std::move(title)) {}
        static void* operator new(std::size_t size)
        {
            REQUIRE(size <= sizeof(s_slot));
            return s_slot;
        }
        static void operator delete(void*) noexcept {}
        const std::string& Title() const override { return m_title; }
        Arcane::Guid AssetGuid() const override { return Arcane::Guid::Nil(); }   // no asset identity: OpenPath adds it as is
        bool Dirty() const override { return false; }
        bool Save() override { return true; }
        void NoteMoved(const fs::path&) override {}
        void Draw(bool&) override
        {
            ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(100.0f, 100.0f));
            ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(300.0f, 200.0f));
            ImGui::Begin("Slot###slotdoc");

        }
        std::string WindowName() const override { return "Slot###slotdoc"; }

    private:
        std::string m_title;
        alignas(std::max_align_t) static inline unsigned char s_slot[512];
    };

            io.Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&px, &w, &h);
        }
        ~HeadlessImGui() { ImGui::DestroyContext(ctx); ImGui::SetCurrentContext(prev); }
    };

TEST_CASE("DocumentHost::PathOf remembers the opened file and follows a move", "[text-openers]")
{
    Arcane::Test::TempDir dir("openers_pathof");
    const fs::path one = Touch(dir.path / "one.fake");
    const fs::path moved = Touch(dir.path / "sub" / "one.fake");
    DocumentHost host;
    const Arcane::Guid guid = Arcane::Guid::Generate();
    host.RegisterFactory(".fake", [guid](const fs::path& p) { return std::make_unique<FakeDoc>(p.stem().string(), guid); });
    EditorDocument* doc = HostOpenAccess::OpenPath(host, one);
    REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
    CHECK(host.PathOf(*doc) == one);
    host.NoteAssetMoved(guid, moved);
    CHECK(host.PathOf(*doc) == moved);
    FakeDoc stray("stray", Arcane::Guid::Generate());
    CHECK(host.PathOf(stray).empty());
}

    // A document that reports a canonical path (TE2-19's identity) and follows a move.
    class MovableDoc final : public EditorDocument
    {
    public:
        MovableDoc(fs::path p, Arcane::Guid g) : m_path(std::move(p)), m_guid(g) {}
        const std::string& Title() const override { return m_title; }
        Arcane::Guid AssetGuid() const override { return m_guid; }
        std::filesystem::path CanonicalPath() const override { return m_path; }
        bool Dirty() const override { return false; }
        bool Save() override { return true; }
        void Draw(bool&) override {}
        void NoteMoved(const fs::path& p) override { m_path = p; }

    private:
        fs::path m_path;
        Arcane::Guid m_guid;
        std::string m_title = "movable";
    };
    Arcane::Test::TempDir dir("openers_move_identity");
    const fs::path one = Touch(dir.path / "one.mov");
    const fs::path moved = Touch(dir.path / "sub" / "one.mov");
    DocumentHost host;
    const Arcane::Guid guid = Arcane::Guid::Generate();
    EditorDocument* doc = host.Add(std::make_unique<MovableDoc>(one, guid));
    REQUIRE(host.FindByCanonicalPath(one) == doc);
    host.NoteAssetMoved(guid, moved);
    CHECK(host.FindByCanonicalPath(moved) == doc);   // re-keyed: the move's new path finds the tab
    CHECK(host.FindByCanonicalPath(one) == nullptr);
}

TEST_CASE("DocumentHost: CloseAll and Add leave no stale path or tab-menu target behind (7.10)", "[text-openers][settings-ui]")
{
    HeadlessImGui imgui;
    Arcane::Test::TempDir dir("openers_closeall");
    const fs::path one = Touch(dir.path / "one.slot");
    DocumentHost host;
    host.RegisterFactory(".slot", [](const fs::path& p) { return std::make_unique<SlotDoc>(p.stem().string()); });
    EditorDocument* first = HostOpenAccess::OpenPath(host, one);
    REQUIRE(first != nullptr);
    REQUIRE(host.PathOf(*first) == one);

    EditorDocument* seenDoc = nullptr;
    host.SetTabMenu([&](EditorDocument& d, const fs::path&) { seenDoc = &d; });
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    const auto frame = [&] {
        io.DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        host.DrawAll(0);
        ImGui::Render();
    };
    frame();
    io.AddMousePosEvent(150.0f, 105.0f);
    frame();
    io.AddMouseButtonEvent(ImGuiMouseButton_Right, true);
    frame();
    io.AddMouseButtonEvent(ImGuiMouseButton_Right, false);
    frame();
    REQUIRE(seenDoc == first);                   // the tab menu is up for it

    host.CloseAll();                             // the project switch
    seenDoc = nullptr;
    frame();
    CHECK(seenDoc == nullptr);                   // the popup does not draw for a destroyed document

    EditorDocument* second = host.Add(std::make_unique<SlotDoc>("second"));
    REQUIRE(second == first);                    // the same address (SlotDoc's one slot)
    CHECK(host.PathOf(*second).empty());         // ... and none of the old document's file
}
```

### Task TE7-14: Open With in the Asset Browser, the Inspector asset page and Problems rows (spec s5.6 "Open With")

**Files:**
- Modify:
  - `ArcaneEditor/src/Panels/AssetPanelCommon.hpp` (`AssetPanelActions` :61-150 gains `openWithAsset` + `openWith`; `AssetPanelServices` :162-202 gains `openWithFacts`)
  - `ArcaneEditor/src/Panels/AssetPanelCommon.cpp:388-391` (the row menu's Open With)
  - `ArcaneEditor/src/Panels/AssetInspectorSource.hpp:68-75` (`PageAction::contextMenu`)
  - `ArcaneEditor/src/Panels/AssetInspectorSource.cpp` (`DrawActionRow` :175-222; the Open action :390)
  - `ArcaneEditor/src/Panels/ProblemsPanel.hpp` / `.cpp` (:28-30 signature; :84-94 the row menu)
  - `ArcaneEditor/src/App/EditorAppFrame.cpp` (services :2459, `ConsumeAssetPanelActions` :3046-3140, the Problems call :2578-2583)
  - `premake5.lua` (append `Panels/ProblemsPanel.cpp` to the TE7 block: the test draws `DrawProblemsPanel`, and the ArcaneTests list does not compile it today -- its dependencies `ConsoleModel.cpp`, `DiagnosticStore.cpp`, `LocatorRoute.cpp`, `OsShell.cpp` and `EditorWidgets.cpp` already are)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/OpenWithMenusTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE7-12 (`BuildOpenWithMenu(path, facts)`, `DrawOpenWithItems`, `OpenWithChoice`, `EditorApp::ApplyOpenWithChoice`), TE7-8 (`PositionFrom`, `FileOpener::FactsFor`, `FileFacts`), `LocatorPath` (`Panels/LocatorRoute.hpp:43`). Not `RouteFacts::hasDocumentFactory` (`:22`): after TE2-20 it is `DocumentHost::HasFactory`, true for every text file, so a `.cpp` row would list "Arcane editor" and mark it "(default)" (finding 7.11). The menus ask `FactsFor`, whose dedicated-editor fact is TE2-19's `HasDedicatedFactory`.
- Produces:
  - `AssetPanelActions::openWithAsset` (`Arcane::Guid`) + `AssetPanelActions::openWith` (`Openers::OpenWithChoice`)
  - `AssetPanelServices::openWithFacts` (`std::function<Openers::FileFacts(const Arcane::Guid&)>`): the host resolves the asset and answers `FileOpener::FactsFor` (7.13); unset = `FileFacts{}`
  - `PageAction::contextMenu` (`std::function<void()>`, drawn on a right-click of a visible icon)
  - `struct ProblemsOpenWith { std::filesystem::path path; int line = 0, column = 0; Openers::OpenWithChoice choice; }`
  - `struct ProblemsOpenWithHook { std::function<Openers::FileFacts(const std::filesystem::path&)> factsFor; std::optional<ProblemsOpenWith> pick; }`
  - `Openers::OpenWithMenuModel ProblemsRowOpenWithMenu(const std::filesystem::path&, const ProblemsOpenWithHook&)` (the row menu's model: `BuildOpenWithMenu(path, factsFor(path))`, `FileFacts{ false, false, true }` when `factsFor` is unset)
  - `DrawProblemsPanel(..., bool* open = nullptr, ProblemsOpenWithHook* openWith = nullptr)`

Every menu here builds its model from the file's **real** facts -- `FileOpener::FactsFor`, through the panel's service or hook -- so the item marked "(default)" is what a plain Open would do, and "Arcane editor" appears only when a dedicated editor takes the file (findings 7.11, 7.13). `FactsFor` sniffs the file (one 8 KB read) while its submenu is open.

Placement:
- **Asset Browser / Asset Graph** row menu (`DrawAssetMenuItems`, both lenses): an "Open With" submenu right after "Open as text".
- **Inspector asset page**: a right-click on the page's **Open** icon opens a context menu with the Open With submenu. The icon row is part of the `editor-asset-page` golden (`scripts/golden-gate.ps1:372-373`). A new icon would change it, and at 1080p could push Delete into the overflow, so the menu rides on the existing button, and the golden is untouched.
- **Problems rows**: an "Open With" submenu in the row's context menu (`ProblemsPanel.cpp:84-94`), at the row's line and column.
- **Console**: its rows carry no file or locator today, so there is nothing to attach to. This is recorded as a spec gap.

```cpp
TEST_CASE("The asset row menu and the action row draw balanced with Open With", "[text-openers][settings-ui]")

    row.push_back(open);

    {
        ImGui::GetIO().DeltaTime = 1.0f / 60.0f;
        ImGui::NewFrame();
        ImGui::Begin("Host");

        drift += (g.ColorStack.Size - c0) + (g.StyleVarStack.Size - v0) + (g.ItemFlagsStack.Size - f0);
```

- Produces (namespace `Arcane::Editor`):
  - `struct OpenWithPageState { std::function<void()> requestBrowseExe; std::function<std::vector<Openers::DetectedEditor>()> detect; std::function<bool(const std::filesystem::path&)> hasDedicatedEditor; std::function<std::filesystem::path()> projectRoot, solution; std::vector<Openers::DetectedEditor> detected; bool detectRan; std::string browseFor; char newExtension[32]; }`
  - `void DrawOpenWithPage(void* user)`
  - pure halves:
    - `struct OpenWithRow { std::string key, label; Openers::OpenerId opener; bool isGroup, explicitEntry; }`, `std::vector<OpenWithRow> OpenWithRows(std::string_view openWith)`
    - `std::vector<Openers::OpenerId> OpenerChoices(bool offerDedicated, std::span<const Openers::CustomEditor>)`, `std::string OpenerLabel(const Openers::OpenerId&, std::span<const Openers::CustomEditor>)`
    - `struct FilesSettingsText { std::string openWith, customEditors; }`, `FilesSettingsText PageSettingsText(const FilesSettingsSnapshot&)` (the trusted entries and programs the page shows and edits from), `FilesSettingsText RemoveCustomEditor(const FilesSettingsText&, std::string_view id)`, `FilesSettingsText AddCustomEditor(const FilesSettingsText&, const Openers::CustomEditor&)`
    - `Openers::TemplateContext PreviewContext(const std::filesystem::path& projectRoot, const std::filesystem::path& solution)`
    - `bool ApplyBrowsedProgram(OpenWithPageState&, const std::string& exePath)`

The page, top to bottom:
1. **File types** -- one row per group, then one per extension entry. The groups are always shown: "C and C++ source", "Other text files", "Files with an Arcane editor". Each row has an opener dropdown; "Arcane editor" is offered on the asset row and on extensions an Arcane editor opens. Extension rows have Remove. An "Add file type" field and button follow.
2. **Custom programs** -- Detect installed editors lists found presets with Add (disabled when already added), and Add custom program adds a blank entry. Each entry edits name, program (with Browse...) and arguments, and shows a **live preview of the exact command line** for a sample file `<project>\Source\Example.cpp` at line 42, column 7, or the template error. Remove drops the entry and every `editor.files.openWith` entry that named it.
3. Any `editor.files.customEditors` problems, then every D-R6 refusal (a project's custom or preset opener, a program list outside machine-wide Preferences), in the warning colour.

The page reads `ReadFilesSettings()`, never the raw strings: a project's refused entries are not shown as rows, and an edit never copies them into the user's value (plan rev 2 D-R6). Every edit writes through `WriteFilesSetting`, so the row's All projects / This project switch (openWith), the machine-wide rung (customEditors), the archive and Publish all apply.

`ArcaneEditor/src/Settings/OpenWithPage.hpp`:

```cpp
#pragma once

// Preferences > Editor > Files > Open With (text editor spec s5.6
// "Choosing"): who opens each kind of file, and the user's own programs.
// The page edits editor.files.openWith / editor.files.customEditors through
// WriteFilesSetting (the row's All projects / This project switch, the
// archive, Publish); both rows are Hidden, so this page is their editor.
// The pure halves (rows, choices, list edits, the preview context) are
// [settings-ui]-tested; DrawOpenWithPage draws them.

#include "Project/Openers/CommandTemplate.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/CustomEditors.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/EditorPresets.hpp"
#include "Project/Openers/OpenerId.hpp"
#include "Settings/FileOpenerSettings.hpp"   // FilesSettingsSnapshot

#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct OpenWithPageState
    {
        std::function<void()> requestBrowseExe;                                    // EditorApp: the OS picker -> DialogInbox::openWithExe
        std::function<std::vector<Openers::DetectedEditor>()> detect;              // EditorApp: DetectInstalledEditors(WindowsInstalledAppProbe)
        std::function<bool(const std::filesystem::path&)> hasDedicatedEditor;      // EditorApp: DocumentHost::HasDedicatedFactory (TE2-19)
        std::function<std::filesystem::path()> projectRoot;                        // the preview's {project}
        std::function<std::filesystem::path()> solution;                           // the preview's {solution}
        std::vector<Openers::DetectedEditor> detected;
        bool detectRan = false;
        std::string browseFor;                 // the custom id the pending Browse... answers
        char newExtension[32] = {};
    };

    struct OpenWithRow
    {
        std::string key;              // "source" / "text" / "asset" / ".ext"
        std::string label;
        Openers::OpenerId opener;     // the entry's opener, or the group's built-in default
        bool isGroup = false;
        bool explicitEntry = false;   // the map holds this key
    };

    // The three groups (always shown), then the extension entries sorted by key.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<OpenWithRow> OpenWithRows(std::string_view openWith);
    // Arcane editor (when offered), Arcane Text Editor, Visual Studio, System default, then each custom program.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Openers::OpenerId> OpenerChoices(bool offerDedicated, std::span<const Openers::CustomEditor> customs);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string OpenerLabel(const Openers::OpenerId& id, std::span<const Openers::CustomEditor> customs);

    struct FilesSettingsText
    {
        std::string openWith;
        std::string customEditors;
    };
    // What the page shows and edits from: the TRUSTED openWith entries (a
    // project's refused custom / preset entries left out, D-R6) and the
    // machine-wide program list.
    [[nodiscard]] FilesSettingsText PageSettingsText(const FilesSettingsSnapshot& snapshot);
    // Drops the program and every openWith entry naming it.
    [[nodiscard]] FilesSettingsText RemoveCustomEditor(const FilesSettingsText& in, std::string_view id);
    // Appends `editor` unless its id is already there.
    [[nodiscard]] FilesSettingsText AddCustomEditor(const FilesSettingsText& in, const Openers::CustomEditor& editor);
    // <projectRoot or C:\Project>\Source\Example.cpp, line 42, column 7.
    [[nodiscard]] Openers::TemplateContext PreviewContext(const std::filesystem::path& projectRoot,
                                                          const std::filesystem::path& solution);
    // The Browse... answer: set the exe of the entry `state.browseFor` names. False when it is gone.
    bool ApplyBrowsedProgram(OpenWithPageState& state, const std::string& exePath);

    void DrawOpenWithPage(void* user);   // user = OpenWithPageState*
}
```

`ArcaneEditor/src/Settings/OpenWithPage.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Settings/OpenWithPage.hpp"

#include "Settings/FileOpenerSettings.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Syntax/LanguageOverrides.hpp"   // Text::NormaliseExtension (TE3-3)
#include "Widgets/EditorTheme.hpp"     // Theme::kWarning
#include "Widgets/EditorWidgets.hpp"   // InputTextString

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>

#include <imgui.h>

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        namespace O = Openers;

        struct GroupInfo
        {
            std::string_view key;
            const char* label;
            O::OpenerId builtIn;
        };

        std::vector<GroupInfo> Groups()
        {
            return {
                { O::kGroupSource, "C and C++ source (.c .cc .cpp .cxx .h .hh .hpp .hxx .inl)", O::OpenerId::VisualStudio() },
                { O::kGroupText,   "Other text files", O::OpenerId::ArcaneText() },
                { O::kGroupAsset,  "Files with an Arcane editor (materials, sprites, meshes, ...)", O::OpenerId::Dedicated() },
            };
        }

        const O::OpenWithEntry* FindKey(std::span<const O::OpenWithEntry> entries, std::string_view key)
        {
            const auto it = std::find_if(entries.begin(), entries.end(), [&](const O::OpenWithEntry& e) { return e.key == key; });
            return it == entries.end() ? nullptr : &*it;
        }
    }

    std::vector<OpenWithRow> OpenWithRows(std::string_view openWith)
    {
        const std::vector<O::OpenWithEntry> entries = O::ParseOpenWith(openWith);
        std::vector<OpenWithRow> rows;
        for (const GroupInfo& g : Groups())
        {
            const O::OpenWithEntry* e = FindKey(entries, g.key);
            rows.push_back(OpenWithRow{ std::string(g.key), g.label, e ? e->opener : g.builtIn, true, e != nullptr });
        }
        std::vector<OpenWithRow> exts;
        for (const O::OpenWithEntry& e : entries)
            if (e.key.starts_with('.'))
                exts.push_back(OpenWithRow{ e.key, e.key, e.opener, false, true });
        std::sort(exts.begin(), exts.end(), [](const OpenWithRow& a, const OpenWithRow& b) { return a.key < b.key; });
        rows.insert(rows.end(), exts.begin(), exts.end());
        return rows;
    }

    std::vector<O::OpenerId> OpenerChoices(bool offerDedicated, std::span<const O::CustomEditor> customs)
    {
        std::vector<O::OpenerId> out;
        if (offerDedicated)
            out.push_back(O::OpenerId::Dedicated());
        out.push_back(O::OpenerId::ArcaneText());
        out.push_back(O::OpenerId::VisualStudio());
        out.push_back(O::OpenerId::SystemDefault());
        for (const O::CustomEditor& e : customs)
            out.push_back(O::OpenerId::Custom(e.id));
        return out;
    }

    std::string OpenerLabel(const O::OpenerId& id, std::span<const O::CustomEditor> customs)
    {
        if (id.kind != O::OpenerKind::Custom)
            return std::string(O::OpenerDisplayName(id.kind));
        if (const O::CustomEditor* e = O::FindCustomEditor(customs, id.custom))
            return e->name;
        return "custom:" + id.custom + " (missing)";
    }

    FilesSettingsText PageSettingsText(const FilesSettingsSnapshot& snapshot)
    {
        return FilesSettingsText{ O::FormatOpenWith(snapshot.openWith), snapshot.customEditorsText };
    }

    FilesSettingsText RemoveCustomEditor(const FilesSettingsText& in, std::string_view id)
    {
        std::vector<O::CustomEditor> list = O::ParseCustomEditors(in.customEditors).editors;
        std::erase_if(list, [&](const O::CustomEditor& e) { return e.id == id; });
        std::vector<O::OpenWithEntry> map = O::ParseOpenWith(in.openWith);
        std::erase_if(map, [&](const O::OpenWithEntry& e) { return e.opener.kind == O::OpenerKind::Custom && e.opener.custom == id; });
        return FilesSettingsText{ O::FormatOpenWith(map), O::FormatCustomEditors(list) };
    }

    FilesSettingsText AddCustomEditor(const FilesSettingsText& in, const O::CustomEditor& editor)
    {
        std::vector<O::CustomEditor> list = O::ParseCustomEditors(in.customEditors).editors;
        if (!O::FindCustomEditor(list, editor.id))
            list.push_back(editor);
        return FilesSettingsText{ in.openWith, O::FormatCustomEditors(list) };
    }

    O::TemplateContext PreviewContext(const std::filesystem::path& projectRoot, const std::filesystem::path& solution)
    {
        O::TemplateContext c;
        const std::filesystem::path root = projectRoot.empty() ? std::filesystem::path(L"C:\\Project") : projectRoot;
        c.file = root / "Source" / "Example.cpp";
        c.line = 42;
        c.column = 7;
        c.project = root;
        c.solution = solution.empty() ? root / "Project.slnx" : solution;
        return c;
    }

    bool ApplyBrowsedProgram(OpenWithPageState& state, const std::string& exePath)
    {
        const std::string id = std::move(state.browseFor);
        state.browseFor.clear();
        std::vector<O::CustomEditor> list = CurrentCustomEditors();
        const auto it = std::find_if(list.begin(), list.end(), [&](const O::CustomEditor& e) { return e.id == id; });
        if (it == list.end())
            return false;
        it->exe = exePath;
        return SetCustomEditors(list);
    }

    void DrawOpenWithPage(void* user)
    {
        OpenWithPageState& st = *static_cast<OpenWithPageState*>(user);
        // The trusted view (D-R6): a project's refused entries are neither rows
        // here nor copied into an edit; the programs are the machine-wide list.
        const FilesSettingsSnapshot snap = ReadFilesSettings();
        const FilesSettingsText text = PageSettingsText(snap);
        const O::CustomEditorList customs{ snap.customEditors, snap.customEditorsProblems };

        ImGui::TextWrapped("Choose who opens each kind of file. A file already open in an Arcane text tab is always "
                           "focused there. Right-click any file for Open With to choose once. Custom programs are "
                           "yours, for every project; a project's own settings can choose only the Arcane Text "
                           "Editor, Visual Studio, the system default or an asset's editor.");

        ImGui::SeparatorText("File types");
        if (ImGui::BeginTable("##openwith_types", 3, ImGuiTableFlags_SizingStretchProp | ImGuiTableFlags_RowBg))
        {
            for (const OpenWithRow& row : OpenWithRows(text.openWith))
            {
                ImGui::TableNextRow();
                ImGui::PushID(row.key.c_str());
                ImGui::TableNextColumn();
                ImGui::TextUnformatted(row.label.c_str());
                ImGui::TableNextColumn();
                const bool offerDedicated = row.key == O::kGroupAsset ||
                    (!row.isGroup && st.hasDedicatedEditor && st.hasDedicatedEditor(std::filesystem::path(L"x" + O::Utf8ToWide(row.key))));
                ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1.0f);
                if (ImGui::BeginCombo("##opener", OpenerLabel(row.opener, customs.editors).c_str()))
                {
                    for (const O::OpenerId& id : OpenerChoices(offerDedicated, customs.editors))
                        if (ImGui::Selectable(OpenerLabel(id, customs.editors).c_str(), id == row.opener))
                            (void)WriteFilesSetting("openWith", O::SetOpenWith(text.openWith, row.key, id));
                    ImGui::EndCombo();
                }
                ImGui::TableNextColumn();
                if (!row.isGroup && ImGui::SmallButton("Remove"))
                    (void)WriteFilesSetting("openWith", O::SetOpenWith(text.openWith, row.key, std::nullopt));
                ImGui::PopID();
            }
            ImGui::EndTable();
        }
        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(ImGui::GetFontSize() * 8.0f);
        ImGui::InputTextWithHint("##newext", ".ext", st.newExtension, sizeof(st.newExtension));
        ImGui::SameLine();
        const std::string newExt = Arcane::Text::NormaliseExtension(st.newExtension);   // TE3-3's, the one normaliser
        ImGui::BeginDisabled(newExt.size() < 2);
        if (ImGui::Button("Add file type"))
        {
            (void)WriteFilesSetting("openWith", O::SetOpenWith(text.openWith, newExt, O::OpenerId::ArcaneText()));
            st.newExtension[0] = '\0';
        }
        ImGui::EndDisabled();

        ImGui::SeparatorText("Custom programs");
        if (ImGui::Button("Detect installed editors"))
        {
            st.detected = st.detect ? st.detect() : std::vector<O::DetectedEditor>{};
            st.detectRan = true;
        }
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("Looks for Visual Studio Code, Sublime Text, Notepad++, JetBrains Rider, CLion and Neovim "
                              "in Windows Terminal (App Paths, installed programs, PATH). Nothing on the system is changed.");
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (ImGui::Button("Add custom program"))
        {
            const O::CustomEditor blank{ O::MintCustomEditorId("program", customs.editors), "Program", "", "\"{file}\"" };
            (void)WriteFilesSetting("customEditors", AddCustomEditor(text, blank).customEditors);
        }
        if (st.detectRan)
        {
            if (st.detected.empty())
                ImGui::TextDisabled("No supported editors were found.");
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < st.detected.size(); ++i)
            {
                const O::DetectedEditor& d = st.detected[i];
                ImGui::PushID(static_cast<int>(i));
                const bool have = O::FindCustomEditor(customs.editors, d.editor.id) != nullptr;
                ImGui::BeginDisabled(have);
                if (ImGui::SmallButton(have ? "Added" : "Add"))
                    (void)WriteFilesSetting("customEditors", AddCustomEditor(text, d.editor).customEditors);
                ImGui::EndDisabled();
                ImGui::SameLine();
                ImGui::Text("%s  (%s)", d.editor.name.c_str(), d.foundBy.c_str());
                ImGui::SameLine();
                ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", d.editor.exe.c_str());
                ImGui::PopID();
            }
        }

        const O::TemplateContext sample = PreviewContext(st.projectRoot ? st.projectRoot() : std::filesystem::path{},
                                                         st.solution ? st.solution() : std::filesystem::path{});
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < customs.editors.size(); ++i)
        {
            O::CustomEditor e = customs.editors[i];
            ImGui::PushID(e.id.c_str());
            ImGui::Separator();
            bool changed = false;
            changed |= InputTextString("Name", &e.name);
            changed |= InputTextString("Program", &e.exe);
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::SmallButton("Browse...") && st.requestBrowseExe)
            {
                st.browseFor = e.id;
                st.requestBrowseExe();
            }
            changed |= InputTextString("Arguments", &e.args);
            ImGui::SetItemTooltip("{file} {line} {col} {project} {solution}; {{ and }} are literal braces. Empty = the quoted file.");
            const std::string preview = O::PreviewCommandLine(e, sample);
            if (preview.starts_with("error: "))
                ImGui::TextColored(Theme::kWarning, "%s", preview.c_str());
            else
                ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", preview.c_str());
            const bool remove = ImGui::SmallButton("Remove");
            ImGui::PopID();
            if (remove)
            {
                const FilesSettingsText next = RemoveCustomEditor(text, e.id);
                (void)WriteFilesSetting("openWith", next.openWith);
                (void)WriteFilesSetting("customEditors", next.customEditors);
                break;   // the list changed under the loop
            }
            if (changed)
            {
                std::vector<O::CustomEditor> list = customs.editors;
                list[i] = e;
                (void)SetCustomEditors(list);
            }
        }
        for (const std::string& p : customs.problems)
            ImGui::TextColored(Theme::kWarning, "%s", p.c_str());
        for (const std::string& r : snap.refusals)   // D-R6: what a project's config tried and was refused
            ImGui::TextColored(Theme::kWarning, "%s", r.c_str());
    }
}
```
