```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/Helpers/ChildProcess.hpp
#pragma once
// A child process that runs WHILE the test does (HostWitness::RunWitness
// waits for exit; a follow witness must interleave). No window, no pipes.
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <Windows.h>

namespace Arcane::Test
{
    class ChildProcess
    {
    public:
        ChildProcess(const std::filesystem::path& exe, const std::vector<std::string>& args)
        {
            std::wstring cmd = L"\"" + exe.wstring() + L"\"";
            for (const std::string& a : args)
                cmd += L" \"" + std::filesystem::path(a).wstring() + L"\"";
            STARTUPINFOW si{};
            si.cb = sizeof(si);
            PROCESS_INFORMATION pi{};
            if (::CreateProcessW(exe.c_str(), cmd.data(), nullptr, nullptr, FALSE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW,
                                 nullptr, nullptr, &si, &pi))
            {
                m_process = pi.hProcess;
                ::CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
            }
        }
        ~ChildProcess()
        {
            if (!m_process) return;
            if (::WaitForSingleObject(m_process, 0) == WAIT_TIMEOUT)
                ::TerminateProcess(m_process, 99);
            ::CloseHandle(m_process);
        }
        ChildProcess(const ChildProcess&) = delete;
        ChildProcess& operator=(const ChildProcess&) = delete;

        [[nodiscard]] bool Started() const noexcept { return m_process != nullptr; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool Wait(std::uint32_t ms) const { return m_process && ::WaitForSingleObject(m_process, ms) == WAIT_OBJECT_0; }
        [[nodiscard]] int ExitCode() const
        {
            DWORD code = 0;
            return m_process && ::GetExitCodeProcess(m_process, &code) ? static_cast<int>(code) : -1;
        }

    private:
        HANDLE m_process = nullptr;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/text-writer-fixture/TextWriterFixtureMain.cpp
// A log writer for the text editor's follow witness (TE6-5). Holds the file
// open for APPENDING between ops with FILE_SHARE_READ|FILE_SHARE_WRITE ("rw",
// no delete sharing: the common logger case s11.4 names) or with
// FILE_SHARE_DELETE too ("rwd"). Ops run in argv order. Dependency-free.
// The handle is FILE_APPEND_DATA | SYNCHRONIZE only: any FILE_WRITE_DATA
// (GENERIC_WRITE includes it) would write at the handle's file pointer --
// offset 0 -- and OVERWRITE the log (finding 6.8).
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <Windows.h>

#include <cstdio>
#include <cwchar>
#include <string>

namespace
{
    std::wstring g_file;
    DWORD g_share = FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE;
    HANDLE g_h = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;

    int Fail(const char* what)
    {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "text-writer-fixture: %s failed (GetLastError %lu)\n", what, ::GetLastError());
        return 3;
    }
    bool Open(DWORD disposition)
    {
        // Append-only: every WriteFile lands at the current end of file, atomically,
        // like a logger's O_APPEND. SYNCHRONIZE keeps the I/O synchronous.
        g_h = ::CreateFileW(g_file.c_str(), FILE_APPEND_DATA | SYNCHRONIZE, g_share, nullptr, disposition,
                            FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
        return g_h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    }
    // Truncation needs FILE_WRITE_DATA, which the append handle must not have: a
    // second short-lived handle truncates (our own append handle shares write, so
    // the open succeeds), and the append handle's next write lands at the new end.
    bool Truncate()
    {
        HANDLE t = ::CreateFileW(g_file.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, g_share, nullptr, TRUNCATE_EXISTING,
                                 FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
        if (t == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return false;
        ::CloseHandle(t);
        return true;
    }
    std::string Unescape(const wchar_t* w)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (const wchar_t* p = w; *p; ++p)
        {
            if (p[0] == L'\\' && p[1] == L'n') { out += '\n'; ++p; continue; }
            out += static_cast<char>(*p);   // ASCII payloads only (witness text)
        }
        return out;
    }
    bool WaitFor(const std::wstring& path)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < 3000; ++i)                // 30 s
        {
            if (::GetFileAttributesW(path.c_str()) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) return true;
            ::Sleep(10);
        }
        return false;
    }
}

int wmain(int argc, wchar_t** argv)
{
    int i = 1;
    for (; i + 1 < argc; i += 2)
    {
        const std::wstring k = argv[i];
        if (k == L"--file") g_file = argv[i + 1];
        else if (k == L"--share")
            g_share = std::wstring(argv[i + 1]) == L"rwd" ? (FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE)
                                                          : (FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE);
        else break;
    }
    if (g_file.empty()) return 2;
    if (!Open(OPEN_ALWAYS)) return Fail("CreateFileW");

    for (; i < argc; ++i)
    {
        const std::wstring op = argv[i];
        const bool hasArg = i + 1 < argc;
        if (op == L"--append" && hasArg)
        {
            const std::string s = Unescape(argv[++i]);
            DWORD n = 0;
            if (!::WriteFile(g_h, s.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(s.size()), &n, nullptr) || n != s.size()) return Fail("WriteFile");
            // No FlushFileBuffers: readers in other processes see the cache at once, and
            // a flush is not what a logger does between lines.
        }
        else if (op == L"--signal" && hasArg)
        {
            const std::wstring p = g_file + L"." + argv[++i];
            HANDLE s = ::CreateFileW(p.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
            if (s == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return Fail("signal");
            ::CloseHandle(s);
        }
        else if (op == L"--wait" && hasArg)
        {
            if (!WaitFor(g_file + L"." + argv[++i])) return 4;
        }
        else if (op == L"--rotate")
        {
            ::CloseHandle(g_h);
            const std::wstring rotated = g_file + L".1";
            if (!::MoveFileExW(g_file.c_str(), rotated.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING)) return Fail("MoveFileExW");
            if (!Open(CREATE_ALWAYS)) return Fail("CreateFileW (rotate)");
        }
        else if (op == L"--truncate")
        {
            if (!Truncate()) return Fail("truncate");
        }
        else if (op == L"--hold" && hasArg)
        {
            ::Sleep(static_cast<DWORD>(std::wcstoul(argv[++i], nullptr, 10)));
        }
        else return 2;
    }
    ::CloseHandle(g_h);
    return 0;
}
```

### Task TE6-21: `VcsProbe` -- walk up for git (+ Git LFS `lockable`), Perforce, Lore, Unity Version Control (D14, spec s5.3)

**Lane (CANON E):** TE6-21 is lane L6 -- pure, it can start any time (no producer dependency) and merges before TE6-22, which consumes it.

**Research behind each detector.** Verified 2026-10-07; the sources are in the TE6 report.

| VCS | Marker | Does it set read-only? |
|---|---|---|
| Git | `.git` **directory, or file** (`gitdir: <path>`: worktrees, submodules) | No, except Git LFS below |
| Git LFS | a `.gitattributes` line with the `lockable` attribute set (`git lfs track --lockable` writes `<pat> filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text lockable`). `$GIT_DIR/info/attributes` is also read. | **Yes.** The post-checkout/merge/commit hooks make lockable files read-only unless locked by you (`lfs.setlockablereadonly`, default true). git-lfs's own matcher collects lines where `lockable` is set and ignores `-lockable` / `!lockable` lines (git-lfs `locking/lockable.go`); the probe matches git-lfs, not strict last-line-wins gitattributes. |
| Perforce | (1) the file named by `P4CONFIG`, searched from the directory upward. `P4CONFIG` has no default; `.p4config` is checked too as the common convention. (2) When the walk finds no marker of any VCS: a configured Perforce client -- `P4CLIENT` or `P4PORT` from the environment, else `p4 set` (`HKCU\Software\Perforce\environment`), else `p4 set -s` (`HKLM\SOFTWARE\Perforce\environment`). That is how most P4V and studio setups configure Perforce, with no config file in the tree (finding 6.15). Each variable resolves in that order, as `p4` itself does. | **Yes** by default (`noallwrite`: unopened files are read-only) |
| Lore (Epic) | a `.lore` **directory** (legacy `.urc`), any ASCII case, at the working-tree root (`lore-client/src/cli/util.rs` `get_repository_path`) | **No.** Lore "informs rather than blocks" (docs/faq.md). No code sets read-only as of `6e87521`. SWFS instances keep `.lore` outside the tree and are not found by a walk-up (stated limit). |
| Unity Version Control (Plastic SCM) | a `.plastic` directory at the workspace root holding `plastic.workspace` / `plastic.selector` (Plastic SCM book p.221) | Only when the opt-in `SetFilesAsReadOnly` client setting is on, or via `readonly.conf` (book p.227) |

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/VcsProbe.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/VcsProbe.cpp`
- Modify: `premake5.lua`, the ArcaneTests `files` list: add `VcsProbe.cpp`.
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VcsProbeTest.cpp`, tag `[text-vcs]`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: nothing beyond `<filesystem>` and Win32 `RegGetValueW`.
- Produces:
  - `enum class VcsKind { None, Git, GitLfsLockable, Perforce, Lore, UnityVcs }`
  - `struct VcsGuess { VcsKind kind; std::filesystem::path root; std::string detail; }` (`root` is empty for a Perforce guess from the environment: the client's root lives on the server)
  - `struct VcsProbeEnv { std::optional<std::string> p4config, p4client, p4port; }`: injected in tests; `VcsProbeEnv::FromSystem()` resolves each from the environment, then `HKCU\Software\Perforce\environment`, then `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Perforce\environment`
  - `VcsGuess ProbeVcs(const std::filesystem::path& file, const VcsProbeEnv& env)`
  - `bool GitLfsLockable(std::string_view attributesText, const std::filesystem::path& attrDir, const std::filesystem::path& file)`
  - `bool GitPatternMatches(std::string_view pattern, std::string_view relPath)`

  Rules:
  - The walk goes from the file's directory up to the volume root. The **first** directory holding any marker decides; the nearest workspace wins.
  - Within one directory the order is:
    1. Git with the path lockable -> `GitLfsLockable`;
    2. Perforce;
    3. Unity VCS;
    4. Lore;
    5. Git.
  - Matching is case-insensitive (Windows `core.ignorecase` default; Lore's "any ASCII case").
  - After the walk reaches the volume root with no marker of any kind: a configured Perforce client (`p4client`, else `p4port`) -> `Perforce`, `root` empty, `detail` `"P4CLIENT=<value>"` / `"P4PORT=<value>"`. A marker anywhere on the walk always wins over the environment (a git repo on a machine that also has Perforce set is git). It is a guess for the banner's wording only (D14): a read-only file outside every marked tree on a machine with a Perforce client is most likely an unopened Perforce file.
  - The probe is cheap: a few `exists` calls per level, and reads only `.gitattributes` / `info/attributes` text.

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VcsProbeTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Document/VcsProbe.hpp"

#include <cstdlib>       // std::getenv, _putenv_s (MSVC)
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <optional>
#include <string>

using namespace Arcane::Editor;
namespace fs = std::filesystem;

namespace
{
    // NOT the suite's TEMP: the gate sets TEMP to <worktree>\.tmp-tests, which
    // sits inside the Arcane-text git worktree, so every probe there would
    // find that .git. %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp is wrapped by no repository; Root()
    // proves it per fixture before any check runs.
    fs::path ProbeBase()
    {
        const char* lad = std::getenv("LOCALAPPDATA");
        REQUIRE(lad != nullptr);
        return fs::path(lad) / "Temp" / "arcane-vcsprobe";
    }
    fs::path Root(const char* name)
    {
        const fs::path r = ProbeBase() / name;
        fs::remove_all(r);
        fs::create_directories(r);
        const fs::path probe = r / "pollution-probe.txt";
        std::ofstream(probe) << "x";
        INFO("a VCS marker sits above " << r.string() << " -- the fixtures need a marker-free ancestry");
        REQUIRE(ProbeVcs(probe, VcsProbeEnv{}).kind == VcsKind::None);
        fs::remove(probe);
        return r;
    }
    void Put(const fs::path& p, std::string_view text = "x")
    {
        fs::create_directories(p.parent_path());
        std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary) << text;
    }
    const VcsProbeEnv kNoP4{};
}

TEST_CASE("vcs probe: git patterns follow gitignore placement rules", "[text-vcs]")
{
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("*.psd", "art/deep/hero.psd"));          // no slash: basename at any depth
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("*.PSD", "art/hero.psd"));               // case-insensitive (Windows core.ignorecase)
    CHECK_FALSE(GitPatternMatches("*.psd", "art/hero.png"));
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("/art/*.psd", "art/hero.psd"));          // leading slash: anchored
    CHECK_FALSE(GitPatternMatches("/art/*.psd", "x/art/hero.psd"));
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("art/*.psd", "art/hero.psd"));           // a middle slash anchors too
    CHECK_FALSE(GitPatternMatches("art/*.psd", "art/sub/hero.psd")); // '*' never crosses '/'
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("art/**/*.psd", "art/a/b/hero.psd"));
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("**/maps/*.umap", "Content/maps/l1.umap"));
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("Content/**", "Content/a/b.uasset"));
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("hero?.psd", "hero1.psd"));
    CHECK(GitPatternMatches("hero[0-9].psd", "hero7.psd"));
}

TEST_CASE("vcs probe: Git LFS lockable patterns (git-lfs semantics)", "[text-vcs]")
{
    const fs::path root = Root("lfs");
    const std::string attrs =
        "*.txt text\n"
        "*.psd filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text lockable\n"
        "Maps/*.umap filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text lockable\n"
        "*.png filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text -lockable\n";
    CHECK(GitLfsLockable(attrs, root, root / "art" / "hero.psd"));
    CHECK(GitLfsLockable(attrs, root, root / "Maps" / "l1.umap"));
    CHECK_FALSE(GitLfsLockable(attrs, root, root / "Other" / "Maps" / "l1.umap"));   // anchored pattern
    CHECK_FALSE(GitLfsLockable(attrs, root, root / "a.png"));                       // -lockable is not "set"
    CHECK_FALSE(GitLfsLockable(attrs, root, root / "notes.txt"));
    CHECK_FALSE(GitLfsLockable("# *.psd lockable\n", root, root / "a.psd"));        // comments
}

{
    SECTION("git LFS lockable")
    {
        const fs::path r = Root("git-lfs");

        Put(r / "art" / "hero.psd");
        Put(r / "art" / "readme.md");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "art" / "hero.psd", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::GitLfsLockable);
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "art" / "readme.md", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::Git);
    }
    SECTION("git LFS lockable from a nested .gitattributes and from .git/info/attributes")
    {
        const fs::path r = Root("git-lfs-nested");
        fs::create_directories(r / ".git" / "info");
        Put(r / ".git" / "info" / "attributes", "*.wav lockable\n");
        Put(r / "Content" / ".gitattributes", "*.uasset lockable\n");
        Put(r / "Content" / "a.uasset");
        Put(r / "Content" / "b.wav");
        Put(r / "a.uasset");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "Content" / "a.uasset", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::GitLfsLockable);
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "Content" / "b.wav", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::GitLfsLockable);
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "a.uasset", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::Git);       // the nested file's patterns are relative to Content/
    }
    SECTION(".git as a FILE (worktree / submodule)")
    {
        const fs::path r = Root("git-file");
        Put(r / ".git", "gitdir: D:/elsewhere/.git/worktrees/x\n");
        Put(r / "a.txt");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "a.txt", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::Git);
    }
    SECTION("Perforce via .p4config, and via a custom P4CONFIG name")
    {
        const fs::path r = Root("p4");
        Put(r / ".p4config", "P4CLIENT=ws\n");
        Put(r / "Source" / "a.ini");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "Source" / "a.ini", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::Perforce);
        const fs::path r2 = Root("p4-custom");
        Put(r2 / "p4.cfg", "P4CLIENT=ws\n");
        Put(r2 / "b.ini");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r2 / "b.ini", VcsProbeEnv{ "p4.cfg" }).kind == VcsKind::Perforce);
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r2 / "b.ini", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::None);
    }
    SECTION("Lore: a .lore directory, the legacy .urc, any case; a .lore FILE is not a workspace")
    {
        const fs::path r = Root("lore");
        fs::create_directories(r / ".lore");
        Put(r / "a.json");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "a.json", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::Lore);
        const fs::path r2 = Root("urc");
        fs::create_directories(r2 / ".URC");
        Put(r2 / "a.json");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r2 / "a.json", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::Lore);
        const fs::path r3 = Root("lore-file");
        Put(r3 / ".lore");
        Put(r3 / "a.json");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r3 / "a.json", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::None);
    }
    SECTION("Unity Version Control: .plastic with plastic.workspace; an empty .plastic is not enough")
    {
        const fs::path r = Root("plastic");
        Put(r / ".plastic" / "plastic.workspace", "ws\n");
        Put(r / "Assets" / "a.prefab");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "Assets" / "a.prefab", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::UnityVcs);
        const fs::path r2 = Root("plastic-empty");
        fs::create_directories(r2 / ".plastic");
        Put(r2 / "a.prefab");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r2 / "a.prefab", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::None);
    }
    SECTION("nearest workspace wins; same directory: lockable git > Perforce > Unity > Lore > git")
    {
        const fs::path r = Root("nested");
        Put(r / ".p4config");
        fs::create_directories(r / "sub" / ".git");
        Put(r / "sub" / "a.txt");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "sub" / "a.txt", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::Git);
        const fs::path r2 = Root("same-dir");
        fs::create_directories(r2 / ".git");
        Put(r2 / ".p4config");
        Put(r2 / "a.txt");
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r2 / "a.txt", kNoP4).kind == VcsKind::Perforce);
    }
    SECTION("none found")
    {
        const fs::path r = Root("none");
        Put(r / "a.txt");
        const VcsGuess g = ProbeVcs(r / "a.txt", kNoP4);
        CHECK(g.kind == VcsKind::None);
    }
    SECTION("Perforce from p4 set / the environment, with no marker file in the tree (finding 6.15)")
    {

        VcsProbeEnv client;
        client.p4client = "arcane-ws";
        const VcsGuess g = ProbeVcs(r / "Source" / "a.ini", client);
        CHECK(g.kind == VcsKind::Perforce);
        CHECK(g.root.empty());                                         // the client root is on the server
        CHECK(g.detail == "P4CLIENT=arcane-ws");
        VcsProbeEnv port;
        port.p4port = "ssl:perforce.example:1666";
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "Source" / "a.ini", port).kind == VcsKind::Perforce);
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "Source" / "a.ini", port).detail == "P4PORT=ssl:perforce.example:1666");
    }
    SECTION("a marker on the walk beats a configured Perforce client")
    {
        const fs::path r = Root("p4-env-git");
        fs::create_directories(r / ".git");
        Put(r / "a.txt");
        VcsProbeEnv client;
        client.p4client = "arcane-ws";
        CHECK(ProbeVcs(r / "a.txt", client).kind == VcsKind::Git);
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vcs probe: FromSystem reads P4CLIENT / P4PORT / P4CONFIG from the environment first", "[text-vcs]")
{
    // Restores whatever the machine had; never touches the registry.
    struct EnvGuard
    {
        const char* name;
        std::optional<std::string> old;
        explicit EnvGuard(const char* n) : name(n)
        {
            if (const char* v = std::getenv(n)) old = v;
        }
        ~EnvGuard() { ::_putenv_s(name, old ? old->c_str() : ""); }
    };
    const EnvGuard g1("P4CLIENT"), g2("P4PORT"), g3("P4CONFIG");
    REQUIRE(::_putenv_s("P4CLIENT", "arcane-env-ws") == 0);
    REQUIRE(::_putenv_s("P4PORT", "perforce.example:1666") == 0);
    REQUIRE(::_putenv_s("P4CONFIG", ".p4env") == 0);
    const VcsProbeEnv env = VcsProbeEnv::FromSystem();
    CHECK(env.p4client == std::optional<std::string>("arcane-env-ws"));
    CHECK(env.p4port == std::optional<std::string>("perforce.example:1666"));
    CHECK(env.p4config == std::optional<std::string>(".p4env"));
}
```

`Root()` puts the fixtures under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp`, and each fixture REQUIREs a marker-free ancestry first. That way a polluted machine fails loudly instead of passing wrong: the "none found" and custom-P4CONFIG cases are only meaningful with nothing above the fixture.

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/VcsProbe.hpp
#pragma once
// D14 (text editor spec s5.3): a read-only file in a game project usually
// means LOCKED BY SOURCE CONTROL. VcsProbe walks up from a file and names the
// likely VCS so the save banner can word itself; it never runs a VCS tool.
// It is the seam the source-control spec (s12.3: git first, then Lore) extends.
#include <filesystem>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    enum class VcsKind : std::uint8_t { None, Git, GitLfsLockable, Perforce, Lore, UnityVcs };

    struct VcsGuess
    {
        VcsKind               kind = VcsKind::None;
        std::filesystem::path root;     // the directory holding the marker
        std::string           detail;   // e.g. the P4CONFIG file name, the matching .gitattributes
    };

    struct VcsProbeEnv
    {
        std::optional<std::string> p4config;   // P4CONFIG's value; nullopt = unset
        std::optional<std::string> p4client;   // P4CLIENT (a configured Perforce workspace)
        std::optional<std::string> p4port;     // P4PORT (a configured Perforce server)
        // Each: the environment variable, else `p4 set` (HKCU\Software\Perforce\environment),
        // else `p4 set -s` (HKLM\SOFTWARE\Perforce\environment) -- p4's own order.
        static VcsProbeEnv FromSystem();
    };

    [[nodiscard]] VcsGuess ProbeVcs(const std::filesystem::path& file, const VcsProbeEnv& env);
    // gitignore-style pattern against a '/'-separated path relative to the attributes file's directory.
    [[nodiscard]] bool GitPatternMatches(std::string_view pattern, std::string_view relPath);
    // git-lfs semantics: any line whose pattern matches and which SETS lockable.
    [[nodiscard]] bool GitLfsLockable(std::string_view attributesText, const std::filesystem::path& attrDir,
                                      const std::filesystem::path& file);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/VcsProbe.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/VcsProbe.hpp"

#include <cctype>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <optional>
#include <sstream>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <Windows.h>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;
    namespace
    {
        char Fold(char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c))); }

        // Glob over one path: '*' and '?' never cross '/', "**" crosses
        // directories, [..] classes (with '!' or '^' negation and ranges).
        bool Glob(std::string_view p, std::string_view s)
        {
            if (p.empty()) return s.empty();
            if (p.starts_with("**"))
            {
                std::string_view rest = p.substr(2);
                if (rest.starts_with('/')) rest.remove_prefix(1);
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i <= s.size(); ++i)
                    if ((i == 0 || s[i - 1] == '/' || rest.empty()) && Glob(rest, s.substr(i))) return true;
                return false;
            }
            if (p[0] == '*')
            {
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i <= s.size(); ++i)
                {
                    if (Glob(p.substr(1), s.substr(i))) return true;
                    if (i < s.size() && s[i] == '/') break;
                }
                return false;
            }
            if (s.empty()) return false;
            if (p[0] == '?') return s[0] != '/' && Glob(p.substr(1), s.substr(1));
            if (p[0] == '[')
            {
                const std::size_t close = p.find(']', 1);
                if (close != std::string_view::npos)
                {
                    std::string_view cls = p.substr(1, close - 1);
                    const bool neg = !cls.empty() && (cls[0] == '!' || cls[0] == '^');
                    if (neg) cls.remove_prefix(1);
                    bool hit = false;
                    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < cls.size(); ++i)
                    {
                        if (i + 2 < cls.size() && cls[i + 1] == '-')
                        {
                            if (Fold(s[0]) >= Fold(cls[i]) && Fold(s[0]) <= Fold(cls[i + 2])) hit = true;
                            i += 2;
                        }
                        else if (Fold(s[0]) == Fold(cls[i])) hit = true;
                    }
                    return hit != neg && s[0] != '/' && Glob(p.substr(close + 1), s.substr(1));
                }
            }
            if (p[0] == '\\' && p.size() > 1) return Fold(p[1]) == Fold(s[0]) && Glob(p.substr(2), s.substr(1));
            return Fold(p[0]) == Fold(s[0]) && Glob(p.substr(1), s.substr(1));
        }

        std::string ReadText(const fs::path& p)
        {
            std::ifstream f(p, std::ios::binary);
            std::stringstream ss;
            ss << f.rdbuf();
            return ss.str();
        }

        bool IsDir(const fs::path& p) { std::error_code ec; return fs::is_directory(p, ec); }
        bool Exists(const fs::path& p) { std::error_code ec; return fs::exists(p, ec); }

        std::string Rel(const fs::path& from, const fs::path& file)
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            return fs::relative(file, from, ec).generic_string();
        }
    }

    bool GitPatternMatches(std::string_view pattern, std::string_view relPath)
    {
        std::string_view pat = pattern;
        if (pat.ends_with('/')) pat.remove_suffix(1);         // a directory pattern: gitattributes never matches files by it
        const bool anchored = pat.find('/') != std::string_view::npos;
        if (pat.starts_with('/')) pat.remove_prefix(1);
        if (anchored) return Glob(pat, relPath);
        const std::size_t slash = relPath.rfind('/');
        return Glob(pat, slash == std::string_view::npos ? relPath : relPath.substr(slash + 1));
    }

    bool GitLfsLockable(std::string_view text, const fs::path& attrDir, const fs::path& file)
    {
        const std::string rel = Rel(attrDir, file);
        if (rel.empty() || rel.starts_with("..")) return false;
        std::istringstream in{ std::string(text) };
        for (std::string line; std::getline(in, line);)
        {
            if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
            std::istringstream words(line);
            std::string pattern;
            if (!(words >> pattern) || pattern.starts_with('#')) continue;
            bool lockable = false;
            for (std::string a; words >> a;)
                if (a == "lockable" || a == "lockable=true") lockable = true;   // -lockable / !lockable: not set (git-lfs skips them)
            if (lockable && GitPatternMatches(pattern, rel)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    namespace
    {
        // One Perforce variable, resolved as p4 does: the environment, then
        // `p4 set` (per user), then `p4 set -s` (per machine).
        std::optional<std::string> P4Variable(const char* name, const wchar_t* wideName)
        {
            if (const char* v = std::getenv(name); v && *v)
                return std::string(v);
            const std::pair<HKEY, const wchar_t*> keys[] = {
                { HKEY_CURRENT_USER, L"Software\\Perforce\\environment" },
                { HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, L"SOFTWARE\\Perforce\\environment" },
            };
            for (const auto& [root, sub] : keys)
            {
                wchar_t buf[512]{};
                DWORD bytes = sizeof(buf);
                if (::RegGetValueW(root, sub, wideName, RRF_RT_REG_SZ, nullptr, buf, &bytes) == ERROR_SUCCESS && buf[0] != L'\0')
                    return fs::path(buf).string();
            }
            return std::nullopt;
        }
    }

    VcsProbeEnv VcsProbeEnv::FromSystem()
    {
        VcsProbeEnv env;
        env.p4config = P4Variable("P4CONFIG", L"P4CONFIG");
        env.p4client = P4Variable("P4CLIENT", L"P4CLIENT");
        env.p4port   = P4Variable("P4PORT", L"P4PORT");
        return env;
    }

    VcsGuess ProbeVcs(const fs::path& file, const VcsProbeEnv& env)
    {
        std::error_code ec;
        fs::path dir = fs::absolute(file, ec).parent_path();
        std::vector<fs::path> walked;                              // the file's dir upward, for .gitattributes
        while (!dir.empty())
        {
            walked.push_back(dir);
            const fs::path git = dir / ".git";
            const bool hasGit = Exists(git);                      // directory OR gitfile
            bool lockable = false;
            if (hasGit)
            {
                for (const fs::path& d : walked)                   // every .gitattributes between file and root
                    if (const fs::path a = d / ".gitattributes"; Exists(a) && GitLfsLockable(ReadText(a), d, file))
                        lockable = true;
                if (IsDir(git))
                    if (const fs::path info = git / "info" / "attributes"; Exists(info) && GitLfsLockable(ReadText(info), dir, file))
                        lockable = true;
            }
            const bool p4 = (env.p4config && Exists(dir / *env.p4config)) || Exists(dir / ".p4config");
            const bool unity = IsDir(dir / ".plastic") &&
                               (Exists(dir / ".plastic" / "plastic.workspace") || Exists(dir / ".plastic" / "plastic.selector"));
            const bool lore = IsDir(dir / ".lore") || IsDir(dir / ".urc");   // NTFS lookups are case-insensitive
            if (hasGit && lockable) return { VcsKind::GitLfsLockable, dir, ".gitattributes lockable" };
            if (p4)                 return { VcsKind::Perforce, dir, env.p4config.value_or(".p4config") };
            if (unity)              return { VcsKind::UnityVcs, dir, ".plastic" };
            if (lore)               return { VcsKind::Lore, dir, ".lore" };
            if (hasGit)             return { VcsKind::Git, dir, ".git" };
            const fs::path parent = dir.parent_path();
            if (parent == dir) break;
            dir = parent;
        }
        // No marker anywhere up the walk. A machine with a Perforce client
        // configured (p4 set / P4V / the environment, no config file in the
        // tree -- finding 6.15) makes Perforce the likely reason a file is
        // read-only. Its root is on the server, so it stays empty.
        if (env.p4client) return { VcsKind::Perforce, {}, "P4CLIENT=" + *env.p4client };
        if (env.p4port)   return { VcsKind::Perforce, {}, "P4PORT=" + *env.p4port };
        return {};
    }
}
```

### Task TE6-22: The D14 wording: VcsReadOnlyReason over TE2-16's read-only banner (spec s5.3, D14)

**Ownership (CANON B3):** TE2-16 owns the D14 mechanics -- the `SaveReadOnly` / `SaveAccessDenied` banners, Save As first, the `RemoveReadOnlyAndSave` -> `ConfirmRemoveReadOnly` confirm step and `SaveMode::RemoveReadOnlyThenAtomic` (the one place the read-only flag is cleared). This task supplies only the wording: the phrase TE2-16 inserts through `TextDocumentServices::readOnlyReason`. There is no second banner, no banner id string, and no second remove path. **Order (CANON E):** after TE6-21 (lane L6 merges first) and TE2-16/TE2-20.

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/VcsProbe.hpp` / `.cpp` (TE6-21's files): add `VcsReadOnlyReason`.
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/App/EditorApp.cpp`: in TE2-20's text-route block (the `Arcane::Editor::TextRouteServices text;` block after the `.arcinput` `RegisterFactory` call), set `text.document.readOnlyReason`; add `#include "TextEditor/Document/VcsProbe.hpp"`.
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VcsReadOnlyReasonTest.cpp`, tags `[text-vcs]` (the phrases) and `[witness][text]` (the phrases inside TE2-16's banner flow on real files).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - TE6-21 `enum class VcsKind`, `struct VcsGuess`, `struct VcsProbeEnv` (`FromSystem()`), `VcsGuess ProbeVcs(const std::filesystem::path&, const VcsProbeEnv&)`
  - TE2-16 `TextDocumentServices::readOnlyReason` (`std::function<std::string(const std::filesystem::path&)>`; null = "it may be under version control"), `TextDocumentServices::saveOps` (`const SaveFileOps*`), `TextBannerKind::{SaveReadOnly, SaveAccessDenied, None}`, `TextBannerAction::{SaveAs, RemoveReadOnlyAndSave, ConfirmRemoveReadOnly, Cancel}`, `TextBanner::{kind, message, confirmingRemoveReadOnly}`, `BannerActions(const TextBanner&)`, `TextDocument::Save()`, `Banner()`, `ApplyBannerAction(TextBannerAction)`. TE2-16 builds the messages as `"'<name>' is read-only -- " + phrase + ". ..."`, the confirm step as `"Remove the read-only flag from '<name>' and save? " + phrase + " -- ..."` (CANON C TE2 #10e: the confirm repeats the phrase), and an ACL denial as `"Windows denied writing '<name>' -- " + phrase + ". Save As keeps your changes elsewhere."` with actions `{ SaveAs, Cancel }`.
  - TE2-6 `struct SaveFileOps { replaceFile; moveFile; listHolders; }` (the test injects an `ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED` replace to produce the ACL case)
  - TE2-15 `TextDocument::Open(path, services, error)`, `Buffer()`, `Model()`; TE2-11 `DefaultEditContext(TextModel&)`; TE1 `Text::TextCommands(...).InsertText(std::string_view)`
- Produces:
  - `std::string VcsReadOnlyReason(const VcsGuess&)`: the D14 phrase -- lower-case start, no file name, no trailing period, so it reads inside each of TE2-16's three sentences.
  - the app wiring `text.document.readOnlyReason = [](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return VcsReadOnlyReason(ProbeVcs(p, VcsProbeEnv::FromSystem())); };`

  The phrases (spec s5.3; the research table in TE6-21):

  | `VcsKind` | Phrase |
  |---|---|
  | `GitLfsLockable` | `it is a Git LFS lockable file: lock it first (git lfs lock), then save` |
  | `Perforce` | `it is not checked out in Perforce: check it out (p4 edit), then save` |

```cpp
using namespace Arcane;

    struct ScratchDir
    {
        std::filesystem::path dir;
        explicit ScratchDir(const char* name) : dir(std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / name)
        {
            Clear();
            std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
        }
        ~ScratchDir() { Clear(); }
        void Clear()
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            if (std::filesystem::exists(dir, ec))
                for (const auto& e : std::filesystem::recursive_directory_iterator(dir, ec))
                    ::SetFileAttributesW(e.path().c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL);
            std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
        }
    };

    void WriteAll(const std::filesystem::path& p, const std::string& bytes) { std::ofstream(p, std::ios::binary) << bytes; }

    std::string ReadAll(const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        std::ifstream in(p, std::ios::binary);
        std::stringstream ss;
        ss << in.rdbuf();
        return ss.str();
    }

    // Exactly the app's wiring (EditorApp.cpp, TE2-20's text-route block).
    TextDocumentServices VcsServices()
    {
        TextDocumentServices s;
        s.readOnlyReason = [](const std::filesystem::path& p) { return VcsReadOnlyReason(ProbeVcs(p, VcsProbeEnv::FromSystem())); };
        return s;
    }

    std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> OpenOrFail(const std::filesystem::path& p, TextDocumentServices s)
    {
        std::string error;
        std::unique_ptr<TextDocument> doc = TextDocument::Open(p, std::move(s), error);
        INFO(error);
        REQUIRE(doc != nullptr);
        return doc;
    }

    void TypeAtStart(TextDocument& doc, std::string_view text)
    {
        doc.Model().selections.SetSingle(0, 0);
        Text::TextCommands(doc.Buffer(), doc.Model().selections, DefaultEditContext(doc.Model())).InsertText(text);
    }

    bool Has(const std::string& haystack, const std::string& needle) { return haystack.find(needle) != std::string::npos; }

    std::uint32_t DeniedReplace(const wchar_t*, const wchar_t*, const wchar_t*) { return ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED; }
    std::uint32_t PassMove(const wchar_t* from, const wchar_t* to, std::uint32_t flags)
    {
        return ::MoveFileExW(from, to, flags) ? 0u : ::GetLastError();
    }
    const SaveFileOps kAclDeniedOps{ &DeniedReplace, &PassMove, nullptr };
}

TEST_CASE("vcs read-only reason: TE2-16's read-only banner and its confirm step carry the phrase; the confirm saves", "[witness][text]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te6-22-readonly");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "Game.ini";
    WriteAll(p, "[a]\nx=1\n");
    WriteAll(s.dir / ".p4config", "P4CLIENT=ws\n");          // the nearest workspace marker: Perforce
    REQUIRE(::SetFileAttributesW(p.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY));
    const std::string phrase = VcsReadOnlyReason(ProbeVcs(p, VcsProbeEnv::FromSystem()));
    REQUIRE(phrase == VcsReadOnlyReason({ VcsKind::Perforce }));

    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p, VcsServices());
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->ReadOnly());                             // the attribute refuses the SAVE, not the edit
    TypeAtStart(*doc, ";");

    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Save());                                 // refused, never silently forced (D14)
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::SaveReadOnly);
    CHECK(Has(doc->Banner().message, phrase));
    CHECK(BannerActions(doc->Banner()) == std::vector<A>{ A::SaveAs, A::RemoveReadOnlyAndSave, A::Cancel });   // Save As first
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Dirty());
    CHECK((::GetFileAttributesW(p.c_str()) & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) != 0);

    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::RemoveReadOnlyAndSave);         // asks first, repeating the VCS warning
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::SaveReadOnly);
    CHECK(doc->Banner().confirmingRemoveReadOnly);
    CHECK(Has(doc->Banner().message, phrase));
    CHECK(BannerActions(doc->Banner()) == std::vector<A>{ A::ConfirmRemoveReadOnly, A::Cancel });
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == "[a]\nx=1\n");                        // nothing written yet
    CHECK((::GetFileAttributesW(p.c_str()) & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) != 0);

    doc->ApplyBannerAction(A::ConfirmRemoveReadOnly);         // TE2-16's SaveMode::RemoveReadOnlyThenAtomic
    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Buffer().Dirty());
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::None);
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == ";[a]\nx=1\n");
    CHECK((::GetFileAttributesW(p.c_str()) & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) == 0);
}

TEST_CASE("vcs read-only reason: an ACL denial is SaveAccessDenied with the phrase and no remove option", "[witness][text]")
{
    const ScratchDir s("arcane-te6-22-acl");
    const std::filesystem::path p = s.dir / "Game.ini";
    WriteAll(p, "[a]\n");
    WriteAll(s.dir / ".p4config", "P4CLIENT=ws\n");
    TextDocumentServices services = VcsServices();
    services.saveOps = &kAclDeniedOps;                        // ReplaceFileW answers ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED: an ACL, not the attribute
    auto doc = OpenOrFail(p, std::move(services));
    TypeAtStart(*doc, ";");

    CHECK_FALSE(doc->Save());
    CHECK(doc->Banner().kind == TextBannerKind::SaveAccessDenied);
    CHECK(Has(doc->Banner().message, VcsReadOnlyReason({ VcsKind::Perforce })));
    const std::vector<A> actions = BannerActions(doc->Banner());
    CHECK(actions == std::vector<A>{ A::SaveAs, A::Cancel });
    CHECK(std::find(actions.begin(), actions.end(), A::RemoveReadOnlyAndSave) == actions.end());   // s5.3: no remove for ACLs
    CHECK(doc->Buffer().Dirty());
    CHECK(ReadAll(p) == "[a]\n");
}
```

  - `std::filesystem::path TextRecoveryDir()`
  - `const std::string& TextRecoverySessionId()`: this process's session id (D-R9), `"<16 hex digits of the process creation FILETIME>-<pid>"`, computed once

  - `struct TextRecoveryDoc { std::string path; Text::RopeSnapshot snapshot; std::uint64_t changeId; bool dirty; std::string encoding /* std::string(Text::EncodingId(doc.Encoding())) */; }`
  - `class TextRecovery`:
    - `explicit TextRecovery(Config)`, where `struct Config { std::filesystem::path dir; Submit submit; bool enabled; std::string sessionId; }` (empty `sessionId` = `TextRecoverySessionId()`; tests inject one per simulated session) and `using Submit = std::function<void(std::function<void()>)>`. The constructor reads the marker and keeps the OTHER sessions' entries (a crash, or an offer answered "Not now") as pending.
    - `std::vector<std::string> Tick(double now, std::span<const TextRecoveryDoc>)`: returns the paths skipped for size for the first time
    - `void SnapshotNow(std::span<const TextRecoveryDoc>)`
    - `void Flush()`
    - `void MarkCleanShutdown()`: this session's snapshots only (D-R9)
    - `void ForgetForeign(std::span<const std::string> snapshotFiles)`: the user answered the offer for these files (restored, or discarded): delete them and drop their entries (D-R9)
    - `bool WriteInFlight() const`, `std::uint32_t FailedWrites() const`, `const std::string& SessionId() const`, `std::size_t PendingForeign() const`
  - settings `editor.text.recoveryMaxMB` (`std::uint32_t`, `CVarValue::UInt32`, 16, Dev) and `editor.text.recoveryIntervalSeconds` (`std::uint32_t`, `CVarValue::UInt32`, 30)

`Tick`'s return value is the list of documents that just went over the cap. This task only returns it; TE6-15 turns each path into the one-time note through `TextDocument::ShowNote` (TE2-15's one note channel, which the status strip draws; CANON B11) and owns the test that the note lands.

The layout follows crash-window s8.4/s8.5 (see finding 1), made session-scoped by D-R9 (finding 6.11):
- the directory is `<project>/Saved/Autosaves/Text/`;
- each snapshot is `<sessionId>-<HashBytes of the lowercased canonical path, 16 hex digits>.arcrecover` (TE2-3's FNV-1a 64), holding the rope's bytes. Two sessions never share a snapshot file, even for the same document;
- the marker is ONE `RestoreData.json` (spec s5.3). It uses the s8.5 schema `{ restoreEnabled, entries: [ { originalPath, autosavePath, stateId, writtenUtc } ] }`, with `stateId` = the buffer `ChangeId` and three text fields added (`encoding`, `bytes`, `sessionId`). It lists every session's unanswered entries: this session writes the marker as the other sessions' pending entries plus its own, so a crashed session's entries survive the next session's writes until the user answers the offer; `restoreEnabled` is true whenever the list is not empty.
- Session rules (D-R9): `MarkCleanShutdown` deletes only this session's snapshots; a crashed session's files survive until the offer is answered (Recover: deleted after the restore succeeds; Discard: deleted; Not now / dismissed: kept and offered again next launch, all through `ForgetForeign`); and there is **no sweep while an offer is pending** (any other session's entry still listed). Only a clean shutdown with nothing pending sweeps strays: snapshot or temp files no marker entry names (a write that never got listed).
- The write path (finding 6.12): every write is checked; a file is written to `<name>.tmp`, flushed (`FlushFileBuffers`), closed and renamed over the target with `MoveFileExW(MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH)`; any failure deletes the temp and leaves the target as it was. Snapshots are written first, the marker second (so it never names bytes not on disk), deletes last and only after the marker stopped naming them. The in-memory entry list changes only to what the worker actually committed: a failed snapshot keeps the previous entry for that file (its old snapshot is intact) or none, so the next interval retries it.
- The marker is never written under `--headless` or a debugger (s8.5). The app decides that through `Config::enabled`, in TE6-15.
- Two editor instances on one project at once are out of scope (the single marker cannot hold both; `EditorLock` is the project's one-editor rule).

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/TextRecoveryTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextRecovery.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSavePlan.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane;
using namespace Arcane::Editor;

namespace
{
    std::filesystem::path Dir()
    {
        const auto d = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "arcane-text-recovery";
        std::filesystem::remove_all(d);
        std::filesystem::create_directories(d);
        return d;
    }
    // A worker the test drives: Submit queues, RunAll executes.
    struct ManualWorker
    {
        std::vector<std::function<void()>> jobs;
        TextRecovery::Submit Submit() { return [this](std::function<void()> j) { jobs.push_back(std::move(j)); }; }
        void RunAll() { auto js = std::move(jobs); jobs.clear(); for (auto& j : js) j(); }
    };
    // One simulated session (D-R9): the session id is injected, never the process's.
    TextRecovery::Config Cfg(const std::filesystem::path& dir, ManualWorker& w, std::string session = "S1")
    {
        return TextRecovery::Config{ dir, w.Submit(), true, std::move(session) };
    }
    TextRecoveryDoc Doc(std::string path, std::string text, std::uint64_t changeId, bool dirty)
    {
        return TextRecoveryDoc{ std::move(path), Text::RopeSnapshot{ Text::Rope::FromUtf8(text), changeId }, changeId, dirty,
                                std::string(Text::EncodingId(Text::TextEncoding::Utf8)) };
    }
    std::string ReadAll(const std::filesystem::path& p)
    {
        std::ifstream f(p, std::ios::binary);
        std::stringstream s;
        s << f.rdbuf();
        return s.str();
    }
    std::optional<TextRecoveryMarker> Marker(const std::filesystem::path& dir)
    {
        return ParseRecoveryMarker(ReadAll(dir / "RestoreData.json"));
    }
    // What a crashed session leaves: its snapshot file and its entry in the one marker.
    TextRecoveryEntry SeedCrashed(const std::filesystem::path& dir, const std::string& session, const std::string& path,
                                  const std::string& text)
    {
        const TextRecoveryEntry e{ path, RecoveryFileName(session, path), 5, "2026-10-07T00:00:00Z", "utf-8", text.size(), session };
        { std::ofstream(dir / e.snapshotFile, std::ios::binary) << text; }
        TextRecoveryMarker m = Marker(dir).value_or(TextRecoveryMarker{});
        m.entries.push_back(e);
        m.restoreEnabled = true;
        { std::ofstream(dir / "RestoreData.json", std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc) << SerializeRecoveryMarker(m); }
        return e;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("recovery: only dirty buffers are snapshotted, on the worker", "[text-recovery]")
{
    const auto dir = Dir();
    ManualWorker w;
    TextRecovery rec(Cfg(dir, w));
    const TextRecoveryDoc docs[] = { Doc("C:/p/a.md", "dirty text\n", 7, true), Doc("C:/p/b.md", "clean\n", 3, false) };
    CHECK(rec.Tick(100.0, docs).empty());
    CHECK(rec.WriteInFlight());
    CHECK(std::filesystem::is_empty(dir));                    // nothing written on the UI thread
    w.RunAll();
    CHECK_FALSE(rec.WriteInFlight());
    CHECK(rec.FailedWrites() == 0u);

    const auto marker = Marker(dir);
    REQUIRE(marker);
    CHECK(marker->restoreEnabled);
    REQUIRE(marker->entries.size() == 1);
    CHECK(marker->entries[0].originalPath == "C:/p/a.md");
    CHECK(marker->entries[0].changeId == 7);
    CHECK(marker->entries[0].encoding == "utf-8");             // Text::EncodingId(TextEncoding::Utf8)
    CHECK(marker->entries[0].sessionId == "S1");               // D-R9
    CHECK(marker->entries[0].snapshotFile == RecoveryFileName("S1", "C:/p/a.md"));
    CHECK(ReadAll(dir / marker->entries[0].snapshotFile) == "dirty text\n");
}

                  static_cast<unsigned long long>(HashBytes("c:/p/notes.md")));
    CHECK(RecoveryFileName("S1", "C:/P/Notes.md") == expected);
    CHECK(RecoveryFileName("S1", "C:/P/Notes.md") == RecoveryFileName("S1", "c:/p/notes.md"));
    CHECK(RecoveryFileName("S1", "C:/P/a.md") != RecoveryFileName("S1", "C:/P/b.md"));
    CHECK(RecoveryFileName("S1", "C:/P/a.md") != RecoveryFileName("S2", "C:/P/a.md"));   // D-R9
    const std::string& id = TextRecoverySessionId();
    CHECK(&id == &TextRecoverySessionId());                    // computed once per process
    CHECK(id.size() > 17u);                                    // 16 hex digits, '-', the pid
    CHECK(id.find_first_of("/\\:*?\"<>|") == std::string::npos);   // a file-name prefix
}

TEST_CASE("recovery: snapshotting never stalls a frame (no I/O, no copy, no wait on the UI thread)", "[text-recovery]")
{
    const auto dir = Dir();
    ManualWorker w;                                           // the worker never runs during this case's Ticks
    TextRecovery rec(Cfg(dir, w));
    const std::string sixteenMB(16u * 1024u * 1024u - 1u, 'q');
    // Both 16 MB documents are built BEFORE the timed region (finding 6.10): the
    // rope build is the test's setup, not the frame's work.
    const TextRecoveryDoc docs[] = { Doc("C:/p/big.txt", sixteenMB, 1, true) };
    const TextRecoveryDoc newer[] = { Doc("C:/p/big.txt", sixteenMB, 2, true) };

    const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    rec.Tick(100.0, docs);                                   // decides + submits; the job holds the O(1) snapshot
    rec.Tick(200.0, newer);                                  // a write is in flight: returns at once, never waits
    const double ms = std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count();
    INFO("two Ticks over a 16 MB dirty buffer with the worker blocked: " << ms << " ms (record it; not asserted)");
    // The mechanical proof: the blocked worker never ran, so the UI thread did
    // no I/O and did not wait; the second Tick queued nothing while one write
    // was in flight. Wall time is recorded, never asserted (Debug is slow).
    CHECK(w.jobs.size() == 1);
    CHECK(rec.WriteInFlight());
    CHECK(std::filesystem::is_empty(dir));
    w.RunAll();
    CHECK_FALSE(rec.WriteInFlight());
    CHECK(ReadAll(dir / RecoveryFileName("S1", "C:/p/big.txt")).size() == sixteenMB.size());
}

TEST_CASE("recovery: clean shutdown removes THIS session's snapshots; a crashed session's survive and stay offered (D-R9)", "[text-recovery]")
{
    const auto dir = Dir();
    const TextRecoveryEntry crashed = SeedCrashed(dir, "OLD", "C:/p/a.md", "lost work\n");
    ManualWorker w;
    TextRecovery rec(Cfg(dir, w, "S2"));
    CHECK(rec.PendingForeign() == 1u);
    const TextRecoveryDoc docs[] = { Doc("C:/p/a.md", "this session\n", 7, true) };   // the same file, dirty again
    rec.Tick(100.0, docs); w.RunAll();
    CHECK(ReadAll(dir / crashed.snapshotFile) == "lost work\n");                     // never overwritten by S2
    CHECK(ReadAll(dir / RecoveryFileName("S2", "C:/p/a.md")) == "this session\n");
    auto marker = Marker(dir);
    REQUIRE(marker);
    CHECK(marker->entries.size() == 2u);                                              // OLD's entry kept beside S2's

    rec.MarkCleanShutdown();
    CHECK_FALSE(std::filesystem::exists(dir / RecoveryFileName("S2", "C:/p/a.md")));
    CHECK(std::filesystem::exists(dir / crashed.snapshotFile));
    marker = Marker(dir);
    REQUIRE(marker);
    CHECK(marker->restoreEnabled);                                                    // offered again next launch
    REQUIRE(marker->entries.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(marker->entries[0].sessionId == "OLD");
}

TEST_CASE("recovery: answering the offer deletes exactly the answered files and entries (D-R9)", "[text-recovery]")
{
    const auto dir = Dir();
    const TextRecoveryEntry a = SeedCrashed(dir, "OLD", "C:/p/a.md", "a\n");
    const TextRecoveryEntry b = SeedCrashed(dir, "OLD", "C:/p/b.md", "b\n");
    ManualWorker w;
    TextRecovery rec(Cfg(dir, w, "S2"));
    REQUIRE(rec.PendingForeign() == 2u);

    const std::string first[] = { a.snapshotFile };          // a restored (or discarded); b: "Not now"
    rec.ForgetForeign(first);
    CHECK_FALSE(std::filesystem::exists(dir / a.snapshotFile));
    CHECK(std::filesystem::exists(dir / b.snapshotFile));
    CHECK(rec.PendingForeign() == 1u);
    auto marker = Marker(dir);
    REQUIRE(marker);
    CHECK(marker->restoreEnabled);
    REQUIRE(marker->entries.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(marker->entries[0].snapshotFile == b.snapshotFile);

    const std::string second[] = { b.snapshotFile };
    rec.ForgetForeign(second);
    CHECK_FALSE(std::filesystem::exists(dir / b.snapshotFile));
    CHECK(rec.PendingForeign() == 0u);
    marker = Marker(dir);
    REQUIRE(marker);
    CHECK_FALSE(marker->restoreEnabled);
    CHECK(marker->entries.empty());
}

TEST_CASE("recovery: a snapshot that cannot be written is never listed and is retried; a failed marker write deletes nothing (finding 6.12)", "[text-recovery]")
{
    const auto dir = Dir();
    ManualWorker w;
    TextRecovery rec(Cfg(dir, w));
    const std::string snap = RecoveryFileName("S1", "C:/p/a.md");
    std::filesystem::create_directories(dir / (snap + ".tmp"));                       // a directory holds the temp's name: the open fails
    const TextRecoveryDoc v7[] = { Doc("C:/p/a.md", "x\n", 7, true) };
    rec.Tick(100.0, v7); w.RunAll();
    CHECK(rec.FailedWrites() == 1u);
    CHECK_FALSE(std::filesystem::exists(dir / snap));
    auto marker = Marker(dir);
    REQUIRE(marker);
    CHECK(marker->entries.empty());                                                   // never names bytes that are not on disk
    CHECK_FALSE(marker->restoreEnabled);

    std::filesystem::remove(dir / (snap + ".tmp"));
    rec.Tick(200.0, v7); w.RunAll();                                                  // same changeId, never committed: retried
    CHECK(ReadAll(dir / snap) == "x\n");
    marker = Marker(dir);
    REQUIRE(marker);
    REQUIRE(marker->entries.size() == 1u);

    // The document goes clean while the marker's temp is blocked: the old marker
    // still names the snapshot, so the snapshot is NOT deleted.
    std::filesystem::create_directories(dir / "RestoreData.json.tmp");
    const TextRecoveryDoc clean[] = { Doc("C:/p/a.md", "x\n", 7, false) };
    rec.Tick(300.0, clean); w.RunAll();
    CHECK(rec.FailedWrites() == 2u);
    CHECK(std::filesystem::exists(dir / snap));
    marker = Marker(dir);
    REQUIRE(marker);
    CHECK(marker->entries.size() == 1u);                                              // the previous marker, intact
    std::filesystem::remove(dir / "RestoreData.json.tmp");
    rec.Tick(400.0, clean); w.RunAll();                                               // retried: marker first, then the delete
    CHECK_FALSE(std::filesystem::exists(dir / snap));
    marker = Marker(dir);
    REQUIRE(marker);
    CHECK(marker->entries.empty());
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextRecovery.hpp
#pragma once

// Crash safety for unsaved text (text editor spec s5.3), in the shapes of the
// crash-window spec's s8 (autosave + recovery), whose own plan 3 is not built:
// <project>/Saved/Autosaves/Text/<session>-<stem>.arcrecover + ONE
// RestoreData.json with s8.5's schema. Only DIRTY buffers are snapshotted; the
// write runs on a worker from an O(1) RopeSnapshot, so the UI thread never
// copies or writes; a buffer above editor.text.recoveryMaxMB is skipped with a
// one-time note. ONE write in flight at a time: a Tick that finds one returns.
// Session-scoped (D-R9): this session writes and deletes only its own files;
// other sessions' entries (a crash, or "Not now") stay listed and on disk
// until the user answers the offer (ForgetForeign); no sweep while any is pending.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"

#include <atomic>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#include <set>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    struct TextRecoveryEntry
    {
        std::string   originalPath;   // canonical, generic separators
        std::string   snapshotFile;   // file name inside the recovery dir (s8.5 "autosavePath")
        std::uint64_t changeId = 0;   // s8.5 "stateId": the buffer ChangeId the snapshot holds
        std::string   writtenUtc;     // ISO 8601, UTC
        std::string   encoding;       // Text::EncodingId at snapshot time ("utf-8", "windows-1252", ...); restore reopens with it
        std::uint64_t bytes = 0;
        std::string   sessionId;      // D-R9: the session that wrote it (the file name starts with it)
    };

    struct TextRecoveryMarker
    {
        bool restoreEnabled = false;
        std::vector<TextRecoveryEntry> entries;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::string SerializeRecoveryMarker(const TextRecoveryMarker& m);
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<TextRecoveryMarker> ParseRecoveryMarker(std::string_view json);
    // <project>/Saved/Autosaves/Text; empty without a project (nothing is snapshotted then).
    [[nodiscard]] std::filesystem::path TextRecoveryDir();
    // D-R9: "<16 hex digits of this process's creation FILETIME>-<pid>", computed once.
    [[nodiscard]] const std::string& TextRecoverySessionId();
    // "<sessionId>-<16 hex digits of HashBytes(lowercased canonicalPath)>.arcrecover" (TE2-3's FNV-1a 64).
    [[nodiscard]] std::string RecoveryFileName(std::string_view sessionId, std::string_view canonicalPath);

    struct TextRecoveryDoc
    {
        std::string        path;              // CanonicalPath().generic_string()
        Text::RopeSnapshot snapshot;          // Buffer().Snapshot()
        std::uint64_t      changeId = 0;      // Buffer().ChangeId()
        bool               dirty = false;     // Dirty()
        std::string        encoding;          // std::string(Text::EncodingId(Encoding()))
    };

    class TextRecovery
    {
    public:
        using Submit = std::function<void(std::function<void()>)>;
        struct Config
        {
            std::filesystem::path dir;
            Submit                submit;
            bool                  enabled = true;
            std::string           sessionId;   // empty = TextRecoverySessionId(); tests inject one per simulated session
        };

        explicit TextRecovery(Config config);  // reads the marker: other sessions' entries become pending
        ~TextRecovery();                    // Flush(): never abandon a half-written snapshot
        TextRecovery(const TextRecovery&) = delete;
        TextRecovery& operator=(const TextRecovery&) = delete;

        std::vector<std::string> Tick(double nowSeconds, std::span<const TextRecoveryDoc> docs);
        // Tick ignoring the interval (clean-exit hook: snapshot everything dirty now).
        void SnapshotNow(std::span<const TextRecoveryDoc> docs);
        void Flush();                       // waits for the in-flight write
        // s8.5 clean shutdown, session-scoped (D-R9): this session's snapshots
        // removed; the marker keeps only the pending entries of other sessions
        // (restoreEnabled == any left); strays swept only when none are pending.
        void MarkCleanShutdown();
        // D-R9: the user answered the offer for these snapshot files (restored
        // successfully, or discarded): drop their entries, then delete them.
        // Names that are not another session's listed entry are ignored.
        void ForgetForeign(std::span<const std::string> snapshotFiles);

        [[nodiscard]] bool WriteInFlight() const noexcept { return m_inFlight.load(std::memory_order_acquire); }
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t FailedWrites() const noexcept { return m_failedWrites.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }
        [[nodiscard]] const std::string& SessionId() const noexcept { return m_session; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t PendingForeign() const noexcept { return m_foreign.size(); }

    private:
        using EntryMap = std::map<std::string, TextRecoveryEntry>;   // by originalPath
        struct WriteItem { TextRecoveryEntry entry; Text::RopeSnapshot snapshot; };
        std::vector<std::string> Plan(std::span<const TextRecoveryDoc> docs);
        void Launch(std::vector<WriteItem> writes, std::vector<std::string> deletes, EntryMap next);
        void AdoptCommitted();              // UI thread: take what the last job actually committed

        Config                         m_config;
        std::string                    m_session;
        double                         m_next = 0.0;
        EntryMap                       m_entries;    // THIS session's snapshots that are on disk AND listed
        std::vector<TextRecoveryEntry> m_foreign;    // other sessions' listed entries, awaiting the user's answer (D-R9)
        std::set<std::string>          m_skipped;    // over the cap and already noted
        std::atomic<bool>              m_inFlight{ false };
        std::atomic<std::uint32_t>     m_failedWrites{ 0 };
        std::mutex                     m_doneMutex;
        std::condition_variable        m_doneCv;
        std::optional<EntryMap>        m_committed;  // set by the job under m_doneMutex; adopted on the UI thread
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Document/TextRecovery.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextRecovery.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Document/TextSavePlan.hpp"   // HashBytes (TE2-3, FNV-1a 64)
#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Platform/Paths.hpp>
#include <Json.hpp>

#include <cctype>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <format>
#include <fstream>
#include <io.h>          // _get_osfhandle
#include <sstream>

#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <Windows.h>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        std::string NowUtc()
        {
            return std::format("{:%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ}",
                               std::chrono::floor<std::chrono::seconds>(std::chrono::system_clock::now()));
        }
        std::string Lower(std::string_view s)
        {
            std::string out(s);
            for (char& c : out) c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
            return out;
        }

        // Finding 6.12: `file` is replaced only by a complete, flushed copy.
        // Every write is checked; the temp is flushed to disk (FlushFileBuffers)
        // and closed before MoveFileExW(REPLACE_EXISTING | WRITE_THROUGH)
        // renames it over the target. Any failure deletes the temp and leaves
        // `file` exactly as it was.
        bool WriteFileAtomically(const std::filesystem::path& file, const std::function<bool(std::FILE*)>& body)
        {
            const std::filesystem::path tmp = file.wstring() + L".tmp";
            std::FILE* f = nullptr;
            if (_wfopen_s(&f, tmp.c_str(), L"wb") != 0 || !f)
                return false;   // nothing was created
            bool ok = body(f);
            ok = std::fflush(f) == 0 && ok;
            ok = ok && ::FlushFileBuffers(reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(_get_osfhandle(_fileno(f)))) != 0;
            ok = std::fclose(f) == 0 && ok;
            ok = ok && ::MoveFileExW(tmp.c_str(), file.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH) != 0;
            if (!ok)
            {
                std::error_code ec;
                std::filesystem::remove(tmp, ec);
            }
            return ok;
        }

        // The one marker: the other sessions' pending entries, then this session's.
        bool WriteMarker(const std::filesystem::path& dir, const std::vector<TextRecoveryEntry>& foreign,
                         const std::map<std::string, TextRecoveryEntry>& own)
        {
            TextRecoveryMarker marker;
            marker.entries = foreign;
            for (const auto& [path, e] : own) marker.entries.push_back(e);
            marker.restoreEnabled = !marker.entries.empty();
            const std::string text = SerializeRecoveryMarker(marker);
            return WriteFileAtomically(dir / "RestoreData.json", [&](std::FILE* f)
            { return std::fwrite(text.data(), 1, text.size(), f) == text.size(); });
        }
    }

    const std::string& TextRecoverySessionId()
    {
        static const std::string id = []
        {
            FILETIME created{}, exited{}, kernel{}, user{};
            ::GetProcessTimes(::GetCurrentProcess(), &created, &exited, &kernel, &user);
            const std::uint64_t t = (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(created.dwHighDateTime) << 32) | created.dwLowDateTime;
            return std::format("{:016x}-{}", t, ::GetCurrentProcessId());   // start time + pid: unique per process (D-R9)
        }();
        return id;
    }

    std::string RecoveryFileName(std::string_view sessionId, std::string_view canonicalPath)
    {
        return std::format("{}-{:016x}.arcrecover", sessionId, HashBytes(Lower(canonicalPath)));
    }

    std::filesystem::path TextRecoveryDir()
    {
        return Paths::Join(Paths::Location::ProjectSaved, Paths::Current(),
                           std::filesystem::path("Autosaves") / "Text");
    }

    std::string SerializeRecoveryMarker(const TextRecoveryMarker& m)
    {
        nlohmann::json j;
        j["restoreEnabled"] = m.restoreEnabled;
        j["entries"] = nlohmann::json::array();
        for (const TextRecoveryEntry& e : m.entries)
            j["entries"].push_back({ { "originalPath", e.originalPath }, { "autosavePath", e.snapshotFile },
                                     { "stateId", e.changeId }, { "writtenUtc", e.writtenUtc },
                                     { "encoding", e.encoding }, { "bytes", e.bytes }, { "sessionId", e.sessionId } });
        return j.dump(2);
    }

    std::optional<TextRecoveryMarker> ParseRecoveryMarker(std::string_view json)
    {
        const nlohmann::json j = nlohmann::json::parse(json, nullptr, /*allow_exceptions*/ false);
        if (!j.is_object() || !j.contains("restoreEnabled") || !j["restoreEnabled"].is_boolean())
            return std::nullopt;
        TextRecoveryMarker m;
        m.restoreEnabled = j["restoreEnabled"].get<bool>();
        if (j.contains("entries") && j["entries"].is_array())
            for (const nlohmann::json& e : j["entries"])
            {
                if (!e.is_object() || !e.contains("originalPath") || !e.contains("autosavePath")) continue;
                TextRecoveryEntry r;
                r.originalPath = e.value("originalPath", std::string{});
                r.snapshotFile = e.value("autosavePath", std::string{});
                r.changeId     = e.value("stateId", std::uint64_t{ 0 });
                r.writtenUtc   = e.value("writtenUtc", std::string{});
                r.encoding     = e.value("encoding", std::string{});
                r.bytes        = e.value("bytes", std::uint64_t{ 0 });
                r.sessionId    = e.value("sessionId", std::string{});
                if (r.snapshotFile.find_first_of("/\\") != std::string::npos) continue;   // a name, never a path
                m.entries.push_back(std::move(r));
            }
        return m;
    }

    TextRecovery::TextRecovery(Config config)
        : m_config(std::move(config))
        , m_session(m_config.sessionId.empty() ? TextRecoverySessionId() : m_config.sessionId)
    {
        if (!m_config.enabled || m_config.dir.empty())
            return;
        // D-R9: what other sessions left listed (a crash, or an offer answered
        // "Not now") stays listed -- and its files stay on disk -- until the
        // user answers. Read-only here: the constructor never writes.
        std::ifstream in(m_config.dir / "RestoreData.json", std::ios::binary);
        if (!in)
            return;
        std::stringstream s;
        s << in.rdbuf();
        if (const std::optional<TextRecoveryMarker> marker = ParseRecoveryMarker(s.str()); marker && marker->restoreEnabled)
            for (const TextRecoveryEntry& e : marker->entries)
                if (e.sessionId != m_session)
                    m_foreign.push_back(e);
    }

    TextRecovery::~TextRecovery() { Flush(); }

    void TextRecovery::Flush()
    {
        std::unique_lock lock(m_doneMutex);
        m_doneCv.wait(lock, [this] { return !m_inFlight.load(std::memory_order_acquire); });
    }

    void TextRecovery::AdoptCommitted()
    {
        const std::lock_guard lock(m_doneMutex);
        if (m_committed)
        {
            m_entries = std::move(*m_committed);
            m_committed.reset();
        }
    }

    std::vector<std::string> TextRecovery::Tick(double nowSeconds, std::span<const TextRecoveryDoc> docs)
    {
        if (!m_config.enabled || m_config.dir.empty() || WriteInFlight() || nowSeconds < m_next)
            return {};
        AdoptCommitted();
        m_next = nowSeconds + Settings<TextSettings>().recoveryIntervalSeconds;
        return Plan(docs);
    }

    void TextRecovery::SnapshotNow(std::span<const TextRecoveryDoc> docs)
    {
        if (!m_config.enabled || m_config.dir.empty())
            return;
        Flush();
        AdoptCommitted();
        (void)Plan(docs);
    }

    std::vector<std::string> TextRecovery::Plan(std::span<const TextRecoveryDoc> docs)
    {
        const std::uint64_t capBytes = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(Settings<TextSettings>().recoveryMaxMB) * 1024u * 1024u;
        std::vector<std::string> newlySkipped;
        std::vector<WriteItem> writes;
        std::vector<std::string> deletes;
        EntryMap next = m_entries;           // what the marker lists if every write succeeds; m_entries changes only on commit
        std::set<std::string> seen;
        bool changed = false;

        for (const TextRecoveryDoc& d : docs)
        {
            seen.insert(d.path);
            const auto it = next.find(d.path);
            if (!d.dirty)
            {
                m_skipped.erase(d.path);
                if (it != next.end()) { deletes.push_back(it->second.snapshotFile); next.erase(it); changed = true; }
                continue;
            }
            if (d.snapshot.rope.Size() > capBytes)
            {
                if (m_skipped.insert(d.path).second) newlySkipped.push_back(d.path);
                if (it != next.end()) { deletes.push_back(it->second.snapshotFile); next.erase(it); changed = true; }
                continue;
            }
            m_skipped.erase(d.path);
            if (it != next.end() && it->second.changeId == d.changeId)
                continue;                                                  // already on disk and listed
            TextRecoveryEntry e{ d.path, RecoveryFileName(m_session, d.path), d.changeId, NowUtc(), d.encoding,
                                 d.snapshot.rope.Size(), m_session };
            next[d.path] = e;
            writes.push_back({ std::move(e), d.snapshot });                 // RopeSnapshot copy is O(1) (s3.1)
            changed = true;
        }
        for (auto it = next.begin(); it != next.end();)                    // documents closed since the last plan
        {
            if (seen.contains(it->first)) { ++it; continue; }
            deletes.push_back(it->second.snapshotFile);
            it = next.erase(it);
            changed = true;
        }
        if (changed)
            Launch(std::move(writes), std::move(deletes), std::move(next));
        return newlySkipped;
    }

    void TextRecovery::Launch(std::vector<WriteItem> writes, std::vector<std::string> deletes, EntryMap next)
    {
        m_inFlight.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        // The job owns copies of everything it reads: the UI thread never
        // touches m_entries / m_foreign while it runs (ForgetForeign and
        // MarkCleanShutdown Flush first).
        auto job = [this, writes = std::move(writes), deletes = std::move(deletes), next = std::move(next),
                    prev = m_entries, foreign = m_foreign]() mutable
        {
            std::error_code ec;
            std::filesystem::create_directories(m_config.dir, ec);
            // 1. Snapshots. A failed one keeps the PREVIOUS entry for its file (the
            //    old snapshot is intact: the temp is renamed only after a full,
            //    flushed write) or, without one, is not listed; the next interval
            //    retries it because the committed set lacks its changeId.
            for (const WriteItem& w : writes)
            {
                const bool ok = WriteFileAtomically(m_config.dir / w.entry.snapshotFile, [&](std::FILE* f)
                {
                    bool good = true;
                    w.snapshot.rope.ForEachChunk({ 0, w.snapshot.rope.Size() }, [&](std::string_view chunk)
                    {
                        if (good && std::fwrite(chunk.data(), 1, chunk.size(), f) != chunk.size())
                            good = false;
                    });
                    return good;
                });
                if (ok)
                    continue;
                m_failedWrites.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                if (const auto old = prev.find(w.entry.originalPath); old != prev.end())
                    next[w.entry.originalPath] = old->second;
                else
                    next.erase(w.entry.originalPath);
            }
            // 2. The marker, after every snapshot it names is on disk.
            const bool listed = WriteMarker(m_config.dir, foreign, next);
            if (!listed)
                m_failedWrites.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            // 3. Deletes, only once the marker on disk stopped naming them.
            if (listed)
                for (const std::string& name : deletes)
                    std::filesystem::remove(m_config.dir / name, ec);
            {
                const std::lock_guard lock(m_doneMutex);
                m_committed = listed ? std::move(next) : std::move(prev);   // exactly what the marker on disk lists
                m_inFlight.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
            }
            m_doneCv.notify_all();
        };
        if (m_config.submit) m_config.submit(std::move(job));
        else job();
    }

    void TextRecovery::ForgetForeign(std::span<const std::string> snapshotFiles)
    {
        if (!m_config.enabled || m_config.dir.empty())
            return;
        Flush();
        AdoptCommitted();
        const std::set<std::string> answered(snapshotFiles.begin(), snapshotFiles.end());
        std::vector<TextRecoveryEntry> kept;
        std::vector<std::string> gone;
        for (const TextRecoveryEntry& e : m_foreign)
        {
            if (answered.contains(e.snapshotFile)) gone.push_back(e.snapshotFile);
            else kept.push_back(e);
        }
        if (gone.empty())
            return;
        // The marker first: an enabled marker must never name a deleted file.
        // A user's answer, not a per-frame path: written on this thread.
        if (!WriteMarker(m_config.dir, kept, m_entries))
        {
            m_failedWrites.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            return;                                    // still listed, so the files stay: offered again next launch
        }
        m_foreign = std::move(kept);
        std::error_code ec;
        for (const std::string& name : gone)
            std::filesystem::remove(m_config.dir / name, ec);
    }

    void TextRecovery::MarkCleanShutdown()
    {
        if (!m_config.enabled || m_config.dir.empty())
            return;
        Flush();
        AdoptCommitted();
        std::error_code ec;
        if (!std::filesystem::exists(m_config.dir, ec))
            return;                                    // this session never wrote: nothing to clear
        // The marker first, listing only the other sessions' pending entries
        // (restoreEnabled stays true while any is left: offered next launch).
        if (!WriteMarker(m_config.dir, m_foreign, {}))
        {
            m_failedWrites.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            return;                                    // the old marker still names our files: keep them
        }
        for (const auto& [path, e] : m_entries)
            std::filesystem::remove(m_config.dir / e.snapshotFile, ec);
        m_entries.clear();
        m_skipped.clear();
        // D-R9: no sweep while an offer is pending.
        if (!m_foreign.empty())
            return;
        // Nothing pending: strays (a snapshot never listed, a half-written temp)
        // belong to no answerable entry and are swept.
        for (const auto& f : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(m_config.dir, ec))
        {
            const std::filesystem::path p = f.path();
            const bool snapshot = p.extension() == ".arcrecover";
            const bool temp = p.extension() == ".tmp" && p.stem().extension() == ".arcrecover";
            const bool markerTemp = p.filename() == "RestoreData.json.tmp";
            if ((snapshot || temp || markerTemp) && f.is_regular_file(ec))
                std::filesystem::remove(p, ec);
        }
    }
}
```
