```cpp
#include <rapidcheck.h>
#include <rapidcheck/catch.h>

#include "TextEditor/Core/DisplayMap.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/FoldModel.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCursorModel.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimText.hpp"

#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;
namespace CM = Arcane::Text::VimCursorModel;

namespace
{
    // "a\xC3\xA9" = "a" + U+00E9 (2 bytes): multi-byte characters must move as one.
    const Rope kWord = Rope::FromUtf8("abcd");
    const Rope kAccent = Rope::FromUtf8("a\xC3\xA9");
    const Rope kLines = Rope::FromUtf8("one\n\ntwo");   // rows: "one" [0,3) "\n"@3, "" @4, "two" [5,8)
}

TEST_CASE("vim cursor model: Normal mode keeps the cursor on a character", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    CHECK(CM::Clamp(kWord, 4) == 3);          // past the last char -> on it
    CHECK(CM::Clamp(kWord, 2) == 2);
    CHECK(CM::Clamp(kAccent, 3) == 1);        // back onto the 2-byte char's first byte
    CHECK(CM::Clamp(kLines, 4) == 4);         // an empty line: the line start is the one exception
    CHECK(CM::Clamp(kLines, 3) == 2);         // "one"'s line end -> 'e'
    CHECK(CM::Clamp(kLines, 8) == 7);         // EOF -> last char
}

TEST_CASE("vim cursor model: inclusive motions take the character under the end", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    CHECK(CM::OperatorRange(kWord, 0, 2, MotionKind::Inclusive).begin == 0);
    CHECK(CM::OperatorRange(kWord, 0, 2, MotionKind::Inclusive).end == 3);
    CHECK(CM::OperatorRange(kWord, 2, 0, MotionKind::Inclusive).end == 3);       // order-free
    CHECK(CM::OperatorRange(kAccent, 0, 1, MotionKind::Inclusive).end == 3);     // the whole 2-byte char
    CHECK(CM::OperatorRange(kWord, 0, 2, MotionKind::Exclusive).end == 2);       // exclusive: not extended
}

TEST_CASE("vim cursor model: linewise ranges take whole lines with their line break", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    const ByteRange mid = CM::OperatorRange(kLines, 0, 1, MotionKind::Linewise);   // rows 0..0
    CHECK(mid.begin == 0);
    CHECK(mid.end == 4);                                                          // "one\n"
    const ByteRange last = CM::LinewiseDeleteRange(kLines, 2, 2);                 // the last row takes the break before it
    CHECK(last.begin == 4);
    CHECK(last.end == 8);
    const ByteRange all = CM::LinewiseDeleteRange(kLines, 0, 2);
    CHECK(all.begin == 0);
    CHECK(all.end == 8);
    CHECK(CM::LinewiseText(kLines, 0, 1) == "one\n\n");
    CHECK(CM::LinewiseText(kLines, 2, 2) == "two\n");                             // registers always end linewise text with \n
}

TEST_CASE("vim line model: a final newline ends the last line (D-R5)", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    CHECK(VimText::LineCount(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb\n")) == 2u);
    CHECK(VimText::LineCount(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb")) == 2u);
    CHECK(VimText::LineCount(Rope::FromUtf8("")) == 1u);
    CHECK(VimText::LineCount(Rope::FromUtf8("\n")) == 1u);
    CHECK(VimText::LineCount(Rope::FromUtf8("a\n\n")) == 2u);              // "a" and one empty line
    CHECK(VimText::LastRow(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb\n")) == 1u);
    CHECK(VimText::EndsWithNewline(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb\n")));
    CHECK_FALSE(VimText::EndsWithNewline(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb")));          // Vim's noeol: recorded, no behaviour change
    CHECK_FALSE(VimText::EndsWithNewline(Rope::FromUtf8("")));
    CHECK(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb\n").LineCount() == 3u);                      // the rope itself is unchanged

    const Rope eol = Rope::FromUtf8("a\nbc\n");                              // a0 \n1 b2 c3 \n4, Size 5
    CHECK(CM::Clamp(eol, 5) == 3);              // the row after the final '\n' -> the last real line's last char
    CHECK(CM::Clamp(Rope::FromUtf8("a\n\n"), 3) == 2);   // ... or its start when that line is empty
    CHECK(CM::Clamp(Rope::FromUtf8("\n"), 1) == 0);

    const ByteRange lastEol = CM::LinewiseDeleteRange(eol, 1, 1);           // dd on the last line: line + terminator
    CHECK(lastEol.begin == 2);
    CHECK(lastEol.end == 5);                                                 // "a\nbc\n" -> "a\n"
    const ByteRange only = CM::LinewiseDeleteRange(Rope::FromUtf8("a\n"), 0, 0);
    CHECK(only.begin == 0);
    CHECK(only.end == 2);                                                    // the only line -> ""
    const ByteRange noeol = CM::LinewiseDeleteRange(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nbc"), 1, 1);
    CHECK(noeol.begin == 1);
    CHECK(noeol.end == 4);                                                   // noeol: the break before it goes -> "a"
    CHECK(CM::OperatorRange(eol, 0, 3, MotionKind::Linewise).end == 5);     // dj over both lines takes everything
    CHECK(CM::LinewiseText(eol, 1, 1) == "bc\n");
    CHECK(CM::PasteRow(eol, 3, true) == 2u);                                 // p below the last line ...
    CHECK(eol.LineStart(2) == 5u);                                           // ... inserts at Size(): "a\nbc\nX\n"

    // D-R14: the .vimcases runner compares Vim's lines, never the bytes
    using Lines = std::vector<std::string>;
    CHECK(VimLinesOf(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb\n")) == Lines{ "a", "b" });
    CHECK(VimLinesOf(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb")) == Lines{ "a", "b" });      // noeol: the same lines
    CHECK(VimLinesOf(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb\n\n")) == Lines{ "a", "b", "" });   // a Vim buffer whose last line is empty
    CHECK(VimLinesOf(Rope::FromUtf8("")) == Lines{ "" });
    CHECK(VimLinesOf(Rope::FromUtf8("\n")) == Lines{ "" });
    CHECK(CM::Clamp(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb\n\n"), 4) == 4u);                // that empty last line is a real vim position
}

TEST_CASE("vim cursor model: Visual includes the character under the larger end", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    const ByteRange v = CM::VisualRange(kWord, 3, 1);
    CHECK(v.begin == 1);
    CHECK(v.end == 4);
    const ByteRange e = CM::VisualRange(kLines, 4, 4);                            // empty line: its line break
    CHECK(e.begin == 4);
    CHECK(e.end == 5);
    const ByteRange eol = CM::VisualRange(kLines, 0, 3);                          // v$ on "one": through the break
    CHECK(eol.end == 4);

    const Selection fwd{ 7, 1, 3, std::nullopt };
    const Selection ed = CM::ToEditorVisual(kWord, fwd);
    CHECK(ed.anchor == 1);
    CHECK(ed.head == 4);
    CHECK(ed.id == 7u);
    const Selection back = CM::FromEditorVisual(kWord, ed);
    CHECK(back.anchor == 1);
    CHECK(back.head == 3);

    const Selection rev{ 1, 3, 1, std::nullopt };
    const Selection edRev = CM::ToEditorVisual(kWord, rev);
    CHECK(edRev.anchor == 4);
    CHECK(edRev.head == 1);
}

TEST_CASE("vim cursor model: p inserts after the cursor char, P at it; linewise below/above", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    CHECK(CM::PasteOffset(kWord, 1, true) == 2);
    CHECK(CM::PasteOffset(kWord, 1, false) == 1);
    CHECK(CM::PasteOffset(kAccent, 1, true) == 3);
    CHECK(CM::PasteOffset(kLines, 4, true) == 4);        // empty line: nothing to step over
    CHECK(CM::PasteRow(kLines, 1, true) == 1u);
    CHECK(CM::PasteRow(kLines, 1, false) == 0u);
}

TEST_CASE("vim cursor model: entering and leaving Insert", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    const Rope r = Rope::FromUtf8("  ab\n");
    CHECK(CM::EnterInsert(r, 2, InsertEntry::Before) == 2);
    CHECK(CM::EnterInsert(r, 2, InsertEntry::After) == 3);
    CHECK(CM::EnterInsert(r, 3, InsertEntry::FirstNonBlank) == 2);
    CHECK(CM::EnterInsert(r, 3, InsertEntry::ColumnZero) == 0);
    CHECK(CM::EnterInsert(r, 2, InsertEntry::LineEnd) == 4);
    CHECK(CM::EnterInsert(kLines, 4, InsertEntry::After) == 4);   // `a` on an empty line stays

    CHECK(CM::LeaveInsert(r, 4) == 3);        // back one char
    CHECK(CM::LeaveInsert(r, 0) == 0);        // unless at the line start
    CHECK(CM::LeaveInsert(kAccent, 3) == 1);  // back over a whole multi-byte char
    CHECK(CM::LeaveInsert(r, 5) == 5);        // a line start stays (Clamp, not LeaveInsert, keeps Normal off the phantom row, D-R5)
}

TEST_CASE("vim text: virtual columns expand tabs", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    const Rope r = Rope::FromUtf8("\tab\n");
    CHECK(VimText::VirtualColumn(r, 0, 4) == 0u);
    CHECK(VimText::VirtualColumn(r, 1, 4) == 4u);
    CHECK(VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, 0, 2, 4) == 0u);   // inside the tab -> on the tab
    CHECK(VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, 0, 5, 4) == 2u);
    CHECK(VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, 0, 99, 4) == 3u);  // past the end -> the line end
}

TEST_CASE("vim text: MapThrough shifts offsets by bias", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    const std::vector<EditOp> ops = { EditOp{ ByteRange{ 2, 2 }, "XY" }, EditOp{ ByteRange{ 5, 7 }, "" } };
    CHECK(VimText::MapThrough(1, ops, Bias::Right) == 1u);
    CHECK(VimText::MapThrough(2, ops, Bias::Left) == 2u);     // an insertion at the offset: left stays before
    CHECK(VimText::MapThrough(2, ops, Bias::Right) == 4u);
    CHECK(VimText::MapThrough(6, ops, Bias::Left) == 7u);     // inside a deletion: its start (5 + 2)
    CHECK(VimText::MapThrough(9, ops, Bias::Left) == 9u);     // +2 -2
}

TEST_CASE("vim text: Apply is one undo step through TextCommands; Select moves the primary; SyncDisplay hides folded rows", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    TextBuffer buffer(Rope::FromUtf8("one\ntwo\nthree\n"));
    SelectionSet sels;
    FoldModel folds;
    DisplayMap display;
    VimDoc doc{ buffer, sels, folds, display };
    VimText::SyncDisplay(doc);
    CHECK(display.DisplayRowCount() == 4u);

    // one batch for two cursors ("one" -> "ONE", "two" -> "TWO"); the ops arrive unsorted on purpose
    std::vector<EditOp> ops = { EditOp{ ByteRange{ 4, 7 }, "TWO" }, EditOp{ ByteRange{ 0, 3 }, "ONE" } };
    std::vector<Selection> after = { VimText::Caret(doc, 0), VimText::Caret(doc, 4) };
    VimText::Apply(doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), 1);
    CHECK(buffer.Text().ToString() == "ONE\nTWO\nthree\n");
    REQUIRE(sels.Size() == 2u);
    CHECK(sels.Primary().head == 4u);
    CHECK(buffer.UndoDepth() == 1u);
    CHECK(TextCommands(buffer, sels).Undo());                  // undo through the TextCommands class, never buffer.Undo
    CHECK(buffer.Text().ToString() == "one\ntwo\nthree\n");
    CHECK(sels.Size() == 1u);                                  // the pre-edit selections come back

    VimText::Select(doc, { VimText::Caret(doc, 8), VimText::Caret(doc, 2) }, 0);
    CHECK(sels.Primary().head == 8u);                          // primaryIndex names the primary
    CHECK(buffer.UndoDepth() == 0u);                           // a move is not an undo step

    REQUIRE(folds.Fold(buffer.Text(), FoldRange{ 0, 1 }, FoldSource::Manual));
    VimText::SyncDisplay(doc);
    CHECK(display.IsHidden(1));
    CHECK(display.DisplayRowCount() == 3u);
}

TEST_CASE("vim cursor model: editor <-> vim visual conversion round-trips", "[text-vim-cursor]")
{
    rc::prop("FromEditorVisual(ToEditorVisual(s)) == s", [] {
        const std::vector<std::string> pieces = *rc::gen::container<std::vector<std::string>>(
            rc::gen::element<std::string>("a", "b", " ", "\t", "\n", "\xC3\xA9"));
        std::string text;
        for (const std::string& p : pieces) text += p;
        text += "z";                                  // the last line is never empty: EOF is not a vim position
        const Rope r = Rope::FromUtf8(text);
        // every Normal-mode position plus the line ends of non-last lines (v$)
        std::vector<ByteOffset> positions;
        for (std::uint32_t row = 0; row < r.LineCount(); ++row)
        {
            const ByteOffset s = r.LineStart(row), e = r.LineEnd(row);
            for (ByteOffset o = s; o < e; o = VimText::NextChar(r, o)) positions.push_back(o);
            if (row + 1 < r.LineCount()) positions.push_back(e);
        }
        const ByteOffset a = *rc::gen::elementOf(positions);
        const ByteOffset h = *rc::gen::elementOf(positions);
        const Selection vim{ 1, a, h, std::nullopt };
        const Selection back = CM::FromEditorVisual(r, CM::ToEditorVisual(r, vim));
        RC_ASSERT(back.anchor == a);
        RC_ASSERT(back.head == h);
    });
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimText.hpp
#pragma once

// The vim layer's one adapter onto TE1's core (spec s2.1): line access,
// grapheme stepping within a line, virtual columns, and the two TextCommands
// entry points every vim change and move goes through. Nothing else in Vim/
// calls a TE1 mutation directly.

#include "TextEditor/Core/DisplayMap.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/FoldModel.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"   // EditContext

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimDoc
    {
        TextBuffer&        buffer;
        SelectionSet&      selections;
        FoldModel&         folds;
        DisplayMap&        display;
        const EditContext* context = nullptr;   // the view's edit context (MakeEditContext / DefaultEditContext); null = EditContext{}
    };

    namespace VimText
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("vim behaviour: curswant MAXCOL -- after $, j/k stay at the line end (:h $)")
        inline constexpr std::uint32_t kGoalEol = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

        // Vim's line view (D-R5): a final '\n' ENDS the last line ("a\nb\n" = 2 lines, "\n" = 1 empty
        // line, "" = 1 empty line). Every vim line count / last-line test uses these, never r.LineCount().
        [[nodiscard]] bool EndsWithNewline(const Rope& r);                                // Size() > 0 && last byte '\n' (else vim's noeol)
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t LineCount(const Rope& r);                             // r.LineCount() - (EndsWithNewline ? 1 : 0)
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t LastRow(const Rope& r);                               // LineCount(r) - 1
        [[nodiscard]] std::string Line(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row);                 // without the line break
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t RowOf(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);
        [[nodiscard]] bool AtLineEnd(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset NextChar(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);                   // within the line; LineEnd stays
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset PrevChar(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);                   // within the line; LineStart stays
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t CharLen(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);                 // 0 at a line end
        [[nodiscard]] char32_t CodePointAt(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);                  // '\n' at a line end, 0 at EOF
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset FirstNonBlank(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row);         // LineEnd when the line is blank
        [[nodiscard]] std::string LeadingWhitespace(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row);
        [[nodiscard]] bool IsBlankLine(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row);                 // empty or spaces/tabs only
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t VirtualColumn(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o, std::uint32_t tabSize);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset OffsetForVirtualColumn(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t vcol, std::uint32_t tabSize);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset MapThrough(ByteOffset o, std::span<const EditOp> ops, Bias bias);  // ops sorted

        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Selection> Selections(const VimDoc& d);
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t PrimaryIndex(const VimDoc& d);
        void Apply(VimDoc& d, std::vector<EditOp> ops, std::vector<Selection> after, std::size_t primary);
        void Select(VimDoc& d, std::vector<Selection> next, std::size_t primary);
        [[nodiscard]] Selection Caret(VimDoc& d, ByteOffset o, std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal = std::nullopt);
        // Rebuilds d.display from d.folds and the buffer's text (TE4-12 Text::SyncDisplay).
        void SyncDisplay(VimDoc& d);
    }

    // D-R14: the rope as Vim's lines (D-R5's model: rows 0..VimText::LastRow, a final terminator ends
    // the last line). The .vimcases runner compares these, joined by "\n", with a case's out:.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::string> VimLinesOf(const Rope& r);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimText.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimText.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/FoldActions.hpp"   // Text::SyncDisplay (TE4-12)
#include "TextEditor/Core/Graphemes.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text::VimText
{
    bool EndsWithNewline(const Rope& r) { return r.Size() > 0 && r.ByteAt(r.Size() - 1) == '\n'; }

    std::uint32_t LineCount(const Rope& r) { return r.LineCount() - (EndsWithNewline(r) ? 1u : 0u); }

    std::uint32_t LastRow(const Rope& r) { return LineCount(r) - 1; }

    std::string Line(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row)
    {
        std::string out;
        r.CopyTo(ByteRange{ r.LineStart(row), r.LineEnd(row) }, out);
        return out;
    }

    std::uint32_t RowOf(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o) { return r.OffsetToPoint(std::min<ByteOffset>(o, r.Size())).row; }

    bool AtLineEnd(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o) { return o >= r.LineEnd(RowOf(r, o)); }

    ByteOffset NextChar(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o)
    {
        const ByteOffset end = r.LineEnd(RowOf(r, o));
        if (o >= end) return end;
        return std::min(NextGraphemeBoundary(r, o), end);
    }

    ByteOffset PrevChar(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o)
    {
        const ByteOffset start = r.LineStart(RowOf(r, o));
        if (o <= start) return start;
        return std::max(PrevGraphemeBoundary(r, o), start);
    }

    std::uint32_t CharLen(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o) { return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(NextChar(r, o) - o); }

    char32_t CodePointAt(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o)
    {
        if (o >= r.Size()) return 0;
        std::string buf;
        r.CopyTo(ByteRange{ o, std::min<ByteOffset>(o + 4, r.Size()) }, buf);
        const Utf8::Unit d = Utf8::DecodeAt(buf, 0);
        return d.valid ? d.cp : U'�';
    }

    ByteOffset FirstNonBlank(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row)
    {
        const std::string line = Line(r, row);
        const std::size_t i = line.find_first_not_of(" \t");
        return r.LineStart(row) + (i == std::string::npos ? line.size() : i);
    }

    std::string LeadingWhitespace(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row)
    {
        const std::string line = Line(r, row);
        return line.substr(0, std::min(line.size(), line.find_first_not_of(" \t")));
    }

    bool IsBlankLine(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row) { return Line(r, row).find_first_not_of(" \t") == std::string::npos; }

    std::uint32_t VirtualColumn(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o, std::uint32_t tabSize)
    {
        const std::uint32_t row = RowOf(r, o);
        std::uint32_t col = 0;
        for (ByteOffset p = r.LineStart(row); p < o && p < r.LineEnd(row); p = NextChar(r, p))
            col = CodePointAt(r, p) == U'\t' ? (col / tabSize + 1) * tabSize : col + 1;
        return col;
    }

    ByteOffset OffsetForVirtualColumn(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t vcol, std::uint32_t tabSize)
    {
        std::uint32_t col = 0;
        ByteOffset p = r.LineStart(row);
        const ByteOffset end = r.LineEnd(row);
        while (p < end)
        {
            const std::uint32_t next = CodePointAt(r, p) == U'\t' ? (col / tabSize + 1) * tabSize : col + 1;
            if (vcol < next) return p;
            col = next;
            p = NextChar(r, p);
        }
        return end;
    }

    ByteOffset MapThrough(ByteOffset o, std::span<const EditOp> ops, Bias bias)
    {
        std::int64_t delta = 0;
        for (const EditOp& op : ops)
        {
            const std::int64_t grow = static_cast<std::int64_t>(op.text.size())
                                    - static_cast<std::int64_t>(op.range.end - op.range.begin);
            if (op.range.end < o) { delta += grow; continue; }
            if (op.range.begin > o) break;
            if (op.range.begin == op.range.end)                 // a pure insertion at o
            {
                if (bias == Bias::Right) delta += grow;
                break;
            }
            if (o == op.range.begin && bias == Bias::Left) break;
            const bool atEnd = o == op.range.end;
            return static_cast<ByteOffset>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(op.range.begin) + delta
                                           + ((bias == Bias::Right || atEnd) ? static_cast<std::int64_t>(op.text.size()) : 0));
        }
        return static_cast<ByteOffset>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(o) + delta);
    }

    std::vector<Selection> Selections(const VimDoc& d)
    {
        const std::span<const Selection> all = d.selections.All();
        return std::vector<Selection>(all.begin(), all.end());
    }

    std::size_t PrimaryIndex(const VimDoc& d) { return d.selections.PrimaryIndex(); }

    void Apply(VimDoc& d, std::vector<EditOp> ops, std::vector<Selection> after, std::size_t primary)
    {
        std::stable_sort(ops.begin(), ops.end(), [](const EditOp& a, const EditOp& b) { return a.range.begin < b.range.begin; });
        // One transaction (TE1-14): Begin(current, Other), Edit(ops), selections := after, End(after).
        TextCommands(d.buffer, d.selections, d.context ? *d.context : EditContext{})
            .ApplyEdits(TransactionKind::Other, std::move(ops), std::move(after), primary);
    }

    void Select(VimDoc& d, std::vector<Selection> next, std::size_t primary)
    {
        TextCommands(d.buffer, d.selections, d.context ? *d.context : EditContext{})
            .SetSelections(std::move(next), primary);
    }

    Selection Caret(VimDoc& d, ByteOffset o, std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal)
    {
        return Selection{ d.selections.AllocateId(), o, o, goal };
    }

    void SyncDisplay(VimDoc& d)
    {
        Text::SyncDisplay(d.folds, d.display, d.buffer.Text());
    }
}

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    std::vector<std::string> VimLinesOf(const Rope& r)
    {
        std::vector<std::string> lines;
        for (std::uint32_t row = 0; row <= VimText::LastRow(r); ++row) lines.push_back(VimText::Line(r, row));
        return lines;
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCursorModel.hpp
#pragma once

// The cursor model, in one place (spec s6.1). The editor's cursors sit BETWEEN
// characters; vim's sit ON one. Every vim feature converts through here:
//   - Normal/Visual: a vim cursor on char c at offset o is the caret at o, o < line end
//     (an empty line is the one exception: o = line start);
//   - inclusive motions extend to o + len(c); exclusive do not; linewise take whole lines + break;
//   - Visual includes the char under the larger end: [min, max + len(char at max));
//   - p inserts at o + len(c), P at o; linewise registers go below / above;
//   - i keeps o, a moves to o + len(c); leaving Insert steps back one char unless at the line start.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class MotionKind : std::uint8_t { Exclusive, Inclusive, Linewise };
    enum class InsertEntry : std::uint8_t { Before, After, FirstNonBlank, ColumnZero, LineEnd };

    struct VimCursor
    {
        ByteOffset anchor = 0;   // the Visual start (= head outside Visual)
        ByteOffset head = 0;     // the vim cursor
        bool operator==(const VimCursor&) const = default;
    };

    namespace VimCursorModel
    {
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset Clamp(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset CharEnd(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset VisualCharEnd(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o);    // at a line end: its break
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset PrevVisual(const Rope& r, ByteOffset end);     // inverse of VisualCharEnd
        [[nodiscard]] ByteRange  OperatorRange(const Rope& r, ByteOffset a, ByteOffset b, MotionKind kind);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteRange  LinewiseDeleteRange(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow);
        [[nodiscard]] std::string LinewiseText(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteRange  VisualRange(const Rope& r, ByteOffset anchor, ByteOffset head);
        [[nodiscard]] Selection  ToEditorVisual(const Rope& r, const Selection& vim);
        [[nodiscard]] Selection  FromEditorVisual(const Rope& r, const Selection& editor);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset PasteOffset(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o, bool after);
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t PasteRow(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o, bool after);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset EnterInsert(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o, InsertEntry entry);
        [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset LeaveInsert(const Rope& r, ByteOffset caret);
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCursorModel.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCursorModel.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimText.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text::VimCursorModel
{
    ByteOffset Clamp(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o)
    {
        o = std::min<ByteOffset>(o, r.Size());
        std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, o);
        if (row > VimText::LastRow(r))                       // D-R5: the row after a final '\n' is never a vim position
        {
            row = VimText::LastRow(r);
            o = r.LineEnd(row);
        }
        const ByteOffset start = r.LineStart(row), end = r.LineEnd(row);
        if (start == end) return start;
        if (o >= end) return VimText::PrevChar(r, end);
        return o;
    }

    ByteOffset CharEnd(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o) { return VimText::NextChar(r, o); }

    ByteOffset VisualCharEnd(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o)
    {
        if (VimText::AtLineEnd(r, o)) return std::min<ByteOffset>(o + 1, r.Size());
        return VimText::NextChar(r, o);
    }

    ByteOffset PrevVisual(const Rope& r, ByteOffset end)
    {
        if (end == 0) return 0;
        const ByteOffset before = end - 1;
        if (before < r.Size() && VimText::AtLineEnd(r, before)) return before;   // the break: a line-end position
        return VimText::PrevChar(r, end);
    }

    ByteRange LinewiseDeleteRange(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow)
    {
        if (lastRow + 1 < VimText::LineCount(r)) return ByteRange{ r.LineStart(firstRow), r.LineStart(lastRow + 1) };
        // D-R5: the last vim line ends with the final '\n' -- take the lines and that terminator ("a\nb\n" dd on b -> "a\n").
        if (VimText::EndsWithNewline(r)) return ByteRange{ r.LineStart(firstRow), r.Size() };
        if (firstRow > 0) return ByteRange{ r.LineEnd(firstRow - 1), r.Size() };   // noeol: the break before the lines goes
        return ByteRange{ 0, r.Size() };
    }

    std::string LinewiseText(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (std::uint32_t row = firstRow; row <= lastRow; ++row)
        {
            out += VimText::Line(r, row);
            out.push_back('\n');
        }
        return out;
    }

    ByteRange OperatorRange(const Rope& r, ByteOffset a, ByteOffset b, MotionKind kind)
    {
        const ByteOffset lo = std::min(a, b), hi = std::max(a, b);
        switch (kind)
        {
        case MotionKind::Exclusive: return ByteRange{ lo, hi };
        case MotionKind::Inclusive: return ByteRange{ lo, CharEnd(r, hi) };
        case MotionKind::Linewise:  return LinewiseDeleteRange(r, VimText::RowOf(r, lo), VimText::RowOf(r, hi));
        }
        return ByteRange{ lo, hi };
    }

    ByteRange VisualRange(const Rope& r, ByteOffset anchor, ByteOffset head)
    {
        const ByteOffset lo = std::min(anchor, head), hi = std::max(anchor, head);
        return ByteRange{ lo, VisualCharEnd(r, hi) };
    }

    Selection ToEditorVisual(const Rope& r, const Selection& vim)
    {
        Selection out = vim;
        if (vim.head >= vim.anchor) { out.anchor = vim.anchor; out.head = VisualCharEnd(r, vim.head); }
        else                        { out.anchor = VisualCharEnd(r, vim.anchor); out.head = vim.head; }
        return out;
    }

    Selection FromEditorVisual(const Rope& r, const Selection& editor)
    {
        Selection out = editor;
        if (editor.head > editor.anchor)      { out.anchor = editor.anchor; out.head = PrevVisual(r, editor.head); }
        else if (editor.head < editor.anchor) { out.head = editor.head; out.anchor = PrevVisual(r, editor.anchor); }
        return out;
    }

    ByteOffset PasteOffset(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o, bool after) { return after ? CharEnd(r, o) : o; }

    std::uint32_t PasteRow(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o, bool after)
    {
        const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, o);
        return after ? row + 1 : row;
    }

    ByteOffset EnterInsert(const Rope& r, ByteOffset o, InsertEntry entry)
    {
        const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, o);
        switch (entry)
        {
        case InsertEntry::Before:        return o;
        case InsertEntry::After:         return CharEnd(r, o);
        case InsertEntry::FirstNonBlank: return VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, row);
        case InsertEntry::ColumnZero:    return r.LineStart(row);
        case InsertEntry::LineEnd:       return r.LineEnd(row);
        }
        return o;
    }

    ByteOffset LeaveInsert(const Rope& r, ByteOffset caret)
    {
        const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, caret);
        if (caret <= r.LineStart(row)) return caret;
        return VimText::PrevChar(r, caret);
    }
}
```

### Task TE5a-3: VimOptions, VimLanguage and the vim word classes (spec s6.4, s6.5 `[K]`, s11.3 word characters)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimOptions.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimOptions.cpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimLanguage.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimLanguage.cpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCharClass.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCharClass.cpp`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimCharClassTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes (TE3-2, `TextEditor/Syntax/Regex.hpp`, the TEST only -- it compiles `PcreClass()` and matches probes; the class itself carries no matcher): `static std::expected<std::shared_ptr<const Regex>, RegexError> Regex::Compile(std::string_view, RegexOptions = RegexOptions::None)`, `struct RegexLimits`, `class MatchScratch { explicit MatchScratch(RegexLimits); MatchStatus Match(const Regex&, std::string_view subject, std::size_t start, MatchFlags = MatchFlags::None); }`, `enum class MatchStatus { Match, NoMatch, LimitHit, Error }`. Every pattern is compiled with `PCRE2_UTF | PCRE2_MATCH_INVALID_UTF` (TE3-2), so `\x{..}` names a code point. (TE1-1) `Utf8::Append` (test). (TE3-7/8, `TextEditor/Syntax/Grammar.hpp`) `struct GrammarDesc { ...; lineComment; blockCommentBegin; blockCommentEnd; indentIncrease; indentDecrease; wordChars = "A-Za-z0-9_"; ... }`, `std::expected<GrammarDesc, GrammarError> ParseGrammar(std::string_view jsonText)`, `GrammarError::Text()`, `CompiledGrammar::Rules().Desc()`. (Test helper) `Arcane::Test::RepoRoot()` from `ArcaneTests/src/Helpers/ConstantScan.hpp`; the engine grammar file `data/Syntaxes/Lua.arcsyntax` (TE3, stem `Lua`).
- Produces:
  - `struct VimOptions` (fields and Neovim defaults below), `bool ParseNrFormats(std::string_view, VimOptions&)`, `std::string FormatNrFormats(const VimOptions&)`
  - `struct VimLanguage { name, wordChars, lineComment, blockCommentBegin, blockCommentEnd, indentIncrease, indentDecrease; }`, `VimLanguage VimLanguageFromGrammar(const GrammarDesc&)`, `VimLanguage VimLanguageFromGrammar(const CompiledGrammar& g)` (= `VimLanguageFromGrammar(g.Rules().Desc())`), `std::string VimCommentString(const VimLanguage&)`
  - `class VimCharClass { explicit VimCharClass(std::string_view wordChars = "A-Za-z0-9_"); int Class(char32_t, bool bigWord) const; bool IsWord(char32_t) const; std::string PcreClass() const; std::string PcreClassNoDigits() const; }` -- a plain copyable value (an ASCII bitset); the non-ASCII classes are a port of Neovim's `utf_class()` (two `constexpr` tables, no PCRE2 probe, no `MatchScratch`, no memo).
  - `int VimUnicodeClass(char32_t cp)` -- Neovim's `utf_class()` for `cp >= 0x100` (0 blank, 1 punctuation, 2 word, 3 emoji, or the script's own class value: `0x2070` superscripts, `0x2080` subscripts, `0x2800` braille, `0x3040` Hiragana, `0x30A0` Katakana, `0x4E00` CJK ideographs, `0xAC00` Hangul).

`VimOptions` is the pure value the vim layer reads; its defaults are Neovim's (D13). Until TE5d-1 binds it to `editor.text.vim.*`, the Neovim defaults hold for every option except the ones TE5a-23 and TE5b-1 already register. **Word classes are a port of Neovim's `utf_class()`** (finding 5a.5; `mbyte.c` `utf_class_tab`), checked code point by code point against `charclass()` of the pinned Neovim v0.12.5 (U+0080..U+3FFFF, 0 mismatches, 2026-10-07): ASCII uses the grammar's `wordChars` (Neovim's `'iskeyword'` aligned to the grammar, spec s11.3 and the oracle's O-4); Latin-1 follows Neovim's default `'iskeyword'` `@,48-57,_,192-255` (NBSP blank, `µ` and U+00C0..U+00FF word -- `×` and `÷` included --, the rest punctuation); above U+00FF an emoji is class 3, a code point in the `utf_class` interval table takes that row's class, and everything else is a word character (2). So CJK ideographs, Hiragana, Katakana and Hangul are each their OWN class (`w` stops between `漢字` and `かな`), U+3000 (ideographic space) is a blank, and `IsWord(cp)` is vim's `vim_iswordc`: `Class(cp) >= 2`. `PcreClass()` (vim's `[K]`, spliced into patterns by TE5c-1) is generated from the same tables as a POSITIVE bracket expression (its body can be spliced into `[[:keyword:]]`), so `\k` agrees with `w` exactly. When the oracle pin moves, the two tables are re-checked against the new Neovim's `charclass()` (TE5a-7, "When the pin moves"). The vim layer only ever needs the grammar's DESCRIPTION (comment tokens, `wordChars`, indent patterns), so `VimLanguageFromGrammar` takes TE3-7's `GrammarDesc`; the `CompiledGrammar` overload forwards `g.Rules().Desc()` for the editor, and tests parse the `.arcsyntax` file text with `ParseGrammar` (no registry, no compile).

```cpp
TEST_CASE("vim word classes: blank, punctuation, word; bigWord folds punctuation into words", "[text-vim-chars]")
{
    const VimCharClass c;
    CHECK(c.Class(U' ', false) == 0);
    CHECK(c.Class(U'\t', false) == 0);
    CHECK(c.Class(U'\n', false) == 0);
    CHECK(c.Class(0, false) == 0);
    CHECK(c.Class(U' ', false) == 0);   // NBSP is blank, as in vim's utf_class
    CHECK(c.Class(U'a', false) == 2);
    CHECK(c.Class(U'_', false) == 2);
    CHECK(c.Class(U'.', false) == 1);
    CHECK(c.Class(U'.', true) == 1);
    CHECK(c.Class(U'a', true) == 1);              // bigWord: every non-blank is one class
    CHECK(c.Class(U'é', false) == 2);        // e-acute: Latin-1 192-255 (Neovim's default iskeyword)
    CHECK(c.Class(U'×', false) == 2);   // multiplication sign: also inside 192-255
    CHECK(c.Class(U'ª', false) == 1);   // feminine ordinal: Latin-1 outside iskeyword
    CHECK(c.Class(U'µ', false) == 2);   // micro sign: iskeyword '@'
    CHECK(c.Class(U'١', false) == 2);        // Arabic-Indic one: not in the table -> word
    CHECK(c.Class(U'—', false) == 1);        // em dash: punctuation (U+200C..U+2027)
    CHECK(c.IsWord(U'中'));
}

TEST_CASE("vim word classes: Neovim's utf_class -- per-script classes, CJK blanks, emoji", "[text-vim-chars]")
{
    const VimCharClass c;
    CHECK(c.Class(U'　', false) == 0);       // ideographic space is a blank (5a.5)
    CHECK(c.Class(U'　', true) == 0);        // ... for W too
    CHECK(c.Class(U'、', false) == 1);       // ideographic comma: punctuation
    CHECK(c.Class(U'あ', false) == 0x3040);      // Hiragana
    CHECK(c.Class(U'ア', false) == 0x30A0);      // Katakana
    CHECK(c.Class(U'中', false) == 0x4E00);      // CJK ideograph
    CHECK(c.Class(U'\U00020000', false) == 0x4E00);   // CJK extension B
    CHECK(c.Class(U'한', false) == 0xAC00);      // Hangul syllable
    CHECK(c.Class(U'⁵', false) == 0x2070);  // superscript five
    CHECK(c.Class(U'⠂', false) == 0x2800);  // braille
    CHECK(c.Class(U'\U0001F600', false) == 3);   // emoji (inside the 1F300..1F9FF punctuation row: emoji wins)
    CHECK(c.Class(U'↔', false) == 3);       // left-right arrow is an emoji ...
    CHECK(c.Class(U'←', false) == 1);       // ... the leftwards arrow is a symbol
    CHECK(c.Class(U'★', false) == 1);       // black star: not in Neovim's emoji table
    CHECK(c.Class(U'中', true) == 1);            // W: one class for every non-blank
    CHECK(c.IsWord(U'\U0001F600'));               // vim_iswordc: class >= 2
    CHECK_FALSE(c.IsWord(U'　'));
    CHECK(VimUnicodeClass(U'ж') == 2);       // Cyrillic zhe
    CHECK(VimUnicodeClass(U';') == 1);       // Greek question mark
}
}

{
    const VimCharClass css("A-Za-z0-9_\\-");
    CHECK(css.IsWord(U'-'));
    CHECK_FALSE(VimCharClass().IsWord(U'-'));
    const VimCharClass d("\\d_");
    CHECK(d.IsWord(U'7'));
    CHECK_FALSE(d.IsWord(U'a'));

TEST_CASE("vim word classes: the PCRE2 [K] class is generated from the same tables, never \\w", "[text-vim-chars]")
{
    const std::string k = VimCharClass().PcreClass();
    CHECK(k.starts_with("[0-9A-Z_a-z\\x{b5}\\x{c0}-\\x{ff}\\x{100}-\\x{37d}\\x{37f}-\\x{386}"));
    CHECK(k.ends_with("\\x{1f947}-\\x{10ffff}]"));
    CHECK(k.find("\\p{") == std::string::npos);                 // no Unicode property escapes: vim's own table
    CHECK(k.find("\\x{3000}") == std::string::npos);            // the ideographic space is not a keyword char
    CHECK(VimCharClass().PcreClassNoDigits().starts_with("[A-Z_a-z\\x{b5}\\x{c0}-\\x{ff}"));
    CHECK(VimCharClass("A-Za-z0-9_\\-").PcreClass().starts_with("[\\-0-9A-Z_a-z\\x{b5}"));

    // The class compiles and agrees with IsWord on every probe (TE3-2 Regex, a test-local scratch).
    const auto re = Regex::Compile("^" + k);
    REQUIRE(re.has_value());
    MatchScratch scratch{ RegexLimits{} };
    const VimCharClass c;
    for (const char32_t cp : { U'a', U'_', U'-', U'é', U'×', U'ª', U'中', U'あ', U'　', U'、',
                               U'—', U'\U0001F600', U'↔', U'←', U'\U00020000', U'١' })
    {
        std::string utf8;
        Utf8::Append(utf8, cp);
        INFO("U+" << std::hex << static_cast<std::uint32_t>(cp));
        CHECK((scratch.Match(**re, utf8, 0) == MatchStatus::Match) == c.IsWord(cp));
    }
    const auto noDigits = Regex::Compile("^" + c.PcreClassNoDigits());
    REQUIRE(noDigits.has_value());
    CHECK(scratch.Match(**noDigits, "7", 0) == MatchStatus::NoMatch);                       // vim \K: ASCII digits only
    CHECK(scratch.Match(**noDigits, "\xD9\xA3", 0) == MatchStatus::Match);                 // U+0663 stays (VIM_ISDIGIT is ASCII)
}

TEST_CASE("vim word classes: a copy answers alike", "[text-vim-chars]")
{
    VimCharClass a("A-Za-z0-9_\\-");
    const VimCharClass b = a;                      // a plain value: the ASCII set is copied
    CHECK(b.IsWord(U'-'));
    CHECK(b.IsWord(U'é'));
    CHECK(b.IsWord(U'ж'));
    CHECK_FALSE(b.IsWord(U'—'));
    a = VimCharClass();
    CHECK_FALSE(a.IsWord(U'-'));
    CHECK(b.IsWord(U'-'));                         // the copy is independent
    CHECK(a.IsWord(U'ж'));
}

TEST_CASE("vim language: comment, wordChars and indent come from the grammar file", "[text-vim-chars]")
{
    std::ifstream in(Arcane::Test::RepoRoot() / "data" / "Syntaxes" / "Lua.arcsyntax", std::ios::binary);
    REQUIRE(in.good());
    const std::string text{ std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>() };
    const auto lua = ParseGrammar(text);
    REQUIRE(lua.has_value());
    const VimLanguage l = VimLanguageFromGrammar(*lua);
    CHECK(l.name == "Lua");
    CHECK(l.lineComment == "--");
    CHECK(l.blockCommentBegin == "--[[");
    CHECK(l.blockCommentEnd == "]]");
    CHECK(VimCommentString(l) == "-- %s");                 // the line comment wins over the block pair
    CHECK(l.wordChars == "A-Za-z0-9_");
    CHECK_FALSE(l.indentIncrease.empty());
    CHECK_FALSE(l.indentDecrease.empty());

    GrammarDesc bare;                                      // a grammar without comment/indent keys
    bare.name = "Bare";
    bare.wordChars.clear();                                // "" never empties vim's word class
    const VimLanguage b = VimLanguageFromGrammar(bare);
    CHECK(b.name == "Bare");
    CHECK(b.wordChars == "A-Za-z0-9_");
    CHECK(VimCommentString(b).empty());

    VimLanguage block;
    block.blockCommentBegin = "/*";
    block.blockCommentEnd = "*/";
    CHECK(VimCommentString(block) == "/* %s */");
    CHECK(VimCommentString(VimLanguage{}).empty());     // Plain Text: no commentstring
}
```

```cpp
#pragma once

// The vim options as one plain value (spec s6.4). Defaults are NEOVIM's (D13):
// Y = y$, hlsearch + incsearch on, startofline off, nrformats=bin,hex,
// scrolloff 0, wrapscan on. TE5d-1 fills this from editor.text.vim.* and the
// editor-wide editor.text.* indentation settings; until then the defaults hold.

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimOptions
    {
        bool          ignorecase = false;
        bool          smartcase = false;
        bool          hlsearch = true;
        bool          incsearch = true;
        bool          wrapscan = true;
        bool          gdefault = false;
        std::uint32_t timeoutlenMs = 1000;
        std::uint32_t scrolloff = 0;
        bool          startofline = false;
        bool          nrBin = true, nrHex = true, nrOctal = false, nrAlpha = false;
        bool          yankToEol = true;                 // Y = y$ (Neovim) vs yy (Vim)
        std::string   leader = "\\";
        bool          handleCtrlKeys = true;            // spec s6.6
        bool          useSystemClipboard = false;       // " aliases +
        // editor-wide text settings (spec s6.4: not vim-only)
        std::uint32_t tabSize = 4;
        std::uint32_t shiftWidth = 4;
        bool          expandTab = true;
        std::uint64_t multilineSearchMaxBytes = 64ull << 20;
        // (no cursor cap here: gb reads editor.text.maxCursors through the view's EditContext, TE5a-21)
    };

    // "bin,hex" -> the nr* flags. False (and `out` untouched) on an unknown item.
    [[nodiscard]] bool ParseNrFormats(std::string_view text, VimOptions& out);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatNrFormats(const VimOptions& o);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimOptions.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimOptions.hpp"

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    bool ParseNrFormats(std::string_view text, VimOptions& out)
    {
        bool bin = false, hex = false, octal = false, alpha = false;
        while (!text.empty())
        {
            const std::size_t comma = text.find(',');
            const std::string_view item = text.substr(0, comma);
            if (item == "bin") bin = true;
            else if (item == "hex") hex = true;
            else if (item == "octal") octal = true;
            else if (item == "alpha") alpha = true;
            else if (!item.empty()) return false;
            if (comma == std::string_view::npos) break;
            text.remove_prefix(comma + 1);
        }
        out.nrBin = bin; out.nrHex = hex; out.nrOctal = octal; out.nrAlpha = alpha;
        return true;
    }

    std::string FormatNrFormats(const VimOptions& o)
    {
        std::string out;
        const auto add = [&out](bool on, std::string_view name) {
            if (!on) return;
            if (!out.empty()) out.push_back(',');
            out += name;
        };
        add(o.nrBin, "bin");
        add(o.nrOctal, "octal");
        add(o.nrHex, "hex");
        add(o.nrAlpha, "alpha");
        return out;
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimLanguage.hpp
#pragma once

// What the vim layer takes from the document's grammar (spec s6.3 gc, s6.5
// [K], s11.3): comment tokens, the wordChars class body, and the indent rules
// `=` uses. Plain Text = the defaults (no comment, ASCII word chars). The
// source is TE3-7's GrammarDesc -- the parsed description, no compile needed;
// the CompiledGrammar overload reads the description its rules were built from.

#include <string>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct GrammarDesc;
    class CompiledGrammar;

    struct VimLanguage
    {
        std::string name = "Plain Text";
        std::string wordChars = "A-Za-z0-9_";
        std::string lineComment;
        std::string blockCommentBegin, blockCommentEnd;
        std::string indentIncrease, indentDecrease;   // PCRE2 sources; empty = none
    };

    [[nodiscard]] VimLanguage VimLanguageFromGrammar(const GrammarDesc& desc);
    [[nodiscard]] VimLanguage VimLanguageFromGrammar(const CompiledGrammar& grammar);   // = (grammar.Rules().Desc())
    // Neovim's padded commentstring for this language: "// %s", "/* %s */", or "" (none).
    [[nodiscard]] std::string VimCommentString(const VimLanguage& language);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimLanguage.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimLanguage.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Syntax/Grammar.hpp"   // GrammarDesc (TE3-7), CompiledGrammar::Rules().Desc() (TE3-8)

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    VimLanguage VimLanguageFromGrammar(const GrammarDesc& desc)
    {
        VimLanguage out;
        if (!desc.name.empty()) out.name = desc.name;
        if (!desc.wordChars.empty()) out.wordChars = desc.wordChars;
        out.lineComment = desc.lineComment;
        out.blockCommentBegin = desc.blockCommentBegin;
        out.blockCommentEnd = desc.blockCommentEnd;
        out.indentIncrease = desc.indentIncrease;
        out.indentDecrease = desc.indentDecrease;
        return out;
    }

    VimLanguage VimLanguageFromGrammar(const CompiledGrammar& grammar)
    {
        return VimLanguageFromGrammar(grammar.Rules().Desc());
    }

    std::string VimCommentString(const VimLanguage& language)
    {
        if (!language.lineComment.empty()) return language.lineComment + " %s";
        if (!language.blockCommentBegin.empty() && !language.blockCommentEnd.empty())
            return language.blockCommentBegin + " %s " + language.blockCommentEnd;
        return {};
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCharClass.hpp
#pragma once

// Vim's character classes for word motions and \k (spec s6.5, s11.3): a port
// of Neovim's utf_class() (mbyte.c utf_class_tab, finding 5a.5). Class 0 is a
// blank (space, tab, line end, NUL, NBSP, U+1680, U+2000..U+200B, U+2028/9,
// U+202F, U+205F, U+3000), 1 punctuation, 2 a word character, 3 an emoji, and
// some scripts have their own class value (0x3040 Hiragana, 0x30A0 Katakana,
// 0x4E00 CJK ideographs, 0xAC00 Hangul, 0x2070 superscripts, 0x2080
// subscripts, 0x2800 braille), so `w` stops where the script changes.
//   - ASCII: the grammar's wordChars (Neovim's 'iskeyword' aligned to it);
//   - Latin-1: Neovim's default 'iskeyword' @,48-57,_,192-255 (µ and
//     U+00C0..U+00FF are word characters, the rest punctuation);
//   - above U+00FF: emoji -> 3; a row of the utf_class table -> its class;
//     anything else -> 2.
// IsWord is vim_iswordc: Class(cp) >= 2. PcreClass is generated from the same
// tables, so a \k search agrees with w. No PCRE2 probe and no Unicode tables
// beyond Neovim's own two: the class is a plain copyable value.

#include <bitset>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    // Neovim's utf_class() for cp >= 0x100 (no 'iskeyword' involved above Latin-1).
    [[nodiscard]] int VimUnicodeClass(char32_t cp);

    class VimCharClass
    {
    public:
        explicit VimCharClass(std::string_view wordChars = "A-Za-z0-9_");

        [[nodiscard]] int Class(char32_t cp, bool bigWord) const;
        [[nodiscard]] bool IsWord(char32_t cp) const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::string PcreClass() const;          // [K]: a positive bracket expression
        [[nodiscard]] std::string PcreClassNoDigits() const;  // [K] minus the ASCII digits (vim \K, \I)

    private:
        [[nodiscard]] std::string AsciiMembers(bool withDigits) const;

        std::bitset<128> m_ascii;
    };
}
```

```cpp
            { 0x1f93c, 0x1f945 }, { 0x1f947, 0x1f9ff }, { 0x1fa70, 0x1fa7c }, { 0x1fa80, 0x1fa8a }, { 0x1fa8e, 0x1fac6 }, { 0x1fac8, 0x1fac8 },

        template <class Row, std::size_t N>
        const Row* FindRow(const Row (&table)[N], char32_t cp)
        {
            const Row* it = std::upper_bound(std::begin(table), std::end(table), cp,
                                             [](char32_t c, const Row& r) { return c < r.first; });
            if (it == std::begin(table)) return nullptr;
            const Row* row = std::prev(it);
            return cp <= row->last ? row : nullptr;
        }

        void AppendCodePoint(std::string& out, char32_t lo, char32_t hi)
        {
            out += std::format("\\x{{{:x}}}", static_cast<std::uint32_t>(lo));
            if (hi > lo) out += std::format("-\\x{{{:x}}}", static_cast<std::uint32_t>(hi));
        }

        // The keyword members above U+007F as a bracket-expression body: Latin-1's iskeyword
        // part, then every code point above U+00FF whose class is >= 2 (the complement of the
        // class 0/1 rows, with the emoji inside those rows put back, and no surrogates).
        const std::string& NonAsciiMembers()
        {
            static const std::string s_body = [] {
                std::vector<CodeRange> gaps;
                for (const ClassRow& row : kClasses)
                {
                    if (row.cls > 1) continue;
                    char32_t from = row.first;
                    for (const CodeRange& e : kEmoji)
                    {
                        if (e.last < from || e.first > row.last) continue;
                        if (e.first > from) gaps.push_back(CodeRange{ from, e.first - 1 });
                        from = e.last + 1;
                    }
                    if (from <= row.last) gaps.push_back(CodeRange{ from, row.last });
                }
                gaps.push_back(CodeRange{ 0xD800, 0xDFFF });
                std::sort(gaps.begin(), gaps.end(), [](const CodeRange& a, const CodeRange& b) { return a.first < b.first; });
                std::string body;
                AppendCodePoint(body, 0xB5, 0xB5);
                AppendCodePoint(body, 0xC0, 0xFF);
                char32_t next = 0x100;
                for (const CodeRange& g : gaps)
                {
                    if (g.first > next) AppendCodePoint(body, next, g.first - 1);
                    next = std::max(next, g.last + 1);
                }
                if (next <= 0x10FFFF) AppendCodePoint(body, next, 0x10FFFF);
                return body;
            }();
            return s_body;
        }
    }

    int VimUnicodeClass(char32_t cp)
    {
        if (FindRow(kEmoji, cp)) return 3;
        if (const ClassRow* row = FindRow(kClasses, cp)) return row->cls;
        return 2;
    }

    VimCharClass::VimCharClass(std::string_view body)
    {
        const auto set = [this](char32_t lo, char32_t hi) {
            for (char32_t c = lo; c <= hi && c < 128; ++c) m_ascii.set(c);
        };
        std::size_t i = 0;
        while (i < body.size())
        {
            char32_t c = static_cast<unsigned char>(body[i]);
            if (c == '\\' && i + 1 < body.size())
            {
                const char e = body[i + 1];
                i += 2;
                if (e == 'd') { set('0', '9'); continue; }
                if (e == 'w') { set('0', '9'); set('A', 'Z'); set('a', 'z'); set('_', '_'); continue; }
                c = static_cast<unsigned char>(e);
            }
            else
                ++i;
            if (i + 1 < body.size() && body[i] == '-')
            {
                char32_t hi = static_cast<unsigned char>(body[i + 1]);
                std::size_t step = 2;
                if (hi == '\\' && i + 2 < body.size()) { hi = static_cast<unsigned char>(body[i + 2]); step = 3; }
                set(c, hi);
                i += step;
                continue;
            }
            if (c < 128) m_ascii.set(c);
        }
    }

    int VimCharClass::Class(char32_t cp, bool bigWord) const
    {
        int cls = 0;
        if (cp < 0x80)
            cls = (cp == 0 || cp == U' ' || cp == U'\t' || cp == U'\n') ? 0 : (m_ascii.test(cp) ? 2 : 1);
        else if (cp < 0x100)
            cls = cp == 0xA0 ? 0 : ((cp == 0xB5 || cp >= 0xC0) ? 2 : 1);   // Neovim's default iskeyword: @ and 192-255
        else
            cls = VimUnicodeClass(cp);
        return (bigWord && cls != 0) ? 1 : cls;                             // W, B, E: every non-blank is one class
    }

    bool VimCharClass::IsWord(char32_t cp) const { return Class(cp, false) >= 2; }   // vim_iswordc

    std::string VimCharClass::AsciiMembers(bool withDigits) const
    {
        std::string out;
        for (char32_t c = 0x21; c < 0x7F; ++c)
        {
            if (!m_ascii.test(c) || (!withDigits && c >= U'0' && c <= U'9')) continue;
            char32_t end = c;
            while (end + 1 < 0x7F && m_ascii.test(end + 1) && (withDigits || end + 1 < U'0' || end + 1 > U'9')) ++end;
            const auto emit = [&out](char32_t ch) {
                if (ch == U'\\' || ch == U']' || ch == U'[' || ch == U'^' || ch == U'-') out.push_back('\\');
                out.push_back(static_cast<char>(ch));
            };
            emit(c);
            if (end >= c + 2) { out.push_back('-'); emit(end); c = end; }
            else if (end == c + 1) { emit(end); c = end; }
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::string VimCharClass::PcreClass() const { return "[" + AsciiMembers(true) + NonAsciiMembers() + "]"; }
    std::string VimCharClass::PcreClassNoDigits() const { return "[" + AsciiMembers(false) + NonAsciiMembers() + "]"; }
}
```

  - `enum class VimCmdKind`, `enum class VimArgKind { None, Literal, Name }`, `enum class VimModeBits`, `enum class VimMotionId`, `enum class VimOperatorId`, `enum class VimObjectId`, `enum class VimActionId` (full lists below; every id is implemented by the task the comment names).
  - `struct VimBinding { keys, modes, kind, id, inner, arg }`, `std::span<const VimBinding> VimBindings()`, `const std::vector<std::vector<VimKey>>& VimBindingKeys()` (parsed once, same order).
  - `struct VimParsed { count, reg, op, linewiseDouble, kind, id, inner, arg, keys; Count1(); Has(); template Id<E>(); }`, `enum class VimParseStatus { NeedMore, Complete, Invalid }`, `class VimCommandParser { Feed(const VimKey&, VimMode); Result(); Reset(); Idle(); OperatorPending(); AwaitingLiteral(); AwaitingName(); PendingText(); }` (D-R15: `AwaitingLiteral` = a LITERAL argument of `f t F T r` is pending -- command mode OFF; `AwaitingName` = a NAME argument of `m ' `` ` `` q @`, Ctrl-W's command, or the register after `"` is pending -- command mode stays ON).

Vim's built-in keys are prefix-free, so the parser resolves as soon as a full binding matches; ambiguity only arises with remaps (the TE5d trie). The table is the s6.3 coverage as data; the s6.6 Ctrl chord rows are in it too, and TE5a-20 decides per mode whether vim claims a chord at all (`handleCtrlKeys`).

**Declared Visual divergences (finding 5a.6).** Neovim 0.10+ ships default Visual mappings that this table does not reproduce: `x *` / `x #` search for the SELECTED text (`:h v_star-default`), and `x @{reg}` / `x Q` run a macro on every selected line (`:h v_@-default`, `:'<,'>normal! @{reg}`). Arcane keeps classic vim: Visual `*`/`#` (and `g*`/`g#`) are the word-under-cursor search motions, which extend the selection; `@` and `Q` are Normal-only rows, so in Visual they are an invalid command (beep, selection kept). Both are rows of the help page's divergence list -- `VimDivergences()` (TE5c-16) gains `"Visual * and #"` and `"Visual @ and Q"` (recorded as CROSS-CHUNK for TE5c-16) -- and a parser test pins the behaviour here. The oracle never sees them: no `.vimcases` case uses Visual `*`, `#`, `@` or `Q`.

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimCommandParserTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCommandParser.hpp"

#include <set>
#include <string>

using namespace Arcane::Text;

namespace
{
    VimParseStatus FeedAll(VimCommandParser& p, std::string_view notation, VimMode mode = VimMode::Normal)
    {
        VimParseStatus s = VimParseStatus::NeedMore;
        for (const VimKey& k : *ParseKeys(notation))
        {
            s = p.Feed(k, mode);
            if (s != VimParseStatus::NeedMore) break;
        }
        return s;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim grammar: effective count = pre x post", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    VimCommandParser p;
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "2d3w") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    const VimParsed& r = p.Result();
    CHECK(r.count == 6u);
    REQUIRE(r.op.has_value());
    CHECK(*r.op == VimOperatorId::Delete);
    CHECK(r.kind == VimCmdKind::Motion);
    CHECK(r.Id<VimMotionId>() == VimMotionId::WordFwd);
    CHECK(FormatKeys(r.keys) == "2d3w");
}

TEST_CASE("vim grammar: doubled operators are linewise on the current line", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    for (const char* keys : { "dd", "yy", "cc", ">>", "<<", "==", "gUU", "gUgU", "guu", "g~~", "gcc" })
    {
        VimCommandParser p;
        INFO(keys);
        REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, keys) == VimParseStatus::Complete);
        CHECK(p.Result().linewiseDouble);
        CHECK(p.Result().kind == VimCmdKind::Operator);
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim grammar: register prefix, counts around it, black hole", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    VimCommandParser p;
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "\"a2yy") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().reg == U'a');
    CHECK(p.Result().count == 2u);
    CHECK(*p.Result().op == VimOperatorId::Yank);
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "3\"_dd") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().reg == U'_');
    CHECK(p.Result().count == 3u);
}

TEST_CASE("vim grammar: 0 is a motion unless a count is being typed", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    VimCommandParser p;
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "0") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimMotionId>() == VimMotionId::LineStart);
    CHECK(p.Result().count == 0u);
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "100G") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().count == 100u);
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimMotionId>() == VimMotionId::FileEnd);
}

TEST_CASE("vim grammar: literal and name arguments", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    VimCommandParser p;
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "d2f") == VimParseStatus::NeedMore);
    CHECK(p.AwaitingLiteral());                          // f's character is LITERAL text: command mode off (D-R15)
    CHECK_FALSE(p.AwaitingName());
    CHECK(p.OperatorPending());
    CHECK(p.PendingText() == "d2f");
    REQUIRE(p.Feed(VimKey::Char(U'é'), VimMode::Normal) == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().arg == U'é');
    CHECK(p.Result().count == 2u);
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "ma") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimActionId>() == VimActionId::SetMark);
    CHECK(p.Result().arg == U'a');
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "m") == VimParseStatus::NeedMore);
    CHECK_FALSE(p.AwaitingLiteral());                    // a mark NAME, not a literal ...
    CHECK(p.AwaitingName());                             // ... so command mode stays on: Latin names on any layout (D-R15, s5.5)
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "\"") == VimParseStatus::NeedMore);
    CHECK(p.AwaitingName());                             // the register name after "
    CHECK_FALSE(p.AwaitingLiteral());
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "q") == VimParseStatus::NeedMore);
    CHECK(p.AwaitingName());                             // q{reg}, @{reg}: names too
    p.Reset();
    CHECK_FALSE(p.AwaitingName());
    CHECK_FALSE(p.AwaitingLiteral());
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "<C-w>v") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimActionId>() == VimActionId::WindowCommand);
    CHECK(p.Result().arg == U'v');
}

TEST_CASE("vim grammar: text objects only after an operator or in Visual", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    VimCommandParser p;
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "gUiw") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(*p.Result().op == VimOperatorId::Upper);
    CHECK(p.Result().kind == VimCmdKind::TextObject);
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimObjectId>() == VimObjectId::Word);
    CHECK(p.Result().inner);
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "a(", VimMode::Visual) == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimObjectId>() == VimObjectId::Paren);
    CHECK_FALSE(p.Result().inner);
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "i") == VimParseStatus::Complete);   // Normal: i is Insert, never a text-object prefix
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimActionId>() == VimActionId::InsertBefore);
}

TEST_CASE("vim grammar: an operator in Visual applies at once; mode-specific keys", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    VimCommandParser p;
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "d", VimMode::Visual) == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().kind == VimCmdKind::Operator);
    CHECK_FALSE(p.Result().linewiseDouble);
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "u", VimMode::VisualLine) == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().kind == VimCmdKind::Operator);
    CHECK(*p.Result().op == VimOperatorId::Lower);
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "u") == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimActionId>() == VimActionId::Undo);
}

TEST_CASE("vim grammar: the declared Visual divergences -- * # keep vim's word search; @ Q are Normal only (5a.6)", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    // Neovim 0.10+ maps Visual * / # to "search for the selection" and Visual @ / Q to
    // ":'<,'>normal @r". Arcane keeps classic vim here; both are VimDivergences() rows (TE5c-16).
    VimCommandParser p;
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "*", VimMode::Visual) == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().kind == VimCmdKind::Motion);
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimMotionId>() == VimMotionId::SearchWordFwd);   // extends the selection to the next word match
    p.Reset();
    REQUIRE(FeedAll(p, "#", VimMode::VisualLine) == VimParseStatus::Complete);
    CHECK(p.Result().Id<VimMotionId>() == VimMotionId::SearchWordBack);
    p.Reset();
    CHECK(FeedAll(p, "@a", VimMode::Visual) == VimParseStatus::Invalid);   // beeps, the selection stays
    p.Reset();
    CHECK(FeedAll(p, "Q", VimMode::VisualBlock) == VimParseStatus::Invalid);
}

TEST_CASE("vim grammar: invalid sequences and Esc cancel", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    VimCommandParser p;
    CHECK(FeedAll(p, "dx") == VimParseStatus::Invalid);
    p.Reset();
    CHECK(FeedAll(p, "d<Esc>") == VimParseStatus::Invalid);
    p.Reset();
    CHECK(FeedAll(p, "dc") == VimParseStatus::Invalid);     // an operator inside a pending operator
    p.Reset();
    CHECK(p.Idle());
}

TEST_CASE("vim key table: every row parses and no full binding is a prefix of another in the same mode", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    const auto bindings = VimBindings();
    const auto& keys = VimBindingKeys();
    REQUIRE(keys.size() == bindings.size());
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < bindings.size(); ++i)
    {
        INFO(std::string(bindings[i].keys));
        REQUIRE_FALSE(keys[i].empty());
        for (std::size_t j = 0; j < bindings.size(); ++j)
        {
            if (i == j || (static_cast<unsigned>(bindings[i].modes) & static_cast<unsigned>(bindings[j].modes)) == 0) continue;
            if (keys[j].size() <= keys[i].size()) continue;
            const bool prefix = std::equal(keys[i].begin(), keys[i].end(), keys[j].begin());
            INFO("prefix of " << std::string(bindings[j].keys));
            CHECK_FALSE(prefix);
        }
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim modes: nvim_get_mode codes and status labels", "[text-vim-parser]")
{
    CHECK(VimModeCode(VimMode::Normal) == "n");
    CHECK(VimModeCode(VimMode::VisualBlock) == "^V");
    CHECK(VimModeCode(VimMode::OperatorPending) == "no");
    CHECK(std::string(VimModeLabel(VimMode::VisualLine)) == "VISUAL LINE");
    CHECK(IsVisual(VimMode::VisualBlock));
    CHECK_FALSE(IsVisual(VimMode::OperatorPending));
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCommand.hpp
#pragma once

// Vim's command vocabulary (spec s6.2, s6.3). Every id here is implemented by
// the task named in its comment; the key table (VimKeymap.cpp) maps key
// sequences to these ids per mode.

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimKey.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class VimMode : std::uint8_t { Normal, Insert, Replace, Visual, VisualLine, VisualBlock, OperatorPending, CommandLine };

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool IsVisual(VimMode m) noexcept
    {
        return m == VimMode::Visual || m == VimMode::VisualLine || m == VimMode::VisualBlock;
    }
    [[nodiscard]] std::string_view VimModeCode(VimMode m) noexcept;   // nvim_get_mode() codes: n i R v V ^V no c
    [[nodiscard]] const char* VimModeLabel(VimMode m) noexcept;       // "NORMAL", "INSERT", "VISUAL LINE", ...

    enum class VimCmdKind : std::uint8_t { Motion, Operator, TextObject, Action };
    enum class VimArgKind : std::uint8_t { None, Literal, Name };   // Literal: f t r (layout characters); Name: marks, registers, macros, Ctrl-W

    enum class VimModeBits : std::uint8_t { None = 0, Normal = 1, Visual = 2, OpPending = 4 };
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr VimModeBits operator|(VimModeBits a, VimModeBits b) noexcept
    {
        return static_cast<VimModeBits>(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(a) | static_cast<std::uint8_t>(b));
    }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool Any(VimModeBits a, VimModeBits b) noexcept
    {
        return (static_cast<std::uint8_t>(a) & static_cast<std::uint8_t>(b)) != 0;
    }

    enum class VimMotionId : std::uint16_t
    {
        Left, Right, Down, Up, DisplayDown, DisplayUp,                                    // TE5a-8
        LineStart, FirstNonBlank, LineEnd, LastNonBlank, FileStart, FileEnd, Column,      // TE5a-8
        FirstNonBlankDown, FirstNonBlankUp, CurrentLine,                                  // TE5a-8
        WordFwd, BigWordFwd, WordBack, BigWordBack, WordEnd, BigWordEnd,                  // TE5a-9
        WordEndBack, BigWordEndBack,                                                      // TE5a-9
        FindFwd, FindBack, TillFwd, TillBack, RepeatFind, RepeatFindReverse,              // TE5a-10
        MatchPair, SentenceBack, SentenceFwd, ParagraphBack, ParagraphFwd,                // TE5a-10
        ScreenTop, ScreenMiddle, ScreenBottom,                                            // TE5a-11
        SearchFwd, SearchBack, SearchNext, SearchPrev,                                    // TE5c-5
        SearchWordFwd, SearchWordBack, SearchPartialFwd, SearchPartialBack,               // TE5c-5
        MarkExact, MarkLine,                                                              // TE5b-6
        FoldNext, FoldPrev,                                                               // TE5c-15
    };

    enum class VimOperatorId : std::uint8_t
    {
        Delete, Change, Yank,                                  // TE5a-12
        IndentRight, IndentLeft, Reindent,                     // TE5a-13
        ToggleCase, Lower, Upper,                              // TE5a-13
        Comment,                                               // TE5a-14
        Fold,                                                  // TE5c-15
    };

    enum class VimObjectId : std::uint8_t
    {
        Word, BigWord, Sentence, Paragraph,                    // TE5a-16
        DoubleQuote, SingleQuote, BackQuote,                   // TE5a-17
        Paren, Brace, Bracket, Angle, Tag,                     // TE5a-17
    };

    enum class VimActionId : std::uint16_t
    {
        InsertBefore, Append, InsertFirstNonBlank, InsertColumnZero, AppendLineEnd, OpenBelow, OpenAbove,   // TE5a-5
        InsertAtLastInsert,                                                                                 // TE5b-6
        DeleteChar, DeleteCharBack, DeleteToEol, ChangeToEol, SubstituteChar, SubstituteLine, YankLine,     // TE5a-12
        PutAfter, PutBefore, PutAfterMoveCursor, PutBeforeMoveCursor,                                       // TE5a-12
        JoinLines, JoinLinesNoSpace, ToggleCaseChar,                                                        // TE5a-13
        Increment, Decrement,                                                                               // TE5a-15
        ScrollHalfDown, ScrollHalfUp, ScrollPageDown, ScrollPageUp, ScrollLineDown, ScrollLineUp,           // TE5a-11
        ScrollCenter, ScrollTop, ScrollBottom,                                                              // TE5a-11
        VisualChar, VisualLine, VisualBlock, VisualSwapEnds, VisualSwapCorner, ReselectVisual,              // TE5a-18
        VisualInsert, VisualAppend, VisualDeleteLines, VisualYankLines, VisualChangeLines,                  // TE5a-18
        ReplaceChar, ReplaceMode,                                                                           // TE5a-19
        WindowCommand,                                                                                      // TE5a-20
        AddNextMatch,                                                                                       // TE5a-21
        Undo, Redo, RepeatChange, RecordMacro, RunMacro, RunLastRecorded,                                   // TE5b-3/4/5
        SetMark, JumpOlder, JumpNewer, ChangeOlder, ChangeNewer,                                            // TE5b-6/8
        EnterExCommand, RepeatSubstitute, WriteQuit, QuitDiscard,                                           // TE5c-6/8/13
        FoldClose, FoldOpen, FoldToggle, FoldOpenAll, FoldCloseAll, FoldDelete,                             // TE5c-15
    };

    struct VimBinding
    {
        std::string_view keys;
        VimModeBits      modes = VimModeBits::None;
        VimCmdKind       kind = VimCmdKind::Action;
        std::uint16_t    id = 0;
        bool             inner = false;                 // text objects: i (true) / a (false)
        VimArgKind       arg = VimArgKind::None;
    };

    struct VimParsed
    {
        std::uint32_t                count = 0;         // effective (pre x post); 0 = none typed
        char32_t                     reg = 0;           // 0 = none
        std::optional<VimOperatorId> op;
        bool                         linewiseDouble = false;   // dd yy cc >> << == g~~ guu gUU gcc
        VimCmdKind                   kind = VimCmdKind::Action;
        std::uint16_t                id = 0;
        bool                         inner = false;
        char32_t                     arg = 0;
        std::vector<VimKey>          keys;              // every key of the command (status strip, dot-repeat)

        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t Count1() const { return count == 0 ? 1u : count; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool Has(VimActionId a) const { return kind == VimCmdKind::Action && id == static_cast<std::uint16_t>(a); }
        template <class E> [[nodiscard]] E Id() const { return static_cast<E>(id); }
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimKeymap.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimKeymap.hpp"

#include <array>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        constexpr VimModeBits N = VimModeBits::Normal;
        constexpr VimModeBits V = VimModeBits::Visual;
        constexpr VimModeBits O = VimModeBits::OpPending;
        constexpr VimModeBits NV = N | V;
        constexpr VimModeBits NVO = N | V | O;
        constexpr VimModeBits VO = V | O;

        constexpr VimBinding M(std::string_view k, VimModeBits m, VimMotionId id, VimArgKind arg = VimArgKind::None)
        {
            return VimBinding{ k, m, VimCmdKind::Motion, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(id), false, arg };
        }
        constexpr VimBinding Op(std::string_view k, VimModeBits m, VimOperatorId id)
        {
            return VimBinding{ k, m, VimCmdKind::Operator, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(id), false, VimArgKind::None };
        }
        constexpr VimBinding I(std::string_view k, VimObjectId id) { return VimBinding{ k, VO, VimCmdKind::TextObject, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(id), true, VimArgKind::None }; }
        constexpr VimBinding A(std::string_view k, VimObjectId id) { return VimBinding{ k, VO, VimCmdKind::TextObject, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(id), false, VimArgKind::None }; }
        constexpr VimBinding Act(std::string_view k, VimModeBits m, VimActionId id, VimArgKind arg = VimArgKind::None)
        {
            return VimBinding{ k, m, VimCmdKind::Action, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(id), false, arg };
        }

            // ---- motions (Normal, Visual, operator-pending) ----

    std::span<const VimBinding> VimBindings() { return kTable; }

    const std::vector<std::vector<VimKey>>& VimBindingKeys()
    {
        static const std::vector<std::vector<VimKey>> s_keys = [] {
            std::vector<std::vector<VimKey>> out;
            out.reserve(kTable.size());
            for (const VimBinding& b : kTable) out.push_back(ParseKeys(b.keys).value_or(std::vector<VimKey>{}));
            return out;
        }();
        return s_keys;
    }

    std::string_view VimModeCode(VimMode m) noexcept
    {
        switch (m)
        {
        case VimMode::Normal:          return "n";
        case VimMode::Insert:          return "i";
        case VimMode::Replace:         return "R";
        case VimMode::Visual:          return "v";
        case VimMode::VisualLine:      return "V";
        case VimMode::VisualBlock:     return "^V";
        case VimMode::OperatorPending: return "no";
        case VimMode::CommandLine:     return "c";
        }
        return "n";
    }

    const char* VimModeLabel(VimMode m) noexcept
    {
        switch (m)
        {
        case VimMode::Normal:          return "NORMAL";
        case VimMode::Insert:          return "INSERT";
        case VimMode::Replace:         return "REPLACE";
        case VimMode::Visual:          return "VISUAL";
        case VimMode::VisualLine:      return "VISUAL LINE";
        case VimMode::VisualBlock:     return "VISUAL BLOCK";
        case VimMode::OperatorPending: return "O-PENDING";
        case VimMode::CommandLine:     return "COMMAND";
        }
        return "NORMAL";
    }
}
```
