```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCommandParser.hpp
#pragma once

// [count]["reg][count]operator[count]{motion | textobject} or [count]action
// (spec s6.2). Effective count = pre x post. Built-in keys are prefix-free, so
// a full match resolves at once; Esc or an unknown key is Invalid.

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCommand.hpp"

#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class VimParseStatus : std::uint8_t { NeedMore, Complete, Invalid };

    class VimCommandParser
    {
    public:
        // `mode`: Normal, or a Visual mode (operator-pending is the parser's own state).
        VimParseStatus Feed(const VimKey& key, VimMode mode);
        [[nodiscard]] const VimParsed& Result() const { return m_parsed; }
        void Reset();
        [[nodiscard]] bool Idle() const { return m_parsed.keys.empty(); }
        [[nodiscard]] bool OperatorPending() const { return m_parsed.op.has_value() && !m_complete; }
        // D-R15 (TE5a-5's Keyboard()): a LITERAL argument (f t F T r) is layout text -- command mode is
        // OFF while it waits, so a dead key composes (f ^ e is fê). A NAME argument (m ' ` q @, Ctrl-W's
        // command, the register after `"`) keeps command mode ON: spec s5.5 makes names Latin on any layout.
        [[nodiscard]] bool AwaitingLiteral() const { return m_state == State::Arg && m_argKind == VimArgKind::Literal; }
        [[nodiscard]] bool AwaitingName() const
        {
            return (m_state == State::Arg && m_argKind == VimArgKind::Name) || m_state == State::Register;
        }
        [[nodiscard]] std::string PendingText() const { return FormatKeys(m_parsed.keys); }

    private:
        enum class State : std::uint8_t { Start, Register, Arg };
        [[nodiscard]] bool IsDoubled() const;
        VimParseStatus Finish();

        State               m_state = State::Start;
        VimArgKind          m_argKind = VimArgKind::None;
        VimParsed           m_parsed;
        std::uint32_t       m_count1 = 0, m_count2 = 0;
        std::vector<VimKey> m_seq;      // keys of the binding being matched
        std::vector<VimKey> m_opKeys;   // the pending operator's own keys
        bool                m_complete = false;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCommandParser.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCommandParser.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimKeymap.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        ARC_CONSTANT("vim behaviour: a typed count saturates at 999999999 (normal.c)")
        constexpr std::uint32_t kMaxCount = 999999999u;

        std::uint32_t Saturate(std::uint64_t v) { return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::min<std::uint64_t>(v, kMaxCount)); }

        bool IsRegisterName(char32_t c)
        {
            if ((c >= U'a' && c <= U'z') || (c >= U'A' && c <= U'Z') || (c >= U'0' && c <= U'9')) return true;
            return c == U'"' || c == U'-' || c == U'_' || c == U'+' || c == U'*' || c == U'/' || c == U':' || c == U'.' || c == U'%';
        }
    }

    void VimCommandParser::Reset()
    {
        m_state = State::Start;
        m_argKind = VimArgKind::None;
        m_parsed = VimParsed{};
        m_count1 = m_count2 = 0;
        m_seq.clear();
        m_opKeys.clear();
        m_complete = false;
    }

    bool VimCommandParser::IsDoubled() const
    {
        if (m_seq == m_opKeys) return true;
        // gUU, guu, g~~, gcc: the operator's last key repeated
        return m_opKeys.size() == 2 && m_opKeys[0] == VimKey::Char(U'g') && m_seq.size() == 1 && m_seq[0] == m_opKeys[1];
    }

    VimParseStatus VimCommandParser::Finish()
    {
        if (m_count1 != 0 || m_count2 != 0)
            m_parsed.count = Saturate(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(m_count1 == 0 ? 1 : m_count1) * (m_count2 == 0 ? 1 : m_count2));
        m_complete = true;
        return VimParseStatus::Complete;
    }

    VimParseStatus VimCommandParser::Feed(const VimKey& key, VimMode mode)
    {
        if (m_complete) Reset();
        m_parsed.keys.push_back(key);
        if (key.IsEsc()) return VimParseStatus::Invalid;

        if (m_state == State::Register)
        {
            if (!key.IsChar() || !IsRegisterName(key.ch)) return VimParseStatus::Invalid;
            m_parsed.reg = key.ch;
            m_state = State::Start;
            return VimParseStatus::NeedMore;
        }
        if (m_state == State::Arg)
        {
            if (!key.IsChar()) return VimParseStatus::Invalid;
            m_parsed.arg = key.ch;
            return Finish();
        }

        const bool visual = IsVisual(mode);
        if (m_seq.empty() && key.IsChar() && key.ch >= U'0' && key.ch <= U'9')
        {
            std::uint32_t& count = m_parsed.op ? m_count2 : m_count1;
            if (key.ch != U'0' || count != 0)
            {
                count = Saturate(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(count) * 10u + (key.ch - U'0'));
                return VimParseStatus::NeedMore;
            }
        }
        if (m_seq.empty() && !m_parsed.op && key == VimKey::Char(U'"'))
        {
            m_state = State::Register;
            return VimParseStatus::NeedMore;
        }

        m_seq.push_back(key);
        if (m_parsed.op && IsDoubled())
        {
            m_parsed.kind = VimCmdKind::Operator;
            m_parsed.linewiseDouble = true;
            return Finish();
        }

        const VimModeBits bits = m_parsed.op ? VimModeBits::OpPending : (visual ? VimModeBits::Visual : VimModeBits::Normal);
        const auto bindings = VimBindings();
        const auto& keys = VimBindingKeys();
        bool prefix = false;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < bindings.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (!Any(bindings[i].modes, bits)) continue;
            const std::vector<VimKey>& k = keys[i];
            if (k.size() < m_seq.size() || !std::equal(m_seq.begin(), m_seq.end(), k.begin())) continue;
            if (k.size() > m_seq.size()) { prefix = true; continue; }

            const VimBinding& b = bindings[i];
            if (b.kind == VimCmdKind::Operator && !visual)
            {
                if (m_parsed.op) return VimParseStatus::Invalid;      // "dc"
                m_parsed.op = static_cast<VimOperatorId>(b.id);
                m_opKeys = m_seq;
                m_seq.clear();
                return VimParseStatus::NeedMore;
            }
            m_parsed.kind = b.kind;
            m_parsed.id = b.id;
            m_parsed.inner = b.inner;
            if (b.kind == VimCmdKind::Operator) m_parsed.op = static_cast<VimOperatorId>(b.id);   // Visual: applies at once
            if (b.arg != VimArgKind::None)
            {
                m_state = State::Arg;
                m_argKind = b.arg;
                return VimParseStatus::NeedMore;
            }
            return Finish();
        }
        return prefix ? VimParseStatus::NeedMore : VimParseStatus::Invalid;
    }
}
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE5a-1..4 (`VimKey`, `VimText` incl. `VimText::SyncDisplay`, `VimCursorModel`, `VimOptions`, `VimLanguage`, `VimCharClass`, `VimCommandParser`, the id enums); TE1 `TextBuffer::BeginTransaction/EndTransaction/BreakUndoGroup`, `Anchor{offset, bias}`, `AnchorSet` (`AnchorSet::Id`, `Add(Anchor)`, `Get(id).offset`, `Remove`), `TextBuffer::RegisterAnchors/UnregisterAnchors`, the `TextCommands` class (`TextCommands(buffer, sels, ctx).SetSelections(next, primaryIndex)`, `.Undo()`, `.Redo()`), `Rope::FromUtf8`; TE2-11 + TE4-12 `Editor::TextModel` (`explicit TextModel(Text::Rope, Text::EolMap = {})`; members `buffer`, `selections`, `display`, `folds`, the fold edit observer `editSync`) and `Text::EditContext Editor::DefaultEditContext(TextModel&)` in `TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp` (ArcaneTests source-compiles `TextModel.cpp`).
- Produces (everything later TE5 tasks build on):
  - `VimHost.hpp`: `enum class VimCursorShape { Block, Bar, Underline }`, `struct VimKeyboardState { commandKeys, latinLetters, imeAllowed }`, `enum class VimFileCommand { Write, Quit, WriteQuit, WriteIfDirtyQuit, Edit, SaveAs, NextBuffer, PrevBuffer }`, `enum class VimWindowCommand { SplitHorizontal, SplitVertical, FocusLeft, FocusDown, FocusUp, FocusRight, FocusNext, Close }`, `struct VimHostResult { bool ok; std::string message; }`, `class IVimHost` (the s6.1 hooks `SetCursorShape/SetLineMode/SetInputEnabled/SetClipAtLineEnds`, `SetKeyboard`, `FirstVisibleRow/VisibleRows/ScrollToRow`, `ReadClipboard/WriteClipboard`, `ShowMessage/ShowListing`, `SetCommandLine`, `SetSearchHighlight`, `RunFileCommand/RunWindowCommand`, `ReadFileText`, `DocumentPath`, `BufferList`, `OpenAt`).
  - `VimGlobals.hpp`: `struct VimFindState { VimMotionId motion; char32_t ch; bool valid; }`, `struct VimGlobals { VimFindState lastFind; }`, `struct VimBufferState {}` (later passes add members).
  - `VimContext.hpp`: `struct VimContext { VimDoc& doc; IVimHost& host; VimGlobals& globals; VimBufferState& bufferState; const VimOptions& options; const VimLanguage& language; const VimCharClass& chars; VimMode mode; const Rope& Text() const; }`.
  - `VimState.hpp`: `struct VimKeyResult { bool handled = true; bool beeped = false; }`, `class VimState` with the public API `HandleKey(const VimKey&, double nowSeconds)`, `Tick(double)`, `OnInputHandled(std::string_view)`, `OnTransactionBegun()`, `OnTransactionUndone()`, `OnSelectionsChanged(bool byMouse)`, `InterruptInsertSession()`, `InsertTransactionOpen()`, `Mode()`, `PendingKeys()`, `Keyboard()`, `Cursors()`, `Options()`, `SetOptions(VimOptions)`, `Language()`, `SetLanguage(VimLanguage)`, `Context()`; private extension points `FeedResolved`, `HandleNormalOrVisual`, `HandleInsert`, `Execute`, `RunAction`, `BeginInsertSession`, `EndInsertSession`, `MarkInsertStart`, `CapturedInsertText`, `StartInsert`, `OpenLine`, `LeaveInsertMode`, `ResumeInsertSession`, `ApplyModeHooks`, `ClampCursors`, `ToVim`, `FromVim`, `Beep`, and members `m_doc, m_host, m_globals, m_bufferState, m_options, m_language, m_chars, m_mode, m_parser, m_insert, m_anchors, m_now, m_beeped`. `Beep()` sets `m_beeped`; `HandleKey` reports it in `VimKeyResult::beeped`. **The beep rule (D-R12, finding 5a.2):** a failed command flushes only NON-typed input -- the rest of a macro being executed, of a `:normal` argument, of a remap's expansion (TE5b/TE5c/TE5d feeders stop on `beeped`) -- and never typed keys: Neovim's `beep_flush()` calls `flush_buffers(FLUSH_MINIMAL)`, which drops mapped and stuffed typeahead only. The rig and the editor feed TYPED keys, so they keep feeding after a beep (`hl` at column 0 still moves right).
  - Test helpers `Arcane::Test::ParseVimMarked`, `FormatVimMarked` (renamed from `ParseMarked`/`FormatMarked` so TE1-14's `Arcane::Text::Test::{ParseMarked, FormatMarked}` keep their names, CANON B17), `FakeVimHost`, `enum class VimRigText { Bytes, VimLines, VimLinesNoEol }` (D-R14), `VimRig { VimRig(marked, language = {}, options = {}, sharedGlobals = nullptr, VimRigText = Bytes); Keys(notation); Marked(); MarkedLines(); Text(); Mode(); Wait(seconds); Globals(); Doc(); Commands(); model, buffer, selections, folds, display, context, host, bufferState, vim, now, beeps }`. `Bytes` (unit tests) builds the rope from the marked string exactly; `VimLines` reads it as Vim's lines with `'eol'` (rope = string + `"\n"`) and `VimLinesNoEol` as `'noeol'` (rope = string); `MarkedLines()` prints `VimLinesOf(rope)` (TE5a-2) joined by `"\n"` with the cursors -- what TE5a-6's `.vimcases` runner compares. The rig hosts an `Editor::TextModel` (CANON B23): `buffer`/`selections`/`folds`/`display` are references to the model's members, so the folds shift with edits through the model's own observer and the display is rebuilt by `VimText::SyncDisplay` exactly as in the editor; `context` is `Editor::DefaultEditContext(model)` and is the `VimDoc::context`.

Insert-mode text is typed by the view, not by vim: in Insert the view's input is enabled (`SetInputEnabled(true)`), `HandleKey` returns `handled = false` for a printable character, the view inserts it through its normal typing path, and tells vim with `OnInputHandled`. Vim owns every other Insert key (Esc, Enter with `autoindent`, Tab with `expandtab`/`smarttab`, Backspace with `backspace=indent,eol,start` + `smarttab`, Delete, arrows), so Neovim's insert rules hold. Autoindent copies the indent's WIDTH and rebuilds it with `expandtab`/`tabstop` (Neovim's `set_indent`, `'copyindent'` off): `O` on a tab-indented line under `expandtab` indents with spaces. Enter keeps the blanks before the split (only an untouched autoindent is removed, vim's `did_ai`) and drops the blanks after it (the moved text's leading white space). One insert session is one `BeginTransaction`/`EndTransaction` pair around everything typed (the `GroupUntil` of spec s3.3), so `u` (TE5b-3) undoes it in one step; arrow keys split it, as in vim (`:h ins-special-special`). The rig plays the view: it types unhandled printable characters at every cursor and calls `OnInputHandled`.

**The open insert transaction never meets an outside change (finding 5a.7).** TE1's `TextBuffer` refuses `AppendExternal`, `ReloadExternal`, `ConvertLineEndings` and `ClearHistory` inside a transaction (they assert in Debug), `Undo`/`Redo` are no-ops while one is open, and any other edit would merge into vim's undo step. So the session is interruptible: `InterruptInsertSession()` commits what was typed so far as its own undo step (`EndTransaction` + `BreakUndoGroup`, exactly what an arrow key does) and leaves vim in Insert with `m_insert.resume` set; the next vim key (or `OnInputHandled`) reopens a fresh transaction at the caret through `ResumeInsertSession()`. `OnTransactionBegun()` interrupts in Insert/Replace (an action row, a menu cut/paste); TE5a-22's adapter interrupts when its view loses keyboard focus, and `TextDocument::NotifyOutsideChange()` (TE2-15; TE5a-22 subscribes both views in `InitAfterLoad`) interrupts every view's session before the document's own changes: `SaveWith` and `SaveAs` (TE2-16), `ReloadFromDisk` and `ReopenWithEncoding` (TE2-15/17), `AppendTail` (Follow, TE2-17), `ConvertLineEndings` (TE4-19), and the shared Undo/Redo verbs. `InsertTransactionOpen()` lets those tests assert the invariant.

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimStateTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp"

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using Arcane::Test::VimRig;

TEST_CASE("vim state: each mode drives the s6.1 hooks and the s5.5 keyboard", "[text-vim-state]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "abc");
    CHECK(r.host.shape == VimCursorShape::Block);
    CHECK(r.host.clip);
    CHECK_FALSE(r.host.inputEnabled);
    CHECK(r.host.keyboard == VimKeyboardState{ true, true, false });   // dead keys bare, Latin letters, no IME

    r.Keys("i");
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Insert);
    CHECK(r.host.shape == VimCursorShape::Bar);
    CHECK(r.host.inputEnabled);
    CHECK_FALSE(r.host.clip);
    CHECK(r.host.keyboard == VimKeyboardState{ false, false, true });  // composition and IME in Insert

    r.Keys("<Esc>2d");
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::OperatorPending);
    CHECK(r.host.shape == VimCursorShape::Underline);
    CHECK(r.vim->PendingKeys() == "2d");
    r.Keys("f");
    CHECK(r.host.keyboard == VimKeyboardState{ false, false, false }); // f's LITERAL argument: dead keys compose, layout letters (D-R15, 5a.20)
    r.Keys("<Esc>");
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Normal);
    CHECK(r.vim->PendingKeys().empty());
    CHECK(r.Text() == "abc");
    r.Keys("m");
    CHECK(r.host.keyboard == VimKeyboardState{ true, true, false });   // a mark NAME: command mode stays on (D-R15)
    r.Keys("<Esc>\"");
    CHECK(r.host.keyboard == VimKeyboardState{ true, true, false });   // the register NAME after "
    r.Keys("<Esc>");
}

TEST_CASE("vim state: i a I gI A enter Insert where s6.1 says; Esc steps back", "[text-vim-state]")
{
    { VimRig r("  a\xCB\x87" "bc"); r.Keys("ix<Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "  a\xCB\x87" "xbc"); }
    { VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bc");   r.Keys("ax<Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "ab\xCB\x87" "xc"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "abc");   r.Keys("Ax<Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "abc\xCB\x87" "x"); }
    { VimRig r("  ab\xCB\x87" "c"); r.Keys("Ix<Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "  \xCB\x87" "xabc"); }
    { VimRig r("  a\xCB\x87" "b");  r.Keys("gIx<Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "x  ab"); }
}

TEST_CASE("vim state: o and O autoindent; an untouched autoindent is removed on Esc", "[text-vim-state]")
{
    { VimRig r("    f\xCB\x87" "oo\nbar"); r.Keys("ox<Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "    foo\n    \xCB\x87" "x\nbar"); }
    { VimRig r("    f\xCB\x87" "oo");      r.Keys("Ox<Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "    \xCB\x87" "x\n    foo"); }
    { VimRig r("    f\xCB\x87" "oo");      r.Keys("o<Esc>");  CHECK(r.Marked() == "    foo\n\xCB\x87"); }
    // autoindent copies the WIDTH and rebuilds it with expandtab (Neovim: 'copyindent' off)
    { VimRig r("x\n\tb\xCB\x87" "ar");     r.Keys("Oy<Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "x\n    \xCB\x87" "y\n\tbar"); }
    {
        VimOptions o;
        o.expandTab = false;
        VimRig r("    f\xCB\x87" "oo", {}, o);
        r.Keys("ox<Esc>");
        CHECK(r.Marked() == "    foo\n\t\xCB\x87" "x");                // noexpandtab: 4 columns = one tab (ts=4)
    }
    // D-R5: o on the last line of a file with a final newline adds a line before the end
    { VimRig r("a\nb\xCB\x87" "\n");       r.Keys("onew<Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\nb\nne\xCB\x87" "w\n"); }
}

TEST_CASE("vim state: Enter keeps the indent; Tab expands; Backspace removes a shiftwidth in the indent", "[text-vim-state]")
{
    { VimRig r("  ab\xCB\x87" "cd"); r.Keys("i<CR><Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "  ab\n \xCB\x87" " cd"); }
    { VimRig r("  ab \xCB\x87" " cd"); r.Keys("i<CR><Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "  ab \n \xCB\x87" " cd"); }   // blanks before the split stay
    { VimRig r("foo\xCB\x87" "  ");    r.Keys("A<CR>x<Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "foo  \n\xCB\x87" "x"); }    // typed trailing blanks stay
    { VimRig r("  a\xCB\x87" "b");     r.Keys("o<CR>x<Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "  ab\n\n  \xCB\x87" "x"); } // an untouched autoindent goes
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "ab");     r.Keys("i<Tab><Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "   \xCB\x87" " ab"); }
    {
        VimOptions o;
        o.expandTab = false;
        VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "ab", {}, o);
        r.Keys("i<Tab><Esc>");
        CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "\tab");
    }
    { VimRig r("        \xCB\x87" "x"); r.Keys("i<BS><Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "   \xCB\x87" " x"); }
    { VimRig r("a\n\xCB\x87" "b");      r.Keys("i<BS><Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "ab"); }   // backspace=eol
}

TEST_CASE("vim state: a count repeats the inserted text", "[text-vim-state]")
{
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87"); r.Keys("3ia<Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "aa\xCB\x87" "a"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "x"); r.Keys("2oab<Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "x\nab\na\xCB\x87" "b"); }

TEST_CASE("vim state: one insert session is one undo step; arrow keys split it", "[text-vim-state]")
{
    {
        VimRig r("\xCB\x87");
        r.Keys("iab<CR>cd<Esc>");
        CHECK(r.Text() == "ab\ncd");
        REQUIRE(r.Commands().Undo());
        CHECK(r.Text().empty());
    }
    {
        VimRig r("\xCB\x87");
        r.Keys("ia<Left>b<Esc>");
        CHECK(r.Text() == "ba");
        REQUIRE(r.Commands().Undo());
        CHECK(r.Text() == "a");
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim state: every cursor enters and leaves Insert", "[text-vim-state]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\n\xCB\x87" "b");
    r.Keys("ix<Esc>");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "xa\n\xCB\x87" "xb");
}

TEST_CASE("vim state: the rig's folds follow edits through the TextModel observer and HandleKey resyncs the display", "[text-vim-state]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc\nd");
    REQUIRE(r.folds.Fold(r.buffer.Text(), FoldRange{ 2, 3 }, FoldSource::Manual));   // hides "d"
    r.Keys("O<Esc>");                                    // a new first line moves the fold down one row
    const std::vector<FoldRange> folded = r.folds.Folded(r.buffer.Text());
    REQUIRE(folded.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(folded[0] == FoldRange{ 3, 4 });
    r.Keys("<Esc>");                                     // any key: HandleKey syncs the display first
    CHECK(r.display.IsHidden(4));
    CHECK_FALSE(r.display.IsHidden(3));
}

TEST_CASE("vim state: a mouse placement past the line end is clamped in Normal", "[text-vim-state]")

    std::vector<Selection> s{ Selection{ r.selections.AllocateId(), 3, 3, std::nullopt } };
    r.Commands().SetSelections(s, 0);
    r.vim->OnSelectionsChanged(true);
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "ab\xCB\x87" "c");
}

TEST_CASE("vim state: a failed command beeps; typed keys after it still run (beep_flush keeps typeahead, 5a.2)", "[text-vim-state]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "abc");
    r.Keys("dxiy<Esc>");                     // "dx" is invalid: one beep; i y <Esc> are typed keys and still run
    CHECK(r.beeps == 1u);
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "yabc");
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Normal);
}

TEST_CASE("vim rig: a Vim-lines string is the rope plus a final newline, or exactly the rope with eol off (D-R14)", "[text-vim-state]")
{
    using Arcane::Test::VimRigText;
    {
        VimRig r("a\n\xCB\x87" "b", {}, {}, nullptr, VimRigText::VimLines);
        CHECK(r.Text() == "a\nb\n");                               // Vim's 'eol': the rope ends with the terminator
        r.Keys("dd");
        CHECK(r.Text() == "a\n");                                  // D-R5: the last line goes with its terminator
        CHECK(r.MarkedLines() == "\xCB\x87" "a");
    }
    {
        VimRig r("a\n\xCB\x87" "b", {}, {}, nullptr, VimRigText::VimLinesNoEol);
        CHECK(r.Text() == "a\nb");                                 // 'noeol': exactly the string
        r.Keys("dd");
        CHECK(r.Text() == "a");                                    // the break before the last line goes
        CHECK(r.MarkedLines() == "\xCB\x87" "a");
    }
    {
        VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a", {}, {}, nullptr, VimRigText::VimLines);
        r.Keys("o<Esc>");
        CHECK(r.Text() == "a\n\n");                                // Vim's lines a, "": the empty last line is a real line
        CHECK(r.MarkedLines() == "a\n\xCB\x87");
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim state: an interrupted insert session commits what was typed and resumes (5a.7)", "[text-vim-state]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87");
    r.Keys("iab");
    REQUIRE(r.vim->InsertTransactionOpen());
    CHECK(r.buffer.InTransaction());
    r.vim->InterruptInsertSession();                         // what the adapter does before an outside change
    CHECK_FALSE(r.vim->InsertTransactionOpen());
    CHECK_FALSE(r.buffer.InTransaction());
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Insert);
    r.buffer.AppendExternal("!");                            // legal now: no transaction is open (Follow's append)
    CHECK(r.Text() == "ab!");
    r.Keys("c<Esc>");                                        // the next key reopens a session at the caret
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "ab\xCB\x87" "c!");   // "c" typed at the caret, before the appended "!"
    REQUIRE(r.Commands().Undo());                            // the resumed part is its own undo step ...
    CHECK(r.Text() == "ab!");
    REQUIRE(r.Commands().Undo());                            // ... and the part before the interruption another
    CHECK(r.Text() == "!");

    VimRig v("\xCB\x87" "x");
    v.Keys("iy");
    v.vim->OnTransactionBegun();                             // an action row / menu paste interrupts too
    CHECK_FALSE(v.buffer.InTransaction());
    CHECK(v.Mode() == VimMode::Insert);
    v.Keys("z<Esc>");
    CHECK(v.Text() == "yzx");
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimHost.hpp
#pragma once

// What the vim layer asks of the editor around it (spec s6.1): the four view
// hooks, the s5.5 keyboard state, the viewport in display rows, the clipboard,
// the message line / listing popups / command line, the search-match painter,
// and the document/window commands ex and Ctrl-W need. VimViewAdapter
// (TE5a-22) implements it over TextEditorView/TextDocument; tests use FakeVimHost.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class VimCursorShape : std::uint8_t { Block, Bar, Underline };

    struct VimKeyboardState
    {
        bool commandKeys = true;    // dead keys arrive bare and the layout's dead state is cleared
        bool latinLetters = true;   // letters come from the key's Latin letter (latinLettersInNormal)
        bool imeAllowed = false;    // the IME is off outside Insert/Replace/command line
        bool operator==(const VimKeyboardState&) const = default;
    };

    enum class VimFileCommand : std::uint8_t { Write, Quit, WriteQuit, WriteIfDirtyQuit, Edit, SaveAs, NextBuffer, PrevBuffer };
    enum class VimWindowCommand : std::uint8_t { SplitHorizontal, SplitVertical, FocusLeft, FocusDown, FocusUp, FocusRight, FocusNext, Close };

    struct VimHostResult
    {
        bool ok = true;
        std::string message;   // shown on the message line when not empty (an error when !ok)
    };

    class IVimHost
    {
    public:
        virtual ~IVimHost() = default;

        virtual void SetCursorShape(VimCursorShape shape) = 0;
        virtual void SetLineMode(bool linewise) = 0;
        virtual void SetInputEnabled(bool enabled) = 0;
        virtual void SetClipAtLineEnds(bool clip) = 0;
        virtual void SetKeyboard(const VimKeyboardState& state) = 0;

        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::uint32_t FirstVisibleRow() const = 0;   // display rows (DisplayMap)
        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::uint32_t VisibleRows() const = 0;
        virtual void ScrollToRow(std::uint32_t firstDisplayRow) = 0;

        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::string ReadClipboard() = 0;
        virtual void WriteClipboard(std::string_view text) = 0;

        virtual void ShowMessage(std::string_view text, bool isError) = 0;
        virtual void ShowListing(std::string_view title, std::span<const std::string> lines) = 0;
        virtual void SetCommandLine(std::string_view text, std::size_t cursorByte) = 0;   // empty = hidden
        virtual void SetSearchHighlight(std::string_view pcre2Pattern) = 0;                // empty = none

        virtual VimHostResult RunFileCommand(VimFileCommand command, std::string_view argument, bool bang) = 0;
        virtual VimHostResult RunWindowCommand(VimWindowCommand command) = 0;
        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::optional<std::string> ReadFileText(std::string_view path) = 0;
        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::string DocumentPath() const = 0;
        [[nodiscard]] virtual std::vector<std::string> BufferList() = 0;
        virtual bool OpenAt(std::string_view path, Point point) = 0;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp
#pragma once

// One VimState per TextEditorView while editor.text.vim.enabled is on (spec
// s6.1). It owns the mode, the command parser and the insert session; it
// changes text only through VimText (TextCommands) and talks to the editor only
// through IVimHost. With vim off no VimState exists and no vim code runs.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Anchor.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCommandParser.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimContext.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCursorModel.hpp"

#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimKeyResult
    {
        bool handled = true;   // false: the key falls through to the view (Insert text, unclaimed chords)
        // The command failed. Whoever feeds NON-typed keys (a macro being run, :normal, a remap's
        // expansion) drops the rest of them; typed keys keep running (Neovim's beep_flush ->
        // flush_buffers(FLUSH_MINIMAL) never drops typed input, D-R12).
        bool beeped = false;
    };

    class VimState
    {
    public:
        VimState(VimDoc doc, IVimHost& host, VimGlobals& globals, VimBufferState& bufferState,
                 VimOptions options = {}, VimLanguage language = {});
        ~VimState();
        VimState(const VimState&) = delete;
        VimState& operator=(const VimState&) = delete;

        VimKeyResult HandleKey(const VimKey& key, double nowSeconds);
        void Tick(double nowSeconds);
        void OnInputHandled(std::string_view text);   // the view typed `text` (Insert)
        void OnTransactionBegun();                     // a transaction vim did not start (the adapter filters its own)
        void OnTransactionUndone();
        void OnSelectionsChanged(bool byMouse);
        // Commits the open insert transaction (one undo step for what was typed) and stays in
        // Insert/Replace; the next key reopens one. Called before any change vim does not make
        // (5a.7): TE1 refuses reloads/appends inside a transaction and undo is a no-op there.
        void InterruptInsertSession();
        [[nodiscard]] bool InsertTransactionOpen() const { return m_insert.open; }

        [[nodiscard]] VimMode Mode() const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::string PendingKeys() const;
        [[nodiscard]] VimKeyboardState Keyboard() const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<VimCursor> Cursors() const;
        [[nodiscard]] const VimOptions& Options() const { return m_options; }
        void SetOptions(VimOptions options);
        [[nodiscard]] const VimLanguage& Language() const { return m_language; }
        void SetLanguage(VimLanguage language);
        [[nodiscard]] VimContext Context();

    private:
        struct InsertSession
        {
            bool          open = false;              // a buffer transaction is open
            VimActionId   entry = VimActionId::InsertBefore;
            std::uint32_t count = 1;
            AnchorSet::Id start = 0;                      // the primary cursor's session start (Left bias)
            bool          hasStart = false;
            bool          autoIndentPending = false; // o/O/Enter inserted an indent nothing has been typed after
            bool          typed = false;             // OnInputHandled seen this session
            bool          resume = false;            // InterruptInsertSession closed the transaction; reopen on the next key
        };

        VimKeyResult FeedResolved(const VimKey& key);
        VimKeyResult HandleNormalOrVisual(const VimKey& key);
        VimKeyResult HandleInsert(const VimKey& key);
        void Execute(const VimParsed& p);
        void RunAction(const VimParsed& p);

        void BeginInsertSession(VimActionId entry, std::uint32_t count);
        void EndInsertSession();
        void MarkInsertStart();
        [[nodiscard]] std::string CapturedInsertText() const;
        void StartInsert(InsertEntry entry, const VimParsed& p);
        void OpenLine(bool below, const VimParsed& p);
        void LeaveInsertMode();
        void ResumeInsertSession();
        void InsertNewline();
        void InsertTab();
        void InsertBackspace();
        void InsertDelete();
        void InsertMove(VimNamedKey key);
        void RepeatInsertForCount();
        void RemovePendingAutoIndent();

        void ApplyModeHooks();
        void ClampCursors();
        [[nodiscard]] VimCursor ToVim(const Selection& s) const;
        [[nodiscard]] Selection FromVim(const VimCursor& c, std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal, std::uint32_t id) const;
        void Beep(std::string_view message = {});

        VimDoc            m_doc;
        IVimHost&         m_host;
        VimGlobals&       m_globals;
        VimBufferState&   m_bufferState;
        VimOptions        m_options;
        VimLanguage       m_language;
        VimCharClass      m_chars;
        VimMode           m_mode = VimMode::Normal;
        bool              m_hooksApplied = false;
        VimMode           m_appliedMode = VimMode::Normal;
        VimKeyboardState  m_appliedKeyboard{};
        VimCommandParser  m_parser;
        InsertSession     m_insert;
        AnchorSet         m_anchors;
        double            m_now = 0.0;
        bool              m_beeped = false;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <utility>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    VimState::VimState(VimDoc doc, IVimHost& host, VimGlobals& globals, VimBufferState& bufferState,
                       VimOptions options, VimLanguage language)
        : m_doc(doc), m_host(host), m_globals(globals), m_bufferState(bufferState),
          m_options(std::move(options)), m_language(std::move(language)), m_chars(m_language.wordChars)
    {
        m_doc.buffer.RegisterAnchors(m_anchors);
        VimText::SyncDisplay(m_doc);
        ClampCursors();
        ApplyModeHooks();
    }

    VimState::~VimState()
    {
        if (m_insert.open) EndInsertSession();
        m_doc.buffer.UnregisterAnchors(m_anchors);
    }

    VimContext VimState::Context()
    {
        return VimContext{ m_doc, m_host, m_globals, m_bufferState, m_options, m_language, m_chars, Mode() };
    }

    void VimState::SetOptions(VimOptions options) { m_options = std::move(options); }

    void VimState::SetLanguage(VimLanguage language)
    {
        m_language = std::move(language);
        m_chars = VimCharClass(m_language.wordChars);
    }

    VimMode VimState::Mode() const
    {
        if (m_mode == VimMode::Normal && m_parser.OperatorPending()) return VimMode::OperatorPending;
        return m_mode;
    }

    std::string VimState::PendingKeys() const { return m_parser.PendingText(); }

    VimKeyboardState VimState::Keyboard() const
    {
        switch (Mode())
        {
        case VimMode::Insert:
        case VimMode::Replace:
        case VimMode::CommandLine:
            return VimKeyboardState{ false, false, true };
        default:
            // D-R15 / finding 5a.20: while f t F T r wait for their LITERAL character, command mode is
            // OFF so a dead key composes (French f ^ e is fê) and the layout's letter arrives; the
            // Latin-letter path lives only in command mode (TE2-10's hook owns the stream there), so it
            // is off too. A NAME argument (m ' ` " q @, AwaitingName) keeps command mode ON: marks and
            // registers are Latin on any layout (spec s5.5).
            if (m_parser.AwaitingLiteral()) return VimKeyboardState{ false, false, false };
            return VimKeyboardState{ true, true, false };
        }
    }

    VimKeyResult VimState::HandleKey(const VimKey& key, double nowSeconds)
    {
        m_now = nowSeconds;
        VimText::SyncDisplay(m_doc);             // first: the folds' rows after any edit made outside vim (j/k, H/M/L read the display)
        VimKeyResult r = FeedResolved(key);
        r.beeped = std::exchange(m_beeped, false);
        ApplyModeHooks();
        return r;
    }

    void VimState::Tick(double nowSeconds) { m_now = nowSeconds; }

    VimKeyResult VimState::FeedResolved(const VimKey& key)
    {
        if (m_insert.resume) ResumeInsertSession();   // 5a.7: an outside change closed the transaction
        switch (m_mode)
        {
        case VimMode::Insert: return HandleInsert(key);
        default:              return HandleNormalOrVisual(key);
        }
    }

    VimKeyResult VimState::HandleNormalOrVisual(const VimKey& key)
    {
        if (key.IsEsc() && m_parser.Idle())
        {
            if (IsVisual(m_mode))
            {
                m_mode = VimMode::Normal;
                ClampCursors();
            }
            return {};
        }
        switch (m_parser.Feed(key, IsVisual(m_mode) ? m_mode : VimMode::Normal))
        {
        case VimParseStatus::NeedMore:
            return {};
        case VimParseStatus::Invalid:
            m_parser.Reset();
            if (!key.IsEsc()) Beep();
            return {};
        case VimParseStatus::Complete:
        {
            const VimParsed p = m_parser.Result();
            m_parser.Reset();
            Execute(p);
            return {};
        }
        }
        return {};
    }

    void VimState::Execute(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        switch (p.kind)
        {
        case VimCmdKind::Action:
            RunAction(p);
            break;
        case VimCmdKind::Motion:       // ExecuteMotion: TE5a-8; with an operator: TE5a-12
        case VimCmdKind::Operator:     // ExecuteOperator: TE5a-12
        case VimCmdKind::TextObject:   // ExtendVisualByObject: TE5a-18
            Beep();
            break;
        }
    }

    void VimState::OnInputHandled(std::string_view text)
    {
        if (text.empty()) return;
        if (m_insert.resume) ResumeInsertSession();
        m_insert.autoIndentPending = false;
        m_insert.typed = true;
    }

    void VimState::OnTransactionBegun()
    {
        // An edit vim did not make (an action row, a menu paste): it must not merge into
        // vim's insert undo step, so the session is interrupted first (5a.7).
        if (m_mode == VimMode::Insert || m_mode == VimMode::Replace) InterruptInsertSession();
        // The Visual selection it replaced is gone, so Visual ends.
        if (IsVisual(m_mode))
        {
            m_mode = VimMode::Normal;
            ClampCursors();
            ApplyModeHooks();
        }
    }

    void VimState::OnTransactionUndone()
    {
        if (IsVisual(m_mode)) m_mode = VimMode::Normal;
        if (m_mode == VimMode::Normal) ClampCursors();
        ApplyModeHooks();
    }

    void VimState::OnSelectionsChanged(bool byMouse)
    {
        if (m_mode == VimMode::Normal) ClampCursors();
        if (m_mode == VimMode::Insert && byMouse)
        {
            // a click inside Insert starts a new undoable insert, as an arrow key does
            EndInsertSession();
            BeginInsertSession(VimActionId::InsertBefore, 1);
            MarkInsertStart();
        }
    }

    void VimState::ApplyModeHooks()
    {
        const VimMode mode = Mode();
        if (!m_hooksApplied || mode != m_appliedMode)
        {
            switch (mode)
            {
            case VimMode::Insert:
                m_host.SetCursorShape(VimCursorShape::Bar); m_host.SetLineMode(false);
                m_host.SetInputEnabled(true); m_host.SetClipAtLineEnds(false); break;
            case VimMode::Replace:
                m_host.SetCursorShape(VimCursorShape::Underline); m_host.SetLineMode(false);
                m_host.SetInputEnabled(false); m_host.SetClipAtLineEnds(false); break;
            case VimMode::Visual:
            case VimMode::VisualBlock:
                m_host.SetCursorShape(VimCursorShape::Block); m_host.SetLineMode(false);
                m_host.SetInputEnabled(false); m_host.SetClipAtLineEnds(false); break;
            case VimMode::VisualLine:
                m_host.SetCursorShape(VimCursorShape::Block); m_host.SetLineMode(true);
                m_host.SetInputEnabled(false); m_host.SetClipAtLineEnds(false); break;
            case VimMode::OperatorPending:
                m_host.SetCursorShape(VimCursorShape::Underline); m_host.SetLineMode(false);
                m_host.SetInputEnabled(false); m_host.SetClipAtLineEnds(true); break;
            case VimMode::CommandLine:
                m_host.SetCursorShape(VimCursorShape::Bar); m_host.SetLineMode(false);
                m_host.SetInputEnabled(false); m_host.SetClipAtLineEnds(true); break;
            case VimMode::Normal:
                m_host.SetCursorShape(VimCursorShape::Block); m_host.SetLineMode(false);
                m_host.SetInputEnabled(false); m_host.SetClipAtLineEnds(true); break;
            }
            m_appliedMode = mode;
        }
        const VimKeyboardState kb = Keyboard();
        if (!m_hooksApplied || !(kb == m_appliedKeyboard))
        {
            m_host.SetKeyboard(kb);
            m_appliedKeyboard = kb;
        }
        m_hooksApplied = true;
    }

    VimCursor VimState::ToVim(const Selection& s) const
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        switch (m_mode)
        {
        case VimMode::Visual:
        {
            const Selection v = VimCursorModel::FromEditorVisual(r, s);
            return VimCursor{ v.anchor, v.head };
        }
        case VimMode::VisualLine:
            return VimCursor{ s.anchor, s.head };
        default:
            return VimCursor{ s.head, s.head };
        }
    }

    Selection VimState::FromVim(const VimCursor& c, std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal, std::uint32_t id) const
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        switch (m_mode)
        {
        case VimMode::Visual:
            return VimCursorModel::ToEditorVisual(r, Selection{ id, c.anchor, c.head, goal });
        case VimMode::VisualLine:
            return Selection{ id, c.anchor, c.head, goal };
        case VimMode::Normal:
        {
            const ByteOffset o = VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, c.head);
            return Selection{ id, o, o, goal };
        }
        default:
            return Selection{ id, c.head, c.head, goal };
        }
    }

    std::vector<VimCursor> VimState::Cursors() const
    {
        std::vector<VimCursor> out;
        for (const Selection& s : m_doc.selections.All()) out.push_back(ToVim(s));
        return out;
    }

    void VimState::ClampCursors()
    {
        if (m_mode != VimMode::Normal) return;
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        bool changed = false;
        for (Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset o = VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, s.head);
            if (s.anchor != o || s.head != o) { s.anchor = s.head = o; changed = true; }
        }
        if (changed) VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }

    void VimState::Beep(std::string_view message)
    {
        m_parser.Reset();
        m_beeped = true;                         // beep_flush: NON-typed feeders (macro, :normal, remap) stop; typed keys run on
        if (!message.empty()) m_host.ShowMessage(message, true);
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimActions.cpp
// VimState::RunAction: one case per VimActionId. Each later TE5 task adds the
// cases it implements; an id with no case yet beeps.
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    void VimState::RunAction(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        switch (p.Id<VimActionId>())
        {
        case VimActionId::InsertBefore:        StartInsert(InsertEntry::Before, p); break;
        case VimActionId::Append:              StartInsert(InsertEntry::After, p); break;
        case VimActionId::InsertFirstNonBlank: StartInsert(InsertEntry::FirstNonBlank, p); break;
        case VimActionId::InsertColumnZero:    StartInsert(InsertEntry::ColumnZero, p); break;
        case VimActionId::AppendLineEnd:       StartInsert(InsertEntry::LineEnd, p); break;
        case VimActionId::OpenBelow:           OpenLine(true, p); break;
        case VimActionId::OpenAbove:           OpenLine(false, p); break;
        default:                               Beep(); break;
        }
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimInsert.cpp
// Insert mode (spec s6.3 "Insert mode", s6.1 entering/leaving rules) with
// Neovim's defaults: autoindent, backspace=indent,eol,start, smarttab,
// expandtab from the editor-wide indentation settings.
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        bool IsBlank(char32_t c) { return c == U' ' || c == U'\t'; }

        // Vim's autoindent without 'copyindent': the indent's WIDTH is copied and rebuilt
        // with expandtab/tabstop (Neovim's set_indent), so "\t" under expandtab becomes spaces.
        std::string AutoIndent(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t row, const VimOptions& o)
        {
            const std::uint32_t tab = std::max(1u, o.tabSize);
            const std::uint32_t width = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, row), tab);
            if (o.expandTab) return std::string(width, ' ');
            return std::string(width / tab, '\t') + std::string(width % tab, ' ');
        }
    }

    void VimState::InterruptInsertSession()
    {
        if (!m_insert.open) return;
        EndInsertSession();                      // commit + BreakUndoGroup: what was typed is one undo step
        m_insert.resume = true;                  // still Insert/Replace: the next key reopens a session
    }

    void VimState::ResumeInsertSession()
    {
        m_insert.resume = false;
        if (m_mode != VimMode::Insert && m_mode != VimMode::Replace) return;
        BeginInsertSession(m_insert.entry, 1);   // a count never repeats across an interruption (as after an arrow key)
        MarkInsertStart();
    }

    void VimState::BeginInsertSession(VimActionId entry, std::uint32_t count)
    {
        if (!m_insert.open)
        {
            m_doc.buffer.BeginTransaction(m_doc.selections);
            m_insert.open = true;
        }
        m_insert.entry = entry;
        m_insert.count = std::max(1u, count);
        m_insert.autoIndentPending = false;
        m_insert.typed = false;
    }

    void VimState::EndInsertSession()
    {
        m_insert.resume = false;
        if (m_insert.hasStart) { m_anchors.Remove(m_insert.start); m_insert.hasStart = false; }
        if (!m_insert.open) return;
        m_doc.buffer.EndTransaction(m_doc.selections);
        m_doc.buffer.BreakUndoGroup();           // the next session never merges into this one by undoGroupMs
        m_insert.open = false;
    }

    void VimState::MarkInsertStart()
    {
        if (m_insert.hasStart) m_anchors.Remove(m_insert.start);
        const auto all = m_doc.selections.All();
        m_insert.start = m_anchors.Add(Anchor{ all[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].head, Bias::Left });
        m_insert.hasStart = true;
    }

    std::string VimState::CapturedInsertText() const
    {
        if (!m_insert.hasStart) return {};
        const ByteOffset start = m_anchors.Get(m_insert.start).offset;
        const ByteOffset caret = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].head;
        if (caret <= start) return {};
        std::string out;
        m_doc.buffer.Text().CopyTo(ByteRange{ start, caret }, out);
        return out;
    }

    void VimState::StartInsert(InsertEntry entry, const VimParsed& p)
    {
        BeginInsertSession(p.Id<VimActionId>(), p.Count1());
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        for (Selection& s : sels)
        {
            s.anchor = s.head = VimCursorModel::EnterInsert(r, s.head, entry);
            s.goalColumn.reset();
        }
        VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        MarkInsertStart();
        m_mode = VimMode::Insert;
    }

    void VimState::OpenLine(bool below, const VimParsed& p)
    {
        BeginInsertSession(p.Id<VimActionId>(), p.Count1());
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::size_t>> rows;   // row, indent bytes
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, s.head);
            if (!rows.empty() && rows.back().first == row) continue;
            const std::string indent = AutoIndent(r, row, m_options);
            rows.emplace_back(row, indent.size());
            if (below) ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.LineEnd(row), r.LineEnd(row) }, "\n" + indent });
            else       ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.LineStart(row), r.LineStart(row) }, indent + "\n" });
        }
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < rows.size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto [row, indentBytes] = rows[i];
            const ByteOffset caret = below ? VimText::MapThrough(r.LineEnd(row), ops, Bias::Right)
                                           : VimText::MapThrough(r.LineStart(row), ops, Bias::Left) + indentBytes;
            after.push_back(Selection{ sels[std::min(i, sels.size() - 1)].id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), std::min(VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc), rows.size() - 1));
        MarkInsertStart();
        m_insert.autoIndentPending = true;
        m_mode = VimMode::Insert;
    }

    VimKeyResult VimState::HandleInsert(const VimKey& key)
    {
        if (key.IsEsc()) { LeaveInsertMode(); return {}; }
        if (key.ctrl) return VimKeyResult{ false };   // TE5a-20: the Insert column of the s6.6 chord table
        switch (key.named)
        {
        case VimNamedKey::Enter:     InsertNewline(); return {};
        case VimNamedKey::Tab:       if (key.shift) return VimKeyResult{ false }; InsertTab(); return {};
        case VimNamedKey::Backspace: InsertBackspace(); return {};
        case VimNamedKey::Delete:    InsertDelete(); return {};
        case VimNamedKey::Left: case VimNamedKey::Right: case VimNamedKey::Up:
        case VimNamedKey::Down: case VimNamedKey::Home: case VimNamedKey::End:
            InsertMove(key.named);
            return {};
        case VimNamedKey::None:      break;
        default:                     return VimKeyResult{ false };
        }
        return VimKeyResult{ false };   // a printable character: the view types it and calls OnInputHandled
    }

    void VimState::InsertNewline()
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> ids;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset lo = std::min(s.anchor, s.head), hi = std::max(s.anchor, s.head);
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, lo);
            const std::string indent = AutoIndent(r, row, m_options);        // autoindent: the current line's width
            ByteOffset cut = lo;                                              // blanks before the caret STAY (Neovim keeps
            if (m_insert.autoIndentPending)                                   // typed trailing blanks) -- only an untouched
                while (cut > r.LineStart(row) && IsBlank(VimText::CodePointAt(r, cut - 1))) --cut;   // autoindent goes (did_ai)
            ByteOffset rest = hi;                                             // leading blanks of the moved text go
            while (rest < r.LineEnd(row) && IsBlank(VimText::CodePointAt(r, rest))) ++rest;
            if (!ops.empty() && cut < ops.back().range.end) continue;         // two carets in one blank run
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ cut, rest }, "\n" + indent });
            ids.push_back(s.id);
        }
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < ops.size(); ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = VimText::MapThrough(ops[i].range.begin, ops, Bias::Right);
            after.push_back(Selection{ ids[i], caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), std::min(VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc), ids.size() - 1));
        m_insert.autoIndentPending = true;
    }

    void VimState::InsertTab()
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset lo = std::min(s.anchor, s.head), hi = std::max(s.anchor, s.head);
            std::string text = "\t";
            if (m_options.expandTab)
            {
                const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, lo);
                const bool inIndent = VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, row) >= lo;              // smarttab
                const std::uint32_t width = std::max(1u, inIndent ? m_options.shiftWidth : m_options.tabSize);
                const std::uint32_t vcol = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, lo, m_options.tabSize);
                text.assign(width - vcol % width, ' ');
            }
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ lo, hi }, std::move(text) });
        }
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sels.size(); ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = VimText::MapThrough(ops[i].range.begin, ops, Bias::Right);
            after.push_back(Selection{ sels[i].id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        m_insert.autoIndentPending = false;
    }

    void VimState::InsertBackspace()
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = s.head;
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, caret);
            ByteOffset from = caret;
            if (caret == r.LineStart(row))
            {
                if (row == 0) continue;                                                 // nothing before the buffer start
                from = caret - 1;                                                       // backspace=eol: join
            }
            else if (m_options.expandTab && VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, row) >= caret
                     && VimText::CodePointAt(r, caret - 1) == U' ')
            {
                const std::uint32_t sw = std::max(1u, m_options.shiftWidth);            // smarttab in the indent
                const std::uint32_t vcol = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, caret, m_options.tabSize);
                const std::uint32_t target = ((vcol - 1) / sw) * sw;
                std::uint32_t v = vcol;
                while (v > target && from > r.LineStart(row) && VimText::CodePointAt(r, from - 1) == U' ') { --from; --v; }
            }
            else
                from = VimText::PrevChar(r, caret);
            if (!ops.empty() && from < ops.back().range.end) continue;                 // two carets, one deletion
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ from, caret }, "" });
        }
        if (ops.empty()) return;
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = VimText::MapThrough(s.head, ops, Bias::Left);
            after.push_back(Selection{ s.id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }

    void VimState::InsertDelete()
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = s.head;
            const ByteOffset end = VimText::AtLineEnd(r, caret) ? std::min<ByteOffset>(caret + 1, r.Size()) : VimText::NextChar(r, caret);
            if (end == caret) continue;                                                 // at the end of the buffer
            if (!ops.empty() && caret < ops.back().range.end) continue;
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ caret, end }, "" });
        }
        if (ops.empty()) return;
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = VimText::MapThrough(s.head, ops, Bias::Left);
            after.push_back(Selection{ s.id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        m_insert.autoIndentPending = false;
    }

    void VimState::InsertMove(VimNamedKey key)
    {
        if (m_insert.autoIndentPending && (key == VimNamedKey::Up || key == VimNamedKey::Down)) RemovePendingAutoIndent();
        m_insert.autoIndentPending = false;
        EndInsertSession();                      // the keys before and after undo separately (:h ins-special-special)
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        for (Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, s.head);
            ByteOffset o = s.head;
            std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal;
            switch (key)
            {
            case VimNamedKey::Left:  o = VimText::PrevChar(r, s.head); break;
            case VimNamedKey::Right: o = VimText::NextChar(r, s.head); break;
            case VimNamedKey::Home:  o = r.LineStart(row); break;
            case VimNamedKey::End:   o = r.LineEnd(row); break;
            case VimNamedKey::Up:
            case VimNamedKey::Down:
            {
                const std::uint32_t vcol = s.goalColumn.value_or(VimText::VirtualColumn(r, s.head, m_options.tabSize));
                goal = vcol;
                if (key == VimNamedKey::Up && row == 0) break;
                if (key == VimNamedKey::Down && row + 1 >= VimText::LineCount(r)) break;   // D-R5 vim lines
                const std::uint32_t target = key == VimNamedKey::Up ? row - 1 : row + 1;
                o = VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, target, vcol, m_options.tabSize);
                break;
            }
            default: break;
            }
            s.anchor = s.head = o;
            s.goalColumn = goal;
        }
        VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        BeginInsertSession(VimActionId::InsertBefore, 1);
        MarkInsertStart();
    }

    void VimState::RepeatInsertForCount()
    {
        const std::string text = CapturedInsertText();
        if (text.empty() || m_insert.count <= 1) return;
        const bool lines = m_insert.entry == VimActionId::OpenBelow || m_insert.entry == VimActionId::OpenAbove;
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const std::string piece = lines ? "\n" + VimText::LeadingWhitespace(r, VimText::RowOf(r, s.head)) + text : text;
            std::string all;
            for (std::uint32_t i = 1; i < m_insert.count; ++i) all += piece;
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ s.head, s.head }, std::move(all) });
        }
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sels.size(); ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = VimText::MapThrough(ops[i].range.begin, ops, Bias::Right);
            after.push_back(Selection{ sels[i].id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }

    void VimState::RemovePendingAutoIndent()
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, s.head);
            if (!VimText::IsBlankLine(r, row) || r.LineStart(row) == r.LineEnd(row)) continue;
            if (!ops.empty() && ops.back().range.begin == r.LineStart(row)) continue;
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.LineStart(row), r.LineEnd(row) }, "" });
        }
        if (ops.empty()) return;
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = VimText::MapThrough(s.head, ops, Bias::Left);
            after.push_back(Selection{ s.id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        m_insert.autoIndentPending = false;
    }

    void VimState::LeaveInsertMode()
    {
        RepeatInsertForCount();
        if (m_insert.autoIndentPending) RemovePendingAutoIndent();
        EndInsertSession();                      // one insert session = one undo step (spec s6.3)
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        for (Selection& s : sels)
        {
            s.anchor = s.head = VimCursorModel::LeaveInsert(r, s.head);
            s.goalColumn.reset();
        }
        m_mode = VimMode::Normal;
        VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp
#pragma once

// The vim test rig: an Editor::TextModel (TE2-11 + TE4-12: buffer, selections,
// display, folds and the observer that shifts the folds with every edit) with a
// VimState over a FakeVimHost -- the same model the editor's views use, so the
// fold/display behaviour under test is the editor's (CANON B23). Marked text:
// U+02C7 (CB 87) is a vim cursor, U+00AB (C2 AB) a Visual anchor; the i-th
// anchor pairs with the i-th cursor. The rig plays the view: printable keys vim
// leaves unhandled in Insert are typed at every cursor and reported through
// OnInputHandled.

#include "TextEditor/Core/DisplayMap.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/FoldModel.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Selection.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextModel.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Test
{
    struct MarkedText
    {
        std::string text;
        std::vector<Arcane::Text::VimCursor> cursors;
    };
    [[nodiscard]] MarkedText ParseVimMarked(std::string_view marked);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatVimMarked(std::string_view text, std::span<const Arcane::Text::VimCursor> cursors, bool showAnchors);

    class FakeVimHost final : public Arcane::Text::IVimHost
    {
    public:
        Arcane::Text::VimCursorShape shape = Arcane::Text::VimCursorShape::Block;
        bool lineMode = false, inputEnabled = false, clip = false;
        Arcane::Text::VimKeyboardState keyboard{ false, false, true };
        std::uint32_t firstRow = 0, rows = 22;            // nvim --headless: 24 lines - cmdline - statusline
        std::string clipboard;
        std::vector<std::pair<std::string, bool>> messages;
        std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::vector<std::string>>> listings;
        std::string commandLine;
        std::size_t commandCursor = 0;
        std::string searchHighlight;
        std::vector<std::string> fileCommands;            // "Write|arg|!" per call
        std::vector<std::string> windowCommands;
        std::map<std::string, std::string> files;          // ReadFileText
        std::string path = "C:/vimrig/doc.txt";
        std::vector<std::string> buffers{ "C:/vimrig/doc.txt" };
        std::vector<std::pair<std::string, Arcane::Text::Point>> opened;
        Arcane::Text::VimHostResult nextFileResult{};

        void SetCursorShape(Arcane::Text::VimCursorShape s) override { shape = s; }
        void SetLineMode(bool on) override { lineMode = on; }
        void SetInputEnabled(bool on) override { inputEnabled = on; }
        void SetClipAtLineEnds(bool on) override { clip = on; }
        void SetKeyboard(const Arcane::Text::VimKeyboardState& s) override { keyboard = s; }
        std::uint32_t FirstVisibleRow() const override { return firstRow; }
        std::uint32_t VisibleRows() const override { return rows; }
        void ScrollToRow(std::uint32_t row) override { firstRow = row; }
        std::string ReadClipboard() override { return clipboard; }
        void WriteClipboard(std::string_view t) override { clipboard = std::string(t); }
        void ShowMessage(std::string_view t, bool e) override { messages.emplace_back(std::string(t), e); }
        void ShowListing(std::string_view title, std::span<const std::string> lines) override
        {
            listings.emplace_back(std::string(title), std::vector<std::string>(lines.begin(), lines.end()));
        }
        void SetCommandLine(std::string_view t, std::size_t c) override { commandLine = std::string(t); commandCursor = c; }
        void SetSearchHighlight(std::string_view p) override { searchHighlight = std::string(p); }
        Arcane::Text::VimHostResult RunFileCommand(Arcane::Text::VimFileCommand c, std::string_view arg, bool bang) override;
        Arcane::Text::VimHostResult RunWindowCommand(Arcane::Text::VimWindowCommand c) override;
        std::optional<std::string> ReadFileText(std::string_view p) override
        {
            const auto it = files.find(std::string(p));
            return it == files.end() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<std::string>(it->second);
        }
        std::string DocumentPath() const override { return path; }
        std::vector<std::string> BufferList() override { return buffers; }
        bool OpenAt(std::string_view p, Arcane::Text::Point pt) override { opened.emplace_back(std::string(p), pt); return true; }
    };

    // D-R14: how the marked string maps onto the rope. Bytes = exactly (unit tests); VimLines = Vim's
    // lines joined by "\n" with 'eol' on (the rope is the string + "\n"); VimLinesNoEol = 'noeol'
    // (the rope is exactly the string). The .vimcases runner (TE5a-6) uses the two VimLines kinds.
    enum class VimRigText : std::uint8_t { Bytes, VimLines, VimLinesNoEol };

    class VimRig
    {
    public:
        explicit VimRig(std::string_view marked, Arcane::Text::VimLanguage language = {}, Arcane::Text::VimOptions options = {},
                        Arcane::Text::VimGlobals* sharedGlobals = nullptr, VimRigText text = VimRigText::Bytes);
        ~VimRig();
        VimRig(const VimRig&) = delete;
        VimRig& operator=(const VimRig&) = delete;

        void Keys(std::string_view notation);
        void Wait(double seconds);                         // advances the clock and Ticks (timeoutlen, TE5d)
        [[nodiscard]] std::string Marked() const;
        // D-R14: VimLinesOf(rope) (TE5a-2) joined by "\n", with the cursors -- Vim's lines, whatever the final terminator.
        [[nodiscard]] std::string MarkedLines() const;
        [[nodiscard]] std::string Text() const { return buffer.Text().ToString(); }
        [[nodiscard]] Arcane::Text::VimMode Mode() const { return vim->Mode(); }
        [[nodiscard]] Arcane::Text::VimGlobals& Globals() { return *m_globals; }
        [[nodiscard]] Arcane::Text::VimDoc Doc() { return Arcane::Text::VimDoc{ buffer, selections, folds, display, &context }; }
        // TE1's command class over the rig's model (undo/redo, SetSelections), as the view would build it.
        [[nodiscard]] Arcane::Text::TextCommands Commands() { return Arcane::Text::TextCommands(buffer, selections, context); }
        void TypeLikeTheView(std::string_view utf8);

    private:
        MarkedText m_marked;
        Arcane::Text::VimGlobals m_ownGlobals;
        Arcane::Text::VimGlobals* m_globals;

    public:
        Arcane::Editor::TextModel model;           // declared before the references below
        Arcane::Text::TextBuffer& buffer;          // = model.buffer
        Arcane::Text::SelectionSet& selections;    // = model.selections
        Arcane::Text::FoldModel& folds;            // = model.folds (shifted by the model's edit observer)
        Arcane::Text::DisplayMap& display;         // = model.display (rebuilt by VimText::SyncDisplay)
        Arcane::Text::EditContext context;         // Editor::DefaultEditContext(model): the VimDoc's context
        FakeVimHost host;
        Arcane::Text::VimBufferState bufferState;
        std::unique_ptr<Arcane::Text::VimState> vim;
        double now = 0.0;
        std::uint32_t beeps = 0;                   // VimKeyResult::beeped seen by Keys (typed keys run on after a beep)
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/Helpers/VimRig.cpp
#include "Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp"

#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Test
{
    using namespace Arcane::Text;

    namespace
    {
        constexpr std::string_view kCursor = "\xCB\x87";   // U+02C7
        constexpr std::string_view kAnchor = "\xC2\xAB";   // U+00AB

        // D-R14: Vim's 'eol' (the default) is the rope's final terminator; 'noeol' and Bytes leave the text as it is.
        std::string RopeTextOf(std::string text, VimRigText kind)
        {
            if (kind == VimRigText::VimLines) text.push_back('\n');
            return text;
        }
    }

    MarkedText ParseVimMarked(std::string_view marked)
    {
        MarkedText out;
        std::vector<ByteOffset> heads, anchors;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < marked.size();)
        {
            if (marked.substr(i, 2) == kCursor) { heads.push_back(out.text.size()); i += 2; continue; }
            if (marked.substr(i, 2) == kAnchor) { anchors.push_back(out.text.size()); i += 2; continue; }
            out.text.push_back(marked[i]);
            ++i;
        }
        if (heads.empty()) heads.push_back(0);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < heads.size(); ++i)
            out.cursors.push_back(VimCursor{ i < anchors.size() ? anchors[i] : heads[i], heads[i] });
        return out;
    }

    std::string FormatVimMarked(std::string_view text, std::span<const VimCursor> cursors, bool showAnchors)
    {
        std::vector<std::pair<ByteOffset, std::string_view>> marks;   // offset, marker
        for (const VimCursor& c : cursors)
        {
            if (showAnchors) marks.emplace_back(c.anchor, kAnchor);
            marks.emplace_back(c.head, kCursor);
        }
        // ascending offset; at one offset the anchor marker comes first
        std::stable_sort(marks.begin(), marks.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
            if (a.first != b.first) return a.first < b.first;
            return a.second == kAnchor && b.second == kCursor;
        });
        std::string out;
        std::size_t at = 0;
        for (const auto& [offset, marker] : marks)
        {
            const std::size_t o = std::min<std::size_t>(offset, text.size());
            out.append(text.substr(at, o - at));
            out.append(marker);
            at = o;
        }
        out.append(text.substr(at));
        return out;
    }

    VimHostResult FakeVimHost::RunFileCommand(VimFileCommand c, std::string_view arg, bool bang)
    {
        static constexpr const char* kNames[] = { "Write", "Quit", "WriteQuit", "WriteIfDirtyQuit", "Edit", "SaveAs", "NextBuffer", "PrevBuffer" };
        fileCommands.push_back(std::string(kNames[static_cast<int>(c)]) + "|" + std::string(arg) + "|" + (bang ? "!" : ""));
        return nextFileResult;
    }

    VimHostResult FakeVimHost::RunWindowCommand(VimWindowCommand c)
    {
        static constexpr const char* kNames[] = { "SplitHorizontal", "SplitVertical", "FocusLeft", "FocusDown", "FocusUp", "FocusRight", "FocusNext", "Close" };
        windowCommands.emplace_back(kNames[static_cast<int>(c)]);
        return {};
    }

    VimRig::VimRig(std::string_view marked, VimLanguage language, VimOptions options, VimGlobals* sharedGlobals, VimRigText text)
        : m_marked(ParseVimMarked(marked)), m_globals(sharedGlobals ? sharedGlobals : &m_ownGlobals),
          model(Rope::FromUtf8(RopeTextOf(m_marked.text, text))), buffer(model.buffer), selections(model.selections),
          folds(model.folds), display(model.display), context(Arcane::Editor::DefaultEditContext(model))
    {
        std::vector<Selection> sels;
        for (const VimCursor& c : m_marked.cursors) sels.push_back(Selection{ selections.AllocateId(), c.head, c.head, std::nullopt });
        Commands().SetSelections(sels, sels.size() - 1);   // the last marker is the primary (newest)
        vim = std::make_unique<VimState>(Doc(), host, *m_globals, bufferState, std::move(options), std::move(language));
    }

    VimRig::~VimRig() { vim.reset(); }

    void VimRig::TypeLikeTheView(std::string_view utf8)
    {
        VimDoc doc = Doc();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ std::min(s.anchor, s.head), std::max(s.anchor, s.head) }, std::string(utf8) });
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sels.size(); ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = VimText::MapThrough(ops[i].range.end, ops, Bias::Right);
            after.push_back(Selection{ sels[i].id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(doc));
        vim->OnInputHandled(utf8);
    }

    void VimRig::Keys(std::string_view notation)
    {
        const auto keys = ParseKeys(notation, vim->Options().leader);
        REQUIRE(keys.has_value());
        for (const VimKey& k : *keys)
        {
            now += 0.001;
            const VimKeyResult r = vim->HandleKey(k, now);
            if (r.beeped) ++beeps;               // the rig feeds TYPED keys: they keep running after a beep (D-R12)
            if (!r.handled && k.IsChar() && vim->Mode() == VimMode::Insert)
            {
                std::string utf8;
                Utf8::Append(utf8, k.ch);
                TypeLikeTheView(utf8);
            }
        }
    }

    void VimRig::Wait(double seconds)
    {
        now += seconds;
        vim->Tick(now);
    }

    std::string VimRig::Marked() const
    {
        const std::vector<VimCursor> cursors = vim->Cursors();
        return FormatVimMarked(Text(), cursors, IsVisual(vim->Mode()));
    }

    std::string VimRig::MarkedLines() const
    {
        // VimLinesOf joined by "\n" is byte-for-byte the rope's prefix (the tables use "\n" breaks only),
        // so the cursors' rope offsets apply unchanged; only a final terminator (Vim's 'eol') is left out.
        std::string text;
        const std::vector<std::string> lines = VimLinesOf(buffer.Text());
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < lines.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (i) text.push_back('\n');
            text += lines[i];
        }
        const std::vector<VimCursor> cursors = vim->Cursors();
        return FormatVimMarked(text, cursors, IsVisual(vim->Mode()));
    }
}
```
