```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        VimRegisterKind KindOf(const VimOpTarget& t)
        {
            if (t.block) return VimRegisterKind::Blockwise;
            return t.kind == MotionKind::Linewise ? VimRegisterKind::Linewise : VimRegisterKind::Charwise;
        }

        std::string Extract(const Rope& r, ByteRange range)
        {
            std::string s;
            r.CopyTo(range, s);
            return s;
        }

        VimOpOutcome DeleteOrChange(VimContext& ctx, bool change, std::span<const VimOpTarget> targets, const VimOpArgs& args)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            const bool block = targets.front().block;
            VimRegisterValue reg;
            reg.kind = KindOf(targets.front());
            std::vector<EditOp> ops;
            std::vector<VimCaretPlan> plans;
            VimOpOutcome out;
            out.enterInsert = change;
            bool multiLine = false;
            bool anyText = false;
            for (const VimOpTarget& t : targets)
            {
                EditOp op;
                std::string part;
                VimCaretPlan plan;
                plan.id = t.cursorId;
                if (t.kind == MotionKind::Linewise && !t.block)
                {
                    const VimRowRange rows = VimLinewiseRows(r, t.range);
                    part = VimCursorModel::LinewiseText(r, rows.first, rows.last);
                    if (change)
                    {
                        const ByteOffset keep = VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, rows.first);   // autoindent: keep the indent
                        op = EditOp{ ByteRange{ keep, r.LineEnd(rows.last) }, "" };
                        plan.at = keep;
                        plan.rule = VimCaretRule::Exact;
                        out.autoIndentPending = keep > r.LineStart(rows.first);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        op = EditOp{ VimCursorModel::LinewiseDeleteRange(r, rows.first, rows.last), "" };
                        plan.at = op.range.begin;
                        plan.rule = VimCaretRule::RowColumn;   // nostartofline: vim restores old_col
                        plan.vcol = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, t.origin, ctx.options.tabSize);
                    }
                    multiLine = true;
                }
                else
                {
                    part = Extract(r, t.range);
                    if (part.find('\n') != std::string::npos) multiLine = true;
                    op = EditOp{ t.range, "" };
                    plan.at = t.range.begin;
                    plan.rule = change ? VimCaretRule::Exact : VimCaretRule::AtOffset;
                }
                if (!ops.empty() && op.range.begin < ops.back().range.end) continue;   // two cursors, one range
                anyText = anyText || !part.empty() || block;
                ops.push_back(std::move(op));
                reg.parts.push_back(std::move(part));
                if (!block || change || plans.empty()) plans.push_back(plan);       // a deleted block keeps its top-left
            }
            // op_delete with oap->empty (x / dl on an empty line): no register is written (5a.14).
            if (anyText)
            {
                const bool oneLine = reg.kind == VimRegisterKind::Charwise && !multiLine;
                const VimRegisterOp kind = (oneLine && !args.forceNumbered) ? VimRegisterOp::SmallDelete : VimRegisterOp::Delete;
                // A one-line delete whose motion is use_reg_one (`d)`, `d/x<CR>`) fills "1 AND, with no register
                // named, the small delete register too -- op_delete yanks into "- after "1 (5a.15).
                std::optional<VimRegisterValue> small;
                if (oneLine && args.forceNumbered && (args.reg == 0 || args.reg == U'"')) small = reg;
                ctx.globals.registers.Store(args.reg, std::move(reg), kind, ctx.host, ctx.options);
                if (small) ctx.globals.registers.Store(0, std::move(*small), VimRegisterOp::SmallDelete, ctx.host, ctx.options);
            }
            VimApplyWithCarets(ctx, std::move(ops), plans, !change);
            return out;
        }

        VimOpOutcome Yank(VimContext& ctx, std::span<const VimOpTarget> targets, const VimOpArgs& args)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            VimRegisterValue reg;
            reg.kind = KindOf(targets.front());
            std::vector<Selection> after;
            for (const VimOpTarget& t : targets)
            {
                if (t.kind == MotionKind::Linewise && !t.block)
                {
                    const VimRowRange rows = VimLinewiseRows(r, t.range);
                    reg.parts.push_back(VimCursorModel::LinewiseText(r, rows.first, rows.last));
                }
                else
                    reg.parts.push_back(Extract(r, t.range));
                if (!t.block || after.empty())
                {
                    // vim's oap->start: a VisualLine yank (Vy, vY) starts at column 0 (finding 5a.13, Neovim v0.12.5)
                    const bool visualLine = args.fromVisual && t.kind == MotionKind::Linewise && !t.block;
                    const ByteOffset start = visualLine ? r.LineStart(VimLinewiseRows(r, t.range).first) : VimOperatorStartCursor(ctx, t);
                    const ByteOffset o = VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, start);
                    after.push_back(Selection{ t.cursorId, o, o, std::nullopt });
                }
            }
            ctx.globals.registers.Store(args.reg, std::move(reg), VimRegisterOp::Yank, ctx.host, ctx.options);
            const std::size_t primary = std::min(VimText::PrimaryIndex(ctx.doc), after.size() - 1);
            VimText::Select(ctx.doc, std::move(after), primary);
            return {};
        }
    }

    VimOpTarget VimLinewiseTarget(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow, std::uint32_t cursorId, ByteOffset origin)
    {
        return VimOpTarget{ ByteRange{ r.LineStart(firstRow), r.LineEnd(lastRow) }, MotionKind::Linewise, false, cursorId, origin };
    }

    VimRowRange VimLinewiseRows(const Rope& r, ByteRange range)
    {
        VimRowRange rows{ VimText::RowOf(r, range.begin), VimText::RowOf(r, range.end) };
        // the LinewiseDeleteRange form: it ends at a later row's start, or starts on the break before the first row
        if (rows.last > rows.first && range.end == r.LineStart(rows.last) && range.end != r.LineEnd(rows.last)) --rows.last;
        if (rows.first < rows.last && range.begin == r.LineEnd(rows.first) && range.begin != r.LineStart(rows.first)) ++rows.first;
        return rows;
    }

    ByteOffset VimOperatorStartCursor(const VimContext& ctx, const VimOpTarget& t)
    {
        const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
        if (t.kind != MotionKind::Linewise || t.block) return t.range.begin;
        const VimRowRange rows = VimLinewiseRows(r, t.range);
        if (VimText::RowOf(r, t.origin) == rows.first) return t.origin;
        return VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, rows.first, VimText::VirtualColumn(r, t.origin, ctx.options.tabSize), ctx.options.tabSize);
    }

    void VimApplyWithCarets(VimContext& ctx, std::vector<EditOp> ops, const std::vector<VimCaretPlan>& plans, bool clampNormal)
    {
        std::stable_sort(ops.begin(), ops.end(), [](const EditOp& a, const EditOp& b) { return a.range.begin < b.range.begin; });
        std::vector<Selection> provisional;
        provisional.reserve(plans.size());
        for (const VimCaretPlan& p : plans)
        {
            const ByteOffset o = VimText::MapThrough(p.at, ops, p.bias);
            provisional.push_back(Selection{ p.id, o, o, std::nullopt });
        }
        if (provisional.empty()) provisional = VimText::Selections(ctx.doc);
        const std::size_t primary = std::min(VimText::PrimaryIndex(ctx.doc), provisional.size() - 1);
        VimText::Apply(ctx.doc, ops, provisional, primary);
        if (plans.empty()) return;
        const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> placed;
        placed.reserve(plans.size());
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < plans.size(); ++i)
        {
            ByteOffset o = std::min<ByteOffset>(provisional[i].head, r.Size());
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, o);
            o = std::min<ByteOffset>(o + plans[i].plusBytes, r.LineEnd(row));
            std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal;
            switch (plans[i].rule)
            {
            case VimCaretRule::AtOffset:
            case VimCaretRule::Exact:
                break;
            case VimCaretRule::BeforeMapped:
                if (o > r.LineStart(row)) o = VimText::PrevChar(r, o);
                break;
            case VimCaretRule::RowColumn:
                o = VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, row, plans[i].vcol, ctx.options.tabSize);
                goal = plans[i].vcol;
                break;
            case VimCaretRule::RowFirstNonBlank:
                o = VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, row);
                break;
            case VimCaretRule::NextRowFirstNonBlank:
                o = VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, std::min(row + 1, r.LineCount() - 1));   // rope rows: the put's new last line may end with the final '\n'
                break;
            }
            if (clampNormal && plans[i].rule != VimCaretRule::Exact) o = VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, o);
            placed.push_back(Selection{ plans[i].id, o, o, goal });
        }
        VimText::Select(ctx.doc, std::move(placed), primary);
    }

    VimOpOutcome RunOperator(VimContext& ctx, VimOperatorId op, std::span<const VimOpTarget> targets, const VimOpArgs& args)
    {
        if (targets.empty())
        {
            VimOpOutcome none;
            none.failed = true;
            return none;
        }
        switch (op)
        {
        case VimOperatorId::Delete: return DeleteOrChange(ctx, false, targets, args);
        case VimOperatorId::Change: return DeleteOrChange(ctx, true, targets, args);
        case VimOperatorId::Yank:   return Yank(ctx, targets, args);
        default:
        {
            VimOpOutcome none;   // the ids TE5a-13/14 and TE5c-15 add
            none.failed = true;
            return none;
        }
        }
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimPut.cpp
// p P gp gP (spec s6.1: p inserts after the vim cursor char, P at it; linewise
// registers go below / above; s6.3 Registers). One EditOp list for all cursors.
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimMotions.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        std::string Repeat(const std::string& s, std::uint32_t count)
        {
            std::string out;
            out.reserve(s.size() * count);
            for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) out += s;
            return out;
        }

        std::uint32_t Width(std::string_view s)   // display cells of a block piece: one per code point
        {
            std::uint32_t n = 0;
            for (const char c : s)
                if ((static_cast<unsigned char>(c) & 0xC0) != 0x80) ++n;
            return n;
        }

        void PutChars(VimContext& ctx, const VimRegisterValue& v, bool after, bool cursorAfter, std::uint32_t count)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            const std::string text = Repeat(v.Text(), count);
            const bool multiLine = text.find('\n') != std::string::npos;
            std::vector<EditOp> ops;
            std::vector<VimCaretPlan> plans;
            for (const Selection& s : ctx.doc.selections.All())
            {
                const ByteOffset at = VimCursorModel::PasteOffset(r, s.head, after);
                if (!ops.empty() && ops.back().range.begin == at) continue;
                ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ at, at }, text });
                VimCaretPlan plan;
                plan.id = s.id;
                plan.at = at;
                if (cursorAfter)    { plan.bias = Bias::Right; plan.rule = VimCaretRule::AtOffset; }       // gp: just after
                else if (multiLine) { plan.bias = Bias::Left;  plan.rule = VimCaretRule::AtOffset; }       // the first inserted char
                else                { plan.bias = Bias::Right; plan.rule = VimCaretRule::BeforeMapped; }   // the last inserted char
                plans.push_back(plan);
            }
            VimApplyWithCarets(ctx, std::move(ops), plans, true);
        }

        void PutLines(VimContext& ctx, const VimRegisterValue& v, bool after, bool cursorAfter, std::uint32_t count)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            const std::string text = Repeat(v.Text(), count);   // every part ends with '\n'
            std::vector<EditOp> ops;
            std::vector<VimCaretPlan> plans;
            std::optional<std::uint32_t> lastTarget;
            for (const Selection& s : ctx.doc.selections.All())
            {
                const VimRowSpan span = VimDisplayRowSpan(ctx, VimText::RowOf(r, s.head));   // a closed fold is one line
                const std::uint32_t target = after ? span.last + 1 : span.first;
                if (lastTarget == target) continue;
                lastTarget = target;
                VimCaretPlan plan;
                plan.id = s.id;
                if (target < r.LineCount())   // rope rows: below the last vim line of "a\n" is the row at Size() (D-R5)
                {
                    plan.at = r.LineStart(target);
                    ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ plan.at, plan.at }, text });
                    if (cursorAfter) { plan.bias = Bias::Right; plan.rule = VimCaretRule::AtOffset; }
                    else             { plan.bias = Bias::Left;  plan.rule = VimCaretRule::RowFirstNonBlank; }
                }
                else
                {
                    plan.at = r.Size();   // below the last line, which has no break of its own
                    ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ plan.at, plan.at }, "\n" + text.substr(0, text.size() - 1) });
                    if (cursorAfter) { plan.bias = Bias::Right; plan.rule = VimCaretRule::AtOffset; }
                    else             { plan.bias = Bias::Left;  plan.rule = VimCaretRule::NextRowFirstNonBlank; }
                }
                plans.push_back(plan);
            }
            VimApplyWithCarets(ctx, std::move(ops), plans, true);
        }

        void PutBlock(VimContext& ctx, const VimRegisterValue& v, bool after, std::uint32_t count, std::uint32_t cursorId, ByteOffset head)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            const std::uint32_t tab = ctx.options.tabSize;
            const ByteOffset at0 = VimCursorModel::PasteOffset(r, head, after);
            const std::uint32_t row0 = VimText::RowOf(r, head);
            const std::uint32_t vcol = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, at0, tab);
            std::uint32_t width = 0;
            for (const std::string& p : v.parts) width = std::max(width, Width(p));
            const auto copies = [&](const std::string& part, bool padLast) {
                std::string out;
                for (std::uint32_t c = 0; c < count; ++c)
                {
                    out += part;
                    if (c + 1 < count || padLast) out.append(width - Width(part), ' ');
                }
                return out;
            };
            std::vector<EditOp> ops;
            std::string tail;   // rows past the end of the buffer
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < v.parts.size(); ++i)
            {
                const std::uint32_t row = row0 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i);
                if (row < VimText::LineCount(r))   // D-R5: the row after a final '\n' is not a line to paste into
                {
                    const ByteOffset end = r.LineEnd(row);
                    const std::uint32_t endV = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, end, tab);
                    if (endV <= vcol)
                        ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ end, end }, std::string(vcol - endV, ' ') + copies(v.parts[i], false) });
                    else
                    {
                        const ByteOffset at = VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, row, vcol, tab);
                        ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ at, at }, copies(v.parts[i], true) });
                    }
                }
                else if (VimText::EndsWithNewline(r))
                    tail += std::string(vcol, ' ') + copies(v.parts[i], false) + "\n";   // new lines before nothing, each with its break
                else
                    tail += "\n" + std::string(vcol, ' ') + copies(v.parts[i], false);
            }
            if (!tail.empty())
            {
                if (!ops.empty() && ops.back().range.begin == r.Size()) ops.back().text += tail;
                else ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.Size(), r.Size() }, tail });
            }
            VimCaretPlan plan;
            plan.id = cursorId;
            plan.at = r.LineStart(row0);
            plan.rule = VimCaretRule::RowColumn;   // the block's top-left
            plan.vcol = vcol;
            VimApplyWithCarets(ctx, std::move(ops), { plan }, true);
        }
    }

    void VimState::Put(const VimParsed& p, bool after, bool cursorAfterText)
    {
        VimContext ctx = Context();
        const std::optional<VimRegisterValue> value = m_globals.registers.Get(p.reg, m_host, m_options);
        if (!value || value->parts.empty())
        {
            std::string message = "E353: Nothing in register ";
            Utf8::Append(message, p.reg ? p.reg : U'"');
            Beep(message);
            return;
        }
        if (IsVisual(m_mode)) { PutOverVisual(p, *value); return; }
        switch (value->kind)
        {
        case VimRegisterKind::Linewise: PutLines(ctx, *value, after, cursorAfterText, p.Count1()); break;
        case VimRegisterKind::Blockwise:
        {
            const Selection& primary = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()];
            PutBlock(ctx, *value, after, p.Count1(), primary.id, primary.head);
            break;
        }
        case VimRegisterKind::Charwise: PutChars(ctx, *value, after, cursorAfterText, p.Count1()); break;
        }
    }

    void VimState::PutOverVisual(const VimParsed& p, const VimRegisterValue& value)
    {
        VimContext ctx = Context();
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<VimOpTarget> targets = VisualTargets();
        const bool keepRegister = p.Has(VimActionId::PutBefore);   // Neovim v_P: the register is not overwritten
        const std::string one = value.Text();
        VimRegisterValue removed;
        removed.kind = m_mode == VimMode::VisualLine ? VimRegisterKind::Linewise
                     : m_mode == VimMode::VisualBlock ? VimRegisterKind::Blockwise : VimRegisterKind::Charwise;
        bool multiLine = false;
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::vector<VimCaretPlan> plans;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < targets.size(); ++i)
        {
            const VimOpTarget& t = targets[i];
            VimCaretPlan plan;
            plan.id = t.cursorId;
            std::string replacement;
            if (t.kind == MotionKind::Linewise && !t.block)
            {
                const VimRowRange rows = VimLinewiseRows(r, t.range);
                removed.parts.push_back(VimCursorModel::LinewiseText(r, rows.first, rows.last));
                multiLine = true;
                std::string lines = Repeat(value.kind == VimRegisterKind::Linewise ? one : one + "\n", p.Count1());
                lines.pop_back();                                           // the selection keeps its own last break
                replacement = std::move(lines);
                plan.at = t.range.begin;
                plan.rule = VimCaretRule::RowFirstNonBlank;
            }
            else
            {
                std::string old;
                r.CopyTo(t.range, old);
                if (old.find('\n') != std::string::npos) multiLine = true;
                removed.parts.push_back(std::move(old));
                if (t.block)
                {
                    const bool single = value.kind == VimRegisterKind::Charwise && value.parts.size() == 1 && one.find('\n') == std::string::npos;
                    replacement = single ? one : value.parts[std::min(i, value.parts.size() - 1)];
                    plan.at = t.range.begin;
                }
                else if (value.kind == VimRegisterKind::Linewise)
                {
                    replacement = "\n" + Repeat(one, p.Count1());           // split the line around the lines
                    plan.at = t.range.begin;
                    plan.rule = VimCaretRule::NextRowFirstNonBlank;
                }
                else
                {
                    replacement = Repeat(one, p.Count1());
                    plan.at = replacement.find('\n') == std::string::npos ? t.range.end : t.range.begin;
                    plan.bias = Bias::Right;
                    plan.rule = replacement.find('\n') == std::string::npos ? VimCaretRule::BeforeMapped : VimCaretRule::AtOffset;
                    if (plan.rule == VimCaretRule::AtOffset) plan.bias = Bias::Left;
                }
            }
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ t.range, std::move(replacement) });
            if (!t.block || plans.empty()) plans.push_back(plan);
        }
        ExitVisual();
        if (!keepRegister)
        {
            const VimRegisterOp kind = removed.kind == VimRegisterKind::Charwise && !multiLine ? VimRegisterOp::SmallDelete : VimRegisterOp::Delete;
            m_globals.registers.Store(0, std::move(removed), kind, m_host, m_options);
        }
        VimApplyWithCarets(ctx, std::move(ops), plans, true);
    }
}
```

`VimExecute.cpp` gains (includes `"TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.hpp"`; an anonymous-namespace helper and three members):

```cpp
    namespace
    {
        // vim do_pending_operator: an exclusive charwise motion that ends in column 0 of a
        // later line ends at the previous line's end (inclusive), or is linewise when it
        // started at or before the first non-blank (`:h exclusive-linewise`).
        VimOpTarget MotionToTarget(const VimContext& ctx, const Selection& s, const VimMotionTarget& t)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            const ByteOffset from = s.head;
            ByteOffset lo = std::min(from, t.offset), hi = std::max(from, t.offset);
            MotionKind kind = t.kind;
            if (kind == MotionKind::Exclusive && !t.noExclusiveAdjust)
            {
                const std::uint32_t loRow = VimText::RowOf(r, lo), hiRow = VimText::RowOf(r, hi);
                if (hiRow > loRow && hi == r.LineStart(hiRow))
                {
                    const std::uint32_t endRow = hiRow - 1;
                    if (lo <= VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, loRow)) { kind = MotionKind::Linewise; hi = r.LineStart(endRow); }
                    else if (r.LineEnd(endRow) > r.LineStart(endRow)) { hi = VimText::PrevChar(r, r.LineEnd(endRow)); kind = MotionKind::Inclusive; }
                    else hi = r.LineStart(endRow);
                }
            }
            if (kind == MotionKind::Linewise)
            {
                const VimRowSpan a = VimDisplayRowSpan(ctx, VimText::RowOf(r, lo));
                const VimRowSpan b = VimDisplayRowSpan(ctx, VimText::RowOf(r, hi));   // closed folds count whole
                return VimLinewiseTarget(r, a.first, b.last, s.id, from);
            }
            return VimOpTarget{ VimCursorModel::OperatorRange(r, lo, hi, kind), kind, false, s.id, from };
        }
    }

    std::vector<VimOpTarget> VimState::VisualTargets() const
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<VimOpTarget> out;
        for (const Selection& s : m_doc.selections.All())
        {
            const ByteOffset lo = std::min(s.anchor, s.head), hi = std::max(s.anchor, s.head);
            switch (m_mode)
            {
            case VimMode::VisualLine:
                out.push_back(VimLinewiseTarget(r, VimText::RowOf(r, lo), VimText::RowOf(r, hi), s.id, s.head));
                break;
            case VimMode::VisualBlock:
                out.push_back(VimOpTarget{ ByteRange{ lo, hi }, MotionKind::Inclusive, true, s.id, s.head });
                break;
            default:   // Visual: the editor selection already includes the char under the larger end
                out.push_back(VimOpTarget{ ByteRange{ lo, hi }, MotionKind::Inclusive, false, s.id, s.head });
                break;
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    void VimState::ExitVisual() { m_mode = VimMode::Normal; }

    void VimState::ExecuteOperator(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        const VimOperatorId op = *p.op;
        VimContext ctx = Context();
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        VimOpArgs args;
        args.reg = p.reg;
        args.count = p.count;
        args.fromVisual = IsVisual(m_mode);
        std::vector<VimOpTarget> targets;
        if (IsVisual(m_mode))
            targets = VisualTargets();
        else if (p.linewiseDouble)
        {
            VimMotionArgs line;            // dd = d_ : count-1 lines down, linewise
            line.id = VimMotionId::CurrentLine;
            line.count = p.count;
            line.op = op;
            // vim nv_lineop: before a doubled operator other than d y > <, the cursor goes to the first
            // non-blank (beginline(BL_WHITE)), so guu g~~ gUU gcc leave it there (finding 5a.13).
            const bool toFirstNonBlank = op == VimOperatorId::ToggleCase || op == VimOperatorId::Lower
                                      || op == VimOperatorId::Upper || op == VimOperatorId::Comment;
            for (const Selection& s : m_doc.selections.All())
            {
                const std::optional<VimMotionTarget> t = ResolveMotion(ctx, s.head, s.goalColumn, line);
                if (!t) continue;
                const VimRowSpan a = VimDisplayRowSpan(ctx, VimText::RowOf(r, s.head));
                const VimRowSpan b = VimDisplayRowSpan(ctx, VimText::RowOf(r, t->offset));
                const ByteOffset origin = toFirstNonBlank ? VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, VimText::RowOf(r, s.head))) : s.head;
                targets.push_back(VimLinewiseTarget(r, a.first, b.last, s.id, origin));
            }
        }
        else if (p.kind == VimCmdKind::TextObject)
        {
            Beep();                        // TE5a-16 replaces this branch with the ResolveTextObject loop
            return;
        }
        else
        {
            const VimMotionArgs a = VimMotionArgsOf(p);
            args.forceNumbered = VimUsesRegisterOne(a.id);
            for (const Selection& s : m_doc.selections.All())
                if (const std::optional<VimMotionTarget> t = ResolveMotion(ctx, s.head, s.goalColumn, a))
                    targets.push_back(MotionToTarget(ctx, s, *t));
        }
        if (targets.empty()) { Beep(); return; }
        if (op == VimOperatorId::Change) BeginInsertSession(VimActionId::InsertBefore, 1);   // the delete + the typing: one undo step
        const VimOpOutcome out = RunOperator(ctx, op, targets, args);
        if (IsVisual(m_mode)) ExitVisual();
        if (out.failed)
        {
            if (op == VimOperatorId::Change) EndInsertSession();
            Beep(out.message);
            return;
        }
        if (out.enterInsert)
        {
            MarkInsertStart();
            m_insert.autoIndentPending = out.autoIndentPending;
            m_mode = VimMode::Insert;
        }
    }
```

```cpp
    void VimState::Execute(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        switch (p.kind)
        {
        case VimCmdKind::Action:
            RunAction(p);
            break;
        case VimCmdKind::Motion:
            if (p.op) ExecuteOperator(p);
            else ExecuteMotion(p);
            break;
        case VimCmdKind::Operator:
            ExecuteOperator(p);
            break;
        case VimCmdKind::TextObject:
            if (p.op && !IsVisual(m_mode)) ExecuteOperator(p);
            else Beep();                   // a Visual selection extended by an object: TE5a-16/18
            break;
        }
    }
```

```cpp
    namespace

        VimParsed WithOperator(const VimParsed& p, VimOperatorId op, VimMotionId motion)
        {
            VimParsed q = p;
            q.op = op;
            q.kind = VimCmdKind::Motion;
            q.id = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(motion);
            q.linewiseDouble = false;
            return q;
        }

        VimParsed Doubled(const VimParsed& p, VimOperatorId op)
        {
            VimParsed q = p;
            q.op = op;
            q.kind = VimCmdKind::Operator;
            q.linewiseDouble = true;
            return q;
        }
    }
```

`RunVimCase` (VimCases.cpp, TE5a-6) drops `INFO("registers in a case need TE5a-12"); REQUIRE(c.setregs.empty()); REQUIRE(c.regs.empty());` and becomes (two helpers added to its anonymous namespace; `#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.hpp"`):

```cpp
        VimRegisterValue CaseValue(const VimCaseRegister& c)
        {
            VimRegisterValue v;
            v.kind = c.kind == 'V' ? VimRegisterKind::Linewise : c.kind == 'b' ? VimRegisterKind::Blockwise : VimRegisterKind::Charwise;
            if (v.kind != VimRegisterKind::Blockwise) { v.parts.push_back(c.text); return v; }
            std::size_t at = 0;
            for (;;)
            {
                const std::size_t nl = c.text.find('\n', at);
                v.parts.push_back(c.text.substr(at, nl == std::string::npos ? std::string::npos : nl - at));
                if (nl == std::string::npos) break;
                at = nl + 1;
            }
            return v;
        }

        char KindChar(VimRegisterKind k)
        {
            return k == VimRegisterKind::Linewise ? 'V' : k == VimRegisterKind::Blockwise ? 'b' : 'v';
        }
```

```cpp
    void RunVimCase(const VimCaseFile& file, const VimCase& c)
    {
        VimOptions options = NeovimDefaultOptions();   // what a fresh nvim starts from (5a.9)
        for (const std::string& s : file.sets) { INFO("@set " << s); REQUIRE(ApplyVimSet(options, s)); }
        for (const std::string& s : c.sets) { INFO("set: " << s); REQUIRE(ApplyVimSet(options, s)); }
        VimRig rig(c.in, VimCaseLanguage(c.grammar), options);
        for (const VimCaseRegister& s : c.setregs)
        {
            INFO("setreg: only a-z (vim's setreg on \" or a digit has extra rules)");
            REQUIRE((s.name >= U'a' && s.name <= U'z'));
            rig.Globals().registers.Preload(s.name, CaseValue(s));
        }
        rig.Keys(c.keys);
        INFO("keys: " << c.keys);
        INFO("in:   " << c.in);
        if (!c.divergence.empty()) INFO("divergence: " << c.divergence);
        CHECK(rig.Marked() == c.out);
        CHECK(std::string(VimModeCode(rig.Mode())) == c.mode);
        for (const VimCaseRegister& want : c.regs)
        {
            std::string name;
            Utf8::Append(name, want.name);
            INFO("reg " << name);
            const auto got = rig.Globals().registers.Get(want.name, rig.host, rig.vim->Options());
            REQUIRE(got.has_value());
            CHECK(KindChar(got->kind) == want.kind);
            CHECK(got->Text() == want.text);
        }
    }
```

- Produces: `MatchScratch VimGlobals::scratch` (initialised `RegexLimits{}` = PCRE2's built-in limits): the ONE scratch every vim regex match goes through (`=` here, TE5c-4 `VimSearch`, TE5c-11 `:sort`; `VimCharClass` runs no regex at all since its port of Neovim's `utf_class`, TE5a-3). Pure vim code never reads settings; the editor's `VimEditorRuntime` (TE5a-23) calls `m_globals.scratch.SetLimits(ToSyntaxLimits(Settings<TextSettings>()).regex)` at construction and in `OnSettingsPublished` (`Editor::ToSyntaxLimits`, TE3-3, declared in `TextSettings.hpp`), so a runaway `indent.increase` pattern stops at `editor.text.regexMatchLimit`/`regexDepthLimit` like the highlighter. `RunOperator` cases `IndentRight IndentLeft Reindent ToggleCase Lower Upper`; `std::string VimMapCase(std::string_view text, VimOperatorId op)` (Upper/Lower/ToggleCase over ASCII, Latin-1 incl. y-diaeresis, Greek, Cyrillic; everything else unchanged -- byte lengths never change, which the cursor logic relies on); `void VimState::ToggleCaseChars(const VimParsed&)` (`~`); `void VimState::JoinLines(const VimParsed&, bool spaces)` (`J`/`gJ`, Normal with a count and Visual over the selected rows).

Shifts follow vim's `shift_line` with `shiftround` off: `sw` per level, `count` levels in Visual (`3>`), one level per command otherwise (`>3j`); empty lines are never shifted; the indent is rebuilt from `expandtab`/`tabstop`; with `nostartofline` the cursor keeps its old screen column on the first line (vim's `old_col`). `=` re-indents with the grammar's `indent.increase`/`indent.decrease` rules from the indent of the nearest non-blank line above (Plain Text: each line copies the line above); the rules are compiled with `RegexOptions::Ucp` exactly as TE3-8 compiles them and matched through `ctx.globals.scratch` (a `LimitHit` or `Error` status counts as "the rule does not apply") -- a declared divergence in general (Neovim with no `indentexpr` uses C-indenting, spec s11.3; a `VimDivergences()` row), but the table's two `=` cases are inputs where C-indenting gives the same result, so the oracle checks them (D-R12 dropped their `divergence:` lines). Case operators put the cursor at vim's `oap->start` (finding 5a.13): a doubled `guu`/`gUU`/`g~~` first moves it to the first non-blank (vim's `nv_lineop` `beginline(BL_WHITE)`; `ExecuteOperator`, TE5a-12, sets that origin for the case and comment operators), a motion keeps the origin (`guj`), and a VisualLine selection goes to column 0 (`Vu`). `J` (Neovim: `nojoinspaces`, `formatoptions` contains `j`): leading blanks of the joined line go; one space is inserted unless the joined text is empty, starts with `)`, or the line so far ends in a blank; when the previous line and the joined line both start with the grammar's line-comment leader, the leader (and for `J` the blanks after it) is removed; the cursor lands on the last join point. `gJ` inserts and removes no blanks (it still drops a comment leader, as vim's `do_join` does with `use_formatoptions`). Divergence (notes): Neovim's default `'comments'` also treats `#`, `%`, `>` and `/* * */` as leaders regardless of the grammar.

```cpp
        char32_t UpperOf(char32_t c)
        {
            if (c >= U'a' && c <= U'z') return c - 0x20;
            if (c >= 0xE0 && c <= 0xFE && c != 0xF7) return c - 0x20;         // Latin-1 (not the division sign)
            if (c == 0xFF) return 0x178;                                       // y-diaeresis
            if (c >= 0x3B1 && c <= 0x3C9 && c != 0x3C2) return c - 0x20;       // Greek (final sigma stays)
            if (c >= 0x430 && c <= 0x44F) return c - 0x20;                     // Cyrillic
            if (c >= 0x450 && c <= 0x45F) return c - 0x50;
            return c;
        }

        char32_t LowerOf(char32_t c)
        {
            if (c >= U'A' && c <= U'Z') return c + 0x20;
            if (c >= 0xC0 && c <= 0xDE && c != 0xD7) return c + 0x20;         // not the multiplication sign
            if (c == 0x178) return 0xFF;
            if (c >= 0x391 && c <= 0x3A9 && c != 0x3A2) return c + 0x20;
            if (c >= 0x410 && c <= 0x42F) return c + 0x20;
            if (c >= 0x400 && c <= 0x40F) return c + 0x50;
            return c;
        }

        std::string IndentString(std::uint32_t width, const VimOptions& o)
        {
            if (o.expandTab) return std::string(width, ' ');
            const std::uint32_t tab = std::max(1u, o.tabSize);
            return std::string(width / tab, '\t') + std::string(width % tab, ' ');
        }

        VimRowRange RowsOf(const Rope& r, const VimOpTarget& t)
        {
            if (t.kind == MotionKind::Linewise && !t.block) return VimLinewiseRows(r, t.range);
            const ByteOffset last = t.range.end > t.range.begin ? t.range.end - 1 : t.range.begin;
            return VimRowRange{ VimText::RowOf(r, t.range.begin), VimText::RowOf(r, last) };
        }

        VimCaretPlan FirstRowCaret(const VimContext& ctx, const VimOpTarget& t, std::uint32_t firstRow)
        {
            VimCaretPlan plan;
            plan.id = t.cursorId;
            plan.at = ctx.Text().LineStart(firstRow);
            plan.rule = ctx.options.startofline ? VimCaretRule::RowFirstNonBlank : VimCaretRule::RowColumn;   // vim old_col
            plan.vcol = VimText::VirtualColumn(ctx.Text(), t.origin, ctx.options.tabSize);
            return plan;
        }

        // vim shift_line with 'shiftround' off
        VimOpOutcome Shift(VimContext& ctx, std::span<const VimOpTarget> targets, const VimOpArgs& args, bool right)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            const VimOptions& o = ctx.options;
            const std::uint32_t by = std::max(1u, o.shiftWidth) * (args.fromVisual ? std::max(1u, args.count) : 1u);
            std::vector<EditOp> ops;
            std::vector<VimCaretPlan> plans;
            std::int64_t done = -1;
            for (const VimOpTarget& t : targets)
            {
                const VimRowRange rows = RowsOf(r, t);
                for (std::uint32_t row = rows.first; row <= rows.last; ++row)
                {
                    if (static_cast<std::int64_t>(row) <= done || r.LineStart(row) == r.LineEnd(row)) continue;
                    const ByteOffset fnb = VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, row);
                    const std::uint32_t cur = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, fnb, o.tabSize);
                    const std::uint32_t next = right ? cur + by : (cur > by ? cur - by : 0);
                    if (next != cur) ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.LineStart(row), fnb }, IndentString(next, o) });
                }
                done = std::max<std::int64_t>(done, rows.last);
                if (!t.block || plans.empty()) plans.push_back(FirstRowCaret(ctx, t, rows.first));
            }
            VimApplyWithCarets(ctx, std::move(ops), plans, true);
            return {};
        }

        // indent.increase / indent.decrease, compiled as TE3-8 compiles them (Ucp); null = no rule
        std::shared_ptr<const Regex> CompileOptional(const std::string& source)
        {
            if (source.empty()) return nullptr;
            std::expected<std::shared_ptr<const Regex>, RegexError> re = Regex::Compile(source, RegexOptions::Ucp);
            if (!re) return nullptr;                       // the grammar loader refuses such a pattern; here: no rule
            return std::move(*re);
        }

        // Through the one shared scratch (VimGlobals::scratch, limits from the editor's settings).
        // NoMatch, LimitHit and Error all mean "the rule does not apply".
        bool Matches(VimContext& ctx, const std::shared_ptr<const Regex>& re, std::string_view text)
        {
            if (!re) return false;
            return ctx.globals.scratch.Match(*re, text, 0) == MatchStatus::Match;
        }

        // `=`: the grammar's indent rules from the nearest non-blank line above (a declared divergence from Neovim)
        VimOpOutcome Reindent(VimContext& ctx, std::span<const VimOpTarget> targets)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            const VimOptions& o = ctx.options;
            const std::int64_t sw = std::max(1u, o.shiftWidth);
            const std::shared_ptr<const Regex> increase = CompileOptional(ctx.language.indentIncrease);
            const std::shared_ptr<const Regex> decrease = CompileOptional(ctx.language.indentDecrease);
            std::vector<EditOp> ops;
            std::vector<VimCaretPlan> plans;
            std::int64_t done = -1;
            for (const VimOpTarget& t : targets)
            {
                const VimRowRange rows = RowsOf(r, t);
                std::int64_t prev = static_cast<std::int64_t>(rows.first) - 1;
                while (prev >= 0 && VimText::IsBlankLine(r, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(prev))) --prev;
                std::int64_t prevIndent = prev >= 0 ? VimText::VirtualColumn(r, VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(prev)), o.tabSize) : 0;
                std::string prevText = prev >= 0 ? VimText::Line(r, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(prev)) : std::string();
                for (std::uint32_t row = rows.first; row <= rows.last; ++row)
                {
                    if (static_cast<std::int64_t>(row) <= done) continue;
                    const std::string line = VimText::Line(r, row);
                    if (VimText::IsBlankLine(r, row))
                    {
                        if (!line.empty()) ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.LineStart(row), r.LineEnd(row) }, "" });
                        continue;
                    }
                    std::int64_t width = prevIndent;
                    if (prev >= 0 && Matches(ctx, increase, prevText)) width += sw;
                    if (Matches(ctx, decrease, line)) width -= sw;
                    width = std::max<std::int64_t>(width, 0);
                    const std::string indent = IndentString(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(width), o);
                    const std::size_t fnb = static_cast<std::size_t>(VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, row) - r.LineStart(row));
                    if (line.compare(0, fnb, indent) != 0 || fnb != indent.size())
                        ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.LineStart(row), r.LineStart(row) + fnb }, indent });
                    prevIndent = width;
                    prevText = indent + line.substr(fnb);
                    prev = row;
                }
                done = std::max<std::int64_t>(done, rows.last);
                if (!t.block || plans.empty()) plans.push_back(FirstRowCaret(ctx, t, rows.first));
            }
            VimApplyWithCarets(ctx, std::move(ops), plans, true);
            return {};
        }

        // The cursor goes to vim's oap->start: the origin for a motion (guj keeps the column, guk lands
        // on the line above), the first non-blank for guu (ExecuteOperator moved the origin there), and
        // column 0 for a VisualLine selection (Vu) -- finding 5a.13, checked against Neovim v0.12.5.
        VimOpOutcome ChangeCase(VimContext& ctx, VimOperatorId op, std::span<const VimOpTarget> targets, bool fromVisual)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            std::vector<EditOp> ops;
            std::vector<Selection> after;
            for (const VimOpTarget& t : targets)
            {
                ByteRange range = t.range;
                if (t.kind == MotionKind::Linewise && !t.block)
                {
                    const VimRowRange rows = VimLinewiseRows(r, t.range);
                    range = ByteRange{ r.LineStart(rows.first), r.LineEnd(rows.last) };
                }
                std::string text;
                r.CopyTo(range, text);
                std::string mapped = VimMapCase(text, op);
                if (mapped != text && (ops.empty() || range.begin >= ops.back().range.end))
                    ops.push_back(EditOp{ range, std::move(mapped) });
                if (!t.block || after.empty())
                {
                    const bool visualLine = fromVisual && t.kind == MotionKind::Linewise && !t.block;
                    const ByteOffset start = visualLine ? r.LineStart(VimLinewiseRows(r, t.range).first) : VimOperatorStartCursor(ctx, t);
                    const ByteOffset o = VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, start);                             // lengths never change
                    after.push_back(Selection{ t.cursorId, o, o, std::nullopt });
                }
            }
            const std::size_t primary = std::min(VimText::PrimaryIndex(ctx.doc), after.size() - 1);
            if (ops.empty()) VimText::Select(ctx.doc, std::move(after), primary);
            else VimText::Apply(ctx.doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), primary);
            return {};
        }
```

```cpp
    std::string VimMapCase(std::string_view text, VimOperatorId op)
    {
        std::string out;
        out.reserve(text.size());
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < text.size();)
        {
            const Utf8::Unit d = Utf8::DecodeAt(text, i);
            if (!d.valid || d.length == 0) { out.push_back(text[i]); ++i; continue; }   // an invalid byte stays as it is
            char32_t c = d.cp;
            if (op == VimOperatorId::Upper) c = UpperOf(c);
            else if (op == VimOperatorId::Lower) c = LowerOf(c);
            else { const char32_t u = UpperOf(c); c = u != c ? u : LowerOf(c); }
            Utf8::Append(out, c);
            i += d.length;
        }
        return out;
    }
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimLineEdits.cpp
// ~ and J / gJ (spec s6.3; Neovim: nojoinspaces, formatoptions+=j).
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    void VimState::ToggleCaseChars(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        bool any = false;
        for (const Selection& s : m_doc.selections.All())
        {
            const ByteOffset end = r.LineEnd(VimText::RowOf(r, s.head));
            if (s.head >= end) { after.push_back(s); continue; }   // an empty line
            any = true;
            ByteOffset o = s.head;
            for (std::uint32_t n = p.Count1(); n > 0 && o < end; --n) o = VimText::NextChar(r, o);
            std::string text;
            r.CopyTo(ByteRange{ s.head, o }, text);
            std::string mapped = VimMapCase(text, VimOperatorId::ToggleCase);
            if (mapped != text && (ops.empty() || s.head >= ops.back().range.end)) ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ s.head, o }, std::move(mapped) });
            const ByteOffset caret = o < end ? o : VimText::PrevChar(r, end);   // right after, or on the last char
            after.push_back(Selection{ s.id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        if (!any) { Beep(); return; }
        if (ops.empty()) VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        else VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }

    void VimState::JoinLines(const VimParsed& p, bool spaces)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::uint32_t lastRow = VimText::LastRow(r);   // D-R5: J on the last line of "a\nb\n" has nothing to join
        const std::string& leader = m_language.lineComment;
        const auto isComment = [&](std::string_view line) {
            const std::size_t i = line.find_first_not_of(" \t");
            return !leader.empty() && i != std::string_view::npos && line.substr(i, leader.size()) == leader;
        };
        const bool visual = IsVisual(m_mode);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::vector<VimCaretPlan> plans;
        std::int64_t done = -1;
        for (const Selection& s : m_doc.selections.All())
        {
            std::uint32_t first = 0, last = 0;
            if (visual)
            {
                first = VimText::RowOf(r, std::min(s.anchor, s.head));
                last = std::max(first + 1, VimText::RowOf(r, std::max(s.anchor, s.head)));
            }
            else
            {
                first = VimText::RowOf(r, s.head);
                last = first + std::max(2u, p.Count1()) - 1;
            }
            if (first >= lastRow || static_cast<std::int64_t>(first) <= done) continue;   // nothing below to join
            last = std::min(last, lastRow);
            done = last;
            std::string joined = VimText::Line(r, first);
            const std::size_t firstLen = joined.size();
            bool prevComment = isComment(joined);
            std::size_t joinCol = 0;
            for (std::uint32_t row = first + 1; row <= last; ++row)
            {
                const std::string curr = VimText::Line(r, row);
                const bool currComment = isComment(curr);
                std::size_t skip = 0;
                if (prevComment && currComment)
                {
                    skip = curr.find_first_not_of(" \t") + leader.size();               // formatoptions j
                    if (spaces) while (skip < curr.size() && (curr[skip] == ' ' || curr[skip] == '\t')) ++skip;
                }
                else if (spaces)
                    skip = std::min(curr.size(), curr.find_first_not_of(" \t"));
                prevComment = currComment;
                const std::string rest = curr.substr(skip);
                joinCol = joined.size();
                if (spaces && !rest.empty() && rest.front() != ')' && !joined.empty() && joined.back() != ' ' && joined.back() != '\t')
                    joined.push_back(' ');                                            // nojoinspaces: one, never two
                joined += rest;
            }
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.LineEnd(first), r.LineEnd(last) }, joined.substr(firstLen) });
            VimCaretPlan plan;
            plan.id = s.id;
            plan.at = r.LineStart(first);
            plan.plusBytes = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(joinCol);                       // vim: the last join point
            plans.push_back(plan);
        }
        if (ops.empty()) { Beep(); return; }
        VimContext ctx = Context();
        if (visual) ExitVisual();
        VimApplyWithCarets(ctx, std::move(ops), plans, true);
    }
}
```

### Task TE5a-14: gc / gcc -- Neovim's comment toggle from the grammar's comment (spec s6.3 Operators `gc`, s11.3 commentstring)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.cpp` (TE5a-12/13: comment helpers + the `Comment` case in `RunOperator`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.hpp` (TE5a-13: declare `VimToggleComment`)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5a.vimcases` (append)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimCommentTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimCommentString(const VimLanguage&)` (TE5a-3, the padded `// %s` form the oracle also sets) over `VimLanguage::lineComment/blockCommentBegin/blockCommentEnd`, which TE5a-3's `VimLanguageFromGrammar(const GrammarDesc&)` copies from TE3-7's `GrammarDesc` (the `.arcsyntax` `"comment": { "line", "block" }` object; in the editor TE5a-23 passes `doc.Grammar()` through the `CompiledGrammar` overload = `g.Rules().Desc()`, in the case runner `VimCaseLanguage` `ParseGrammar`s the mapped `data/Syntaxes/<Stem>.arcsyntax`), `VimApplyWithCarets`, `VimOperatorStartCursor`, `RowsOf` (TE5a-12/13).
- Produces: `RunOperator` case `Comment`; `std::vector<std::string> VimToggleComment(std::span<const std::string> lines, std::string_view commentString)` (pure: the lines after one `gc`; empty `commentString` returns the input unchanged); the failure message `E: Option 'commentstring' is empty (this language has no comment syntax)` when the grammar has no comment.

The algorithm is Neovim's `runtime/lua/vim/_comment.lua` (Apache-2.0; reimplemented, not translated): the comment string's `left`/`right` parts come from `commentstring` (`// %s` -> `// ` and ``); the lines are already commented when every non-blank line starts (after blanks) with `trim(left)` and ends (before trailing blanks) with `trim(right)`; commenting puts `indent .. left` before the text after the smallest indent of the non-blank lines and `right` after it, and turns a blank line into `indent .. trim(left) .. trim(right)`; uncommenting tries the exact parts, then the trimmed ones, and drops the indent and trailing blanks of a line that becomes blank. `gc` always works on whole lines. The cursor keeps its byte column on vim's `oap->start` line (the `nvim_buf_set_lines` in the Lua keeps the cursor position), clamped.

`VimOperators.cpp` adds to its anonymous namespace (after `ChangeCase`):

```cpp
        struct CommentParts { std::string left, right; };

        std::optional<CommentParts> SplitCommentString(std::string_view cs)
        {
            const std::size_t at = cs.find("%s");
            if (cs.empty() || at == std::string_view::npos) return std::nullopt;
            return CommentParts{ std::string(cs.substr(0, at)), std::string(cs.substr(at + 2)) };
        }

        std::string TrimBlanks(std::string_view s)
        {
            const std::size_t a = s.find_first_not_of(" \t");
            if (a == std::string_view::npos) return {};
            const std::size_t b = s.find_last_not_of(" \t");
            return std::string(s.substr(a, b - a + 1));
        }

        bool IsBlankText(std::string_view s) { return s.find_first_not_of(" \t") == std::string_view::npos; }

        // _comment.lua make_comment_check: ^%s-<trim(left)>.*<trim(right)>%s-$
        bool IsCommentedLine(std::string_view line, const CommentParts& p)
        {
            const std::string l = TrimBlanks(p.left), r = TrimBlanks(p.right);
            const std::size_t i = std::min(line.size(), line.find_first_not_of(" \t"));
            if (line.substr(i, l.size()) != l) return false;
            if (r.empty()) return true;
            const std::size_t w = line.find_last_not_of(" \t");
            const std::size_t contentEnd = w == std::string_view::npos ? 0 : w + 1;
            return contentEnd >= i + l.size() + r.size() && line.substr(contentEnd - r.size(), r.size()) == r;
        }

        // _comment.lua make_comment_function
        std::string CommentLine(std::string_view line, const CommentParts& p, std::string_view indent)
        {
            if (IsBlankText(line)) return std::string(indent) + TrimBlanks(p.left) + TrimBlanks(p.right);
            return std::string(indent) + p.left + std::string(line.substr(std::min(indent.size(), line.size()))) + p.right;
        }

        // _comment.lua make_uncomment_function: ^(%s*)<left>(.*)<right>(%s-)$, exact parts first, then trimmed
        std::optional<std::string> TryUncomment(std::string_view line, std::string_view l, std::string_view rr)
        {
            const std::size_t i = std::min(line.size(), line.find_first_not_of(" \t"));
            if (line.substr(i, l.size()) != l) return std::nullopt;
            std::string_view indent = line.substr(0, i);
            const std::string_view rest = line.substr(i + l.size());
            std::string_view middle = rest, trail;
            if (!rr.empty())
            {
                const std::size_t w = rest.find_last_not_of(" \t");
                const std::size_t contentEnd = w == std::string_view::npos ? 0 : w + 1;
                if (contentEnd < rr.size() || rest.substr(contentEnd - rr.size(), rr.size()) != rr) return std::nullopt;
                middle = rest.substr(0, contentEnd - rr.size());
                trail = rest.substr(contentEnd);
            }
            if (IsBlankText(middle)) { indent = {}; trail = {}; }   // never leave trailing whitespace
            return std::string(indent) + std::string(middle) + std::string(trail);
        }

        std::string UncommentLine(std::string_view line, const CommentParts& p)
        {
            if (auto exact = TryUncomment(line, p.left, p.right)) return *exact;
            const std::string l = TrimBlanks(p.left), r = TrimBlanks(p.right);
            if (auto trimmed = TryUncomment(line, l, r)) return *trimmed;
            return std::string(line);
        }

        VimOpOutcome Comment(VimContext& ctx, std::span<const VimOpTarget> targets)
        {
            const std::string cs = VimCommentString(ctx.language);
            if (!SplitCommentString(cs))
            {
                VimOpOutcome failed;
                failed.failed = true;
                failed.message = "E: Option 'commentstring' is empty (this language has no comment syntax)";
                return failed;
            }
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            std::vector<EditOp> ops;
            std::vector<VimCaretPlan> plans;
            std::int64_t done = -1;
            for (const VimOpTarget& t : targets)
            {
                const VimRowRange rows = RowsOf(r, t);
                if (static_cast<std::int64_t>(rows.first) > done)
                {
                    std::vector<std::string> lines;
                    for (std::uint32_t row = rows.first; row <= rows.last; ++row) lines.push_back(VimText::Line(r, row));
                    const std::vector<std::string> next = VimToggleComment(lines, cs);
                    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < lines.size(); ++i)
                        if (next[i] != lines[i])
                        {
                            const std::uint32_t row = rows.first + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i);
                            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.LineStart(row), r.LineEnd(row) }, next[i] });
                        }
                    done = rows.last;
                }
                if (!t.block || plans.empty())
                {
                    const ByteOffset start = VimOperatorStartCursor(ctx, t);
                    const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, start);
                    VimCaretPlan plan;
                    plan.id = t.cursorId;
                    plan.at = r.LineStart(row);
                    plan.plusBytes = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(start - r.LineStart(row));   // the byte column survives
                    plans.push_back(plan);
                }
            }
            VimApplyWithCarets(ctx, std::move(ops), plans, true);
            return {};
        }
```

the public function (after `VimMapCase`):

```cpp
    std::vector<std::string> VimToggleComment(std::span<const std::string> lines, std::string_view commentString)
    {
        const std::optional<CommentParts> parts = SplitCommentString(commentString);
        std::vector<std::string> out(lines.begin(), lines.end());
        if (!parts) return out;
        std::string indent;                 // _comment.lua get_lines_info: the smallest indent of the non-blank lines
        bool haveIndent = false, commented = true;
        for (const std::string& l : lines)
        {
            const std::size_t w = std::min(l.size(), l.find_first_not_of(" \t"));
            if (w >= l.size()) continue;    // blank lines never decide
            if (!haveIndent || w < indent.size()) { indent = l.substr(0, w); haveIndent = true; }
            if (commented) commented = IsCommentedLine(l, *parts);
        }
        for (std::string& l : out) l = commented ? UncommentLine(l, *parts) : CommentLine(l, *parts, indent);
        return out;
    }
```

### Task TE5a-15: Ctrl-A / Ctrl-X with nrformats=bin,hex (spec s6.3 Operators, s6.4 nrformats, D13)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimIncrement.hpp`

- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (TE5a-13: declare `Increment`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimActions.cpp` (TE5a-13: `Increment Decrement` cases)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5a.vimcases` (append)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimIncrementTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimOptions::nrBin/nrHex/nrOctal/nrAlpha` (TE5a-3), `VisualTargets`, `ExitVisual`, `VimApplyWithCarets`, `VimLinewiseRows` (TE5a-12).
- Produces: `struct VimNumberEdit { begin; end; text; }`, `std::optional<VimNumberEdit> VimAddSub(std::string_view line, std::size_t col, std::size_t visualLength, std::uint64_t delta, bool subtract, const VimOptions&)` (pure: vim's `do_addsub` on one line; `visualLength` 0 = Normal), `void VimState::Increment(const VimParsed&, bool add)`. TE5a-20 routes Normal/Visual Ctrl-A / Ctrl-X here (Insert keeps the Windows meanings, spec s6.6); TE5a-18 (Visual) exercises the Visual branch.

`do_addsub` semantics: in Normal the number is the one under or after the cursor on its line (a hex `0x..` or binary `0b..` number under the cursor is found from any of its digits); a `-` right before a decimal number makes it negative; hex/binary/octal ignore the `-`; decimal results wrap through zero with a sign flip as in vim's unsigned arithmetic; leading zeros keep the number's width unless octal is on (Neovim's default `nrformats=bin,hex` has no octal, so `007` becomes `008`); hex keeps the case of the last letter it had; the cursor ends on the number's last character. In Visual every selected line's first number in the selection changes by the count and the cursor goes to the selection's start. `alpha` steps single letters and saturates at `a`/`z`.

```cpp
        if (!e) return "<none>";
        std::string s(line);
        s.replace(e->begin, e->end - e->begin, e->text);
        return s;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim Ctrl-A: decimal, sign, hex, binary, zero padding", "[text-vim-increment]")
{
    CHECK(Apply("x 7 y", 0, 1, false) == "x 8 y");
    CHECK(Apply("-1", 0, 1, false) == "0");
    CHECK(Apply("x-5", 2, 10, false) == "x5");
    CHECK(Apply("1", 0, 2, true) == "-1");
    CHECK(Apply("0xff", 0, 1, false) == "0x100");
    CHECK(Apply("0xFE", 2, 1, false) == "0xFF");               // the last letter's case is kept
    CHECK(Apply("0b101", 0, 1, false) == "0b110");
    CHECK(Apply("007", 0, 1, false) == "008");                 // no octal in Neovim's nrformats: decimal, width kept
    CHECK(Apply("18446744073709551615", 0, 1, false) == "-18446744073709551615");   // vim's unsigned wrap
    CHECK(Apply("abc", 0, 1, false) == "<none>");
    CHECK(Apply("12 x", 3, 1, false) == "<none>");             // nothing at or after the cursor
}

TEST_CASE("vim Ctrl-A: octal and alpha when nrformats asks for them", "[text-vim-increment]")
{
    VimOptions oct;
    REQUIRE(ParseNrFormats("octal,hex", oct));
    CHECK(Apply("007", 0, 1, false, oct) == "010");
    VimOptions alpha;
    REQUIRE(ParseNrFormats("bin,hex,alpha", alpha));
    CHECK(Apply("a", 0, 3, false, alpha) == "d");
    CHECK(Apply("y", 0, 5, false, alpha) == "z");               // saturates
    CHECK(Apply("C", 0, 9, true, alpha) == "A");
}

TEST_CASE("vim Ctrl-A: every cursor's number changes", "[text-vim-increment]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "1\n\xCB\x87" "9");
    r.Keys("<C-a>");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "2\n1\xCB\x87" "0");
    VimRig none("\xCB\x87" "abc");
    none.Keys("<C-a>l");                                        // no number: beep; the typed l still runs (D-R12)
    CHECK(none.beeps == 1u);
    CHECK(none.Marked() == "a\xCB\x87" "bc");
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimIncrement.hpp
#pragma once

// Ctrl-A / Ctrl-X (spec s6.3): vim's do_addsub on one line, pure.

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimOptions.hpp"

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimNumberEdit
    {
        std::size_t begin = 0, end = 0;   // replace line[begin, end) with text; the cursor goes on its last char
        std::string text;
    };

    // `visualLength` 0 = Normal (the number under or after `col`); > 0 = Visual (the first number in [col, col + length)).
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<VimNumberEdit> VimAddSub(std::string_view line, std::size_t col, std::size_t visualLength,
                                                         std::uint64_t delta, bool subtract, const VimOptions& options);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimIncrement.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimIncrement.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        bool Digit(char c) { return c >= '0' && c <= '9'; }
        bool Hex(char c) { return Digit(c) || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F'); }
        bool Bin(char c) { return c == '0' || c == '1'; }
        bool Oct(char c) { return c >= '0' && c <= '7'; }
        bool Alpha(char c) { return (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z'); }
        bool Upper(char c) { return c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z'; }

        std::string ToBase(std::uint64_t n, unsigned base, bool upper)
        {
            if (n == 0) return "0";
            const char* digits = upper ? "0123456789ABCDEF" : "0123456789abcdef";
            std::string out;
            while (n != 0) { out.push_back(digits[n % base]); n /= base; }
            std::reverse(out.begin(), out.end());
            return out;
        }
    }

    std::optional<VimNumberEdit> VimAddSub(std::string_view line, std::size_t col, std::size_t visualLength,
                                          std::uint64_t delta, bool subtract, const VimOptions& o)
    {
        constexpr std::uint64_t kMax = std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max();
        const bool visual = visualLength > 0;
        const std::size_t size = line.size();
        const auto at = [&](std::size_t i) -> char { return i < size ? line[i] : '\0'; };
        if (col >= size) return std::nullopt;
        std::size_t c = col;
        bool negative = false, wasPositive = true;
        if (visual)
        {
            std::size_t length = visualLength;
            while (c < size && length > 0 && !Digit(line[c]) && !(o.nrAlpha && Alpha(line[c]))) { ++c; --length; }
            if (length == 0 || c >= size) return std::nullopt;
            if (c > col && line[c - 1] == '-') { negative = true; wasPositive = false; }
        }
        else
        {
            const auto hexAt = [&](std::size_t i) { return i > 0 && (at(i) == 'x' || at(i) == 'X') && at(i - 1) == '0' && Hex(at(i + 1)); };
            const auto binAt = [&](std::size_t i) { return i > 0 && (at(i) == 'b' || at(i) == 'B') && at(i - 1) == '0' && Bin(at(i + 1)); };
            if (o.nrBin) while (c > 0 && Bin(at(c))) --c;
            if (o.nrHex) while (c > 0 && Hex(at(c))) --c;
            if (o.nrBin && o.nrHex && !hexAt(c))
            {
                c = col;                                   // binary / hex overlap: rescan over decimal digits
                while (c > 0 && Digit(at(c))) --c;
            }
            if ((o.nrHex && hexAt(c)) || (o.nrBin && binAt(c)))
                --c;                                       // on a hex / binary number: its leading 0
            else
            {
                c = col;                                   // forward to a number, then back to its start
                while (c < size && !Digit(line[c]) && !(o.nrAlpha && Alpha(line[c]))) ++c;
                while (c > 0 && Digit(line[c - 1]) && !(o.nrAlpha && Alpha(at(c)))) --c;
            }
        }
        if (c >= size) return std::nullopt;
        const char firstDigit = line[c];
        if (!Digit(firstDigit) && !(o.nrAlpha && Alpha(firstDigit))) return std::nullopt;

        if (o.nrAlpha && Alpha(firstDigit))
        {
            ARC_CONSTANT("the Latin alphabet: nrformats=alpha saturates at a/z (vim do_addsub)")
            constexpr std::uint64_t kLetters = 26;
            const char base = Upper(firstDigit) ? 'A' : 'a';
            const std::uint64_t ord = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(firstDigit - base);
            char out = firstDigit;
            if (subtract) out = ord < delta ? base : static_cast<char>(firstDigit - static_cast<char>(delta));
            else out = kLetters - ord - 1 < delta ? static_cast<char>(base + kLetters - 1) : static_cast<char>(firstDigit + static_cast<char>(delta));
            return VimNumberEdit{ c, c + 1, std::string(1, out) };
        }

        if (!visual && c > 0 && line[c - 1] == '-') { --c; negative = true; }
        const std::size_t start = (!visual && negative) ? c + 1 : c;   // the first digit
        char pre = 0;
        if (line[start] == '0' && start + 1 < size)
        {
            const char x = line[start + 1];
            if (o.nrHex && (x == 'x' || x == 'X') && Hex(at(start + 2))) pre = x;
            else if (o.nrBin && (x == 'b' || x == 'B') && Bin(at(start + 2))) pre = x;
            else if (o.nrOctal && Digit(x))
            {
                pre = '0';
                for (std::size_t i = start + 1; i < size && Digit(line[i]); ++i)
                    if (!Oct(line[i])) { pre = 0; break; }   // an 8 or a 9: decimal after all
            }
        }
        unsigned base = 10;
        std::size_t digitsBegin = start;
        if (pre == 'x' || pre == 'X') { base = 16; digitsBegin = start + 2; }
        else if (pre == 'b' || pre == 'B') { base = 2; digitsBegin = start + 2; }
        else if (pre == '0') { base = 8; digitsBegin = start + 1; }
        const std::size_t limit = visual ? std::min(size, col + visualLength) : size;
        std::size_t end = digitsBegin;
        std::uint64_t n = 0;
        bool hexUpper = false;
        while (end < limit)
        {
            const char d = line[end];
            unsigned v = 0;
            if (base == 16 && Hex(d))
            {
                v = Digit(d) ? static_cast<unsigned>(d - '0') : static_cast<unsigned>((Upper(d) ? d - 'A' : d - 'a') + 10);
                if (Alpha(d)) hexUpper = Upper(d);        // the last letter decides
            }
            else if (base == 2 && Bin(d)) v = static_cast<unsigned>(d - '0');
            else if (base == 8 && Oct(d)) v = static_cast<unsigned>(d - '0');
            else if (base == 10 && Digit(d)) v = static_cast<unsigned>(d - '0');
            else break;
            n = n > (kMax - v) / base ? kMax : n * base + v;
            ++end;
        }
        std::size_t replaceBegin = visual ? start : c;     // Normal: from the '-' when there is one
        if (pre != 0 && negative) { ++replaceBegin; negative = false; }   // hex / binary / octal ignore a '-'
        bool sub = subtract;
        if (negative) sub = !sub;
        const std::uint64_t oldn = n;
        n = sub ? n - delta : n + delta;
        if (pre == 0)                                      // decimal: wrap through zero with a sign flip
        {
            if (sub) { if (n > oldn) { n = 1 + (n ^ kMax); negative = !negative; } }
            else if (n < oldn) { n = n ^ kMax; negative = !negative; }
            if (n == 0) negative = false;
        }
        if (visual && !wasPositive && !negative && replaceBegin > 0) --replaceBegin;   // went non-negative: drop its '-'
        std::string out;
        if (negative && (!visual || wasPositive)) out.push_back('-');
        if (pre != 0) { out.push_back('0'); if (pre != '0') out.push_back(pre); }
        std::string digits = ToBase(n, base, hexUpper);
        const std::size_t oldDigits = end - digitsBegin;
        if (firstDigit == '0' && !(o.nrOctal && pre == 0) && digits.size() < oldDigits)
            digits.insert(0, oldDigits - digits.size(), '0');   // keep the number's width
        out += digits;
        return VimNumberEdit{ replaceBegin, end, std::move(out) };
    }

    void VimState::Increment(const VimParsed& p, bool add)
    {
        VimContext ctx = Context();
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::vector<VimCaretPlan> plans;
        const auto edit = [&](std::uint32_t row, ByteOffset from, std::size_t visualLength) -> std::optional<ByteOffset> {
            const ByteOffset ls = r.LineStart(row);
            const std::string line = VimText::Line(r, row);
            const auto e = VimAddSub(line, static_cast<std::size_t>(from - ls), visualLength, p.Count1(), !add, m_options);
            if (!e) return std::nullopt;
            if (!ops.empty() && ls + e->begin < ops.back().range.end) return std::nullopt;   // two cursors on one number
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ ls + e->begin, ls + e->end }, e->text });
            return ls + e->begin;
        };
        if (IsVisual(m_mode))
        {
            for (const VimOpTarget& t : VisualTargets())
            {
                const bool lines = t.kind == MotionKind::Linewise && !t.block;
                const VimRowRange rows = lines ? VimLinewiseRows(r, t.range)
                                               : VimRowRange{ VimText::RowOf(r, t.range.begin),
                                                              VimText::RowOf(r, t.range.end > t.range.begin ? t.range.end - 1 : t.range.begin) };
                for (std::uint32_t row = rows.first; row <= rows.last; ++row)
                {
                    const ByteOffset s = lines ? r.LineStart(row) : std::max(t.range.begin, r.LineStart(row));
                    const ByteOffset e = lines ? r.LineEnd(row) : std::min(t.range.end, r.LineEnd(row));
                    if (e > s) (void)edit(row, s, static_cast<std::size_t>(e - s));
                }
                if (!t.block || plans.empty())
                {
                    VimCaretPlan plan;
                    plan.id = t.cursorId;
                    plan.at = t.range.begin;   // the selection's start
                    plans.push_back(plan);
                }
            }
            ExitVisual();
        }
        else
        {
            for (const Selection& s : m_doc.selections.All())
            {
                const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, s.head);
                if (const std::optional<ByteOffset> begin = edit(row, s.head, 0))
                {
                    VimCaretPlan plan;
                    plan.id = s.id;
                    plan.at = *begin;
                    plan.plusBytes = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(ops.back().text.size() - 1);   // the new number's last char
                    plans.push_back(plan);
                }
            }
        }
        if (ops.empty()) { Beep(); return; }
        VimApplyWithCarets(ctx, std::move(ops), plans, true);
    }
}
```

```
DIVERGENCES TO LIST IN THE VIM HELP PAGE / ORACLE NOTES (not oracle-testable or deliberate)
  - `=` uses the grammar's indent rules (Neovim: C-indenting without indentexpr) -- a VimDivergences() row; the table's two `=` cases are inputs where both agree (oracle-checked, no `divergence:` line).
  - J's formatoptions-j removes only the grammar's line-comment leader; Neovim's default 'comments' also knows # % > /* * */.
  - % matches ()[]{} with nesting only: no /* */, no #if/#else/#endif, no quote heuristics.
  - Paragraph/sentence boundaries: empty lines and form feeds only (no nroff macros from 'paragraphs'/'sections').
  - Word classes are a port of Neovim's utf_class (TE5a-3, finding 5a.5: per-script CJK/kana/Hangul classes, emoji 3,
    U+3000 blank, Latin-1 per iskeyword @,48-57,_,192-255) -- no divergence left there. Word motions do not skip closed folds.
  - Virtual columns count every grapheme as one cell (wide CJK glyphs are two cells in Neovim).
  - Case mapping covers ASCII, Latin-1, Greek, Cyrillic; other scripts are unchanged (sharp s does not become SS).
  - A count on Ctrl-D/Ctrl-U applies to that command only (vim also stores it in 'scroll').
  - `dd` after `$` restores the origin's virtual column, not curswant MAXCOL.
  - Cursor rules the oracle must confirm on first run (Step 2b of each task): >> / << keep the screen column (old_col),
    gcc from the first non-blank (5a.13), Ctrl-D/Ctrl-F in a buffer shorter than the window, gJ with a comment leader, the Enter
    blank rule (TE5a-5: blanks before the split stay). Neovim wins on any mismatch; the task fixes expectation and code together.
```

### Task TE5a-16: Text objects -- iw aw iW aW is as ip ap (spec s6.3 Text objects, s6.2 operators on objects)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimTextObjects.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimTextObjects.cpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimObjectOps.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (TE5a-5: two private members)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.cpp` (`VimState::Execute`, the `VimCmdKind::TextObject` routing)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5a.vimcases` (append the text-object section)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimTextObjectsTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimContext`, `VimCharClass::Class`, `VimText::*`, `VimCursorModel::LinewiseDeleteRange` (TE5a-2..5); `RunOperator`, `VimOpTarget`, `VimOpArgs`, `VimOpOutcome` (TE5a-12, contract signatures); `BeginInsertSession`, `EndInsertSession`, `MarkInsertStart` (TE5a-5).
- Produces:
  - `struct VimObjectArgs { VimObjectId id; bool inner; std::uint32_t count; bool visual; }`, `struct VimObjectRange { ByteRange range; MotionKind kind; }`
  - `std::optional<VimObjectRange> ResolveTextObject(VimContext& ctx, ByteRange current, ByteOffset cursor, const VimObjectArgs& args)` -- the range is FINAL (editor bytes); `ip`/`ap` are `MotionKind::Linewise` with the CONTENT range `[LineStart(first), LineEnd(last))` of their rows (Part A's linewise form, `VimLinewiseTarget`; `RunOperator` expands it to `LinewiseDeleteRange` itself).
  - `std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t> LinewiseRows(const Rope&, ByteRange linewiseRange)` (rows of a linewise content range; delegates to Part A's `VimLinewiseRows`).
  - `VimState::ObjectTargets(const VimParsed&, std::vector<VimOpTarget>&)`, `VimState::ExecuteObjectOperator(const VimParsed&)`.

An operator on a text object does not go through Part A's motion path: `ExecuteObjectOperator` builds one `VimOpTarget` per cursor from `ResolveTextObject` and calls `RunOperator` once, opening the insert session first for `c` so the delete and the typed text undo together (the same rule `ExecuteOperator` applies to motions). Word classes come from `VimCharClass` (grammar `wordChars` + the port of Neovim's `utf_class`, TE5a-3), so `diw` on `café` takes the whole word and on `漢字かな` only the kanji. `aw` with no trailing blank takes the leading blank -- never the indent (vim's `current_word`, finding 5a.23).

```cpp
{
    std::optional<VimObjectRange> Obj(VimRig& r, ByteOffset at, VimObjectId id, bool inner, std::uint32_t count = 1)
    {

        return ResolveTextObject(ctx, ByteRange{ at, at }, at, VimObjectArgs{ id, inner, count, false });
    }
    void CheckRange(const std::optional<VimObjectRange>& o, ByteOffset b, ByteOffset e)
    {
        REQUIRE(o.has_value());
        CHECK(o->range.begin == b);
        CHECK(o->range.end == e);
    }

TEST_CASE("vim text objects: iw / aw over word, punctuation and blank runs", "[text-vim-objects]")
{
    // "foo bar  baz": f0 o1 o2 _3 b4 a5 r6 _7 _8 b9 a10 z11
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "foo bar  baz");
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 5, VimObjectId::Word, true), 4, 7);
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 5, VimObjectId::Word, false), 4, 9);          // the word and its trailing blanks
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 5, VimObjectId::Word, true, 2), 4, 9);        // iw counts blank runs too
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 5, VimObjectId::Word, false, 2), 3, 12);      // no trailing blank after baz: leading blank joins
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 7, VimObjectId::Word, true), 7, 9);           // on blanks: the blank run
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 7, VimObjectId::Word, false), 7, 12);         // blanks + the next word
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 10, VimObjectId::Word, false), 7, 12);        // last word: the leading blanks instead

    VimRig p("\xCB\x87" "a foo-bar b");
    CheckRange(Obj(p, 3, VimObjectId::Word, true), 2, 5);           // '-' is punctuation: its own run
    CheckRange(Obj(p, 3, VimObjectId::BigWord, true), 2, 9);        // iW: every non-blank is one class
}

    CHECK(ip->kind == MotionKind::Linewise);
```
