```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimTextObjects.hpp
#pragma once

// Vim text objects (spec s6.3): resolved per cursor to a FINAL editor byte
// range. Word classes come from VimCharClass (the grammar's wordChars plus the
// port of Neovim's utf_class, TE5a-3); ip/ap are linewise, in Part A's content form [LineStart(first), LineEnd(last)).

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimContext.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCursorModel.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <utility>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimObjectArgs
    {
        VimObjectId   id = VimObjectId::Word;
        bool          inner = true;
        std::uint32_t count = 1;
        bool          visual = false;
    };

    struct VimObjectRange
    {
        ByteRange  range;
        MotionKind kind = MotionKind::Inclusive;   // Linewise for ip/ap (and whole-line i{ blocks, TE5a-17)
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<VimObjectRange> ResolveTextObject(VimContext& ctx, ByteRange current, ByteOffset cursor,
                                                                  const VimObjectArgs& args);
    // The rows a linewise content range [LineStart(first), LineEnd(last)) covers (Part A's VimLinewiseRows).
    [[nodiscard]] std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t> LinewiseRows(const Rope& r, ByteRange range);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimTextObjects.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimTextObjects.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.hpp"   // VimLinewiseRows (TE5a-12)

#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        std::optional<VimObjectRange> WordObject(const VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset cursor, bool inner, std::uint32_t count, bool big)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, cursor);
            const ByteOffset ls = r.LineStart(row), le = r.LineEnd(row);
            if (ls == le) return VimObjectRange{ ByteRange{ ls, ls }, MotionKind::Inclusive };
            const auto cls = [&](ByteOffset o) { return ctx.chars.Class(VimText::CodePointAt(r, o), big); };
            const auto runEnd = [&](ByteOffset o) {
                const int c = cls(o);
                while (o < le && cls(o) == c) o = VimText::NextChar(r, o);
                return o;
            };
            const auto runStart = [&](ByteOffset o) {
                const int c = cls(o);
                while (o > ls)
                {
                    const ByteOffset p = VimText::PrevChar(r, o);
                    if (cls(p) != c) break;
                    o = p;
                }
                return o;
            };
            ByteOffset start = runStart(cursor), end = runEnd(cursor);
            if (inner)
            {
                for (std::uint32_t i = 1; i < count && end < le; ++i) end = runEnd(end);
                return VimObjectRange{ ByteRange{ start, end }, MotionKind::Inclusive };
            }
            if (cls(cursor) == 0)                       // on blanks: the blanks and the word after them
            {
                for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
                {
                    if (i > 0 && end < le && cls(end) == 0) end = runEnd(end);
                    if (end < le) end = runEnd(end);
                }
                return VimObjectRange{ ByteRange{ start, end }, MotionKind::Inclusive };
            }
            bool trailing = false;
            for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
            {
                if (i > 0 && end < le) end = runEnd(end);
                trailing = end < le && cls(end) == 0;
                if (trailing) end = runEnd(end);
            }
            // No trailing white space: take the leading white space instead -- but never the indent (vim's
            // current_word: "don't delete white space at start of line", finding 5a.23).
            if (!trailing && start > ls && cls(VimText::PrevChar(r, start)) == 0)
            {
                const ByteOffset white = runStart(VimText::PrevChar(r, start));
                if (white > ls) start = white;
            }
            return VimObjectRange{ ByteRange{ start, end }, MotionKind::Inclusive };
        }

        bool IsWhite(char c) { return c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n'; }

        std::optional<VimObjectRange> SentenceObject(const VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset cursor, bool inner, std::uint32_t count)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, cursor);
            if (r.LineStart(row) == r.LineEnd(row)) return std::nullopt;   // an empty line is a paragraph boundary
            std::uint32_t first = row, last = row;
            while (first > 0 && r.LineStart(first - 1) != r.LineEnd(first - 1)) --first;
            while (last + 1 < VimText::LineCount(r) && r.LineStart(last + 1) != r.LineEnd(last + 1)) ++last;
            const ByteOffset base = r.LineStart(first);
            std::string t;
            r.CopyTo(ByteRange{ base, r.LineEnd(last) }, t);

            struct Span { std::size_t b, e; bool white; };
            std::vector<Span> items;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < t.size();)
            {
                if (IsWhite(t[i]))
                {
                    std::size_t j = i;
                    while (j < t.size() && IsWhite(t[j])) ++j;
                    items.push_back(Span{ i, j, true });
                    i = j;
                    continue;
                }
                std::size_t j = i, end = t.size();
                while (j < t.size())
                {
                    if (t[j] == '.' || t[j] == '!' || t[j] == '?')
                    {
                        std::size_t k = j + 1;
                        while (k < t.size() && (t[k] == ')' || t[k] == ']' || t[k] == '"' || t[k] == '\'')) ++k;
                        if (k == t.size() || IsWhite(t[k])) { end = k; break; }
                        j = k;
                        continue;
                    }
                    ++j;
                }
                items.push_back(Span{ i, end, false });
                i = end;
            }
            const std::size_t c = static_cast<std::size_t>(cursor - base);
            std::size_t idx = 0;
            while (idx < items.size() && !(c >= items[idx].b && c < items[idx].e)) ++idx;
            if (idx == items.size()) return std::nullopt;

            std::size_t b = items[idx].b, e = items[idx].e, k = idx;
            if (inner)
            {
                for (std::uint32_t n = 1; n < count && k + 1 < items.size(); ++n) e = items[++k].e;
                return VimObjectRange{ ByteRange{ base + b, base + e }, MotionKind::Inclusive };
            }
            bool trailing = false;
            for (std::uint32_t n = 0; n < count; ++n)
            {
                if (n > 0 && k + 1 < items.size()) e = items[++k].e;
                trailing = k + 1 < items.size();
                if (trailing) e = items[++k].e;           // a sentence's trailing blanks, or the sentence after blanks
            }
            if (!trailing && !items[idx].white && idx > 0 && items[idx - 1].white) b = items[idx - 1].b;
            return VimObjectRange{ ByteRange{ base + b, base + e }, MotionKind::Inclusive };
        }

        std::optional<VimObjectRange> ParagraphObject(const VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset cursor, bool inner, std::uint32_t count)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            const std::uint32_t rows = VimText::LineCount(r);   // D-R5: the row after a final '\n' is not a blank line
            const auto blank = [&](std::uint32_t row) { return VimText::IsBlankLine(r, row); };   // ip/ap: blank = only white
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, cursor);
            const auto runFirst = [&](std::uint32_t at) { const bool b = blank(at); while (at > 0 && blank(at - 1) == b) --at; return at; };
            const auto runLast = [&](std::uint32_t at) { const bool b = blank(at); while (at + 1 < rows && blank(at + 1) == b) ++at; return at; };
            std::uint32_t first = runFirst(row), last = runLast(row);
            if (inner)
            {
                for (std::uint32_t n = 1; n < count && last + 1 < rows; ++n) last = runLast(last + 1);
            }
            else
            {
                const bool startedBlank = blank(row);
                bool trailing = false;
                for (std::uint32_t n = 0; n < count; ++n)
                {
                    if (n > 0 && last + 1 < rows) last = runLast(last + 1);
                    trailing = last + 1 < rows;
                    if (trailing) last = runLast(last + 1);   // blank lines after a paragraph / the paragraph after blanks
                }
                if (!trailing && !startedBlank && first > 0) first = runFirst(first - 1);   // no blank after: the blank before
            }
            return VimObjectRange{ ByteRange{ r.LineStart(first), r.LineEnd(last) }, MotionKind::Linewise };   // Part A's content form
        }
    }

    std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t> LinewiseRows(const Rope& r, ByteRange range)
    {
        const VimRowRange rows = VimLinewiseRows(r, range);       // Part A (TE5a-12): the content form is unambiguous
        return { rows.first, rows.last };
    }

    std::optional<VimObjectRange> ResolveTextObject(VimContext& ctx, ByteRange current, ByteOffset cursor, const VimObjectArgs& args)
    {
        (void)current;
        const std::uint32_t count = std::max(1u, args.count);
        switch (args.id)
        {
        case VimObjectId::Word:      return WordObject(ctx, cursor, args.inner, count, false);
        case VimObjectId::BigWord:   return WordObject(ctx, cursor, args.inner, count, true);
        case VimObjectId::Sentence:  return SentenceObject(ctx, cursor, args.inner, count);
        case VimObjectId::Paragraph: return ParagraphObject(ctx, cursor, args.inner, count);
        default:                     return std::nullopt;     // quotes, brackets, tags: TE5a-17
        }
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimObjectOps.cpp
// An operator on a text object (spec s6.2): one VimOpTarget per cursor, one
// RunOperator call, the insert session opened first for c.
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimTextObjects.hpp"

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    bool VimState::ObjectTargets(const VimParsed& p, std::vector<VimOpTarget>& out)
    {
        VimContext ctx = Context();
        for (const Selection& s : m_doc.selections.All())
        {
            const VimCursor vc = ToVim(s);
            const auto obj = ResolveTextObject(ctx, ByteRange{ vc.head, vc.head }, vc.head,
                                               VimObjectArgs{ p.Id<VimObjectId>(), p.inner, p.Count1(), false });
            if (!obj) continue;
            out.push_back(VimOpTarget{ obj->range, obj->kind, false, s.id, vc.head });
        }
        return !out.empty();
    }

    void VimState::ExecuteObjectOperator(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        std::vector<VimOpTarget> targets;
        if (!ObjectTargets(p, targets)) { Beep(); return; }
        const VimOperatorId op = *p.op;
        if (op == VimOperatorId::Change) BeginInsertSession(VimActionId::InsertBefore, 1);
        VimContext ctx = Context();
        const VimOpOutcome out = RunOperator(ctx, op, targets, VimOpArgs{ p.reg, p.count, false, false });
        if (out.failed)                                  // the same outcome handling as ExecuteOperator (TE5a-12)
        {
            if (op == VimOperatorId::Change) EndInsertSession();
            Beep(out.message);
            return;
        }
        if (out.enterInsert)
        {
            MarkInsertStart();
            m_insert.autoIndentPending = out.autoIndentPending;
            m_mode = VimMode::Insert;
        }
        else if (op == VimOperatorId::Change)
            EndInsertSession();
    }
}
```

### Task TE5a-17: Text objects -- quotes, brackets and tags (spec s6.3 Text objects)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimTextObjects.cpp` (new resolvers + the `ResolveTextObject` switch)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5a.vimcases` (append)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimTextObjectsTest.cpp` (append)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE5a-16's `ResolveTextObject`, `VimObjectArgs`, `VimObjectRange`.
- Produces: `ResolveTextObject` answers `DoubleQuote SingleQuote BackQuote Paren Brace Bracket Angle Tag`.

Rules (vim's `current_quote` / `current_block` / `current_tagblock`): quotes are found on the cursor's line only, a quote preceded by an odd number of backslashes is escaped, a cursor ON a quote counts the quotes before it to tell an opening from a closing quote, a cursor NOT on a quote takes the nearest quote before it as the opening one with no parity count -- so between two strings `"a" x "b"` the object is ` x `, the text between them (finding 5a.22, Neovim v0.12.5) -- and a cursor before any quote takes the first pair after it; `a"` adds the trailing blanks, or the leading blanks when there are none, and `i2"` includes the quotes. Brackets enclose the cursor (a cursor ON a bracket takes that pair; a count selects the n-th enclosing pair); when no pair encloses the cursor, the next pair AFTER it is used, even on a later line (Neovim 0.11+, the corrected `di(` case), and only a block wholly behind the cursor fails. Brackets and tags read the rope through a 4 KiB `RopeBytes` window -- never a whole-buffer `ToString()` per cursor (finding 5a.26); an inner block whose open bracket ends its line and whose close bracket starts its line (after blanks) covers whole lines and is linewise. Tags: the innermost element whose open tag starts at or before the cursor and whose close tag ends after it; `it` is the content, `at` the element; comments, `<!...>` and `<?...?>` are skipped and self-closing tags are not elements.

```cpp
TEST_CASE("vim text objects: quotes on the cursor line", "[text-vim-objects]")
{
    // x = "hello" y : x0 _1 =2 _3 "4 h5 .. o9 "10 _11 y12
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "x = \"hello\" y");
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 6, VimObjectId::DoubleQuote, true), 5, 10);
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 6, VimObjectId::DoubleQuote, false), 4, 12);      // + the trailing blank
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 6, VimObjectId::DoubleQuote, true, 2), 4, 11);    // i2" includes the quotes
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 4, VimObjectId::DoubleQuote, true), 5, 10);       // on the opening quote
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 10, VimObjectId::DoubleQuote, true), 5, 10);      // on the closing quote
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 0, VimObjectId::DoubleQuote, true), 5, 10);       // before any pair: the first pair after
    VimRig b("\xCB\x87" "\"a\" x \"b\"");                               // "a" x "b" : "0 a1 "2 _3 x4 _5 "6 b7 "8
    CheckRange(Obj(b, 4, VimObjectId::DoubleQuote, true), 3, 6);        // between two strings: the text between (5a.22)
    CheckRange(Obj(b, 8, VimObjectId::DoubleQuote, true), 7, 8);        // ON a quote: the parity count decides (closing)
    VimRig e("\xCB\x87" "\"a\\\"b\" c");                                // "a\"b" c : the escaped quote is content
    CheckRange(Obj(e, 2, VimObjectId::DoubleQuote, true), 1, 5);
    VimRig n("\xCB\x87" "no quotes");
    CHECK_FALSE(Obj(n, 1, VimObjectId::DoubleQuote, true).has_value());
}

TEST_CASE("vim text objects: brackets enclose the cursor; outside any pair, the next pair after it", "[text-vim-objects]")
{
    // f(a, (b)) : f0 (1 a2 ,3 _4 (5 b6 )7 )8
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "f(a, (b))");
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 2, VimObjectId::Paren, true), 2, 8);
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 2, VimObjectId::Paren, false), 1, 9);
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 6, VimObjectId::Paren, true), 6, 7);
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 6, VimObjectId::Paren, true, 2), 2, 8);           // the second enclosing pair
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 5, VimObjectId::Paren, true), 6, 7);              // on the open bracket
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 7, VimObjectId::Paren, true), 6, 7);              // on the close bracket
    CheckRange(Obj(r, 0, VimObjectId::Paren, true), 2, 8);              // before the pair: the next pair (Neovim 0.11+)
    VimRig a("\xCB\x87" "x <ab> y");
    CheckRange(Obj(a, 4, VimObjectId::Angle, false), 2, 6);

    VimRig later("\xCB\x87" "x\n(y)");
    CheckRange(Obj(later, 0, VimObjectId::Paren, true), 3, 4);          // the next pair may sit on a later line
}
```

```cpp
        std::optional<VimObjectRange> QuoteObject(const VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset cursor, char quote, bool inner, std::uint32_t count)
        {
            const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, cursor);
            const ByteOffset ls = r.LineStart(row);
            const std::string line = VimText::Line(r, row);
            const std::size_t c = static_cast<std::size_t>(cursor - ls);
            std::vector<std::size_t> q;                                 // unescaped quotes on the line
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < line.size(); ++i)
            {
                if (line[i] != quote) continue;
                std::size_t backslashes = 0;
                for (std::size_t j = i; j > 0 && line[j - 1] == '\\'; --j) ++backslashes;
                if (backslashes % 2 == 0) q.push_back(i);
            }
            std::size_t open = 0, close = 0;
            if (const auto it = std::find(q.begin(), q.end(), c); it != q.end())
            {
                const std::size_t k = static_cast<std::size_t>(it - q.begin());
                if (k % 2 == 0) { if (k + 1 >= q.size()) return std::nullopt; open = q[k]; close = q[k + 1]; }
                else            { open = q[k - 1]; close = q[k]; }
            }
            else
            {
                // vim current_quote, the cursor not on a quote: the nearest quote BEFORE it opens -- no parity
                // count, so between two strings the text between them is the object (5a.22); with no quote
                // before the cursor, the first quote after it opens.
                const std::size_t before = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::lower_bound(q.begin(), q.end(), c) - q.begin());
                const std::size_t k = before > 0 ? before - 1 : 0;
                if (k + 1 >= q.size()) return std::nullopt;
                open = q[k];
                close = q[k + 1];
            }
            std::size_t b = open + 1, e = close;
            if (!inner || count >= 2)
            {
                b = open;
                e = close + 1;
                if (!inner)
                {
                    std::size_t t = e;
                    while (t < line.size() && (line[t] == ' ' || line[t] == '\t')) ++t;
                    if (t > e) e = t;
                    else while (b > 0 && (line[b - 1] == ' ' || line[b - 1] == '\t')) --b;
                }
            }
            return VimObjectRange{ ByteRange{ ls + b, ls + e }, MotionKind::Inclusive };
        }

        // Byte reads over the rope through one 4 KiB window centred on the last miss, so a bracket or tag
        // scan walking either way copies about two bytes per byte visited and never the whole buffer
        // (finding 5a.26: the v1 code called ToString() once per cursor).
        class RopeBytes
        {
        public:
            explicit RopeBytes(const Rope& r) : m_rope(r) {}
            [[nodiscard]] std::size_t Size() const { return m_rope.Size(); }
            [[nodiscard]] char At(std::size_t i)                      // i < Size()
            {
                if (i < m_base || i >= m_base + m_window.size())
                {
                    m_base = i >= kWindowBytes / 2 ? i - kWindowBytes / 2 : 0;
                    const std::size_t end = std::min<std::size_t>(m_base + kWindowBytes, m_rope.Size());
                    m_rope.CopyTo(ByteRange{ static_cast<ByteOffset>(m_base), static_cast<ByteOffset>(end) }, m_window);
                }
                return m_window[i - m_base];
            }
            [[nodiscard]] bool Matches(std::size_t i, std::string_view s)
            {
                if (i + s.size() > Size()) return false;
                for (std::size_t k = 0; k < s.size(); ++k) if (At(i + k) != s[k]) return false;
                return true;
            }

        private:
            ARC_CONSTANT("perf: rope window for bracket/tag scans; one CopyTo per ~2 KiB walked")
            static constexpr std::size_t kWindowBytes = 4096;
            const Rope& m_rope;
            std::size_t m_base = 0;
            std::string m_window;
        };

        std::optional<VimObjectRange> BracketObject(const VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset cursor, char open, char close, bool inner, std::uint32_t count)
        {
            RopeBytes t(ctx.Text());
            if (t.Size() == 0) return std::nullopt;
            const std::size_t c = std::min<std::size_t>(static_cast<std::size_t>(cursor), t.Size() - 1);
            const auto findOpen = [&](std::size_t before) -> std::optional<std::size_t> {
                int depth = 0;
                for (std::size_t i = before; i-- > 0;)
                {
                    const char ch = t.At(i);
                    if (ch == close) ++depth;
                    else if (ch == open) { if (depth == 0) return i; --depth; }
                }
                return std::nullopt;
            };
            const auto findClose = [&](std::size_t openAt) -> std::optional<std::size_t> {
                int depth = 0;
                for (std::size_t i = openAt + 1; i < t.Size(); ++i)
                {
                    const char ch = t.At(i);
                    if (ch == open) ++depth;
                    else if (ch == close) { if (depth == 0) return i; --depth; }
                }
                return std::nullopt;
            };
            std::optional<std::size_t> o = t.At(c) == open ? std::optional<std::size_t>(c) : findOpen(c);
            for (std::uint32_t n = 1; n < count && o; ++n) o = findOpen(*o);
            std::optional<std::size_t> cl = o ? findClose(*o) : std::nullopt;
            if (!o || !cl)
            {
                // Not inside a (closed) block: Neovim 0.11+ takes the next block after the cursor, on any
                // later line; a block wholly behind the cursor fails (the corrected di( case).
                o.reset();
                for (std::size_t i = c + 1; i < t.Size() && !o; ++i) if (t.At(i) == open) o = i;
                if (!o) return std::nullopt;
                cl = findClose(*o);
                if (!cl) return std::nullopt;
            }
            if (!inner) return VimObjectRange{ ByteRange{ *o, *cl + 1 }, MotionKind::Inclusive };
            std::size_t b = *o + 1, e = *cl;
            bool startsLine = false;
            if (b < t.Size() && t.At(b) == '\n') { ++b; startsLine = true; }    // the open bracket ends its line
            MotionKind kind = MotionKind::Inclusive;
            if (startsLine)
            {
                std::size_t ls = e;
                while (ls > 0 && t.At(ls - 1) != '\n') --ls;
                bool blankBefore = true;
                for (std::size_t i = ls; i < e; ++i) if (t.At(i) != ' ' && t.At(i) != '\t') { blankBefore = false; break; }
                if (blankBefore && ls > b) { e = ls - 1; kind = MotionKind::Linewise; }   // whole lines between the brackets, content form
            }
            if (e < b) e = b;
            return VimObjectRange{ ByteRange{ b, e }, kind };
        }

        struct XmlTag { std::size_t start = 0, end = 0; std::string name; bool closing = false; };

        std::vector<XmlTag> ScanTags(RopeBytes& t)
        {
            std::vector<XmlTag> out;
            const std::size_t n = t.Size();
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            {
                if (t.At(i) != '<') continue;
                if (t.Matches(i, "<!--"))
                {
                    std::size_t e = i + 4;
                    while (e < n && !t.Matches(e, "-->")) ++e;
                    if (e >= n) break;
                    i = e + 2;
                    continue;
                }
                if (i + 1 < n && (t.At(i + 1) == '!' || t.At(i + 1) == '?'))
                {
                    std::size_t e = i;
                    while (e < n && t.At(e) != '>') ++e;
                    if (e >= n) break;
                    i = e;
                    continue;
                }
                XmlTag tag;
                tag.start = i;
                std::size_t j = i + 1;
                if (j < n && t.At(j) == '/') { tag.closing = true; ++j; }
                while (j < n)
                {
                    const char ch = t.At(j);
                    if (!(std::isalnum(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch)) || ch == '_' || ch == ':' || ch == '.' || ch == '-')) break;
                    tag.name.push_back(ch);
                    ++j;
                }
                if (tag.name.empty()) continue;
                char quote = 0;
                while (j < n && (quote != 0 || t.At(j) != '>'))
                {
                    const char ch = t.At(j);
                    if (quote == 0 && (ch == '"' || ch == '\'')) quote = ch;
                    else if (quote != 0 && ch == quote) quote = 0;
                    ++j;
                }
                if (j >= n) break;
                tag.end = j + 1;
                const bool selfClosing = !tag.closing && j > 0 && t.At(j - 1) == '/';
                if (!selfClosing) out.push_back(std::move(tag));
                i = j;
            }
            return out;
        }

        std::optional<VimObjectRange> TagObject(const VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset cursor, bool inner, std::uint32_t count)
        {
            RopeBytes t(ctx.Text());                                     // no whole-buffer copy (5a.26)
            const std::vector<XmlTag> tags = ScanTags(t);
            struct Element { std::size_t openStart, openEnd, closeStart, closeEnd; };
            std::vector<Element> elements;
            std::vector<std::size_t> stack;                              // indices into tags
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < tags.size(); ++i)
            {
                if (!tags[i].closing) { stack.push_back(i); continue; }
                for (std::size_t s = stack.size(); s-- > 0;)
                    if (tags[stack[s]].name == tags[i].name)
                    {
                        const XmlTag& o = tags[stack[s]];
                        elements.push_back(Element{ o.start, o.end, tags[i].start, tags[i].end });
                        stack.resize(s);
                        break;
                    }
            }
            std::vector<Element> enclosing;
            for (const Element& e : elements)
                if (e.openStart <= cursor && cursor < e.closeEnd) enclosing.push_back(e);
            std::sort(enclosing.begin(), enclosing.end(), [](const Element& a, const Element& b) { return a.openStart > b.openStart; });
            if (enclosing.size() < count) return std::nullopt;
            const Element& e = enclosing[count - 1];
            return inner ? VimObjectRange{ ByteRange{ e.openEnd, e.closeStart }, MotionKind::Inclusive }
                         : VimObjectRange{ ByteRange{ e.openStart, e.closeEnd }, MotionKind::Inclusive };
        }
```

add `#include <algorithm>`, `#include <cctype>`, `#include <string_view>` and `#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>` at the top of `VimTextObjects.cpp`, and replace the switch's `default:` line in `ResolveTextObject` with:

```cpp
        case VimObjectId::DoubleQuote: return QuoteObject(ctx, cursor, '"', args.inner, count);
        case VimObjectId::SingleQuote: return QuoteObject(ctx, cursor, '\'', args.inner, count);
        case VimObjectId::BackQuote:   return QuoteObject(ctx, cursor, '`', args.inner, count);
        case VimObjectId::Paren:       return BracketObject(ctx, cursor, '(', ')', args.inner, count);
        case VimObjectId::Brace:       return BracketObject(ctx, cursor, '{', '}', args.inner, count);
        case VimObjectId::Bracket:     return BracketObject(ctx, cursor, '[', ']', args.inner, count);
        case VimObjectId::Angle:       return BracketObject(ctx, cursor, '<', '>', args.inner, count);
        case VimObjectId::Tag:         return TagObject(ctx, cursor, args.inner, count);
        }
        return std::nullopt;
```

(the switch now covers every `VimObjectId`; the closing brace of the switch moves above the final `return`).

- Consumes: `ResolveMotion`, `VimMotionArgs`, `VimMotionTarget` (TE5a-8); `RunOperator`, `VimOpTarget`, `VimOpArgs`, `VimOpOutcome`, `VimState::ExitVisual`, `VimRegisters::Get`, `VimRegisterKind` (TE5a-12); `ResolveTextObject`, `LinewiseRows`, `ExecuteObjectOperator` (TE5a-16).
- Produces: `VimState::BlockCorners m_block` (contract shape `{ anchorRow, headRow, anchorVcol, headVcol, toEol }`), `SwitchVisual(VimMode)`, `ToggleVisual(VimMode)`, `EndVisualAtHeads()`, `RebuildBlock()`, `BlockCornerOffset(row, vcol)`, `MoveBlockCursor(const VimParsed&)`, `SwapVisualEnds(bool corner)`, `ExtendVisualByObject(const VimParsed&)`, `BlockInsert(bool append)`, `VisualLinesOperator(VimOperatorId, const VimParsed&)`, `RunVisualTargets(VimOperatorId, std::vector<VimOpTarget>, const VimParsed&)`; the VisualBlock storage rule: one editor selection per row covering `[vcol min, vcol max]` (each piece includes the character under the right edge; `$` takes each row to its end; a row that does not reach the block holds an empty selection at its line end).

Representation (spec s6.1/s6.2): in Visual the `SelectionSet` holds the inclusive editor ranges (`VimCursorModel::ToEditorVisual`), in VisualLine the raw vim positions (the view draws whole lines through `SetLineMode(true)`), in VisualBlock one selection per row rebuilt from the two corners in `m_block`. Operators in Visual (Part A's `ExecuteOperator`) read those editor selections directly. `I`/`A` in VisualBlock become a multi-cursor insert on the block's rows (rows that do not reach the block are skipped by `I`; `A` pads them with spaces, or appends at each line end after `$`), and leaving Insert puts the single cursor back at the block's top-left insert point, as vim does.

```cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using Arcane::Test::VimRig;

TEST_CASE("vim visual: v / V / Ctrl-V enter, switch and leave; the hooks follow", "[text-vim-visual]")
{
    VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bcd");
    r.Keys("v");
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Visual);
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\xC2\xAB\xCB\x87" "bcd");
    r.Keys("l");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\xC2\xAB" "b\xCB\x87" "cd");
    CHECK(r.selections.All()[0].head == 3u);            // the editor range includes the char under the head
    r.Keys("V");
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::VisualLine);
    CHECK(r.host.lineMode);
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\xC2\xAB" "b\xCB\x87" "cd");
    r.Keys("<C-v>");
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::VisualBlock);
    CHECK_FALSE(r.host.lineMode);
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\xC2\xAB" "b\xCB\x87" "cd");
    r.Keys("<Esc>");
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Normal);
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "ab\xCB\x87" "cd");
    r.Keys("vlv");                                      // the same key again leaves Visual at the head
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Normal);
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "abc\xCB\x87" "d");
}

TEST_CASE("vim visual: X D Y C act on lines; D in a block cuts to the line ends", "[text-vim-visual]")
{
    { VimRig r("ab\nc\xCB\x87" "d\nef"); r.Keys("vX"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "ab\ne\xCB\x87" "f"); CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Normal); }   // column kept
    { VimRig r("ab\nc\xCB\x87" "d\nef"); r.Keys("Vd"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "ab\ne\xCB\x87" "f"); }   // nostartofline
    { VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bc\ndef");   r.Keys("<C-v>jD"); CHECK(r.Text() == "a\nd"); }
    {
        VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "b\ncd");
        r.Keys("vY");
        const auto reg = r.Globals().registers.Get(0, r.host, r.vim->Options());
        REQUIRE(reg.has_value());
        CHECK(reg->kind == VimRegisterKind::Linewise);
        CHECK(reg->Text() == "ab\n");
        CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "ab\ncd");                    // a VisualLine yank starts at column 0
    }
    { VimRig r("  A\xCB\x87" "B"); r.Keys("Vu"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "  ab"); }   // VisualLine case op: column 0
    { VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "b\ncd"); r.Keys("vCx<Esc>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "x\ncd"); }
}

TEST_CASE("vim visual block: X and Y stay blockwise (5a.24)", "[text-vim-visual]")
{
    {
        VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bc\ndef");
        r.Keys("<C-v>jX");
        CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\xCB\x87" "c\ndf");
        const auto reg = r.Globals().registers.Get(0, r.host, r.vim->Options());
        REQUIRE(reg.has_value());
        CHECK(reg->kind == VimRegisterKind::Blockwise);
        CHECK(reg->parts == std::vector<std::string>{ "b", "e" });
    }
    {
        VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bc\ndef");
        r.Keys("<C-v>jY");
        CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\xCB\x87" "bc\ndef");                  // the block's top-left
        const auto reg = r.Globals().registers.Get(0, r.host, r.vim->Options());
        REQUIRE(reg.has_value());
        CHECK(reg->kind == VimRegisterKind::Blockwise);
        CHECK(reg->parts == std::vector<std::string>{ "b", "e" });
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim visual block: the edge on a short head row is the head's clamped column (5a.21)", "[text-vim-visual]")
{
    // "abcde\nab\nabcde": row0 [0,5) row1 [6,8) row2 [9,14); the anchor on d (column 3)
    VimRig r("abc\xCB\x87" "de\nab\nabcde");
    r.Keys("<C-v>j");
    const auto all = r.selections.All();
    REQUIRE(all.size() == 2u);
    CHECK(std::min(all[0].anchor, all[0].head) == 2u);               // columns 2..3: the head sits one past "ab"
    CHECK(std::max(all[0].anchor, all[0].head) == 4u);
    r.Keys("j");                                                      // the goal column (3) survives the short row
    const auto three = r.selections.All();
    REQUIRE(three.size() == 3u);
    CHECK(std::min(three[2].anchor, three[2].head) == 12u);
    CHECK(std::max(three[2].anchor, three[2].head) == 13u);
    VimRig d("abc\xCB\x87" "de\nab");
    d.Keys("<C-v>jd");
    CHECK(d.Marked() == "ab\xCB\x87" "e\nab");
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimVisual.cpp
// Visual, VisualLine and VisualBlock (spec s6.1, s6.2). Visual stores inclusive
// editor ranges, VisualLine the raw vim positions (the view draws whole lines),
// VisualBlock one selection per row rebuilt from the corners in m_block.
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimTextObjects.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    ByteOffset VimState::BlockCornerOffset(std::uint32_t row, std::uint32_t vcol) const
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        return VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, row, vcol, m_options.tabSize));
    }

    void VimState::RebuildBlock()
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::uint32_t tab = m_options.tabSize;
        const std::uint32_t r0 = std::min(m_block.anchorRow, m_block.headRow), r1 = std::max(m_block.anchorRow, m_block.headRow);
        const std::uint32_t v0 = std::min(m_block.anchorVcol, m_block.headVcol), v1 = std::max(m_block.anchorVcol, m_block.headVcol);
        std::vector<Selection> sels;
        std::size_t primary = 0;
        for (std::uint32_t row = r0; row <= r1; ++row)
        {
            const ByteOffset a = VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, row, v0, tab);
            ByteOffset b = r.LineEnd(row);
            if (!m_block.toEol)
            {
                const ByteOffset last = VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, row, v1, tab);
                b = VimText::AtLineEnd(r, last) ? last : VimText::NextChar(r, last);
            }
            if (b < a) b = a;
            Selection s{ m_doc.selections.AllocateId(), a, b, std::nullopt };
            if (m_block.headVcol < m_block.anchorVcol && !m_block.toEol) std::swap(s.anchor, s.head);
            if (row == m_block.headRow) primary = sels.size();
            sels.push_back(s);
        }
        VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), primary);
    }

    void VimState::SwitchVisual(VimMode target)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<VimCursor> cur = Cursors();          // positions in the mode being left
        std::vector<Selection> old = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::size_t primary = VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc);
        if (m_mode == VimMode::VisualBlock) { primary = 0; old.resize(1); }
        if (target == VimMode::VisualBlock)
        {
            const VimCursor c = cur[std::min(primary, cur.size() - 1)];
            m_block = BlockCorners{ VimText::RowOf(r, c.anchor), VimText::RowOf(r, c.head),
                                    VimText::VirtualColumn(r, c.anchor, m_options.tabSize),
                                    VimText::VirtualColumn(r, c.head, m_options.tabSize), false, 0 };
            m_block.headGoal = m_block.headVcol;
            m_mode = VimMode::VisualBlock;
            RebuildBlock();
            return;
        }
        m_mode = target;
        std::vector<Selection> next;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < cur.size(); ++i) next.push_back(FromVim(cur[i], std::nullopt, old[std::min(i, old.size() - 1)].id));
        VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(next), std::min(primary, next.size() - 1));
    }

    void VimState::ToggleVisual(VimMode target)
    {
        if (m_mode == target) EndVisualAtHeads();
        else SwitchVisual(target);
    }

    void VimState::EndVisualAtHeads()
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<VimCursor> cur = Cursors();
        const std::vector<Selection> old = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        const std::size_t primary = m_mode == VimMode::VisualBlock ? 0 : VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc);
        ExitVisual();
        std::vector<Selection> next;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < cur.size(); ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset o = VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, cur[i].head);
            const bool eol = VimText::AtLineEnd(r, cur[i].head) && r.LineStart(VimText::RowOf(r, cur[i].head)) != cur[i].head;
            next.push_back(Selection{ i < old.size() ? old[i].id : m_doc.selections.AllocateId(), o, o,
                                      eol ? std::optional<std::uint32_t>(VimText::kGoalEol) : std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(next), std::min(primary, next.size() - 1));
    }

    void VimState::MoveBlockCursor(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        VimContext ctx = Context();
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const ByteOffset from = m_block.toEol ? r.LineEnd(m_block.headRow) : BlockCornerOffset(m_block.headRow, m_block.headVcol);
        VimMotionArgs a;
        a.id = p.Id<VimMotionId>();
        a.count = p.count;
        a.arg = p.arg;
        const std::optional<std::uint32_t> goal = m_block.toEol ? std::optional<std::uint32_t>(VimText::kGoalEol)
                                                                : std::optional<std::uint32_t>(m_block.headGoal);
        const std::optional<VimMotionTarget> t = ResolveMotion(ctx, from, goal, a);
        if (!t) { Beep(); return; }
        m_block.headRow = VimText::RowOf(r, t->offset);
        if (t->goal && *t->goal == VimText::kGoalEol) m_block.toEol = true;
        else if (!t->goal)                                          // a horizontal motion: the column follows it
        {
            m_block.toEol = false;
            m_block.headVcol = m_block.headGoal = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, t->offset, m_options.tabSize);
        }
        else
        {
            // A vertical motion: the goal survives, but the block edge is the head's ACTUAL column -- on a
            // short row the line's width, i.e. one past its last char, as Visual allows (Neovim's coladvance
            // with one_more; finding 5a.21: "abcde"/"ab" with the head on d, j: the block is columns 2..3).
            m_block.headGoal = *t->goal;
            const std::uint32_t width = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, r.LineEnd(m_block.headRow), m_options.tabSize);
            m_block.headVcol = std::min(*t->goal, width);
        }
        RebuildBlock();
    }

    void VimState::SwapVisualEnds(bool corner)
    {
        if (m_mode == VimMode::VisualBlock)
        {
            std::swap(m_block.anchorVcol, m_block.headVcol);
            if (!corner) std::swap(m_block.anchorRow, m_block.headRow);
            m_block.headGoal = m_block.headVcol;
            RebuildBlock();
            return;
        }
        std::vector<VimCursor> cur = Cursors();
        const std::vector<Selection> old = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<Selection> next;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < cur.size(); ++i)
        {
            std::swap(cur[i].anchor, cur[i].head);
            next.push_back(FromVim(cur[i], std::nullopt, old[i].id));
        }
        VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(next), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }

    void VimState::ExtendVisualByObject(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        if (m_mode == VimMode::VisualBlock) { Beep(); return; }
        VimContext ctx = Context();
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<VimCursor> next;
        bool any = false, linewise = false;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const VimCursor vc = ToVim(s);
            const bool single = vc.anchor == vc.head;
            const ByteOffset lo = std::min(vc.anchor, vc.head), hi = std::max(vc.anchor, vc.head);
            const ByteOffset at = single ? vc.head : std::min<ByteOffset>(VimCursorModel::VisualCharEnd(r, hi), r.Size());
            const auto obj = ResolveTextObject(ctx, ByteRange{ lo, at }, at, VimObjectArgs{ p.Id<VimObjectId>(), p.inner, p.Count1(), true });
            if (!obj || (obj->kind != MotionKind::Linewise && obj->range.begin == obj->range.end)) { next.push_back(vc); continue; }
            any = true;
            if (obj->kind == MotionKind::Linewise)
            {
                linewise = true;
                const auto rows = LinewiseRows(r, obj->range);
                const std::uint32_t first = single ? rows.first : std::min(rows.first, VimText::RowOf(r, lo));
                next.push_back(VimCursor{ r.LineStart(first), r.LineStart(rows.second) });
                continue;
            }
            const ByteOffset end = VimCursorModel::PrevVisual(r, obj->range.end);
            next.push_back(single ? VimCursor{ obj->range.begin, end }
                                  : VimCursor{ std::min(lo, obj->range.begin), std::max(end, hi) });
        }
        if (!any) { Beep(); return; }
        if (linewise && m_mode == VimMode::Visual) m_mode = VimMode::VisualLine;   // vip / vap are linewise
        std::vector<Selection> out;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < next.size(); ++i) out.push_back(FromVim(next[i], std::nullopt, sels[i].id));
        VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(out), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }

    void VimState::BlockInsert(bool append)
    {
        if (m_mode != VimMode::VisualBlock) { Beep(); return; }   // I / A in Visual are block commands
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::uint32_t tab = m_options.tabSize;
        const std::uint32_t r0 = std::min(m_block.anchorRow, m_block.headRow), r1 = std::max(m_block.anchorRow, m_block.headRow);
        const std::uint32_t v0 = std::min(m_block.anchorVcol, m_block.headVcol), v1 = std::max(m_block.anchorVcol, m_block.headVcol);
        std::vector<EditOp> pads;
        std::vector<ByteOffset> carets;
        for (std::uint32_t row = r0; row <= r1; ++row)
        {
            const ByteOffset le = r.LineEnd(row);
            const std::uint32_t width = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, le, tab);
            if (!append)
            {
                if (width <= v0) continue;                          // the row does not reach the block: unchanged
                carets.push_back(VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, row, v0, tab));
            }
            else if (m_block.toEol)
                carets.push_back(le);
            else if (width > v1)
                carets.push_back(VimText::NextChar(r, VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, row, v1, tab)));
            else
            {
                pads.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ le, le }, std::string(v1 + 1 - width, ' ') });
                carets.push_back(le);
            }
        }
        if (carets.empty()) { Beep(); return; }
        BeginInsertSession(append ? VimActionId::VisualAppend : VimActionId::VisualInsert, 1);
        m_insert.blockRow = r0;                                     // Esc returns here: the block's top-left (5a.24)
        m_insert.blockVcol = v0;
        ExitVisual();
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (const ByteOffset o : carets)
        {
            const ByteOffset c = VimText::MapThrough(o, pads, Bias::Right);
            after.push_back(Selection{ m_doc.selections.AllocateId(), c, c, std::nullopt });
        }
        if (pads.empty()) VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(after), 0);
        else VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(pads), std::move(after), 0);   // the top row is the primary
        MarkInsertStart();
        m_mode = VimMode::Insert;
    }

    void VimState::RunVisualTargets(VimOperatorId op, std::vector<VimOpTarget> targets, const VimParsed& p)
    {
        if (targets.empty()) { Beep(); return; }
        if (op == VimOperatorId::Change) BeginInsertSession(VimActionId::VisualChangeLines, 1);
        ExitVisual();
        VimContext ctx = Context();
        const VimOpOutcome out = RunOperator(ctx, op, targets, VimOpArgs{ p.reg, p.count, true, false });
        if (out.enterInsert)
        {
            MarkInsertStart();
            m_mode = VimMode::Insert;
        }
        else if (op == VimOperatorId::Change)
            EndInsertSession();
    }

    void VimState::VisualLinesOperator(VimOperatorId op, const VimParsed& p)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<VimOpTarget> targets;
        const VimKey last = p.keys.empty() ? VimKey{} : p.keys.back();
        if (m_mode == VimMode::VisualBlock && (last == VimKey::Char(U'X') || last == VimKey::Char(U'Y')))
        {
            // block X / Y stay blockwise: they act on the block itself, like d / y (finding 5a.24, Neovim v0.12.5)
            RunVisualTargets(op, VisualTargets(), p);
            return;
        }
        const bool toEol = m_mode == VimMode::VisualBlock && (last == VimKey::Char(U'D') || last == VimKey::Char(U'C'));
        if (toEol)                                                  // block D / C: from the left edge to each line end
        {
            const std::uint32_t r0 = std::min(m_block.anchorRow, m_block.headRow), r1 = std::max(m_block.anchorRow, m_block.headRow);
            const std::uint32_t v0 = std::min(m_block.anchorVcol, m_block.headVcol);
            const std::uint32_t id = VimText::Selections(m_doc).front().id;
            for (std::uint32_t row = r0; row <= r1; ++row)
            {
                const ByteOffset a = VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, row, v0, m_options.tabSize);
                targets.push_back(VimOpTarget{ ByteRange{ a, r.LineEnd(row) }, MotionKind::Inclusive, true, id, a });
            }
            RunVisualTargets(op, std::move(targets), p);
            return;
        }
        // X D Y C S R: whole lines of every selection, overlapping row spans merged
        std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t>> spans;
        for (const VimCursor& c : Cursors())
            spans.emplace_back(VimText::RowOf(r, std::min(c.anchor, c.head)), VimText::RowOf(r, std::max(c.anchor, c.head)));
        std::sort(spans.begin(), spans.end());
        std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t>> merged;
        for (const auto& s : spans)
        {
            if (!merged.empty() && s.first <= merged.back().second + 1) merged.back().second = std::max(merged.back().second, s.second);
            else merged.push_back(s);
        }
        const std::uint32_t id = VimText::Selections(m_doc).front().id;
        // the origin is the vim cursor: with nostartofline a linewise X / D keeps its column (vX on "ab\ncd\nef"
        // with the cursor on d leaves it on f -- the corrected table; Y and C place their own cursor)
        const std::vector<VimCursor> heads = Cursors();
        const ByteOffset origin = heads[std::min(VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc), heads.size() - 1)].head;
        for (const auto& [first, lastRow] : merged)
            targets.push_back(VimLinewiseTarget(r, first, lastRow, id, origin));   // Part A's content form
        RunVisualTargets(op, std::move(targets), p);
    }
}
```

```cpp
    void VimState::LeaveInsertMode()
    {
        const bool block = m_insert.entry == VimActionId::VisualInsert || m_insert.entry == VimActionId::VisualAppend;
        RepeatInsertForCount();
        if (m_insert.autoIndentPending) RemovePendingAutoIndent();
        EndInsertSession();                      // one insert session = one undo step (spec s6.3)
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        for (Selection& s : sels)
        {
            s.anchor = s.head = VimCursorModel::LeaveInsert(r, s.head);
            s.goalColumn.reset();
        }
        std::size_t primary = VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc);
        if (block && !sels.empty())
        {
            // the block's top-left -- for A and $A too, not the first appended char (finding 5a.24: "abc"/"def",
            // <C-v>jAx<Esc> leaves the cursor on b)
            const ByteOffset o = BlockCornerOffset(m_insert.blockRow, m_insert.blockVcol);
            sels = { Selection{ sels.front().id, o, o, std::nullopt } };
            primary = 0;
        }
        m_mode = VimMode::Normal;
        VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), primary);
    }
```

### Task TE5a-19: r{char} and Replace mode R (spec s6.2 Replace mode, s6.3 Operators)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimReplace.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCommandParser.cpp` (TE5a-4: `<CR>` and `<Tab>` as literal arguments)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (private members below; `#include <map>`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.cpp` (`FeedResolved`: the Replace case)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimActions.cpp` (`ReplaceChar`, `ReplaceMode` cases)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimInsert.cpp` (`HandleInsert`: `<Insert>` switches to Replace)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5a.vimcases` (append)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimReplaceTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE5a-5 insert-session helpers (`BeginInsertSession`, `MarkInsertStart`, `InsertNewline`, `InsertMove`, `LeaveInsertMode`, `EndInsertSession`); TE5a-18 `Cursors()` block form; TE5a-12 `ExitVisual`.
- Produces: `VimState::HandleReplace`, `ReplaceChars`, `ReplaceVisual`, `EnterReplaceMode`, `ReplaceType`, `ReplaceNewline`, `ReplaceBackspace`, `LeaveReplaceMode`, `ToggleInsertReplace`; `struct VimState::ReplaceUndo { std::string original; std::uint32_t insertedBytes; }`; `m_replaceStack`, `m_replaceTyped`; the parser accepts `<CR>` (`'\n'`) and `<Tab>` (`'\t'`) as a Literal argument (`r<CR>`, `f<Tab>`); `<Insert>` in Insert mode switches to Replace and in Replace back to Insert (the key reaches vim through TE5a-22's `VimKeyFromNamed`, cross-fix X24).

Vim's rules: `r` with a count needs that many characters left on the line or the whole command fails; it leaves the cursor on the last replaced character; `r<CR>` deletes the count characters and inserts ONE line break, typed as Insert-mode Enter (autoindent), then Esc. In Visual, `r` replaces every character of the selection (line breaks stay) and the cursor goes to the selection's start. `R` overtypes, appends past the line end, inserts (does not replace) on Enter, and Backspace restores what was overtyped -- one restore stack per cursor -- or only moves left where nothing was overtyped; a count repeats the typed text on Esc. Replace mode is one insert session, so `u` undoes it in one step; vim handles every Replace key itself (`SetInputEnabled(false)`, TE5a-5). `<Insert>` toggles Insert and Replace inside the same session (vim's `ins_insert`): the restore stack and the count-repeat text start empty on each switch, the session (and so its one undo step) carries on, and `ApplyModeHooks` swaps the cursor shape and the view's input on the next key. In Normal, `<Insert>` is `i` (TE5a-4's table).

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimReplaceTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp"

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using Arcane::Test::VimRig;

TEST_CASE("vim r: replaces count characters, fails when the line is too short", "[text-vim-replace]")
{
    { VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bc");   r.Keys("rx");  CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\xCB\x87" "xc"); }
    { VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bcd");  r.Keys("3rx"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "axx\xCB\x87" "x"); }
    { VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bc");   r.Keys("5rx"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\xCB\x87" "bc"); }
    { VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "\xC3\xA9" "b"); r.Keys("rx"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\xCB\x87" "xb"); }   // the whole 2-byte char
    { VimRig r("ab\xCB\x87" " cd"); r.Keys("r<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "ab\n\xCB\x87" "cd"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "ab\n\xCB\x87" "cd"); r.Keys("rx"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "xb\n\xCB\x87" "xd"); }
}

TEST_CASE("vim r in Visual replaces every selected character", "[text-vim-replace]")
{
    VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bcd");
    r.Keys("vlrx");
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Normal);
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\xCB\x87" "xxd");
}

TEST_CASE("vim R: overtype, append, Backspace restores, count repeats", "[text-vim-replace]")
{
    {
        VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bcd");
        r.Keys("R");
        CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Replace);
        CHECK(r.host.shape == VimCursorShape::Underline);
        CHECK_FALSE(r.host.inputEnabled);
        r.Keys("xy<Esc>");
        CHECK(r.Marked() == "ax\xCB\x87" "yd");
    }
    { VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "b");    r.Keys("Rxyz<Esc>");       CHECK(r.Marked() == "axy\xCB\x87" "z"); }
    { VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bcd");  r.Keys("Rxy<BS><Esc>");    CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\xCB\x87" "xcd"); }
    { VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "b");    r.Keys("Rx<BS><BS><Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "ab"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "12345"); r.Keys("2Rab<Esc>");       CHECK(r.Marked() == "aba\xCB\x87" "b5"); }
    { VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bc");   r.Keys("Rx<CR>y<Esc>");    CHECK(r.Marked() == "ax\n\xCB\x87" "y"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "\xC3\xA9" "a"); r.Keys("Rx<Esc>");  CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "xa"); }
    {
        VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bcd");
        r.Keys("Rxy<Esc>");
        REQUIRE(r.Commands().Undo());
        CHECK(r.Text() == "abcd");
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim <Insert> toggles Insert and Replace inside one session", "[text-vim-replace]")
{
    {
        VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bcd");
        r.Keys("i<Insert>");
        CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Replace);
        CHECK(r.host.shape == VimCursorShape::Underline);
        CHECK_FALSE(r.host.inputEnabled);
        r.Keys("x<Insert>");
        CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Insert);
        CHECK(r.host.shape == VimCursorShape::Bar);
        CHECK(r.host.inputEnabled);
        r.Keys("<Esc>");
        CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\xCB\x87" "xcd");
        REQUIRE(r.Commands().Undo());                                   // one session, one undo step
        CHECK(r.Text() == "abcd");
    }
    { VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bcd"); r.Keys("<Insert><Insert>x<Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\xCB\x87" "xcd"); }   // Normal <Insert> is i
    { VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bcd"); r.Keys("Rx<Insert>y<Esc>");       CHECK(r.Marked() == "ax\xCB\x87" "ycd"); }
    { VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bcd"); r.Keys("Rx<Insert><Insert><BS>z<Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\xCB\x87" "zcd"); }   // Arcane's rule: the stack restarts at a toggle, BS only moves
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimReplace.cpp
// r{char} and Replace mode (spec s6.2, s6.3).
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        std::size_t CodePoints(std::string_view s)
        {
            std::size_t n = 0;
            for (const char c : s) if ((static_cast<unsigned char>(c) & 0xC0) != 0x80) ++n;
            return n;
        }

        void PopCodePoint(std::string& s)
        {
            while (!s.empty() && (static_cast<unsigned char>(s.back()) & 0xC0) == 0x80) s.pop_back();
            if (!s.empty()) s.pop_back();
        }
    }

    void VimState::ReplaceChars(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        if (IsVisual(m_mode)) { ReplaceVisual(p.arg); return; }
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::uint32_t n = p.Count1();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            ByteOffset e = s.head;
            for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            {
                if (VimText::AtLineEnd(r, e)) { Beep(); return; }       // not enough characters: the command fails
                e = VimText::NextChar(r, e);
            }
            std::string text;
            if (p.arg != U'\n')
                for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) Utf8::Append(text, p.arg);
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ s.head, e }, std::move(text) });
        }
        if (p.arg == U'\n')                     // r<CR>: the chars go, ONE line break is typed as in Insert, then Esc
        {
            BeginInsertSession(VimActionId::ReplaceChar, 1);
            std::vector<Selection> after;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sels.size(); ++i)
            {
                const ByteOffset c = VimText::MapThrough(ops[i].range.begin, ops, Bias::Left);
                after.push_back(Selection{ sels[i].id, c, c, std::nullopt });
            }
            VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
            MarkInsertStart();
            InsertNewline();
            LeaveInsertMode();
            return;
        }
        std::string one;
        Utf8::Append(one, p.arg);
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sels.size(); ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset c = VimText::MapThrough(ops[i].range.begin, ops, Bias::Left) + (n - 1) * one.size();
            after.push_back(Selection{ sels[i].id, c, c, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }

    void VimState::ReplaceVisual(char32_t ch)
    {
        if (ch == U'\n') { Beep(); return; }
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<ByteRange> ranges;
        if (m_mode == VimMode::VisualLine)
        {
            for (const VimCursor& c : Cursors())
            {
                const std::uint32_t r0 = VimText::RowOf(r, std::min(c.anchor, c.head)), r1 = VimText::RowOf(r, std::max(c.anchor, c.head));
                ranges.push_back(ByteRange{ r.LineStart(r0), r.LineEnd(r1) });
            }
        }
        else
            for (const Selection& s : m_doc.selections.All()) ranges.push_back(ByteRange{ std::min(s.anchor, s.head), std::max(s.anchor, s.head) });
        std::string one;
        Utf8::Append(one, ch);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const ByteRange& range : ranges)
        {
            std::string text;
            for (ByteOffset o = range.begin; o < range.end;)
            {
                if (VimText::AtLineEnd(r, o)) { text.push_back('\n'); ++o; continue; }   // line breaks stay
                text += one;
                o = VimText::NextChar(r, o);
            }
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ range, std::move(text) });
        }
        const std::uint32_t id = VimText::Selections(m_doc).front().id;
        ExitVisual();
        const ByteOffset start = VimText::MapThrough(ops.front().range.begin, ops, Bias::Left);
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), { Selection{ id, start, start, std::nullopt } }, 0);   // the cursor at the start
    }

    void VimState::EnterReplaceMode(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        BeginInsertSession(VimActionId::ReplaceMode, p.Count1());
        m_replaceStack.clear();
        m_replaceTyped.clear();
        MarkInsertStart();
        m_mode = VimMode::Replace;
    }

    VimKeyResult VimState::HandleReplace(const VimKey& key)
    {
        if (key.IsEsc()) { LeaveReplaceMode(); return {}; }
        if (key.ctrl) return VimKeyResult{ false };
        switch (key.named)
        {
        case VimNamedKey::Backspace: ReplaceBackspace(); return {};
        case VimNamedKey::Enter:     ReplaceNewline(); return {};
        case VimNamedKey::Insert:    ToggleInsertReplace(); return {};   // <Insert>: Replace -> Insert, same session
        case VimNamedKey::Left: case VimNamedKey::Right: case VimNamedKey::Up:
        case VimNamedKey::Down: case VimNamedKey::Home: case VimNamedKey::End:
            m_replaceStack.clear();
            m_replaceTyped.clear();
            InsertMove(key.named);
            return {};
        case VimNamedKey::None:      break;
        default:                     return VimKeyResult{ false };
        }
        if (key.IsChar()) { ReplaceType(key.ch); return {}; }
        return VimKeyResult{ false };
    }

    void VimState::ReplaceType(char32_t ch)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::string text;
        Utf8::Append(text, ch);
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::vector<ReplaceUndo> undo;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset o = s.head;
            if (VimText::AtLineEnd(r, o))
            {
                ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ o, o }, text });
                undo.push_back(ReplaceUndo{ "", static_cast<std::uint32_t>(text.size()) });
                continue;
            }
            const ByteOffset e = VimText::NextChar(r, o);
            std::string original;
            r.CopyTo(ByteRange{ o, e }, original);
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ o, e }, text });
            undo.push_back(ReplaceUndo{ std::move(original), static_cast<std::uint32_t>(text.size()) });
        }
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sels.size(); ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset c = VimText::MapThrough(ops[i].range.begin, ops, Bias::Right);
            after.push_back(Selection{ sels[i].id, c, c, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sels.size(); ++i) m_replaceStack[sels[i].id].push_back(std::move(undo[i]));
        m_replaceTyped += text;
    }

    void VimState::ReplaceNewline()
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ s.head, s.head }, "\n" + VimText::LeadingWhitespace(r, VimText::RowOf(r, s.head)) });
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sels.size(); ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset c = VimText::MapThrough(ops[i].range.begin, ops, Bias::Right);
            after.push_back(Selection{ sels[i].id, c, c, std::nullopt });
            m_replaceStack[sels[i].id].push_back(ReplaceUndo{ "", static_cast<std::uint32_t>(ops[i].text.size()) });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        m_replaceTyped.push_back('\n');
    }

    void VimState::ReplaceBackspace()
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::vector<ByteOffset> targets;                    // pre-edit caret per selection
        bool popped = false;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            std::vector<ReplaceUndo>& stack = m_replaceStack[s.id];
            if (stack.empty())
            {
                targets.push_back(VimText::PrevChar(r, s.head));   // nothing to restore: just move left
                continue;
            }
            const ReplaceUndo u = std::move(stack.back());
            stack.pop_back();
            popped = true;
            const ByteOffset start = s.head - u.insertedBytes;
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ start, s.head }, u.original });
            targets.push_back(start);
        }
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sels.size(); ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset c = VimText::MapThrough(targets[i], ops, Bias::Left);
            after.push_back(Selection{ sels[i].id, c, c, std::nullopt });
        }
        if (ops.empty()) VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        else VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        if (popped) PopCodePoint(m_replaceTyped);
    }

    void VimState::LeaveReplaceMode()
    {
        if (m_insert.count > 1 && !m_replaceTyped.empty() && m_replaceTyped.find('\n') == std::string::npos)
        {
            std::string repeat;
            for (std::uint32_t i = 1; i < m_insert.count; ++i) repeat += m_replaceTyped;
            const std::size_t chars = CodePoints(repeat);
            const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
            const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
            std::vector<EditOp> ops;
            for (const Selection& s : sels)
            {
                ByteOffset e = s.head;
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < chars && !VimText::AtLineEnd(r, e); ++i) e = VimText::NextChar(r, e);
                ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ s.head, e }, repeat });
            }
            std::vector<Selection> after;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sels.size(); ++i)
            {
                const ByteOffset c = VimText::MapThrough(ops[i].range.begin, ops, Bias::Right);
                after.push_back(Selection{ sels[i].id, c, c, std::nullopt });
            }
            VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        }
        m_replaceStack.clear();
        m_replaceTyped.clear();
        EndInsertSession();                      // Replace mode is one undo step
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        for (Selection& s : sels)
        {
            s.anchor = s.head = VimCursorModel::LeaveInsert(r, s.head);
            s.goalColumn.reset();
        }
        m_mode = VimMode::Normal;
        VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }

    void VimState::ToggleInsertReplace()
    {
        // vim's ins_insert: the insert session (one undo step) carries on; the restore stack and the
        // count-repeat text start over, so BS in the new Replace part only restores what it overtyped.
        m_replaceStack.clear();
        m_replaceTyped.clear();
        m_mode = m_mode == VimMode::Replace ? VimMode::Insert : VimMode::Replace;   // ApplyModeHooks swaps shape and input
    }
}
```

### Task TE5a-20: The s6.6 per-mode chord table, `handleCtrlKeys`, and the Insert / window chords (spec s6.6, s7 item 4, s5.5 `Ctrl+[`)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimChords.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimChords.cpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimInsertChords.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimKeymap.cpp` (TE5a-4 table: the `<C-z>` row)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (private members below)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.cpp` (`FeedResolved`: the claim gate; `HandleNormalOrVisual`: Ctrl-C and the Ctrl-O restart)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimInsert.cpp` (`HandleInsert`: Ctrl chords)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimActions.cpp` (`WindowCommand` case)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5a.vimcases` (append)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimChordsTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimKey`, `VimMode`, `VimOptions::handleCtrlKeys`, `IVimHost::RunWindowCommand/WriteClipboard`, TE5a-18 `EndVisualAtHeads`, TE5a-5 insert helpers.
- Produces (contract names):
  - `struct VimChordRow { VimKey chord; std::string_view normal, visual, insert, vimOff; bool normalClaimed, visualClaimed, insertClaimed; }`
  - `std::span<const VimChordRow> VimChordTable()` -- the s6.6 table as data, one row per chord, in the spec's row order (Esc and Ctrl+[ are two rows).
  - `bool VimClaimsChord(const VimKey& chord, VimMode mode, const VimOptions& options)` -- Esc / Ctrl+[ always; any other Ctrl chord only with `handleCtrlKeys` on and the row claimed in that mode's column; CommandLine claims every Ctrl chord but Ctrl+S; a non-Ctrl key is always vim's.
  - `VimState::HandleInsertCtrl`, `InsertDeleteWord`, `InsertDeleteLine`, `InsertShiftIndent(bool)`, `InsertOneNormal`, `InsertUndoRedo(bool)`, `MaybeRestartInsert`, `CopyVisualToClipboard`, `RunWindowKey(char32_t)`; members `m_insertRestart`, `m_insertRestartEol`, `m_insertRestartAt`.

A chord vim does not claim returns `handled = false`, so the view (TE5a-22) lets the action table answer it (`edit.paste` for Insert Ctrl+V, `document.save` for Ctrl+S in every mode); a chord vim DID claim is reported to TE4-24's `DispatchTextActions` and TE2-18's `TextDocument::ApplySharedVerbs` through `view.ChordConsumed(actionId)` (TE5a-22), so the row it shadows does not fire as well. The table's text columns are what the Shortcuts page shows beside each shadowed action (TE5d-7). Insert Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo inside Insert safely: the open insert session ends first, `TextCommands(m_doc.buffer, m_doc.selections, <the view's EditContext>).Undo()/Redo()` runs (the TextCommands class, never `TextBuffer::Undo` directly), a new session starts (TE5b-3 replaces the bodies with `UndoCommand`/`RedoCommand` and vim's cursor rule). Ctrl-W and Ctrl-U stop once at the start of the insert (Neovim's `backspace=indent,eol,start`), Ctrl-U keeps the indent (`autoindent`), and Ctrl-O runs one Normal command and returns to Insert (back at the line end when the caret was there and the command did not move it).

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimChordsTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimChords.hpp"

#include <iterator>

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using Arcane::Test::VimRig;

namespace
{
    struct Expect { VimKey chord; bool normal, visual, insert; };
    // spec s6.6, row by row (Esc and Ctrl+[ split)
    const Expect kRows[] = {
        { VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Esc), true, true, true },
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U'['), true, true, true },
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U'z'), true, true, true },    // undo / undo / undo
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U'y'), true, true, true },    // scroll up 1 / scroll up 1 / redo
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U'r'), true, true, true },    // redo / redo / insert register
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U'c'), true, true, false },   // cancel / copy -> Normal / copy (action table)
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U'x'), true, true, false },   // decrement / decrement / cut
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U'a'), true, true, false },   // increment / increment / select all
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U'v'), true, true, false },   // Visual Block / toggle / paste
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U'w'), true, true, true },    // window prefix / window prefix / delete word back
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U'd'), true, true, true },    // half page / half page / outdent line
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U'u'), true, true, true },    // half page / half page / delete to line start
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U'f'), true, true, false },   // page / page / find
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U'b'), true, true, false },   // page / page / (unbound)
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U'e'), true, true, false },   // scroll down 1 / scroll down 1 / (unbound)
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U'o'), true, false, true },   // jump back / -- / one Normal command
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U'i'), true, false, false },  // jump forward / -- / --
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U't'), false, false, true },  // -- / -- / indent line
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U's'), false, false, false }, // save everywhere: the action table's document.save
        { VimKey::Ctrl(U'h'), true, true, true },    // h / h / backspace
    };
}

TEST_CASE("vim chords: every s6.6 row in every mode with handleCtrlKeys on", "[text-vim-chords]")
{
    REQUIRE(VimChordTable().size() == std::size(kRows));
    const VimOptions on;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < std::size(kRows); ++i)
    {
        const Expect& e = kRows[i];
        INFO("row " << i << " " << FormatKey(e.chord));
        CHECK(VimChordTable()[i].chord == e.chord);
        CHECK(VimClaimsChord(e.chord, VimMode::Normal, on) == e.normal);
        CHECK(VimClaimsChord(e.chord, VimMode::OperatorPending, on) == e.normal);
        CHECK(VimClaimsChord(e.chord, VimMode::Visual, on) == e.visual);
        CHECK(VimClaimsChord(e.chord, VimMode::VisualLine, on) == e.visual);
        CHECK(VimClaimsChord(e.chord, VimMode::VisualBlock, on) == e.visual);
        CHECK(VimClaimsChord(e.chord, VimMode::Insert, on) == e.insert);
        CHECK(VimClaimsChord(e.chord, VimMode::Replace, on) == e.insert);
        CHECK_FALSE(VimChordTable()[i].vimOff.empty());
        CHECK_FALSE(VimChordTable()[i].insert.empty());
    }
    CHECK(VimChordTable()[8].insert == "paste");
    CHECK(VimChordTable()[9].vimOff == "close document");
}

TEST_CASE("vim chords: handleCtrlKeys off leaves vim only plain keys, Esc and Ctrl+[", "[text-vim-chords]")
{
    VimOptions off;
    off.handleCtrlKeys = false;
    for (const Expect& e : kRows)
    {
        INFO(FormatKey(e.chord));
        const bool esc = e.chord.IsEsc();
        for (const VimMode m : { VimMode::Normal, VimMode::Visual, VimMode::Insert, VimMode::VisualBlock })
            CHECK(VimClaimsChord(e.chord, m, off) == esc);
    }
    CHECK(VimClaimsChord(VimKey::Char(U'j'), VimMode::Normal, off));
}

TEST_CASE("vim chords: an unclaimed chord falls through to the view", "[text-vim-chords]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "ab");
    r.Keys("i");
    CHECK_FALSE(r.vim->HandleKey(VimKey::Ctrl(U'v'), 1.0).handled);     // Insert Ctrl+V: the action table pastes
    CHECK_FALSE(r.vim->HandleKey(VimKey::Ctrl(U's'), 1.1).handled);     // Ctrl+S saves in every mode
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Insert);
    r.Keys("<Esc>");
    CHECK(r.vim->HandleKey(VimKey::Ctrl(U'v'), 1.2).handled);           // Normal Ctrl+V: Visual Block
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::VisualBlock);

    VimOptions off;
    off.handleCtrlKeys = false;
    VimRig o("\xCB\x87" "ab", {}, off);
    CHECK_FALSE(o.vim->HandleKey(VimKey::Ctrl(U'd'), 1.0).handled);
    CHECK(o.vim->HandleKey(VimKey::Ctrl(U'['), 1.1).handled);
}

TEST_CASE("vim chords: Normal Ctrl+C cancels a pending command; Visual Ctrl+C copies and leaves", "[text-vim-chords]")
{
    VimRig r("a\xCB\x87" "bcd");
    r.Keys("2d");
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::OperatorPending);
    r.vim->HandleKey(VimKey::Ctrl(U'c'), 1.0);
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Normal);
    CHECK(r.vim->PendingKeys().empty());
    CHECK(r.Text() == "abcd");
    r.Keys("vl");
    r.vim->HandleKey(VimKey::Ctrl(U'c'), 2.0);
    CHECK(r.host.clipboard == "bc");
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Normal);
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "ab\xCB\x87" "cd");
}

{

TEST_CASE("vim chords: Insert Ctrl+[ Ctrl+Z Ctrl+Y Ctrl+O", "[text-vim-chords]")

    { VimRig r("ab\xCB\x87" "c"); r.Keys("A<C-o><Esc>y<Esc>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "abc\xCB\x87" "y"); }
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimChords.hpp
#pragma once

// The per-mode chord table of spec s6.6 as data. A claimed chord is handled by
// vim in that mode; an unclaimed one falls through to the editor action table
// (s7). With editor.text.vim.handleCtrlKeys off, vim claims only Esc and Ctrl+[.
// The text columns are what the Shortcuts page shows beside shadowed actions.

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCommand.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimKey.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimOptions.hpp"

#include <span>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimChordRow
    {
        VimKey           chord;
        std::string_view normal, visual, insert, vimOff;
        bool             normalClaimed = false, visualClaimed = false, insertClaimed = false;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::span<const VimChordRow> VimChordTable();
    [[nodiscard]] bool VimClaimsChord(const VimKey& chord, VimMode mode, const VimOptions& options);
}
```

```cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimChords.hpp"

#include <array>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
```
