```cpp
// One VimState over one TextEditorView: the IVimHost implementation (spec
// s6.1), the key interception, hlsearch painting and the vim status-strip
// slot. Document and window operations are DEFERRED (TakeDeferred) to the
// frame boundary, never run inside a key dispatch.

#include "Project/Openers/FileOpener.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/SearchWorker.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextSearch.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextAreaOverlays.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextClipboard.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextViewHooks.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class DocumentHost;
    class EditorDocument;
    class TextDocument;
    class TextEditorView;

    // The vim segment of the status strip (CANON A9: TE5-owned, drawn into TE4-19's
    // StatusSlot::VimMode by DrawVimStatus).
    struct TextStatusVim
    {
        std::string mode;                 // "NORMAL", "-- INSERT --", "-- VISUAL LINE --" ...
        std::string pending;              // the typed keys of an unfinished command
        std::string recording;            // "recording @q" (filled by TE5b-5a)
        std::string message;              // the last ShowMessage
        bool        messageIsError = false;
        std::string commandLine;          // ":s/a/b" while the command line is open
        bool        experimental = false; // kVimExperimental: the spec D12 badge
    };
    void DrawVimStatus(const TextStatusVim& status);

    struct VimDeferredOp
    {
        TextDocument*   doc = nullptr;
        TextEditorView* view = nullptr;
        std::function<void(TextDocument&, TextEditorView&)> run;
    };

    class VimViewAdapter final : public Text::IVimHost
    {
    public:
        struct Services
        {
            DocumentHost* documents = nullptr;   // close, :ls / :bn (never an open route)
            // Opens a file in the Arcane text editor (TE5a-23 wires it to FileOpener::OpenWith, CANON A10).
            std::function<EditorDocument*(const std::filesystem::path&, std::optional<Openers::FilePosition>)> openText;
            TextClipboard           clipboard = ImGuiTextClipboard();   // TE2-18
            std::function<double()> now;
        };

        VimViewAdapter(TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView& view, Text::VimGlobals& globals, Text::VimBufferState& bufferState,
                       Text::VimOptions options, Text::VimLanguage language, Services services);
        ~VimViewAdapter() override;
        VimViewAdapter(const VimViewAdapter&) = delete;
        VimViewAdapter& operator=(const VimViewAdapter&) = delete;

        [[nodiscard]] Text::VimState& Vim() { return *m_vim; }
        void SetLatinLettersWanted(bool wanted);
        // m_context := doc.MakeEditContext(doc.ModelOf(view)) (TE4-24): the VimDoc's EditContext.
        void RefreshContext();
        void Tick();                                            // timeoutlen, keyboard state, status: once per frame
        void DrawOverlays();                                    // the :marks / :reg / :jumps / :ls listing popup
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<VimDeferredOp> TakeDeferred();

        // ---- IVimHost ----
        void SetCursorShape(Text::VimCursorShape shape) override;
        void SetLineMode(bool linewise) override;
        void SetInputEnabled(bool enabled) override;
        void SetClipAtLineEnds(bool clip) override;
        void SetKeyboard(const Text::VimKeyboardState& state) override;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t FirstVisibleRow() const override;
        [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t VisibleRows() const override;
        void ScrollToRow(std::uint32_t firstDisplayRow) override;
        [[nodiscard]] std::string ReadClipboard() override;
        void WriteClipboard(std::string_view text) override;
        void ShowMessage(std::string_view text, bool isError) override;
        void ShowListing(std::string_view title, std::span<const std::string> lines) override;
        void SetCommandLine(std::string_view text, std::size_t cursorByte) override;
        void SetSearchHighlight(std::string_view pcre2Pattern) override;
        Text::VimHostResult RunFileCommand(Text::VimFileCommand command, std::string_view argument, bool bang) override;
        Text::VimHostResult RunWindowCommand(Text::VimWindowCommand command) override;
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::string> ReadFileText(std::string_view path) override;
        [[nodiscard]] std::string DocumentPath() const override;
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::string> BufferList() override;
        bool OpenAt(std::string_view path, Text::Point point) override;

    private:
        bool Dispatch(const Text::VimKey& key);
        [[nodiscard]] bool ClaimsChord(const KeyChord& chord) const;   // the EditorActions chord claim (5a.18)
        void PushKeyboard();
        void PublishStatus();
        void RefreshHighlight();                                // the visible hlsearch matches (overlay source)
        [[nodiscard]] std::filesystem::path ResolvePath(std::string_view arg) const;
        void Defer(std::function<void(TextDocument&, TextEditorView&)> run);

        TextDocument&                    m_doc;
        TextEditorView&                  m_view;
        Services                         m_services;
        Text::EditContext                m_context;            // VimDoc::context points here (stable: non-movable)
        int                              m_contextFrame = -1;  // ImGui frame of the last RefreshContext
        std::string                      m_hlPattern;          // the pcre2 pattern hlsearch paints ("" = none)
        Text::CompiledQuery              m_hlQuery;
        std::uint64_t                    m_hlGeneration = 0;
        Text::VisibleMatchCache          m_hlCache;
        std::vector<Text::ByteRange>     m_hlVisible;
        SearchHighlightOverlay           m_hlOverlay{ [this]
        {
            RefreshHighlight();
            return MatchHighlights{ m_hlVisible, std::nullopt };
        } };
        std::unique_ptr<Text::VimState>  m_vim;
        Text::VimKeyboardState           m_keyboard{};
        bool                             m_latinWanted = false;
        bool                             m_inDispatch = false;
        std::string                      m_message;
        bool                             m_messageError = false;
        std::string                      m_commandLine;
        std::string                      m_listingTitle;
        std::vector<std::string>         m_listing;
        bool                             m_listingOpen = false;
        std::vector<VimDeferredOp>       m_deferred;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/VimViewAdapter.cpp
#include "TextEditor/View/VimViewAdapter.hpp"

#include "Documents/DocumentHost.hpp"
#include "Input/EditorActions.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/FileCodec.hpp"   // Text::EncodeFile (TE1-11): :w {file}
#include "TextEditor/Document/TextDocument.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/TextSearchLimits.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextEditorView.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextInputHook.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/TextStatusStrip.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/VimKeyTranslate.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>

#include <imgui.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <utility>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        TextCursorShape ToViewShape(Text::VimCursorShape s)
        {
            switch (s)
            {
            case Text::VimCursorShape::Block:     return TextCursorShape::Block;
            case Text::VimCursorShape::Underline: return TextCursorShape::Underline;
            case Text::VimCursorShape::Bar:       break;
            }
            return TextCursorShape::Bar;
        }

        std::vector<TextDocument*> TextDocuments(DocumentHost* host)
        {
            std::vector<TextDocument*> out;
            if (!host) return out;
            host->ForEach([&out](EditorDocument& d) {
                if (auto* t = dynamic_cast<TextDocument*>(&d)) out.push_back(t);
            });
            return out;
        }
    }

    void DrawVimStatus(const TextStatusVim& s)
    {
        if (!s.commandLine.empty())
        {
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(s.commandLine.c_str());
            ImGui::SameLine();
        }
        else if (!s.message.empty())
        {
            if (s.messageIsError) ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_PlotLinesHovered));
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(s.message.c_str());
            if (s.messageIsError) ImGui::PopStyleColor();
            ImGui::SameLine();
        }
        ImGui::TextUnformatted(s.mode.c_str());
        if (!s.recording.empty())
        {
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(s.recording.c_str());
        }
        if (!s.pending.empty())
        {
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", s.pending.c_str());
        }
        if (s.experimental)
        {
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::TextDisabled("Experimental");
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
                ImGui::SetTooltip("Vim mode is Experimental until the full vim behaviour suite passes (spec D12).");
        }
    }

    VimViewAdapter::VimViewAdapter(TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView& view, Text::VimGlobals& globals, Text::VimBufferState& bufferState,
                                   Text::VimOptions options, Text::VimLanguage language, Services services)
        : m_doc(doc), m_view(view), m_services(std::move(services))
    {
        m_view.SetKeyInterceptor(TextKeyInterceptor{
            [this](char32_t ch) { return Dispatch(Text::VimKey::Char(ch)); },
            [this](const KeyChord& chord) {
                const std::optional<Text::VimKey> k = VimKeyFromChord(chord);
                return k ? Dispatch(*k) : false;
            },
            [this](const TextKeyPress& key) {
                const std::optional<Text::VimKey> k = VimKeyFromNamed(key);
                return k ? Dispatch(*k) : false;
            } });
        m_view.SetEvents(TextViewEvents{
            [this](std::string_view text) { if (m_vim) m_vim->OnInputHandled(text); },
            [this] { if (m_vim && !m_inDispatch) m_vim->OnTransactionBegun(); },
            [this] { if (m_vim && !m_inDispatch) m_vim->OnTransactionUndone(); },
            [this](bool byMouse) {
                if (!m_vim || m_inDispatch) return;
                m_inDispatch = true;                            // vim's own selection change must not re-enter
                m_vim->OnSelectionsChanged(byMouse);
                m_inDispatch = false;
                PublishStatus();
            },
            [this] { if (m_vim) m_vim->InterruptInsertSession(); } });   // outsideChange (5a.7)
        m_view.AddOverlay(&m_hlOverlay);
        TextModel& model = m_doc.ModelOf(m_view);               // TE4-17: this view's buffer, selections, folds, display
        RefreshContext();
        m_vim = std::make_unique<Text::VimState>(Text::VimDoc{ model.buffer, model.selections, model.folds, model.display, &m_context },
                                                 *this, globals, bufferState, std::move(options), std::move(language));
        PublishStatus();
    }

    VimViewAdapter::~VimViewAdapter()
    {
        m_vim.reset();                                          // ends an open insert session through the hooks below
        EditorActions::Get().ClearChordClaim(this);             // only this adapter's claim (5a.18)
        m_view.RemoveOverlay(&m_hlOverlay);
        m_view.SetKeyInterceptor({});
        m_view.SetEvents({});
        m_view.SetCursorShape(TextCursorShape::Bar);            // back to the plain editor (vim off)
        m_view.SetLineMode(false);
        m_view.SetInputEnabled(true);
        m_view.SetClipAtLineEnds(false);
        if (m_view.KeyboardActive()) ResetTextKeyboard(TextInputHook::Get());
        m_doc.StatusStrip().SetSlot(StatusSlot::VimMode, {});   // a split's other vim view republishes on its next Tick
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::RefreshContext()
    {
        m_context = m_doc.MakeEditContext(m_doc.ModelOf(m_view));
        m_contextFrame = ImGui::GetFrameCount();
    }

    bool VimViewAdapter::Dispatch(const Text::VimKey& key)
    {
        if (!m_vim) return false;
        if (ImGui::GetFrameCount() != m_contextFrame) RefreshContext();   // once per frame, before vim's first key
        m_message.clear();
        m_inDispatch = true;
        const Text::VimKeyResult r = m_vim->HandleKey(key, m_services.now ? m_services.now() : ImGui::GetTime());
        m_inDispatch = false;
        PublishStatus();
        return r.handled;
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::SetLatinLettersWanted(bool wanted)
    {
        m_latinWanted = wanted;
        PushKeyboard();
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::Tick()
    {
        if (!m_vim) return;
        m_vim->Tick(m_services.now ? m_services.now() : ImGui::GetTime());
        // 5a.7: the view lost the keyboard (another view, the find bar, a menu, another panel) --
        // vim's insert transaction must not stay open while other code edits the buffer.
        if (!m_view.KeyboardActive()) m_vim->InterruptInsertSession();
        PushKeyboard();                                         // focus may have moved to this view
        PublishStatus();
    }

    std::vector<VimDeferredOp> VimViewAdapter::TakeDeferred() { return std::exchange(m_deferred, {}); }

    void VimViewAdapter::Defer(std::function<void(TextDocument&, TextEditorView&)> run)
    {
        m_deferred.push_back(VimDeferredOp{ &m_doc, &m_view, std::move(run) });
    }

    // The input hook and the chord claim are process-wide: only the view that holds the keyboard
    // drives them (VimEditorRuntime::FrameBoundary resets both when no vim view does).
    void VimViewAdapter::PushKeyboard()
    {
        if (!m_view.KeyboardActive()) return;
        ApplyVimKeyboard(TextInputHook::Get(), m_keyboard, m_latinWanted);
        EditorActions::Get().SetChordClaim(this, [this](const KeyChord& chord) { return ClaimsChord(chord); });
    }

    bool VimViewAdapter::ClaimsChord(const KeyChord& chord) const
    {
        return m_vim && VimClaimsKeyChord(chord, m_vim->Mode(), m_vim->Options());
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::PublishStatus()
    {
        if (!m_vim) return;
        if (&m_doc.FocusedView() != &m_view) return;            // a split's focused view owns the document's strip
        TextStatusVim s;
        const std::string modeText = VimModeStatusText(m_vim->Mode());
        s.mode = modeText.empty() ? std::string(Text::VimModeLabel(m_vim->Mode())) : modeText;
        s.pending = m_vim->PendingKeys();
        s.message = m_message;
        s.messageIsError = m_messageError;
        s.commandLine = m_commandLine;
        s.experimental = kVimExperimental;
        m_doc.StatusStrip().SetSlot(StatusSlot::VimMode, [s = std::move(s)] { DrawVimStatus(s); });
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::DrawOverlays()
    {
        if (m_listingOpen)
        {
            ImGui::OpenPopup("##vimlisting");
            m_listingOpen = false;
        }
        if (ImGui::BeginPopup("##vimlisting"))
        {
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(m_listingTitle.c_str());
            ImGui::Separator();
            for (const std::string& line : m_listing) ImGui::TextUnformatted(line.c_str());
            if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Enter)) ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
            ImGui::EndPopup();
        }
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::SetCursorShape(Text::VimCursorShape shape) { m_view.SetCursorShape(ToViewShape(shape)); }
    void VimViewAdapter::SetLineMode(bool linewise) { m_view.SetLineMode(linewise); }
    void VimViewAdapter::SetInputEnabled(bool enabled) { m_view.SetInputEnabled(enabled); }
    void VimViewAdapter::SetClipAtLineEnds(bool clip) { m_view.SetClipAtLineEnds(clip); }

    void VimViewAdapter::SetKeyboard(const Text::VimKeyboardState& state)
    {
        m_keyboard = state;
        PushKeyboard();
    }

    std::uint32_t VimViewAdapter::FirstVisibleRow() const { return m_view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow(); }
    std::uint32_t VimViewAdapter::VisibleRows() const { return m_view.VisibleRowCount(); }
    void VimViewAdapter::ScrollToRow(std::uint32_t row) { m_view.SetFirstVisibleDisplayRow(row); }   // TE4-9 (CANON A7)

    std::string VimViewAdapter::ReadClipboard()
    {
        return m_services.clipboard.get ? m_services.clipboard.get() : std::string{};
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::WriteClipboard(std::string_view text)
    {
        if (m_services.clipboard.set) m_services.clipboard.set(std::string(text));
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::ShowMessage(std::string_view text, bool isError)
    {
        m_message = std::string(text);
        m_messageError = isError;
        PublishStatus();
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::ShowListing(std::string_view title, std::span<const std::string> lines)
    {
        m_listingTitle = std::string(title);
        m_listing.assign(lines.begin(), lines.end());
        m_listingOpen = true;
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::SetCommandLine(std::string_view text, std::size_t)
    {
        m_commandLine = std::string(text);
        PublishStatus();
    }

    // hlsearch (CANON B19): vim's translated pattern compiled as TE4's regex query and painted
    // by this adapter's own SearchHighlightOverlay (the find bar keeps its own).
    void VimViewAdapter::SetSearchHighlight(std::string_view pattern)
    {
        if (pattern == m_hlPattern) return;
        m_hlPattern = std::string(pattern);
        m_hlQuery = Text::CompiledQuery{};
        m_hlVisible.clear();
        m_hlCache.Invalidate();
        ++m_hlGeneration;
        if (pattern.empty()) return;
        Text::SearchQuery q;
        q.text = m_hlPattern;
        q.regex = true;
        q.caseSensitive = true;                                 // the translation already carries \c / smartcase
        // TE5c-1's VimPattern::Translate emits "(?m)" as the FIRST token exactly when
        // TranslatedPattern::multiline is set (a vim pattern's own "(" is escaped), so this IS
        // translated.multiline -- IVimHost::SetSearchHighlight carries only the pcre2 text.
        q.forceMultiline = m_hlPattern.starts_with("(?m)");
        m_hlQuery = Text::TextSearch::Compile(q, std::string_view{});   // no whole-word option: word chars unused
    }

    void VimViewAdapter::RefreshHighlight()
    {
        m_hlVisible.clear();
        if (!m_hlQuery.Valid() || m_hlQuery.multiline) return;  // multi-line queries are not painted (as the find bar)
        const Text::DisplayMap& display = m_view.Display();
        const std::uint32_t rows = display.DisplayRowCount();
        if (rows == 0) return;
        const std::uint32_t first = display.DisplayRowToBuffer(std::min(m_view.FirstVisibleDisplayRow(), rows - 1));
        const std::uint32_t last = display.DisplayRowToBuffer(std::min(m_view.LastVisibleDisplayRow(), rows - 1));
        const std::span<const Text::ByteRange> v = m_hlCache.Get(m_view.Buffer().Snapshot(), m_hlQuery, m_hlGeneration, first, last,
                                                                 SearchLimitsFromSettings(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>()));
        m_hlVisible.assign(v.begin(), v.end());
    }

    std::filesystem::path VimViewAdapter::ResolvePath(std::string_view arg) const
    {
        const std::filesystem::path p = Utf8ToPath(arg);
        if (p.is_absolute()) return p;
        const auto base = m_doc.CanonicalPath();                // by value (CANON A7)
        return base.parent_path() / p;
    }

    Text::VimHostResult VimViewAdapter::RunFileCommand(Text::VimFileCommand command, std::string_view argument, bool bang)
    {
        using Text::VimFileCommand;
        const Text::VimHostResult cannotWrite{ false, "E212: Can't open file for writing" };
        // :q in a split closes the window (TE4-17's CloseView); otherwise the document.
        const auto closeWindowOrDoc = [this](bool discard) {
            if (m_doc.SplitOpen())
            {
                Defer([](TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView& view) { doc.CloseView(view); });
                return;
            }
            DocumentHost* host = m_services.documents;
            Defer([host, discard](TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView&) {
                if (!host) return;
                host->RequestClose(&doc);
                if (discard && host->HasPendingConfirm() && host->PendingConfirmDoc() == &doc) host->ConfirmDiscard();
            });
        };
        switch (command)
        {
        case VimFileCommand::Write:
            if (!argument.empty())
            {
                // :w {file} writes a COPY (finding 5a.25): the document keeps its path, its title and its
                // dirty state; an existing file needs ! (E13). The buffer is written as it is, in the
                // document's encoding and line endings (no save transforms: those belong to Save).
                const std::filesystem::path target = ResolvePath(argument);
                std::error_code ec;
                const Text::VimHostResult decision = WriteCopyDecision(std::filesystem::exists(target, ec), bang);
                if (!decision.ok) return decision;
                const auto bytes = Text::EncodeFile(m_doc.Buffer().Text(), m_doc.Buffer().Eols(), m_doc.Encoding());
                if (!bytes) return Text::VimHostResult{ false, "E513: write error, conversion failed" };
                std::ofstream out(target, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
                if (!out || !out.write(bytes->data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes->size()))) return cannotWrite;
                return Text::VimHostResult{ true, "\"" + PathToUtf8(target) + "\" written" };
            }
            return m_doc.Save() ? Text::VimHostResult{ true, "\"" + DocumentPath() + "\" written" } : cannotWrite;
        case VimFileCommand::Quit:
        {
            if (!m_doc.SplitOpen())
            {
                const Text::VimHostResult d = QuitDecision(m_doc.Dirty(), bang);
                if (!d.ok) return d;
            }
            closeWindowOrDoc(bang);
            return {};
        }
        case VimFileCommand::WriteQuit:
            if (!m_doc.Save()) return cannotWrite;
            closeWindowOrDoc(false);
            return {};
        case VimFileCommand::WriteIfDirtyQuit:
            if (m_doc.Dirty() && !m_doc.Save()) return cannotWrite;
            closeWindowOrDoc(false);
            return {};
        case VimFileCommand::Edit:
        {
            if (argument.empty())
            {
                const Text::VimHostResult d = QuitDecision(m_doc.Dirty(), bang);
                if (!d.ok) return d;
                Defer([](TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView&) { doc.ReloadFromDisk(); });
                return {};
            }
            if (!m_services.openText) return Text::VimHostResult{ false, "E32: No file name" };
            const std::filesystem::path target = ResolvePath(argument);
            auto open = m_services.openText;                    // FileOpener (CANON A10), never DocumentHost::OpenAt
            Defer([open, target](TextDocument&, TextEditorView&) { (void)open(target, std::nullopt); });
            return {};
        }
        case VimFileCommand::SaveAs:
            if (argument.empty()) return Text::VimHostResult{ false, "E471: Argument required" };
            return m_doc.SaveAs(ResolvePath(argument)) ? Text::VimHostResult{} : cannotWrite;
        case VimFileCommand::NextBuffer:
        case VimFileCommand::PrevBuffer:
        {
            const std::vector<TextDocument*> docs = TextDocuments(m_services.documents);
            const auto it = std::find(docs.begin(), docs.end(), &m_doc);
            if (docs.size() < 2 || it == docs.end()) return Text::VimHostResult{ false, "E85: There is no listed buffer" };
            const std::size_t i = static_cast<std::size_t>(it - docs.begin());
            const std::size_t n = docs.size();
            TextDocument* next = docs[command == VimFileCommand::NextBuffer ? (i + 1) % n : (i + n - 1) % n];
            DocumentHost* host = m_services.documents;
            Defer([host, next](TextDocument&, TextEditorView&) {
                const std::vector<TextDocument*> open = TextDocuments(host);   // an earlier op may have closed it
                if (std::find(open.begin(), open.end(), next) != open.end()) host->Focus(next);   // TE7-9
            });
            return {};
        }
        }
        return {};
    }

    Text::VimHostResult VimViewAdapter::RunWindowCommand(Text::VimWindowCommand command)
    {
        using Text::VimWindowCommand;
        switch (command)
        {
        case VimWindowCommand::SplitHorizontal: Defer([](TextDocument& d, TextEditorView&) { d.OpenSplit(false); }); break;   // stacked
        case VimWindowCommand::SplitVertical:   Defer([](TextDocument& d, TextEditorView&) { d.OpenSplit(true); }); break;    // side by side
        case VimWindowCommand::FocusLeft:
        case VimWindowCommand::FocusDown:
        case VimWindowCommand::FocusUp:
        case VimWindowCommand::FocusRight:
        case VimWindowCommand::FocusNext:
            // TE4-17 has at most two views: the other one, when it lies that way; else beep.
            if (!OtherViewLiesIn(command, m_doc.SplitOpen(), m_doc.SplitVertical(), &m_view == &m_doc.View()))
                return Text::VimHostResult{ false, "" };
            Defer([](TextDocument& d, TextEditorView&) { d.FocusOtherView(); });
            break;
        case VimWindowCommand::Close:
            if (!m_doc.SplitOpen()) return Text::VimHostResult{ false, "E444: Cannot close last window" };
            Defer([](TextDocument& d, TextEditorView& v) { d.CloseView(v); });
            break;
        }
        return {};
    }

    std::optional<std::string> VimViewAdapter::ReadFileText(std::string_view path)
    {
        std::ifstream in(ResolvePath(path), std::ios::binary);
        if (!in) return std::nullopt;
        std::stringstream ss;
        ss << in.rdbuf();
        return ss.str();
    }

    std::string VimViewAdapter::DocumentPath() const { return PathToUtf8(m_doc.CanonicalPath()); }

    std::vector<std::string> VimViewAdapter::BufferList()
    {
        std::vector<std::string> out;
        for (TextDocument* d : TextDocuments(m_services.documents)) out.push_back(PathToUtf8(d->CanonicalPath()));
        return out;
    }

    // Global marks in another file (TE5b-7) and `:e` open through FileOpener (CANON A10). The
    // position is the mark's line, column 1: the documented 'A column divergence (VimDivergences).
    bool VimViewAdapter::OpenAt(std::string_view path, Text::Point point)
    {
        if (!m_services.openText) return false;
        const std::filesystem::path target = Utf8ToPath(path);
        const Openers::FilePosition at{ point.row + 1, 1 };
        auto open = m_services.openText;
        Defer([open, target, at](TextDocument&, TextEditorView&) { (void)open(target, at); });
        return true;
    }
}
```

`editor.text.vim.enabled` is live (spec s6.1): turning it on attaches a `VimViewAdapter` (and so a `VimState`) to every open text view; turning it off destroys them, which restores the plain view (Bar caret, input on, no interception, the hlsearch overlay removed, the status slot cleared, the text keyboard back) -- with it off no vim code runs. `VimEditorRuntime::FrameBoundary` (called once per frame, after `DocumentHost::DrawAll`) reads the published settings, applies the difference, refreshes the regex limits of the one vim `MatchScratch` (`m_globals.scratch.SetLimits(ToSyntaxLimits(Settings<TextSettings>()).regex)`, also done at construction) and every adapter's `EditContext` (`RefreshContext`, i.e. `doc.MakeEditContext(model)`), re-resolves "Latin letters: Auto" against the active layout (`!TextInputHook::Get().Layout().lettersLatin`), ticks every adapter (timeoutlen, keyboard state, status strip), resets the input hook to the text keyboard when no vim view holds the keyboard, and then runs the deferred document/window operations. Files vim opens (`:e`, a global mark) go through `SetFileOpener`'s `FileOpener::OpenWith(p, OpenerId::ArcaneText(), at).document` (CANON A10); the `DocumentHost` stays only for closing documents and the buffer list (`:q`, `:ls`, `:bn`). The status strip's vim slot shows the Experimental badge (`kVimExperimental`, TE5a-22) for as long as VIM-GATE has not dropped it.

```cpp
    const auto first = Editor::DiffVimRuntime(std::nullopt, on);
    CHECK(first.attach);

    CHECK_FALSE(Editor::DiffVimRuntime(std::nullopt, off).attach);
    const auto down = Editor::DiffVimRuntime(on, off);
    CHECK(down.detach);

    Editor::VimRuntimeState changed = on;
    changed.options.handleCtrlKeys = false;
    const auto opt = Editor::DiffVimRuntime(on, changed);
    CHECK(opt.options);
    CHECK_FALSE(opt.attach);
    changed = on;
    changed.latin = Editor::VimLatinLetters::On;
    CHECK(Editor::DiffVimRuntime(on, changed).options);
    const auto same = Editor::DiffVimRuntime(on, on);
    CHECK_FALSE(same.attach);
    CHECK_FALSE(same.detach);
    CHECK_FALSE(same.options);
}
```

```cpp
    Text::VimLanguage VimLanguageOf(const Text::GrammarSnapshot& grammar)
    {
        return grammar ? Text::VimLanguageFromGrammar(*grammar) : Text::VimLanguage{};   // the CompiledGrammar overload (TE5a-3)
    }

    bool ResolveLatinLetters(VimLatinLetters setting, bool layoutNonLatin)
    {
        switch (setting)
        {
        case VimLatinLetters::On:   return true;
        case VimLatinLetters::Off:  return false;
        case VimLatinLetters::Auto: break;
        }
        return layoutNonLatin;
    }

    VimRuntimeChange DiffVimRuntime(const std::optional<VimRuntimeState>& before, const VimRuntimeState& after)
    {
        VimRuntimeChange c;
        const bool wasOn = before && before->enabled;
        c.attach = after.enabled && !wasOn;
        c.detach = !after.enabled && wasOn;
        c.options = after.enabled && wasOn && (!(before->options == after.options) || before->latin != after.latin);
        return c;
    }
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/VimEditorRuntime.hpp
#pragma once

// The editor's vim runtime (spec s6.1): the process-wide VimGlobals, one
// VimBufferState per TextDocument (shared by its split views), and one
// VimViewAdapter per TextEditorView while editor.text.vim.enabled is on.
// FrameBoundary runs once per frame after DocumentHost::DrawAll: it applies
// settings changes live, ticks every adapter, then runs their deferred
// document/window operations.

#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/VimKeyTranslate.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/View/VimViewAdapter.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimGlobals.hpp"

#include <functional>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor::Openers
{
    class FileOpener;
}

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    class DocumentHost;
    class TextDocument;
    class TextEditorView;

    class VimEditorRuntime
    {
    public:
        static VimEditorRuntime& Get();

        void SetDocumentHost(DocumentHost* host) { m_documents = host; }    // close, :ls, :bn (never an open route)
        void SetFileOpener(Openers::FileOpener* files) { m_files = files; } // :e and global marks (CANON A10)
        [[nodiscard]] Text::VimGlobals& Globals() { return m_globals; }
        [[nodiscard]] Text::VimBufferState& BufferState(TextDocument& doc);

        void Register(TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView& view);     // every view a TextDocument creates (TE2-15, TE4-17)
        void Unregister(TextEditorView& view);                      // before the view is destroyed
        void Attach(TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView& view);
        void Detach(TextEditorView& view);
        void OnSettingsPublished();
        void FrameBoundary();
        void ForEachVim(const std::function<void(Text::VimState&)>& fn);
        [[nodiscard]] VimViewAdapter* AdapterFor(const TextEditorView& view);

    private:
        VimEditorRuntime();                                         // sets the vim MatchScratch's regex limits

        struct Entry
        {
            TextDocument*                   doc = nullptr;
            TextEditorView*                 view = nullptr;
            std::unique_ptr<VimViewAdapter> adapter;
            Text::GrammarSnapshot           grammar;   // the grammar vim's language came from (5a.19: re-checked every frame)
        };
        [[nodiscard]] VimRuntimeState Current() const;
        [[nodiscard]] bool IsRegistered(const TextEditorView* view) const;
        [[nodiscard]] static bool LatinWanted(VimLatinLetters setting);

        DocumentHost*                                                        m_documents = nullptr;
        Openers::FileOpener*                                                 m_files = nullptr;
        Text::VimGlobals                                                     m_globals;
        std::vector<Entry>                                                   m_entries;
        std::map<const TextDocument*, std::unique_ptr<Text::VimBufferState>> m_bufferStates;
        std::optional<VimRuntimeState>                                       m_applied;
    };
}
```

```cpp
    VimEditorRuntime::VimEditorRuntime()
    {
        // The one vim MatchScratch (TE5a-13) runs under the editor's regex limits (TE3-3); pure vim
        // code never reads settings.
        m_globals.scratch.SetLimits(ToSyntaxLimits(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>()).regex);
    }

    Text::VimBufferState& VimEditorRuntime::BufferState(TextDocument& doc)
    {
        std::unique_ptr<Text::VimBufferState>& slot = m_bufferStates[&doc];
        if (!slot) slot = std::make_unique<Text::VimBufferState>();
        return *slot;
    }

    VimRuntimeState VimEditorRuntime::Current() const
    {
        const TextVimSettings& vim = Arcane::Settings<TextVimSettings>();
        return VimRuntimeState{ vim.enabled, ReadVimOptions(vim, Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>()), vim.latinLettersInNormal };
    }

    bool VimEditorRuntime::LatinWanted(VimLatinLetters setting)
    {
        return ResolveLatinLetters(setting, !TextInputHook::Get().Layout().lettersLatin);   // CANON A8
    }

    bool VimEditorRuntime::IsRegistered(const TextEditorView* view) const
    {
        return std::any_of(m_entries.begin(), m_entries.end(), [view](const Entry& e) { return e.view == view; });
    }

    void VimEditorRuntime::Register(TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView& view)
    {
        if (IsRegistered(&view)) return;
        m_entries.push_back(Entry{ &doc, &view, nullptr });
        if (Current().enabled) Attach(doc, view);
    }

    void VimEditorRuntime::Unregister(TextEditorView& view)
    {
        const auto it = std::find_if(m_entries.begin(), m_entries.end(), [&view](const Entry& e) { return e.view == &view; });
        if (it == m_entries.end()) return;
        const TextDocument* doc = it->doc;
        it->adapter.reset();                                    // the adapter restores the view before the view goes
        m_entries.erase(it);
        const bool lastView = std::none_of(m_entries.begin(), m_entries.end(), [doc](const Entry& e) { return e.doc == doc; });
        if (lastView) m_bufferStates.erase(doc);
    }

    void VimEditorRuntime::Attach(TextDocument& doc, TextEditorView& view)
    {
        for (Entry& e : m_entries)
        {
            if (e.view != &view || e.adapter) continue;
            const VimRuntimeState state = Current();
            e.grammar = doc.Grammar();                                       // TE4-11; null = Plain Text
            Text::VimLanguage language = VimLanguageOf(e.grammar);
            VimViewAdapter::Services services;
            services.documents = m_documents;
            services.openText = [this](const std::filesystem::path& path, std::optional<Openers::FilePosition> at) -> EditorDocument*
            {
                // Read at call time: SetFileOpener may come after the first attach.
                return m_files ? m_files->OpenWith(path, Openers::OpenerId::ArcaneText(), at).document : nullptr;
            };
            services.now = [] { return ImGui::GetTime(); };
            e.adapter = std::make_unique<VimViewAdapter>(doc, view, m_globals, BufferState(doc), state.options, std::move(language), services);
            e.adapter->SetLatinLettersWanted(LatinWanted(state.latin));
        }
    }

    void VimEditorRuntime::Detach(TextEditorView& view)
    {
        for (Entry& e : m_entries)
            if (e.view == &view) e.adapter.reset();
    }

    void VimEditorRuntime::OnSettingsPublished()
    {
        const VimRuntimeState now = Current();
        const VimRuntimeChange change = DiffVimRuntime(m_applied, now);
        if (change.attach)
            for (Entry& e : m_entries) Attach(*e.doc, *e.view);
        if (change.detach)
            for (Entry& e : m_entries) e.adapter.reset();
        if (change.options)
            for (Entry& e : m_entries)
                if (e.adapter) e.adapter->Vim().SetOptions(now.options);
        // Every publish: the regex limits of the one vim MatchScratch and each view's EditContext
        // (doc.MakeEditContext(model): indentation, word chars, comment tokens, cursor limit).
        m_globals.scratch.SetLimits(ToSyntaxLimits(Arcane::Settings<TextSettings>()).regex);
        for (Entry& e : m_entries)
            if (e.adapter) e.adapter->RefreshContext();
        m_applied = now;
    }

    void VimEditorRuntime::FrameBoundary()
    {
        OnSettingsPublished();                                  // live: the published block is read once per frame
        const bool latin = m_applied && LatinWanted(m_applied->latin);   // Auto follows a layout switch
        bool vimHasKeyboard = false;
        std::vector<VimDeferredOp> ops;
        for (Entry& e : m_entries)
        {
            if (!e.adapter) continue;
            // 5a.19: the grammar may change after attach (a late detection, Set Language, a grammar
            // reload): vim's language -- gc's comment string, the word classes, = -- follows it.
            if (const Text::GrammarSnapshot grammar = e.doc->Grammar(); grammar != e.grammar)
            {
                e.grammar = grammar;
                e.adapter->Vim().SetLanguage(VimLanguageOf(grammar));
            }
            e.adapter->SetLatinLettersWanted(latin);
            e.adapter->Tick();
            vimHasKeyboard = vimHasKeyboard || e.view->KeyboardActive();
            for (VimDeferredOp& op : e.adapter->TakeDeferred()) ops.push_back(std::move(op));
        }
        if (!vimHasKeyboard)
        {
            ResetTextKeyboard(TextInputHook::Get());            // no vim view holds the keyboard: text entry everywhere
            EditorActions::Get().ClearChordClaim();             // ... and every chord is the editor's again (5a.18)
        }
        for (VimDeferredOp& op : ops)
            if (op.run && IsRegistered(op.view)) op.run(*op.doc, *op.view);   // an earlier op may have closed it
    }

    void VimEditorRuntime::ForEachVim(const std::function<void(Text::VimState&)>& fn)
    {
        for (Entry& e : m_entries)
            if (e.adapter) fn(e.adapter->Vim());
    }

    VimViewAdapter* VimEditorRuntime::AdapterFor(const TextEditorView& view)
    {
        for (Entry& e : m_entries)
            if (e.view == &view) return e.adapter.get();
        return nullptr;
    }
}
```

The option is Neovim's `clipboard=unnamedplus` (spec s6.4): when it is on, every yank, delete and put that names no register uses the `+` register, which is the system clipboard. It is a preference, not a limit, so it is not Dev. Its default is Neovim's (`clipboard` empty, so off), not a measured value.

```cpp
    std::string VimRecordingStatusText(std::optional<char32_t> recordingRegister)
    {

        std::string text = "recording @";
        Text::Utf8::Append(text, *recordingRegister);
        return text;
    }
```

### Task TE5b-1: The complete register rules, put distribution, and `useSystemClipboard` (spec s6.3 Registers, s6.4)

**Files:**
- Modify (rewrite in full): `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.hpp`, `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.cpp` (TE5a-12)
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimPutRegister.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (private: `PutRegister`, `PutBlock`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimActions.cpp` (the four put cases' Normal-mode calls)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimOperators.cpp` (`RunOperator`'s delete/change register store, TE5a-12)
- Create: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5b.vimcases`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimRegistersTest.cpp`

**Lane (D-R11 X1):** lane L7 (pure vim library). The `editor.text.vim.useSystemClipboard` setting row, its sweep and its `ReadVimOptions` line are TE5b-1a's (serial, after TE5a-23); this task touches no `TextSettings.*`, `SweepTextVimTest.cpp` or frozen-names file. It reads only `VimOptions::useSystemClipboard`, which TE5a-3 declares.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `IVimHost::ReadClipboard/WriteClipboard/DocumentPath` (TE5a-5; in the editor the adapter, TE5a-22, implements the clipboard pair over TE2-18's `TextClipboard { set; get; }` -- `TextDocumentServices::clipboard`, `ImGuiTextClipboard()` -- and the path from `TextDocument::CanonicalPath()`, by value), `VimOptions::useSystemClipboard` (TE5a-3), `VimCursorModel::PasteOffset/PasteRow/Clamp` (TE5a-2), `VimText::*`, `VimRig` (TE5a-5).
- Produces (API of CONTRACT.md unchanged, plus):
  - `static bool VimRegisters::IsWritable(char32_t)`
  - `[[nodiscard]] char32_t VimRegisters::UnnamedName() const noexcept` / `void VimRegisters::SetUnnamedName(char32_t name) noexcept` -- the register `""` reads; TE5b-5 saves and restores it around a recording, as Neovim's `do_record` saves and restores `y_previous`.
  - `void StoreDeletedText(VimRegisters& regs, char32_t name, VimRegisterValue value, bool forceNumbered, IVimHost& host, const VimOptions& options)` -- the one delete/change store: `forceNumbered` = the operator's motion was one of vim's `use_reg_one` motions (`VimUsesRegisterOne`, TE5a-10).
  - `void VimState::PutRegister(const VimParsed& p, bool after, bool cursorAfterText)`, `void VimState::PutBlock(const VimRegisterValue& v, std::uint32_t count, bool after, bool cursorAfterText)`

Rules (Neovim `register.c` / `ops.c`): a yank with no register writes `"0`; with a register, only that register. A delete or change writes the named register if one is given, then -- when it is linewise, spans lines, or its motion forces it -- shifts `"1`..`"8` into `"2`..`"9` and writes `"1` (the unnamed register then points at `"1` unless the name was an append); a one-line charwise delete with no register writes `"-`. "Spans lines" is judged part by part: a multi-cursor charwise delete keeps one part per cursor, and it counts as multi-line only when one of those parts holds a line break (joining the parts with `'\n'` would make every multi-cursor `x` look multi-line). A blockwise value spans lines when it has more than one part. Uppercase appends: charwise onto charwise concatenates; any linewise side makes the result linewise with the appended text on new lines. `"_` discards. `"+` and `"*` are the system clipboard (one on Windows); the text vim wrote keeps its kind while the clipboard still holds it, otherwise clipboard text ending in a line break reads linewise. `useSystemClipboard` (Neovim `clipboard=unnamedplus`) turns "no register" into `"+` for writes and reads. `"%` is the document path; `".` `":` `"/` are read-only (set by vim itself through `SetSpecial`). A value has one part per cursor after a multi-cursor yank; a put with as many cursors as parts gives cursor *i* part *i*, any other put gives every cursor the whole text. `:registers` (TE5c-14) lists in Neovim's `ex_display` order: `"`, `0`-`9`, `a`-`z`, `-`, `*`, `+`, `.`, `:`, `%`, `/`.

**`d%` on one line (D-R13).** `%` is one of vim's `use_reg_one` motions (`:h quote1`), so a one-line `d%` fills `"1` AND `"-` (te5b: `reg: 1 v "(a)"`), exactly as a one-line `d/pat<CR>` does (te5c). `forceNumbered` is set for every `use_reg_one` motion, `%` (`MatchPair`) included, through TE5a-10's `VimUsesRegisterOne`. The oracle runs Neovim with `-u NONE` (D-R13): `--clean` loads the bundled matchit even with `--noplugin`, and matchit's operator-pending `%` (a Visual-mode delete) left `"1` empty -- that was the D-R12 table's `reg: 1 v ""`, now re-verified without matchit on v0.12.5. The unit test below exercises `forceNumbered` itself with the te5c `d/bar<CR>` value.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimRegistersTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.hpp"

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using Arcane::Test::FakeVimHost;
using Arcane::Test::VimRig;

namespace
{
    VimRegisterValue Chars(std::string t) { return VimRegisterValue{ { std::move(t) }, VimRegisterKind::Charwise }; }
    VimRegisterValue Lines(std::string t) { return VimRegisterValue{ { std::move(t) }, VimRegisterKind::Linewise }; }
    std::string TextOf(const VimRegisters& r, char32_t name, FakeVimHost& h, const VimOptions& o)
    {
        const auto v = r.Get(name, h, o);
        return v ? v->Text() : std::string("<none>");
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim registers: a yank writes \"0 and the unnamed register points at it", "[text-vim-registers]")
{
    VimRegisters r; FakeVimHost h; const VimOptions o;
    r.Store(0, Chars("foo"), VimRegisterOp::Yank, h, o);
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'0', h, o) == "foo");
    CHECK(TextOf(r, 0, h, o) == "foo");
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'"', h, o) == "foo");
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'1', h, o) == "<none>");
}

TEST_CASE("vim registers: multi-line deletes shift 1-9; small deletes go to \"-", "[text-vim-registers]")
{
    VimRegisters r; FakeVimHost h; const VimOptions o;
    r.Store(0, Lines("a\n"), VimRegisterOp::SmallDelete, h, o);   // linewise: numbered whatever the caller says
    r.Store(0, Lines("b\n"), VimRegisterOp::Delete, h, o);
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'1', h, o) == "b\n");
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'2', h, o) == "a\n");
    CHECK(TextOf(r, 0, h, o) == "b\n");
    r.Store(0, Chars("x"), VimRegisterOp::SmallDelete, h, o);
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'-', h, o) == "x");
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'1', h, o) == "b\n");                          // unchanged
    CHECK(TextOf(r, 0, h, o) == "x");
    for (int i = 0; i < 9; ++i) r.Store(0, Lines(std::to_string(i) + "\n"), VimRegisterOp::Delete, h, o);
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'9', h, o) == "0\n");                          // the oldest numbered entry falls off
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'1', h, o) == "8\n");
}

TEST_CASE("vim registers: a forced numbered delete on one line writes \"1 and \"-", "[text-vim-registers]")
{
    VimRegisters r; FakeVimHost h; const VimOptions o;
    StoreDeletedText(r, 0, Chars("foo "), true, h, o);              // d/bar<CR> on "foo bar" (te5c)
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'1', h, o) == "foo ");
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'-', h, o) == "foo ");
    StoreDeletedText(r, 0, Chars("b"), false, h, o);
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'1', h, o) == "foo ");
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'-', h, o) == "b");
}

TEST_CASE("vim registers: a multi-cursor charwise delete is small when no part spans lines", "[text-vim-registers]")
{
    VimRegisters r; FakeVimHost h; const VimOptions o;
    r.Store(0, Lines("keep\n"), VimRegisterOp::Delete, h, o);
    StoreDeletedText(r, 0, VimRegisterValue{ { "a", "b" }, VimRegisterKind::Charwise }, false, h, o);   // x with two cursors
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'-', h, o) == "a\nb");
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'1', h, o) == "keep\n");                       // no shift: neither part holds a line break
    CHECK(r.Get(0, h, o)->parts.size() == 2u);
    StoreDeletedText(r, 0, VimRegisterValue{ { "x\ny", "z" }, VimRegisterKind::Charwise }, false, h, o);
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'1', h, o) == "x\ny\nz");                     // one part spans lines: numbered
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'2', h, o) == "keep\n");
}

TEST_CASE("vim registers: named registers, uppercase append rules, black hole", "[text-vim-registers]")
{
    VimRegisters r; FakeVimHost h; const VimOptions o;
    r.Store(U'a', Chars("foo"), VimRegisterOp::Yank, h, o);
    r.Store(U'A', Chars("bar"), VimRegisterOp::Yank, h, o);
    CHECK(r.Get(U'a', h, o)->kind == VimRegisterKind::Charwise);
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'a', h, o) == "foobar");
    CHECK(TextOf(r, 0, h, o) == "foobar");
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'0', h, o) == "<none>");                       // a named yank leaves "0 alone

    r.Store(U'b', Chars("x"), VimRegisterOp::Yank, h, o);
    r.Store(U'B', Lines("y\n"), VimRegisterOp::Yank, h, o);
    CHECK(r.Get(U'b', h, o)->kind == VimRegisterKind::Linewise);
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'b', h, o) == "x\ny\n");

    r.Store(U'c', Lines("x\n"), VimRegisterOp::Yank, h, o);
    r.Store(U'C', Chars("y "), VimRegisterOp::Yank, h, o);
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'c', h, o) == "x\ny \n");

    r.Store(U'_', Chars("gone"), VimRegisterOp::Delete, h, o);
    CHECK(TextOf(r, 0, h, o) == "x\ny \n");

    r.Store(U'd', Lines("l\n"), VimRegisterOp::SmallDelete, h, o);   // named + linewise: "1 too, unnamed -> "1
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'd', h, o) == "l\n");
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'1', h, o) == "l\n");
}

TEST_CASE("vim registers: + and * are the clipboard; useSystemClipboard aliases the unnamed register", "[text-vim-registers]")
{
    VimRegisters r; FakeVimHost h; VimOptions o;
    r.Store(U'+', Lines("c\n"), VimRegisterOp::Yank, h, o);
    CHECK(h.clipboard == "c\n");
    CHECK(r.Get(U'*', h, o)->kind == VimRegisterKind::Linewise);
    h.clipboard = "other";
    CHECK(r.Get(U'+', h, o)->kind == VimRegisterKind::Charwise);
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'+', h, o) == "other");
    h.clipboard = "line\n";
    CHECK(r.Get(U'+', h, o)->kind == VimRegisterKind::Linewise);

    o.useSystemClipboard = true;
    r.Store(0, Chars("z"), VimRegisterOp::Yank, h, o);
    CHECK(h.clipboard == "z");
    CHECK(TextOf(r, 0, h, o) == "z");
    h.clipboard = "from another app";
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'"', h, o) == "from another app");
}

TEST_CASE("vim registers: % . : / are read-only sources", "[text-vim-registers]")
{
    VimRegisters r; FakeVimHost h; const VimOptions o;
    h.path = "C:/p/notes.md";
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'%', h, o) == "C:/p/notes.md");
    r.Store(U'.', Chars("no"), VimRegisterOp::Yank, h, o);
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'.', h, o) == "<none>");
    r.SetSpecial(U'.', "typed");
    r.SetSpecial(U':', "s/a/b/");
    r.SetSpecial(U'/', "foo");
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'.', h, o) == "typed");
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U':', h, o) == "s/a/b/");
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'/', h, o) == "foo");
    CHECK_FALSE(VimRegisters::IsWritable(U'%'));
    CHECK(VimRegisters::IsWritable(U'5'));
    CHECK(VimRegisters::IsValidName(U'/'));
    CHECK_FALSE(VimRegisters::IsValidName(U'!'));
}

TEST_CASE("vim registers: :reg order is Neovim's and skips empty registers", "[text-vim-registers]")
{
    VimRegisters r; FakeVimHost h; const VimOptions o;
    r.Store(U'b', Chars("B"), VimRegisterOp::Yank, h, o);
    r.Store(0, Chars("Z"), VimRegisterOp::Yank, h, o);
    r.SetSpecial(U'/', "pat");
    h.path.clear();                                                 // no document path: "% is empty
    const auto list = r.List(h, o);
    REQUIRE(list.size() == 4u);                                     // " 0 b /
    CHECK(list[0].first == U'"');
    CHECK(list[1].first == U'0');
    CHECK(list[2].first == U'b');
    CHECK(list[3].first == U'/');
    h.path = "C:/p/x.txt";
    h.clipboard = "clip";
    r.SetSpecial(U'.', "ins");
    r.SetSpecial(U':', "noh");
    r.Store(0, Chars("x"), VimRegisterOp::SmallDelete, h, o);      // "- and the unnamed register
    std::u32string order;
    for (const auto& [name, value] : r.List(h, o)) order.push_back(name);
    CHECK(order == U"\"0b-*+.:%/");                                 // ex_display: " 0-9 a-z - * + . : % /
}

TEST_CASE("vim registers: a multi-cursor yank keeps one part per cursor and a matching put distributes them", "[text-vim-registers]")
{
    VimRig rig("\xCB\x87" "ab\n\xCB\x87" "cd");
    rig.Keys("yl");
    const auto v = rig.Globals().registers.Get(0, rig.host, rig.vim->Options());
    REQUIRE(v.has_value());
    REQUIRE(v->parts.size() == 2u);
    CHECK(v->parts[0] == "a");
    CHECK(v->parts[1] == "c");
    rig.Keys("p");
    CHECK(rig.Marked() == "a\xCB\x87" "ab\nc\xCB\x87" "cd");
}

TEST_CASE("vim registers: a put with a different cursor count gives every cursor the whole text", "[text-vim-registers]")
{
    VimRig rig("\xCB\x87" "x\n\xCB\x87" "y");
    rig.Globals().registers.Store(U'a', VimRegisterValue{ { "1" }, VimRegisterKind::Charwise }, VimRegisterOp::Yank,
                                  rig.host, rig.vim->Options());
    rig.Keys("\"ap");
    CHECK(rig.Marked() == "x\xCB\x87" "1\ny\xCB\x87" "1");
}

TEST_CASE("vim registers: a blockwise put pads short lines and adds missing ones", "[text-vim-registers]")
{
    VimRig rig("a\xCB\x87" "b\nc");
    rig.Globals().registers.Store(U'q', VimRegisterValue{ { "12", "34", "56" }, VimRegisterKind::Blockwise },
                                  VimRegisterOp::Yank, rig.host, rig.vim->Options());
    rig.Keys("\"qp");
    CHECK(rig.Text() == "ab12\nc 34\n  56");
    CHECK(rig.Marked() == "ab\xCB\x87" "12\nc 34\n  56");

    VimRig eol("a\xCB\x87" "b\nc\n");                             // D-R5: a final '\n' ends the last line
    eol.Globals().registers.Store(U'q', VimRegisterValue{ { "12", "34", "56" }, VimRegisterKind::Blockwise },
                                  VimRegisterOp::Yank, eol.host, eol.vim->Options());
    eol.Keys("\"qp");
    CHECK(eol.Text() == "ab12\nc 34\n  56\n");                       // the missing row goes AFTER the final '\n', ending in one
}

TEST_CASE("vim registers: Nothing in register is an error; typed keys after it still run", "[text-vim-registers]")
{
    VimRig rig("\xCB\x87" "ab");
    rig.Keys("\"zpx");                                              // beep_flush drops only non-typed keys (D-R12)
    CHECK(rig.Text() == "b");
    REQUIRE_FALSE(rig.host.messages.empty());
    CHECK(rig.host.messages.back().first == "E353: Nothing in register z");
    CHECK(rig.host.messages.back().second);
}

TEST_CASE("vim registers: the unnamed register's target can be saved and restored", "[text-vim-registers]")
{
    VimRegisters r; FakeVimHost h; const VimOptions o;
    r.Store(0, Chars("kept"), VimRegisterOp::Yank, h, o);
    const char32_t before = r.UnnamedName();
    CHECK(before == U'0');
    r.Store(U'q', Chars("macro"), VimRegisterOp::Yank, h, o);       // a named write moves "" ...
    CHECK(r.UnnamedName() == U'q');
    r.SetUnnamedName(before);                                       // ... and TE5b-5's recording puts it back
    CHECK(TextOf(r, 0, h, o) == "kept");
    CHECK(TextOf(r, U'q', h, o) == "macro");
}
```

```
# TE5b: registers, dot-repeat, macros, marks, jumps, undo (spec s6.3, s11.3).
@nvim v0.12.5
@grammar plain
@set tabstop=4 shiftwidth=4 expandtab

=== yw yanks into "0 and the unnamed register
keys: yw
in: "ˇfoo bar"
out: "ˇfoo bar"
mode: n

reg: " v "foo "

=== dd twice shifts the numbered registers
keys: dddd
in: "ˇa\nb\nc"
out: "ˇc"
mode: n
reg: 1 V "b\n"
reg: 2 V "a\n"
reg: " V "b\n"

=== a small delete goes to "- and the unnamed register
keys: dw
in: "ˇfoo bar"
out: "ˇbar"
mode: n

reg: " v "foo "

=== "A appends charwise onto charwise
keys: "ayiww"Ayiw
in: "ˇfoo bar"
out: "foo ˇbar"
mode: n
reg: a v "foobar"
reg: " v "foobar"

=== "add writes a and "1; "Ayy appends a line
keys: "add"Ayy
in: "ˇx\ny"
out: "ˇy"
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.hpp
#pragma once

// Vim's registers (spec s6.3), Neovim's rules: "0 yank, "1-"9 numbered deletes,
// "- small deletes, a-z / A-Z append, "_ black hole, "+ "* system clipboard,
// "% document path, ". ": "/ read-only. A value keeps one part per cursor after
// a multi-cursor yank (or one per line of a block); Linewise parts end with '\n'.

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimHost.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimOptions.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class VimRegisterKind : std::uint8_t { Charwise, Linewise, Blockwise };

    struct VimRegisterValue
    {
        std::vector<std::string> parts;
        VimRegisterKind kind = VimRegisterKind::Charwise;
        [[nodiscard]] std::string Text() const;   // Linewise: parts concatenated; otherwise joined with '\n'
        bool operator==(const VimRegisterValue&) const = default;
    };

    enum class VimRegisterOp : std::uint8_t { Yank, Delete, SmallDelete };   // Delete = numbered even on one line

    class VimRegisters
    {
    public:
        void Store(char32_t name, VimRegisterValue value, VimRegisterOp op, IVimHost& host, const VimOptions& options);
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<VimRegisterValue> Get(char32_t name, IVimHost& host, const VimOptions& options) const;
        void SetSpecial(char32_t name, std::string text);
        void Preload(char32_t name, VimRegisterValue value);   // kept from TE5a-12: setreg() -- the unnamed pointer stays
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::pair<char32_t, VimRegisterValue>> List(IVimHost& host, const VimOptions& options) const;
        [[nodiscard]] static bool IsValidName(char32_t c);
        [[nodiscard]] static bool IsWritable(char32_t c);
        // The register "" reads. Neovim's do_record saves and restores it around storing a recording (TE5b-5).
        [[nodiscard]] char32_t UnnamedName() const noexcept { return m_unnamed; }
        void SetUnnamedName(char32_t name) noexcept { m_unnamed = name; }

    private:
        void WriteNamed(char32_t name, VimRegisterValue value, IVimHost& host);
        void ShiftNumbered(VimRegisterValue value, bool append);

        std::map<char32_t, VimRegisterValue> m_regs;       // '0'-'9' 'a'-'z' '-' '.' ':' '/'
        char32_t m_unnamed = U'0';                          // the register "" reads
        std::optional<VimRegisterValue> m_clipboardShadow;  // what vim last wrote to + / *
    };

    // The delete/change store (Neovim op_delete): named register if given, then
    // "1 with a shift when the text is linewise / spans lines / forceNumbered,
    // then "- for a one-line charwise delete with no register.
    void StoreDeletedText(VimRegisters& regs, char32_t name, VimRegisterValue value, bool forceNumbered,
                          IVimHost& host, const VimOptions& options);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        // Part by part: Text() joins the parts of a multi-cursor value with '\n', which would make
        // every multi-cursor charwise delete look multi-line (shifting "1, skipping "-).
        bool IsMultiLine(const VimRegisterValue& v)
        {
            if (v.kind == VimRegisterKind::Linewise) return true;
            if (v.kind == VimRegisterKind::Blockwise && v.parts.size() > 1) return true;   // a block over several lines
            for (const std::string& part : v.parts)
                if (part.find('\n') != std::string::npos) return true;
            return false;
        }

        char32_t Lower(char32_t c) { return (c >= U'A' && c <= U'Z') ? c - U'A' + U'a' : c; }

        // The value as lines without their breaks.
        std::vector<std::string> LinesOf(const VimRegisterValue& v)
        {
            if (v.kind == VimRegisterKind::Blockwise) return v.parts;
            std::string t = v.Text();
            if (v.kind == VimRegisterKind::Linewise && !t.empty() && t.back() == '\n') t.pop_back();
            std::vector<std::string> out;
            std::size_t start = 0;
            while (true)
            {
                const std::size_t nl = t.find('\n', start);
                out.push_back(t.substr(start, nl == std::string::npos ? std::string::npos : nl - start));
                if (nl == std::string::npos) break;
                start = nl + 1;
            }
            return out;
        }

        // Neovim yank_register append: a linewise side makes the result linewise
        // (lines appended); a block stays a block (lines appended); charwise onto
        // charwise concatenates the last old line with the first new one.
        VimRegisterValue Append(const VimRegisterValue& old, const VimRegisterValue& add)
        {
            if (add.kind == VimRegisterKind::Linewise || old.kind == VimRegisterKind::Linewise)
            {
                std::string text;
                for (const std::string& l : LinesOf(old)) text += l + "\n";
                for (const std::string& l : LinesOf(add)) text += l + "\n";
                return VimRegisterValue{ { std::move(text) }, VimRegisterKind::Linewise };
            }
            if (old.kind == VimRegisterKind::Blockwise)
            {
                VimRegisterValue out = old;
                for (const std::string& l : LinesOf(add)) out.parts.push_back(l);
                return out;
            }
            return VimRegisterValue{ { old.Text() + add.Text() }, VimRegisterKind::Charwise };
        }

        ARC_CONSTANT("vim behaviour: the numbered delete registers are \"1..\"9 (:h quote_number)")
        constexpr char32_t kLastNumbered = U'9';
    }

    std::string VimRegisterValue::Text() const
    {
        std::string out;
        if (kind == VimRegisterKind::Linewise)
        {
            for (const std::string& p : parts) out += p;
            return out;
        }
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < parts.size(); ++i)
        {
            if (i) out.push_back('\n');
            out += parts[i];
        }
        return out;
    }

    bool VimRegisters::IsValidName(char32_t c)
    {
        if ((c >= U'a' && c <= U'z') || (c >= U'A' && c <= U'Z') || (c >= U'0' && c <= U'9')) return true;
        return c == U'"' || c == U'-' || c == U'_' || c == U'+' || c == U'*' || c == U'/' || c == U':' || c == U'.' || c == U'%';
    }

    bool VimRegisters::IsWritable(char32_t c)
    {
        if ((c >= U'a' && c <= U'z') || (c >= U'A' && c <= U'Z') || (c >= U'0' && c <= U'9')) return true;
        return c == U'"' || c == U'-' || c == U'_' || c == U'+' || c == U'*';
    }

    void VimRegisters::WriteNamed(char32_t name, VimRegisterValue value, IVimHost& host)
    {
        if (name == U'+' || name == U'*')
        {
            host.WriteClipboard(value.Text());
            m_clipboardShadow = std::move(value);
            m_unnamed = U'+';
            return;
        }
        const bool append = name >= U'A' && name <= U'Z';
        const char32_t lower = Lower(name);
        const auto it = m_regs.find(lower);
        if (append && it != m_regs.end()) it->second = Append(it->second, value);
        else m_regs[lower] = std::move(value);
        m_unnamed = lower;
    }

    void VimRegisters::ShiftNumbered(VimRegisterValue value, bool append)
    {
        for (char32_t r = kLastNumbered; r > U'1'; --r)
        {
            const auto prev = m_regs.find(r - 1);
            if (prev != m_regs.end()) m_regs[r] = prev->second;
            else m_regs.erase(r);
        }
        m_regs[U'1'] = std::move(value);
        if (!append) m_unnamed = U'1';
    }

    void VimRegisters::Store(char32_t name, VimRegisterValue value, VimRegisterOp op, IVimHost& host, const VimOptions& options)
    {
        if (name == U'"') name = 0;
        if (name == U'_') return;
        if (name != 0 && !IsWritable(name)) return;                     // E354: % . : / are read-only
        bool smallTarget = name == 0;                                    // "- is written only without a register...
        if (name == 0 && options.useSystemClipboard)
            name = U'+';                                                 // ...or with clipboard=unnamedplus's implied "+
        const bool append = name >= U'A' && name <= U'Z';
        if (op == VimRegisterOp::Yank)
        {
            if (name == 0) { m_regs[U'0'] = std::move(value); m_unnamed = U'0'; }
            else WriteNamed(name, std::move(value), host);
            return;
        }
        const bool multiLine = IsMultiLine(value);
        if (name != 0) WriteNamed(name, value, host);
        if (op == VimRegisterOp::Delete || multiLine) ShiftNumbered(value, append);
        if (smallTarget && !multiLine)
        {
            m_regs[U'-'] = std::move(value);
            if (!options.useSystemClipboard) m_unnamed = U'-';
        }
    }

    std::optional<VimRegisterValue> VimRegisters::Get(char32_t name, IVimHost& host, const VimOptions& options) const
    {
        if (name == 0 || name == U'"') name = options.useSystemClipboard ? U'+' : m_unnamed;
        if (name == U'+' || name == U'*')
        {
            std::string text = host.ReadClipboard();
            if (text.empty()) return std::nullopt;
            if (m_clipboardShadow && m_clipboardShadow->Text() == text) return m_clipboardShadow;
            const VimRegisterKind kind = text.back() == '\n' ? VimRegisterKind::Linewise : VimRegisterKind::Charwise;
            return VimRegisterValue{ { std::move(text) }, kind };
        }
        if (name == U'%')
        {
            std::string path = host.DocumentPath();
            if (path.empty()) return std::nullopt;
            return VimRegisterValue{ { std::move(path) }, VimRegisterKind::Charwise };
        }
        const auto it = m_regs.find(Lower(name));
        if (it == m_regs.end()) return std::nullopt;
        return it->second;
    }

    void VimRegisters::SetSpecial(char32_t name, std::string text)
    {
        if (name == U'.' || name == U':' || name == U'/')
            m_regs[name] = VimRegisterValue{ { std::move(text) }, VimRegisterKind::Charwise };
    }

    void VimRegisters::Preload(char32_t name, VimRegisterValue value)
    {
        if (name >= U'A' && name <= U'Z') name = name - U'A' + U'a';
        m_regs[name] = std::move(value);   // the .vimcases setreg: column and the TE5d-6 restore; "" keeps pointing where it did
    }

    std::vector<std::pair<char32_t, VimRegisterValue>> VimRegisters::List(IVimHost& host, const VimOptions& options) const
    {
        std::vector<char32_t> order{ U'"' };
        for (char32_t c = U'0'; c <= U'9'; ++c) order.push_back(c);
        for (char32_t c = U'a'; c <= U'z'; ++c) order.push_back(c);
        for (const char32_t c : { U'-', U'*', U'+', U'.', U':', U'%', U'/' }) order.push_back(c);   // Neovim ex_display order
        std::vector<std::pair<char32_t, VimRegisterValue>> out;
        for (const char32_t c : order)
            if (const auto v = Get(c, host, options); v && !v->Text().empty()) out.emplace_back(c, *v);
        return out;
    }

    void StoreDeletedText(VimRegisters& regs, char32_t name, VimRegisterValue value, bool forceNumbered,
                          IVimHost& host, const VimOptions& options)
    {
        regs.Store(name, std::move(value), forceNumbered ? VimRegisterOp::Delete : VimRegisterOp::SmallDelete, host, options);
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimPutRegister.cpp
// p P gp gP (spec s6.1 put rules, s6.3 multi-cursor registers): charwise text
// goes after (p) or at (P) the vim cursor and the cursor lands on its last char
// (one line) or its first char (several lines); linewise text goes below/above
// and the cursor lands on the first non-blank; gp/gP leave the cursor after the
// text. With as many cursors as parts, cursor i gets part i.
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        std::size_t LastCharStart(std::string_view s)
        {
            if (s.empty()) return 0;
            std::size_t i = s.size() - 1;
            while (i > 0 && (static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]) & 0xC0) == 0x80) --i;
            return i;
        }

        std::string Repeat(std::string_view s, std::uint32_t n)
        {
            std::string out;
            out.reserve(s.size() * n);
            for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) out += s;
            return out;
        }

        std::uint32_t Width(std::string_view s, std::uint32_t tabSize)
        {
            std::uint32_t col = 0;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i)
            {
                const auto b = static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]);
                if ((b & 0xC0) == 0x80) continue;
                col = b == '\t' ? (col / tabSize + 1) * tabSize : col + 1;
            }
            return col;
        }
    }

    void VimState::PutRegister(const VimParsed& p, bool after, bool cursorAfterText)
    {
        const char32_t name = p.reg == 0 ? U'"' : p.reg;
        const std::optional<VimRegisterValue> v = m_globals.registers.Get(p.reg, m_host, m_options);
        if (!v || v->Text().empty())
        {
            std::string msg = "E353: Nothing in register ";
            Utf8::Append(msg, name);
            Beep(msg);
            return;
        }
        if (v->kind == VimRegisterKind::Blockwise)
        {
            PutBlock(*v, p.Count1(), after, cursorAfterText);
            return;
        }
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        const bool distribute = v->parts.size() > 1 && v->parts.size() == sels.size();
        const bool linewise = v->kind == VimRegisterKind::Linewise;
        const std::uint32_t count = p.Count1();

        struct Pending { std::uint32_t id; std::size_t op; std::size_t cursorInText; };
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::vector<Pending> pending;
        std::uint32_t lastRow = UINT32_MAX;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sels.size(); ++i)
        {
            const std::string piece = distribute ? v->parts[i] : v->Text();
            const ByteOffset head = sels[i].head;
            if (linewise)
            {
                const std::uint32_t row = VimCursorModel::PasteRow(r, head, after);
                if (row == lastRow) continue;                                   // two cursors on one line put once
                lastRow = row;
                std::string text = Repeat(piece, count);
                ByteOffset at = 0;
                std::size_t lineStartInText = 0;
                if (row < r.LineCount()) at = r.LineStart(row);
                else
                {
                    at = r.Size();                                              // below the last line: "\n" + lines
                    if (!text.empty() && text.back() == '\n') text.pop_back();
                    text.insert(text.begin(), '\n');
                    lineStartInText = 1;
                }
                std::size_t cursor = lineStartInText;
                if (cursorAfterText) cursor = text.size();                     // the line after the put lines
                else
                    while (cursor < text.size() && (text[cursor] == ' ' || text[cursor] == '\t')) ++cursor;
                ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ at, at }, std::move(text) });
                pending.push_back(Pending{ sels[i].id, ops.size() - 1, cursor });
            }
            else
            {
                std::string text = Repeat(piece, count);
                const ByteOffset at = VimCursorModel::PasteOffset(r, head, after);
                const bool multiLine = text.find('\n') != std::string::npos;
                const std::size_t cursor = cursorAfterText ? text.size() : (multiLine ? 0 : LastCharStart(text));
                ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ at, at }, std::move(text) });
                pending.push_back(Pending{ sels[i].id, ops.size() - 1, cursor });
            }
        }
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (const Pending& pd : pending)
        {
            const ByteOffset start = VimText::MapThrough(ops[pd.op].range.begin, ops, Bias::Left);
            const ByteOffset caret = start + pd.cursorInText;
            after.push_back(Selection{ pd.id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), std::min(VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc), pending.size() - 1));
        ClampCursors();
    }

    void VimState::PutBlock(const VimRegisterValue& v, std::uint32_t count, bool after, bool cursorAfterText)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        const Selection prim = sels[VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc)];
        const std::uint32_t row0 = VimText::RowOf(r, prim.head);
        const ByteOffset at0 = after ? VimCursorModel::CharEnd(r, prim.head) : prim.head;
        const std::uint32_t col = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, at0, m_options.tabSize);
        std::uint32_t width = 0;
        for (const std::string& part : v.parts) width = std::max(width, Width(part, m_options.tabSize));

        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        std::string tail;                                                       // rows below the last line
        std::size_t firstPad = 0;
        for (std::size_t j = 0; j < v.parts.size(); ++j)
        {
            const std::uint32_t row = row0 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(j);
            const std::string& part = v.parts[j];
            const std::string padded = part + std::string(width - Width(part, m_options.tabSize), ' ');
            if (row < VimText::LineCount(r))                                    // D-R5: never the row after a final '\n'
            {
                const ByteOffset lineEnd = r.LineEnd(row);
                const std::uint32_t lineWidth = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, lineEnd, m_options.tabSize);
                ByteOffset at = lineEnd;
                std::string lead;
                if (lineWidth < col) lead.assign(col - lineWidth, ' ');
                else at = VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, row, col, m_options.tabSize);
                const bool atEnd = at == lineEnd;
                std::string text = lead + Repeat(padded, count - 1) + (atEnd ? part : padded);
                if (j == 0) firstPad = lead.size();
                ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ at, at }, std::move(text) });
            }
            else
                tail += "\n" + std::string(col, ' ') + Repeat(padded, count - 1) + part;
        }
        if (!tail.empty())
        {
            // D-R5: with a final '\n' the new rows go after it, each ending in '\n' ("a\n" -> "a\nrow\n");
            // without one (noeol) they follow the last line, each starting with '\n' ("a" -> "a\nrow").
            if (VimText::EndsWithNewline(r)) tail = tail.substr(1) + "\n";
            if (!ops.empty() && ops.back().range.begin == r.Size()) ops.back().text += tail;
            else ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.Size(), r.Size() }, tail });
        }
        const ByteOffset firstStart = VimText::MapThrough(ops.front().range.begin, ops, Bias::Left) + firstPad;
        const ByteOffset lastEnd = VimText::MapThrough(ops.back().range.begin, ops, Bias::Left) + ops.back().text.size();
        const ByteOffset caret = cursorAfterText ? lastEnd : firstStart;
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), { Selection{ prim.id, caret, caret, std::nullopt } }, 0);
        ClampCursors();
    }
}
```

### Task TE5b-2: Insert-mode `Ctrl-R{reg}`, the insert capture, and the `.` register (spec s6.3 Insert mode / Registers, s6.6)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (InsertSession `serial`; capture members; helpers)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.cpp` (`HandleKey`, `Keyboard`, `OnInputHandled`, new `AfterKey`, `UpdateInsertCapture`, `FinishInsertCapture`, `TypeText`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimInsert.cpp` (`MarkInsertStart`, `HandleInsert`, new `InsertRegister`)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5b.vimcases`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimInsertRegisterTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimRegisters::Get/SetSpecial/IsValidName` (TE5b-1), `InsertNewline`, `CapturedInsertText`, `m_insert` (TE5a-5).
- Produces (used by TE5b-4 / TE5b-6 / TE5b-8 and by Part D's command line Ctrl-R):
  - `struct VimState::InsertCapture { valid; serial; text; deletedBefore; lastStart; lastCaret; startAnchor; caretAnchor; }`, member `m_capture`
  - `void VimState::AfterKey(VimMode before)` -- called after every key `FeedResolved` handled (by `HandleKey`, and by `FeedKeys` from TE5b-4); keeps the capture current while Insert/Replace runs and finishes it on the way back to Normal
  - `void VimState::UpdateInsertCapture()`, `void VimState::FinishInsertCapture()`, `void VimState::TypeText(std::string_view)` (inserts at every cursor as the view's typing path does, then `OnInputHandled`), `void VimState::InsertRegister(char32_t)`
  - `InsertSession::serial` (incremented by `MarkInsertStart`: an arrow key or a click starts a new insert for `.` and undo)

`Ctrl-R {reg}` follows Neovim v0.12 (`:h i_CTRL-R`, news-0.12: "inserts named/clipboard registers literally"). The named and clipboard registers -- `a`-`z`, `A`-`Z`, `0`-`9`, `+` and `*` (one clipboard on Windows) -- are inserted **literally**, like pasting: the text goes in as it is, line breaks included, with no autoindent. Every other register (`"`, `-`, `.`, `:`, `/`, `%`) is inserted **as typed**: a line break goes through `InsertNewline`, so autoindent applies, and a linewise register ends on a fresh line. (`Ctrl-R Ctrl-R` / `Ctrl-R Ctrl-O` / `Ctrl-R Ctrl-P` are not in v1.) While vim waits for the register name the keyboard is in command mode (dead keys bare, Latin letters, no IME: on US-International `"` is a dead key). An empty register inserts nothing and does not beep (vim's `vim_beep`, which never flushes typeahead). The capture is the net text typed between the session start and the primary caret; the view types it, so the capture updates in `OnInputHandled` as well as after each key.
