```cpp
        struct InsertSession
        {
            bool          open = false;              // a buffer transaction is open
            VimActionId   entry = VimActionId::InsertBefore;
            std::uint32_t count = 1;
            AnchorSet::Id start = 0;                      // the primary cursor's session start (Left bias)
            bool          hasStart = false;
            bool          autoIndentPending = false; // o/O/Enter inserted an indent nothing has been typed after
            bool          typed = false;             // OnInputHandled seen this session
            std::uint64_t serial = 0;                // bumped by MarkInsertStart: arrows and clicks start a new insert
        };

        // The net text of the running insert (spec s6.3 Repeat: "recorded commands + inserted text").
        struct InsertCapture
        {
            bool          valid = false;
            std::uint64_t serial = 0;                // the InsertSession::serial it belongs to
            std::string   text;                      // session start .. primary caret
            std::uint32_t deletedBefore = 0;         // bytes Backspace removed before the session start
            ByteOffset    lastStart = 0, lastCaret = 0;
            AnchorSet::Id startAnchor = 0;                // Left bias: '[ of the insert (TE5b-6)
            AnchorSet::Id caretAnchor = 0;                // Right bias: '^ of the insert (TE5b-6)
        };

        void AfterKey(VimMode before);
        void UpdateInsertCapture();
        void FinishInsertCapture();
        void TypeText(std::string_view utf8);
        void InsertRegister(char32_t name);

        InsertCapture     m_capture;
        bool              m_awaitingInsertRegister = false;
```

`VimState.cpp` -- `HandleKey`, `Keyboard` and `OnInputHandled` become, and the four new functions are added:

```cpp
    VimKeyResult VimState::HandleKey(const VimKey& key, double nowSeconds)
    {
        m_now = nowSeconds;
        VimText::SyncDisplay(m_doc);             // first: the folds' rows after any edit made outside vim (j/k, H/M/L read the display)
        const VimMode before = m_mode;
        VimKeyResult r = FeedResolved(key);
        AfterKey(before);
        ScrollToCursor();                        // TE5a-11: stays; later tasks only patch around FeedResolved
        r.beeped = std::exchange(m_beeped, false);
        ApplyModeHooks();
        return r;
    }

    VimKeyboardState VimState::Keyboard() const
    {
        // D-R15: Insert Ctrl-R waits for a register NAME -- command mode ON, Latin letters, no IME (spec s5.5).
        if (m_mode == VimMode::Insert && m_awaitingInsertRegister) return VimKeyboardState{ true, true, false };
        switch (Mode())
        {
        case VimMode::Insert:
        case VimMode::Replace:
        case VimMode::CommandLine:
            return VimKeyboardState{ false, false, true };
        default:
            // TE5a-5's rule, unchanged (D-R15): a LITERAL argument (f t F T r) turns command mode off so a
            // dead key composes; a NAME argument (m ' ` " q @) keeps it on.
            if (m_parser.AwaitingLiteral()) return VimKeyboardState{ false, false, false };
            return VimKeyboardState{ true, true, false };
        }
    }

    void VimState::OnInputHandled(std::string_view text)
    {
        if (text.empty()) return;
        if (m_insert.resume) ResumeInsertSession();   // TE5a-5 (5a.7): an interrupted session reopens before the text counts
        m_insert.autoIndentPending = false;
        m_insert.typed = true;
        if (m_mode == VimMode::Insert || m_mode == VimMode::Replace) UpdateInsertCapture();
    }

    void VimState::AfterKey(VimMode before)
    {
        const auto textMode = [](VimMode m) { return m == VimMode::Insert || m == VimMode::Replace; };
        if (textMode(m_mode)) UpdateInsertCapture();
        else if (textMode(before)) FinishInsertCapture();
    }

    void VimState::UpdateInsertCapture()
    {
        if (!m_insert.hasStart) return;
        const ByteOffset start = m_anchors.Get(m_insert.start).offset;
        const ByteOffset caret = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].head;
        if (!m_capture.valid || m_capture.serial != m_insert.serial)
        {
            if (m_capture.valid)
            {
                m_anchors.Remove(m_capture.startAnchor);
                m_anchors.Remove(m_capture.caretAnchor);
            }
            m_capture = InsertCapture{};
            m_capture.valid = true;
            m_capture.serial = m_insert.serial;
            m_capture.startAnchor = m_anchors.Add(Anchor{ start, Bias::Left });
            m_capture.caretAnchor = m_anchors.Add(Anchor{ caret, Bias::Right });
        }
        else if (start < m_capture.lastStart && m_capture.lastCaret <= m_capture.lastStart)
            m_capture.deletedBefore += static_cast<std::uint32_t>(m_capture.lastStart - start);   // Backspace past the start
        m_capture.text = CapturedInsertText();
        m_capture.lastStart = start;
        m_capture.lastCaret = caret;
        m_anchors.Set(m_capture.startAnchor, Anchor{ start, Bias::Left });
        m_anchors.Set(m_capture.caretAnchor, Anchor{ caret, Bias::Right });
    }

    void VimState::FinishInsertCapture()
    {
        if (!m_capture.valid) return;
        if (!m_capture.text.empty()) m_globals.registers.SetSpecial(U'.', m_capture.text);
        m_anchors.Remove(m_capture.startAnchor);
        m_anchors.Remove(m_capture.caretAnchor);
        m_capture.valid = false;
    }

    void VimState::TypeText(std::string_view utf8)
    {
        if (utf8.empty()) return;
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ std::min(s.anchor, s.head), std::max(s.anchor, s.head) }, std::string(utf8) });
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sels.size(); ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = VimText::MapThrough(ops[i].range.end, ops, Bias::Right);
            after.push_back(Selection{ sels[i].id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        OnInputHandled(utf8);
    }
```

`VimInsert.cpp` -- `MarkInsertStart` bumps the serial, `HandleInsert` gains the Ctrl-R handling at its top, and `InsertRegister` is added:

```cpp
    void VimState::MarkInsertStart()
    {
        if (m_insert.hasStart) m_anchors.Remove(m_insert.start);
        const auto all = m_doc.selections.All();
        m_insert.start = m_anchors.Add(Anchor{ all[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].head, Bias::Left });
        m_insert.hasStart = true;
        ++m_insert.serial;
    }
```

```cpp
    void VimState::InsertRegister(char32_t name)
    {
        if (!VimRegisters::IsValidName(name)) return;
        const std::optional<VimRegisterValue> v = m_globals.registers.Get(name, m_host, m_options);
        if (!v) return;                                // an empty register inserts nothing (vim_beep: no flush)
        const std::string text = v->Text();
        const bool literal = (name >= U'a' && name <= U'z') || (name >= U'A' && name <= U'Z')
                          || (name >= U'0' && name <= U'9') || name == U'+' || name == U'*';
        if (literal)
        {
            TypeText(text);                            // Neovim v0.12: named / clipboard registers paste as they are
            return;
        }
        std::size_t pos = 0;
        while (true)
        {
            const std::size_t nl = text.find('\n', pos);
            TypeText(std::string_view(text).substr(pos, nl == std::string::npos ? std::string::npos : nl - pos));
            if (nl == std::string::npos) break;
            InsertNewline();                           // typed: autoindent applies, as in vim
            pos = nl + 1;
        }
    }
```

### Task TE5b-3: `u` / `Ctrl-R` with vim's undo cursor rule; one insert session = one undo step (spec s6.3 Undo, s3.3)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimUndo.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (public `UndoCommand`, `RedoCommand`; private `UndoRedo`, `PlaceCursorAfterUndo`, `struct RedoCursor`, `m_redoCursors`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimActions.cpp` (cases `Undo`, `Redo`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimInsert.cpp` (`StartInsert`: the cursor moves before the session opens; `HandleInsertCtrl`'s Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y cases and the removal of `InsertUndoRedo`, TE5a-20)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5b.vimcases`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimUndoTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the `TextCommands` class's `Undo()` / `Redo()` (bool; TE1-14 -- built as `TextCommands(m_doc.buffer, m_doc.selections, m_doc.context ? *m_doc.context : EditContext{})`, never `TextBuffer::Undo(sels)` directly), `TextBuffer::Version/EditsSince/ChangeId/CanRedo`, `EditLogEntry` (TE1-8), `Rope::OffsetToPoint`, `VimText::LastRow` (TE5a-2, D-R5), `ExitVisual` (TE5a-12), `EndInsertSession/BeginInsertSession/MarkInsertStart` (TE5a-5).
- Produces: `void VimState::UndoCommand(std::uint32_t count)`, `void VimState::RedoCommand(std::uint32_t count)` (public; also what Insert Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y and Visual Ctrl+R call); private `struct RedoCursor { changeId; at; id; }`, `std::vector<RedoCursor> m_redoCursors` (vim's `uh_cursor` for redo, finding 5b.2).

Vim's rule (`undo.c u_undoredo`): the cursor goes to the first changed line; when the cursor saved before the change lies inside the changed block (or one line around it) the cursor returns to exactly that position; otherwise, after the "off by one line" correction (undoing `o` returns to the line it was typed from), the column is the saved one when the rows match, else the line's first non-blank with `startofline`, or the remembered column (`curswant`) with Neovim's default `nostartofline`. TE1's undo entry (reached through `TextCommands::Undo()`) restores `selectionsBefore`, which is vim's saved cursor -- provided the cursor is where the first change is made, which is why `StartInsert` now moves the cursor before it opens the session (vim saves the undo cursor after `A` has moved it). With several cursors the restored cursors are the answer (spec s3.3: undo restores the cursors). **Redo uses the same rule with the same saved cursor** (vim's `uh_cursor`, the cursor before the change), not the cursor the change left: so `ddu<C-r>` lands where the `dd` began, in that column. TE1's `Redo()` restores the entry's `after` selections and TE1 has no accessor for the entry's `before`, so vim keeps its own small stack: each `u` pushes the cursors it restored (the change's `before`) tagged with the buffer's `ChangeId()` after the undo; `Ctrl-R` pops the top entry when its tag equals the current `ChangeId()` (nothing changed the buffer since that undo -- a new edit clears TE1's redo stack and makes every tag stale) and applies vim's rule from it. With several cursors, or without a matching entry (an undo the view ran), TE1's `after` selections stand. Nothing left to undo is a beep plus the message "Already at oldest change" (not an error), as in Neovim; the beep stops a macro, `:normal` or a mapping, and typed keys after it still run (D-R12: Neovim's `beep_flush` flushes only non-typed input).

```cpp
    REQUIRE_FALSE(r.host.messages.empty());
    CHECK(r.host.messages.back().first == "Already at oldest change");
    CHECK_FALSE(r.host.messages.back().second);
}

TEST_CASE("vim undo: Ctrl-R places the cursor from the cursor saved before the change", "[text-vim-undo]")
{
    VimRig r("ab\nc\xCB\x87" "d\nef");

    CHECK(r.Marked() == "ab\nc\xCB\x87" "d\nef");
    r.Keys("<C-r>");

    VimRig stale("\xCB\x87" "abc");

    stale.Keys("u<C-r>");                                          // vim's stack still pairs each u with its Ctrl-R
    CHECK(stale.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "bc");
}

    CHECK(r.Text().empty());
    r.Keys("c<Esc>");
    CHECK(r.Text() == "c");
    r.Keys("u");

TEST_CASE("vim undo: Ctrl-R in Visual redoes and leaves Visual", "[text-vim-undo]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "abc");
    r.Keys("xuv<C-r>");
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Normal);
    CHECK(r.Text() == "bc");
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimUndo.cpp
// u / Ctrl-R (spec s6.3): TextBuffer's history (one insert session = one entry)
// with vim's undo cursor rule (undo.c u_undoredo).
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/TextCommands.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>
#include <optional>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    void VimState::UndoCommand(std::uint32_t count) { UndoRedo(true, count); }
    void VimState::RedoCommand(std::uint32_t count) { UndoRedo(false, count); }

    void VimState::UndoRedo(bool undo, std::uint32_t count)
    {
        const bool inInsert = m_insert.open;
        if (inInsert) EndInsertSession();                      // never undo inside an open transaction
        if (IsVisual(m_mode)) ExitVisual();
        if (!m_doc.buffer.CanRedo()) m_redoCursors.clear();    // a new change dropped every redo entry
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < std::max(1u, count); ++i)
        {
            const Rope& before = m_doc.buffer.Text();
            const Selection cur = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()];
            const std::uint32_t curswant = cur.goalColumn.value_or(VimText::VirtualColumn(before, cur.head, m_options.tabSize));
            const std::uint64_t version = m_doc.buffer.Version();
            std::optional<RedoCursor> saved;                   // Ctrl-R: vim's uh_cursor of the change being redone
            if (!undo && !m_redoCursors.empty() && m_redoCursors.back().changeId == m_doc.buffer.ChangeId())
            {
                saved = m_redoCursors.back();
                m_redoCursors.pop_back();
            }
            TextCommands commands(m_doc.buffer, m_doc.selections, m_doc.context ? *m_doc.context : EditContext{});
            const bool ok = undo ? commands.Undo() : commands.Redo();   // TE1-14: restores the entry's selections
            if (!ok)
            {
                m_parser.Reset();
                m_beeped = true;                               // beep: a macro / :normal / mapping stops; typed keys go on
                if (i == 0) m_host.ShowMessage(undo ? "Already at oldest change" : "Already at newest change", false);
                break;
            }
            if (undo && m_doc.selections.All().size() == 1)
            {
                const Selection restored = m_doc.selections.All()[0];   // the change's `before`: vim's uh_cursor
                m_redoCursors.push_back(RedoCursor{ m_doc.buffer.ChangeId(), m_doc.buffer.Text().OffsetToPoint(restored.head), restored.id });
            }
            if (saved && m_doc.selections.All().size() == 1)
            {
                const Rope& now = m_doc.buffer.Text();
                const std::uint32_t row = std::min(saved->at.row, VimText::LastRow(now));
                const ByteOffset at = std::min<ByteOffset>(now.LineStart(row) + saved->at.col, now.LineEnd(row));
                VimText::Select(m_doc, { Selection{ saved->id, at, at, std::nullopt } }, 0);   // redo: from the saved cursor
            }
            if (!inInsert) PlaceCursorAfterUndo(version, curswant);
        }
        if (inInsert)
        {
            BeginInsertSession(VimActionId::InsertBefore, 1);
            MarkInsertStart();
        }
    }

    void VimState::PlaceCursorAfterUndo(std::uint64_t versionBefore, std::uint32_t curswant)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const std::span<const EditLogEntry> edits = m_doc.buffer.EditsSince(versionBefore);
        std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        if (edits.empty() || sels.size() != 1)
        {
            ClampCursors();
            return;
        }
        std::uint32_t top = std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max(), bottom = 0;
        for (const EditLogEntry& e : edits)
        {
            top = std::min(top, e.firstRow);
            const std::int64_t last = static_cast<std::int64_t>(e.lastRowBefore) + e.rowDelta;
            bottom = std::max(bottom, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::max<std::int64_t>(last, e.firstRow)));
        }
        top = std::min(top, VimText::LastRow(r));                 // D-R5: never the row after a final line break
        const Selection saved = sels.front();
        const std::uint32_t savedRow = VimText::RowOf(r, saved.head);
        ByteOffset target = saved.head;
        if (!(savedRow + 1 >= top && savedRow <= bottom + 1))   // the saved cursor is outside the changed block
        {
            std::uint32_t row = top;
            if (savedRow + 1 == row && row > 0) --row;           // undoing `o`: back to the line it was typed from
            if (row != savedRow)
            {
                if (m_options.startofline) target = VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, row);
                else if (curswant == VimText::kGoalEol) target = r.LineEnd(row);
                else target = VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, row, curswant, m_options.tabSize);
            }
        }
        target = VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, target);
        VimText::Select(m_doc, { Selection{ saved.id, target, target, std::nullopt } }, 0);
    }
}
```

```cpp
    void VimState::StartInsert(InsertEntry entry, const VimParsed& p)
    {
        // The cursor moves first: vim saves the undo cursor at the first change,
        // so `u` after `A` returns to the line end, after `i` to where Insert began.
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        for (Selection& s : sels)
        {
            s.anchor = s.head = VimCursorModel::EnterInsert(r, s.head, entry);
            s.goalColumn.reset();
        }
        VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
        BeginInsertSession(p.Id<VimActionId>(), p.Count1());
        MarkInsertStart();
        m_mode = VimMode::Insert;
    }
```

- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (public `FeedKeys`; private `struct QueuedKey`, `FeedOne`, `DrainTypeahead`, `ExecuteAndRecord`, `RepeatLastChange`, `CaptureVisualExtent`, `DeleteBeforeCarets`; members `m_pendingChange`, `m_replaying`, `m_typeahead`, `m_draining`, `m_keyDepth`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.cpp` (`HandleNormalOrVisual`'s Complete branch, `FinishInsertCapture`, new functions)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimActions.cpp` (case `RepeatChange`)

- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimRepeatTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimParsed`, `Execute` (TE5a-5 + passes), `m_capture` / `AfterKey` / `TypeText` (TE5b-2), `m_block` (TE5a-18), `ToVim` (TE5a-5).
- Produces:
  - `struct VimRepeatRecord { VimParsed parsed; bool insert; std::string insertedText; std::uint32_t deletedBefore; VimMode visualMode; std::uint32_t visualLines, visualChars, visualEndVcol, visualWidth; }`, `bool IsRepeatableChange(const VimParsed&)`, `std::vector<VimKey> VisualReplayKeys(const VimRepeatRecord&)` (VimRepeat.hpp)
  - `VimGlobals::lastChange` (`std::optional<VimRepeatRecord>`)
  - `VimKeyResult VimState::FeedKeys(std::span<const VimKey> keys, bool remap)` (public; the typeahead executor macros, `:normal`, `.` and remaps use: the keys always go to the FRONT of the one typeahead queue, in order, as vim's `ins_typebuf` -- so keys a macro queues while a mapping or another macro is running run before the rest of that mapping; a beep empties the queue and is reported to the outer `HandleKey`; an unhandled printable key in Insert is typed through `TypeText`). `remap` is stored on each queued key; TE5d-3's trie honours it, until then every key is fed as resolved.
  - `struct VimState::QueuedKey { VimKey key; bool remap = true; std::uint32_t depth = 0; }` and the ONE queue `std::deque<QueuedKey> m_typeahead` (private) -- TE5d-3 reuses both and never declares its own (finding 5d.1).
  - `VimKeyResult VimState::FeedOne(const VimKey& key, bool viewMayType = false)` (private: `FeedResolved`, then -- unless the view will type the key itself -- an unhandled printable Insert key typed through `TypeText`, then `AfterKey`; every key a mapping, macro or replay produces goes through it, so `.` and the insert capture see mapped changes too), `VimKeyResult VimState::DrainTypeahead()` (private; TE5d-3 replaces it with the trie-aware `DrainTypeahead(bool userKey)`).

What `.` repeats (vim's redo buffer): the last command that changed text -- an operator other than `y` and `zf`, or one of `i a I gI A o O gi x X D C s S p P gp gP J gJ ~ r R Ctrl-A Ctrl-X` and the Visual `I A X D C S R` -- with its count and register, plus the text typed in the insert session it opened (the net text, and the bytes Backspace removed before the session start). A new count replaces the old one and is remembered; `"1p` repeated takes `"2p`, `"3p`, ... (vim's numbered-register rule). A Visual change repeats on the same amount of text from the cursor (same mode, same number of lines; one-line charwise: the same number of characters; several lines: the same end column; block: the same width). After an arrow key in Insert, the redo is "insert the text typed since" (vim resets the redo buffer to `1i`).

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRepeat.hpp
#pragma once

// Dot-repeat (spec s6.3): the last change as the parsed command plus the text
// its insert session typed (vim's redo buffer, as a structure instead of keys).

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCommand.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimRepeatRecord
    {
        VimParsed     parsed;                      // count, register, operator, target / action
        bool          insert = false;              // the command opened Insert or Replace
        std::string   insertedText;                // the net text typed in that session
        std::uint32_t deletedBefore = 0;           // bytes Backspace removed before the session start
        VimMode       visualMode = VimMode::Normal;   // Normal: not a Visual change
        std::uint32_t visualLines = 1;             // Visual: rows spanned
        std::uint32_t visualChars = 1;             // Visual, one line: characters selected
        std::uint32_t visualEndVcol = 0;           // Visual, several lines: the end column
        std::uint32_t visualWidth = 1;             // VisualBlock: columns
    };

    [[nodiscard]] bool IsRepeatableChange(const VimParsed& p);
    // The keys that re-create the Visual area from the cursor: v / V / Ctrl-V + moves.
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<VimKey> VisualReplayKeys(const VimRepeatRecord& r);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRepeat.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRepeat.hpp"

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        void AppendCount(std::vector<VimKey>& keys, std::uint32_t n)
        {
            for (const char c : std::to_string(n)) keys.push_back(VimKey::Char(static_cast<char32_t>(c)));
        }
    }

    bool IsRepeatableChange(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        if (p.op) return *p.op != VimOperatorId::Yank && *p.op != VimOperatorId::Fold;
        if (p.kind != VimCmdKind::Action) return false;
        switch (p.Id<VimActionId>())
        {
        case VimActionId::InsertBefore: case VimActionId::Append: case VimActionId::InsertFirstNonBlank:
        case VimActionId::InsertColumnZero: case VimActionId::AppendLineEnd: case VimActionId::OpenBelow:
        case VimActionId::OpenAbove: case VimActionId::InsertAtLastInsert:
        case VimActionId::DeleteChar: case VimActionId::DeleteCharBack: case VimActionId::DeleteToEol:
        case VimActionId::ChangeToEol: case VimActionId::SubstituteChar: case VimActionId::SubstituteLine:
        case VimActionId::PutAfter: case VimActionId::PutBefore: case VimActionId::PutAfterMoveCursor:
        case VimActionId::PutBeforeMoveCursor: case VimActionId::JoinLines: case VimActionId::JoinLinesNoSpace:
        case VimActionId::ToggleCaseChar: case VimActionId::Increment: case VimActionId::Decrement:
        case VimActionId::ReplaceChar: case VimActionId::ReplaceMode:
        case VimActionId::VisualInsert: case VimActionId::VisualAppend: case VimActionId::VisualDeleteLines:
        case VimActionId::VisualChangeLines:
            return true;
        default:
            return false;
        }
    }

    std::vector<VimKey> VisualReplayKeys(const VimRepeatRecord& r)
    {
        std::vector<VimKey> keys;
        keys.push_back(r.visualMode == VimMode::VisualLine ? VimKey::Char(U'V')
                       : r.visualMode == VimMode::VisualBlock ? VimKey::Ctrl(U'v') : VimKey::Char(U'v'));
        if (r.visualLines > 1) { AppendCount(keys, r.visualLines - 1); keys.push_back(VimKey::Char(U'j')); }
        if (r.visualMode == VimMode::Visual)
        {
            if (r.visualLines > 1) { AppendCount(keys, r.visualEndVcol + 1); keys.push_back(VimKey::Char(U'|')); }
            else if (r.visualChars > 1) { AppendCount(keys, r.visualChars - 1); keys.push_back(VimKey::Char(U'l')); }
        }
        else if (r.visualMode == VimMode::VisualBlock && r.visualWidth > 1)
        {
            AppendCount(keys, r.visualWidth - 1);
            keys.push_back(VimKey::Char(U'l'));
        }
        return keys;
    }
}
```

```cpp
    // One key a macro, :normal, . or a mapping produced (or one the trie held): the view never
    // sees it, so vim types an unhandled printable Insert key itself; AfterKey keeps the insert
    // capture (and so `.` and the `.` register) current per key, exactly as HandleKey does.
    VimKeyResult VimState::FeedOne(const VimKey& key, bool viewMayType)
    {
        const VimMode before = m_mode;
        VimKeyResult r = FeedResolved(key);
        if (!r.handled && !viewMayType && key.IsChar() && m_mode == VimMode::Insert)
        {
            std::string utf8;                          // no view in a replay: vim types it
            Utf8::Append(utf8, key.ch);
            TypeText(utf8);
            r.handled = true;
        }
        AfterKey(before);
        return r;
    }

    VimKeyResult VimState::FeedKeys(std::span<const VimKey> keys, bool remap)
    {
        // vim's ins_typebuf: the new keys go in FRONT of whatever is queued, in order.
        std::vector<QueuedKey> queued;
        queued.reserve(keys.size());
        for (const VimKey& k : keys) queued.push_back(QueuedKey{ k, remap, 0 });
        m_typeahead.insert(m_typeahead.begin(), queued.begin(), queued.end());
        if (m_draining) return {};                     // the running drain loop reaches them next
        const VimKeyResult last = DrainTypeahead();
        if (m_keyDepth == 0)                           // called outside HandleKey: settle here
        {
            m_beeped = false;
            ApplyModeHooks();
        }
        return last;
    }

    VimKeyResult VimState::DrainTypeahead()
    {
        m_draining = true;
        VimKeyResult last;
        while (!m_typeahead.empty())
        {
            const QueuedKey q = m_typeahead.front();
            m_typeahead.pop_front();
            last = FeedOne(q.key);                     // TE5d-3 sends q.remap keys through the trie first
            if (m_beeped)
            {
                m_typeahead.clear();                   // beep_flush: the non-typed queue goes; m_beeped stays for HandleKey
                last.beeped = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        m_draining = false;
        return last;
    }

    void VimState::ExecuteAndRecord(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        if (m_replaying || !IsRepeatableChange(p))
        {
            Execute(p);
            return;
        }
        VimRepeatRecord rec;
        rec.parsed = p;
        if (IsVisual(m_mode)) CaptureVisualExtent(rec);
        const std::uint64_t changeBefore = m_doc.buffer.ChangeId();
        Execute(p);
        if (m_beeped) return;
        if (m_mode == VimMode::Insert || m_mode == VimMode::Replace)
        {
            rec.insert = true;
            m_pendingChange = std::move(rec);          // finished by FinishInsertCapture
            return;
        }
        if (m_doc.buffer.ChangeId() != changeBefore) m_globals.lastChange = std::move(rec);
    }

    void VimState::CaptureVisualExtent(VimRepeatRecord& rec) const
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        rec.visualMode = m_mode;
        if (m_mode == VimMode::VisualBlock)
        {
            rec.visualLines = (m_block.headRow > m_block.anchorRow ? m_block.headRow - m_block.anchorRow
                                                                   : m_block.anchorRow - m_block.headRow) + 1;
            rec.visualWidth = (m_block.headVcol > m_block.anchorVcol ? m_block.headVcol - m_block.anchorVcol
                                                                     : m_block.anchorVcol - m_block.headVcol) + 1;
            return;
        }
        const VimCursor c = ToVim(m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()]);
        const ByteOffset lo = std::min(c.anchor, c.head), hi = std::max(c.anchor, c.head);
        rec.visualLines = VimText::RowOf(r, hi) - VimText::RowOf(r, lo) + 1;
        if (rec.visualLines == 1)
        {
            std::uint32_t n = 1;
            for (ByteOffset o = lo; o < hi; o = VimText::NextChar(r, o)) ++n;
            rec.visualChars = n;
        }
        else
            rec.visualEndVcol = VimText::VirtualColumn(r, hi, m_options.tabSize);
    }

    void VimState::DeleteBeforeCarets(std::uint32_t bytes)
    {
        const std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        std::vector<EditOp> ops;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset from = s.head > bytes ? s.head - bytes : 0;
            if (!ops.empty() && from < ops.back().range.end) continue;
            ops.push_back(EditOp{ ByteRange{ from, s.head }, "" });
        }
        std::vector<Selection> after;
        for (const Selection& s : sels)
        {
            const ByteOffset caret = VimText::MapThrough(s.head, ops, Bias::Left);
            after.push_back(Selection{ s.id, caret, caret, std::nullopt });
        }
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, std::move(ops), std::move(after), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }

    void VimState::RepeatLastChange(std::uint32_t count)
    {
        if (!m_globals.lastChange) { Beep(); return; }
        VimRepeatRecord& stored = *m_globals.lastChange;
        if (count != 0 && stored.visualMode == VimMode::Normal) stored.parsed.count = count;   // replaces, and is kept
        const bool put = stored.parsed.Has(VimActionId::PutAfter) || stored.parsed.Has(VimActionId::PutBefore)
                      || stored.parsed.Has(VimActionId::PutAfterMoveCursor) || stored.parsed.Has(VimActionId::PutBeforeMoveCursor);
        if (put && stored.parsed.reg >= U'1' && stored.parsed.reg < U'9') ++stored.parsed.reg;   // "1p. -> "2p
        const VimRepeatRecord rec = stored;
        m_replaying = true;
        if (rec.visualMode != VimMode::Normal)
            for (const VimKey& k : VisualReplayKeys(rec)) FeedOne(k);
        if (!m_beeped) Execute(rec.parsed);
        if (!m_beeped && rec.insert && (m_mode == VimMode::Insert || m_mode == VimMode::Replace))
        {
            if (rec.deletedBefore != 0) DeleteBeforeCarets(rec.deletedBefore);
            if (m_mode == VimMode::Insert) TypeText(rec.insertedText);
            else
            {
                std::size_t i = 0;                     // Replace: overtype one character at a time
                while (i < rec.insertedText.size())
                {
                    const Utf8::Unit d = Utf8::DecodeAt(rec.insertedText, i);
                    FeedOne(d.cp == U'\n' ? VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Enter) : VimKey::Char(d.valid ? d.cp : U'�'));
                    i += d.length == 0 ? 1 : d.length;
                }
            }
            FeedOne(VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Esc));
        }
        m_replaying = false;
    }
```

### Task TE5b-5: Macros -- `q{reg}`, `@{reg}`, `@@`, `@:`, `Q` (spec s6.3 Repeat)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimMacros.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimGlobals.hpp` (`lastMacro`, `lastRecorded`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (public `RecordingRegister`; private `StartRecording`, `StopRecording`, `RunMacro`; members `m_recording`, `m_recorded`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.cpp` (`HandleKey` records typed keys; `HandleNormalOrVisual` stops a recording on `q`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimActions.cpp` (cases `RecordMacro`, `RunMacro`, `RunLastRecorded`)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5b.vimcases`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimMacroTest.cpp`

**Lane (D-R11 X2):** lane L7 (pure vim library). The status strip's `recording @q` text, an edit of TE5a-22's `View/VimViewAdapter.cpp`, is TE5b-5a's (serial, after TE5a-22).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `FeedKeys` and the one typeahead queue (TE5b-4), `VimRegisters::Store/Get/IsValidName/UnnamedName/SetUnnamedName/Preload` (TE5b-1), `FormatKeys/ParseKeys` (TE5a-1), `Utf8::DecodeAt` (TE1-1).
- Produces: `std::optional<char32_t> VimState::RecordingRegister() const` (TE5b-5a shows it in the status strip); `VimGlobals::lastMacro`, `VimGlobals::lastRecorded` (char32_t, 0 = none).

A macro is **key text stored in the register** (spec s6.3): `q{reg}` records the keys as typed -- before remapping, as vim does -- and stores `FormatKeys(keys)` charwise in the register through `VimRegisters::Store`. Storing the recording does **not** move the unnamed register: Neovim's `do_record` saves `y_previous` before `stuff_yank` and restores it after, so `qaxqp` puts what `x` deleted, not the macro (D-R12, oracle case "a recording leaves the unnamed register alone"); vim does the same through `UnnamedName()` / `SetUnnamedName()`. `"ap` pastes the macro for editing and `@a` runs whatever the register holds, parsed with `ParseKeys`. Running a macro hands its keys to `FeedKeys`, which puts them in front of the typeahead queue -- a macro that calls itself (`@a` inside `a`) queues instead of recursing, and stops at the first beep (a failed motion): vim's `beep_flush` empties the non-typed queue, which ends a recursive macro, while keys the user types afterwards still run. **Documented divergence:** the stored text is Arcane key notation, so a pasted macro shows `<Esc>` where Neovim shows the raw `^[` byte; replaying either is identical. A line break inside register text runs as `<CR>` (vim runs a linewise register's line ends as `<NL>`).

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimMacros.cpp
// q{reg} / @{reg} / @@ / @: / Q (spec s6.3): macros are key text in registers.
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    void VimState::StartRecording(char32_t name)
    {
        const bool ok = (name >= U'a' && name <= U'z') || (name >= U'A' && name <= U'Z')
                     || (name >= U'0' && name <= U'9') || name == U'"';
        if (!ok) { Beep(); return; }
        m_recording = name;
        m_recorded.clear();
    }

    void VimState::StopRecording()
    {
        if (!m_recording) return;
        if (!m_recorded.empty()) m_recorded.pop_back();          // the q that stopped it
        const char32_t name = *m_recording;
        m_recording.reset();
        VimRegisterValue value{ { FormatKeys(m_recorded) }, VimRegisterKind::Charwise };
        m_recorded.clear();
        const char32_t unnamed = m_globals.registers.UnnamedName();   // Neovim do_record: save y_previous ...
        m_globals.registers.Store(name == U'"' ? 0 : name, std::move(value), VimRegisterOp::Yank, m_host, m_options);
        m_globals.registers.SetUnnamedName(unnamed);                  // ... and restore it after stuff_yank
        m_globals.lastRecorded = (name >= U'A' && name <= U'Z') ? name - U'A' + U'a' : name;
    }

    void VimState::RunMacro(char32_t name, std::uint32_t count)
    {
        char32_t reg = name;
        if (reg == U'@')
        {
            reg = m_globals.lastMacro;
            if (reg == 0) { Beep("E748: No previously used register"); return; }
        }
        std::vector<VimKey> keys;
        if (reg == U':')
        {
            const std::optional<VimRegisterValue> cmd = m_globals.registers.Get(U':', m_host, m_options);
            if (!cmd || cmd->Text().empty()) { Beep("E30: No previous command line"); return; }
            const std::string text = cmd->Text();
            keys.push_back(VimKey::Char(U':'));
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < text.size();)
            {
                const Utf8::Unit d = Utf8::DecodeAt(text, i);
                keys.push_back(VimKey::Char(d.valid ? d.cp : U'�'));
                i += d.length == 0 ? 1 : d.length;
            }
            keys.push_back(VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Enter));
        }
        else
        {
            if (!VimRegisters::IsValidName(reg)) { Beep(); return; }
            const std::optional<VimRegisterValue> v = m_globals.registers.Get(reg, m_host, m_options);
            if (!v || v->Text().empty()) { Beep(); return; }
            const auto parsed = ParseKeys(v->Text(), m_options.leader);
            if (!parsed) { Beep(); return; }
            for (const VimKey& k : *parsed)
                keys.push_back(k.IsChar() && k.ch == U'\n' ? VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Enter) : k);
        }
        m_globals.lastMacro = reg;
        std::vector<VimKey> all;
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < std::max(1u, count); ++i) all.insert(all.end(), keys.begin(), keys.end());
        FeedKeys(all, true);
    }
}
```

Marks are anchors (spec s3.2), held in `VimBufferState` so split views share them, attached to the buffer by the first `VimState` over it and detached by the last. A linewise deletion that removes a whole line erases the lowercase marks on it, as vim's `mark_adjust` does (`one_adjust`). **File marks `A`-`Z` are not erased** (Neovim `one_adjust_nodel`): they move to the first line after the deleted ones -- the line that took the deleted line's place -- and keep their column, clamped to that line. Special marks just move. Every edit vim makes goes through `VimText::Apply`, which now tells the acting view's observer before (to erase marks on rows about to disappear, and to remember the columns of the uppercase marks there) and after (to put those uppercase marks back at their column, and to set `'[` `']` `'.`); yanks report their range through `NoteYank`.

`VimText::Apply` is also where multi-cursor operators meet (finding 5d.7): two cursors in one word (`diw`) or on one line (`dd`) produce the same range twice, and `d2w` from two nearby cursors produces overlapping ranges, which TE1's `ApplyEdits` refuses as non-disjoint edits. The rule, applied after the sort: an op identical to the previous one (same range, same text) is dropped; a deletion (empty text) that overlaps or touches the previous deletion is merged into it (their union); any other op that overlaps the previous one is dropped (the earlier op wins). The cursors' `after` selections are kept as given, so cursors that end on one offset merge through `SelectionSet`'s normal merge (spec s2.1: each cursor acts as single-cursor vim, then selections merge). Inserts typed by the view are covered by the insert capture: when Insert or Replace ends, `'^` is where the caret stopped, `'[`/`']` the inserted text, `'.` its last character. `'<` / `'>` are recorded whenever Visual ends (start / end; in VisualLine `'<` reads column 0 and `'>` the line end, as vim's `mark_get`). `gv` reselects the last Visual area (swapping with the current one inside Visual); `gi` inserts at `'^`.

```cpp
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "fo\xCB\x87" "o bar");

    CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" " bar");
    VimRig d("a\xCB\x87" "b\xCB\x87" "c\nd");
    d.Keys("dd");                                          // two cursors on one line: one line goes
    CHECK(d.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "d");

    CHECK(w.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "d");
    const std::vector<EditOp> ops = VimText::DisjointOps({ EditOp{ ByteRange{ 0, 3 }, "" }, EditOp{ ByteRange{ 0, 3 }, "" },
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimMarks.hpp
#pragma once

// Vim marks of one buffer (spec s6.3, s3.2): a-z, A-Z while this file holds them,
// and the special marks ' ` . ^ [ ] < > -- each an anchor, so edits move them.
// Shared by the buffer's split views through VimBufferState.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Anchor.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Core/TextBuffer.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <map>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    ARC_CONSTANT("internal mark names: the last Visual area's anchor/head for gv; never listed")
    inline constexpr char32_t kVisualAnchorMark = U'\x01';
    ARC_CONSTANT("internal mark names: the last Visual area's anchor/head for gv; never listed")
    inline constexpr char32_t kVisualHeadMark = U'\x02';

    class VimMarks
    {
    public:
        void Attach(TextBuffer& buffer);
        void Detach(TextBuffer& buffer);
        void Set(char32_t name, ByteOffset at);
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<ByteOffset> Get(char32_t name) const;
        void Remove(char32_t name);
        // Erases the a-z marks on rows [firstRow, lastRow] of `before` (the rows an edit removes). The A-Z
        // marks there are kept (Neovim one_adjust_nodel) and returned with their byte column, for
        // PlaceKeptMarks once the edit is done.
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::pair<char32_t, std::uint32_t>> EraseRows(std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow, const Rope& before);
        // Puts each kept mark on the row its anchor collapsed to, at its old column clamped to that line.
        void PlaceKeptMarks(std::span<const std::pair<char32_t, std::uint32_t>> kept, const Rope& after);
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::pair<char32_t, ByteOffset>> List() const;   // printable names, sorted
        [[nodiscard]] static bool IsSettable(char32_t name);                       // m{name}: a-z A-Z ' ` [ ] < >

    private:
        AnchorSet m_anchors;
        std::map<char32_t, AnchorSet::Id> m_ids;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimMarks.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimMarks.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimText.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    void VimMarks::Attach(TextBuffer& buffer) { buffer.RegisterAnchors(m_anchors); }
    void VimMarks::Detach(TextBuffer& buffer) { buffer.UnregisterAnchors(m_anchors); }

    void VimMarks::Set(char32_t name, ByteOffset at)
    {
        if (const auto it = m_ids.find(name); it != m_ids.end()) m_anchors.Set(it->second, Anchor{ at, Bias::Left });
        else m_ids.emplace(name, m_anchors.Add(Anchor{ at, Bias::Left }));
    }

    std::optional<ByteOffset> VimMarks::Get(char32_t name) const
    {
        const auto it = m_ids.find(name);
        if (it == m_ids.end()) return std::nullopt;
        return m_anchors.Get(it->second).offset;
    }

    void VimMarks::Remove(char32_t name)
    {
        const auto it = m_ids.find(name);
        if (it == m_ids.end()) return;
        m_anchors.Remove(it->second);
        m_ids.erase(it);
    }

    std::vector<std::pair<char32_t, std::uint32_t>> VimMarks::EraseRows(std::uint32_t firstRow, std::uint32_t lastRow, const Rope& before)
    {
        std::vector<std::pair<char32_t, std::uint32_t>> kept;
        for (auto it = m_ids.begin(); it != m_ids.end();)
        {
            const char32_t c = it->first;
            const ByteOffset at = m_anchors.Get(it->second).offset;
            const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(before, at);
            const bool onErasedRow = row >= firstRow && row <= lastRow;
            if (onErasedRow && c >= U'A' && c <= U'Z')
                kept.emplace_back(c, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(at - before.LineStart(row)));   // one_adjust_nodel
            if (onErasedRow && c >= U'a' && c <= U'z')
            {
                m_anchors.Remove(it->second);                // one_adjust: the mark is deleted with its line
                it = m_ids.erase(it);
            }
            else
                ++it;
        }
        return kept;
    }

    void VimMarks::PlaceKeptMarks(std::span<const std::pair<char32_t, std::uint32_t>> kept, const Rope& after)
    {
        for (const auto& [name, column] : kept)
        {
            const std::optional<ByteOffset> collapsed = Get(name);   // the anchor fell to the start of the deleted range
            if (!collapsed) continue;
            const std::uint32_t row = std::min(VimText::RowOf(after, std::min<ByteOffset>(*collapsed, after.Size())), VimText::LastRow(after));
            const ByteOffset start = after.LineStart(row);
            Set(name, start + std::min<ByteOffset>(column, after.LineEnd(row) - start));
        }
    }

    std::vector<std::pair<char32_t, ByteOffset>> VimMarks::List() const
    {
        std::vector<std::pair<char32_t, ByteOffset>> out;
        for (const auto& [name, id] : m_ids)
            if (name >= U' ') out.emplace_back(name, m_anchors.Get(id).offset);
        return out;   // std::map: already sorted by name
    }

    bool VimMarks::IsSettable(char32_t c)
    {
        if ((c >= U'a' && c <= U'z') || (c >= U'A' && c <= U'Z')) return true;
        return c == U'\'' || c == U'`' || c == U'[' || c == U']' || c == U'<' || c == U'>';
    }
}
```

```cpp
    namespace
    {
        std::unordered_map<const SelectionSet*, IVimApplyObserver*>& Observers()
        {
            static std::unordered_map<const SelectionSet*, IVimApplyObserver*> s_observers;   // UI thread only
            return s_observers;
        }

        IVimApplyObserver* ObserverOf(const SelectionSet& s)
        {
            const auto it = Observers().find(&s);
            return it == Observers().end() ? nullptr : it->second;
        }
    }

    void SetApplyObserver(const SelectionSet& selections, IVimApplyObserver* observer)
    {
        if (observer) Observers()[&selections] = observer;
        else Observers().erase(&selections);
    }

    void NoteYank(const VimDoc& d, ByteOffset begin, ByteOffset end)
    {
        if (IVimApplyObserver* o = ObserverOf(d.selections)) o->OnYank(begin, end);
    }

    // Multi-cursor operators (finding 5d.7): an identical op is dropped, an overlapping or touching
    // deletion is merged into the previous deletion, any other overlap keeps the earlier op.
    std::vector<EditOp> DisjointOps(std::vector<EditOp> sorted)
    {
        std::vector<EditOp> out;
        out.reserve(sorted.size());
        for (EditOp& op : sorted)
        {
            if (!out.empty())
            {
                EditOp& prev = out.back();
                if (op.range.begin == prev.range.begin && op.range.end == prev.range.end && op.text == prev.text) continue;
                const bool bothDeletions = op.text.empty() && prev.text.empty()
                                        && prev.range.end > prev.range.begin && op.range.end > op.range.begin;
                if (bothDeletions && op.range.begin <= prev.range.end)
                {
                    prev.range.end = std::max(prev.range.end, op.range.end);
                    continue;
                }
                if (op.range.begin < prev.range.end) continue;
            }
            out.push_back(std::move(op));
        }
        return out;
    }

    void Apply(VimDoc& d, std::vector<EditOp> ops, std::vector<Selection> after, std::size_t primary)
    {
        std::stable_sort(ops.begin(), ops.end(), [](const EditOp& a, const EditOp& b) { return a.range.begin < b.range.begin; });
        ops = DisjointOps(std::move(ops));
        IVimApplyObserver* observer = ObserverOf(d.selections);
        std::vector<EditOp> seen;                          // the observer's copy: ops is moved into the command
        if (observer)
        {
            observer->BeforeApply(d.buffer.Text(), ops);
            seen = ops;
        }
        // One transaction (TE1-14): Begin(current, Other), Edit(ops), selections := after, End(after).
        TextCommands(d.buffer, d.selections, d.context ? *d.context : EditContext{})
            .ApplyEdits(TransactionKind::Other, std::move(ops), std::move(after), primary);
        if (observer) observer->AfterApply(d.buffer.Text(), seen);
    }
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimMarkMotion.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimMarkMotion.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    std::optional<VimMotionTarget> ResolveMarkMotion(VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset from, const VimMotionArgs& args)
    {
        (void)from;
        char32_t name = args.arg == U'`' ? U'\'' : args.arg;
        const std::optional<ByteOffset> at = ctx.bufferState.marks.Get(name);
        if (!at) return std::nullopt;
        const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
        ByteOffset o = std::min<ByteOffset>(*at, r.Size());
        const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, o);
        if (ctx.bufferState.lastVisualMode == VimMode::VisualLine)
        {
            if (name == U'<') o = r.LineStart(row);              // vim mark_get: '< column 0 in linewise Visual
            if (name == U'>') o = r.LineEnd(row);                // '> column MAXCOL
        }
        VimMotionTarget t;
        t.jump = true;
        if (args.id == VimMotionId::MarkLine)
        {
            t.offset = VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, row);
            t.kind = MotionKind::Linewise;
        }
        else
        {
            t.offset = o;
            t.kind = MotionKind::Exclusive;
        }
        return t;
    }
}
```

`VimState.cpp`: the constructor body and destructor become:

```cpp
    VimState::VimState(VimDoc doc, IVimHost& host, VimGlobals& globals, VimBufferState& bufferState,
                       VimOptions options, VimLanguage language)
        : m_doc(doc), m_host(host), m_globals(globals), m_bufferState(bufferState),
          m_options(std::move(options)), m_language(std::move(language)), m_chars(m_language.wordChars)
    {
        m_doc.buffer.RegisterAnchors(m_anchors);
        if (m_bufferState.attachCount++ == 0) AttachBufferState();
        m_applyObserver.self = this;
        VimText::SetApplyObserver(m_doc.selections, &m_applyObserver);
        VimText::SyncDisplay(m_doc);                   // TE5a-5's order: display rows current before the clamp
        ClampCursors();
        ApplyModeHooks();
    }

    VimState::~VimState()
    {
        if (m_insert.open) EndInsertSession();
        VimText::SetApplyObserver(m_doc.selections, nullptr);
        if (--m_bufferState.attachCount == 0) DetachBufferState();
        m_doc.buffer.UnregisterAnchors(m_anchors);
    }

    void VimState::AttachBufferState() { m_bufferState.marks.Attach(m_doc.buffer); }
    void VimState::DetachBufferState() { m_bufferState.marks.Detach(m_doc.buffer); }

    void VimState::BeforeVimEdit(const Rope& before, std::span<const EditOp> ops)
    {
        m_keptFileMarks.clear();
        for (const EditOp& op : ops)
        {
            if (op.range.begin == op.range.end) continue;
            const std::uint32_t first = VimText::RowOf(before, op.range.begin);
            const std::uint32_t last = VimText::RowOf(before, op.range.end);
            bool any = false;
            std::uint32_t lo = 0, hi = 0;
            for (std::uint32_t row = first; row <= last; ++row)
            {
                // the row's whole line, with a line break, is inside the deleted range
                const bool gone = row + 1 < before.LineCount()
                    ? op.range.begin <= before.LineStart(row) && before.LineStart(row + 1) <= op.range.end
                    : row > 0 && op.range.begin <= before.LineEnd(row - 1) && op.range.end >= before.LineEnd(row);
                if (!gone) continue;
                if (!any) lo = row;
                hi = row;
                any = true;
            }
            if (any)
                for (const auto& kept : m_bufferState.marks.EraseRows(lo, hi, before)) m_keptFileMarks.push_back(kept);
        }
    }

    void VimState::AfterVimEdit(const Rope& after, std::span<const EditOp> ops)
    {
        if (!m_keptFileMarks.empty())
        {
            m_bufferState.marks.PlaceKeptMarks(m_keptFileMarks, after);   // A-Z: the next line, the old column
            m_keptFileMarks.clear();
        }
        if (ops.empty()) return;
        const ByteOffset first = VimText::MapThrough(ops.front().range.begin, ops, Bias::Left);
        const ByteOffset lastBegin = VimText::MapThrough(ops.back().range.begin, ops, Bias::Left);
        const ByteOffset lastEnd = lastBegin + ops.back().text.size();
        m_bufferState.marks.Set(U'[', first);
        m_bufferState.marks.Set(U']', lastEnd > lastBegin ? VimCursorModel::PrevVisual(after, lastEnd) : lastBegin);
        m_bufferState.marks.Set(U'.', lastBegin);
    }

    void VimState::AfterVimYank(ByteOffset begin, ByteOffset end)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        m_bufferState.marks.Set(U'[', begin);
        m_bufferState.marks.Set(U']', end > begin ? VimCursorModel::PrevVisual(r, end) : begin);
    }
```

`FinishInsertCapture` becomes:

```cpp
    void VimState::FinishInsertCapture()
    {
        if (!m_capture.valid) return;
        if (!m_capture.text.empty()) m_globals.registers.SetSpecial(U'.', m_capture.text);
        if (m_pendingChange && !m_replaying)
        {
            m_pendingChange->insertedText = m_capture.text;
            m_pendingChange->deletedBefore = m_capture.deletedBefore;
            m_globals.lastChange = std::move(*m_pendingChange);
        }
        m_pendingChange.reset();
        // '^ where the caret stopped; '[ '] the inserted text; '. its last character
        const ByteOffset start = m_anchors.Get(m_capture.startAnchor).offset;
        const ByteOffset stop = m_anchors.Get(m_capture.caretAnchor).offset;
        m_bufferState.marks.Set(U'^', stop);
        if (m_insert.typed || !m_capture.text.empty())
        {
            const ByteOffset lastChar = stop > start ? VimCursorModel::PrevVisual(m_doc.buffer.Text(), stop) : start;
            m_bufferState.marks.Set(U'[', start);
            m_bufferState.marks.Set(U']', lastChar);
            m_bufferState.marks.Set(U'.', lastChar);
        }
        m_anchors.Remove(m_capture.startAnchor);
        m_anchors.Remove(m_capture.caretAnchor);
        m_capture.valid = false;
    }
```

Visual bookkeeping. `ExitVisual()` (TE5a-12) calls `RememberVisual();` as its first statement; so does every other place that leaves a Visual mode for Normal without `ExitVisual` -- the Esc-in-Visual branch of `HandleNormalOrVisual` and the Visual exits in `OnTransactionBegun` / `OnTransactionUndone` (TE5a-5, or their TE5a-18 replacements), before they change `m_mode`.

```cpp
    void VimState::RememberVisual()
    {
        if (!IsVisual(m_mode)) return;
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        ByteOffset anchor = 0, head = 0;
        if (m_mode == VimMode::VisualBlock)
        {
            anchor = VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, m_block.anchorRow, m_block.anchorVcol, m_options.tabSize);
            head = VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, m_block.headRow, m_block.headVcol, m_options.tabSize);
            m_bufferState.lastBlockAnchorVcol = m_block.anchorVcol;
            m_bufferState.lastBlockHeadVcol = m_block.headVcol;
            m_bufferState.lastBlockToEol = m_block.toEol;
        }
        else
        {
            const VimCursor c = ToVim(m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()]);
            anchor = c.anchor;
            head = c.head;
        }
        m_bufferState.marks.Set(kVisualAnchorMark, anchor);
        m_bufferState.marks.Set(kVisualHeadMark, head);
        m_bufferState.marks.Set(U'<', std::min(anchor, head));
        m_bufferState.marks.Set(U'>', std::max(anchor, head));
        m_bufferState.lastVisualMode = m_mode;
        m_bufferState.hasLastVisual = true;
    }

    void VimState::EnterVisualAt(VimMode mode, ByteOffset anchor, ByteOffset head,
                                 std::uint32_t anchorVcol, std::uint32_t headVcol, bool toEol)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        anchor = std::min<ByteOffset>(anchor, r.Size());
        head = std::min<ByteOffset>(head, r.Size());
        const std::uint32_t primaryId = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].id;
        m_mode = mode;
        if (mode == VimMode::VisualBlock)
        {
            m_block.anchorRow = VimText::RowOf(r, anchor);
            m_block.headRow = VimText::RowOf(r, head);
            m_block.anchorVcol = anchorVcol;
            m_block.headVcol = headVcol;
            m_block.toEol = toEol;
            const std::uint32_t top = std::min(m_block.anchorRow, m_block.headRow);
            const std::uint32_t bottom = std::max(m_block.anchorRow, m_block.headRow);
            const std::uint32_t left = std::min(anchorVcol, headVcol), right = std::max(anchorVcol, headVcol);
            std::vector<Selection> sels;
            std::size_t primary = 0;
            for (std::uint32_t row = top; row <= bottom; ++row)
            {
                const ByteOffset lo = VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, row, left, m_options.tabSize);
                ByteOffset hi = r.LineEnd(row);
                if (!toEol)
                {
                    const ByteOffset edge = VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, row, right, m_options.tabSize);
                    hi = edge < r.LineEnd(row) ? VimText::NextChar(r, edge) : r.LineEnd(row);
                }
                const std::uint32_t id = row == m_block.headRow ? primaryId : m_doc.selections.AllocateId();
                if (row == m_block.headRow) primary = sels.size();
                sels.push_back(headVcol < anchorVcol ? Selection{ id, hi, lo, std::nullopt } : Selection{ id, lo, hi, std::nullopt });
            }
            VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), primary);
            return;
        }
        const Selection vim{ primaryId, anchor, head, std::nullopt };
        VimText::Select(m_doc, { mode == VimMode::Visual ? VimCursorModel::ToEditorVisual(r, vim) : vim }, 0);
    }

    void VimState::ReselectVisual()
    {
        VimBufferState& b = m_bufferState;
        const std::optional<ByteOffset> anchor = b.marks.Get(kVisualAnchorMark);
        const std::optional<ByteOffset> head = b.marks.Get(kVisualHeadMark);
        if (!b.hasLastVisual || !anchor || !head) { Beep(); return; }
        const VimMode mode = b.lastVisualMode;
        const std::uint32_t av = b.lastBlockAnchorVcol, hv = b.lastBlockHeadVcol;
        const bool toEol = b.lastBlockToEol;
        if (IsVisual(m_mode)) RememberVisual();                 // gv inside Visual swaps the two areas
        EnterVisualAt(mode, *anchor, *head, av, hv, toEol);
    }

    void VimState::SetMarkCommand(char32_t name)
    {
        if (!VimMarks::IsSettable(name)) { Beep(); return; }
        if (name == U'`') name = U'\'';
        const VimCursor c = ToVim(m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()]);
        m_bufferState.marks.Set(name, c.head);
    }
```

### Task TE5b-7: Global marks `A-Z` across files (spec s6.3 Marks/jumps, s9 FileOpener `Files().OpenWith`)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimGlobalMarks.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimGlobalMarks.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimGlobals.hpp` (`globalMarks`, `fileMarks`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimMarkMotion.cpp` (TE5b-6: uppercase marks)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp`, `VimState.cpp` (`Execute` top, `SetMarkCommand`, `AttachBufferState`, `DetachBufferState`, new `SyncGlobalMarks`)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5b.vimcases`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimGlobalMarksTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `IVimHost::DocumentPath/OpenAt` (TE5a-5). The editor adapter (TE5a-22) implements `DocumentPath()` from `TextDocument::CanonicalPath()` (returned BY VALUE: `const auto p = doc.CanonicalPath();`) and `OpenAt(path, point)` through its `Services::openText` (FileOpener, TE7-8: `Files().OpenWith(path, Openers::OpenerId::ArcaneText(), Openers::FilePosition{ point.row + 1, 1 })`, wired by `VimEditorRuntime::SetFileOpener`) -- never `DocumentHost::OpenAt`. `Rope::OffsetToPoint`, `VimMarks` (TE5b-6).
- Produces:
  - `struct VimGlobalMark { std::string path; Point point; bool operator==(const VimGlobalMark&) const = default; }`, `class VimGlobalMarks { Set; Get; Remove; List; }` (contract), `ByteOffset VimPointToOffset(const Rope&, Point)` (clamped)
  - `VimGlobals::globalMarks`, `VimGlobals::fileMarks` (`std::map<std::string, std::map<char32_t, Point>>`: the lowercase marks of files with no VimState, by canonical path -- TE5d-6 persists both)
  - `void VimState::SyncGlobalMarks()` (public: refreshes this file's uppercase Points from their anchors; TE5c-14 `:marks` and TE5d-6 persistence call it before reading)

An uppercase mark names a file and a position. While the file has a VimState the position is an anchor in its `VimMarks` (so edits move it) and `VimGlobalMarks` holds the file's canonical path (`IVimHost::DocumentPath`, the `TextDocument` key, spec s5.3) plus a `Point` refreshed whenever this file's marks are read out. `'A` or `` `A `` in another file opens it through `IVimHost::OpenAt`, which the adapter routes to the FileOpener (`Files().OpenWith(path, OpenerId::ArcaneText(), FilePosition{ row + 1, 1 })`, TE5a-22 / TE7-8); with an operator or in Visual that is `E20: Mark not set`, as in vim. When the last view of a file goes, its lowercase marks are kept by path in `fileMarks` and come back when the file is opened again. An uppercase mark whose line is deleted is **kept** (Neovim's `one_adjust_nodel`, TE5b-6): its anchor moves to the line that took the deleted line's place, at its old column, and `SyncGlobalMarks` refreshes the global table's `Point` from it, so `'A` still opens the file there. **Divergence:** `'A` (and `` `A ``) into another file lands on column 0 of the mark's line rather than its first non-blank / exact column: the open goes through the FileOpener as `FilePosition{ point.row + 1, 1 }` (the documented `'A` column-0 divergence; the other document's text is not known until it opens). Vim still hands the host the mark's Point (`` `A `` keeps its column, `'A` column 0), so a host that can place a column may.

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimGlobalMarksTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp"

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using Arcane::Test::VimRig;

TEST_CASE("vim global marks: 'A in another file opens it through the host", "[text-vim-marks]")
{
    VimRig a("ab\nc\xCB\x87" "d");
    a.host.path = "C:/p/a.txt";
    a.Keys("mA");
    VimRig b("\xCB\x87" "x", {}, {}, &a.Globals());
    b.host.path = "C:/p/b.txt";
    b.Keys("`A");
    REQUIRE(b.host.opened.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(b.host.opened[0].first == "C:/p/a.txt");
    CHECK(b.host.opened[0].second.row == 1u);
    CHECK(b.host.opened[0].second.col == 1u);
    b.Keys("d`Ax");                                       // an operator cannot cross files: E20; the typed x still runs
    CHECK(b.Text().empty());
    REQUIRE_FALSE(b.host.messages.empty());
    CHECK(b.host.messages.back().first == "E20: Mark not set");
}

TEST_CASE("vim global marks: the point follows edits and is synced when the file closes", "[text-vim-marks]")
{
    VimRig a("a\n\xCB\x87" "b");
    a.host.path = "C:/p/a.txt";
    a.Keys("mAggOnew<Esc>");
    a.vim.reset();                                        // the last view: marks sync out
    const auto g = a.Globals().globalMarks.Get(U'A');
    REQUIRE(g.has_value());
    CHECK(g->point.row == 2u);
}

TEST_CASE("vim global marks: lowercase marks survive the file closing and reopening", "[text-vim-marks]")
{
    VimRig a("a\xCB\x87" "bc");
    a.host.path = "C:/p/a.txt";
    a.Keys("ma");
    a.vim.reset();
    REQUIRE(a.Globals().fileMarks.count("C:/p/a.txt") == 1u);
    VimBufferState fresh;                                 // a new buffer state: only fileMarks can bring the mark back
    a.vim = std::make_unique<VimState>(a.Doc(), a.host, a.Globals(), fresh);
    CHECK(fresh.marks.Get(U'a').has_value());
    a.Keys("0`a");
    CHECK(a.Marked() == "a\xCB\x87" "bc");
    a.vim.reset();                                        // before `fresh` goes out of scope
}

TEST_CASE("vim global marks: deleting the line of an uppercase mark keeps it on the next line", "[text-vim-marks]")
{
    VimRig a("a\n\xCB\x87" "b\nc");
    a.host.path = "C:/p/a.txt";
    a.Keys("mAdd");
    a.vim->SyncGlobalMarks();
    const auto g = a.Globals().globalMarks.Get(U'A');
    REQUIRE(g.has_value());                               // Neovim one_adjust_nodel: file marks are never deleted
    CHECK(g->point.row == 1u);                            // the line "c" took row 1
    CHECK(g->point.col == 0u);
}
```

(The first case's name predates the D-R12 run and the expectation passes either way: `x` deletes the `b` whether `` `A `` jumps there or fails. The second case tells the two apart: Neovim keeps file marks on a deleted line, `one_adjust_nodel`, so `` `A `` lands on `d` and `x` deletes it; a lost mark would leave the cursor on `a`.)

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimGlobalMarks.hpp
#pragma once

// Vim's file marks A-Z (spec s6.3): a canonical path (the TextDocument key,
// spec s5.3) and a position, process-wide in VimGlobals.

#include "TextEditor/Core/Rope.hpp"

#include <map>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimGlobalMark
    {
        std::string path;
        Point point;
        bool operator==(const VimGlobalMark&) const = default;   // TE5d-6's three-way merge compares marks
    };

    class VimGlobalMarks
    {
    public:
        void Set(char32_t name, VimGlobalMark mark) { m_marks[name] = std::move(mark); }
        [[nodiscard]] std::optional<VimGlobalMark> Get(char32_t name) const
        {
            const auto it = m_marks.find(name);
            return it == m_marks.end() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<VimGlobalMark>(it->second);
        }
        void Remove(char32_t name) { m_marks.erase(name); }
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::pair<char32_t, VimGlobalMark>> List() const
        {
            return std::vector<std::pair<char32_t, VimGlobalMark>>(m_marks.begin(), m_marks.end());
        }

    private:
        std::map<char32_t, VimGlobalMark> m_marks;
    };

    // A Point in `rope`, clamped to an existing row and column.
    [[nodiscard]] ByteOffset VimPointToOffset(const Rope& rope, Point point);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimGlobalMarks.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimGlobalMarks.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimText.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    ByteOffset VimPointToOffset(const Rope& rope, Point point)
    {
        const std::uint32_t row = std::min(point.row, VimText::LastRow(rope));   // D-R5: never the row after a final '\n'
        const ByteOffset start = rope.LineStart(row);
        return start + std::min<ByteOffset>(point.col, rope.LineEnd(row) - start);
    }
}
```

`VimMarkMotion.cpp` -- `ResolveMarkMotion` becomes:

```cpp
    std::optional<VimMotionTarget> ResolveMarkMotion(VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset from, const VimMotionArgs& args)
    {
        (void)from;
        const char32_t name = args.arg == U'`' ? U'\'' : args.arg;
        const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
        std::optional<ByteOffset> at;
        if (name >= U'A' && name <= U'Z')
        {
            const std::optional<VimGlobalMark> g = ctx.globals.globalMarks.Get(name);
            if (!g || g->path != ctx.host.DocumentPath()) return std::nullopt;   // other files: VimState::Execute opens them
            at = ctx.bufferState.marks.Get(name);
            if (!at) at = VimPointToOffset(r, g->point);
        }
        else
            at = ctx.bufferState.marks.Get(name);
        if (!at) return std::nullopt;
        ByteOffset o = std::min<ByteOffset>(*at, r.Size());
        const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, o);
        if (ctx.bufferState.lastVisualMode == VimMode::VisualLine)
        {
            if (name == U'<') o = r.LineStart(row);
            if (name == U'>') o = r.LineEnd(row);
        }
        VimMotionTarget t;
        t.jump = true;
        if (args.id == VimMotionId::MarkLine)
        {
            t.offset = VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, row);
            t.kind = MotionKind::Linewise;
        }
        else
        {
            t.offset = o;
            t.kind = MotionKind::Exclusive;
        }
        return t;
    }
```

`SetMarkCommand`, `AttachBufferState`, `DetachBufferState` become, and `SyncGlobalMarks` is added. `BeforeVimEdit` / `AfterVimEdit` stay as TE5b-6 wrote them: an uppercase mark on a deleted line keeps its anchor (moved to the next line), so nothing is removed from `globalMarks`; `SyncGlobalMarks` refreshes its `Point` whenever the marks are read out.

```cpp
    void VimState::SetMarkCommand(char32_t name)
    {
        if (!VimMarks::IsSettable(name)) { Beep(); return; }
        if (name == U'`') name = U'\'';
        const VimCursor c = ToVim(m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()]);
        m_bufferState.marks.Set(name, c.head);
        if (name >= U'A' && name <= U'Z')
        {
            const std::string path = m_host.DocumentPath();
            if (!path.empty()) m_globals.globalMarks.Set(name, VimGlobalMark{ path, m_doc.buffer.Text().OffsetToPoint(c.head) });
        }
    }

    void VimState::SyncGlobalMarks()
    {
        const std::string path = m_host.DocumentPath();
        if (path.empty()) return;
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        for (const auto& [name, mark] : m_globals.globalMarks.List())
            if (mark.path == path)
                if (const std::optional<ByteOffset> at = m_bufferState.marks.Get(name))
                    m_globals.globalMarks.Set(name, VimGlobalMark{ path, r.OffsetToPoint(*at) });
    }

    void VimState::AttachBufferState()
    {
        m_bufferState.marks.Attach(m_doc.buffer);
        const std::string path = m_host.DocumentPath();
        if (path.empty()) return;
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        if (const auto it = m_globals.fileMarks.find(path); it != m_globals.fileMarks.end())
            for (const auto& [name, point] : it->second) m_bufferState.marks.Set(name, VimPointToOffset(r, point));
        for (const auto& [name, mark] : m_globals.globalMarks.List())
            if (mark.path == path) m_bufferState.marks.Set(name, VimPointToOffset(r, mark.point));
    }

    void VimState::DetachBufferState()
    {
        const std::string path = m_host.DocumentPath();
        if (!path.empty())
        {
            SyncGlobalMarks();
            std::map<char32_t, Point>& saved = m_globals.fileMarks[path];
            saved.clear();
            const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
            for (const auto& [name, at] : m_bufferState.marks.List())
                if (name >= U'a' && name <= U'z') saved[name] = r.OffsetToPoint(at);
        }
        m_bufferState.marks.Detach(m_doc.buffer);
    }
```

### Task TE5b-8: The jump list (`Ctrl-O` / `Ctrl-I`) and the change list (`g;` / `g,`) (spec s6.3 Marks/jumps)

**Files:**

- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp`, `VimState.cpp` (`m_jumps`, `RecordJump`, `JumpCommand`, `ChangeCommand`, change-list feeding, attach/detach)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimMotions.cpp` (TE5a-8: `ExecuteMotion` records jumps)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimActions.cpp` (cases `JumpOlder`, `JumpNewer`, `ChangeOlder`, `ChangeNewer`)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5b.vimcases`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimJumpListTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `AnchorSet` (`AnchorSet::Id`, `Add(Anchor{ offset, bias })`, `Get(id).offset`, `Remove`; TE1-5), `TextBuffer::RegisterAnchors/UnregisterAnchors` (TE1-8), `ExecuteMotion`'s `jumped` / `jumpFrom` and trailing `Select` (TE5a-8), `AfterVimEdit` / `FinishInsertCapture` (TE5b-6).
- Produces:
  - `class VimJumpList { explicit VimJumpList(AnchorSet&); void Record(ByteOffset at, const Rope&); std::optional<ByteOffset> Move(std::int32_t count, ByteOffset current, const Rope&, const std::function<void(ByteOffset)>& setpcmark); std::vector<std::string> Listing(const Rope&) const; std::size_t Size() const; std::size_t Index() const; }` -- `Move` calls `setpcmark(current)` when the first `Ctrl-O` after a jump must remember where it was pressed (Neovim `movemark` calls `setpcmark()`, which also sets the `''` mark); `VimState` passes `RecordJump`.
  - `class VimChangeList { Attach; Detach; void Add(ByteOffset at, const Rope&); Size; At; Generation; std::vector<std::string> Listing(const Rope&) const; }`
  - `void VimState::RecordJump(ByteOffset from)` (public: Part D's search, `:N` and other jumps call it), `const VimJumpList& VimState::Jumps() const` (TE5c-14 `:jumps`)
  - `VimBufferState::changes`

Neovim semantics (`mark.c`): a jump (`G gg % ( ) { } H M L n N * # / ? `` ` `` `' ``...) appends the position it left to this view's list (100 entries) and sets the `''` mark. `Ctrl-O` first drops entries that a later entry duplicates on the same row (keeping their index right), and -- when the index is past the end -- appends the current position before stepping back, so `Ctrl-I` can return; that append is Neovim's `setpcmark()`, so it also moves the `''` mark to where `Ctrl-O` was pressed (it goes through `VimState::RecordJump`, finding 5b.8). Out of range is a beep. The change list is per buffer (100 entries): a change on the same row as the newest entry and within 79 columns of it updates that entry (`textwidth` 0 -> 79, vim's `changed_common`), otherwise appends; `g;` / `g,` walk it from the newest end, with vim's `E662` / `E663` / `E664` at the ends. Each view's position in the change list resets to the end whenever the list grows.

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimJumpListTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimChangeList.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimJumpList.hpp"

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using Arcane::Test::VimRig;

TEST_CASE("vim jumps: Ctrl-O from the newest end inserts the current position first", "[text-vim-jumps]")
{
    TextBuffer buffer(Rope::FromUtf8("a\nb\nc\nd"));
    AnchorSet anchors;
    buffer.RegisterAnchors(anchors);
    {
        VimJumpList j(anchors);
        const Rope& r = buffer.Text();
        j.Record(0, r);                        // G from row 0
        j.Record(6, r);                        // gg from row 3
        CHECK(j.Index() == 2u);
        std::vector<ByteOffset> pcmarks;
        const auto setpcmark = [&](ByteOffset at) { pcmarks.push_back(at); j.Record(at, r); };
        const auto back = j.Move(-1, 0, r, setpcmark);   // at row 0 again: row 0 is added, the older row-0 entry dropped
        REQUIRE(back.has_value());
        CHECK(*back == 6u);
        CHECK(pcmarks == std::vector<ByteOffset>{ 0 });  // the first Ctrl-O after a jump is a setpcmark
        CHECK_FALSE(j.Move(-1, 6, r, setpcmark).has_value());
        const auto fwd = j.Move(1, 6, r, setpcmark);
        REQUIRE(fwd.has_value());
        CHECK(*fwd == 0u);
        CHECK(pcmarks.size() == 1u);                     // only that first one
    }
    buffer.UnregisterAnchors(anchors);
}
```
