### Task TE5c-5: Search commands and the command-line editor -- `/ ? n N * # g* g#`, incsearch, hlsearch, history (spec s6.3 motions, s6.4 hlsearch/incsearch/wrapscan, s6.5 search details)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimSearchCommands.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimSearchCommands.cpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCommandLine.cpp`
- Create: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5c.vimcases`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimGlobals.hpp` (VimSearchState, histories)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (command-line members)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.cpp` (`FeedResolved`, the top of `Execute`, the first line of `Keyboard()` -- D-R15)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimMotions.cpp` (Part A, TE5a-8: `ResolveMotion` cases)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimSearchCommandsTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimMotionArgs`, `VimMotionTarget`, `ResolveMotion` (TE5a-8); `VimRegisters::SetSpecial/Get` (TE5a-12); `VimBufferState::marks` (`VimMarks::Get`), `lastVisualMode`, `hasLastVisual` (TE5b-6); `VimState::ExecuteMotion/ExecuteOperator` (TE5a-8/12, reached through `Execute`); `VimPattern`, `VimSearch` (TE5c-1..4); `VimGlobals::scratch` (the vim `MatchScratch`, TE5a-13; `VimSearchEnvFor` hands it to `VimSearchEnv::scratch`); `VimCharClass::IsWord/PcreClass/PcreClassNoDigits`; `Utf8::DecodeAt` (TE1-1); `IVimHost::SetSearchHighlight(std::string_view pcre2)` (TE5a-5; vim's own host hook -- the adapter paints it with its `SearchHighlightOverlay`, CANON B19).
- Produces:
  - `struct VimSearchState { std::string lastPattern; bool lastForward = true; bool highlight = false; std::string lastSubPattern; std::optional<std::string> lastSubReplacement /* nullopt: no :s yet (E33 for ~ in a pattern) */; std::string lastSubFlags; bool lastNoSmartcase = false; /* added */ }`; `VimGlobals::search`, `VimGlobals::searchHistory`, `VimGlobals::commandHistory` (contract names).
  - `VimSearchCommands.hpp`: `kVimHistoryMax`, `VimPatternOptionsFor`, `VimSearchEnvFor`, `VimLastVisualArea`, `VimCompileForContext`, `VimWordForStar`, `VimStarPattern`, `ResolveSearchMotion`, `VimPushHistory`.
  - `VimState` (private): `enum class CmdLineKind { Ex, SearchForward, SearchBackward, SubstituteConfirm }`, `struct CommandLine`, `m_cmdline`, `HandleCommandLine`, `BeginSearchCommandLine`, `EnterCommandLine`, `LeaveCommandLine`, `SubmitCommandLine`, `SubmitSearch`, `ShowCommandLine`, `UpdateIncrementalSearch`, `BrowseHistory`.

`/` and `?` are the parser's `SearchFwd`/`SearchBack` motions; `Execute` intercepts them and opens the command line with the parsed command (count, register, pending operator) waiting. Enter stores the pattern as the last search pattern and direction, then executes that same command as `SearchNext` -- so `d/foo<CR>`, `v/foo<CR>` and `3/foo<CR>` all go through Part A's motion/operator paths unchanged, and the typed command-line keys are appended to `VimParsed::keys` for dot-repeat. `*`/`#` take the keyword under or after the cursor (else the non-blank word), wrap it in `\<`/`\>` when its ends are keyword characters, escape it for magic, and ignore smartcase (remembered with the pattern, so a following `n` ignores it too, as vim does). Every search turns `hlsearch` painting on through `IVimHost::SetSearchHighlight`; `incsearch` paints the typed pattern and scrolls to its next match while typing, and Esc restores the view.

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimSearchCommandsTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp"

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using Arcane::Test::VimRig;

namespace
{
    std::string Reg(VimRig& r, char32_t name)
    {
        const auto v = r.Globals().registers.Get(name, r.host, r.vim->Options());
        return v ? v->Text() : std::string("<none>");
    }

    bool HasMessage(const VimRig& r, std::string_view prefix, bool error)
    {
        for (const auto& [text, isError] : r.host.messages)
            if (text.starts_with(prefix) && isError == error) return true;
        return false;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim search: / moves, remembers the pattern, fills \"/ and paints hlsearch", "[text-vim-search]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "foo bar baz bar");
    r.Keys("/bar<CR>");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "foo \xCB\x87" "bar baz bar");
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Normal);
    CHECK(r.Globals().search.lastPattern == "bar");
    CHECK(r.Globals().search.lastForward);
    CHECK(r.Globals().search.highlight);
    CHECK(r.host.searchHighlight == "bar");
    CHECK(Reg(r, U'/') == "bar");
    CHECK(r.Globals().searchHistory.back() == "bar");
    CHECK(r.host.commandLine.empty());
    r.Keys("nn");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "foo \xCB\x87" "bar baz bar");
    CHECK(HasMessage(r, "search hit BOTTOM, continuing at TOP", false));
}

TEST_CASE("vim search: ? and N go backward; a count repeats", "[text-vim-search]")
{
    VimRig r("foo bar baz \xCB\x87" "qux bar");
    r.Keys("?bar<CR>");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "foo \xCB\x87" "bar baz qux bar");
    CHECK_FALSE(r.Globals().search.lastForward);
    r.Keys("N");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "foo bar baz qux \xCB\x87" "bar");
    VimRig c("\xCB\x87" "foo bar baz bar");
    c.Keys("2/bar<CR>");
    CHECK(c.Marked() == "foo bar baz \xCB\x87" "bar");
}

TEST_CASE("vim search: a search is a motion for operators and Visual", "[text-vim-search]")
{
    VimRig d("\xCB\x87" "foo bar");
    d.Keys("d/bar<CR>");
    CHECK(d.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "bar");
    VimRig v("\xCB\x87" "abc");
    v.Keys("v/c<CR>");
    CHECK(v.Mode() == VimMode::Visual);
    CHECK(v.Marked() == "\xC2\xAB" "ab\xCB\x87" "c");
}

TEST_CASE("vim search: not found is E486; typed keys after it still run", "[text-vim-search]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "x foo");
    r.Keys("/zzz<CR>x");                               // the cursor stays; the typed x still runs (D-R12)
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" " foo");
    CHECK(HasMessage(r, "E486: Pattern not found: zzz", true));
    VimOptions o;
    o.wrapscan = false;
    VimRig w("x foo \xCB\x87" "y", {}, o);
    w.Keys("/foo<CR>");
    CHECK(HasMessage(w, "E385", true));
}

TEST_CASE("vim search: * and # use the word under the cursor, ignore smartcase, honour ignorecase", "[text-vim-search]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "foo foobar foo");
    r.Keys("*");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "foo foobar \xCB\x87" "foo");
    CHECK(r.Globals().search.lastPattern == "\\<foo\\>");
    CHECK(r.Globals().search.lastNoSmartcase);
    VimRig g("\xCB\x87" "foo foobar foo");
    g.Keys("g*");
    CHECK(g.Marked() == "foo \xCB\x87" "foobar foo");
    VimRig h("foo bar \xCB\x87" "foo");
    h.Keys("#");
    CHECK(h.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "foo bar foo");
    VimOptions o;
    o.ignorecase = true;
    o.smartcase = true;
    VimRig s("\xCB\x87" "Foo x foo", {}, o);
    s.Keys("*");
    CHECK(s.Marked() == "Foo x \xCB\x87" "foo");
    VimRig none("\xCB\x87" "   ");
    none.Keys("*");
    CHECK(HasMessage(none, "E348", true));
}

TEST_CASE("vim search: incsearch paints while typing; Esc restores", "[text-vim-search]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "x foo");
    r.Keys("/fo");
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::CommandLine);
    CHECK(r.host.commandLine == "/fo");
    CHECK(r.host.commandCursor == 3u);
    CHECK(r.host.searchHighlight == "fo");
    CHECK(r.host.keyboard == VimKeyboardState{ false, false, true });   // the command line is text entry
    r.Keys("<Esc>");
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Normal);
    CHECK(r.host.searchHighlight.empty());
    CHECK(r.host.commandLine.empty());
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "x foo");
}

TEST_CASE("vim command line: editing keys, history, Ctrl-R", "[text-vim-search]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "x foo y foo");
    r.Keys("/a<BS>fx<Left><Del>o<End>o<CR>");      // "a" "" "fx" "f" "fo" "foo"
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "x \xCB\x87" "foo y foo");
    r.Keys("0/zz<C-u>foo<CR>");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "x \xCB\x87" "foo y foo");
    r.Keys("0/<Up><CR>");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "x \xCB\x87" "foo y foo");
    VimRig q("\xCB\x87" "foo x foo");
    q.Keys("yiw/<C-r>\"<CR>");
    CHECK(q.Marked() == "foo x \xCB\x87" "foo");
    VimRig b("\xCB\x87" "x");
    b.Keys("/<BS>");
    CHECK(b.Mode() == VimMode::Normal);                // Backspace on an empty line leaves it
    VimRig k("\xCB\x87" "x");
    k.Keys("/<C-r>");
    CHECK(k.host.keyboard == VimKeyboardState{ true, true, false });   // Ctrl-R's register NAME: command mode on (D-R15)
    k.Keys("a");
    CHECK(k.host.keyboard == VimKeyboardState{ false, false, true });  // back to text entry once the name arrived
    k.Keys("<Esc>");
}
```

```
# ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5c.vimcases
# TE5c: search, the command line, ex commands, :s, :g, :sort, folds (spec s6.3, s6.5, s11.3).
@nvim v0.12.5
@grammar plain
@set tabstop=4 shiftwidth=4 expandtab

=== / moves to the next match
keys: /bar<CR>
in: "ˇfoo bar baz bar"
out: "foo ˇbar baz bar"
mode: n
reg: / v "bar"

=== n repeats and wraps around the end
keys: /bar<CR>nn
in: "ˇfoo bar baz bar"
out: "foo ˇbar baz bar"
mode: n

=== N searches the other way and wraps
keys: /bar<CR>N
in: "ˇfoo bar baz bar"
out: "foo bar baz ˇbar"
mode: n

=== ? searches backward
keys: ?bar<CR>
in: "foo bar baz ˇqux bar"
out: "foo ˇbar baz qux bar"
mode: n

=== n after ? keeps going backward
keys: ?b<CR>n
in: "ab ab ˇx"
out: "aˇb ab x"
mode: n

=== a count finds the n-th match
keys: 2/bar<CR>
in: "ˇfoo bar baz bar"
out: "foo bar baz ˇbar"
mode: n

=== / with an empty pattern reuses the last one
keys: /b<CR>/<CR>
in: "ˇab ab"
out: "ab aˇb"
mode: n

=== search crosses lines
keys: /foo<CR>
in: "ˇfoo\nbar\nfoo"
out: "foo\nbar\nˇfoo"
mode: n

=== not found leaves the cursor
keys: /zzz<CR>
in: "ˇx foo"
out: "ˇx foo"
mode: n

=== nowrapscan stops at the end
set: nowrapscan
keys: /foo<CR>
in: "x foo ˇy"
out: "x foo ˇy"
mode: n

=== d/pat deletes up to the match (exclusive)
keys: d/bar<CR>
in: "ˇfoo bar"
out: "ˇbar"
mode: n
reg: 1 v "foo "

=== d?pat deletes backward to the match
keys: d?a<CR>
in: "xa bˇc"
out: "xˇc"
mode: n

=== Visual extends to a search match
keys: v/c<CR>
in: "ˇabc"
out: "«abˇc"
mode: v

=== * searches the whole word forward
keys: *
in: "ˇfoo foobar foo"
out: "foo foobar ˇfoo"
mode: n
reg: / v "\\<foo\\>"

=== g* matches inside words
keys: g*
in: "ˇfoo foobar foo"
out: "foo ˇfoobar foo"
mode: n
reg: / v "foo"

=== # searches the whole word backward
keys: #
in: "foo bar ˇfoo"
out: "ˇfoo bar foo"
mode: n

=== * takes the keyword after the cursor
keys: *
in: "ˇ(foo) foo"
out: "(foo) ˇfoo"
mode: n

=== * ignores smartcase but honours ignorecase
set: ignorecase smartcase
keys: *
in: "ˇFoo x foo"
out: "Foo x ˇfoo"
mode: n

=== smartcase: an upper-case letter makes the search case-sensitive
set: ignorecase smartcase
keys: /Foo<CR>
in: "ˇx foo Foo"
out: "x foo ˇFoo"
mode: n

=== smartcase: all lower case ignores case
set: ignorecase smartcase
keys: /foo<CR>
in: "ˇx Foo"
out: "x ˇFoo"
mode: n

=== \c forces ignore case
keys: /\cfoo<CR>
in: "ˇx Foo"
out: "x ˇFoo"
mode: n

=== \C forces case over ignorecase
set: ignorecase
keys: /\Cfoo<CR>
in: "ˇx Foo foo"
out: "x Foo ˇfoo"
mode: n

=== \n matches the line break
keys: /a\nc<CR>
in: "ˇa\nb\na\nc"
out: "a\nb\nˇa\nc"
mode: n

=== \_s matches blanks and line breaks
keys: /a\_s\+b<CR>
in: "ˇx a\n b"
out: "x ˇa\n b"
mode: n

=== \%^ never matches in the middle of the file
keys: /\%^foo<CR>
in: "ˇx\nfoo"
out: "ˇx\nfoo"
mode: n

=== \%$ matches only at the end of the file
keys: /foo\%$<CR>
in: "ˇfoo\nfoo"
out: "foo\nˇfoo"
mode: n

=== ^ anchors at a line start
keys: /^b<CR>
in: "ˇab\nb"
out: "ab\nˇb"
mode: n

=== $ anchors at a line end
keys: /b$<CR>
in: "ˇba\nab"
out: "ba\naˇb"
mode: n

=== \< is a word start
keys: /\<foo<CR>
in: "ˇxfoo foo"
out: "xfoo ˇfoo"
mode: n

=== \> is a word end
keys: /foo\><CR>
in: "ˇfoox foo"
out: "foox ˇfoo"
mode: n

=== very magic
keys: /\va+b<CR>
in: "ˇab aab"
out: "ab ˇaab"
mode: n

=== nomagic: . is literal
keys: /\Ma.b<CR>
in: "ˇx axb a.b"
out: "x axb ˇa.b"
mode: n

=== very nomagic: * is literal
keys: /\Va*b<CR>
in: "ˇx aab a*b"
out: "x aab ˇa*b"
mode: n

=== a backreference
keys: /\(.\)\1<CR>
in: "ˇab cc"
out: "ab ˇcc"
mode: n

=== \zs starts the match later
keys: /foo\zsbar<CR>
in: "ˇx foobar"
out: "x fooˇbar"
mode: n

=== \ze needs what follows
keys: /foo\zebar<CR>
in: "ˇx foo foobar"
out: "x foo ˇfoobar"
mode: n

=== \%3l only on line 3
keys: /\%3lfoo<CR>
in: "ˇfoo\nfoo\nfoo"
out: "foo\nfoo\nˇfoo"
mode: n

=== \%5c only in byte column 5
keys: /\%5cx<CR>
in: "ˇx x x x"
out: "x x ˇx x"
mode: n

=== \%5v counts tabs as screen columns
keys: /\%5vx<CR>
in: "ˇa\n\tx"
out: "a\n\tˇx"
mode: n

=== \%V only inside the last Visual area
keys: vl<Esc>0/\%Vb<CR>
in: "ˇab b"
out: "aˇb b"
mode: n

=== the search history recalls the last pattern
keys: /foo<CR>0/<Up><CR>
in: "ˇx foo y foo"
out: "x ˇfoo y foo"
mode: n

=== Esc cancels the search
keys: /foo<Esc>
in: "ˇx foo"
out: "ˇx foo"
mode: n

=== Ctrl-R inserts a register into the search
keys: yiw/<C-r>"<CR>
in: "ˇfoo x foo"
out: "foo x ˇfoo"
mode: n

=== / continues after the match at the cursor (cpo-c): no overlapping match
keys: /aa<CR>
in: "ˇaaaa"
out: "aaˇaa"
mode: n

=== \%$ matches the last line of a file that ends in a line break
keys: /foo\%$<CR>
in: "ˇfoo\nfoo"
out: "foo\nˇfoo"
mode: n

=== \%$ matches the last line of a file without a final line break (eol: off)
keys: /foo\%$<CR>
in: "ˇfoo\nfoo"
out: "foo\nˇfoo"
mode: n
eol: off

=== /^$ never stops after the final line break
keys: /^$<CR>
in: "a\n\nˇb"
out: "a\nˇ\nb"
mode: n

=== /^$ in a file without a final line break (eol: off)
keys: /^$<CR>
in: "a\n\nˇb"
out: "a\nˇ\nb"
mode: n
eol: off
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimSearchCommands.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimSearchCommands.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Core/Utf8.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimCursorModel.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    VimPatternOptions VimPatternOptionsFor(const VimContext& ctx, bool ignoreSmartcase)
    {
        VimPatternOptions o;
        o.ignorecase = ctx.options.ignorecase;
        o.smartcase = ctx.options.smartcase;
        o.ignoreSmartcase = ignoreSmartcase;
        o.kClass = ctx.chars.PcreClass();
        o.kClassNoDigits = ctx.chars.PcreClassNoDigits();
        o.lastSubstitute = ctx.globals.search.lastSubReplacement;
        return o;
    }

    std::optional<ByteRange> VimLastVisualArea(const VimContext& ctx)
    {
        if (!ctx.bufferState.hasLastVisual) return std::nullopt;
        const std::optional<ByteOffset> lt = ctx.bufferState.marks.Get(U'<');
        const std::optional<ByteOffset> gt = ctx.bufferState.marks.Get(U'>');
        if (!lt || !gt) return std::nullopt;
        const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
        if (ctx.bufferState.lastVisualMode == VimMode::VisualLine)
            return ByteRange{ r.LineStart(VimText::RowOf(r, *lt)), std::min<ByteOffset>(r.LineEnd(VimText::RowOf(r, *gt)) + 1, r.Size()) };
        return VimCursorModel::VisualRange(r, *lt, *gt);
    }

    VimSearchEnv VimSearchEnvFor(const VimContext& ctx)
    {
        VimSearchEnv env{ ctx.Text(), ctx.globals.scratch };   // the one vim MatchScratch (TE5a-13); the editor sets its limits
        env.multilineMaxBytes = ctx.options.multilineSearchMaxBytes;
        env.tabSize = ctx.options.tabSize;
        env.visualArea = VimLastVisualArea(ctx);
        return env;
    }

    std::expected<VimPatternHandle, std::string> VimCompileForContext(VimContext& ctx, std::string_view vimPattern, bool ignoreSmartcase)
    {
        const auto t = VimPattern::Translate(vimPattern, VimPatternOptionsFor(ctx, ignoreSmartcase));
        if (!t) return std::unexpected(t.error().message);
        return ctx.bufferState.patterns.Get(*t);
    }

    std::optional<std::pair<ByteOffset, std::string>> VimWordForStar(const VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset at)
    {
        const Rope& r = ctx.Text();
        const std::uint32_t row = VimText::RowOf(r, at);
        const ByteOffset start = r.LineStart(row), end = r.LineEnd(row);
        const auto find = [&](auto&& in) -> std::optional<std::pair<ByteOffset, std::string>> {
            ByteOffset s = at;
            if (s < end && in(VimText::CodePointAt(r, s)))
            {
                while (s > start && in(VimText::CodePointAt(r, VimText::PrevChar(r, s)))) s = VimText::PrevChar(r, s);
            }
            else
            {
                while (s < end && !in(VimText::CodePointAt(r, s))) s = VimText::NextChar(r, s);
            }
            if (s >= end) return std::nullopt;
            ByteOffset e = s;
            while (e < end && in(VimText::CodePointAt(r, e))) e = VimText::NextChar(r, e);
            std::string word;
            r.CopyTo(ByteRange{ s, e }, word);
            return std::make_pair(s, std::move(word));
        };
        if (auto k = find([&](char32_t c) { return ctx.chars.IsWord(c); })) return k;
        return find([](char32_t c) { return c != U' ' && c != U'\t'; });
    }

    std::string VimStarPattern(const VimCharClass& chars, std::string_view word, bool partial)
    {
        const std::string body = VimPattern::EscapeForStar(word);
        if (partial || word.empty()) return body;
        const Utf8::Unit first = Utf8::DecodeAt(word, 0);
        std::size_t lastAt = word.size() - 1;
        while (lastAt > 0 && (static_cast<unsigned char>(word[lastAt]) & 0xC0) == 0x80) --lastAt;
        const Utf8::Unit last = Utf8::DecodeAt(word, lastAt);
        return (chars.IsWord(first.cp) ? "\\<" : "") + body + (chars.IsWord(last.cp) ? "\\>" : "");
    }

    void VimPushHistory(std::vector<std::string>& history, std::string entry)
    {
        if (entry.empty()) return;
        std::erase(history, entry);
        history.push_back(std::move(entry));
        if (history.size() > kVimHistoryMax) history.erase(history.begin(), history.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(history.size() - kVimHistoryMax));
    }

    std::optional<VimMotionTarget> ResolveSearchMotion(VimContext& ctx, ByteOffset from, const VimMotionArgs& args)
    {
        VimSearchState& s = ctx.globals.search;
        bool forward = true;
        switch (args.id)
        {
        case VimMotionId::SearchNext: forward = s.lastForward; break;
        case VimMotionId::SearchPrev: forward = !s.lastForward; break;
        case VimMotionId::SearchWordFwd:
        case VimMotionId::SearchWordBack:
        case VimMotionId::SearchPartialFwd:
        case VimMotionId::SearchPartialBack:
        {
            const auto word = VimWordForStar(ctx, from);
            if (!word) { ctx.host.ShowMessage("E348: No string under cursor", true); return std::nullopt; }
            const bool partial = args.id == VimMotionId::SearchPartialFwd || args.id == VimMotionId::SearchPartialBack;
            s.lastPattern = VimStarPattern(ctx.chars, word->second, partial);
            s.lastForward = args.id == VimMotionId::SearchWordFwd || args.id == VimMotionId::SearchPartialFwd;
            s.lastNoSmartcase = true;
            ctx.globals.registers.SetSpecial(U'/', s.lastPattern);
            VimPushHistory(ctx.globals.searchHistory, s.lastPattern);
            forward = s.lastForward;
            from = word->first;           // vim searches from the start of the word
            break;
        }
        default:
            return std::nullopt;
        }
        if (s.lastPattern.empty()) { ctx.host.ShowMessage("E35: No previous regular expression", true); return std::nullopt; }
        const auto compiled = VimCompileForContext(ctx, s.lastPattern, s.lastNoSmartcase);
        if (!compiled) { ctx.host.ShowMessage(compiled.error(), true); return std::nullopt; }
        const VimSearchEnv env = VimSearchEnvFor(ctx);
        ByteOffset at = from;
        bool wrapped = false;
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < args.Count1(); ++i)
        {
            const VimFindResult f = VimFindNext(env, **compiled, at, forward, ctx.options.wrapscan);
            if (f.status != VimSearchStatus::Found)
            {
                ctx.host.ShowMessage(VimSearchMessage(f.status, s.lastPattern, forward, ctx.options.wrapscan), true);
                return std::nullopt;
            }
            wrapped = wrapped || f.wrapped;
            at = f.match.range.begin;
        }
        s.highlight = ctx.options.hlsearch;
        ctx.host.SetSearchHighlight(s.highlight ? std::string_view((*compiled)->Pattern().pcre2) : std::string_view());
        if (wrapped) ctx.host.ShowMessage(forward ? "search hit BOTTOM, continuing at TOP" : "search hit TOP, continuing at BOTTOM", false);
        VimMotionTarget t;
        t.offset = at;
        t.kind = MotionKind::Exclusive;
        t.jump = true;
        return t;
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCommandLine.cpp
// The command line (spec s6.2 "command line (: / ?)"): typing, editing keys,
// history, Ctrl-R {reg}, Esc, Enter. Search lines become a SearchNext motion
// for the command that opened them; ex lines go to RunExLine (TE5c-6).
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimSearchCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        std::size_t PrevUtf8(const std::string& s, std::size_t i)
        {
            if (i == 0) return 0;
            --i;
            while (i > 0 && (static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]) & 0xC0) == 0x80) --i;
            return i;
        }

        std::size_t NextUtf8(const std::string& s, std::size_t i)
        {
            if (i >= s.size()) return s.size();
            ++i;
            while (i < s.size() && (static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]) & 0xC0) == 0x80) ++i;
            return i;
        }

        bool IsWordByte(char c)
        {
            const auto u = static_cast<unsigned char>(c);
            return u >= 0x80 || std::isalnum(u) || c == '_';
        }

        // The pattern part of a search line: up to the first unescaped delimiter.
        std::size_t PatternEnd(const std::string& text, char delim)
        {
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < text.size(); ++i)
            {
                if (text[i] == '\\') { ++i; continue; }
                if (text[i] == delim) return i;
            }
            return std::string::npos;
        }
    }

    void VimState::BeginSearchCommandLine(const VimParsed& p)
    {
        EnterCommandLine(p.Id<VimMotionId>() == VimMotionId::SearchFwd ? CmdLineKind::SearchForward : CmdLineKind::SearchBackward,
                         std::string(), p);
    }

    void VimState::EnterCommandLine(CmdLineKind kind, std::string initial, std::optional<VimParsed> pending)
    {
        m_cmdline = CommandLine{};
        m_cmdline.kind = kind;
        m_cmdline.text = std::move(initial);
        m_cmdline.cursor = m_cmdline.text.size();
        m_cmdline.pending = std::move(pending);
        m_cmdline.returnMode = IsVisual(m_mode) ? m_mode : VimMode::Normal;
        m_cmdline.savedFirstRow = m_host.FirstVisibleRow();
        m_mode = VimMode::CommandLine;
        ShowCommandLine();
    }

    void VimState::ShowCommandLine()
    {
        const char prefix = m_cmdline.kind == CmdLineKind::SearchForward ? '/' : m_cmdline.kind == CmdLineKind::SearchBackward ? '?' : ':';
        m_host.SetCommandLine(std::string(1, prefix) + m_cmdline.text, 1 + m_cmdline.cursor);
    }

    void VimState::LeaveCommandLine(bool cancelled)
    {
        const bool search = m_cmdline.kind == CmdLineKind::SearchForward || m_cmdline.kind == CmdLineKind::SearchBackward;
        m_host.SetCommandLine("", 0);
        m_mode = m_cmdline.returnMode;
        if (search && cancelled)
        {
            m_host.ScrollToRow(m_cmdline.savedFirstRow);
            std::string paint;
            if (m_globals.search.highlight && !m_globals.search.lastPattern.empty())
            {
                VimContext ctx = Context();
                if (const auto c = VimCompileForContext(ctx, m_globals.search.lastPattern, m_globals.search.lastNoSmartcase)) paint = (*c)->Pattern().pcre2;
            }
            m_host.SetSearchHighlight(paint);
        }
        if (m_mode == VimMode::Normal) ClampCursors();
    }

    void VimState::BrowseHistory(bool older)
    {
        CommandLine& cl = m_cmdline;
        const std::vector<std::string>& history = cl.kind == CmdLineKind::Ex ? m_globals.commandHistory : m_globals.searchHistory;
        if (!cl.browsing)
        {
            cl.browsing = true;
            cl.historyPrefix = cl.text;
            cl.historyIndex = history.size();
        }
        if (older)
        {
            for (std::size_t i = cl.historyIndex; i-- > 0;)
                if (history[i].starts_with(cl.historyPrefix)) { cl.historyIndex = i; cl.text = history[i]; break; }
        }
        else
        {
            std::size_t i = cl.historyIndex + 1;
            while (i < history.size() && !history[i].starts_with(cl.historyPrefix)) ++i;
            cl.historyIndex = std::min(i, history.size());
            cl.text = cl.historyIndex < history.size() ? history[cl.historyIndex] : cl.historyPrefix;
        }
        cl.cursor = cl.text.size();
    }

    void VimState::UpdateIncrementalSearch()
    {
        const bool search = m_cmdline.kind == CmdLineKind::SearchForward || m_cmdline.kind == CmdLineKind::SearchBackward;
        if (!search || !m_options.incsearch) return;
        const bool forward = m_cmdline.kind == CmdLineKind::SearchForward;
        std::string pattern = m_cmdline.text.substr(0, std::min(m_cmdline.text.size(), PatternEnd(m_cmdline.text, forward ? '/' : '?')));
        if (pattern.empty()) { m_host.SetSearchHighlight(""); return; }
        VimContext ctx = Context();
        const auto compiled = VimCompileForContext(ctx, pattern, false);
        if (!compiled) { m_host.SetSearchHighlight(""); return; }
        const ByteOffset from = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].head;
        const VimFindResult f = VimFindNext(VimSearchEnvFor(ctx), **compiled, from, forward, m_options.wrapscan);
        if (f.status != VimSearchStatus::Found) { m_host.SetSearchHighlight(""); return; }
        m_host.SetSearchHighlight((*compiled)->Pattern().pcre2);
        const std::uint32_t row = m_doc.display.BufferRowToDisplay(VimText::RowOf(m_doc.buffer.Text(), f.match.range.begin));
        const std::uint32_t first = m_host.FirstVisibleRow(), rows = std::max(1u, m_host.VisibleRows());
        if (row < first || row >= first + rows) m_host.ScrollToRow(row > rows / 2 ? row - rows / 2 : 0);
    }

    VimKeyResult VimState::HandleCommandLine(const VimKey& key)
    {
        CommandLine& cl = m_cmdline;
        cl.typed.push_back(key);
        if (cl.awaitingRegister)
        {
            cl.awaitingRegister = false;
            if (key.IsChar())
                if (const auto v = m_globals.registers.Get(key.ch, m_host, m_options))
                {
                    std::string text = v->Text();
                    while (!text.empty() && text.back() == '\n') text.pop_back();
                    std::replace(text.begin(), text.end(), '\n', '\r');
                    cl.text.insert(cl.cursor, text);
                    cl.cursor += text.size();
                }
            cl.browsing = false;
            UpdateIncrementalSearch();
            ShowCommandLine();
            return {};
        }
        if (key.IsEsc() || (key.ctrl && key.ch == U'c')) { LeaveCommandLine(true); return {}; }
        if (key.named == VimNamedKey::Enter && !key.ctrl) { SubmitCommandLine(); return {}; }
        bool edited = false;
        const auto backspace = [&]() -> bool {
            if (cl.text.empty()) { LeaveCommandLine(true); return false; }
            const std::size_t p = PrevUtf8(cl.text, cl.cursor);
            cl.text.erase(p, cl.cursor - p);
            cl.cursor = p;
            edited = true;
            return true;
        };
        if (key.ctrl)
        {
            switch (key.ch)
            {
            case U'u': cl.text.erase(0, cl.cursor); cl.cursor = 0; edited = true; break;
            case U'w':
            {
                std::size_t s = cl.cursor;
                while (s > 0 && cl.text[s - 1] == ' ') --s;
                const bool word = s > 0 && IsWordByte(cl.text[s - 1]);
                while (s > 0 && cl.text[s - 1] != ' ' && IsWordByte(cl.text[s - 1]) == word) --s;
                cl.text.erase(s, cl.cursor - s);
                cl.cursor = s;
                edited = true;
                break;
            }
            case U'h': if (!backspace()) return {}; break;
            case U'r': cl.awaitingRegister = true; ShowCommandLine(); return {};
            case U'b': cl.cursor = 0; break;
            case U'e': cl.cursor = cl.text.size(); break;
            case U'p': BrowseHistory(true); break;
            case U'n': BrowseHistory(false); break;
            default: break;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            switch (key.named)
            {
            case VimNamedKey::Backspace: if (!backspace()) return {}; break;
            case VimNamedKey::Delete:
                if (cl.cursor < cl.text.size()) { cl.text.erase(cl.cursor, NextUtf8(cl.text, cl.cursor) - cl.cursor); edited = true; }
                break;
            case VimNamedKey::Left:  cl.cursor = PrevUtf8(cl.text, cl.cursor); break;
            case VimNamedKey::Right: cl.cursor = NextUtf8(cl.text, cl.cursor); break;
            case VimNamedKey::Home:  cl.cursor = 0; break;
            case VimNamedKey::End:   cl.cursor = cl.text.size(); break;
            case VimNamedKey::Up:    BrowseHistory(true); break;
            case VimNamedKey::Down:  BrowseHistory(false); break;
            case VimNamedKey::None:
                if (key.IsChar())
                {
                    std::string utf8;
                    Utf8::Append(utf8, key.ch);
                    cl.text.insert(cl.cursor, utf8);
                    cl.cursor += utf8.size();
                    edited = true;
                }
                break;
            default: break;
            }
        }
        if (edited) cl.browsing = false;
        UpdateIncrementalSearch();
        ShowCommandLine();
        return {};
    }

    void VimState::SubmitSearch(const CommandLine& line)
    {
        const bool forward = line.kind == CmdLineKind::SearchForward;
        const char delim = forward ? '/' : '?';
        std::string pattern = line.text;
        if (const std::size_t end = PatternEnd(pattern, delim); end != std::string::npos)
        {
            if (end + 1 < pattern.size()) { Beep("E: search offsets (/pat/e) are not supported (a documented divergence)"); return; }
            pattern.resize(end);
        }
        if (!forward)
            for (std::size_t i = pattern.find("\\?"); i != std::string::npos; i = pattern.find("\\?", i + 1)) pattern.erase(i, 1);
        if (pattern.empty())
        {
            if (m_globals.search.lastPattern.empty()) { Beep("E35: No previous regular expression"); return; }
        }
        else
        {
            VimPushHistory(m_globals.searchHistory, line.text);
            m_globals.search.lastPattern = pattern;
            m_globals.search.lastNoSmartcase = false;
            m_globals.registers.SetSpecial(U'/', pattern);
        }
        m_globals.search.lastForward = forward;
        VimParsed p = line.pending.value_or(VimParsed{});
        p.kind = VimCmdKind::Motion;
        p.id = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(VimMotionId::SearchNext);
        p.keys.insert(p.keys.end(), line.typed.begin(), line.typed.end());
        Execute(p);
    }

    void VimState::SubmitCommandLine()
    {
        const CommandLine line = m_cmdline;
        LeaveCommandLine(false);
        if (line.kind == CmdLineKind::SearchForward || line.kind == CmdLineKind::SearchBackward) SubmitSearch(line);
    }
}
```

### Task TE5c-6: `:` -- the ex parser with ranges, the ex command table, `:{N}`, `:noh`, `:p` (spec s6.2 command line, s6.3 Ex ranges)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimEx.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimEx.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (ex members)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCommandLine.cpp` (`SubmitCommandLine` gains the ex branch)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimActions.cpp` (`EnterExCommand`)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5c.vimcases` (append)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimExTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE5c-5 command line; `VimMarks::Get` (TE5b-6), `VimGlobalMarks::Get` (TE5b-7), `VimState::RecordJump` (TE5b-8), `VimState::ExitVisual` (TE5a-12), `VimRegisters::SetSpecial` (TE5a-12); `VimCompileForContext`, `VimFindNext` (TE5c-4/5).
- Produces:
  - `VimEx.hpp`: `struct VimExCommand { name, bang, firstRow, lastRow, rangeGiven, args; std::uint32_t line1, line2; /* added: the 1-based addresses as typed (0 allowed) */ }`, `struct VimExSpec { full; minLen; run; range; bang; }` (contract), `struct VimExRangeEnv { currentLine, lastLine, markLine, searchLine }`, `struct VimExRange { line1, line2, addressCount, consumed }`, `std::expected<VimExRange, std::string> ParseExRange(std::string_view, const VimExRangeEnv&)`, `const VimExSpec* LookupExCommand(std::span<const VimExSpec>, std::string_view name)`.
  - `VimState` public `VimHostResult RunExLine(std::string_view line)` (parse + dispatch; `:g`, `:normal` and TE5b's `@:` reuse it); private `RunExWithUndo`, `static std::span<const VimExSpec> ExCommandTable()` holding `kVimExCommands` (Part E adds the `set` row there), `ExGoto`, `ExNohlsearch`, `ExPrint`, helpers `PrimaryRow`, `PlaceCursorKeepColumn`, `PlaceCursorFirstNonBlank`, `CollapseToVimHeads`, and the `:g` state `m_inGlobal`, `m_globalPrint`.

The table is a function-local static inside a `VimState` member so its member-function pointers may name private handlers. Abbreviations follow vim: a typed name matches the first row (in table order) whose full name starts with it and is at least `minLen` long. Each command line runs as one transaction (one undo step). An error message beeps the way vim's `emsg` does: it stops a running macro, `:normal` or mapping (`flush_buffers(FLUSH_MINIMAL)` drops non-typed input), and keys the user types afterwards still run (D-R12).

**Line addresses (finding 5c.5, D-R5).** `ParseExRange` refuses only a negative address (`E16`); an address past the last line is kept as typed. A range with no command is a jump, and vim clamps it: `:999` goes to the last line (`do_one_cmd`: "if (ea.line2 > curbuf->b_ml.ml_line_count) ea.line2 = ml_line_count"). A range given to a command must lie inside the buffer, else `E16: Invalid range`. The last line is `VimText::LineCount` (D-R5): `$` in `"a\nb\n"` is line 2.

```cpp
TEST_CASE("vim ex ranges: addresses, offsets, separators", "[text-vim-ex]")
{
    CHECK(R("").line1 == 3u);
    CHECK(R("").addressCount == 0u);
    CHECK(R("%").line1 == 1u);
    CHECK(R("%").line2 == 10u);
    CHECK(R("5").line2 == 5u);
    CHECK(R(".,$").line2 == 10u);
    const VimExRange m = R("'a,$-1");
    CHECK(m.line1 == 5u);
    CHECK(m.line2 == 9u);
    CHECK(R("+2").line1 == 5u);
    CHECK(R("-").line1 == 2u);
    const VimExRange semi = R(".+1;+2");
    CHECK(semi.line1 == 4u);
    CHECK(semi.line2 == 6u);
    CHECK(R("/foo/").line1 == 7u);
    CHECK(R("?foo?").line1 == 1u);
    const VimExRange swapped = R("4,2");
    CHECK(swapped.line1 == 2u);
    CHECK(swapped.line2 == 4u);
    CHECK(R(",5").line1 == 3u);
    CHECK(R("2,").line2 == 3u);

}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimEx.hpp
#pragma once

// The ex command line (spec s6.3 "Ex"): ranges % . $ N 'a /pat/ ?pat? +n -n
// '<,'> with , and ;, then a command looked up in VimState's ex table by
// vim's abbreviation rule. Lines are 1-based here, as vim writes them.

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimHost.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <expected>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    class VimState;

    struct VimExCommand
    {
        std::string name;              // the table's full name ("substitute")
        bool bang = false;
        std::uint32_t firstRow = 0, lastRow = 0;   // 0-based, clamped to the buffer
        bool rangeGiven = false;
        std::string args;              // after the name and the bang, leading blanks removed
        std::uint32_t line1 = 0, line2 = 0;        // the 1-based addresses as given (0 allowed: :0r, :m0)
    };

    struct VimExSpec
    {
        std::string_view full;
        std::size_t minLen = 1;
        VimHostResult (VimState::*run)(const VimExCommand&) = nullptr;
        bool range = false;            // accepts a range
        bool bang = false;             // accepts !
    };

    struct VimExRangeEnv
    {
        std::uint32_t currentLine = 1;
        std::uint32_t lastLine = 1;
        std::function<std::optional<std::uint32_t>(char32_t)> markLine;                                       // 1-based
        std::function<std::optional<std::uint32_t>(std::string_view, bool forward, std::uint32_t fromLine)> searchLine;
    };

    struct VimExRange
    {
        std::uint32_t line1 = 0, line2 = 0;
        std::size_t addressCount = 0;  // 0 = no range typed
        std::size_t consumed = 0;      // bytes of the input the range used
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<VimExRange, std::string> ParseExRange(std::string_view text, const VimExRangeEnv& env);
    [[nodiscard]] const VimExSpec* LookupExCommand(std::span<const VimExSpec> table, std::string_view name);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimEx.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimEx.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimSearchCommands.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        void SkipBlanks(std::string_view s, std::size_t& i) { while (i < s.size() && (s[i] == ' ' || s[i] == '\t')) ++i; }

        // One address at s[i]; nullopt (and i unchanged) when there is none.
        std::expected<std::optional<std::int64_t>, std::string> ParseAddress(std::string_view s, std::size_t& i, std::int64_t cur,
                                                                            const VimExRangeEnv& env)
        {
            SkipBlanks(s, i);
            std::optional<std::int64_t> value;
            if (i < s.size())
            {
                const char c = s[i];
                if (c == '.') { value = cur; ++i; }
                else if (c == '$') { value = env.lastLine; ++i; }
                else if (std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)))
                {
                    std::int64_t n = 0;
                    while (i < s.size() && std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]))) n = std::min<std::int64_t>(n * 10 + (s[i++] - '0'), INT32_MAX);
                    value = n;
                }
                else if (c == '\'' && i + 1 < s.size())
                {
                    const char32_t name = static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i + 1]);
                    const auto line = env.markLine ? env.markLine(name) : std::nullopt;
                    if (!line) return std::unexpected(std::string("E20: Mark not set"));
                    value = *line;
                    i += 2;
                }
                else if (c == '/' || c == '?')
                {
                    std::size_t j = i + 1;
                    std::string pat;
                    while (j < s.size() && s[j] != c)
                    {
                        if (s[j] == '\\' && j + 1 < s.size())
                        {
                            if (s[j + 1] == c && c == '?') { pat += c; j += 2; continue; }
                            pat += s[j];
                            pat += s[j + 1];
                            j += 2;
                            continue;
                        }
                        pat += s[j++];
                    }
                    const auto line = env.searchLine ? env.searchLine(pat, c == '/', static_cast<std::uint32_t>(cur)) : std::nullopt;
                    if (!line) return std::unexpected("E486: Pattern not found: " + pat);
                    value = *line;
                    i = j < s.size() ? j + 1 : j;
                }
            }
            while (i < s.size() && (s[i] == '+' || s[i] == '-'))
            {
                const int sign = s[i] == '+' ? 1 : -1;
                ++i;
                std::int64_t n = 1;
                if (i < s.size() && std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i])))
                {
                    n = 0;
                    while (i < s.size() && std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]))) n = std::min<std::int64_t>(n * 10 + (s[i++] - '0'), INT32_MAX);
                }
                value = value.value_or(cur) + sign * n;
            }
            return value;
        }
    }

    std::expected<VimExRange, std::string> ParseExRange(std::string_view s, const VimExRangeEnv& env)
    {
        VimExRange out;
        std::size_t i = 0;
        while (i < s.size() && (s[i] == ' ' || s[i] == ':')) ++i;
        if (i < s.size() && s[i] == '%')
        {
            out.line1 = env.lastLine > 0 ? 1 : 0;
            out.line2 = env.lastLine;
            out.addressCount = 2;
            out.consumed = i + 1;
            return out;
        }
        std::int64_t cur = env.currentLine;
        std::vector<std::int64_t> addrs;
        for (;;)
        {
            auto a = ParseAddress(s, i, cur, env);
            if (!a) return std::unexpected(a.error());
            if (*a)
            {
                // Only a negative line is refused here. Past the last line is kept as typed: a bare range
                // clamps it (:999 -> the last line), a command refuses it with E16 (RunExLine).
                if (**a < 0) return std::unexpected(std::string("E16: Invalid range"));
                addrs.push_back(std::min<std::int64_t>(**a, INT32_MAX));
            }
            SkipBlanks(s, i);
            if (i < s.size() && (s[i] == ',' || s[i] == ';'))
            {
                if (!*a) addrs.push_back(cur);                              // ",5" = ".,5"
                if (s[i] == ';') cur = addrs.back();
                ++i;
                std::size_t peek = i;
                SkipBlanks(s, peek);
                const bool more = peek < s.size() && (std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(s[peek])) || std::string_view(".$'/?+-").find(s[peek]) != std::string_view::npos);
                if (!more) { addrs.push_back(cur); break; }                 // "2," = "2,."
                continue;
            }
            break;
        }
        out.consumed = i;
        if (addrs.empty()) { out.line1 = out.line2 = env.currentLine; return out; }
        out.addressCount = std::min<std::size_t>(addrs.size(), 2);
        out.line2 = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(addrs.back());
        out.line1 = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(addrs.size() >= 2 ? addrs[addrs.size() - 2] : addrs.back());
        if (out.line1 > out.line2) std::swap(out.line1, out.line2);       // vim asks "Backwards range given, OK to swap"; Arcane swaps
        return out;
    }

    const VimExSpec* LookupExCommand(std::span<const VimExSpec> table, std::string_view name)
    {
        if (name.empty()) return nullptr;
        for (const VimExSpec& spec : table)
            if (name.size() >= spec.minLen && spec.full.starts_with(name)) return &spec;
        return nullptr;
    }

    std::span<const VimExSpec> VimState::ExCommandTable()
    {
        static const VimExSpec kVimExCommands[] = {
            { "print",      1, &VimState::ExPrint,      true,  false },
            { "nohlsearch", 3, &VimState::ExNohlsearch, false, false },
        };
        return kVimExCommands;
    }

    std::uint32_t VimState::PrimaryRow() const
    {
        return VimText::RowOf(m_doc.buffer.Text(), m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].head);
    }

    void VimState::PlaceCursorKeepColumn(std::uint32_t row)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        row = std::min(row, VimText::LastRow(r));                 // D-R5
        const Selection& s = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()];
        const std::uint32_t vcol = s.goalColumn.value_or(VimText::VirtualColumn(r, s.head, m_options.tabSize));
        const ByteOffset o = vcol == VimText::kGoalEol ? r.LineEnd(row) : VimText::OffsetForVirtualColumn(r, row, vcol, m_options.tabSize);
        const ByteOffset clamped = VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, o);
        VimText::Select(m_doc, { Selection{ s.id, clamped, clamped, vcol } }, 0);
    }

    void VimState::PlaceCursorFirstNonBlank(std::uint32_t row)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        row = std::min(row, VimText::LastRow(r));                 // D-R5
        const Selection& s = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()];
        const ByteOffset o = VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, VimText::FirstNonBlank(r, row));
        VimText::Select(m_doc, { Selection{ s.id, o, o, std::nullopt } }, 0);
    }

    void VimState::CollapseToVimHeads(const std::vector<VimCursor>& cursors)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<Selection> sels = VimText::Selections(m_doc);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sels.size() && i < cursors.size(); ++i)
        {
            const ByteOffset o = VimCursorModel::Clamp(r, cursors[i].head);
            sels[i].anchor = sels[i].head = o;
            sels[i].goalColumn.reset();
        }
        VimText::Select(m_doc, std::move(sels), VimText::PrimaryIndex(m_doc));
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExGoto(std::uint32_t line)
    {
        const ByteOffset before = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].head;
        RecordJump(before);
        PlaceCursorKeepColumn(line == 0 ? 0 : line - 1);
        return {};
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExNohlsearch(const VimExCommand&)
    {
        m_globals.search.highlight = false;
        m_host.SetSearchHighlight("");
        return {};
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExPrint(const VimExCommand& cmd)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::vector<std::string> lines;
        for (std::uint32_t row = cmd.firstRow; row <= cmd.lastRow; ++row) lines.push_back(VimText::Line(r, row));
        if (m_inGlobal) { for (std::string& l : lines) m_globalPrint.push_back(std::move(l)); return {}; }
        if (lines.size() == 1) return VimHostResult{ true, lines.front() };
        m_host.ShowListing(":print", lines);
        return {};
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::RunExLine(std::string_view line)
    {
        const Rope& rope = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        VimExRangeEnv env;
        env.currentLine = PrimaryRow() + 1;
        env.lastLine = VimText::LineCount(rope);                   // D-R5: "a\nb\n" has 2 lines
        env.markLine = [this](char32_t name) -> std::optional<std::uint32_t> {
            const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
            if (name >= U'A' && name <= U'Z')
            {
                const auto g = m_globals.globalMarks.Get(name);
                if (g && g->path == m_host.DocumentPath()) return g->point.row + 1;
                return std::nullopt;
            }
            const auto at = m_bufferState.marks.Get(name);
            if (!at) return std::nullopt;
            return VimText::RowOf(r, *at) + 1;
        };
        env.searchLine = [this](std::string_view pat, bool forward, std::uint32_t fromLine) -> std::optional<std::uint32_t> {
            std::string p(pat);
            if (p.empty()) p = m_globals.search.lastPattern;
            else m_globals.search.lastPattern = p;
            if (p.empty()) return std::nullopt;
            VimContext ctx = Context();
            const auto c = VimCompileForContext(ctx, p, false);
            if (!c) return std::nullopt;
            const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
            const std::uint32_t row = fromLine == 0 ? 0 : fromLine - 1;
            const ByteOffset from = forward ? r.LineEnd(row) : r.LineStart(row);   // vim: the next / previous line on
            const VimFindResult f = VimFindNext(VimSearchEnvFor(ctx), **c, from, forward, m_options.wrapscan);
            if (f.status != VimSearchStatus::Found) return std::nullopt;
            return VimText::RowOf(r, f.match.range.begin) + 1;
        };
        const auto range = ParseExRange(line, env);
        if (!range) return VimHostResult{ false, range.error() };
        std::string_view rest = line.substr(range->consumed);
        std::size_t i = 0;
        while (i < rest.size() && rest[i] == ' ') ++i;
        rest.remove_prefix(i);
        if (rest.empty())
        {
            // a bare range is a jump; vim clamps a line past the end to the last line (finding 5c.5)
            if (range->addressCount > 0) return ExGoto(std::min(range->line2, env.lastLine));
            return {};
        }
        std::size_t n = 0;
        if (std::isalpha(static_cast<unsigned char>(rest[0])))
            while (n < rest.size() && std::isalpha(static_cast<unsigned char>(rest[n]))) ++n;
        else if (std::string_view("&<>=~#").find(rest[0]) != std::string_view::npos)
            n = 1;
        const std::string_view name = rest.substr(0, n);
        const VimExSpec* spec = LookupExCommand(ExCommandTable(), name);
        if (!spec) return VimHostResult{ false, "E492: Not an editor command: " + std::string(line) };
        bool bang = false;
        std::size_t a = n;
        if (a < rest.size() && rest[a] == '!') { bang = true; ++a; }
        if (bang && !spec->bang) return VimHostResult{ false, "E477: No ! allowed" };
        if (range->addressCount > 0 && !spec->range) return VimHostResult{ false, "E481: No range allowed" };
        if (range->line1 > env.lastLine || range->line2 > env.lastLine) return VimHostResult{ false, "E16: Invalid range" };
        while (a < rest.size() && (rest[a] == ' ' || rest[a] == '\t')) ++a;
        VimExCommand cmd;
        cmd.name = std::string(spec->full);
        cmd.bang = bang;
        cmd.args = std::string(rest.substr(a));
        cmd.rangeGiven = range->addressCount > 0;
        cmd.line1 = range->line1;
        cmd.line2 = range->line2;
        const std::uint32_t last = VimText::LastRow(rope);
        cmd.firstRow = std::min(range->line1 == 0 ? 0u : range->line1 - 1, last);
        cmd.lastRow = std::min(range->line2 == 0 ? 0u : range->line2 - 1, last);
        return (this->*spec->run)(cmd);
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::RunExWithUndo(std::string_view line)
    {
        m_doc.buffer.BeginTransaction(m_doc.selections);
        const VimHostResult r = RunExLine(line);
        m_doc.buffer.EndTransaction(m_doc.selections);
        if (m_mode != VimMode::CommandLine) m_doc.buffer.BreakUndoGroup();   // :s///c keeps its transaction open (TE5c-9)
        if (!r.message.empty()) m_host.ShowMessage(r.message, !r.ok);
        if (!r.ok) m_beeped = true;                       // vim's emsg: a macro / :normal / mapping stops; typed keys go on
        return r;
    }
}
```

```cpp
    {

    }
```

### Task TE5c-7: `:d :y :m :t :co :> :< :j :normal` (spec s6.3 Ex)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExCommands.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimEx.cpp` (table rows)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (handler declarations)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5c.vimcases` (append)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimExEditTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimRegisters::Store` with `VimRegisterOp::Delete/Yank`, `VimRegisterValue{ parts, Linewise }` (TE5a-12); `VimCursorModel::LinewiseText/LinewiseDeleteRange`; `VimState::FeedKeys(std::span<const VimKey>, bool remap)` (TE5b-4); `VimLanguage::lineComment` (formatoptions+=j for `:j`); TE5c-6 `RunExLine`, `ParseExRange`, cursor helpers.
- Produces: handlers `ExDelete`, `ExYank`, `ExMove` (a deletion plus an insertion, never one region replacement), `ExCopy`, `ExShiftRight`, `ExShiftLeft`, `ExJoin`, `ExNormal`; free helpers in `VimExCommands.cpp`: `ExRowsEdit` (replace rows by lines), `JoinRowsText` (vim's do_join: leading white removed, one space unless the line ends in white space or the next starts with `)`, comment leader dropped when both lines are line comments, nojoinspaces).

Cursor rules follow vim's ex code with Neovim's `nostartofline`: `:d` and `:j` leave the cursor on the first non-blank (`beginline(BL_WHITE)`), `:m`/`:t` on the last moved/copied line in the remembered column, `:>`/`:<` on the first non-blank of the last shifted line (vim's `set_indent` ends with the cursor column at the new indent; D-R12 corrected the `:<` case to `"    ˇa"`), `:y` does not move. Each command line is one undo step (TE5c-6).

`:m` is two edits, a deletion of the moved lines and an insertion at the destination, never one replacement of the whole region between them (finding 5c.3): a replacement would collapse every anchor inside the region, and `:g` marks its lines with anchors, so `:g/x/m$` would lose the lines still to be visited. With two edits the lines between keep their anchors (and their marks). Line counts follow D-R5 (`VimText::LineCount`/`LastRow`).

```cpp
TEST_CASE("vim ex: :d with ranges, a register and a count", "[text-vim-ex]")
{
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc"); r.Keys(":2d<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\n\xCB\x87" "c"); CHECK(Reg(r, U'"') == "b\n"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc"); r.Keys(":%d<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc\nd"); r.Keys(":2,3d<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\n\xCB\x87" "d"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc"); r.Keys(":d x 2<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "c"); CHECK(Reg(r, U'x') == "a\nb\n"); }
    { VimRig r("a\n\xCB\x87" "  b"); r.Keys(":1d<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "  \xCB\x87" "b"); }
}

TEST_CASE("vim ex: :y keeps the cursor", "[text-vim-ex]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc");
    r.Keys(":1,2y<CR>");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc");
    CHECK(Reg(r, U'0') == "a\nb\n");
    r.Keys(":3y q<CR>");
    CHECK(Reg(r, U'q') == "c\n");
}

TEST_CASE("vim ex: :m keeps the anchors of the lines it does not move (two edits)", "[text-vim-ex]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "x1\na\nx2\nb");
    r.Keys("jjmq");                                       // a mark on x2, a line between the moved line and $
    r.Keys(":1m$<CR>");
    CHECK(r.Text() == "a\nx2\nb\nx1");
    REQUIRE(r.bufferState.marks.Get(U'q').has_value());
    CHECK(*r.bufferState.marks.Get(U'q') == 2u);          // still on x2 (row 1), not collapsed to the region start
    VimRig e("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc\n");                     // D-R5: $ is line 3; the final '\n' stays the last byte
    e.Keys(":1m$<CR>");
    CHECK(e.Text() == "b\nc\na\n");
}

TEST_CASE("vim ex: :m and :t / :co", "[text-vim-ex]")
{
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc"); r.Keys(":1m$<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "b\nc\n\xCB\x87" "a"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc"); r.Keys(":3m0<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "c\na\nb"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc\nd"); r.Keys(":1,2m3<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "c\na\n\xCB\x87" "b\nd"); }
    {
        VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc\nd");
        r.Keys(":1,3m2<CR>");
        CHECK(r.host.messages.back().first.starts_with("E134"));
        CHECK(r.Text() == "a\nb\nc\nd");
    }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb"); r.Keys(":1t.<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\n\xCB\x87" "a\nb"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb"); r.Keys(":2co0<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "b\na\nb"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb"); r.Keys(":1t$<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\nb\n\xCB\x87" "a"); }
}

TEST_CASE("vim ex: :> :< shift by shiftwidth; the cursor ends on the last line's first non-blank", "[text-vim-ex]")
{
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a"); r.Keys(":><CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "    \xCB\x87" "a"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a"); r.Keys(":>><CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "        \xCB\x87" "a"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "        a"); r.Keys(":<<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "    \xCB\x87" "a"); }   // D-R12 (was column 0)
    { VimRig r("  x\xCB\x87" "y\nb"); r.Keys(":1,2><CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "      xy\n    \xCB\x87" "b"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\n\nb"); r.Keys(":1,3><CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "    a\n\n    b"); }   // empty lines stay empty
    {
        VimOptions o;
        o.expandTab = false;
        VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a", {}, o);
        r.Keys(":><CR>");
        CHECK(r.Text() == "\ta");                                // noexpandtab: a full tabstop of indent is a tab
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim ex: :j joins with vim's spacing rules", "[text-vim-ex]")
{
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb"); r.Keys(":j<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "a b"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc"); r.Keys(":1,3j<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "a b c"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\n   b"); r.Keys(":j<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "a b"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a \nb"); r.Keys(":j<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "a b"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "f(\n)"); r.Keys(":j<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "f()"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\n b"); r.Keys(":j!<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "a b"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc"); r.Keys(":j 3<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "a b c"); }
    {
        VimLanguage lua;
        lua.lineComment = "--";
        VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "-- one\n-- two", lua);
        r.Keys(":j<CR>");
        CHECK(r.Text() == "-- one two");                       // formatoptions+=j
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim ex: :normal runs keys on each line of the range", "[text-vim-ex]")
{
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "ab"); r.Keys(":normal Ax<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "ab\xCB\x87" "x"); CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Normal); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb"); r.Keys(":%norm Ax<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "ax\nb\xCB\x87" "x"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a b"); r.Keys(":normal dw<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "b"); }
}

TEST_CASE("vim ex: one ex line is one undo step", "[text-vim-ex]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb\nc\nd");
    r.Keys(":2,3d<CR>");
    REQUIRE(r.Commands().Undo());
    CHECK(r.Text() == "a\nb\nc\nd");
    VimRig n("\xCB\x87" "a\nb");
    n.Keys(":%norm Ax<CR>");
    REQUIRE(n.Commands().Undo());
    CHECK(n.Text() == "a\nb");
}
```

```
=== :j with a count
keys: :j 3<CR>
in: "ˇa\nb\nc"
out: "ˇa b c"
mode: n

=== :j drops the comment leader of a joined comment line (formatoptions+=j)
grammar: lua
keys: :j<CR>
in: "ˇ-- one\n-- two"
out: "ˇ-- one two"
mode: n

=== :normal runs Normal-mode keys
keys: :normal Ax<CR>
in: "ˇab"
out: "abˇx"
mode: n

=== :%normal runs on every line
keys: :%norm Ax<CR>
in: "ˇa\nb"
out: "ax\nbˇx"
mode: n

=== :normal with an operator
keys: :normal dw<CR>
in: "ˇa b"
out: "ˇb"
mode: n

=== u undoes a whole ex command
keys: :2,3d<CR>u
in: "ˇa\nb\nc\nd"
out: "a\nˇb\nc\nd"
mode: n
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExCommands.cpp
// Line-editing ex commands (spec s6.3 "Ex"): :d :y :m :t :co :> :< :j :normal.
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <charconv>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        bool IsBlank(char c) { return c == ' ' || c == '\t'; }

        std::string LTrim(std::string_view s)
        {
            std::size_t i = 0;
            while (i < s.size() && IsBlank(s[i])) ++i;
            return std::string(s.substr(i));
        }

        // "[x] [count]" -> register (0 = none) and count (0 = none)
        void RegisterAndCount(std::string_view args, char32_t& reg, std::uint32_t& count)
        {
            reg = 0;
            count = 0;
            std::size_t i = 0;
            while (i < args.size() && IsBlank(args[i])) ++i;
            if (i < args.size() && !std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(args[i]))) reg = static_cast<unsigned char>(args[i++]);
            while (i < args.size() && IsBlank(args[i])) ++i;
            std::from_chars(args.data() + i, args.data() + args.size(), count);
        }

        // One op replacing rows [first, last] with `lines` (joined by '\n').
        EditOp ExRowsEdit(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t first, std::uint32_t last, const std::vector<std::string>& lines)
        {
            std::string text;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < lines.size(); ++i)
            {
                if (i) text.push_back('\n');
                text += lines[i];
            }
            return EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.LineStart(first), r.LineEnd(last) }, std::move(text) };
        }

        std::vector<std::string> Rows(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t first, std::uint32_t last)
        {
            std::vector<std::string> out;
            for (std::uint32_t row = first; row <= last; ++row) out.push_back(VimText::Line(r, row));
            return out;
        }
    }

    // vim's do_join (formatoptions+=j, nojoinspaces): the joined lines' leading
    // white space goes; one space is inserted unless the result ends in white
    // space or the next line starts with ')' or is empty; a line comment
    // leader is dropped when the accumulated line is a line comment too.
    std::string JoinRowsText(const Rope& r, std::uint32_t first, std::uint32_t last, bool insertSpace, std::string_view lineComment)
    {
        std::string out = VimText::Line(r, first);
        const bool firstIsComment = !lineComment.empty() && LTrim(out).starts_with(lineComment);
        for (std::uint32_t row = first + 1; row <= last; ++row)
        {
            std::string next = VimText::Line(r, row);
            if (insertSpace)
            {
                next = LTrim(next);
                if (firstIsComment && next.starts_with(lineComment)) next = LTrim(std::string_view(next).substr(lineComment.size()));
                if (!next.empty() && next.front() != ')' && !out.empty() && !IsBlank(out.back())) out.push_back(' ');
            }
            out += next;
        }
        return out;
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExDelete(const VimExCommand& cmd)
    {
        char32_t reg = 0;
        std::uint32_t count = 0;
        RegisterAndCount(cmd.args, reg, count);
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::uint32_t first = cmd.firstRow, last = cmd.lastRow;
        if (count) { first = cmd.lastRow; last = std::min(first + count - 1, VimText::LastRow(r)); }
        m_globals.registers.Store(reg, VimRegisterValue{ { VimCursorModel::LinewiseText(r, first, last) }, VimRegisterKind::Linewise },
                                  VimRegisterOp::Delete, m_host, m_options);
        const ByteRange range = VimCursorModel::LinewiseDeleteRange(r, first, last);
        const std::uint32_t id = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].id;
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, { EditOp{ range, "" } }, { Selection{ id, range.begin, range.begin, std::nullopt } }, 0);
        PlaceCursorFirstNonBlank(std::min(first, VimText::LastRow(m_doc.buffer.Text())));
        return {};
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExYank(const VimExCommand& cmd)
    {
        char32_t reg = 0;
        std::uint32_t count = 0;
        RegisterAndCount(cmd.args, reg, count);
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::uint32_t first = cmd.firstRow, last = cmd.lastRow;
        if (count) { first = cmd.lastRow; last = std::min(first + count - 1, VimText::LastRow(r)); }
        m_globals.registers.Store(reg, VimRegisterValue{ { VimCursorModel::LinewiseText(r, first, last) }, VimRegisterKind::Linewise },
                                  VimRegisterOp::Yank, m_host, m_options);
        return {};
    }

    // Two edits -- delete the moved rows, insert them at the destination -- so the rows between keep
    // their anchors (:g's line marks, vim marks; finding 5c.3). Rope rows: a buffer ending in '\n' has
    // the empty rope row after it, so "insert before row d" works for d == the vim line count too.
    VimHostResult VimState::ExMove(const VimExCommand& cmd)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const auto dest = ParseExRange(cmd.args, VimExRangeEnv{ PrimaryRow() + 1, VimText::LineCount(r), {}, {} });
        if (!dest || dest->addressCount == 0 || dest->line2 > VimText::LineCount(r)) return VimHostResult{ false, "E14: Invalid address" };
        const std::uint32_t d = dest->line2;                     // the moved lines go below line d (0 = top)
        const std::uint32_t f = cmd.firstRow, l = cmd.lastRow, n = l - f + 1;
        if (d >= f + 1 && d <= l) return VimHostResult{ false, "E134: Cannot move a range of lines into itself" };
        const Selection& primary = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()];
        const std::uint32_t vcol = primary.goalColumn.value_or(VimText::VirtualColumn(r, primary.head, m_options.tabSize));
        if (d == l + 1 || d == f) { PlaceCursorKeepColumn(l); return {}; }   // already there
        std::string block;
        for (const std::string& s : Rows(r, f, l)) { block += s; block.push_back('\n'); }
        // the deletion: the rows with the break after them, or -- for rows at the end of a buffer with no
        // final '\n' -- the break before them
        const ByteRange cut = l + 1 < r.LineCount() ? ByteRange{ r.LineStart(f), r.LineStart(l + 1) }
                                                    : ByteRange{ r.LineEnd(f - 1), r.LineEnd(l) };
        // the insertion: before rope row d when it exists (always when moving up), else (below the last row
        // of a buffer with no final '\n') after a new break at the end
        const EditOp insert = d < r.LineCount() ? EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.LineStart(d), r.LineStart(d) }, block }
                                                : EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.Size(), r.Size() }, "\n" + block.substr(0, block.size() - 1) };
        const std::uint32_t cursorRow = d < f ? d + n - 1 : d - 1;
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, { insert, EditOp{ cut, "" } }, { Selection{ primary.id, 0, 0, vcol } }, 0);
        PlaceCursorKeepColumn(cursorRow);                               // vcol rides on the selection's goal column
        return {};
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExCopy(const VimExCommand& cmd)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const auto dest = ParseExRange(cmd.args, VimExRangeEnv{ PrimaryRow() + 1, VimText::LineCount(r), {}, {} });
        if (!dest || dest->addressCount == 0) return VimHostResult{ false, "E14: Invalid address" };
        const std::uint32_t d = dest->line2;
        const std::uint32_t n = cmd.lastRow - cmd.firstRow + 1;
        std::string text;
        for (const std::string& s : Rows(r, cmd.firstRow, cmd.lastRow)) { text += s; text.push_back('\n'); }
        EditOp op;
        if (d == 0) op = EditOp{ ByteRange{ 0, 0 }, text };
        else if (d >= r.LineCount()) { text.pop_back(); op = EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.Size(), r.Size() }, "\n" + text }; }
        else op = EditOp{ ByteRange{ r.LineStart(d), r.LineStart(d) }, text };
        const std::uint32_t id = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].id;
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, { op }, { Selection{ id, op.range.begin, op.range.begin, std::nullopt } }, 0);
        PlaceCursorKeepColumn(d + n - 1);
        return {};
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExShiftRight(const VimExCommand& cmd) { return ExShift(cmd, true); }
    VimHostResult VimState::ExShiftLeft(const VimExCommand& cmd) { return ExShift(cmd, false); }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExShift(const VimExCommand& cmd, bool right)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        const char sign = right ? '>' : '<';
        std::size_t i = 0;
        std::uint32_t amount = 1;
        while (i < cmd.args.size() && cmd.args[i] == sign) { ++amount; ++i; }
        std::uint32_t count = 0;
        while (i < cmd.args.size() && IsBlank(cmd.args[i])) ++i;
        std::from_chars(cmd.args.data() + i, cmd.args.data() + cmd.args.size(), count);
        std::uint32_t first = cmd.firstRow, last = cmd.lastRow;
        if (count) { first = cmd.lastRow; last = std::min(first + count - 1, VimText::LastRow(r)); }
        const std::uint32_t sw = std::max(1u, m_options.shiftWidth), ts = std::max(1u, m_options.tabSize);

        std::vector<std::string> lines;
        for (std::uint32_t row = first; row <= last; ++row)
        {
            const std::string line = VimText::Line(r, row);
            if (line.empty()) { lines.push_back(line); continue; }        // op_shift skips empty lines
            const std::size_t oldInd = std::min(line.size(), line.find_first_not_of(" \t"));
            std::uint32_t width = 0;
            for (std::size_t k = 0; k < oldInd; ++k) width = line[k] == '\t' ? (width / ts + 1) * ts : width + 1;
            const std::uint32_t newWidth = right ? width + amount * sw : (width > amount * sw ? width - amount * sw : 0);
            std::string indent = m_options.expandTab ? std::string(newWidth, ' ') : std::string(newWidth / ts, '\t') + std::string(newWidth % ts, ' ');
            lines.push_back(indent + line.substr(oldInd));
        }
        const std::uint32_t id = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].id;
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, { ExRowsEdit(r, first, last, lines) }, { Selection{ id, r.LineStart(first), r.LineStart(first), std::nullopt } }, 0);
        // ex :> / :< (op_shift with curs_top false): the last line, and set_indent leaves the column at the new
        // indent -- the first non-blank (D-R12 corrected case ":< shifts left": "    ˇa")
        PlaceCursorFirstNonBlank(last);
        return {};
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExJoin(const VimExCommand& cmd)
    {
        const Rope& r = m_doc.buffer.Text();
        std::uint32_t count = 0;
        std::from_chars(cmd.args.data(), cmd.args.data() + cmd.args.size(), count);
        std::uint32_t first = cmd.firstRow, last = cmd.lastRow;
        if (count) { first = cmd.lastRow; last = first + count - 1; }
        else if (first == last) last = first + 1;               // ":j" joins the line and the next
        last = std::min(last, VimText::LastRow(r));
        if (first >= last) return {};
        const std::string joined = JoinRowsText(r, first, last, !cmd.bang, m_language.lineComment);
        const std::uint32_t id = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].id;
        VimText::Apply(m_doc, { ExRowsEdit(r, first, last, { joined }) }, { Selection{ id, r.LineStart(first), r.LineStart(first), std::nullopt } }, 0);
        PlaceCursorFirstNonBlank(first);
        return {};
    }

    VimHostResult VimState::ExNormal(const VimExCommand& cmd)
    {
        const auto keys = ParseKeys(cmd.args, m_options.leader);
        if (!keys) return VimHostResult{ false, "E: :normal keys are not valid UTF-8" };
        const auto runOnce = [&]() {
            (void)FeedKeys(*keys, !cmd.bang);
            // an incomplete command ends as if <Esc> was typed (vim's :normal)
            for (int guard = 0; guard < 4 && (m_mode != VimMode::Normal || !m_parser.Idle()); ++guard)
                (void)FeedResolved(VimKey::Named(VimNamedKey::Esc));
        };
        if (!cmd.rangeGiven) { runOnce(); return {}; }
        for (std::uint32_t row = cmd.firstRow; row <= cmd.lastRow && row < VimText::LineCount(m_doc.buffer.Text()); ++row)
        {
            const ByteOffset start = m_doc.buffer.Text().LineStart(row);
            const std::uint32_t id = m_doc.selections.All()[m_doc.selections.PrimaryIndex()].id;
            VimText::Select(m_doc, { Selection{ id, start, start, std::nullopt } }, 0);
            runOnce();
        }
        return {};
    }
}
```

### Task TE5c-8: `:s` with `g i I e`, `&` / `:&` / `:&&`, the replacement engine, gdefault (spec s6.3 Ex, s6.4 gdefault, s6.5 replacement row and `~`)

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimSubstitute.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimSubstitute.cpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimExSubstitute.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimEx.cpp` (table rows), `VimState.hpp` (handler), `VimActions.cpp` (`RepeatSubstitute`)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5c.vimcases` (append)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimSubstituteTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: TE5c-4/5/6 search glue and ex dispatch; `VimSearchState::lastSub*`; `VimRegisters::SetSpecial`; `VimOptions::gdefault`.
- Produces:
  - `struct VimSubstituteArgs { bool hasPattern; std::string pattern, replacement, flags; std::uint32_t count; }`, `std::expected<VimSubstituteArgs, std::string> ParseSubstituteArgs(std::string_view args)` (refuses the flags `n p # l r` and a `\=` replacement as documented divergences)
  - `std::string ExpandTilde(std::string_view replacement, std::string_view previous)` (`~` -> the previous replacement; `\~` kept for the engine)
  - `std::string VimExpandReplacement(std::string_view replacement, std::string_view whole, std::span<const std::optional<std::string>> groups)` (`& \0-\9 \u \U \l \L \e \E \r \n \t \\ \&`) -- in `Arcane::Text`, deliberately distinct from TE4-7's find-bar `Text::ExpandReplacement(std::string_view, const SearchHit&, bool regex)` (vim's replacement syntax differs; CANON B16). The substitution's edits apply through `VimText::Apply` (one `TextCommands::ApplyEdits` transaction).
  - `VimState::ExSubstitute` (rows `substitute` and `&`), the `RepeatSubstitute` action (Neovim's `&` = `:&&`).
  - `VimState::ExSubstituteMatches(...)`: the shared match list TE5c-9's confirm mode takes over.

Vim stores the `~`-expanded replacement as the "previous" one, so `~` in a later pattern (TE5c-1) and in a later replacement both see what was actually used; before the first `:s` there is none (`std::nullopt`: `~` in a pattern is `E33`, `~` in a replacement is empty, as in vim). `:s` also becomes the last search pattern (so `n` finds it) and fills `"/`.

Which matches `g` replaces follows vim's `do_sub` (finding 5c.6): an empty match that starts exactly where the previous replaced match ended is skipped (`:s/a*/-/g` on `baaac` gives `-b-c`, not `-b--c-`), and on the line path the scan stops once a match ends at the end of the line or a skipped empty match reaches it (`:s/x*/-/g` on `abc` gives `-a-b-c`). `VimFindAll` returns PCRE2's non-overlapping matches; `SubstituteMatches` applies those two rules per row. Divergences (listed in TE5c-16): `\n` in a replacement breaks the line like `\r` (vim inserts a NUL); `\u \U \l \L` change ASCII letters only; the flags `n p # l r` and a `\=` expression replacement are refused with `E: unsupported ...` rather than misread (`:%s/x//gn`, vim's match count, would otherwise delete every `x`).

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimSubstituteTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimSubstitute.hpp"

#include <vector>

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using Arcane::Test::VimRig;

TEST_CASE("vim :s: argument parsing", "[text-vim-substitute]")
{
    const auto a = ParseSubstituteArgs("/a\\/b/c\\/d/gi 3");
    REQUIRE(a.has_value());
    CHECK(a->hasPattern);
    CHECK(a->pattern == "a\\/b");
    CHECK(a->replacement == "c/d");
    CHECK(a->flags == "gi");
    CHECK(a->count == 3u);
    const auto hash = ParseSubstituteArgs("#x/y#z#");
    REQUIRE(hash.has_value());
    CHECK(hash->pattern == "x/y");
    CHECK(hash->replacement == "z");
    const auto bare = ParseSubstituteArgs("&g");
    REQUIRE(bare.has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(bare->hasPattern);
    CHECK(bare->flags == "&g");
    const auto noRep = ParseSubstituteArgs("/x");
    REQUIRE(noRep.has_value());
    CHECK(noRep->replacement.empty());
    CHECK(ParseSubstituteArgs("/a/b/gz").error().starts_with("E488"));
    CHECK(ParseSubstituteArgs("/x//gn").error() == "E: unsupported :s flag `n` (a documented divergence)");
    for (const char* f : { "/a/b/p", "/a/b/#", "/a/b/l", "/a/b/r" })
    {
        INFO(f);
        CHECK(ParseSubstituteArgs(f).error().starts_with("E: unsupported :s flag"));
    }
    CHECK(ParseSubstituteArgs("/a/\\=1+1/").error() == "E: unsupported :s replacement `\\=` (a documented divergence)");
}

TEST_CASE("vim :s: g skips an empty match right after the previous one and stops at the line end (do_sub)", "[text-vim-substitute]")
{
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "baaac"); r.Keys(":s/a*/-/g<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "-b-c"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "aab");   r.Keys(":s/a*/-/g<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "-b"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "abc");   r.Keys(":s/x*/-/g<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "-a-b-c"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "abc");   r.Keys(":s/$/!/g<CR>");  CHECK(r.Text() == "abc!"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "");      r.Keys(":s/x*/-/g<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "-"); }
}

TEST_CASE("vim :s: replacement expansion", "[text-vim-substitute]")
{
    const std::vector<std::optional<std::string>> g{ std::string("foo"), std::string("bar") };
    CHECK(VimExpandReplacement("[&]", "xy", g) == "[xy]");
    CHECK(VimExpandReplacement("\\&\\0", "xy", g) == "&xy");
    CHECK(VimExpandReplacement("\\2\\1\\3", "xy", g) == "barfoo");
    CHECK(VimExpandReplacement("\\u\\1 \\U\\2\\E!", "xy", g) == "Foo BAR!");
    CHECK(VimExpandReplacement("\\L\\uABC", "xy", g) == "Abc");
    CHECK(VimExpandReplacement("a\\rb\\nc\\td\\\\", "xy", g) == "a\nb\nc\td\\");
    CHECK(ExpandTilde("x~y\\~", "PREV") == "xPREVy\\~");
}

TEST_CASE("vim :s: substitute, flags, repeat forms", "[text-vim-substitute]")
{
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "aaa"); r.Keys(":s/a/b/<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "baa"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "aaa"); r.Keys(":s/a/b/g<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "bbb"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\na"); r.Keys(":%s/a/b/<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "b\n\xCB\x87" "b"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "aA"); r.Keys(":s/A/x/i<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "xA"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "ab"); r.Keys(":s/\\(a\\)\\(b\\)/\\2\\1/<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "ba"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a,b,c"); r.Keys(":s/,/\\r/g<CR>"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\nb\n\xCB\x87" "c"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "ab"); r.Keys(":s/a/X/<CR>:s/b/~~/<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "XXX"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "aa\naa"); r.Keys(":s/a/b/g<CR>j&"); CHECK(r.Marked() == "bb\n\xCB\x87" "bb"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "aa\naa"); r.Keys(":s/a/b/g<CR>j:&<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "bb\nba"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "aa\naa"); r.Keys(":s/a/b/g<CR>j:&&<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "bb\nbb"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "aa\naa"); r.Keys(":s/a/b/<CR>j:s<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "ba\nba"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\na\na"); r.Keys(":s/a/b/g 2<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "b\nb\na"); }
}

TEST_CASE("vim :s: gdefault inverts g; not found is E486 unless e", "[text-vim-substitute]")
{
    VimOptions o;
    o.gdefault = true;
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "aa", {}, o); r.Keys(":s/a/b/<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "bb"); }
    { VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "aa", {}, o); r.Keys(":s/a/b/g<CR>"); CHECK(r.Text() == "ba"); }
    {
        VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "x");
        r.Keys(":s/z/y/<CR>");
        REQUIRE_FALSE(r.host.messages.empty());
        CHECK(r.host.messages.back() == std::pair<std::string, bool>{ "E486: Pattern not found: z", true });
        r.host.messages.clear();
        r.Keys(":s/z/y/e<CR>");
        CHECK(r.host.messages.empty());
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim :s: the pattern becomes the last search, \"/ and ~", "[text-vim-substitute]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "x abc foo foo");
    r.Keys(":s/x/abc/<CR>");
    CHECK(r.Globals().search.lastPattern == "x");
    CHECK(r.Globals().search.lastSubReplacement == "abc");
    r.Keys("/~<CR>");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "abc \xCB\x87" "abc foo foo");
    r.Keys(":s/foo/bar/<CR>n");
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "abc abc bar \xCB\x87" "foo");
    REQUIRE(r.Commands().Undo());
    CHECK(r.Text() == "abc abc foo foo");                      // one :s = one undo step
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimSubstitute.hpp
#pragma once

// :s pieces that need no buffer (spec s6.3, s6.5 last row): argument parsing,
// ~ expansion, and the replacement engine (& \0-\9 \u \U \l \L \e \E \r \n \t).

    {
```
