## Pass TE5d: options, remaps, persistence

Pass (d) turns the Neovim defaults that TE5a-3 froze into `VimOptions` into real `editor.text.vim.*` settings (spec s6.4, D13), adds vim's `:set` with session-only semantics on the settings system's Console rung, puts a key trie with `timeoutlen` in front of every key vim resolves (`:map` entries from TE5c-12 plus the `editor.text.vim.remaps` table), gives vim its Preferences page with the Experimental badge, persists marks/registers/history in the editor user folder, and shows on the Shortcuts page what each vim-shadowed chord means. It closes with the hand-written multi-cursor table, its separate review, and the full oracle suite run that VIM-GATE consumes.

### Task TE5d-1: The full `editor.text.vim.*` settings block with Neovim defaults (spec s6.4, s8, D13)

**Files:**
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp` (the `TextVimSettings` struct TE5a-23 created and TE5b-1a extended)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.cpp` (the `TextVimSettings` reflection block + `ARC_SETTINGS(TextVimSettings)` and `ReadVimOptions`, created by TE5a-23 after the `EditorConsoleSettings.cpp` pattern -- struct in the header, reflection in the .cpp)
- Modify: `docs/superpowers/audits/2026-10-03-settings-inventory.md` (14 rows in `### Text editor`, one row in the "Post-freeze amendments" table)
- Modify: `scripts/settings-frozen-names.txt` (regenerated by the lint, never by hand -- D-R8, finding 5d.5)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/src/SweepTextVimTest.cpp` (created by TE5a-23, extended by TE5b-1a)
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimOptionsReadTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Arcane::Editor::TextVimSettings { enabled, handleCtrlKeys, latinLettersInNormal, useSystemClipboard }`, `enum class VimLatinLetters` (TE5a-23, TE5b-1a), the D-R8 inventory route (TE1-9: `### Text editor` rows + "Post-freeze amendments" row, `scripts/settings-inventory-lint.ps1 -RequireFrozen -EmitFrozen`), `Arcane::Editor::TextSettings { std::uint32_t tabSize; bool insertSpaces; }` (TE1-15), `TextSettings::multilineSearchMaxMB` (`std::uint32_t`, TE4-3) -- read only, owned by those tasks, `Arcane::Text::VimOptions`, `ParseNrFormats` (TE5a-3), `Arcane::Test::RequireDefault`, `ScopedCodeLayer` (`ArcaneTests/src/Helpers/SettingsSweep.hpp:19-81`), `CVarRegistry::Describe` (`CVarRegistry.hpp:456`), `CVarDescInfo` (`CVarRegistry.hpp:105-121`).
- Produces: `TextVimSettings` gains `ignorecase, smartcase, hlsearch, incsearch, wrapscan, gdefault` (bool), `timeoutlen` (`std::uint32_t` ms), `scrolloff` (`std::uint32_t`), `startofline` (bool), `nrformats` (string), `yankToEol` (bool), `leader` (string), `remaps` (string, JSON, Hidden -- the Vim page edits it, TE5d-5), `persistState` (bool); `Arcane::Text::VimOptions Arcane::Editor::ReadVimOptions(const TextVimSettings&, const TextSettings&)` maps every field (complete version). Cvar names `editor.text.vim.<field>`.

The settings system's field types are bool/int/float/double/string/enum (`ArcaneCore/src/Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp:18-20`), so `nrformats`, `leader` and the remap table are strings. Every default is Neovim's (D13, s6.4): ignorecase off, smartcase off, hlsearch on, incsearch on, wrapscan on, gdefault off, timeoutlen 1000, scrolloff 0, startofline off, nrformats `bin,hex`, `Y` = `y$`, leader `\`. Integral fields are `std::uint32_t` (the settings type rule; sweep values `CVarValue::UInt32`), so `ReadVimOptions` copies `timeoutlen` and `scrolloff` straight into `VimOptions::timeoutlenMs` / `scrolloff` (already `std::uint32_t`, TE5a-3) -- the registry's `Range` keeps them in bounds, no sign clamp is needed. Shift width IS Arcane's single editor-wide indent width (`editor.text.tabSize`; spec s6.4 amended: `:set sw` and `:set ts` move together), so `ReadVimOptions` maps both `tabstop` (`tabSize`) and `shiftwidth` (`shiftWidth`) from it. None of the fourteen is a limit (each is a vim behaviour or feel preference), so none is Dev; every default is Neovim's documented one, not a measured value.

```cpp
TEST_CASE("vim options: ReadVimOptions maps every editor.text.vim field and the editor-wide indentation", "[text-vim-options]")
{

    v.handleCtrlKeys = false;
    v.useSystemClipboard = true;
    v.ignorecase = true;
    v.smartcase = true;
    v.hlsearch = false;
    v.incsearch = false;
    v.wrapscan = false;
    v.gdefault = true;
    v.timeoutlen = 300u;
    v.scrolloff = 5u;
    v.startofline = true;
    v.nrformats = "octal,alpha";
    v.yankToEol = false;
    v.leader = ",";
    Editor::TextSettings t;
    t.tabSize = 2u;
    t.insertSpaces = false;
    t.multilineSearchMaxMB = 8u;

    const Text::VimOptions o = Editor::ReadVimOptions(v, t);
    CHECK_FALSE(o.handleCtrlKeys);
    CHECK(o.useSystemClipboard);
    CHECK(o.ignorecase);
    CHECK(o.smartcase);
    CHECK_FALSE(o.hlsearch);
    CHECK_FALSE(o.incsearch);
    CHECK_FALSE(o.wrapscan);

    CHECK(o.scrolloff == 5u);
    CHECK(o.startofline);

    CHECK_FALSE(o.yankToEol);
    CHECK(o.leader == ",");
    CHECK(o.tabSize == 2u);
    CHECK(o.shiftWidth == 2u);              // one editor-wide indent width (spec s6.4)
    CHECK_FALSE(o.expandTab);
    CHECK(o.multilineSearchMaxBytes == (8ull << 20));
}

TEST_CASE("vim options: defaults read as Neovim's; bad text falls back to the default; zero widths clamp to 1", "[text-vim-options]")
{
    const Text::VimOptions d = Editor::ReadVimOptions(Editor::TextVimSettings{}, Editor::TextSettings{});
    const Text::VimOptions neovim;
    CHECK(d.ignorecase == neovim.ignorecase);
    CHECK(d.hlsearch == neovim.hlsearch);
    CHECK(d.timeoutlenMs == neovim.timeoutlenMs);
    CHECK(Text::FormatNrFormats(d) == "bin,hex");
    CHECK(d.yankToEol);
    CHECK(d.leader == "\\");

    Editor::TextVimSettings bad;
    bad.nrformats = "hex,unsigned";         // unknown item: the whole value is refused
    bad.leader.clear();                     // an empty leader would make <Leader> vanish
    bad.timeoutlen = 0u;                    // 0 is a legal timeoutlen (act at once), copied as is
    Editor::TextSettings zero;
    zero.tabSize = 0u;                      // a zero indent width / search cap never reaches vim
    zero.multilineSearchMaxMB = 0u;
    const Text::VimOptions b = Editor::ReadVimOptions(bad, zero);
    CHECK(Text::FormatNrFormats(b) == "bin,hex");
    CHECK(b.leader == "\\");
    CHECK(b.timeoutlenMs == 0u);
    CHECK(b.tabSize == 1u);
    CHECK(b.shiftWidth == 1u);
    CHECK(b.multilineSearchMaxBytes == (1ull << 20));
}
```

```cpp
    // editor.text.vim.* (spec s6.4, D13: NEOVIM defaults). Per-machine
    // preferences; `:set` writes the Console rung (session only, TE5d-2).
    struct TextVimSettings
    {
        bool            enabled = false;                                 // TE5a-23 (spec s6.1: off = no vim code runs)
        bool            handleCtrlKeys = true;                           // TE5a-23 (spec s6.6)
        VimLatinLetters latinLettersInNormal = VimLatinLetters::Auto;    // TE5a-23 (spec s5.5)
        bool            useSystemClipboard = false;                      // TE5b-1a (Neovim clipboard=unnamedplus)
        bool            ignorecase = false;
        bool            smartcase = false;
        bool            hlsearch = true;
        bool            incsearch = true;
        bool            wrapscan = true;
        bool            gdefault = false;
        std::uint32_t   timeoutlen = 1000;                               // ms (settings type rule: integral = uint32)
        std::uint32_t   scrolloff = 0;
        bool            startofline = false;
        std::string     nrformats = "bin,hex";
        bool            yankToEol = true;                                // Y = y$ (Neovim) / yy (Vim)
        std::string     leader = "\\";
        std::string     remaps = "[]";                                   // JSON: [{"mode","from","to","recursive"}] (TE5d-4)
        bool            persistState = true;                             // TE5d-6
        bool operator==(const TextVimSettings&) const = default;         // TE5a-23
    };
```

```cpp
        o.yankToEol = vim.yankToEol;
```

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimSetOption.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimSetOption.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimHost.hpp` (TE5a-5: add `VimSessionOption` and the pure virtual `IVimHost::SetSessionOption`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (TE5a-5: declare `VimHostResult ExSet(const VimExCommand&)`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimEx.cpp` (TE5c-6: one row in `kVimExCommands`, the `ExSet` definition)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp/.cpp` (`ApplyVimSessionOption`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/View/VimViewAdapter.hpp/.cpp` (TE5a-22: the `SetSessionOption` override)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp` (TE5a-5: `FakeVimHost` records session options)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/Helpers/VimCases.cpp` (TE5a-6: `ApplyVimSet` uses the production parser)
- Create: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5d.vimcases`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimSetTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimExCommand`, `VimExSpec`, `kVimExCommands`, `VimState::RunExLine` (TE5c-6), `VimOptions`, `ParseNrFormats`, `FormatNrFormats` (TE5a-3), `CVarRegistry::Find/Set/ClearRung/Publish/RungValue` (`CVarRegistry.hpp:331-470`), `SetBy::Console` (`CVarTypes.hpp:83`, a session rung that is never archived).
- Produces:
  - `enum class VimOptionType : std::uint8_t { Bool, Number, String }`, `struct VimOptionInfo { std::string_view name, abbrev; VimOptionType type; std::string_view cvar; }`, `std::span<const VimOptionInfo> VimOptionTable()`, `const VimOptionInfo* FindVimOption(std::string_view)`, `std::string FormatVimOption(const VimOptions&, const VimOptionInfo&)`.
  - `struct VimSessionOption { std::string cvar; VimOptionType cvarType; bool boolValue; std::uint32_t numberValue; std::string stringValue; bool reset; }`, `struct VimSetResult { bool ok; std::string message; std::vector<VimSessionOption> changes; }`, `VimSetResult ApplySetArguments(VimOptions&, std::string_view args)`, `bool ApplySetAssignment(VimOptions&, std::string_view item)`.
  - `virtual VimHostResult IVimHost::SetSessionOption(const VimSessionOption&) = 0`; `VimHostResult VimState::ExSet(const VimExCommand&)`; ex row `set`/`se`.
  - `Arcane::Text::VimHostResult Arcane::Editor::ApplyVimSessionOption(CVarRegistry&, const Text::VimSessionOption&)`.

`:set` changes a value for the **session only** (spec s6.4): it writes the cvar's **Console** rung, which the settings archive never writes, so the Preferences page keeps its permanent value and shows the row as "Overridden by Console" with Clear override. The VimState that ran `:set` updates its own `VimOptions` at once; the publish re-reads `ReadVimOptions` for every vim view (TE5a-23's `VimEditorRuntime::OnSettingsPublished`), so all views agree, as vim's global options do. Forms: `opt` `noopt` `invopt` `opt!` `opt&` `opt?` `opt=v` `opt:v` `opt+=v` `opt-=v` `opt^=v`, several per line; `:set` alone lists the options that differ from Neovim's default, `:set all` lists every option. Supported vim names: `ignorecase ic`, `smartcase scs`, `hlsearch hls`, `incsearch is`, `wrapscan ws`, `gdefault gd`, `startofline sol`, `timeoutlen tm`, `scrolloff so`, `nrformats nf`, `clipboard cb` (`unnamedplus`/`unnamed` <-> `useSystemClipboard`), and the editor-wide `tabstop ts`, `shiftwidth sw`, `expandtab et` (spec s6.4: not vim-only; `ts` and `sw` are Arcane's one indent width, `editor.text.tabSize`). Documented differences: `opt&` drops the session value (back to the Preferences value, not vim's built-in default), and `ts`/`sw` move together.

```cpp
TEST_CASE(":set: booleans, no/inv/!, numbers, lists, queries", "[text-vim-set]")
{
    VimOptions o;
    VimSetResult r = ApplySetArguments(o, "ic noscs hls! ts=2 nf+=alpha");
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    CHECK(o.ignorecase);
    CHECK_FALSE(o.smartcase);
    CHECK_FALSE(o.hlsearch);                 // hls! toggled the default on -> off
    CHECK(o.tabSize == 2u);
    CHECK(o.shiftWidth == 2u);               // one indent width
    CHECK(FormatNrFormats(o) == "bin,hex,alpha");
    REQUIRE(r.changes.size() == 5u);
    CHECK(r.changes[0].cvar == "editor.text.vim.ignorecase");
    CHECK(r.changes[0].boolValue);
    CHECK(r.changes[3].cvar == "editor.text.tabSize");
    CHECK(r.changes[3].numberValue == 2u);
    CHECK(r.changes[4].stringValue == "bin,hex,alpha");

    r = ApplySetArguments(o, "invic nf-=bin tm^=2 ic? ts?");
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    CHECK_FALSE(o.ignorecase);
    CHECK(FormatNrFormats(o) == "hex,alpha");
    CHECK(o.timeoutlenMs == 2000u);
    CHECK(r.message == "  noignorecase  tabstop=2");

    r = ApplySetArguments(o, "cb=unnamedplus et&");
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    CHECK(o.useSystemClipboard);
    CHECK(o.expandTab == VimOptions{}.expandTab);
    REQUIRE(r.changes.size() == 2u);
    CHECK(r.changes[0].cvar == "editor.text.vim.useSystemClipboard");
    CHECK(r.changes[0].cvarType == VimOptionType::Bool);
    CHECK(r.changes[1].reset);
}

    CHECK_FALSE(o.smartcase);

    CHECK(ApplySetArguments(o, "ic=1").message == "E474: Invalid argument: ic=1");

TEST_CASE(":set through the command line updates this view at once and asks the host for the session value", "[text-vim-set]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "abc");
    r.Keys(":set ic sw=8<CR>");
    CHECK(r.vim->Options().ignorecase);
    CHECK(r.vim->Options().shiftWidth == 8u);
    REQUIRE(r.host.sessionOptions.size() == 2u);
    CHECK(r.host.sessionOptions[0].cvar == "editor.text.vim.ignorecase");
    CHECK(r.host.sessionOptions[1].cvar == "editor.text.tabSize");
    r.Keys(":set ic?<CR>");
    REQUIRE_FALSE(r.host.messages.empty());
    CHECK(r.host.messages.back().first == "  ignorecase");
    r.Keys(":set bogus<CR>");
    CHECK(r.host.messages.back().first == "E518: Unknown option: bogus");
    CHECK(r.host.messages.back().second);
    r.Keys(":se all<CR>");
    REQUIRE_FALSE(r.host.listings.empty());
    CHECK(r.host.listings.back().first == "--- Options ---");
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Normal);
}

TEST_CASE(":set writes the Console rung only: the Preferences value stays and nothing is archived", "[text-vim-set]")
{
    const Test::ScopedCodeLayer codeLayer;
    CVarRegistry& reg = CVarRegistry::Get();
    struct ConsoleRungGuard   // a failed REQUIRE must not leak the session value into a later random-order case
    {
        CVarRegistry& r;
        ~ConsoleRungGuard() { (void)r.ClearRung(r.Find("editor.text.vim.ignorecase"), SetBy::Console); r.PublishImmediate(); }
    } guard{ reg };
    const std::optional<CVarValue> userBefore = reg.RungValue("editor.text.vim.ignorecase", SetBy::EditorUser);

    VimSessionOption on;
    on.cvar = "editor.text.vim.ignorecase";
    on.cvarType = VimOptionType::Bool;
    on.boolValue = true;
    REQUIRE(Editor::ApplyVimSessionOption(reg, on).ok);
    reg.PublishImmediate();
    CHECK(Settings<Editor::TextVimSettings>().ignorecase);
    const std::optional<CVarValue> console = reg.RungValue("editor.text.vim.ignorecase", SetBy::Console);
    REQUIRE(console.has_value());
    CHECK(console->AsBool());
    CHECK(reg.RungValue("editor.text.vim.ignorecase", SetBy::EditorUser) == userBefore);

    VimSessionOption reset = on;
    reset.reset = true;
    REQUIRE(Editor::ApplyVimSessionOption(reg, reset).ok);
    reg.PublishImmediate();
    CHECK_FALSE(reg.RungValue("editor.text.vim.ignorecase", SetBy::Console).has_value());
    CHECK_FALSE(Settings<Editor::TextVimSettings>().ignorecase);

    VimSessionOption unknown = on;
    unknown.cvar = "editor.text.vim.nope";
    CHECK_FALSE(Editor::ApplyVimSessionOption(reg, unknown).ok);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimSetOption.hpp
#pragma once

// vim's :set over VimOptions (spec s6.4). Pure: ApplySetArguments changes the
// options and reports, per item, the cvar the editor must write at the session
// (Console) rung -- the IVimHost does that, so ArcaneText never touches the
// settings registry.

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimOptions.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    enum class VimOptionType : std::uint8_t { Bool, Number, String };

    struct VimOptionInfo
    {
        std::string_view name, abbrev;
        VimOptionType    type;           // the vim option's type
        std::string_view cvar;           // the Arcane setting it maps onto
    };

    struct VimSessionOption
    {
        std::string   cvar;
        VimOptionType cvarType = VimOptionType::Bool;
        bool          boolValue = false;
        std::uint32_t numberValue = 0;   // every integral setting is std::uint32_t (CVarValue::UInt32)
        std::string   stringValue;
        bool          reset = false;     // opt&: drop the session value
    };

    struct VimSetResult
    {
        bool ok = true;
        std::string message;             // queries ("  ignorecase  tabstop=4") or the error
        std::vector<VimSessionOption> changes;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::span<const VimOptionInfo> VimOptionTable();
    [[nodiscard]] const VimOptionInfo* FindVimOption(std::string_view nameOrAbbrev);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatVimOption(const VimOptions& options, const VimOptionInfo& info);   // "ignorecase", "noic..", "tabstop=4"
    [[nodiscard]] VimSetResult ApplySetArguments(VimOptions& options, std::string_view args);
    [[nodiscard]] bool ApplySetAssignment(VimOptions& options, std::string_view item);                 // one item, no query
}
```

```cpp
        bool* BoolField(VimOptions& o, std::string_view name)
        {
            if (name == "ignorecase") return &o.ignorecase;
            if (name == "smartcase") return &o.smartcase;
            if (name == "hlsearch") return &o.hlsearch;
            if (name == "incsearch") return &o.incsearch;
            if (name == "wrapscan") return &o.wrapscan;
            if (name == "gdefault") return &o.gdefault;
            if (name == "startofline") return &o.startofline;
            if (name == "expandtab") return &o.expandTab;
            return nullptr;
        }

        std::uint32_t* NumberField(VimOptions& o, std::string_view name)
        {
            if (name == "timeoutlen") return &o.timeoutlenMs;
            if (name == "scrolloff") return &o.scrolloff;
            if (name == "tabstop") return &o.tabSize;
            if (name == "shiftwidth") return &o.shiftWidth;
            return nullptr;
        }

        std::string StringValue(const VimOptions& o, std::string_view name)
        {
            if (name == "nrformats") return FormatNrFormats(o);
            if (name == "clipboard") return o.useSystemClipboard ? "unnamedplus" : "";
            return {};
        }

        // nrformats / clipboard text -> options; false = invalid
        bool SetString(VimOptions& o, std::string_view name, std::string_view value)
        {
            if (name == "nrformats") return ParseNrFormats(value, o);
            if (name == "clipboard")
            {
                bool plus = false;
                std::string_view rest = value;
                while (!rest.empty())
                {
                    const std::size_t comma = rest.find(',');
                    const std::string_view item = rest.substr(0, comma);
                    if (item == "unnamedplus" || item == "unnamed") plus = true;
                    else if (!item.empty()) return false;
                    if (comma == std::string_view::npos) break;
                    rest.remove_prefix(comma + 1);
                }
                o.useSystemClipboard = plus;
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        std::vector<std::string> SplitList(std::string_view s)
        {
            std::vector<std::string> out;
            while (!s.empty())
            {
                const std::size_t comma = s.find(',');
                if (comma != 0) out.emplace_back(s.substr(0, comma));
                if (comma == std::string_view::npos) break;
                s.remove_prefix(comma + 1);
            }
            return out;
        }

        std::string JoinList(const std::vector<std::string>& items)
        {
            std::string out;
            for (const std::string& i : items) { if (!out.empty()) out.push_back(','); out += i; }
            return out;
        }

        VimSessionOption ChangeFor(const VimOptions& o, const VimOptionInfo& info, bool reset)
        {
            VimSessionOption c;
            c.cvar = std::string(info.cvar);
            c.reset = reset;
            VimOptions copy = o;
            if (info.name == "clipboard") { c.cvarType = VimOptionType::Bool; c.boolValue = o.useSystemClipboard; return c; }
            c.cvarType = info.type;
            if (info.type == VimOptionType::Bool) c.boolValue = *BoolField(copy, info.name);
            else if (info.type == VimOptionType::Number) c.numberValue = *NumberField(copy, info.name);
            else c.stringValue = StringValue(o, info.name);
            return c;
        }

        // ts and sw are one width in Arcane (spec s6.4): keep them together.
        void SyncIndent(VimOptions& o, std::string_view name)
        {
            if (name == "tabstop") o.shiftWidth = o.tabSize;
            if (name == "shiftwidth") o.tabSize = o.shiftWidth;
        }
    }

    std::span<const VimOptionInfo> VimOptionTable() { return kOptions; }

    const VimOptionInfo* FindVimOption(std::string_view n)
    {
        for (const VimOptionInfo& i : kOptions)
            if (i.name == n || i.abbrev == n) return &i;
        return nullptr;
    }

    std::string FormatVimOption(const VimOptions& options, const VimOptionInfo& info)
    {
        VimOptions o = options;
        switch (info.type)
        {
        case VimOptionType::Bool:   return (*BoolField(o, info.name) ? "" : "no") + std::string(info.name);
        case VimOptionType::Number: return std::string(info.name) + "=" + std::to_string(*NumberField(o, info.name));
        case VimOptionType::String: return std::string(info.name) + "=" + StringValue(o, info.name);
        }
        return {};
    }

    VimSetResult ApplySetArguments(VimOptions& o, std::string_view args)
    {
        VimSetResult result;
        std::istringstream words{ std::string(args) };
        const auto fail = [&result](std::string text) { result.ok = false; result.message = std::move(text); return result; };
        for (std::string item; words >> item;)
        {
            std::size_t nameEnd = 0;
            while (nameEnd < item.size() && item[nameEnd] >= 'a' && item[nameEnd] <= 'z') ++nameEnd;
            std::string_view name(item.data(), nameEnd);
            const std::string_view rest = std::string_view(item).substr(nameEnd);
            const VimOptionInfo* info = FindVimOption(name);
            enum class Prefix { None, No, Inv } prefix = Prefix::None;
            if (!info && name.starts_with("no") && FindVimOption(name.substr(2))) { prefix = Prefix::No; info = FindVimOption(name.substr(2)); }
            if (!info && name.starts_with("inv") && FindVimOption(name.substr(3))) { prefix = Prefix::Inv; info = FindVimOption(name.substr(3)); }
            if (!info) return fail("E518: Unknown option: " + std::string(name.empty() ? std::string_view(item) : name));
            const std::string_view full = info->name;

            if (rest == "?")
            {
                if (prefix != Prefix::None) return fail("E474: Invalid argument: " + item);
                result.message += "  " + FormatVimOption(o, *info);
                continue;
            }
            if (rest == "&")
            {
                VimOptions d;
                if (bool* b = BoolField(o, full)) *b = *BoolField(d, full);
                else if (std::uint32_t* n = NumberField(o, full)) { *n = *NumberField(d, full); SyncIndent(o, full); }
                else if (full == "nrformats") { o.nrBin = d.nrBin; o.nrHex = d.nrHex; o.nrOctal = d.nrOctal; o.nrAlpha = d.nrAlpha; }
                else if (full == "clipboard") o.useSystemClipboard = d.useSystemClipboard;
                result.changes.push_back(ChangeFor(o, *info, true));
                continue;
            }
            if (info->type == VimOptionType::Bool)
            {
                bool* b = BoolField(o, full);
                if (rest == "!" && prefix == Prefix::None) *b = !*b;
                else if (!rest.empty()) return fail("E474: Invalid argument: " + item);
                else if (prefix == Prefix::Inv) *b = !*b;
                else *b = prefix != Prefix::No;
                result.changes.push_back(ChangeFor(o, *info, false));
                continue;
            }
            if (prefix != Prefix::None) return fail("E474: Invalid argument: " + item);
            if (rest.empty())                                           // a number or string option alone shows its value
            {
                result.message += "  " + FormatVimOption(o, *info);
                continue;
            }
            std::string_view op = rest.substr(0, 1);
            std::string_view value;
            if (rest.starts_with("+=") || rest.starts_with("-=") || rest.starts_with("^=")) { op = rest.substr(0, 2); value = rest.substr(2); }
            else if (rest[0] == '=' || rest[0] == ':') { op = "="; value = rest.substr(1); }
            else return fail("E518: Unknown option: " + item);

            if (info->type == VimOptionType::Number)
            {
                std::uint32_t v = 0;
                const auto res = std::from_chars(value.data(), value.data() + value.size(), v);
                if (res.ec != std::errc{} || res.ptr != value.data() + value.size()) return fail("E521: Number required after =: " + item);
                std::uint32_t* n = NumberField(o, full);
                std::uint64_t next = v;
                if (op == "+=") next = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(*n) + v;
                else if (op == "-=") next = *n >= v ? *n - v : 0;
                else if (op == "^=") next = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(*n) * v;
                if ((full == "tabstop" || full == "shiftwidth") && next == 0) return fail("E487: Argument must be positive: " + item);
                *n = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::min<std::uint64_t>(next, std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()));
                SyncIndent(o, full);
                result.changes.push_back(ChangeFor(o, *info, false));
                continue;
            }
            // string lists: nrformats, clipboard
            std::vector<std::string> items = SplitList(StringValue(o, full));
            std::string next;
            if (op == "=") next = std::string(value);
            else if (op == "+=" || op == "^=")
            {
                for (const std::string& v : SplitList(value))
                {
                    if (std::find(items.begin(), items.end(), v) != items.end()) continue;
                    if (op == "+=") items.push_back(v);
                    else items.insert(items.begin(), v);
                }
                next = JoinList(items);
            }
            else
            {
                for (const std::string& v : SplitList(value)) std::erase(items, v);
                next = JoinList(items);
            }
            if (!SetString(o, full, next)) return fail("E474: Invalid argument: " + item);
            result.changes.push_back(ChangeFor(o, *info, false));
        }
        return result;
    }

    bool ApplySetAssignment(VimOptions& options, std::string_view item)
    {
        VimOptions copy = options;
        const VimSetResult r = ApplySetArguments(copy, item);
        if (!r.ok || !r.message.empty()) return false;
        options = copy;
        return true;
    }
}
```

The `std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()` clamp keeps `+=`/`^=` inside the cvar's `std::uint32_t` type; the cvar's own `Range` (e.g. `timeoutlen` 0..10000) is applied by the registry when the session value is written.

```cpp
    VimHostResult VimState::ExSet(const VimExCommand& cmd)
    {
        std::string_view args = cmd.args;
        while (!args.empty() && args.front() == ' ') args.remove_prefix(1);
        while (!args.empty() && args.back() == ' ') args.remove_suffix(1);
        if (args.empty() || args == "all")
        {
            const VimOptions defaults;
            std::vector<std::string> lines;
            for (const VimOptionInfo& info : VimOptionTable())
            {
                const std::string now = FormatVimOption(m_options, info);
                if (args == "all" || now != FormatVimOption(defaults, info)) lines.push_back("  " + now);
            }
            m_host.ShowListing("--- Options ---", lines);
            return {};
        }
        const bool hlsearchBefore = m_options.hlsearch;
        VimSetResult r = ApplySetArguments(m_options, args);
        for (const VimSessionOption& change : r.changes)
        {
            const VimHostResult h = m_host.SetSessionOption(change);
            if (!h.ok) return h;
        }
        if (hlsearchBefore && !m_options.hlsearch) m_host.SetSearchHighlight("");
        return VimHostResult{ r.ok, r.message };
    }
```

```cpp
    Text::VimHostResult ApplyVimSessionOption(CVarRegistry& reg, const Text::VimSessionOption& option)
    {
        const CVarHandle h = reg.Find(option.cvar);
        if (h.IsStale()) return Text::VimHostResult{ false, "E518: Unknown option: " + option.cvar };
        if (option.reset)
        {
            (void)reg.ClearRung(h, SetBy::Console);   // nothing held there = nothing to clear
            reg.Publish();
            return {};
        }
        CVarValue v = CVarValue::Bool(option.boolValue);
        if (option.cvarType == Text::VimOptionType::Number) v = CVarValue::UInt32(option.numberValue);   // timeoutlen, scrolloff, tabSize: all std::uint32_t
        else if (option.cvarType == Text::VimOptionType::String) v = CVarValue::String(option.stringValue);
        const SetResult r = reg.Set(h, std::move(v), SetBy::Console, "vim :set");
        if (r != SetResult::Applied)
            return Text::VimHostResult{ false, "E: the settings registry refused " + option.cvar };
        reg.Publish();
        return {};
    }
```

### Task TE5d-3: The remap key trie with `timeoutlen` in front of every vim key (spec s6.4 "Remaps resolve through a key trie with timeoutlen")

**Files:**
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimKeyTrie.hpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimKeyTrie.cpp`
- Create: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRemapFeed.cpp`
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimCommandParser.hpp` (TE5a-4: add `MidCommand()`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp` (TE5a-5: trie members and the feed functions; TE5b-4's `DrainTypeahead()` declaration becomes `DrainTypeahead(bool userKey)`)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimState.cpp` (TE5a-5: `HandleKey` feeds through the trie; `Tick` resolves an expired prefix; `PendingKeys` shows held keys)
- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRepeat.cpp` (TE5b-4: `FeedOne` runs vim's own meaning of a mapped Insert key the view never sees; `FeedKeys` drains through the trie; TE5b-4's `DrainTypeahead()` body moves to `VimRemapFeed.cpp` as `DrainTypeahead(bool)`)
- Modify: `ArcaneTests/data/vim/te5d.vimcases`
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimRemapTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimRemap` (with its defaulted `operator==`), `VimRemapModes`, `VimRemapTable::Add/All`, `VimGlobals::sessionRemaps` (TE5c-12); TE5b-4's ONE typeahead queue -- `struct QueuedKey { key, remap, depth }`, `std::deque<QueuedKey> m_typeahead`, `m_draining`, `FeedKeys`, `FeedOne(key, viewMayType)` -- and `TypeText` (TE5b-2); `HandleInsertCtrl`, `InsertShiftIndent` (TE5a-20), `Scroll(const VimParsed&)` (TE5a-11), `MarkInsertStart` (TE5a-5); `ParseKeys` with the leader, `VimKeyHash` (TE5a-1).
- Produces:
  - `kVimMaxMapDepth` (1000), `struct VimTrieMapping { std::vector<VimKey> from, to; bool recursive; }`, `enum class VimTrieMatch : std::uint8_t { None, Prefix, Full, FullAndPrefix }`, `class VimKeyTrie { Clear(); Add(std::uint8_t modes, const std::vector<VimKey>& from, VimTrieMapping); Find(std::uint8_t modeBit, std::span<const VimKey>, const VimTrieMapping**) const; LongestFull(std::uint8_t modeBit, std::span<const VimKey>, const VimTrieMapping**) const; Empty() const; }`.
  - `VimCommandParser::MidCommand() const` (true while a command is half typed: an argument, a register name after `"`, or a key after a multi-key prefix such as `g`, `z`, `[`, `Ctrl-W` or an operator's `i`/`a`).
  - VimState privates `FeedMapped`, `DrainTypeahead(bool userKey)` (replaces TE5b-4's), `RequeuePending`, `QueueMapping`, `RemapModeBit`, `RebuildTrieIfStale`, `AddToTrie`, `RunMappedInsertKey`; members `m_trie, m_trieSource, m_trieLeader, m_pendingMap, m_pendingDepth, m_pendingSince`. It declares no queue: expansion runs through TE5b-4's `m_typeahead` (finding 5d.1: a second `m_typeahead` would not compile, and two queues lose vim's order), so 1000 levels never deepen the call stack.

Vim's rules, reimplemented: a typed key sequence that is a strict prefix of a mapping is **held** until it completes, fails, or `timeoutlen` passes; on expiry the longest complete mapping inside it runs, otherwise its first key acts unmapped and the rest is examined again. `noremap` results are fed past the trie. A recursive `{rhs}` that starts with its `{lhs}` feeds only its **first** key unmapped -- vim's `ins_typebuf(..., REMAP_SKIP)`, `:h recursive_mapping` -- the rest of it is mapped again (finding 5d.8). Recursion deeper than `maxmapdepth` (1000) stops with `E223: recursive mapping`. Only the key that **starts** a command is looked up (finding 5d.2): vim's `normal_cmd` reads the second key of `g z [ ] Ctrl-W`, an operator's `i`/`a` text object and every argument of `f t F T r m ' `` ` `` q @ "` with mapping off, so `onoremap w iw` leaves `diw` alone and `nnoremap e x` leaves `ge` alone; `VimCommandParser::MidCommand()` tells the trie so. After a count or an operator a new command starts (`2x`, `dw` -- the `w` is an operator-pending key and is mapped by `omap`). The command line is never mapped; `imap` applies in Insert and Replace.

Keys the trie held or produced, and keys a macro, `:normal` or `.` fed, are not the view's to type. Every one goes through TE5b-4's `FeedOne`, which runs `AfterKey` per key (so the insert capture, `.` and the `.` register see a mapped change, finding 5d.1) and types an unhandled printable Insert key with `TypeText`. A named key or chord HandleInsert leaves to the view would be lost the same way (finding 5d.8), so `FeedOne` gives it to `RunMappedInsertKey`, vim's own meaning: the Insert column of the s6.6 table (`HandleInsertCtrl`: Ctrl-W/U/T/D/H/O/Z/Y, even when `handleCtrlKeys` is off -- the mapping asked for vim's key and the view cannot run it), `<S-Tab>` as the view's outdent (`InsertShiftIndent(false)`), `<PageUp>`/`<PageDown>` as vim's page scroll; anything else has no vim meaning and is dropped (a documented divergence: Neovim would insert an unknown control character literally). A single unmapped key the user typed still falls through to the view as before. Held keys show in the status strip's pending keys.

```cpp
// ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimRemapTest.cpp
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include "Text/Helpers/VimRig.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimKeyTrie.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRegisters.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRemap.hpp"

using namespace Arcane::Text;
using Arcane::Test::VimRig;

namespace
{
    const std::uint8_t kN = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(VimRemapModes::Normal);
    const std::uint8_t kV = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(VimRemapModes::Visual);
    const std::uint8_t kO = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(VimRemapModes::OpPending);
    const std::uint8_t kI = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(VimRemapModes::Insert);

    VimRemap Map(std::uint8_t modes, std::string_view from, std::string_view to, bool recursive)
    {
        VimRemap r;
        r.modes = modes;
        r.from = *ParseKeys(from);
        r.to = *ParseKeys(to);
        r.recursive = recursive;
        r.fromText = std::string(from);
        r.toText = std::string(to);
        return r;
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim key trie: prefix, full, full-and-prefix, none, per mode", "[text-vim-remap]")
{
    VimKeyTrie t;
    CHECK(t.Empty());
    t.Add(kN, *ParseKeys("a"), VimTrieMapping{ *ParseKeys("a"), *ParseKeys("x"), false });
    t.Add(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(kN | kV), *ParseKeys("ab"), VimTrieMapping{ *ParseKeys("ab"), *ParseKeys("dd"), false });
    const VimTrieMapping* m = nullptr;
    CHECK(t.Find(kN, *ParseKeys("a"), &m) == VimTrieMatch::FullAndPrefix);
    CHECK(t.Find(kV, *ParseKeys("a"), &m) == VimTrieMatch::Prefix);
    CHECK(t.Find(kN, *ParseKeys("ab"), &m) == VimTrieMatch::Full);
    REQUIRE(m != nullptr);
    CHECK(FormatKeys(m->to) == "dd");
    CHECK(t.Find(kN, *ParseKeys("ac"), &m) == VimTrieMatch::None);
    CHECK(t.Find(kI, *ParseKeys("a"), &m) == VimTrieMatch::None);
    CHECK(t.LongestFull(kN, *ParseKeys("ac"), &m) == 1u);
    CHECK(FormatKeys(m->to) == "x");
    t.Add(kN, *ParseKeys("a"), VimTrieMapping{ *ParseKeys("a"), *ParseKeys("y"), true });   // a later Add wins
    CHECK(t.LongestFull(kN, *ParseKeys("a"), &m) == 1u);
    CHECK(FormatKeys(m->to) == "y");
    CHECK(m->recursive);
}

TEST_CASE("vim remap: nnoremap, recursive chains, noremap stops the chain, rhs-starts-with-lhs", "[text-vim-remap]")
{
    {
        VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb");
        r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kN, "x", "dd", false));
        r.Keys("x");
        CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "b");

    {
        VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "xy");
        r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kN, "a", "x", true));
        r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kN, "b", "a", false));
        r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kN, "c", "a", true));
        r.Keys("c");                                  // c -> a -> x: deletes
        CHECK(r.Marked() == "\xCB\x87" "y");
        r.Keys("b");                                  // b -> a, not remapped: Append
        CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Insert);
    }
    {
        VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "xy");
        r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kN, "ab", "abcd", true));   // {rhs} starts with {lhs}: its first key is not mapped again
        r.Keys("ab");                                                // a appends, then b c d are typed
        CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Insert);
        CHECK(r.Marked() == "xbcd\xCB\x87" "y");
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim remap: an {rhs} starting with its {lhs} skips mapping only its first key (REMAP_SKIP)", "[text-vim-remap]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "ab\ncd");
    r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kN, "y", "dd", true));
    r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kN, "xy", "xyl", true));
    r.Keys("xy");                                     // x runs unmapped (deletes a); y is mapped again (dd); l moves
    CHECK(r.Marked() == "c\xCB\x87" "d");
}

TEST_CASE("vim remap: only the key that starts a command is mapped", "[text-vim-remap]")
{
    {
        VimRig r("foo \xCB\x87" "bar baz");
        r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kO, "w", "iw", false));
        r.Keys("diw");                                // the w of a text object is read with mapping off
        CHECK(r.Marked() == "foo \xCB\x87" " baz");
    }
    {
        VimRig r("foo \xCB\x87" "bar");
        r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kN, "e", "x", false));
        r.Keys("ge");                                 // the e after g is not mapped: ge goes back to the end of foo
        CHECK(r.Marked() == "fo\xCB\x87" "o bar");
        r.Keys("e");                                  // an e that starts a command is: x
        CHECK(r.Text() == "fo bar");
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim remap: keys a macro queues inside a mapping run before the rest of it; . repeats a mapped change", "[text-vim-remap]")
{
    {
        VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "abc");
        r.Globals().registers.Preload(U'q', VimRegisterValue{ { "l" }, VimRegisterKind::Charwise });
        r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kN, "Z", "@qx", false));
        r.Keys("Z");                                  // @q's "l" goes in front of the mapping's "x" (ins_typebuf)
        CHECK(r.Marked() == "a\xCB\x87" "c");
    }
    {
        VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "a\nb");
        r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kN, "Q", "A!<Esc>", false));
        r.Keys("Qj.");                                // AfterKey ran for every mapped key: the insert reached .
        CHECK(r.Text() == "a!\nb!");
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim remap: a named key or chord an Insert mapping produces runs as vim's key", "[text-vim-remap]")
{
    {
        VimOptions four;
        four.tabSize = 4u;
        four.shiftWidth = 4u;
        four.expandTab = true;
        VimRig r("        \xCB\x87" "ab", {}, four);
        r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kI, ";;", "<S-Tab>", false));
        r.Keys("A;;<Esc>");                           // the view never sees a mapped key: vim outdents by shiftwidth
        CHECK(r.Text() == "    ab");
    }
    {
        VimOptions o;
        o.handleCtrlKeys = false;
        VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "foo", {}, o);
        r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kI, "jj", "<C-w>", false));
        r.Keys("A barjj<Esc>");                       // a mapped <C-w> is vim's delete-word even with handleCtrlKeys off
        CHECK(r.Text() == "foo ");
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim remap: an ambiguous prefix waits timeoutlen, then acts alone", "[text-vim-remap]")
{
    VimRig r("\xCB\x87");
    r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kI, "jk", "<Esc>", false));
    r.Keys("ij");
    CHECK(r.Text().empty());                       // held
    CHECK(r.vim->PendingKeys() == "j");
    r.Wait(0.5);
    CHECK(r.Text().empty());                       // still within timeoutlen (1000 ms)
    r.Wait(0.6);
    CHECK(r.Text() == "j");                        // expired: vim types it itself
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Insert);
    CHECK(r.vim->PendingKeys().empty());
    r.Keys("jk");
    CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Normal);
    CHECK(r.Text() == "j");
}

TEST_CASE("vim remap: full-and-prefix runs the short mapping on timeout; a failed prefix feeds its first key unmapped", "[text-vim-remap]")
{
    {
        VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "ab\ncd");
        r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kN, "a", "x", false));
        r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kN, "ab", "dd", false));

    }

        VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "xy");
        r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kN, "ab", "dd", false));
        r.Keys("ax");                                 // a = Append (unmapped), then x is typed by vim
        CHECK(r.Mode() == VimMode::Insert);
        CHECK(r.Text() == "xxy");
    }
}

TEST_CASE("vim remap: E223 on runaway recursion; arguments are never mapped", "[text-vim-remap]")
{
    {
        VimRig r("\xCB\x87" "ab");
        r.Globals().sessionRemaps.Add(Map(kN, "a", "b", true));
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimKeyTrie.hpp
#pragma once

// The remap key trie (spec s6.4): one trie per remap mode (n, v, o, i).
// VimState holds a typed prefix until it completes, fails, or timeoutlen passes.

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimKey.hpp"

#include <Arcane/Core/Constant.hpp>

#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    ARC_CONSTANT("vim behaviour: 'maxmapdepth' default 1000 -- deeper remap recursion is E223")
    inline constexpr std::uint32_t kVimMaxMapDepth = 1000;

    struct VimTrieMapping
    {
        std::vector<VimKey> from;     // the {lhs} (for the rhs-starts-with-lhs rule)
        std::vector<VimKey> to;       // the {rhs}
        bool recursive = true;        // map vs noremap
    };

    enum class VimTrieMatch : std::uint8_t { None, Prefix, Full, FullAndPrefix };

    class VimKeyTrie
    {
    public:
        void Clear();
        // `modes`: VimRemapModes bits. Adding an existing {lhs} again replaces it (later wins).
        void Add(std::uint8_t modes, const std::vector<VimKey>& from, VimTrieMapping mapping);
        [[nodiscard]] VimTrieMatch Find(std::uint8_t modeBit, std::span<const VimKey> keys, const VimTrieMapping** mapping) const;
        // The longest leading run of `keys` that is a complete mapping (0 = none).
        [[nodiscard]] std::size_t LongestFull(std::uint8_t modeBit, std::span<const VimKey> keys, const VimTrieMapping** mapping) const;
        [[nodiscard]] bool Empty() const { return m_empty; }

    private:
        struct Node
        {
            std::unordered_map<VimKey, std::uint32_t, VimKeyHash> next;
            std::optional<VimTrieMapping> mapping;
        };
        [[nodiscard]] static int Slot(std::uint8_t modeBit);
        std::array<std::vector<Node>, 4> m_slots;   // Normal, Visual, OpPending, Insert
        bool m_empty = true;
    };
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimKeyTrie.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimKeyTrie.hpp"

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRemap.hpp"

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    int VimKeyTrie::Slot(std::uint8_t modeBit)
    {
        if (modeBit == static_cast<std::uint8_t>(VimRemapModes::Normal)) return 0;
        if (modeBit == static_cast<std::uint8_t>(VimRemapModes::Visual)) return 1;
        if (modeBit == static_cast<std::uint8_t>(VimRemapModes::OpPending)) return 2;
        if (modeBit == static_cast<std::uint8_t>(VimRemapModes::Insert)) return 3;
        return -1;
    }

    void VimKeyTrie::Clear()
    {
        for (std::vector<Node>& s : m_slots) s.clear();
        m_empty = true;
    }

    void VimKeyTrie::Add(std::uint8_t modes, const std::vector<VimKey>& from, VimTrieMapping mapping)
    {
        if (from.empty()) return;
        for (const VimRemapModes mode : { VimRemapModes::Normal, VimRemapModes::Visual, VimRemapModes::OpPending, VimRemapModes::Insert })
        {
            const auto bit = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(mode);
            if ((modes & bit) == 0) continue;
            std::vector<Node>& nodes = m_slots[static_cast<std::size_t>(Slot(bit))];
            if (nodes.empty()) nodes.emplace_back();
            std::uint32_t at = 0;
            for (const VimKey& k : from)
            {
                const auto it = nodes[at].next.find(k);
                if (it != nodes[at].next.end()) { at = it->second; continue; }
                const auto child = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(nodes.size());
                nodes[at].next.emplace(k, child);
                nodes.emplace_back();
                at = child;
            }
            nodes[at].mapping = mapping;
            m_empty = false;
        }
    }

    VimTrieMatch VimKeyTrie::Find(std::uint8_t modeBit, std::span<const VimKey> keys, const VimTrieMapping** mapping) const
    {
        *mapping = nullptr;
        const int slot = Slot(modeBit);
        if (slot < 0 || m_slots[static_cast<std::size_t>(slot)].empty()) return VimTrieMatch::None;
        const std::vector<Node>& nodes = m_slots[static_cast<std::size_t>(slot)];
        std::uint32_t at = 0;
        for (const VimKey& k : keys)
        {
            const auto it = nodes[at].next.find(k);
            if (it == nodes[at].next.end()) return VimTrieMatch::None;
            at = it->second;
        }
        const Node& n = nodes[at];
        if (n.mapping) *mapping = &*n.mapping;
        if (n.mapping && !n.next.empty()) return VimTrieMatch::FullAndPrefix;
        if (n.mapping) return VimTrieMatch::Full;
        return n.next.empty() ? VimTrieMatch::None : VimTrieMatch::Prefix;
    }

    std::size_t VimKeyTrie::LongestFull(std::uint8_t modeBit, std::span<const VimKey> keys, const VimTrieMapping** mapping) const
    {
        *mapping = nullptr;
        const int slot = Slot(modeBit);
        if (slot < 0 || m_slots[static_cast<std::size_t>(slot)].empty()) return 0;
        const std::vector<Node>& nodes = m_slots[static_cast<std::size_t>(slot)];
        std::uint32_t at = 0;
        std::size_t best = 0;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < keys.size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto it = nodes[at].next.find(keys[i]);
            if (it == nodes[at].next.end()) break;
            at = it->second;
            if (nodes[at].mapping) { best = i + 1; *mapping = &*nodes[at].mapping; }
        }
        return best;
    }
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRemapFeed.cpp
// VimState's remap layer (spec s6.4): the trie sits between HandleKey and FeedResolved,
// over TE5b-4's one typeahead queue (QueuedKey, m_typeahead).
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimState.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <utility>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    std::uint8_t VimState::RemapModeBit() const
    {
        switch (m_mode)
        {
        case VimMode::Insert:
        case VimMode::Replace:
            return static_cast<std::uint8_t>(VimRemapModes::Insert);
        case VimMode::Visual:
        case VimMode::VisualLine:
        case VimMode::VisualBlock:
            return m_parser.MidCommand() ? std::uint8_t{} : static_cast<std::uint8_t>(VimRemapModes::Visual);
        case VimMode::CommandLine:
            return std::uint8_t{};
        default:
            if (m_parser.MidCommand()) return std::uint8_t{};   // only a command's first key is mapped (5d.2)
            return static_cast<std::uint8_t>(m_parser.OperatorPending() ? VimRemapModes::OpPending : VimRemapModes::Normal);
        }
    }

    void VimState::AddToTrie(const VimRemap& remap)
    {
        // the text forms are re-parsed so <Leader> follows the current leader option
        const std::optional<std::vector<VimKey>> from =
            remap.fromText.empty() ? std::optional<std::vector<VimKey>>(remap.from) : ParseKeys(remap.fromText, m_options.leader);
        const std::optional<std::vector<VimKey>> to =
            remap.toText.empty() ? std::optional<std::vector<VimKey>>(remap.to) : ParseKeys(remap.toText, m_options.leader);
        if (!from || from->empty() || !to) return;
        m_trie.Add(remap.modes, *from, VimTrieMapping{ *from, *to, remap.recursive });
    }

    void VimState::RebuildTrieIfStale()
    {
        const std::span<const VimRemap> session = m_globals.sessionRemaps.All();
        if (m_trieLeader == m_options.leader && m_trieSource.size() == session.size()
            && std::equal(session.begin(), session.end(), m_trieSource.begin()))   // VimRemap::operator== (TE5c-12)
            return;
        m_trie.Clear();
        for (const VimRemap& r : session) AddToTrie(r);
        m_trieSource.assign(session.begin(), session.end());
        m_trieLeader = m_options.leader;
    }

    // A named key or chord that a mapping, a macro, :normal or . produced, or that the trie held, and that
    // HandleInsert left to the view: the view never sees it, so vim runs its own meaning (finding 5d.8).
    bool VimState::RunMappedInsertKey(const VimKey& key)
    {
        if (key.ctrl) return HandleInsertCtrl(key).handled;          // the s6.6 Insert column, even with handleCtrlKeys off
        if (key.named == VimNamedKey::Tab && key.shift)               // the view's Shift+Tab: outdent the line
        {
            InsertShiftIndent(false);
            return true;
        }
        if (key.named == VimNamedKey::PageDown || key.named == VimNamedKey::PageUp)
        {
            VimParsed p;
            p.kind = VimCmdKind::Action;
            p.id = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(key.named == VimNamedKey::PageDown ? VimActionId::ScrollPageDown : VimActionId::ScrollPageUp);
            Scroll(p);
            MarkInsertStart();                                        // the cursor moved: a new insert for . and undo
            return true;
        }
        return false;                                                 // no vim meaning: dropped (documented divergence)
    }

    bool VimState::QueueMapping(const VimTrieMapping& mapping, std::uint32_t depth)
    {
        if (depth + 1 > kVimMaxMapDepth)
        {
            m_typeahead.clear();
            m_pendingMap.clear();
            Beep("E223: recursive mapping");
            return false;
        }
        // :h recursive_mapping -- a {rhs} that starts with its {lhs} is inserted with REMAP_SKIP:
        // only its FIRST key is not mapped again (finding 5d.8), the rest is
        const bool startsWithLhs = mapping.to.size() >= mapping.from.size()
            && std::equal(mapping.from.begin(), mapping.from.end(), mapping.to.begin());
        for (std::size_t i = mapping.to.size(); i-- > 0;)
        {
            const bool remap = mapping.recursive && !(startsWithLhs && i == 0);
            m_typeahead.push_front(QueuedKey{ mapping.to[i], remap, depth + 1 });
        }
        return true;
    }

    void VimState::RequeuePending()
    {
        const std::vector<VimKey> keys = std::exchange(m_pendingMap, std::vector<VimKey>{});
        if (keys.empty()) return;
        const VimTrieMapping* mapping = nullptr;
        const std::size_t full = m_trie.LongestFull(RemapModeBit(), keys, &mapping);
        const std::size_t used = full > 0 ? full : 1;
        for (std::size_t i = keys.size(); i-- > used;)    // the rest is examined again
            m_typeahead.push_front(QueuedKey{ keys[i], true, m_pendingDepth });
        if (full > 0)
        {
            const VimTrieMapping m = *mapping;
            (void)QueueMapping(m, m_pendingDepth);
        }
        else
            m_typeahead.push_front(QueuedKey{ keys[0], false, m_pendingDepth });   // the first key acts unmapped
        m_pendingDepth = 0;
    }

    VimKeyResult VimState::FeedMapped(const VimKey& key)
    {
        m_typeahead.push_back(QueuedKey{ key, true, 0 });  // the user's key: nothing else is queued between keys
        return DrainTypeahead(true);
    }

    // Replaces TE5b-4's DrainTypeahead(). `userKey`: the queue holds just the key the view delivered;
    // when that key resolves unmapped and unheld, the view may still type it (IME, its own path).
    VimKeyResult VimState::DrainTypeahead(bool userKey)
    {
        m_draining = true;
        bool viewMayType = userKey && m_typeahead.size() == 1 && m_pendingMap.empty();
        VimKeyResult last;
        while (!m_typeahead.empty() && !m_beeped)
        {
            const QueuedKey q = m_typeahead.front();
            m_typeahead.pop_front();
            RebuildTrieIfStale();
            const std::uint8_t bit = RemapModeBit();
            if (!q.remap || (m_pendingMap.empty() && (bit == 0 || m_trie.Empty())))
            {
                last = FeedOne(q.key, viewMayType);           // TE5b-4: FeedResolved + vim's own typing + AfterKey
                continue;
            }
            m_pendingMap.push_back(q.key);
            m_pendingDepth = std::max(m_pendingDepth, q.depth);
            const VimTrieMapping* mapping = nullptr;
            switch (bit == 0 ? VimTrieMatch::None : m_trie.Find(bit, m_pendingMap, &mapping))
            {
            case VimTrieMatch::Prefix:
            case VimTrieMatch::FullAndPrefix:
                m_pendingSince = m_now;                    // held until it completes, fails, or timeoutlen passes
                viewMayType = false;
                last = VimKeyResult{};
                break;
            case VimTrieMatch::Full:
            {
                const VimTrieMapping m = *mapping;        // a copy: the expansion may rebuild the trie (:map inside)
                m_pendingMap.clear();
                const std::uint32_t depth = std::exchange(m_pendingDepth, 0u);
                viewMayType = false;
                (void)QueueMapping(m, depth);
                break;
            }
            case VimTrieMatch::None:
                if (m_pendingMap.size() == 1)
                {
                    m_pendingMap.clear();
                    m_pendingDepth = 0;
                    last = FeedOne(q.key, viewMayType);
                    break;
                }
                viewMayType = false;
                RequeuePending();
                break;
            }
        }
        if (m_beeped)
        {
            m_typeahead.clear();                          // beep_flush: the non-typed queue goes (D-R12)
            last.beeped = true;
        }
        m_draining = false;
        if (!viewMayType) last.handled = true;            // vim typed whatever it held or produced
        return last;
    }
}
```

In `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRepeat.cpp` (TE5b-4): delete TE5b-4's `VimState::DrainTypeahead()` (its loop is the one above); in `FeedKeys` the call `DrainTypeahead()` becomes `DrainTypeahead(false)`, so the keys of `@q`, `:normal` (without `!`) and replays resolve mappings by their own `remap` flag, in front of whatever is still queued. In `FeedOne`, the branch that types an unhandled key gains the named-key case:

```cpp

        {

            {

        }
```

- Modify: `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimOptions.hpp` (TE5a-3: `configuredRemaps`)

- Modify: `premake5.lua` -- the `ArcaneText` project's `includedirs` (TE1's project block) gains `"%{IncludeDir.nlohmann}"` (`IncludeDir["nlohmann"]` is declared at `premake5.lua:73`) unless an earlier chunk already added it
- Test: `ArcaneTests/src/Text/VimRemapJsonTest.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `VimRemap`, `VimRemapModes` (TE5c-12), `ParseKeys`/`FormatKeys` (TE5a-1), nlohmann/json (`ThirdParty/nlohmann`), `Test::ScopedCodeRung` (`SettingsSweep.hpp:39-59`).
- Produces: `struct VimRemapsParse { std::vector<VimRemap> remaps; std::string error; }`, `std::uint8_t ParseRemapModes(std::string_view)`, `std::string FormatRemapModes(std::uint8_t)`, `VimRemapsParse ParseVimRemapsJson(std::string_view)`, `std::string FormatVimRemapsJson(std::span<const VimRemap>)`; `VimOptions::configuredRemaps`; `ReadVimOptions` fills it.

The table is the spec's `{mode, from, to, recursive}` record list stored as JSON in the string setting: `[{"mode":"i","from":"jk","to":"<Esc>","recursive":false}]`. `mode` is any combination of the letters `n v o i` (`""` = `nvo`, like `:map`); `from`/`to` are key notation (`<Leader>` expands with the leader option when the trie is built, so changing the leader re-targets every remap); `to` may be empty (vim's `<Nop>`: the key does nothing); `recursive` defaults to `false` (noremap, the safe choice). A bad entry is skipped and reported (the Vim page shows the first problem, TE5d-5); good entries still apply. The configured table enters the trie first and the session `:map` table second, so a `:map` typed this session wins over the Preferences one for the same keys.

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRemapJson.hpp
#pragma once

// editor.text.vim.remaps (spec s6.4): the {mode, from, to, recursive} table as JSON.

#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRemap.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    struct VimRemapsParse
    {
        std::vector<VimRemap> remaps;   // the good entries, in order
        std::string error;              // the first problem ("" = none)
    };

    // Letters n v o i in any order; "" = n|v|o (:map). 0 = an unknown letter.
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint8_t ParseRemapModes(std::string_view modes);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatRemapModes(std::uint8_t modes);   // canonical "nvoi" order
    [[nodiscard]] VimRemapsParse ParseVimRemapsJson(std::string_view json);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string FormatVimRemapsJson(std::span<const VimRemap> remaps);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRemapJson.cpp
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRemapJson.hpp"

#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>

namespace Arcane::Text
{
    namespace
    {
        struct ModeLetter { char letter; VimRemapModes mode; };
        constexpr ModeLetter kLetters[] = {
            { 'n', VimRemapModes::Normal }, { 'v', VimRemapModes::Visual },
            { 'o', VimRemapModes::OpPending }, { 'i', VimRemapModes::Insert },
        };
    }

    std::uint8_t ParseRemapModes(std::string_view modes)
    {
        if (modes.empty())
            return static_cast<std::uint8_t>(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(VimRemapModes::Normal) | static_cast<std::uint8_t>(VimRemapModes::Visual)
                                             | static_cast<std::uint8_t>(VimRemapModes::OpPending));
        std::uint8_t out = 0;
        for (const char c : modes)
        {
            bool known = false;
            for (const ModeLetter& m : kLetters)
                if (m.letter == c) { out = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(out | static_cast<std::uint8_t>(m.mode)); known = true; }
            if (!known) return 0;
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::string FormatRemapModes(std::uint8_t modes)
    {
        std::string out;
        for (const ModeLetter& m : kLetters)
            if ((modes & static_cast<std::uint8_t>(m.mode)) != 0) out.push_back(m.letter);
        return out;
    }

    VimRemapsParse ParseVimRemapsJson(std::string_view json)
    {
        VimRemapsParse out;
        const nlohmann::json j = nlohmann::json::parse(json, nullptr, false);
        if (j.is_discarded() || !j.is_array())
        {
            if (!(j.is_object() && j.empty())) out.error = "remaps: not a JSON array";   // {} reads as "none"
            return out;
        }
        std::size_t index = 0;
        for (const nlohmann::json& e : j)
        {
            ++index;
            const auto problem = [&out, index](const std::string& what) {
                if (out.error.empty()) out.error = "remap " + std::to_string(index) + ": " + what;
            };
            if (!e.is_object()) { problem("not an object"); continue; }
            const auto text = [&e](const char* key, std::string& value) {
                const auto it = e.find(key);
                if (it == e.end()) return true;              // absent: the caller's default
                if (!it->is_string()) return false;
                value = it->get<std::string>();
                return true;
            };
            std::string mode, from, to;
            if (!text("mode", mode)) { problem("'mode' is not text"); continue; }
            if (!text("from", from)) { problem("'from' is not text"); continue; }
            if (!text("to", to)) { problem("'to' is not text"); continue; }
            VimRemap r;
            r.modes = ParseRemapModes(mode);
            if (r.modes == 0) { problem("unknown mode '" + mode + "' (use n v o i)"); continue; }
            if (from.empty()) { problem("'from' is empty"); continue; }
            const auto fromKeys = ParseKeys(from);
            const auto toKeys = ParseKeys(to);
            if (!fromKeys || fromKeys->empty()) { problem("'from' is not key notation"); continue; }
            if (!toKeys) { problem("'to' is not key notation"); continue; }
            if (const auto rec = e.find("recursive"); rec != e.end())
            {
                if (!rec->is_boolean()) { problem("'recursive' is not true/false"); continue; }
                r.recursive = rec->get<bool>();
            }
            else
                r.recursive = false;                         // noremap unless asked
            r.from = *fromKeys;
            r.to = *toKeys;
            r.fromText = std::move(from);
            r.toText = std::move(to);
            out.remaps.push_back(std::move(r));
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::string FormatVimRemapsJson(std::span<const VimRemap> remaps)
    {
        nlohmann::json j = nlohmann::json::array();
        for (const VimRemap& r : remaps)
            j.push_back({ { "mode", FormatRemapModes(r.modes) },
                          { "from", r.fromText.empty() ? FormatKeys(r.from) : r.fromText },
                          { "to", r.toText.empty() ? FormatKeys(r.to) : r.toText },
                          { "recursive", r.recursive } });
        return j.dump(-1, ' ', false, nlohmann::json::error_handler_t::replace);
    }
}
```

The `kLetters` array holds characters and enumerators only (no numeric literal), so ConstantGuardTest has nothing to mark.

In `ArcaneEditor/src/TextEditor/Vim/VimRemapFeed.cpp` (TE5d-3), replace `RebuildTrieIfStale` with:

```cpp
    void VimState::RebuildTrieIfStale()
    {
        const std::vector<VimRemap>& configured = m_options.configuredRemaps;
        const std::span<const VimRemap> session = m_globals.sessionRemaps.All();
        const std::size_t total = configured.size() + session.size();
        bool same = m_trieLeader == m_options.leader && m_trieSource.size() == total;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; same && i < total; ++i)
            same = m_trieSource[i] == (i < configured.size() ? configured[i] : session[i - configured.size()]);   // VimRemap::operator== (TE5c-12)
        if (same) return;
        m_trie.Clear();
        m_trieSource.clear();
        for (const VimRemap& r : configured) { AddToTrie(r); m_trieSource.push_back(r); }
        for (const VimRemap& r : session) { AddToTrie(r); m_trieSource.push_back(r); }   // later wins: :map beats Preferences
        m_trieLeader = m_options.leader;
    }
```

```cpp
    CVarRegistry& reg = CVarRegistry::Get();
    const std::string json = RemapRowsToJson(std::vector<VimRemapRow>{ { "i", "jk", "<Esc>", false } });
    std::string refusal;
    REQUIRE(WriteVimRemaps(json, &refusal));
    CHECK(refusal.empty());
    reg.PublishImmediate();
    CHECK(Settings<TextVimSettings>().remaps == json);
    const std::optional<CVarValue> rung = reg.RungValue(std::string(kVimRemapsCVar), SetBy::EditorUser);
    REQUIRE(rung.has_value());
    CHECK(rung->AsString() == json);
    CHECK(SettingsHostArchivePending());

    CHECK_FALSE(WriteVimRemaps(R"([{"mode":"z","from":"a","to":"b"}])", &refusal));   // invalid: nothing written
    CHECK(refusal == "remap 1: unknown mode 'z' (use n v o i)");

    CHECK(reg.RevertRung(std::string(kVimRemapsCVar), SetBy::EditorUser));
    reg.PublishImmediate();
    CHECK(Settings<TextVimSettings>().remaps == "[]");
    FlushSettingsArchives();
    _wputenv_s(L"LOCALAPPDATA", had ? saved.c_str() : L"");
    std::filesystem::remove_all(local);
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/Settings/VimPreferencesPage.hpp
#pragma once

// Preferences > Text Editor > Vim (text editor spec s6.4, s12.2): the
// Experimental badge, the remap table (editor.text.vim.remaps, a Hidden field
// only this table edits), then the window's standard rows for the other
// editor.text.vim.* settings on the same node (the Fonts page pattern).
// kVimExperimental is TE5a-22's (View/VimKeyTranslate.hpp, CANON B15): the
// page reads that one switch, it never defines its own.

#include "TextEditor/View/VimKeyTranslate.hpp"   // kVimExperimental (TE5a-22)

#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    inline constexpr std::string_view kVimPageCategory = "Text Editor/Vim";
    inline constexpr std::string_view kVimRemapsCVar = "editor.text.vim.remaps";
    // Vim ships behind "Experimental" (spec D12, s12.2): the badge below reads
    // Editor::kVimExperimental from VimKeyTranslate.hpp (TE5a-22), the same
    // constant the status strip reads; VIM-GATE flips that one constant.

    struct VimRemapRow
    {
        std::string modes = "n";      // letters n v o i
        std::string from, to;         // key notation
        bool recursive = false;
    };

    struct VimPrefsPageState
    {
        std::vector<VimRemapRow> rows;
        std::string loadedFrom;       // the published JSON the rows were read from
        bool loaded = false;
        bool edited = false;          // unapplied edits: SyncRemapRows leaves the rows alone
        std::string status;           // the last Apply's refusal, or the published value's problem
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<VimRemapRow> RemapRowsFromJson(std::string_view json, std::string* error);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string RemapRowsToJson(std::span<const VimRemapRow> rows);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string ValidateRemapRows(std::span<const VimRemapRow> rows);   // "" = valid
    // Validated write of editor.text.vim.remaps at the EditorUser rung + Publish + archive queue.
    bool WriteVimRemaps(std::string_view json, std::string* refusal);
    void SyncRemapRows(VimPrefsPageState& state);
    void DrawVimPreferencesPage(void* user);   // RegisterSettingsPage callback; user = VimPrefsPageState*
}
```

```cpp
// ArcaneEditor/src/Settings/VimPreferencesPage.cpp
#include "Settings/VimPreferencesPage.hpp"

#include "Settings/SettingsEdit.hpp"   // RungSource
#include "Settings/SettingsHost.hpp"   // NoteSettingEdited
#include "TextEditor/TextSettings.hpp"
#include "TextEditor/Vim/VimRemapJson.hpp"
#include "Widgets/EditorTheme.hpp"
#include "Widgets/EditorWidgets.hpp"
#include "Widgets/IconsLucide.h"

#include <Arcane/Config/CVarRegistry.hpp>
#include <Arcane/Config/Settings.hpp>

#include <imgui.h>

namespace Arcane::Editor
{
    namespace
    {
        Text::VimRemap ToRemap(const VimRemapRow& row)
        {
            Text::VimRemap r;
            r.modes = Text::ParseRemapModes(row.modes);
            r.fromText = row.from;
            r.toText = row.to;
            r.from = Text::ParseKeys(row.from).value_or(std::vector<Text::VimKey>{});
            r.to = Text::ParseKeys(row.to).value_or(std::vector<Text::VimKey>{});
            r.recursive = row.recursive;
            return r;
        }
    }

    std::vector<VimRemapRow> RemapRowsFromJson(std::string_view json, std::string* error)
    {
        const Text::VimRemapsParse p = Text::ParseVimRemapsJson(json);
        if (error) *error = p.error;
        std::vector<VimRemapRow> rows;
        for (const Text::VimRemap& r : p.remaps)
            rows.push_back(VimRemapRow{ Text::FormatRemapModes(r.modes), r.fromText, r.toText, r.recursive });
        return rows;
    }

    std::string RemapRowsToJson(std::span<const VimRemapRow> rows)
    {
        // written field by field so a row the parser would refuse still round-trips for validation
        std::string out = "[";
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < rows.size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto quote = [](const std::string& s) {
                std::string q = "\"";
                for (const char c : s)
                {
                    if (c == '"' || c == '\\') { q.push_back('\\'); q.push_back(c); }
                    else if (static_cast<unsigned char>(c) < 0x20) { char buf[8]; std::snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "\\u%04x", c); q += buf; }
                    else q.push_back(c);
                }
                return q + "\"";
            };
            if (i) out.push_back(',');
            out += "{\"mode\":" + quote(rows[i].modes) + ",\"from\":" + quote(rows[i].from) + ",\"to\":" + quote(rows[i].to)
                 + ",\"recursive\":" + (rows[i].recursive ? "true" : "false") + "}";
        }
        return out + "]";
    }

    std::string ValidateRemapRows(std::span<const VimRemapRow> rows)
    {
        return Text::ParseVimRemapsJson(RemapRowsToJson(rows)).error;
    }

    bool WriteVimRemaps(std::string_view json, std::string* refusal)
    {
        const Text::VimRemapsParse p = Text::ParseVimRemapsJson(json);
        if (!p.error.empty()) { if (refusal) *refusal = p.error; return false; }
        CVarRegistry& reg = CVarRegistry::Get();
        const std::string name(kVimRemapsCVar);
        const SetResult r = reg.Set(reg.Find(name), CVarValue::String(std::string(json)), SetBy::EditorUser,
                                    RungSource(SetBy::EditorUser));
        if (r != SetResult::Applied && r != SetResult::RefusedWeaker)
        {
            if (refusal) *refusal = "The remaps were not saved: the settings registry refused them.";
            return false;
        }
        reg.Publish();
        NoteSettingEdited(SetBy::EditorUser, name);
        if (refusal)
            *refusal = r == SetResult::RefusedWeaker ? std::string("Saved for all projects, but a stronger rung still wins: "
                                                                   "use Clear override on the remaps row.")
                                                     : std::string();
        return true;
    }

    void SyncRemapRows(VimPrefsPageState& st)
    {
        const std::string& published = Settings<TextVimSettings>().remaps;
        if (st.edited || (st.loaded && st.loadedFrom == published)) return;
        std::string error;
        st.rows = RemapRowsFromJson(published, &error);
        st.loadedFrom = published;
        st.loaded = true;
        st.status = error;
    }

    void DrawVimPreferencesPage(void* user)
    {
        VimPrefsPageState& st = *static_cast<VimPrefsPageState*>(user);
        SyncRemapRows(st);
        if (kVimExperimental)
        {
            ImGui::TextColored(Theme::kAmber, ICON_LC_FLASK_CONICAL " Experimental");
            ImGui::SetItemTooltip("Vim mode is Experimental: each vim pass widens it, and the label drops when the full "
                                  "Neovim-checked behaviour suite is green.");
            ImGui::SameLine();
        }
        ImGui::TextWrapped("Vim keys for text documents. The options below follow Neovim's defaults; :set changes one "
                           "for this session only, these rows change it for good.");

        ImGui::SeparatorText("Remaps");
        const ImGuiTableFlags flags = ImGuiTableFlags_RowBg | ImGuiTableFlags_BordersInnerV | ImGuiTableFlags_Resizable;
        int removeAt = -1;
        if (ImGui::BeginTable("##vimremaps", 5, flags))
        {
            ImGui::TableSetupColumn("Mode", ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthFixed, ImGui::GetFontSize() * 4.0f);
            ImGui::TableSetupColumn("From");
            ImGui::TableSetupColumn("To");
            ImGui::TableSetupColumn("Recursive", ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthFixed);
            ImGui::TableSetupColumn("##remove", ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthFixed);
            ImGui::TableHeadersRow();
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < st.rows.size(); ++i)
            {
                VimRemapRow& row = st.rows[i];
                ImGui::PushID(static_cast<int>(i));
                ImGui::TableNextRow();
                ImGui::TableNextColumn(); ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-FLT_MIN);
                st.edited |= InputTextString("##modes", &row.modes);
                ImGui::SetItemTooltip("n Normal, v Visual, o operator-pending, i Insert; empty = n v o (like :map)");
                ImGui::TableNextColumn(); ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-FLT_MIN);
                st.edited |= InputTextString("##from", &row.from);
                ImGui::TableNextColumn(); ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-FLT_MIN);
                st.edited |= InputTextString("##to", &row.to);
                ImGui::TableNextColumn();
                st.edited |= ImGui::Checkbox("##recursive", &row.recursive);
                ImGui::SetItemTooltip("On: the result is remapped again (:map). Off: it is not (:noremap).");
                ImGui::TableNextColumn();
                if (ImGui::SmallButton(ICON_LC_TRASH_2)) removeAt = static_cast<int>(i);
                ImGui::PopID();
            }
            ImGui::EndTable();
        }
        if (removeAt >= 0) { st.rows.erase(st.rows.begin() + removeAt); st.edited = true; }
        if (ImGui::Button(ICON_LC_PLUS " Add remap")) { st.rows.push_back(VimRemapRow{}); st.edited = true; }
        ImGui::SameLine();
        ImGui::BeginDisabled(!st.edited);
        if (ImGui::Button("Apply"))
        {
            std::string refusal;
            if (WriteVimRemaps(RemapRowsToJson(st.rows), &refusal))
            {
                st.edited = false;
                st.loaded = false;           // re-read the published value next frame
            }
            st.status = refusal;
        }
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (ImGui::Button("Revert")) { st.edited = false; st.loaded = false; st.status.clear(); }
        ImGui::EndDisabled();
        if (!st.status.empty()) ImGui::TextColored(Theme::kWarning, ICON_LC_TRIANGLE_ALERT " %s", st.status.c_str());
        else if (st.edited)
            if (const std::string why = ValidateRemapRows(st.rows); !why.empty())
                ImGui::TextColored(Theme::kWarning, ICON_LC_TRIANGLE_ALERT " %s", why.c_str());
        ImGui::Spacing();
    }
}
```
